We are seeking a Firmware Engineer specializing in FPGA development and embedded real time control, with strong skills in digital design and low level embedded software. In this role, you will design the firmware and control systems that interface tightly with power electronics, mixed signal ASICs and advanced imaging hardware used across CT, MR, and Ultrasound platforms. Familiarity with power electronics and/or ASIC RTL design is a strong plus. 
 Job Description 
 As a leading global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator, GE HealthCare enables clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications, and services, supported by the Edison intelligence platform. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect, transparency, and unyielding integrity.
 We are seeking a Firmware Engineer specializing in FPGA development and embedded real‑time control , with strong skills in digital design and low‑level embedded software. In this role, you will design the firmware and control systems that interface tightly with power electronics, mixed‑signal ASICs and advanced imaging hardware used across CT, MR, and Ultrasound platforms. Familiarity with power electronics and/or ASIC RTL design is a strong plus.
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the planning, development, and transition of embedded control technologies from concept to product. You will:
 Embedded Firmware & Real‑Time Control (Primary Focus) 
 Implement and test signal processing, control and data interfaces between FPGAs, processors, custom ASICs and imaging subsystems.
 Design FPGAs and custom ASICs using VHDL/Verilog, perform timing analysis and timing closure using tools such as QuestaSim, Quartus, Xcelium.
 Design and implement real-time embedded firmware in C/C++ for control, configuration, calibration, and diagnostics of mixed‑signal ASICs and custom hardware modules.
 Develop deterministic, low‑latency control loops and high‑speed data acquisition routines for advanced imaging applications.
 Integrate embedded firmware with FPGA or SoC platforms, supporting tight hardware/software co‑design.
 Interface with sensors, analog front ends, actuators, RF subsystems, and other hardware components.
 Implement and optimize real‑time communication protocols (SPI, I²C, UART, Ethernet, etc.).
 Software Integration & System Control 
 Partner with embedded software teams to define register maps, communication layers, drivers, and system-level behavior.
 Develop driver‑level software, scripts, and automation tools to enable hardware bring‑up, system validation, and production test.
 Create simulation and modeling frameworks to verify real‑time control algorithms.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation 
 Work closely with electrical engineers, ASIC designers, systems engineers, and software teams.
 Communicate technical results through documentation, reports, and presentations.
 Track industry trends in embedded systems, real‑time control, FPGAs, and ASIC technologies.
 Contribute to internal R&D proposals and collaborative programs with government agencies.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
 Strong fundamentals in synchronous digital design, floor-planning, synthesizable RTL code, timing analysis and closure, developing embedded firmware in C/C++, including register-level programming and hardware abstraction layers.
 Experience with FPGA development, or SoC platforms (e.g., Altera, Xilinx, Zynq)
 Experience with verification tools (Quartus, QuestaSim) and STA workflows.
 Experience with Verilog, VHDL for understanding hardware–firmware interaction.
 Must work onsite in Niskayuna, NY Tuesday–Thursday (hybrid schedule).
 Desired Characteristics 
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
 4+ years of full-time professional engineering experience
 Familiarity with ASIC digital design flows
 Familiarity with power electronics control
 Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink for modeling or algorithm development.
 Background in high‑reliability industries (medical, aerospace, defense).
 Strong problem-solving ability, communication skills, and ability to work in cross-functional teams

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You will support the smooth, high-quality delivery of Learning & Development (L&D) operations, including onboarding, learning logistics, platform administration, and content coordination, so that every Faculty employee has a seamless, engaging, and data-enabled learning experience from day one. This will be a highly collaborative role, working in a high-agency learning and development function, partnering with  an array of stakeholders and course facilitators.

This role suits somebody highly organised, who enjoys ticking off to-do lists, thrives in context switching and enjoys the opportunity to identify where processes can be improved with the autonomy to build a solution that suits.

This role requires a regular presence in the London office (minimum 3 days per week) to ensure smooth delivery, strong collaboration, and a consistently high-quality learner experience.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Coordinating Faculty's end-to-end onboarding programme for all new joiners, managing schedules, logistics, facilitators, and communications while co-hosting cohort sessions in person.

 - Managing day-to-day administration of our Learning Experience Platform (Sana), including content uploads, tagging standards, user enrollments, and basic technical troubleshooting.

 - Supporting the Faculty-wide learning calendar and workshop logistics, handling invitations, materials, attendee tracking, and continuous improvement evaluation surveys.

 - Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to update learning content, maintain brand standards, and manage document version control.

 - Utilising cutting-edge AI tools to increase efficiency across content creation, communication drafting, and learning administration processes.

 - Generating regular LXP analytical dashboards and insight summaries to track engagement, compliance, and overall operational performance.

 - Liaising across cross-functional teams, external partners, and facilitators to deliver seamless, clear, and timely communication for all learning initiatives.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - You bring experience in L&D, HR operations, events, or programme coordination, with a strong foundation in managing multi-stakeholder workflows.

 - You are highly organised with exceptional attention to detail, easily balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - You possess digital confidence and a strong tech aptitude, ideally with exposure to LXPs/LMSs (such as Sana) or adjacent HR tools.

 - You are an articulate communicator who builds clear, effective relationships with learners, internal experts, and external contributors alike.

 - You embrace an innovative mindset, proactively exploring AI and digital tools to streamline manual processes and raise delivery standards.

 - You thrive on taking ownership and bringing an adaptable, solutions-focused approach to high-touch learner support.
   
   

Our Interview Process

1) Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

2) Panel interview with L&D Associate and People Team (60 mins)

3) Interview with Head of Talent Development (60 mins)




OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

 Our Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside industry leaders.

 We’re on a mission to make excellence our everyday standard.  As a Graduate Continuous Improvement Engineer, you will 
 Design electronic production layouts using Lean tools to improve productivity. 
 Facilitate cross-functional improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies. 
 Analyse workflows and data to identify bottlenecks, waste, and opportunities for optimisation. 
 Assist with/facilitate workshops and training sessions to upskill teams in continuous improvement tools and techniques. Developing an imbedded excitement and culture of CI in manufacturing. 
 Develop and track KPIs to measure the success of improvement initiatives. 
 Ensure the sustainability of our changes. 
 What You'll Bring 
 Knowledge or strong interest of Lean, Six Sigma or similar methodologies. 
 Excellent facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills—you can bring people with you on the journey. 
 Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, ideally qualified to engineering degree level or equivalent work experience. 
 Resilience, adaptability, and a passion for making things better every day 
 Entry Requirements 
 A minimum of a 2:2 Bachelor’s/Integrated Master’s degree, or higher degree, such as MSc or PhD. 
 For this role, acceptable degree disciplines include: Engineering degrees 
 Maths and Science degrees 
 Computing & Digital degrees 
 Business & Professional Degrees 
 A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV. 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

items.desc: TechWolf is at the forefront of transforming the HR tech industry through the power of Artificial Intelligence. Our AI team owns everything from cutting-edge research through end-to-end production deployment, empowering companies to thrive in the age of AI through skills-based decision making. We prioritize fair, transparent, and impactful AI. As a Junior AI Engineer, you'll learn how to turn an idea into an AI feature that customers use every day. Our AI team works close to the product and close to our customers: we experiment quickly, measure carefully and ship what works. Here's what you can expect: Hands-On Learning: You'll learn from experienced AI engineers through mentorship, pairing sessions and code reviews, and build a real understanding of how AI systems work in production. Real Product Impact: Your work reaches customers. Within your first months you'll ship features that enterprises rely on. Room to Experiment: New models and techniques appear every week. We give you the space to try them, measure them and share what you find. Career Growth: We're invested in your success. As your strengths and interests become clear, we'll tailor a development plan to help you grow into a well-rounded AI engineer. What you'll do Model Development: Help improve the models and pipelines that infer skills from the work people actually do, using Transformers, PyTorch and LLMs, and measure whether each change makes our inference more accurate. Agent Engineering: Help build agentic features with LLMs (AWS Bedrock) and modern agent SDKs, from first prototype to production. Evaluation: Build eval sets and offline evaluations that show whether a change actually makes a feature better, and learn to read the signals from production. Experimentation: Try new models, prompts and approaches, and share what you learn, including what didn't work. Productization: Ship your work as tested, observable Python services (FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes) in AWS. Product & Customer Focus: Work with Product and customer-facing colleagues to understand the problem before building the solution. Who you are You're a (soon-to-be) graduate, preferably in Computer Science or Engineering, or you have up to 2 years of experience. You've built something with LLMs or ML, such as a thesis, internship, side project or hackathon, and you can tell us what worked and what didn't. You write solid Python and are comfortable with git and writing tests. You care about the people who use what you build, and you ask "why" before "how". You're curious, you enjoy experimenting, and you learn fast. You exhibit excellent communication and teamwork. You're passionate about impactful AI, fairness and transparency. You already work AI-first: coding agents and AI assistants are a natural part of how you build, learn and solve problems. You're based in Belgium and excited to work together with the TechWolf team in our Ghent office at least three days per week. What's in it for you? Fair & competitive salaries – we benchmark our salaries yearly and pay above the market median in every role and location. ‍‍‍ Hybrid working and flexible hours - make your work schedule work for you Mobility your way - choose between a company car or a mobility budget Health insurance & retirement savings ️ Work from abroad 3 weeks each year Learning and development opportunities ‍ ️ Walking culture - who doesn’t love brainstorming or connecting with colleagues while taking a walk around the office? Fun teambuildings, social & sports activities Sounds like your cup of tea? There’s more! TechWolf is on a mission to make work better and fairer for millions of people by powering the shift from jobs to skills as a framework to model talent. Our enterprise software uses AI to provide the skill data needed to power that transformation. We provide a unique opportunity to work with an all-star team and cutting-edge product, in a purpose-driven company that aims to empower people to flourish at work. TechWolf is growing fast and you’ll join a high-performing international team with a unicorn dream. Are you ready to build a rocket ship with us?

items.desc: Jobomschrijving: Je komt terecht in een team dat volop in transformatie is, waar kwaliteit, risicobeheersing, automatisering en artificiële intelligentie een sleutelrol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van de activiteiten binnen de rechtsbijstandsverzekering. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan betrouwbare, conforme en efficiënte processen, met een sterke focus op een kwalitatieve dienstverlening aan onze klanten. Je werkt op het kruispunt van operations, governance, data en continue verbetering om het interne controlesysteem te versterken en de kwaliteitsstandaarden van de organisatie verder uit te bouwen. Jouw dagelijkse verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert het interne controlekader voor operationele activiteiten, schadedossiers en betalingen. Je voert risicoanalyses uit en coördineert eerstelijnscontroles. Je ontwikkelt steekproefmethodologieën waarmee de kwaliteit van dossiers en processen objectief kan worden gemeten. Je analyseert kwaliteitsresultaten en identificeert de grondoorzaken van vastgestelde afwijkingen. Je benut data en AI-oplossingen om risico's sneller te detecteren en de kwaliteitsopvolging te versterken. Je coördineert interne audits, regelgevende controles en de opvolging van actieplannen. Je werkt mee aan de uitwerking van controles voor nieuwe processen, digitale projecten en geautomatiseerde oplossingen. Je waakt over datakwaliteit, toegangsbeheer en de naleving van wettelijke en regelgevende vereisten. Je ontwikkelt dashboards en KPI's die een efficiënte sturing van de activiteiten mogelijk maken. Je ondersteunt teams bij het uitbouwen van een cultuur van kwaliteit, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering. Onmisbare competenties Je beschikt over ruime ervaring in interne controle, audit, risicobeheer of kwaliteitsmanagement. Je hebt een grondige kennis van governance, interne controlemechanismen en risico-evaluatie. Je bent vertrouwd met data-analyse, performantiemeting en rapporteringstools. Je vertaalt regelgeving en controlevereisten naar pragmatische en werkbare oplossingen. Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Frans. Troeven Ervaring binnen de verzekeringssector of de financiële dienstverlening. Kennis van artificiële intelligentie, data-analyse en geavanceerde rapportering. Vertrouwdheid met frameworks zoals COSO, het Three Lines Model of Lean Six Sigma. Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare business intelligence-oplossingen. Je voelt je comfortabel in een Engelstalige werkomgeving. AXA wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de diverse samenleving waarin wij leven en voert daarom al jaren een beleid van actieve diversiteit, non-discriminatie en gelijke kansen. In dit kader garanderen wij een gelijke behandeling en toegang tot selecties, ongeacht leeftijd, afkomst, culturele achtergrond, handicap, geslacht of seksuele geaardheid of andere kenmerken . Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. AXA Belgium Meer dan 3000 mensen werken bij ons, vanuit onze vooruitstrevende kantoren in Brussel, Antwerpen, Eupen en Luik. We werken samen met 3200 makelaars. We hebben 3 miljoen klanten en zijn nummer 1 in autoverzekeringen. Het is onze ambitie om onze relatie met al onze klanten te transformeren van betaler naar partner om ons echt te onderscheiden. Onze fundamenten Onze belangrijkste leidraad zijn onze waarden: Customer first, Integrity, Courage en One AXA . Alles wat we doen, daar staan we als één team achter. Bij AXA wijzen wij alle vormen van oneerlijke of onwettige discriminatie af. Meer info in ons Diversiteits- en Inclusiebeleid. Wat we aanbieden Een mooie beloning voor je werk Een competitief loon, eventueel aangevuld met discretionaire persoonlijke en collectieve premies en natuurlijk ook maaltijd- en ecocheques, een volledige terugbetaling van het openbaar vervoer en een cafetariaplan. Alle voordelen van werken bij een verzekeraar Van groepsverzekering tot ambulante en hospitalisatieverzekering (ook gezinsleden kunnen daarbij aansluiten aan een voordelig tarief) en met tot 30% korting op onze andere verzekeringsproducten. Een job die zich aanpast aan je leven en dromen Een flexibel rooster van 35 uur per week, 36 dagen verlof per jaar om op te laden, evenals de mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk van thuis uit te werken. Wij bieden sportlessen op het werk, welzijnsprogramma's voor werknemers en trainingen, om u in topvorm te houden, zowel fysiek als mentaal.

Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, Wavestone s’est donné pour mission d’éclairer et guider les grandes organisations dans leurs transformations les plus critiques. Des transformations qui visent à répondre aux grands enjeux stratégiques auxquels elles vont faire face dans les années à venir : l’accélération de la révolution numérique, l’intensification de la concurrence, ou encore la prise en considération de l’urgence climatique. Le cabinet possède des compétences sectorielles centrées sur le cœur de métier de ses clients, des compétences technologiques parmi les plus pointues tant sur le digital, les systèmes d’information qu’en matière de cybersécurité, et des compétences en développement durable. Wavestone se distingue dans sa capacité à conjuguer étroitement toutes ces compétences, sans couture, au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires afin d’apporter une réponse à 360°, en phase avec les grands enjeux auxquels sont confrontés ses clients. Le cabinet réalise un chiffre d’affaires de l’ordre de 940 M€ et rassemble près de 5500 collaborateurs présents dans 17 pays répartis sur 4 continents. Il figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe. Wavestone est coté sur Euronext à Paris et labellisé Great Place To Work. Pour plus d'informations, consulter www.wavestone.com Description du poste Contexte Au sein du bureau de Paris, la business unit Digital Customer (350 collaborateurs) accompagne les grandes entreprises françaises et internationales dans leurs projets de transformation. La BU accompagne en particulier les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, de la Beauté, de l'Hospitalité, des Services et des FMCG. Au cœur des plus grands enjeux actuels et futurs de ces secteurs, vous accompagnerez nos clients dans leurs projets de transformation les plus importants : lancement de nouvelles offres et de produits, digitalisation des parcours et processus métier, amélioration de la connaissance client, performance de la Supply Chain, exploitation des données pour la recherche et l'innovation, refonte des modèles de distribution… Au sein de la BU DC, l'offre Data, Analytics & AI (70 consultants au sein de cette communauté) accompagne les directions métiers, Data & IT dans leurs transformations liées aux données. Les enjeux sont vastes : le renforcement de la connaissance client pour mieux cibler les actions Marketing, l'automatisation de processus via l'IA, la monétisation des données en sont des exemples. Nos équipes vont intervenir de bout en bout sur ces projets de transformation, de la stratégie à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle. Nos interventions vont par exemple se décliner en : Définition de stratégies Data/IA et pilotage des programmes de transformation associées Cadrage de cas d'usage et pilotage de leur mise en œuvre Définition des organisations et des modèles opérationnels Data/IA Diagnostic de la qualité des données …

Rejoindre le groupe Ovalt, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts prête à relever des challenges, pour accompagner sa croissance et contribuer à l’industrie de demain, dans un groupe indépendant, grâce à l’actionnariat salarié. Avec ses 5 filiales - OET, PGC, ID Automation, CIP Automation et Ovalt Connect - notre groupe breton propose à ses clients une gamme complète de services dans les domaines du génie électrique, de l'automation, de l'informatique industrielle et data, de la robotique, de l’ingénierie mécanique et process ou encore de la tuyauterie - chaudronnerie et de la métrologie. Située à Betton, en Ille-et-Vilaine, OET avec ses 310 collaborateurs, apporte son expérience et son professionnalisme dans les domaines du génie électrique, de l'automatisme et de l'informatique industrielle depuis 1975. Quelles seront vos missions ? items.desc: Tycker du att det mest spännande med ny teknik är vad den faktiskt kan förändra i en verksamhet? Kanske har du arbetat med processutveckling, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, automation eller börjat utforska vad AI och agenter kan göra. Du gillar att förstå hur människor arbetar idag och fundera på hur det skulle kunna göras enklare, smartare eller mer automatiserat. Då tror vi att konsultrollen hos Dizparc kan vara ett naturligt nästa steg. Vi söker inte nödvändigtvis dig som redan är utvecklare eller teknisk specialist. Vi söker framför allt dig som förstår verksamheten, processerna och användarnas vardag, har ett stort teknikintresse och vill lära dig mer om hur man omsätter behov och möjligheter till bra digitala lösningar. Du tycker också om kunddialogen och drivs av att hitta möjligheter som skapar värde och kan utvecklas till nya lösningar och affärer. Du behöver inte vara säljare, men du ska tycka om att vara med i säljsituationer och vilja bidra till att utveckla våra kundrelationer. Hos oss får du utvecklas från verksamhetsnära problemlösare till rådgivare och specialist Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med våra kunder för att förstå deras processer, identifiera möjligheter och hitta bättre sätt att arbeta med hjälp av bland annat: Dynamics 365 Power Platform Power Apps och Power Automate Dataverse Copilot, AI och agenter integrationer mot andra verksamhetssystem En viktig del av rollen är också att delta i kund- och säljdialoger, fånga upp nya behov och tillsammans med kunden och dina kollegor utveckla dem till konkreta lösningar och affärer. Du behöver alltså inte kunna allt detta idag. Det viktiga är att du förstår hur teknik och system används i en verksamhet och har en stark vilja att förstå mer om möjligheterna bakom. Vi tror att du kanske idag arbetar som verksamhetsutvecklare eller processutvecklare systemförvaltare eller systemansvarig applikationsspecialist superuser inom exempelvis Dynamics 365 CRM-ansvarig med Power Platform, automation eller low-code med AI, Copilot eller agenter i verksamheten eller i en verksamhetsroll där du driver digitalisering och förbättring Du kanske arbetar på IT-sidan. Eller så finns du inom exempelvis försäljning, kundservice, marknad, ekonomi eller någon annan del av verksamheten och har blivit den som förstår både behovet och möjligheterna med tekniken. Det viktigaste är hur du tänker Du är nyfiken på teknik och tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar och hur de skulle kunna fungera bättre. När någon säger ”det där går inte” blir din spontana tanke snarare ”varför inte?”. Du tycker om kombinationen människor, processer och teknik och vill utvecklas mot en roll där du både kan förstå kundens behov och vara med och skapa lösningen. Du har också ett affärsmässigt driv. Du tycker om att träffa kunder, diskutera möjligheter och vara med i dialogen när en idé ska utvecklas till något kunden faktiskt vill investera i. Hos oss får du göra just den resan, tillsammans med kollegor som kan Microsofts plattform, utveckling, affärssystem, data och AI. Varför Dizparc Umeå? Vi är ett lokalt konsultbolag i Umeå med kunder både i regionen och runt om i Sverige. items.desc: Four FM är ett nordiskt facility management-företag som erbjuder skräddarsydda tjänster till företag och fastighetsägare. Verksamheten omfattar bland annat kontorsservice, lokalvård, teknisk fastighetsservice och andra tjänster som får kundernas vardag att fungera smidigt. Med verksamhet i fem nordiska länder kombinerar Four FM flexibilitet och personlig service med ambitionen att ständigt utveckla och förbättra sina arbetssätt. Läs mer om Four FM på https://fourfm.com/ Om uppdraget Vill du omsätta AI i praktiken och bidra till smartare arbetssätt i ett växande företag? Four FM söker dig som är nyfiken på AI, gillar att lösa problem och vill identifiera hur ny teknik kan skapa konkret verksamhetsnytta. Här får du möjlighet att utforska nya lösningar, testa idéer och hjälpa en verksamhet att ta nästa steg i sin digitala utveckling. AI utvecklas snabbt, men hur kan tekniken användas för att förenkla arbetsmoment, effektivisera processer och skapa verklig nytta i en verksamhet? Det är frågan du får vara med och utforska hos Four FM. I uppdraget arbetar du nära verksamheten för att identifiera möjligheter med AI och automatisering. Du undersöker hur befintliga verktyg kan användas smartare exempelvis inom Microsofts verktygsmiljö, och hur AI kan integreras i det dagliga arbetet. Du förväntas inte ha alla svar från början. Det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken, vågar testa nytt och kan omsätta idéer till konkreta förslag som går att använda i praktiken. Du förväntas att arbeta 12 tim/veckan på plats på deras kontor i Örebro. Uppdraget förväntas starta så snart som möjligt och pågå åtminstone fram till sommaren 2027. Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara att: Kartlägga arbetsprocesser och identifiera moment som kan effektiviseras med AI och automatisering. Undersöka hur befintliga digitala verktyg, exempelvis Microsoft 365 och relevanta AI-funktioner kan användas på nya sätt. Ta fram och testa idéer, prototyper eller enklare automatiserade lösningar. Utvärdera vilka lösningar som skapar störst nytta för verksamheten. Dokumentera resultat och presentera konkreta rekommendationer för fortsatt utveckling. Bidra till att öka kunskapen om AI och inspirera kollegor att använda tekniken i sitt arbete. Fungera som stöd i allmänna IT-frågor. Din bakgrund Vi söker dig som studerar det systemvetenskapliga programmet eller datateknik vid Örebro universitet och som har kommit en bit in i studierna. Du är kreativ, orädd för nya utmaningar och bekväm med att testa dig fram. Du gillar att förstå hur saker fungerar, ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder och tar gärna egna initiativ för att komma framåt. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och kan förklara tekniska lösningar på ett begripligt sätt. Du uttrycker dig obehindrat i såväl tal som skrift på både engelska och svenska. Du behöver inte vara expert på AI, men du bör ha ett intresse för tekniken och vilja lära dig mer genom att använda den i verksamhetsnära situationer. Du har grundläggande förståelse för digitala verktyg och gärna erfarenhet av Microsofts verktygsmiljö. Det är meriterande om du har testat att bygga AI-agenter, automatisera arbetsflöden eller använda AI för att lösa konkreta problem. Det viktigaste är dock din nyfikenhet, ditt driv och din förmåga att omsätta idéer till handling. Välkommen med din ansökan Bifoga ditt CV, personligt brev och något du själv byggt/skapat. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag, dock senast 8 november 2026. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post utan hänvisar samtliga sökande till att ansöka via vårt rekryteringssystem Varbi. Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Kajsa-Stina Johansson på kajsa-stina.johansson@oruholding.se. items.desc: Join Pay.UK as a Data Scientist and work with data connected to services that millions of people and businesses across the UK rely on every day. This is a role for someone who wants to apply solid data science practice in a clear, meaningful setting, with the chance to help shape how we use data and AI across a trusted payments environment. We are looking for a specialist who enjoys turning complex data into clear insight, practical models and well-structured analysis. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, using evidence to support decisions, improve understanding and help us develop our data capability in a way that is thoughtful, transparent and useful. Accountabilities Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends and risks relevant to Pay.UK's services and operations. Build, test and refine statistical and machine learning models that support better forecasting, monitoring and decision-making. Prepare clear visualisations, reports and presentations that explain methods, findings and limitations in a straightforward way. Work with colleagues across business and technical teams to define data questions, shape analytical approaches and agree practical outputs. Translate business problems into structured analytical tasks, including data preparation, feature selection and model evaluation. Improve data quality and analytical processes by documenting methods, validating outputs and supporting good data practice. Use SQL and programming tools to extract, clean and transform data from multiple sources for analysis and modelling. Support the development of Pay.UK's wider data and AI capability by contributing to repeatable methods, standards and shared learning. Qualifications, Skills and Experience Professional experience in a Data Scientist role, with responsibility for delivering analysis and predictive or statistical models. Solid applied experience using Python and SQL to extract, prepare, analyze, and model data. Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning, with the ability to choose and evaluate suitable methods for real business questions. Experience presenting technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences through reports, visualisations or presentations. Experience working with large, complex datasets and applying clear quality checks, documentation and validation methods. Pay.UK Behaviours At Pay.UK, our behaviours are central to who we are and how we operate. They bring our values to life, shape our culture, and guide how we make decisions, collaborate, and respond to challenges across the payments ecosystem. All interview processes will assess the following behaviours: Listen to Find Win-Wins - Empathy, Listening and Understanding Influence with Courage - Influence, Courage Go Horizontal First - Cross Boundary Collaboration Take Ownership - Self Development Opportunity Mindset - Initiative Simplify - Achievement Orientation Inclusivity At Pay.UK, we value diversity and inclusivity. Research has shown that candidates from underrepresented groups may hesitate to apply unless they meet all the requirements listed. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of how closely their skills and experience match the requirements. We are committed to supporting accessibility needs and creating a welcoming environment for all employees. Become part of our team and contribute to the creation of an inclusive work environment that values everyone's unique input. Who we are Pay.UK is the recognised operator and standards body for the UK's interbank retail payment systems. We provide the infrastructure and services that millions of people and businesses rely on every day, including Bacs, Faster Payments and the Image Clearing System for cheques, the Current Account Switch Service and Confirmation of Payee. Together, these services help keep money moving safely, securely and reliably across the UK and play an important role in supporting the economy. In 2025, the UK's retail payment systems processed more than 12.5 billion transactions worth over £11 trillion. Since its launch in 2013, the Current Account Switch Service has successfully helped consumers and businesses switch more than 12 million current accounts. These services help people receive their salaries, pay their bills, make payments and manage their finances with confidence. Our purpose is to provide the trusted infrastructure, standards and services that underpin UK retail payments. We deliver safe, resilient and efficient payment systems while working collaboratively with industry, regulators and stakeholders to strengthen resilience, tackle fraud, improve access and support innovation across the payments landscape. As the ecosystem evolves, we are continuing to develop our capabilities in areas such as data and AI, enhancing operational insight and helping to build a modern, trusted payments ecosystem. items.desc: Description Turn data into performance. Start your Formula 1 journey at Aston Martin Aramco Formula 1 Team. Are you passionate about mathematics, data science and understanding how complex systems perform? Join our Vehicle Science team as a Graduate Data Scientist , applying mathematical modelling, statistical analysis and machine learning to help improve the performance of our Formula One car. You'll work with data from simulation, wind tunnel testing and the track, developing practical models and analysis tools that help our engineers understand vehicle behaviour, identify trends and make better-informed decisions. Working alongside experienced specialists, you'll build your technical expertise while contributing to the engineering work that drives car development. Key Responsibilities Develop and improve physics-based, reduced-order and data-driven models to support engineering analysis and vehicle performance decisions. Build and maintain Python analysis tools to turn simulation, wind tunnel and track data into meaningful engineering insight. Undertake modelling tasks from problem definition and data preparation through to development, verification, validation and documentation, with guidance from experienced colleagues. Apply mathematical modelling, statistics and machine-learning techniques to identify trends, improve predictions and accelerate engineering workflows. Help integrate data from multiple sources and contribute to reliable data pipelines, shared modelling tools and datasets. Collaborate with Vehicle Science, Simulation and Modelling, Aerodynamics, Vehicle Performance and other engineering teams to understand problems and develop practical solutions. Communicate findings through clear reports, visualisations and presentations, while maintaining good coding practices, testing, version control and documentation. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise BSc or MSc in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or another relevant quantitative discipline. A sound understanding of mathematical modelling, statistics and data analysis, with an interest in applying these to complex engineering problems. Knowledge of regression, optimisation and machine-learning methods; familiarity with surrogate or reduced-order modelling would be advantageous. Programming experience in Python, ideally using libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy and scikit-learn. Understanding of model validation, uncertainty and error analysis, with the ability to investigate unexpected results and draw evidence-based conclusions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn, with the ability to communicate findings clearly. A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work to demanding timescales. An interest in Formula 1, motorsport, aerospace or other high-performance engineering environments would be advantageous. Make an impact At Aston Martin Aramco, data science is an important part of understanding and improving car performance. You'll have the opportunity to apply your mathematical and programming skills to real engineering problems, helping our engineers extract greater value from simulation, wind tunnel and track data. You'll learn from experienced specialists, develop your modelling and data science capabilities, and see how your work contributes to the decisions that shape a Formula 1 car. If you're curious about how things work, enjoy solving complex problems and want to apply your skills where engineering performance is pushed to its limits, we'd like to hear from you. Benefits Investing in your career is paramount. We promote professional and personal development through a provision of learning opportunities and work with you to shape your career and realise your full potential. As part of our high-performing, collaborative team, you'll enjoy a competitive package, including a discretionary bonus scheme, private healthcare, pension plan, life assurance, TEDSgroup childcare benefits, a cycle-to-work scheme, tech scheme, and car scheme. You will also have access to our state-of-the-art facilities at the AMR Technology Campus, featuring a new on-site gym with fitness, spin and yoga classes, a bistro café, and restaurant. About Aston Martin F1 Embark on a journey with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team to reshape history at our cutting-edge, sustainable campus in Northamptonshire. Combining our rich heritage with innovation, we bring fresh energy to the sport, driven by a commitment to challenge the status quo and dominate the track. With new investment fueling our ambitions, we're seeking talented individuals who share our passion for racing and drive for success. As part of our high-performing, collaborative team, you'll enjoy a competitive package, including a discretionary bonus scheme, private health care, pension plan, life assurance, and benefits like, cycle-to-work, tech, and car schemes. items.desc: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing Data Science & Analytics at Trainline Data Science & Analytics (DSA) is central to how we build products, delight our customers and grow our business. Our Data Scientists are embedded alongside Data Analysts in cross-functional teams which exist across product and marketing. Data Scientists have a high degree of autonomy and are empowered to drive the success of their teams, using all data and techniques at their disposal. As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in driving insights and strategy for the product team, creating and measuring value through experimentation, creating focus through metrics and goals, and building deep learning about what is most impactful for each team. You will be able to determine the underlying dynamics of our complex ecosystem and use this to deliver insights and strategic direction, but your main focus will be a complete obsession with driving impact within the product team, drawing on whatever analytical and statistical techniques that will unlock the most benefits. Data Science and Analytics at Trainline exists within the wider data organisation as part of the tech org, and is complemented by data engineering teams, data platform teams, and ML teams for when deep ML and AI techniques are required. Our autonomous model creates a huge opportunity for personal influence and impact – as the data scientist on the team you will be actively driving innovation on the team by contributing to strategy, execution and continuous learning. As a Data Scientist at Trainline, you will... As a Data Scientist in our New Business team, you'll help shape how Trainline grows beyond train tickets. From insurance and protection to hotels, car hire, attractions and other travel experiences, we're exploring new ways to add value throughout the customer journey, including making it easier for customers to plan more of their trip in one place. You'll use customer insights, experimentation and analytical techniques to uncover new opportunities, influence product strategy and create meaningful value for both our customers and Trainline. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for influencing product and business outcomes, have the autonomy to make things happen and must obsess about having business impact. More specifically you will: Own data science work from start to finish within an embedded product team, from shaping the right question with your colleagues to delivering a solution and measuring its impact Explore customer behaviour and product usage to uncover areas of friction, spot new opportunities and estimate the benefit of acting on them Contribute to simple, seamless customer journeys by identifying where we can remove barriers and add value Design, run and analyse experiments using sound statistical methods, and help define metrics Build, test and improve models such as forecasting, personalisation or customer behaviour prediction that enhance the customer experience and support business growth Turn your findings into clear, practical recommendations that help shape product and monetisation strategy, tailoring your message for both technical and non-technical audiences We'd love to hear from you if you have... Hands-on experience applying data science to real product or customer problems, ideally within an embedded or cross-functional team Confidence using Python and SQL to explore large datasets of customer activity, build models and write efficient, readable code Experience of product engagement evaluation and measurement of success. For example, running A/B tests to evaluate product effectiveness or using front-end data to quantify the effectiveness of new features and how it changes user engagement. The ability to explain complex ideas simply and adapt how you communicate for different audiences Ideally, an interest in monetisation, advertising, recommendations or e-commerce, and familiarity with tools such as dbt, Looker or Tableau, although none of these are essential Tech Stack: SQL, Python, R, Tableau, AWS Athena + More! items.desc: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected WoodMac.com Wood Mackenzie Brand Video Wood Mackenzie Values Inclusive – we succeed together Trusting – we choose to trust each other Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions Future Focused – we accelerate change Curious – we turn knowledge into action The Role and Main Responsibilities We are looking for an Associate to work as part of our Refinery monitoring research team. Train our machine learning models to improve the quality of their asset on/off predictions. Query our large datasets of high-frequency data to proactively generate insights or/and respond to client queries. Support efforts to improve current internal processes. Connect with colleagues internally to discuss data and insights that can be useful to form an integrated view of the short-term markets. Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie. items.desc: About CommonAI CommonAI CIC is a non-profit organisation built around collaborative engineering and is backed by a mix of UK Government and private funding in order to design, build and deploy innovative AI systems. Our Scaling Inference Lab (SIL) is developing simulation grounded in real measurements to help the UK invest in promising AI infrastructure. We connect proposed hardware designs to realistic workloads, helping investors and engineers understand their potential, their limitations and the next experiment worth doing. The Opportunity Build simulation software that helps engineers and investors explore how AI systems would behave with different processors, memory systems, networks or serving strategies. Your work will help turn models and existing software into a practical framework for comparing design choices against realistic LLM workloads. You will develop and connect simulation components, making sure that changes in one part of a system have the appropriate consequences elsewhere. This means understanding unfamiliar code, designing clear interfaces and building software whose predictions can be investigated and tested against measurements. We aim to reuse and extend existing frameworks wherever they provide a sound foundation. We welcome depth in one or more relevant areas, including simulation, systems software, performance modelling and inference serving. Your initial focus will reflect your strengths and the components we choose to build on, with complementary expertise added as the team grows. What you will do Develop and integrate simulation components that capture behaviour and interactions relevant to an AI infrastructure comparison. Work with the technical lead and our partners to evaluate existing frameworks and software, extending and connecting useful components through clear interfaces. Develop appropriate models of system state and resource use so that changes in one component have the appropriate consequences elsewhere. Build reproducible simulation scenarios, diagnostic outputs and tests that expose incorrect assumptions, integration errors and unsupported cases. Work with measurement and uncertainty colleagues to compare predictions with evidence, improve models and integrate calibration and uncertainty methods into the simulator. Maintain reliable software, documentation and development workflows, using AI coding agents to support implementation and testing. An example early project would be to bridge an existing simulator component with our workload models and measurement datasets, producing a reproducible comparison between predicted and measured performance over two systems. Requirements Strong software engineering skills and evidence of building, debugging and maintaining substantial technical software. Experience in one or more of: discrete-event simulation; computer architecture or performance modelling; distributed/HPC systems; inference runtimes and serving; memory or network modelling; integration of scientific software and heterogeneous components. The ability to understand unfamiliar code, reason about interfaces and assess the suitability and maintenance costs of reusing, extending or building software. A collaborative approach to testing assumptions and working with specialists in adjacent areas. Practical experience using AI coding agents, with the judgement to check their output for correctness and maintainability. Python, C++, Rust or other relevant systems or scientific programming experience can provide a route into the role. Familiarity with vLLM or SGLang, simulator frameworks, or hardware performance tools would be useful. Depth in a subset of these areas is sufficient; languages and frameworks will follow the engineering needs of the programme. Why join us Help build UK AI capability and improve how investment and compute serve the public good. Build a network spanning UK hardware SMEs, major technology companies, venture and public investors, and leading universities. Shape a growing team with startup pace and close academic links. Use frontier models and coding agents with a substantial tooling budget. Benefits A collaborative and supportive work environment The opportunity to have a high impact in a growing organisation Competitive salary package, including pension and benefits Professional development opportunities Networking opportunities with influential figures from across the tech sector and academia A vibrant office environment located a few minutes’ walk away from Cambridge train station Working with us Hybrid, with Cambridge attendance agreed individually around collaboration and the work; applicants across the UK are welcome. We are open to permanent employment, part-time arrangements and consultancy. We would like you to start as soon as practical and can be flexible for the right person. We particularly welcome experienced engineers and can also consider earlier-career candidates with strong evidence of ability. Relevant postgraduate study …

You will translate between investment and engineering audiences, turning diligence questions into well-defined simulation studies and experiments, and explaining what the findings mean for a proposed technology. Working with the engineering team, you will make SIL's simulation framework accessible to investors without specialist systems knowledge. You will guide users through studies, help them understand the assumptions and uncertainty behind the results, and turn their feedback into improvements to our framework. Turn those questions into clear study briefs with the simulation team, including assumptions, relevant workloads and criteria for a useful result. Produce concise assessments explaining technical findings, assumptions, uncertainty, integration requirements and the next evidence worth obtaining. Bring together simulator results, company and research developments, and investor questions to contribute to the Scientific Director's technology roadmap for SIL. An example early project would be to work with an investor and the engineering team to compare two AI infrastructure options, producing a concise assessment of the findings, assumptions and further evidence needed to inform an investment decision. The project seeks to explore the expansion of current cultivated meat research at Aberystwyth through the use of edible scaffolds, 3D bioprinting and AI-Machine Learning (AI-ML) driven methods to create high-throughput research pipelines. To make an informal enquiry, please contact Dr Ruth Wonfor at rec21@aber.ac.uk. Appointments are normally made within 4 - 8 weeks of the closing date. The role will also have some lab work in our cell culture lab to produce proof of concept data of the growth of primary bovine satellite cells on 3D bioprinted scaffolds. The PGRA post will be based in the Department of Life Sciences in Dr Ruth Wonfor’s research group, but will also require collaboration with Prof Tossapon Boongoen in the Department of Computer Science. There will also be opportunities to connect with other companies in the cultivated meat space to network with experts in the field whilst gaining an overview of current industry needs. The project will be completed over 5 months and is expected to have a full time PGRA post. However, due to the nature of the project encompassing two diverse fields around cell culture/scaffolds and AI-ML, we are open to appointing two individuals on a part time basis to ensure delivery of the diverse aims. Partake in site visits to external companies or academic institutes to assess technologies used and discuss data requirements. items.desc: Research Assistant – In Vivo Neurophysiology, Circuit Biology Are you a passionate, hands-on, experimental neuroscience, interested in using advanced in vivo technologies to support the discovery of new treatments for brain diseases? Do you have experience in electrophysiology and/or functional imaging? Then you may be our new Research Assistant in Circuit Biology. Your new role As Research Assistant, you will be a key hands-on contributor to Lundbeck’s early drug discovery projects, generating high-quality in vivo pharmacology data that help us understand how novel treatments affect neuronal and neuromuscular function. You will work across central and peripheral in vivo electrophysiology, with opportunities to contribute to approaches such as EEG, multiunit and high-density neuronal recordings, and neuromuscular electrophysiology. In close collaboration with scientists and project teams, you will plan and perform experiments, analyse and document data, troubleshoot methods, and help drive timely project decisions. You will also have the opportunity to broaden your expertise across other advanced in vivo platforms, including functional imaging with genetically encoded biosensors and neurochemical measurements. The role offers a strong development opportunity to build practical expertise in cutting-edge neuroscience technologies while contributing directly to Lundbeck’s drug discovery pipeline. Your future team You will join the Circuit Biology Department at Lundbeck's headquarters. We are an experimental neuroscience group focused on understanding how brain circuits are altered in disease, and how our drug candidates can correct these. Our department combines complementary approaches including: in vivo electrophysiology, including EEG and high-density neuronal recordings ex vivo brain slice electrophysiology and imaging peripheral and neuromuscular electrophysiology in vivo functional imaging using biosensors neurochemistry using microdialysis and advanced perfusion approaches We work closely with drug discovery project teams across our pipeline and place a strong emphasis on scientific quality, collaboration and developing experimental approaches that can answer critical questions for our projects. The position is based in Valby, Copenhagen. What you bring to the team We are looking for someone who enjoys experimental work and is comfortable spending a substantial part of their time hands-on in the laboratory. Ideally, you have: An MSc in neuroscience, physiology, biomedical science, pharmacology, biology or a related discipline. Hands-on experience conducting in vivo experiments in rodents, preferably involving electrophysiology, neurophysiology or functional imaging. FELASA accreditation or equivalent qualification permitting experimental work with laboratory animals. Experience with animal surgery, physiological recordings or other technically demanding in vivo procedures. A solid understanding of experimental design, data quality and documentation. Experience with analysis of physiological or biological data using appropriate software. The ability to troubleshoot experimental procedures and learn new techniques quickly. A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach to working in a multidisciplinary research environment. Experience with techniques such as EEG, extracellular electrophysiology, high-density neuronal recordings, peripheral nerve or muscle electrophysiology, or in vivo optical imaging would be an advantage, but we do not expect candidates to have experience across all of these areas. Most importantly, you are curious, technically skilled and motivated by generating robust experimental data that directly contribute to drug discovery projects. Our promise to you Lundbeck offers an inspiring workplace and innovative culture, where our curiosity, accountability and adaptability enable us to transform lives. We want to go faster and further on addressing the big unmet needs of people living with brain disorders. We offer rewarding careers with a mix of exciting tasks and development opportunities that are balanced with initiatives focused on your well-being. We need every brain in the game, and at Lundbeck, we are committed to building a workforce that is as diverse as the people we serve. Read more about our commitment at www.lundbeck.com/global/about-us/our-commitment/diversity-and-inclusion. Annual base salary range: 491 000 - 675 400 DKK gross. Encadrer les choix technologiques et les trajectoires d'implémentation. Développer et capitaliser les référentiels d'architecture, bonnes pratiques et actifs réutilisables de la Practice. Une forte proximité avec les experts et dirigeants de la Practice Data & IA. L'opportunité de contribuer au développement de nouvelles offres Data & IA. Un parcours de carrière personnalisé et des perspectives d'évolution rapides. Un environnement favorisant l'expertise, le partage de connaissances et l'innovation. items.desc: Equal1 is building silicon-based quantum computers, integrating spin qubits and cryo-CMOS control electronics on standard semiconductor processes. We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineer to join our team in Timișoara and build infrastructure for the whole company, across all our sites, with a focus on our full-stack software framework and our measurement activities. You will work closely with our IT Manager from day one. Over time, the role will also support our SoC / hardware modeling team. Main Duties and Responsibilities Own CI/CD, build and release pipelines for the quantum software stack (Python, C/C++), including simulator and hardware-in-the-loop testing. Automate the flow of data from lab instruments and measurement setups into central storage, with experiment tracking and traceability. Design data infrastructure that scales across sites: storage, backup, retention and access policies. Manage lab and engineering compute as code, and run observability (logging, metrics, alerting) for internal services. Progressively support the SoC / HW modeling team with simulation compute, job scheduling, license servers and regression pipelines. Evaluate and, if pursued, build GPU infrastructure for ML / LLM training and serving. Work with the IT Manager on identity, networking, security and cloud accounts, so DevOps and IT form one coherent setup. Experience and Qualifications Required: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 4+ years of experience in DevOps, platform, SRE or build/release engineering. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python). Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins), Docker and Kubernetes or similar. Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) across on-premises and cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP). Solid networking and security fundamentals. Fluent English and the ability to work with physicists, hardware and software engineers. Desired: Experience with HPC, EDA or scientific computing environments (Slurm, license servers). Lab automation or data acquisition (QCoDeS, PyVISA) and experiment tracking (ClearML, MLflow). Data engineering (object storage, HDF5/Parquet, PostgreSQL) or GPU / ML infrastructure. If you want to build the platform behind a quantum computer from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

What will
items.desc: IoT Security Analyst (m/f/d) Campanillas, MA, ES, 29590 Key Area: Product Testing & Laboratory Services Level of Experience: Entry Level Employment Type: Permanent Full Time / Part Time: Full Time Weekly Hours: 40.00 Remote Working: Hybrid Requisition ID: 7068 Posting Date: Oct 22, 2026 Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. Today, DEKRA employs around 48,000 people across more than 60 countries on all five continents. Following our 100th anniversary in 2025, our vision remains clear and ambitious: to be the global partner for a safe, secure, and sustainable world. Within our Cybersecurity Hub , we evaluate the security of connected products end to end, with a strong focus on IoT and embedded devices and their full ecosystem: hardware, firmware, wireless protocols, companion mobile apps, web interfaces and cloud backends. We collaborate with world-leading manufacturers and technology companies to identify risks and vulnerabilities and verify compliance with international security standards and certification schemes. You will join a globally recognized security lab within a multidisciplinary team covering IoT/hardware, web and mobile security, working on international projects for top-tier customers. We are looking for professionals passionate about IoT and embedded security who also want to grow in web and mobile penetration testing, combining analytical thinking and creativity to help safeguard our digital world. What will your responsibilities be? Perform security evaluations of IoT devices and their full ecosystem (device, companion app and cloud backend) against standards such as EN 18031, ETSI EN 303 645 and OWASP ISVS. Analyze hardware and firmware: identify debug interfaces (UART, JTAG/SWD), extract firmware from flash memory or update packages, and review embedded Linux systems for weaknesses. Assess wireless and IoT communication protocols such as BLE, Wi-Fi, Zigbee and MQTT. Perform penetration tests of web applications and APIs, including device web interfaces and cloud backends, following OWASP WSTG and OWASP ASVS. Perform security assessments of Android and iOS applications, including IoT companion apps, following OWASP MASVS/MASTG. Support product security certification and compliance projects (e.g., EU Cyber Resilience Act, ETSI/EN standards, ioXt, MASA, CASA) under the guidance of senior team members. Prepare clear technical reports documenting vulnerabilities, risk ratings and recommended mitigations, and communicate findings to international customers. Stay current with emerging attack techniques, tools and security practices across IoT, web and mobile. What do we expect from you? Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field. 1–2 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally in IoT or embedded security (professional experience, internships, research or personal projects). Practical knowledge of IoT and embedded systems (microcontrollers, embedded Linux, firmware) and common IoT communication protocols such as BLE, Wi-Fi or MQTT. Basic hardware security skills: identifying and using debug interfaces (UART, JTAG/SWD) and extracting and analyzing firmware (e.g., binwalk, unblob). Basic knowledge of web and mobile application security (OWASP Top 10, OWASP MASVS) and tools such as Burp Suite. Working knowledge of Linux and scripting (Python, Bash or similar). Support responses to audits and regulatory enquiries by preparing materials and gathering documentation. Prepare regular compliance reports, with oversight from your manager. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. About The Role As a Research Software Engineer on the Safety team, you will design, build, and own the infrastructure used to run our most sensitive model evaluations — including evaluations in CBRN (chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear), child safety, and other dangerous-capability domains. These evaluations inform release decisions for our open models, so the systems you build must be secure, isolated, reproducible, and trustworthy under scrutiny. This is a deeply technical, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering, security, and safety research. You will partner closely with domain experts, legal, and safety researchers to turn their evaluation needs into robust, scalable infrastructure: sandboxed execution environments, controlled data pipelines for sensitive material, access controls, audit logging, and the tooling that lets researchers safely elicit and measure model capabilities in high-consequence areas. What You'll Do Design and build secure, sandboxed infrastructure for running sensitive model evaluations, including CBRN and other dangerous-capability domains. Build controlled data pipelines and storage for sensitive evaluation material, applying least-privilege and need-to-know access, role-based access control (RBAC), encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and data-minimization safeguards. Partner with safety researchers and domain experts to translate evaluation designs into reliable, reproducible, and scalable systems. Build eval-orchestration tooling and harnesses that let researchers run high-throughput evaluations against models and agents in isolated environments. Develop infrastructure for measuring AI capability uplift in high-consequence domains, and integrate results into the pipelines that inform release decisions. items.desc: We are currently looking for an Algorithm Engineer to join the team in Delft . You will be part of the Defence & Security business unit, where we develop innovative solutions using space technologies. Within the domain of Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT), our work includes satellite navigation signal quality monitoring, radio-frequency (RF) interference direction-finding, and antenna array technologies for RF interference mitigation. Our solutions support applications in Defence, Space and Critical Infrastructure. In this role, you will develop and implement algorithms to detect, classify and localize and suppress RF-emitters in challenging environments, and combining sensor outputs in an optimal way. Working in a collaborative team of 10 engineers, you will contribute to signal processing and system-control algorithm development and evaluate their performance using custom or off-the-shelf hardware. You will also carry out testing, verification and validation in laboratory environments and during field operations. This position offers the opportunity to design innovative technical solutions, solve complex engineering challenges and contribute to product development in a dynamic, high-tech organisation. Main responsibilities: Translate end-user needs into measurable technical and performance requirements. Design algorithmic processing architectures that combine stochastic analysis, system identification, optimization and data-driven methods. Develop and implement signal-processing and system-control algorithms. Collaborate with software and hardware engineers to balance detection accuracy, computational performance and other product requirements. Keep up to date with scientific developments and state-of-the-art techniques relevant to the field. Design test benches and define and perform testing, verification and validation activities. Take ownership of technical tasks and lead projects within larger programmes. Requirements: Education: A master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience: A good understanding of signal processing, system control and digital communications. Experience in one or more relevant areas, such as RF systems, GNSS and satellite navigation, sensor fusion, system identification, stochastic modelling, constrained optimization (e.g. mixed integer), state-estimation. Experience in data-driven AI modelling is strongly preferred. Knowledge: Programming experience in Python is essential. Experience with Rust, C or C++ is an advantage. Experience: The ability to communicate technical ideas clearly in English, both verbally and in writing. Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage. Interest: An interest in working in the Defence domain and the ability to obtain the required security clearances (Dutch, NATO and EU, as applicable). Important: You do not need to have experience in every technical area listed above. We value the different perspectives and expertise that people bring, whether developed through education, research or practical experience. items.desc: zurück zur Stellenübersicht Die Hochschule für Technik, Wirtschaft und Kultur Leipzig (HTWK Leipzig) ist eine der führenden Hochschulen für Angewandte Wissenschaften in Deutschland. Mit einer Vielzahl an innovativen Studiengängen, interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekten und einer starken Vernetzung in die regionale Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft bieten wir eine lebendige akademische Umgebung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams ist an der Fakultät Informatik und Medien folgende Stelle zum 01.12.2026 zu besetzen: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin/Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter für Computer Vision und digitales Kulturerbe (w/m/d) Ihre Aufgaben An der HTWK Leipzig ist im Rahmen des Forschungsprojektes „V.E.R.B. - Verschwundenes Erbe - Rekonstruierte Bauwerke. Bauerbe als Ressource für gesellschaftliche Resilienz“ eine wissenschaftliche Stelle mit dem Ziel der Promotion zu besetzen. Das auf 36 Monate angelegte Verbundprojekt der HTWK Leipzig und des Leibniz-Instituts für Raumbezogene Sozialforschung (IRS) untersucht, wie gesellschaftliche Aneignung, digitale Technologien und Erinnerungsprozesse zusammenwirken, wenn gebaute Umwelt sich verändert oder verschwindet. Kultur-, sozial- und geisteswissenschaftliche Forschung wird dabei mit digitalen Methoden verbunden. Im Zentrum des an der HTWK Leipzig angesiedelten Forschungsprojektes steht die maschinelle Analyse und Rekonstruktion baulicher Veränderungen . Untersucht wird zugleich, wie algorithmische Verfahren selbst zu Akteuren erinnerungskultureller Prozesse werden. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere: Recherche und Erprobung von Verfahren des maschinellen Sehens und Machine Learnings für historische Bildbestände; Aufbau und Aufbereitung geeigneter Datensets für maschinelles Sehen; Entwicklung und Training von Machine-Learning-Modellen; Erprobung von Deep-Learning-basiertem Bild-Matching zur Ergänzung fehlender räumlicher und zeitlicher Metadaten; Mitwirkung an Verfahren zur 3D-Rekonstruktion historischer bzw. verschwundener Bauwerke auf Grundlage historischer Fotografien; Arbeit mit digitalen Bildverarbeitungsverfahren, KI-gestützten Qualitäts- und Georeferenzierungsalgorithmen sowie Structure-from-Motion-Techniken (SfM); Literaturrecherche und wissenschaftliche Einordnung. Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Verbundprojekt an der Schnittstelle von Digital Humanities, Digital Cultural Heritage, maschinellem Sehen, 3D-Rekonstruktion, Architektur- und Erinnerungskulturforschung sowie Forschungsdatenmanagement . Grundlage der technischen Arbeiten sind u. a. historische Architekturfotografien aus den Wissenschaftlichen Sammlungen zur Bau- und Planungsgeschichte der DDR am IRS sowie weitere historische Fotografien, Karten und Pläne. Das bringen Sie mit einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Masterabschluss oder einen vergleichbaren Hochschulabschluss in Medieninformatik, Informatik, Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft, Digital Humanities, Data Science oder einer verwandten Disziplin; Interesse an einer wissenschaftlichen Qualifikation und der Anfertigung einer Dissertation im Themenfeld des Projektes; Kenntnisse bzw. Interesse im Bereich Machine Learning, Computer Vision und digitale Bildverarbeitung; Interesse an der Verarbeitung und Analyse historischer Bilddaten; Interesse an Verfahren der räumlichen Zuordnung und 3D-Rekonstruktion; Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit zwischen digitalen Methoden und kultur- bzw. geisteswissenschaftlicher Forschung; Interesse an nachvollziehbaren, dokumentierten und nachnutzbaren Forschungsworkflows sowie am Forschungsdatenmanagement. Wir bieten Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem interessanten und vielfältigen Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung. Individuelle Entwicklungsgespräche und umfangreiche Weiter- und Fortbildungsangebote. Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gesundheit liegen uns am Herzen. Hierfür bieten wir insbesondere flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, einen familiengerechten Arbeitsplatz und vielfältige Angebote des Hochschulgesundheitsmanagements sowie des Hochschulsports. Sie erhalten eine Jahressonderzahlung und haben die Möglichkeit, ein ermäßigtes Ticket für den bundesweiten Personennahverkehr (Deutschland-Jobticket) zu beziehen. So bewerben Sie sich Bitte bewerben Sie sich bis zum 10.11.2026 über unser Online-Formular mit Ihren aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. Die HTWK Leipzig begrüßt Bewerbungen von Frauen ausdrücklich. Bei Unterrepräsentanz werden Frauen bei entsprechender Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter und diesen gleichgestellten Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Im Zusammenhang mit der Bewerbung entstehende Kosten werden nicht erstattet. A collaborative, proactive approach, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work to demanding timescales.
