items.card: ABOUT THE JOB Every decision at CAIA, from which shade to restock to which campaign to scale or which market to grow, starts with data. Our data platform turns orders, ad spend and retail sales into numbers the whole company can trust, and our AI assistants let colleagues ask those numbers questions directly. We’re looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join our Tech team. Reporting to our CTO, you’ll work with
items.desc: CAIA Cosmetics is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand, founded in 2018 by beauty industry veterans and experts in social media and content. We create high-performing, top-quality products at accessible price points, always crafted with intention and grounded in our Scandinavian heritage of effortlessness, warmth and clean design. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative spirit, CAIA blends quality and expertise with creativity and entertainment to make beauty feel inspiring, joyful and easy to use. Our world is aspirational yet attainable - rooted in access, community, inclusivity and our signature “effortless glow.” ABOUT THE JOB Every decision at CAIA, from which shade to restock to which campaign to scale or which market to grow, starts with data. Our data platform turns orders, ad spend and retail sales into numbers the whole company can trust, and our AI assistants let colleagues ask those numbers questions directly. We’re looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join our Tech team. Reporting to our CTO, you’ll work with marketing, finance and operations to build and run the data pipelines, services and AI tooling behind CAIA’s reporting and analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you'll help ensure everyone at CAIA works from figures that are correct, documented and on time. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, enjoys clean and tested code, builds with AI every day, and wants to own real production systems at a fast-growing brand. MAIN TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery – incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning and clustering. Ingest data from our source systems – e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP and retail partners – into BigQuery, with scheduling, alerting and backfills. Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with correct IAM, secrets and logging. Work with marketing, finance and operations to turn vague business questions into precise data questions and reliable data models. Build, deploy and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run that connect AI assistants to our data – with authentication, least-privilege IAM, secrets and monitoring. Keep our semantic layer answerable for AI – define metrics once, write table and column descriptions, catalog entries and test questions, and fix wrong answers at the source. Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default way of building – write clear task specs, review the output critically and ship tested code through pull requests and CI/CD. Support the whole organisation in building up its AI toolset – setting up assistants and connectors, and helping teams put AI to work in their daily tasks. Q UALIFICATIONS & PERSONAL SKILLS A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems or equivalent. Up to around two years of experience in data or software engineering – internships, thesis work and serious side projects count. Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models. Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own. Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud. An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output. A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues. Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment. Fluent Swedish and English. IT'S A PLUS IF YOU HAVE Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt. Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing. An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking. Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands. Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count. WHY CAIA? At CAIA, you'll be part of one of Scandinavia's most exciting and fast-growing beauty brands, working in a creative, collaborative and dynamic environment where ideas come to life, and where you'll have the opportunity to grow your skills while contributing to products loved by customers around the world. If you're passionate about data, code and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application and let's continue building CAIA's story together. Please submit your application by November 9, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application day.

items.desc: AI-samordnare, vikariat – Stadsledningsförvaltningen Helsingborg Generativ AI är på väg att bli en självklar del av arbetsvardagen för tusentals medarbetare i Helsingborgs stad. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och forma hur det går till. Som AI-samordnare hos oss driver du stadens AI-vägledning, tjänstefierar generativ AI och transkribering och leder produktutvecklingen av vår egen AI-plattform Eneo. Du blir den som verksamheterna vänder sig till när de vill veta vad som är möjligt, lämpligt och klokt — och den som omsätter svaren i tjänster som faktiskt används. Vill du vara med och göra skillnad på riktigt? Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Om arbetsplatsen Helsingborgs stad har cirka 10 000 medarbetare och 470 chefer. Stadsledningsförvaltningen har ett viktigt och spännande uppdrag där vi finns till för andra, för kollegor, andra förvaltningar, helsingborgare och företag. Genom att leda, utveckla och samordna kommunens verksamhet inom övergripande och gemensamma områden skapar vi förutsättningar för en välfungerande organisation. Vi tillhandahåller tjänster och produkter som efterfrågas av kommunstyrelsen, förvaltningar och bolag, samt gemensamma funktioner som riktar sig direkt till helsingborgarna. Som en del av uppdraget samverkar vi även med externa parter för att skapa förutsättningar för en positiv utveckling av Helsingborg. Du kommer att tillhöra avdelningen för digitalisering, som ansvarar för stadens gemensamma digitala utveckling. Här arbetar vi nära varandra och nära verksamheterna — rollen är placerad centralt, men effekten av det du gör märks ute i skolor, vård och omsorg, stadsbyggnad och alla andra delar av staden. AI-arbetet i Helsingborg är inte ett pilotprojekt utan en etablerad del av verksamheten, med en egen plattform, en vägledning och ett internt nätverk. Samtidigt är området ungt nog att du får stort utrymme att påverka riktningen. Du arbetar självständigt i din roll, men aldrig ensam: du har kollegor inom arkitektur, informationssäkerhet, juridik och verksamhetsutveckling att luta dig mot. Arbetsuppgifter Tjänsten benämns som tjänsteägare och innebär att du ansvarar för stadens AI-vägledning: förvaltar den löpande och leder arbetet när den behöver ändras eller byggas ut. Vägledningen är det som gör att verksamheterna vågar och vet hur de ska använda AI, så den behöver vara både aktuell och begriplig. En stor del av vardagen handlar om tjänstefiering. Du tar generativ AI och AI-transkribering från möjlighet till färdig tjänst som verksamheterna kan beställa och använda, med allt vad det innebär av behovsanalys, utformning, införande och förvaltning. Du driver produktutvecklingen av Eneo, stadens egen AI-plattform. Det innebär att prioritera vad som ska byggas, hålla ihop arbetet mot leverantörer och interna resurser och se till att plattformen svarar mot verkliga behov i staden. Du bistår också i framtagandet av stadsgemensamma AI-assistenter. Rådgivning är en återkommande uppgift. Verksamheter och projekt vänder sig till dig för att få hjälp att bedöma idéer, välja väg och undvika fallgropar. Du tar också fram underlag och förslag till ledningen när frågorna är av mer strategisk art. Vad vi erbjuder Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande, ansvarsfullt och stimulerande arbete med stora möjligheter till egen utveckling. Du får arbeta med AI i skarp kommunal drift, inte i presentationsform, och du får göra det i en organisation som redan bestämt sig för att området är viktigt. Du får också ett brett kontaktnät — inom staden, inom Familjen Helsingborg och genom samverkan med andra kommuner och regionala aktörer. Du arbetar självständigt och strukturerat, och du är bekväm med att driva frågor framåt i en miljö där allt ännu inte är färdigtänkt. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. items.desc: About Myrspoven Buildings use a huge share of the world's energy, and most of it is controlled by rules written decades ago. Myrspoven changes that. Our AI controls heating, cooling and ventilation in real time, cutting energy use and emissions while keeping people comfortable. Our products myCoreAI and myLoadShift run in buildings today. We are a growth-stage scaleup in Stockholm, and we are now looking for a software engineer to join our AI team. The role You will join our AI team, which owns the model that optimises our customers' buildings and that our whole product is built on – along with the data and systems around it. The team's mission is to make our optimisation smarter, more reliable and easier to scale to new buildings – and to make it understandable. Through visualisation and clear explanations, we help our users see what the model does, how it works and why it makes the decisions it does. This is a software engineering role: you will improve the model itself and build the data and platform foundation it runs on. Agents write more and more of our code, so what we value most is the engineering judgement around it: framing the problem, designing the system and knowing that what we ship actually works. You will: Work across teams – Platform, Product, Customer Success and partners – to understand the problem before you build the solution Share knowledge and work closely with your teammates – we keep teams small but redundant, so no one is a single point of failure Use AI agents as a natural part of how you work – to write, test, review and ship faster Improve the model – from data and features to training, evaluation and how it performs in real buildings Build and run the data pipelines and platform behind our AI – ingestion, processing, orchestration, deployment and monitoring Visualise building data and the model's decisions so they are easy to explore and understand for internal teams and for customers Own what you build, from idea to production and beyond Who you are A strong software engineer. You have solid experience building and running software in production. You understand how systems fit together, read code critically and know how to dig into the details when something breaks. You are at home in Linux and on the command line. Experienced in data engineering. You have built data pipelines at scale with tools like Spark, Airflow or similar. Self-driven with AI agents. You already use coding agents daily, know their strengths and limits, and work independently with them – steering, reviewing and verifying what they produce rather than just accepting it. Product-oriented. You care about why something is built, not only how. You think in terms of customer value and are happy to challenge a requirement. A clear communicator. You work well across teams, explain technical trade-offs and complex ideas simply – in words and visuals – and you ask early and keep others in the loop. Curious. You like to understand how things work – the data, the buildings, the customers – and you keep learning as the tools change. Ready to pitch in. We are a small company with varied needs, so you jump in where you are needed, even when it is outside your usual area. Excited about what we do. You believe AI can make buildings far more energy efficient, and you want to help make that happen at scale. Nice to have Cloud experience, ideally Azure Experience with time-series data or with taking ML models into production Knowledge of buildings, HVAC or energy systems Experience from a B2B SaaS scaleup Technologies we use You don't need to know all of these from day one, but familiarity with any of them is a plus: Language and tooling: Python, uv, Ruff, mypy, pytest ML and optimisation: JAX, Flax, Optax, scikit-learn, SciPy Data: Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, Polars, pandas, Spark, Kafka Platform: Airflow, Kubernetes and Helm, Docker, Nix, Azure Monitoring and apps: Prometheus, Grafana, FastAPI, Streamlit What we offer Work that cuts energy use and emissions in real buildings, every day A friendly, relaxed workplace with smart, helpful colleagues who enjoy working together A small, senior team where your work goes straight to customers Lots of room to shape how we build with AI – tools, ways of working and architecture Competitive salary and stock options Hybrid work, with at least 3 days a week at our office on Södermalm in Stockholm How to apply Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us your CV with short answers to two questions: Tell us about something you built that ran in production, and what went wrong. We care more about how you handled the problem than about how impressive the project was. How do you use AI agents in your work today? Be concrete: which tools you use, what you use them for, and where they still fall short.

items.desc: Use your life-sciences degree to review and improve a cutting-edge medical AI system. Aykua is a Cambridge-based, venture-backed startup developing AI systems to automate medical administration workflows accurately and efficiently. Medical admin is a huge, largely manual burden on clinics and a source of delay and error for patients; we are building the systems that make that exchange fast, accurate, and compliant at scale. We are a lean, fast-paced team with significant opportunities to grow with the company. The Role This role sits at the centre of Aykua’s product quality engine. Your work will help us understand where the system fails and how to improve it. You will review outputs from our proprietary AI system, assessing whether they are accurate, complete, and consistent with the underlying information. Alongside the quality review work, you will run experiments to make the system more accurate, reliable, and efficient. The role is well suited to someone with strong life-sciences knowledge and a genuine interest in growing into more technical work over time. What You’ll Do Review AI-generated outputs against a structured rubric, using source material and general life-sciences knowledge to determine correctness, completeness, and consistency. This is a daily activity required to uphold Service Level Agreements with Aykua’s customers. Identify, classify, and document errors, inconsistencies, and hallucinations. Help refine our core prompts and workflows as the system evolves. Run focused experiments to make the system more accurate, reliable, and efficient. Contribute to internal documentation, examples, and quality-control processes. What We’re Looking For A degree in a life-sciences subject, and the ability to understand medical and biological terminology in context. Exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Care and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information. Comfortable working independently for sustained periods, staying accurate and motivated through focused solo review work. Curiosity about AI systems and how they can be evaluated and improved. Nice to have Experience reviewing scientific, medical, or technical information. Familiarity working with patient data or healthcare documentation. Experience using AI tools. Basic coding or data-analysis experience. Prior work in a lab, healthcare organisation, research environment, or startup. How to Apply Please send your CV and cover letter to jobs@aykua.com . Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, and we aim to respond to every applicant within one week. You must have the right to work in the UK, as this is an in-person role near Cambridge. Working within an integrated Design & Build environment, you will contribute to live water and wastewater projects and gain practical experience of how mechanical engineering develops from initial concept and design through to safe, operable and maintainable assets. Alongside project experience, you will follow a structured technical and professional development programme designed to progressively build your knowledge, practical experience and engineering judgement. It's your career, let's shape it together! The graduate programme is tailored to your needs with a flexible and varied learning environment, you'll feel empowered to make decisions and harness your knowledge and practical skills. The sky's the limit! Purpose of Role To develop the technical knowledge, practical experience and engineering judgement required to become a capable and increasingly independent Mechanical Engineer, while contributing to the successful delivery of water and wastewater projects. As your capability develops, you will progress from supported engineering activities towards ownership of defined mechanical design packages, supported by experienced engineers and a structured Graduate Development Programme (GDP). Key Responsibilities Collaborate with Process, Civil, EICA, Design, Delivery and other disciplines to develop safe, practical and cost-effective engineering solutions. Produce and contribute to mechanical design layouts, specifications, datasheets, equipment and pipeline schedules, calculations, reports and technical documentation. Support the development and review of 3D models and engineering visualisations, considering construction, operation, access and maintenance requirements. Develop mechanical solutions in accordance with project specifications, client asset standards, WIMES, relevant engineering standards and HSE guidance. Develop practical engineering knowledge of pumps, hydraulics, pipework, valves, materials, mechanical equipment, filtration, disinfection and water and wastewater treatment processes. Attend water and wastewater treatment sites to undertake surveys, condition assessments and design verification, developing an understanding of operational assets and site constraints. Prepare and contribute to design risk assessments, multidisciplinary design reviews, HAZOP studies and Operability & Maintenance (OpMan) reviews. Develop commercial awareness by understanding project deliverables, design allowances, programme, design costs and the impact of engineering decisions on project affordability. Engage with equipment manufacturers and suppliers through technical meetings, factory visits, Lunch & Learns and industry events. Develop deeper knowledge in selected mechanical or treatment areas, with opportunities to become a technical champion as your experience develops. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing, including lessons learned, technical presentations, engineering guidance and standard templates. Develop awareness of the responsible use of AI and digital tools to support engineering activities, while maintaining engineering judgement and appropriate verification. Graduate Programme Our structured three-year GDP is designed to develop you into a rounded Mechanical Engineer with strong technical foundations and practical Design & Build experience. You will benefit from: A structured development pathway that progressively builds technical knowledge, practical experience, responsibility and engineering judgement. Support from an established Mechanical Engineering team, together with a Mechanical Engineering buddy and professional-development mentor. Support towards professional registration with the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (IMechE) through the Monitored Professional Development Scheme (MPDS) and Graduate Development Log (GDL). Structured technical learning, including online training in hydraulics, pumping systems, pump selection and sizing, pump efficiency and variable-speed pumping, alongside water and wastewater treatment, engineering standards, CDM2015 and design safety. Opportunities to engage with the wider water industry, equipment manufacturers and suppliers, including opportunities to attend the Water Equipment Show (WES) and other technical events. A minimum six-month site placement during the GDP, providing practical exposure to procurement, supplier and contractor interaction, installation, construction, testing, commissioning and handover.

items.desc: About Predikt ‍ Predikt is a dynamic Swiss-Belgian deeptech company at the forefront of innovation, developing cutting-edge AI-driven technology. We are an AI-driven cost & margin intelligence platform built for enterprise procurement and finance teams, providing unmatched visibility into external cost drivers and their impact on margins. We empower organizations to navigate market volatility, proactively manage risks, protect profitability and make confident, data-driven decisions. As an early-stage startup, we are fueled by a strong sense of mission and enthusiasm, striving to make cost intelligence accessible to every procurement and finance leader across the globe. ‍ At Predikt, we are defined by our core values and high ambitions. We are a company that champions integrity, innovation and excellence, creating an environment where everyone supports each other and works collaboratively towards common goals. Our customer-centric approach ensures we deliver exceptional value and service, while fostering a culture of mutual respect, open communication, and continuous improvement. ‍ Join us on this exciting journey as we transform the way procurement and finance teams understand and act on cost and create a future where volatility is no longer a threat, but a challenge every organization is equipped to face with confidence. About the role As a Data Engineer, you're part of the Customer team, working behind the scenes to keep customer implementations and the Predikt platform running smoothly. You work independently based on clear input and requirements. You'll have some contact with the clients but your mainly focused on the engineering side. What you'll do Build, run and maintain data pipelines, including re-running scripts for specific periods when needed Set up and maintain technical environments (including SSO) and support deployments and releases Provide first-line bug fixing and technical troubleshooting Help prepare demos: clean and process data, and load the right data into demo environments Execute technical tasks and think along, working independently based on input gathered by others on the team What we're looking for A can-do mentality: you dive in, figure things out, and don't wait around when something is unclear A Master degree in a technical or IT-related field A first experience with Python and/or SQL and frontend technologies A structured, independent way of working Curiosity about data and systems, and a willingness to learn You are fluent in English, knowledge of Dutch is not required. Candidates must already have an unrestricted right to work in Belgium/EU at the time of application. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor a work permit (single permit) or visa for this role. Nice to have Exposure to cloud environments or deployment tooling An interest in scripting or automating repetitive tasks (real room to grow the role in that direction as you take on more ownership) What we offer Pay & perks A competitive salary and a stock option plan, so you share in the growth you help create. Meal vouchers of €8 per working day. Eco vouchers worth €250 per year. A net allowance per month for working from home and using your own equipment. Getting around Mobility budget or company car via Lizy: you choose what fits your life. Bike lease option. Our Leuven office is a 2-minute walk from the train station. Health Hospitalisation insurance via Alan. Flexibility Hybrid work, split between our Leuven office and home. Bring your own device: work with the tools you know best. A flexible reward plan is planned for 2027, so you can shape part of your package yourself. Team & culture A yearly offsite, sometimes in the Swiss Alps, sometimes closer to home. Plenty of moments together throughout the year: drinks, our Christmas dinner and other team activities. A culture of radical transparency, where open and honest communication is the norm. An early-stage startup that's growing fast, with room to take on more if you want it.

items.desc: Tasks Develop, deploy and maintain the real-time online tool that detects and visualizes global record-breaking and compounding extreme weather events as they occur. Set up, operate and maintain numerical and AI/ML-based climate models and aid in the setup of modeling experiments on MPI-GEA’s HPC systems Build and maintain a climate database, including reanalysis, observational, model and impact data, with reproducible workflows Develop and maintain analytical tools and shared code libraries for the research group (Co-)author scientific publications and present research at workshops and conferences Support group members in efficient data handling, machine learning workflows and good software practice (version control, testing, documentation) Ensure that data, code and tools are documented, and available for use by the wider community Profile PhD in climate, physics, math, data science, or related fields Experience with climate model data and gridded climate data tools and libraries (e.g. xarray, Dask, CDO) Experience with machine-learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) Experience with setting up climate or weather model simulations and with HPC environments Experience in web development and deploying interactive data platforms (e.g. web mapping and dashboards, containers, APIs) Good command of written and spoken English Our offer This full-time or part-time position with at least 34 hours/week will begin on the 1st of January, 2027, though some flexibility in start date is possible. The term is three years, with the option of an extension. Renumeration will follow the public service pay scale (TVöD Bund ) up to paygroup 13, according to the candidate’s qualifications and experience. You are entitled to an annual bonus, 31 days' holiday and time off on 24th and 31st December. We also offer attractive, family-friendly flexi-time and remote-working arrangements. A company pension scheme (VBL), an employer subsidy for public transport, the opportunity for further training, and language and health courses complete our offer. The Max Planck Society is committed to employing more individuals with disabilities and especially encourages them to apply. We are also committed to encouraging diversity and actively challenging biases based on gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion and other components of identity. We were honored with the TOTAL E-QUALITY award for the first time in 2023 for our commitment. The Max Planck Society supports the compatibility of family and career and is certified according to the "berufundfamilie" (“job and family”) audit. Your application should include: A cover letter A CV of no more than 3 pages A summary of research interests with max. 2 pages A list of scientific, peer-reviewed publications or examples of successful coding projects related to the position Contacts of two referees Any relevant certificates Position remains open until filled. About us The Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology (MPI-GEA) was founded in summer 2022 and is a dynamically growing, highly-interdisciplinary and international research institution. The research focuses on modeling and analyzing the interrelationships between biophysical and human-made systems, looking from the deep past to the future. The institute examines how humanity has driven the emergence of the Anthropocene – the period in which human activities began significantly impacting our planet’s climate and ecosystems – and identifying potential intervention points towards a more sustainable future. The Carl Zeiss Stiftung Independent Research Group on High-End Climate Risks (CZS-HECR) at MPI-GEA works towards an end-to-end understanding of worst-case climate outcomes, from unprecedented and compounding extremes to their societal impacts. The group combines fundamental physical process understanding rooted in climate physics and Earth System analyses, targeted climate model experiments, advanced statistics, including machine-learning- and explainable AI to deliver usable climate risk estimates under current and future climates for core societal sectors such as health, food, energy and finance. Contact Dr. Kai Kornhuber Email: kornhuber@gea.mpg.de Max-Planck-Institute for the Science of Human Kahlaische Straße 10 07745 Jena gea.mpg.de Twitter: @MPI_GEA

The research group focuses on the development of new cancer therapeutics such as antibodies, antibody derivatives, and modified mRNA cancer vaccines using in vitro screening platforms and cell and molecular techniques. The position will provide a unique opportunity to pursue basic and translational research with the aim to identify novel targets and strategies for cancer immunotherapy. Further information on the activity of the research group can be accessed at http://ous-research.no/sioud/. To date, the group has published 220 scientific papers, all of which are indexed in PubMed. Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Experience designing and operating CI/CD infrastructure , including runners, jobs, artifacts, caching, parallel execution and failure recovery. Experience with Docker and software deployment/configuration. Experience with HIL, embedded or edge devices (Jetson), robotics or ROS2 is a strong plus, but previous robotics experience is not required. You are at ease communicating in English. Your work will directly reduce repetitive manual efforts across the team and strengthen the overall reliability of our products. items.desc: Band 3 Radiology Department Assistant It is essential that you complete the Care Certificate and cannulation course in order to be up-banded to Band 3 Are you a caring, enthusiastic and hard working person looking to make a big impact? We are looking for dedicated and caring Radiology Department assistants to support our brand new, state of the art Community Diagnostic Centre (CDC) at Milford, Surrey. The CDC Is part of Royal Surrey’s continuing investment in its diagnostic capabilities and follows refurbishment of the Trust’s interventional suite, MRI and X-ray facilities You should have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work well within a team. You will be expected to complete a Care Certificate Induction for your first two weeks in order to bring you up to speed regarding what is required for you in the position. This take up to two weeks (dependent on previous experience.) After a settling in period, you will be offered the opportunity to complete a cannulation course, which will allow you to progress to a band 3 position once competence has been confirmed. Applications are welcome from those with unrestricted right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this role. This roles provides support to the department in providing patient focused, efficient service in a caring, professional and timely manner. This is a patient focused role. You will assist out-patients during their time in the radiology department from transferring the patients to and from the departments, greeting them on arrival, assisting with their preparation for the examinations, and helping to provide a pleasant experience. You will also take on some admin roles which may include, booking patients in for the appointment, stock management and room preparation for both CT and MRI examinations. Training for all will be provided. Our Radiology department at Royal Surrey is made up of 5 X-ray rooms, 4 CT scanners, 3 MRI scanners, 10 Ultrasound machines, an IR suite and 8 theatre machines. As well as 2 mammography machines and two OPG machines, one of which has CBCT capabilities. This year, we are working on our Interventional strategy which will hopefully see us moving from 1 to 3 interventional suites in the next 5-10 years and restructure the whole department to improve the experience and service we can provide to our patients. Additionally we have 3 community sites situated at Haslemere, Milford and Cranleigh, which provide an additional 3 x ray rooms, 4 Ultrasound rooms, a CT scanner and 2 MRI scanners. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The post holder will support the provision of a high quality diagnostic service to patients, visitors and staff within the Radiology Department. They will facilitate an efficient work flow between the scanner and support in an admin position where required. The post holder will provide an efficient and friendly service or patients undergoing Radiology examinations and provide any administrative support required, to ensure that the unit is running efficiently. They will assist with patient and room preparation, perform admin role and support the Radiographers where required. This post works closely and efficiently with the radiology team. Please note, this role will start as a band 2 position and be up-banded to band 3 once competency for cannulation and completion of the Care Certificate have been completed .

items.title: Ingénieur·e de recherche en IA et data science pour la R&D et l’industrie F/H
items.card: vos missions seront les suivantes : Identifier, cadrer et mener des projets de recherche appliquée en IA et data science. Concevoir, développer et évaluer des agents IA experts et des architectures agentiques capables de mobiliser des connaissances scientifiques, de raisonner sur des problématiques métier et d’utiliser des outils, des modèles et des sources de données pour assister les workflows de recherche :
items.desc: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous ? Au sein de la R&D de Saint-Gobain, l’équipe de Data Science développe et déploie des approches d’intelligence artificielle au service des activités scientifiques et industrielles du Groupe. L’équipe combine des compétences en analyse de données, statistiques, machine learning, IA générative, systèmes agentiques et graphes de connaissances pour accélérer la compréhension des phénomènes, la capitalisation des connaissances, la conception des matériaux et des procédés, ainsi que la transformation des pratiques de R&D. Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes : Identifier, cadrer et mener des projets de recherche appliquée en IA et data science. Concevoir, développer et évaluer des agents IA experts et des architectures agentiques capables de mobiliser des connaissances scientifiques, de raisonner sur des problématiques métier et d’utiliser des outils, des modèles et des sources de données pour assister les workflows de recherche : recherche bibliographique, génération d’hypothèses, expérimentation, simulation, aide à la décision et production de livrables. Développer des méthodes d’analyse de données et de machine learning adaptées aux données scientifiques et industrielles : statistiques, apprentissage supervisé et non supervisé, modèles probabilistes, optimisation, séries temporelles, traitement d’images ou de signaux. Développer des prototypes robustes et sécurisés avec les équipes scientifiques et IT, en intégrant les usages afin de favoriser leur adoption et la transformation IA de la R&D. Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique, valoriser les résultats et développer des collaborations avec les équipes du Groupe et des partenaires académiques. Des déplacements ponctuels de courte durée sont à prévoir en France et à l’étranger (visites d’usines, conférences, formations…). Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ? Doctorat dans une discipline scientifique avec une forte composante en machine learning / IA, ou doctorat en ML/IA appliqué à des données et problématiques scientifiques ou industrielles. Les candidatures présentant un autre parcours, avec une expérience significative en recherche appliquée, seront également étudiées. Vous avez une bonne compréhension des modèles de langage et de leurs usages. Une première expérience du développement d’agents IA, de systèmes multi-agents ou de l’évaluation de LLM est appréciée, sans être indispensable. Vous maîtrisez Python et les bonnes pratiques de développement ; une familiarité avec le cloud Azure est un plus. Vous êtes à l’aise pour contribuer à plusieurs projets, travailler avec autonomie, proposer des orientations et communiquer clairement avec des interlocutrices et interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques ou non spécialistes. L’entraide, l’écoute et la coopération font partie de votre manière de travailler. Atouts supplémentaires : une connaissance ou un intérêt pour les graphes de connaissances, le product management et l’expérience utilisateur. Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Nous savons qu’une candidature ne correspond pas toujours à 100 % des critères. Si ce poste vous intéresse et que vous pensez pouvoir y apporter votre contribution, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

items.desc: Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan den senaste AI-forskningen och praktisk mjukvaruutveckling? Är du en skicklig utvecklare som använder AI och agentbaserade utvecklingsverktyg för att snabbt gå från idé till fungerande prototyp eller system? Vill du dessutom använda din kompetens för att stärka Sveriges totalförsvar? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i framkant och omsätta nya forskningsresultat till lösningar med verklig samhällsnytta. Om tjänsten Som forskningsingenjör arbetar du med att utveckla och utforska intelligenta informationssystem för försvar och säkerhet – exempelvis AI-drivna beslutsstöd, agentiska system och lösningar för avancerad informationsanalys. En central del av arbetet är att snabbt omsätta nya idéer, tekniker och forskningsresultat till fungerande prototyper som kan demonstreras, utvärderas och vidareutvecklas. Du arbetar AI-native, där kodagenter och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling är naturliga delar av utvecklingsprocessen. Du följer kontinuerligt forsknings- och teknikfronten, utvärderar nya metoder och tekniska genombrott och prövar lovande resultat i egna experiment och prototyper. Hos oss får du Möjlighet att arbeta i framkant inom AI och agentisk mjukvaruutveckling, där du får experimentera med nya utvecklingsmetoder och utforska nya sätt att utveckla mjukvara där människor och AI-agenter arbetar tillsammans. Du får stort inflytande över arkitektur, tekniska lösningar och val av verktyg och arbetar med komplexa och samhällsviktiga problem inom försvar och säkerhet. Du blir en del av en miljö där forskare och ingenjörer arbetar nära varandra och där kreativitet, utforskande och kontinuerligt lärande uppmuntras. Om organisationen Du kommer att ingå i verksamhetsområdet Ledningssystem. Verksamhetsområdet arbetar med forskning och utveckling av metoder och tekniker för informationshantering och beslutsfattande, främst på uppdrag från Försvarsmakten men även inom europeiska forskningsprojekt och tillsammans med civila myndigheter. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? items.desc: Machine Learning Scientist, Generative Modelling Location: London | Type: Full-time About the company A fast-growing TechBio company that develops new medicines by combining single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning. The team is highly interdisciplinary, with biology, computation, and engineering working side by side in state-of-the-art wet and dry labs. The opportunity Help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour. Your work will be central to understanding and controlling cellular decision-making, which enables new therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models. You’ll have access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced compute infrastructure, and modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows. You’ll also see your models tested directly in experimental biology. What you’ll do Design and implement generative modelling approaches that learn intervention effects from diverse biological data, including single-cell perturbation experiments. Develop models that go beyond correlation, with a focus on generalisation, counterfactual prediction, and experimental design. Work with experimental teams to design and validate computational hypotheses, iterating to identify the highest-signal next experiment. Evaluate models for causal coherence, mechanistic fidelity, and real-world utility, not just fit. Communicate findings clearly to colleagues across disciplines. What you’ll bring A PhD in ML, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field. Deep expertise in generative modelling. Strong foundations in probabilistic modelling, representation learning, or neural network architectures for structured or sequential data. Excellent Python skills and familiarity with scalable ML tooling and high-performance computing. A disciplined approach to model evaluation, including experiments that test real-world utility beyond standard benchmarks. Willingness to engage deeply with biological data. Experience with single-cell or perturbation datasets is a strong plus. Nice to have A track record of impactful ML publications or open-source contributions. Experience in interdisciplinary teams or applying ML in real-world settings.

items.desc: Job Description Version française de l’offre disponible sur demande. Our Perception and Navigation Team is expanding to meet new challenges! To serve new industrial use cases ever more reliably, our humanoid robot must be able to detect multiple objects of interest and estimate their poses. It must also be able to understand its environment in order to navigate safely and autonomously. Our team is responsible for developing the knowledge and the codebase needed to address these challenges. We explore a range of state-of-the-art techniques, whether based on machine learning, classical computer vision, or model-based control. The Perception and Navigation team is part of the AI & Control department and works closely with other members of this department. It also collaborates regularly with other R&D teams: embedded software, electronics, and mechanics. Your Responsibilities May Include Selecting the most suitable vision/perception sensors for our needs Conducting literature reviews related to ongoing projects Presenting the latest innovations from the literature or internally developed algorithms to the team Developing algorithms for object detection, pose estimation, or feature recognition Creating a map of the environment that can be used to understand and navigate it Developing navigation and control algorithms for various robots, including autonomous navigation for humanoid robots and navigation assistance for exoskeletons Working closely with other teams to ensure the overall performance of the algorithms Testing on real robots and in simulation Traveling to customer sites (e.g., healthcare centers or factories) to ensure algorithms function properly in real-world conditions and making corrections as needed Automated testing, code quality, and designing verification pipelines to ensure non-regression Preferred Experience Qualifications : Engineering degree or PhD in perception, navigation, machine learning, robotics, or a similar field. Experience We are looking for various seniority levels. Academic experience will be highly valued, particularly in relation to perception or the use of point clouds, navigation or optimal control, machine learning, etc. Ideally, you have experience in software development (Python/C++), particularly in a team (version control tools, modularity, responding to specifications, continuous integration, etc.). You are creative and innovative. You are comfortable in developing new things with a limited existing base and making prototypes (personal or professional robotics projects are valued). You enjoy experimental work and adapting algorithms to the constraints of real-world environments and commercial products. You are comfortable with general algorithmic, and in particular with linear algebra (matrix calculations), and physical modeling (reference frame changes, odometry, etc.). You are rigorous, able to proofread your work, and explain your calculations or algorithms clearly. You are curious and have good analytical skills, enabling you to monitor technological developments effectively and learn from scientific literature or meetings at conferences. Skills (hard And Softskills) Python - Expert level C++ - Expert level Vision (feature detection, mapping, SLAM) - Expert level Navigation (path planning, path tracking…) - Expert level Machine learning (data analysis, augmentation, labeling, validation) - Autonomous level Robotics (kinematics, odometry, real data analysis) - Autonomous level Linear algebra, numerical optimization - Autonomous level Control systems (observers, controllers) - Basic knowledge Continuous analysis of the state of the art in the field - Autonomous level Software development best practices, continuous integration, automated testing - Autonomous level Who are they? At Wandercraft we pioneer intelligent robotics to help people do what they can’t do. We apply the most advanced robotics and AI to expand what’s possible for humans in the fields of healthcare and now industry. Founded in 2012, Wandercraft is globally recognized for creating the world’s first self-balancing walking exoskeleton, Atalante X, which is used in more than 100 rehabilitation centers across four continents helping individuals with disabilities re-learn how to walk, with over a million steps taken each month. Building on over a decade of real-world experience and a proprietary neural network trained on billions of steps, we’re bringing mobility beyond clinical settings and into the home. Our personal exoskeleton, Eve, is a first-of-its-kind device designed to assist wheelchair users in standing and walking in everyday life. Now we’re expanding our platform to support industrial and assistive tasks with the Calvin family of humanoid robots. Built in just 40 days, Calvin-40 is designed to relieve factory workers from hazardous labor. Future versions of Calvin will assist persons with reduced autonomy in their daily activities. Our growth into home and industrial robotics opens new …

items.desc: Wir sind Oberösterreichs größte Bildungs- und Forschungseinrichtung mit 27.000 Studierenden und 4.500 Mitarbeitenden. Interesse, an Österreichs wohl schönster Campusuniversität die Zukunft mitzugestalten? Wir besetzen zum ehestmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine: Tenure-Track Stelle „Intelligent Biosignal Processing“ mit Doktorat/Ph.D. im vollen Beschäftigungsausmaß (befristet auf 6 Jahre) an der Universitätsklinik für Anästhesiologie und Operative Intensivmedizin der Medizinischen Fakultät und am Linz Institute of Technology (LIT) der Johannes Kepler Universität Linz Die Tenure-Track Professur ist mit einer Person mit Doktorat/PhD nach dem Kollektivvertrag der Arbeitnehmer*innen der Universitäten und dem Universitätsgesetz 2002 (UG) im vollen Beschäftigungsausmaß (40 Wochenstunden) befristet auf sechs Jahre zu besetzen. Die Tenure-Track Professur wird der Universitätsklinik für Anästhesiologie und Operative Intensivmedizin an der Medizinischen Fakultät erst- und dem Linz Institute of Technology Artificial Intelligence LAB (LIT AI LAB) zweitzugeordnet. Die Stelle ist für hochqualifizierte Nachwuchswissenschafter*innen mit einem Doktorat/PhD aus dem medizinischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Biologie, Biochemie, Informatik, o.ä.) eingerichtet und bietet die Möglichkeit des Abschlusses einer Qualifizierungsvereinbarung und damit – nach positiver Entscheidung – einer Dauerstelle als Assoziierte*r Professor*in (§ 99 Abs 5 und 6 UG). Mit der ausgeschriebenen Tenure-Track- Professur Intelligent Biosignal Processing soll der Aufbau des Erweiterungsstudiums „Medical AI“ an der JKU maßgeblich vorangetrieben und gemeinsam mit dem Zentrum für Medizinische Lehre organisiert werden. Von dem*der erfolgreichen Bewerber*in wird weiters erwartet, im Rahmen der Forschungsaktivitäten an der JKU, mathematische Modellierung, maschinelles Lernen und medizinische Signalverarbeitung zu verbinden, um diagnostische Verfahren zu optimieren. Die Methoden sollen sowohl der Verbesserung der Signalqualität als auch der Untersuchung der Relevanz der Signale im Hinblick auf unterschiedliche pathologische Prozesse dienen. Besonderes Augenmerk wird bei allen Analysen auf die klinische Anwendbarkeit der erhaltenen Ergebnisse gelegt. Sämtliche Analysen sind daher eng mit der klinischen Bedeutung und Aussagekraft verbunden. Der*Die Stelleninhaber*in der Tenure-Track Professur für Intelligent Biosignal Processing soll eine hohe Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären und zur interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Fachrichtungen sowie zu Berufsgruppen der Pflege und medizinisch-technischen Diensten mitbringen. Der*Die Kandidat*in muss bereits eine wissenschaftliche Tätigkeit nach dem Doktorat/PhD und sollte weiters exzellente Publikationen und Lehrerfahrung sowie erfolgreiche Drittmittelakquise vorweisen, wobei der Abschluss des Doktorats-/Ph.D.-Studiums höchstens 10 Jahre zurückliegen sollte (Karriereunterbrechungen auf Grund von Elternkarenz, Wehr(ersatz)dienst, usw. sind abzuziehen). Die detaillierte Stellenbeschreibung sowie Hinweise zu den Voraussetzungen finden Sie unter www.jku.at/tenuretrack . Dem Stellenprofil können Sie Informationen über die strategische Positionierung der Stelle im Bereich der Forschung, die Schwerpunktzuordnung, die erwartete Art von Forschung, der erwartete Umfang der Beiträge zum Lehrangebot, die erforderliche Praxiserfahrung, die wesentlichen Qualifizierungsziele, die im Rahmen der Stelle erreicht werden sollen, wesentliche Informationen über die bestehende Forschungsinfrastruktur und weitere stellenspezifische Anforderungen entnehmen. Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt beträgt auf Basis einer Vollzeitbeschäftigung EUR 70.200,20 brutto pro Jahr. Nach Abschluss der Qualifizierungsvereinbarung erhöht sich das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt auf EUR 82.656,00 brutto jährlich. Das endgültige Gehalt wird im Rahmen der Berufungsverhandlung mit dem Rektor verhandelt. An der JKU wird Leistung im Kontext der jeweiligen Biografie und der Möglichkeiten einer Person berücksichtigt. Damit wird anerkannt, dass wissenschaftliche Leistungen in unterschiedliche Lebensläufe (wie reduziertes Beschäftigungsausmaß oder Unterbrechung der Erwerbstätigkeit aufgrund von Pflege, Kinderbetreuung, etc.) eingebettet sein können. Qualifikationen werden daher im Sinne der Chancengerechtigkeit unter Berücksichtigung biografischer Faktoren wie des akademischen Alters bewertet. Die Johannes Kepler Universität strebt eine Erhöhung des Anteils an Frauen im wissenschaftlichen Personal an und fordert deshalb qualifizierte Frauen nachdrücklich auf, sich zu bewerben. Bei gleicher Qualifikation wird bevorzugt eine Frau berufen. Bewerber*innen mit dem Status begünstigt behindert werden bei entsprechender Eignung besonders berücksichtigt. items.desc: Är du en erfaren AI/ML-utvecklare som vill utveckla och produktionssätta lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt? Då kan du vara en bra match för oss på Softhouse! Vad vi kommer att göra tillsammans 🧑‍💻 Som AI/ML-utvecklare på Softhouse hjälper du våra kunder att planera, bygga och realisera sina AI/ML-projekt i olika leveranser och kunduppdrag. Du tar helhetsansvar för maskininlärningsmodellers livscykel, från datainsamling och utveckling, till utvärdering och stabil driftsättning i produktion. Vårt AI-team arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans i leveranser och träffas regelbundet för att diskutera utmaningar och dela kunskap. Här ges du utrymme och möjlighet att vara med och utveckla Softhouse erbjudande inom AI samt skapa värde och driva innovation för våra kunder. Vad vi söker hos dig 📌 På Softhouse värdesätter vi vår konsultmässighet högt. För oss handlar det inte bara om dina tekniska färdigheter, utan också om att du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och driven med förmåga att bygga förtroende hos våra kunder. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har minst 3 års erfarenhet inom: AI/ML-utveckling i Python Implementering och produktionssättning av maskininlärningsmodeller. Hela ML-livscykeln, från datainsamling och utveckling, till modellträning, utvärdering och driftsättning. Vi tror att du har en masterexamen eller PhD inom Teknisk Matematik, Teknisk Fysik, Datateknik, Elektroteknik eller motsvarande. Då konsultrollen innebär mycket kundkontakt krävs det att du är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av MLOps, on-premises-implementering och driftsättning av AI-lösningar, samt hantering av stora datamängder. Lite av vad vi erbjuder 🤝 Ett stabilt och välmående bolag där du och din work-life balance är i fokus En mix av spännande inhouseprojekt och teamleveranser tillsammans med dina Softhouse-kollegor samt externa uppdrag Skräddarsydd utvecklingsplan och aktiv kunskapsdelning med andra Softhouse-kollegor Ett team som gillar att göra saker tillsammans för att förhöja vardagen - allt från hälsofrämjande aktiviteter till gemensamma frukostar och aw’s Ett värderingsstyrt bolag där vi alla känner igen oss i våra värdeord: Team, Enkelhet, Mod och Passion Lite mer om oss på Softhouse! 🏡 På Softhouse är vi ca 300 medarbetare fördelade på 8 orter i Sverige och ett kontor i Sarajevo. I Stockholm hittar du oss på Tegnérgatan, högst upp i en härlig vindsvåning, där vi är närmare 40 kollegor. I Uppsala huserar våra konsulter på Svartbäcksgatan med utsikt över Domkyrkan. Vi har kodat mjukvara sedan 1996, och arbetar tillsammans varje dag för att skapa lösningar som motsvarar våra kunders behov och överträffar deras förväntningar. Låter det intressant? Vårt urval sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de producto y negocio para identificar oportunidades donde la IA pueda aportar valor estratégico. Investigar y evaluar nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y metodologías en el campo de la IA y GENAI. Participar activamente en la definición de la arquitectura de soluciones de IA, asegurando escalabilidad, eficiencia y mantenibilidad. Trabajar con plataformas y servicios de Microsoft Azure para la construcción y despliegue de soluciones de IA. Optimizar el rendimiento de los modelos y las aplicaciones de IA. Documentar el proceso de desarrollo, los modelos y las decisiones de diseño. Mantenerse al día de las últimas tendencias y avances en IA, GENAI y Microsoft Foundry. Contribuir a la cultura de innovación y aprendizaje continuo dentro del equipo. Beneficios Seguro médico completo. Oportunidades de formación continua: Idiomas, Certificaciones técnicas relevantes (ej. Azure AI), Bootcamps especializados y mucho más. Participación en multitud de eventos: BETWEEN Night, Torneo de Padel, actividades de team building y mucho más. Retribución flexible: Opciones para optimizar tus beneficios en restaurante, transporte, guardería y otros. Incentivos por validar o recomendar talento. Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo. Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo de carrera. Participación en proyectos innovadores y de vanguardia tecnológica. Requisitos Requisitos Experiencia mínima de 4 años en el campo de la Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning. Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia práctica en Generative AI (GENAI) y LLMs. Experiencia con el ecosistema de Microsoft, especialmente con servicios de IA en Azure (ej. Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Machine Learning). Dominio de lenguajes de programación como Python y sus librerías asociadas (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.). Conocimientos en arquitecturas de Deep Learning. Experiencia en el ciclo de vida completo del desarrollo de modelos de ML (desde la experimentación hasta la puesta en producción). Ingeniería Informática, Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, o campo relacionado, o experiencia práctica equivalente.

items.desc: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. About The Role You’ll be building AI models that make human-like conversations possible. You’ll work at the intersection of speech, language, and intelligence, taking cutting-edge research and transforming it into real-time, scalable systems that power our core products. You’ll have the unique opportunity to make a huge impact as one of our first ML hires, shaping not only the technology but also the direction of our company. From designing robust models to deploying them in production, you’ll own the entire lifecycle of ML systems and help us stay ahead of the curve in AI innovation. About The Role Design, build, and maintain scalable ML systems — from data ingestion and preprocessing to training, testing, and deployment. Develop and optimize end-to-end ML pipelines (data collection, labeling, training, validation, monitoring) to ensure reliability and reproducibility. Implement robust MLOps practices, including model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, and continuous monitoring in production. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate and deploy models into real-time products with a focus on efficiency and scalability. Ensure data quality, observability, and performance across all AI systems. Stay current with the latest in AI infrastructure, tooling, and research — helping us stay ahead of the curve. Must Have Strong experience in machine learning, deep learning, and NLP. Solid background in MLOps and data pipelines — e.g., model deployment, monitoring, and scaling in production environments. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with Go. Experience with ML lifecycle management tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases). Ability to design ML systems for robustness, scalability, and automation. Strong coding, debugging, and data engineering skills. Passion for AI infrastructure and its real-world impact. Founder mindset: ownership, independence, and willingness to go deep. Nice to Have Experience in speech recognition, TTS, or audio processing. Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, or real-time inference systems. Hands-on experience with data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster). Prior experience in startup environments with fast iteration cycles. Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). Why join us? Join a world-class team of engineers and builders. Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage. Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. items.desc: Combineer technologie en innovatie en maak positieve impact op de wereld! Onze oplossingen helpen voedselverspilling te verminderen, productieketens duurzamer te maken en de kwaliteit van voedsel en planten te verhogen. Zo dragen we bij aan een gezondere en efficiëntere wereld. Sluit jij je aan bij ons team en help je mee het verschil te maken? Een klant komt met een duidelijke vraag: kan ons systeem onderscheid maken tussen rijp en onrijp fruit of zelfs rotte exemplaren detecteren, voordat het verpakt wordt? Jij stapt in de auto, laptop in de tas, richting productielocatie. Daar observeer je de lijn. Hoe ligt het fruit op de band? Hoe moet je belichten, kunnen we de juiste data verzamelen? Camera positioneren, belichting afstellen, eerste beelden schieten. Binnen no-time staat er een kleine testomgeving waar jij data verzamelt. Ruwe beelden, maar waardevol. Op kantoor duik je in de beelden. Je zoekt patronen, afwijkingen, bruikbare kenmerken. Je stelt niet alleen vast wat zichtbaar moet zijn, maar ook hoe het visionmodel daarop moet kunnen reageren. Misschien ontwikkel je een eenvoudige pre-analyse, of overleg je met een collega over de keuze tussen een traditioneel algoritme of een neuraal netwerk. Uiteindelijk lever je niet alleen beelddata of een stukje techniek, je selecteert de camera's en lenzen en je configureert de belichting zoals vereist door het project. Technisch inzicht en kennis kan jij vertalen naar gerealiseerde, praktische oplossingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Vision Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen, analyseren en implementeren van industriële vision-oplossingen binnen geautomatiseerde systemen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige traject: van probleemanalyse en het selecteren van geschikte camera’s, lenzen en verlichting, tot het verzamelen en analyseren van beeldmateriaal en het opstellen van duidelijke eisen voor algoritmeontwikkeling. Je combineert een technische en wetenschappelijke aanpak met een goed gevoel voor praktische toepasbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met onze software developers, system engineers en projectteams om ervoor te zorgen dat de visionoplossing robuust, herhaalbaar en goed te integreren is. Denk aan projecten zoals bovenstaande, een eierinspectiesysteem dat afwijkingen herkent voordat het ei de volgende productiefase ingaat, of een cameraopstelling die plantjes scant op groei en gezondheid. Je combineert je kennis van algoritmen met praktische inzichten om het optimale resultaat te bereiken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Opstellen van functionele en technische requirements voor vision-systemen. Plannen en uitvoeren van beeldacquisities (zowel intern als op locatie), inclusief opstelling en parametrisering. Analyseren van ruwe beelddata en evalueren van algoritmische aanpakken in samenwerking met vision developers. Documenteren van waarnemingen, keuzes en systeemparameters in gestructureerde technische documentatie. Selecteren van geschikte hardware: camera’s, lenzen en belichtingsopstellingen, afgestemd op producttype, snelheid, nauwkeurigheid en omgevingscondities. Samenwerken met software developers aan de implementatie van vision pipelines, inclusief annotatiebehoeften, model keuzes en testprocedures. Afstemmen met system engineers om de visionoplossing integraal af te stemmen op de mechanische en automatiseringsarchitectuur van de machine. Actief bijdragen aan FAT/SAT en validatietesten: je controleert niet alleen of het systeem werkt, maar ook waarom. Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses, haalbaarheidsstudies en performance-evaluaties op basis van datasetkwaliteit en systeemparameters. Volgen van technologische ontwikkelingen in visiontechnologie (bijv. 2D/3D vision, hyperspectral, AI) en deze vertalen naar interne toepasbaarheid. Betrokkenheid bij innovatietrajecten bij onze R&D-afdeling. Wat kunnen we je bieden? Bij Viscon werk je in een innovatieve en groeiende organisatie die wereldwijd impact maakt met slimme technologische oplossingen. Wij zorgen goed voor onze medewerkers en bieden jou: Een salaris tot €5.800 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen. Met volgend jaar een uitbreiding van 2 ATV-dagen. Reiskosten- (ook de kiltunnel) en thuiswerkvergoeding. Een goede overurenregeling. Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling (slechts 4% eigen bijdrage). Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega’s. Internationale projecten en veel afwisseling in je werk. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een Vision Engineer die nieuwsgierig is, analytisch denkt en graag samenwerkt. Verder vragen we: HBO of WO-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals Computer Vision, Kunstmatige Intelligentie, Mechatronica, of Elektrotechniek + Technische informatica. Je spreekt zowel Nederlands als Engels en bent woonachtig in Nederland. Ervaring met industriële beeldverwerking en/of vision-systemen in een praktische setting (R&D, productie, integratie, testing). items.desc: Om stillingen Institutt for informasjonsteknologi ved Fakultet for teknologi, kunst og design har en ledig åremålsstilling som stipendiat innen pålitelig KI med verifikasjon av kunnskap. Nåværende arbeidssted for stillingen er på campus Pilestredet i Oslo. I forbindelse med etableringen av ny campus på Lillestrøm kan det bli aktuelt med endring av arbeidssted på et senere tidspunkt. Dine ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver vil være å Dette prosjektet er banebrytende i utviklingen av et nevro-symbolsk KI-rammeverk som adresserer den kritiske «hallusinasjons»-barrieren i generativ KI (GenAI). Per i dag fungerer GenAI-modeller som probabilistiske «svarte bokser» som ofte produserer plausible, men faktisk feilaktig informasjon uten kildehenvisning. Dette utgjør uakseptable risikoer, særlig i høyrisiko-domener som for eksempel utdanning, trafikksikkerhet og fornybar energi. For å håndtere dette utvikler prosjektet et generaliserbart nevro-symbolsk verifikasjonsrammeverk, med mål om systematisk å transformere GenAI til etterprøvbare, verifiserbare og sosialt ansvarlige systemer for høy-risiko- og datafattige domener. Prosjektet undersøker hybride rammeverk hvor GenAI fungerer som semantiske tolkningsmoduler, mens symbolske logikkmoduler — som resonerer over strukturerte grafer eller regler — fungerer som faktasjekkere. Stipendiaten Vil Utføre Følgende Oppgaver rammeverk design og implementering utvikling av resonneringsalgoritmer og validering. Det primære bruksområdet bygger på en KI-forsterket nettplattform for nord-samisk språklæring. Doktorgradsprosjektet vil utvikle en modulær verifikasjonsmotor integrerti plattformen for å sikre at KI-generert innhold er språklig korrekt og kulturelt passende. To tilleggstilfeller kan velges for å teste generaliserbarheten til det foreslåtte rammeverket: autonom kjøring og informasjonsmodellering for bærekraft. Det forventes at PhD prosjektet involverer akademisk samarbeid med Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT, Germany). Stillingen lyses ut som 3 år med 100% forskning, eller 4 år med 75% forskning og 25% annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Det er et mål at kandidaten skal fullføre PhD-programmet/-graden innenfor den besluttede tidsrammen. Beslutningen om 3- eller 4- årigstilling vil bli diskutert som en del av intervjuene i ansettelsesprosessen. Som stipendiat ved OsloMet har du mulighet til å søke om stipend for lengre forskningsopphold i utlandet. Kvalifikasjonskrav Mastergrad/hovedfag innen informatikk, matematikk, ingeniørfag eller tilsvarende relaterte fagdisipliner. Graden må normalt inneholde 120 studiepoeng (ECTS). Det vil være en fordel om du har dokumentert sterk kompetanse innen programmering, for eksempel Python. gode analytiske evner og matematisk grunnlag, med en stor interesse for å anvende formell logikk på generative modeller. kjennskap til kunnskapsrepresentasjon (f.eks. kunnskapsgrafer og semantiske teknologier); formell resonnering er en fordel. Applicants should have obtained a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The appointment is within the framework of the EPSRC Quantum
items.desc: Salary £38 – £46 pa Job Type Contract Work Pattern Full-time Posted 20 Oct 2026 (Yesterday) {}); } }"> Share Save job Create job alert Salary £38 – £46 pa Job Type Contract Work Pattern Full-time Posted 20 Oct 2026 (Yesterday) {}); } }"> Share Save job Create job alert About The Role Applications are invited for a 12 months full-time postdoctoral position (with the possibility for extension) in Experimental Quantum Technology at the University of Sussex. Applicants should have obtained a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The appointment is within the framework of the EPSRC Quantum Technology Hub: Quantum Computing via Integrated and Interconnected Implementations. The successful candidate will work in a team of experienced researchers led by Prof Matthias Keller. The aim of the project is to combine two of the most successful techniques in quantum information processing, trapped ions and photons, and use them to create a distributed quantum network. The main challenge is the implementation of an efficient ion-photon interface based on strongly-coupled cavity-QED. We have developed a multi-zone ion trap that incorporates zones for loading, quantum information processing, and a cavity-based ion-photon interface. The first part of the project is to test and characterise the ion trap system and implement a highly efficient ion-photon interface. This involves the setting up and testing of the system as well as simulating and implementing novel schemes for ion-photon entanglement. Based on successful testing of the multi-zone trap, a second system will be established to implement a basic quantum network. About You Ideally, you will have a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The project requires working with a complex optical system with diode lasers, ultra-high vacuum systems, and control electronics to operate the experiment. Having experience and a good understanding of such systems is highly beneficial. About Our School We are a research-intensive School that simultaneously delivers outstanding teaching to our students. As such we aim to be consistently recognised as truly world leading in key areas of our science, by extending the international excellence, impact and visibility of our research. We aim to be within the top UK universities in our discipline areas, attracting high-quality students at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. We will establish a reputation as having a particularly open, stimulating, collaborative and supportive working environment for both staff and students, enabling the best possible outcomes for research, teaching and learning. We will further enhance our links with non-academic actors on local, national and international scales, and will maximize the impact of our work. Why work here Find Out More About Our Reward And Benefits Package. Find out about our equality, diversity and inclusion. Further Key Information Please contact Matthias Keller () for informal enquiries. The University is committed to equality and valuing diversity, and applications are particularly welcomed from women and black and minority ethnic candidates, who are under-represented in academic posts in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Mathematics (STEMM) at Sussex. The University of Sussex values the diversity of its staff and students, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Eligibility The University requires that work undertaken for the University is performed in the UK.
