The postholder will work closely with researchers, clinicians and external partners to support the development of robust, reproducible and predictive human disease models. The Successful Candidate Will Have A PhD
items.desc: The UK Hub for Predictive and AI-Enabled Human Disease Models is a UK national research initiative funded by the Medical Research Council (MRC), which aims to translate academic New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) into validated, industry-ready systems. The Hub brings together leading scientists, clinicians and commercial organisations to accelerate the development, validation and adoption of predictive human disease models for biomedical research, drug discovery and experimental medicine. The Hub is based at the Cambridge Stem Cell Institute (CSCI), University of Cambridge. The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Matthias Zilbauer at the Cambridge Stem Cell Institute. The group specialises in human intestinal stem cell biology, organoid technology and the study of intestinal health and disease, with a particular focus on epithelial biology and epigenetic regulation. We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Postdoctoral Research Associate to contribute to the development, optimisation and validation of human intestinal organoid models as part of this ambitious national programme. The postholder will play a key role in expanding the human intestinal organoid biobank, contributing to the Hub's target of establishing an additional 2,000 organoid lines. They will develop and optimise organoid culture systems, support the introduction of automated culture workflows and undertake molecular and epigenetic profiling, including DNA methylation profiling, spatial transcriptomics and other multi-omics approaches. The role will involve independent and collaborative research, including the development of functional assays and application of molecular and cellular techniques to characterise intestinal organoid models. The postholder will work closely with researchers, clinicians and external partners to support the development of robust, reproducible and predictive human disease models. The Successful Candidate Will Have A PhD in Stem Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated hands-on experience in establishing, maintaining, expanding and cryopreserving human intestinal organoid cultures. Experience with molecular biology techniques and molecular profiling approaches, including DNA methylation, transcriptomics or related multi-omics methods. Experience with CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing or related genetic manipulation techniques. Basic knowledge or experience of bioinformatic analysis. Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to undertake independent research and work collaboratively. Experience with advanced imaging, flow cytometry, organoid-derived monolayers or automated cell culture workflows would be advantageous. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a major national research initiative, working at the interface of human stem cell biology, disease modelling and translational research. The position offers opportunities to develop new experimental approaches, work with academic and industry partners, and contribute to research with applications in biomedical science and drug discovery. Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD, an equivalent research doctorate. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will be appointed at Research Assistant level (Grade 5), which will be amended to Research Associate once PhD has been awarded. Full-time: 1.0 FTE Fixed-term until 31/03/2030 Informal enquiries: Professor Matthias Zilbauer - mz304@medschl.cam.ac.uk To apply online for this vacancy and view further information about the role, please use the University of Cambridge recruitment website. Click the 'Apply' button below to register an account with our recruitment system (if you have not already) and apply online. Applicants must have (or be close to obtaining) a PhD. Appointment at Research Associate level is dependent on having a PhD. Those who have submitted but not yet received their PhD will initially be appointed as a Research Assistant (Grade 5, Point 38 £34,132) moving to Research Associate (Grade 7) upon confirmation of your PhD award. Please ensure that you upload a covering letter and CV in the Upload section of the online application. The covering letter should outline how you match the criteria for the post and why you are applying for this role. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please include details of your referees, including email address and phone number, one of which must be your most recent line manager. Please quote reference PS51462 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK.

items.desc: Are you a Data Scientist that likes building and owning products? At Pine59, we are developing products for the rapidly growing data industry and the need to know how humans interact with the physical world. We innovate to create products which leverage sources of temporal and spatial data that helps explain human and device movement. Our products are built to help with city planning, making decisions within retail and real estate, emergency planning and more. With the acceleration of AI the opportunity to grow and develop a high quality location data product is optimal. As a result, we are not only developers, we are inventors and product owners! We wish to drive the industry forward by creating tools that have not been possible previously, due to new advances in cloud technology, AI, and location data. Do you want to take ownership and be part of that journey? Come and join us! Pine59 is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage you to apply We are hiring a Data Scientist At Pine59, we are products from the largest communications datasets available. This is a rapidly growing industry, and our product scope and reach is expanding to meet this demand. As a result, we are excited to be expanding our team, and are searching for an enthusiastic Data Scientist with a product mindset to join us. Our teams are multidisciplinary, with product, data engineering, data science, machine learning, and data analysis coming together in one team to develop competitive products. While closely collaborating with various teams and stakeholders within the company, we have the freedom of innovation and experimentation to develop high-quality and privacy-friendly location data insights that can change the location data industry for good. Specifically for the role we are looking for, you will develop and improve statistical data products used by clients around the world. Pine59 emphasizes anonymisation and privacy, ensuring the location events never even have to leave a customer's servers (thus ensuring security). It is important that you have a strong product and value oriented mindset and want to understand the true end value of what we are building. This is an on-site hybrid position (with 3-4 days in the week working in our Oslo office, or more if you want!). Our main office is on Karl Johans Gate in the heart of Oslo, where we meet every week with our international colleagues. Being part of Pine59 means being part of a friendly and efficient workplace, with opportunities to grow and advance within the company. Key Responsibilities Be part of a team owning location data products end to end: methodology, validation, production pipelines, and the quality and usefulness of what clients receive Invent and improve the methods that turn vast quantities of anonymised location data into reliable aggregate data products Validate results against ground truth and external sources, quantify bias and uncertainty, and track down the cause when the numbers shift Build robust data pipelines in BigQuery SQL and Python, with monitoring that detects data drift and quality issues before they reach clients Required Qualifications You have an academic degree equivalent to a Bachelor's or higher in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics or engineering You have at least 2 years of professional experience in data science You have a strong ownership mentality and passion for what you build You have rich experience in using Python and SQL for data processing (preferably within the BigQuery dialect) You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in person, and can explain technical results to people without a technical background You are a positive force. Adaptable and full of curiosity, you enjoy a high degree of collaboration and working in a team You are value oriented and want to understand how the products you build are used You have some basic Data Engineering skills (Airflow especially) You have experience working with geospatial data You are adept at using AI tooling to be effective Most relevant technologies BigQuery Python Git Apache Airflow Visualization tools: Kepler.gl, matplotlib, + What we expect of you We expect you to be positive-minded with a “can do” attitude to tackle challenges together with your team We are a startup, so things can change fast and you need to be agile and proactive on this journey. We have customers using the product daily, so you will take part in an on-call rotation, during normal working hours only

items.desc: Pricing Data Scientist (PhD – Maths / Statistics / Physics) | London, hybrid | £80,000–£100,000 + up to 20% bonus Finished a quantitative PhD and want your first industry role to be one with real ownership? A fast-growing, well-funded UK consumer business is creating a new pricing data science position. At the moment its prices are largely uniform across customers. The plan is to move to pricing that reflects the risk and value of each customer, and this hire will lead that work from the start. What you’ll do Work out which customer and product characteristics drive cost to serve, and turn them into pricing models that can be explained and defended Design and run controlled price tests, and build the company’s first demand elasticity curves Build customer lifetime value models so pricing decisions weigh long-term value as well as short-term volume Present findings to senior leadership, including board-level stakeholders What they’re looking for A PhD in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science or a related field, with a strong academic record from a leading university Confidence with the maths behind the methods: regression and GLMs, experimental design and causal inference (Bayesian methods a plus) Clean, reproducible Python, plus SQL and Git, or the ability to pick them up quickly The ability to explain technical work to non-technical colleagues Interest in the commercial trade-offs between growth, profit and customer value No pricing or industry experience is needed. Ability, rigour and curiosity matter more than job history here. Why it’s worth a look: a new problem, real data, direct financial impact and strong senior visibility. You’d join a small, hands-on team in a modern cloud data environment. Pricing Data Scientist (PhD – Maths / Statistics / Physics) | London, hybrid | £80,000–£100,000 + up to 20% bonus

items.desc: Vill du använda Data Science för att utveckla ett av Sveriges största paketnätverk? På PostNord får du göra data till beslut. PostNord befinner sig i en förändringsresa med stora investeringar i framtidens paketverksamhet. Nu söker de en Data Scientist som vill använda stora mängder data för att skapa konkreta förbättringar i paketverksamheten. Här får du kombinera Data Science, prognostisering och optimering med ett verksamhetsnära och strategiskt perspektiv. PostNord hanterar dagligen mycket stora volymer paket och samlar in stora mängder data genom hela paketflödet. Potentialen är stor – och mycket av informationen kan användas mer för att förstå, förutse och optimera verksamheten. I den här rollen får du vara med och identifiera möjligheterna, utveckla modeller och omsätta analyser till beslutsunderlag som kan påverka allt från bemanning och kapacitet till terminaler, transporter och framtida nätverksdesign. Du tillhör PostNords affärsområde Paket och arbetar i en central funktion med uppdrag mot hela paketorganisationen för Sverige. Vad du kommer att göra Här arbetar du med frågor där data kan ge bättre förståelse för både dagens paketflöden och framtidens pakethantering. Tillsammans med verksamheten identifierar du vad som behöver lösas och hur data kan bidra. Analyserar stora datamängder och omsätter dem till konkreta beslutsunderlag och strategiska beslut inom paketverksamheten. Utvecklar och implementerar tidsserie- och prognosmodeller för paketflöden och paketvolymer. Använder maskininlärning för att utveckla prognosernas noggrannhet och tillförlitlighet. Arbetar med optimering av exempelvis kapacitet, resursallokering, ruttplanering och bemanning. Identifierar tillsammans med verksamheten vilken data som kan användas för att lösa problem och skapa affärsvärde. Använder geodata för analyser kopplade till exempelvis leveransrutter, terminalverksamhet och nätverksdesign. Samarbetar med bland annat Data Engineers och andra specialistfunktioner kring data, AI och Machine Learning. Vem du är Det viktiga är samtidigt att du inte enbart vill arbeta med modeller och data isolerat. Du är nyfiken på verksamheten och vill förstå vilka problem som behöver lösas och hur dina analyser kan bidra till resultat. Du kan hantera komplex information, se helheten och omsätta analys till tydliga rekommendationer. Rollen innebär många samarbeten, vilket gör att du behöver kunna kommunicera dina slutsatser på ett begripligt sätt och trivas med att arbeta tillsammans med olika delar av organisationen. Vad du tar med dig För att lyckas i rollen har du minst fem års erfarenhet inom Data Science och är van att arbeta med stora datamängder. Du har erfarenhet av tidsserieanalys, prognostisering och optimering samt mycket goda kunskaper i programmering, exempelvis Python. Du har arbetat med relevanta Data Science-bibliotek och verktyg såsom NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn eller TensorFlow och har erfarenhet av matematiska optimeringstekniker. Erfarenhet av geospatial analys och GIS-verktyg är meriterande. Du har en kandidat- eller masterexamen inom datavetenskap, statistik, operationsanalys eller motsvarande område och behärskar svenska och engelska mycket väl. Välkommen med din ansökan I den här rekryteringen samarbetar PostNord med med Ada Digital (TNG). Om du har några frågor, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Sandra Peiper på 0709-56 39 46 eller sandra.peiper@adadigital.se. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! För fackliga kontaktpersoner se Fackliga kontakter.

As Data Scientist, you will be a critical member of the Business Technology Data and Analytics team, responsible for implementing the construction and optimization of large-scale models to solve business problems and communicate the value to the business stakeholders. Essential Functions : Main Accountabilities Design, implement and test reusable codebase utilizing data science best practice and supports the sustainability of our technical portfolio Develop deep understanding of Bunge’s internal data products that will drive critical commercial insights Collaborate with various stakeholders to understand business problems to implement scalable and sustainable solutions Work closely with other Data Scientists and Data Engineers to build and deliver valuable analytical solutions Communicates and document the design, functioning and output of the analytical models/solutions developed to a variety of audience Ensure timely deliverables and testing for regular maintenance of solutions over time Communicate data insights and value articulation to business stakeholders Contribute to a culture of learning through development of reusable modules and technical tutorials Minimum Requirements: Post graduate degree in STEM field or Bachelor degree with a combination of years of experience as in Data Science or Computer Science, IT or a related field Strong foundations in math, analytics and computer science, knowledge of machine learning methods, statistical models, advanced data science programming 3+ years of hands-on working experience and fluency in Python and SQL Comfortable with scripting language such as bash Experience writing reusable and maintainable code with version control and automation pipelines Ability to transform a project from POC to production Experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS or Azure), with preference to GCP services including but not limited to Compute Engine, Big Query, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer Creative and self-motivated. Demonstrate drive to learn new skills and solve challenging problems with minimal oversight. Act as a great team player in a global environment, take responsibility to consistently build better solutions both in technical quality and business impact Preferred Qualifications: Good understanding of software development best practice, and ability to apply that to machine learning projects, including unit tests, CI/CD integration Experience building and deploying resilient data and modeling pipelines in GCP environment Experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Terradom Experience implementing Kubernetes and Docker (or similar container engine) solutions Obtained Google Cloud Professional certifications in area such as MLE, data engineer, DevOps engineer Experience working with customer analytics and geospatial data, domain knowledge in global agri-business and food industry is a plus Ś1 At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of :37,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com. Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core: We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

items.desc: Data Scientist – Conversion Experiences Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working options available) Contract duration: 12 months Salary: £104,000 per year About the Role We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our Conversion Experiences group. Operating much like a dynamic e-commerce unit centered on product data science, this team focuses on optimizing user interactions, consumer-facing retail models, and offerings across major global consumer platforms. Rather than routing traffic off-site, you will work on product analytics to assess total addressable markets, execute feature experiments involving parameters like shipping or organic materials, and evaluate buyer interactions alongside purchasing trends. Workflow cycles feature initial setup and test preparation, a hands-off execution window, evaluation phases, and resolving key analytical inquiries between testing cycles. This position leverages internal proprietary tools, with scripting performed mainly in Python. Please note that backend software engineering and production model deployment fall outside the scope of this role, as team members rely extensively on automated multi-agent frameworks and advanced tooling to execute analytical tasks efficiently. Key Responsibilities Apply knowledge of statistics, machine learning, programming, data modeling, simulation, and advanced mathematics to recognize patterns, identify opportunities, pose business questions, and make valuable discoveries leading to prototype development and product improvement. Use a flexible, analytical approach to design, develop, and evaluate predictive models and advanced algorithms that lead to optimal value extraction from complex and high-dimensional datasets. Generate and test hypotheses, and analyze and interpret the results of product experiments. Work with product engineers to translate prototypes into new products, services, and features, and provide guidelines for large-scale implementation. Provide Business Intelligence (BI) and data visualization support, including support for online customer service dashboards and other ad-hoc requests requiring data analysis and visual support. Key Skills & Requirements Core Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, and/or R, big data tools, or data visualization platforms like Tableau. E-commerce & Industry Background: Previous experience in the e-commerce sector, specifically within advertising platforms or alongside major retail enterprises. Experimentation Domain Expertise: Strong domain expertise in advertising along with practical, hands-on knowledge of experimentation methodology. Independent Execution: Strong individual contributor (hands-on) capability to drive work independently, rather than acting as a people manager supervising team members. Communication: The ability to communicate effectively in writing, including conveying complex information clearly. Data Experience: Extensive experience working with large datasets. Education: Relevant degree in computer science or in a relevant field. Nice-to-Have Skills: Previous experience within major consumer technology or e-commerce environments. Experience integrating analytics with machine learning infrastructure to autonomously construct and validate feature recommendations for products. Familiarity with cutting-edge automated agent frameworks and AI tooling. What Makes This Role Interesting? Pioneering Innovation: A distinct opportunity to operate at the forefront of AI-powered e-commerce analytics, a space pioneered by very few global organizations utilizing cutting-edge personal agent and automated frameworks. High-Impact Scope: Shape user experiences and consumer interactions at a massive global scale. Autonomous Environment: A strong focus on individual milestone creation, structured quantitative evaluations, and driving core analytical findings to spur direct business impact.

items.title: Statistical Data Scientist
items.card: About the Role As a Statistical Data Scientist, you'll build the statistical models and machine learning methods behind our origin-verification science, then work with teams across Oritain to get those models running within live products and workflows. You'll partner with scientists, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to turn complex data into solutions that solve real customer problems. From
items.desc: Department: Data Science & Analytics Location: London Description Oritain is a global leader in forensic origin verification of products and raw materials. With offices in Auckland, Dunedin, London, Paris, Singapore and Washington D.C, our vision is to be the source of truth in global supply chains. Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialized services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing - creating real change in our world. About the Role As a Statistical Data Scientist, you'll build the statistical models and machine learning methods behind our origin-verification science, then work with teams across Oritain to get those models running within live products and workflows. You'll partner with scientists, engineers, product teams and business stakeholders to turn complex data into solutions that solve real customer problems. From developing predictive models to improving analytical approaches and supporting decision-making, your work will have a direct impact on our products, customers and future growth. This role sits in a business that is growing fast. We're building, evolving and scaling. That means you'll have the opportunity to shape how things are done, influence decisions, and contribute well beyond the boundaries of a traditional data science role. If you're looking for an environment where ownership is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and your work can genuinely move the business forward, Oritain is the right place for you. What you'll be doing Collect, clean and process data from a range of sources. Build statistical models and machine learning algorithms that turn data into decisions. Develop and deploy predictive models to solve operational and commercial challenges. Build visualisations, dashboards and analytical tools that make insight easy to use. Work closely with cross-functional teams to embed analytical solutions into existing products and workflows. Evaluate and improve modelling approaches using rigorous quantitative assessment. Track developments in statistics and data science and bring the useful ones into our analytics. Provide expert guidance on data science initiatives across the organisation. What we're looking for Essential: A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field (postgraduate study preferred). A minimum of 2 years of commercial experience applying statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to real-world problems. Solid grounding in probability, statistics, uncertainty, linear algebra and calculus. Experience working with large datasets, data transformation and cleaning. Experience with classification, clustering, dimension reduction and other machine learning methods. Experience using software development tools such as VS Code, Conda and GitHub, and working with command line tools and Unix-based operating systems, including environment management. Experience using Python and R to develop and deploy models in cloud environments (Azure experience is advantageous). Understanding of machine learning lifecycles and MLOps principles. Experience working with databases, APIs and collaborative development tools. Sharp problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and sound judgement. Confident communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. An open, curious and learning-oriented approach, with a commitment to doing great work. Nice to have: Experience working with geospatial data / spatial statistics. Experience with Databricks or similar platforms. Experience with HTML, JavaScript or related technologies. Exposure to supply chain, sustainability or risk-focused analytics environments. What you'll get Hybrid working (minimum 3 days per week in our Farringdon office) 35 days paid leave, inclusive of public holidays Birthday off Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave Life insurance Healthcare Cash Plan Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Pension Monthly Wellbeing Allowance Breakfast, snacks, Friday lunch and barista coffee in the office Learning portal with over 100,000 assets for professional development

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. Data Scientist Quale sarà la tua sfida? Bip ha creato all’interno del proprio Competence Centre “xTech” il più nutrito gruppo di Data Scientist in Italia (fonte: statistiche LinkedIn), e dall’Italia coordina anche i propri gruppi di Data Scientist locali presso le proprie sedi estere. Il/La Data Scientist in Bip evolve non solo le proprie competenze di AI e Machine Learning, ma anche la comprensione dei fenomeni legati al Business dei nostri Clienti e le proprie capacità di tradurli in algoritmi e poi di comunicare e utilizzare i risultati degli stessi per migliorare ed efficientare i processi. I/Le nostri/e Data Scientist verranno introdotti in contesti progettuali dove comprenderanno le esigenze del Cliente, daranno indicazione ai Data Engineer sulla preparazione desiderata dei dati, sceglieranno o costruiranno i migliori mix di modelli più adatti al caso specifico, discuteranno gli output con il cliente e consegneranno il modello per l’ottimizzazione e passaggio in produzione finale ai Data Engineer. In contesti più semplificati in cui la componente di Data Engineering è meno elaborata, i nostri Data Scientist procederanno in autonomia anche nella data preparation e nel porting in produzione dei modelli ingegnerizzati. Oltre alle progettualità, ai/alle Data Scientist sarà richiesto un contributo attivo per alimentare la Community con attività di ricerca, scouting, concept di nuove soluzioni e business development. Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti Indispensabili: Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo Laurea Specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Informatica, Statistica o discipline affini (STEM); Forte approccio quantitativo e brillanti doti analitiche; Passione e competenza in ambito data exploration, analisi dati e creazione di modelli: il nostro team disegna e sviluppa sistemi a supporto di decisioni strategiche per il business; Competenze statistiche, di Data Mining, Machine Learning; Solida conoscenza e comprovata esperienza in programmazione e scripting con Python Conoscenza di tematiche di Deep Learning, NLP e analisi dati non strutturati Esperienza con strumenti di version control (es. Git); Comprensione di tecnologie legate ai Big Data come Hadoop, MapReduce, Spark Conoscenza approfondita di database relazionali e di costrutti SQL e SQL Programming; Conoscenza di database non relazionali Esperienza comprovata di gestione tecnica delle risorse (persone) su progetto Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese professionali Plus: Conoscenza dei linguaggi PySpark o Scala Esperienza di lavoro su piattaforma Databricks Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Gen AI Conoscenza e l’utilizzo di API Cloud di Intelligenza Artificiale dei principali cloud provider (Google, Microsoft, AWS, IBM) e di altri strumenti di Advanced Analytics di Vendor specializzati Conoscenza di tecniche di semi-supervised e self-supervised learning. Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban) Soft Skills: Standing consulenziale Spiccate doti comunicative e interpersonali Orientamento al cliente e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi Adattabilità e flessibilità Precisione e stress tolerance nel rispetto delle scadenze Ottime capacità di gestione di progettualità complesse Capacità di coordinamento di un team Disponibilità per trasferte in Italia e all’estero. Perchè Bip? Crescita e Formazione Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Salute & Benefits Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. Famiglia e Genitorialità Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). Cosa offriamo / What we offer La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui , in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL …

items.card: Responsibilities Lead product analytics and experimentation initiatives to improve conversion, engagement and purchasing experiences. Design, execute and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, measuring their impact on customer behaviour and business outcomes. Analyse large-scale datasets to identify purchasing trends, market opportunities and opportunities for product improvement. Apply statistical analysis
items.desc: Contract: 12 months Salary: £104,000 per annum + 15% bonus, paid annual leave and pension Location: Remote within UK About the Opportunity We are recruiting a Data Scientist to join a global technology company, working within a product data science team focused on e-commerce, advertising and conversion experiences. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact consumer-facing products, using advanced analytics, experimentation and AI-powered tools to understand purchasing behaviour, optimise product features and improve conversion performance. The successful candidate will bring strong experience in e-commerce, advertising analytics and product experimentation , alongside the ability to independently translate complex data into actionable commercial recommendations. Key Responsibilities Lead product analytics and experimentation initiatives to improve conversion, engagement and purchasing experiences. Design, execute and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments, measuring their impact on customer behaviour and business outcomes. Analyse large-scale datasets to identify purchasing trends, market opportunities and opportunities for product improvement. Apply statistical analysis and Python/SQL to investigate hypotheses and generate actionable insights. Evaluate product features and customer experiences, using quantitative evidence to recommend improvements. Leverage AI-powered analytics tools and automated workflows to accelerate research and experimentation. Partner with Product, Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to influence product strategy and decision-making. Present complex analytical findings clearly, connecting recommendations to measurable commercial outcomes. Required Experience Strong background in product data science or product analytics within e-commerce, advertising platforms or large-scale retail environments. Proven experience designing and evaluating product experiments, including A/B testing and statistical analysis. Strong understanding of digital advertising, consumer behaviour, conversion funnels and commercial performance metrics. Hands-on experience using Python and SQL for data analysis. Experience working with large, complex datasets and translating findings into product recommendations. Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from problem definition through to recommendations. Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. Desirable Experience Previous experience working within major technology companies or large-scale consumer platforms. Experience using AI tools, intelligent agents or automated analytical workflows. Familiarity with machine learning applications for product recommendations and feature optimisation. Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams on large-scale experimentation initiatives. Why Consider This Opportunity? You will join an established product data science function working on innovative e-commerce experiences used at significant scale. The role offers exposure to AI-powered analytical tools, complex product experimentation and commercially meaningful decisions, with the opportunity to directly influence conversion performance. Interested? Apply with your updated CV to discuss the opportunity in more detail. Shortlisting soon!

items.desc: Alma Real Estate Insights tekee data- ja analytiikkapalveluita asuntokaupan, asuntoluototuksen ja kiinteistösijoittamisen ammattilaisille. Asuntopuntari arvioi asuntojen arvoa ja hintakehitystä koneoppimismalleilla, ja Aluepuntari kokoaa asuinalueiden markkinatiedon ja ennusteet yhteen. Palveluitamme käyttävät pankit, välittäjät ja sijoittajat, ja Asuntopuntari valittiin vuoden datatalousinnovaatioksi AI Gaalassa 2025. Etsimme Data & ML Engineeriä Helsinkiin. Tiimimme vastaa datan koko elinkaaresta: keruusta ja käsittelystä malleihin ja tuotteistukseen asti. Roolisi Pidät datan liikkeessä lähteistä tuotteisiin ja koneoppimismallit ajan tasalla. Käytännössä ylläpidät ja kehität Airflow-dataputkia ja niiden takana olevia tietokantoja, hallitset pilvi-infraa koodina, koulutat ja julkaiset Asuntopuntarin malleja Azure ML:ssä ja SageMakerissa ja selvität, miksi niiden tulokset muuttuivat. Lisäksi kehität LLM-pohjaisia ominaisuuksia, kuten aluekuvauksia tai taloyhtiötietoanalyysiä. Arvostamme erityisesti, jos olet kehittänyt ja ylläpitänyt ajastettuja dataputkia tuotannossa kirjoitat sujuvasti Pythonia ja SQL:ää hallitset infran koodina (esim. Terraform tai CDK) ja olet rakentanut CI/CD-putkia olet ylläpitänyt koneoppimismalleja tuotannossa: uudelleenkoulutus, monitorointi, kontitus ja julkaisu tunnet AWS:n datapalvelut (S3, Redshift, Athena ym.). Azure- ja GCP-kokemus on plussaa. Lisäksi eduksi on, jos ymmärrät rajapintakehitystä Pythonilla asuntomarkkinaa ja sitä, miten datalla palvellaan alan eri toimijoita ML- ja AI-mallien kehittämistä. Käytössämme Python, SQL, Airflow, Terraform, CDK, GitHub Actions, Docker AWS (S3, Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB, Lambda, SageMaker, Bedrock) Azure (ML, App Services) GCP (BigQuery, Gemini, ADK) FastAPI, Flask Tutustu Tekemiseemme https://www.almainsights.fi/kaikki-tuotteet-ja-palvelut/asuntopuntari/ https://www.almainsights.fi/blogi/ennennakematonta-lapinakyvyytta-suomen-asuntomarkkinoille/ https://www.almarealestate.fi/tuotteet/aluepuntari/ Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme näköalapaikan ainutlaatuisessa liiketoimintakokonaisuudessa. Alma Real Estateen kuuluvat dataratkaisujen lisäksi muun muassa Etuovi.com ja Vuokraovi.com, kaupallisten kiinteistöjen markkinapaikat Suomessa ja Ruotsissa, kiinteistönvälitysjärjestelmät sekä digitaalisen asunto- ja kiinteistökaupan edelläkävijä DIAS. Pääset työskentelemään datan parissa, jolla on todellista asiakasarvoa ja merkitystä. Ratkaisujamme käyttävät Suomen keskeiset asuntokaupan, pankki- ja kiinteistösijoittamisen toimijat. Tarjoamme Sinulle vastuullisen roolin kokeneessa ja kompaktissa tiimissä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, miten dataa hyödynnetään tuotteissamme monipuolisia ja kiinnostavia datalähteitä sekä haastavia teknisiä ongelmia Alma Median laajan data-, teknologia- ja kehittäjäyhteisön tuen modernit työskentelytavat ja mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi työskentelyn hybridimallilla ja toimiston hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä Helsingissä tai Tampereella rennon ja mutkattoman työyhteisön, jossa saat olla oma itsesi. Toimimme tuotevetoisesti ja ketterästi. Rakennamme ratkaisuja pitkäjänteisesti, opimme tekemisestä ja kehitämme palveluita jatkuvan palautteen perusteella. Työskentelemme monipaikkaisesti ja joustavasti sekä etänä että viihtyisässä Alma-talossa Helsingin Töölönlahdella. Toimipisteemme ovat esteettömiä. Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi 15.11. mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut heti hakemusten saapuessa. Lähetä hakemus ja kerro siinä taustastasi ja siitä, mikä tässä roolissa kiinnostaa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Rasmus Siljander, AI & Data Lead rasmus.siljander@almamedia.fi Tutustu Almaan Työnantajana https://almamedia.dev/ https://www.almamedia.fi/tyopaikat/ Alma työnantajana Meille almalaisille tärkeitä asioita ovat rohkeus, yhteistyö ja ystävällinen kulttuuri, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä. Rohkeus ei tarkoita vain suuria näkyviä tekoja, vaan myös pieniä arjen hetkiä: uskallusta sanoa mielipiteensä, tehdä asioita uudella tavalla, kokeilla ja oppia virheistä. Työskentelemme jatkuvasti muuttuvassa ympäristössä, ja siksi etsimme ihmisiä, joita innostaa kehittäminen ja halu kasvaa kanssamme. Lupauksemme sinulle 💜 Ystävällinen kulttuuri, jossa saat olla oma itsesi Saat vastuuta ja vapautta työhösi. Arvostamme tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välillä. Monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme tukevat hyvinvointiasi. 🌟 Työ, jolla on merkitystä ja vaikutusta Meillä pääset työskentelemään tunnettujen ja arvostettujen brändien parissa. Palvelumme ovat tärkeitä miljoonille ihmisille arjen päätöksissä. 🚀 Kasvua, jota vauhdittaa tekoäly Saat käyttöösi työsi kannalta oleelliset AI-työkalut ja mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Odotamme almalaisilta halua oppia, uudistua ja kasvaa tekoälyn vauhdittamassa arjessa.

items.desc: Date: 21 oct. 2026 Lieu Puteaux, FR Société: CANAL+ TECH Bienvenue chez CANAL+ ! Séries, films, documentaires, émissions, sports, …Ce qui nous tient à cœur c’est de créer les meilleurs contenus et une expérience immersive pour nos millions d’abonnés : émotions et sensations garanties ! Et si vous passiez derrière l’écran ? Vous trouverez forcément votre place parmi nos 15 000 passionnés dans le monde ! Pour être au courant de nos dernières actualités, n’hésitez pas à nous suivre sur LinkedIn et X ! 💻 Les équipes DATA & IA CANAL+ ? + de 100 expertes et experts qui transforment les données en leviers de performance et développent de nouveaux usages innovants. Elles conçoivent des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et des produits data à fort impact pour accompagner nos équipes métiers dans leurs décisions 🔎 Plus précisément, vous rejoindrez notre direction AI Factory d’une quarantaine de personnes qui s’occupent de construire la plateforme agentique IA du Groupe Canal+. La direction est composée de 4 équipes : AI Platform, AI Products, Business Science Portfolio et Business Science Content. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe Business Science Content qui rend la performance des contenus mesurable, prédictible et comparable à l’échelle du Groupe. Elle aide les équipes à mieux acheter, programmer et valoriser les contenus grâce à la donnée. Notre Stack technique : Python, SQL, Dataiku Nos Projets Développer nos modèles de scoring de performance des contenus à destination de nos équipes en France et à l’international (Outre-mer & Pologne) Travailler sur la segmentation de la consommation de nos abonnés 🎯 Votre rôle et vos missions Transformer les enjeux Contenus en décisions data : identifier les besoins, définir les indicateurs clés et formuler des recommandations concrètes. Développer des modèles à fort impact : segmentation, prédiction de performance, valorisation des contenus et tests A/B. Fédérer les expertises data du Groupe : capitaliser sur les travaux locaux, partager les bonnes pratiques et construire une feuille de route commune. Industrialiser les solutions IA : faire passer les prototypes en production avec AI Platform, dans le respect des standards de qualité, de documentation et de réutilisabilité. items.desc: Tule rakentamaan rokotetutkimuksen data- ja AI-ratkaisuja Koetko vetoa merkityksellistä rokotetutkimustyötä kohtaan? Haluatko hyödyntää dataa ja tekoälyä ratkaisuissa, jotka tukevat tutkimuksen laatua, sujuvaa toimintaa ja terveyttä edistäviä kehitysharppauksia? Meillä on erityistehtävä: sinun terveytesi. Rokotteilla parannetaan ihmisten elämänlaatua ennaltaehkäisemällä sairauksia. Niillä on keskeinen rooli kansanterveyden edistämisessä ja vakavien tautien taltuttamisessa. Me tutkimme rokotteiden tehoa, turvallisuutta ja vaikuttavuutta vuosikymmenten kokemuksella ja kansainvälisesti tunnustetulla, tieteellisesti laadukkaalla osaamisella. FVR – Suomen rokotetutkimus on yksityinen osakeyhtiömuotoinen yritys, joka aloitti toimintansa vuonna 2022. Suomen valtio omistaa yrityksestä 51 % ja Tampereen korkeakoulusäätiö 49 %. Yhtiön omistajaohjauksesta vastaa sosiaali- ja terveysministeriö (STM). Asiakkaitamme ovat suuret kansainväliset lääkeyhtiöt. Ainutlaatuinen mahdollisuus data- ja AI-kehityksen parissa Etsimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen data- ja AI-asiantuntijaa Tampereen, Oulun tai Helsingin toimistollemme hybridityömahdollisuuksin . Tehtävässä suunnittelet, toteutat ja kehität ratkaisuja, joilla data saadaan luotettavasti tutkimuksen, operatiivisen toiminnan ja liiketoiminnan käyttöön. Tunnistat tekoälyn hyödyntämismahdollisuuksia ja viet käyttötapauksia hallitusti kokeiluista tuotantoon. Työskentelet osana in-house-digitiimiä ja teet työtä tutkimusliiketoimintamme tiedonhallinnan, analytiikan ja AI-ratkaisujen parissa. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoiminnan, prosessien omistajien, tutkijoiden ja klinikkahenkilökunnan kanssa. Olet mukana rakentamassa ratkaisuja, jotka mahdollistavat uudenlaisia tutkimuspalveluja, laadukasta tutkimustietoa sekä sujuvan, tietoturvallisen ja vastuullisen toiminnan. Pääasialliset tehtävät Suunnittelet, rakennat ja ylläpidät data-alustan ratkaisuja Microsoft Azure- ja Fabric-ympäristössä. Kehität tietomalleja, integraatioita, datan laatua, master dataa sekä raportoinnin ja analytiikan tietopohjaa. Tunnistat ja priorisoit AI-käyttötapauksia yhdessä liiketoiminnan ja tutkimuksen asiantuntijoiden kanssa sekä toteutat kokeiluja ja tuotantoratkaisuja. Rakennat ratkaisuja hyödyntäen SQL:ää ja Pythonia sekä soveltuvia pilvi-, automaatio- ja AI-palveluja. Huolehdit ratkaisujen dokumentoinnista, ylläpidettävyydestä, seurannasta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Varmistat osaltasi datan ja AI:n vastuullisen käytön sekä tietoturvan, tietosuojan, jäljitettävyyden ja sääntelyvaatimusten toteutumisen. Osallistut teknologioiden ja kumppaneiden arviointiin sekä ohjaat palveluntuottajien työtä käytännönläheisesti ja kustannustietoisesti. Mitä odotamme sinulta Soveltuvaa teknistä, matemaattista tai kaupallista korkeakoulututkintoa. Vähintään 3-5 vuoden kokemusta data-, analytiikka- tai AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisestä. Käytännön kokemusta data-alustoista, dataputkista, integraatioista ja tietomallinnuksesta; Microsoft Azure- ja Fabric-osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Kokemusta Power BI -raportoinnista ja sen kehittämisestä. Vahvaa SQL- ja Python-osaamista sekä kykyä rakentaa laadukkaita ja ylläpidettäviä ratkaisuja. Kokemusta generatiivisen AI:n, koneoppimisen tai muun soveltavan tekoälyn käyttötapauksista ja niiden hallitusta käyttöönotosta. Ymmärrystä tietosuojasta, tietoturvasta, datan hallintamalleista ja vastuullisen AI:n periaatteista. Kokemus säädellystä toimintaympäristöstä on etu. Kokemusta toimintaa ohjaavista järjestelmistä, kuten potilastietojärjestelmästä tai ERP-ratkaisusta; käytössämme ovat Acute-potilastietojärjestelmä ja Odoo ERP. Kykyä johtaa omia kehityskokonaisuuksia, viestiä teknisistä ratkaisuista ymmärrettävästi ja työskennellä sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle Monipuolisia data- ja AI-kehityshankkeita tutkimuksen ja liiketoiminnan parissa. Vastuuta ja aitoja vaikutusmahdollisuuksia ratkaisuihin, toimintatapoihin, teknologioihin ja kumppanivalintoihin. Mahdollisuuden kasvattaa osaamistasi yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisessä toimintaympäristössä. Asiantuntevan työyhteisön sekä kollegoiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden tuen. Yrityskulttuurin, jossa asiantuntevuus, välittävyys ja vastuullisuus ohjaavat jokapäiväistä toimintaamme. Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja siinä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Ensisijainen työskentelypaikka on Tampere, Oulu tai Helsinki . Tehtävässä on hybridityömahdollisuus. Tervetuloa joukkoomme! Innostuitko? Hae tehtävään mahdollisimman pian, sillä etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa jo hakuaikana. Haku päättyy 28.10.2026 ja ensimmäinen haastattelukierros tullaan tekemään Recright-videohaastatteluna. Liitäthän hakemukseesi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista ja arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. items.desc: Applied Scientist Position: Applied Scientist Type: Contractor Compensation: $245–$280/hour Location: Remote About the Opportunity We are seeking skilled Applied Scientists to contribute to a data-driven project focused on advanced analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation. In this role, you will apply your expertise in Python, machine learning, and applied statistics to help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems. Your work will help improve how AI models learn, reason, and perform by providing high-quality, real-world expertise. The opportunity emphasizes quantitative problem-solving, experimentation, and clear technical communication. Prior AI experience is not required; relevant domain expertise is what matters. Key Responsibilities Design and conduct statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets. Develop, validate, tune, and evaluate machine learning models for business and research objectives. Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas. Collaborate with stakeholders to establish experimentation frameworks and analyze results. Document methodologies, findings, and recommendations through clear, precise analytical reports. Review peer contributions and provide constructive, high-quality feedback. Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports. Evaluate AI-generated outputs involving statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative reasoning. Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions. Identify flawed methodologies, statistical errors, and weaknesses in quantitative reasoning. Provide structured feedback to improve AI model performance and capabilities. Required Qualifications Proficiency in Python for data analysis, statistical computing, and machine learning. Experience with Pandas and familiarity with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn. Demonstrated knowledge of applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning. Experience developing, tuning, and evaluating machine learning models in practical settings. Strong data modeling skills and experience working with structured and unstructured data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to produce reproducible code, precise technical documentation, and clear analytical reports. Preferred Qualifications At least one year of experience at a leading company in technology, finance, or research. An advanced academic background or hands-on experience in data science, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field. Experience collaborating on open or cross-functional data science projects. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to assess complex quantitative problems. Compensation & Engagement Compensation: $245–$280 per hour. Engagement Type: Contractor. Work Arrangement: Fully remote. Project Focus: Applied science, advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical analysis, and experimentation.

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. AI ENGINEER EXPERT Quale sarà la tua sfida? Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Almeno 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban). items.desc: Location: London Hybrid: 3 to 4 times in person per month Salary: £65,000 to £75,000 We are looking for an experienced Data Coach to join our training team at Rockborne. This is a varied role combining technical training, content development and client-facing work across both our internal consultant cohorts and external client programmes. You will play a key role in developing our consultants through high-quality technical training, while also working directly with clients to understand their needs, design tailored learning programmes and deliver bespoke Data, Analytics and AI training. There will also be opportunities to support wider client projects and work with our commercial team to provide technical input into client briefs and potential solutions. This position will suit someone who combines strong technical knowledge with confident training and client-facing skills, and who enjoys the variety of moving between teaching, content creation, stakeholder engagement and commercial support. About Rockborne Rockborne is a fast-growing Data & Analytics consultancy and training provider. We recruit, train and deploy diverse early-career data professionals into organisations across multiple industries, combining hands-on technical training, business education and professional skills development to prepare our consultants to thrive in client environments. Alongside our consultant development programmes, we also work directly with organisations to deliver tailored Data, Analytics and AI training, as well as broader consulting and capability-building projects. Founded by industry experts with decades of global Data & Analytics experience, we help both individuals and organisations build practical, relevant data skills. Rockborne sits within the Harnham Group, one of the world’s leading Data & AI recruitment specialists, with offices in London, New York, Phoenix and Amsterdam. Deliver bespoke training programmes to external corporate clients, adapting content to different audiences, skill levels and business needs. Work directly with clients to understand technical and training requirements. Create and maintain training content, exercises, projects and learning resources. Support the ongoing development and improvement of Rockborne’s technical curriculum. Provide coaching, feedback and mentoring to learners throughout their development. Support consultants in applying technical skills in real-world client environments. Contribute to client-facing projects where appropriate. Work with Rockborne’s commercial team to provide technical input into client briefs and help shape potential training or consulting solutions. Independently manage training projects and priorities while collaborating closely with the wider coaching and commercial teams. Technical Skills Strong practical knowledge across several of the following areas: Excel SQL Python Power BI Tableau Data Modelling Cloud Platforms, including AWS, GCP or Azure AI and Generative AI Experience across Data Engineering, Data Science, BI, Data Warehousing, ETL or related areas would also be advantageous. Person Specification Strong communication, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage a range of audiences. Previous experience delivering technical training, coaching, teaching or workshops. Previous client-facing experience, with confidence working directly with external stakeholders. Experience creating or developing technical learning content and training programmes. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and connect them to practical business use cases. Strong stakeholder management skills. A self-starter who can take ownership of projects and manage multiple priorities. items.desc: Descrizione dell'azienda Retoria è un’organizzazione di formazione con sede di lavoro a Milano, che promuove una alfabetizzazione all’intelligenza artificiale critica e centrata sull’essere umano, insieme alle lingue come strumenti fondamentali di autonomia. La metodologia didattica è guidata dai dati e basata sull’evidenza, con percorsi di apprendimento progettati per misurare i progressi reali e sostenere l’autonomia a lungo termine delle persone. Retoria rifiuta mode passeggere e tendenze temporanee, puntando invece su competenze e valori umani duraturi, indispensabili per governare i cambiamenti tecnologici. L’organizzazione collabora con scuole, università, istituzioni culturali e sociali, oltre che con realtà impegnate nella transizione digitale attenta alla centralità della persona. Descrizione del ruolo Human-Centered AI experts contribuiranno alla progettazione e alla realizzazione di percorsi formativi su intelligenza artificiale e linguaggi, garantendo un approccio critico e human-centered per diverse tipologie di studenti e organizzazioni. Nel ruolo, con sede di lavoro a Milano, full time e in presenza, la persona sarà responsabile dell’analisi dei bisogni formativi, della creazione di contenuti didattici data-driven e della definizione di metriche per valutare l’efficacia dei percorsi. Le principali attività quotidiane includono la conduzione di laboratori e workshop, la facilitazione di momenti di confronto con scuole, università e istituzioni partner, e la collaborazione con il team interno per ottimizzare materiali e strumenti educativi. Il ruolo prevede inoltre il monitoraggio dell’evoluzione tecnologica dell’AI, la traduzione di questi sviluppi in pratiche pedagogiche sostenibili e il supporto alle organizzazioni nel gestire la transizione digitale preservando il proprio nucleo umano. Qualifiche Competenze solide in human-centered ai e alfabetizzazione digitale critica, con capacità di tradurre concetti complessi in percorsi formativi accessibili. items.desc: Projektbeskrivning Kemiska föroreningar hotar människors hälsa och ekosystem över hela jorden. Data om kemiska faror är avgörande för att upptäcka och mildra potentiella negativa effekter i ett tidigt skede. På senare tid har beräkningsverktyg, såsom transformers-modeller, använts för att exakt förutsäga bland annat kemisk toxicitet gentemot miljön. Träningen av sådana modeller är beroende av att stora mängder toxicitetsdata extraheras från vetenskapliga publikationer, rapporter och säkerhetsdokument och samlas i öppna databaser, som ECOTOX. Dataextraktion görs för närvarande för hand, oftast av myndigheter, vilket inte hinner med den ständigt växande mängden ny forskning. Detta har blivit en stor flaskhals som inte bara hindrar tillämpningen av beräkningsmetoder för riskbedömning, utan i slutändan också begränsar en effektiv lagstiftning för att skydda både människor och miljö. AI-agenter (LLM-agenter) är lovande alternativ som har potential att ta bort denna flaskhals och automatisera arbetsflödet. Eftersom den genererade datan används i sammanhang med höga insatser krävs dock garantier för både noggrannhet och spårbarhet i extraktionsprocessen. Framför allt är ekotoxikologiska studier ökänt svåra att läsa och förstå, vilket kräver att agenterna kan särskilja relevant data från irrelevant data i publikationer som ofta är fyllda med figurer, tabeller, referenser med mera, baserat på kontext. Huvudsakliga uppgifter Vi söker två studenter som ska utveckla och implementera AI-agenter i syfte att extrahera kemisk toxicitetsdata från vetenskaplig litteratur. Med utgångspunkt i tidigare arbete blir målet att vidareutveckla en pipeline som (1) kan ta emot en lista med publikationer som indata och producera strukturerad data, samt (2) sålla bland tidigare publicerad litteratur som ännu inte har utvärderats. Vi kommer att börja med – men inte begränsa oss till – att använda ECOTOX-databasen som referensdatabas, vilken vi siktar på att återskapa och göra en benchmark för. Det gör att ni kan validera extraktionsprocessen och toxicitetsdatans många olika dimensioner. Därefter kommer vi att tillämpa pipen på nya, outforskade publikationer för att skapa ett nytt öppet dataset med tidigare otillgängliga, strukturerade toxicitetsdata. Kort Sagt Kommer Ert Arbete Att Innebära Att hantera "brusiga" PDF-filer (figurer, referenser, tabeller, OCR-fel). Att utforma utvärderingsmått för extraktionsnoggrannhet och spårbarhet. Att integrera domänspecifik validering (kontrollera konsekvens gentemot ECOTOX). Lärandemål Att lära sig bygga, skala och validera data- och AI-pipelines. Att utveckla färdigheter inom mjukvaruutveckling samt MLOps/DevOps. Vem söker vi? Vi söker studenter som vill skriva ett examensarbete på 30 högskolepoäng under våren 2027. Vi Tror Att Du Läser masterprogram med inriktning Data/AI, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande Har erfarenhet av Python och förståelse för att arbeta med LLM-agenter via API:er (inte bara konversera med ChatGPT). Meriterande Erfarenhet av LLM-arbetsflöden, erfarenhet av docling eller liknande PDF-till-text-pipelines, NLP och databaser. Kunskaper i kemi är såklart till nytta, men det är inget krav! Projektet kommer att utföras på Knightec Groups kontor på Lindholmen i Göteborg, med handledning av professor Erik Kristiansson (Chalmers), doktoranden Styrbjörn Käll (Chalmers, Knightec Group) och doktor Jens Henriksson (Knightec Group). En spännande resa med Knightec Group Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det? Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling. På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort. För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt. Praktisk information Detta är en Master Thesis - tjänst med placering på vårt kontor i Göteborg, Lindholmsallén 2. Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-11-30. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

items.desc: Description Description Au sein de l'équipe Data Science du Pôle Technique de la Direction Maîtrise des Risques et Expertise de l'usine Orano Recyclage La Hague , vous contribuerez à un projet innovant combinant simulation industrielle, systèmes multi-agents et intelligence artificielle . L'objectif est d'étudier la mise en place d'une plateforme capable de reproduire et d'analyser le fonctionnement de flux de production industriels afin d'identifier automatiquement les situations normales ou dégradées à partir de données historiques. Vous explorerez également la capacité de l'Intelligence Artificielle à proposer des stratégies d'optimisation face à différents aléas de production (pannes, maintenance préventive, variations d'activité...). Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes : Analyser les règles métier, contraintes opérationnelles et données disponibles sur le périmètre retenu pour l'étude des flux industriels ; Réaliser une veille technologique et un benchmark des solutions existantes afin d'identifier les leviers permettant d'accélérer le développement d'une maquette fonctionnelle ; Concevoir et développer une plateforme de simulation reposant sur des systèmes multi-agents représentant les différentes unités de production à un niveau macroscopique ; Intégrer et exploiter des données historiques afin de reproduire et analyser différents scénarios de fonctionnement ; Développer des indicateurs de performance permettant d'évaluer l'activité des installations (cadence, disponibilité, temps d'ouverture, etc.) ; Enrichir les agents avec des mécanismes d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Machine Learning afin d'optimiser certains scénarios ou circuits de production ; Évaluer les gains potentiels apportés par ces optimisations à l'aide des métriques définies. Ces travaux seront réalisés au sein de l'équipe Data Science, en étroite collaboration avec les experts métiers des domaines production et maintenance , vous offrant une vision concrète des enjeux industriels et de la valeur apportée par la Data et l'IA. Profil souhaité Vous êtes en formation Ingénieur(e) ou en formation universitaire de type Master orientée statistiques, mathématiques ou informatique décisionnelle, avec une spécialisation en Data Science. Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et de réactivité dans votre travail. Vous savez allier travail en équipe et travail en autonomie. Avantages Un stage chez Orano, un véritable tremplin pour votre avenir : 🎓 1 étudiant sur 2 est embauché à l’issue de ses études 💼 Une gratification attractive et des avantages compétitifs (ex : activités et avantages loisirs et culture CSE) 🏡 Possibilité de bénéficier d’1 jour de télétravail par semaine 🌱 Des missions qui font sens dans l’énergie bas carbone, la santé et les technologies de demain 🏗️ Des projets industriels uniques, notamment la construction des usines du futur 📍 Des opportunités sur l’ensemble du territoire français 📈 Des perspectives d’évolution riches avec plus de 500 mobilités internes chaque année 👉 Pour toutes ces raisons, plus de 9 alternants sur 10 recommandent Orano . Découvrez leurs témoignages sous ce lien Groupe Orano Contribuer à relever les défis actuels et futurs pour préserver notre monde et construire celui de demain, tout en prenant soin de la santé de chacun — cela vous inspire. Nous aussi. En rejoignant Orano, un acteur international majeur du secteur nucléaire, vous êtes au bon endroit. Chaque jour, nous œuvrons pour produire une énergie performante et bas-carbone, lutter contre le changement climatique, trouver des solutions qui préservent les ressources naturelles et faire progresser le domaine de la santé. Nos atouts ? Sur l’ensemble du cycle du combustible : la maîtrise de technologies de pointe, des produits et services sûrs et à forte valeur ajoutée, une expertise spécialisée et une grande capacité d’innovation. Autant de qualités qui illustrent le savoir‑faire exceptionnel de nos 18 000 collaborateurs, dont nous soutenons en permanence le développement. Divers par leurs profils et leurs expériences — preuve de notre ouverture à tous les talents — ils partagent la même ambition : révéler tout le potentiel de l’énergie nucléaire.

items.desc: About This Programme Build the future with breakthrough technology. At Sky, we're not just keeping up with technology; we're shaping it. From AI and data to automation and digital products, the Emerging Technology Graduate Programme helps you develop skills in the technologies shaping the future. The programme combines an immersive bootcamp with two years of rotational experience, giving you the opportunity to build strong foundations before developing your skills across a range of technology teams and projects. Over two years, you'll rotate through teams working on cutting-edge projects that power millions of customer experiences. Whether it's building software, experimenting with Generative AI, or delivering solutions within agile frameworks, you'll gain hands-on experience with the tools and technologies transforming the industry. You don't need to choose a specialism immediately. This programme is designed to help you explore, grow and find your path, whether that's in software development, networks, broadcast technology, cyber security, artificial intelligence or technology delivery. We're looking for curious, motivated people who want to build a career in technology. You don't need a technical background to apply. What matters most is a genuine interest in technology and the impact it can have on customers. Over two years, we'll help you become a well-rounded technology professional, giving you insight into how our teams create and deliver great customer experiences across Sky's products and services. As you gain experience across different technology teams, you'll discover where your strengths and interests lie and have the opportunity to specialise in the areas that excite you most. What you'll be doing Technology never stands still, and neither do we. From exploring new ideas to delivering solutions used by millions of customers, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects from concept through to launch. If you enjoy learning, adapting to change and solving problems, you'll thrive at Sky. Throughout the programme, you'll rotate across a range of teams and develop a blend of technical, analytical and delivery skills while gaining exposure to Sky's wider technology landscape. You Could Build digital products using technologies such as AI, cloud platforms and modern software development tools. Learn about cyber security, threat modelling and how we protect customers, systems and data from emerging risks. Explore network technologies across physical, virtual and broadcast environments. Help shape the future of new technology solutions as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner. From day one, you'll work on real projects with real impact, supported by experienced mentors and surrounded by people who are passionate about technology. By the end of the programme, you'll have the confidence, experience and specialist skills needed to take the next step in your career at Sky. What are we looking for? Be curious about emerging technologies and how they're changing the world. Be passionate about solving problems and building smart, scalable solutions. Feel comfortable learning new tools and working in agile teams. Be excited to explore areas such as AI, data, automation and cloud platforms. items.desc: Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement) We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad. You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops. The Company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't. The squad works across three areas: Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model. The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from. New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches. The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead. The role As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems. You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows. Live project examples: Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use. Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning. Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers... The Requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring. Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision. Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership. Bonus: Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending. Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production. Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance. Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on …

items.desc: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. 🔍 Dive Into the World of Data — Fever’s Data Graduate Program Awaits Are you a recent graduate ready to jump into the world of data? Fever’s Data Graduate Program is a six-month, full-time rotational experience designed to launch your career in Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Web Analytics . From day one, you’ll work on real projects, use cutting-edge technologies, and learn directly from experts who are shaping how millions of people discover entertainment worldwide. What usually takes years to learn, you’ll get in just six months — through hands-on work, mentorship, and exposure to multiple data disciplines. What’s in it for you? A paid six-month contract in 📍 Madrid with the chance to transition into a full-time role Rotations across key data teams: Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Marketing Engineering & Web Analytics Mentorship and training from experts in the field. Real impact from day one — contribute to projects used across the company English lessons. 40% discount on all Fever events. Cigna health Insurance. Flexible compensation with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee. Wellhub membership. If you reside outside of Madrid, we can offer relocation assistance to help make your move and adaptation to the city as smooth as possible. How does the program work? 📍 Location : Madrid, Spain (100% in-person) 🕓 Duration : 6 months 🔄 Rotation: You’ll rotate across 3–4 data teams depending on your skills and interests Rotation Structure: 6 months total, rotating across 3-4 teams depending on your skills and interests: Data Engineering: Learn how to build and manage scalable data pipelines. Work with tools like SQL, Python, and cloud-based databases. Machine Learning: Work on real-world ML models and recommendations. Learn how ML models are developed, trained, and deployed. Data Science: Analyze complex business problems and help drive data-driven decisions. Use A/B testing and predictive modeling to optimize Fever’s platform. Web Analytics & Data Collection: Improve how data is collected across the complex Fever ecosystem (multiple websites and mobile apps) to deliver the best quality inputs to all internal areas and stakeholders to make better decisions. You'll learn about best practices for tracking and analytics using technologies such as GA4 and Mixpanel. Who should apply? We’re looking for motivated, ambitious recent graduates who: Have a bachelor / master's / PhD degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Mathematics or a related field. Rank in the top 10% of their class Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Have all your credits completed. Speak and understand business-level English. How to apply? Submit your application and select your preferred team. Talent interview to assess fit. Technical interview to evaluate skills. Final offer and onboarding. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!
