items.desc: Ben je net afgestudeerd of toe aan een nieuwe stap? En wil je jezelf ontwikkelen tot AI developer in een omgeving waar je leert van ervaren collega’s en vanaf dag één onderdeel bent van een hecht team? Bij 9altitudes bieden we je een uniek traineeship waarin je alles leert over Python, Microsoft Foundry en Copilot en nog veel meer hoe je dat inzet bij klanten. Je dagelijkse avontuur Wat ga je doen? Je start samen met andere Trainees in een intensief en energiek opleidingsprogramma van drie maanden. Geen droge training vanaf de zijlijn, maar direct aan de slag met de tools, klanten en collega’s van 9altitudes. Je leert hoe je data analyseert, inzichten vertaalt naar een helder verhaal en jouw advies overtuigend presenteert. Alles wat je leert, pas je meteen toe in echte klantprojecten. Stap voor stap krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid. Tegelijkertijd sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt coaching, feedback en ruimte om te werken aan jouw eigen leerdoelen. Na het programma stroom je door in één van onze teams. En als je later verder wilt groeien richting ERP of BI, dan liggen daar ook volop kansen. Over het team: Ons team in Veenendaal is gespecialiseerd in Business Intelligence & AI en helpt organisaties om meer waarde uit hun data en processen te halen. Vanuit onze Data & Analytics expertise vertalen we data naar heldere inzichten, slimme dashboards en concrete beslisinformatie. Met onze eigen oplossing 9A Smart Insights, ook wel BIRDS, maken we binnen een paar dagen zichtbaar waar andere trajecten vaak maanden over doen. Je komt terecht in een team van 55 collega’s, waar we werken in hechte teams en technologie combineren met samenwerking, nieuwsgierigheid en plezier in wat we doen. Vaardigheden Wie ben jij en wat heb je nodig? Je wordt enthousiast van AI, data, technologie en analytics; Je hebt hbo-denkniveau en zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen; Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands (at least C1); Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail; Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en pakt nieuwe informatie snel op; Je kunt jouw ideeën helder uitleggen en wilt groeien in communicatie, ook richting klanten; Je vindt samenwerken belangrijk, maar kunt ook zelfstandig je verantwoordelijkheid pakken; Je denkt in oplossingen en ziet kansen om data slimmer in te zetten; Heb je al ervaring met MS Foundry en Phyton dat is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste. Je travelpack wordt gevuld met Wat krijg jij van ons? Een traineeship dat met jou meegroeit, met persoonlijke begeleiding vanaf dag één; Training in technische tools, adviesvaardigheden en soft skills die je direct in de praktijk gebruikt; De kans om mee te werken aan projecten voor mooie klanten, samen met ervaren BI-specialisten die je graag meenemen in hun vak; Een goed salaris en sterke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een premievrij pensioen, bonusregeling, winstuitkering, onkostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding en een aantrekkelijke compensatieregeling; Ruimte voor een gezonde werk en privébalans, met onder andere reistijdcompensatie en flexibele werktijden; Vijf weken vakantie, met de mogelijkheid om een extra week bij te kopen; Een fijne, nuchtere werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt leren en kunt groeien op jouw manier. Neem contact op 9altitudes is de internationale proactieve voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie! Vandaag zijn we actief in 8 landen (Nederland, België, Brazilië, Denemarken, Spanje, Turkije, Portugal en Frankrijk). Met meer dan 800 werknemers hebben we een expertise in verschillende domeinen, zoals Microsoft Dynamics ERP en CRM, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IOT & Argumented Reality, CAD en e-commerce. Als Europese end-to-end-partner streven we de doelen van onze klanten na, gedreven door geïnspireerd denken. Onze teams en hun kennis zijn samengesmolten om 'echte waarde' te leveren, die verder gaat dan alleen expertise. We zijn er van overtuigd dat dit de beste garantie is voor duurzame bedrijfsresultaten voor onze klanten. Wij gaan ervoor ... jij ook? High time to say hi!

Het begeleiden van investeringsprojecten van concept tot operationele ingebruikname. Het standaardiseren van technische oplossingen en best practices voor toekomstige toepassingen. Wat breng je mee? items.desc: As the world leader in cleaning technology, Kärcher is known for innovation, quality, and sustainability. As a family-owned company, we value strong relationships with both our customers and our employees. To drive the success of our autonomous cleaning technology in the region, we are now looking for a highly skilled, commercially driven, and self-starting Regional KIRA Specialist. Location: Banbury, UK About The Role Kärcher is pioneering the future of industrial cleaning with intelligent, autonomous technology. As our Regional KIRA Specialist , you will act as the primary technical and commercial hub driving the adoption and performance of Kärcher’s autonomous robotics (KIRA) across the region. In this role, you will serve as a versatile technical expert and customer advocate. You will oversee the full lifecycle of autonomous deployments—from conducting initial site feasibility surveys and live product trials to managing cloud fleet telemetry and delivering hands-on technical troubleshooting. You will also bridge the gap between regional executive leadership, headquarters engineering teams, and ground-level facility operators. Key Responsibilities Technical Diagnostics & Fleet Operations Deliver expert remote and on-site troubleshooting, software updates, and mechanical or electrical adjustments. Monitor and optimize connected machines using cloud-based fleet management software, IoT telemetry, and web platforms such as KEM or OneView. Provide advanced operational support for autonomous systems, including LiDAR, sonar, optical sensors, 3D cameras, and spatial navigation mapping. Customer Success & Deployment Oversee end-to-end technical machine delivery, onboarding, and site configuration at customer facilities. Design and lead enablement training programs for facility staff, end-user operators, and internal sales/demonstration teams. Maintain active customer feedback loops, proactively resolving operational bottlenecks to ensure satisfaction. Identify successful deployments and collaborate on creating impactful customer case studies. Commercial Enablement & Market Growth Analyze target sectors—including Logistics, Retail, Healthcare, and Public Spaces—to identify high-potential opportunities for autonomous cleaning solutions. Conduct detailed physical site surveys and facility layout feasibility studies to assess infrastructure readiness for KIRA deployments. Deliver customer pitches, product demonstrations, live field trials, and specialized robotics workshops. Cross-Functional Coordination & Performance Reporting Serve as the vital link connecting HQ technical engineers (AKW), regional leadership (@ALG), and client facility teams. Track and evaluate robot operational metrics, providing performance reports directly to regional executive management. Qualifications & Experience We are looking for You hold a degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a technical equivalent—or equivalent hands-on background in industrial automation—with specialized certifications in Autonomous Systems, IoT Telemetry, or Robotics preferred. You bring proven experience in industrial automation, robotics, and cloud-based IoT fleet platforms. Your background demonstrates success leading live customer pitches, product demonstrations, physical site feasibility studies, machinery delivery, and technical training, with prior experience hosting specialized sales workshops or producing customer case studies preferred. You combine robust field and remote troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software systems with a deep understanding of sensor suites (LiDAR, sonar, optical, 3D cameras) and autonomous navigation mapping, with advanced data analytics capabilities for performance reporting preferred. Finally, you possess exceptional cross-functional collaboration and English communication skills to resolve issues objectively and partner with diverse stakeholders, with regional vertical experience across Logistics, Retail, Healthcare, or Public Spaces preferred. A valid driver’s license and the flexibility to travel for on-site client trials, field visits, and surveys are required. Does this sound like your next challenge? We look forward to receiving your application! We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your CV and application through the portal as soon as possible.

items.desc: Bij een hightech organisatie in Eindhoven voor engineering, assemblage van modules en machinesystemen en productie van complexe componenten maak je bedrijfsprocessen slimmer met AI en automatisering. Je vertaalt vraagstukken uit engineering, supply chain, kwaliteit, operations en finance naar praktische oplossingen. Denk aan workflowautomatisering, voorspellende analyses en generatieve AI. Daarbij combineer je technische vernieuwing met de eisen aan veiligheid, kwaliteit en compliance in een sterk gereguleerde omgeving. In de dagelijkse praktijk analyseer je processen, bouw je proofs of concept en werk je oplossingen uit tot betrouwbare toepassingen. Je schakelt met data engineers, IT en gebruikers over datakwaliteit, architectuur en integraties. Ook adviseer je het management over digitalisering en help je collega’s nieuwe werkwijzen toe te passen. Je verdiept je in nieuwe AI-methodieken, met aandacht voor uitlegbaarheid, logging, traceerbaarheid en beheersbare wijzigingen. Wat ga je doen? Analyseer en optimaliseer end-to-end bedrijfsprocessen van engineering tot finance. Ontwerp en implementeer workflowautomatisering met AI, low-code/no-code en scripting. Ontwikkel toepassingen voor voorspellende analyses, beslissingsondersteuning en veilige generatieve AI. Werk met data engineers en IT aan data-architectuur, datakwaliteit en systeemintegraties. Borg compliance, uitlegbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid met logging, traceerbaarheid en change control. Initieer proofs of concept en pilots en begeleid gebruikers bij de toepassing. Adviseer het management over digitaliseringsstrategie en relevante nieuwe technologie. Wat vragen we van jou? Je hebt een hbo/wo-diploma, bij voorkeur in Technische Informatica, Data Science/AI, Industriële Automatisering of Bedrijfskundige Informatica. Je hebt ervaring met AI/ML-toepassingen, API’s, webhooks of ERP/MES/PLM-integraties. Je analyseert complexe bedrijfsprocessen en vertaalt deze naar pragmatische technische oplossingen. Je communiceert helder met business, IT en compliance en begeleidt gebruikers bij veranderingen. Je werkt gestructureerd, onderzoekt nieuwe technologie en houdt oog voor risico’s en betrouwbaarheid. Ervaring in een gereguleerde sector zoals aerospace, defensie, medische industrie of semicon is een pre. Wat bieden wij jou? Bruto maandsalaris tussen € 3.800 en € 5.000 (indicatie op basis van functie en ervaring) 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Een bonusregeling. Reiskostenvergoeding en/of fietsvergoeding. Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een collectieve zorgverzekering. Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen een hightech omgeving. Een informele werksfeer met gezamenlijke activiteiten. #Jobster

items.desc:
Location: Bristol, UK 
 Start date: September 2027
 Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 
 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 
 The Graduate Programme at Graphcore
 Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.
 What you’ll work on
 Put your programming skills to work on the firmware that helps Graphcore products start up, communicate and run reliably.
 As a Graduate Firmware Engineer, you’ll help design, develop and deliver firmware for Graphcore’s next generation products. Working closely with our silicon and hardware teams, you’ll contribute to software that supports hardware bootup, power control, telemetry and monitoring.
 You’ll write firmware to Graphcore standards, review code, contribute to technical discussions and help investigate issues. You’ll also work with continuous integration, build systems and Agile practices.
 Your team and support
 The Firmware team develops the software that powers Graphcore hardware and silicon. We are involved in the design of hardware and software interfaces.
 You’ll work with engineers across teams through technical design discussions, code reviews, Agile ceremonies, and practical problem solving. Technical evidence and open discussion guide our decisions, with shared responsibility for product quality.

What you’ll work on 
 Put your engineering foundations to work on the electronic systems behind Graphcore’s AI compute platforms. 
 This role spans Hardware Design and Signal Integrity. Depending on your interests, project needs and developing strengths, you could focus on either area or work across both. You’ll build broad board-level engineering skills while developing deeper expertise. 
 In Hardware Design, you could develop circuits, select components, create schematics and work with PCB layout through review, bring-up and validation. You’ll compare simulations with laboratory measurements, investigate issues and take increasing ownership of defined analyses and interface reviews. 
 Your team and support 
 Hardware Design and Signal Integrity engineers work closely with PCB layout, silicon, validation, firmware, mechanical and thermal engineering, manufacturing and system teams. Together, they turn requirements into buildable hardware and investigate how it behaves in practice. 
 Staff Hardware Engineers and Team Leads will support you through design reviews, laboratory work and day-to-day collaboration. You’ll learn how the team identifies risks before boards are built and resolves issues during development. 
 Bring your questions and ideas, explain your reasoning and use evidence to challenge assumptions constructively. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when you spot a problem or need support.

 During the two-year programme, you’ll develop the judgement to connect circuit design and interconnect behaviour with the performance of a complete board. 
 You’ll gain experience with tools such as Mentor Expedition for hardware design, and Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS for electromagnetic and circuit simulation. Comparing models with measurements will help you test hypotheses, understand trade-offs and investigate faults methodically. 
 Following work through review, implementation, validation and release will help you build confidence in your decisions, document your reasoning and see where you’d like to deepen your expertise.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. 
 Our 12-month Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside subject matter experts. On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria. 
 We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 During the programme, you will 
 Report to the Lead Supportability Engineer and be responsible to comprehend and deliver a wide range of Supportability Engineering tasks, in order to meet the needs of Integrated Project Teams in winning and delivering their business. 
 As a Graduate Supportability Engineer, you will 
 Assist with the analysis, preparation and delivery of Supportability Engineering activities, with a particular focus on Supportability Analysis, across a variety of projects within Leonardo’s Electronic Warfare (EW) and Future Combat Air (FCA) Line of Business. You will help ensure that reliability and maintainability considerations influence product concepts and designs so that required performance and availability targets are met, while contributing to a culture of best-practice sharing and turning requirements into supportable solutions. 
 Working both independently and collaboratively with engineers and support staff across multiple UK and overseas locations, you will manage your time effectively and adapt to varied project needs. You will receive the training and mentoring needed to develop your supervisory skills and will have opportunities to take ownership of work packages, including planning and scheduling your own work and that of others. 
 What you will bring 
 A minimum 2:2 Bachelor’s or Integrated Master’s degree, or a higher degree such as an MSc or PhD. 
 Relevant degree disciplines include: 
 Aerospace Engineering 
 Physics 
 Mathematical Sciences 
 Mechanical Engineering 
 Electrical and Electronic Engineering 
 Other degree disciplines will also be considered. 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). items.desc:
About Us
 Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.
 Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.
 Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.
 We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.
 If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.
 The Job
 We're looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build the features, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Alongside that, you'll help own the quality of how we build: the tests, pipelines and guardrails that let us ship fast without breaking what care teams depend on.
 In this role, you will focus on:
 Feature Development : Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.
 Customer Insight : Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.
 Code Quality & Guardrails : Help own code quality across the frontend. Improve our CI/CD pipelines and automated tests, keep the infrastructure scalable, and build the guardrails that let AI coding agents contribute safely.
 Backend & APIs : Work with the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.
 Quality, Privacy & Safety : Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.
 Qualifications
 Several years of experience building production web applications.
 Strong TypeScript skills : this is the language for everything we build.
 Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.
 Experience with CI/CD and automated testing, and a strong sense of what good code quality looks like.
 Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.
 Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.
 Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.X
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with React Native and Expo in production.
 Experience working with AI coding agents in a real codebase.
 AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.
 Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.
 Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).
 What We Offer
 Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
 A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.
 A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.
 Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.
 Join Our Team
 We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.
 At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.
 If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Les gens parlent de nous pour la fiabilité de notre infra, notre support qui assure, et nos produits qui tiennent la route. Et franchement, ça fait plaisir. Pourquoi on recrute ? Nos services évoluent vite, nos projets se multiplient, et pour continuer à faire les choses bien, on agrandit la team IT ! Un poste est ouvert chez nous : Développeur Web PHP / Symfony (CDI, temps plein) Le job, concrètement : Tu rejoins une équipe de devs (sympas) qui bossent sur des projets au cœur de notre activité. Et il y a de quoi faire ! Tu prends soin de ton code : qualité, perf et sécurité sont dans ton ADN. Tu utilises Git , tu connais Gitlab ou Github . Tu es à l’aise sur Linux , la ligne de commande ne te fait pas peur, et tu sais faire du bash. Tu comprends l’anglais technique (genre lire une doc sans soupirer). Tu aimes bosser en équipe et tu communiques avec bienveillance. Et surtout : tu viens avec ta bonne humeur et ton esprit d’équipe ! items.desc: Type de contrat : CDD Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent Fonction : Doctorant A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelle Le centre de recherche Inria de l’Université Grenoble Alpes regroupe un peu moins de 600 personnes réparties au sein de 27 équipes de recherche et 8 services support à la recherche. Son effectif est distribué sur 3 campus à Grenoble, en lien étroit avec les laboratoires et les établissements de recherche et d'enseignement supérieur (Université Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, CEA, INRAE, …), mais aussi avec les acteurs économiques du territoire. Présent dans les domaines du calcul et grands systèmes distribués, logiciels sûrs et systèmes embarqués, la modélisation de l’environnement à différentes échelles et la science des données et intelligence artificielle, Inria Grenoble - Rhône-Alpes participe au meilleur niveau à la vie scientifique internationale par les résultats obtenus et les collaborations tant en Europe que dans le reste du monde. Contexte et atouts du poste Évaluation des risques liés aux modèles d’IA en Santé Contexte Les données de santé, généralement issues du soins, constituent un potentiel important pour la recherche et l’organisation du système de santé. Compte tenu du caractère sensible des données médicales, dont la divulgation non maîtrisée entraîne des risques d’atteinte à la réputation et de préjudices pour les personnes concernées, la mise en place de mesures de protections adéquates est un préalable à leur exploitation. Un cadre normatif strict s’applique d’ailleurs aux traitements réalisés sur ces données (règlement général sur la protection des données, loi informatique et liberté, méthodologies de référence, règles internes des organisations, etc.). Outre leur coût et leur complexité de mise en œuvre, ces mesures de protection limitent le potentiel d’exploitation des données et donc les conséquences positives attendues pour la santé des populations. Les méthodes visant à garantir la protection des données sensibles sont nombreuses comme l’anonymisation ou la dé-identification des informations, l’agrégation de données, l’apprentissage fédéré, ou la génération de données synthétiques . Dans leurs versions actuelles, ces méthodes ne permettent pas de répondre aux besoins pratiques d’un Entrepôt de Données de Santé (EDS) : Le choix de la méthode appropriée au cadre légal dans un contexte spécifique dépend de chaque situation et mélange des arguments de nature juridique, scientifique, organisationnel et technique ; Mise en œuvre complexe dans un environnement évoluant très rapidement (ex : structure des données souvent complexe, volumétrie importante, évolution rapide des méthodes et modèles de traitement des données, développement de méthodes de ré-identification par exemple sur les modèles entraînés sur des données personnelles, etc.) ; Faible niveau de connaissance sur les risques d’atteinte à la vie privée et les possibilités des méthodes de protection au sein des organisations ; Les craintes de risques résiduels d’atteinte à la vie privée conduisent souvent les organisation à une limitation préventives des traitements, parfois au-delà du cadre légal. Au sein de la direction des services numériques de l’AP-HP, le pôle innovation et données assure, parmi d’autres missions, le développement et l’exploitation d’un entrepôt de données de santé (EDS) regroupant les données de soin des hôpitaux de l’AP-HP. Cet entrepôt, l’un des plus importants d’Europe, contient des informations sur des millions de patients (dossiers médicaux, comptes rendus, résultats d’analyse, imagerie, etc.) et offre des perspectives importantes en matière de recherche clinique, d’appui au pilotage et plus largement d’innovation dans le domaine de la santé. Comme les autres entrepôts de données de santé, il est soumis à des impératifs d’exploitation et de transmission des données pour réaliser des missions primaires ainsi qu’à des contraintes réglementaires et éthiques fortes. Une grande partie de ces données issues d’un EDS sont des documents textuels non structurés sous forme de rapports médicaux. Avec l'essor de l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et l'avènement du traitement automatique du langage naturel (NLP), les grands modèles de langage (LLMs) sont de plus en plus utilisés pour automatiser le traitement de ces rapports médicaux. Les dossiers médicaux des patients sont des données extrêmement sensibles et privées. Leur utilisation et leur diffusion sont donc soumises à de nombreuses réglementations, telles que la loi HIPAA aux États-Unis ou le RGPD en Europe. Dans cette réglementation, l'une des principales conditions préalables à la diffusion des données médicales est la suppression de tout élément permettant l'identification directe (c'est-à-dire la dé-identification ou la pseudonymisation) ou indirecte (c'est-à-dire l'anonymisation) d'un patient. Les avancées récentes en NLP basées sur les réseaux de neurones ont démocratisé leur utilisation. Depuis l'avènement de ChatGPT, …

items.desc: Contesto e obiettivo del ruolo Sice Previt opera nei settori delle costruzioni e degli arredi su misura di alta gamma, gestendo attività che spaziano dalla preventivazione e dalla progettazione fino alla produzione e alla realizzazione delle commesse. Per supportare l’evoluzione dei propri processi, l’azienda ricerca un Forward Deployed AI Engineer da inserire in un percorso di crescita dedicato allo sviluppo e all’integrazione di soluzioni software e di intelligenza artificiale. La figura opererà a stretto contatto con le funzioni aziendali coinvolte nelle diverse fasi della commessa. Partendo dall’osservazione delle attività e dall’analisi dei flussi informativi, contribuirà a individuare opportunità di miglioramento e a trasformarle in soluzioni utilizzabili nel contesto operativo. Ambiti di attività I progetti potranno riguardare la preventivazione, la gestione delle commesse, la progettazione tecnica, gli acquisti e la produzione. Tra le iniziative previste rientrano lo sviluppo di applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale, l’integrazione dei sistemi aziendali e il progetto di sviluppo del MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Il MES è il sistema informatico che supporta la gestione operativa della produzione, consentendo, per esempio, di monitorare l’avanzamento delle lavorazioni, raccogliere dati dai reparti e garantire la tracciabilità delle attività. La figura contribuirà inoltre all’integrazione del MES e degli altri sistemi industriali con l’ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), il sistema gestionale che organizza le informazioni relative a commesse, ordini, acquisti, materiali e altri processi aziendali. L’obiettivo è assicurare continuità e coerenza dei dati tra pianificazione, progettazione e produzione. Principali responsabilità Affiancare preventivisti, project manager, progettisti, personale IT e reparti produttivi nell’analisi dei processi e dei bisogni operativi; Contribuire alla definizione dei requisiti funzionali e tecnici delle nuove soluzioni; Sviluppare, configurare e integrare applicazioni software e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale; Collaborare alla realizzazione del MES e allo scambio di dati tra MES, ERP e altri applicativi aziendali, insieme ai referenti interni e agli eventuali partner tecnologici; Realizzare prototipi e verificarli su casi d’uso reali, raccogliendo il riscontro degli utenti; Supportare il rilascio delle soluzioni, la documentazione tecnica e il miglioramento successivo alla messa in esercizio; Contribuire alla valutazione dei risultati in termini di efficienza, qualità dei dati e riduzione delle attività ripetitive. Requisiti Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni software, anche in ambiente web, e conoscenza dei principi di integrazione tra sistemi, con l’utilizzo dei seguenti linguaggi C#, Python, AL, T-SQL, Power Automate, Powershell, Power BI; Buona familiarità con database (prevalentemente MS SQL Server), API (Application Program Interface) e Data Analysis (BI); Interesse ed esperienza pratica nell’applicazione dell’intelligenza artificiale a processi o strumenti aziendali, sia tramite API sia in locale; Capacità di comprendere esigenze operative e tradurle in requisiti e soluzioni tecniche; Attitudine al confronto con interlocutori di funzioni diverse; Flessibilità, curiosità e apertura a rivedere le soluzioni proposte sulla base delle evidenze raccolte sul campo; Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Informatica. Competenze preferenziali Costituiscono un valore aggiunto la conoscenza dei sistemi ERP e/o MES, processi manifatturieri, strumenti CAD/CAM e contesti produttivi che operano su commessa. Non è richiesta una conoscenza pregressa di tutti i software e i processi di Sice Previt. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un ruolo trasversale, con collaborazione diretta con le funzioni tecniche e produttive; Partecipazione a progetti di digitalizzazione e intelligenza artificiale applicati a processi aziendali reali; Un percorso di crescita professionale nell’ambito dello sviluppo software, dell’integrazione dei sistemi e dei processi industriali; Package retributivo commisurato all’esperienza e al profilo del candidato, con una RAL indicativa compresa tra € 30.000 e € 50.000, in funzione dell’esperienza maturata, delle competenze tecniche e dell’effettiva seniority. Orario: Tempo pieno. Luogo di lavoro: Segrate (MI) La ricerca è rivolta a candidati e candidate nel rispetto dei principi di pari opportunità, inclusione e non discriminazione, ai sensi del D. Lgs 198/2006. I dati personali saranno trattati nel rispetto del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR). Contratto di lavoro: Tempo pieno Retribuzione: €30.000,00 - €50.000,00 all'anno Sede di lavoro: In presenza

items.desc: Il progetto Stiamo sviluppando uno strumento basato sull’intelligenza artificiale che parte dalla contabilità aziendale e utilizza i dati delle fatture per calcolare le emissioni di gas serra Scope 1, 2 e 3, fino al dettaglio della singola riga di spesa. L’obiettivo è rendere la misurazione dell’impronta carbonica più accessibile, precisa e scalabile, in coerenza con i principali standard e framework di riferimento, tra cui GHG Protocol, VSME ed ESRS. È il primo passo di un percorso più ampio: aiutare le aziende a misurare il proprio impatto ambientale e trasformare i dati in azioni concrete, attraverso programmi di impatto integrati nell’offerta di vendita. Il ruolo Cerchiamo una persona con solide competenze tecniche, attitudine commerciale e voglia di costruire. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il founder, contribuendo sia allo sviluppo commerciale sia alla validazione e all’evoluzione del prodotto. Il ruolo è trasversale, pensato per chi sa muoversi tra dati, tecnologia e relazioni con i clienti, con un approccio pragmatico e orientato ai risultati. 1. Sales & Business Development: circa 70% Sviluppo commerciale: identificare e contattare potenziali clienti, dalle PMI alle aziende strutturate, attraverso attività di prospezione diretta e cold calling. Gestione delle trattative: costruire relazioni con CEO, CFO e referenti ESG, gestendo il processo commerciale dalla prima conversazione alla chiusura di contratti ricorrenti. Costruzione del processo di vendita: sviluppare e affinare script, argomentazioni commerciali e modalità di approccio sulla base dei risultati e dei feedback raccolti sul campo. Sviluppo della relazione con il cliente: accompagnare le aziende dalla misurazione delle emissioni alla definizione di percorsi e programmi di impatto attraverso l’offerta Treedom. Sviluppo del mercato: contribuire a individuare segmenti, bisogni e opportunità commerciali per consolidare il posizionamento del prodotto. 2. Product & Carbon Accounting: circa 30% Test e validazione: utilizzare lo strumento su casi aziendali reali e verificare la coerenza dei risultati generati. Qualità metodologica: controllare i dati di input, i criteri di classificazione delle spese e i fattori di emissione utilizzati nei calcoli. Allineamento agli standard: contribuire a verificare la coerenza della metodologia con il GHG Protocol e con i requisiti applicabili dei framework VSME ed ESRS. Evoluzione del prodotto: raccogliere i feedback degli utenti e tradurli in indicazioni concrete per le priorità di sviluppo, lavorando a stretto contatto con il team. AI e automazione: utilizzare quotidianamente strumenti di intelligenza artificiale per accelerare analisi, test, attività di ricerca e produzione di materiali commerciali. Requisiti essenziali Laurea in ingegneria ambientale, energetica, gestionale o in un percorso affine. 2–4 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali o di business development nell’ambito della carbon footprint, della Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), della ISO 14064 o di soluzioni software per il carbon accounting, con risultati commerciali dimostrabili. Conoscenza solida del GHG Protocol e familiarità con VSME, ESRS e fattori di emissione, inclusi quelli DEFRA. Esperienza diretta nella prospezione commerciale e nel cold calling, con capacità di aprire conversazioni con interlocutori senior. Utilizzo concreto e quotidiano di strumenti di AI, come ChatGPT, Claude e soluzioni di automazione. Completano il profilo Approccio analitico e attenzione alla qualità e all’affidabilità dei dati. Autonomia operativa, spirito di iniziativa e capacità di lavorare in un contesto in evoluzione. Orientamento agli obiettivi, resilienza commerciale e capacità di trasformare i feedback in azioni. Curiosità tecnologica e interesse per l’utilizzo dell’AI nello sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e processi. La familiarità con Claude Code o strumenti analoghi costituisce un plus. Ottima padronanza dell’italiano e buona conoscenza dell’inglese. Cosa offriamo Responsabilità e ownership: un ruolo di prima linea nello sviluppo commerciale e nell’evoluzione di un nuovo prodotto. Impatto diretto: la possibilità di contribuire alle scelte di prodotto, alla metodologia e alla strategia di go-to-market. Accesso al management: collaborazione quotidiana con il fondatore e confronto diretto con il management aziendale. Autonomia e sperimentazione: spazio per testare approcci, sviluppare processi e costruire un modello commerciale scalabile. Retribuzione legata ai risultati: componente fissa e variabile connessa ai contratti conclusi. Missione concreta: lavorare per trasformare la misurazione delle emissioni in decisioni e interventi di impatto reale. Perché unirti a noi Non cerchiamo soltanto qualcuno che venda un software o validi dei dati. Cerchiamo una persona che voglia contribuire a costruire un prodotto, trovare il suo mercato e trasformare una nuova tecnologia in una soluzione concreta per le aziende. Definiowanie i utrzymywanie standardów, polityk oraz mechanizmów kontrolnych związanych z przetwarzaniem, integracją i udostępnianiem danych. items.desc: Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów. Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie - dlatego mamy własne R&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji. Działamy w takich modelach biznesowych jak managed services, fixed prices oraz wspieramy zespoły naszych klientów w modelach scale up the team. Naszymi klientami są firmy z wielu zróżnicowanych branż, szukające wsparcia najwyższej klasy ekspertów. Opis stanowiska Dla klienta z sektora ubezpieczeniowego poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Data Scientist, który dołączy do projektu skupiającego się na rozwoju nowoczesnego systemu do obsługi szkód i świadczeń. Rola w tym projekcie skupia się na pracy z modelami do oceny ryzyka, weryfikacji nowych metod i źródeł danych. Twój zakres obowiązków Budowa, rozwój i utrzymanie modeli oceny ryzyka nadużyć. Realizacja pełnego cyklu życia modeli: pozyskiwanie i analiza danych, przygotowania, trenowanie modeli, po wdrożenie. Dobór odpowiednich metod analitycznych i modelowych do problemów biznesowych z wykorzystaniem różnych danych (tabelaryczne / tekstowe / grafowe). Projektowanie i rozwijanie feature engineering. Analiza jakości danych oraz identyfikacja ograniczeń. Weryfikacja nowych modeli i źródeł danych. Interpretacja, wyjaśnianie i dokumentowanie wyników analiz oraz modeli. Współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi i programistami w celu wdrażania i utrzymywania wprowadzonych rozwiązań. Nasze wymagania Min. 3 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku Data Scientist. Doświadczenie we wdrażaniu wytworzonych modeli na środowiska produkcyjne. Umiejętność oceny skuteczności modeli oraz przewidywania ich zachowania w środowisku produkcyjnym. Umiejętność oceny, jak model poradzi sobie po wprowadzeniu na produkcji i uzasadnić jego wskazania. Bardzo dobra znajomość SQL. Doświadczenie w budowie modeli klasyfikacyjnych, od etapu regresji logistycznej i do gradient boosting. Praktyczna znajomość feature engineering. Umiejętność doboru metod walidacji oraz metryk oceny modeli. Umiejętność projektowania eksperymentów i analizy ich rezultatów. Znajomość metod wyjaśniania modeli, np. SHAP. Umiejętność samodzielnego programowania i prowadzenia eksperymentów analitycznych. Znajomość aktualnych trendów i metod w obszarze machine learning. Umiejętność oceny zasadności wykorzystania modeli LLM w porównaniu z klasycznymi metodami analitycznymi. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w obszarze przeciwdziałania nadużyciom (Fraud Detection), AML lub ryzyka kredytowego. Znajomość branży ubezpieczeniowej. Doświadczenie w analizie sieci powiązań oraz modelowaniu danych grafowych. Doświadczenie w obszarze NLP, szczególnie dla języka polskiego. Doświadczenie w monitorowaniu modeli po wdrożeniu produkcyjnym. Znajomość języka Java. Doświadczenie w pracy z repozytoriami kodu, testami automatycznymi, code review oraz współpracą w zespołach programistycznych. To oferujemy Stabilność zatrudnienia - długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT. Elastyczne formy współpracy - umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie. Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego. Treningi na siłowni F45 - zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów. Wewnętrzny program poleceń. Możliwość finansowania certyfikatów IT. W zależności od projektu pracujemy w trybie hybrydowym, zdalnym lub stacjonarnym. Wydarzenia okolicznościowe oraz wyjazdy integracyjne - budujemy zgrany zespól również poza biurem. Lubimy pomagać - wspieramy akcje charytatywne, takie jak Szlachetna Paczka, a w ramach #PomagamyNexio angażujemy się tam, gdzie naprawdę możemy coś zmienić. items.desc: Desarrolla una carrera profesional con nosotros ¡Me apunto! Forma parte de una compañía puntera en el sector seguros Aplicamos tecnología de vanguadia en el sector seguros. Crece con nosotros y lidera proyectos pioneros en este sector. ¿Cómo es trabajar en Reale ITES? En Reale ITES ofrecemos la experiencia y estabilidad que solo una gran empresa con gran recorrido puede ofrecer. El lugar de empleo será en nuestra oficina del centro de Madrid, con un horario de jornada completa e intensiva, dependiendo de la época del año, y teletrabajo varios días a la semana. Se ofrece un contrato indefinido con un salario atractivo e interesantes beneficios sociales. Reale Seguros cuenta con los reconocimientos mejor valorados para trabajar en una empresa: Great Place to Work, Empresa Familiarmente Responsable, Igualdad en la Empresa y Sellos de Horarios Racionales. ¿A quién estamos buscando? En Reale ITES, parte de Reale Group, activamos una posición de Data Scientist para formar parte del Group Data Science Centre of Excellence. Los principales requisitos que estamos buscamos son: Grado universitario (STEM). Alto conocimiento práctico de modelos predictivos/prescriptivos, técnicas de Machine/Deep Learning y modelos de lenguaje (LLM) e IA generativa . Altos estándares de ética digital, muy especialmente sobre el uso ético y responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial . Dominio de Python . Sólidos conceptos y aplicación práctica de ingeniería del software. Conocimientos de lenguajes de prototipado rápido. Experiencia en desarrollo de modelos estadísticos y predictivos/prescriptivos. Experiencia en stack tecnológico MS Azure y sus soluciones orientadas a AA/AI (altamente recomendable). Experiencia en proyectos de diversa escala (muy valorable si internacionales) bajo metodologías agile. Nivel de inglés B2. Valoraremos muy positivamente si cuentas con experiencia previa en el sector de seguros, aunque no es indispensable. La persona seleccionada deberá aportar alto nivel en las competencias: Trabajo en equipo y cooperación, Ejecución, Orientación a resultados, Apertura al cambio, Resolución de problemas, Resiliencia y auto-desarrollo personal ¿Qué tendrás que hacer? La misión principal del rol de Data Scientist es actuar como nexo entre las necesidades de negocio de la compañía y la analítica avanzada, traduciendo los requerimientos corporativos en modelos cuantitativos, prototipos y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. Para ello, la persona seleccionada se encarga de desarrollar soluciones piloto, coordinar entregables técnicos en equipos multidisciplinares, presentar resultados a audiencias no técnicas e investigar técnicas innovadoras que impulsen la toma de decisiones basada en datos. Algunas de las funciones más específicas Comprender las necesidades de las líneas de negocio y saber cómo traducirlas en términos de análisis de datos y modelos cuantitativos de Analítica Avanzada e Inteligencia Artificial Desarrollar el conocimiento de los datos recopilados y su estructura, así como de los sistemas en los que están contenidos hasta donde sea preciso para la realización con éxito de su actividad. Desarrollar prototipos rápidos y soluciones piloto que permitan a las áreas de negocio un mejor entendimiento de las soluciones de Data Science propuestas. Analizar y valorar opciones make/buy para dar solución a las necesidades de negocio y la estrategia definida por la organización, colaborando con proveedores externos y fabricantes de soluciones Presentar resultados a un público no técnico, tanto a través de informes regulares como en reuniones y presentaciones. Participar en equipos multidisciplinares (Negocio, Data/AI/Visualization Engineers, IT Architects, SW Engineers) en los diferentes proyectos en los que se requiera. Para Sistemas de IA específicos, coordinar y desarrollar los entregables técnicos de las soluciones E2E junto al equipo de desarrollo (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, MLOps engineers, Data Visualization Engineers, SW Engineers, …) Investigar nuevas técnicas dentro de las disciplinas bajo su competencia (Analítica Avanzada e Inteligencia Artificial) y sugerir e impulsar cambios guiados por los datos (Data Driven) que contribuyan a mejorar los resultados de Negocio. ¿Cómo será el proceso de selección? Regístrate Rellena el formulario de registro. No te llevará más de un minuto Test Online Realiza las pruebas que nos ayudarán a entender tu perfil y fortalezas Conoce al equipo Participa de nuestra entrevista personal para conocer mejor tus intereses y motivaciones ¡Bienvenido a Reale! Entra a formar parte de nuestra compañía!

items.desc: Är du en utvecklare som gillar att ta idéer hela vägen till färdiga produkter? Vill du kombinera teknisk skicklighet med AI, automation och smarta lösningar som skapar verkligt värde? Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig. Vi söker en driven och nyfiken Software Developer som vill vara med och bygga, förbättra och utveckla våra digitala tjänster. Hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka hur vi arbetar, komma med egna idéer och omsätta visioner till fungerande produkter. Vi tror på att kombinera bra kod med AI för att utveckla snabbare, arbeta smartare och skapa bättre resultat. Om rollen I rollen arbetar du genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från idé och problemlösning till utveckling, testning och produktion. Du vidareutvecklar våra befintliga system och bygger nya lösningar med fokus på kvalitet, användarupplevelse och affärsnytta. Du förväntas inte bara lösa uppgifter som någon annan har definierat. Vi vill att du själv ser vad som kan förbättras, kommer med egna idéer och driver utvecklingen framåt. Det kan handla om allt från att automatisera arbetsflöden och förbättra våra system till att utveckla hemsidor och funktioner som gör det enklare för fler människor att hitta rätt hjälp. AI är en naturlig del av vårt utvecklingsarbete. Vi söker dig som använder AI-verktyg aktivt för att effektivisera utvecklingen, men som också har kunskapen att granska, testa och kvalitetssäkra resultatet. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med Ta idéer från koncept till färdig produkt och produktion. Utveckla och förbättra backend, frontend, databaser och API. Identifiera möjligheter till AI-automation och smartare tekniska lösningar. Vidareutveckla våra hemsidor, system och digitala tjänster. Förbättra konvertering och användarupplevelse genom kontinuerliga förbättringar och A/B-tester. Skriva strukturerad, läsbar, testbar och säker kod. Bidra med egna idéer och tekniska initiativ som skapar bättre resultat. Vi söker dig som Har erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling och god förståelse för objektorienterad programmering. Har erfarenhet av både backend och frontend, gärna med PHP, Vue.js och Nuxt. Har god vana av databaser, API och integrationer. Använder AI-verktyg i din utveckling och vet hur du kvalitetssäkrar det som genereras. Kan ta ansvar för en lösning hela vägen från idé till färdig produkt. Är bra på att identifiera problem, se möjligheter och hitta egna lösningar. Har ett öga för användarupplevelse och förstår att teknik ska bidra till konkreta resultat. Trivs i ett högt tempo där du får stort eget ansvar och samarbetar nära andra. Vi är öppna för olika erfarenhetsnivåer. Det viktigaste är att du är tekniskt skicklig, har ett starkt eget driv och vill fortsätta utvecklas. Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett, men du ska vara nyfiken, våga testa och vilja bygga saker som blir bättre än det vi har idag. Därför kommer du att trivas hos oss Stort utrymme att påverka: Du får komma med egna idéer och vara med och forma våra tekniska lösningar. Från idé till verklighet: Du får följa arbetet hela vägen och se resultatet av det du bygger. Vi är ett företag som växer utan externa investerare och avtal med regionen, vilket bidrar till korta beslutsvägar. AI i praktiken: Du får utforska hur AI och automation kan göra utvecklingen effektivare och våra tjänster bättre. Ansvar och tempo: Vi gillar när saker händer, beslut fattas och bra idéer blir verklighet. Nära samarbete: Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor som delar kunskap, tänker nytt och vill framåt. Om Svea KBT & Elly Care Utan hjälp av externa investerare har vi gått från 5 till över 150 medarbetare och över 20 kliniker runt om i Sverige på fyra år. Det har vi gjort genom att engagera oss i det värde vi skapar: psykisk hälsa. Svea KBT och Elly Care arbetar brett inom psykisk hälsa, från terapi och medicinsk behandling till neuropsykiatriska utredningar, företagshälsa, utbildningar och handledning. Våra psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor arbetar sida vid sida med ett verksamhetsteam som ständigt utvecklar och förbättrar verksamheten. Vi gillar tempo, ansvar och utveckling. Här finns stor kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och noll prestige. Vi testar nya idéer, utmanar befintliga arbetssätt och letar alltid efter smartare sätt att nå och hjälpa fler människor. Vi har en spännande resa framför oss och vill att du ska vara med och bygga nästa del av den. Praktisk information Placering: Stockholm Solna, med minst 60 % närvaro på kontoret. Omfattning: Heltid. Start: Enligt överenskommelse. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan!

items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the NHS as a Data Scientist based in Bristol. The ICB’s Data Science team was one of the earliest teams set up within the NHS to employ specialist quantitative skills to some of the biggest healthcare problems of the day. We use a wide variety of techniques within the operational research, mathematical modelling, statistical analysis, data science and machine learning toolkits, often working at the interface of academic research and practical application. No problem is too big or too small, and we endeavour to apply the most appropriate solution to the problem, whatever that may be. Therefore expect a varied workload and the opportunity to learn and apply new skills. Also expect an opportunity to collaborate with universities, run externally-funded projects, and write research papers. Flexible working options are available, subject to a required minimum 50% working in the central Bristol office. Occasional travel may be expected. Applicants need not have experience in managing others, and experience within the NHS or wider health field is not required. Of most importance is a good grasp of applied modelling approaches underpinned by degree-level qualification(s) in a quantitative discipline. Experience of coding in statistical languages, especially in ‘R’, is strongly desirable. The role-holder should have an open and inquisitive mind and be prepared to think innovatively and creatively. We are committed to creating an inclusive organisation that promotes and values diversity. We know from experience that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger, more creative workplace that helps us to deliver the best services. We welcome applications which represent the rich diversity of our community; from people of all ages, disabled people, all genders, people from ethnic minority groups, LGBTQ+ people, people with diverse gender identity and expression, people from all religions and beliefs and other diverse characteristics, and we have processes in place to ensure that all applications are treated fairly and consistently at every stage of the recruitment process. Production and deployment of advanced statistical, analytical, and models-based solutions for defined workstreams that support system priorities. Work under direction to support colleagues where specialist modelling and analytical input is required. Advise on innovative opportunities and support strategic commissioning leads to maximise the use of quantitative techniques and approaches. Communicate complex information and analysis, concisely conveying results and insights from sophisticated quantitative methods to a wide range of non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Participate in external networks, including national and regional Population Health Management groups and learned societies such as the Operational Research Society, to share best practice and keep up to date with the latest approaches. Contribute to growth and seasonality components in the setting of activity plans between the ICB and acute providers as part of the annual planning cycle, and in support of ad hoc modelling requirements in relation to acute or other provider contracts throughout the year. Support the training and development in quantitative approaches and visualisation methods within the Data and Analytics team.

Our Data & Analytics team is building a technically advanced, commercially focused and impactful capability, powering our Next Level Strategy and helping to create a Sainsbury’s powered by industry leading AI algorithms. We use data, technology and advanced analytics to drive better decisions across the business, from forecasting and optimisation to experimentation, personalisation and machine learning. With one of the richest retail datasets I n the UK and a portfolio spanning Sainsbury’s, Argos, Habitat and Nectar, the opportunity to innovate is huge. Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges at scale, create measurable impact and grow quickly alongside brilliant colleagues. People who thrive with us combine business understanding, technical expertise and curiosity, with a natural instinct for problem-solving. Join us and help shape the future of retail through data and AI. Associate Data Scientist – ML / Python – London/Hybrid Working What you’ll do As a Data Scientist and member of our Data Science team, you will play a pivotal role in developing in-house data science solutions that automate decision-making and provide valuable insights across our business. Working in cross-functional agile squads, you will contribute to the design and development of our data science products. You will deliver high-quality analyses that guide future development work and contribute to the team’s continuous learning and upskilling efforts. Why join us Wide impact. Deploying models here means improving the experience of millions of customers each day. Range of projects. Our projects vary from supply chain optimisation for Argos, predicting which substitution products online shoppers prefer, to helping our Sainsburys colleagues keep shelves full. Focus on data science work . Access to extensive, clean, and well-documented data in our industry-leading platform: spend your time building data science solutions, not cleaning datasets. Time for growth. 10% of time set aside for learning & personal development Learning and mentoring. With a team of 50 data scientists, engineers and product managers, there are lots of opportunities to learn from colleagues through knowledge shares, pair programming, and communities of practice. Flexible working. Our team prioritizes hybrid working, both at home and in our central London Farringdon office. Save on groceries . 10% discount on products across Sainsburys (Up to 15% for two days each week!) Join us and be part of a team that encourages innovation, values your expertise, and prioritises work-life balance while delivering exceptional results. What you need to excel in this role: Essential: Educated to degree level, preferably within a mathematical, statistical or STEM discipline Proven track record of using Python and SQL to deliver complex ML solutions in a corporate environment or substantial relevant academic experience. Strong statistical foundation in concepts such as regression, hypothesis testing and experimental design. Strong presentation skills and business acumen: you regularly receive positive feedback about your ability to explain complex topics to non-technical audiences You feel comfortable working independently to achieve results using your own guidance and initiative. Experience getting the best out of sklearn and tree-based models. Highly proficient in Git best practices. You are familiar with software engineering best practises and can utilise them to produce code that passes an engineering code review. Desirable: A relevant Post-graduate degree (Masters or PhD) within a mathematical, statistical or other STEM discipline. Experience delivering value on ML projects in retail (in areas such as price elasticity or differential pricing) or supply chain (demand forecasting, optimisation). Experience with composite materials (e.g., cutting, laminating, bonding, and finishing) is a strong plus. Familiarity with manufacturing and prototyping processes, including machining, basic fabrication, and 3D printing. High attention to detail and commitment to quality throughout the prototyping process. Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to work effectively in a cross-functional team. Flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative development environment. items.desc: Department of Cancer Immunology, Institute of Cancer Research, Oslo University Hospital Oslo Om jobben Lagre favoritt Oppstart 15. januar 2027 Stillingstittel Special Engineer Type ansettelse Engasjement, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Vis flere detaljer Søk senest søndag 15. november A research engineer (spesialingeniør) position in molecular and cell biology is available in the research group targeted therapies and immunomodulation headed by Prof. Mouldy Sioud, Department of Cancer Immunology, Institute of Cancer Research, Oslo University Hospital-Radiumhospitalet. The research group focuses on the development of new cancer therapeutics such as antibodies, antibody derivatives, and modified mRNA cancer vaccines using in vitro screening platforms and cell and molecular techniques. The position will provide a unique opportunity to pursue basic and translational research with the aim to identify novel targets and strategies for cancer immunotherapy. Further information on the activity of the research group can be accessed at http://ous-research.no/sioud/. To date, the group has published 220 scientific papers, all of which are indexed in PubMed. Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Position Description The successful candidate will work closely with the group leader and other team members to design and conduct a range of in vitro and in vivo experiments, analyse experimental data, and contribute to scientific publications. The main aim is to identify cell-surface receptors involved in antibody binding to cancer cells and enhance the efficacy of mRNA-based cancer vaccines through mRNA modifications The position is available for one year with the possibility for extension based on the candidate performance. Requirements Master's degree in molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, immunology, or a related field Practical experience in molecular and cellular biology, including cell culture, transfection, cloning, and protein analysis Experience with flow cytometry, immunoprecipitation, tagged protein purification, and/ or immunological techniques is highly desirable Good communication skills in English and the ability to work independently and collaboratively How to apply Only applications received through webcruiter will be considered and should include A brief cover letter describing your research experience, relevant technical expertise, and motivation for applying A CV outlining relevant education, research experience, and technical skills Contact details for two references We offer A varied and exciting work in an environment in the intersection between research and industry, developing novel cancer treatments A productive and motivating research environment Attractive welfare benefits Salary according to the OUS salary scale Kontaktinformasjon Mouldi Sioud, Enhetsleder, mouldi.sioud@ous-research.no Arbeidssted Ullernchausseen 70 0310 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon: Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5195633177 Stillingsprosent: 100% Contract Startdato: 15.01.2027 Sluttdato: 14.01.2028 Søknadsfrist: 15.11.2026 Kontaktperson for stillingen Mouldi Sioud Enhetsleder mouldi.sioud@ous-research.no Om bedriften Oslo University Hospital is a highly specialized hospital in charge of extensive regional and local hospital assignments. As Scandinavia’s largest hospital, we carry out more than 1.2 million patient treatments each year. The hospital has a nationwide responsibility for a number of national and multi-regional assignments, and has several national centers of competence. Oslo University Hospital is responsible for approximately 50 percent of all medical and health care research conducted at Norwegian hospitals, and is a significant role player within the education of a large variety of health care personnel. items.desc: Purpose. Performance. People. Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians. With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide. For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success. The Role As an Analyst in External Portfolio Management (EPM), you will support the evaluation, monitoring and management of external investment managers and co-investment opportunities across global public markets. Working alongside investment professionals, you will contribute to hedge fund due diligence, investment research, portfolio analysis and the development of investment recommendations. This 12-month contract offers an opportunity to develop your investment expertise and contribute to informed investment decision-making at CPP Investments. The Team The Capital Markets and Factor Investing (CMF) department invests globally across public equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and derivatives, and oversees external investment managers and public market co-investments. Within CMF, the External Portfolio Management (EPM) team allocates capital to external managers, including hedge funds, and co-investment opportunities across investment strategies, trading styles, asset classes and geographies in public markets. Accountabilities Monitor and analyse existing fund investments, including developing robust, flexible tools to support ongoing portfolio analysis. Conduct quantitative and qualitative hedge fund due diligence, evaluating investment processes, team capabilities and contributions to the broader portfolio. Evaluate co-investment opportunities across fundamental equities, credit and macro strategies. Research hedge fund strategies, performance across market environments and industry trends to develop investment insights. Support weekly research meetings and contribute to investment discussions. Prepare investment memoranda and recommendations, and participate in investment recommendation meetings and decision-making processes. Contribute to research on portfolio strategy and construction, factor modelling and portfolio optimisation. Understanding of public capital markets; familiarity with alternative investment strategies is an asset. Strong analytical, qualitative research, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop thoughtful solutions to complex challenges. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas and contribute to investment discussions. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with an interest in learning, sharing perspectives and contributing to team success. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook. Interest in developing a career in investment management, with a commitment to integrity, partnership and high performance. You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment. We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact. Inclusion & Accessibility CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. items.desc: Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing. That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building. Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time. One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion. That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch. If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters. We're looking for people who want to build that future with us. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products. You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding. We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges. We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to mid-level engineer or/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must. What you will do: Train state-of-the-art machine learning models Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge Define and supervise data annotation tasks Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks What you will need: MSc or PhD in a relevant field Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects Great coding skills Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts Ability to examine details closely and critically Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community. Values we hold at Veo: Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work. Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing. Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills. Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes. Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally) We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

items.desc: Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. Cato Networks is looking for an experienced Research Engineer to join the Cato Security team. As a security engineer in the Threats team, you will take part in analyzing emerging security threats, reproducing them in a lab environment, and developing prevention logic based on Cato's proprietary security engines. Your work outcome will feed Cato Cloud security products and protect thousands of enterprises around the globe. In your day-to-day, you will be tasked with researching and analyzing exploits and post exploitation tools and techniques used by attackers, as well as performing meticulous data analysis - harnessing Cato's big data warehouse - to produce the best possible prevention logic. In addition, each member in our team of six engineers has their own long-term projects, ranging from developing automation and internal tools, researching a complex issue, or contributing to new product feature developments (which there are many). Joining Cato is an excellent opportunity for network security enthusiasts who are passionate about the future of Networking and Security. Responsibilities Research and analyze new threats and develop product content such as IPS signatures and logic to provide the best protection for Cato’s customers. Enhance product accuracy and its ability to detect new threats in the dynamically changing security landscape. Monitor and analyze your work to maintain 0 false positive rate. Utilize Cato Data Warehouse with big data technologies to support your work. Requirements At least 2 years of hands-on experience in the cybersecurity industry. Excellent knowledge of networking architecture and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL, HTTP, SMB, etc.). Understand the cyber-security landscape, and common attack scenarios: Exploitation, Malware C&C, Post exploitation, Phishing, Network scans, etc. Experience (Hands-on) with Wireshark and PCAP analysis. Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python or PowerShell - a must. Experience with signature development for IPS and Firewall - Advantage. Analytic spirit: define a thesis and validate it based on in-depth analysis and technical facts. Excellent English and communication skills. Team player, responsible, independent, and well-organized. B.Sc. in Computer Science, Information technology or Mathematics. We operate in a hybrid model, requiring three days in the office. Location: NR7, Náměstí republiky, Prague, Czech Republic.

items.desc: Die Hochschule für Technik, Wirtschaft und Kultur Leipzig (HTWK Leipzig) ist eine der führenden Hochschulen für Angewandte Wissenschaften in Deutschland. Mit einer Vielzahl an innovativen Studiengängen, interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekten und einer starken Vernetzung in die regionale Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft bieten wir eine lebendige akademische Umgebung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams ist an der Fakultät Informatik und Medien folgende Stelle zum 01.11.2026 zu besetzen: Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin/Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter für Computer Vision und digitales Kulturerbe (w/m/d) Ihre Aufgaben An der HTWK Leipzig ist im Rahmen des Forschungsprojektes „V.E.R.B. - Verschwundenes Erbe - Rekonstruierte Bauwerke. Bauerbe als Ressource für gesellschaftliche Resilienz“ eine wissenschaftliche Stelle mit dem Ziel der Promotion zu besetzen. Das auf 36 Monate angelegte Verbundprojekt der HTWK Leipzig und des Leibniz-Instituts für Raumbezogene Sozialforschung (IRS) untersucht, wie gesellschaftliche Aneignung, digitale Technologien und Erinnerungsprozesse zusammenwirken, wenn gebaute Umwelt sich verändert oder verschwindet. Kultur-, sozial- und geisteswissenschaftliche Forschung wird dabei mit digitalen Methoden verbunden. Im Zentrum des an der HTWK Leipzig angesiedelten Forschungsprojektes steht die maschinelle Analyse und Rekonstruktion baulicher Veränderungen . Untersucht wird zugleich, wie algorithmische Verfahren selbst zu Akteuren erinnerungskultureller Prozesse werden. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere: Recherche und Erprobung von Verfahren des maschinellen Sehens und Machine Learnings für historische Bildbestände; Aufbau und Aufbereitung geeigneter Datensets für maschinelles Sehen; Entwicklung und Training von Machine-Learning-Modellen; Erprobung von Deep-Learning-basiertem Bild-Matching zur Ergänzung fehlender räumlicher und zeitlicher Metadaten; Mitwirkung an Verfahren zur 3D-Rekonstruktion historischer bzw. verschwundener Bauwerke auf Grundlage historischer Fotografien; Arbeit mit digitalen Bildverarbeitungsverfahren, KI-gestützten Qualitäts- und Georeferenzierungsalgorithmen sowie Structure-from-Motion-Techniken (SfM); Literaturrecherche und wissenschaftliche Einordnung. Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Verbundprojekt an der Schnittstelle von Digital Humanities, Digital Cultural Heritage, maschinellem Sehen, 3D-Rekonstruktion, Architektur- und Erinnerungskulturforschung sowie Forschungsdatenmanagement . Grundlage der technischen Arbeiten sind u. a. historische Architekturfotografien aus den Wissenschaftlichen Sammlungen zur Bau- und Planungsgeschichte der DDR am IRS sowie weitere historische Fotografien, Karten und Pläne. Das bringen Sie mit einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Masterabschluss oder einen vergleichbaren Hochschulabschluss in Medieninformatik, Informatik, Bibliotheks- und Informationswissenschaft, Digital Humanities, Data Science oder einer verwandten Disziplin; Interesse an einer wissenschaftlichen Qualifikation und der Anfertigung einer Dissertation im Themenfeld des Projektes; Kenntnisse bzw. Interesse im Bereich Machine Learning, Computer Vision und digitale Bildverarbeitung; Interesse an der Verarbeitung und Analyse historischer Bilddaten; Interesse an Verfahren der räumlichen Zuordnung und 3D-Rekonstruktion; Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit zwischen digitalen Methoden und kultur- bzw. geisteswissenschaftlicher Forschung; Interesse an nachvollziehbaren, dokumentierten und nachnutzbaren Forschungsworkflows sowie am Forschungsdatenmanagement. Wir bieten Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem interessanten und vielfältigen Aufgabengebiet mit Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie erhalten eine umfassende Einarbeitung. Individuelle Entwicklungsgespräche und umfangreiche Weiter- und Fortbildungsangebote. Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gesundheit liegen uns am Herzen. Hierfür bieten wir insbesondere flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, einen familiengerechten Arbeitsplatz und vielfältige Angebote des Hochschulgesundheitsmanagements sowie des Hochschulsports. Sie erhalten eine Jahressonderzahlung und haben die Möglichkeit, ein ermäßigtes Ticket für den bundesweiten Personennahverkehr (Deutschland-Jobticket) zu beziehen.
