items.card: About The Role As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities. Responsibilities Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets. Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data. Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response. Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable. Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints. Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results. Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements. Candidate Requirements 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably. Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus. Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions. A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight. Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Data Scientist Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world. You'll work alongside curious, ambitious technologists who value ownership, rigour, and fast, visible impact over process for its own sake. Rather than settling into one fixed lane, you'll move with the work as priorities shift, growing your expertise across a genuinely wide range of problems. If you want your day-to-day work to reach millions of patients and to help shape what a still-emerging technology looks like in practice, this is a rare moment to join at the ground floor. At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our Warsaw or Poznań office on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. The opportunity: Roche's AI Function builds the platforms, tools, and data science muscle that let teams across Roche turn AI, GenAI, and agentic ideas into real products, fast. We make it safe, simple, and scalable to build with LLMs, enterprise data, and orchestration, so experimentation stops staying experimental and starts driving real business value. And now we're pushing further into agentic AI: systems that reason, plan, and act on their own, under human oversight. Join us and help define how Roche builds, evaluates, and governs that next generation of AI at enterprise scale. items.desc: Role Purpose The Team The AI Team, part of Front Office Technology, builds the AI tools and platforms used across the front office: assistants and agents for investment teams, secure access to firm data and knowledge, and the controls that let AI be used safely in a regulated trading environment. We build central capabilities for the whole firm and support teams across the business as they build their own, bringing the most successful into Technology ownership as they grow in importance. The Role As an AI Engineer with a focused on optimisation, you will build and run the AI tools and platforms used across the front office, and make sure the firm gets the most value from its AI spend. You will design and deliver central AI services, assistants and agents for PMs, traders and researchers, while making AI usage more efficient across providers and teams. A key area is moving suitable workloads onto open-weight models served on our own GPUs, fine-tuned where needed, at a fraction of the cost of external APIs. The team is small and priorities shift as the firm’s use of AI grows. You will be expected to pick up other priorities across the team as they arise, so this role will not be dedicated solely to cost optimisation. Why Join Build AI tools used in live investment workflows, and help the firm run its own models on its own GPUs. Join an AI function with a real mandate and the backing to shape how AI is built across the firm. Work with current frontier AI tooling in a team that values engineering discipline over hype. Key Responsibilities Building front office AI tools Build central platform capabilities such as model access, an AI gateway, MCP services and knowledge retrieval, with entitlements, audit and monitoring built in. Design, build and run AI assistants, agents and services used by PMs, traders, quants and researchers. Self-hosted models Stand up and run production inference for open-weight models on our own GPUs, using engines such as vLLM or SGLang behind OpenAI-compatible APIs. Fine-tune models for specific front office tasks with LoRA and QLoRA, and serve multiple adapters efficiently on shared base models. Apply quantisation (e.g. FP8, AWQ, GPTQ) and serving optimisations such as prefix caching, continuous batching, speculative decoding and tensor parallelism to get the most from each GPU. Benchmark latency and throughput (time to first token, inter-token latency, tokens per second) with tools such as GuideLLM, and plan GPU capacity against service levels. Run inference on Kubernetes with GPU scheduling, autoscaling, and monitoring of GPU utilisation and health. Cost optimisation Route traffic across hosted and self-hosted models through a central gateway such as LiteLLM, sending each workload to the cheapest model that meets its quality bar. Apply cost levers: model right-sizing, prompt caching, batching and context efficiency. Compare the cost and quality of self-hosted and API models per task, and support provider and hardware decisions with evidence. Centralising and reuse Identify AI applications built in the business with real usage or value, and bring them onto central platforms. Turn repeated requirements into shared services, MCP servers, skills and agent templates, reducing duplication across teams and providers. Wider AI engineering Pick up other priorities across the team as they arise, from new front office tools to knowledge services, MCP integrations and data access. Contribute to shared engineering standards, code review and production support. Business outcomes Provide usage, performance and cost metrics from the models and services you run to the colleague responsible for AI spend reporting, so decisions to scale, consolidate or retire AI tools are based on data. BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. As an employer, we provide equal opportunities to all people regardless of their gender, marital or civil partnership status, race, religion or ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation or nationality.

items.card: Kan du lide at bygge nye tekniske løsninger med data, AI og automatisering? Kan du omsætte komplekse problemer til software – også når de rigtige data eller værktøjer ikke findes endnu? Så er det måske dig, vi søger. JP/Politiken Redaktionel AI, Metode & Research er en ny fælles specialistfunktion, der skal styrke journalistikken gennem AI, data, OSINT og digitale metoder – og udvikle nye værktøjer til
items.desc: Kan du lide at bygge nye tekniske løsninger med data, AI og automatisering? Kan du omsætte komplekse problemer til software – også når de rigtige data eller værktøjer ikke findes endnu? Så er det måske dig, vi søger. JP/Politiken Redaktionel AI, Metode & Research er en ny fælles specialistfunktion, der skal styrke journalistikken gennem AI, data, OSINT og digitale metoder – og udvikle nye værktøjer til redaktionerne. Afdelingen understøtter Politiken, Jyllands-Posten, Ekstra Bladet, Business Media og Monitor Medier med specialiserede kompetencer og nye metoder, der hjælper medierne med at løfte deres egen journalistik. Dine hovedopgaver Du bliver én af tre medarbejdere i et helt nyt team. Din opgave bliver at omsætte journalistiske idéer til fungerende tekniske løsninger. Det kan være et system, der overvåger tusindvis af offentlige kilder og opdager interessante ændringer. En scraper, der bygger et datasæt, som ikke eksisterede før. En database, der finder forbindelser mellem virksomheder og personer. Eller et AI-værktøj, der gør det muligt at undersøge hundredtusindvis af dokumenter. Nogle gange bygger du en prototype på få dage for at teste en idé. Andre gange udvikler du et værktøj, der skal bruges igen og igen på tværs af redaktionerne. Din profil Du er teknisk stærk, nysgerrig og god til at finde løsninger på problemer, du ikke har mødt før. Du interesserer dig for data, automatisering og AI, men endnu mere for, hvad teknologien kan bruges til. Du trives med opgaver, hvor løsningen ikke er givet på forhånd, og hvor du selv skal finde den bedste vej fra problem til fungerende værktøj. Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med flere, men ikke nødvendigvis alle, af følgende områder: Python, SQL og analyse af store datasæt Scraping, API'er og automatiseret indsamling af data Overvågning af hjemmesider, registre og andre digitale kilder Databaser og kobling af information på tværs af forskellige datakilder AI-modeller og automatiserede workflows Dokumentanalyse, OCR og søgning i store mængder materiale Udvikling af researchværktøjer, dashboards og mindre applikationer Git, test, deployment og dokumentation Du behøver ikke kunne det hele. Måske er du softwareudvikler, data scientist, data engineer eller kommer fra et helt andet teknisk miljø. Det vigtigste er, at du har et stærkt teknisk fundament, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at eksperimentere med nye teknologier og metoder. Erfaring med OSINT, netværksanalyse, graph databases, digital forensics eller cybersikkerhed er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi tilbyder Du får en sjælden mulighed for at være med til at opbygge en ny journalistisk specialistfunktion fra begyndelsen – med stor frihed til at eksperimentere, vælge teknologier og præge de værktøjer og metoder, vi udvikler. Den ene dag bygger du en scraper, den næste analyserer du millioner af datapunkter, og den tredje eksperimenterer du med en ny AI-model, fordi en journalist har fået en idé, ingen endnu ved, om kan lade sig gøre. Vi skal undersøge, bygge, teste og lære. Nogle idéer bliver til permanente værktøjer. Andre bliver kasseret efter to dage. Begge dele er en del af arbejdet. Du får korte beslutningsveje og stor teknisk frihed. Og det, du bygger, kan være det, der gør det muligt at finde en historie, ingen andre har fundet. Ansøgning Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV. Vi vil også gerne se noget, du har bygget. Det kan være et professionelt projekt, open source eller noget, du lavede en weekend, fordi du blev nysgerrig. Vi er mere interesserede i, hvad du fik til at virke, og hvordan du tænkte, end i hvor stort projektet var. Yderligere oplysninger Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonas Gülstorff, leder af Redaktionel AI, Metode & Research på jogu@jppol.dk eller telefon 60779962. Stillingen er i første omgang finansieret frem til udgangen af 2027, hvor projektet evalueres, med mulighed for forlængelse. JP/Politikens Hus - Vi skaber oplyste borgere JP/Politikens Hus er en af Nordens førende medievirksomheder med aktiviteter i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Tyskland. Vi formidler oplysning, nyheder, debat og litteratur til borgerne, og det grundlæggende formål med JP/Politikens Hus er at sikre udgivelsen af frie, pålidelige og uafhængige medier. Koncernens udgivelser tæller blandt andet Ekstra Bladet, Jyllands-Posten og Politiken samt nogle af Danmarks toneangivende erhvervsudgivelser; vi ejer 49,9 pct. af Dagbladet Børsen og står bag Finans, Marketwire samt Watch Medier, som udgiver digitale medier i Danmark, Tyskland, Norge og Sverige. Med Politikens Forlag udgiver vi en række af Danmarks, Sveriges og Norges mest læste forfattere. Og i regi af Jyllands-Posten udgiver vi syv lokalaviser i Østjylland. Vi ejer også Saxo, Danmarks førende online boghandel og en af danskernes foretrukne bogstreamingtjenester. JP/Politikens Hus har 2.850 medarbejdere og havde i 2025 en omsætning på mere end 4,1 mia. kr.

Bei Nesto löst Du genau diese Aufgabe mit mathematischer Optimierung für Restaurants, Hotels und Betriebsgastronomie. Gemeinsam mit uns entwickelst Du unseren automatischen Dienstplan so weiter, dass er noch stärker aus dem Feedback der Planenden lernt. Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich bei uns Als Teil unseres Scheduling-Teams setzt Du neue Funktionen unseres automatischen Dienstplans in Python um und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für einzelne Bausteine unserer Optimierungsmodelle. Du formulierst und erweiterst lineare Optimierungsmodelle aus dem Operations Research und löst sie mit Gurobi. Dafür arbeitest Du mit Daten aus MongoDB und bringst Deine Lösungen über Tests, Reviews und CI/CD in Produktion. Deine Arbeit landet direkt in den Dienstplänen unserer Kunden aus der Hospitality-Branche: Du hilfst mit, ihr Feedback zu verstehen und in bessere Pläne zu übersetzen. Gelegentlich stehst Du dabei auch direkt mit Kunden im Austausch. Du entwickelst mit uns die lernenden Komponenten unseres Dienstplans weiter, probierst dabei eigene Ideen aus und arbeitest Dich in Ansätze ein, wie das Feedback der Nutzer laufend in die Optimierungsentscheidungen einfließen kann. Dabei begleiten Dich erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, mit denen Du Deine Lösungen regelmäßig reflektierst. Dein Hintergrund, der Dich auszeichnet Du bringst einen quantitativen Hintergrund mit, etwa aus einem Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Mathematik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach, und hast erste praktische Erfahrung aus Werkstudententätigkeit, Projekten oder Deiner Abschlussarbeit. Du schreibst sauberen, gut strukturierten Python-Code, gehst sicher mit Zeitstempeln, Zeitintervallen und Zeitzonen um und hast bereits praktisch mit Operations Research bzw. Linear Programming gearbeitet: Du verstehst Zielfunktionen, Constraints und Zielkonflikte und kannst nachvollziehen, warum ein Modell ein bestimmtes Ergebnis liefert. Idealerweise hast Du erste Erfahrung mit Machine Learning oder hast schon einmal Code in der Cloud, etwa auf AWS, deployt. Qualität ist Dir wichtig: Du testest Deinen Code automatisiert, arbeitest mit Git und Code Reviews, sprichst technische Schulden offen an und teilst Dein Wissen im Team. Außerdem hast Du Lust, KI-gestützte Coding-Assistenten intensiv in Deinen Arbeitsalltag einzubinden. Du gehst neugierig an neue Themen heran, stellst auch vermeintlich einfache Fragen und nimmst Feedback als Chance zum Lernen. Du diskutierst gerne in der Sache, bringst eigene Vorschläge aktiv ein, klärst Blockaden zügig mit dem Team und erklärst die Ergebnisse unserer Optimierung auch Menschen ohne technischen Hintergrund ruhig und verständlich. Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du bist bei uns genau richtig, wenn … Dich unsere Vorteile ansprechen: Freue Dich auf Vertrauensurlaub, flexibel gestaltbare Arbeitszeiten in einem modernen Bürogebäude sowie die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Du eine Unternehmenskultur voller Vertrauen erleben willst: Wir ziehen alle an einem Strang und schenken uns gegenseitig einen Vertrauensvorschuss. Wir suchen nicht nach Fehlern, sondern nach Lösungen und feiern unsere Erfolge gegenseitig. Du Teil unseres Geheimcodes werden willst: Unser hochmotiviertes Team eint die Leidenschaft für unser gemeinsames Tun und unsere Produkte. Mit einem großartigen Teamspirit, Kreativität und Begeisterung verfolgen wir gemeinsam unsere Ziele. Leidenschaft ist unser Geheimcode. Du bereit bist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Als motiviertes Team-Mitglied kannst Du bei Nesto unsere Kultur und unsere Produkte entscheidend prägen und gemeinsam im Team Großartiges für unsere Kunden erreichen. Hast du Fragen zur Stellenausschreibung? Wende Dich gerne an uns Bianca Gräder jobs@nesto-software.de Genau Dein Ding? Du teilst unsere Werte und fühlst Dich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Bei Nesto erwarten Dich eine inspirierende berufliche Herausforderung, ein dynamisches Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an unserer Erfolgsgeschichte mitzuschreiben. Werde Teil unserer innovativen Community und gestalte die Zukunft von Dir selbst und der Personalplanung entscheidend mit! Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Über uns Wir bauen Software, die Hospitality verändert. Mit Nesto bringen wir gemeinsam wieder das Wertvollste zurück: Zeit für echte Beziehungen, für Gäste, für Kollegen und für gute Momente. Das leben wir auch bei Nesto und suchen leidenschaftliche und motivierte Team-Mitglieder, die gerne Verantwortung übernehmen.

items.desc: Who We Are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What You Will Do As our ML Engineer, you'll be the technical backbone powering our content platform. You'll tackle the critical questions: How do we build ML systems that scale to millions of users while maintaining low latency? What's the optimal architecture for training and deploying models that understand cultural trends in real-time? And how do we leverage cutting-edge models to enhance creative processes while preserving quality? Working fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, your answers to these questions will directly influence our company's success. On a typical day, your tasks may include: Building and deploying production ML models for within our content and product ecosystem Designing scalable ML infrastructure and pipelines that handle massive media datasets Implementing inference systems for content optimization across multiple verticals Fine-tuning and deploying multimodal AI systems using MLOps best practices Collaborating with data science teams to transition research models into production-ready systems Optimizing model performance for cost efficiency while maintaining accuracy and speed requirements Integrating ML capabilities into existing platforms and building APIs for seamless model consumption Who You Are You're a production-focused ML engineer who bridges the gap between cutting-edge tech and scalable systems. Your expertise lies in building robust ML infrastructure that powers real-world applications at scale. You thrive in fast-paced environments where your technical decisions directly impact business outcomes and user experiences. Typically, your profile will look like this: Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or related technical field 3+ years of hands-on ML engineering experience building production systems at Big Tech companies, high-growth startups, or media/entertainment platforms Expert-level proficiency in Python, ML frameworks, and cloud platforms Extensive experience with MLOps tools and practices including Docker, Kubernetes, model versioning, and monitoring systems Proven track record deploying and scaling ML models in production environments with high availability requirements Self-directed approach with ability to architect complex systems independently while collaborating across technical teams You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment Colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent You're obsessed with music, video or social media What Makes This Exciting You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. What The Process Will Look Like We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP. Once You Begin Our Process, You Can Progress From Start To Offer Within a Week, Depending On How Quickly You Can Move Through Each Stage Take-home case study: Real-world project - showcase your skills and working style Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - getting to know you & present and debate your results with a team member Online assessment: Motivational questionnaire and aptitude test - are you made for the job? Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics Team interview: Individual or group interview with other team members - depending on position Offer, contract signing and onboarding Note : As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

items.desc: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €3.314 - €7.919 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling (50% premie door ons betaald of extra salaris). Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via raoel.fatehmahomed@linkit.nl of via +31638859892. Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. items.desc: Are you an ambitious researcher looking for your next challenge? Do you have an interest in tribology, surfaces or interfaces? Do you want to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive Universities and an emerging research area? Maritime transport remains one of the most energy-efficient means for transporting goods and raw materials globally. However, it is also a significant contributor to greenhouse gas emissions, responsible for around 2.9% of global emissions generated by human activities. As the sector moves towards decarbonisation, alternative fuels are expected to play a key role in reducing its carbon footprint. Despite this, the impact of these new fuels on the performance and reliability of existing lubricant technologies remains poorly understood. This project aims to investigate the potential impact of alternative fuels on the friction and wear performance of marine engine lubricants. Using bespoke wear-testing rigs and advanced analytical facilities, we will investigate how fuel-lubricant interactions impact friction, wear and overall system reliability under representative engine operating conditions. We are open to discussing flexible working arrangements What We Offer In Return 26 days holiday plus approx.16 Bank Holidays/days that the University is closed by custom (including Christmas) – That’s 42 days a year! Generous pension scheme plus life assurance– the University contributes 14.5% of salary Health and Wellbeing: Discounted staff membership options at The Edge, our state-of-the-art Campus gym, with a pool, sauna, climbing wall, cycle circuit, and sports halls. Personal Development: Access to courses run by our Organisational Development & Professional Learning team. Access to on-site childcare, shopping discounts and travel schemes are also available. And much more! To explore the post further or for any queries you may have, please contact: Professor Ardian Morina (a.morina@leeds.ac.uk) or Dr Cayetano Espejo Conesa (c.espejoconesa@leeds.ac.uk) Please note that this post may be suitable for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa route but first-time applicants might need to qualify for salary concessions. items.desc: About The Role Applications are invited for a 12 months full-time postdoctoral position (with the possibility for extension) in Experimental Quantum Technology at the University of Sussex. Applicants should have obtained a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The appointment is within the framework of the EPSRC Quantum Technology Hub: Quantum Computing via Integrated and Interconnected Implementations. The successful candidate will work in a team of experienced researchers led by Prof Matthias Keller. The aim of the project is to combine two of the most successful techniques in quantum information processing, trapped ions and photons, and use them to create a distributed quantum network. The main challenge is the implementation of an efficient ion-photon interface based on strongly-coupled cavity-QED. We have developed a multi-zone ion trap that incorporates zones for loading, quantum information processing, and a cavity-based ion-photon interface. The first part of the project is to test and characterise the ion trap system and implement a highly efficient ion-photon interface. This involves the setting up and testing of the system as well as simulating and implementing novel schemes for ion-photon entanglement. Based on successful testing of the multi-zone trap, a second system will be established to implement a basic quantum network. About You Ideally, you will have a PhD in experimental quantum information, laser- or atomic physics and be able to demonstrate working experience in this field. The project requires working with a complex optical system with diode lasers, ultra-high vacuum systems, and control electronics to operate the experiment. Having experience and a good understanding of such systems is highly beneficial. About Our School We are a research-intensive School that simultaneously delivers outstanding teaching to our students. As such we aim to be consistently recognised as truly world leading in key areas of our science, by extending the international excellence, impact and visibility of our research. We aim to be within the top UK universities in our discipline areas, attracting high-quality students at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. We will establish a reputation as having a particularly open, stimulating, collaborative and supportive working environment for both staff and students, enabling the best possible outcomes for research, teaching and learning. We will further enhance our links with non-academic actors on local, national and international scales, and will maximize the impact of our work. The University is committed to equality and valuing diversity, and applications are particularly welcomed from women and black and minority ethnic candidates, who are under-represented in academic posts in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Mathematics (STEMM) at Sussex. Please note that this position may be subject to ATAS clearance if you require visa sponsorship. Why work here Our university is situated off the A27, next to the beautiful South Downs where you will enjoy everything that our 150-acre campus has to offer. We are accessible by public transport; Falmer train station is a five-minute walk to campus and several bus stops are located within campus. We also have dedicated cycling paths and encourage our staff to use these with our offering of a cycle to work scheme. Sussex is a renowned, multi-accredited, research-led International University and this is only possible because of the people that work here. Whether you are a member of Faculty, part of a Professional Services team or a Student, it’s our people that make us great and we want you to be part of that. Find Out More About Our Reward And Benefits Package. Find out about our equality, diversity and inclusion. Further Key Information Please contact Prof Matthias Keller - Phone: +44 (1273) 877673, email: M.K.Keller@sussex.ac.uk - for informal enquiries. The University is committed to equality and valuing diversity, and applications are particularly welcomed from women and black and minority ethnic candidates, who are under-represented in academic posts in Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Mathematics (STEMM) at Sussex. The University of Sussex values the diversity of its staff and students, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Eligibility for sponsorship will depend on the salary offered, or whether a candidate can make use of tradeable points to meet the salary threshold. Conocimientos de arquitecturas de IA y del funcionamiento de los sistemas agénticos, incluyendo sus limitaciones y cómo evaluar sus resultados. Una base de ingeniería de software que abarque procesamiento de datos, bases de datos y tecnologías web, con conocimientos de despliegue en entornos cloud. Facilidad para colaborar con perfiles de negocio y técnicos, explicar tus decisiones y aportar ideas que ayuden al equipo a mejorar. Grado en Ingeniería, Informática o una disciplina afín. items.desc: About The Role At Signifyd , we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy. Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here ! The Applied Decision Science (ADS) team builds production ML models and risk management tools that are the core of Signifyd's product. We help businesses of all sizes minimize their fraud exposure and grow their sales. We improve the e-commerce shopping experience for everyone by reducing the friction experienced by good buyers and blocking fraudulent purchase attempts. ADS builds and manages the entire decision stack - from designing and deploying the ML models that assess the riskiness of a transaction, to building the tools the Risk team uses to manage and fight fraud. We seek to standardize and automate repetitive work so we can spend more time on experiments and high-leverage projects. We value collaboration and team ownership. Data scientists in Signifyd are true “full stack” operators, requiring knowledge of how transaction information received via our API traverses its way through our system and into the models we are responsible for building. When you test a hypothesis at Signifyd, you’re responsible for the end-to-end development, deployment, and evaluation process. This is a massive responsibility, and no one should feel like they're solving a hard problem alone. Together we help each other develop our skillsets through peer review of experiments and code, group paper study to deepen our machine learning and statistical understanding, and frequent knowledge-sharing through live demos, write-ups, and cross-team projects. All team members are expected and encouraged to weigh in as an external reviewer on a peer's idea or approach, regardless of level. A couple quick notes on the Signifyd culture: We’re no stranger to remote work. Most of our workforce (ICs and leaders) are primarily remote. We tend to gather individual teams together once a year. There is no travel requirement for this role. We are heavy Slack users. We are heavy users of generative AI tools. We dislike token-maxxing, but enjoy the expansion of capabilities that have come with genAI. We ask that during the interview you don’t use genAI, as we want to know what you know. Responsibilities: Partner with the Business Unit Lead and their merchant portfolio to identify gaps in decisioning performance and implement solutions, with guidance from senior team members. Utilize existing, or build net new production machine learning models that identify fraud, in collaboration with other data scientists and machine learning engineers. Identify and build automation that reduces repetitive manual work. Run experiments to identify optimal decisioning strategies, balancing complexity and performance. Communicate complex ideas to a variety of audiences, from Customer Success and Sales, to limited interactions with external customers. Write production and offline analytical code in Python. Work with distributed data pipelines in Spark/Databricks/GCP. Requirements: A degree in computer science or a comparable analytical field. 3+ years of post-undergrad work experience required. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong machine learning and statistical background. Write code and review others' in a shared codebase in Python. Practical SQL knowledge. Design experiments and collect data. Experience with distributed analytics and data tooling such as Spark and Databricks. This role has on-call shifts, as part of our weekend rotation, Fri/Sat/Sun. While the number of shifts is subject to change, currently it works out to about six weekends a year. Nice to Have: Previous work in fraud, payments, or e-commerce. Data analysis in a distributed environment. A passion for writing well-tested production-grade code. Experience with AI coding agents and automation. Experience of running A/B tests in production environments. An advanced degree. items.desc: This Research Associate position forms part of the Retrofit Advanced Materials & Manufacturing Innovation Centre (RAMMIC), a major collaborative research and innovation programme supported through the UKRI Local Innovation Partnership Fund. Led by the University of Salford’s Energy House Labs, RAMMIC brings together Greater Manchester capabilities in building performance, advanced materials, indoor air quality, acoustics, environmental sustainability assessment, and innovation support. Its purpose is to establish a collaborative innovation ecosystem for smart and sustainable retrofit products and processes. RAMMIC will work with businesses to overcome technical and commercial barriers to retrofit innovation. Research and innovation activities will make use of the Energy House Labs facilities, including existing and newly developed test houses in controlled environment warehouses. The programme will evaluate new products and services under controlled conditions, generate reliable evidence of their performance and environmental effects, quantify environmental impacts across marketable comparators, and support promising innovations towards commercialisation and wider deployment. The programme will address challenges associated with the building envelope, heating and cooling systems, ventilation, material selection, commissioning, indoor air quality and the assessment of retrofit performance. items.desc: YOUR MISSION AT VOI As a Data Scientist/Data Analyst at Voi, you will own a business area from an analytics and data science perspective, helping your team make better decisions that create value for our riders, cities, and business. You will work across the full decision-making funnel: from building reliable data models and KPIs to designing experiments, uncovering insights, and driving meaningful change. In this role, you will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, business owners and other data scientists to turn complex data into clear recommendations and measurable impact. You Will Apply the right methods for each question, from simple business cases to advanced statistical models. Lead data projects independently, from problem framing to insights, recommendations and follow-up. Develop and maintain data models and KPIs that reflect Voi’s products, operations and business processes. Design and analyse A/B tests and other approaches to measure the impact of decisions, product changes or market events. Translate findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate actively with your team and contribute to healthy, inclusive and high-performing team dynamics. What You Need To Embark We are looking for a curious and collaborative data professional who enjoys solving business problems, communicating insights clearly and working close to decision-making. You combine strong technical skills with a good understanding of customers, products, and business needs. To be successful in this role, we believe you have: A few years of experience as a Data Scientist, Data Analyst or similar in an autonomous and agile environment. Strong SQL and data modelling skills. Experience with Python, statistical modelling and experimentation. Experience designing, analysing and communicating A/B tests or similar impact measurement methods. The ability to explain insights, findings and recommendations in a clear way to different audiences. Experience owning and leading projects in the data space. A university degree in a relevant field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Science, Engineering or Business, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with dbt and a semantic layer is a plus. Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box. WHY VOI? Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This, You’ll Have The Opportunity To Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups. Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme. Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office. Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal. Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution. Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain. Diversity Matters As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. Mi objetivo es claro: dejar de jugar con pilotos aislados y construir soluciones que transformen de verdad cómo operamos, cómo vendemos, y qué podemos poner al servicio de la población sénior. Antes de esto, pasé 5 años en Amazon liderando productos tecnológicos y programas de gran escala en Europa. Ahora, mi obsesión es usar la IA (especialmente GenAI) como palanca de transformación estructural para Qida. ¿Quiénes somos? 😊 Fundada en 2018, Qida es una start-up privada y social de alto crecimiento con una misión clara: hacer sostenible el sistema sociosanitario. Lo hacemos ayudando a que más personas vivan más tiempo y con más calidad de vida en casa (Triple M), reduciendo hospitalizaciones evitables y promoviendo una atención más preventiva, coordinada, humana y centrada en el paciente. En Qida, impacto social e impacto económico van de la mano, los dos son inseparables y ambos son condición necesaria para cumplir nuestra misión. Hoy somos un equipo de más de 350 personas en oficina y 1.800 cuidadores a domicilio, y hemos atendido a más de 25.000 familias. En 2025 cerramos una ronda de 37M€, la mayor de impacto social en España y el sur de Europa. Somos líderes en calidad (4,8/5) y en tecnología en el sector. ¿Cuál sería tu rol? 📋 La misión es simple: "Hacer que la IA deje de ser una promesa y se convierta en valor real para miles de personas". Buscamos a un AI Product Builder . Olvídate de roles puramente técnicos; este es un perfil híbrido: AI Product Manager + Engineer + AI Evangelist . Diseñarás, desarrollarás y desplegarás soluciones que mejoren la vida de los mayores y la eficiencia de Qida. Tus retos principales: Identificar y ejecutar: Liderar el roadmap de IA junto a mí, detectando dónde la tecnología puede mover la aguja. Construir (de verdad): Desarrollar MVPs y soluciones escalables E2E (usando Python, SQL o herramientas low-code) con autonomía, calidad y velocidad. Entrar al barro: Desde desplegar agentes de voz hasta optimizar modelos predictivos de salud. Medir el impacto : Si no genera ROI y impacto social real, no nos interesa. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? 🔍 Buscamos a alguien con mentalidad de Builder. "Buena persona" y "persona buena" en lo suyo. +5 años de experiencia en ámbitos técnicos (Data, Ingeniería o Analítica). Dominio de Python y SQL. Experiencia real construyendo o implementando soluciones basadas en datos o IA. Ownership Radical : No esperas a que te digan qué hacer. Ves un problema, diseñas la solución y la ejecutas. Mentalidad de "Entrar al barro" : Te apasiona la estrategia, pero te diviertes picando código o ajustando prompts hasta que el producto brilla. Visión Híbrida (Negocio-Tech) : Eres capaz de hablar con un desarrollador sobre arquitectura y con el equipo de ventas sobre impacto en conversión. Obsesión por la calidad : No aceptas que tus soluciones funcionen sólo “okay”, y te aseguras de tener medidas que permitan garantizar la calidad de los productos en todo momento. Hambre : La IA corre muy rápido. Tienes la curiosidad y la velocidad para no quedarte atrás. Sólidas competencias interpersonales. Alta energía, pasión y compromiso. ¿Por qué unirte a Qida? 💚 Nuestra propuesta de valor es clara: Buenas personas: humildes, sin política interna, que tratan con respeto y se preocupan de verdad por los demás. Personas buenas: máxima densidad de talento: high agency (motivación, ownership, intensidad) + high intrinsics (aprendizaje rápido y competencias a la altura de nuestra barra). Alto crecimiento: invertimos en feedback, formación y carreras profesionales claras y motivantes. Buscamos personas a las que les mueva aprender, no quedarse donde están. Entorno de alta intensidad y cambio: ritmo alto, mayor exigencia en equipos corporate y roles de liderazgo, con jornadas largas y flexibilidad. Esperamos que cada persona se adapte y empuje el cambio. No es para todo el mundo. Impacto y sentido: trabajamos en algo que importa, tiene y da sentido: mejoramos el sistema sanitario y social, y la vida de las personas mayores, sus familias y quienes las cuidan. Nos cuidamos: estamos ahí el uno por el otro. Promovemos hábitos saludables, conexión, transparencia y escucha activa. Condiciones económicas competitivas: condiciones alineadas con el mercado e instrumentos que nos alinean con el éxito de la compañía. No queremos atraer por condiciones económicas, ni perder talento por ellas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 🙌 Contrato indefinido a jornada completa en un sector en crecimiento. Modalidad híbrida : 2 días en oficina y 3 de teletrabajo. 3 semanas de teletrabajo al año desde donde tu quieras. 23 días de vacaciones + día libre de cumpleaños. items.desc: Job Description About us Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them. What you'll join Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you? If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance groundbreaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come. What you'll do Develop software, algorithms and scientific workflows for High Performance Computing (HPC) and High Throughput Computing (HTC) environments, helping to advance cutting-edge fusion research and simulation capabilities. Build computational tools and software solutions to tackle complex engineering and scientific challenges, supporting the development of future fusion technologies. Gain hands-on experience in software development, data analysis and emerging technologies, including AI, machine learning and advanced computing, while collaborating with experts across UKAEA, academia and industry. How you'll develop On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership. The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route. What you'll need Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or Engineering from 2025 to 2027. Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges. Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload. Benefits We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include: £35,227 base salary. Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution. 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays. Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions. Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network. Our commitment to ED&I UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit. UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments . AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work. To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests. Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 21st October 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

items.desc: Partout dans le monde, grâce aux solutions innovantes conçues et fabriquées par ses équipes, Sagemcom permet au plus grand nombre d'accéder au haut débit Internet, aux divertissements, et à une énergie maîtrisée. Entreprise à mission depuis 2022, Sagemcom est leader technologique dans le monde des télécoms et de l'énergie, et ses équipes s'engagent chaque jour à fournir des solutions sur mesure et responsables, adaptées aux besoins de leurs clients opérateurs télécom et utilities. Aujourd'hui, notre Groupe est : * Numéro 1 mondial des solutions haut débit (box internet et services logiciels associés) * Leader technologique des solutions audio-vidéo (hubs vidéo 4K et Video SoundBox™ ) * Leader européen des solutions smart-grid (comptage communicant, réseaux intelligents, électrification rurale, IoT) En 2024, Sagemcom a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 2.3 milliards d'euros, et s'appuie sur 6 500 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 50 pays. Intégrer le groupe Sagemcom, c'est rejoindre un groupe de dimension internationale, où vous pourrez chaque jour relever de nouveaux défis. Si le travail en équipe, l'agilité, la créativité et les nouvelles technologies vous intéressent, rejoignez l'aventure ! » Votre mission consiste à concevoir, faire évoluer et fiabiliser les applications logicielles qui valorisent les données de nos compteurs d'eau intelligents auprès des gestionnaires de réseau : plateforme d'Analytique, algorithmes de détection et assistant conversationnel basé sur l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous intervenez sur des sujets variés mêlant développement web, analyse de données, détection de fuite d'eau, Intelligence Artificielle générative et industrialisation logicielle. Principales missions : -Faire évoluer la plateforme web d'Analytique utilisée par les gestionnaires de réseau d'eau lors de nos expérimentations terrain. -Industrialiser nos applications et structurer nos pratiques de développement : conteneurisation, CI/CD, déploiements multi-serveurs automatisés, tests, supervision et documentation. -Poursuivre le développement de notre assistant d'Intelligence Artificielle permettant d'interroger les données du réseau en langage naturel : conception des tools, routage des requêtes, orchestration de scénarios d'analyse en plusieurs étapes et évaluation de la fiabilité des réponses. -Concevoir des algorithmes de détection de fuite d'eau et de tout type d'évènement utile à l'exploitation des réseaux. -Prototyper rapidement des applications sur mesure pour tester de nouvelles idées avec nos clients, et intégrer les données des nouveaux capteurs développés par la cellule. -Tirer parti des outils de développement agentiques pour accélérer le cycle idée → prototype → production, et en diffuser les bonnes pratiques. -Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, R&D et Data ainsi qu'avec les clients pour transformer les retours terrain en nouvelles fonctionnalités, et participer à la protection des innovations du groupe. Les sujets pourront notamment concerner : l'Analytique des réseaux d'eau ; la détection de fuite d'eau et sa localisation à partir des données acoustiques ; l'Intelligence Artificielle générative appliquée aux données métier (tool calling, systèmes agentiques, évaluation de LLM) ; les applications web orientées données et la visualisation cartographique ; le DevOps, le déploiement multi-sites et la sécurité des données ; l'intégration de nouveaux capteurs et la valorisation des données des compteurs communicants. Votre profil: Ingénieur Bac+5 ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel et avez déjà mis en production et maintenu une application utilisée au quotidien. Vous aimez construire des applications complètes, de la base de données à l'interface, et les faire fonctionner de façon fiable en production. L'intégration de l'Intelligence Artificielle générative dans des applications métier vous intéresse particulièrement. Vous êtes attiré par le métier de l'eau et avez envie de comprendre les problématiques des gestionnaires de réseau. Vous savez passer rapidement d'une idée à un prototype fonctionnel, puis de ce prototype à une application robuste. Compétences appréciées : Python et un framework web (idéalement Django) bases de données relationnelles et NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) Docker, CI/CD, environnement Linux tests automatisés et bonnes pratiques de développement traitement et visualisation de données (Pandas…) intégration de LLM : tool calling, orchestration, évaluation Des connaissances en data science, traitement du signal, SIG/cartographie, IoT ou dans le domaine de l'eau constituent un plus. Une pratique avancée des outils de développement agentiques est fortement appréciée. Ce que vous trouverez chez Sagemcom : > Un cadre de travail stimulant dans une entreprise internationale et engagée > Des perspectives d’évolution et de formation régulière > Un management de proximité et une grande autonomie dans les missions > Des accords d’intéressement …

items.desc: (Afstudeer)stage: Ontwikkeling van een AI-Agent voor Hydraulische Modellering Deze stage biedt een unieke kans om geavanceerde AI-/LLM-technologie te combineren met echte uitdagingen op het gebied van hydraulische en hydrologische modellering. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan de manier waarop we watermodellen bouwen, aanpassen en analyseren. Je helpt mee met het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van een AI-agent die onze modelleurs ondersteunt en de brug slaat tussen kunstmatige intelligentie en praktische toepassingen binnen het watermanagement. Doe mee en help tastbare impact te maken op hoe modellen worden gebouwd, gebruikt en vertrouwd. Wat je in je afstudeeropdracht/ stageopdracht doet Je wordt meegenomen in ons dagelijkse werk samen met onze enthousiaste collega’s binnen het vakgebied watermanagement. Zo krijg je een goed beeld van het werken bij een advies- en ingenieursbureau. Voor deze stage zijn verschillende invalshoeken mogelijk, en we bespreken graag samen welke combinatie het beste aansluit bij jouw interesses. Naast Dat Je Absoluut Je Eigen Onderwerp Kan Aandragen Binnen Het Brede Thema Praktische Toepassingen Van AI, Zou Je Je Bijvoorbeeld Bezig Kunnen Houden Met Bijdragen aan het ontwerpen van de architectuur van een AI-/LLM-gebaseerde agent die hydraulische en hydrologische modellen kan bouwen, aanpassen en analyseren (bijvoorbeeld D-HYDRO); Het ontwikkelen en integreren van tools die de agent verbinden met onze modelleersoftware en data; Het testen en valideren van de output en het gedrag van de agent aan de hand van best practices binnen modellering en expertkennis; Het helpen automatiseren van repetitieve modelleerwerkprocessen om watermodellering efficiënter te maken; Onderzoeken hoe de agent kan worden geïntegreerd in onze Haskoning-omgeving, met aandacht voor compliance- en security-eisen; Het ondersteunen bij het opstellen van technische documentatie, visualisaties en presentaties van de resultaten voor interne en externe stakeholders. Bovenstaande punten zijn voorbeelden van richtingen die wij samen kunnen onderzoeken. Mocht je zelf een bepaalde andere interesse hebben binnen dit thema of een bepaald onderwerp graag willen uitwerken, dan gaan we graag in gesprek! Deze stage kan worden ingevuld als afstudeeropdracht, maar ook als meewerkstage of ander soort stage naar gelang de eisen van jouw opleiding. We horen graag jouw ideeën en gaan graag samen met jou in gesprek om het onderwerp verder aan te scherpen en af te stemmen op jouw interesses. Waar je komt te werken Bij Haskoning maak je deel uit van een onafhankelijke, internationaal opererende advies- en ingenieursorganisatie die eigendom is van haar medewerkers. We combineren engineering, ontwerp- en adviesdiensten met software en technologie. Onze missie, “Enhancing Society Together”, vormt de drijfveer achter alles wat we doen en helpt ons om een positieve impact op de wereld te maken. Wij bieden uitdagend en betekenisvol werk binnen uiteenlopende internationale projecten, waarbij we voortbouwen op meer dan 140 jaar expertise. Met ruim 6.800 collega’s in meer dan 25 landen werken we samen om uitdagingen om te zetten in kansen en een blijvende bijdrage aan de samenleving te leveren. Daarbij werken we voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in sectoren zoals infrastructuur, klimaatadaptatie, hernieuwbare energie, verduurzaming van de industrie en duurzame mobiliteit. Als onze nieuwe stagiair(e) Ontwikkeling van een AI-Agent voor Hydraulische Modellering word je onderdeel van ons Team Surface Water in Nederland. Je standplaats kan ons kantoor in Zwolle , Amersfoort of Nijmegen zijn — we bespreken graag samen welke locatie het beste bij jou past. Wat je meebrengt Je volgt een opleiding (Universiteit of HBO) en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage. Deze brede opdracht kan aansluiten bij meerdere studierichtingen zoals civiele techniek, milieukunde, watermanagement of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Je hebt interesse in AI en praktische toepassingen van Large Language Models. Je hebt interesse in hydrologie en watermanagement. Interesse in en/of ervaring met data-analyse (bijvoorbeeld met Python of Excel) is een pré. Ook enige ervaring met modelleren is gewenst maar ook zeker te leren tijdens je stage. Je bent nieuwsgierig om technische analyses te vertalen naar praktische maatregelen en aanbevelingen. Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden deelt graag je bevindingen met anderen. Je hebt een proactieve houding en de bereidheid om te leren binnen een samenwerkende teamomgeving. Daarnaast ben je bereid om regelmatig naar kantoor Zwolle, Nijmegen of Amersfoort te reizen. Dit krijg je van ons Bij je afstudeeropdracht/ stage word je begeleid door zeer ervaren wateradviseurs uit onze kantoren in Zwolle, Amersfoort en Nijmegen. Zij helpen je bij de aanpak, het vinden van informatie en jouw sparringpartner zijn tijdens je opdracht. Je doet ervaring op met het werken in een adviesbureau aan integrale projecten. items.desc: Am Fraunhofer-Institut für Angewandte Festkörperphysik IAF kennen wir unsere Technologien wie unsere Westentasche. Denn als eine der wenigen wissenschaftlichen Einrichtungen weltweit forschen wir entlang der gesamten Halbleiter-Wertschöpfungskette und an maßgeschneiderten synthetischen Diamanten. Ob Hochfrequenzschaltungen für Kommunikationstechnik, Spannungswandler-Module für die Elektromobilität, Lasersysteme für Messverfahren oder neuartige Hard- und Software für Quantencomputer sowie Quantensensoren: Wir entwickeln die Technologie von morgen aus einer Hand für eine nachhaltige und sichere Gesellschaft. Bringen Sie Ihre Karriere auf das nächste Level als Gruppenleitung beim Fraunhofer-Institut für Angewandte Festkörperphysik (IAF) im Bereich Schaltungsdesign mit Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI)! Werden Sie Teil unseres KI-Teams im brandneuen „Innovation Park Artificial Intelligence“ in unserer Außenstelle in Heilbronn ( IPAI Campus ). Gemeinsam mit führenden Partnern aus Industrie und Wissenschaft erforschen und entwickeln Sie elektronische CMOS Digitalschaltungen mit KI für KI! Seien Sie dabei, wenn wir mittels KI-gestütztem Schaltungsdesign revolutionäre KI-Anwendungen in den vielseitigen Bereichen Automobil, Robotik, Space und Sicherheit vorantreiben! Weltweit wird mit Hochdruck daran gearbeitet, die Nutzung von künstlicher Intelligenz zu verbessern. Dabei spielt die Optimierung der grundlegenden Hardware-Komponenten, die für die enormen Rechnerlistungen benötigt werden, eine entscheidende Rolle. Die Entwicklung anwendungs-spezifischer Schaltungen und (Sub-)Systeme ist dabei ein Schlüssel zur Realisierung bahnbrechender Anwendungen. Hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Ihre Expertise und Kreativität sind gefragt, um gemeinsam mit uns innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der KI-Technologie mitzugestalten! Was Sie bei uns tun Wissenschaftliche Verantwortung: Sie leiten die Entwicklung moderner CMOS-Schaltungsentwurfsmethoden auf Projektbasis. Projektleitung: Sie akquirieren und leiten spannende Forschungsprojekte oder Teilprojekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Gruppen und Abteilungen des Fraunhofer IAF. Teamleitung: Sie gestalten, planen und steuern die Arbeitsabläufe in Ihrem Team und sind Ansprechperson für alle Fragen zur Projektakquise und -bearbeitung. Kommunikationsprofi: Sie informieren Ihr Team über wichtige Abteilungsangelegenheiten, stehen im regelmäßigen Austausch mit der Abteilungsleitung des Instituts und nationalen wie internationalen Projektpartnern. Mentor*in: Sie fördern die fachliche Qualifizierung Ihrer Mitarbeitenden, wirken bei der Auswahl und Entwicklung neuer Talente mit und begleiten Promovierende auf Ihrem Weg zur Promotion . Was Sie mitbringen Akademischer Hintergrund: Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom/Master) in Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Mikrosystemtechnik, Nachrichtentechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung – idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Promotion. Praxisnahe Erfahrung: Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse in der Projektakquise und -leitung mit und sind versiert in und begeistert von CMOS-Digitaltechnik und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Technologische Kompetenz: Der Umgang mit dem digitalen Design-Flow von CMOS-Schaltungen ist für Sie selbstverständlich und macht Ihnen Spaß. items.desc: Wil jij jouw data-skills inzetten voor het waarborgen van het grondwettelijk recht op rechtsbijstand? Beheers je de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en weet je complexe informatie helder en begrijpelijk over te brengen? Het Kenniscentrum van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand zoekt een data scientist. In deze functie vertaal je ruwe data naar waardevolle inzichten en verschillende rapportagevormen. Hiermee voed je de politiek en het beleid om de toegang tot het recht voor kwetsbare burgers te beschermen. De afdeling Het Kenniscentrum Stelsel Gesubsidieerde Rechtsbijstand (hierna: Kenniscentrum) zoekt een data scientist die zich wil inzetten voor toegang tot het recht van mensen in een vaak kwetsbare situatie. Wij monitoren, evalueren en onderzoeken de werking van het stelsel van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand. Door politiek, beleid en uitvoering te voeden met kennis en data, dragen we bij aan een lerend stelsel. Het Kenniscentrum is iets meer dan drie jaar geleden gestart als onderdeel van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand (hierna: RvR), en verricht in onafhankelijkheid onderzoek. We werken veelal in opdracht van de RvR, maar ook van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, het Juridisch Loket, de Nederlandse orde van advocaten en/of de Mediatorsfederatie Nederland. De RvR is als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan en uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid verantwoordelijk voor een belangrijke voorziening in onze democratische rechtsstaat: gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand. De RvR zorgt ervoor dat financieel minderdraagkrachtige burgers toegang hebben tot goede en betaalbare rechtsbijstand en ondersteuning krijgen voor het oplossen van juridische problemen. De rechtsbijstand wordt verleend door zo’n 7.000 advocaten en mediators die voldoen aan de gestelde kwaliteitseisen. Werken bij het Kenniscentrum kenmerkt zich door een prettige en informele organisatie met korte lijnen tussen management en medewerkers. Het team bestaat momenteel uit negentien medewerkers. De RvR telt ongeveer 350 medewerkers. Het hoofdkantoor van de RvR is gevestigd in ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Het Kenniscentrum is op zoek naar een data scientist voor 32 tot 36 uur per week. De functie Als data scientist lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan het onderzoek van het Kenniscentrum. Daartoe voer je, meestal als deel van een team, onderzoek uit en genereer je informatie uit een veelheid van gestructureerde en niet gestructureerde databronnen. Ook schrijf je mee aan onderzoeksrapporten en voer je overleg met opdrachtgevers en andere belanghebbenden. Je komt te werken in het cluster monitoring en data, dat momenteel bestaat uit zes andere data scientists, data analisten en data onderzoekers. Dit cluster richt zich op de uitvoering van monitoring en analyse behorende bij de wettelijke monitoringstaak, cijfermatige vraagbeantwoording en cijfermatige analyses die onderdeel uitmaken van het onderzoek dat het Kenniscentrum verricht. Om dit goed te kunnen doen, houdt deze functie in ieder geval in: Identificeren van onderzoeks- en informatievragen. Afstemmen met de (interne) klant over de achterliggende vraag. Onderzoeken van de datakwaliteit en de mogelijkheden om informatie/inzichten uit beschikbare data en bronnen te halen. Opschonen en verwerken van ruwe data tot bruikbare data. Onttrekken van relevante informatie/inzichten uit beschikbare data. Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van visualisaties en schrijven aan rapportages om de gevonden inzichten en relevante data intuïtief weer te geven. Rapporteren en delen van gegenereerde inzichten en kennis met opdrachtgevers. Advies uitbrengen over het gebruik van data en de best passende analysemethode binnen de onderzoeksteams waarin wordt gewerkt. Wat vragen wij? Wo werk- en denkniveau. Ten minste twee jaar werkervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van data-analyse of data-onderzoek. Ten minste twee jaar werkervaring met het identificeren, verkennen en plannen van analysevraagstukken. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van visualisaties of dashboards voor een gevarieerd publiek. Ervaring met het schrijven van onderzoeksrapportages. Programmeerervaring op het gebied van data-analyse of data-onderzoek. Een nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkinstelling. Zelforganiserend vermogen: inbreng van ideeën, meedenken werkwijze, verantwoordelijkheid voor de afgegeven planning. Ervaring met projectmatig werken: je bent in staat om aan meerdere projecten tegelijk te werken. Ervaring met de programmeertaal R en MS Power BI is een pre. Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Wat bieden wij? Een stimulerende en uitdagende werkomgeving in een organisatie met een belangrijke maatschappelijke betekenis die volop in ontwikkeling is. Veel aandacht en ruimte voor je professionele- en persoonlijke ontwikkeling en talentgericht werken. Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Inschaling in schaal J (min. 4.514,- en maximaal € 6.101,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur) conform de cao …

items.desc: One of the companies we work with at Joppy, a TOP Fintech, is looking for a Data & Machine Learning Engineer to join the team. Working arrangement: HYBRID in Barcelona (3 days a week in the office) Our company is an end-to-end working capital solutions provider focused on enabling CFOs/Finance teams of SMEs to pay their suppliers and collect from their customers. This includes short-term credit (factoring, supply chain finance and loans) and payment automation solutions. We are looking for a Data Engineer with a strong product mindset to join our Data team. Your primary mission will be to design, build, and maintain production-grade data products that power our credit workflows — turning Data Scientist research and models into robust, scalable services that enable real-time decisions at the core of our business. What will you own? You will be the bridge between Data Science and Engineering. Your day-to-day will be grounded in building data products/services that directly enable credit and fraud decisions — not just moving data, but shaping it into services, models, and systems that internal users trust and rely on. In order to achieve your mission, you will: Productionize credit risk and fraud models Work closely with the Data Science team to productionize Data Science solutions Own the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training and retraining workflows, model versioning (MLflow), and live monitoring for drift and degradation. Ensure deployed models meet the performance and latency standards required by automated credit decision workflows. Design and deliver data services and products Build internal APIs to expose credit scoring, risk signals, and underwriting features — consumed by the company's platform, operational teams, and third-party partners. Model and maintain database schemas for credit products: scoring results, decision logs, exposure tracking, repayment history — optimized for both operational and analytical access. Own the data layer for new products (micro-credit, portfolio factoring, supply chain finance) from scratch: define the business logic, model the data, and implement end-to-end pipelines. Build for scalability and reliability Design systems that grow with credit volumes and new product types — without requiring hard architectural rework every time. Apply software engineering best practices: modular code, unit and integration tests, CI/CD pipelines, clear documentation. Containerize and deploy services on AWS with Docker; orchestrate batch workflows (scoring runs, data refresh) with tools like Airflow. Collaborate closely across teams Data Scientists: iterate rapidly on productionization — you are their engineering partner, not just a deployment step. Software Engineers: integrate data services into the platform cleanly, with clear API contracts and stable interfaces. Credit, Risk and Underwriting teams: translate operational needs into robust data product requirements. In doing so, you will contribute to the achievement of XXXXX’s long-term growth plans Your skills: End-to-end ML & data engineering — You have at least 3 years of experience in shipping Data Science solutions into production: feature pipelines, training and retraining workflows, model versioning, and live monitoring. Not prototypes — real systems that users and workflows depend on. Python & modern data frameworks — Clean, modular, testable Python is your default. Comfortable with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic and similar libraries; you know the difference between code that works and code that ships. Data services & APIs — Hands-on building internal REST APIs: request validation, async patterns, error handling, OpenAPI docs. You design stable contracts and think about versioning and performance from day one. Data modeling & SQL — Strong database skills across operational and analytical workloads: schema design, indexing, partitioning, query optimization. Comfortable modeling finance-domain data — scoring outputs, decision logs, exposure and repayment history. Cloud & infrastructure — Solid AWS cloud experience (S3, RDS, EC2, Lambda, IAM, others) deploying and operating APIs and batch workers. Comfortable containerizing workloads with Docker. Ownership & business acumen — Small team, high autonomy. You drive work from problem definition to production with minimal guidance, and you measure quality in terms of credit decisions — not just technical correctness. What can we offer you? Full-time work with an open-ended contract Hybrid work model: we work 3 days from the office and 2 days from home to improve work-life balance Flexible benefits with Coverflex: you will be able to include in your paycheck the monthly expenses for food, transportation, daycare and others Medical insurance: we offer an optional health insurance through Sanitas, with competitive rates and company subsidizes 30% to guarantee your wellbeing Communicate better with your colleagues by signing up for free English or Spanish classes if you need …
