Lead the data science aspects of customer implementations, pilots, and production deployments. Build strong technical relationships with customers and external partners. Provide recommendations to improve products, algorithms, and analytical capabilities. Deliver training and knowledge transfer to end users and stakeholders. Support investigation and resolution of data-related and analytical challenges. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. 2+ years of experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or Big Data development. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with PySpark . Hands-on experience working with large-scale data processing frameworks and machine learning pipelines. Experience with ML lifecycle and workflow management tools such as MLflow , Airflow , or similar platforms. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and statistical modeling skills. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is a plus. Preferred Qualifications Experience in financial services, fraud detection, risk analytics, compliance, or transaction monitoring. Familiarity with cloud-based data and machine learning environments. Experience investigating anomalies and extracting insights from high-volume datasets. Knowledge of machine learning model deployment and monitoring best practices. Technical Skills PySpark Python Apache Spark Machine Learning MLflow Airflow SQL Big Data Analytics Feature Engineering Statistical Analysis This role is ideal for a data scientist who enjoys combining advanced analytics, machine learning, and business problem-solving to create impactful, scalable solutions. Why Join Us? You’ll work with a talented global team, contribute to meaningful technical initiatives, and help shape a high performing DevOps culture. Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors. With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio. At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success. Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together. Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization. To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

items.desc: JT AI Labs is JobTeaser's dedicated AI venture, born in 2026. Our mission is to connect domain experts (Master's, PhDs, professionals) with leading AI labs that need top-tier human expertise to train their models — through annotation, evaluation, and complex problem-solving across STEM, Law, Finance, Humanities, and more. We believe high-quality AI is built by humans who master nuance, logic, and depth. We're here to make that happen at scale, within a European framework built on transparency, flexibility, and quality. JobTeaser – Our young grads got talent. At JobTeaser, we believe the new generation is the future of business, and that young talent has so much to offer to the professional world and society as a whole. But finding your path as a student? That’s not easy. And for companies, understanding and recruiting this generation isn’t any simpler. That’s where we come in. JobTeaser is the career space of 800+ European schools and universities, seamlessly integrated into their Student Hubs. 👨 🎓 For students: a platform and tools to help them find their path, showcase their skills, and land an internship, a work-study program, or their very first job that truly fits them. 💼 For companies: privileged access to the best young talent, even before they officially enter the job market. 🏫 For schools & universities: a complete career and recruitment platform to boost students’ employability. Today, we support over 2 million students and young graduates across Europe. And you — are you ready to make an impact on the new generation? Job Description As one of the first members of JT AI Labs, you will own the quality of the audio datasets we collect, from the first applicant sample to the dataset the client accepts: ● Review audio by ear and with tools: noise, echo, clipping, distortion, silence, cross-talk and leakage between tracks, narrowband or Bluetooth input, and wrong sample rates or formats. ● Check that recordings meet each project’s specification: duration, speaker profile, language and accent, spontaneity of speech, and absence of personal data the expert shouldn’t have shared. ● Review applicants’ audio samples in our review console and help decide who is accepted. Monitor speaker quotas (age, gender, region, accent, hours per speaker) against client targets. ● Write and maintain QC guidelines, rejection reasons and the issue taxonomy. Turn them into clear recording instructions and training material for experts. ● Run and extend our QC scripts on session exports. Work with the data engineer to decide which checks get automated and to tune their thresholds against your human judgement. ● Design and run the human sample review that complements automated QC. Calibrate reviewers and measure their agreement so decisions stay consistent across projects. ● Track and report quality metrics: QC rejection rate per project and per expert, recurring issues, client acceptance rate. Propose improvements to the platform and the recording setup. Qualifications ● You have a degree in Audio Engineering, Sound Production, Phonetics or Linguistics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. ● You have 2+ years of experience in audio quality control, speech data QA, transcription or annotation QA, or audio post-production. ● You have a trained ear and can reliably hear subtle problems: background noise, compression artefacts, clipping, echo, mic handling, channel imbalance. ● You understand the technical basics of digital audio: sample rates, bit depth, codecs, lossless versus lossy formats, mono and multi-track recordings. ● You are comfortable with audio tools such as Audacity, Praat, iZotope RX or a DAW, and can read a waveform and a spectrogram. ● You can write and adapt small scripts in Python or Bash to batch-check files, parse metadata or compute statistics (ffmpeg, sox, soundfile, pandas or similar). You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you automate anything you do twice. ● You understand what makes speech data useful for training ASR or TTS models, or you are keen to learn. ● You thrive in a startup setting: you enjoy building processes from scratch, taking ownership, and navigating ambiguity. ● You communicate clearly with experts, clients and engineers, and can explain a rejection in a way people accept. ● You are autonomous, curious, and comfortable in a fast-evolving ecosystem. ● Professional proficiency in English, bilingual in French. Nice to have ● Experience with ASR or TTS datasets, or with a speech data provider. ● Knowledge of objective audio metrics (SNR, voice activity detection, speech quality scores) and how they relate to perceived quality. ● Experience designing gold or honeypot tasks, running calibration sessions, or measuring inter-annotator agreement. ● Additional languages or a good ear for regional accents, which helps check speaker profiles across projects. items.desc: Take on a codebase. Rebuild it with AI. Move on to the next one. My client owns a large international portfolio of software businesses. Each one has a real product, real customers and a real engineering team, and plenty have systems ready for their next big rebuild. They’re building a small forward-deployed team of hands-on engineers to lead that work. The job Every 3-6 months you join a different business and take on one hard problem, such as re-platforming a system that’s held the company back for years, or building the feature its customers have been waiting for. Half your time you’re building it yourself. The other half you’re bringing that team into AI-first engineering: setting up coding agents and workflows, working out what genuinely helps, and leaving them faster than you found them. You write the code and you get it into production. How you’ll work: AI across the whole lifecycle You’ll cover frontend, backend and infrastructure, using AI at every stage of the software development lifecycle: understanding an unfamiliar codebase, designing the solution, writing the code, testing and reviewing it, and getting it deployed and running. Work that would normally pass between a frontend developer, a backend developer and a DevOps engineer sits with you, from first look to production. You’ll have your strengths, and AI helps you cover the rest. That’s also the way of working you’ll pass on to each team you join. The aim is speed: shipping far faster than a traditional team could, and showing each business how it’s done. You’ll love this if… You’re an experienced engineer who’s comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room You’ve already used AI to make your own delivery faster, through coding agents, MCP or AI in your pipeline, and can point to what got quicker and how You like owning a problem end to end, across the whole stack You get a buzz from opening an unfamiliar codebase and working it out fast You enjoy bringing people with you: you’re curious about how other teams work, patient with sceptics, and you get satisfaction from seeing other engineers level up You build trust quickly, can read a room, and are as comfortable talking to a CEO as to a junior developer Python, TypeScript, Java, .NET: you’re comfortable picking up whatever the business runs on Why it’s different Real backing: you’ll join an established AI transformation function that’s already running AI programmes across the group, so you’re building on momentum that’s already there Zero sales: every business you work with is already part of the group, so your time goes on engineering and people, with no pitching, bidding or chasing contracts Get in early: the forward-deployed team is new, so you’ll help shape how it works, which tools it backs and what AI-first engineering looks like in practice Constant variety with a stable base: a new industry, product and problem every few months, with one permanent employer behind you Industries you’d rarely see from the inside: specialist software that runs real-world sectors, with a new domain to learn on every project Competitive salary plus bonus, remote-first anywhere in the UK If you’re the person on your team who’s already figured out how to build properly with AI, this is where you take that across a whole portfolio. Please note: applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

items.desc: Description Description Au sein de l’équipe Data Science du Pôle Technique de la Direction Maîtrise des Risques et Expertise de l’usine Orano Recyclage de La Hague, vous aurez comme mission de développer un pipeline de récupération de données techniques au sein d’un corpus documentaire métier. items.desc: AI Engineer (m/f/x) · Key Predict · London · 6-month fixed-term contract · ASAP Key Predict develops a SaaS talent assessment platform connected to its clients’ ATS systems: psychometric assessments, predictive models, and online interviews. Our R&D team, comprising psychometricians, data scientists, and project managers based in Paris, London, and India designs these assessments and models. The team also integrates AI at multiple levels: to interpret results, to evaluate unstructured content, and to enhance the quality and reliability of the assessment processes. The Role As part of the R&D team , you will develop and maintain its AI services, integrating them into the platform alongside the development team. You won’t be working alone on development: you’ll coordinate the entire effort to ensure the smooth operation and implementation of all our AI applications. → You’ll also contribute to the design on two levels: the AI applications themselves, based on functional requirements; and, together with the tech team, the platform-level developments they carry out to implement these applications. Responsibilities Deliver AI services, from specification to production deployment. Translate functional requirements into user stories and technical specifications, then implement them using spec-driven development (SDD) with code agents (Claude Code, Codex). Develop and maintain Python microservices, each with its own specifications and code. Design generative AI solutions: versioned prompts, structured and validated outputs, and model selection based on quality, cost, and response time. Test the services and monitor the quality of model outputs. Coordinate development efforts within the R&D team to ensure the smooth operation and implementation of all applications. Define API contracts and oversee the integration of services into the platform in collaboration with the IT team. Contribute to the design of applications and the related development work carried out by the IT team within the platform. Serve as the technical point of contact for the scientific team and promote the SDD within the team. Occasionally present our products to clients or during webinars. Provide technical leadership for projects, without direct supervisory oversight. Technical skills Python: solid hands-on experience in production environments. Microservices and APIs: REST services (FastAPI, Flask), API contracts, integration with other services. Generative AI: language model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), prompt design, structured outputs. SDD: precise specifications, code agents, critical review of their output. Data and testing: SQL, PostgreSQL, pytest. Machine learning: the basics, to understand and refine a model. Profile Engineering degree or master’s degree, with 2 to 3 years of experience in R&D and development. A genuine interest in talent assessment and behavioral sciences. A passion for design as well as coding and coordination. Desirable Qualifications Experience in NLP or data science. Evaluating the outputs of language models. Practical Information Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with potential for advancement, starting as soon as possible. Location: London (UK), hybrid working model (1 day per week in the office) Process: HR interview, our online assessments, technical interview, final round.

items.desc: AI Deployment Engineer // Stratford-upon-Avon // Up to £50,000 // 12 Month FTC 🚀 What if you could join an established software business and have the freedom to completely rethink how technical documentation is produced using AI? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a greenfield AI project, where you'll be encouraged to experiment, introduce new ideas and build something from scratch. They're looking for an AI Deployment Engineer to explore how Generative AI and automation can transform the way technical and product documentation is created. What do they do? The business develops a complex software platform used within manufacturing environments. They want someone to explore how AI can turn technical information, such as developer notes, Jira tickets, diagrams, PDFs and recorded conversations, into clear documentation and step-by-step instructions for customers. You'll be given the autonomy to: Explore and recommend different AI and automation tools Build prompts, templates and repeatable AI workflows Turn complex technical information into clear customer-facing documentation Automate manual documentation processes Work with developers to understand new features and technical information Review AI-generated content for accuracy and quality Introduce new ideas and improve how documentation is produced The exciting part? They don't have all the answers yet. They want someone who's genuinely excited by AI, enjoys experimenting with new technology and naturally thinks about how things could be done better. You'll have the freedom to explore what's possible and build a completely new approach. Who are they looking for? They're flexible on background. You could be a Technical Writer who's embraced AI, an AI/Automation Consultant with documentation experience, or someone from a technical or engineering environment. What's important is that you: Have experience creating technical documentation or explaining complex information clearly Have hands-on experience with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot Are interested in building AI workflows and automating processes Understand technical concepts, software workflows and ideally basic code or SQL Are creative, curious and full of ideas about how AI can improve processes Can work independently and take ownership without lots of hand-holding You don't need to be a developer or an AI researcher. Your curiosity, technical understanding and ability to innovate are what matter most. Why join? This isn't a traditional documentation role. You'll have the opportunity to influence how AI is adopted, experiment with new technologies and build something that could fundamentally change how the business operates. You'll also receive: 25 days' holiday + bank holidays Free onsite parking and onsite gym Dog-friendly office and casual dress Catered team lunch every fortnight Countryside office environment Contract: Initial 12-month FTC, with the potential to become permanent. Apply using "Easy Apply" and I'll be in touch.

items.desc: Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare. ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future. About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X. Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland Are you looking to work for a company that is Ahead of What’s Possible…. a company where you are empowered to Act with Courage, to Build great teams, to Create the future, and to Drive for Excellence? If so, then Analog Devices International (ADI) is the place for you. Leading Edge Technology; From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality. This helped prevent 33 million metric tonnes of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital xray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world. We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it ; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be Ahead of What’s Possible . Silicon Meets Software; Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real. One Company, Unlimited Opportunity; The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program, to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success. We hire Graduates primarily from Electronics, Software, Computer Science, Physics, Maths Science, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Artificial Intelligence & Robotics and Chemical & Biochemical disciplines. Our software grad opportunities are in areas like Embedded Software, Software Systems, Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, UI/UX Design and Cloud Architecture. Why Join ADI? Competitive Salary, Bonus Scheme, plus relocation assistance Competitive Holiday Allowance Graduate …

items.desc: Dans un monde en évolution permanente, VINCI Energies accélère la transition écologique en concrétisant deux mutations majeures, numérique et énergétique. Attentif à ses marchés et intégrateur de solutions multi techniques sur mesure, VINCI Energies accompagne ses clients dans le déploiement de technologies utiles aux hommes et à la planète, de la conception à la réalisation, l’exploitation et la maintenance. Actemium Tours Logistics est une entreprise de Vinci Energies, spécialisée dans le domaine de la transitique, c’est-à-dire les moyens logistiques automatisés utilisés pour le stockage/déstockage, le tri, la préparation de commande ou encore l’expédition de tout type de produits. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception et la réalisation de solutions intralogistiques innovantes : convoyage, trieurs, AMR, WCS/WMS, automatisation d'entrepôts et transformation digitale. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous créons un poste stratégique visant à accélérer l'intégration de l'Intelligence Artificielle au sein de notre entreprise et de nos offres, tout en renforçant nos compétences cybersécurité et notre souveraineté logicielle. Missions : Transformation digitale & Intelligence Artificielle Vous définissez et pilotez la feuille de route IA de l'entreprise. À ce titre, vous : Identifiez les usages IA créateurs de valeur pour nos métiers (commerce, études, réalisation, maintenance et direction). Déployez des assistants IA internes pour améliorer la productivité des équipes. Intégrez l'IA dans nos offres clients (maintenance prédictive, optimisation de flux, supervision, aide à la décision, vision industrielle, exploitation des données). Réalisez une veille technologique active sur les évolutions des marchés IA, automatisation et robotique. Accompagnez les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux outils et méthodes de travail. Cybersécurité Industrielle & IT Garant de la sécurité numérique de nos solutions et infrastructures, vous : Construisez et animez la stratégie cybersécurité de l'entreprise. Réalisez des analyses de risques sur les architectures OT/IT. Définissez les standards de sécurisation des solutions développées. Accompagnez les projets clients sur les sujets cybersécurité industrielle. Assurez une veille réglementaire et normative (NIS2, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, RGPD). Développement logiciel WCS Vous participez directement au développement et à l'évolution de notre plateforme ATL FLEX WCS. Vous : Concevez les futures briques logicielles de notre solution. Développez les interfaces utilisateur sur technologies Microsoft et Angular. Concevez des architectures évolutives et maintenables. Intégrez les fonctionnalités IA dans les outils d'exploitation et de supervision. Assurez les revues de code et l'amélioration continue des pratiques de développement. Modalité du poste : Lieu : Sorigny (37) Type de contrat : CDI Statut : Cadre Formation ingénieur ou Master en informatique ou domaine équivalent Expérience significative dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : Intelligence Artificielle (Azure AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Machine Learning, Ia générative, Data Engineering), Développement logiciel (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, APIs REST), cybersécurité (ISO 27001, IEC 62443, NIS2, Analyse de risques, Sécurité des systèmes industriels). La connaissance des systèmes intralogistiques (WCS, WMS, MES), de la robotique mobile (AMR/AGV) et de l'automatisme est un plus Esprit entrepreneurial, curiosité, autonomie, gout du terrain Ce que nous vous offrons : Un poste à fort impact et visibilité auprès de la Direction. La possibilité de construire la stratégie IA d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Des projets mêlant automatisation, robotique, data et intelligence artificielle. Une grande autonomie et une forte capacité d'initiative. L'opportunité de devenir le référent IA et cybersécurité d'Actemium Tours Logistics. Avantages groupe Vinci Energies (Plan d'épargne entreprise et retraite, accompagnement au développement de carrière et mobilité...)

items.desc: About This Programme Build the future with breakthrough technology. At Sky, we're not just keeping up with technology; we're shaping it. From AI and data to automation and digital products, the Emerging Technology Graduate Programme helps you develop skills in the technologies shaping the future. The programme combines an immersive bootcamp with two years of rotational experience, giving you the opportunity to build strong foundations before developing your skills across a range of technology teams and projects. Over two years, you'll rotate through teams working on cutting-edge projects that power millions of customer experiences. Whether it's building software, experimenting with Generative AI, or delivering solutions within agile frameworks, you'll gain hands-on experience with the tools and technologies transforming the industry. You don't need to choose a specialism immediately. This programme is designed to help you explore, grow and find your path, whether that's in software development, networks, broadcast technology, cyber security, artificial intelligence or technology delivery. We're looking for curious, motivated people who want to build a career in technology. You don't need a technical background to apply. What matters most is a genuine interest in technology and the impact it can have on customers. Over two years, we'll help you become a well-rounded technology professional, giving you insight into how our teams create and deliver great customer experiences across Sky's products and services. As you gain experience across different technology teams, you'll discover where your strengths and interests lie and have the opportunity to specialise in the areas that excite you most. What you'll be doing Technology never stands still, and neither do we. From exploring new ideas to delivering solutions used by millions of customers, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects from concept through to launch. If you enjoy learning, adapting to change and solving problems, you'll thrive at Sky. Throughout the programme, you'll rotate across a range of teams and develop a blend of technical, analytical and delivery skills while gaining exposure to Sky's wider technology landscape. You Could Build digital products using technologies such as AI, cloud platforms and modern software development tools. Learn about cyber security, threat modelling and how we protect customers, systems and data from emerging risks. Explore network technologies across physical, virtual and broadcast environments. Help shape the future of new technology solutions as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner. Use machine learning, large language models (LLMs) and Generative AI to solve real-world business and customer challenges. From day one, you'll work on real projects with real impact, supported by experienced mentors and surrounded by people who are passionate about technology. By the end of the programme, you'll have the confidence, experience and specialist skills needed to take the next step in your career at Sky. What are we looking for? The one essential requirement is that you're currently in the final year of your undergraduate degree, completing a postgraduate qualification, or have already graduated. Your degree can be in any subject. Skills that will help you thrive Demonstrate the ability to learn new technical skills quickly. Be curious about emerging technologies and how they're changing the world. Be passionate about solving problems and building smart, scalable solutions. Feel comfortable learning new tools and working in agile teams. Be excited to explore areas such as AI, data, automation and cloud platforms. Right to work Please be aware that Sky does not offer sponsorship for this role. Employment is contingent on having a valid right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme. You can find information on the length of Sky's programmes on the website. Your application journey Here's what to expect, step by step. Step 1: Apply online Tell us a bit about yourself, your degree and anything else you think Sky should know about you, such as: Part-time jobs Volunteering experience Projects you've worked on Relevant achievements Once you submit your application, keep an eye on your inbox (and junk folder). Sky will send you a link to begin the digital assessment process. Please note that you can only apply to one programme per year. Step 2: Show us your skills You'll complete two online assessments designed to help Sky understand: How you think What motivates you How you might fit into the programme Your technical abilities Don't worry, you'll have an opportunity to practise first and Sky will provide guidance to help you prepare. While you may use AI to help understand Sky and prepare for the application process, the assessments themselves must be completed without AI assistance. items.desc: Wil jij onderzoeken hoe AI kan helpen om complexe SAP-landschappen slimmer en efficiënter te controleren? Binnen ons Enterprise Solutions team zoeken we een afstudeerder die onderzoekt hoe AI kan worden ingezet om risico’s, inconsistenties, performanceproblemen en security-issues binnen SAP-omgevingen automatisch te signaleren. Ben jij analytisch sterk, geïnteresseerd in AI en IT-landschappen en wil je werken aan een oplossing die in de praktijk toepasbaar is? Dan maken we graag kennis! Wat ga je doen? SAP-landschappen worden steeds complexer door de combinatie van cloudcomponenten, integraties, API’s en hybride architecturen. Het controleren van deze omgevingen vraagt daardoor veel tijd en is gevoelig voor menselijke fouten. AI biedt mogelijkheden om kwaliteitscontrole gedeeltelijk te automatiseren en sneller inzicht te krijgen in mogelijke risico’s. Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe bestaande AI-platformen, frameworks en tooling kunnen worden ingezet voor kwaliteitscontrole binnen SAP-landschappen. Je analyseert de huidige kwaliteitscontroleprocessen binnen SAP-landschappen en brengt mogelijke verbeterpunten in kaart; Je onderzoekt bestaande AI-platformen, frameworks en tooling voor het analyseren van complexe IT-landschappen; Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan worden ingezet om onder andere risico’s, inconsistenties, performanceproblemen en security-issues te detecteren; Je brengt de relevante datastromen en integratiemogelijkheden met technologieën zoals SAP Solution Manager, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) en monitoringtools in kaart; Je ontwerpt een conceptueel model voor AI-gedreven kwaliteitscontrole binnen SAP-landschappen; Je ontwikkelt een proof-of-concept of simulatie om de haalbaarheid van je aanpak te toetsen; Je vertaalt je bevindingen naar een concreet advies over de mogelijke implementatie binnen Emixa. This position is funded by Research Ireland and is available from 1st January 2027 to contract end date of 31st December 2027. Salary: Research Assistant salary scale €34,129 - €44,311 per annum, (subject to the project’s funding limitations), and pro rata for shorter and/or part-time contracts. items.desc: We're hiring a Graduate Software Developer to join our small engineering team and work across our suite of desktop applications. You'll be working on interesting problems from day one, contributing to feature architecture and design, not just implementation, across 3D geometry, path planning, robot control, and predictive process modelling. At WAAM3D we create WAAM systems that sit at the frontier of metal additive manufacturing, combining hardware, robotics, and software into a single turnkey solution. What you'll be working on • Building new features, improving performance, and fixing bugs across our software products. • Contributing to the architecture and design of new features alongside the engineering team • Working with 3D geometry, simulation, and path planning algorithms • Developing and improving AI-driven predictive process models • Working with sensor integration and real-time data from the manufacturing process • Integrating with industrial robot controllers • Collaborating closely with engineers, researchers, and product stakeholders across the business What we're looking for • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or something similar • Solid fundamentals in software design, including SOLID principles and writing clean, maintainable code • A good attitude toward testing and documentation — you understand that code is not done until it is tested and explained • Some experience with C# or another statically typed language (C++, Java, etc.) • An interest in or exposure to machine learning or data-driven modelling • Curiosity about manufacturing, robotics, or CAD/CAM • We care more about how you think than what you already know What you'll get • A collaborative team that will invest in your growth • Exposure to a genuinely unique technical domain Benefits Our benefit package after completion of probation compromises: · Excellent training / development opportunities · Bonuses up to 10% of gross salary · Sick pay · Private Health Insurance Scheme · Cycle to work scheme · 25 days holiday plus 8 days bank holidays · Salary - £33,000 per annum

items.desc: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems. Technologies We Use Java, Scala, Rust, and Python Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution Apache Iceberg for table management and catalog interoperability Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage Gradle and Cargo for builds, and GitHub for collaboration You do not need prior experience with these technologies. We expect you to learn them here. What We Value Curiosity about how data systems work, from query optimisers and execution operators to file formats and distributed processing A high bar for correctness and a willingness to dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does Comfort following a problem across languages, services, and layers of the stack A practical approach to performance, grounded in measurement rather than intuition Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and incorporate feedback Interest in applying deep systems engineering to real-world problems, with empathy for the people who depend on our software What We Require Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience Proficiency in at least one language such as Java, Rust, Scala, C++, or C Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and concurrency Strong written and verbal communication skills Coursework or projects in databases, compilers, operating systems, or distributed systems Contributions to open-source projects Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a …

items.desc: (Dit is een externe vacature bij onze klant: vaste werving, niet op freelancebasis mogelijk) Onze klant is een producent van exclusieve outdoor meubels en staat bekend als een toonaangevend internationaal designmerk van Belgische oorsprong in high-end outdoor living meubilair. Ter versterking van het team zijn wij voor hen op zoek naar een creatieve 3D & AI content visualiser . Heb jij een scherp oog voor detail, een grote interesse in design en interieur en de commerciële drive om een internationaal premium merk naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Ben je daarnaast grafisch ijzersterk en heb je de nodige affiniteit met de wereld van 3D-rendering en AI-content? Dan is deze rol als Creative 3D & AI content visualiser bij de klant van OMcollective jou op het lijf geschreven. Jobinhoud Als 3D & AI content visualiser ondersteun je de commerciële en operationele groei van het bedrijf door hoogwaardige visuele digitale content te creëren, te beheren en de productdatabase optimaal te onderhouden. De rol focust op het uitwerken van AI-gegenereerde interieurscenes, het coördineren van hoogwaardige 3D-renderings en het vertalen van producten en collecties naar inspirerende marketingassets voor verkoop van projecten bij hoogstaande internationale hospitality klanten. Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Je werkt AI-gegenereerde interieurscenes uit en past AI-tools toe om efficiënt, slim en consistent beelden, moodboards en conceptvisualisaties te ontwikkelen. Je werkt zelfstandig visuele 3D-concepten uit en coördineert het 3D-renderingproces nauwgezet met een externe partner. Je visualiseert beelden tot in het kleinste detail. Je leert stoffen, texturen en verschillende materialen grondig te begrijpen om deze visueel 100% correct over te brengen in renders en 3D-designs. Je vult actief productinformatie en beelden aan in het PIM-systeem (Product Information Management) en beheert overige beelddatabases. Je ondersteunt marketingcollega’s bij het maken van brochures, assets, product sheets, klantgerichte content en sales presentaties. Je bewaakt continu de visuele kwaliteit en de merkuitstraling over alle digitale en commerciële touchpoints heen. Jouw profiel Je beschikt over een sterk grafisch en esthetisch gevoel met een uitgesproken oog voor detail. Je hebt een sterke technische affiniteit met 3D-rendering en werkte al eerder met software zoals SketchUp, Blender 3D of gelijkaardige visualisatietools. Je hebt ervaring met AI-gedreven creatietools, zoals Nano Banana. Je brengt ideeën makkelijk over en krijgt iedereen mee. Of je nu afstemt met marketing, verkoop, management of externe 3D-partners: jij bewaart het overzicht en zorgt voor een heldere afstemming. Je bent leergierig ingesteld en bereid om jezelf te verdiepen in materiaal- en stofkennis om deze visueel correct te vertalen naar digitale beelden. Je bent een echte teamplayer, die ownership neemt over kwaliteit en commercieel ingesteld is. Je hebt een goede kennis van grafische software zoals Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, InDesign en Illustrator) of Canva voor het ondersteunen en opmaken van brochures en assets. Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd bij het aanvullen van gegevens en beelden in een PIM-systeem. Je beschikt over een solide basiskennis van Microsoft Office, waaronder PowerPoint, Excel, Word en Teams of SharePoint. Aanbod Je komt terecht in een warme werkomgeving met veel collegialiteit en een hechte groep collega’s. Je werkt in een bedrijf met korte communicatielijnen, wat betekent dat jij mee je stempel kunt drukken op het geheel. Je werkt vanuit een nieuw en stijlvol kantoor, vlot bereikbaar met de wagen tussen Gent en Kortrijk. Je krijgt een inspirerende werkomgeving waarin je veel kunt realiseren en de ruimte krijgt om eigen verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je maakt deel uit van een ambitieus en internationaal groeiend bedrijf. Je geniet van een aantrekkelijke werk-privébalans met glijdende werktijden en 32 vakantiedagen.

Product mission is to empower gamers with a new way to discover games, connect with their friends, and earn fantastic rewards. Joining us, you will get to build the highest quality consumer app in one of the hottest domains in the gaming industry, and make real measurable business impact. With tens of thousands of daily active users and over a hundred games on clients platform, there are growing fast. Join us and let's open a whole new market together. You'll be the first dedicated engineer on the SDK, owning architecture, public API, releases and the partner experience end to end. What makes you a great fit: Hands-on experience with generative AI, fal.ai, and ComfyUI, supported by workflows or applications you have built. Strong Python or TypeScript skills to automate workflows, integrate APIs, and handle async processing, background jobs, and errors. Ability to build modular, config-driven pipelines that generate multiple variations by changing avatars, scripts, and other creative elements while reusing assets. Experience integrating image, video, text-to-speech, and talking-head models, selecting models based on quality, cost, and the use case. Practical FFmpeg experience with clip assembly, UI overlays, subtitles, audio mixing, and aspect-ratio formatting. Ability to implement reliable job orchestration, retries, resumable execution, and cost tracking. Clear, maintainable code and documentation that allows marketing staff to operate workflows without writing code. Good English communication and the ability to collaborate with AI-video creative specialists. Relevant work to demonstrate: be prepared to share your screen and walk us through a working pipeline or application, explaining your technical contribution. Nice to Have Experience with Seedance, MiniMax, Kling, or similar video-generation models. Experience with Stable Diffusion, LoRA training, or evaluating character consistency. Experience building internal applications for creative teams or scaling automated video production. Familiarity with paid mobile user acquisition creatives and CTR, CPI, or ROAS. Experience with agent-driven or AI-assisted video editing. Your day-to-day in this position: Build modular, config-driven workflows covering scripts, hooks, avatars or LoRAs, voices, music, UI assets, and aspect ratios. Integrate the fal Queue API to manage jobs, rate limits, webhooks, and retries. Make runs resumable so failures don’t trigger duplicate generation costs. Fetch and cache UI assets, then use FFmpeg to assemble clips, add subtitles and CTAs, sync talking-head audio, and mix sound. Produce video ads in 9:16 and 1:1 formats. Document the pipeline and provide configuration examples that the marketing team can use without writing code. Why work with us?: People-first management with minimal bureaucracy A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return Flexible working hours 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays) 10 paid recovery days Full financial and legal support for independent contractors Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers Dedicated HR support Our next steps: ✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Home assignment — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer

items.desc: À propos de nous L’Université de Rennes, établissement d’enseignement et de recherche et un des premiers employeurs du bassin rennais, offre un environnement propice à l’épanouissement de ses personnels et étudiants. Elle est engagée dans la transition écologique et environnementale, la promotion de la diversité, l’égalité entre les femmes et les hommes, l’inclusion des personnes en situation de handicap. Service d’affectation : Direction du Système d’information (DSI) La DSI, composée d’environ 95 personnes, a pour mission de proposer et mettre en œuvre la politique du système d’information de l’Université. Elle est ainsi chargée de moderniser, exploiter et maintenir le SI et les services numériques de l’établissement en lien avec les orientations stratégiques et politiques de l’établissement. La DSI est organisée en six pôles (PMO-Urbanisation, Infrastructures, Applications et Services Numériques, Proximité, Administration, Décisionnel) auxquels s’ajoute une cellule dédiée à la sécurisation du Système d’information. Son pôle « Infrastructures » regroupant 16 personnes, est en charge de l'ensemble des équipements systèmes, réseaux et de téléphonie fixe. Eléments de contexte : L’Université de Rennes pilote le projet Cluster SequoIA « Cluster IA – Confiance et Sécurité », l'un des 9 IA clusters au niveau national, visant à faire émerger un pôle européen d’excellence en recherche et formation sur le thème de l'Intelligence Artificielle, de la confiance et de la sécurité dans et par les systèmes numériques en Bretagne. Le Cluster SequoIA se concentre sur 3 principaux domaines : IA fondamentale (sécurisée, hybride, frugale, ...), IA pour la cybersécurité et la défense, IA pour l’environnement et océan. Un des pivots du projet consiste en la création d’une plateforme de mise à disposition et de partage de données, de ressources de calcul et de cas d’usages (datalab) pour développer des projets de recherche et d’enseignement en lien avec les partenaires (établissements d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche, collectivités, entreprises…). Mission Rattaché.e au responsable du pôle Infrastructures, vous piloterez les activités de l’équipe en charge des projets d’infrastructures de recherche et d’intelligence artificielle (RIA) de l’établissement, dans le cadre du Cluster SequoIA. items.desc: Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling. Jobbeskrivning Operations, Engineering, AI & Data stödjer våra kunder att driva strategiska förändringsprojekt där vi implementerar affärsstrategier och utvecklar deras operationella förmågor för att hjälpa dem nå sina affärsmål. Vi arbetar med verksamhetsförändring där vi använder våra industrispecifika lösningar och tekniska kunskaper för att transformera, modernisera och optimera våra klienters processer och tekniska plattformar. Inom Operations, Engineering, AI & Data finns tre olika team: Operations Transformation & Industry Solutions: Inom OTIS-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att innovativt förändra sina organisationer. Du driver förändringsprojekt, förnyar operativa modeller, implementerar nya system och processer samt förbättrar effektiviteten. Hos oss fokuserar du primärt på bank och finans samt försäkring, där vi arbetar tillsammans med flertalet av Nordens största banker och försäkringsbolag. Du kommer att arbeta i projektteam med stark laganda och nära kunden. Som Analyst driver du analysarbete, stöttar i framtagandet av presentationsmaterial och hjälper kunden att lyckas med sin förändringsresa. Du får möjlighet att arbeta nära och lära dig av erfarna kollegor om olika industrier och affärsutveckling, samt adressera tekniska och affärsmässiga utmaningar. AI & Data: Inom AI & Data-teamet hjälper du Deloittes kunder att förbättra beslutsfattande genom datadrivna insikter och skapa insiktsdrivna organisationer. Du kommer att arbeta med implementering av AI, GenAI, cloud data platforms, data warehouse och BI/analytics, med fokus på data science, maskininlärning, statistisk analys och modellering för att leverera avancerade insikter och affärsvärde. Vår modell är on-the-job-training där du växer in i mer ansvarsfulla roller och vidareutbildar dig i tekniska plattformar som Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Azure, Snowflake och Databricks. I det rådgivande spåret arbetar du med data management, data governance och datastrategi. Vi ser gärna att du har en traditionell managementkonsultutbildning kombinerad med data och teknik samt ett intresse för rådgivning. AI & Data-teamet verkar i en nordisk organisation med mycket kunskapskapital och kompetens, så du kommer att medverka i projekt, communities och utbildningar tillsammans med nordiska kollegor. Engineering: Inom Engineering-teamet fokuserar du på att hjälpa Deloittes kunder att transformera sin affär genom planering och implementation av kritiska verksamhetssystem och molnplattformar. Du kombinerar teknik- och affärsexpertis inom systemutveckling och molnplattformar med bred projektledningsförmåga och djup branscherfarenhet inom flera sektorer. Därmed stödjer du kunder genom hela deras system- och affärstransformationsresa, oavsett fas. Vårt erbjudande inkluderar utveckling av strategier, skräddarsydda plattformar, modernisering av applikationer, alla aspekter av molnteknik samt rådgivning kring systemimplementation. Som Analyst i vårt team stödjer du kunder med roller inom kravställning, systemutveckling, testning och projektledning. Du skaffar dig erfarenhet genom kundprojekt samt deltar vid branschevent, specialiserad utbildning och certifieringsprogram. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som: Är nyexaminerad ingenjör, systemvetare eller ekonom med en masterexamen inom management eller data/data science/analytics. Har relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – erfarenhet inom konsultbranschen är meriterande Har goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Meriterande: Goda akademiska meriter, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv Intresse för hur digitalisering och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher Du är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta projektbaserat, i nära samarbete med både ditt team och klienter, i en dynamisk miljö. Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå. Ytterligare information Vi erbjuder Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. items.desc: Job Description About us Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them. What you'll join Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you? If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground-breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come. What you'll do Contribute to the development of AI-enabled data and knowledge management solutions for fusion research, helping to structure, improve and share scientific and engineering information using modern software and data technologies. Work collaboratively with scientists, engineers and stakeholders to develop high-quality software and data solutions, apply best practices, research emerging technologies, and support the adoption of new tools and ways of working. Deliver technical outputs through effective task management, documentation and presentations, while building technical, professional and stakeholder engagement skills in an inclusive, collaborative and innovative environment. How you'll develop On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership. The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route. What you'll need Degree in Physics, Engineering, Maths, Computer Science, or similar from 2025 to 2027 An interest in data, information and knowledge management and computing architectures. Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload Benefits We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include: £35,227 base salary. Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution. 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays. Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions. Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network. Our commitment to ED&I UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit. UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments . AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work. To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests. Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 21st October 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here. Additional Information volume of applications.

Lavorerà a stretto contatto con i diversi reparti aziendali per trasformare esigenze operative in soluzioni concrete, contribuendo alla diffusione di una cultura orientata all’innovazione e all’efficienza. Principali attività Analizzare i processi aziendali al fine di individuare attività automatizzabili o ottimizzabili tramite strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale; Raccogliere e comprendere le esigenze delle diverse funzioni aziendali, traducendole in soluzioni digitali efficaci; Progettare e implementare soluzioni basate su AI Generativa, LLM, automazioni e agenti AI; Collaborare con i reparti aziendali durante tutte le fasi di sviluppo e adozione delle nuove soluzioni; Promuovere l’utilizzo degli strumenti implementati attraverso attività di formazione e supporto agli utenti interni; Monitorare i risultati ottenuti in termini di efficienza, qualità, tempi e costi, proponendo azioni di miglioramento continuo; Supportare l’azienda nel percorso di trasformazione digitale e innovazione dei processi. items.desc: We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. Join Lenovo's Solutions Services Group (SSG) as an AI Business Insights Analyst and help transform data into actionable business intelligence. In this role, you will support analytics, reporting, dashboard development, and automation initiatives, leveraging tools such as Excel, Power BI, and AI-enabled solutions to generate insights that improve decision-making and operational efficiency across the business. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Europe and META, helping identify trends, optimize processes, and drive data-informed strategies. Reporting directly to the Director Europe META Service Delivery Manager, you will gain exposure to international projects, emerging technologies, and business-critical initiatives within one of Lenovo's fastest-growing organizations. This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates and early-career professionals looking to start a career in AI, business analytics, data-driven decision making, and digital transformation, while developing both technical and stakeholder management skills in a global environment. What You Will Do Maintain and enhance Power BI dashboards and reports. Analyze business data and provide actionable insights. Support regular reporting activities and KPI tracking. Validate data quality and reporting accuracy. Leverage AI tools to automate reporting and improve analytics processes. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation. What You Will Need Hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel and Power BI, with the ability to work confidently with data, reports, and dashboards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to identifying trends, insights, and opportunities. Genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and data analytics, and how technology can improve business processes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and quickly learn new tools, systems, and technologies. Excellent attention to detail, ensuring high levels of data accuracy and quality in reporting and analysis. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and collaborate across teams. Experience using AI-powered productivity, reporting, or analytics tools is a plus and will help you succeed in this role. Curiosity about emerging technologies, digital transformation, reporting automation, and data visualization best practices, with a desire to continuously learn and innovate. What We Offer Opportunities for career development growth Performance based rewards Hybrid working model (homeoffice/office) Up to 3 paid Personal Days annually Additional vacation days 100% sick leave compensation up to 2 months per year A broad selection of soft / hard skills trainings and individual mentoring Employer contribution to the Third Pillar Pension System Life life events insurance, fully covered by company We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

items.card: What you'll be doing Over two years, you'll rotate through four different teams, gaining hands-on experience across: Econometrics Advanced Analytics Digital Decisioning Applied Data Science Customer Insight You'll work on real projects, develop cutting-edge analytical skills, and collaborate with brilliant minds to solve complex challenges, from advanced forecasting and credit risk modelling to machine learning for
items.desc: About The Programme Join the team that transforms data into action. At Sky, data drives everything we do, from creating new products and exploring new markets to predicting the future of our multi-billion-pound business. On our Data and Analytics Graduate Programme, you'll help shape how we communicate with customers and deliver the entertainment millions love. What you'll be doing Over two years, you'll rotate through four different teams, gaining hands-on experience across: Econometrics Advanced Analytics Digital Decisioning Applied Data Science Customer Insight You'll work on real projects, develop cutting-edge analytical skills, and collaborate with brilliant minds to solve complex challenges, from advanced forecasting and credit risk modelling to machine learning for personalisation and customer segmentation. Best of all, you won't need to specialise right away. You'll explore the full spectrum of data and analytics before choosing your path. What are we looking for? The one essential requirement is that you're currently in the final year of your undergraduate degree, completing a postgraduate qualification, or have already graduated. Your degree can be in any subject. Our programme is designed to give you all the knowledge and experience you need, so we're much more interested in the passion, drive and talent you're able to bring to the team. Skills that will help you thrive Logical, end-to-end thinking Strong problem-solving, presentation and IT skills Enjoy fast-paced, task-focused environments Collaborative and curious about market trends Technical skills Right to work Please be aware that Sky does not offer sponsorship for this role. Employment is contingent on you having a valid right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme. You can find information on the length of our programmes on the website. Your application journey Here's what to expect, step by step. Step 1: Apply online Tell us a bit about yourself, your details, your degree, and anything else you think we should know, such as part-time jobs, volunteering, or projects you've worked on. Once you hit submit, keep an eye on your inbox (and junk folder). We'll send you a link to start your digital assessments. Please note: You can only apply to one programme per year. Step 2: Show us your skills You'll complete two online assessments that help us get to know you better: how you think, what motivates you, and how you might fit into the programme. Don't worry, you'll get a chance to practise first, and we'll send you tips to help you feel confident. We understand that you may want to use AI to support your preparation for the assessments, such as researching Sky and understanding the role. However, the assessments themselves should be completed without the assistance of AI. Want to go a step further? Check out our Preparation Hub. It's packed with: Practice exercises Insights into the assessment process Stories from current graduates and apprentices Information about your values and learning style Guidance on the types of work that may suit you Step 3: Virtual Assessment Centre If you make it to the final stage, we'll invite you to a virtual assessment day. You'll take part in a range of activities designed to show us how you think, solve problems and work with others, while giving you a real feel for what it's like to work in Data at Sky. We'll let you know when to expect a decision once the assessment day has taken place. Need support? If you need any adjustments to help you complete any stage of your application, let us know when you submit your application. A member of our Early Careers team will get in touch if we need more information. Where developing you begins At Sky, your development starts from day one. Through personalised skills discovery, future-focused learning and real-world experiences, you'll build the confidence and skills to thrive. Along The Way, You'll Be Supported By A dedicated Early Careers team Experienced mentors Buddies Managers This support network will help you make the most of your career from the very start. Why Sky? This is your chance to be part of something big. Our graduate programme puts you right at the centre of the action, learning, growing, and helping make the magic of Sky happen every day. No matter your background, interests or degree subject, there's space here for your ideas and ambition. A career at Sky is where better begins, and it starts with you. Important information If your application is successful, your offer will be conditional upon passing a Criminal Record Check. Application deadline We may close applications before 15 November 2026 due to high application volumes. However, this programme will not close before 1 November 2026 . We therefore encourage you to submit your application as early as possible to avoid disappointment.

items.desc: Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. Applications are open until 25 October 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and may close this opportunity before the advertised deadline. We encourage you to apply to ensure your application is considered. Who We Are We are MUFG. With over 360 years of heritage and more than 150,000 employees in 40 countries, we’ve grown to become one of the top ten banks in the world. Combining our global network and financial strength with a dedication to becoming the world's most trusted financial group, we pride ourselves on exceeding client expectations and building long-term relationships. We support our clients and protect their interests with the highest levels of professionalism and expertise, while also serving society and fostering a sustainable vision for growth. DX&AI The DX & Transformation Office is responsible for shaping and coordinating MUFG’s digital, AI and data transformation agenda across EMEA, working in close partnership with the business, Technology and control functions. The team drives the overall transformation programme, focusing on defining the DX, AI and data strategy developing and delivering a pipeline of business-led use cases establishing the technology and data foundations needed to deliver solutions securely and at scale operating the regional AI governance framework to support safe, responsible and compliant innovation building the skills, engagement and organisational capabilities required to embed new ways of working. Through close collaboration with colleagues across EMEA, Japan, the Americas and Asia, the team connects global direction with regional priorities, fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, and supports the translation of strategy into meaningful business outcomes. What To Expect Our 18-month Analyst Programme begins with a comprehensive training curriculum designed to build your understanding of our products, clients, and business strategy. This foundation will equip you with the knowledge and confidence needed to succeed as you transition into your role. As part of a select Analyst cohort, you'll learn from some of the most experienced professionals in the industry while building connections with peers across the programme. Our collaborative culture encourages teamwork, while also creating opportunities for you to make your own impact. In our open and inclusive environment, senior colleagues are approachable, invested in your development, and eager to support your growth. In addition, your buddy and mentor will make sure you have all the support you need to succeed. And you’ll enjoy an ongoing commitment to your development as you build a lasting and rewarding career with us. Key Dates Assessment Centre: 20th & 27th November2026 Start Date: 19th July 2027 Join Our Team We look for talented, motivated and ambitious people who will be able to help drive our business forward. Successful Candidates Will Foundational understanding of AI concepts and responsible/safe AI usage. Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills. have excellent communication & interpersonal skills have high levels of motivation and integrity Have excellent attention to detail and accuracy Project management or coordination experience would be advantageous. be innovative and have the ability to generate new and creative ideas be in their final year of study or have graduated in the last 12 months We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements. MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership. We make our recruitment decisions in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with our commitment to identifying the right skills for the right role and our obligations under the law.
