items.desc: At Trailmix, our players are the very reason we exist and our mission is to create delightful spaces where millions of people can flourish. Our hit game Love & Pies , launched in September 2021, has resonated with millions worldwide and we build free-to-play mobile games that are snackable yet filled with heart, humour, and stories that stick. We're a focused and highly collaborative team with a big creative spirit. We believe the best games are made when the people behind them feel inspired, supported, and proud of the work they do. That's why our values sit at the heart of how we work, shaping every decision and creative choice we make. Trailmix Values We win as one: Success is shared, and collaboration fuels everything we do because great games are never built solo. We are resilient by nature: We adapt and rise stronger each time because every challenge is a chance to evolve. We are powered by our players: Every choice begins with them because when our players thrive, so do we. We are kind and direct: We speak with honesty and care because clarity and compassion build the trust that makes us better. We stay curious and grow: We ask, explore, and learn because curiosity keeps our creativity alive. We decide boldly and own fully: We move with courage and conviction because great ideas only matter when we stand behind them. Our values are what set Trailmix apart: they guide us in crafting games that are joyful, authentic, and player-first. We've created a workplace where both people and players feel seen, supported, and inspired. If you're excited by meaningful creativity, true collaboration, and making games that bring people joy, you'll feel right at home here, too. The Opportunity We're looking for a Data Analyst or Data Scientist to join our data team in London on a 12-month Fixed Term Contract. If you love turning player data into clear answers and care about the games those answers shape, you'll fit right in. The title matters less to us than the person: a strong analyst with a product mindset is exactly who we're after. Reporting to our Game Data Lead, you'll start by exploring new ways to grow our games organically, building on the groundwork the team is laying now. You'll also pick up work across our existing games. You'll sit within a lean game team, giving them the insight they need to make good decisions, while being a valued part of the wider data team. Success looks like a game team that treats you as one of their own and makes better decisions because of your work, and a data team that's stronger for having you in it. We keep things simple. We'd rather act on a clear answer today than a perfect one next month. You'll have the independence to shape your approach, make decisions within your area and take ownership of outcomes, with experienced teammates to collaborate with when you need another perspective. The Day to Day Analyse player behaviour across our games, identifying what's working, where there's room to improve and the likely impact of different changes. Own the measurement of organic growth , from tracking organic install share to testing how shareable our games are, and using the findings to recommend next steps. Investigate and improve install attribution , applying causal methods to understand where new players come from and what brings them in. Design and analyse A/B tests with the game team, choosing appropriate methods, interpreting results and recommending what to do next. Build and maintain dashboards and data models using Omni, dbt and BigQuery, making sure game teams have reliable data to inform their decisions. Work with developers to define tracking requirements , identifying the events and data points needed to measure features before they ship. Apply player insights to game design , identifying opportunities to balance and optimise features and measure their impact. Turn loosely defined questions into clear analytical approaches , choosing the right data and methods, owning your work from start to finish and making decisions within your scope. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to game teams and the wider studio, sharing knowledge and collaborating with teammates to improve how we work. Use good judgement in how you work , balancing speed with quality, adapting to changing priorities and raising risks early. Use AI confidently and critically throughout your work, from writing SQL and dbt models to exploring data, while checking outputs and applying your own judgement. About You You write clean, reliable SQL and use Python for analysis. You have a solid understanding of applied statistics, including sampling, hypothesis testing and A/B tests , and know how to apply them to real problems. You can take a loosely defined question, work out the right analytical approach and turn it into an answer people can trust and act on. You've used data to understand how people use a product , and you think about what the findings mean for the product, not just the …

items.desc: Bouw jij mee aan slimme en efficiënte processen binnen Ten Brinke? Ten Brinke is continu bezig met het verbeteren van haar bedrijfsprocessen. Digitalisering en data spelen daarin een steeds grotere rol. Om hierin verdere stappen te zetten, zijn wij op zoek naar een AI Specialist met een sterke focus op de business. Geen theoretische experimenten, maar het toepassen van AI op vragen uit de dagelijkse praktijk: projectontwikkeling, bouw, inkoop, finance en administratieve processen. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Specialist Help Je Collega’s Slimmer Te Werken Door Data Om Te Zetten In Concrete En Bruikbare Oplossingen. Je haalt vraagstukken op bij de business (o.a. bouw, projectontwikkeling, inkoop en finance); vertaalt deze naar praktische AI‑ en datagedreven toepassingen; ontwikkelt en implementeert oplossingen die direct waarde opleveren; analyseert project-, financiële en administratieve data om knelpunten en verbeterkansen inzichtelijk te maken en om te zetten in slimme AI-tools; realiseert quick wins die tijd besparen, kosten verlagen of de kwaliteit verbeteren; presenteert resultaten helder en begrijpelijk aan gebruikers en management; borgt dat oplossingen veilig, beheersbaar en AVG‑proof zijn; meet of oplossingen daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt en waarde toevoegen. Je werkt nauw samen met de business en stemt af met IT, security en privacy. Je kan werken vanuit onze vestiging in Varsseveld, Almelo of Nieuwegein maar bent bereid om wekelijks de hoofdvestiging in Varsseveld te bezoeken. Wat breng je mee? Je denkt vanuit processen en businessvraagstukken, niet vanuit technologie; Je hebt ervaring met data-analyse en het toepassen van AI / machine learning; Je kunt werken met data uit ERP-, project- en financiële systemen; Je kunt complexe analyses helder uitleggen aan niet‑technische collega’s; Je durft keuzes te maken en prioriteiten te stellen Ervaring met tools zoals Python, SQL en moderne data-/AI‑platformen is een pré. (Exacte tooling is minder belangrijk dan je vermogen om oplossingen praktisch toe te passen.) Wie ben jij? Praktisch en nuchter, passend bij een bouw- en projectorganisatie; Ondernemend en zelfstandig; Niet bang voor onvolwassen data of processen; Gericht op samenwerken met de business; Krijgt energie van het opbouwen van nieuwe werkwijzen; Focus op resultaat en toepasbaarheid. Wat bieden wij? Een sleutelrol in de verdere digitalisering van Ten Brinke; Een goed salaris. Dit groeit natuurlijk mee met jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling; Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, een goede pensioenregeling, ANW verzekering en een werkgeversbijdrage voor de ziektekosten; Een veelzijdige en uitdagende baan met veel verantwoordelijkheid, zelfstandigheid én afwisseling; Een mobiele telefoon en laptop van de zaak; Directe impact op kernprocessen binnen bouw, projectontwikkeling en finance; Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid; Werken in een internationale, no‑nonsense organisatie. Klik op de sollicitatieknop om te solliciteren. Vragen of meer informatie? items.desc: JT AI Labs is JobTeaser's dedicated AI venture, born in 2026. We believe high-quality AI is built by humans who master nuance, logic, and depth. We're here to make that happen at scale, within a European framework built on transparency, flexibility, and quality. JobTeaser – Our young grads got talent. At JobTeaser, we believe the new generation is the future of business, and that young talent has so much to offer to the professional world and society as a whole. But finding your path as a student? That’s not easy. And for companies, understanding and recruiting this generation isn’t any simpler. That’s where we come in. JobTeaser is the career space of 800+ European schools and universities, seamlessly integrated into their Student Hubs. 👨 🎓 For students: a platform and tools to help them find their path, showcase their skills, and land an internship, a work-study program, or their very first job that truly fits them. 💼 For companies: privileged access to the best young talent, even before they officially enter the job market. 🏫 For schools & universities: a complete career and recruitment platform to boost students’ employability. Job Description As one of the first members of JT AI Labs, you will design and build the data foundations of our audio collection activity, from the raw recording to the dataset delivered to the client: ● Own audio storage on AWS: bucket design, encryption, versioning, lifecycle and retention rules, and reconciliation between the database and storage. ● Build audio processing jobs: track alignment between speakers, resampling to client specifications, and format validation, transform quality control ad-hoc scripts into full blown quality control pipelines. ● Design and run the dataset delivery pipeline: packaging to client spec, file naming, metadata manifests, pseudonymised speaker IDs, consent records per file, checksums, and secure transfer. ● Guarantee traceability: every file can be traced to its speaker, project and consent, and consent withdrawal deletes every version of the affected data and logs the deletion. ● Make sure all storage and processing complies with GDPR and EU AI Act data requirements. ● Analyse datasets, spot quality problems early, propose solutions and iterate quickly. ● Under the supervision of the Head of AI, work closely with the full-stack engineer, the delivery lead and clients to meet our goals on acceptance rate. ● Contribute to the team’s best practices in testing, CI/CD, data versioning and deployment automation. Qualifications ● You hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative field. ● You have 3+ years of experience building and running data pipelines in production. ● You are proficient in Python and comfortable with NumPy and the data tooling around it. ● You have hands-on experience processing audio or other signal data: ffmpeg, formats and codecs, sample rates, and signal quality metrics. ● You have strong experience with AWS (S3, IAM, KMS, lifecycle policies) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). ● You are rigorous about data quality, reproducibility and traceability: checksums, manifests, versioning, idempotent jobs. ● You are familiar with data protection requirements (GDPR, PII handling, pseudonymisation), and you are aware of the EU AI Act or keen to learn about it. ● You have a pragmatic, analytical, and results-oriented mindset: you favor frequent iterative deliveries over long research tunnels. ● You thrive in a startup setting: you enjoy building from scratch, taking ownership, and navigating ambiguity. ● You enjoy working in cross-functional teams (Operations, Tech, Product) and can translate client specifications into reliable pipelines. ● You are autonomous, curious, and comfortable in a fast-evolving ecosystem. ● Professional proficiency in English, bilingual in French. Nice to have ● Experience with speech datasets for ASR or TTS: voice activity detection (Silero VAD or similar), speaker diarisation, and transcription tools. ● Experience delivering datasets to AI labs or data buyers, and with their delivery conventions. ● Experience with annotation tools (e.g. Label Studio) and human-in-the-loop quality workflows. ● Experience with health-data or other regulated data environments. items.desc: Bij Zonneplan bouwen we AI Commerce: een autonoom verkoopkanaal voor energie, thuisbatterijen, zonnepanelen en laadpalen. Of een klant nu via chat in de app advies vraagt, een gepersonaliseerde aanvraagstraat doorloopt of de voicebot belt om half tien 's avonds, hij krijgt een gesprek dat past bij zijn situatie en een offerte die hij direct kan tekenen. AI Commerce is een volledig nieuw kanaal voor Zonneplan, op een vakgebied dat nu wordt uitgevonden. We bouwen op een eigen productieplatform met de nieuwste modellen van OpenAI, Anthropic en Google. Je werkt samen met marketing, sales en development om dit van de grond te krijgen. Het terrein is nieuw, je hebt vrijheid om de aanpak te bepalen. Jouw bijdrage aan plan Zero Jij bouwt mee aan autonome verkoop, van klantgesprek tot getekend contract. De agent voert het gesprek, gepersonaliseerde pagina's tonen wat past, het offertesysteem maakt het contract. Dit werkt over alle productlijnen, energie, thuisbatterij, zon en laadpaal, en draait 24/7, met een accountmanager voor de uitzonderingen. Jij maakt de klantervaring persoonlijk bij de aankoop. Een klant die bespaart ziet terugverdientijd vooraan, een klant met een EV ziet slim laden, een gezin ziet comfort. Je bouwt de hyperpersonalisatie die bepaalt wat voor wie werkt, over web, app, chat en voice. Elke klant krijgt zijn eigen flow, opgebouwd uit wat we van hem weten. Jij meet, leert en optimaliseert continu. Je definieert evaluatiecriteria en kwaliteitsdrempels waaraan we toetsen voordat iets live gaat. Elke deal, elk gesprek en elke afwijzing voedt het systeem. Wat we vandaag leren komt morgen in productie. Jij slaat de brug tussen commercie en techniek. Je vertaalt commerciële doelen direct naar werkende pagina's, gesprekken en flows. Je werkt nauw samen met het team Customer Acquisition & Journey op de raakvlakken in web, app en aanvraagstraat. Hierin word je ondersteund door een team van 45+ data scientists, ML-engineers en developers. Dit krijg je van ons Salaris €3.250 tot €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je achtergrond en impact. 25 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen) en reiskostenvergoeding. Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past. Vanaf dag één investeren we in jouw groei met de Zonneplan Academie, goede tools en ruimte om te blijven leren. Volledige vrijheid in tooling, providers en modellen, inclusief een Claude Max-abonnement. Dit neem jij mee Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring waarin je zelf prompts, agent-flows en conversational interfaces hebt gebouwd en in productie gezet, en kunt laten zien wat dat heeft opgeleverd. Je AI-werk heeft aantoonbaar iets verkocht of geconverteerd: autonome verkoop, conversational commerce of AI-gedreven funnels. Je hebt commercieel instinct en begrijpt klantgedrag. Je weet hoe je iemand door een geautomatiseerde flow tot een aankoop brengt en vertaalt commerciële doelen direct naar werkende oplossingen. Je werkt pragmatisch en datagedreven: je shipt snel, meet het effect en stuurt bij. Plannen schrijven is bijzaak, bouwen is de norm. Zo ziet het proces eruit 1. Solliciteer op deze vacature. 2. Telefonische kennismaking met Samer (recruiter). 3. Eerste gesprek met Glenn (Lead GenAI) en Samer. 4. Tweede gesprek met Dennis en Erwin, inclusief een casus waarin je laat zien hoe je een AI Commerce-flow aanpakt, en persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest. 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod. Klaar om jouw AI-expertise in te zetten voor plan Zero? Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Dat klinkt groot, en dat is het ook. Maar jouw werk brengt het een flinke stap dichterbij. Zonneplan wil naar één miljoen energieklanten, en dat lukt niet door meer mensen aan te nemen, maar door duurzame energie op een fundamenteel andere manier te verkopen. Jij bouwt mee aan dat verkoopkanaal: AI Commerce dat 24/7 draait en persoonlijk werkt op een schaal die met menselijke capaciteit niet haalbaar is. Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

The product is live and growing week on week, so your
items.desc: Build the AI therapist that delivers end-to-end CBT to patients in the US: live, clinically supervised, and measured on whether people actually get better. About Limbic Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians. Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomised, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill. The Role As an AI/ML Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of computational psychiatry, clinical science, and software engineering. You will join the product team building our AI therapist: a voice agent that delivers structured, evidence-based CBT over the phone to adults with depression and anxiety, with licensed clinicians overseeing every patient’s care. The product is live and growing week on week, so your work reaches real patients quickly. You will own problems end to end: frame them with clinicians and product managers, ship a change, measure whether it helped, and iterate. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so what you build here is reused across Limbic. What You’ll Do Improve how our AI therapist runs sessions, from session structure and case formulation to therapeutic techniques and continuity across a course of treatment, working closely with clinicians. Strengthen the safety systems that protect patients in real time, including risk detection and how the agent responds when risk is disclosed. Build evaluations and LLM-as-judge autolabellers, validated against clinician labels, so we know quickly and reliably whether a change made care better or worse. Make voice conversations feel natural: responsive, well-paced, and able to recover gracefully when a conversation goes off script. Help patients stay with their treatment long enough to recover, through AI features such as well-timed session reminders and clear expectations about what therapy involves, and test what works with experiments. Optimise how we collect outcome measures such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, including the methods, timing and predictive modelling of recovery. Ship changes safely through incremental rollouts, automated testing and a clinical sign-off process built for a regulated medical device. What You’ll Bring You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds: A PhD in Computational Psychiatry or a related field, coupled with demonstrated industry experience in Data Science, Product, or ML engineering. OR A BSc/MSc in a Computational Psychiatry related field (research focus) plus 2 years of experience in ML engineering or Data Science within an Engineering/Product Development environment. Proficiency in either Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Experience building LLM-powered features and a track record of eval-driven development. An expert approach to hypothesis-driven work, with a track record of balancing product development with scientific rigour. Experience using Machine Learning in a production environment or via high-impact scientific publications (e.g., predictive modelling, reinforcement learning). Experience modelling text/language data, including building LLM classifiers and using vector-based methods. Experience modelling longitudinal data and working with databases (SQL or NoSQL). A strong understanding of evidence-based mental health care (such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) and a deep interest in the causal mechanisms that drive therapeutic benefit. A bias to action: you break big problems into pieces you can ship within a week, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. Proficiency with version control systems, preferably Git. Ideal but not required: Experience building an LLM agent harness or real-time voice AI. The ability to work from our London (Spitalfields) office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the flexibility to work remotely or from the office on other days of the week. Benefits & Wellbeing Competitive salary and equity share options. An amazing office in central London (Spitalfields) for our collaborative team days on Tuesdays and Thursdays, paired with a flexible/hybrid working model on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. 25 days PTO plus bank holidays. Company pension scheme (UK). Enhanced parental leave packages (UK). Support with purchasing work-related books and materials. Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 …

Description Du Poste Au sein de nos équipes Cyber Trust, vous accompagnez nos clients dans la sécurisation de leurs initiatives autour de l'Intelligence Artificielle, de l'IA générative et des modèles de Machine Learning. En tant qu' AI Security Specialist , vous intervenez à la croisée de la cybersécurité, de la gouvernance de l'IA et de l'innovation afin d'identifier, évaluer et maîtriser les risques liés aux systèmes d'IA. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Réaliser des évaluations de sécurité sur des solutions d'IA, d'IA générative et des applications intégrant des LLM ; Identifier les vulnérabilités spécifiques aux systèmes d'IA : prompt injection, data poisoning, model theft, adversarial attacks, fuite d'informations sensibles ou détournement d'usage ; Définir et mettre en œuvre des mesures de sécurité adaptées tout au long du cycle de vie des modèles d'IA ; Accompagner les équipes métiers, data et techniques dans l'adoption sécurisée de l'IA ; Participer à la sécurisation des architectures intégrant des services d'IA cloud et des modèles tiers ; Réaliser des analyses de risques et produire des recommandations de remédiation ; Contribuer à la définition de standards, politiques et bonnes pratiques de sécurité applicables aux usages d'IA ; Accompagner les clients sur les exigences réglementaires émergentes liées à l'IA (AI Act, protection des données, gestion des tiers) ; Animer des ateliers de sensibilisation et de formation autour des enjeux de sécurité de l'IA ; Assurer une veille active sur les menaces, les référentiels et les évolutions technologiques du domaine. Vous interviendrez auprès d'acteurs majeurs de secteurs variés tels que la banque, l'assurance, le luxe, l'industrie ou le secteur public. Qualifications Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur, d'un Master en cybersécurité, data science ou informatique, vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en cybersécurité, sécurité applicative, cloud security ou sécurité des environnements IA. Vous disposez idéalement de compétences sur plusieurs des sujets suivants : Sécurité des applications et des API ; Gouvernance des risques et analyses de risques ; Sécurité cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ; Concepts de Machine Learning et d'IA générative ; Sécurisation des LLM et des frameworks d'IA ; DevSecOps et sécurisation des chaînes CI/CD ; Protection des données et enjeux de confidentialité ; Référentiels de sécurité tels que NIST, ISO 27001 ou OWASP. Une connaissance des référentiels et standards dédiés à l'IA constituera un véritable atout : OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications ; NIST AI Risk Management Framework ; ISO/IEC 42001 ; AI Act européen. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre curiosité, votre esprit d'analyse, votre capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes et votre aptitude à travailler dans des environnements multidisciplinaires. La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel est indispensable. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un suivi de carrière réalisé par un manager tech avec des échanges réguliers ; Des certifications techniques et soft skills en libre accès avec un objectif de 2 certifications minimum par an, des vouchers fournis et du coaching d’experts ; Des partenaires technologiques de choix : Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Snowflake, MuleSoft, Outsystems, SAP, Databricks, Gitlab, … ; Une trajectoire aux possibilités variées via la mobilité interne géographique, fonctionnelle et inter entité / tribu ou squad. items.desc: Är du en utvecklare som gillar att ta idéer hela vägen till färdiga produkter? Vill du kombinera teknisk skicklighet med AI, automation och smarta lösningar som skapar verkligt värde? Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig. Vi söker en driven och nyfiken Software Developer som vill vara med och bygga, förbättra och utveckla våra digitala tjänster. Hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka hur vi arbetar, komma med egna idéer och omsätta visioner till fungerande produkter. Vi tror på att kombinera bra kod med AI för att utveckla snabbare, arbeta smartare och skapa bättre resultat. Om rollen I rollen arbetar du genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från idé och problemlösning till utveckling, testning och produktion. Du vidareutvecklar våra befintliga system och bygger nya lösningar med fokus på kvalitet, användarupplevelse och affärsnytta. Du förväntas inte bara lösa uppgifter som någon annan har definierat. Vi vill att du själv ser vad som kan förbättras, kommer med egna idéer och driver utvecklingen framåt. Det kan handla om allt från att automatisera arbetsflöden och förbättra våra system till att utveckla hemsidor och funktioner som gör det enklare för fler människor att hitta rätt hjälp. AI är en naturlig del av vårt utvecklingsarbete. Vi söker dig som använder AI-verktyg aktivt för att effektivisera utvecklingen, men som också har kunskapen att granska, testa och kvalitetssäkra resultatet. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med Ta idéer från koncept till färdig produkt och produktion. Utveckla och förbättra backend, frontend, databaser och API. Identifiera möjligheter till AI-automation och smartare tekniska lösningar. Vidareutveckla våra hemsidor, system och digitala tjänster. Förbättra konvertering och användarupplevelse genom kontinuerliga förbättringar och A/B-tester. Skriva strukturerad, läsbar, testbar och säker kod. Bidra med egna idéer och tekniska initiativ som skapar bättre resultat. Vi söker dig som Har erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling och god förståelse för objektorienterad programmering. Har erfarenhet av både backend och frontend, gärna med PHP, Vue.js och Nuxt. Har god vana av databaser, API och integrationer. Använder AI-verktyg i din utveckling och vet hur du kvalitetssäkrar det som genereras. Kan ta ansvar för en lösning hela vägen från idé till färdig produkt. Är bra på att identifiera problem, se möjligheter och hitta egna lösningar. Har ett öga för användarupplevelse och förstår att teknik ska bidra till konkreta resultat. Trivs i ett högt tempo där du får stort eget ansvar och samarbetar nära andra. Vi är öppna för olika erfarenhetsnivåer. Det viktigaste är att du är tekniskt skicklig, har ett starkt eget driv och vill fortsätta utvecklas. Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett, men du ska vara nyfiken, våga testa och vilja bygga saker som blir bättre än det vi har idag. Därför kommer du att trivas hos oss Stort utrymme att påverka: Du får komma med egna idéer och vara med och forma våra tekniska lösningar. Från idé till verklighet: Du får följa arbetet hela vägen och se resultatet av det du bygger. Vi är ett företag som växer utan externa investerare och avtal med regionen, vilket bidrar till korta beslutsvägar. AI i praktiken: Du får utforska hur AI och automation kan göra utvecklingen effektivare och våra tjänster bättre. Ansvar och tempo: Vi gillar när saker händer, beslut fattas och bra idéer blir verklighet. Nära samarbete: Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor som delar kunskap, tänker nytt och vill framåt. Om Svea KBT & Elly Care Utan hjälp av externa investerare har vi gått från 5 till över 150 medarbetare och över 20 kliniker runt om i Sverige på fyra år. Det har vi gjort genom att engagera oss i det värde vi skapar: psykisk hälsa. Svea KBT och Elly Care arbetar brett inom psykisk hälsa, från terapi och medicinsk behandling till neuropsykiatriska utredningar, företagshälsa, utbildningar och handledning. Våra psykologer, läkare och sjuksköterskor arbetar sida vid sida med ett verksamhetsteam som ständigt utvecklar och förbättrar verksamheten. Vi gillar tempo, ansvar och utveckling. Här finns stor kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och noll prestige. Vi testar nya idéer, utmanar befintliga arbetssätt och letar alltid efter smartare sätt att nå och hjälpa fler människor. Vi har en spännande resa framför oss och vill att du ska vara med och bygga nästa del av den. Praktisk information Placering: Stockholm Solna, med minst 60 % närvaro på kontoret. Omfattning: Heltid. Start: Enligt överenskommelse. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan!

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Manufacturing Engineering Business Methods Engineer - Data Analytics & Foundations has arisen within Airbus Operations, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the Central Manufacturing Engineering Work Preparation (OMMD) team within the Airbus Production System Efficiency organization. Responsible for Work Preparation processes, methods, tools, and competencies across all Airbus plants, Final Assembly Lines (FALs), and aircraft programs, our department focuses on deploying efficient production solutions to enable industrial excellence and support company profitability.
 The jobholder will reinforce our team by leading transformational digital projects targeting the Manufacturing Engineering Work Preparation community, leveraging Data Analytics, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 Lead digital transformation projects by deploying unified platforms (e.g., MEGA) to streamline end-to-end Preparation Dossier creation (PFMEA, Routing, SOI, Work Order Release) across plants and FALs.
 Define and set the ME Data Analytics Strategy for the department while acting as the Data Custodian and main link to Data Governance teams.
 Drive process automation initiatives through the deployment of RPA, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence solutions within the Work Preparation perimeter.
 Ensure compliance and governance by enforcing Airbus Export Control Regulations through specialized digital tools (e.g., tagging tools) and maintaining data consistency.
 Provide technical expertise and change management to local/transnational teams through digital coaching, communication, and facilitation.
 Support end-to-end data integration across business objects (SOI, BoM, Routing, Drawing) across all aircraft programs and shop floor guidance functions.

 Education: 5-year degree (Master's or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering, IT, or a related engineering field.
 Experience: Hands-on experience in Manufacturing Engineering Work Preparation activities, along with proven project leadership and change management experience.
 Technical knowledge: Expertise in Palantir Foundry (Skywise) or programming, strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence foundations, and deep understanding of ME Work Preparation end-to-end data flows.
 Languages: English at a negotiation level.
 Soft skills: Excellent stakeholder management, strong negotiation and communication skills, ability to work in a transnational environment, and availability to travel.

Location: Bristol, UK 
 Start date: September 2027

 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 
 The Graduate Programme at Graphcore
 Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.
 What you’ll work on
 Put your design skills to work on clearer ways for people to understand complex AI workloads. 
 In Graphcore’s UX team, you’ll help shape software used to understand and optimise workloads running on our hardware. Your work will make technical workflows easier to navigate and turn complex system behaviour into clear user experiences. 
 With support from senior designers, you’ll create wireframes, high-fidelity designs and research materials. You’ll also help run usability studies, analyse findings and maintain our research repository, using what you learn to improve designs. 
 Your team and support 
 The UX team works closely with engineers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle. Design decisions are shaped by user insight, technical constraints and clear evidence. 
 Your manager, Lucy, will work with you to build your skills, make time for learning and shape your career. Her favourite part of leadership is helping talented, driven people turn ideas into action, with the support and space to do their best work. You’ll also have a buddy to help you settle in, alongside a team of experienced designers keen to share what they know and help you develop. 
 Josh recently joined us as a graduate and is confident, he’ll have discovered all the best lunch spots near the office by the time you arrive. He’s looking forward to sharing his favourites with you! 
 You’ll contribute to Decagon, our design library, and help keep research insights useful and easy to find. The work moves from discovery to design, testing and iteration, and you will build confidence and take ownership of defined tasks. 
 You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. We’ll support you to take responsibility for your work and speak up when you spot a problem or need help. Thoughtful discussion and clear communication help us learn from each other and improve our designs. 
 How you’ll learn and grow 
 During the two-year programme, you’ll build skills across user experience (UX), user interface (UI) design, research and design systems through real product work. 
 Creating designs and helping run usability studies will give you practical experience of exploring user needs, testing ideas and turning findings into improvements. Contributing to Decagon will help you understand how a shared design library supports consistent interfaces. 
 Working with senior designers, engineers and product managers will help you explain your design decisions, respond to feedback and understand how user needs and technical constraints shape a product.

 A degree in UX, Interaction Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design or a related discipline 
 UX/UI design experience and a portfolio demonstrating your UX thinking, design process and visual skills 
 Proficiency in design tools such as Figma or Adobe XD 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an interest in designing for complex, technical or business-to-business (B2B) software products 
 Your experience can come from academic or personal projects, internships or placements. In your portfolio, show the problem you explored, how you approached it, the design decisions you made and what you learned.

items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

 - Are fluent in both French and English

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Every model we train runs on infrastructure this role owns. We operate NVIDIA GPU clusters across bare metal and rented capacity, and we're looking for an engineer to join our small research infrastructure team and make that compute fast, reliable, and boring - in the best sense. When the clusters just work, research moves faster. Your impact is measured directly in training throughput and researcher velocity.



This is a builder-operator role with real breadth: one week you're writing automation that eliminates a whole class of manual work, the next you're benchmarking a new provider's InfiniBand fabric or on-site bringing new hardware online. You'll have unusual scope and autonomy - we're a lean team where decisions are made by the people closest to the problem.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Operate and improve our GPU fleet end to end: provisioning, scheduling, monitoring, upgrades, capacity planning

 - Build automation that keeps the fleet healthy without human intervention — node health checks, automated draining and remediation, burn-in pipelines for new capacity

 - Own the stack beneath the training code: OS images, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, NCCL, high-speed networking (InfiniBand/RoCE)

 - Run and tune job scheduling (Slurm or similar) so researchers get compute fairly and fast

 - Build and maintain high-performance storage for datasets and checkpoints

 - Hunt down performance problems: stragglers, degraded links, thermal issues, flaky GPUs — and fix the class of problem, not just the instance

 - Evaluate rented GPU capacity: benchmark it, validate it, hold providers to their SLAs

 - Hands-on hardware work when it's needed: racking, cabling, diagnostics, coordinating with datacenter staff and vendors

 - Keep clusters secure by default: access control, network isolation, secrets




REQUIREMENTS

 - Have run large-scale Linux server or GPU environments in production and enjoy both building and operating

 - Know the NVIDIA stack well — drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM — or have deep systems experience and learn hardware stacks fast

 - Are comfortable with bare-metal environments, server hardware, and high-speed networking

 - Write solid automation in Python and/or Bash, with IaC tools like Ansible or Terraform

 - Are happy digging into noisy data (metrics, …

items.desc: About Mercor Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. Mercor AI Research Fund Grants: Economics of AI One of the biggest challenges facing the industry today is determining whether frontier AI is capable enough to deliver value in real-world settings. A model can perform well on benchmarks and still struggle in production. That’s why investing in research, realistic evaluations, and robust verification is critical. Mercor is seeking to fund AI research on the economic impacts of AI. This is separate from the Mercor Research Fellowship, which funds individual experts (apply HERE), our $5m of safety funding awards (apply HERE), and our funding of benchmarking research. The grant supports: The time of experts from Mercor's platform Researcher hours API costs Stipends for event and conference attendance Budget Categories Applications are grouped into three budget tiers. Please state your tier clearly in your application and ensure your overall budget ask falls within it: Tier 1: under $50,000 : Suited to focused, well-scoped projects such as pilot studies, evaluations, replications, or extensions of existing work. These applications undergo a streamlined review. Tier 2: under $200,000 : Suited to substantial projects requiring dedicated personnel time, meaningful compute, or data collection. Reviewed with proportionally greater attention to the budget breakdown and implementation plan. Tier 3: under $500,000 : Reserved for ambitious, multi-component research programs. These applications receive the highest level of scrutiny: reviewers will expect a detailed justification of each spend category, a clear account of team capacity to execute at this scale, and milestones against which progress can be assessed. The level of review scrutiny scales with the size of the ask, so applicants should request the smallest budget that credibly supports the proposed work. Research Agenda We are interested in submissions in the following area: 1. Measuring AI’s impact on labor How should we measure AI’s effect on real economic and labor outcomes — and what methodologies are up to the task? To what extent do benchmark scores map onto real economic outcomes? What is the right methodology for measuring AI’s impact on labor outcomes (employment, wages, task composition)? How does occupational exposure to AI evolve over time, and how can novel datasets improve its measurement? 2. Human–AI collaboration and productivity How do humans actually work with AI systems, and when does that collaboration make them more productive? What is the efficiency gain of human experts when paired with AI models, and under what conditions? How can we measure the “review cost” that model outputs impose on humans — the time and effort spent checking, correcting, and verifying AI work? Which collaboration patterns improve output quality rather than merely output volume? 3. Enterprise adoption and returns What does AI adoption look like inside organizations, and what returns does it generate? How are organizations actually using AI, and how is that usage changing? How can the effect of AI and agent deployments be measured causally, rather than through self-report or correlation? What are the right enterprise-level variables for quantifying AI-driven productivity gains? Eligibility Researchers at universities and non-profit research organizations, as well as public benefit corporations and small startups (<20 people) that do not sell AI training data. Awards are made to the researcher’s institution. Applicants must be based in the United States or the United Kingdom We expect grantees to publish a paper, an open dataset, a public methodology, or a tool the field can use, released under an open license that permits commercial use. Timeline Application deadline: November 27, 2026, 11:59 PM PT (UTC 8) Notification to applicants: by December 18, 2026 Late or incomplete applications will not be reviewed. All applicants will be notified of the outcome whether or not they are shortlisted. How to apply We invite interested researchers …

items.desc: À propos du poste Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse en modèles fondamentaux pour la robotique incarnée. En intégrant notre équipe de recherche, vous participerez à l’élaboration de modèles innovants visant à améliorer la compréhension et la performance des systèmes robotiques. Ce poste offre une opportunité unique de contribuer à des projets de pointe dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant, où l’innovation et l’excellence scientifique sont au cœur de nos préoccupations. Responsabilités 1. Concevoir et développer des grands modèles multimodaux pour la robotique incarnée, notamment les modèles VLA (Vision-Language-Action), les modèles VLM appliqués à la robotique incarnée (Embodied VLM) et les modèles du monde (World Models / VAWAM), ainsi que des algorithmes d’apprentissage par renforcement et de prise de décision dynamique. Assurer une veille technologique sur les avancées présentées dans les principales conférences scientifiques internationales, proposer des innovations algorithmiques et résoudre les problématiques liées à la généralisation, au fonctionnement en temps réel et au transfert de la simulation vers le monde réel (Sim2Real). Mettre en place des environnements de simulation et des plateformes expérimentales sur robots réels, et favoriser le déploiement des algorithmes dans des applications concrètes telles que la livraison de café par robot, la collaboration homme-robot et les tâches ménagères. Participer à la constitution de jeux de données, à la rédaction de brevets et à la publication d’articles scientifiques, tout en encadrant les membres juniors de l’équipe. Profil recherché : Solides connaissances en apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), apprentissage par renforcement (Reinforcement Learning), grands modèles multimodaux, vision par ordinateur et commande du mouvement. Maîtrise de Python et C++, excellente connaissance de PyTorch, TensorFlow ou JAX, et bonne maîtrise des environnements Linux et de Git. Une expérience en intelligence incarnée (Embodied AI), en modèles VLA (Vision-Language-Action), ou des publications scientifiques et une expérience de projets en robotique présentées lors de conférences internationales de premier plan constituent un atout. Rémunération : à partir de 48 000,00€ par mois Lieu du poste : Télétravail

items.desc: About the position A research engineer (spesialingeniør) position in molecular and cell biology is available in the research group targeted therapies and immunomodulation headed by Prof. Mouldy Sioud, Department of Cancer Immunology, Institute of Cancer Research, Oslo University Hospital-Radiumhospitalet. The research group focuses on the development of new cancer therapeutics such as antibodies, antibody derivatives, and modified mRNA cancer vaccines using in vitro screening platforms and cell and molecular techniques. The position will provide a unique opportunity to pursue basic and translational research with the aim to identify novel targets and strategies for cancer immunotherapy. Further information on the activity of the research group can be accessed at http://ous-research.no/sioud/. To date, the group has published 220 scientific papers, all of which are indexed in PubMed. Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply! Key information Application deadline: 15.11.2026 Employer: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Town/city: Oslo Title: Special Engineer Positions: 1 Full-time/part-time: Full-time Employment type: Contract Percentage of full-time: 100 Webcruiter ID: 5195633177 Start date: 15.01.2027 End date: 14.01.2028 Social sharing : Share on x Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook Share by email Position Description The successful candidate will work closely with the group leader and other team members to design and conduct a range of in vitro and in vivo experiments, analyse experimental data, and contribute to scientific publications. The main aim is to identify cell-surface receptors involved in antibody binding to cancer cells and enhance the efficacy of mRNA-based cancer vaccines through mRNA modifications The position is available for one year with the possibility for extension based on the candidate performance. Requirements Master's degree in molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, immunology, or a related field Practical experience in molecular and cellular biology, including cell culture, transfection, cloning, and protein analysis Experience with flow cytometry, immunoprecipitation, tagged protein purification, and/ or immunological techniques is highly desirable Good communication skills in English and the ability to work independently and collaboratively How to apply Only applications received through webcruiter will be considered and should include A brief cover letter describing your research experience, relevant technical expertise, and motivation for applying A CV outlining relevant education, research experience, and technical skills Contact details for two references We offer A varied and exciting work in an environment in the intersection between research and industry, developing novel cancer treatments A productive and motivating research environment Attractive welfare benefits Salary according to the OUS salary scale Address: Oslo universitetssykehus HF, Radiumhospitalet, Ullernchausseen 70, 0379 Oslo, Norway Open directions (in new tab) Contacts Mouldi Sioud Enhetsleder Email: mouldi.sioud@ous-research.no About the employer Oslo University Hospital is a highly specialized hospital in charge of extensive regional and local hospital assignments. As Scandinavia’s largest hospital, we carry out more than 1.2 million patient treatments each year. The hospital has a nationwide responsibility for a number of national and multi-regional assignments, and has several national centers of competence. Oslo University Hospital is responsible for approximately 50 percent of all medical and health care research conducted at Norwegian hospitals, and is a significant role player within the education of a large variety of health care personnel.

items.card: The role offers flexible hybrid work in Estonia, a competitive salary and employee options. Interested? Apply here: info@soundfr.ee #Hiring #MachineLearning #Accessibility #Estonia
items.desc: We’re hiring an AI/ML Engineer to join Soundfr team in Estonia. Soundfr helps hard of hearing stay aware of important sounds at home. Users record sounds such as their doorbell, home appliances or a baby crying to train the their own sound recognition model, then receive an alert when any of those sounds is detected. We are also providing them communication tools like speech to text and many more in the future. You’ll work directly with our CTO to improve how Soundfr recognises everyday sounds in people’s homes. You’ll develop pipelines for training personalised models from user recordings, improve how we evaluate detection performance, and deploy efficient models to our connected microphone and mobile devices. A key challenge is making detection reliable with limited training data, background noise and varying recording conditions. We’re looking for an ML engineer with strong Python skills and practical experience taking models from data preparation through training, evaluation and deployment. Experience with audio ML, signal processing, learning from small datasets or running models on resource-constrained devices would be a strong advantage. The role offers flexible hybrid work in Estonia, a competitive salary and employee options. Interested? Apply here: info@soundfr.ee #Hiring #MachineLearning #Accessibility #Estonia

Nous intervenons auprès de grands comptes industriels sur des projets associant développement logiciel, intelligence artificielle, automatisation et transformation numérique. Nos consultants contribuent à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions technologiques répondant à des enjeux concrets de production, de qualité et de performance industrielle. Nous privilégions la proximité, la qualité des missions et l'accompagnement individuel de nos collaborateurs. L'innovation, le partage des connaissances et le développement des compétences sont au cœur de notre démarche. Description Du Poste Vous êtes ingénieur(e) et souhaitez mettre vos compétences en développement C#, vision industrielle et intelligence artificielle au service d'applications concrètes dans l'industrie ? Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Vision Industrielle & IA (H/F) pour participer au développement et à l'amélioration d'un système automatisé de détection et de caractérisation de défauts sur des produits industriels. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de vision, depuis le pilotage des caméras et l'acquisition des images jusqu'à leur analyse par des modèles d'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission s'articulera autour de trois domaines complémentaires : 🔹 Développement C# et pilotage des systèmes de vision Développer et faire évoluer les applications en C# permettant le pilotage de caméras industrielles motorisées. Participer à l'intégration des équipements de vision dans les applications existantes. Contribuer à l'automatisation des séquences d'acquisition d'images. Assurer la fiabilité et l'évolution des outils logiciels associés aux systèmes de vision. 🔹 Acquisition et qualité des images Comprendre les procédés industriels et les différentes typologies de défauts à détecter. Déterminer les images pertinentes à acquérir et les moments optimaux de capture. Participer à l'amélioration de la qualité et de l'exploitabilité des images. Collaborer avec les experts métier pour identifier les caractéristiques visuelles des défauts. Constituer, qualifier et annoter les jeux de données nécessaires à l'entraînement des modèles d'IA. Définir et appliquer les règles garantissant la qualité et la traçabilité des annotations. 🔹 Vision par ordinateur et intelligence artificielle Participer à l'amélioration des modèles de vision par ordinateur existants. Concevoir, développer et entraîner de nouveaux modèles de détection et de classification de défauts. Évaluer les performances des modèles et identifier les axes d'optimisation. Contribuer à l'intégration des modèles d'IA dans les applications industrielles. Assurer le suivi des performances en conditions réelles de production. Participer à l'amélioration continue des solutions de contrôle qualité automatisé. Environnement technique Développement : C#, Python Vision industrielle : caméras industrielles motorisées, acquisition d'images, optique Traitement d'images : Computer Vision, traitement du signal, OpenCV Intelligence artificielle : Machine Learning, modèles de détection et de classification d'images Industrialisation : intégration applicative, suivi des performances, notions de MLOps Qualifications 🎓 Formation Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation Bac+5 à dominante industrielle, informatique industrielle, traitement d'images ou systèmes embarqués. 💼 Expérience Vous justifiez d'une première expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, idéalement en C#, hors stage et alternance. Vous disposez de connaissances ou d'une expérience pratique en vision industrielle, acquisition d'images ou traitement d'images. Une expérience dans un environnement industriel (production, qualité, maintenance, sidérurgie ou procédés continus) constitue un véritable atout. 🔥 Compétences clés Développement C# : capacité à développer et maintenir des applications interagissant avec des équipements industriels. Soron Systems is building the navigation brain for autonomous drones that operate where GPS can't be trusted: contested airspace, indoor environments, and GPS denied zones. Born out of cutting edge research at TU Dresden, we've already flown our system under active jamming conditions and proven it works. Now we're going from prototype to product, and we need exceptional engineers to make it happen. This is a rare chance to join at the ground floor of a deep tech startup solving one of the hardest problems in autonomous systems. You'll write code that flies (literally) and see it tested on real hardware within days, not quarters. If you're excited by computer vision, robotics, and building things that matter, keep reading. You'll work directly with the three co-founders, Justus Rischke, Christian Vielhaus, and Johannes Hofer, all from TU Dresden's Deutsche Telekom Chair of Communication Networks. items.desc: Vill du bidra till att förbättra människors hälsa? Institutionen för klinisk forskning och utbildning, Södersjukhuset (KI SÖS) är en institution som kännetecknas av medicinsk forskning nära integrerad med den kliniska vardagen. Vår placering vid ett av Stockholms stora akutsjukhus ger möjlighet att undersöka kliniskt relevanta frågeställningar genom samarbete mellan forskare och hälso- och sjukvårdspersonal. Institutionen söker nu en statistiker som kommer att arbeta i Gianluigi Savareses forskargrupp. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en tvärvetenskaplig akademisk miljö, utveckla din kompetens och bidra till forskning som kan förbättra vården. Din roll Som statistiker kommer du att tillhöra forskargruppen för hjärtsvikt och arytmi. Gruppen fokuserar på hjärtsvikt, arytmier och relaterade hjärt-kärlsjukdomar. Vi använder stora kliniska register, länkade nationella hälsodataregister, elektroniska patientjournaler och kliniska prövningar för patientutfall, behandlingseffektivitet, implementering av evidensbaserad vård och sjukdomarnas epidemiologi. I nära samarbete med kliniska forskare, doktorander och internationella samarbetspartners kommer du bidra till hela forskningsprocessen, från studiedesign till vetenskaplig publicering. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bestå av att: Utveckla studiedesigner och statistiska analysplaner i samarbete med forskargruppen. Ansöka om tillgång till data från kvalitetsregister och administrativa register. Bearbeta, hantera och validera stora datamängder, inklusive data från det svenska hjärtsviktsregistret (RiksSvikt/SwedeHF) länkade till andra nationella register. Självständigt genomföra statistiska analyser, inklusive överlevnadsanalys, longitudinell modellering, analys av konkurrerande risker, propensity score-metoder, metoder för hantering av saknade data, maskinlärning och AI samt emulering av kliniska prövningar med metoden clone-censor-weight. Bidra till vetenskapliga manuskript och forskningsansökningar. Ge statistisk vägledning och stöd till doktorander och andra forskare samt säkerställa väldokumenterade och reproducerbara analysflöden. Fungera som kontaktperson mellan forskargruppen och KI:s IT-avdelning för att samordna hantering och lösning av IT-frågor som rör forskningsservrar, virtuella maskiner och tillhörande IT-infrastruktur. Delta i forskargruppens samtliga aktiviteter. Andra arbetsuppgifter kan tillkomma beroende på forskargruppens utveckling och din kompetens. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen i statistik, biostatistik, epidemiologi eller ett närliggande kvantitativt ämnesområde. Du har omfattande och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ansöka om tillgång till data från kvalitetsregister och administrativa register samt av att extrahera, hantera och analysera stora registerdatamängder och data från elektroniska patientjournaler. Din kompetens omfattar farmakoepidemiologi, studier av behandlingseffektivitet och säkerhet, överlevnadsanalys, longitudinella analyser samt tillämpning av maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens. God förståelse för det svenska hälso- och sjukvårdssystemet krävs för att kunna tolka extraherade data korrekt. Vidare har du goda kunskaper i både R och Stata. Som person är du strukturerad, noggrann och har förmåga att arbeta självständigt. Du tycker om att dela med dig av din kompetens och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt ge vägledning och stöd till doktorander och andra forskare. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga, är flexibel och har förmåga att anpassa dig till varierande behov och prioriteringar i en stor internationell forskargrupp. Vad erbjuder vi? En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Vår vision är att driva utvecklingen av kunskap om livet och verka för en bättre hälsa för alla. Här bedriver vi framgångsrik medicinsk forskning och har det största utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. Som universitet är Karolinska Institutet en statlig myndighet. Det gör att du får goda förmåner genom vårt kollektivavtal. Medarbetare på KI erbjuds också möjlighet till ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Det innebär att om den verksamhet du jobbar i tillåter, så kan du arbeta en del av din arbetstid på distans. Du får även träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar där utbildad personal finns på plats. Placering: SÖS Hjärtsvikt och arytmi - Gianluigi Savareses forskargrupp Tio skäl att välja Karolinska Institutet Ansökan Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast den 10 november 2026. KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T. Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV utan personligt brev. I ansökningsformuläret kommer du istället att få svara på några frågor om varför du söker jobbet. Vid tillsvidareanställning tillämpar Karolinska Institutet 6 månaders provanställning. Vill du göra skillnad – och bidra till en …

items.desc: Functie inhoud Als research software engineer ontwikkel en onderhoud je software die onderzoeksdata toegankelijk, bruikbaar en uitwisselbaar maakt voor onderzoekers binnen het Erasmus MC. Je werkt aan technische oplossingen die data uit verschillende bronnen ontsluiten, transformeren en beschikbaar maken voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek. Je vertaalt functionele en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare software-oplossingen en draagt bij aan een moderne data-architectuur voor onderzoek. Daarbij werk je met standaarden zoals FHIR, OMOP en FAIR-principes om data duurzaam en herbruikbaar beschikbaar te stellen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige levenscyclus van de oplossingen die je ontwikkelt: van analyse, ontwerp, ontwikkeling en testen tot deployment, beheer en doorontwikkeling. Ook onderhoud en verbeter je CI/CD-pipelines, bewaak je de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van de dienstverlening en zorg je ervoor dat oplossingen beheersbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn. Je denkt mee over de inrichting van dataflows, automatisering en integratie van databronnen. Daarbij heb je regelmatig contact met onderzoekers en andere eindgebruikers. Je inventariseert behoeften, biedt ondersteuning bij technische en functionele vraagstukken en helpt bij het oplossen van verstoringen. Binnen een klein en hecht team van software engineers werk je samen aan mooie resultaten. In je dagelijkse werkzaamheden heb je veel contact met collega's van het Data Engineering team en collega's van Research Support. Samen werk je aan oplossingen die de onderzoek omgeving van het Erasmus MC versterken. De focus van de functie ligt op ontwikkeling. Daarnaast vervul je een rol als achtervang voor supportcollega's wanneer onderzoekers behoefte hebben aan advies over maatwerkscripts of technische ondersteuning bij het optimaliseren van hun dataflow. Je helpt dan bij het ontwerpen of ontwikkelen van praktische oplossingen die aansluiten op bestaande voorzieningen en standaarden. Je volgt de ontwikkelingen binnen software engineering, datamanagement en (landelijke) onderzoeksinfrastructuren op de voet en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van de technische dienstverlening voor onderzoek.

items.desc: About Translated Translated is a leading provider of AI-powered language solutions. Founded in 1999 by a linguist and a computer scientist, we are on a mission to allow everyone to understand and be understood in their own language. We envision a world where people from different cultures can communicate seamlessly, gaining unprecedented access to knowledge, cultural exchange, and opportunity. To make this possible, we combine proprietary translation AI (Lara Translate) with advanced text, audio, and video translation technologies (Matecat, Matesub, and Matedub) and the world’s largest network of vetted, native-speaking language professionals. We welcome complex technical challenges from our customers and engineer tailored solutions that often become part of our core products, whether integrated into our enterprise localization platform, the tools designed to support translators, or Lara Translate, our online AI translator for teams and individuals. Everything we build reflects a simple principle: technology should amplify human potential, not replace it. We believe in humans. We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Scientist to work closely with our customers, product teams, and leadership, transforming complex business challenges into data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with business acumen and the ability to work directly with stakeholders. You will investigate customer and product data, develop analyses and models, and help deploy solutions that generate measurable business impact. The Role: Forward Deployed Data Science Forward Deployed Data Scientists operate at the intersection of data science, product, engineering, and customer success. You will collaborate directly with Translated’s enterprise customers and internal teams to understand their objectives, investigate their data, identify opportunities, and develop solutions tailored to their operational needs. These solutions may include analytical models, forecasting systems, performance metrics, experiments, dashboards, and data products. Rather than working only on predefined datasets or isolated research questions, you will follow projects through their complete lifecycle: from problem definition and data discovery to implementation, validation, deployment, and communication of results. You will gradually develop a deep understanding of Translated’s business, products, and technology, working across areas such as translation quality, operational efficiency, customer behavior, demand forecasting, marketing performance, and financial outcomes. Successful projects may become reusable capabilities integrated into Translated’s products, enterprise platform, or internal decision-making systems. Responsibilities Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into well-defined data problems. Identify, access, and evaluate relevant internal and external data sources. Conduct initial data investigations and exploratory data analysis. Develop metrics, statistical analyses, machine learning models, and other data-driven solutions. Design experiments and measurement frameworks to evaluate product and business initiatives. Analyze customer behavior, operational performance, translation quality, revenue, costs, and other key business indicators. Build prototypes and collaborate with engineering teams to turn successful analyses into reliable production solutions. Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that make complex findings accessible and actionable. Present recommendations and results clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and customers. Define success criteria, measure outcomes, and continuously improve deployed solutions. Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, AI researchers, sales teams, and customer-facing teams. Help develop reusable analytical methods, tools, and best practices across the company. Stay informed about developments in data science, machine learning, analytics, and applied AI. Requirements 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Applied Machine Learning, or a related quantitative role. Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, and experimental design. Excellent programming skills in Python. Strong experience with SQL and working with large, complex datasets. Experience with data exploration, statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation. Ability to transform ambiguous business questions into structured, measurable analytical problems. Experience defining business and product metrics and using data to support decision-making. Familiarity with modern data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytical workflows.
