mimic robotics is a frontier physical AI company building the full stack of general-purpose dexterous manipulation. Founded in 2024 by ETH Zurich researchers, mimic pioneered Video-Action Models for robotics while also developing in-house dexterous hand hardware. Our growing team brings together world-class researchers working across our offices in Zurich and San Francisco.
 As a Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer , you will bring mimic's AI capabilities to new robotic platforms and customer environments. You will work directly with robotics customers to integrate our models, optimize their software and robotics stack, and drive the technical changes required for successful deployment. 
 Working across AI, robotics, and software, you will own technical integrations from initial planning through deployment. You will also help build scalable tooling and workflows that make our AI capabilities easier to deploy, monitor, and improve across different robotic platforms 
 Responsibilities 
 Integrate and deploy mimic's AI models on different robotic platforms and hardware stacks
 Adapt our software, training, and deployment stack to new robots, sensors, and environments
 Work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate and optimize their robotics stack
 Diagnose AI, software, and robotics integration issues and drive them to resolution
 Build scalable tooling and workflows for deploying, monitoring, and improving our models
 Define technical requirements and implement features that improve model productization
 Own deployment planning and execution, coordinating across customers and internal teams
 Translate deployment learnings into improvements for our AI, robotics, and product stack
 Track deployment performance and communicate progress and technical risks to stakeholders
 Requirements 
 Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
 Strong robotics background and a very good understanding of physical AI and robotics systems
 Excellent software engineering skills, with the ability to design, implement, and test robust solutions
 Strong Python skills and experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch
 Experience deploying AI/ML systems on real robotic hardware
 Good understanding of AI training methods, data pipelines, and model evaluation
 Ability to build repeatable and scalable solutions rather than one-off integrations
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across AI, software, and robotics
 Strong ownership and ability to independently plan and execute technical deployments
 Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with technical customers
 Fluent English
 Willingness to travel for customer deployments and technical workshops
 Driving Licence (B)
 Nice to have 
 Familiarity with modern robot learning approaches (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, diffusion policies, foundation models)
 Experience with robotic manipulation, ROS/ROS2, robot control systems, or simulation environments
 Experience integrating AI models with robotic hardware platforms
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerization, and deployment tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
 Compensation & Benefits 
 We offer a total compensation package including a competitive yearly base salary and a strong stock option package to make you part of our shared success. 
 You will have the opportunity to shape a robotics & AI company from the ground up . In flat hierarchies you will work directly with the founders and some of the best talents in the robotics space. At mimic, you are accepted for who you are.  Join our Team

• Candidates who are willing to take initiative, challenge themselves, and make a positive impact
• Good proficiency in English, both verbal and written

• Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for further assessment

items.desc:
DISCOVER PIRELLI 
We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! 
 WHY JOIN US 
We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with: 
 • International, engaging, and supportive working environment.
• Global onboarding process.
• Bespoke training and development programs accessible to all.
• Competitive welfare and benefits package.
• International mobility opportunities.
 DRIVE YOUR FUTURE 
The Cyber Tyre Algorithms Engineer will contribute to the development of innovative algorithms that transform the Smart Tyre vision into real-world automotive solutions. The mission is to enable new vehicle functionalities that enhance safety, driving performance, and the overall driving experience.
The role combines algorithm development, experimental validation, and hands-on engineering. You will have the opportunity to explore new ideas, develop working prototypes, and validate innovative solutions directly on vehicles, supporting the entire development process from concept generation to real-world implementation.
 YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES 
• Develop and validate innovative estimation and control algorithms for Smart Tyre and vehicle applications. 
• Design, implement, and test prototypes using embedded systems and rapid prototyping platforms. 
• Perform experimental activities, including vehicle testing, data acquisition, and track validation. 
• Analyze vehicle data and simulation results to improve algorithm performance and robustness. 
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to bring new functionalities from concept to real-world implementation. 
• Explore innovative technologies and approaches to continuously enhance Smart Tyre solutions.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
• Master’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or equivalent disciplines. 
• 2-3 years of experience in Vehicle Dynamics, Vehicle Control Systems, State Estimation, ADAS, or related automotive fields. 
• Strong knowledge of vehicle dynamics and experience in estimation and control-oriented algorithm development. 
• Good programming skills in MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C/C++, or similar environments. 
• Experience in experimental data analysis, algorithm validation, vehicle testing, and simulation environments. 
• Good proficiency in English.
 WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION 
• Experience with embedded systems, rapid prototyping platforms, and hands-on engineering projects. 
• Familiarity with machine learning techniques, cloud-based data analysis environments, or tyre-related applications. 
• Strong creativity, engineering curiosity, and passion for experimentation. 
• Pragmatic problem-solving attitude with the ability to transform ideas into validated solutions. 
• Strong ownership and ability to effectively collaborate within multidisciplinary teams.
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
• The employment contract will be regulated by “Gomma Plastica” National Collective Bargaining Agreement.
• The gross annual base salary (RAL) offered will be no less than €32.000.
• The Company is committed to offering a competitive compensation package and, following the selection process, may propose a final gross annual base salary above the stated level, commensurate with the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications.
• The position’s compensation package also includes a variable component and a competitive welfare and benefits offer. Further details will be provided at a later stage and will be subject to the applicable Company policies.
 APPLY NOW, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE! 
 #WePirelli 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and this search is open to all individuals, in compliance with the principles of equal opportunity and non-discrimination, pursuant to applicable laws and regulations.

items.desc: Voorstelling dienst: Intelligence Georganiseerde criminaliteit is slim, snel en meedogenloos. Wie daartegen wil optreden, moet minstens even scherp staan. Bij de Federale Gerechtelijke Politie West-Vlaanderen is intelligence één van onze krachtigste wapens. Binnen de cluster Intelligence bouwen we elke dag aan een helder en betrouwbaar beeld van de criminaliteit: wie speelt welke rol, waar lopen geldstromen, welke patronen tekenen zich af? Dat doen we door enorme hoeveelheden data te verzamelen, te verrijken en te analyseren — met behulp van innovatieve technologieën en zelfontwikkelde tools. Onze intelligence-specialisten zijn pioniers. Ze vertalen ruwe data naar inzichten die onderzoekers helpen om sneller, gerichter en veiliger te werken. Zo dragen ze rechtstreeks bij aan de bestrijding van zware en georganiseerde criminaliteit. Functieomschrijving Criminele netwerken laten vandaag overal digitale sporen na: banktransacties, telefoniegegevens, logistieke data, open bronnen, handelsstromen… Die informatie is goud waard — als je ze tenminste kan structureren, koppelen en analyseren. Als Machine Learning Engineer/data scientist versterk jij de capaciteit van FGP West-Vlaanderen om dat te doen. Je werkt samen met analisten en onderzoekers. Je ontwikkelt en implementeert tools die grote hoeveelheden data automatisch verwerken en doorzoekbaar maken. Je helpt complexe datasets structureren zodat onderzoekers er meteen mee aan de slag kunnen. Je bouwt mee aan oplossingen die geldstromen reconstrueren, netwerken blootleggen en patronen of anomalieën detecteren. Je vertaalt analytische modellen naar robuuste en gebruiksvriendelijke toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat ontwikkelde oplossingen schaalbaar, onderhoudbaar en betrouwbaar blijven. Dankzij jouw werk worden hypotheses niet alleen vermoed, maar onderbouwd met objectieve data-inzichten. Je werkt mee aan dossiers en projecten met maatschappelijke impact — jouw code maakt écht een verschil. Kortom: jij maakt van data operationele intelligence. Gewenst profiel Je houdt ervan om complexe problemen te ontleden en op te lossen. Je denkt analytisch, maar verliest de praktijk nooit uit het oog. Je werkt graag samen en communiceert vlot met zowel technische profielen als eindgebruikers. Je hebt een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en denkt data-driven. Je kan helder communiceren en overlegt vlot met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Je hecht veel belang aan datakwaliteit, nauwkeurigheid en betrouwbaarheid. Je ziet automatisering en schaalbaarheid niet als extra’s, maar als basisprincipes. Je deelt je kennis graag en draagt actief bij aan een positieve teamsfeer. Specifieke vaardigheden Minstens 4 jaar relevante ervaring in data science of machine learning engineering. Grondige kennis van Python voor data-analyse en automatisering. Ervaring met ML Ops en infrastructuur (zoals Git, MLflow; ervaring met Kubernetes of Kubeflow is een plus). Kennis van datamodellering en het optimaliseren van complexe queries is een meerwaarde. Ervaring met relationele en niet-relationele databanken (SQL & NoSQL), zoals PostgreSQL, MySQL, Neo4j, Elastic DB… Talenkennis: je beheerst het Nederlands en kan vlot werken in het Engels. Opmerkingen Je komt terecht in een innovatieve werkomgeving waar leren, experimenteren en verbeteren centraal staan. Toelatingsvoorwaarden Minstens 4 jaar relevante ervaring Je beschikt over een masterdiploma ICT of een gelijkgestelde opleiding (Twijfel? Neem gerust contact op). items.desc: Vi søger en data scientist med stor erfaring i at udføre sundhedsøkonomiske analyser ved Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi, Institut for Sundhedstjenesteforskning , Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet , Syddansk Universitet , med tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027. Der er tale om en 2-årig ansættelse. Stillingen udgør 75% (27,75 timer per uge). Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi (DaCHE) er nordens største center for sundhedsøkonomisk forskning og undervisning. DaCHE bygger på mere end 25 års erfaring med at designe og gennemføre sundhedsøkonomiske forskningsprojekter og analyser med stærk faglig forankring og høj samfundsrelevans. Centeret har en stærk international profil, og samarbejder tæt med både kliniske forskningsmiljøer og sundhedspolitiske myndigheder. Vi er ca. 40 forskere, data scientists og data managers, der arbejder for at skabe innovativ forskning og stærk evidens, som kan understøtte styring og prioritering i sundhedsvæsenet. Vores forskning spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet analyser af sundhedsrelateret adfærd, præferencer og incitamenter, evaluering af nye sundhedspolitiske initiativer samt sundhedsøkonomiske vurderinger af nye interventioner. Vi er meget empirisk drevne og anvender en bred vifte af metoder, herunder registerbaserede analyser, spørgeskemaundersøgelser, økonomiske evalueringer og præferencemålinger. Vi arbejder ofte med store og komplekse datasæt, der kombinerer register- og spørgeskemadata, og vi lægger stor vægt på metodisk kvalitet og samfundsmæssig relevans. Ansvarsområder Behandle store datamængder og foretage opdateringer Designe spørgeskemaer Ansvarlig for at linke data og udføre økonometriske analyser Foretage økonometriske analyse med henblik på at afdække kausale forhold Udarbejdelse af statistiske analyser Samarbejde med forskere, klinikere og myndigheder om forskningsprojekter med sundhedspolitisk relevans Kvalifikationer Har en relevant kandidatgrad inden for økonomi, sundhedsøkonomi, data science, statistik, matematik, folkesundhedsvidenskab eller et beslægtet fagområde. En ph.d.-grad vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav Har erfaring med forskningsresultater og kan understøtte forskere i forbindelse med publicering af forskningsresultater i anerkendte fagfællebedømte tidsskrifter Der vil blive lagt vægt på kendskab til og erfaring med økonometriske analyser af registerdata Der vil endvidere blive lagt vægt på erfaring med design af spørgeskemaer Kontakt Ønsker du yderligere information om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte professor Dorte Gyrd-Hansen, dgh@sdu.dk . Ansøgningsproces Ansøgningsfristen er den 8. november 2026 kl. 23:59. Ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Dit tjenestested er Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi, Institut for Sundhedstjenesteforskning, Syddansk Universitet i Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M. Ansættelse finder sted i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og AC. Løn fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst og på baggrund af objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, herunder stillingens indhold, ansvar og krav til kvalifikationer. Du har som ansøger ret til information om startløn og lønspænd for stillingen. Disse oplysninger kan fås i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen. SDU indhenter ikke oplysninger om ansøgers tidligere løn. Er du interesseret i stillingen, skal du sende en ansøgning, som skal indeholde følgebrev, CV med angivelse af måneder og år (uden billede) og eksamensbevis. Alle dokumenter i forbindelse med ansøgning bør ikke indeholde billede og CPR-nummer – i så fald skal CPR-nummer overstreges. Alle vedhæftede filer skal være i Adobe PDF-format. Følgebrev og CV må max. fylde 5 Mb. Vejledning i forbindelse med ansøgning findes her . Om Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet (SUND) ved Syddansk Universitet er et af Danmarks førende sundhedsvidenskabelige fakulteter. Med ni institutter, forskning i international topklasse og et bredt udvalg af sundhedsuddannelser bidrager vi til at udvikle fremtidens viden, behandling og sundhedsvæsen. Som medarbejder på SUND bliver du en del af et ambitiøst og tværfagligt miljø præget af høj faglighed, stærke samarbejder og gode muligheder for udvikling. Fakultetet har aktiviteter i Odense, Esbjerg og København. I Esbjerg og København danner stærke faglige miljøer ramme om forskning og uddannelse, mens vores moderne fakultetsbygning i Odense samler forskning, uddannelse og administration under ét tag og er direkte forbundet med Odense Universitetshospital. Læs mere om Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet her . Om SDU Syddansk Universitet er sat i verden for skabe værdi for og med samfundet. Uanset om vores bidrag kommer i form af fremragende forskning, innovative løsninger, uddannelse eller læring, så skal vi gøre en positiv forskel for samfundet og bidrage til en bæredygtig fremtid. items.desc: Kalray est une entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les semi-conducteurs et le calcul haute performance au service de l’intelligence artificielle. Forte de plus de quinze ans d’expertise en architectures de calcul parallèle, en conception de processeurs et en systèmes de calcul haute performance, Kalray est une entreprise technologique française et un acteur européen de premier plan dans des domaines devenus essentiels aux infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle. Avec plus de 120 collaborateurs en France et en Roumanie, Kalray développe et licencie des technologies matérielles et logicielles stratégiques pour les nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs dédiées aux infrastructures d’IA et, plus largement, aux applications nécessitant le traitement de volumes massifs de données. Ces technologies permettent de traiter, de faire circuler et d’orchestrer efficacement les données entre les différentes ressources de calcul, afin d’optimiser les performances, la consommation énergétique et la sécurité. Kalray accompagne ses clients à travers la concession de licences sur ses technologies matérielles et logicielles (IP), complétée par des projets de développement sur mesure. De la définition d’architectures complexes jusqu’à leur intégration dans de nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs, Kalray associe ses technologies propriétaires à une solide expertise des systèmes, de la conception des puces en silicium et du développement de systèmes complets. Rejoindre Kalray, c’est intégrer une entreprise technologique européenne pionnière, qui conçoit des solutions innovantes à la croisée des semi-conducteurs, de l’intelligence artificielle et du calcul haute performance. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’ingénieurs et d’experts technologiques reconnus, sur des projets de pointe qui contribuent à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’IA. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant, collaboratif et inclusif, où les professionnels expérimentés comme les nouveaux talents peuvent développer leurs compétences, évoluer et contribuer concrètement à des projets ambitieux. Le tout dans un cadre de vie privilégié, au cœur des paysages inspirants des Alpes ou de la Côte d’Azur. Envie de contribuer avec nous à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle ? Rejoignez l’aventure Kalray ! Kalray est cotée sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKAL). Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre site internet et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn. Rejoignez l’équipe IA de Kalray, à la pointe de l’innovation, pour développer des solutions d’IA autonomes dédiées à la conception de puces de bout en bout, depuis la définition des exigences initiales et l’exploration architecturale jusqu’à la génération du RTL, à la vérification et à l’implémentation physique. Notre ambition est de repenser la manière dont les puces sont conçues en développant des systèmes agentiques capables de planifier des activités d’ingénierie complexes, de coordonner les outils de conception et d’itérer sur les résultats en s’appuyant sur des mécanismes de validation fiables. Cette approche doit ouvrir une nouvelle ère pour les architectures de puces, en permettant d’explorer des possibilités de conception difficiles à envisager avec les méthodes conventionnelles. Vous contribuerez directement à cette ambition en développant des solutions combinant des grands modèles de langage (LLM) de dernière génération, des agents d’IA et des outils de conception de semi-conducteurs. Dans un premier temps, vos travaux associeront une collaboration étroite avec les ingénieurs de Kalray, un accompagnement opérationnel à l’adoption de l’IA et le développement de prototypes fonctionnels. À mesure que vous vous familiariserez avec nos pratiques d’ingénierie et nos contraintes de conception, vous évoluerez vers le développement de processus autonomes de plus en plus ambitieux, avec pour objectif de transformer les premières expérimentations en solutions robustes capables de prendre en charge des projets complets de conception de puces. Vos principales responsabilités : Appliquer l’IA à des problématiques concrètes de nos activités techniques, développer des processus de travail efficaces et partager les approches qui ont fait leurs preuves. Concevoir des prototypes d’agents capables de planifier des tâches, d’utiliser des outils d’ingénierie, d’évaluer les résultats et d’itérer pour atteindre un objectif de conception défini. Explorer des processus couvrant l’exploration architecturale, la génération du RTL, la vérification et l’implémentation, en collaboration avec les experts en conception de puces. Connecter les modèles et les agents aux outils de conception via des API, des interfaces en ligne de commande et des scripts. Évaluer le degré d’autonomie, la fiabilité, la qualité de conception et l’efficacité des solutions développées par rapport aux processus d’ingénierie existants. items.desc: À propos de FGAS FGAS est une société à taille humaine (35 salariés), partenaire de l’État et des établissements de crédit dans le cadre du financement de l’accession sociale à la propriété et de la rénovation des logements. Elle assure notamment la gestion et le suivi de dispositifs publics liés à la distribution de prêts réglementés tels que le Prêt à taux zéro (PTZ), l’Eco-PTZ, les prêts à l’accession sociale garantis par l’État et l’épargne logement. Votre mission Le poste proposé fait partie du service Statistiques-Process-Analyse-Données (SPAD), chargé de la production, régulière ou ponctuelle, de statistiques, de bilans et d’études économiques et financières. items.desc: Ben jij geduldig, klantgericht en heb je affiniteit met techniek? Vind je het belangrijk om mensen op een rustige en duidelijke manier te helpen? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou. Voor onze Low Vision hulpmiddelen zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste buitendienstmedewerker. In deze functie ben jij het gezicht van Van Lent Systems bij onze klanten thuis. Je reist door heel Nederland om hulpmiddelen af te leveren, te installeren, uit te leggen en waar nodig te repareren. Onze hulpmiddelen helpen mensen met een visuele beperking om zelfstandiger te leven. Denk aan het kunnen lezen van een krant of boek, het bekijken van foto’s, het uitoefenen van hobby’s of het werken met een computer. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de klant het hulpmiddel goed begrijpt en met vertrouwen kan gebruiken. Je hoeft nog niet alles van onze producten te weten. Wij zorgen voor een uitgebreide producttraining én een technische training, zodat je precies weet hoe onze hulpmiddelen werken en hoe je kleine reparaties zelfstandig kunt uitvoeren. Wat ga je doen? Als buitendienstmedewerker ben je veel onderweg en kom je bij klanten in heel Nederland. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het afleveren en installeren van Low Vision hulpmiddelen Het geven van duidelijke uitleg en instructie aan klanten Het uitvoeren van kleine reparaties aan beeldschermloepen en andere hulpmiddelen Het ophalen van hulpmiddelen bij klanten Wie ben jij? Jij bent iemand die graag zelfstandig werkt, maar ook goed communiceert met klanten en collega’s. Je vindt het belangrijk om mensen op een rustige, duidelijke en geduldige manier te helpen. Veel van onze klanten hebben extra uitleg of begeleiding nodig bij het gebruik van hun hulpmiddel. Daarom neem jij de tijd, luister je goed en zorg je ervoor dat de klant zich begrepen en op zijn gemak voelt. Daarnaast vragen wij: Minimaal MBO 4 werk- en denkniveau Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Een klantgerichte, vriendelijke en geduldige houding Affiniteit met techniek of technisch inzicht Een representatieve uitstraling Flexibiliteit; geen 9-tot-17-mentaliteit Rijbewijs B Wat bieden wij jou? Je krijgt een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is. Je bent veel onderweg, ontmoet verschillende mensen en werkt met producten die een waardevolle bijdrage leveren aan het dagelijks leven van slechtziende klanten. Bij Van Lent Systems kom je terecht in een betrokken organisatie die zich inzet voor mensen die ondersteuning verdienen in hun dagelijks leven. Wij leveren niet alleen hulpmiddelen, maar vinden goede service, begeleiding en persoonlijke aandacht minstens zo belangrijk. items.desc: OptoScale’s underwater cameras record fish in real time, around the clock. Our machine learning models turn the images into measurements of weight, lice, health and behaviour, and show how the fish respond when the feed comes in. Now we want to close the loop. Feeding thousands of fish is a control problem with almost everything that makes control hard. You only see part of what’s going on. The feedback is noisy and delayed. Currents, temperature and weather keep shifting the conditions. And at the other end of the loop are living fish, whose appetite, stress and behaviour change from one day to the next. We already have the sensors, the data and the models, and the first parts of the decision layer are in place. The next step is to make it autonomous, and we’re looking for someone to help us get there. You’ll join our AI & Optics team in Trondheim, a group with backgrounds in physics, mathematics, cybernetics and marine technology. What you’ll do Shape and develop the control strategy for autonomous feeding: how sensor data turns into feeding decisions Estimate the state of the fish and their environment from noisy, delayed data, and forecast how both develop over time Work with our machine learning team to turn model outputs into reliable inputs for feeding decisions Write Python that runs in production, not just in notebooks Follow your work from first idea to deployment, and keep improving it once it’s running Who you are You have an MSc or PhD with a strong foundation in control theory, cybernetics or autonomous systems. You write strong Python, and you’re fluent in English, written and spoken. You take ownership and finish what you start, also when it gets hard. You know when to pull others in and when to get on with it yourself. And you’d rather see something work in the sea than look good in a simulation. What gives you an edge At least three years in research or development (a PhD counts) Statistical modelling, data science or forecasting Reinforcement or imitation learning It’s also a plus if you’ve built something that already runs in a real product, worked with transformers, generative models, computer vision or deep learning, or know aquaculture. About us We operate across Norway, Sweden and Chile. We build our own hardware and software, from the optics and electronics in the cameras to the algorithms and the portal our customers log into. So you’re not working around a black box. If your controller needs better data, you can sit down with the people who build the sensors. We’re small enough that what you build gets used, and specialised enough that someone will push back on your thinking. Recruitment process We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. To reduce bias, applications are first reviewed anonymously. Selected candidates will be invited to take an aptitude test and a personality test (Matrigma and MAP from Assessio), and we may carry out background checks as part of the process.

items.card: The role You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice and LedaFlow, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes. items.desc: Shape the future of industrial operations with Falkor At Falkor, we’re building technology that helps industrial companies understand, optimise and operate complex assets more intelligently. We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. We’re now looking for a Graduate Process Engineer to join our Energy Simulation team in Fornebu or Horten. This is an opportunity to begin your career at the intersection of process engineering, industrial operations and technology, learning from experienced engineers while developing specialist expertise in dynamic process simulation. The role You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice and LedaFlow, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes. Our technology is used across the energy industry for engineering studies, design verification, virtual commissioning, operator training, real-time production monitoring and flow assurance. It also supports Falkor’s Digital Twin solutions and applications including CO₂ capture, transportation and storage. You’ll receive support as you learn to build and run simulation models, understand customer processes and contribute to simulator deliveries. What you’ll do Build, configure and run dynamic process simulation models. Support the integration of dynamic models with control systems. Help prepare simulators for engineering testing, virtual commissioning and operator training. Work with experienced colleagues to understand customer processes and technical challenges. Apply your engineering knowledge to practical industrial problems. Test and document simulation models and technical solutions. Collaborate with process engineers, software specialists and other technical disciplines. Contribute ideas that improve our tools, products and ways of working. Build your technical knowledge and gradually take on greater responsibility. What we’re looking for A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed BSc or MSc in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation or another relevant technical discipline. A structured and analytical approach to solving technical problems. Curiosity and a genuine appetite to learn. An interest in process simulation, industrial software or energy operations. A collaborative and solution-oriented approach. The ability to communicate and work effectively across technical disciplines. Fluency in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Flexibility to travel to customer sites when required. Interest or academic experience in Python programming, digitalisation, industrial AI, energy-transition technologies or CO₂ capture, transportation and storage would be an advantage. We know that graduates will not arrive with experience in every area. We’re looking for strong engineering foundations, learning agility and the potential to develop into a specialist within our team. Why Falkor? Industrial companies generate enormous amounts of data, but turning that data into better decisions remains a complex challenge. At Falkor, you’ll work on technology designed for the realities of industrial operations. You’ll learn how sophisticated simulation and software can help customers understand complex systems, test decisions before putting them into practice, train operators safely and operate assets more effectively. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, software specialists and industry experts, giving you the opportunity to build deep technical expertise and develop your career in industrial technology. Application process Send us your CV and tell us why you’re interested in beginning your career with Falkor. We’re interested in your potential, so you should still apply if you don’t meet every requirement. Please upload your diploma, academic transcript and/or other relevant documentation under Additional files. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Different perspectives make better technology The problems we’re solving are complex, and we believe solving them requires different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are valued, respected and able to contribute at their best. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds and experiences. Recruitment agencies Falkor occasionally partners with recruitment agencies for specific roles. We work with a limited number of preferred suppliers under agreed terms and processes. We therefore cannot accept responsibility for unsolicited candidate submissions or associated fees unless terms have been agreed with our Procurement team in advance.

Vi söker en högskolepedagogisk utvecklare som har erfarenhet inom generativ AI i högre utbildning och vill utforska dess möjligheter tillsammans med oss. På Högskolan Dalarna vill vi ligga i framkant och med högskolepedagogisk utgångspunkt vill vi utveckla hur generativ AI och andra digitala verktyg kan bidra till studenternas lärande. Här får du inte bara arbeta med utveckling, utan också avsatt tid för att själv utveckla din kompetens inom området. Du kommer att möta och samarbeta med många olika kompetenser inom högskolan, från lärare och forskare till högskolepedagogiska utvecklare och IKT-pedagoger. Tillsammans prövar vi nya idéer, delar erfarenheter och omsätter ny kunskap i praktiken. Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera pedagogik, utveckling och samarbete och samtidigt vara med där mycket händer just nu. Din arbetsdag som högskolepedagogisk utvecklare I tjänsten som högskolepedagogisk utvecklare kommer du att undervisa i behörighetsgivande högskolepedagogisk utbildning, både på svenska och engelska, samt utveckla, planera och genomföra workshops inom högskolepedagogik och digitala verktyg, där utvecklingen av kompetens inom generativ AI får allt större betydelse. Du kommer att driva och delta i högskolepedagogiskt utvecklingsarbete och olika projekt samt ge pedagogisk konsultation till lärare i frågor som rör högskolepedagogiska förhållningssätt, upplägg och digitala verktyg. I rollen ingår även att utveckla och pröva nya högskolepedagogiska metoder samt bidra till utvecklingen av såväl digitala som fysiska lärmiljöer. Du kommer att jobba nära andra högskolepedagogiska utvecklare och IKT-pedagoger. Är du personen vi söker? Våra krav för denna tjänst är att du har : akademisk examen på avancerad nivå i pedagogik, utbildningsvetenskap eller motsvarande som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig dokumenterad erfarenhet av högskolepedagogiskt arbete eller undervisning i högre utbildning dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda workshops och högskolepedagogiska utvecklingsarbeten behörighetsgivande högskolepedagogisk utbildning (motsvarande SUHF:s rekommendationer) dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med generativ AI inom högre utbildning dokumenterad erfarenhet av digitala verktyg för att stödja lärande och undervisning inom högre utbildning mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både skriftligt och muntligt Meriterande är: erfarenhet av att utveckla och genomföra distansutbildningar erfarenhet av att handleda kollegor i högskolepedagogiska frågor genomförd forskarutbildning Vid tillsättningen lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi vill att du som person är strukturerad, initiativtagande, kvalitetsmedveten och har samarbetsförmåga. Anställningen Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning, tjänstgöringsgrad 100%, med tillträde snarast möjligt. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Högskolan Dalarna är ett lärosäte som verkar på två orter. Placeringsort för denna anställning är Falun och visst arbete förekommer även i Borlänge. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete på max 40% av din arbetstid. Välkommen med din an! Du er via vår webbplats senast 2026-11-08 . Din an ska innehålla CV samt betygshandlingar. Övrigt Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som mångfald tillför verksamheten och vi använder oss av kompetensbaserad metodik genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Högskolan kommer i denna rekrytering att göra en kvalitativ helhetsbedömning för att bedöma vilken sökande som har de bästa förutsättningarna för att fullgöra uppgifterna i anställningen. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba vid Högskolan Dalarna så besök vår hemsida www.du.se/sv/om-oss/jobba-hos-oss/ Vi undanber oss all kontakt med försäljare av annonser. Vi har gjort våra strategiska val för denna rekrytering. På Högskolan Dalarna är du med och skapar framtiden. Vårt uppdrag är att utbilda och forska kring aktuella frågor. I nära samarbete med näringsliv och omgivande samhället skapar vi spännande möjligheter och erfarenheter för både studenter och medarbetare. Vi är en akademisk miljö som bygger på öppenhet, mod och ansvar och för oss är våra medarbetares kompetens och kreativitet viktig. Högskolan Dalarna är en högskola med två campus som lockar studenter och forskare från hela världen. Hos oss studerar ca 17 800 studenter och vi är ca 700 anställda. items.desc: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens arbetssätt inom processledning, ledningssystem och ansvarsfull AI-användning? items.desc: Kan du energibranschen, bygger förtroende och vet hur du tar en affär hela vägen till avslut? Hos Solpulsen får du sälja helheten – från solceller och batterilagring till vår Energy Hub och AI-baserade energistyrning. Nu söker Solpulsen Energy Norden AB en erfaren, affärsdriven säljare som vill ta en viktig roll i vår fortsatta utveckling. OM SOLPULSEN Vi arbetar med energilösningar för villor, företag och bostadsrättsföreningar. Solceller, batterier, laddning och smart styrning är delar av vårt erbjudande. Med vår Energy Hub och AI-styrning är ambitionen att hjälpa kunderna att använda, lagra och styra sin energi smartare. Här får du kombinera etablerade energiprodukter med ett erbjudande under utveckling – och vara med och påverka hur det når marknaden. DIN ROLL Du driver hela säljprocessen: från första kontakt och behovsanalys till offert, förhandling och avslut. Du förstår kundens förutsättningar och presenterar en lösning med tydlig kundnytta och realistiska kalkyler. I arbetet ingår att: • Aktivt hitta nya kunder och affärsmöjligheter. • Boka och genomföra kundmöten. • Sälja solceller, batterilagring, Energy Hub och AI-baserad energistyrning. Ta fram och följa upp offerter tillsammans med vårt tekniska team. • Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och utveckla samarbeten. • Hålla ordning på affärer, uppföljningar och nästa steg i vårt CRM. • Säkerställa en tydlig överlämning till installation och leverans. VI SÖKER DIG SOM Har erfarenhet av försäljning inom solenergi, batterier, laddning eller närliggande energiteknik. Du kan visa vad du har åstadkommit och är van att själv skapa aktivitet och driva affärer framåt. Du behöver kunna förklara tekniska lösningar på ett enkelt och trovärdigt sätt. Du lyssnar, ställer rätt frågor och hjälper kunden att fatta ett välgrundat beslut. Vi värdesätter särskilt att du: • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av försäljning och avslut. • Förstår energibranschen och kundernas vanligaste frågor. • Är självgående, strukturerad och håller vad du lovar. • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift. Trivs med tydliga mål och eget ansvar. Erfarenhet av företagskunder, bostadsrättsföreningar, energistyrning eller partnerförsäljning är meriterande. Ett relevant kontaktnät är också ett plus. DET HÄR FÅR DU HOS OSS • Ett brett energierbjudande med solceller, batterier och intelligent styrning. Nära samarbete med teknik och installation. • Korta beslutsvägar och direktkontakt med ledningen. • Möjlighet att påverka försäljningen, arbetssättet och kundernas erbjudande. • Utrymme att växa med verksamheten och på sikt ta större kommersiellt ansvar. Vi söker dig som vill göra affärer som håller – där kunden förstår vad den köper och vi levererar det vi har lovat. ANSÖKAN Skicka ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av din erfarenhet inom energibranschen. Berätta vilka lösningar du har sålt, vilka kundgrupper du har arbetat med och vilka försäljningsresultat du är mest stolt över. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vill du vara med och utveckla försäljningen av nästa generations energilösningar? Välkommen till Solpulsen.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens digitala universitet – och samtidigt fortsätta arbeta praktiskt med teknik? Luleå tekniska universitet befinner sig i en omfattande digital förflyttning. Vi moderniserar vårt IT-landskap, utvecklar vår integrationsförmåga och skapar nya lösningar med hjälp av molnplattformar, data och AI. Det här är en roll för dig som redan arbetar som lösningsarkitekt – eller som har en gedigen bakgrund inom systemutveckling och teknisk design och är redo att ta nästa steg. Rollen Som lösningsarkitekt har du en central roll i utformningen av universitetets framtida IT-stöd. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, utvecklingsteam, förvaltningsansvariga, IT-drift, informationssäkerhet och externa leverantörer. items.desc: Institutionen för programvaruteknik omfattar ca. 50 personer från 20 olika länder. Vår tradition inom programvaruteknik sträcker sig tillbaka till 1990 då vi startade Sveriges första utbildning inom området. Institutionens forsknings- och utbildningsmiljö, SERL Sweden ‒ Software Engineering Research and Education Lab Sweden, har sedan dess expanderat och är nu positionerad som världsledande när det gäller forskning inom mjukvaruutveckling. Institutionen ansvarar för utbildningar i programvaruteknik från kandidatnivå upp till forskarutbildning. Arbetsbeskrivning I anställningen ingår forskning, kursutveckling, undervisning och handledning inom programvaruteknik, med särskild inriktning mot verifiering och validering (V&V) av AI-intensiva system. Anställningen fördelas på 60 % forskning och 40 % undervisning under sex år. Inom det första året förväntas den sökande delta i rekryteringen av en doktorand inom kärnområdet och ta på sig huvudansvaret för handledningen, med stöd av ett team av erfarna handledare. Den sökande förväntas uppfylla kraven för befordran till universitetslektor inom högst fem och ett halvt år, vilket leder till en tillsvidareanställning. Den sökande kommer att leda uppbyggnaden av ett nytt forskningsområde och en ny forskargrupp inom SERL (Software engineering Education and Reserach Lab)och ta sig an en av de mest angelägna utmaningarna inom modern programvaruteknik – att säkerställa tillförlitlighet, pålitlighet, säkerhet och regelefterlevnad i system som innehåller generativ AI (GenAI) och andra lärande komponenter. AI-intensiva system uppvisar icke-deterministiskt, adaptivt och föränderligt beteende, vilket utmanar etablerad praxis för utveckling och kvalitetssäkring. Anställningen inriktas på att utveckla nya metoder, verktyg och principer för verifiering och validering som säkerställer kvalitet och regelefterlevnad i sådana system utan att begränsa deras generativa potential. Tillämpningsområden omfattar, men är inte begränsade till, autonoma fordon, försvarssystem, telekommunikation och andra programvaruintensiva produkter och tjänster. Den sökande förväntas utveckla sin egen forskningsinriktning, leda industrirelevanta projekt i samproduktion och bidra till SERL: s fortsatta utveckling som en forsknings- och utbildningsmiljö i världsklass. Samverkan med industrin och extern forskningsfinansiering är centrala delar av anställningen. Den sökande kommer att arbeta nära SAAB, Ericsson och FMV för att hantera verkliga V&V-utmaningar i AI-intensiva system, och ytterligare industripartnerskap förväntas tillkomma i takt med att forskargruppen växer. Den sökande ska vara beredd att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning som en del av anställningsförfarandet. items.desc: Job number NAT02308 Faculties Faculty of Natural Sciences Departments Department of Physics Salary or Salary range £50,733 - £62,001 per annum Location/campus South Kensington Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 16 Nov 2026 About the role We are looking for a candidate with experience in optimal quantum control for the collaborative QuantERA project FALCON. The successful candidate is expected to design optimised driving schemes that allow the experimental partner in Innsbruck (UIBK & AQT) to implement entangling gates with trapped ions that achieve high fidelities under practical conditions, i.e. at finite temperature and without accurate calibration. The candidate should have strong interest in collaborative work, and they should collaborate both with the experimental partner in Innsbruck and with the theory partner in Sofia. What you would be doing Your main role would be the design of optimised driving patterns for the realisation of noise-resilient quantum gates of trapped ions. Together with the other consortium partners you would identify the main sources of imperfections in the consortium’s experiments that result in reduction of gate fidelities, and you would develop optimal control solutions to achieve resilience to the identified imperfections. You would use both analytical and numerical tools for your work, and you would interact on a regular basis with all the project partners. What we are looking for We are looking for a candidate who holds a PhD with theoretical/numerical work in the fields of quantum information/quantum technologies. Additional experience as Postdoc is desired but not necessary. You should have a strong interest in collaborative work, and the ability to communicate with experimental partners. Ideally, you would have a strong background in optimal control and it’s application to quantum-optical systems. items.title: Research Coordinator in Accelerator Science
items.card: The role will be based at the Cockcroft Institute on Daresbury Science and Innovation Campus and make substantial contributions to the research portfolio of the pan-European QUASAR Group. It will focus on the development and experimental exploitation of particle accelerators and light sources and we are looking for an outstanding accelerator expert to strengthen our team and complement our existing expertise.
items.desc: Hours of work: Full-time - 35 hours per week Tenure: Permanent A permanent position as Research Coordinator in the Accelerator Science cluster at Liverpool University is available. The role will be based at the Cockcroft Institute on Daresbury Science and Innovation Campus and make substantial contributions to the research portfolio of the pan-European QUASAR Group. It will focus on the development and experimental exploitation of particle accelerators and light sources and we are looking for an outstanding accelerator expert to strengthen our team and complement our existing expertise. Applicants are expected to have an internationally recognized researcher profile and make major contributions to the cluster’s world-class research programme in accelerator science. The cluster’s work currently stretches over the following principal research areas: Scientific frontier facilities and underpinning technologies, including beam physics studies for particle colliders and light sources; Novel acceleration techniques, including beam and laser-driven acceleration, as well as micro accelerators; Applications of accelerators in addressing global challenges with a focus on medical applications and the commercialization of accelerator technologies. The scientific frontier facilities on which we aim to focus for the next decade include the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN; the Future Circular Collider (FCC); and the low energy antimatter facility AD/ELENA. We will continue to push the development of novel acceleration techniques. We are a key partner in the EuPRAXIA facility and involved in many international collaborations such as PACRI and EPITA where we combine cutting-edge R&D with leadership in cross-sector knowledge transfer. Our research focuses in particular on more sustainable accelerators, the development of high-resolution diagnostics and knowledge transfer with identified industry partners. We also carry out research into high impact applications of accelerators to address global challenges in health, security, energy, manufacturing and the environment. The accelerator science cluster has led a number of European research and training networks in these areas, and works closely with industry partners in the UK and around the world. Candidates are expected to develop the cluster’s cutting-edge research portfolio, work with our international partners, maximise the impact from our projects, co-supervise PhD and undergraduate students and contribute to research grant applications and the dissemination of our research results. We are looking for an outstanding accelerator scientist to make important contributions to the cluster’s research and training programme. Your research will involve leadership in one are several of the following areas: accelerator design and optimization, sustainable accelerator technologies including AI, novel acceleration techniques, sensor and beam instrumentation development, and accelerator applications. There are opportunities to contribute to teaching and supervision, and to make important contributions to major European projects such as High Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC), EuPRAXIA, EPITA and TwinRISE. This role is based at the Cockcroft Institute on the campus of Daresbury Laboratory. The research will be carried out at partner institutions around the world and some national and international travel will be required. Candidates should have a PhD in a relevant discipline and an excellent track record in accelerator design and optimization, demonstrated through publications in high impact journals. Experience in the training and supervision of students will be an asset. The working language is English. items.desc: Role : Electrochemical Water Treatment Technology Specialist (KTP Associate) (Heriot-Watt University and Sidon Water Ltd; KTP Project Number 10197548) Salary : £36,500 per annum Contract Type : Full-time (35 hours per week), Fixed term for 26 months Detailed Description The successful candidate will secure a 26-month collaborative Knowledge Transfer Project (KTP) position between Heriot-Watt University and Sidon Water Ltd. The Associate will receive specialist training in electrochemistry, water-chemistry analysis, materials and surface characterisation, and predictive modelling from experts at Heriot-Watt University before leading the development of a practical, evidence-based framework for predicting the performance of Sidon Water's Integro electrochemical water-conditioning technology. The role represents an opportunity to shape how a growing UK water-technology company evaluates, validates and deploys a sustainable, non-chemical approach to scale control and fouling mitigation. You will be at the heart of an interdisciplinary programme linking fundamental scientific investigation with real-world applications in desalination, reverse osmosis, industrial water treatment, leisure, hospitality and commercial hot-water systems. This project and its Associate fulfil a critical role at Sidon Water. The Associate will transfer and embed new scientific, analytical and modelling capability within the business, helping Sidon move from demonstration-led sales to a scalable, evidence-based technical-sales and consultancy model. The project will build an improved understanding of ion behaviour, mineral nucleation and scale formation; establish in-house water-testing and analytical procedures; define the technology's operational performance envelope; and develop Sidon's first validated predictive performance model. This full-time position is funded by Sidon Water Ltd and Innovate UK. The successful appointee will be based primarily at Sidon Water's premises at 18 North Street, Glenrothes, Fife, KY7 5NA, with approximately nine months of laboratory-based activity at Heriot-Watt University's Riccarton campus in Edinburgh across the project. If the project is successful, there may be an opportunity to secure a permanent role at Sidon Water to support the continued development and commercialisation of the capability. The role may particularly appeal to people currently engaged in work such as: Water chemistry, water analysis, industrial water treatment, desalination or reverse-osmosis research and development. Electrochemistry, materials science, chemical engineering, environmental engineering, physics or surface-characterisation research. Applied scientific or engineering roles that combine laboratory investigation, data analysis, modelling and translation into practical commercial tools. As a KTP Associate, you will receive training as part of a national Associate cohort, training on Sidon Water systems and processes, protected development time, and a dedicated personal and professional development budget. Keyword search: electrochemistry, water chemistry, scale control, predictive modelling, desalination, reverse osmosis, materials characterisation, industrial water treatment Key Duties and Responsibilities The successful appointee will be expected to undertake the following: Plan and manage project activity in line with the approved workplan, including project scheduling, budgets, milestones, reporting, risk management and engagement with the Local Management Committee. Design and carry out a structured programme of laboratory and applied research covering electrochemical behaviour, mineral nucleation, scale formation, water chemistry and operating conditions. Use and interpret electrochemical methods such as cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and related techniques to investigate ion behaviour, charge-transfer processes and early-stage mineral nucleation. Develop and validate methods for monitoring nucleation and scale-suppression behaviour, working with Heriot-Watt specialists to ensure scientific rigour and commercial relevance. Specify, coordinate and interpret materials and surface-characterisation studies, potentially including SEM, EDS, XPS and XRD, to understand mineral composition, growth and adhesion. Establish Sidon Water's internal water-chemistry testing capability, including methods for hardness, alkalinity, pH, conductivity, dissolved solids and scaling indices such as LSI and RSI. Evaluate how water composition, temperature, flow, pressure and other operating conditions influence performance, and define an operational performance envelope for the Integro technology. Integrate electrochemical, water-chemistry, materials and operational datasets into a validated predictive model capable of forecasting performance under different site conditions. Create and embed standard operating procedures, testing protocols, supplier and intellectual-property databases, decision tools and …

The role This company is building a proactive AI assistant that maintains a living model of a person's entire work history — emails, messages, meetings, documents. It acts on their behalf, drafting replies and preparing for meetings, all before being asked. The core challenge is building long-term memory that stays current, retrieving messy context across diverse sources, and reasoning about information live on screen. This is a genuinely unsolved problem in AI. You will own the research direction for these core problems, working end-to-end from hypothesis to production. Develop and deploy reasoning models that operate across diverse, messy data sources. Build models capable of real-time reasoning over live screen and application context. Take research from initial hypothesis and experimentation through to robust, production-ready systems, owning the entire lifecycle. You implement and build upon current research papers, not just apply existing libraries. You've run both halves of the work: forming and testing hypotheses, and building robust, scalable systems. items.desc: Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. About The Role Own the red-teaming and adversarial evaluation pipeline for Reflection’s models, continuously probing for failure modes across security, misuse, and alignment gaps. Work hand-in-hand with the Alignment team to translate safety findings into concrete guardrails, ensuring models behave reliably under stress and adhere to deployment policies. Validate that every release meets the lab’s risk thresholds before it ships, serving as a critical gatekeeper for our open weight releases. Develop scalable, automated safety benchmarks that evolve alongside our model capabilities, moving beyond static datasets to dynamic adversarial testing. Research and implement state-of-the-art jailbreaking techniques and defenses to stay ahead of potential vulnerabilities in the wild. About You Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience in AI Safety. Deep technical understanding of LLM safety, including adversarial attacks, red-teaming methodologies, and interpretability. Strong software engineering capabilities with experience building automated evaluation pipelines or large-scale ML systems. Experience with Reinforcement Learning (RLHF/RLAIF) and how it impacts model safety and alignment is a strong plus. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-agency startup environment with bias toward action. Willing to make high-stakes decisions regarding model release and safety thresholds. Passionate about advancing the frontier of intelligence. What We Offer We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models. We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported. Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally. Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options. Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance. Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily. Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys. Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K. Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable. Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations. Any offer of employment for this role may be conditioned on the Company's ability to provide the candidate with access to such technology or source code in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, which may require the Company to seek government authorization. items.desc: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in developing high-quality, validated markers that extract insights from dense temporal stacks of satellite imagery across agriculture, land management, and climate. The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers to deploy models at scale, while expanding beyond compliance into land-cover change detection using embeddings and AI-first workflows. Ideal candidates are adaptable, curious about AI agents, and eager to iterate directly based on customer feedback. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to work with multi-sensor Earth observation data to solve complex environmental and agricultural challenges. This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Graz, Ljubljana or Haarlem office 3 days per week. Impact You’ll Own Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run. Take a research topic from exploration through to production. Own marker results for production AMS deliveries across several EU countries — run them, review them, and confirm quality before they reach the client. Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP. Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it. Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team. Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them. Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable. Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients. What You Bring 4+ years of relevant work experience. Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field. Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques. Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code. Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools. Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase. Working knowledge of the geospatial domain. Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables. Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains. Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company. What Makes You Stand Out Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery. Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series. Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1). Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes. Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing. Application Deadline 11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to. Benefits While Working At Planet These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy. Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off Employee Wellness Program Home Office Reimbursement Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning Equity Volunteering Paid Time Off …

You will find Intermedia is a place where you can indulge your passion for creating and supporting great cloud technology. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been with us 10, 15, and 20+ years! Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back! While primarily remote , this role requires occasional visits to the Bristol office or London. About The Role Intermedia is looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI Data Science team. In this role, you will develop and apply advanced machine learning, generative AI, and statistical techniques to improve the intelligence, effectiveness, and reliability of Intermedia's digital agents. You will work on challenging problems involving large language models, retrieval, agent behavior, experimentation, evaluation, and optimization to help create digital agents that can understand customer needs, access relevant knowledge, and successfully complete complex tasks. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other data scientists to take ideas from experimentation through production. You will have significant ownership of data science solutions while helping establish strong practices for measuring and continuously improving the quality of our AI-powered experiences. What You Will Be Doing Machine Learning & Agent Intelligence Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning and generative AI solutions that power Intermedia's Digital Agent Platform. Apply large language models (LLMs), natural language processing, retrieval, and other advanced AI techniques to improve agent understanding and performance. Develop approaches that improve agent reasoning, tool selection, knowledge retrieval, context management, personalization, and task completion. Experiment with model, prompt, retrieval, and agent configuration strategies to identify approaches that deliver the best customer and business outcomes. Evaluate commercial and open-source models and recommend appropriate approaches based on quality, latency, scalability, and cost. Generative AI & RAG Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions that ground digital agents in relevant enterprise and customer information. Develop and evaluate embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking approaches, semantic search, and other knowledge-retrieval techniques. Build and refine end-to-end pipelines that combine LLMs with retrieval systems, enterprise knowledge sources, and agent workflows. Develop approaches to improve the relevance, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated responses. Identify and mitigate issues such as hallucinations, poor retrieval, inappropriate responses, and other failure modes in generative AI applications. Evaluation & Experimentation Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for measuring digital agent quality, including accuracy, relevance, task completion, reliability, safety, and customer experience. Design offline and online experiments to compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent configurations, and other AI approaches. Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, and other quantitative methods to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Define appropriate metrics and benchmarks that connect model and agent performance to customer and business outcomes. Analyze production behavior and feedback to identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities to continuously improve digital agents. Ensure data and model quality through comprehensive testing, validation, and performance evaluation. Data & Solution Development Gather, preprocess, analyze, and model large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. Use Python, SQL, Spark, and other relevant technologies to build scalable analytical and machine learning solutions. Develop features, datasets, and analytical approaches that support model development, experimentation, and evaluation. Partner with data and engineering teams to build and maintain reliable pipelines for model training, evaluation, and production use. Contribute to scalable ML/AI pipelines that support experimentation, deployment, monitoring, …

Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires Description Du Poste Filiale 100% de Naval Group, Sirehna est une entité experte en hydrodynamique navale, controle dynamique des plateformes et perception de l'environnement marin et langage embarqué pour la tenue au temps réel des systèmes qu'elle met à bord de navire militaire comme civil allant de la barge de travaux Offshore jusqu'au porte-avions. Sirehna déploie également des outils d'aides à la décision pour la maitrise énergétique des navires de surface et sous-marins ainsi que pour la maitrise des risques en opération par mer formée. En tant qu'ingénieur Perception de l'environnement maritime, vos missions principales seront les suivantes: Vous serez amené à maintenir et faire évoluer des suites logiciels de traitement d'images et de données Vous serez amené à interagir avec les algorithmiciens pour l'analyse, le portage de solution ou et l'intégration de logiciels Vous serez amené à développer des outils de tests et de validation Vous serez amené à réaliser des architectures de système de perception basée notamment sur les technologies optroniques (caméra jour/nuit, IR, LWIR, etc...) pour la détection/classifcation d'objets Vous serez amené également à tester, valider, installer, calibrer des systèmes de perception multicapteurs en condition laboratoire et en conditions opérationnelles. Vous serez amené également à développer des preuves de concept et les mettre en oeuvre afin d'assurer une levé de risque dans la montée en maturité de fonctions de perception spécialisées à base de machine learning ou de méthode plus classique pour réaliser des taches de detection/classification/pistage et fusion de données multicapteurs. Vous participerez à la construction des feuilles de route du domaine perception avec le responsable d'axe technologique. Vous serez donc en interface avec l'ensemble des métiers de Sirehna (Ingénierie système, hydrodynamique, Contrôle/Commande, perception, navigation, guidage, essais, simulation) et la direction technique innovation de Naval Group. Les applications principales étant sur bâtiment de surface, sous-marins, véhicule marin autonome Profil Diplômé(e) d'un bac+5 (Ecole d'Ingénieur généraliste), avec au minimum 3-5 ans d'expérience professionnelle, - Vous maitrisez les développements en C++, gestion des SDK, traitement vidéos, cuda - Vous maitrisez les environnements Linux, virtuels et conteneurisés (production image conteneur et déploiement) - Vous avez des notions en conception et ingénierie système, et êtes capable de rédiger des spécifications - Vous maitrisez la validation logicielle et système, la rédaction et déroulement de plan de tests, en particulier du point de vue performances. - Solides connaissances en configuration et analyse des réseaux - Vous avez exercé un poste d'ingénieur développement de logiciel de traitement d'images pendant au moins 3 ans Les plus pour ce poste: - Autonomie dans les déplacements pour l'intégration en platforme et les mises en service sur navire - Analyse des faits techniques, recherche de pannes et rédaction de rapport d'essais - Maitrise des outils gitlab, wireshark, gstreamer ou ffmpeg - Géométrie 3D, changement de repère et calibration caméras - être familier avec les capteurs de type radar ; caméra (voie visible et infrarouge) ; plateformes Pan Tilt - Python 3.10+ - une connaissance et une appétence pour le milieu marin, - une expérience dans le développement de véhicules autonomes, Vous êtes curieux, ouvert d'esprit et aimez les travaux d'innnovation et de prototypage et vous êtes à l'aise avec le travail en équipe. Des déplacements en France métropolitaine sont à prévoir Le contexte international du poste nécessite un niveau d'anglais courant tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Description Du Poste Vous êtes ingénieur(e), passionné(e) par l'industrie et curieux(se) des applications concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle ? Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Vision Industrielle & IA (H/F) pour participer à un projet innovant de contrôle qualité automatisé dans un environnement industriel exigeant. Vous contribuerez au développement de solutions de vision par ordinateur permettant d'identifier et de caractériser des défauts sur des produits industriels. Votre mission couvrira deux dimensions complémentaires : 🔹 Analyse industrielle et préparation des données (40 %) Collaborer avec les experts industriels pour comprendre les procédés de fabrication et les défauts à détecter. Identifier les caractéristiques visuelles pertinentes pour les contrôles qualité. Participer à la collecte, à la qualification et à l'annotation des images. Définir des méthodes d'annotation fiables et assurer la qualité des données. Traduire les besoins opérationnels en problématiques exploitables par des solutions d'IA. 🔹 Vision par ordinateur et intelligence artificielle (60 %) Participer à la conception de solutions de détection et de classification de défauts. Contribuer au développement et à l'entraînement des modèles de vision par ordinateur. Évaluer les performances des modèles et identifier les axes d'optimisation. Participer à l'intégration des solutions dans les applications industrielles. Suivre leur efficacité en conditions réelles de production. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et méthodes de contrôle. Une expérience dans l'industrie, notamment en production, qualité, maintenance ou procédés industriels, constitue un véritable atout. 🔥 Compétences clés Connaissances en vision industrielle, optique, traitement du signal ou traitement d'images. Capacité à comprendre des problématiques industrielles et à les traduire en solutions techniques. Intérêt marqué pour l'intelligence artificielle et l'analyse de données. Connaissance d'OpenCV ou d'outils de vision industrielle appréciée. Notions de Machine Learning et de MLOps appréciées. Anglais requis. 🤝 Qualités personnelles Curiosité technique et envie d'apprendre. Rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Autonomie et force de proposition. Goût du terrain et des échanges avec les équipes industrielles. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi rejoindre Citech ? 🤔 Chez CITECH, nous accordons une importance particulière à la qualité des missions proposées et à l'accompagnement de nos consultants. Vous bénéficiez d'une relation de proximité avec nos équipes et d'un suivi individualisé tout au long de votre parcours. Notre client recherche plusieurs profils AI Engineer / Data Scientist , avec une attention particulière portée aux compétences en Machine Learning, NLP, Large Language Models (LLM) et IA générative. Expérimenter, évaluer et améliorer des modèles et systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Contribuer à l'industrialisation et au déploiement des solutions IA en production. Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie logicielle et les différentes parties prenantes. Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des approches adaptées aux besoins des projets. Pour les profils Lead et Manager : Définir les orientations techniques et participer aux décisions d'architecture. Assurer le leadership technique et accompagner les équipes dans leurs choix technologiques. Piloter les projets de leur conception jusqu'à leur livraison. Participer aux échanges avec les clients et à la compréhension de leurs enjeux. Coordonner les équipes et assurer, selon les responsabilités, le management de projets ou de collaborateurs. Profil recherché Formation et parcours Diplôme d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu, idéalement de premier plan. Une expérience professionnelle au sein d'une entreprise technologique de référence peut également constituer un parcours particulièrement apprécié. Les profils présentant une expérience technique solide et des réalisations significatives seront également considérés. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise des fondamentaux de la Data Science, du Machine Learning et des méthodes statistiques. Expérience en développement et exploitation de modèles d'intelligence artificielle. Connaissances ou expérience en IA générative, NLP et LLM particulièrement appréciées . Pour les profils spécialisés en IA générative, une expérience concrète de conception et de développement de solutions, au-delà de la simple utilisation d'outils de génération de code, constitue un véritable atout. Une expérience couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie des modèles, jusqu'à leur déploiement en production, sera fortement valorisée. Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements techniques variés et à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies. Curiosité, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes. Expérience attendue Confirmé / Data Scientist : différents niveaux d'expérience sont considérés selon les compétences techniques et les réalisations. Senior : minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de niveau senior. Lead : environ 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 1 an en tant que Lead ou dans une fonction équivalente. Manager : expérience significative en pilotage de projets, coordination technique et/ou management d'équipe. Pour les profils Lead et Manager, des compétences en leadership technique, gestion de projet et relation client sont particulièrement recherchées. Pourquoi rejoindre cette opportunité ? Participer à des projets concrets et ambitieux autour de la Data Science et de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Intervenir sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception à la mise en production. Développer votre expertise sur des technologies en constante évolution. Évoluer au sein d'équipes techniques expérimentées. Bénéficier de perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions d'expertise, de leadership ou de management.

items.card: The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel.
