Design and build agentic
items.desc: We are looking for a consultant to join Devleaps and work together with us on our client's project. Our client, an international company in the retail and e-commerce industry, is building agentic workflows in its Finance domain. The first end-to-end journey is purchase-to-pay (P2P): it starts in Coupa and ends in the payment system, with AI agents handling the steps in between. As a Devleaps consultant, you will be part of the team delivering this journey, working with the client's Finance team alongside a Product Owner, an Engineering Manager and data colleagues who support you as the work develops. At the same time, you are part of the Devleaps team, with colleagues to collaborate with, learn from and share your experience with. What you will do Build agents that move money, safely. Design and build agentic workflows across the full P2P journey, from Coupa through to payment. Create the missing connections. Build MCP servers on top of Finance systems, such as Coupa and payment platforms, where none exist yet. Plug in what's already out there. Integrate and configure vendor-provided MCP servers where they are available. Own the integration layer. Take ownership of the MCP layer for the Finance domain, including reliability, security, versioning and documentation. Go end to end. Build the supporting application components, from backend services and APIs to lightweight front ends where users need them. Keep humans in the loop. Build logging, audit trails and human-in-the-loop steps into every workflow that touches financial transactions. Turn process into product. Work directly with Finance users to translate their process steps into workflows that can be tested. What you bring Experience: Medior level, with roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on development experience. Full-stack skills: A strong backend and integration focus, working in Python and/or TypeScript. Agentic AI in practice: Hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based workflows, for example tool calling, orchestration frameworks, and prompt and evaluation design. MCP knowledge: Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol), or clear evidence that you can pick it up quickly. Integration expertise: Experience with REST APIs, authentication and integrating third-party SaaS platforms. Cloud and CI/CD: Comfortable working in a cloud environment with CI/CD pipelines. The right attitude: A clear communicator who is easy to work with. You ask for help early and share what you learn. Nice to have Exposure to finance or procurement processes, such as P2P, invoice matching and approvals. Experience with Coupa or ERP integrations. Experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. Why Devleaps At Devleaps you are not just placed on a project. You join a team of engineers who work together, share knowledge and support each other across client assignments. You get to work on meaningful, technically challenging projects like this one, with the backing of a company that invests in your growth and keeps you connected to a wider engineering community. Ready to build the future of finance with AI? We'd love to hear from you.

items.title: Intership Agentic Multimodal AI for Understanding and Reasoning over Complex Technical Documents-H/F
items.card: you will have the opportunity to work within a world-renowned research environment. Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an ideal setting for learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work conducted may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context : Complex technical documents
items.desc: As an intern at the CEA, you will have the opportunity to work within a world-renowned research environment. Our teams consist of passionate and dedicated experts, providing an ideal setting for learning and collaboration. You will have access to state-of-the-art equipment and top-tier research resources to carry out your assignments. The work conducted may potentially lead to a scientific publication. Context : Complex technical documents combine heterogeneous information such as text, tables, diagrams, figures and equations, often distributed across multiple pages. They include technical manuals, maintenance procedures, user guides, datasheets, product specifications, engineering documents, and technical or scientific reports. Understanding such documents raises several challenges: retrieving relevant information across long documents, jointly interpreting heterogeneous modalities, linking information distributed over multiple pages, and performing multi-step reasoning. This internship aims to develop multimodal agentic AI capable of planning and orchestrating specialized models and tools for complex document understanding and reasoning. What do we expect from you? To address these challenges, the internship will investigate the following research directions: Review existing benchmarks and, if necessary, develop a benchmark covering a fine-grained taxonomy of technical documents and multimodal reasoning tasks. Evaluate recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for technical document understanding. Design an agentic architecture able to decompose complex queries and plan multi-step reasoning. Dynamically retrieve relevant pages and select appropriate tools or models. Combine and reason over information from text, tables, figures, diagrams and equations across multiple pages. Evaluate the proposed approach against direct VLM and multimodal RAG baselines. # Cea-List Profil du candidat Students in their 4th or 5th year of studies (M1, M2 or gap year) Strong interest for Multimodal Generative AI Knowledge of LLMs, Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Transformers, RAG and agentic systems Computer vision skills Machine learning skills (deep learning, perception models, generative AI…) Python proficiency in a deep learning framework (especially TensorFlow or PyTorch) Localisation du poste Site Saclay Localisation du poste France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Ville Saclay Critères candidat Langues Français (Courant) Anglais (Courant) Diplôme préparé Bac+5 - Diplôme École d'ingénieurs Formation recommandée Apprentissage automatique et IA Possibilité de poursuite en thèse Oui

We are looking for an Associate DevOps Engineer to join our team and contribute to developing, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered tools that streamline
items.desc: Job Description Are you passionate about the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and robust software development practices? Do you have a foundational understanding of DevOps principles and a keen interest in applying them to AI solutions? We are looking for an Associate DevOps Engineer to join our team and contribute to developing, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered tools that streamline and enhance the daily workflows of our R&D engineers across hardware, software, architecture, and test functions. In this role, you will work closely with experienced engineers, learning to bridge the gap between AI development and operational excellence. You will help ensure our R&D teams can leverage AI tools safely, effectively, and efficiently, gaining valuable hands-on experience in a supportive environment. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn Support AI Solution Development & Integration: Assist in the development and integration of AI-driven tools and platforms (e.g., internal LLM chatbots, specialized applications) into existing R&D workflows and systems. Collaborate with AI experts and R&D engineers to understand their needs and contribute to building effective AI solutions. Learn about and contribute to use cases such as initial code drafting, test scaffolding, refactoring, documentation generation, test plan generation, script generation, log analysis, debugging, and design option exploration. Contribute to DevOps Pipelines for AI: Support the building, maintenance, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines for AI models and applications, focusing on automated testing, deployment, and continuous integration. Gain hands-on experience with tools like GitLab, Artifactory, Argo CD, and SonarQube for efficient and secure software delivery. Learn and apply DevSecOps practices to embed security throughout the AI solution lifecycle. Assist with Infrastructure & Cloud Management: Help manage and provision cloud infrastructure (e.g., Azure, NESC, AWS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform and Kubernetes. Support the configuration and access for approved AI tools and environments, adhering to corporate policies and security baselines. Assist in the deployment and lifecycle management of containerized AI applications. Monitor, Log & Optimize Performance: Contribute to implementing monitoring and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) for AI tools and their underlying infrastructure. Learn to identify and help resolve performance bottlenecks, ensuring the reliability of AI services. Participate in the continuous improvement of AI-assisted R&D processes by analyzing metrics and feedback. Develop AI/ML Understanding & Application: Apply academic knowledge or project experience in machine learning fundamentals, algorithms (e.g., Linear Regression, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), and data science techniques. Develop skills in prompt engineering to maximize the effectiveness of large language models for R&D tasks. Understand basic data preprocessing, feature selection, model evaluation, and deployment strategies in cloud and local environments. Collaborate & Communicate: Work effectively within R&D teams, learning from architects, product owners, and the PSE AI Council to align AI initiatives with business objectives and technical standards. Provide support to R&D engineers on the effective and safe use of AI tools. Learn about and report suspected policy violations or data leakage related to AI usage through established channels. Key Skills And Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or graduating soon). Academic projects, internships, or demonstrable personal projects showcasing an understanding of DevOps principles and practices. Foundational knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including basic model development or application. Familiarity with at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) and an eagerness to learn relevant AI/ML libraries. Basic understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, OpenStack) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Awareness of IaC concepts (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). Basic understanding of monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Interest in secure coding practices and DevSecOps principles. Strong problem-solving aptitude, analytical skills, and clear communication. Eagerness to learn and adapt in an agile, fast-paced R&D environment. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. Learn more about life at Nokia . As our AI Enablement Engineer, you are the hands-on engine helping colleagues across the company build and deploy working GenAI solutions. You work side-by-side with Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Engineering teams – unblocking technical hurdles, building rapid prototypes, and showcasing plug-and-play setups. You report to the AI Transformation Lead, and you're a big part of why our whole organisation moves fast with AI. What You'll Do Technical resolution and support: Step in to resolve technical hurdles for non-technical teams. Enable colleagues to bring their GenAI experiments across the finish line. Rapid prototyping and automation: Build practical GenAI prototypes and workflow automations. Set up custom Gemini or Claude tools to address daily operational challenges. Demos and capability showcase: Develop and present tangible AI demos. Inspire teams across Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Engineering. Coaching and workshops: Co-facilitate hands-on workshops with internal teams. Coach peers on prompt engineering, workflow setups, and GenAI tooling. Evaluation and validation: Test, evaluate, and validate emerging GenAI capabilities and platforms. Keep our internal technology stack up to date. Experiment tracking and standardisation: Maintain the central AI Experiment Registry. Track active projects, measure performance, and standardize successful workflows company-wide. What You Bring BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field 2–4 years of hands-on experience in technical business analysis, systems integration, or solutions engineering Clear and patient communicator able to coach non-technical colleagues without using overly technical jargon Proactive and curious investigator comfortable building relationships across different departments to identify needs Solid experience creating genAI solutions with enterprise GenAI environments like OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Anthropic Claude Strong proficiency with API integrations, scripting in Python, and automation platforms like Workato or n8n Fluent in written and spoken English Pragmatic, hands-on builder focused on delivering fast, working prototypes over complex theoretical frameworks Comfortable with hybrid working at our office premises, with occasional travel as required N.B. items.desc: Hybrid | Vienna, Austria We build Miyon AI, an agentic AI platform for voice. Telecommunications and UCaaS providers offer it to their customers under their own brand, and enterprises connect it to the systems they already use. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys both building things and talking to the people who need them. Someone who can join a customer conversation, work out what’s needed, and take it from an initial idea to a working integration. The work You’ll work with our white-label partners, prospective customers, and enterprise clients. Some conversations will start with a clear technical brief. Others will start with “could we make this work?” You should be comfortable with both. You’ll help shape proofs of concept, build custom extensions and integrations into our core platform, and see them through to production. That means writing code, asking questions, working through tradeoffs, and staying involved once real users arrive. In practice, you’ll: Join technical conversations with partners, leads, and enterprise customers Turn open-ended problems into practical designs and working software Build proofs of concept that give customers something concrete to evaluate Connect Miyon AI agents to customer APIs, systems, and data sources Build custom extensions and production-ready integrations within the Miyon AI core platform Run workshops and work through integration questions with client teams Take responsibility for deployment, reliability, performance, and ongoing improvements Test with real data and use the results to improve what you’ve built Work closely with Engineering, Sales, and Product, bringing what you learn from customers back into the platform Document useful patterns and build tools that make the next integration easier What you bring You have several years of software engineering experience and have built systems that run in production. You know your way around APIs, cloud infrastructure, and the details that come up when connecting different systems. You enjoy working directly with customers. You can explain a technical decision clearly, ask useful questions, and keep moving when the requirements aren’t fully worked out yet. You take ownership of your work and care about whether it solves the customer’s problem. You’re interested in voice AI and enjoy getting things working in practice. For this position, you need to be comfortable communicating in both German and English, including technical discussions, workshops, and day-to-day collaboration. A few things that would be useful, but aren’t requirements: Experience in customer-facing technical role Familiarity with AI agents, MCP, automation, or conversational systems Experience with SIP trunking, VoIP systems, or telephony integrations Experience with Python, Ruby, or TypeScript Having worked in a growing startup Working here You’ll work on integrations for telecommunications providers, UCaaS companies, and enterprise customers, alongside a team with experience at leading tech companies. There’s room to make technical decisions, own delivery, and influence the product through what you learn in the field. Our office is in Vienna’s 9th district. We work hybrid, with home office flexibility and occasional travel to partner and client sites. If that sounds like your kind of work, let’s talk. The collective agreement minimum for this full-time role is €64,554 gross per year. We’re happy to pay above that.

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

 - Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

 - Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

 - Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

 - Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

 - Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

 - Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

 - Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

 - Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

 - New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 - You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

 - You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

 - You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

 - You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

 - You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

 - You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

 - Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

 - Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

 - Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent …

items.desc: Software Developer – AI-Native Business Solutions Build agents that do more than answer questions. Help people get work done. We are looking for a developer to build agentic solutions for our customers’ business processes. You will combine software development, data, and business understanding: defining the problem together with the team, building a working solution, evaluating its impact, and improving it based on feedback. The goal is not an impressive demo, but a useful, controlled, and maintainable service. What will you get to work on? You build agentic workflows to support areas such as customer work, service delivery, or project work. A solution might compile a situational overview, prepare the next action, or update a system according to an approved operating model. You develop focused prototypes and take them towards production together with architects, business experts, and the customer. You develop tools and reusable capabilities for agents, as well as integrations using API and MCP interfaces. You connect solutions to CRM, document sources, and other business systems. You build information retrieval and context-handling solutions that preserve source information, permissions, freshness, and data provenance. You implement operational boundaries in code, including access checks, input validation, approval points, and error handling. You take care of automated testing, evaluation datasets for agents, deployment pipelines, and monitoring. You measure quality, latency, and cost, and ensure that recovery and rollback paths are in place. What do we expect from you? A strong foundation in software development and experience taking solutions into production. You know how to build and maintain more than just a prototype. Experience with API integrations, cloud services, and data processing, as well as skills in technologies such as TypeScript, Python, or C#. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and with using agents or generative AI in your own projects or customer projects. The ability to break down a business problem into implementable stages, make quality-related trade-offs visible, and communicate fluently in Finnish and English. What kind of expertise will help you succeed? We value experience with Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure, agent orchestration, MCP, information retrieval, and Dataverse. You do not need to know every framework. More important is your ability to learn quickly, choose the right implementation for the purpose, and recognise when conventional software workflow is a better solution than an agent. How do we work with AI? GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or a similar tool is part of the development process, not just code autocomplete. You use agents to support requirements analysis, implementation, testing, and documentation. You make goals and acceptance criteria explicit, review the outputs, and remain responsible for the end result. When evaluating solutions, you also test failure scenarios: missing context, an incorrect source, a prohibited action, or an integration failure. You make sure that a convincing response does not hide incorrect information or a failed action. Autonomy is increased only when quality and controls have been demonstrated. What does this role offer you? You will build end-to-end solutions where the user interface, agents, context, and backend systems work together. You will have room to experiment, while also having the support of an experienced team in building production-ready solutions. The success of your work is measured by how well it helps the customer’s users and processes, not by the number of agents. Why Twoday? We combine the agility of customer-focused teams with the support of a broad expert community. You will work alongside specialists in business applications, software development, data, AI, and cloud platforms. We share what we learn and build solutions together, so you do not need to know everything on your own. You will receive support for your professional development through training, community learning events, conferences, and online learning environments. Our benefits include lunch and recreational benefits, as well as comprehensive occupational healthcare including mental wellbeing support services. We offer flexible remote working opportunities and the possibility to influence your choice of work equipment. Our community is built through approachable colleagues, office breakfasts, hobby clubs, and shared activities. Interested? Apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. A separate cover letter is optional; please answer the screening questions on the application form. Tell us about one solution you have built: what problem did it solve, what was your role, and how did you ensure its quality? You can also use a personal project as your example. Please note that we can only proceed with applicants who have a valid right to work in Finland. Working at Twoday Twoday is a leading technology consulting company helping …

items.desc: Job Description: We are seeking a forward-thinking security leader to become our AI CISO. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI security at a global scale, protecting our models, data, and infrastructure from emerging threats while fostering responsible and ethical AI innovation. About the job Job purpose Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy. Main missions Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI: Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service Expected skills & experience We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills: Experience More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof. Technical skills Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle Knowledge of common AI frameworks Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential Soft skills / transversal skills Profile Fluent in English. Outstanding oral and written communication skills with proven ability to develop and present concise information Strong multi-cultural understanding Experience of interacting with Directors and all levels of management Team player and able to collaborate, influence and guide others Strategic Mindset A passion for innovation balanced with a pragmatic, risk-based approach. Ability to think strategically and establish a new function in a complex, global organization Maintains a wider perspective, aligns actions and contributes to the enhancement of the overall organizational strategy, including outputs from benchmarking activities and reviews Understands and articulates the projected direction of the organization and how changes to it might impact the group Is aware of trends in the external environment and key differentiators vis-à-vis competition and uses this information to anticipate how these changes would impact the organization Leadership / Stakeholder Management / Communication: A visionary leader capable of navigating ambiguity and influencing a wide range of stakeholders to adopt new security paradigms in a matrix organization Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities. Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives Where will you be in the organization? The department / team The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant. The department / team: Operating within a global matrix structure, you will use your leadership and influence to embed security into the entire AI lifecycle across all AXA entities. Your mission is to make "secure AI" a core principle of every project, ensuring our innovation is built on a foundation of trust. What we offer We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

items.desc: The Royal College of Art (RCA) is the world’s leading university for art and design, ranked number one globally for 12 consecutive years (QS World University Rankings by Subject, 2015–2026). We are a postgraduate-only university with a rich history of creative innovation and a global community of artists, designers, researchers and practitioners. We are seeking an established computational researcher, creative technologist or artist with expertise in creative coding, machine learning and artificial intelligence to join our MA/MFA Artificial Intelligence and Digital Art (AiDA) programme as a Tutor (Research) . About the role This is an exciting opportunity to shape how the next generation of artists engage critically and creatively with AI. You will lead teaching in Creative Coding, developing students’ programming skills and computational thinking while supporting their progression into more advanced areas, including machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI. Working with postgraduate artists from diverse disciplinary and technical backgrounds, you will help students explore how AI systems are constructed, how data and models can embed cultural assumptions and biases, and how artistic practice can challenge, reinterpret and reconfigure these technologies. You will bring emerging developments in AI and computation into the studio, encouraging experimentation across creative coding, photography, installation, performance, robotics, software, moving image and networked media. You will also contribute to curriculum development, student supervision, assessment and the wider research culture of the programme. As a research-active academic, you will develop and disseminate your own research, contribute to funding opportunities and help strengthen the RCA’s reputation for innovative, critical and artist-led approaches to emerging technologies. About you You will have advanced programming skills and expertise in creative coding, contemporary AI or machine-learning methods, alongside a strong research profile in computational art or a related field. You will be able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and inspire postgraduate artists with varying levels of technical experience. You will bring a critical understanding of AI, including the cultural assumptions, representation and bias embedded in data and models, as well as a commitment to inclusive, supportive learning environments. A doctorate or equivalent professional or academic achievement is required, together with evidence of high-quality postgraduate teaching and research excellence. Join us At the RCA, you will join a collaborative, interdisciplinary community where art, technology and critical thinking come together to challenge conventions and imagine new possibilities. Contract: Permanent & full time, subject to a two-year probationary period. Help us shape the future of creative practice and AI at the world’s leading university for art and design. Closing for applications at 11.59pm on Wednesday 4th November 2026

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité RESTORE, a geroscience and rejuvenation research center Type de Contrat IT en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 31100 TOULOUSE Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 23/11/2026 Rémuneration 2300 Date limite de candidature : mardi 10 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Mener un stage de recherche de 3 ans dans le cadre du projet imHODA. Il est demandé de valoriser les travaux via des communications orales, poster et par au moins une publication dans une revue internationale avec comité de lecture. Ces travaux se feront à travers une collaboration avec le laboratoire de l’IMFT sous la direction de Mme Pauline Assémat. L'Activité WP1. Génération d’organoïdes / caractérisation moléculaire. T1.1 Cultures 3D d’organoïdes. Des cellules souches mésenchymateuses médullaires (BM-MSC) issues de donneurs d’âges différents (jeunes vs âgés) seront cultivées en 3D ; elles formeront spontanément des organoïdes ostéogéniques en 7 jours, selon une méthodologie décrite dans nos travaux précédents (publiés et brevetés). Par ailleurs, des organoïdes contenant des cellules sénescentes seront obtenus par co-culture de MSC avec des MSC rendues sénescentes par induction de stress. Les organoïdes seront collectés quotidiennement pour des analyses 3D utilisant diverses techniques de microscopie, ainsi que des analyses de biologie moléculaire (RT-qPCR quantitative), afin de caractériser l’expression de marqueurs ostéoblastiques (voir Tâche 1.2). T1.2 Caractérisation des organoïdes par imagerie (microscopie confocale, biphotonique, microscopie à feuille de lumière [lightsheet] et microscopie confocale 3D dédiée aux organoïdes) et par RT-qPCR quantitative. L’objectif est d’évaluer l’engagement lignée, les marqueurs de sénescence, les facteurs associés au phénotype sécrétoire lié à la sénescence (SASP), la différenciation vasculaire et la structure tissulaire, grâce à une imagerie 3D à haut contenu (high-content imaging). T1.3 Évaluation fonctionnelle du cil primaire. Différents marqueurs (ARL13B, γ-tubuline) seront utilisés pour visualiser le cil primaire dans les organoïdes, qu’ils contiennent ou non des cellules sénescentes. La longueur des cils primaires sera également mesurée, car elle influence la fonction de cette structure. Détails techniques : Organoïdes : Des BM-MSC immatures, isolées à partir de têtes fémorales ou de crêtes iliaques (issues de donneurs sains, équilibrés en termes de sexe et d’âge — jeunes/âgés), sont amplifiées en 2D, puis cultivées en 3D (agrégation induite en conditions de très faible adhérence) selon nos protocoles standardisés. Les MSC sénescentes sont obtenues par des traitements génotoxiques ou par exposition à des cytokines inflammatoires (phénomène de sénescence induite par le stress [SIPS] ; caractérisé par un marquage γH2AX, la présence d’inhibiteurs de CDK, une diminution de la lamine B1 et une augmentation des facteurs SASP). L’engagement dans la lignée ostéoblastique est évalué par RT-qPCR, immunobuvardage (Western blot) et microscopie 3D des marqueurs d’ostéogenèse ; les structures vasculaires sont identifiées grâce à des marqueurs endothéliaux et des marqueurs de péricytes (visualisation 3D par microscopie confocale et microscopie à feuille de lumière, système Opera Phenix® Plus HCS ; projet RESTORE). Votre Profil Compétences Poste de doctorant de 36 mois sur un projet de recherche financé par TIRIS au sein de l’équipe 2 Flames de l’institut Restore. Cet Institut est une unité de recherche rattachée à différentes tutelles (Inserm, CNRS, EFS-Occitanie, Univ. Toulouse 3, ENVT). Cet institut regroupe plus d’une centaine de personne réparties en 5 équipes dont l’objectif est de développer une recherche intégrée et pluri-disciplinaire (biologie cellulaire, physiologie, immunologie, ingénierie cellulaire et tissulaire, bio-informatique, mathématiques, biophysique, machine learning, IA), support à une médecine préventive et prédictive peu invasive et ciblée capable de limiter les troubles fonctionnels liés à l’âge. C’est au sein de l’équipe 2 que sont menées des recherches (et développement) sur les organoïdes mimant des tissus comme la moelle osseuse humaine. Votre Environnement de Travail Temps plein. 9h00-12h00 et 13h00-17h00. Certains déplacements pour missions extérieures (congrès, réunion de travail). Contraintes et risques Les contraintes et les risques sont liés à la culture cellulaire humaine issue de tissue sanguins et à la manipulation de produits chimiques clairement identifiés. Il sera demandé de suivre des formations pour être autorisé à faire ces expériences et à la manipulation de ces produits. items.desc: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we’ve become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Ensuring Authenticity for Billions of Daily Rewards Industry reports suggest 25 percent of global mobile ad spend is lost to fraudulent activities like click farms, fake installs, SDK spoofing, and emulator farms. At adjoe, we define our platform through trust and proactive engineering. We build high-performance defenses that guarantee accurate reward attribution, ensuring every interaction is authentic. This creates a sustainable value exchange that empowers our partners to grow with confidence. The Anti-Fraud team develops systems that detect and prevent malicious activity at scale. Our custom Android and iOS SDKs analyze device integrity for modifications like Xposed frameworks, Magisk modules, and jailbroken devices. Supporting these, Go microservices and DynamoDB deliver millisecond-level responses, while Kafka and SQS process billions of daily events in real time . This infrastructure protects publisher margins and ensures a trustworthy platform for all users. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: AdTech Domain & Anti-Fraud Core Requirement You bring a solid foundation in the AdTech ecosystem (publishers, advertisers, SDK attribution, monetization) and direct exposure to cheating in mobile games. Joining our Anti-Fraud Operations unit, you will act as the primary technical PoC for Support, Sales, and BI teams, owning complex fraud escalations and translating business edge cases into technical fixes. Investigative Mindset & Root-Cause Analysis You possess eagle-eyed curiosity and an investigative, hacker mindset. When publisher margins drop, external platforms (iOS/Android) shift, or campaigns misbehave, you won't wait for step-by-step instructions—you will connect messy clues, reproduce exploit scenarios, and trace non-obvious fraud patterns to their source. AI-Empowered Big Data Interrogation You will leverage AI tools alongside Trino SQL, ScyllaDB, and DynamoDB to rapidly query and analyze billions of daily telemetry events. You will direct AI to accelerate complex data analyses, build models, and surface bad actors in real time without getting bogged down in manual query assembly. Observability, Profiling & Microservice Debugging You will monitor platform health and debug system anomalies using Kibana, Grafana, and Go profiling tools like Pyroscope and pprof. You will trace real-time pipeline bottlenecks and API glitches across Kafka, SQS, and Go microservices to catch bugs or platform misconfigurations. Cross-Functional Fraud Mitigation & Pragmatic Engineering You bring a functional software development background in backend engineering (preferably Go) alongside experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, allowing you to comfortably navigate backend code logic. Collaborating with Backend, Mobile, and Data Science teams, you will use AI to draft clean code fixes, propose new detection rules, and take full responsibility for deploying verified mitigations that protect publisher margins. We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. items.desc: Bilthoven Gepromoveerd 36 uur Schaal 10 / €3.496 - €5.535 (bruto) Medisch / verzorging, Onderzoek / wetenschap Solliciteer voor 2 november 2026 Dit ga je doen Are you active in the field of immunology of infectious diseases and eager to contribute to better pandemic preparedness? As a bioinformatician at RIVM, you will analyze large-scale immunological and multi-omic datasets to untangle how the immune system defends against potential pandemic viruses. This role gives you the opportunity to deepen your technical expertise alongside experienced data scientists using state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical tools. You will see your data analyses inform public health decisions and future vaccine strategies. Your responsibilities As bioinformatician at RIVM you will be involved in multiple projects aimed at understanding immune responses to vaccination and infection, in particular projects investigating broadly reactive immunity to viruses with pandemic potential. You will be part of the broad-immunity team, which consists of three postdoctoral researchers, four technicians and a group leader, and you will be responsible for the analysis of multi-omic and high-dimensional immunological datasets from preclinical and clinical studies. These datasets include bulk RNA sequencing, single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), multimodal single-cell datasets incorporating cell hashing and oligonucleotide-tagged antibodies for surface protein detection (e.g. CITE-seq), single-cell T-cell receptor sequencing (scTCR-seq), and high-dimensional flow cytometry. You will be responsible for the analysis, processing and storage of large datasets in accordance with best practices for ensuring analytical reproducibility. For this purpose, you will use available computational workflows or design and implement new pipelines to address specific questions related to immune responses following infection or vaccination. Examples include the characterization of immune cell populations and their activation states, integration of transcriptomic, surface-protein and TCR repertoire information, and identification of potential biomarkers associated with immune protection or disease progression. Robust statistical analyses will form an integral part of this process. Finally, you contribute to academic research publications in collaboration with other team members, by visualizing and communicating the results, using state-of-the-art figures and data visualizations. You will join the centre's data team, consisting of several data scientists, data managers and bioinformaticians, to exchange expertise and develop and implement best practices for data analysis. The department The center for Immunology of Infectious Diseases and Vaccines (IIV) at RIVM is the knowledge center of the government in the field of immunology of infectious diseases and vaccines. The core mission of this center is to provide information and advice about effectiveness of vaccines, vaccination strategies and immune responses against infectious diseases to parties within the government and to the general public. The center collaborates intensively with other RIVM knowledge centers and national and international collaborators. Within IIV, the department of Immune Mechanisms - Immunological Models (IIM) specifically employs immunological models to understand immune responses to infection and vaccination. We are an international, dynamic, highly motivated department of 20+ scientists at different stages of our careers with a strong drive to push immunological research for the benefit of Public Health. We combine expertise in virology, immunology, molecular biology and bioinformatics and strongly believe in collaboration and teamwork. We highly value a psychologically safe working environment in which we learn from one another, mistakes are considered part of the learning process, and feedback is given in a constructive way in an informal, relaxed atmosphere. Monday is our fixed office day where we start over coffee, followed by our weekly department work discussion. Do you have any questions before applying? Please contact Jørgen at +316 311 423 89, he will be happy to answer your questions. We look forward to hearing from you. In the event of substantial interest in this vacancy, we may invite a larger group of candidates for a short 15-minute online interview, including a brief pitch and two or three predefined questions. items.desc: Data Steward - Sequencing & Phenotyping TU Delft & CropXR are looking for a Data Steward with a strong affinity for plant research, sequencing and phenotyping data. You will work closely with researchers to make sure that valuable research data is well organised, understandable, findable and reusable. Job description Your responsibilities You will be a bridge between research, data and the CropXR data infrastructure. Your work includes: Supporting researchers with data management throughout the research lifecycle, from experiment design and data collection to publication and long-term reuse. Working with sequencing and phenotyping data, including sample and plant-material information, experimental metadata, sensor and imaging data, and files such as FASTQ, BAM and VCF. Helping researchers describe experiments and datasets using consistent metadata and relevant standards, including MIAPPE, ISA and the CropXR Metadata Management Procedure. Making research data more FAIR by establishing practical conventions for file organisation, naming, identifiers, metadata, versioning and documentation. Reviewing datasets with researchers, identifying missing information, and advising on suitable formats, repositories, access conditions and data publication, including submissions to repositories such as ENA or NCBI. Job description The research to which this vacancy belongs is part of the “Mapping the Archaeological Pre-Columbian Heritage in South America – MAPHSA” project funded by Arcadia – a charitable fund of Lisbet Rausing and Peter Baldwin. items.desc: We are offering an exciting opportunity for Specialist Clinical Scientist (Medical Physics Expert, MPE) to join our team in a forward thinking radiotherapy physics department at the Velindre Cancer Service based in Velindre Hospital, Whitchurch, Cardiff. The post holder, in conjunction with other Medical Physics Experts (MPEs) and senior staff within the Radiotherapy Department, is responsible for ensuring the safe delivery of radiotherapy. They will act as Medical Physics Expert under the IR(ME)R 2017 legislation across all areas of radiotherapy, taking the lead in areas in which they have specific expertise e.g. treatment planning, dosimetry, imaging physics, RTTQA or computing. They will lead the implementation and commissioning of new technologies and techniques, provide specialist advice at MPE level to multidisciplinary teams and provide advice on the most complex patient treatment plans, radiobiology and dosimetric issues and provide expert support for clinical trials and research. Applicants who have not yet achieved MPE certification may be considered for appointment at Annex 21 @ 75% of the top of the fully qualified Band. See the Annexe 21 document for more details. Provide highly complex scientific and technical advice on imaging, treatment planning and dosimetric issues to radiotherapy consultants and other clinical staff regarding patient external beam radiotherapy treatments. Liaise with manufacturers and colleagues at other centres as necessary on issues related to radiotherapy treatments, imaging and image optimisation. Discuss with clinical staff and patients issues associated with Radiotherapy Treatment set up, radiobiological, dosimetric and other issues describing complex scientific information and its implications on the patient’s treatment. Present and disseminate clinical results through oral or poster presentations at local, national and international meetings and conferences and where appropriate prepare papers for publication in scientific journals. Teach the principles of Radiotherapy Physics to all disciplines in classroom and workplace settings. In accordance with IR(ME)R(2017), ensure all operators of relevant radiotherapy equipment have received sufficient training and achieved the required level of competency. Discuss the status of the quality system with internal and external auditors including justification of process changes, resolution of non-conformances and the reporting of reportable incidents according to IR(ME)R 2017 At Velindre University NHS Trust, we are proud to deliver specialist services across Wales through the Velindre Cancer Centre and Welsh Blood Service, supported by our corporate teams and partnerships with NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership and Health Technology Wales. As we look to the future, we are preparing for the opening of the new Velindre Cancer Centre (nVCC) in Spring 2027—an exciting milestone that will transform cancer care for our population. Located within easy reach of the vibrant city of Cardiff and the stunning Brecon Beacons, we offer a unique working environment that combines innovation, collaboration and an excellent quality of life. Since our formation in 1994, our dedicated workforce has remained committed to delivering the principles of prudent healthcare across a wide range of roles. We continue to play a vital role in our communities and have ambitious plans to further improve the services we provide. Everything we do is underpinned by our Trust values. We are caring, respectful, and accountable in how we work with patients, donors, partners and each other—ensuring we deliver the highest standards of care while continuously striving to improve. If you want to work for an organisation that makes a real difference, embraces innovation, and offers rewarding career opportunities in an inspiring setting, Velindre University NHS Trust is the place for you. items.desc: Computational Biologist Oxford Centre for Diabetes Endocrinology and Metabolism (OCDEM), Churchill Hospital, Old Road, Headington, Oxford, OX3 7LE Grade 7: £39,424 - £47,779 per annum An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Computational Biologist to lead the core computational analyses for a British Heart Foundation-funded project investigating how RSPO3 regulates human body fat distribution and cardiometabolic risk. The study combines recall-by-genotype human phenotyping with single-nucleus RNA sequencing of abdominal and gluteal adipose tissue, large-scale proteomic datasets and genetic analyses. You will analyse and integrate these data to define the cellular and molecular effects of RSPO3 and identify pathways linking adipose tissue biology to cardiometabolic disease. We are seeking a highly motivated Bioinformatician to lead the core computational analyses for a British Heart Foundation-funded three-year project investigating how RSPO3 regulates human body fat distribution and cardiometabolic risk. The study combines recall-by-genotype human phenotyping with single-nucleus RNA sequencing of abdominal and gluteal adipose tissue, large-scale proteomic datasets and genetic analyses. The postholder will analyse and integrate these data to define the cellular and molecular effects of RSPO3 and identify pathways linking adipose tissue biology to cardiometabolic disease. The appointee will bring strong computational and statistical skills and work closely with experts in adipose tissue biology, single-cell genomics and statistical genetics. The role offers substantial scope for intellectual contribution, method development, first-author publications and presentation of findings at national and international meetings. The position is full time and fixed term for 3 years in the first instance. The position will be based at OCDEM, Churchill Hospital, Oxford. For informal enquiries, please contact Ruby Ramsamy at ocdem.personnel@ndm.ox.ac.uk Please quote reference 189348 on all correspondence. As part of your formal online application, you will be required to upload a CV and supporting statement. Only applications received before midday on Tuesday, 10 November 2026 can be considered. Interviews are scheduled for the W/C 30 November 2026.

The selected candidate will collaborate closely with both the orthogeriatric and orthopaedic teams to deliver essential medical support and maintain consistent care for the patient population in this specific cohort. This role is ward based only to support foundation doctors. This responsibility involves working in tandem with junior doctors within the team and the broader multidisciplinary group. The primary objectives include ensuring patient safety, enhancing overall patient experience, and optimizing the patient flow through collaborative efforts and effective medical oversight. Ashford and St. Peters Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is the largest provider of acute hospital services to Surrey residents, serving a population of 410,00 people and employing approximately 4,800 staff. Our vision is to provide an outstanding experience and best outcomes for patients and the team. We are committed to providing continuous professional development and flexibility to deliver our workforce plan. We work in partnership with Royal Surrey Hospital NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. St Peter’s Hospital delivers complex medical and surgical care, maternity and emergency services. Day and Orthopaedic surgery, ophthalmology and outpatient services are delivered at Ashford Hospital. Additional services are delivered at Woking Community Hospital. Our Values provide us with the behaviours we respect and can commit to. By living our values through our everyday interactions, we can build a stronger, more resilient, and forward- thinking organisation, guiding us to achieve success and make a positive impact on how we deliver our services. We can offer you the full range of NHS benefits and discounts. Please note that adverts may close early, so early application is encouraged. For more information about careers at ASPH please visit: www.asph-careers.org The successful candidate will be a crucial part of the healthcare team, primarily stationed on Swan Ward while occasionally extending their expertise to patients in Heron and Falcon Ward. These wards cater to a diverse patient population, all of whom are under the specialized care of either orthopaedic or orthogeriatric consultants. The candidate will work closely with experienced orthogeriatricians, receiving valuable guidance and mentorship to provide comprehensive medical coverage. A significant aspect of this position involves supporting the junior members of the orthopaedic team. By offering medical expertise and guidance, the candidate will ensure the timely and effective management of various medical issues that patients may face during their stay. This involves not only the technical aspects of medical care but also effective communication with patients' families, providing them with the necessary information and reassurance. Furthermore, active participation in discharge planning alongside the wider Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) is a key responsibility. This collaborative approach ensures that patients receive well-coordinated and holistic care, not just within the hospital but also upon their transition back to their homes or other care facilities. The candidate will play a vital role in facilitating this smooth transition, addressing the medical, emotional, and logistical aspects of each patient's journey. In addition to the clinical responsibilities, this role offers exciting opportunities for educational and teaching activities. The candidate will have the chance to impart knowledge and expertise to both medical professionals and students, contributing to the growth and development of the healthcare community. Moreover, the department places a strong emphasis on research, quality improvement, and publications. The successful candidate is actively encouraged to engage with these activities. In doing so, they will have the opportunity to contribute to the advancement of medical knowledge, participate in quality enhancement initiatives, and share their insights and findings with the broader medical community. This involvement not only enriches the candidate's professional experience but also contributes significantly to the overall progress and innovation within the field of healthcare. Overall, this role offers a comprehensive and enriching experience, combining clinical expertise, educational opportunities, and active involvement in research and quality improvement efforts. The candidate will be an integral part of a dynamic and forward-thinking healthcare team, making meaningful contributions to patient care, education, and the advancement of medical knowledge.

We are proud to be one of the first companies to protect mainframes with our cutting edge precision liquid cooling systems. We were the first to introduce an integrated enclosure system to distributed networks. We help some of the largest names in the industry bring new capacity online faster and at a lower cost, at a time when AI increased demand for storage and computing is changing the data centre landscape as we know it. Our portfolio spans power, thermal and infrastructure management products, software and solutions, and is complemented by a network of nearly 250 service centres worldwide. As Service Project Technician you will be responsible for helping the company to develop and maintain strong commercial growth through coordinating projects in a challenging team environment. items.desc: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. Vous rejoignez le département Vision et traitement d'images de MBDA France. Ce département est responsable de la conception, du développement et de la validation des algorithmes de traitement d'images pour les effecteurs (missiles, drones), les postes de tir ou les conduites de tir à partir d'Imagerie optique ou radar ainsi que des aspects système et des modules de préparation de mission associés. Les activités du département s’étendent de la recherche amont sur les sujets les plus innovants – deep learning, modélisation 3D, décision/fusion, autonomie – à la réalisation des algorithmes finaux intégrés dans les produits MBDA. Afin de développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes basées sur le deep learning, nous recherchons un expert en Deep Learning spécialisé en traitement d’images pour concevoir et déployer de futurs modèles, en lien avec les autres experts en Traitement d’Images et IA et avec l’ensemble du département. Au Quotidien, Vous Aurez La Charge De Suivre l’état de l’art et prototyper ou/et faire explorer de nouvelles approches afin de permettre l’intégration de l’état de l’art aux projets MBDA. Entrainer et optimiser des modèles de deep learning (CNN, Transformers, modèles de diffusion) adaptés au Traitement d’images (détection, segmentation classification). Prendre en charge la mise en place des pipelines complets d'applicatifs IA, et participer à l'évolution de la méthodologie IA pour l'ensemble du département. Participer à la définition des roadmaps technologiques à court et moyen terme des travaux à mener en deep learning pour le département. Proposer, piloter et/ou valider des études de R&T. Sélectionner les modèles et outils à introduire dans nos lignes de produits. Émettre des recommandations techniques dans le cadre des revues de conception, de livraisons, des revues de pairs ou internes métiers. Emettre un avis lors de l’établissement des propositions techniques et financières. Développer des relations avec des universités, des entreprises innovantes (dont PMEs) ou des laboratoires afin de promouvoir des technologies innovantes et de contribuer à leur montée en maturité en cohérence avec les besoins futurs de MBDA. Contribuer à la gestion de la connaissance du métier : Contribuer à la capitalisation des connaissances et bonnes pratiques métier, notamment à travers la rédaction de processus et guides métier, Accompagner et développer les connaissances des membres de l’équipe métier, Élaborer des modules de formations techniques pour son domaine métier, et les dispenser, en interne ou en externe, Proposer des évolutions métier (outils, moyens de laboratoire, …) et produits. Vous justifiez de plus de 10 ans d’expérience , avec au moins : une expérience significative en développement d'algorithme de traitement d'images, une expérience significative d'entrainement et déploiement d'IA pour la vision par ordinateur, une expérience significative dans la mise en œuvre du MLOPS (Machine Learning Operations). Vous disposez de compétences techniques spécifiques en : Traitement d’Images et IA Mathématiques appliquées Langages et outils : Python, C++, C OpenCV, Pytorch Linux, Git MLFlow, Gitlab, DVC, Docker, Airflow,Temporal Vous devrez faire preuve d’autonomie en particulier pour être force de proposition sur les travaux à réaliser et avoir un bon esprit de synthèse pour définir la feuille de route au moins cours terme. Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

With our software, we enable hospitals, doctors & nurses to provide their patients with the best possible care. Experience from e-commerce, streaming, media, marketplaces or ad tech counts. Your job title matters less than what you've built. Why you'll like it Real scale: your models reach millions of players worldwide. Real ownership: you own problems from idea to production. Real growth: learn alongside data scientists, ML engineers and data engineers who ship. Modern stack: deep learning, cloud ML and real-time data, with room to test new ideas.

items.desc: Athenco, fondée en juin 2020 et filiale du groupe TeamWork depuis le 1er janvier 2023, est une société spécialisée reconnue pour son expertise en matière d'industrialisation et d'automatisation des tests pour les environnements SAP et hors SAP. What You Will Do Join us as our first dedicated Data Scientist to bring order to the chaos of culture. You'll extract insights from hard-to-reach data sources to tackle the big questions: What cultural trends are emerging that everyone else is missing? How can we predict virality? And what characterizes an underserved category? We sit on a lot of data we do not use yet, and you are the person who turns it into decisions. You work fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, next to a backend engineer who owns the pipelines and infrastructure, so your time goes into the questions rather than the plumbing. On a typical day, your tasks may include: New data sources: discovering and opening up untapped sources, with creative scraping and acquisition techniques when standard APIs run out Trends and audiences: analyzing trends, audience behavior and performance across streaming and social to find the underserved categories and the next growth opportunity, and proposing the next step Prediction: prototyping and deploying ML models on AWS for virality prediction and content analysis, and checking whether they hold up in production Experiments: designing and reading A/B tests, holdouts and spend experiments across our releases and campaigns, and telling the team where the next dollar should go Numbers people trust: owning the dashboards and reports leadership runs on, and investigating what really drives a metric when it moves AI-native workflows: using LLMs and agentic coding tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis and reporting Who You Are We look for battle-tested data scientists who understand that real impact comes from turning messy, unstructured data into business-critical insights that drive company direction. You don't just build models: you solve business problems by finding creative ways to access hard-to-reach data and translating statistical findings into actions the team takes. Typically, Your Profile Will Look Like This Background: a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Math or a related quantitative field Experience: 3 or more years of hands-on data science in fast-paced business environments, at Tier 1 consultancies, Big Tech, high-growth start-ups and scale-ups, or media industry leaders Python: expert-level proficiency with the standard data science and ML frameworks, and SQL as a daily tool Data acquisition: you have scraped and acquired raw data from new sources, building creative solutions to reach datasets beyond standard APIs Statistical rigour: you design and read experiments properly, you know when a signal is noise, and you have run A/B tests or causal analyses that changed a decision Models in production: you have deployed models that people actually used, and you know what it takes to keep them honest over time AI-native: extensive hands-on experience with agentic coding tools and LLMs in your data workflows From data to decision: you find the opportunity in the data and propose the next step, and your dashboards and visualizations (standard libraries or Tableau) are the ones leadership trusts Collaboration: you work well across engineering, product and business teams, and colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you're obsessed with music, video or social media What Makes This Exciting You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. items.desc: Ben jij een AI-ontwikkelaar die technologie wil inzetten voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken? Wil jij werken aan integratie van (generatieve) AI, databronnen en intelligente zoekoplossingen én wil jij bijdragen aan een gemeente die data en AI verantwoord inzet voor inwoners, beleid en dienstverlening? Hier begint het! Hier werk je aan mee De afdeling Onderzoek, Informatie en Statistiek Groningen (OIS Groningen) levert kennis, informatie en data-oplossingen voor beleidsvorming en bedrijfsvoering van de gemeente Groningen. OIS houdt zich bezig met onderzoek, datascience, business intelligence, datawarehousing en informatievoorziening. De komende jaren wil de gemeente Groningen de mogelijkheden van kunstmatige intelligentie verder ontwikkelen. Bijvoorbeeld door AI-assistenten voor medewerkers, transcribeertooling waarbij gevoelige gegevens lokaal verwerkt worden in plaats van in de cloud, intelligente zoek- en vraag-antwoordoplossingen en geautomatiseerde analyse van documenten. Hier ga jij je mee bezig houden Als AI-Ontwikkelaar bouw jij niet alleen slimme toepassingen, maar werk jij ook mee aan een AI-landschap waarin data, modellen en infrastructuur zoveel mogelijk onder eigen regie blijven. Jij ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en beheert AI-oplossingen die aansluiten op de informatiebehoefte van de gemeente Groningen. Daarbij gebruik jij moderne AI-technologieën zoals Large Language Models (LLM's), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search en agent-gebaseerde toepassingen. Jij ontwikkelt AI-toepassingen die lokaal worden gehost binnen de gemeentelijke infrastructuur. Jouw Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit het ontwikkelen van AI-toepassingen voor medewerkers en beleidsmakers; het bouwen van RAG-oplossingen die informatie ophalen uit gemeentelijke documenten en registratiesystemen; het ontwikkelen van intelligente zoek- en antwoordsystemen; het ontwerpen van datamodellen voor AI-toepassingen; het in productie brengen van lokaal gehoste AI-toepassingen die draaien op eigen infrastructuur; het ontwerpen en implementeren van interfaces voor gebruikers; bijdragen aan AI-governance, privacy, veiligheid en uitlegbaarheid; het adviseren van collega's over de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van AI; het uitvoeren van experimenten, proof-of-concepts en innovatietrajecten; samenwerken met onderzoekers, data scientists, BI-specialisten en datawarehouseontwikkelaars. Hier kom je te werken De AI-Ontwikkelaar maakt onderdeel uit van OIS Groningen, onderdeel van de directie Informatie & Services binnen het Shared Service Center van de gemeente Groningen. Jij werkt samen met de andere AI-ontwikkelaars, onderzoekers, data scientists, datawarehouse-ontwikkelaars en informatieadviseurs. Binnen OIS krijg jij de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en innovaties daadwerkelijk in productie te brengen. Hier herken jij je in Jij bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en houdt ervan om nieuwe technologie praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Jij kunt complexe technische vraagstukken vertalen naar oplossingen die collega's daadwerkelijk helpen. Daarnaast Beschik Jij Ook Over een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Artificial Intelligence, Informatiekunde, Data Science, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare opleiding; werkervaring met Python, NumPy, Docker, Django, Linux en Transformers, PyTorch; ervaring met AI-ontwikkeling, LLM's en API’s; kennis van retrieval, embeddings, vector databases en RAG-architecturen, SQL, Git en moderne softwareontwikkelmethoden; affiniteit met overheidsinformatie, privacy en informatiebeveiliging. Ervaring met het zelf hosten van LLM’s of andere lokale AI modellen, user interfaces, in productie brengen van AI modellen op lokale hardware (niet cloud), AI-governance en Responsible AI, zijn een pré. Hier kun je op rekenen afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring: een salaris van maximaal € 5.624,- bij een fulltime dienstverband (functioneel schaal 10, HR21 normfunctie Medewerker Gegevens I); een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; een individueel keuzebudget van 17,05% boven op je salaris waarbij je kunt kiezen voor een jaarlijkse of maandelijkse uitbetaling; een werkweek van 32-36 uur, met de mogelijkheid om ADV op te bouwen en hybride te werken (incl. thuiswerkvergoeding); je bouwt pensioen op via ABP, waarbij wij het grootste deel (70%) van de premie betalen; een passende reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werk; bekijk hier meer informatie over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en reiskostenregeling; een digitale leeromgeving, personeels- en jongerenvereniging en thuiswerkfaciliteiten; maar bovenal: een ontzettend gezellige afdeling! Hier beginnen? Voor meer informatie over de inhoud van de functie, kun je contact opnemen met Jeanine Vosselman, afdelingshoofd Onderzoek, Informatie & Statistiek, telefoonnummer 06-5074 9964. Voor meer informatie over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met Yasemin Leidsman-Kucuk, Corporate recruiter, op het telefoonnummer 06-1562 9155 (ook via WhatsApp bereikbaar). …

items.desc: Data Scientist, Recommender Systems | Remote | Python, PyTorch, Deep Learning Millions of players. Thousands of games. One question: what should they play next? We're hiring a Data Scientist specialising in Recommender Systems for a fast-growing global gaming technology company. You'll build the machine-learning models that decide what millions of players discover, and you'll see your work go live, not sit in a notebook. What you'll actually do Build recommendation models. Candidate generation, retrieval and ranking that make every player's lobby feel personal. Predict what's next. Use sequential behaviour, user and item embeddings and deep learning for next-item prediction. Ship to production. Take models from data and experiments through deployment and monitoring, then keep improving them. Prove it works. Run offline evaluation and A/B testing, and connect model quality to real product results. Try new things. Test transformer-based recommendation, two-tower models and multimodal signals where they genuinely help. What you'll bring Around 3–5 years of hands-on experience in machine learning , with real work on recommender systems, personalisation or ranking Strong Python and SQL Deep-learning experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX Models you've taken to production on AWS, GCP or Azure The ability to explain what you built, why, and what changed because of it Bonus points (not dealbreakers) Two-tower models, learning to rank, ANN search, cold start, session-based recommendations, MLOps, Spark, Kafka or Flink. Experience from e-commerce, streaming, media, marketplaces or ad tech counts. Your job title matters less than what you've built. Why you'll like it Real scale: your models reach millions of players worldwide. Real ownership: you own problems from idea to production. Real growth: learn alongside data scientists, ML engineers and data engineers who ship. Modern stack: deep learning, cloud ML and real-time data, with room to test new ideas.

Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries.
