Job Description We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to drive technical excellence in our AI initiatives. You will act with high-impact projects, serving as a hands-on guide for the teams and a trusted advisor for strategic decisions. Your focus is on building and scaling intelligent systems. In this role, you will: Act as the Tech Lead for complex AI projects, ensuring high-quality implementation and technical rigor. Design and optimize production-ready AI solutions, moving beyond prototypes to scalable systems. Experiment with and implement cutting-edge Generative AI, LLMs, and Multi-agent systems to solve real-world problems. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering growth and best practices within the team. Work closely with the Area Manager to align technical roadmaps with business goals. Stay at the forefront of AI advancements, proactively identifying new tools and techniques to integrate into our stack. Qualifications Proven track record of developing and deploying AI/ML models in production environments. Strong foundation in classical ML, with deep practical experience in Generative AI, LLMs, and Multi-agent systems. Proficiency in Python and core frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn. Experience with advanced decision-support systems, real-time predictive modeling, and optimization techniques. Solid understanding of data pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including Docker and Kubernetes. Expertise in model evaluation, feature engineering, and ensuring model interpretability/reliability. Experience with graph-based algorithms, time-series forecasting, or probabilistic models. Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field (Advanced degrees are welcome). Additional Information The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. We are convinced that diversity contributes to the creativity, dynamism and excellence of our organization. All of our vacancies are open to people with disabilities.

items.desc: At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. Your role Within the Financial Services domain, you will help address business challenges by applying AI solutions to real‑world financial use cases. The role combines Generative and Agentic AI with a strong understanding of financial processes to support automation and decision‑making, delivered in close collaboration with business stakeholders, finance experts and technical teams. Your tasks You will contribute to AI initiatives and support the delivery of modern AI solutions across the financial industry. Your responsibilities will include: Designing and implementing AI solutions, including Generative AI, LLM based workflows and Agentic AI components, supporting automated and assisted decision making in financial processes. Executing end to end testing of AI solutions and AI agent workflows, ensuring accuracy, reliability and alignment with business and regulatory expectations. Collaborating with SMEs and technical teams to design, implement and optimize data pipelines for AI model training, inference and agent execution. Evaluating model and agent performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement with a focus on accuracy, compliance, explainability and iterative enhancement. Identifying reusable Gen AI and Agentic AI components and patterns that can be leveraged across ongoing and future projects. Your profile Practical banking/financial industry experience with Generative AI and/or Agentic AI, including LLM based workflows, prompt engineering and orchestration of multi-step AI or agent workflows. Very good Python and SQL skills, with hands on experience in cloud based data platforms and databases, supporting end to end LLM based solutions. Good understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical and AI related concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Degree in Finance, Mathematics, Data Science or a related quantitative or technical field. Nice to Have: Hands on exposure to infrastructure and automation tools such as Terraform, GitHub CI/CD, Kubernetes or similar platforms. Familiarity with financial workflows such as risk modeling, valuation, forecasting, regulatory reporting or fraud detection. Basic knowledge of architecture design principles across IT and AI systems. What You'll Love About Working Here Practical benefits: yearly financial bonus, private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and access to NAIS benefit platform. Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Excel, Business Analysis, Project Management) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, TED Talks and Udemy Business materials and trainings. Cutting-Edge Technology: Position yourself at the forefront of IT innovation, working with the latest technologies and platforms. Capgemini partners with top global enterprises, including 145 Fortune 500 companies. Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details. Get to know us Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued. Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska. You can also find us on YouTube. About Capgemini Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. In questo ruolo, entrerai in un contesto tecnologico strutturato, orientato ad architetture moderne a microservizi. Lavorerai su soluzioni basate su tecnologia Microsoft, partecipando allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione di applicazioni Back-End ad alta affidabilità e scalabilità, integrando componenti e servizi di Intelligenza Artificiale. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team di sviluppo e con le altre funzioni tecniche coinvolte nei progetti, contribuendo attivamente sia all’implementazione delle soluzioni sia alle scelte progettuali. Collaborerai dunque allo sviluppo di soluzioni che includono componenti AI e svilupperai Agentic AI. Cosa offriamo Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall’incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, una RAL compresa tra i 35-40K, e un pacchetto di benefit solido: variabile, assicurazione sanitaria (CCNL Commercio), buoni pasto, welfare, e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning. items.desc: Are you a developer with an AI-native engineering mindset who takes pride in building rock-solid, critical software? We at Talented are looking for a Software Developer - AI Champion to join our client Jetico as a key technical anchor for their expanding R&D team in Espoo, Finland. Jetico is a Finnish cybersecurity pioneer specializing in endpoint data protection across the complete data lifecycle. Trusted in more than 100 countries by defense and government agencies, national laboratories, industrial manufacturers, and security-conscious enterprises, Jetico develops world-class data encryption and data sanitization solutions that leave zero room for error. Your mission will be to modernize how Jetico builds software: championing AI-assisted development, embedding security-by-design and shaping a unified cross-product architecture. This spans everything from AI-assisted hands-on implementation and refactoring to integrating AI tools into CI/CD pipelines and team-wide engineering practices. In this role, you will Champion practical AI workflows: Drive the adoption of secure, on-prem AI tools and automated practices across the development team. Own architecture and dependencies: Identify technical debt and manage releases across interconnected products, gradually taking greater ownership of the system. Engineering support & problem-solving: Collaborate closely with Lead Developers to resolve technical issues, explore existing codebases, and unblock everyday engineering challenges. What we are looking for We are looking for a mid- to senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals who naturally leverages AI in daily development workflows. You are a pragmatic problem-solver who works autonomously, champions code quality, and brings fresh ideas while respecting our battle-tested systems. AI is a natural part of your daily engineering toolchain, always guided by solid technical judgment. To succeed in this role, you bring Previous professional experience in software development Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to work across an existing, multi-product codebase Frontier AI models: previous hands-on experience with models from OpenAI or Anthropic. AI coding tools and agentic workflows: experience with tools such as OpenAI Codex or Anthropic Claude Code (aka harnesses), as well as agentic software development workflows. AI-native development experience: confident use of modern AI coding tools for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, code understanding, and technical research Ability to distinguish where AI accelerates engineering work and where human review, security controls, and deeper architectural judgment are essential Interest in establishing AI-assisted engineering practices across the development team, rather than using AI only as an individual productivity tool Experience with, or strong interest in, cybersecurity / security software Ability to understand dependencies across several products and contribute to coordinated releases Ability to gradually take ownership of architecture and cross-product technical direction Currently, most of Jetico's R&D team is distributed across Europe. However, this role will become an important anchor for the R&D organization in Finland as Jetico expands its local team. Therefore, you should be comfortable working in a distributed international team as well as working in a hybrid model with the team at the office in Otaniemi, Espoo. Why Jetico? Jetico is a small but mighty company offering a rare commodity in modern tech: grounded stability and exceptionally long developer tenures, as most of their engineers have been with the company for over a decade. You’ll be backed by a close-knit team that genuinely has your back. Paired with true autonomy and trust in your expertise, you’ll get to join a small team where your contribution will be visible and meaningful. Jetico is looking for someone who wants to grow alongside the business. For the right candidate, there is significant room to expand your expertise in directions that align with your interests. If you thrive in a purpose-driven role and are excited about pushing the boundaries of AI in cybersecurity, we’d love to hear from you! Interested? Leave us your CV and cover letter, telling us more about your prior experience with AI. The recruitment is done in co-operation between Talented & Jetico. Talented will be handling all of the applications, and will be the one to reach out to each of the candidates. Please note that the position will be filled as soon as possible. The recruitment process: Screening interview with Talented’s recruitment consultant Live interview with Jetico’s COO and CEO Meet the rest of the R&D Team Offer and Contract

items.desc: You think AI is coming for data jobs? It's coming for the boring half. AI is taking over more of the technical work, and nobody in data will pretend otherwise. Cleaning a dataset, writing a query, building a first model: a lot of it now takes minutes instead of days. That doesn't make you less needed. It changes what you're needed for. Someone still has to understand what the business is truly struggling with, separate hype from impact, decide which problem is worth solving first, and get people to trust and use what gets built. That bridge between technology, business and people is where the value sits now, and no agent is taking it over. And that's where you come in. The next generation of AI and data talent, who build what the business actually needs and get people on board to use it. Sounds like the better half, doesn't it? The traineeship in short Belgian companies are investing in AI and data, but many are still working out what to do with it. Building isn't the bottleneck anymore. Making it land in the business is. So we built a traineeship that develops exactly that. Here's how. By learning it three ways at once. 26 months, one contract with Ormit Talent, and two to three assignments at client companies. You keep sharpening your AI and data skills, and build the business sense and people skills that turn them into results. By doing it. Real AI and data challenges at our clients. With others. A coach, a technical mentor, an assignment manager, and a group of peers in the same boat. In training. Training days on business and people skills, real client cases and peer exchanges give everyone the same foundation. A personal learning budget lets you go deeper where it matters most to you. What makes a NextGen AI & Data Talent It's not how much tech you know. It's what you do with it. We looked at what the AI and data assignments at our clients really ask, and kept finding the same six skillsets. Together, they're what it takes to make a lasting difference in a business: hard skills and human skills in one. Which assignments will you get? We can't tell you yet, and each one leans on a different mix. What we can tell you: over 26 months, you get to know all six, and your training, coach and mentor help you get good at them. Problem definition and feasibility. Where every good project starts. You turn a vague request into a question data can answer. Which decision does it support, what does success look like, and is the data even there? Sometimes the honest answer is that AI or data is the wrong lever. Saying so is part of the job. Data exploration, analysis, and reasoning. The hands-on part. You clean, explore and test datasets. You find the quality issues, the anomalies and the limits, and you challenge the analysis someone else hands you. SQL and Excel to start, Python and hypothesis testing as you go deeper. Insights and value creation. Where data turns into decisions. You build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau that someone actually decides with, not reports that describe what already happened. Plus the storytelling that gets them read. Automation, tooling and smart enablement. Where the manual work disappears. You spot the tasks that keep coming back and get rid of them, with Power Automate, a Python script, an API, or an AI agent where it earns its place. And you judge a tool on what it delivers, not on how new it is. Responsible AI and data use. Where trust gets built. You check for bias and data quality, explain what a model does and doesn't do, and know which rules you're working under before someone from legal asks. Translation to business and IT. Where it all lands. You explain the constraint to the business and the priority to the data engineers. And you set expectations before the work starts, not when the deadline moves. How you get there AI and data skills, business sense and people skills. Most data jobs sharpen one and leave the other two to chance. Here, you build all three at the same time. 01 Sharpen your AI and data skills You learn on the job. Every assignment hands you a little more responsibility than the last. Next to you is a technical mentor: someone who knows the craft, challenges your tooling and approach, and answers the questions a coach can't. 02 Build your business sense Different teams, different sectors, different starting points. You see how Belgian companies really work with AI and data, and learn to read each new context faster. Then you put it to the test. In a hackathon and a real client case, you sit in the decision maker's seat and weigh opportunities, risks and competing priorities, not just the data question. Experts watch and give you feedback on your approach. 03 Grow your people skills Training that starts with you. First you discover who you are. From there you build towards working better with others, getting to the core of what a business needs from you, and bringing people along. Your own coach helps you widen your range, until the hard situations stop …

Talenten die je inzet om de digitale ervaring van onze gebruikers continu te verbeteren. We zoeken een vaardige en ervaren AI Engineer met bewezen ervaring in het bouwen van solide end‑to‑end klantgerichte producten, die kan helpen om van POC’s naar productie‑rijpe oplossingen te gaan, met focus op betrouwbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. De ideale kandidaat heeft een sterke achtergrond in .NET‑ en Angular‑ontwikkeling en hands‑on ervaring met Azure en Azure DevOps. Je brengt een zeldzame combinatie van front‑end, back‑end en toegepaste AI‑vaardigheden mee, en je weet hoe je die kunt gebruiken om complexe uitdagingen om te zetten in praktische, gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen. Je bloeit op wanneer je samenwerkt met data engineers en data scientists en hen helpt een software‑engineeringmindset te omarmen. Je vindt het leuk om anderen te coachen en trainen, best practices te delen en teams in staat te stellen hun engineeringskills en manier van werken continu te verbeteren. Je hebt ook ervaring met: Software engineering 3–5 jaar ervaring met het bouwen van applicaties, met sterke hands‑on ervaring in C# en TypeScript. Ervaring met Python is een plus, vooral voor AI‑prototyping, automatisering of werken met data. Ervaring met Azure en Azure DevOps, inclusief geautomatiseerde build‑ en release‑pipelines. Ervaring met Databricks is een plus. Een praktische mindset: je schrijft graag schone, onderhoudbare code die werkt in real‑life omgevingen. Front‑end development Solide ervaring met Angular. Goede werkkennis van JavaScript, TypeScript, RxJS, HTML5 en CSS. De capaciteit om responsive, gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces te bouwen voor datarijke applicaties. Back‑end en API’s Sterke ervaring met het ontwikkelen en integreren van RESTful API’s, bij voorkeur met hands‑on ervaring in .NET. Je voelt je comfortabel bij het verbinden van front‑endapplicaties, back‑endservices en externe systemen. Toegepaste AI Ervaring met het bouwen van applicaties of prototypes met LLM‑API’s zoals OpenAI, Anthropic of Gemini. Bekendheid met LLM‑concepten zoals prompting, tool calling, gestructureerde outputs en evaluatie. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe AI‑ontwikkelingen en enthousiast om ideeën om te zetten in praktische oplossingen. Als iemand “Responses” of “Completions” zegt, weet je dat het waarschijnlijk niet over klanttevredenheidsenquêtes gaat. Hoe jij werkt Goede beheersing van het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Van nature nieuwsgierig, zelf‑gemotiveerd en leergierig. Je voelt je comfortabel bij experimenteren, vragen stellen en ideeën delen met het team. Je vindt het leuk om een ambitieuze doelstelling te krijgen en uit te zoeken hoe je daar komt, door je front‑end, back‑end en toegepaste AI‑skills te combineren en zo ideeën om te zetten in praktische, waardevolle oplossingen. Zet je volgende stap bij Van Lanschot Kempen Samen met uiteenlopende klanten toekomstgerichter, duurzamer en datagedreven beleggen. Zowel nationaal als internationaal. Met ruim 300 jaar ervaring maken we van die ambitie realiteit bij Van Lanschot Kempen. Dat doen we met zo’n 2.300 collega’s verdeeld over verschillende expertises. Als onderdeel van het AIRCAT & People Analytics Team (AI Risk Compliance Team) werk je aan data‑ en AI‑oplossingen die Van Lanschot Kempen helpen om in control te blijven op privacy en andere niet‑financiële risico’s. Het team combineert data engineering, analytics en AI om praktische tools te bouwen voor Non‑Financial Risk & Risk Management, Internal Control, HR en Compliance. We werken nauw samen met stakeholders, zetten feedback om in verbeteringen en focussen op robuuste, verantwoorde oplossingen …

items.desc: Software Developer – AI-Native Business Solutions Build agents that do more than answer questions. Help people get work done. We are looking for a developer to build agentic solutions for our customers’ business processes. You will combine software development, data, and business understanding: defining the problem together with the team, building a working solution, evaluating its impact, and improving it based on feedback. The goal is not an impressive demo, but a useful, controlled, and maintainable service. What will you get to work on? You build agentic workflows to support areas such as customer work, service delivery, or project work. A solution might compile a situational overview, prepare the next action, or update a system according to an approved operating model. You develop focused prototypes and take them towards production together with architects, business experts, and the customer. You develop tools and reusable capabilities for agents, as well as integrations using API and MCP interfaces. You connect solutions to CRM, document sources, and other business systems. You build information retrieval and context-handling solutions that preserve source information, permissions, freshness, and data provenance. You implement operational boundaries in code, including access checks, input validation, approval points, and error handling. You take care of automated testing, evaluation datasets for agents, deployment pipelines, and monitoring. You measure quality, latency, and cost, and ensure that recovery and rollback paths are in place. What do we expect from you? A strong foundation in software development and experience taking solutions into production. You know how to build and maintain more than just a prototype. Experience with API integrations, cloud services, and data processing, as well as skills in technologies such as TypeScript, Python, or C#. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and with using agents or generative AI in your own projects or customer projects. The ability to break down a business problem into implementable stages, make quality-related trade-offs visible, and communicate fluently in Finnish and English. What kind of expertise will help you succeed? We value experience with Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure, agent orchestration, MCP, information retrieval, and Dataverse. You do not need to know every framework. More important is your ability to learn quickly, choose the right implementation for the purpose, and recognise when conventional software workflow is a better solution than an agent. How do we work with AI? GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or a similar tool is part of the development process, not just code autocomplete. You use agents to support requirements analysis, implementation, testing, and documentation. You make goals and acceptance criteria explicit, review the outputs, and remain responsible for the end result. When evaluating solutions, you also test failure scenarios: missing context, an incorrect source, a prohibited action, or an integration failure. You make sure that a convincing response does not hide incorrect information or a failed action. Autonomy is increased only when quality and controls have been demonstrated. What does this role offer you? You will build end-to-end solutions where the user interface, agents, context, and backend systems work together. You will have room to experiment, while also having the support of an experienced team in building production-ready solutions. The success of your work is measured by how well it helps the customer’s users and processes, not by the number of agents. Why Twoday? We combine the agility of customer-focused teams with the support of a broad expert community. You will work alongside specialists in business applications, software development, data, AI, and cloud platforms. We share what we learn and build solutions together, so you do not need to know everything on your own. You will receive support for your professional development through training, community learning events, conferences, and online learning environments. Our benefits include lunch and recreational benefits, as well as comprehensive occupational healthcare including mental wellbeing support services. We offer flexible remote working opportunities and the possibility to influence your choice of work equipment. Our community is built through approachable colleagues, office breakfasts, hobby clubs, and shared activities. Interested? Apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. A separate cover letter is optional; please answer the screening questions on the application form. Tell us about one solution you have built: what problem did it solve, what was your role, and how did you ensure its quality? You can also use a personal project as your example. Please note that we can only proceed with applicants who have a valid right to work in Finland. Working at Twoday Twoday is a leading technology consulting company helping …

items.desc: About the Company I'm partnering with an exciting, well-funded AI Digital health company that is transforming how healthcare organisations operate through intelligent automation. Backed by leading international investors and experiencing significant growth, the business is developing sophisticated, real-time AI solutions designed to streamline complex workflows, improve operational efficiency and reduce administrative burdens across healthcare. About the Role They're now looking for a talented Software Engineers to join their growing engineering team in Barcelona. This is an opportunity to work on genuinely cutting-edge AI technology, take ownership of complex technical challenges and contribute directly to the development of products already being used in real-world environments. For the right individual, there may also be opportunities for international relocation as the business continues to expand. You'll play a key role in building, developing and scaling a high-performance AI platform, working across backend infrastructure, frontend applications and real-time intelligent systems. This isn't a position where you'll simply maintain existing software. You'll have the opportunity to shape technical decisions, solve challenging engineering problems and build products from the ground up. Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy scalable, production-grade software solutions. Build and optimise backend services, APIs and modern frontend applications. Develop infrastructure supporting real-time AI applications and intelligent automation. Work with distributed systems, asynchronous processing and complex orchestration workflows. Improve platform performance, reliability, scalability and system architecture. Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities to market. Take ownership of technical projects throughout the entire software development lifecycle. Help develop systems capable of supporting high volumes of real-time interactions. Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Required Skills 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within a fast-paced technology or product environment. Strong experience with Python, ideally FastAPI or similar backend frameworks. Experience working with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases. Proficiency with React and TypeScript, or equivalent modern frontend technologies. Experience designing, developing and maintaining scalable distributed systems. Understanding of asynchronous processing, workload orchestration and production infrastructure. Proven ability to take ownership of projects from initial design through to deployment. Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in tackling technically challenging problems. Preferred Skills Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents or machine learning applications. Exposure to conversational AI, speech technologies or real-time AI systems. Previous experience working within a startup or high-growth technology company. Experience building applications operating at significant scale. About the Opportunity Cutting-edge technology: Work on advanced AI systems solving real operational challenges. High-impact engineering: Your work will directly influence product development, performance and scalability. Strong financial backing: Join an ambitious company supported by established technology investors. Career progression: Opportunities to take on greater technical ownership as the engineering organisation expands. International exposure: Collaborate with an international team, with potential future relocation opportunities. Startup environment: Join a business where ideas are valued, decisions move quickly and engineers have a genuine voice. Interested? I'm working closely with the team on this opportunity and would love to speak with software engineers who enjoy building ambitious products, solving difficult technical problems and working at the intersection of AI and healthcare technology. If you're based in Barcelona, or open to relocating, and this sounds interesting, please get in touch for a confidential conversation.

In unserem Fachbereich Informatik und Digitalisierung ist zum Sommersemester 2027 eine Professur in Vollzeit (18 Semesterwochenstunden) zu besetzen. Der Fachbereich Informatik und Digitalisierung verbindet praxisnahe Lehre mit wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz. Durch einen starken Anwendungsbezug und moderne Lehrmethoden bereiten wir unsere Studierenden darauf vor, eine aktive und verantwortliche Rolle zur Gestaltung der digitalen Transformation übernehmen zu können. Die Vergütung erfolgt leistungsgerecht und Ihrem Einsatz entsprechend in Anlehnung an W2 in NRW plus betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Diese Aufgaben Erwarten Sie Sie vertreten das Gebiet der modernen Anwendungsentwicklung unter Einbezug Künstlicher Intelligenz in Lehre und Forschung. Zu Ihrem Lehrangebot gehören insbesondere die folgenden Inhalte: Moderne Programmierung - Full Stack Entwicklung Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen in der Anwendungsentwicklung Requirements Engineering und Testing Anwendungsgebiete Generativer KI / Agentic AI sowie weitere Grundlagenfächer der Informatik. Sie sind in der Lage, Lehrveranstaltungen auch in englischer Sprache zu halten. Mit Ihrem Lehr- und Forschungsengagement stärken Sie das Profil des Fachbereichs Informatik und Digitalisierung. Die Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Verantwortung im Wissenschaftsmanagement / in der akademischen Selbstverwaltung der Hochschule und der Forschung wird erwartet. Außerdem sind Sie bereit, Vorlesungen auch an Abenden und / oder Samstagen für die berufsbegleitenden Studiengänge zu übernehmen. Das Bringen Sie Mit Sie haben vorzugsweise ein Hochschulstudium im Bereich der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Mathematik mit einer Promotion abgeschlossen und besitzen Erfahrung in mindestens einem der oben genannten Fachgebiete. Neben dem fachlichen Schwerpunkt auf die Anwendungsgebiete der Software-Entwicklung bzw. Künstlichen Intelligenz wären Erfahrungen zum Betrieb von IT-Systemen in industriellen Umgebungen von Vorteil. Idealerweise haben Sie bereits erste Lehrerfahrungen gesammelt und sind am Einsatz von Methoden der modernen Hochschuldidaktik interessiert. Weiterhin haben Sie Interesse an Forschungsprojekten Ihres Fachgebietes und besitzen die Bereitschaft, bei der Einwerbung von Fördermitteln aktiv mitzuwirken. Sie orientieren eigenes Denken und Handeln an den langfristigen Zielen der Hochschule und besitzen die Fähigkeit, Lösungen im Team zuverlässig zu erarbeiten. Sie erfüllen im Weiteren die Einstellungsvoraussetzungen des 36 HG NRW. Wir Bieten Ihnen Sie werden bei uns Chancengeber:in für Bildungswillige und können aktiv mitgestalten. Darüber hinaus profitieren Sie von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder Jobrad. In unserem Haus gibt es vielfältige Mitarbeiterangebote aus Freizeit, Kultur, Veranstaltungen, Elektronik u.v.m. und attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Firmenevents. items.title: Data Scientist (Contractor)
items.card: Position: Data Scientist – Agentic Search, Personalisation & Recommendations Type: Contract (Outside IR35) - £500 per day Location: Manchester | Hybrid Project: Build the next generation of intelligent discovery We’re currently looking for a Data Scientist (on an initial 3 month contract basis) to help build a next-generation platform that is rethinking how customers search, discover and interact with products
items.desc: Position: Data Scientist – Agentic Search, Personalisation & Recommendations Type: Contract (Outside IR35) - £500 per day Location: Manchester | Hybrid Project: Build the next generation of intelligent discovery We’re currently looking for a Data Scientist (on an initial 3 month contract basis) to help build a next-generation platform that is rethinking how customers search, discover and interact with products through AI. You’ll work at the intersection of Agentic AI, intelligent search, recommendation engines, personalisation and augmentation, helping create experiences that understand intent, surface the right results and increasingly support users through intelligent, AI-powered discovery journeys. Think agentic search, smarter recommendations, intelligent ranking and hyper-personalised experiences, built for real users, at scale. And importantly, this isn’t an R&D role where models disappear into notebooks. Your work will make its way into production and directly influence the customer experience. What You’ll Be Building You’ll join a high-performing and growing Data Science team developing the intelligence behind the platform, working across areas including: Agentic Search – exploring how AI agents, reasoning and tool use can transform traditional search and discovery Recommendation Engines – building models that surface increasingly relevant products, content and experiences Personalisation – creating experiences that adapt to individual customer behaviour, context and intent Search Relevance & Ranking – continuously improving what customers see and why they see it AI Augmentation – using AI to enrich and enhance the overall discovery journey Explainable AI – ensuring sophisticated models can still be understood, challenged and trusted What You’ll Do You’ll design, build, evaluate and improve machine learning models across search, personalisation and recommendations, taking ideas from experimentation through to measurable customer impact. You’ll explore how agentic AI concepts, including goal-driven systems, multi-step reasoning and tool use, can enhance discovery experiences and create entirely new ways for customers to interact with the platform. Using Python, SQL and Snowflake, you’ll work hands-on with large datasets, developing features, evaluating models and identifying opportunities to improve relevance, engagement and customer experience. Model explainability will also be important. You’ll use techniques including SHAP to understand model behaviour and turn complex outputs into clear stories that product, engineering and business stakeholders can act on. You’ll work closely with teams across Data, Product and Engineering, helping shape not only the models but the direction of the next generation of the platform. Sound interesting? Apply today. We'll then give you a call to run through the project in more detail!

items.desc: S vyše 2,3 mil. zákazníkov patríme medzi lídrov v poskytovaní telekomunikačných služieb na slovenskom trhu. Ako prví prinášame prelomové inovácie na trhu, či už to bol prvý mobil za korunu alebo nová generácia siete 5G Standalone a stále ideme ďalej. Dnes poskytujeme komplexné telekomunikačné služby pre domácnosti aj podnikateľov vrátane mobilných služieb, pevného internetu, digitálnej televízie a moderných smart riešení. V prvom rade sme však starostlivý, zodpovedný a ľudský zamestnávateľ, a preto hľadáme rovnakých ľudí do nášho tímu. U nás budete od prvého dňa plnohodnotnou súčasťou firmy a našej komunity. Záleží nám na spoločnosti, v ktorej pôsobíme, vnímame svoju zodpovednosť voči nej, a preto sa angažujeme vo verejnoprospešných aktivitách. Pomáhame nášmu okoliu cez Nadáciu Orange, podporujeme mimovládne organizácie a tiež aktívnych jednotlivcov. Prostredníctvom týchto aktivít sa snažíme meniť svet na lepšie miesto pre všetkých. Záleží nám na tom, aby sa u nás každý cítil dobre. Veríme, že zamestnanie nie je len o hodnote, ktorú prinášate firme Vy, no i o tej, ktorú prináša firma Vám. Váš rozvoj je pre nás rovnako dôležitý ako pre Vás, preto Vás v ňom budeme podporovať. Sme hrdí na to, že sme starostlivý a zodpovedný zamestnávateľ. Pokiaľ Vás naša pozícia zaujala a zdieľate s nami rovnaké hodnoty, budeme sa tešiť na Váš životopis. Zaujíma ťa umelá inteligencia, machine learning a nové možnosti, ktoré prinášajú generatívne AI technológie? V Orange Slovensko rozširujeme tím Data Science a hľadáme kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorí chcú svoje analytické a technické schopnosti posunúť na ďalšiu úroveň a pracovať na projektoch, ktoré sa reálne dostávajú do produkcie. Budeš súčasťou tímu, ktorý navrhuje a nasadzuje moderné AI riešenia v prostredí veľkej technologickej spoločnosti. Získaš možnosť pracovať s najnovšími technológiami v oblasti umelej inteligencie, cloudových služieb a spracovania dát, pričom tvoje riešenia budú používať tisíce zákazníkov aj zamestnancov. Hľadáme človeka, ktorý má dobré základy v Data Science, rád experimentuje, neustále sa učí nové veci a chce sa rozvíjať v oblasti AI technológií. Čo Bude Tvojou Náplňou Práce Data Science a Machine Learning: pripravovať, analyzovať a transformovať dáta pre AI a ML riešenia navrhovať, trénovať a vyhodnocovať machine learning modely podieľať sa na nasadzovaní modelov do produkčného prostredia monitorovať kvalitu a výkonnosť modelov podieľať sa na riešení analytických a prediktívnych úloh Generatívna AI spolupracovať na vývoji GenAI a RAG riešení experimentovať s novými AI technológiami a frameworkami pripravovať proof-of-concept riešenia a prototypy podieľať sa na evaluácii a optimalizácii AI riešení sledovať nové trendy a možnosti využitia umelej inteligencie Cloud a AI Platforma pracovať s modernými cloudovými technológiami vytvárať a rozvíjať dátové a AI pipeline spolupracovať na budovaní AI platformy a MLOps procesov integrovať AI riešenia do firemného prostredia podieľať sa na automatizácii a zlepšovaní AI služieb Spolupráca s Biznisom spolupracovať s odborníkmi z rôznych oblastí spoločnosti identifikovať príležitosti na využitie dát a AI transformovať biznisové požiadavky do analytických a AI riešení prezentovať výstupy a odporúčania stakeholderom Must-have Technické zručnosti: minimálne 2 roky items.desc: Who We Are MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. About WPP MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. We’re hiring an AI Creative Technologist to explore what AI makes possible and create experiences, products, and tools that people want to use. Working alongside our AI Lead, you’ll bring creative thinking and hands-on experimentation to customer experiences and enterprise challenges. You’ll help shape the ideas, make them tangible, and develop the strongest ones with clients and colleagues. We’re looking for someone who is curious about technology, cares about the quality of what they make, and enjoys discovering possibilities through the work. What will your day look like? Your time will be spent researching, experimenting, designing, building with AI, presenting, and debating ideas. We work in a nimble, collaborative way, moving between customer journeys, Figma, vibe coding, and client conversations. Some projects will begin with a clear brief; others with a question. You’ll help decide what is worth creating and how to make it work, with room to experiment and learn along the way. Experience and opportunity framing: Explore customer and business needs, question assumptions, and spot opportunities for useful or unexpected ideas. Think across journeys, services, channels, physical and digital touchpoints, and the people and systems behind them. Help shape the brief and identify where AI could make a meaningful contribution. Creative development: Use Figma and vibe-coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalents to bring ideas to life as interactive experiences, tools, and AI-powered products. Use experiments and prototypes to explore directions, then refine promising work through feedback and testing. Bring the taste and attention to detail that make an experience distinctive and enjoyable to use. Shaping how AI works: Explore the role AI should play within an experience or solution. Experiment with how it creates content, responds to context, communicates, and helps people accomplish something. Consider its limitations and where people need understanding, choice, or control. Client collaboration: Work with senior colleagues to explore opportunities with clients, contribute to pitches, and bring ideas into workshops and demonstrations. Explain your thinking, invite debate, and use what you learn to shape the next iteration. Developing ideas into useful solutions: Help promising concepts progress through pilots and into reusable experiences, products, or services. Work with product and engineering colleagues to refine how they should work, document key decisions, and support their development into solutions clients can use and adopt. Research and practice development: Stay curious about emerging AI capabilities, creative applications, and ways of working. Run focused experiments, share discoveries, and help the Agentic AI Lab develop reusable approaches. Contribute ideas that other teams can build on and adapt as the technology evolves. Who are you going to work with? You will join our AI Consulting team, bringing together consulting, customer experience, product thinking, and the ability to apply emerging technologies creatively. We share early ideas, learn by making, and bring different perspectives to the work. You will work alongside our AI Lead and senior colleagues as you develop your own approach. AI Consulting is part of the wider AI Capability, alongside dedicated engineering and product teams. Together, our team explores opportunities, develops new concepts, and turns promising ideas into enterprise solutions. You will also collaborate with strategists, designers, consultants, and specialists across the wider business. What do you bring to the table? We welcome junior and mid-level applicants, including recent graduates with a strong portfolio. We do not expect a particular academic or professional background: our team is multifaceted – your path might be product design, service design, creative technology, computer science, or something entirely different. About The Role We are recruiting for an AI & Automation Developer to join our team and help deliver innovative AI and automation solutions that improve how people work across the business. This is a hands-on role focused on developing AI agents, workflow automation, and productivity solutions using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, the Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 technologies . Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, you'll turn ideas into practical tools that streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance operational efficiency. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, exploring new technologies, and building solutions that make a real impact. You'll have the freedom to shape the role, experiment with emerging AI capabilities, and drive the adoption of automation across the business. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and support AI agents using Copilot Studio. Build workflow and automation solutions using Power Platform, including Power Automate, and wider Microsoft 365 technologies. Identify opportunities to improve business processes through AI, automation, and workflow solutions. Work directly with business users to understand challenges and deliver practical, user-focused solutions. Prototype, test, and refine solutions to demonstrate value and drive adoption. Support the rollout and continuous improvement of AI and automation tools across the organisation. Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365 data sources, including SharePoint and other business systems. Collaborate with IT, Data, and Business teams to develop scalable and sustainable solutions. Promote best practice in AI adoption, data handling, and automation governance. Essential Experience & Skills Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365, and the Power Platform. Experience building workflow and automation solutions using tools such as Power Automate. Understanding of how AI technologies can be applied to solve business challenges. Experience working with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver practical solutions. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex processes. Degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related discipline. Understanding of data security, governance, and responsible use of business information. Desirable Experience developing AI agents using Copilot Studio or similar platforms. Knowledge of Power BI and reporting solutions. Basic SQL and data querying skills. items.desc: Wat jij mag verwachten Als Functioneel Analist AI maak je deel uit van het AI-team en rapporteer je inhoudelijk aan de Product Owner. items.desc: Who We Are Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR. What You Will Do Join us as our first dedicated Data Scientist to bring order to the chaos of culture. You'll turn raw, messy data into insights to tackle the big questions: What is changing in how people find and enjoy media? Why do some bets work and others not? And where is our next opportunity? We sit on a lot of data we do not use yet, and you are the person who turns it into decisions. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include: New data sources: finding and opening up new sources that help us make better decisions Trends and audiences: analyzing trends, audience behavior and performance to find the next growth opportunity, and proposing the next step Prediction: prototyping and deploying ML models on AWS for forecasting and content analysis, and checking whether they hold up in production Experiments: designing and reading A/B tests, holdouts and spend experiments across our products and campaigns, and telling the team where the next dollar should go Numbers people trust: owning the dashboards and reports leadership runs on, and investigating what really drives a metric when it moves AI-native workflows: using LLMs and agentic coding tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis and reporting Who You Are We look for battle-tested data scientists who understand that real impact comes from turning messy, unstructured data into business-critical insights that drive company direction. You don't just build models: you solve business problems and translate statistical findings into actions the team takes. Typically, your profile will look like this: Background: a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Math or a related quantitative field Experience: 3 or more years of hands-on data science in fast-paced business environments, at Tier 1 consultancies, Big Tech, high-growth start-ups and scale-ups, or media industry leaders Python: expert-level proficiency with the standard data science and ML frameworks, and SQL as a daily tool Data acquisition: you have brought new raw data sources into use and made them reliable enough to decide on Statistical rigour: you design and read experiments properly, you know when a signal is noise, and you have run A/B tests or causal analyses that changed a decision Models in production: you have deployed models that people actually used, and you know what it takes to keep them honest over time AI-native: extensive hands-on experience with agentic coding tools and LLMs in your data workflows From data to decision: you find the opportunity in the data and propose the next step, and your dashboards and visualizations (standard libraries or Tableau) are the ones leadership trusts Collaboration: you work well across engineering, product and business teams, and colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment A big plus: you're obsessed with music, video or social media What Makes This Exciting You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate. We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together. items.card: responsibilities Cleanroom work in CMi/Labwork (60%): Fabricate photonics chips using advanced semiconductor processing (etching, lithography, thin film depositions) Perform statistical analysis of in-line metrology of the fabrication process, develop measurements to ensure reproducibility Explore new material deposition techniques, etching techniques, cladding oxides, wafer platforms Test and learn to operate new
items.desc:
Mission
 The Laboratory of Photonics and Quantum Measurements (LPQM) at the Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) is seeking a nanofabrication engineer to develop advanced processes and techniques for next-generation photonic integrated circuits and lasers. This role will involve collaborating with Bühler Group on a 2-year industry research project, which has the potential for startup commercialization. 
 The researcher will be responsible for developing advanced thin film deposition and ion beam trimming techniques on various material platforms, such as SiN, LTOI and LNOI. He/she will lead the collaboration with the Bühler Group on in-house fabrication of wafer-scale integrated photonic circuits, ensuring optimal operation and reproducibility in the cleanroom facilities (CMi). The candidate will design, fabricate, and characterize PICs for the project, as well as develop and improve existing processes and explore new material platforms and tools available from Bühler. He/she will also regularly travel to the R&D facilities in Germany to assist in optimising the recipes. He/she will prepare quarterly reports and facilitate effective technical exchanges between LPQM and the Bühler Group. High-level publications are expected at the end of the project in collaboration with the industrial partner. The position also offers the potential for technology transfer to a startup. 
 Main duties and responsibilities
 Cleanroom work in CMi/Labwork (60%): 
 Fabricate photonics chips using advanced semiconductor processing (etching, lithography, thin film depositions) 
 Perform statistical analysis of in-line metrology of the fabrication process, develop measurements to ensure reproducibility 
 Explore new material deposition techniques, etching techniques, cladding oxides, wafer platforms 
 Test and learn to operate new tools 
 Characterize the photonic chip performance 
 Travelling to Bühler Group in Darmstadt and Leibniz (20%): 
 Assist in the process development and master the tools available at Bühler 
 Document progress and report back to the team
 Design photonic chips and process flows (10%): 
 Modify existing designs to test the tool capabilities 
 Design new PIC devices to demonstrate the capabilities of the developed processes, using new techniques, tools and materials 
 Documentation and coordination (10%): 
 Quarterly report preparation 
 Technical reports on each new process, as defined in the project tasks 
 Technical meeting organisation and reporting on a need to go basis 
 Publication of new results in high impact journals 
 Profile
 Qualification/experience: 
 PhD in engineering or sciences with micro-nanofabrication of PICs as the theme of the thesis 
 3-5 years equivalent experience in thin film process development, instrument operation, and/or the fabrication industry 
 Extensive cleanroom experience 
 Technical skills: 
 Ability to rigorously follow processes 
 Ability to operate instruments with a high level of patience and attention to detail 
 Willingness to maintain highly organized data records 
 Interpersonal skills: 
 Ability to work independently, with a high level of responsibility 
 Strong communication skills towards the other lab members, CMi staff and collaborators 
 Willingness to work in a multi-national team 
 Willingness to travel 
 Computer/software skills: 
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office 
 Familiarity with K-layout, COMSOL, Lumerical 
 Languages: 
 Working proficiency in English, German and/or French is a plus 
 We offer
 A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated R&D environment 
 A productive team of high scientific and industrial impacts 
 Excellent laboratory conditions at Center of MicroNanoTechnology at EPFL 
 Opportunity to work on technology development with potential continuation in industry 
 Potential for technology transfer to a startup 
 Information
 Contract Start Date : as soon as possible. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis. 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. 
 Activity Rate : 100% 
 Contract Type: CDD 
 Duration: 1 year renewable 
 Reference: 2546 
 Contact
 For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

items.desc: Position description Category Materials, solid state physics Contract Internship Job title Development and Application of Time-Resolved Cathodoluminescence for Nanoscale Characterization H/F Subject The candidate will work on the development and application of advanced TRCL measurements on microLED structures. The internship will be carried out within the PFNC platform at CEA Leti which provides access to advanced nanoscale characterization facilities. The candidate will work in close interaction with researchers and engineers involved in III nitride and microLED technologies. Contract duration (months) 6 Job description Framework and context: MicroLEDs based on III nitride semiconductors are promising candidates for next generation display and optoelectronic technologies. Their performance is strongly influenced by carrier recombination and transport processes occurring at the nanoscale, particularly in the vicinity of sidewalls, interfaces and material defects. Time Resolved Cathodoluminescence (TRCL) is a powerful technique combining the high spatial resolution of electron microscopy with time and spectrally resolved luminescence measurements. It enables the investigation of local carrier dynamics and luminescence properties with nanometric spatial and sub nanosecond temporal resolution. The objective of this internship is to develop and apply TRCL characterization methodologies to III nitride microLEDs with a particular focus on understanding spatial variations in luminescence and carrier dynamics. Work description: The work will include: 1. Development and optimization of TRCL measurement protocols for microLED characterization including the control of electron beam energy, beam current and sample temperature, 2. Investigation of carrier dynamics in microLED structures with particular attention to the influence of device dimensions, sidewalls, interfaces and material defects, 3. Data processing and analysis of multidimensional TRCL datasets, combining spatial, spectral and temporal information, and correlation with complementary characterization techniques such as Time Resolved Photoluminescence and Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy. Methods / Means Time Resolved Cathodoluminescence (TRCL) Applicant Profile The applicant must be strongly motivated to learn how to handle advanced facilities and analyze the data. He will have the opportunity to develop transverse skills as the work will be carried out with academic collaborators, and will involve issues of intellectual property, industrial experience with the LETI partners and a daily practise of English. Proper background in solid state physics is essential. Basic knowledge about luminescence techniques is not mandatory but will be appreciated. Possible continuation as a PhD thesis. Depending on the results of the internship and the candidate's performance, the internship may lead to a PhD thesis starting after the internship. items.desc: Etude de la corrélation entre les paramètres de cycles de NEP sur l’efficacité de nettoyage en milieu laitier Réf ABG-140618 Sujet de Thèse 20/10/2026 Cifre Biodymia (Université Lyon1-Isara Lyon)/PAPC (UMR PAM, Université de Bourgogne, Agrosup Dijon) Lieu de travail Lyon - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - France Intitulé du sujet Etude de la corrélation entre les paramètres de cycles de NEP sur l’efficacité de nettoyage en milieu laitier Champs scientifiques Sciences de l’ingénieur Agronomie, agroalimentaire Mots clés NEP, TACT, efficacité de nettoyage, durabilité, lait, process Description du sujet Le nettoyage en place (NEP) constitue un enjeu majeur dans l’industrie laitière, en particulier pour les lignes de lait stérilisé, où se combinent exigences de sécurité microbiologique, maintien de la disponibilité des équipements et maîtrise de l’encrassement. Malgré le recours à des séquences alcalines et acides classiques, l’efficacité du NEP reste fortement dépendante de la nature des dépôts, des conditions hydrodynamiques et de la configuration réelle des installations. Le traitement thermique du lait, étape indispensable à l’industrie laitière, modifie fortement la nature des souillures. Dans le cas de traitement plus sévère comme la stérilisation, les dépôts deviennent plus protéino-minéraux et plus difficiles à éliminer. La nettoyabilité est également fortement conditionnée par la géométrie de la ligne. Les échangeurs, coudes, vannes, dérivations et changements de section créent des hétérogénéités locales de vitesse, de cisaillement et de temps de résidence, susceptibles de favoriser l’accumulation des dépôts et leur persistance après NEP, créant ainsi des réservoirs microbiologiques. Cette thèse vise à comprendre de manière intégrée le nettoyage en place (NEP) d’une ligne de lait stérilisée, en reliant les paramètres TACT du cycle, les signaux réellement observés pendant le nettoyage, la géométrie de la ligne, la nature des dépôts et l’état microbiologique des surfaces à la performance hygiénique et environnementale. L’objectif est de dépasser une lecture purement normative du NEP pour construire une approche explicative, puis prédictive par intégration de données dans un modèle d’IA, de la performance réelle du nettoyage. L’objectif est majeur : réduire l’utilisation de ressource (eau, énergie et produits chimiques) utilisés lors des cycles de NEP, sans compromettre l’hygiène des équipements de production en industrie laitière. Prise de fonction : 04/01/2027 Nature du financement Cifre Précisions sur le financement Présentation établissement et labo d'accueil Biodymia (Université Lyon1-Isara Lyon)/PAPC (UMR PAM, Université de Bourgogne, Agrosup Dijon) Origine et composition L’équipe BioDyMIA a été créée sur l’initiative conjointe de l’université et de l’ISARA en 2011. Elle résulte de l’accrétion du LRGIA (laboratoire de recherche en génie industriel alimentaire) de l’IUT de Bourg-en Bresse, alors dirigé par le Pr Pascal Degraeve, avec le LMA, le laboratoire de microbiologie alimentaire, dont la responsable était Marie Jeanne Blachier. L’équipe s’est enrichie de l’apport de la plateforme analytique de l’Isara, constituée de sept laboratoires et structurée en 2018 sous le nom d’AgroLab (animateur : Yann Demarigny, EC). Ces sept laboratoires sont : microbiologie, chimie, biologie, physique, agronomie, automatisme, technologie. Elle comporte actuellement huit enseignants-chercheurs, quatre agents techniques et un support administratifs cinq doctorants. Mais elle a accueilli depuis 2019, dix doctorants sur les deux sites que compte BioDyMIA. Organisation et ressources Le budget moyen entre 2019 et 2024 était de 226 k€ dont un cinquième environ reposait sur des fonds propres récurrents. La plupart des autres ressources sont issues des contrats types ANR, FUI, et Région. Le budget global de l’équipe BioDyMIA fluctue globalement entre 100 et 300k€ en fonction des contrats et des projets développés, d’une année sur l’autre. La nature des contrats portés par BioDyMIA est variable, couvrant des ressources de différentes origine : contrats nationaux, internationaux, collectivités territoriales, partenariat avec environnement socio-économique, contrat financé par des associations caritatives et des fondations. Thématique de recherche Depuis sa création en 2011, BioDyMIA s’intéresse à la biopréservation des aliments au sens large du terme. Il s’agit de contrôler le développement des flores d’altérations et/ou pathogènes des aliments en exploitant des microorganismes (au sens strict du terme, essentiellement des bactéries lactiques, LAB) ou des biomolécules au sens large. L’objectif consiste à prolonger la durée de vie et/ou d’améliorer la qualité de matrices alimentaires périssables sensibles en ciblant les flores responsables de leur altération. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges. Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage. Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. Evaluate the impact to the organization of current security trends, advisories, publications, and academic research. Coordinate responses as necessary across affected teams to do the right thing for our customers and our organization. Ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of sensitivity, and multiple audiences. Recognize, adopt and instill the best practices in security engineering fields throughout the organization: development, cryptography, network security, security operations, incident response, security intelligence. Provide subject matter expertise on architecture, authentication and system security. Fulfill regular on-call responsibilities. Key job responsibilities An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following: Triage/assess security issues and engage with internal service teams to ensure timely remediation of issues, escalating internally as necessary to ensure appropriate levels of urgency and engagement. Demonstrate high capacity and tolerance for context switching and interruptions while remaining productive and effective. Develop pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while maintaining an acceptable level of risk. Mentoring of junior staff and proactively share knowledge sharing within the team and across the company. Assist with hiring new employees Fulfil regular on-call responsibilities. We also work to develop tools and systems, and implement changes to drive automation, scalability and continuous improvements for our organization and AWS as a whole. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. items.desc: Applied Researcher Mid to Senior Full-time Remote / Hybrid (Warsaw or Cracow) About Unabyss We're building Unabyss - the universal context layer for AI. Users store all their context (background, expertise, preferences, goals) in one place, and any AI tool can access it via MCP and APIs. The user controls what gets shared, with whom, at what depth. We've just raised pre-seed funding and are assembling the founding engineering team. This is the ground floor of a company building core infrastructure for the AI era. What You're Gonna Do Design and build a knowledge/memory system that structures user context for precise, traceable retrieval Build data processing pipelines that enrich, classify, and structure information as it flows in Design retrieval mechanisms that are cheap, accurate, and traceable to their root sources Implement permission-aware access control at the retrieval layer - enforcing per-app consent boundaries Evaluate and compare architectural approaches (knowledge graphs, hybrid retrieval, structured extraction) through rapid prototyping and benchmarking Design prompt engineering strategies and LLM pipeline architectures using commercially available models Collaborate directly with the CTO to shape the core technical direction of the product What We Require From You 2+ years of professional experience building ML/NLP/LLM systems in production Strong Python proficiency Deep understanding of retrieval architectures beyond basic RAG - hybrid search, structured extraction, re-ranking, query decomposition Comfort with rapid prototyping - building POCs, running experiments, measuring results, iterating fast Experience with AI-first programming - using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code etc.) as a core part of your workflow Strong algorithmic thinking and ability to reason about trade-offs: precision vs. recall, cost vs. accuracy, latency vs. completeness Experience designing and evaluating ML pipelines end-to-end Ability to work independently, make design decisions, and drive research-to-production cycles with minimal supervision Fluent English (written and spoken) What's Nice To Have Experience with knowledge graphs - construction, querying, integration with LLM pipelines Background in information theory or information retrieval research Experience with permission/access-control systems at the data layer Familiarity with prompt engineering at scale - structured outputs, chain-of-thought, tool use Experience in early-stage / small-team environments Published research or open-source contributions in relevant areas What You'll Get €5,000-€8,000/month gross (€60k-€96k/year), calibrated to experience and location Fully remote with full flexibility - work from anywhere within CET ±2h ESOPs planned as the company scales - you're joining early enough to benefit Sports benefits Direct collaboration with the CTO - outsized influence on the product's core architecture A clear growth path: evolve into Head of ML/AI or deepen into a principal/staff track as the team grows The chance to help build something massive from the very beginning

What you need: Strong Python - 2+ years of production code. You have owned a service or library other people depended on: HTTP APIs (Fast API/Flask), async basics, error handling and retries, structured logging, dependency management, unit and integration tests; Hands-on experience building LLM applications - context windows and token cost, retrieval over documents vs. feeding full context, embeddings and chunking, knowledge bases, tool/function calling, and the judgement to tell whether a bad answer came from the model, the prompt or the retrieved content; Practical data-science foundations. You have trained models yourself, even if not professionally, and have good foundations in them; SQL and a relational database from application code - schema and migrations, indexes, transactions, connection pooling; Observability - metrics, logs and traces with Prometheus, Grafana, the ELK stack and distributed tracing (e.g. Open Telemetry, Jaeger/Tempo); Model monitoring in production - data drift, concept drift and model performance decay. Comfortable with Kubernetes and Helm - you can deploy, inspect and debug a workload; Depth is welcome but it is not the bar; you will grow it here; Docker, CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitLab / GitHub Actions), Linux, git; GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux), or the willingness to pick it up quickly.

items.title: Data Engineer (Data and AI)
items.card: About the role You'll design and deliver the data pipelines, platforms and AI applications that drive our clients' decision-making, working directly with them to turn business questions into production-ready systems on Google Cloud. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the
items.desc: About the role You'll design and deliver the data pipelines, platforms and AI applications that drive our clients' decision-making, working directly with them to turn business questions into production-ready systems on Google Cloud. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the technical lead on your own projects and client accounts, trusted to make the calls and own the outcome. You'll also be part of an engineering team that reviews each other's work and pitches in across projects. On your accounts, you'll work day to day with fifty-five's consultants and data scientists. You'll combine strong SQL, Python and cloud engineering with sound technical judgement, using AI tools to build faster and to a higher standard while keeping full ownership of what you deliver. You'll also build AI applications for clients and for fifty-five's own teams, and help shape what we offer in data and AI. What you'll do Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines, data models and end-to-end solution architectures on GCP (BigQuery, Python, dbt, Airflow, Dataform), balancing reliability, maintainability, performance and cost. Own technical delivery on your projects and accounts, from scoping to production: making the design decisions, managing risks and dependencies, and communicating trade-offs clearly. Own the quality of what we deliver, with rigorous validation, automated testing, observability and data-quality controls built into production pipelines, and lead the diagnosis and fix when production issues come up. Design and build AI applications for clients and for fifty-five, such as LLM agents on Google Cloud with Gemini and Google's ADK. Take them from prototype to production, with evaluation, cost control and secure handling of client data. Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to build faster and improve testing, checking their output critically and staying accountable for the result. Share what works with the team as demos, docs and reusable patterns. Work with clients, consulting and data science teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions and turn business needs into pragmatic designs, and explain your reasoning to technical and non-technical people. Raise the team's engineering standards through design and code reviews, strong testing practices and clear documentation. What you'll bring Excellent SQL and strong Python skills. Proven experience designing, building and operating reliable data pipelines, data models and cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome), with transformation and orchestration tooling such as dbt, Airflow or Dataform. Strong software engineering practices: Git-based workflows, code review, automated testing and CI/CD. Hands-on experience building with LLMs (Gemini or similar), such as agents, connecting models to data and APIs, and evaluating outputs. The judgement to know when to rely on AI-assisted engineering tools and when to verify. The ability to break down ambiguous problems, see the business challenge behind a task, make well-reasoned decisions, and prototype and pitch ideas for what we could build for clients. Excellent client-facing communication and confidence leading delivery independently: running several client projects at once and re-prioritising as client needs change, solo or within a larger project team. Desirable experience Infrastructure as code (Terraform), cloud IAM, and secure handling of client data. Taking LLM agents to production: evaluation and guardrails, cost control, or making them available in Slack, Teams or similar tools. Applied data science (exploratory or statistical analysis), and dashboarding tools such as Looker or Power BI. Marketing platforms and an understanding of marketing data. About the company Part of The Brandtech Group, fifty-five is a data company helping brands collect, analyse and activate their data across paid, earned and owned channels to increase their marketing ROI and improve customer acquisition and retention. Headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Hong Kong, New York and Shanghai, fifty-five is a certified Google Partner company and was named by Deloitte as one of the fastest-growing tech firms in Europe, thanks to its unique technology approach combining talent with software and service expertise. If this sounds like you, please get in touch! We look forward to meeting you. In return, we are pleased to offer you the following benefits: Being part of a multicultural, dynamic and fast-growing team Continuous (and certified) training on the digital ecosystem and technologies (initial training for all new employees, followed by recurring training sessions) Private medical coverage through AXA Transport for London monthly travel card allowance The flexibility to work remotely for part of the week 25 days holiday per year, in addition to UK bank and …
