items.desc: Summary You will become part of the AI and Automated Detection sub-division in Bratislava. Backed by a major AI investment program across the company, we build systems that defend against real-world cyber threats at scale, from automated threat detection processing terabytes of behavioral data, to multi-agent AI systems that help security analysts work faster, to SOAR platforms that automate incident response. Job Description Our work spans distributed backend services, machine learning pipelines, LLM-powered agents, and production security tooling. As a Python Software Engineer on the AI Security Platform, you build the backend systems that power AI-driven threat detection, automated incident response, and LLM-based security tooling. You will join one of three teams based on your interests and our needs, each tackling a different part of the security stack. About The Role Design, build, and maintain distributed backend services and processing pipelines in Python. Develop asynchronous, event-driven systems and message-based integrations across services. Work with one of three focus areas, chosen based on your interests and team needs: Detection Systems : automated threat detection pipelines, detection engine integrations, and high-volume data processing. LiveAI : multi-agent AI systems, LLM-powered assistants, agent orchestration, and evaluation infrastructure. SOAR Platform : microservice ecosystem for incident handling, automation workflows, and AI-powered Security Operations Center capabilities. Take ownership of services across their full lifecycle, from design and deployment to monitoring and troubleshooting. Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code. Collaborate with software engineers, security researchers, and security operators across the division. Essential Requirements Strong software development experience with Python. Experience designing and developing backend services or distributed systems. Understanding of asynchronous programming and distributed task processing. Experience working with APIs and service integrations. Knowledge of relational databases and SQL. Experience writing maintainable, testable, and production-ready code. Familiarity with modern software development workflows. Desirable Requirements Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with Kafka, Celery, or similar messaging and task-queue technologies. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure). Knowledge of multi-agent systems, LLM-based tooling, or prompt engineering. Previous experience in cybersecurity, threat detection, or high-volume data processing. Technologies Python, FastAPI, Celery, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, gRPC, Envoy, Hadoop, Spark, Impala, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Kubeflow, Argo, Jenkins, Git, JIRA, Confluence Basic wage component (brutto): from 2900 EUR/m. items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirement Esperienza di almeno 2 anni su progetti di AI/ML nel ruolo di Data Scientist, nonché conoscenza di tematiche di Deep Learing, NLP e analisi dati non strutturati e dell’architettura di soluzioni di AI/ML; Esperienza di almeno un anno in progetti di sviluppo applicazioni basate su LLM e Agentic AI; Ottima conoscenza di Python e i principali framework moderni di sviluppo soluzioni GenAI, e.g. Langraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, Azure AI Foundry; La conoscenza di linguaggi per lo sviluppo web (HTML5, JSP, HTML, CSS, XML, javascript, jquery, node.js), del tool di RPA UiPathdi e di strumenti di Data Visualization (QlikView, Qlik Sense, PowerBI o Tableau) e servizi cloud su AWS, Azure, ecc. è considerata un plus. To Make An Impact That Matters Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone. In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformantion, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal. In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale. La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

items.desc: At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas: Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture Climate Change & Managing CO₂ Artificial Intelligence & Robotics This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at www.eit.org. Welcome to the Pathogen Program: Within this ecosystem, the Pathogen Program exemplifies EIT's dedication to ground-breaking science. It seeks to transform pathogen risk management, detection and response by leveraging Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)-based metagenomic and pathogen-specific analytical tools. The goal is to power metagenomic devices using long-read sequencing technologies by building a comprehensive database of pathogen information to inform response. The database will comprise >400,000 paired high-quality long read sequences with comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility profiles. Enabled by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security, the Pathogen Program is advancing toward certified diagnostic tools for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide. Your Role: As a (Senior) Scientist , you will design, develop, and evaluate novel computational methods for translating metagenomic sequencing data into actionable results in a clinical or public health context. You will develop algorithms and AI/ML methods that are accurate and robust enough to be integrated into our infectious disease diagnostic product. You will report to the Lead Scientist in Computational Genomics, and you will work closely with bioinformaticians, data scientists, microbiologists, and software engineers to deliver clinically relevant innovation in the microbial genomics space. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and evaluate novel computational algorithms in areas such as taxonomic classification and antimicrobial resistance Develop ML/AI techniques to address real-world problems in the pathogen genomics space, in collaboration with scientists across EIT Validate and benchmark methods using public and internal datasets Work with bioinformaticians and software engineers to implement methods in scalable, reproducible, and modular workflows Communicate technical work clearly to interdisciplinary teams Requirements Requirements This is a methods development role. Strong candidates will have deep expertise in either bioinformatics algorithm development or ML/AI in a genomics context. Depth in both areas is a plus. Experience with microbial genomics and metagenomics is preferred but not required. We actively welcome applicants with genomics experience in other contexts who are interested in applying their methods development expertise in the pathogens space. For Senior : Candidates will have a track record of independently executed research projects, typically with three or more years of experience in industry or as a postdoc. Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience: PhD or equivalent experience in a quantitative field, such as computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or physics Track record of developing computational algorithms or tools in the genomics space. Algorithms: Designed and released a tool in a relevant area, such as sequence search/storage, genome assembly/annotation, pangenome graphs, or phylogenetics. AI/ML: Ownership of model training and evaluation at scale, with a deep understanding of the underlying methods and architectures Strong command of underlying fundamental data structures, algorithms, and statistical methods (e.g. De Bruijn graphs, embeddings, Bayesian methods) Solid programming skills (e.g. Python; C, C++, or Rust is a plus) and software development best practices (version control, CI/CD) Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Experience in microbial genomics Experience with long-read sequencing data (ONT) Experience with cloud computing, workflow management, and ML ops For senior: Experience mentoring or line-managing scientists Benefits Our Benefits: Travel allowance Annual Bonus Enhanced holiday pay Pension Life Assurance Income Protection Private Medical Insurance Hospital Cash Plan Therapy Services Perk Box Electric Car Scheme Working Together - What It Involves: You must have the right to work permanently in the UK with a willingness to travel as necessary. items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
R&D Team Lead 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
 At the ABB Corporate Research Center Germany ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vd4BLrNbvlc ), we research and prototype innovative technologies that shape ABB’s future product portfolio for sustainable automation, digitalization, and electrification. We work in cross-functional teams at the intersection of industrial research, end-customers, start-ups, and universities globally. 
The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-Hybrid 
You will be mainly accountable for: 
 You bridge the gap between academic research and industrial applications and drive the innovation in simulation, system modelling and industrial digitalization to contribute to future ABB solutions.
 You develop and apply hybrid modeling that combines analytical approaches and data-driven methods to represent the behavior of assets in process industry and manufacturing. 
 You leverage physics-informed AI methods that combine first-principles knowledge of industrial systems to develop more interpretable, efficient, and reliable models for simulation and process optimization. 
 You bring a system integration perspective to your work, meaning you understand how components, control logic, and physical dynamics interact at plant or system level, rather than focusing on purely mathematical modeling.
 You build simulation models used to validate control logic, support scenario analysis, and enable process optimization and operator training for complex industrial processes.· 
 You converge domain expertise with engineering practice, translating knowledge of industrial plant dynamics into robust simulation and monitoring systems. 
 With your technical expertise, you initiate, guide, and contribute to applied research projects, and you provide consultancy to product development teams. 
 You collaborate internationally with ABB divisions, customers, partners, startups, and renowned academic institutes. 
 You build prototypes and demonstrators, and you bring a software development and architecture mindset to turn simulation models into usable, maintainable tools.
 You present your work to expert and management audiences within and outside ABB, as well as at scientific conferences/journals and trade fairs.
 You secure intellectual property by patent applications.
 Qualifications for the role 
 You hold a degree in engineering, scientific computing, mathematics, physics, or a related discipline with specialization on modeling and simulation, combined with either academic experience (PhD) or professional experience in applied modeling and simulation. 
 Experience with model based, data based, and/or physics-informed AI based simulation and monitoring methods for dynamic systems. 
 Domain knowledge of industrial plant or process dynamics, with a focus on system level behavior and system integration. 
 Experience with machine learning and AI methods, including neural networks, deep learning, or reinforcement learning, preferably applied to dynamical systems, process modeling, or real-world applications. 
 Experience in one or more of the following application areas is beneficial: automation engineering, industrial control, condition monitoring, advanced process control and optimization. 
 Hands on experience in software development and software architecture is a plus (for example Python, C++, Modelica, or similar).
 Hands on experience with simulation and modeling tools is a plus (such as OpenModelica, Julia, FMU based co-simulation, DWSIM, the IDEAS PSE framework, or commercial tools such as Dymola, Aspen HYSYS, Matlab Simulink / Simscape or similar). 
 Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. German is a plus.We value cross-cultural communication skills, creativity, initiative, enthusiasm, and result-orientation to bring your innovations towards new products and digital offerings.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.

You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go-to-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.

Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.

Requirements

 - A strong Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.

 - A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade-offs and shipped without analysis paralysis.

 - Proactive ownership. You drive work end to end without a ticket board or someone assigning tasks.

 - Comfortable working across research, legal, safety, growth, design and enterprise customers.

 - Genuinely excited about music and AI. You’re the kind of person who prototypes ideas for fun and pushes the good ones into production.

Bonus: music or audio experience (even as a hobby), or experience shipping ML models into production.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

 - Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

 - Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

 - Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

 - Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

 - Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

items.desc:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

You will work on reinforcement learning for agents that reason over long horizons, use tools, coordinate with other agents, recover from failure, and improve from experience. This is Prime's broad, cross-domain Applied Research role, focused on RL and ML systems. Your work should hold up across several application domains: algorithms, environments, harnesses, reward and credit-assignment methods, evaluation, and scalable experimental systems. You will work regularly with application teams, partners, and open-source users while remaining focused on methods and systems that transfer across domains.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

Recent Prime work includes verifiers v1 https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/verifiers-v1, an algorithms layer for prime-rl https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/algorithms-layer, multi-agent training https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/multi-agent-systems, Prime Agent https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/prime-agent, and RL systems tested at trillion-parameter scale https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/rl-at-1t-scale. You will extend this line of work and pressure-test it against live application programs.

Representative early problems

 - Build agentic judges and credit-assignment methods that inspect complete trajectories, use tools, and assign useful learning signal beyond one final score.

 - Make multi-agent and long-horizon environments train reliably at scale while preserving debuggable traces and comparable baselines.

 - Detect when apparent gains come from reward hacking, harness behavior, data leakage, or infrastructure artifacts, then redesign the loop so the result survives.

What you will own

 - RL and post-training methods for tool-using, multi-agent, memory-augmented, and long-horizon systems.

 - Reusable environments, harnesses, rewards, and evaluations.

 - Experiments that connect algorithm choices to training and inference behavior.

 - Open-source systems and papers built from problems surfaced by application researchers and external users.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Relevant experience: hands-on RL training, scalable ML systems, agent environments, evaluation, inference/training infrastructure, or research crossing methods and systems.

 - Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

 - Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

 - Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. …

Chip design is a natural fit for agentic reinforcement learning: long-horizon work, specialized tools, expensive mistakes, hard constraints, and objective feedback from simulation, verification, timing, power, and area. You will build agents, environments, evaluations, and post-training systems for real semiconductor design and verification workflows. The work is grounded in an external design workflow, with access to relevant domain experts and toolchains. It may span RTL generation and debugging, formal verification, simulation, physical design, optimization, and orchestration across EDA tools.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. Representative early problems

 - Build an interactive verification environment where an agent reads a specification, writes or repairs RTL, invokes simulation or formal tools, interprets failures, and iterates toward a verified result.

 - Design rewards and evaluations that combine functional correctness with tool efficiency, robustness, and performance/power/area constraints without opening easy shortcuts.

 - Train long-horizon agents to recover from design and tool failures, preserve useful state, and generalize across blocks, designs, and constraint sets.

What you will own

 - Interactive environments where agents use EDA tools to modify designs, debug failures, and plan multi-step work.

 - Verifiers and rewards grounded in tests, simulation, formal methods, design rules, and engineering outcomes.

 - Experiments on credit assignment when feedback arrives late and several tools contribute.

 - Evaluations for correctness, recovery, and generalization, with reusable methods for other simulator-grounded engineering domains.


REQUIREMENTS

 - We are looking first for depth in RL, agents, or post-training systems and the ability to become fluent in semiconductor workflows.

 - Prior work in design automation, compilers, formal methods, or ML for systems is useful but not required.

 - Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

 - Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

 - Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 What you will do as an Industrial Placement Software Engineer 
 You can look forward to working with highly skilled professionals who are passionate about their work of designing and developing cutting edge technology for a worldwide market. 
 It is likely that you will need to be in the office for a least 4 days per week, although you may be able to work some days from home, depending on your projects. You will report to an experienced Software Engineer who will provide day to day guidance and on-the-job training. You will be introduced to the software development processes and utilise state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools. You will also gain experience on one or more aspects of the software development lifecycle, which could include: applied research, requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration and test. 
 During your 1-year placement, you will spend half of your time working on an existing customer-facing project and the other half working on a project with other industrial placement software, systems, electronics, firmware, hardware and antenna engineers. There will also be opportunities to work as STEM ambassadors in schools, colleges and universities. 
 Particular emphasis will be placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university. 
 Key Responsibility Areas 
 As part of our early careers community, you will work alongside developers and experts in an environment that is both challenging and rewarding. Your responsibilities will include: 
 Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of an Integrated Project Team. 
 Developing practical skills in design techniques for land, sea or aerospace applications. 
 Growing your understanding of the business as well as the software engineering lifecycle. 
 What you will bring 
 Entry Requirements

 We would like to hear from you if you are currently studying the following degrees 
 Software Engineering 
 Computer Science

 Possess excellent communication and inter-personal skills and have the confidence and ability to challenge and contribute. 
 Have an enthusiasm and passion for software development. 
 Be able to demonstrate and apply system-level thinking. 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

items.desc:
Your mission 
 Put your software engineering skills to work for the energy transition. The Photovoltaics and Thin Film Electronics Laboratory (PV-Lab) at EPFL is seeking a motivated Software Engineer to take responsibility for its monitoring platform and dashboards, and to lead a work package within a Horizon Europe project.
 Based in Neuchâtel, you will develop reliable software that turns data from photovoltaic installations, weather stations and laboratory experiments into useful information for researchers and project partners. You will combine hands-on development with project coordination in an international, multidisciplinary team with strong links to CSEM and industry.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 You will:
 Take ownership of the PV-Lab monitoring platform and dashboards, including maintenance, troubleshooting and further development. Work with colleagues and users to define requirements and prioritize improvements. Ensure traceability and consistent metadata.
 Develop applications to collect, validate, process and store data from monitoring sites, sensors and external APIs. Ensure data quality and reliable operation.
 Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and automate builds and deployments through GitLab CI/CD. Maintain logging, alerts, backups and secure configuration in coordination with EPFL IT.
 Lead Horizon Europe work packages: coordinate partners and tasks, plan resources, track milestones and risks, and ensure timely delivery of technical deliverables and progress reports. Organize meetings and represent the work package in project discussions.
 Write maintainable, tested and documented code. Support researchers using the platform and share technical knowledge within PV-Lab.
 Participate in internal scientific meetings and seminars, as well as local and international conferences. Contribute to writing scientific papers in collaboration with PV-Lab researchers and project partners.
 Supervise and mentor students working on software development, monitoring and data analysis, helping them plan their projects, review their code and interpret their results.
 Your profile 
 Essential qualifications and skills
 A degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, engineer in physics with strong software skills or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Strong Python programming skills and experience developing and maintaining applications used by others, including automated testing, debugging and documentation.
 Good command of SQL and relational database design, with experience in data processing and HTTP API integration.
 Experience with Git, collaborative development and Docker, together with an understanding of CI/CD and application deployment.
 Ability to translate user needs into reliable data visualization tools and usable dashboards.
 Strong organizational and communication skills, with experience coordinating technical activities and the ability to manage partner contributions, deadlines and deliverables independently.
 A clear motivation to contribute to the energy transition and to learn about photovoltaic technology systems. Excellent written and spoken English and a collaborative approach to working with researchers and engineers.
 Additional assets
 Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD and container registries, Grafana, SQLite, Linux administration or reverse proxies.
 Experience developing web interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, or Python-based web frameworks.
 Familiarity with time-series data, sensor integration, photovoltaic monitoring or energy performance analysis.
 Experience in Horizon Europe or other collaborative R&D projects, particularly work package coordination and technical reporting. French language skills are an advantage.
 We offer 
 A dynamic and stimulating work environment
 Access to state-of-the-art research facilities and laboratory resources
 Opportunity to collaborate with world-class scientists through a network of national and international stakeholders
 Opportunity to work at EPFL, an internationally renowned and top-ranking engineering university, which offers a dynamic, stimulating, interdisciplinary, international and friendly working environment, a broad range of scientific training and networking events and also hosts a vibrant entrepreneurial community
 Opportunity to combine research, scientific leadership, project management and industrial collaboration within a single role.
 Informations 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. 
 Contract Start Date : 01/01/2027 
 Activity Rate Min : 80.00 
 Activity Rate Max : 100.00 
 Contract Type: CDD
 Duration: 1 year renouvelable 
 Reference: 2527

Wir bieten einen Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge. Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Bei uns kommt wöchentlich ein Masseur (Massagen inkl. Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber) und wir veranstalten viele gemeinsame Team- und Firmenevents, vom Bowling übers Sommerfest bis zu selbst organisierten Kurzreisen. items.desc: Le descriptif de l’offre ci-dessous est en Anglais Type de contrat : CDD Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel Niveau d'expérience souhaité : De 3 à 5 ans A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelle Created in 2008, the Inria center at the University of Lille employs 360 people, including 305 scientists in 16 research teams. Recognized for its strong involvement in the socio-economic development of the Hauts-De-France region, the Inria center at the University of Lille maintains a close relationship with large companies and SMEs. By fostering synergies between researchers and industry, Inria contributes to the transfer of skills and expertise in the field of digital technologies, and provides access to the best of European and international research for the benefit of innovation and businesses, particularly in the region. For over 10 years, the Inria center at the University of Lille has been at the heart of Lille's university and scientific ecosystem, as well as at the heart of Frenchtech, with a technology showroom based on avenue de Bretagne in Lille, on the EuraTechnologies site of economic excellence dedicated to information and communication technologies (ICT). Contexte et atouts du poste The person will join the cross disciplinary project Loop (closed Loop neurOtechnologies: from sensOrs to aPplications). The project will implement an interdisciplinary strategy applied to the development of a mechanism-based therapy for drug-resistant hallucinations in patients with schizophrenia. The project will be structured around three main research pillars: 1) the algorithmic level of closed-loop systems (online signal processing, machine learning); 2) the design of a complete and non-invasive solution to address the question of refractory hallucinations, and study how closed-loop interaction schemes can be beneficial for highly impaired psychiatric patients; 3) the design of the sensors themselves and translational research with animal models, in order to enhance the quality of the recordings and pave the way for future invasive miniaturized solutions. In this context, the objective is to apply federated and decentralized learning techniques to learn predictive models. Mission confiée The objective is to adapt the declearn API to the specific case of FRMI and EEG data, time series and eventually to address the problem of federated learning in the neuromorphic paradigm. The work plan is the following Join the team that writes the data preparation pipeline. The challenges are the scalability with respect to data size, data dimensionality, and time dependent data. The declearn readers and data representation choices will be monitored and adapted to the new choices and constraints. Adapt and implement federated algorithms tailored to the learning problem specifications. A specific attention will be on the scalability and the efficiency of the communications. Extend DecLearn to the fully decentralized setting. Address the problem of privacy. Implement specific approaches for neuromorphic computation. Principales activités Develop code. Write documentation. Write tests. Launch experiments. Report activity in the consortium. items.card: you will work on the CRC project “Nonlinear imaging of structural order and symmetry breaking in mol2Dmat heterostructures” under the supervision of Dr. Niclas Mueller, starting as soon as possible. items.desc: Department: Department of Physics contract duration: limited untill 30.06.2029 Salary / pay grade: E 13 TV-L FU Working hours: 75 % Requisition ID: 968 Application deadline: 09.11.2026 Salary calculator TV-L Salary Student assistant TV Stud III Who We Are The Mueller group studies nanoscale light-matter coupling phenomena in quantum materials. We use polaritons to shrink light to the nanoscale and employ ultrafast nonlinear optical techniques to bridge phenomena in the typically separate mid-infrared and visible spectral ranges. We aim to advance the understanding of 2D quantum materials, activate new coupling channels to convert light between different spectral ranges, and engineer materials through hybrid light-matter states. Our group is funded by the Emmy Noether Programme of the German Research Foundation (DFG). More about the group: www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/einrichtungen/ag/ag-mueller/ The position is part of the Collaborative Research Centre CRC 1772 "mol2Dmat", which studies collective states and quantum phenomena in heterostructures of molecules and two-dimensional materials. 2D materials are atomically thin crystals that can be stacked into heterostructures with entirely new properties. CRC 1772 goes a step further by combining them with organic and inorganic molecules. The consortium brings together 20 physics and chemistry groups from Freie Universität Berlin, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, and Technische Universität Berlin. More about CRC 1772: www.crc1772.de What You Can Expect in Your New Role As a PhD student, you will work on the CRC project “Nonlinear imaging of structural order and symmetry breaking in mol2Dmat heterostructures” under the supervision of Dr. Niclas Mueller, starting as soon as possible. Specifically, you will: investigate how molecules self-assemble into ordered 2D lattices on van der Waals materials, and how collective excitonic states emerge in these heterostructures help build a new sum-frequency generation (SFG) microscope that combines ultrafast mid-infrared and visible lasers use nonlinear optical and photoluminescence microscopy to link the structural order of molecular lattices to the crystal structure of the underlying 2D material develop ways to tune the nonlinear optical response of these heterostructures through molecular charge transfer and electric fields collaborate closely with partner groups in the CRC, present your work at international conferences, and publish in leading journals What we offer: The structured, interdisciplinary graduate program of CRC 1772, with tailored training, workshops, retreats, and funding for conference travel A newly built, state-of-the-art nonlinear- and nano-optics laboratory Close, hands-on supervision in a young and growing group A large scientific network across Berlin's three major universities Key Requirements Master’s degree in Physics, Physical Chemistry, or a related discipline, completed by the start of the position. Desirable Research experience, for example from your Master's thesis, in at least one of these areas: nonlinear optics, 2D materials, organic semiconductors, or solid-state physics. Hands-on experience with experimental work, ideally optical setups Python programming skills, ideally including lab instrument automation Excellent command of written and spoken English; experience with scientific communication in English. Enthusiasm for teamwork and strong motivation to work on open scientific questions. We are committed to building a diverse research community and particularly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply. Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your application documents: A motivation letter explaining your interest in the project and relevant experience, as well as your earliest possible start date Your CV Certificates including transcripts of records from your Bachelor's and Master's studies. If you have not yet completed your Master's degree, please submit a current transcript of records and indicate when you expect to complete your degree. Please submit your application exclusively via our career portal by clicking the "Apply now" button. Applications submitted by post or by e-mail unfortunately cannot be considered. For further information, please contact Dr. Niclas Mueller (niclas.mueller@fu-berlin.de). Please note Freie Universität Berlin is an equal opportunity employer.

What we are looking for We are looking for a Cyber Security Operations Analyst to join our Security Operations Center team. In this role, you will protect Orange customer systems and environments, working directly with customers and security partners—not only on internal Orange services. What you’ll be doing Monitor and correlate security logs and events to identify potential threats. Investigate alerts, eliminate false positives and escalate genuine security incidents. Perform incident identification, triage, tracking, reporting and escalation. Protect Orange customer systems and support the resolution of security incidents. Work and interact directly with customers in a professional and effective manner. Collaborate with Orange Group Cyber Defense, Security Operations Centers and managed security service providers. Support security dashboards, assessments and testing activities. Contribute to security procedures, work instructions and continuous improvement initiatives. Prepare periodic and ad-hoc reports for management. Follow Orange security, quality, health and safety policies. • What you need to know/have University degree in IT, Telecommunications or a related field. Minimum one year of experience in security administration, network administration or a similar role. Mandatory hands-on experience with log onboarding, including collecting, integrating and validating security logs from customer systems. Knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line troubleshooting. Knowledge of security methodologies, processes and technical security solutions. Good understanding of TCP/IP, network analysis and network/security applications. Familiarity with common internet protocols and applications. Knowledge of SIEM and security event management. items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION A nutrition technician is required for Endocrinology and Nutrition research group to conduct research. The successful candidate will also be responsible for entering and managing the collected data in the REDCap database. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Performance of morphofunctional assessments of patients using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA), strength assessment, and anthropometric measurements, as well as the evaluation of the results. Performance of nutritional assessments and evaluation of the results. Data management: accurately entering patient data into the REDCap database within the established timelines. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Hold a bachelor's degree in Human Nutrition and Dietetics. Willingness to work in the field of Endocrinology and Nutrition. Ability and willingness to work in a team. Proven prior experience in clinical research. Proven good level of English. WHAT WE OFFER Type of contract and working hours: Permanent, part-time employment contract (10 hours per week) under the Spanish Science Law / Ley de la Ciencia. Estimated start date: 01/11/2026. Gross annual remuneration inherent to the square objected to this call, will be fixed based on the experience provided and the skills of the candidate, distributed in 12 payments. Flexible payment (childminding vouchers). 23 days holiday and 5 days for personal matters. Training capsules by the company. Be part of an excellent multidisciplinary research centre with the HRS4R badge. Location on the Can Ruti Campus, a first-class translational research environment in the Barcelona area, in a very stimulating scientific environment. The IGTP offers a supportive, friendly and collaborative ecosystem to promote professional development and help you achieve your research goals. FOR MORE INFORMATION http://www.germanstrias.org/ HOW TO APPLY Interested persons must attach to the application: Motivation letter explaining their interest in the position. Updated CV. Contact of 2-3 references. Applications will be evaluated in accordance with the guiding principles and objectives of the supply systems, following the process described below: Curricular evaluation : analysis of the curriculum vitae to assess aspects related to training, professional career and experience in positions related to the job position under selection. Personal interview : once the résumé has been evaluated, the selected candidates will be called for a personal interview to verify and expand on the information detailed in the résumé and to evaluate aspects related to experience and professional skill s. Applications that do not meet the requirements, that are not included in the cases foreseen or that are not processed in accordance with the established procedure will not be considered in the selection process. DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS The call for applications will close on October 28th, 2026. About us The Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) is a public research centre located in Badalona. Its main objective is to increase scientific knowledge in order to transform it into solutions to improve the health and medical care of patients and the community. The Institute is associated with one of the major university hospitals in the Barcelona area, the Germans Trias i Pujol Hospital, and is part of the Can Ruti biomedical campus. items.desc:
Chez Kiiro , nous accompagnons nos clients, de la scale-up aux grands comptes, dans la conception et l’industrialisation de leurs produits IA & data.
 En tant qu’ AI Engineer, vous construisez les systèmes qui orchestrent leurs modèles et résolvent leurs problèmes métiers.
En pratique, comptez environ 90 % de temps projet client (conception, build, industrialisation) et 10 % de contribution interne (partenariats, montée en compétence des équipes).
 Vous ne serez pas seul·e : rejoignez une équipe Data habituée au travail à distance, et vous vous appuyez sur nos partenariats Databricks et AWS. 
 Ce poste est ouvert aux profils ayant un background mixte en développement logiciel, Data Engineering ou Machine Learning, justifiant d’environ 1 an d’expérience concrète sur des architectures IA. 
 Vos missions : 
 Cadrer avec le client : vous êtes en première ligne pour comprendre le besoin et poser les bonnes questions.
 Concevoir & déployer sur le cloud : vous designez, développez et déployez des architectures cloud modernes (principalement AWS) et des services backend scalables au service des produits d’IA.
 Construire des systèmes agentiques : vous développez des agents, des systèmes RAG et des pipelines sur des données non structurées (documents, Speech-to-Text), principalement sur AWS et Databricks.
 Mettre en prod : CI/CD, conteneurs, infra as code, observabilité. Vous travaillez la latence, le coût des tokens et la tenue en charge.
 Évaluer & fiabiliser : vous mettez en place les évaluations et les garde-fous qui permettent de savoir si le système répond juste.
 Rester en veille & évangéliser : l’écosystème bouge très rapidement. Vous partagez ce qui mérite vraiment d’être adopté, en interne comme chez le client 🦸‍♂️
 Côté interne : 
 Partenariats : vous soutenez nos partenariats Databricks & AWS sur le volet technique.
 Diffusion de la culture Data & IA : webinars, événements en présentiel co-animés avec nos partenaires, publication d’articles.
 L’environnement technique : 
 Langages : Python, SQL
 Cloud & Serverless : AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock, Secrets Manager, KMS), Databricks.
 Bases de données & stockage : PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra.
 IA, Data & outillage : Python, SQL, architectures RAG, frameworks d’orchestration d’agents, Speech-to-Text, dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte.
 Pratiques : MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, conteneurisation.

Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait !L’IA évolue trop vite pour ça. Ce qui nous intéresse, c’est quelqu’un qui a déjà mis un système d’IA en production, qui l’a vu casser, et qui sait pourquoi.Ce qui compte pour nous :Vous avez au moins 3 ans en développement logiciel, Data Engineering ou ML, en produit ou en ESN.Vous êtes hands-on : solide expérience en Python et SQL.Vous avez construit et mis en production au moins un système d’IA générative : RAG, orchestration d’agents (Agentcore, Agent Bricks etc), usage d’APIs LLM, traitement de données non structurées.Vous avez une connaissance pratique des services Cloud AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, KMS, Bedrock). Vous venez de GCP ou d’Azure, les réflexes se transfèrent.Vous avez de bonnes pratiques software & DevOps : de bonnes bases en industrialisation applicative (CI/CD, conteneurisation Docker, versioning, tests automatisés).Français professionnel obligatoire et anglais technique.Vous avez une posture conseil :Communication et force de proposition : vous êtes en capacité d’interagir efficacement avec les équipes de développement et les différentes parties prenantes.Autonomie et gestion des priorités, en équipe comme en solo.Les petits + qui font plaisir :Une expérience sur Databricks.Des certifications AWS ou DatabricksCe poste n’est probablement PAS pour vous si…Vous n’avez jamais écrit de code qui tourne en production : votre parcours en ESN s’est fait côté pilotage ou coordination.Vous êtes plus à l’aise avec le POC qu’avec la production et tout ce qu’elle implique (monitoring, évals, incidents).Vous préférez recevoir des specs toutes faites plutôt qu’aller cadrer le besoin chez le client.Ce que nous vous proposons :🤑 Rémunération : 40 à 60K€.💪 Développement des compétences : formations certifiantes AWS et Databricks prises en charge, accompagnement individualisé, budget conférences.🏡 Rythme : hybride, télétravail fréquent et horaires flexibles.🚀 Une aventure à construire : vous n’arrivez pas dans une case figée. Votre expérience, votre savoir-être et votre ambition participeront activement au développement de votre rôle. Une trajectoire qui se construit avec celle de l’entreprise. Si vous avez envie de laisser votre empreinte plutôt que d’appliquer un cadre existant, vous allez vous plaire ici 🫶

items.desc: Akkodis est une société internationale de conseil en ingénierie numérique (digital engineering) qui accompagne les organisations dans leurs efforts d'innovation et de développement grâce à des solutions technologiques permettant de repenser la conception et l'optimisation des processus et produits. Fort de nos expertises reconnues en ingénierie, performance industrielle, digital et IA, nous associons solutions technologiques, approches cross-sectorielles et solides capacités d'exécution pour fournir des services de pointe en conseil en technologie. Avec notre approche Akkodis Intelligence, nous accompagnons les entreprises ainsi que les experts à relever des défis complexes et à obtenir des résultats durables. Akkodis compte près de 40 000 ingénieurs et experts du digital dans le monde. Akkodis est une marque de The Adecco Group. Missions La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d'Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région Île-de-France et recrute un(e) Docteur IA H/F en CDI à Courbevoie. Ce poste s'inscrit dans un contexte d'innovation en intelligence artificielle appliquée au secteur médical et d'industrialisation de projets de R&D. Vous interviendrez sur des missions à fort impact, en lien avec l'architecture de solutions IA et la transformation numérique des pratiques de santé. Responsabilités principales : Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles d'intelligence artificielle répondant aux besoins médicaux spécifiques. Analyser, interpréter et valoriser des données médicales complexes pour améliorer les diagnostics cliniques. Collaborer étroitement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour intégrer l'IA dans les processus métiers et cliniques. Assurer la conformité des solutions IA avec les normes éthiques, réglementaires et de confidentialité en santé. Participer à la formation et à la sensibilisation des professionnels de santé à l'usage de l'IA. Réaliser le prototypage rapide, piloter des PoC et rédiger des rapports techniques et scientifiques. Effectuer une veille scientifique et technique, valoriser les travaux R&D et contribuer à la publication d'articles scientifiques. Environnement de travail : Vous rejoignez la Direction Recherche & Développement Appliqué d'Akkodis et travaillez sur une diversité de projets innovants en environnement pluridisciplinaire. Vous évoluez au sein d'une équipe dynamique, ouverte à l'exploration technique, avec des interactions fréquentes avec des partenaires industriels et académiques. Vous participez à la gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, à la veille scientifique et à la transformation commerciale des solutions développées. Profil du candidat Diplômé(e) d'un doctorat (Bac+8) ou d'un diplôme d'ingénieur Bac+5 avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la data science, de l'intelligence artificielle ou des technologies médicales. Vous maîtrisez les algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique et profond, la programmation en Python ou R, ainsi que la gestion et la sécurisation des bases de données médicales. Vous démontrez une compréhension des enjeux réglementaires et éthiques en santé, ainsi que des aptitudes pour la gestion de projets et le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire. Des compétences complémentaires en mathématiques appliquées, cybersécurité, modélisation probabiliste ou dynamique des systèmes sont appréciées. La maîtrise des outils de visualisation de données et un anglais courant sont requis. Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

items.desc: Company Overview Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately. Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific. Group Overview The Digital and Synthetic Capability Unit (D&S) is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space. Position Summary In this role, you will apply machine learning, data science, and advanced analytical techniques to complex challenges across the electromagnetic environment. Working within Metrea’s Decision Science Laboratory (DESLAB) and automated Solution Engine, you will design, test, and deploy ML-enabled capabilities that go beyond traditional signal processing approaches. This includes exploring the potential of methods such as Transformers, self-supervised learning, probabilistic modelling and simulation-driven learning approaches for electromagnetic sensing and exploitation. You will be successful if you are comfortable moving between research, experimentation, and operational delivery, turning ambiguous Defence and Aerospace problems into robust technical solutions that can be tested, explained, and deployed in real-world settings. items.desc: Depuis 2019, Nextra s’affirme comme un hub d’innovation dédié à la data et à l’intelligence artificielle, en rupture avec les codes traditionnels du conseil. La société se distingue par : Une organisation à hiérarchie plate, et un partage des responsabilités RH Des investissements forts et continus dans l’IA (R&D, développement de produits, infrastructure…) Une capacité unique à activer des écosystèmes pour nourrir les réflexions et accélérer la transformation Nextra accompagne des clients de premier plan, grands groupes industriels, maisons emblématiques du luxe et acteurs publics, dans la structuration, le pilotage et le déploiement de leurs initiatives Data & IA les plus stratégiques. 👉 Pourquoi ce recrutement Chez Nextra, les équipes Data IA en environnement industriel jouent un rôle clé dans notre développement. Dans ce cadre, nous renforçons nos équipes pour accompagner des projets structurants autour de l’exploitation de données opérationnelles & industrielles et du développement de cas d’usage avancés en IA dans le domaine de la Data Science. Ces sujets s’inscrivent dans des contextes où les enjeux sont à la fois techniques et stratégiques, avec une forte attente sur la capacité à passer rapidement de l’expérimentation à la mise en production. 👉 Missions Missions principales : Vous concevez et développez des modèles avancés en machine learning et deep learning pour répondre à des problématiques complexes (classification, régression, séries temporelles, clustering...) Vous développez des cas d’usage en NLP en exploitant des modèles de langage (LLM) pour analyser, structurer et valoriser des données textuelles et tabulaires Vous construisez des POC innovants et convaincants pour démontrer rapidement l’impact des solutions IA Vous déployez des solutions data et IA en environnement cloud (Azure), incluant pipelines, APIs et intégration aux systèmes existants Vous participez activement à des projets de R&D en IA et contribuez à la veille technologique pour proposer de nouvelles approches Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes métiers pour traduire des problématiques complexes en solutions IA concrètes et opérationnelles Missions transverses et stratégiques : Vous contribuez activement à un chantier interne structurant permettant à Nextra de conserver sa posture d’avant-garde, tant sur le plan organisationnel que sur les contenus et formats proposés à nos clients. Vous êtes acteur du développement commercial de Nextra. En effet, les consultants ne sont pas uniquement preneurs du business généré, mais sont également amené à : effectuer une veille marché et concurrentielle afin d’anticiper les besoins émergents et de cibler les futurs clients. Conduire des actions de prospection, inscrites dans une stratégie définie, identifier et remonter des opportunités business issues des missions, contribuer à l’upsell et au développement de comptes existants. Vous collaborez à des sujets transverses en lien avec les fonctions supports, en partageant vos retours d'expérience avec les recruteurs ou encore, en participant aux onboardings des nouveaux collaborateurs. 👉 Vous vous épanouirez chez Nextra si Vous êtes curieux.se, cultivé.e et passionné.e : vous vous intéressez aux sujets de sociétés contemporains. Chez Nextra, la curiosité intellectuelle, l'envie d'échanger et de débattre n’est pas un “nice to have” mais c’est un socle commun. Vous êtes à l'aise dans des environnements professionnels codifiés : vous êtes régulièrement seul.e en front face à des C-levels, que nos clients soient des PME ou des multinationales, et vous les accompagnez sur des enjeux à fort impact. Vous vous adaptez aisément à des environnements codifiés et restez pédagogue et accessible dans votre discours. Vous n'attendez pas (uniquement) de reconnaissance extérieure : la progression chez Nextra ne passe pas par un track de carrière linéaire jalonné par des avancements de grade ou des progressions de coefficient. En revanche, le développement des compétences de chacun est bien réel, mais se passe de titre ou d'étiquette. Vous avez le sens de la réussite collective : que ce soit sur une mission, sur un chantier transverse ou lors de temps informels, vous prenez part à la vie du cabinet. Naturellement, vous aidez quand on vous sollicite, vous partagez vos acquis et vos problématiques, vous prenez un plaisir sincère à passer du temps avec le reste de l'équipe. 👉 Vous êtes probablement la bonne personne si Vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en data science dans des environnements exigeants (industrie, conseil ou R&D) Vous maîtrisez Python et SQL pour manipuler, modéliser et exploiter des données complexes Vous utilisez couramment des librairies de machine learning et deep learning (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) ainsi que des outils liés au NLP (type Hugging Face, transformers ou équivalent) Vous avez une première expérience ou un intérêt marqué pour les modèles de langage (LLM) et leurs applications concrètes (ex : GPT, BERT, …

items.desc: Description The opportunity ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences. Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks. Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias. Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them. Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts. Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing. A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation. Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices. Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field. Useful Additional Experience Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation. Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required. Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience. items.desc: About ELTEMATE ELTEMATE is a Hogan Lovells legal technology company. We make clients’ lives easier by delivering practical solutions to complex, everyday legal problems. Our portfolio spans artificial intelligence, eDiscovery, information analysis, regulatory intelligence, deal rooms, workflow and case management, document automation, risk assessment, reporting, and legal applications. Knowledge of distributed systems and high-availability service design. Experience with Rust, Go, or C++ for performance-critical components. Contributions to open-source AI or machine-learning projects. Experience conducting red-team exercises or building safeguards for AI applications. items.desc: Job Title: AI Engineer Entity: Aventum Group Department: Technology Location: London This isn’t a job description. It’s your invitation. At Aventum Group, we don’t hire to fill seats. We bring people in to build something real. We want people to join us (that person might be you) on our mission to be the world’s most inspiring insurance group, not by playing it safe but by delivering the unexpected and creating meaningful impact. That means backing ideas early, trusting people to own their work and giving them the space to grow faster than they thought possible. If you’re looking for rigid career paths or a one-size-fits-all management, Aventum Group probably isn’t for you. However, if you do want responsibility from day one, honest feedback and a culture that expects you to speak up, take ownership and keep getting better, then you might just be a great fit. Some people join us knowing exactly where they want to go. Others figure it out once they’re here. Both work here - the question is, will you? What You’ll Take On (The Actual Job Description) So you’re looking for a new challenge? This is your chance to step into a role with real responsibility. You’ll be given the space to own your work, supported to move as fast as you want and expected to keep raising the bar for yourself and the business. AI Engineer – Behavioural & Decision Systems. This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who wants their models to matter. You’ll take advanced behavioural and decision‑based AI and turn it into production systems that sit at the core of live digital products. Your work will shape how our platforms predict behaviour, make decisions and adapt in real time, powering Digital Twins, agentic systems and intelligent automation across the business. You’ll operate at the point where modelling meets delivery, with real ownership from data through to live impact. What you’ll do Turn behavioural and sequential models into production‑grade systems that directly influence real decisions and outcomes. Own end‑to‑end AI pipelines, from raw data to monitored, reliable inference in live products. Embed causal thinking into how we evaluate impact, helping teams understand what actually changes behaviour and why. Build AI services that integrate cleanly into existing platforms, shaping APIs, events and decision flows alongside engineers. Bring behavioural dynamics to life in Digital Twins and agentic systems, making complex decision processes observable and actionable. This role is built for someone who backs themselves, takes ownership and wants to see their work used not parked in notebooks. If you are willing to learn, take ownership and ask questions when you don’t know the answer, you’re already off to a great start. Why Apply Because you want more than a job title. Because you want to grow, not wait your turn. Because you want to be trusted to do good work (and get recognised when you do it). And because you want to help build something inspiring, unexpected and meaningful. So… challenge accepted?
