items.desc: About ve2ventures We're ve2ventures, a venture studio that invests in external startups and also builds our own companies from the ground up. We're a mix of entrepreneurs, product people and tech experts who love building innovative products. Together, we're building the world's largest sports and media tech ecosystem. In 2 years, we've grown to a team of 60+, working on over 20 ventures and supported by 35 investors. As our startups grow, so does our need for strong technical talent. That's where you, our new Machine Learning Engineer, come in. You'll join the data science team behind PadelPlay, our padel performance platform. It turns data from a wearable sensor into shot detection, technique feedback and AI coaching for thousands of players. The Role As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own models from the first look at the data through to production. You'll build, evaluate and ship the ML and AI features players use after every session. You'll work closely with the app, backend and product teams, and as you grow you'll take on more of the technical decisions about how we model, deploy and monitor what we build. What You'll Do - Own the full ML lifecycle: data collection and labelling, feature engineering, training, rigorous evaluation, deployment and monitoring. - Design evaluation that holds up in the real world. That means testing on users the model hasn't seen, and being honest about what the numbers can and can't tell us. - Build and maintain the data pipelines and serving infrastructure behind our models (serverless functions, queues, object storage, SQL/NoSQL databases) across dev, staging and production. - Build LLM-powered features such as our AI coach: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval, multi-language output and guardrails, using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic and TypesafeAI. - Use AI-assisted, agentic development in your own workflow (e.g. Claude Code) to move fast without cutting corners. - Turn product questions from the PM and coaches into clear experiments, and explain the results to non-technical stakeholders. - Help improve our tooling, reproducibility and code quality as the team grows. What You Bring Required - 3–5 years of experience as an ML Engineer, Data Scientist or similar, with models you've taken to production. - Strong Python and the standard ML stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; PyTorch or similar). - Solid grounding in classical ML and evaluation: cross-validation, avoiding leakage, handling class imbalance, choosing the right metric. - Experience deploying and maintaining models or data services on a cloud platform (Azure preferred ). - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar). - Comfort with SQL and working with messy, real-world data. - A strong sense of ownership, a pragmatic mindset, and clear written and spoken English. Nice to Have - Experience with time-series, sensor or wearable data (accelerometer/gyroscope, signal processing). - Sports, health or fitness tech experience. - Model explainability (e.g. SHAP) and turning model output into feedback people can act on. - LLM agents, RAG or LLM observability tooling. - Serverless and container-based deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. - Experience in a startup or small, fast-moving team. Why This Role Is Interesting You'll work on a product where ML is the product. Your models run on real players' sessions every day, and the results go straight into what they see in the app. The problems are hard in the good way: noisy sensor data, a small number of expert reference players, and feedback that has to be accurate and useful to an amateur on court. You'll have real ownership, a short path from idea to production, and an AI-native workflow you can help push further.

items.desc: We are QUALCO, the technology arm of Qualco Group, with over 25 years of experience in delivering innovative solutions to the financial sector. We serve clients in over 30 countries, helping banks and other financial institutions manage credit and loans effectively while ensuring full regulatory compliance. Our advanced software leverages analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies to support every stage of the credit and lending lifecycle, remaining at the forefront of fintech innovation. Qualco is building its Credit Institution (CI), a first-of-its-kind non-bank lending entity in Greece, currently in the licensing process with the Bank of Greece, targeting launch in H1 2027. The AI/ML Engineer will be a core builder of the credit decision engine that powers this new entity, working directly on Qualco ML Studio . This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of ML platform development, financial data integration and credit decisioning, building the flows that turn data into credit decisions at scale. Responsibilities: Design, implement and maintain ML flows on Qualco ML Studio powering the CI's credit decision engine — from data ingestion through feature engineering to model scoring and decision output; Build and own data integrations for model inputs from internal sources (application database, D3E data layer) and external bureaus (Teiresias credit bureau), ensuring data quality, latency and reliability standards are met; Implement end-to-end ML pipelines using ML Studio's Workflow Canvas and AutoML capabilities across credit risk use cases: application scoring, limit setting, fraud detection and behavioral monitoring; Collaborate with Data Scientists to translate model specifications into production-ready flows and with Product and Engineering to embed model outputs into the credit decisioning workflow; Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for model deployment, versioning and monitoring, ensuring traceability and governance requirements for a regulated financial entity are met; Contribute to MLOps best practices: model drift monitoring, retraining triggers, performance logging and audit trails required by the Bank of Greece regulatory framework; Support integration of ML Studio with Qualco's broader AI Suite (Data Studio → ML Studio → Agentic Studio) & non-AI Suite to ensure a coherent data-to-decision flow; Ensure all activities are carried out in full compliance with Credit institution regulatory requirements; and Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements and supporting the continued implementation of the Group Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policy. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in ML engineering or a closely related Data Engineering role; Proven track record building and deploying ML pipelines in prod — not just prototyping; Strong Python skills; proficiency with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM or equivalent); familiarity with SQL and data pipeline tooling; Experience with CI/CD practices, Git, Docker/Kubernetes and MLOps tooling for model delivery and monitoring; Hands-on experience integrating data from multiple sources (APIs, databases, third-party bureaus or equivalent), having built the plumbing, not just the models; Understanding of model interpretability and explainability requirements — essential for a regulated credit context; Fluency in Greek and English oral and written. Nice to Have: Experience in financial services, Fin/Tech, banking, or any regulated environment where model governance and audit trails are non-negotiable; Familiarity with credit risk use cases: application scoring, behavioural models, PD/LGD, or collections prioritisation; Knowledge of credit bureau integrations (Teiresias or equivalent) or open banking data sources; Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and understanding of data lake / data warehouse architecture; Exposure to Qualco ML Studio or similar low-code/AutoML platforms for financial ML. Within a truly human-centred environment built on mutual respect and trust, your dedication to our shared vision will not only be recognized but also celebrated, offering boundless opportunities for your personal and professional growth. items.desc: 🚀 Your role At Dataroots, we deliver end-to-end data and AI solutions, from strategy and platform design to data engineering and AI-enabled systems. That broad scope is reflected in our team: AI engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, and data strategists. Each discipline brings its own expertise, but we share knowledge, perspectives, and a common way of thinking across disciplines. Within that team, you design, build and deploy AI solutions that deliver tangible business value for our clients across a variety of industries, spanning classical ML, modern GenAI, and Agentic AI use cases. Beyond developing AI solutions, you have a particular passion for bringing them into production. You design robust deployment pipelines, automate testing and releases, implement monitoring and observability, and help build AI systems that remain reliable, scalable and maintainable throughout their lifecycle. By combining strong AI engineering skills with expertise in MLOps and LLMOps, you help clients operationalize AI at scale. Whether it's deploying machine learning models, productionizing GenAI applications, or improving the reliability and governance of AI systems, you ensure solutions are built to create lasting business value. 💼 Your Expertise You bring the following to the table: A deep passion for Artificial Intelligence and modern AI engineering practices. At least 3 years of experience building, deploying and operating AI systems in production. Strong software engineering skills , with excellent proficiency in Python and SQL and a solid understanding of software engineering best practices. Experience building modern GenAI applications and familiarity with LLMOps practice s such as prompt management, evaluation frameworks, retrieval-based systems, guardrails, AI observability and LLM lifecycle management. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for AI applications. Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tooling. Experience deploying AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). A solid understanding of MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model lifecycle management, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, observability and versioning. Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for clients. A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset : able to translate business problems into technical scopes and help AI solutions land, with a focus on product thinking and real business value. Experience working in consulting is a strong plus. Fluency in English. Dutch and/or French is a significant advantage. Not every box needs to be ticked to be a great fit. If you’re excited about the role and eager to grow, we’d still love to hear from you. 🎉 Why choose Dataroots? We’re a data & AI consulting company where people, growth, and impact go hand in hand. Since our early days, we’ve built a culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and an environment where individuals can thrive. This focus has allowed us to grow steadily while staying true to what matters: delivering meaningful results for our clients and creating a place where people enjoy doing their best work. Working at Dataroots means gaining exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone, while being supported by experienced colleagues who are always ready to share their expertise. As part of the Talan Group, we further extend these opportunities by offering an international dimension to your career path. 💰 What we offer An attractive salary with extralegal benefits, including: + Mobility budget or a company car with fuel/charging card + Hospitalisation and group insurance + High-end laptop + Smartphone with subscription + Substantial amount of holidays + Meal vouchers + ... Diverse and welcoming work environment , where you’ll collaborate & unwind with colleagues from different cultures and disciplines. The organisation of both fun & professional events and initiatives is actively encouraged and supported. A training budget for individual and team learning opportunities. Tons of team-building events and sports initiatives to stay connected and unwind. 📍 Where you’ll work Our main offices are in Leuven and Ghent . These spaces are perfect for both focusing and unwinding with colleagues, as well as brainstorming sessions and team events. While much of your work can be performed remotely, you will also work on-site with clients . 🎯 Ready to join Dataroots? Excited to shape the future of AI with us? We’re looking forward to hearing from you! Apply now and start a new chapter as AI Engineer (MLOps & LLMOps) at Dataroots! 🎉

items.desc: About Axom Axom is a venture-backed AI company building a marketing automation platform that helps businesses choose the next best action for each customer. We combine behavioural data, predictive models and decision optimisation to personalise customer interactions and deliver measurable commercial value. Our existing clients include online casino operators, where high volumes of customer activity create complex, real-time decision problems. Our platform is designed to work across sectors, and we are expanding our partnerships to bring intelligent personalisation to other businesses and platforms. Our next phase is agentic AI for next-best-action (NBA) systems: agents that can use models and tools, recommend or orchestrate marketing actions, and learn from outcomes and user feedback. We are developing this capability around clear business objectives, human oversight and reliable evaluation. We move quickly, with a small, highly technical team and a practical approach to testing ideas and shipping improvements. You will work closely with colleagues across data science, engineering and product, with real ownership of the decisions our platform makes. The role We are looking for a Data Scientist with commercial experience, strong Python skills and practical machine learning experience to help improve the models and analysis behind Axom. You will join a talented and ambitious engineering team, contributing to established systems and learning new techniques as our product develops. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with data and solving business problems. You will have ownership of defined projects, with support from the wider team on specialist modelling, production deployment and agentic AI development. This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in the office. What you will do • Explore and prepare customer data, investigate patterns and help answer questions about product and client performance. • Build, train and evaluate machine learning models, and improve existing models through feature engineering and validation. • Contribute to our predictive models for customer lifetime value, churn and response to marketing actions, including the deep neural networks we use, with support from colleagues. • Write clear, maintainable Python code and use AI coding agents to support development, reviewing and testing the code they produce. • Work with engineers to put models and analysis into use, and help monitor their performance and investigate issues. • Contribute to experiments and analysis that help us understand whether changes improve customer decisions and commercial outcomes. • Contribute to our agentic AI and next-best-action capabilities alongside the wider team. • Explain your findings clearly and collaborate with colleagues to turn analysis into practical product improvements. What we are looking for Must have • At least 3 years of commercial work experience in data science, analytics, software development or a related technical role. • A university degree in a technical subject, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics or engineering. • Strong Python skills, including practical experience using pandas to prepare, analyse and work with data. • SQL skills and experience working with behavioural or transactional datasets. • Practical experience applying supervised machine learning to real-world problems, including training models, evaluating performance and understanding overfitting and data leakage. • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents or assistants, such as Codex, Claude, or Cursor, to write and improve code, with the ability to understand, review and test their output. Nice to have • Experience across different model types, including regression, random forests, gradient boosting models and neural networks. • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. • Experience using Git, working through code review, or helping deploy and monitor machine learning models. • Knowledge of statistics, A/B testing, experimental design or measuring incremental business impact. • Experience with LLMs, AI agent workflows or frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. • Experience with Azure, Databricks or Synapse, real-time analytics, or data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI. • Experience with customer lifetime value, churn, recommendation systems, or marketing optimisation. • Familiarity with causal inference, uplift modelling, contextual bandits or reinforcement learning. You do not need to have worked with every technology listed above. We are looking for strong core skills, clear communication, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Why join Axom You will work on real business problems, see how your work influences customer decisions, and develop your skills alongside a highly technical team. As Axom expands its agentic AI capabilities, you will have opportunities to contribute and build experience in this area.

We’ve grown very fast and are determined to keep doing so. What brought us here is our desire for continuous evolution and practical results. More than 6000 colleagues are part of eMAG Teams . We strongly believe in people's development and therefore every year we invest more and more energy and resources to remain an organization that is constantly learning. We want to ensure that you’ll have the most talented colleagues and the proper environment to grow and achieve great results, to become what you desire on a personal and professional level. Join us, grow faster ! Commercial Data Scientist (Flip Team) FLIP is the leading refurbished consumer electronics platform in Southeast Europe, operating across Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Greece. As part of the eMAG ecosystem, we are building the most trusted marketplace for pre-owned devices, and growing fast. We run a data-driven, performance-obsessed commercial operation, and we are looking for someone who loves turning complexity into clear decisions. The Commercial Data Scientist acts actually as A Decision Intelligence operator . Are we taking the right decisions based on our strategy and objectives? Is the planning reflecting reality? What are the Risks & Opportunities and how can we tap them? Your role will build and consolidate models & frameworks that recommend the best way forward to hitting our targets and creating clarity for strategic choices & their trade-offs. This is a high-exposure role. You will present to senior leadership, challenge assumptions with data, and engage directly with Commercial/Growth, Marketing, Supply, Finance, Operations, and Product & Tech to turn insight into action. You will also co-create the engine behind FLIP’s forecasting capability: building the process, challenging the inputs and co-owning the accuracy. What you’ll have to do: What This Role Is Really About The core of the job is triangulation: reconciling several independent angles on the same number until you can defend it and explain what moved it. We expect you to triangulate three sets of drivers: GMV: what is driving growth, or holding it back. Profitability: the quality of that growth, not just its size. Forecast accuracy: how much confidence we can put behind the plan. Triangulate means you never take a single number at face value. You cross-check top-down against bottom-up, model against actuals, volume against price, and you can always say which driver moved and by how much (by having a clear view of correlation and causality between drivers). Responsibilities Build and scale price elasticity models for the shop: conversion versus price at product level, feeding the Pricing engine directly, with clear guardrails on Gross Margin. Industrialize the Pricing engine: evolve it from its current Excel and Python setup toward an automated, product-level system. Design and execute pricing experiments and A/B tests across shops, and convert results into recommendations with quantified impact. Act as the sounding board for the Commercial team: pressure-test plans, assortment choices and price moves with data before they land. Be a sparring partner to the Demand/Growth team: challenge and sharpen the demand and pricing thinking behind the growth plan, not just report on it. Generate insights on elasticity, customer behavior and market dynamics per market, using fair like-for-like comparisons. Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation and AI usage, including automated reporting against budget and current forecast. Build models and frameworks that make trade-offs explicit: price versus volume, category mix versus margin, promotional cost versus incremental units. Act as a trusted analytical partner to growth, marketing, supply, finance, and product leadership, and navigate competing priorities across them. What makes you a good fit: 5+ years in data science / commercial analysis, business intelligence, management consulting, or a similar role in a data-intensive environment. A quantitative degree (Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related). Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling and machine learning. Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL. Proven experience in time-series forecasting (modeling, feature engineering, evaluation at scale). A/B testing and experimental design experience with measurable business impact. Daily use of AI tools in your workflow. FLIP runs Claude Enterprise across the company; we expect you to build with it, not around it. A proactive, self-starting mindset with end-to-end ownership of your domain. Strong stakeholder management: you can hold your ground in a commercial debate and explain what a model implies for the P&L to senior leadership, in plain language. items.desc: AI Engineer: agentic systemen voor de tandartspraktijk Fulltime · €5.000 – €7.000 per maand + aandelenopties Aivory heeft net €2 miljoen opgehaald en groeit hard. Daarom zoeken we een AI Engineer die met ons de volgende stap zet. Over Aivory Een tandartspraktijk draait op honderden kleine handelingen: telefoon opnemen, afspraken plannen, verwijzingen verwerken, declareren, patiënten herinneren. Nu doen mensen dat met de hand. Aivory automatiseert die handelingen. In acht maanden gingen we van nul naar 100 praktijken. Na de eerste omzetting leek het een onmogelijke klus. Nu zetten we een praktijk om in iets meer dan een uur. In oktober en november doen we in sommige weken tien per week, met drie mensen. De bottleneck zit niet meer in het omzetten. Die zit in zorgen dat een praktijk ons systeem vanaf de eerste dag maximaal gebruikt. Daar hebben we goede ideeën voor. Daar zoeken we iemand voor. Dit is geen 9-tot-5-baan We zitten midden in hypergroei gemiddeld 10% week over week. Er komen elke week nieuwe praktijken bij, en wat vandaag af is, moet volgende maand op veel meer volume werken. Dat vraagt tempo, eigenaarschap en soms een avond doorwerken als iets live moet. Daar krijg je iets voor terug wat je bij een groot bedrijf niet leert. Je bouwt van idee tot iets wat zorgverleners elke dag gebruiken. Je zit dicht op de oprichters, ziet hoe beslissingen worden genomen en draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor grote stukken van het product. Wat je gaat doen • Agents bouwen die echt werk overnemen in de praktijk, van de AI-receptioniste aan de telefoon tot agents die administratie en planning afhandelen • Bepalen hoe agents bij de juiste context komen: tool-design, retrieval, geheugen en de koppeling met onze bestaande data • Evaluaties en monitoring bouwen, zodat we weten wanneer een agent het goed doet en wanneer niet. In de zorg is "meestal goed" niet goed genoeg • Meewerken in de codebase (TypeScript, NestJS, Angular, PostgreSQL) en features opleveren die productie halen • Meedenken over architectuur, kosten en betrouwbaarheid van LLM-gebruik op schaal Wat je meeneemt • Je hebt agentic systemen gebouwd die in productie draaien, niet alleen demo's. Je weet waar ze stukgaan • Je hebt een stevige basis als software engineer: je schrijft onderhoudbare code, denkt na over datamodellen en test je werk • Je hebt ervaring met LLM-API's, tool calling, prompt- en contextontwerp en evaluatie • Je hebt affiniteit met privacy en security. We werken met medische gegevens onder AVG en NEN 7510 • Je krijgt energie van tempo en onzekerheid, en je pakt dingen op zonder te wachten tot iemand het vraagt • Pré: ervaring met voice agents, TypeScript/NestJS of multi-tenant SaaS Wat wij bieden • €5.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring • Aandelenopties • Werk dat direct effect heeft: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken zorgverleners de week erna • Een klein team, korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en veel verantwoordelijkheid Interesse? Reageer op deze vacature of mail Ties op ties@aivory.nl. Vertel kort over een agent die je hebt gebouwd: wat het deed, en wat er misging.

items.desc: Wil jij zélf kunnen bepalen bij welke opdrachtgever je werkt — en daar het verschil maken met slimme AI-oplossingen? Én werk je graag in een omgeving vol kennis, innovatie en collega’s die net zo enthousiast zijn over AI als jij? Dan pas jij perfect als expert bij Data Talents. Dit ga je doen Als AI Engineer zet jij je expertise tijdelijk in bij grote opdrachtgevers, waar jij werkt aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante AI-uitdagingen. Denk aan het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare AI componenten, het ontwikkelen van data pipelines voor LLM`s of het realiseren van vector search systemen. Jij vertaalt abstracte vraagstukken naar werkende AI-oplossingen, en dat doe je niet alleen — wij staan altijd voor je klaar met begeleiding, sparring en kennisdeling. Jouw nieuwe thuisbasis Data Talents is een open, platte organisatie waar jouw ontwikkeling voorop staat. Je maakt deel uit van een team van ruim 80 collega’s — data engineers, scientists én AI-specialisten — met wie je kennis deelt, ervaringen uitwisselt en af en toe ook gewoon leuke dingen doet. Denk aan kennissessies, peer reviews, of een weekendje Texel. We zijn groot genoeg om veel expertise in huis te hebben, en klein genoeg om persoonlijk te blijven. Dit mag je van ons verwachten Je gaat bij ons aan de slag als midlancer. Dat betekent: de autonomie van een ondernemer én de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband. Je bepaalt zelf welke opdrachten je oppakt, hoe je je werkweek inricht en hoe je je ontwikkelt. En dat zie je terug: 70% van je uurtarief is voor jou. Via onze House of Talents Academy zorgen we voor verdieping in je vakgebied, met trainingen in onder andere: deep learning, NLP, MLOps en ethische AI. Jouw persoonlijke Business Manager (met inhoudelijke kennis van AI!) begeleid je bij elke stap. In het kort betekent werken bij Data Talents: Zelf kiezen welke AI-uitdaging bij je past Werken aan modellen die écht worden gebruikt 70% van het uurtarief bij de klant is voor jou Salaris tussen €7.000 en €11.000 per maand Onbeperkt vakantiedagen opnemen Sparren met een community van AI- en dataspecialisten Een thuisbasis in Utrecht Permanente scholing en training Elk kwartaal iets leuks doen met je collega’s (niet verplicht, wél leuk) Onkosten- en reiskostenvergoeding Dit verwachten wij van jou Wij zoeken AI Engineers die energie krijgen van complexe vraagstukken en graag samenwerken aan slimme oplossingen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en weet technische concepten helder uit te leggen. Daarnaast zijn er een aantal ‘vinkjes’ die we graag zetten voordat we het gesprek met je aangaan: Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het datadomein, waarvan 3 jaar ervaring met AI, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Image Recognition of Operational Research. Je hebt ruime kennis van RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Je hebt ervaring met LLM platformen zoals OpenAI/ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Hbo- of academisch werk- en denkniveau Je programmeert soepel in Python Je hebt ervaring met dataplatforms zoals Databricks en Snowflake Je hebt ervaring met TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark of soortgelijke frameworks Je bent bekend met MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes en cloud (AWS, Azure of GCP) Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en woont in Nederland Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Bij Data Talents zijn de lijnen kort – ook in onze sollicitatieprocedure. Dus: spreken de werkzaamheden, het team én onze organisatie je aan? Stuur ons dan jouw sollicitatie. Als jij de expert bent die we zoeken, plannen we snel een digitale kennismaking met je in. Heb je eerst nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met Erik van Galen via 06 – 824 91 411 (appen kan ook) of via erik.van.galen@data-talents.nl. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen! Onderdeel van House of Talents Data Talents is een van de domeinen van House of Talents Nederland, waar we dagelijks met meer dan 1.000 topexperts werken om de verwachtingen van onze opdrachtgevers én onszelf te overtreffen. Ook zijn we - net als House of Talents België - onderdeel van de internationale holding World of Talents, waardoor we de mooiste opdrachtgevers met de meest uitdagende interim opdrachten aantrekken en onze expertise kunnen delen.

Building MVPs & Impact: Onze Business Analisten (BA's) experimenteren in tools zoals Google AI Studio & Lovable. Jij pakt hun ideeën op en bouwt de nodige code en integraties om hier een werkend prototype van te maken. Jouw code vormt de blauwdruk voor nieuwe features in ons platform. Vibe Coding naar Marktvalidatie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het technische fundament van nieuwe features. Samen met de BA’s vertaal je AI-gestuurde prototypes naar eerste werkbare versies. Je bouwt een solide basis waarop interne validatie en demo's uitgevoerd kunnen worden. De brug naar Productie: Zodra de product-market fit bewezen is, verzorg je een gestroomlijnde overdracht naar ons Core Engineering team. Zij integreren jouw MVP vervolgens definitief binnen het BrightAnalytics platform. Speed to Market: Je hebt een sterke drang om zaken 'live' te zien gaan. Je werkt autonoom en begrijpt de essentie van een MVP: focus op de kernfunctionaliteit zonder je te verliezen in details, maar wel rustend op een kwalitatieve technische basis. Welke waarden breng jij naar ons Business Analist team? Technical Stack: Je bent minstens twee jaar ervaring als developer. Jouw focus ligt op Python (voor AI/data). Kennis van design patterns is een plus, zodat je begrijpt hoe jouw innovaties uiteindelijk landen in ons core platform. AI Obsessed: Je volgt de razendsnelle AI-evolutie niet alleen, je experimenteert er dagelijks mee. Je begrijpt de logica achter LLM’s en technical prompting, waardoor je AI-gegenereerde concepten razendsnel vertaalt naar robuuste oplossingen. Startup Mentaliteit: Je houdt van snelheid. Je bent comfortabel met onzekerheid en vindt het leuk om vanaf een wit blad te vertrekken. Business Mindset: Je denkt graag mee over de waarom achter de code. Je vindt het interessant om te begrijpen voor welke uitdagingen onze klanten (zoals CFO’s of finance managers) staan, zodat jouw technische keuzes ook een functioneel schot in de roos zijn. Communicator: Je kunt technische uitdagingen helder uitleggen aan je collega's en staat open voor hun feedback vanuit de markt. Daarnaast communiceer je vlot met ons Development team, dit zowel voor hun UX experience als technische insights. Welke voordelen kan je van BrightAnalytics verwachten? Een plekje in één van de snelst groeiende fintech bedrijven in België Wij zijn een internationale, financieel gezonde en ISO-gecertificeerde scale-up met veel ambitie Een open en ondernemende cultuur waar jouw ideeën écht het verschil maken Je maakt deel uit van een gedreven, dynamisch en enthousiast team en je kan ook rekenen op een job vol variatie On-the-job coaching en groeikansen Maar liefst 20 wettelijke + 12 extra vakantiedagen Flexibele werkuren, dat wil zeggen opstarten tussen 7u30 en 9u30 en jouw pc dichtklappen vanaf 16u30 tot 18u30 Bedrijfswagen Maaltijdcheques van 10 euro per gewerkte dag; Ecocheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Alan Health Benefits (jouw aanvullende complete gezondheidsverzekering) Friday after work drinks, legendarische teambuildings en een jaarlijks weekend met het voltallige BrightAnalytics team Interesse? items.desc: Als Workplace AI & Automation Specialist bouw je AI- en automatiseringsoplossingen die collega's door heel Coolblue slimmer en efficiënter laten werken. Je voert projecten van idee tot resultaat uit en bouwt aan AI-agents die processen zelfstandig kunnen uitvoeren. Je weet precies wanneer je een AI-tool inzet en wanneer een nieuw te bouwen integratie nodig is. Wat je doet Je voert automatiseringsprojecten van begin tot eind uit. Je maakt handmatig, repetitief en tijdrovend werk overbodig. Dat doe je door het slim te automatiseren. Dat kan van alles zijn: een proces dat steeds dezelfde handelingen vraagt, werk dat informatie uit verschillende hoeken moet samenbrengen, of taken die continu opvolging nodig hebben. Zo houden teams tijd over voor het werk dat er écht toe doet. Steeds vaker doe je dit met agentic AI. Je bouwt AI-agents die zelfstandig stappen zetten, keuzes maken en taken afronden. Je geeft ze de juiste skills en tools, test hoe ze werken en verbetert ze steeds verder. Soms bouw je daarbij, samen met een Data Engineer, een integratie via een API. Soms los je het zelfstandig sneller en slimmer op met LLM-tooling. Jij kiest de beste route en maakt het werkend. Past onze huidige tooling niet bij het probleem? Dan stel je een betere oplossing en tooling voor. Door de hele organisatie liggen kansen om werk slimmer te automatiseren, en daar ga jij mee aan de slag. Steeds een ander team, steeds een andere uitdaging. Jij bent de schakel die die kansen herkent, de juiste vragen stelt en weer vertrekt met een werkende oplossing. Zo voeg je voor de hele organisatie waarde toe. Wat je kan Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld richting (data) engineering, informatica, (business) informatiemanagement of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring, bij voorkeur in automation, development of data-gerelateerd werk. Affiniteit met AI, LLM-tooling en het bouwen van AI-agents. Ervaring met SQL, Python en API's. Inschatten wanneer AI past en wanneer een andere oplossing beter werkt. Makkelijk schakelen met stakeholders en ideeën omzetten in werkende oplossingen. Goed Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift. Wat je krijgt Geld. Ongekend goede werksfeer. Waar we met elkaar omgaan als vrienden en je gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Maandelijkse borrels, versbereide happen, legendarische Coolblue-feesten en de leukste teamactiviteiten Een fijne combinatie van werken op kantoor en vanuit huis. Natuurlijk zorgen we dat je thuis een top werkplek hebt. Inclusief bureaustoel, laptop en blauwe slingers. Alle ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën, initiatieven en keuzes. Jij doet je werk op jouw manier. Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en een vergoeding voor als je thuiswerkt. 25 vakantiedagen. Als je belooft dat je terugkomt. Een kantoor waar je foto's van wilt maken op een toplocatie. Vanaf Rotterdam Centraal is het 3 keer vallen voor je er bent. Oké, het is 2 minuten lopen. Meer dan 100 trainingen in onze eigen Studiefabriek om elke dag een beetje beter te worden. Korting op alle spullen die we verkopen. #Jobster

items.desc: Sobre a BindTuning Há mais de uma década que a BindTuning ajuda organizações de todo o mundo a fazer o Microsoft 365 funcionar como deve ser. A nossa plataforma de Workspace Integrity mantém os ambientes Microsoft 365 governados, seguros, preparados para IA e efetivamente usados. Somos Microsoft Solutions Partner for Modern Work, trabalhamos com clientes e parceiros internacionais e temos uma equipa pequena, próxima e com muita autonomia. O desafio Procuramos alguém que transforme processos manuais em fluxos inteligentes. Vais identificar oportunidades de automação, dentro da BindTuning e para os nossos clientes, e construir soluções que combinam ferramentas Microsoft 365 com modelos de IA. O que vais fazer Desenhar, construir e manter automações com Claude, Power Automate, Logic Apps, Azure Functions e APIs (Microsoft Graph, REST). Integrar modelos de IA (Claude, Copilot, agentes e LLMs) em processos de trabalho reais, enquadrando Skills, MCPs com conversações em linguagem natural. Automatizar processos internos de equipas como suporte, vendas, marketing e operações. Apoiar a equipa de produto e de customer success em casos de uso de IA e automação para clientes Documentar soluções, monitorizar a sua fiabilidade e melhorá-las continuamente. Acompanhar as novidades do ecossistema Microsoft 365 e IA e propor novas ideias. O que procuramos Conhecimentos de scripting ou programação (PowerShell, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) Familiaridade com APIs, JSON e integração entre sistemas Experiência prática com ferramentas de IA generativa e prompt engineering Conhecimento de Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Azure, Power Platform) é uma grande vantagem. Pensamento analítico, autonomia e vontade de aprender rápido Bom inglês, falado e escrito Valorizamos Experiência com Claude, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry ou frameworks de agentes Certificações Microsoft (PL-900, PL-400, AI-900, AI-102) Experiência em ambiente SaaS ou consultoria O que oferecemos Projetos tecnicamente desafiantes na interseção entre Microsoft 365 e IA Clientes e parceiros internacionais Horário flexível e possibilidade de trabalho híbrido Formação e Certificações Microsoft Uma equipa com forte cultura de partilha e espaço real para crescer Se gostas de pôr a IA a trabalhar a sério e de eliminar tarefas repetitivas, queremos conhecer-te. items.desc: At the Institute for the Protection of Maritime Infrastructure in Bremerhaven, we research and develop innovative solutions to strengthen the resilience of maritime infrastructure and ensure it is adaptable, safe and sustainable. Working closely with partners from research, industry and other stakeholders in maritime security, we combine technological innovation with practical expertise and offer you the chance to work on pioneering projects. What To Expect We develop innovative sensing and imaging technologies to address challenges in the protection and security of critical infrastructures. One of our key research areas is muon tomography, a non-destructive imaging technique that uses elementary particles to investigate dense, shielded and difficult-to-access objects. We are now exploring the use of artificial muon sources based on laser-plasma accelerators, which offer the potential to significantly reduce measurement times, improve imaging performance and open up new applications beyond conventional cosmic-ray muon tomography. This emerging field brings together particle physics, accelerator technology, computational modelling and advanced image reconstruction. We are looking for a motivated researcher to join our interdisciplinary team and contribute to the development of these next-generation muon imaging technologies. The position offers the opportunity to work on challenging scientific questions, develop and validate new simulation and reconstruction methods, and collaborate with international research partners on experimental campaigns and innovative European research projects. Your tasks Develop innovative methods for muon tomography using artificial muon sources based on laser-plasma accelerators. Perform computational modelling, Monte Carlo simulations and scientific data analysis to investigate and evaluate novel imaging concepts. Develop and optimise image reconstruction, material characterisation and AI-based data analysis methods for accelerator-based muon tomography. Plan, conduct and evaluate experimental validation campaigns in close collaboration with an interdisciplinary research team and international project partners. Contribute to the advancement of muon imaging technologies through scientific publications, conference presentations and international collaboration. Support the preparation of national and European research proposals and contribute to the development of new research activities. Your profile A completed academic degree (university diploma or Master’s degree) in a natural science subject (e.g. physics) or an engineering discipline (e.g. computer science), or other degree programmes relevant to the role Experience in experimental physics gained through involvement in a research collaboration or a multinational research project Experience in data analysis, Monte Carlo modelling (for example, in Geant4) and handling experimental data from particle physics Very good programming skills in Python and/or C/C++ Very good communication skills Experience in authoring scientific publications and presenting results Fluency in spoken and written English We look forward to getting to know you! If you have any questions about this position ( Vacancy-ID 5833 ) please contact: Sarah Barnes Tel.: +49 471 924199 49 Maurice Stephan Tel.: +49 471 924199 42

items.desc: Job Description FICC Quantitative Researcher, Associate / VP, London We are a team of FICC Quantitative Researchers who work to transform the Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities (FICC) business through quantitative trading, automating the key decisions taken every day. Our team has a wide remit across product types such as Interest Rates (IR), Foreign Exchange (FX), Credit, and Commodities, with strategies including market making, automatic quoting, central risk books, systematic trading, and algorithmic execution, trading on venues around the world. We deploy statistical analysis techniques and mathematical models, including advanced machine learning and AI, to improve business performance while working closely with traders and salespeople on the trading floor to bring value to our clients and the firm. Role Responsibilities Take a leading role on our Quantitative Trading & Market Making desk, building market making and quoting strategies across FICC products. Use advanced statistical analysis and quantitative techniques such as neural networks, machine learning, and factor models to build models that drive systematic alpha strategies which make real-time trading and risk management decisions. Implement frameworks to manage risk centrally and build optimal portfolios across FICC asset classes. Build model calibration frameworks for our advanced statistical and AI models, operating at scale with large quantities of time series data, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Drive our market making strategy development using a range of technologies, and collaborate closely with Quant Developers and core engineering teams to enhance core analytics infrastructure and trading tools. Develop and enhance critical pricing, trading, and risk tools, and create new frameworks leveraging trade and franchise data to optimize and systematize market making and hedging strategies. Basic Qualifications Excellent academic record in a relevant quantitative field such as physics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or computer science. Strong programming skills in an object-oriented or functional paradigm such as C++, Java, or Python. Self-starter with strong self-management skills, ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a high-pressure environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical About Goldman Sachs At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. items.desc: Our team of engineers, scientists, and software developers explores the potential of Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the world's most challenging problems. We integrate machine learning, systems modeling, advanced control, and mathematical optimization to tackle complex engineering challenges. Our ultimate mission is to develop sustainable technologies that drive progress and contribute to the advancement of human development. About The Position We are looking for a passionate and analytical Researcher in Computational Biology & Bioinformatics to join our growing R&D team. In this role, you will be at the intersection of data science, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology, developing models that translate complex biological data into actionable, real-world solutions for industrial and environmental sectors. Key Responsibilities Genome-Scale Metabolic Modeling: Develop, curate, and validate genome-scale metabolic models; define objective functions (e.g., growth maximization), constrain metabolic fluxes, incorporate nutrient availability and cultivation conditions, and perform sensitivity and robustness analyses. Algorithmic Development: Design, implement, and optimize algorithms and computational models to analyze complex biochemical and multi-omics datasets. Experimental Design: Formulate and conduct computational experiments to test biological hypotheses and rigorously validate results. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with wet-lab scientists to seamlessly integrate experimental data with computational pipelines. AI Integration: Contribute actively to the development and deployment of cutting-edge, AI-driven tools for advanced biological data interpretation. Scientific Dissemination: Prepare project deliverables and technical reports for the European Commission, present findings at international conferences, and co-author manuscripts for high-impact scientific publications. Continuous Innovation: Stay updated with the latest advancements in bioinformatics, machine learning, and AI technologies to keep Idener at the forefront of the industry. Minimum Requirements Education: MSc (or equivalent) in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Data Science, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative/life-science discipline. A strong foundational understanding of biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology, and genomics. Proficiency in programming languages essential for data analysis (e.g., Python, R, or C++) and experience applying statistical analysis to biological problems. Sharp analytical skills, critical thinking abilities, and a strong willingness to learn and adapt to emerging technologies. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset tailored for multicultural and multidisciplinary teams. Excellent written and spoken English (working language for international projects). What We Offer Impactful Work: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge European Commission projects with a direct impact on sustainability and biotechnology. Professional Growth: Continuous learning environment with access to the latest AI and bioinformatics tools. Flexible Environment: Flexible working hours and options for hybrid work to promote work-life balance. Collaborative Culture: A young, dynamic, and international team of scientists and engineers. Career Path: Clear opportunities for professional advancement within the company’s R&D tracks.

Job Description: 
 Are you interested in joining into a team that offers you the possibility of having a multidisciplinary view of the A/C development process, having a close relationship will all the Centres of Competence (Design offices), Chief Engineering Offices, Services organization, System Suppliers, Airworthiness Authorities and in some cases with operational customers?
 To support the Aircraft Development Safety team in Getafe, we are looking for a System Safety Engineer who will ensure that Airbus products are designed, developed and supported according to the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations).
 Tasks 
 As a member of the Aircraft Development Safety team, you will develop the following challenging tasks and activities:
 Performing System Safety Assessment activities for military aircraft systems, supporting the development phases until certification.
 Performing a systematic and comprehensive examination of System functions to identify and classify failure conditions of those functions according to their severity.
 Establishing the System Safety requirements and performing preliminary evaluations to determine that the proposed architecture can reasonably be expected to meet the safety objectives.
 Generating evidences to demonstrate in front of the Airworthiness Authorities that the final system architecture meets required System Safety requirements.
 Performing analyses of Common-Cause (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis).
 Performing Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to demonstrate the Continuous Airworthiness of the platform.
 Manage and establish safety requirements at the interface to interacting systems.

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams in der Fertigung sucht Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH eine/n 
 Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) der Arbeitsvorbereitung zivile Montage / MRO 
 Ihr Arbeitsort in Calden 
 Die Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH mit Sitz in Kassel-Calden ist ein weltweit agierendes High-Tech-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung, Herstellung und Wartung luftfahrttechnischer Systeme, Komponenten und Präzisionsteile. Wir begeistern uns für hochwertige Technik und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft für Sicherheit und faszinierende Innovationen in der Luftfahrt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Arbeit und teilen unsere Fachkenntnisse gepaart mit langjähriger Erfahrung für die gemeinsame Erfüllung zukunftsorientierter Spitzenleistungen. Wir sind der Ansprechpartner für internationale zivile sowie militärische Programme und Entwickler neuer Schlüsseltechnologien. 
 Ihre Vorteile bei Airbus: 
 Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Getriebe- und Antriebskomponenten, dem Herzstück des Helicopters 
 Eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die von unseren Produkten begeistert sind 
 Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen nach Tarif der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Hessen 
 30 Tage Urlaub, 35 Stunden/Woche sowie Gleitzeit (außer im Schichtbetrieb) geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Job und Privatleben ideal miteinander zu vereinbaren 
 Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und interne Entwicklungsperspektiven für unseren gemeinsamen Blick in die Zukunft 
 Weitere Benefits wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Fahrradleasing, Gesundheitsangebote sowie eine werkseigene Kantine runden unser Angebot ab 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: 
 Sie sind die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen der Konstruktion und der Montage und stellen sicher, dass unsere Produktionsprozesse reibungslos, effizient und in höchster Qualität ablaufen. 
 Prozessplanung und -steuerung: Sie planen und definieren die technologischen Bearbeitungsschritte für komplexe Bauteile 
 Erstellung von Arbeitsunterlagen: Sie erstellen und pflegen Arbeitspläne, Stücklisten und Fertigungsanweisungen im ERP-System (z. B. SAP). 
 Werkzeug- und Vorrichtungsauswahl: Sie wählen die passenden Werkzeuge und Vorrichtungen aus und beschaffen diese in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Einkauf. 
 Kalkulation: Sie ermitteln Vorgabezeiten und führen Vorkalkulationen für die Fertigungskosten von Neu- und Bestandteilen durch. 
 Prozessoptimierung (KVP): Sie analysieren bestehende Fertigungs-/Montageabläufe, identifizieren Verbesserungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit um. 
 Technische Unterstützung: Sie agieren als technischer Ansprechpartner für die Mechaniker (m/w/d) und unterstützen bei der Erstbemusterung und bei fertigungstechnischen Herausforderungen. 
 Stammdatenpflege: Sie sind für die Anlage und Pflege aller fertigungsrelevanten Stammdaten im ERP- und CAM-System verantwortlich. 
 Ihre Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen: 
 Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. als Zerspanungsmechaniker, Industriemechaniker) mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/Techniker (m/w/d) oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 
 Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Fertigungsplanung, idealerweise in einem metallverarbeitenden Unternehmen. 
 IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit einem gängigen ERP-System (Infor LN, BaaN, SAP) sowie den MS-Office-Anwendungen. 
 Persönlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus. Sie sind ein kommunikationsstarker Teamplayer, der lösungsorientiert denkt und handelt. 
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich. 
 Kein 100%-iges Match? Kein Problem! Airbus unterstützt Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit individualisierten Entwicklungslösungen.

Job Description: 
 Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Ingénieur(e) Safety Système au sein des équipes System Safety. 
 Votre futur job, si vous l’acceptez… 
 La sûreté de fonctionnement est un élément essentiel dans la conception des systèmes avion et leur intégration. Elle permet de maîtriser les risques associés aux défaillances en suivant le développement du système depuis les phases préliminaires jusqu’à l’intégration. 
 En tant que filiale du groupe AIRBUS, Airbus Protect est positionné sur des activités clés du groupe, autant sur le développement des grandes familles d’avions que sur des projets R&T stratégiques. En plus, notre présence en dehors du groupe nous permet d’accompagner d’autres entreprises du milieu aéronautique pour assurer la sûreté de leurs produits. 
 Chez Airbus Protect vous intégrerez l’équipe en charge des activités de sûreté de fonctionnement des systèmes avion dont les tâches principales sont : 
 évaluer les risques associés aux défaillances du système, 
 évaluer et contribuer au choix des solutions d’architecture en fonction des exigences de sûreté applicables, 
 contribuer aux analyses de causes communes, 
 établir la conformité du système aux exigences de sûreté. 
 En tant qu’ingénieur safety, vous serez un acteur clef du processus de développement des systèmes aéronautiques. En collaboration avec le bureau d’études, le programme et d’autres activités support ; vous serez responsable de l’accompagnement des projets de recherche et futurs développements (multi-systèmes, multi programmes) pour atteindre les objectifs de sûreté.

 Vous êtes ingénieur avec de solides connaissances en architecture systèmes avion et vous connaissez le processus de développement de systèmes complexes.

 Vous possédez une expérience en aéronautique.

Are you an experienced systems administrator with strong Microsoft 365, Azure and endpoint management expertise? Do you have experience managing on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including hybrid environments and migrations? Would you enjoy managing and improving the IT services that support a world-leading research organisation? 
 EMBL’s European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI) is hiring for two Systems Administrators to help deliver, maintain and develop our Microsoft and cloud services. Our Systems Administrator will primarily work across Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune and hybrid infrastructure but also assist in supporting our Linux desktop environment, combining hands-on technical administration with project delivery, service improvement and user support.
 This is an opportunity to take ownership of key systems, contribute to technical design and implementation, and help ensure our IT environment remains secure, reliable and responsive to the needs of our scientific community.
 About the Team 
 You will join the IT Services (ITS) Service Desk team at EMBL-EBI in Hinxton, working alongside colleagues who provide technical services and support across the organisation.
 The team supports EMBL-EBI staff, visitors and guests, maintaining the systems and services that enable our research and operations. You will play a key role in managing our Microsoft environment, working collaboratively with colleagues across IT to deliver projects, improve services and provide effective technical support.
 What you will do 
 You will manage and develop Microsoft on-premises and cloud services, ensuring they are secure, reliable and fit for purpose. With a primary focus on Microsoft 365, Azure and endpoint management, you will take ownership of Windows infrastructure, contribute to technical projects and migrations, and support the wider desktop environment where needed. In particular, you will lead a project on our 2027 roadmap to review and potentially retire or greatly reduce the existing Linux desktop service offering. This will involve consulting with users, assessing alternative desktop solutions and helping to implement an appropriate replacement, potentially supported by Linux server-based infrastructure.
 Your key responsibilities will include: 
 Manage Microsoft and cloud services: Design, install, administer and maintain Microsoft 365, Azure and associated enterprise services.
 Lead endpoint management: Administer Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment and compliance policies.
 Maintain hybrid infrastructure: Administer and support on-premises Active Directory and its integration with Microsoft cloud services, alongside Windows servers and infrastructure running on physical and VMware platforms.
 Deliver technical projects and migrations: Plan and implement Windows infrastructure projects, including migrations to Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid or cloud environments.
 Monitor and improve services: Take the lead in managing Windows infrastructure, monitoring service performance and making informed decisions about system maintenance and improvement.
 Maintain security and documentation: Ensure systems comply with IT security requirements and policies, maintaining clear documentation of the environment and application configurations.
 Provide technical support and expertise: Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for staff, visitors and guests, and provide systems training to helpdesk technicians and users where required.
 Support the wider desktop environment: Provide assistance and cover across systems administration functions, including Linux desktop installation, administration and automation where required.
 You will have: 
 A bachelor's degree, or equivalent in Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Extensive experience in user support and Microsoft Windows systems administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file and print services, and Windows deployment tools.
 Strong practical experience administering and managing Microsoft 365 enterprise services, including tenant configuration and the services required to support users and devices.
 Experience administering Microsoft Azure services and identity management, with an understanding of cloud infrastructure and services.
 Strong experience with Microsoft Endpoint Manager / Intune, including device enrolment, configuration, application deployment, compliance and endpoint policies.
 Experience designing, building and managing Microsoft 365 / Azure tenants, managing hybrid Microsoft environments and supporting migrations from on-premises services to cloud or hybrid environments. Candidates should have experience supporting migrations or building and preparing a tenant for migration.
 Knowledge of IT service management processes, including incident, change and problem management, and the use of service management or ticketing systems.

Working at the intersection of hardware and systems engineering,
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As an Electronics Engineer on the Physical Products team, you will design and build the electrical systems that bring Helsing's platforms to life. From component selection and electrical architecture definition through to bespoke PCB design and hands-on prototype bring-up, you will shape how our systems are powered, connected, and controlled. Working at the intersection of hardware and systems engineering, you will translate complex requirements into robust, field-ready electronics, iterating rapidly to de-risk designs and validate concepts early. Your work will directly advance Helsing's mission to equip democratic societies with capable, reliable defence technology.
 The day-to-day 
 Design, build, and validate bespoke PCBs from schematic through to hands-on bring-up, covering power, digital, and mixed-signal electronics using tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad
 Define the electrical architecture of UAV platforms, producing wiring diagrams, power distribution schemes, and interface definitions that underpin system integration across mechanical, software, and avionics boundaries
 Select and specify components across sensors, actuators, controllers, and power systems, trading off performance, cost, availability, and integration effort to make well-reasoned, documented design decisions
 Integrate communication interfaces such as CAN Bus, Ethernet, and RS422/485, and support RF and radio systems, ensuring robust data and power distribution across the platform
 Define and execute unit-level tests, contribute to reliability and safety analyses such as FMEA, and produce clear design documentation including wiring diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and BOMs
 You should apply if you 
 Have designed and integrated electrical and electronic systems in a professional engineering context, ideally within aerospace or a similarly demanding domain
 Are proficient in PCB design and layout, with hands-on experience using ECAD tools such as Altium Designer or KiCad and simulation tools such as LTSpice
 Can interpret complex third-party datasheets and technical documentation, translating electrical characteristics and constraints into sound, well-reasoned design decisions
 Have experience designing cable harnesses and defining communication interfaces, and have worked with RF or radio systems in a hardware integration context
 Collaborate effectively across mechanical, software, and systems engineering disciplines, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Experience with ECAD/MCAD co-design workflows and the integration of electrical systems into complex electromechanical assemblies
 Experience contributing to reliability or safety analyses such as FMEA in a production or pre-production engineering context
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Lieu : Palaiseau, France

 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 En nous rejoignant, vous intégrer le laboratoire d’analyse des technologies et procédés industriels (LATPI). Le LATPI est un laboratoire de référence pour le groupe Thales, intégré au centre de recherche Thales Research&Technology. Il a pour mission d’expertiser, diagnostiquer, résoudre tout type de problématique technologique liée à un composant, une carte électronique, un équipement. Son domaine d’intervention couvre toutes les phases du cycle de développement et de production.

 Ingénieur de recherche matériaux, mécanique et traitements de surface (H/F)

 Vous avez l’ambition de contribuer à l’innovation au sein de Thales ?

 Connaissances des matériaux et des processus industriels lié aux composants électroniques

 Anglais (Niveau C1 attendu)

You'll join a
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE MISSION

You will work every day on the racks that power one of Sweden's largest AI clusters.
Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.
You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.
Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at our data center in Dalarna region.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

 - Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

 - Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

 - Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

 - Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.

 - Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers and respect for the people around you.


ABOUT YOU

 - Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.

 - Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.

 - Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.

 - Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.

 - Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.

 - Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.

 - Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.

Even if you don't match every criterion
Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.



NICE TO HAVE

 - HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.

 - Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.

 - Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.

 - Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

 




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.desc:
About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

 - Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

 - Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

 - Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

 - Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

 - Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

 - Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

 - Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

 - End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

 - Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

 - Experience collaborating across Engineering, Legal, operations, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls.
The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment.
You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required.


Requirements

 - Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs.

 - Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed.

 - Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work.

 - Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding.



We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
