items.desc:
Als Business Strategist bij Framna help je organisaties hun uitdagingen en ambities te vertalen naar strategische richting. Je ontdekt waar digitale innovatie écht waarde toevoegt, adviseert klanten over hun digitale toekomst en speelt een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol in commerciële trajecten. Je werkt vanuit Zwolle of Amsterdam.
 Word onderdeel van ons team 
 Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en product. Waar onze teams digitale producten ontwerpen en bouwen, kijk jij een stap eerder: Welke groeikansen zie je bij onze partners, en hoe kan een digitaal product daar optimaal in faciliteren?wat heeft een partner nodig om te groeien, en welk product hoort daarbij?
 Wat je gaat doen 
 Je ziet waar partners groeipotentie hebben en neemt zelf het initiatief om die kansen uit te werken.. Je overziet wat er nodig is om die kansen te realiseren; je brengt de input van stakeholders en disciplines samen, weegt belangen af en komt met een onderbouwd voorstel voor de volgende stap.
 Je dagen wisselen tussen partners en de studio. Bij partners voer je gesprekken en faciliteer je workshops en sessies, vaak met management en directie aan tafel. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit de Strategy & Consulting Hub en het salesteam. Samen duiken jullie in complexe klantvraagstukken, voeren jullie strategische analyses uit en ontwikkelen jullie overtuigende commerciële voorstellen.
 Jouw belangrijkste taken zijn:
 Complexe businessvraagstukken vertalen naar een heldere visie en concrete oplossingsrichtingen
 Partners adviseren over digitale strategie, businessmodellen, transformatie en groei
 Markten, concurrenten en technologische ontwikkelingen analyseren en daar kansen uit halen
 Meewerken aan commerciële trajecten: van eerste gesprek en workshop tot pitch en voorstel
 Samen met business development en andere disciplines nieuwe partnerrelaties en kansen ontwikkelen
 Strategisch gesprekspartner zijn voor de klant.
 Framna's strategische dienstverlening en proposities verder vormgeven
 Wie jij bent 
 Klaar om deze rol helemaal eigen te maken? Wij denken dat je goed bij ons past als je:
 Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt in een strategische of adviserende rol, bijvoorbeeld als Business Strategist, Digital Strategist of Business Consultant.
 In het bezit bent van een HBO- en/of WO Diploma.
 Verschillende belangen en disciplines samenbrengt tot één heldere richting.
 Complexe businessvraagstukken weet te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete strategische kansen en overtuigende adviezen.
 Een sterk gevoel hebt voor business en begrijpt hoe digitale oplossingen bijdragen aan strategische en commerciële doelstellingen.
 Energie krijgt van commerciële trajecten en graag bijdraagt aan pitches, klantpresentaties en overtuigende voorstellen.
 Ervaring hebt met strategische analyses, markt- en concurrentieonderzoek en het ontwikkelen van businesscases.
 Een stevige gesprekspartner bent voor klanten en gemakkelijk schakelt met stakeholders op management- en directieniveau.
 Vloeiend Nederlands spreekt.
 Over Framna 
 Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren.
 Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega's aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen.
 Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product.
 Wat je krijgt 
 Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.500 - €6.300 afhankelijk van je ervaring.
 Pensioenbijdrage van 67% vanuit Framna.
 27 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.
 Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.
 Een Macbook en telefoon in bruikleen.
 Dagelijkse lunch in de studio.
 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.

Auditer et tester la résilience des systèmes agentiques : manipulation des appels d?outils (function calling), élévation de privilèges via les agents autonomes et exécution de code non sollicitée. Parfaite compréhension des mécanismes d?injection de prompt, de jailbreak, d?évasion et de manipulation des modèles de langage. items.desc: Athens (Center), Attiki, Greece | IT Drive the transformation of FAMAR’s business and industrial processes by combining Lean methodologies, data engineering, artificial intelligence and automation. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will work directly with operational teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows and develop practical AI-powered solutions through to production deployment. You’ll connect fragmented systems and build reliable, secure and reusable data integrations that make enterprise data accessible. Using generative AI, intelligent agents, document intelligence and workflow automation, you’ll simplify complex processes, eliminate repetitive tasks and help teams work more effectively. What you’ll do: Work alongside business and manufacturing teams to identify bottlenecks and simplify processes using Lean principles. Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, RAG solutions and automated workflows that solve practical operational challenges. Connect enterprise systems through reliable data pipelines, APIs and reusable integrations, improving data quality and accessibility. Develop document automation solutions supporting activities such as customer quotations, quality reviews and reporting. Take solutions from prototype to production using Microsoft Azure and sound engineering practices, including testing, monitoring and appropriate human oversight. Partner with IT and Quality to ensure security, data integrity and regulatory compliance where applicable. Train users, drive adoption and work with IT to establish ongoing support and maintenance. Measure results through time saved, shorter lead times, improved quality and validated savings, scaling successful solutions across FAMAR. What makes you a great fit Min. 3 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI development or intelligent process automation. Proven ability to map, analyse, challenge and simplify end-to-end processes together with business teams. Strong collaboration skills, with a track record of delivering results jointly with operational, IT and Quality teams. Demonstrated experience developing and deploying production-ready AI applications in operational environments. Strong hands-on engineering capabilities, including application development, data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows and production deployment. Experience integrating diverse enterprise systems, data sources and AI solutions into business processes. Practical experience with LLM applications, intelligent agents, RAG architectures or workflow automation. Experience with cloud technologies and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Experience with document intelligence or enterprise workflow platforms would be advantageous. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Exposure to Lean methodologies or business process improvement would be advantageous. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders . Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story — what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect.

items.desc: Data is de motor van elke digitale transformatie. Werk je graag mee aan de meest innovatieve data oplossingen van de toekomst? Dan heeft Cegeka de uitdaging voor jou! We zijn binnen ons Data & AI team binnen Cegeka op zoek naar een Snowflake Data Engineer. Naast ons partnership met Snowflake zijn we ook Microsoft- en Databricks-partner. Heb je zin om ons team van specialisten te vervoegen? Solliciteer dan zeker en laat je talent en ervaring bijdragen aan onze missie! In je rol als Snowflake Data Engineer werk je nauw samen met collega's aan data- en AI-projecten voor bedrijven in verschillende sectoren. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt robuuste, schaalbare ELT-pipelines met dbt (ook native via dbt Projects on Snowflake), georkestreerd met Apache Airflow of Snowflake Tasks, Streams en Dynamic Tables, met een sterke focus op automatisering en herbruikbaarheid. Je ontsluit data uit bronsystemen met Snowpipe (Streaming) en Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, en transformeert die volgens de business logica tot betrouwbare datamodellen op het centrale dataplatform. Datakwaliteit en robuustheid staan centraal. Je bouwt mee aan open lakehouse-architecturen met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris). Je ondersteunt domeinteams volgens data mesh-principes en ontsluit data products via secure data sharing en het Internal Marketplace. Je bewaakt governance (RBAC, masking en row access policies, tagging) en performance en kosten (warehouse-sizing, resource monitors, query profiling). Je automatiseert deployments via CI/CD en gebruikt CoCo (Cortex Code) om sneller en beter te ontwikkelen. Je vertaalt functionele en technische requirements naar concrete dataoplossingen. Cegeka is Snowflake-partner. Dit geeft je rechtstreeks toegang tot hun solution architects bij technische uitdagingen of specifieke vragen. Wat breng jij mee? Je hebt ruime ervaring als Data Engineer of in een hands-on datarol binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen. Je werkt dagelijks met Snowflake en beheerst SQL en Python (Snowpark). Je bent vertrouwd met Apache Iceberg tables en Iceberg-catalogs (Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, catalog integrations met bv. AWS Glue of Unity Catalog). Je kent multi-cloud omgevingen (Azure, AWS) en integreert die met Snowflake (storage integrations, external volumes, private connectivity). Je werkt met CI/CD: versiebeheer in Git, geautomatiseerde deployments met Snowflake CLI en/of Terraform, en testen in de pipeline. Je bent vertrouwd met Snowflake CoCo (Cortex Code), de AI-codingagent van Snowflake. Je kent Snowflake-governance en -kostenbeheer (RBAC, masking en row access policies, warehouse-sizing, resource monitors). Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in datamodellering (Data Vault, Kimball) en past die schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar toe in productie. Een bepaalde flexibiliteit naar verplaatsingen is vereist aangezien er regelmatig van bij de klant wordt gewerkt. Als je aanwezigheid bij de klant niet vereist is dan kan je in het Cegeka-kantoor dichtst bij je woonplaats werken (Antwerpen, Brussel, Gent, Hasselt of Leuven) in combinatie met thuiswerk. Pluspunten: SnowPro Core / SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer. Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels. Kennis van het Nederlands en Frans zijn een grote meerwaarde. Wat hebben wij jou te bieden? Je komt terecht bij een echte Top Employer. Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud & Infrastructure Services en Network & Connectivity. We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren. Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. items.desc: Refnr: 61217 Functieomschrijving Als medewerker Asset Liability Management & Modelling maak je deel uit van een gespecialiseerd team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en de opvolging van het rente- en liquiditeitsrisico van de bank. Daarnaast werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling en het onderhoud van de modellen die deze risico's ondersteunen, evenals andere belangrijke modellen binnen de bank, zoals credit scoring- en IFRS9 modellen. Je staat in voor de maandelijkse risico-rapportering en analyseert de evolutie van de verschillende risico's binnen de balans. Bovendien speel je een actieve rol gedurende de volledige modellevenscyclus: van ontwikkeling en kalibratie tot monitoring, documentatie en periodieke herziening. Zo draag je rechtstreeks bij aan een robuuste meting en beheersing van onder meer renterisico (IRRBB) en kredietrisico, en ondersteun je strategische beslissingen binnen de bank. Tot je takenpakket behoren onder andere: - het controleren, analyseren en rapporteren van de rente- en liquiditeitsrisicoposities van de bank, het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van statistische modellen, het testen van de performantie, stabiliteit en robuustheid van modellen en het bewaken van hun blijvende geschiktheid voor het beoogde gebruik, het analyseren en interpreteren van modelresultaten, inclusief het beoordelen van de impact van gewijzigde aannames, klantgedrag en marktomstandigheden, het uitvoeren van periodieke reviews, herkalibraties en de implementatie van modelwijzigingen, het opstellen van risicoanalyses, managementrapporteringen en modeldocumentatie ter ondersteuning van besluitvorming en governance binnen de bank. Profiel studieniveau master wiskunde of gelijkwaardig, ervaring in soortgelijke functie is een pluspunt maar geen vereiste, je bent vertrouwd met SQL en R, kennis van Python is een pluspunt, je weet de modellen op een begrijpelijke manier over te brengen aan een niet-gespecialiseerd publiek en weet de opgestelde modellen goed te documenteren, je kan zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken, je werkt gestructureerd en planmatig, je beschikt over verantwoordelijkheidszin en een positieve attitude. Wij bieden je een stabiele werkgever, een voltijds (36u) contract van onbepaalde duur en een goed sociaal klimaat, een marktconform verloningspakket inclusief extralegale voordelen: hospitalisatieverzekering voor het hele gezin, verzekering gewaarborgd inkomen, groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques, fietsvergoeding en gratis openbaar vervoer voor woon-werkverkeer, en een cafetariaplan, , een uitgebreide basisopleiding en on-the-job training in een ervaren team, een open familiale werksfeer, met een goed evenwicht tussen werk en privé en de mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontplooien en door te groeien, startdatum overeen te komen.

items.title: Data & AI Compliance Consultant
items.card: Your role We are looking for a Data & AI Compliance Consultant who can help organizations navigate the evolving regulatory landscape around data, privacy and artificial intelligence, translating complex requirements into practical, workable solutions. You'll operate at the intersection of regulation, business and technology, advising clients on data protection, AI governance, risk management and regulatory
items.desc: Your role We are looking for a Data & AI Compliance Consultant who can help organizations navigate the evolving regulatory landscape around data, privacy and artificial intelligence, translating complex requirements into practical, workable solutions. You'll operate at the intersection of regulation, business and technology, advising clients on data protection, AI governance, risk management and regulatory compliance. You will support organizations in navigating European digital regulations, including the GDPR, EU AI Act, Data Act and Data Governance Act , while helping them establish effective governance frameworks, processes and controls. Building on your expertise in privacy, compliance, risk management or governance , you will help clients conduct compliance and risk assessments, identify regulatory and operational risks, and translate findings into concrete actions and improvements. This is more than a traditional compliance role. You will help organizations adopt AI responsibly while enabling innovation, ensuring that governance and regulatory requirements are embedded into existing business and technology processes. You'll work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, IT, Security, Data and Business stakeholders , bridging regulatory expectations with operational realities. You will also contribute to client discussions, identify opportunities for further advisory support and help develop our growing Data & AI Governance and Compliance practice. Location: Our headquarters are located in Antwerp. As you'll be working with clients across different locations, we offer a flexible and hybrid working model, combining work from our office (flexible), client sites and home, depending on the needs of the project. Job requirements Required Experience Experience in data protection, privacy, regulatory compliance, risk management, IT governance or AI governance, preferably in a consulting or complex organizational environment. Strong understanding of GDPR and the EU AI Act, including their practical implications for organizations. Familiarity with the broader European digital regulatory landscape, including the Data Act, Data Governance Act, DORA and other relevant regulations. Experience in translating regulatory requirements into governance frameworks, policies, processes and internal controls . Hands-on experience with compliance assessments, risk assessments, impact assessments (such as DPIAs or FRIAs), or regulatory implementation projects. Understanding of AI Governance, Responsible AI and AI-related risks , including the implications of Generative AI and emerging AI technologies. Understanding of data governance principles, including data sharing, data access, data ownership and responsible data use. Familiarity with related domains such as information security, IT risk, operational resilience and third-party risk management. Experience identifying compliance gaps, defining remediation actions and supporting ongoing risk and compliance monitoring. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Legal, Compliance, Risk, IT, Security, Data and Business teams. Ability to translate regulatory and governance requirements into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Languages: Fluent in English and either Dutch or French , with a good working knowledge of the other language. What sets you apart A background as a DPO, Privacy Consultant, Compliance Officer, IT Risk Consultant, AI Governance Specialist or Regulatory Advisor, combined with practical knowledge of data and AI-related regulatory challenges. Ability to bridge data protection, AI governance, risk management and broader data governance and compliance challenges. Pragmatic, hands-on and solution-oriented, with experience making governance and compliance requirements workable in practice. Experience supporting organizations with AI risk classification, governance operating models, third-party risk assessments or regulatory compliance monitoring. Comfortable advising clients and engaging with senior stakeholders across business and technology functions. Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory and technical topics in a clear and accessible way. Interest in AI technologies, responsible innovation and emerging European digital regulations. A proactive and client-oriented mindset, with an interest in contributing to business development and growing client relationships. Ready to make an impact? Let's talk.

items.desc: 1 - Werken bij de VUB De Vrije Universiteit Brussel staat al meer dan 50 jaar voor vrijheid, gelijk(waardig)heid en verbondenheid , en dat leeft sterk op onze campussen bij zowel studenten als personeel. Bij de VUB vind je een diverse verzameling aan persoonlijkheden: innovators pur sang, maar vooral mensen die 100% hun authentieke zelf zijn . Met zo’n 4.000 medewerkers zijn we de grootste Nederlandstalige werkgever, in de privésector, in Brussel ; een internationale stad waarmee we ons maar al te graag verbinden en waar(rond) onze 4 campussen gelegen zijn. Voeg daarbij ons beginsel van vrij onderzoek - waarin zelfreflectie, een kritische houding en een open, creatieve geest rond wetenschappelijke en maatschappelijke vraagstukken centraal staan - en je hebt een universiteit die fundamenteel grensverleggend en pionierend is op het vlak van onderwijs en onderzoek. Kortom: de VUB ten voeten uit . De VUB is bovendien lid van EUTOPIA , een alliantie van gelijkgestemde Europese universiteiten, allen klaar om zichzelf opnieuw uit te vinden. 2 - Functie Momenteel zijn we voor de Onderzoeksbursalen van de Faculteit Ingenieurswetenschappen , vakgroep Toegepaste mechanica , onderzoeksgroep Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics op zoek naar een doctoraatsbursaal . Meer concreet zal je takenpakket, ter voorbereiding van een doctoraat , er als volgt uitzien: Wij bieden een voltijdse doctoraatspositie aan in het kader van het ERC Starting Grant-project “Energising the future with clean plasma-based technologies” (ESCAPADE, proposal number 101302707). Plasma-assisted combustion (PAC) biedt veelbelovende perspectieven voor een schonere en efficiëntere verbranding van duurzame brandstoffen. De verdere industriële toepassing wordt echter beperkt door het ontbreken van voorspellende computermodellen die de complexe interacties tussen plasmaontladingen, chemische reacties en vlamdynamica nauwkeurig kunnen beschrijven. ESCAPADE pakt deze uitdaging aan door een innovatief multiphysics-simulatiekader te ontwikkelen dat modellering op basis van eerste principes combineert met machine learning, reduced-order technieken en computational fluid dynamics (CFD). Het project zal een nieuwe generatie voorspellende tools opleveren voor het ontwerp en de optimalisatie van verbrandingssystemen met lage emissies die werken op zowel duurzame als conventionele brandstoffen. De onderzoeksgroep FLOW van de VUB beschikt over uitgebreide expertise in zowel fundamenteel als toegepast onderzoek naar de modellering van thermo-fluid systemen, met toepassingen in de luchtvaart (aerodynamica, flow control), ruimtevaart (atmosferische terugkeer, ruimtevaartplasma's) en energie (windenergie, bio-energie, waterstof, warmtenetten en verbranding). Sinds 2021 werkt FLOW samen met de ATM-onderzoeksgroep van de ULB binnen de gezamenlijke onderzoeksgroep BRITE (Brussels Institute for Thermal-fluid Systems and clean Energy, https://brite-research.be). Plasma-assisted combustion combineert plasmaontladingen met verbrandingsprocessen om ontsteking, vlamstabiliteit en emissies van verontreinigende stoffen te verbeteren voor duurzame brandstoffen. Hoewel gedetailleerde state-to-state plasmaverbrandingsmodellen een ongeziene beschrijving bieden van de onderliggende fysica, blijft hun rekenkost te hoog voor multidimensionale simulaties en industriële toepassingen. Dit doctoraatsproject heeft als doel de volgende generatie computationele tools voor plasma-assisted combustion te ontwikkelen door gedetailleerde state-to-state kinetische modellering, mechanismereductie en physics-informed machine learning te combineren. De onderzoeker zal bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde simulatiecodes die plasmaontladingen, chemie en verbrandingsprocessen expliciet kunnen modelleren over een breed scala aan operationele omstandigheden. Een centraal doel van het project is de ontwikkeling van nieuwe reductiemethodologieën voor omvangrijke state-to-state kinetische mechanismen met honderden tot duizenden soorten en reacties. Voortbouwend op recente ontwikkelingen zoals plasma-directed relation graph-technieken (P-DRGEP), principal component analysis en machine-learninggebaseerde lumping-strategieën, zal de doctoraatsstudent reduced-order modellen met hoge nauwkeurigheid ontwikkelen die de essentiële plasma-verbrandingsinteracties behouden en tegelijk de rekenkost aanzienlijk verminderen. De ontwikkelde methodologieën zullen worden geïntegreerd in intern ontwikkelde plasma-assisted combustion solvers en gevalideerd aan de hand van experimentele benchmarkdatasets die worden aangeleverd door toonaangevende internationale projectpartners. Bijzondere aandacht gaat uit naar ammoniak- en waterstofverbrandingssystemen, die worden beschouwd als veelbelovende koolstofvrije brandstoffen voor toekomstige energie- en voortstuwingssystemen. De resulterende gereduceerde modellen zullen de rechtstreekse integratie van gedetailleerde plasmachemie mogelijk maken binnen geavanceerde CFD-omgevingen, …

items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You Should Apply If: You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching …

items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. items.desc: Søg stillingen her Vil du være med til at forme samfundskritiske digitale produkter gennem brugerindsigter, konceptudvikling og tæt samarbejde med kunder og brugere? Bliv en del af vores ambition om at udvikle innovative softwareprodukter, der bidrager til mere bæredygtige byer og et stærkere samfund. Du bliver en del af divisionen Sweco Digital, hvor du får 140 engagerede og kompetente kollegaer. Stillingen er placeret i Products, hvor du indgår i vores UX-team bestående af erfarne Product Designers. Vi prioriterer faglig udvikling og samarbejde højt, og vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når forskellige perspektiver mødes. Samtidig lægger vi vægt på en uformel kultur, hvor vi har det sjovt og interesserer os for hinanden. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med brugere, kunder og interessenter på tværs af Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Tyskland samt udviklingsteams på flere lokationer, blandt andet i Kolding og Portugal. Du skaber retning gennem brugerindsigter og konceptudvikling Som Product Designer får du en central rolle i udviklingen af nogle af Sweco Digitals softwareprodukter inden for drift, forvaltning og vedligeholdelse af kritisk infrastruktur i vores samfund. Du kommer i første omgang til at arbejde med RoSy (Road System) og DriftWeb. Produkterne bidrager til planlægning, drift og vedligeholdelse af samfundskritisk infrastruktur og bliver brugt af kommuner, forsyninger og virksomheder i Danmark og resten af Norden. Fælles for dem er, at de understøtter komplekse, datatunge arbejdsprocesser og stiller høje krav til både brugervenlighed og domæneforståelse. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives med at sætte dig ind i komplekse faglige domæner, forstå brugernes hverdag og omsætte specialiseret viden til enkle, intuitive og værdiskabende brugeroplevelser. Både RoSy og DriftWeb står over for en spændende udvikling med strategiske initiativer, der skal styrke produkterne og vores position blandt kommuner i Norden. På sigt får du mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer indenfor for research og konceptudvikling i spil på tværs af hele vores produktportefølje og bidrage til at skabe en sammenhængende brugeroplevelse på tværs af Sweco Digitals løsninger. I rollen driver du research- og designaktiviteter i tæt samarbejde med brugere, kunder, produktteams og andre designere. Samtidig bliver du en del af vores UX-team, hvor du bidrager til at udvikle fælles metoder, designprincipper og best practices for brugercentreret produktudvikling. Dine opgaver vil være: Planlægge og gennemføre brugerresearch, herunder brugerinterviews, feltstudier, usability tests, spørgeskemaundersøgelser og analyse af produktdata Opbygge en dyb forståelse for brugernes behov, arbejdsprocesser og udfordringer i komplekse, datatunge og domænedrevne produkter Analysere, formidle og omsætte brugerindsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og beslutningsgrundlag Udarbejde brugerrejser, wireframes, koncepter og prototyper, der understøtter produktudviklingen Facilitere workshops og discovery-aktiviteter med brugere, kunder og interne interessenter f.eks. Design Sprints, Discovery Workshops, Journey Mapping og idéudviklingsforløb Samarbejde tæt med Product Managers, Product Owners, udviklere, domæneeksperter og andre designere om at skabe værdifulde produktløsninger Identificere synergier og skabe sammenhængende brugeroplevelse på tværs af produkter Være med til at udvikle og styrke vores fælles UX-metoder, processer og best practices indenfor brugercentreret design Hvem er du? Relevant videregående uddannelse inden for design, UX, antropologi eller lignende 3-5 års erfaring som Product Designer, UX Designer eller tilsvarende rolle Solid erfaring med brugerresearch og indsigtsskabende aktiviteter Erfaring med at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til brugervenlige konceptdesigns og wireframes Trives med selvstændigt ansvar og som del af et etableret UX-team, der arbejder tæt med hinanden og i tværfaglige teams Stærke kommunikations- og faciliteringsevner Arbejder struktureret og formår at planlægge og drive aktiviteter i samarbejde med både interessenter og designkollegaer. Erfaring med agile produktudviklingsprocesser er en fordel Fleksibel i forhold til rejseaktivitet i Norden og Tyskland. Hos os får du mulighed for at komme tæt på kunder og brugere og arbejde med produkter, der har stor betydning for samfundet. Din rolle vil have stor indflydelse på produktudvikling og brugeroplevelse og du vil arbejde sammen med dygtige, passionerede og easy-going kollegaer. Interesseret? Brug linket til at sende dit CV og andre relevante dokumenter. Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen eller Sweco som arbejdsplads, kan du kontakte Damir Hodzic Mehic, Lead Product Designer på tlf. 4282 1442 eller damirhodzic.mehic@sweco.dk. items.desc: Location: Humlebæk, DK Job Family: Research & Development Country/Region: Denmark Mechanical Design Engineer: Develop robust medical devices from concept to production Would you like to use your mechanical engineering expertise to develop medical devices that make a real difference for people with intimate healthcare needs? Working with engineers, scientists and project managers, you will turn product requirements and concepts into robust mechanical solutions, combining creative problem-solving with engineering rigour from concept evaluation through to production. Welcome to CC & BC Mechanical Engineering At our headquarters in Humlebæk, Denmark, you will join CC & BC Mechanical Engineering within Product Development, developing products for Continence Care and Bowel Care. Mechanical design connects what users need with how a product performs and how reliably it can be manufactured. Our work brings together functionality, materials, tolerances and production considerations to create practical solutions that perform consistently in everyday use. You will work closely with colleagues across Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Technical Design, Materials, Systems Engineering, Usability and Test Engineering, as well as Manufacturing Systems Development and Centre of Excellence specialists. Turn product concepts into reliable, manufacturable solutions As our new Mechanical Design Engineer, you will plan and deliver mechanical design activities in Product Development projects. Your work will span concept development and evaluation, detailed design, verification support and transfer to production. You will take ownership of your mechanical deliverables and provide clear technical conclusions and recommendations. Working within the agreed project scope, you will identify risks early, make design trade-offs visible and bring in the right expertise to move decisions forward. More specifically, you will: Develop and evaluate mechanical concepts, translating product requirements into practical design solutions in collaboration with Systems Engineering and relevant specialists. Develop and document mechanical designs using 3D CAD, working closely with Technical Design on drawings and specifications. Apply robust design methods and tolerance analysis to understand variation and secure reliable product performance. Apply Design for X principles to balance performance, manufacturability, sustainability and cost, involving manufacturing specialists early. Use calculations, simulation, prototypes and test evidence to evaluate solutions and support timely design decisions. Contribute mechanical expertise to risk assessments, verification planning, technical reviews and design documentation. Plan and deliver your activities against agreed project commitments, communicating risks, dependencies and the impact of proposed changes early. Share technical learning and help improve mechanical design practices across projects. A mechanical engineer with practical judgement and a collaborative approach You enjoy both exploring concepts and working through the details that make a design reliable. You can turn analysis into clear recommendations, explain design trade-offs and challenge unclear assumptions constructively. You take a structured approach without making solutions more complex than necessary. You understand when further analysis is needed and when the available evidence supports moving forward. Above all, you take responsibility for your work while recognising that strong product solutions depend on contributions from several disciplines. We imagine that you: Hold a BSc or MSc in mechanical engineering, mechanical design, product development or a related discipline. Have experience developing mechanical solutions, including plastic components for injection moulding and high-volume production. Work confidently with 3D CAD, preferably SolidWorks. Have experience with robust design, tolerance calculations and design for manufacture. Can apply engineering theory, calculations and data analysis to practical design challenges. Communicate technical ideas and conclusions clearly, both visually and verbally. Work effectively across disciplines and document your work clearly. Communicate confidently in English. Experience in medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage. We also value experience with simulation and an interest in using digital tools, including AI where relevant, to improve engineering analysis and development efficiency. You do not need to know every method from the outset. Curiosity, sound engineering judgement and a willingness to develop your expertise are important. Interested? If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Jesper Bruun Jensen, Head of Continence Care & Bowel Care Mechanical Engineering, at DKJBRJ@coloplast.com. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate …

items.desc: Do you want to lead the ecological interpretation of complex offshore bird-monitoring projects? Can you turn radar, video, acoustic and environmental data into scientifically defensible conclusions for clients and regulators? Join DHI and take scientific ownership of projects at the intersection of avian ecology, technology and offshore wind. Responsibilities and challenges We are looking for a Biologist to support the scientific delivery of DHI MUSE and avian ecology projects. You will contribute to biological reviews, ecological analyses, reporting, and project coordination, working with experienced biologists, data scientists, instrumentation specialists and project managers. You will take increasing ownership of routine project-level scientific tasks, with guidance from senior colleagues and the Scientific Lead. Your main responsibilities and challenges will include: Prepare, organise and analyse radar, video, acoustic, weather and system-status data needed for scientific deliverables. Contribute to ecological analyses of flight trajectories, bird flux, species distribution, phenology, avoidance behaviour and collision risk. Work with data scientists and analysts to review results and interpret them in their ecological context. Draft report sections, technical notes, presentations, figures, tables and responses to review comments. Document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and other performance aspects clearly and consistently. Participate in project meetings and support communication with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and other DHI teams. Follow approved methods and quality procedures, and escalate unsupported conclusions or non-standard methods to senior colleagues. Qualifications and personal skills We are looking for a colleague with the following qualifications: Required: Master's degree in biology, ecology, ornithology or a closely related discipline, equivalent relevant qualifications or other proven merits and references in ornithology. A strong foundation in avian ecology, species identification, animal behaviour, migration ecology or environmental monitoring. Ability to analyse scientific information and communicate findings clearly in writing and orally. Careful and consistent approach to biological classification, quality assurance and documentation. Good data-handling skills and willingness to work with radar, video, acoustic and environmental datasets. Excellent written and spoken English. Ability to collaborate across biological, analytical, technical and project-management disciplines. Ability to use AI to speed up delivery without loss of quality. Desirable: Relevant professional, internship, thesis or research experience in bird monitoring, ecological consultancy or offshore wind. Experience reviewing wildlife video or acoustic recordings, identifying birds, or working with behavioural annotations. Experience in R, Python or other tools used for data analysis. Knowledge of environmental impact assessment, collision-risk modelling or remote-sensing methods. Personal qualities: Curious, methodical and keen to learn. Self-motivated and comfortable asking for guidance when needed. Strong attention to detail and scientific integrity. Collaborative, service-minded and able to communicate with colleagues from different disciplines. We offer To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that addresses complex challenges in water and the environment. We will offer you: A role where ecological science is applied directly to offshore wind and environmental decision-making. Collaboration with biologists, data scientists, analysts, instrumentation specialists and project managers. Professional and personal development, with room to grow your scientific and client-facing responsibilities. Flexible working opportunities. A diverse, international network of highly skilled colleagues. The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of DHI MUSE and avian ecology services. About DHI and DHI MUSE DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE and MUSE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team. DHI MUSE specifically is dedicated to managing the interplay between avian fauna and offshore wind energy. The product and associated work ultimately aim to automate bird monitoring, and as an add-on do curtailment of specific turbines when there is a risk of collision. By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices. Office …

items.desc: Biomarker Scientist, Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy Can you turn advanced bioanalytical data into decisions that accelerate neuroscience drug discovery? Connect fluid biomarkers with in vivo pharmacology and clinical translation. Your new role You will develop and apply fluid biomarker strategies that inform critical decisions across Lundbeck's discovery and translational neuroscience programmes. Using LC-MS/MS, quantitative proteomics, peptidomics and other emerging methods, you will design, qualify and implement targeted and untargeted bioanalytical workflows for CSF, plasma, blood, brain and other relevant tissues. You will plan and lead in vivo pharmacology studies, linking drug exposure, target engagement and pharmacodynamic effects to biological readouts. You will critically interpret complex datasets and translate the findings into clear project recommendations. As scientific lead or Study Director, you will take ownership of internal and external studies, working with discovery, DMPK, translational medicine, clinical biomarkers, CROs and academic partners. Your future team You will join our 13-person Preclinical Fluid Biomarkers and Occupancy department at Lundbeck's R&D headquarters in Valby, Copenhagen. Our team brings together scientists, research assistants, laboratory technicians and students to investigate compound effects in mechanistic animal models and measure related fluid biomarker changes. We combine hands-on science and a translational mindset to generate data that support project decisions. The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. What you bring to the team You enjoy solving scientific problems, working across disciplines and turning complex findings into clear recommendations. We are looking for: A PhD in neuroscience, pharmacology, biochemistry, bioanalytical sciences, biomedical sciences or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS and mass spectrometry-based proteomics, including the development and qualification of bioanalytical assays in biological matrices. Experience designing, planning and executing in vivo pharmacology studies, together with FELASA B certification or equivalent. Understanding of translational biomarkers, PK/PD and target engagement, and the communication and collaboration skills to lead studies and work effectively with project teams and external partners. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. Stillingen indebærer arbejde med datadrevne analyser i epidemiologiske forskningsprojekter, hvor du får en central rolle i håndteringen og analysen af komplekse sundhedsdata. Ansvarsområder Strukturering og kvalitetssikring af store sundhedsrelaterede datasæt Udvikling af scripts og analyseflows med fokus på reproducerbarhed, transparens og dokumentation Statistiske analyser af epidemiologiske data Bidrage til koordinering, kvalitetssikring og administrativ understøttelse af forskningsprojekter, herunder udarbejdelse af materiale til rapporter, præsentationer og publikationer Administrativ og teknisk understøttelse af forskningsaktiviteter i samarbejde med forskere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere på tværs af fagområder Kvalifikationer Vi forventer, at du: Har en relevant kandidatgrad inden for Health Data Science, biostatistik, epidemiologi eller et beslægtet fagområde Har erfaring med analyse af store sundheds- eller registerdatasæt Har erfaring med ét eller flere af følgende værktøjer: STATA, SPSS, R og/eller Python Har erfaring med datamanagement og scriptbaseret analyse Behersker engelsk flydende i både skrift og tale Trives i et tværfagligt samarbejdsmiljø og er en stærk holdspiller Om Forskningsenheden for Epidemiologi, Biostatistik og Biodemografi EBB forsker i menneskelig udvikling, sygdom og aldring samt sammenhængene mellem disse områder. Forskningen bygger på tværfaglige tilgange, der kombinerer metoder fra epidemiologi, genetik, statistik, bioinformatik og demografi. Forskningsmiljøet er internationalt orienteret og kendetegnet ved høj faglig kvalitet, stærkt samarbejde og adgang til unikke danske registre og sundhedsdata. Om Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet (SUND) ved Syddansk Universitet er et af Danmarks førende sundhedsvidenskabelige fakulteter. Med ni institutter, forskning i international topklasse og et bredt udvalg af sundhedsuddannelser bidrager vi til at udvikle fremtidens viden, behandling og sundhedsvæsen. Som medarbejder på SUND bliver du en del af et ambitiøst og tværfagligt miljø præget af høj faglighed, stærke samarbejder og gode muligheder for udvikling. Fakultetet har aktiviteter i Odense, Esbjerg og København. I Esbjerg og København danner stærke faglige miljøer ramme om forskning og uddannelse, mens vores moderne fakultetsbygning i Odense samler forskning, uddannelse og administration under ét tag og er direkte forbundet med Odense Universitetshospital. items.desc: Position description Category Intrumentation, metrology and control Contract Internship Job title Sub-30 nm sample preparation and limited-angle STEM tomography H/F Subject Prepare sub-30-nm FIB lamellae and use limited-angle STEM tomography to reduce projection effects in nanoscale semiconductor devices. Contract duration (months) 6 Job description As semiconductor devices become smaller and more complex, structural information from 2D STEM images becomes harder to interpret because projection effects and overlapping features through conventional FIB lamellae can obscure nanoscale structures. The internship will improve both sample preparation and STEM characterization. Lamellae thinner than 30 nm will be prepared using FIB milling followed by low-energy argon-ion polishing. Limited-angle electron tomography will then reconstruct the central slice of the FIB lamella to reduce projection effects. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Premier assureur de biens et responsabilité en France et 10ème réassureur mondial, le groupe Covéa est un leader européen de l’assurance et de la réassurance, à travers ses 4 marques MAAF, MMA, GMF et PartnerRe. Acteur économique majeur des territoires, grâce à ses 24 000 collaborateurs en France et dans le monde, le groupe Covéa protège 11,4 millions de clients et sociétaires en France. Description du poste Vos missions? En tant que "Pentester", vous avez la charge de réaliser les activités les tests d’intrusion sur les SI COVEA. Vous contribuez au renforcement de la posture de sécurité du Groupe en évaluant de manière proactive la résistance de nos actifs numériques face aux menaces cyber. Vous intervenez sur un périmètre varié couvrant les systèmes d'information, les infrastructures, les applications métiers, les services Cloud et les nouvelles technologies déployées au sein des marques MAAF, MMA et GMF. En collaboration étroite avec le SOC, les équipes de gestion des vulnérabilités, les architectes sécurité et les équipes projets, vous participez à l'identification des faiblesses de sécurité et à l'amélioration continue de nos capacités de cyberdéfense. Et concrètement? Réaliser des évaluations de sécurité Conduire des tests d'intrusion sur les applications Web, API, infrastructures et environnements Cloud. Identifier, qualifier et exploiter les vulnérabilités dans un cadre maîtrisé. Évaluer les scénarios d'attaque susceptibles d'impacter les activités du Groupe. Vérifier l'efficacité des mesures de sécurité existantes. Produire les rapports d'audit et restituer les résultats aux équipes techniques, aux responsables de projet et aux parties prenantes concernées. Contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités Participer à l'analyse des vulnérabilités critiques détectées sur le système d'information. Prioriser les risques en fonction de leur exploitabilité et de leur impact métier. Accompagner les équipes dans la définition des plans de remédiation. Réaliser des contrôles de correction et des campagnes de revalidation. Participer à la stratégie de cybersécurité offensive Contribuer à l'évolution des pratiques de sécurité offensive. Participer aux exercices Purple Team en coordination avec le SOC. Alimenter les cas d'usage de détection à partir des techniques observées lors des tests. Participer aux exercices de simulation d'attaque et de validation des capacités de détection. Accompagner les projets Apporter une expertise sécurité lors des phases de conception des projets. Réaliser des revues techniques de sécurité. Contribuer à l'intégration des exigences de sécurité dans les démarches DevSecOps. Sensibiliser les équipes aux risques et bonnes pratiques. Qualifications Et si c'était vous? Compétences techniques : Indispensables : Bonne maîtrise des environnements Windows et Linux. Connaissance des architectures réseau et des protocoles TCP/IP. Maîtrise des méthodologies de tests d'intrusion. Connaissances des référentiels OWASP Top 10 et MITRE ATT&CK. Maîtrise d'outils tels que : Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, Metasploit, Nessus, Wireshark, Kali Linux Appréciées : Sécurité Azure ou AWS. Sécurité Active Directory. Automatisation Python ou PowerShell. Sécurité des conteneurs et Kubernetes. Expérience Purple Team ou Red Team. Connaissance des solutions EDR/XDR et de leur exploitation par un SOC. Compétences comportementales : Curiosité technique et veille permanente. Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. Capacité à transformer une problématique technique en risque compréhensible par les métiers. Rigueur et autonomie. Goût du travail collaboratif. Sens du service et culture du résultat. Qualités de communication écrite et orale, d’écoute et d’expression développées (présentations techniques, transfert de connaissances) Capacité à coopérer et collaborer dans le cadre de travaux collectifs sur site et en distanciel. Capacité d’adaptation et à appréhender de manière constructive les situations nouvelles ou inhabituelles. Informations complémentaires Ce poste est à pourvoir sur les sites Le Mans, Saran ou Niort et nécessite, de par son périmètre Covéa, des déplacements ponctuels sur les différents sites. Parce que chez COVEA, nous sommes attachés à la diversité dans nos recrutements et à l’égalité des chances, nous vous offrons, à compétences égales, les mêmes possibilités de parcours professionnels !

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Do you like helping customers implement innovative cloud computing solutions and solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing and AI technologies? Do you have a knack for helping groups understand application architectures and integration approaches? Do you have the consultative and leadership skills to help customers succeed with their cloud efforts? Are you passionate about cloud computing with a special focus on virtualized desktops, applications, document collaboration, and AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences? Amazon Web Services is looking for Solutions Architects to help establish AWS Agentic WorkSpaces (formerly known as Amazon End User Computing) as the market leader in end user computing. We are especially seeking SAs with a high level of AI fluency who are excited to help customers adopt the next generation of our portfolio, including Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents. We built AWS Agentic WorkSpaces services to give customers the agility to respond to the changing needs of their workforce. Customers can scale up or scale down on-demand, providing users with the resources they need, all without deploying and operating infrastructure. This is a highly technical position for someone who can dive deep, build complex, AWS-optimized architectures, and help customers accelerate their adoption of AWS services and AI-powered, agentic workflows. Your broad responsibilities include owning technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects. You should be as comfortable discussing complex technical details with a room full of engineers as you are briefing an executive audience. In addition, you will engage with other AWS solutions architects, partner and professional services organizations to drive large and highly complex sales opportunities to closure. The AWS Agentic WorkSpaces SA team is creating and migrating large scale and compelling workloads on AWS. You will be collaborating with and influencing technical teams requiring AWS expertise and in so doing will be making a significant impact on Amazon’s customers. Enjoy working with enterprise customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI-enabled solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers. Key job responsibilities Work with customers to deploy Amazon Agentic WorkSpaces — Personal, Applications and Core — as well as Workspaces for Builders and Workspaces for Agents. Guide customers on designing and operating AI-powered, agentic end user computing experiences, helping them apply AI fluency to real-world builder and agent workflows. Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS. Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community. Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers, blogs, and technical guides. Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates. Act as a technical liaison between customers, partners, service engineering teams and support, advocating for the Voice of the Customer and channeling field insights to help shape product strategy and roadmap. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Fort de plus d’un siècle d’expertise, le groupe est aujourd’hui présent dans plus de 90 pays, avec 22 filiales et environ 1 500 collaborateurs à travers le monde. Le laboratoire concentre son expertise sur trois domaines thérapeutiques majeurs : la gynécologie, l’endocrinologie et l’urologie. Il développe notamment des solutions destinées à la santé féminine et masculine, couvrant des enjeux tels que la ménopause, la fertilité, la grossesse, les troubles hormonaux et le déficit en testostérone. La filiale France – Besins Healthcare France – s’appuie sur des équipes locales en lien avec les équipes du groupe. Dans un environnement à taille humaine, les échanges sont directs et les collaborateurs sont proches des enjeux opérationnels. La filiale recherche un(e) Data Analyst SFE / CRM en contrat à durée indéterminée. LE CONTEXTE Ce recrutement s’inscrit dans le cadre du remplacement du collaborateur actuellement en charge à 50% du SFE local, et promu dans un autre département. Il permettra de reprendre les travaux déjà engagés sur les données et de développer progressivement le volet analytique de la fonction. L’objectif est de renforcer l’analyse de la performance commerciale et structurer ses données afin de mieux accompagner les équipes de vente et les prises de décision. Le CRM actuel est une solution locale externalisée. Les données sont accessibles via des exports, mais elles sont encore dispersées et doivent être structurées. LE POSTE Missions Rattaché(e) au Directeur Business Intelligence au sein de la filiale France, vous contribuerez à structurer les données CRM et à faire de l’analyse un outil utile aux décisions commerciales. Vous travaillerez avec la direction des ventes, les équipes siège, les équipes terrain et, selon les projets, les interlocuteurs du groupe. synthétiques Diffuser des analyses et reportings réguliers aux managers régionaux, à la Direction commerciale, au Marketing et à la Direction Contribuer à la sectorisation, aux plans d’action terrain traitements et reportings récurrents Être progressivement l’interlocuteur de référence des équipes commerciales sur les usages CRM et les indicateurs SFE Être le référent local du projet pilote CRM Assurer le rôle de référent opérationnel local pour le CRM actuel et le projet pilote d’implémentation du nouveau CRM Coordonner les besoins métiers locaux avec les équipes Globales, IT, Ventes, Marketing et BI Participer au cadrage fonctionnel, à la définition des processus cibles, des règles de gestion et des besoins de reporting Contribuer à préparer, contrôler et valider les données contribuer à l’accompagnement des utilisateurs au changement Suivre l’adoption du CRM après son déploiement et mettre en place des indicateurs de qualité, d’usage et de performance Assurer le lien entre le projet CRM et l’écosystème BI local afin de sécuriser les flux de données, les reportings et les usages analytiques. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Sopra Steria , acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe, avec 51 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services et solutions numériques. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, en combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d’activité et des technologies à une approche collaborative. Sopra Steria place l’humain au cœur de son action et s’engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du numérique pour construire un avenir positif. En 2025, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 5,6 milliards d’euros. Description du poste Votre environnement de travail : Donnez de la valeur aux données des acteurs financiers Vous souhaitez transformer les besoins métiers en solutions Data concrètes et contribuer à des projets stratégiques pour de grands acteurs de la banque et de l’assurance ? Rejoignez Sopra Steria et intervenez au cœur des enjeux de valorisation des données, de conformité et d’innovation. Notre vertical Services Financiers accompagne les grandes banques et compagnies d’assurance françaises et européennes dans leurs transformations numériques : modernisation des systèmes d’information, amélioration de la qualité des données, performance opérationnelle, sécurité et conformité réglementaire. Des projets à fort impact Vous interviendrez sur des projets stratégiques mobilisant des expertises en Data, Cloud, IA, API, automatisation des processus et architectures distribuées . Vous pourrez notamment contribuer à des sujets de gouvernance et de qualité des données, de référentiels clients, de reporting réglementaire, de lutte contre la fraude et le blanchiment, ou encore de modernisation de plateformes Data. Au sein d’une agence de spécialité Data et IA, vous rejoignez des équipes pluridisciplinaires qui conjuguent expertise sectorielle, excellence technologique et proximité client. Votre rôle : faire le lien entre les enjeux métiers et les équipes IT pour concevoir des solutions utiles, fiables et durables. Vous savez comprendre et challenger un besoin métier, le traduire en solution fonctionnelle et collaborer avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques. Une première expérience en développement, en SQL ou dans la manipulation de données constituera un atout. Votre esprit d’analyse, votre sens du service, votre rigueur et vos qualités relationnelles vous permettront de réussir dans ce rôle et d’évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités de Product Owner, Lead Business Analyst ou pilotage de projet. ✨ Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? items.desc: About the Role We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success , turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy. You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world. What You’ll Do Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems. Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale. Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks. Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.) Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences. Why This Role Matters Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information . You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say. Your work will inform: The stories we tell in marketing. The use cases we automate in our GTM systems. The features we prioritize in our roadmap. If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you. You’re a Great Fit If You 2+ years in technical support engineering , software engineering , or solutions engineering , with direct application development experience. Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency. Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines. Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments. Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences. Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment. Example Projects Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow. Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results. Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability. Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures. Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation. About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: …
