items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day The Software Architect OT shapes the Industrial Digital Foundation and Software-Defined Automation architecture across Digital Products and Solutions (DPS). The role defines how industrial assets, control systems, edge platforms, operational data and knowledge, enterprise services, and AI capabilities work together in a secure, governed, and reusable architecture. Combining deep OT expertise with cross-portfolio architecture leadership, the role guides technology convergence and turns strategic direction into practical standards, roadmaps, and scalable solutions. Create and scale an Industrial Digital Foundation that reduces product-specific engineering, enables reusable software-defined automation and edge capabilities, and provides trusted operational context for digital services and AI-enabled energy systems across components, assets, plants, fleets, and enterprise platforms. How You’ll Make an Impact Architecture leadership: Define, maintain, and govern target and reference architectures, principles, reusable patterns, technical standards, and guardrails for OT, edge, industrial data, and automation across DPS. Industrial Digital Foundation: Establish shared asset, system, equipment, semantic, and state models that can be governed once and reused across engineering, operations, digital services, analytics, and AI. Software-defined automation: Decouple control applications and engineering artifacts from specific hardware while preserving deterministic behavior, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, availability, and lifecycle support. Edge and distributed runtime: Define resilient architectures connecting industrial assets, control workloads, edge services, enterprise platforms, cloud services, and AI. Address local processing, offline operation, store-and-forward, remote lifecycle management, observability, and graceful degradation. OT/IT integration and interoperability: Drive secure, open, multi-vendor integration across plant networks, industrial DMZs, edge, cloud, and enterprise environments using appropriate protocols, APIs, brokers, gateways, and information models. Trusted industrial data: Define consistent approaches for acquiring, timestamping, validating, buffering, normalizing, contextualizing, and securely transporting industrial data, including metadata, lineage, data quality, and time synchronization. Cybersecurity and compliance: Embed defense in depth, segmentation, secure remote access, identity, certificate and secrets management, hardening, vulnerability management, auditability, and applicable industrial cybersecurity requirements into architecture decisions. Architecture governance: Lead architecture reviews, document significant decisions and trade-offs, resolve cross-domain conflicts, and ensure agreed guardrails are reflected in product and platform roadmaps. Technology & Business Leadership Translate the Industrial Digital Foundation into prioritized technology roadmaps and cross-product adoption plans. Identify high-value opportunities, validate them through prototypes, site evidence, and customer feedback, and move successful concepts into scalable portfolio and platform initiatives. Guide technology selection and integration based on interoperability, security, scalability, operational resilience, lifecycle sustainability, cost, and business value. Build strategic partnerships and ecosystems that close capability gaps, accelerate adoption, and create reusable technology and business opportunities. Increase engineering productivity through reusable components, shared patterns, reference implementations, and systematic reduction of product-specific solutions. Mentor engineers and architects, build critical competencies, and align product, platform, controls, cybersecurity, data, and AI teams. Communicate complex architecture choices clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and represent DPS Technology & Innovation with customers, suppliers, partners, standards bodies, and industry communities. Define governance and assurance principles for AI agents and agent-based architectures, including safe tool access, human oversight, operational boundaries, and integration with trusted industrial context. What You Bring Education and experience: Master’s degree in automation, electrical or control engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Extensive experience in industrial automation, industrial software, digital platforms, or critical infrastructure is expected. OT and control systems: Deep knowledge of PLC, DCS, SCADA, historian, protection, and condition-monitoring environments, including plant operations, high-availability and safety constraints, long asset lifecycles, brownfield integration, and controlled change. items.desc: Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection – growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,500 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 28 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products. At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy. Are you ready to turn your scientific curiosity into a career that makes a real impact? Our Ignite Graduate Programme is a unique two-year development journey designed for ambitious graduates who want to accelerate their careers, build technical expertise, and develop the leadership capabilities needed to become the next generation of innovators at Synthomer. Working within our Research and Development function, you'll support real innovation projects that help solve customer challenges, develop new technologies, and create business value. Through a combination of hands-on project work, mentoring, training, and rotational placements, you'll gain the experience, confidence and commercial understanding needed to thrive in a technical or leadership career. What You'll Experience During the programme, you'll have the opportunity to: Complete four six-month rotations across key areas of our R&D organisation. Deliver experimental programmes and contribute to innovation projects that support business growth. Design, conduct and evaluate laboratory experiments. Analyse scientific and commercial data, draw conclusions and present recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to the development of new products, technologies, capabilities and intellectual property. Gain experience across multiple technical disciplines including synthesis, applications and analytical science. Work closely with both technical and commercial teams to understand how innovation creates value for customers. Develop a broad internal network across research, manufacturing, commercial and support functions. Participate in structured leadership development and mentoring programmes. Build confidence presenting ideas, influencing stakeholders and managing projects. Play an active role in maintaining a strong Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) culture. You'll thrive in this programme if you : Have recently completed, or are on track to complete, a degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, or a related scientific discipline . Enjoy analysing data and turning insights into practical solutions. Are passionate about research, innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills. Enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of people and functions. Can manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment. Are adaptable, resilient and open to new experiences. Have excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to safe working practices. Show leadership potential and the desire to make a positive impact. Have a good working knowledge of English. The Behaviours We Valu e We're looking for individuals who demonstrate: Curiosity - asking questions and challenging conventional thinking. Collaboration - building strong relationships and working effectively in teams. Adaptability - embracing change and learning from new experiences. Customer Focus - understanding how innovation creates value. Leadership Potential - taking ownership, showing initiative and driving improvement. Ready to Ignite Your Career? This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to contribute to meaningful innovation, learn from experienced scientists and business leaders, and accelerate your development within a global organisation. If you're ready to challenge yourself, grow your expertise and make your mark from day one, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching …

items.desc: Job Description: Unternehmen: Airbus Defence and Space Standort: Tesat, Backnang Anstellungsart: Vollzeit, Tarifanstellung Über uns : Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und geeinte Welt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt kontinuierlich effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung und vernetzte Dienste. Im Bereich der Verkehrsflugzeuge bietet Airbus die modernsten und treibstoffeffizientesten Flugzeugfamilien an. Darüber hinaus ist Airbus ein europäischer Marktführer im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit sowie eines der weltweit größten Raumfahrtunternehmen. Damit gestalten wir aktiv die technologische Zukunft, um die Sicherheit und Souveränität Europas zu stärken. Ihr neues Umfeld: Um die Zukunft autonomer Systeme zu gestalten, bündelt Airbus seine Kräfte in den Bereichen Künstliche Intelligenz und Autonomie. Zu diesem Zweck bauen wir am traditionsreichen Technologiestandort der Tesat in Backnang ein neues, agiles Kompetenz- und Entwicklungszentrum auf. In diesem Umfeld, das jahrzehntelange Expertise in der Weltraumtechnik mit der Dynamik eines Start-ups verbindet, entwickeln wir die nächste Generation KI-gestützter Verteidigungs- und Dual-Use-Anwendungen. Ihre Rolle: Als Business Operations Specialist halten Sie den kaufmännischen und operativen Betrieb des AI Hubs am Laufen - alles, was nicht technisch ist. Der Schwerpunkt liegt dabei im Controlling. Sie berichten direkt an die Leitung des AI Hubs und arbeiten eng mit den Bereichen Engineering und Product zusammen. Wir verbinden die Arbeitsweise eines Start-ups mit den Strukturen eines großen Konzerns: Finanz- und Personalfunktionen, SAP und Exportkontrolle. Sie sorgen dafür, dass unsere Teams zügig arbeiten können und die Konzernprozesse dabei sauber eingehalten werden. Ihre Aufgaben: - Controlling & Forecast: Sie verantworten Kostenstellen, Budgetplanung, Forecast und das monatliche Reporting. Planungsanfragen der Finanzabteilung beantworten Sie termingerecht und mit nachvollziehbaren Annahmen. - Stundensätze & Abrechnung: Sie verantworten die Kette von der geleisteten Stunde bis zur Rechnung: Stundensätze einschließlich Gemeinkostenzuschlägen, Qualität der Zeiterfassung, interne und externe Verrechnung sowie die zugehörigen Projekt- und Förderquoten. - Business Cases: Sie erstellen Business Cases mit belastbaren Zahlen für unsere größten Kostenblöcke - Rechenleistung, Cloud, Daten, Tools - und unterstützen Anträge auf öffentliche Förderung, etwa im Rahmen von IPCEI. - Beschaffung & Arbeitsumgebung: Sie bestellen Hardware so, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen ab dem ersten Tag arbeitsfähig sind, und begleiten Bestellungen durch den Airbus-Einkauf. Sie halten die Arbeitsumgebung funktionsfähig: Flächenplanung, Ausstattung, Facility-Themen. - HR & Onboarding : Sie sind die lokale Schnittstelle zu HR, koordinieren das Recruiting und organisieren das Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender. - Schlanke Prozesse: Sie gestalten Zeiterfassung, Reporting und Bestellwege so einfach, dass die Teams sie im Alltag selbstständig nutzen, und erklären die Regeln so, dass sie verstanden und mitgetragen werden. Sicherheit im Handwerk ab dem ersten Tag: Stundensätze und Gemeinkostenzuschläge, Kostenstellen, Forecast und Monatsabschluss. Erfahrung mit SAP CO/PS ist ein klares Plus. Echte Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie prüfen Zeitbuchungen und bestellen Laptops selbst, und es ist Ihnen wichtig, dass die Zahlen stimmen. Beharrlichkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Sie bleiben an Anliegen dran, bis sie erledigt sind, und pflegen dabei eine gute Zusammenarbeit mit allen Beteiligten. Freude an einem Umfeld , das sich noch im Aufbau befindet. Prioritäten verschieben sich mit den Projekten, die wir gewinnen. Interesse daran, was die Teams entwickeln . Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch sowie Offenheit für das Verteidigungsumfeld, in dem Exportkontrolle und Vertraulichkeit zum Arbeitsalltag gehören. items.desc: Irgendwo an einem norwegischen Fjord steht gerade ein Camper im Regen. Drinnen ist es warm, weil eine Firmware zuverlässig ihren Job macht. Vielleicht bald Deine. REVOTION digitalisiert die Yacht- und Campingbranche. Wir entwickeln ein smartes Bordsystem für Caravans, Camper, Boote und Yachten: Heizung, Licht, Batterien, Tanks und Sensoren, alles vernetzt, alles per App und Touchscreen steuerbar. Das Herzstück sind unsere eigenen Hardware-Module: das BRAIN (Zentralrechner mit Bluetooth, LTE-M und GPS) und unsere NODEs (Schalt-, Batterie-, Tank-, Temperatur- und Klimamodule). Gestartet in einer Garage, ausgezeichnet mit dem European Innovation Award. Und auf jedem einzelnen Modul läuft Firmware, die wir selbst geschrieben haben. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich: einen erfahrenen Embedded-Softwareentwickler, der nicht nur Tickets abarbeitet, sondern die Firmware-Architektur mitprägt. Wir sind ein kleines Team aus Düsseldorf. Das heißt: kurze Wege, echte Verantwortung, und Deine Entscheidungen landen nicht in einem Backlog, sondern auf Geräten, die Menschen jeden Tag benutzen. Aufgaben Du entwickelst unsere Firmware in C für BRAIN- und NODE-Module weiter (ESP32-S3, FreeRTOS/ESP-IDF) und prägst dabei mit, wie sie in fünf Jahren aussieht Du gestaltest unsere BLE-Schnittstellen zwischen Modulen und App Du bringst Drittgeräte zum Sprechen : Heizungen, Batterien, Wechselrichter und Sensorik namhafter Hersteller, über CAN, RS-485/Modbus und VEDirect Du verantwortest OTA-Updates , Diagnose und Logging für eine wachsende Geräteflotte im Feld Du debuggst hardware-nah, gemeinsam mit unserem Elektronik-Team direkt am Prototypen (Logic Analyzer, Oszilloskop, Bring-up) Qualifikation Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Embedded-Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise 5–10 Jahre Bachelor- oder Master im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Embedded Systems oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C für Mikrocontroller (vorzeigbare Projekte aus der Praxis) Erfahrung mit ESP32, STM32 oder vergleichbaren MCUs und einem RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr o.Ä.) Gute Erfahrungen mit Bluetooth (BLE) : GATT, Advertising, Pairing Vertraut mit gängigen Bus- und Kommunikationsprotokollen (UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS-485) Sicherer Umgang mit Git und strukturierter Arbeitsweise (Code Reviews, Versionierung) Mindestens C1 Deutschkenntnisse Nice-to-Have: Erfahrung mit KI im Embedded-Umfeld : KI-gestützte Entwicklung (z.B. Copilot, Claude Code) oder Edge-AI/TinyML auf Mikrocontrollern Erfahrung mit ESP-IDF und dem Espressif-Ökosystem Kenntnisse in Embedded Security (Secure Boot, Flash Encryption, TLS) oder Berührungspunkte mit dem Cyber Resilience Act Erfahrung mit OTA-Update-Mechanismen und Geräteflotten im Feld Praktische Hardware-Erfahrung : Schaltpläne lesen, Prototypen aufbauen, Löten, Messtechnik (Spannungsteiler Blackbox) Erfahrung in der App-Entwicklung , idealerweise mit Flutter Python für Test-Tooling und Automatisierung Benefits voll ausgestattetes Elektrotechnik Labor mit sämtlichen Instrumenten und Fertigungsmaschinen, auch für Deine privaten Projekte nutzbar Kein langweiliger Bürojob, viele Testfahrten mit Yachten und Campern sowie Kundenbesuche ein eigenes MacBook Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch Experten (Coachings von externen Dienstleistern) Free Drinks und Snacks (natürlich auch Kaffee-Flat) keinen Tischkicker, dafür aber gemütliches Office in der Innenstadt Düsseldorfs Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Anteil Firmenevents Corporate Benefits (Angebote für zahlreiche Shops) Die meisten Embedded-Jobs sehen so aus: Du bekommst ein Modul zugeteilt, schreibst Code nach Lastenheft und erfährst nie, ob das Produkt jemals das Werk verlassen hat. Bei uns ist es anders. Du siehst Dein Feature vom ersten Commit bis zum Camper auf dem Weg nach Skandinavien. Und wenn Du eine bessere Idee hast als wir, dann machen wir es so, wie Du es sagst. Nicht, weil das in einer Kultur-Broschüre steht, sondern weil wir zu klein sind für Politik und zu ehrgeizig für „haben wir schon immer so gemacht". Dazu gibt's ein Labor, in dem Du auch privat basteln darfst, Kollegen, die Schaltpläne genauso lieben wie sauberen Code, und ab und zu eine Testfahrt, die sich verdächtig nach Urlaub anfühlt. Idealerweise wohnst Du in der Nähe von Düsseldorf, dann sehen wir uns im Office und im Labor. Und noch etwas: Uns ist deine Herkunft, dein Aussehen, dein Geschlecht und wen oder was du anbetest sowas von egal, hauptsache du brennst für das, was Du machst <3 Bewerbungen sind immer langwierig und langweilig. Daher musst du bei uns nur deinen Lebenslauf hochladen und ganz kurz und knapp schreiben, warum wir Dich kennenlernen müssen. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Nachricht!

With a deep-rooted passion and a drive to redefine industry standards, we strive to create seamless logistics solutions that empower businesses and individuals alike. Our mission is to navigate the complexities and challenges of global logistics, ensuring flexibility, reliability, efficiency, and an unwavering focus on customer satisfaction. As part of the OB Streem family, you will contribute to maintaining a legacy of excellence while being empowered to innovate, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact every day. We are seeking a highly motivated Air Freight Operator to join our Air Freight Forwarding Department at our offices located at Athens International Airport. The Air Freight Operator, will be responsible for managing and coordinating all air freight shipments end-to-end, ensuring timely, cost-effective, and compliant execution of import and export operations. Responsibilities Ensure readiness for air freight import/export shipments by verifying documentation and shipment details. Coordinate bookings with airlines, agents, and correspondents, providing accurate flight and loading instructions to carriers, and preparing/loading notes as necessary. Ensure accuracy within the company’s ERP system (Orian). Generate and distribute required air freight documents, such as airway bills, delivery orders, and customs declarations. Oversee the issuance and management of invoices related to air freight shipments. Requirements Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, with customers and suppliers. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Advanced business writing and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English. Advanced MS Office skills. Familiarity with Orian ERP software will be considered an advantage. To qualify for the role, you must have: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Business administration or other related fields. Demonstrated experience in Freight Operations or relevant position. Previous experience in the Air freight forwarding industry is desirable. Benefits Competitive remuneration package. Life and medical insurance. Provision of technological equipment. Excellent career opportunities and learning development. Modern and friendly working environment. Working within an outstanding Team of experts in a dynamic and fast-growing organization. items.desc: Location: Athens Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 22, 2026 Job description Requisition ID: 1739715 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals ! At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI . We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world . The opportunity Patch and Vulnerability Management is a foundational capability for modern cyber resilience. Organizations need to continuously identify exposures, prioritize remediation based on real risk, and deploy fixes safely across complex endpoint, server and cloud estates. In this role, you will help our clients strengthen their security posture by designing, improving, and operationalizing vulnerability and patch management processes and by leveraging automation to increase speed, quality, and auditability. Your Key Responsibilities You will be a key member of our security engineering/operations delivery teams, responsible for establishing and running end-to-end vulnerability and patch management in alignment with client needs and operating models. Deliver end‑to‑end vulnerability assessment and risk‑based remediation prioritization. Partner with stakeholders to validate scope, impact, and remediation approach across environments. Plan and govern patching activities in line with SLAs, maintenance windows, and change processes. Execute standard and emergency patching with appropriate testing, approvals, and rollback controls. Operate and continuously optimize patching and remediation tooling (e.g. Intune, Azure Update Manager, MECM/SCCM, Tanium). Drive automation and scripting to improve remediation efficiency and operational quality. Maintain accurate asset inventory, tagging, and ownership to enable accountability and reporting. Produce operational and executive‑level reporting, highlighting trends and improvement opportunities. Skills and attributes for success To qualify for the role you must have: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics or related field, or equivalent work experience. Proven experience establishing and/or operating Vulnerability & Patch Management processes in a corporate environment. Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment methodologies and patch prioritization principles (risk/exposure-based). Hands-on familiarity with enterprise endpoint/server patching operations and change-controlled environments. Strong analytical/problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ideally, you will also have: Strong Microsoft ecosystem experience (e.g., Microsoft security/endpoint platform exposure) Experience optimizing a tool stack and proposing improvements. Experience in hybrid/cloud environments and supporting large-scale operations. Microsoft Security certifications such as MD102, AZ-500, MS-500, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400 Vendor-agnostic security Certification(s) such as from ISC2 (CISSP, CCSP, etc.), ISACA (CISM, CISA) or SANS/GIAC (GSEC, GCLD, GPCS, etc.) will be considered a plus. In depth hands-on experience with a multitude of operating systems, databases and networking infrastructure. Ability in writing custom scripting tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, etc.), interacting with API’s. items.desc: Position: Infrastructure Operation Specialist Job Purpose: The Infrastructure Operations Specialist, which reports directly to the Infrastructure Operation Manager, contributes directly to business continuity, service security, and the support of the company’s infrastructure projects by ensuring the optimal functioning of the IT infrastructure, monitoring systems, networks, and cloud platforms, promptly resolving operational issues, and implementing technical improvements. Key responsibilities: Monitor the health and performance of the IT infrastructure and respond to anomalies or degradation. Perform daily operational activities: provisioning, patching, updates, backups, capacity management. Administer and maintain operating systems and cloud platforms. Resolve incidents, problems, and changes. Collaborate with security teams to ensure compliance, system hardening, and vulnerability management. Manage and improve monitoring and logging tools. Conduct capacity and performance analysis to optimize resource usage and costs. Support infrastructure evolution projects and technology migrations. Technical Skills: Must Have: Solid knowledge of Linux Server and Linux operating systems (including Active Directory and GPO) Experience with virtualization environments (VMware ESXi/vCenter; Nutanix) Working knowledge of AWS cloud services (EC2, VPC, IAM) Other Skills: IT Infrastructure Management: Expertise in cloud services, server management, networking, storage solutions, and disaster recovery planning. Project Management: Ability to execute infrastructure projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business requirements. Service Management: Knowledge of ITIL or other service management frameworks to optimize service delivery and support functions. Digital Security: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices to safeguard the organization’s infrastructure. Compliance & Regulations: Familiarity with regulatory requirements related to IT infrastructure and operations. Change Management: Ability to work on large-scale infrastructure changes while minimizing operational disruption. English Language: Competent (written & spoken) Nice to Have: Certification: AWS Cloud Practitioner/SysOps Associate, ITIL 4 Foundation Soft Skills: Time-management skills. Team working, ability to collaborate effectively to achieve set objectives Proven problem-solving skills, ability to consider complex multi-disciplinary aspects of problem. Adaptability and Flexability. Node / Typescript) Strong IaaS security skills, with a focus on cloud technologies like AWS. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Preventief en correctief onderhoud plannen en uitvoeren Technische en softwarematige storingen analyseren en oplossen Structurele verbeteringen voorstellen en doorvoeren Nieuwe machines begeleiden bij installatie en afname Externe onderhoudspartijen en leveranciers coördineren Productieapparatuur, labinstallaties en technische voorzieningen onderhouden Wat breng je mee? items.desc: Ben jij onze nieuwe collega? Wil jij werken aan techniek die letterlijk de grenzen van de aarde overstijgt? Bij SRON werk je aan instrumentatie voor ruimteonderzoek: van testopstellingen en toepassingen voor grondtelescopen en stratosferische ballonnen tot instrumenten die uiteindelijk met een satelliet de ruimte in gaan. Ben jij een gedreven fijnmechanisch werktuigbouwer met een passie voor het ontwerpen en numeriek analyseren van complexe mechanieken? En krijg je energie van technische vraagstukken waarvoor niet meteen een standaardoplossing bestaat? Als constructeur bij SRON zet je jouw vakkennis, creativiteit en technische inzicht in om wetenschappers te ondersteunen bij baanbrekend onderzoek. Je werkt mee aan instrumenten die daadwerkelijk de ruimte in gaan en daarmee een bijdrage leveren aan onze kennis van het heelal. Klinkt dit als een uitdaging die bij jou past? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Jouw functie Als constructeur ontwerp en analyseer je complexe onderdelen en samenstellingen voor instrumenten voor ruimteonderzoek. Daarbij krijg je te maken met een unieke combinatie van technische eisen. Denk aan extreme temperaturen, cryogene omstandigheden, vacuüm, straling en zeer hoge betrouwbaarheid. Bovendien moeten de instrumenten bestand zijn tegen de enorme krachten die tijdens een lancering optreden. Je werk beperkt zich niet tot het instrument zelf. Je draagt ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van laboratorium- en testopstellingen waarmee we onze instrumenten onder deze omstandigheden kunnen testen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega-constructeurs en ontwerpers uit andere disciplines, fysici en instrumentmakers. Samen onderzoek je mogelijke oplossingsrichtingen en vertaal je complexe wetenschappelijke en technische vraagstukken naar betrouwbare technische oplossingen. Kwaliteit loopt als een rode draad door je werk. Je hebt oog voor zowel de kwaliteit van het ontwerp als voor de processen waarmee het product wordt ontwikkeld, geproduceerd, samengesteld en getest. Je wordt onderdeel van het team Mechanica en bent regelmatig betrokken bij het produceren, samenbouwen en testen van jouw ontwerpen. Een groot deel hiervan vindt in-house plaats. Hierdoor zie je jouw ontwerp niet alleen op papier of in een CAD-model, maar daadwerkelijk tot leven komen. Binnen deze functie ligt het zwaartepunt op het numeriek analyseren van ontwerpen. Je werkt onder andere met Finite Element Methods (FEM) voor structurele analyses, zoals vibratie- en shock-spectra. Daarnaast voer je thermische en magneto-dynamische analyses uit. Je vertaalt de resultaten van deze analyses naar concrete verbeteringen en onderbouwde ontwerpkeuzes. Tegelijkertijd blijf je constructeur in hart en nieren. Je ontwerpt en werkt oplossingen uit, legt deze technisch vast en maakt ze productierijp. Zo combineer je analytische diepgang met praktisch technisch inzicht. Jouw team Deze functie valt binnen de Sectie Mechanica van SRON’s Engineering Group (EG). Werken binnen een technische afdeling van een ruimtevaartinstituut is bijzonder. Hier draait het niet alleen om het realiseren van een goed ontwerp, maar vooral om zekerheid en betrouwbaarheid. Zodra een instrument de ruimte in gaat, is er immers geen mogelijkheid om het even open te maken, te repareren of een onderdeel te vervangen. Dat maakt het werk uitdagend én betekenisvol. Binnen ons engineeringteam werken we aan technische puzzels die soms bijna onmogelijk lijken. We ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, analyseren, leren en verbeteren. En als het nodig is, beginnen we opnieuw. Net zo lang totdat het werkt én we er volledig op kunnen vertrouwen. Juist die combinatie van uitdaging, vakmanschap en maatschappelijke en wetenschappelijke impact maakt het werk binnen onze Engineering Group zo interessant. Je werkt samen met gedreven specialisten die hun kennis willen inzetten voor iets dat groter is dan alleen het product: het vergroten van onze kennis over het heelal. Binnen de Engineering Group ontwikkelen, bouwen en testen we hightech mechanica en elektronica voor innovatieve wetenschappelijke instrumenten. We werken in kleine, dynamische teams waarin verschillende technische disciplines nauw samenwerken. Als constructeur word je onderdeel van het team binnen de Sectie Mechanica. Vanuit dit team werk je mee aan verschillende projecten die op dat moment binnen SRON worden uitgevoerd. Dat kunnen interne projecten zijn, maar ook projecten binnen internationale samenwerkingsverbanden met collega-instituten en hightech industriële partners. De projecten variëren sterk in omvang en looptijd: van enkele maanden tot projecten die zich over bijna twee decennia uitstrekken. Die variatie zorgt ervoor dat je steeds met nieuwe technische uitdagingen en samenwerkingspartners te maken krijgt. Bij het verdelen van projecten kijken we niet alleen naar wat er nodig is, maar ook naar jouw kennis, interesses en ambities. We vinden het belangrijk dat je werk aansluit bij jouw ontwikkeling en groeipad. Je krijgt veel ruimte om …

Are you passionate about clinical microbiology and eager to contribute to the development and qualification of diagnostic solutions used in laboratories worldwide? You will also have opportunities to work with laboratory automation technologies and stay at the forefront of developments within the field. Prepare study protocols, technical documentation, and reports, ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained when required. Support validation studies and product performance evaluations within a clinical microbiology setting. Collaborate with research, development, and cross-functional teams on project activities and platform support. Maintain awareness of scientific and technological developments relevant to microbiology and diagnostic testing. Occasionally provide support at customer sites and assist with product-related investigations when required. Job Description The Systems Verification and Validation (V&V) Engineer plays a pivotal role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of complex systems through structured testing and validation processes. This position focuses on translating identified risks into actionable test strategies, creating detailed test plans, and driving defect resolution in collaboration with cross-functional teams. By leveraging both manual and automated testing approaches, the engineer ensures that system functionality and performance meet stringent requirements throughout the development lifecycle. In addition to executing comprehensive test cases, the role emphasizes efficiency and scalability through the development and maintenance of automated test solutions using industry-standard tools. Responsibilities include conducting risk and impact assessments, organizing defect review meetings, and maintaining a robust test environment that mirrors real-world conditions. Through meticulous documentation and proactive communication, the Systems V&V Engineer provides clear visibility into test progress and outcomes, ultimately safeguarding system integrity and user confidence. Main responsibilities will include: Participate in risk and impact assessments to identify potential system vulnerabilities. Translate identified risks into a comprehensive and executable test strategy. Estimate and plan verification and validation activities across the development lifecycle. Specify detailed and traceable test cases based on system requirements and risk analysis. Implement manual and automated test cases to verify system functionality and performance. Document test results, findings, and defects in a clear and structured manner. Develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve test efficiency and coverage. Organize and lead defect review meetings with relevant team members. Provide timely updates on test progress, defect status, and overall V&V activities. Define and maintain the test environment, ensuring it reflects the intended use conditions. About you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience, will also be accepted. Certified in ISTQB (preferably beyond Foundation level) or TMap Several years of experience working in SAFe, Scrum and/or Agile environments Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written) Shown experience in system-level testing, preferably in a regulated or high-tech environment. Experience with ISO 13485 or similar standards is a plus Familiarity with risk-based testing methodologies and test automation tools Experience with test management and defect tracking tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Detailed and focused approach. Proactive and structured approach to planning and execution. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You Should Apply If: You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching …

From autonomous cars to to solutions against wildfires, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. What you'll be working on as a Connectivity Design Engineer Are you excited to design connectivity solutions for some of the world's most advanced high-tech systems? Do you enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and solving complex engineering challenges? As a Connectivity Design Engineer through Capgemini Engineering at ASML, you will contribute to the development of next-generation lithography machines within the EUV and DUV programs. You will design and realize electrical connectivity solutions that enable reliable power and signal distribution across complex systems, including cabling, connection modules, racks, and related infrastructure. Working in a multidisciplinary environment, you will help deliver the technologies that enable semiconductor manufacturers worldwide to produce increasingly advanced chips. Responsibilities Operate in a multidisciplinary team and interface with multiple projects to realize own work Manage the electrical interfaces between the modules in the product (in modules) Implement engineering changes into products Investigate and solve issues on the electrical connectivity Design, specify and validate various electrical connectivity parts that meet the international standards on electrical safety and EMC, by documenting. items.desc: Job Description: Mars is delivering a global Product Lifecycle Management transformation program (cPLM) to replace our existing process and system used to capture and evolve knowledge about our products. This role serves as the critical functional bridge between global External Manufacturing team and the cPLM team, securing the foundational data integrity of external manufacturing recipes before and during all FN site deployments. By driving hands-on system validation, enforcing data compliance standards, and directly enabling EMs, this position ensures that our external manufacturing recipes are digitized accurately and compliantly. In this role, you will work closely with the Food Nutrition (FN) Scope Lead, the FN SMEs and FN cPLM leadership team. You will also occasionally need to collaborate with Enterprise POs, Corporate DT and other segment scope Leads. You will also need to engage with external partners including Co-Manufacturers, Co-Packers, and Supplier teams to ensure seamless deployment and capability building. This is a project-role for the Food cPLM program. The role is funded through June 2028. As we approach the funding end date, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including pilot and deployment. Based country: UK or Netherlands External Manufacturing Discovery Support External Manufacturing Discovery Scoping: Participate in discovery workshops with External Manufacturing, Commercial, Product Development and other functions. Capture, consolidate and translate requirements from FN and share with the enterprise team. Provide Day-to-Day Functional Suppor: Act as the primary functional point of contact for External Manufacturing, Commercial leads, and external supplier technical contacts to troubleshoot process, system or data issues. Triage Issue Resolution: Rapidly diagnose and categorize user inquiries from external and internal co-manufacturing stakeholders, resolving functionalhow-to questions and partnering with technical teams for bug resolution. Coordinate External Deployment Readiness: Drive EM site specific deployment checklists, ensuring external partners and internal co-man data teams complete legacy data cleansing, access setup, and onboarding activities prior to go-live. .External Manufacturing Data Quality, Governance Compliance Audit External Manufacturing Legacy Data Readiness: Conduct rigorous audits on legacy external manufacturing specifications, recipe structures, and packaging records, identifying missing, obsolete, or non-compliant attributes prior to cPLM migration. Remediate Data Gaps Enrich External Specs: Directly assist internal external-manufacturing teams and external suppliers in gathering missing technical parameters, filling data gaps, and enriching specification records for seamless ingestion. Enforce Global Standardization Governance: Partner with global data stewards to enforce strict naming, classification, and taxonomy rules across all external supplier records, proactively identifying unauthorized workarounds or process deviations. Testing and Continuous Improvement Validate External Bill of Materials (BOM) Specifications: Build, configure, and validate raw material, recipe, packaging, and trade item specifications for external manufacturing streams in test environments to verify accurate data flows. Execute End-to-End Testing (UAT) for External Scenarios: Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by following test scripts, logging defects, and providing feedback on system KPIs. Support FN Pilot and Future Deployments: Support the initial pilot deployment and subsequent Food Nutrition site deployments by establishing reusable templates, checklists, and gathering learning for continuous improvement. Drive Process Interface Optimizations – long term: Analyze support ticket trends, supplier onboarding bottlenecks, and partner feedback to propose proactive improvements to external data exchange templates, workflows, and guidelines. External Partner Enablement, Support Community Engagement Design Deliver Targeted Partner Training: Partner with enterprise change and training leads to create and deliver role-based training, interactive demos, and step-by-step guides for external partners and internal co-man teams. Lead On-Site and/or Virtual Hypercare for External Go-Lives: Act as the dedicated hypercare lead during external manufacturing deployment waves, working shoulder-to-shoulder with our technical teams to resolve any issues. Prepare Stakeholder Communications: Translate deployment milestones, system release updates, and risk escalations into concise, impact-oriented summaries for External Manufacturing and RD leadership. . As the program evolves, your responsibilities may need to shift to support the team where needed most.

items.desc: Ready to scale your career in a high-growth scale up where your results drive real world change? We’re Sensorfact , Europe’s #1 smart monitoring platform for the industry , on a mission to make industry smarter, cleaner, and more efficient. Every day, our technology helps thousands of manufacturers cut energy waste, reduce costs, and lower carbon emissions through intelligent data insights and automation. Today, we’ve joined forces with ABB, a global leader in electrification and automation. This partnership has propelled us onto the world stage, enabling us to expand rapidly and help more businesses optimize their energy efficiency, cut costs, and make a positive impact on the planet. Apply today and help shape a smarter and more sustainable industry. As an analytics engineer you build, scale and optimize data pipelines your colleagues use every day to make data-driven decisions. You design pipelines that extract, load, transform and monitor data from both internal and external sources in a way that’s easy to draw conclusions from. In this role you will build a deep understanding of the drivers of Sensorfact and how we work, because you can’t model a business you don’t understand! You’ll work closely together with stakeholders to understand the questions being asked, spotting the gaps in our data and figure out together what would genuinely help About the team You join a small analytics team, working closely with stakeholders, data engineers and data analysts and data scientists, picking up projects independently. That means you are able to make judgement calls about what to build properly and what to build quickly, and being comfortable making these decisions. We work in 2 week sprints with planning, retrospectives and daily standups. We keep track of things in Linear, Miro, Google Drive and Outline and stay in touch with each other over Slack. We work from home about 60% of the time and enjoy meeting each other in the office in Utrecht or Amsterdam on a regular basis. items.desc: We’re building the next generation of Schibsted’s media products Schibsted’s product ambition is to reinvent our media destinations for the AI era to make our journalism a relevant daily habit for more people. Most of that work happens in our existing product organisation, where we continuously improve and reinvent products used by millions of people every day. But some opportunities require something different: more freedom from today’s products and business models, longer horizons, greater uncertainty and permission to challenge the core. That's why we're setting up Schibsted Product Lab . Product Lab is a small, autonomous product environment that builds, launches and tests the next generation of Schibsted’s media products with real users. We start small, increase investment as evidence grows, stop ideas that do not prove themselves, and help successful products become part of, or reshape, Schibsted’s core. We are now looking for an Editorial Developer to join the Product Lab core team! How we want to work Our ambition is to make Product Lab an AI-enabled, high-velocity product environment where we can move from idea to execution at high speed. We want to push the boundaries of how emerging technologies can transform the way we discover, design and build products, equipping small teams with the tools and capabilities to turn ambitious ideas into real user experiences in days rather than months. We embrace experimentation, challenge established ways of working and prioritise learning over perfection. And we see the ability to confidently stop an idea that doesn't work as just as important as knowing when to invest further. The role and mission As Editorial Developer in Product Lab, you will work at the intersection of journalism, technology, product and design to explore what the next generation of media destinations could look like. You will combine deep editorial understanding with technical curiosity and hands-on experimentation, turning emerging technologies, changing user behaviours and new ideas into concrete editorial experiences. This is a role tasked with challenging assumptions about how journalism works, exploring entirely new ways of bringing journalistic value to people, and making those possibilities real enough to test. You will be part of Product Lab's small permanent core team, working across early-stage initiatives alongside product managers, designers, engineers and colleagues from Schibsted's editorial organisations. What you will do Identify new editorial opportunities, exploring how emerging technologies and changing user behaviours could transform how journalism is created, distributed and experienced. Develop, prototype and test new editorial concepts, working hands-on with Product, UX and Tech to turn ideas into tangible experiments with real users. Define the editorial logic of new products, including what information they provide, how it is selected, produced or transformed, and how humans and AI systems collaborate. Shape editorial quality and principles, navigating questions of accuracy, trust, transparency, accountability and editorial independence in new product concepts. Assess editorial and operational feasibility, identifying the capabilities, workflows, resources and organisational changes needed to bring promising concepts to life. Connect Product Lab with Schibsted's editorial environments, bringing relevant newsroom expertise into initiatives and helping promising concepts find pathways into existing brands and organisations. Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who combines strong journalistic understanding, technical fluency and a genuine drive to build what comes next. You might come from editorial development, digital journalism, newsroom innovation, interactive storytelling, editorial product development or a related field. Your exact background matters less than your ability to move between journalistic ideas, technological possibilities and practical experimentation. You are equally comfortable discussing editorial principles with an editor, exploring technical possibilities with a developer and making something tangible enough to test with users. We believe you need to bring: Deep understanding of journalism and editorial environments, including hands-on experience with editorial decision-making, journalistic methods and newsroom workflows. Experience developing and testing digital editorial products, formats or experiences, with a user-oriented approach to turning ideas into tangible solutions and learning from feedback. Technical fluency and hands-on prototyping skills, with the ability to independently build, configure or experiment with digital solutions using code, AI tools, low-code platforms or other relevant technologies. Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies, combined with curiosity about how they could reshape journalism, editorial workflows and audience experiences. Experience working across editorial, product and …

items.desc: Location: Oslo, Norway Business: Group Position type: Full Time Contract type: Permanent Employee Job ID: 7828 Overview About us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About the role Group Research and Development (GRD) performs strategic and applied research to develop the knowledge, methods and technologies required for DNV’s future assurance services. The Energy Security and Resilience research programme focuses on assurance of critical energy infrastructure by developing practical and transparent methods for assessing security risk, vulnerabilities, system dependencies and resilience. The programme combines energy-system knowledge with security research, risk analysis, data science and societal perspectives, and validates new approaches through case studies, prototypes and collaboration with industry, authorities and academia. Are you interested in how geopolitical developments, threat actors and vulnerabilities may affect critical energy infrastructure, and in developing practical methods and tools for threat-informed risk assessment? As a Researcher in energy security, you will develop methods and tools for establishing a relevant and traceable threat picture for critical energy infrastructure. A central part of the role is to use AI-supported methods to collect, evaluate and synthesise open-source information from multiple sources into descriptions of threat actors, capabilities, intent, possible targets and attack vectors . The resulting threat picture shall provide a documented basis for assessing risk and for identifying proportionate protective security and resilience measures. The research will contribute to future DNV assurance services for energy security and resilience. Your main responsibilities include: Develop repeatable and traceable methods supported by AI to collect, classify, evaluate and consolidate open-source threat information relevant to critical energy infrastructure Establish threat pictures that describe relevant threat actors, capabilities, intent, possible targets, attack vectors and plausible scenarios Translate the threat picture into input for security risk assessments, vulnerability assessments and decisions on protective security and resilience measures Develop methods for identifying physical, digital, operational and organisational vulnerabilities in the energy systems. Du sørger for at arbeidet flyter, at folk vet hva de skal gjøre og at nødvendige materialer, tegninger og avklaringer er på plass. Du samarbeider tett med anleggsleder og får et tydelig ansvar for gjennomføringen innenfor ditt område. Dine viktigste oppgaver blir å: Lede og følge opp den daglige produksjonen på byggeplassen. Fange opp utfordringer tidlig og bidra med praktiske løsninger sammen med anleggsleder. Arbeidsstedet er ute i prosjektene, hovedsakelig i området fra Jessheim til Drammen. Er du klar for mer ansvar på byggeplassen? Vi ser etter deg som har god praktisk erfaring fra byggeplass og som trives med å få mennesker og produksjon til å fungere godt sammen. Du kan allerede jobbe som formann, bas eller arbeidsleder, eller være en erfaren fagarbeider som er klar for neste steg. items.desc: Responsibilities Societe Generale Global Solution Center Poland is a new and growing area of the SG Warsaw Branch. Within the Global Banking and Advisory business unit (GLBA), the Business Transformation Office (BTO) supports the strategy, development and transformation of the business while maintaining a solid and secure operating framework. As part of the business rather than the IT department, the team combines strong IT expertise with a strong interest in functional topics. The successful candidate will manage the full development lifecycle of applications dedicated to business users, including needs analysis, development, user support, training and technical advisory. The initial mission will focus on taking over existing applications, understanding their functional and technical scope, identifying improvement opportunities, organizing support, reviewing backlogs with product owners and delivering enhancements. During your VIE, your main mission will be: Collaborate with business users and stakeholders to understand and analyze their needs and translate them into functional applications that improve operational efficiency and user experience. Design, develop, test, debug and maintain high-quality software applications, APIs and tools throughout the software development lifecycle. Take over existing applications by learning their functional and technical scope, identifying improvement areas, performing root-cause analysis, organizing support and delivering backlog enhancements with product owners. Produce clear technical documentation and reporting, and provide technical advice, user support and training. Apply sound database design, risk awareness and attention to detail to deliver robust, secure and reliable solutions. Stay current with industry trends and advances in data engineering and rapid prototyping, including BI, low-code and no-code solutions. Promote data-driven approaches and innovation among business users while collaborating effectively across teams. A questionnaire will be provided to you in order to check your VIE (Société Générale and Business France) eligibility. For an efficient analysis of your application, please make sure to truthfully answer all the questions. Please note that it is mandatory to provide us a formal proof of your M2 diploma validation before the assignment start date. No VIE mission will start without this document. *Grade sheets are not accepted as justification of diploma. Profile required PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship. To facilitate the examination of your application by our English-speaking managers, we thank you for applying in English. Studies & experience: Graduate with a Master's degree from an engineering school, business school or university, preferably with a specialization in software development, computer science, data engineering or a related field At least five years of software development experience, including practical experience as a Python developer Language skills: Fluent in English Technical, operational & Soft skills: Proficiency in Python and experience with web frameworks such as Django or Flask. Experience designing REST APIs and working with OAuth 2.0 authentication. Knowledge of PostgreSQL, object-relational mapping (ORM), and database design and management. Knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Tomcat is appreciated. Familiarity with front-end technologies such as Angular or React. Proficiency in Excel and Power BI; experience with low-code or no-code solutions is appreciated. Knowledge of data engineering is essential; knowledge of data science is a plus. Autonomous, curious, rigorous and organized, with very strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving, testing and debugging, and time-management skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder-management and team-collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong interest in functional business topics, business analytics and user-interface design, with an understanding of Rapid Application Development, the software development lifecycle, project management, reporting and documentation, risk management and root-cause analysis. The VIE assignment in a nutshell This VIE in Warsaw is to begin as soon as possible, but you need to plan 3 months between your application date and the beginning of your VIE assignment. Doświadczenie w analizie i obsłudze podatności bezpieczeństwa w środowiskach chmurowych. Dobra znajomość zagadnień takich jak: IAM, network security, secrets management, vulnerability management, security posture management, hardening środowisk chmurowych. Security Hub, Inspector, GuardDuty, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Defender for Cloud). Znajomość GitHub Actions. Doświadczenie z Dockerem oraz podstawowa znajomość Kubernetes. Skrypty automatyzacyjne w Pythonie lub Bashu. items.desc: Company Description InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading out-of-home (OOH) e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska, InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants. InPost’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognised for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions. Job Description We’re looking for a Billing System Engineer who will help us develop and ensure the stability of our billing systems. In this role, you’ll work closely with the Comarch BSS platform, combining technical expertise with a good understanding of business processes. This is a role for someone who enjoys working in a complex system environment, likes getting to the root cause of issues, and wants to have a real impact on the reliability and further development of billing solutions. What will you work on? maintaining and configuring the Comarch BSS platform, particularly Product Catalog, Billing and Billing Mediation, monitoring platform performance, system jobs, error logs and runtime incidents, investigating data issues and identifying their root causes, monitoring system interfaces and integrations to ensure uninterrupted end-to-end data flows, supporting backup and recovery processes and solutions that strengthen system availability, configuring data connections and integrations and taking technical ownership after implementation, supporting audit controls, security requirements and compliance-related activities, following the BSS roadmap, running Proofs of Concept and maintaining technical documentation, contributing to platform upgrades, patches, new functionalities and technical issue resolution. Qualifications This cooperation may be a strong match if you: have at least three years of experience with Comarch BSS, particularly Product Catalog, Billing or Billing Mediation, use SQL for data analysis, record tracing and troubleshooting, have at least two years of experience with enterprise system integrations and integration tools, understand billing processes, including invoicing, rating and usage-based billing, are familiar with Oracle or PostgreSQL databases and Elasticsearch, have practical experience with Linux, REST API testing and Apache Kafka, communicate in English at B2 level or higher. Additional advantages: experience with enterprise systems such as CRM, ERP, data warehouses or event-streaming solutions, knowledge of Apache Cassandra, knowledge of Kubernetes, English proficiency at C1 level. Technology and AI in everyday work We are looking for someone who actively uses AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot. These tools may support log analysis, SQL query generation and optimisation, technical documentation and the initial diagnosis of system issues. Additional Information What we offer A real impact on the stability, development, and future direction of our billing solutions. The opportunity to work with complex, business-critical systems and solve challenges that matter to day-to-day operations. Space to bring your expertise, propose improvements, and take technical ownership of the solutions you work on. Collaboration with experts across technology and business areas in an international environment. Exposure to a broad technology landscape, including Comarch BSS, system integrations, databases, APIs, and event-driven solutions. Opportunities to explore new technologies, run Proofs of Concept, and contribute to the further evolution of the billing platform. Full time contract of employment Thank you for your interest in this opportunity. We will contact only those candidates whose qualifications and experience best match the requirements of the position. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality

items.desc: About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance. We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution. About the Role We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. This is an analytics-driven, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in Google Search Console, GA4, and the browser dev tools as in a keyword report. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. In practice, the role covers part of what product marketing would otherwise do. What You Will Do Technical SEO and GEO Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data and schema, rendering, redirects, internal linking, and site architecture. Optimize the site for AI search (generative engine optimization): make Improvado understandable, citable, and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar engines. Monitor visibility in both classic and AI search, and turn the findings into prioritized fixes. Website optimization and conversion Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages). Plan and run experiments (A/B tests, template and layout changes, messaging tests) and measure their impact on conversions and pipeline. Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking). Analytics and measurement Build and maintain dashboards that connect organic and on-site behavior to leads, pipeline, and revenue. Own tracking quality: events, attribution, and data accuracy across GA4, Search Console, and related tools. Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form. Product and messaging input Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy. Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions. What We Are Looking For Must have 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion. Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered. Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast. Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, or a clear, demonstrable track record of working on it. Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data. Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents). Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team. Nice to have B2B SaaS or marketing technology background. Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript. SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows. Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms. Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging. You are Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes. Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision. A clear communicator across time zones. What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement HAVkWB50SQ

items.desc: TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions. As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US. Requirements: Must have End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch. Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests. English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions. Nice to have Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation. EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness. Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards. Brand: TripleTen What you will do: Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on. Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off. Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive. Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers. Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed. Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done. Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend. What we can offer you: Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage. Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.
