items.desc: You will join our Post-Trade Program and work with the newly established Post-Trade Harmonization Initiative. The program addresses post-trade harmonization requirements and develops future-ready solutions that support our member banks in making informed decisions and remaining compliant. The QA engineer role offers the opportunity to help secure post-trade harmonization for our member banks. You will join a dedicated team with colleagues in Denmark and Poland. Primary tasks and responsibilities include: Drive testing and quality within the team by establishing a clear testing vision and strategy and supporting its implementation. Begin with a strong focus on manual testing and gradually contribute to test automation, moving towards a balanced mix of manual and automated testing, with approximately 30-50% automation over time. Collaborate closely with team members and BEC's QA service team to adopt best practices, streamline testing processes and initiate automation activities. To succeed you will have: Ability to analyse complex end-to-end flows across integrated systems, select an appropriate testing approach, manage defects end to end, advocate for quality across the software development life cycle and communicate quality risks and results to technical and business stakeholders. Solid understanding of key non-functional testing types, including performance, reliability and security testing, and the ability to identify when they should be applied based on system context and risk. Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Xray or similar, as well as practical experience with API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI or Bruno, including validation of request and response structures and error handling. Ability to work with message queues, including IBM MQ, understand message flows, validate XML and JSON payloads, interpret XSD and JSON Schema, and test data structures and variations in message-based integrations. Experience with Playwright is preferred; experience with Cypress or a similar automation tool is also relevant. Familiarity with TypeScript and Java is desirable, although experience with other programming languages is acceptable. Ability to analyse application and system logs to support defect investigation, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, together with a willingness to learn and apply AI-based tools to improve testing effectiveness and support test automation. A self-motivated and structured approach, strong communication skills, the ability to organise and drive the testing agenda, and experience helping teams clarify requirements towards an acceptance test-driven development (ATDD) setup. ISTQB Foundation certification is required. It's nice-to-have: Familiarity with investment products, the trade life cycle and settlement processes. Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and processes, including basic integration of testing into CI/CD pipelines. Be your best self with BEC's benefits! We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them. Mental health support Free lunch at the office Professional development budget Referral bonus up to PLN 10,000 PLN 600 on a benefit platform a month Passion clubs and social events (tennis, salsa dancing, board games, family picnics and more) What does the recruitment process look like? Send us your CV: We want to get to know you Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match Technical test: Show off your knowledge! Meet our talent partner and technical expert: Learn more about the job, BEC Poland, and tell us more about your skills and experience. Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with. Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC! If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner at Robert.piec@bec.dk BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

You will play an important role in ensuring our integration services remain reliable while identifying opportunities to improve performance, automation and development standards. Solution Design: Translate business and technical requirements into integration solutions, including data mapping, transformation, routing and connectivity. Technical Support: Monitor integration performance, troubleshoot incidents, identify root causes and implement effective solutions. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. items.desc: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful. Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build. That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level. This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow. If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you. About This Role As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow. Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work. What You'll Own Training Program Design and Delivery Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes. Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience. Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials. Measuring and Improving Training Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences. Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team. Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement. Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed. Staying Close to Support Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows. Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires. Role Requirements Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment. Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function. Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development. Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates. Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time. Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists. Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty. Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth. Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels. You Should Apply If: You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics. You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging. You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance. You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes. You love coaching …

Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials. items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Development Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48363 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Tasks You design and operate the one or the other sovereign cloud services with focus on pure excellence. You ensure the reliability, performance, and fault tolerance of the messaging infrastructure by implementing robust disaster recovery and failover strategies and tune operating system configurations for low-latency delivery. You are on the forefront of setting standards which allow our Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to be continuously met, ensuring system stability. You define best practices for application developers and build a self-service platform that makes it easy for internal teams to independently configure their integrations. You conduct regular Chaos Engineering tests and incident response simulations to detect vulnerabilities early and guarantee resilient production services. You lead structured post-mortems and root cause analyses for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective measures. Your Profile You have a strong passion for Site Reliability Engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and full automation. You bring solid experience with Go, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and automating production environments. You are familiar with SRE concepts such as Error Budgets, SLAs/SLOs/SLIs, and Chaos Engineering methods. You understand the operational requirements of complex platform services (i.e. PubSub, KMS, Secrets Manager, DNS, MailOut) and know how to make them highly available and reliable. You enjoy exploring new technologies (e.g., OpenTelemetry) and enthusiastically share your knowledge with the community and team. You look beyond dashboards to understand the underlying data structures and how to optimize them for high-cardinality environments.

items.desc: Join our Team About the Opportunity Help build and run the network infrastructure that enables Ericsson’s R&D teams to develop and test what’s next. As part of the Network Evolution Unit, you’ll work across network and lab environments to deploy and operate reliable infrastructure. This is an infrastructure-led DevOps role: you’ll use software, automation and secure ways of working to improve services throughout their lifecycle. This is an opportunity for a curious, hands-on problem solver. Recent graduates and candidates with up to around five years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. DevOps candidates are welcome: you don’t need to be a security specialist, but you should care about building and operating services securely. What you’ll do Investigate issues in dedicated lab and network environments, find root causes and help resolve service requests and reported problems. Install, configure, upgrade and deploy network systems and services, supporting a reliable, business-like lab environment. Develop and improve automation to reduce manual tasks and make operations more consistent. Support both new and existing services, including maintaining and adapting configurations created by others. Help monitor service health, communicate performance, changes and risks, and contribute to timely incident resolution and escalation. Work with stakeholders and third-party vendors to support deployments and improve the services delivered to users. Apply security and compliance practices throughout development and operations, and contribute to reliable, well-documented ways of working. What you’ll bring A degree or relevant coursework in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical knowledge. A foundation or strong interest in IP networking, network topologies, data-centre infrastructure and network services. Relevant coursework, projects or hands-on experience are valuable. Some experience through work, studies, projects or internships in network or systems infrastructure, operations, or DevOps and software development. Early-career applicants are very welcome. A willingness to code and automate. Python is used frequently; experience with Bash, Java, scripting or other programming languages is useful. Familiarity with Linux or Unix, troubleshooting, and APIs such as REST. A security-aware mindset, collaborative approach, and clear communication skills. Experience with cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, microservices, Spring Boot, SQL or agile methods is beneficial. You don’t need to know every technology listed; curiosity and the ability to learn matter. Network infrastructure is at the heart of this role. You’ll combine infrastructure knowledge with development and operations, using automation to improve delivery while helping maintain service availability and resolve issues. Security is built into the work, not a separate specialty. Security clearance, references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates. What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. About the Role We are now looking for a Project Delivery Specialist to join our team in Sweden, with a focus on implementing Tandem across municipal healthcare and social care organisations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end implementation journey, from the moment a municipality partners with Tandem to the point where our product is fully integrated into its workflows and social workers and healthcare professionals are confidently using it in their day-to-day work. You will work closely with municipal stakeholders, social workers, healthcare teams, and our internal Engineering and Medical Operations teams to ensure successful implementations across both social services and municipal healthcare. This includes coordinating technical integrations, adapting workflows to local needs, and supporting the adoption of new ways of working across municipal healthcare and social care organisations. What You Will Do Lead implementation projects end to end , ensuring customers move smoothly from project kick-off to go-live, with clear plans, timelines, responsibilities, and deliverables. Coordinate stakeholders across municipal healthcare and social care organisations , working with project leads, managers, IT teams, and frontline clinicians and social workers to align expectations and maintain momentum throughout implementation. Coordinate technical setup and integrations , including EHR integrations, working closely with our Engineering team and customer IT stakeholders to ensure technical readiness. Adapt workflows to municipal settings , collaborating with customers and our Delivery and Medical Operations team to configure documentation templates and workflows that reflect local needs and ways of working. Plan and coordinate user training , ensuring healthcare professionals and social workers across relevant teams across social services and municipal healthcare are prepared and confident ahead of go-live. Drive adoption and change management , supporting customers as they introduce Tandem into existing routines, address user feedback, and establish sustainable ways of working. Act as the primary point of contact during implementation , building trusted relationships with customers, maintaining clear communication, and ensuring stakeholders know what needs to happen next. Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and blockers across technical and operational workstreams, escalating issues where needed to keep implementations on track. Support successful transitions into ongoing use , ensuring customers are ready for go-live and that implementation outcomes translate into meaningful value for healthcare professionals and social workers. Continuously improve our delivery playbook , capturing learnings from municipal implementations and developing scalable processes as Tandem expands across Sweden’s municipal sector. What You Bring A strong track record in project management, ideally delivering technology solutions within healthcare, social care, or the public sector. Experience working in a technology company, with particular value placed on SaaS implementation or software deployment projects. Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders in complex organisations, ideally involving municipalities, public-sector customers, or decentralised healthcare environments. Familiarity with healthcare and/or social care IT environments, including EHR integrations, workflows, and change management within social care and municipal healthcare. An understanding of the realities of municipal healthcare and social care, where successful implementation requires alignment between operational leadership, IT teams, and frontline professionals. A structured yet flexible approach: you run a tight project plan, anticipate dependencies, and adapt quickly when circumstances shift. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively with everyone from frontline professionals to senior decision-makers. Genuine curiosity about technology and AI. Deep technical expertise is not required, but you understand how modern software products are implemented and adopted. An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced, scaling environment, where you can take ownership and help shape how we deliver to customers. items.desc: Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services. More and more of our network runs on open source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you. About the job As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed. Your day-to-day work may include: Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office. About you You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions. Key skills and experience we’re looking for: Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec) Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash) Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries Good to have: Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.) Join us at Telavox Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect. Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication. We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture. Read more about our new HQ in Malmö ! How to apply! At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are. We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English. Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email. For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com Learn more about what we do! ️

What You Bring A strong track record in project management, ideally delivering technology solutions or complex multi-stakeholder projects within healthcare settings. Excellent stakeholder management — you're comfortable engaging with everyone from frontline clinicians to C-level decision-makers. Familiarity with healthcare IT environments — EHR integrations, clinical workflows, and change management in care organisations. Genuine curiosity about technology and AI — deep technical expertise is not required, but you understand how modern software products are delivered. An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced, scaling environment. Excellent communication skills in English. Bonus Experience in management consulting or a similar high-paced, client-facing environment, where you’ve had to get up to speed on a new organisation and deliver results under pressure. Additional languages relevant to our growth markets. Experience in a startup or scale-up, or in setting up delivery processes from scratch. Location We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with the Hiring Manager Follow-up interviews and tasks with members of the team and the Director of Global Expansion Working Day — Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

items.desc: At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Could you be the Requirements Management Engineer (RME) in Stockholm or Västerås we’re looking for? Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your Requirement Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. The Nordic Technology Center of Alstom is an internal development and supplier organization for train onboard signaling; train control and communication system. The organization is global with sites in Sweden, Germany, Switzerland, France, and India. The team in Stockholm and Västerås is responsible for computers legacy control and communication products as well as new, input and output products, and human machine interface products. We are now investing in new products with increased performance, cyber security protection and increased functionality. As Requirements Management Engineer (RME) you shall be a key user for requirement tools , manage requirement structure and support multiple programs by providing guidelines, coaching and training team members for the management and writing requirements. You will collaborate daily with the Program Development Managers, System Architects and engineering teams. We will look to you for: Implement Requirement Management processes for product development Administrate and be key user for Requirement Management tool Drive the engineers in their requirements development activities Verify the data quality & consistency in the Requirement Management database Manage the requirements changes & configuration Be the first line contact for Requirement Management queries All about you We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: Master’s degree in engineering like System Engineering, Electronic Engineering or similar. Previous working experience (3-5 years) as requirement manager, requirement engineer (Doors and Doors NG). Previous working experience with DevOps (CI/CD) Previous working experience in international teams Previous working experience in configuration and change management. Experience in the development of embedded software and hardware. It would be highly appreciated if you have knowledge and or experience of industrial or railway safety standards (IEC61508/EN50128/EN60567/EN50129). Fluent in English. Swedish is an advantage. Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines. Work with newest train control systems Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues Contribute to innovative projects Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Important to note As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

items.desc: Vill du använda film, berättande och möten med människor för att göra kunskap användbar för svensk animalieproduktion? Trivs du lika bra ute på en gård som framför redigeringsdatorn? Då kan det här vara en tjänst för dig! Om Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion Kunskapsnav Animalieproduktion arbetar för att stärka produktivitet, lönsamhet och konkurrenskraft inom svensk animalieproduktion. Inom enheten är vi 16 medarbetare med bred och kompletterande kompetens inom bland annat kommunikation, animalieproduktion, veterinärmedicin och företagsekonomi. Genom att sammanställa, tillgängliggöra och sprida relevant kunskap till lantbrukare och rådgivare bidrar vi till en robust och konkurrenskraftig svensk livsmedelsproduktion. Du blir en del av en innovativ miljö där vi ständigt utvecklar nya sätt att göra kunskap tillgänglig och användbar för Sveriges lantbrukare . Om rollen Vi söker en innehållsproducent som vill vara ute där det händer. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att besöka lantbruk, träffa djurägare och rådgivare, fånga erfarenheter från vardagen och omvandla dem till filmer och annat innehåll som inspirerar och skapar nytta för branschen. Hos oss får du kombinera kreativt innehållsskapande med ett genuint intresse för människor, praktiskt lantbruk och kunskapsutveckling. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Planera, filma och redigera kunskapsfilmer. Genomföra intervjuer och dokumentera praktiska exempel. Skapa innehåll för webb, sociala medier och digitala utbildningar. Producera fotografier, presentationer, infografik och kortare texter. Medverka vid mässor och andra branschevenemang. Bidra till utvecklingen av nya kunskapsprojekt och digitala format. Placering är Lund eller Uppsala. Vi utgår idag från ett hybridarbetssätt där det går att dela sin arbetstid mellan kontoret och hemarbetsplatsen. Resor är en naturlig del av rollen och förekommer regelbundet. Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen är du nyfiken, kreativ och självgående. Du tycker om att möta människor och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du ser berättelser och kunskap i människors vardag och kan omsätta det till innehåll som engagerar och skapar nytta. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för hela produktionen och trivs med att växla mellan självständigt arbete och nära samarbete med andra. Krav för rollen: Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom film, journalistik, media, kommunikation eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av filmproduktion, från planering och intervju till redigering och publicering. Goda kunskaper i Adobe Premiere Pro eller motsvarande redigeringsverktyg. Erfarenhet av fotografering, ljudinspelning och produktion för digitala kanaler. Kunskap och erfarenhet inom lantbruk, animalieproduktion eller andra gröna näringar. God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. B-körkort och möjlighet att resa regelbundet i tjänsten. Meriterande: Erfarenhet av journalistiskt arbete, intervjuteknik eller reportageproduktion. Erfarenhet av kunskapsförmedling, utbildningsproduktion eller forskningskommunikation. Erfarenhet av tillgänglighetsanpassning och textning av digitalt innehåll. Kunskaper i ytterligare verktyg inom Adobe Creative Cloud. Erfarenhet av webbpublicering, livesändningar, webbinarier eller AI-baserade produktionsverktyg. Är vi en bra match? Hos oss är du inte bara innehållsproducent. Du är också med och utvecklar framtidens kunskapsförmedling för svensk animalieproduktion. Du får stor frihet att testa nya idéer, utforska nya format och bidra till projekt som gör verklig skillnad för lantbrukare, rådgivare och andra aktörer i branschen. Arbetet är varierat, kreativt och utvecklande, med ena foten i den digitala världen och den andra ute på gårdar runt om i landet. Välkommen med din ansökan! Låter detta intressant och du vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta Kristina Yngwe, Enhetschef Kunskapsnav animalieproduktion, kristina.yngwe@ri.se. Sista ansökningsdag är 12 november. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under och efter ansökningsperioden. Sök utan personligt brev. Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, Saco, 010 228 41 22 och Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-5165161.

items.desc: Information Security Engineer - two positions 80%-100%, Lugano, fixed-term The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates the compute and data infrastructure behind much of Switzerland’s computational science, from climate and weather to materials and large-scale AI. We are now extending the flagship Alps to compute on sensitive data, including medical data and other regulated datasets, through a Secure Computing Environment built for partners whose data must stay inside a tightly controlled perimeter. For that work, trust is what we deliver. Project background We are building an ISO/IEC 27001-certified information security management system, first for the Secure Computing Environment and then across the whole centre. Our Management Board and Director have approved a lasting expansion of CSCS’s security capability, and we are growing the team that runs it, starting with two Information Security Engineers to strengthen our security operations. We have two positions to fill, both initially offered on a two-year contract. The preferred work location is Lugano , although Zürich may also be considered. These positions are funded through ETH Zurich's strategic HPCN-28 initiative, which supports the continued development of key institutional capabilities in line with ETH Zurich's strategic objectives. Following the initial contract period, the contracts may be extended and, subject to organisational needs and funding, could potentially become permanent over time. Job description As an Information Security Engineer, you will play a key role in protecting CSCS services, infrastructure and research environments. You will work closely with infrastructure, platform and application teams to strengthen CSCS’s security posture and keep its operating environment resilient and secure. Your responsibilities will include: Design, implement and continuously improve security controls across the infrastructure. Monitor, detect, investigate and respond to security incidents using SIEM platforms (e.g. Wazuh or equivalent) and other security tools, including on-call duties where applicable and subject to an agreed operational arrangement. Extend security monitoring to the Secure Computing Environment: onboard log sources, manage retention, and operate its circuit-breaker and audit trails. Conduct threat hunting and security investigations using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK. Lead and coordinate vulnerability management, including identification, prioritisation, remediation tracking and risk assessment. Secure containerised and Kubernetes-based environments, integrating security throughout the platform lifecycle. Develop and maintain security monitoring, detection and response capabilities, automating wherever it pays off. Collaborate with internal teams to prevent, identify and mitigate security risks. Promote a strong security culture through awareness initiatives, training sessions and engagement across the organisation and our user community. Profile Required Several years of hands-on experience in security operations or security engineering. Strong knowledge of security monitoring, threat detection, incident response and security investigations Experience with SIEM technologies (Wazuh or comparable platforms). Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and modern adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs). Proven experience with vulnerability management processes and tools. Experience securing Kubernetes and containerised environments. Solid Linux skills and fluency in scripting and automation (Python or similar; detection-as-code is a plus). Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive mindset, strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently. Fluent English. Nice to have Experience with threat intelligence platforms, processes and threat-informed defence. Knowledge of AI security, including risks, governance and controls for AI-based systems and workloads. Experience in research, academic, HPC or large-scale distributed computing environments. Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, GIAC GSEC/GCIA/GCIH, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist). You find “it works” mildly suspicious until you know why it works. items.desc: As a joint venture of the University of Basel and the University Hospitals Basel, the Department of Biomedicine (DBM) brings together basic and clinical scientists to advance the understanding of health and disease. We are home to more than 67 research groups and over 800 employees across six locations in the heart of Basel. Our collaborative and international environment fosters innovation, excellence, and impactful research. The Developmental Genetics led by Prof. Aimée Zuniga, is looking for a Research Assistant/Technician. Join our community and help shape the future of biomedicine. Your position The Research Assistant will join the Developmental Genetics Research Group, which investigates the signalling interactions and molecular mechanisms controlling embryonic development. Our research uses genetically engineered mouse models, mouse models of human diseases, and organoid systems to investigate the gene regulatory networks that control normal organ development and the alterations resulting in congenital disorders. We combine these experimental models with state-of-the-art genetic and molecular technologies, genome-wide approaches, and advanced 3D confocal imaging techniques. Your profile Applicants must have completed an apprenticeship as molecular biology research technician (Laborant:in) and/or hold a BSc/MSc in molecular biology and excellent skills in molecular biology. Prior expertise in using mouse models and/or transcriptome/analysis (immunofluorescence cells/frozen embryo sections, protein biochemistry etc) will be an asset for the position. Applicants with certification for animal experimentation (LTK1 or FELASA certification) and experience in using mouse models will be given preference. Good knowledge of (spoken) English is important as this is the working language. We offer you We offer a stimulating discovery research environment in an internationally renowned research team at the University of Basel. The group is located in one of the flagship Research Institutes at the Department of Biomedicine with state-of-the-art research facilities and excellent training and career development opportunities. For more information, please go to: https://www.devgenbasel.com/ The University of Basel is an equal opportunity employer that offers competitive salaries. Application Please submit a letter of motivation, CV, copies of the relevant diplomas, degrees and certifications, brief summary of research and technology expertise, and the names and email addresses of minimally two referees. The position is available from January 1, 2027 or as agreed. Apply

items.desc: Are you looking for an exciting new challenge in a place to take your career to the next level? Would you like to join a friendly, progressive, innovative team and play a part in the transformation of pathology services across South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw? Do you want to work in a fully UKAS-accredited, modern laboratory environment where you can make a difference? We are looking for a passionate HCPC Registered Biomedical Scientist who either has or is part way through completing their specialist portfolio to join our small, busy, friendly team on a fixed term 12 month contract. You will help maintain and develop the work of the Rotherham Histopathology department of delivering a high quality, efficient service. This would be an excellent opportunity for somebody hoping to progress with their specialist portfolio or gain new skills and experiences in a new Histology department. The Rotherham Histology department receives 30000 Histology, 1000 non-gynae cytology and 600 andrology samples a year. We undertake all routine histological processes including BMS specimen dissection, microtomy, special stains, immunohistochemistry, molecular diagnostics and andrology. The successful candidate will rotate across all areas of the laboratory and support the monitoring of quality indicators, supervising and training other staff and other quality management duties such as audit and documentation review. As a Biomedical Scientist the post holder will be expected to work within the professional standards expected as a registrant of the Health Professions Council (HCPC) and maintain a portfolio of evidence supporting Continuing Professional Development (CPD). The post holder will be responsible for scientific and technical service delivery within the Histopathology services section of the laboratory. Duties as a Specialist Biomedical Scientist will include performing a range of scientific procedures involving the processing of biomedical specimens to contribute to the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of diseases and investigation of pathological processes and will include undertaking of complex diagnostic tests and the interpretation of complex diagnostic tests to facilitate a diagnostic report to be produced. The post holder will be required to conform to agreed standard operational procedures, Health & Safety procedures, departmental and organisational policies and good laboratory practice. Within their work duties the post holder will be expected to comply with the standards as required of UKAS and other relevant professional and regulatory Bodies e.g. H.T.A. Please also note this vacancy is banded dependent upon applicants experience relevant to this post. The banding of the successful applicant/s will start at Band 5 unless applicants meet the necessary threshold of skills and experience required to start on Band 6. You will be working for an organisation which values and respects all its staff and the community it serves. The Trust is a leader in the NHS and research sectors and provides excellent benefits for its staff. This includes commitments to professional development but also many policies to support employees in balancing their personal and professional lives. STHFT operates with a budget of £1.2 bn, has a workforce of over 18,500 employees, covers five hospital sites, provides care from over forty community settings, and has an excellent reputation for research. As an organisation we value and respect our staff and the community we serve. We provide excellent staff benefits; this includes commitment to professional development but also many initiatives to support employees in balancing their personal and professional lives. The South Yorkshire and Bassetlaw Pathology Partnership are invested in training, developing, and supporting staff in all aspects including academic courses from certificates of achievement, registration, specialist and higher specialist IBMS portfolios, apprenticeships and leadership and management qualifications. We pride ourselves in enabling opportunity across all our sites to develop staff and provide a strong and sustained service for the future. This vacancy is advertised on a fixed term contract basis for the maximum period of twelve (12) months. Where there is potential, the secondment/fixed term contract may finish early, or in the first instance, the secondment/fixed term contract may be extended due to the internal/external secondment of the substantive post holder. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,500 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 28 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products. At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy. Are you ready to turn your scientific curiosity into a career that makes a real impact? Our Ignite Graduate Programme is a unique two-year development journey designed for ambitious graduates who want to accelerate their careers, build technical expertise, and develop the leadership capabilities needed to become the next generation of innovators at Synthomer. Working within our Research and Development function, you'll support real innovation projects that help solve customer challenges, develop new technologies, and create business value. Through a combination of hands-on project work, mentoring, training, and rotational placements, you'll gain the experience, confidence and commercial understanding needed to thrive in a technical or leadership career. Deliver experimental programmes and contribute to innovation projects that support business growth. Design, conduct and evaluate laboratory experiments. Analyse scientific and commercial data, draw conclusions and present recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to the development of new products, technologies, capabilities and intellectual property. Gain experience across multiple technical disciplines including synthesis, applications and analytical science. Work closely with both technical and commercial teams to understand how innovation creates value for customers. Develop a broad internal network across research, manufacturing, commercial and support functions. Participate in structured leadership development and mentoring programmes. Build confidence presenting ideas, influencing stakeholders and managing projects. Play an active role in maintaining a strong Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) culture. You'll thrive in this programme if you : Have recently completed, or are on track to complete, a degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, or a related scientific discipline . Enjoy analysing data and turning insights into practical solutions. Are passionate about research, innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills. Enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of people and functions. Can manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment. Are adaptable, resilient and open to new experiences. Have excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to safe working practices. Show leadership potential and the desire to make a positive impact. Have a good working knowledge of English. The Behaviours We Valu e We're looking for individuals who demonstrate: Curiosity - asking questions and challenging conventional thinking. Collaboration - building strong relationships and working effectively in teams. Adaptability - embracing change and learning from new experiences. Customer Focus - understanding how innovation creates value. Leadership Potential - taking ownership, showing initiative and driving improvement. Ready to Ignite Your Career? This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to contribute to meaningful innovation, learn from experienced scientists and business leaders, and accelerate your development within a global organisation. If you're ready to challenge yourself, grow your expertise and make your mark from day one, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: About us: Founded in 2015, B2C2 is a global leader for institutional liquidity within digital assets. We bring 24/7 365 days a year deep, reliable pricing for spot, futures, options, CFDs, and NDFs across all market conditions. Our growing team has deep expertise across pricing, structuring, risk, systems, and regulation. B2C2 bridges the gap between traditional financial and digital assets, and is relied upon by brokerages, exchanges, banks, fund managers, and other institutions to provide 24/7 liquidity. Headquartered in London, with global offices in Paris, Jersey City, Tokyo, Singapore, and Luxembourg, our fast-growing team has expertise in traditional financial and crypto markets. We pride ourselves on our company culture and ability to attract not only the top talent but the right people. If you are looking for a role in an exciting new industry, at a dynamic company please keep reading. About the role: We are seeking a highly specialised HFT System and Network Engineer to join our trading infrastructure team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our cutting-edge AWS environments and physical colocation facilities. You will be responsible for the end-to-end optimisation of our global trading stack: minimising tail latency, optimising cross-region connectivity, and automating the deployment of performance-tuned "bare metal" and cloud instances. This is a high-impact role where your optimisations directly translate to our competitive edge in execution speed across both CeFi and DeFi exchanges. Jobs to be Done: Low-latency Infrastructure Build: Architect and deploy HFT-grade stacks, focusing on low-latency connectivity to crypto exchanges and internal networking alike. Hybrid Cloud Optimisation: Manage the interplay between AWS servers and physical hardware in traditional colocation centers. System Performance Tuning: Implement deep-level Linux kernel optimisations to minimise jitter and improve performance Network Automation: Develop "Zero-Touch" deployment pipelines using Terraform and Ansible to ensure infrastructure is reproducible and error-free. Precision Monitoring: Instrument the network for microsecond-level visibility, tracking packet loss, jitter, and retransmissions. Connectivity Management: Coordinate with exchanges and providers to manage cross-connects, LOAs, and high-speed transit lines. Required Skills and experience: Low-Latency DNA: Proven experience in HFT or ultra-low latency environments where microseconds matter. Linux Mastery: Deep knowledge of system internals (CPU pinning, NUMA, kernel bypass) and performance profiling. Advanced Networking: Expert understanding of BGP, Multicast, and AWS networking. Automation-First Mindset: Proficiency in Python/Bash and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) to manage complex global deployments. Hardware Savvy: Comfort working with high-performance NICs, low-latency switches (Arista/Cisco), and physical data centre requirements. Execution-Driven: A clear, concise communicator who thrives in high-pressure environments and takes ownership of the entire infra lifecycle. What we offer: An amazing global culture, who are ambitious, innovative and fun while working with the highest levels of honesty and integrity. Two discretionary bonus awards a year. A range of benefits in line with local market practice. Regular fun events and activities, as well as Social Impact volunteering days. Manage Preferences Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles. SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems – we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages. Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work. What you’ll do Manage system(s) uptime across cloud-native (AWS, GCP) and hybrid architectures. Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meet security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK). Build CI/CD pipelines for build, test and deployment of application and cloud architecture patterns, using platform (Jenkins) and cloud-native toolchains. Build automated tooling to deploy service requests to push a change into production. Build runbooks that are comprehensive and detailed to manage detect, remediate and restore services. items.desc: As a Network & Connectivity Solution Architect reporting to the VP of Software Engineering, you'll play a critical role in designing and governing the end-to-end network and connectivity architectures that power the Calypso CapCloud platform — a cloud-native capital markets solution serving clients across global financial markets. You'll thrive in this position if you're technically deep, client-focused, and energized by solving complex connectivity challenges across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. You bring a global mindset, a passion for cloud networking and security, and the ability to translate complex architecture into clear, actionable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Lead the design of scalable, secure network and connectivity architectures for the CapCloud platform, spanning cloud-native, hybrid, and on-premises environments across AWS and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Serve as the primary technical advisor for customer connectivity and integration architecture, leading discovery workshops, design reviews, and onboarding engagements with clients and implementation partners. Define and maintain connectivity reference architectures, solution blueprints, and design standards — covering private connectivity, VPNs, APIs, load balancing, proxy architectures, and traffic management. Architect and govern enterprise PKI, TLS/mTLS, and Zero Trust networking solutions, ensuring compliance with X.509, RFC 5280, and PKIX standards. Lead adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using Terraform and cloud-native automation, standardizing connectivity deployment patterns and integrating networking into CI/CD pipelines. Required Qualifications Several years of experience in network architecture, cloud networking, or connectivity engineering, with hands-on expertise across AWS (preferred) and/or OCI environments. Proven ability to design end-to-end network solutions including VPC/VCN architectures, BGP/OSPF routing, VPN technologies (IPsec, FortiGate), and private connectivity services (AWS Direct Connect, OCI FastConnect, AWS PrivateLink). Strong experience with traffic management technologies including Layer 4/7 load balancers, HAProxy, Squid Proxy, SSL termination, and reverse proxy architectures. Demonstrated experience with Kubernetes networking, service mesh architectures (mTLS, East-West traffic), and API gateway standards (authentication, rate limiting, developer onboarding). Clear communicator with a track record of presenting architecture recommendations to both technical teams and senior stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Cloud networking certifications (e.g., AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, OCI Networking) or equivalent experience. Experience in capital markets, fintech, or regulated financial services environments. Familiarity with connectivity protocols used in financial markets, including FIX connectivity, IBM MQ, market data distribution, and third-party trading and clearing platforms. This position is based in London and offers a hybrid work environment with at least 3 days per week in-office, subject to change. items.desc: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. You will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better business decisions. This role combines business intelligence, advanced analytics and data storytelling. You will work closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges, use SQL and Python to explore and analyze data, and build scalable reporting and analytical solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Use Python and SQL for data manipulation, advanced analysis, automation and analytical modelling. Design and develop intuitive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI. Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences. Nice to Have Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure. Experience developing automated or scalable analytical solutions. Exposure to machine learning or predictive analytics. Degree or equivalent experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. All About You You are naturally curious and want to understand why something is happening, not simply report that it has happened. You enjoy working with complex data, testing hypotheses and finding patterns others might miss. You are comfortable moving between Python, SQL, Fabric and Power BI, but understand that technology is only part of the role. Most importantly, you can turn data into insight, understanding and action. This role serves as the critical functional bridge between global External Manufacturing team and the cPLM team, securing the foundational data integrity of external manufacturing recipes before and during all FN site deployments. By driving hands-on system validation, enforcing data compliance standards, and directly enabling EMs, this position ensures that our external manufacturing recipes are digitized accurately and compliantly. In this role, you will work closely with the Food Nutrition (FN) Scope Lead, the FN SMEs and FN cPLM leadership team. You will also occasionally need to collaborate with Enterprise POs, Corporate DT and other segment scope Leads. You will also need to engage with external partners including Co-Manufacturers, Co-Packers, and Supplier teams to ensure seamless deployment and capability building. This is a project-role for the Food cPLM program. The role is funded through June 2028. As we approach the funding end date, your manager will be in touch with additional information including funding for next phases, including pilot and deployment. Based country: UK or Netherlands External Manufacturing Discovery Support External Manufacturing Discovery Scoping: Participate in discovery workshops with External Manufacturing, Commercial, Product Development and other functions. Capture, consolidate and translate requirements from FN and share with the enterprise team. items.desc: Liberty Global | Europe Build a business from the ground up. Liberty Global is looking for an exceptional Chief Executive Officer to lead a new business currently being incubated within Liberty Global. This is not an established business looking for its next leader. It is a start-up. The proposition is being developed, the foundations are being built and we’re now looking for the CEO who can take it through launch, prove the model and build it into a successful, scalable business. You’ll have the backing, expertise and reach of Liberty Global, but you’ll need the mindset of a founder: comfortable starting with a blank sheet of paper, making decisions with incomplete information, building a team and operating model from the ground up, and staying close enough to the detail to make things happen. It’s a rare opportunity to combine the pace, ownership and ambiguity of a start-up with the backing of an established international business. The opportunity As CEO, you’ll have end-to-end accountability for taking the business from incubation through launch and into its next stage of growth. You will: Build the business : turn the proposition and strategic ambition into a clear business plan, operating model and organisation. Lead the launch : bring together product, technology, commercial and operational capabilities to successfully take the business to market. Prove and scale the model : use customer and commercial insight to validate the proposition, make smart choices and determine where to invest. Own commercial performance : take accountability for growth, financial performance, investment decisions and resource allocation. Create the organisation : recruit and lead a high-performing leadership team and build the capabilities the business needs as it grows. Build for scale : establish the systems, governance, disciplines and operating rhythms needed to move from start-up to scaled business. Develop opportunities for growth : identify new partnerships, markets and commercial opportunities as the business develops. Lead with pace and discipline : balance entrepreneurial thinking and rapid execution with strong governance, risk management and operational resilience. Engage at the highest level : work closely with Liberty Global leadership, venture sponsors, shareholders and strategic partners. Who we’re looking for We’re looking for a builder, not simply a custodian . Someone who has experienced the reality of creating and scaling something new: the ambiguity, pace, trade-offs and hands-on leadership that come with building a start-up. You’ll bring: Significant leadership experience within a digital, technology-enabled, fintech, marketplace or subscription business A strong track record of building, launching and/or scaling a start-up, venture or high-growth business Commercial leadership experience with meaningful accountability for growth and business performance The ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution Experience leading across product, technology, commercial and operational disciplines Strong judgement and the ability to make decisions when there isn’t a perfect answer The credibility to operate with senior executives, Boards, investors and external partners A customer-led, commercially sharp and data-driven approach Experience of consumer digital businesses, fintech, marketplaces, regulated environments or scaling across multiple markets would be particularly valuable. The person This role will suit someone who gets energy from building . You’re entrepreneurial without being chaotic. You move quickly, but know when rigour matters. You can create a compelling vision and then roll up your sleeves to make it real. You build great teams, create clarity where there isn’t any and are comfortable being personally accountable for the outcome. Most importantly, you want to build the next business, not simply run the last one. Why Liberty Global? You’ll be joining at a point where you can have a fundamental impact on what this business becomes. The venture is currently being incubated within Liberty Global , giving it access to the capabilities and backing of an established international business while operating with the entrepreneurial mindset and pace of a start-up. The business itself remains confidential at this stage. More detail on the proposition, opportunity and ambition will be shared with candidates as they progress through the process.

items.desc: We are pleased to offer an opportunity to join our friendly and forward‑thinking radiotherapy physics team at North Middlesex Hospital in North London as a Band 7 Radiotherapy Physicist . This post is ideally suited to candidates who have recently completed the STP and achieved HCPC registration, or those nearing completion and looking to develop strong clinical and technical skills within a supportive team. Our radiotherapy service is equipped with Varian TrueBeam and Halcyon linacs, with Varian Eclipse used for all treatment planning. We have recently commissioned a TrueBeam equipped with HyperSight and AlignRT for SGRT. We also have an XStrahl treatment unit for superficial radiotherapy. The department provides a comprehensive physics service across treatment planning, machine QA, and molecular radiotherapy. You will be able to rotate through each section and contribute to service improvement and innovation alongside routine clinical work. Ongoing developments include knowledge-based planning, QA automation with RadMachine, planning with RapidArcDynamic, and lots more besides. The team includes 10 clinical scientists (including this post), 6 dosimetrists, and 6 engineering and technical staff, creating a collaborative and well-supported working environment. The post holder will participate in the general Radiotherapy Physics service provision to the North Middlesex Hospital site . The post holder may be required to specialise in one or more sections within the Radiotherapy Physics service. items.desc: About Kibble Kibble supports children and young people (aged 5-26) who have experienced trauma and adversity through residential care, education and mental health services. For more than 200 years, we’ve put young people first and have built a trusted charity with vital services that strive to transform lives, families and communities. When starting a new job at Kibble, you’ll become part of a dedicated staff team who make sure children are happy and safe 365 days a year, 24/7. Whether your role is in care, education, or the corporate side, you’ll help give young people a chance at life. Are you interested in making a real change with families with complex needs? The Systemic Family service is part of the Specialist Intervention Team who work with children 5-18 years old who are living away from home. We work across the range of facilities, including the safe centre, community services and early years provisions. You will become an integral part of the SIS team, which is responsible for the planning, implementation and evaluation of a range of specialist interventions for young people and their families. The service prides itself on working alongside families who have previously struggled to engage with services. We are looking to recruit a motivated and passionate family worker to work with families using therapeutic approaches. The post involves providing direct systemic interventions with all of the family, structured work with parents and carers, dyadic work with parents/children, family focused work with children and young people and family support. The role involves working closely with all the systems who work with the young person and their family such as education, the care team, health, support agencies and the local authority. The candidate is required to be flexible, creative, and be able to use playful approaches to engaging children in a therapeutic process. We also work with young people who have complex emotional and behavioural difficulties therefore having an understanding of mental health needs is essential. Main Duties: To implement a range of systemic interventions for individuals, carers, staff, professionals and families using systemic models. To work with young people, children, and their families both within a residential setting and where required within the family home. To work in collaboration with the therapeutic practitioners and psychology team. To provide consultation to professionals and those using the service regarding systemic formulation and care planning. To provide systemic advice, guidance and consultation to other professionals contributing directly to an intervention or care plan of those using the service. To communicate in a skilled and sensitive manner, information concerning the assessment, formulation and intervention plans of children and families. To write reports summarising systemic assessment, formulation or intervention outcomes. Or A counsellor or psychotherapist registered with a regulatory body with a knowledge of systemic practice and experience of working with families. Desirable A Foundation and/or Intermediate Certificate in Systemic Practice. Understanding of the impact of trauma and child development approaches. DDP qualification. Experience of working with families with complex needs. Experience of delivering interventions with families and young people, monitoring individual/group interventions for challenged families. It is responsible for receiving, screening and clinically triaging referrals, ensuring service users are directed to the most appropriate service in a timely and safe manner. You will contribute to continuous service improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, supporting team learning, and helping shape a responsive, high-quality service. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking team, where your contribution will directly influence how urgent mental services evolve and improve for the people who need them most. We have excellent shopping, eating out, top ranking schooling and affordable house prices too.
