items.desc: We are seeking enthusiastic, motivated and adaptable clinicians to join us as CAMHS Community High Intensity CBT Practitioner Trainees. This is a unique opportunity to undertake a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Evidence Based Psychological Treatment for Children and Young People (CBT Route) while gaining valuable clinical experience within a progressive and forward-thinking mental health service. The role is designed to equip practitioners with the knowledge and skills required to deliver evidence-based Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) interventions to children, young people and their families. CYPMH Dorset: A Service in Transformation Children and Young People's Mental Health (CYPMH) Dorset is entering an exciting period of growth and transformation. Through significant new investment, we are developing and expanding our services in line with the i-THRIVE Framework, creating more responsive, accessible and needs-led support for children, young people and families across Dorset. As our transformation programme progresses, this role will evolve alongside the service. Successful candidates will initially support existing teams from a temporary base during the transition period, before becoming part of our future service model. All posts are pan-Dorset, and candidates should be prepared to work flexibly as services continue to expand, including the introduction of extended operational hours in the future. About the Training Programme Successful candidates will undertake a 12-month Postgraduate Diploma in Evidence-Based Psychological Treatment for Children and Young People (CBT Route) at the University of Exeter. The programme combines academic study with supervised clinical practice, preparing trainees to deliver High Intensity CBT for children and young people experiencing anxiety, depression and related mental health difficulties. [HI CBT trainee JD | PDF] Trainees will usually spend two days per week in university teaching and three days working within CYPMH services, developing a supervised clinical caseload and applying their learning in practice. Some teaching may be delivered online. Throughout the programme, trainees will provide evidence-based interventions within a stepped-care model and receive regular clinical supervision and support. [HI CBT trainee JD | PDF] The course is BABCP Level 2 accredited and, on successful completion, trainees will be eligible to apply for BABCP Provisional Accreditation. Following qualification, there may be opportunities to progress into a structured Preceptorship Programme, offering enhanced supervision, peer support, protected development opportunities and a managed caseload to support the transition into autonomous practice. Subject to successful completion and organisational requirements, this would typically lead to progression into a permanent Band 7 CBT Therapist role. items.card: Job Description and Person Specification for further details for the post of Locum Consultant Gastroenterologist & Hepatologist at Blackpool Teaching Hospitals.
items.desc: An excellent opportunity has arisen to join our expanding patient centred and supportive Gastroenterology department at Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. Our hard-working and forward-thinking team are keen to develop the Gastroenterology and Liver service and would welcome similar minded candidates to join our department. This is an exciting time to join us following investment of £4.0 million recurrent funding to support a blended workforce and £4.5 million capital investment to refurbish our Endoscopy unit. There will be opportunity to support outpatient transformation as part of a blended workforce as we develop our Luminal and Liver services and establish novel outpatient pathways. Our Gastroenterology and Liver service is one of the busiest in the UK – we offer a broad range of diagnostic and therapeutic services for all gastroenterological conditions. Our recently refurbished JAG accredited, performance driven and patient centred Endoscopy unit delivers approximately 15,000 procedures per annum and is a spoke centre for the North-West Endoscopy training academy and is the admin hub for Bowel cancer screening within the Lancashire region. The post holder is expected to have a broad experience of Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Endoscopy, contributing to the core Gastroenterology elective and emergency service but with special emphasis on delivering Hepatology services. There is shared care of inpatients under the Gastroenterology team on the Gastroenterology ward with a Consultant currently being ward based for 1 week out of every 6 weeks. The appointee will make an equal contribution to the care of Gastroenterology inpatients and the out-of-hours GI-Bleed endoscopy service which is 1:6 at present with plans to transition to a 1:8 model with further recruitment. All on-call weeks are followed by a post-on-call (POC) week where Gastroenterology triage, a post-on-call clinic and fast-track clinic are delivered. The POC week is followed by standard normal weeks until the next on-call cycle. Elective activity (outpatient clinics, endoscopy lists) is mainly concentrated in the 5-week period off the ward. The job plan comprises 10 Programmed activities including allocation for the current on call commitment. Job plans will be formally reviewed within the first 6 months after appointment and agreed according to evidence from actual activity. The job plan comprises 10 Programmed activities including allocation for the current on call commitment. Job plans will be formally reviewed within the first 6 months after appointment and agreed according to evidence from actual activity. Predictable emergency on call (Gastroenterology / GI Bleeding Service) is 1.5 DCC. Category A for unpredictable emergency work. This includes a daily ward round on the Gastroenterology ward at weekends when on-call. Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is situated on the west coast of Lancashire, with services covering the local authority areas of Blackpool, Fylde and Wyre. The Trust is part of the Lancashire and South Cumbria Integrated Care System (ICS) supporting a population of around 1.6 million people. Blackpool Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust serves a resident population of approximately 330,000 and the 12 million holidaymakers who visit the area every year. The Trust comprises Blackpool Victoria Hospital which is a large busy acute hospital and a smaller community/ rehabilitation hospital - Clifton Hospital. Outpatient services are also provided in Blackpool, Fleetwood and Lytham Hospital. The Trust is also responsible for the provision of a wide range of community healthcare services, including District Nursing, Community Matrons and therapy services. The organisation provides specialist tertiary care for Cardiac and Haematology services, delivers community health services to over 445,000 residents including those in North Lancashire and hosts the National Artificial Eye Service across England. We also have specialised Cardio-thoracic Surgical and Sleep Medicine services (including polysomnography) and provide urgent and emergency care services to an estimated 18 million people who visit the seaside resort each year. The role of the Physical Healthcare Community Co-ordinator is a one year fixed term contract and will facilitate the launch of this new model. The clinics will be supported by dedicated Band 4 Health Care Assistant and will have administrative time, with clear clinical oversight from existing senior clinicians. Work with the Lived experience lead, to help meet the needs of people who are hard to reach. items.desc: Location: Wrexham, Denbighshire, GB, LL13 9XS Business Unit: Spectro Posting Date: Oct 22, 2026 Job Description: The Test & Installation (T&I) role involves taking a newly assembled mass spectrometer, built by our in-house assembly team, and turning it into a fully tested and commissioned instrument ready for customer use. Due to the complex nature of the manufacturing process, problem-solving and fault-finding are an important part of the role. Following testing, you will prepare instruments for delivery to customers around the world, primarily in China, the USA, and Europe. You will also travel to customer laboratories to install and commission systems and provide training to help customers get the most from their new instruments. Key Responsibilities Test products in accordance with documented test procedures. Maintain and produce factory test reports as required. Install products at customer sites while meeting contractual performance, quality, and safety requirements. Produce on-site test reports following installation activities. Deliver customer training both at the factory and on-site when required. Support the Service department through service visits, email support, phone support, or remote assistance when requested by the Test & Installation Manager. Diagnose and resolve issues encountered during the testing and installation process. Prepare instruments for shipment and deployment to customer locations worldwide. Requirements Technical Knowledge knowledge across a range of disciplines, including: physics, chemistry, mathematics, electronics, software Fault-finding and diagnostic skills. Ability to solve problems in a practical manufacturing environment. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to people from different backgrounds and locations around the world. Strong practical, hands-on approach to work. Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs. Personal Attributes Naturally curious and motivated to understand how complex systems work. Flexible and adaptable in a varied working environment. Comfortable with solo international travel. Able to work effectively with a diverse range of people. Why Join Us? At our company, your work directly contributes to scientific progress by helping researchers access the advanced tools they need for discovery. You will have the opportunity to: Work with leading researchers using our instruments to push the boundaries of scientific knowledge. Make a tangible contribution to solving real-world challenges. Contribute to the development and manufacture of advanced technology that is continually evolving. Support scientific discoveries across medicine, materials science, and environmental analysis. About the Business Unit Nu Instruments, a sub-business unit of SPECTRO within AMETEK’s Materials Analysis Division, specializing in the design and manufacture of high-performance mass spectrometry systems for scientific research and advanced analytical applications. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Wrexham, UK, Nu Instruments is recognized as a global leader in ICP-MS, GD-MS, IRMS, TIMS, and noble gas mass spectrometry solutions, supporting customers across academia, government, and industry in fields such as environmental science, materials research, life sciences, geochemistry, and semiconductor technology. For more information, visit www.ametek.com/ and https://www.nu-ins.com/ Compensation Currency: GBP Salary Minimum: 35,000 Salary Maximum: 45,000 Incentive: No Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. items.desc: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About the Role Humanoid is looking for a hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the continued development, deployment and operation of the existing data platform within Humanoid. The role spans cloud infrastructure, full-stack development, platform engineering and data engineering, with responsibility for turning internal engineering requirements into reliable production systems. You will also lead delivery by external contractors and act as their sole point of contact with Humanoid. You will gather requirements from our internal engineering teams, translate them into technical briefs, oversee implementation and bring completed work back for validation. All contractor questions, feedback and delivery coordination will flow through you, without requiring direct communication between contractors and other Humanoid team members. This role combines substantial engineering work with technical leadership and delivery ownership. What You'll Do Own platform delivery: Understand the existing platform architecture, identify the changes needed for Humanoid’s environment and workflows, and take those changes through development, integration, testing and deployment. Lead external contractors: Define work packages, priorities, technical requirements and acceptance criteria. Review designs and code, resolve technical questions, track delivery and ensure completed work meets Humanoid’s standards. Connect internal needs to implementation: Work with Humanoid’s engineering teams to understand requirements and constraints. Maintain a clear backlog, communicate tradeoffs and progress, and raise risks or decisions early. Build and operate cloud infrastructure: Manage compute, storage, networking and environments through infrastructure as code, with attention to security, reliability, performance and cost. Develop across the stack: Implement and maintain backend services, APIs, integrations and frontend interfaces that support internal users and engineering workflows. Improve the engineering platform: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, deployment processes, environment configuration and developer tooling. Own data workflows: Develop and maintain data ingestion, processing, storage and access pipelines. Address data quality, schema changes, failed jobs and recovery. Maintain production reliability: Establish monitoring, logging and alerting; investigate incidents; and maintain practical rollback, backup and recovery procedures. Control access and preserve knowledge: Manage contractor permissions and secrets appropriately. Ensure source code, infrastructure definitions, documentation and operational knowledge remain accessible to Humanoid. Verify and hand over completed work. Validate contractor deliverables against agreed acceptance criteria and ensure releases include the documentation and support needed for ongoing operation. What We're Looking For Experience building, deploying and operating production software on a major cloud platform. Strong practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking, identity and access management, and CI/CD. Solid software engineering skills, including backend services, APIs, databases and the ability to work across frontend and backend code. Experience with data pipelines, object storage, relational databases and reliable processing of large datasets. Evidence of taking ownership of an existing platform: understanding unfamiliar code, diagnosing problems and delivering improvements safely. Experience leading external developers or contractors, including scoping work, reviewing implementation and holding delivery to clear quality standards. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn incomplete requirements into actionable technical work. Sound judgment about what to build directly, what to delegate and when to involve internal engineering specialists. Experience with robotics, machine learning infrastructure, sensor data or internal data platforms would be valuable. We welcome engineers with particular depth in infrastructure or platform engineering who can demonstrate effective delivery across the wider software stack. What success looks like? The data platform is deployed reliably within Humanoid and develops in line with internal engineering needs. Contractor work arrives tested, documented and ready to integrate. Internal teams have clear visibility into progress and decisions, while you own the technical context, coordination and follow-through needed to deliver. Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Работиш с бизнес клиенти от собствен портфейл;
 ● Осъществяваш контакти с оглед тяхното задържане, консултиране и търсене на решения при казуси;
 ● Използваш пълната гама от банкови продукти за бизнес клиенти, предлагани от Банката, включително и в областта на кредитирането;
 ● Правиш предложения за повишаване на качеството на обслужване и ще съдействаш при възникнали запитвания, постъпващи от клиенти;
 ● Търсиш и привличаш нови клиенти в сегмента.
 В теб търсим
 ● Завършено висше икономическо или друго подходящо образование, магистърска степен или в ход на обучение;
 ● Познания по счетоводство и финанси, както и опит в сходна област ще се считат за предимство;
 ● Търговски умения, ориентираност към клиента;
 ● Предприемчивост, аналитичност, умения за работа в екип, инициативност.
 ● Компютърни умения - Microsoft Officе пакет;
 ● Ползване на английски език (счита се за предимство).

 ● Коледен бонус;
 ● Стартово възнаграждение от минимум 1580 евро БРЗ;
 ● Бонуси за постигнати резултати;
 ● Ваучери за храна в размер на 102.26 евро;
 ● 25 дни отпуск;
 ● Платен почивен ден и подарък за рожден ден;
 ● Платен почивен ден за доброволчество;
 ● Програма „Препоръчай приятел“;
 ● Кредити при преференциални условия;

 If you really want to make a difference – make it with us 
 Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens AG and has been a leading supplier in the field of mobility for over 160 years. Our core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems and related services. We have always been very innovative in making traveling faster, safer and more comfortable. Today, we need new solutions to new challenges such as climate change and rising populations worldwide. That's what drives us. That's why we shape mobility with passion, always being one step ahead. Through digitalization, we make infrastructures smart and create opportunities that get us from A to B sustainably and seamlessly. Our over 40,000 employees are pioneers in mobility who help to keep the world moving.
 What do you contribute? 
 You will be responsible for the setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of customized embedded Linux distributions for automated and driverless train operation (Automatic Train Operation), with a particular focus on kernel options, driver integration, and partitioning.
 Building on this, you optimize and manage modern build automation environments using BitBake, Buildroot, CMake, and Make, thereby facilitating efficient development workflows.
 Furthermore, you develop, adapt, and maintain drivers and interfaces for industrial bus systems such as TRDP, MVB, and ProfiNet to enable seamless hardware integration.
 Additionally, you configure network namespaces and services (including PAM, lighttpd, NginX) and ensure secure, encrypted communication via OpenSSL and certificate management.
 To round off your responsibilities, you support application teams with OS-level interfaces, maintain Git/GitLab repositories, oversee base applications and compilers, and validate your results through system testing and vulnerability management.
 What do you bring along? 
 You have a university degree with extensive relevant professional experience in the field or a completed vocational training with further qualification as a technician and extensive relevant professional experience.
 You have in-depth experience in the embedded Linux environment, including configuration, maintenance, partitioning of distributions, and integration of kernels and drivers.
 You are proficient in network programming, configuration of network services (PAM, lighttpd, NginX), and have a solid understanding of secure communication (OpenSSL, certificates).
 You possess practical knowledge in bus systems, driver adaptation, protocol integration (TRDP, MVB, ProfiNet), and are skilled in build tools such as BitBake, Buildroot, CMake, Make, and Debian package management.
 You demonstrate a structured, solution-oriented, and team-focused working style with a high willingness to learn.
 You have very good command of German, both written and spoken, and good English skills.

items.desc: Job Description The Enterprise Machine Learning team builds intelligent systems that help the business make better decisions at scale. We combine machine learning, data engineering, and modern AI techniques to transform complex customer and revenue data into products and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. As part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics organization, we work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to build production-ready ML solutions that continuously improve as new data becomes available. Role Overview As a Machine Learning Engineer , you'll build, deploy, and continuously improve machine learning systems that power this intelligence layer. You'll own the complete lifecycle—from understanding the business problem and developing models to deploying them into production, monitoring performance, and iterating based on real-world results. You'll work alongside AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analytics professionals, building scalable ML solutions that become part of our core platform. What You'll Do Design, build, and deploy machine learning models that predict key business outcomes such as churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement. Develop and maintain scalable ML pipelines that continuously ingest data, retrain models, validate performance, and serve predictions in production. Work with large-scale structured and unstructured data, applying modern ML and LLM techniques where they deliver measurable business value. Monitor production models, improve performance over time, and ensure reliability through testing, validation, and continuous iteration. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver ML solutions that solve real customer and business problems. Own machine learning solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and experimentation to production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization. This Role Is For You If You enjoy building machine learning systems that solve real business problems—not just achieving better benchmark metrics. You've worked with imperfect, real-world datasets and understand challenges like noisy labels, feature leakage, class imbalance, and concept drift. You write clean, production-quality Python with testing, modular design, and maintainable code. You think beyond model performance and care about the impact your work has on users and business outcomes. You're comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial idea through production deployment and ongoing maintenance. You use data to guide decisions and proactively identify opportunities for new ML applications. What We're Looking For 3–5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline. Master's or PhD is a plus, but not required. Technical Skills Strong understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques, including regression, classification, survival analysis, causal inference, uplift modeling, or related methods. Experience developing models on large-scale, real-world datasets, including feature engineering, model validation, and handling imperfect data. Experience working with unstructured data using embeddings, fine-tuning, vector representations, or other modern NLP techniques. Strong Python programming skills with experience building production-ready software. Solid SQL skills and experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). Experience deploying, serving, and monitoring machine learning models in production environments. Familiarity with experiment design, A/B testing, or causal inference is a plus. Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar platforms is a plus. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar. The Poland annualized base salary range for this position is €98,000.00-€146,000.00. Please note that while the salary range represents the minimum and maximum base salary rate for this position, the actual compensation offered will be based on job related capabilities, applicable experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, or related incentives that will be communicated during the offer stage. items.desc: Join us on our mission to develop the world’s most sustainable battery chemistry . We’re a growing startup developing organic electrolytes for flow batteries, and we’re looking for a Flow Battery Expert to help us shape the future of our battery technology. This is a key role for someone who enjoys the intersection of chemistry, electrochemistry and engineering. We're seeking a experienced scientist with deep expertise in organic flow batteries . You’ll be joining a tight-knit team focused on progress and real-world deployment. About Rivus Rivus Batteries is a Swedish startup developing aqueous organic flow battery electrolytes to deliver stationary energy storage at lower cost and climate footprint than today’s battery systems. Our electrolytes are based on widely available elements – we believe this is crucial for sustainably covering the growing global demand for energy storage capacity. Following years of academic research, we’re now in our fourth year of commercialisation – with R&D and scaling up at the heart of everything we do. We are currently working on optimising our electrolyte formulation, installing customer pilot installations and moving towards commercialization. We are a mission-driven tech startup, committed to holistic care for the environment and corporate responsibility on all levels. About the job We are looking for a Flow Battery Expert to support us in the next phase as a Research Scientist: from lab and stack tests to commercial scale. As part of our R&D team, you will lead the design, execution, and interpretation of experiments aimed at advancing our aqueous organic flow battery technology. You will take ownership of electrolyte optimisation, using your deep know how to identify promising research directions, design rigorous experimental campaigns, analyse complex datasets, and translate findings into practical improvements in battery performance. Working closely with our CEO, Head of R&D, and the technical team, you will play a key role in shaping our R&D strategy. Your scientific insight will be instrumental during technical discussions and weekly results meetings, where you will help define priorities, challenge assumptions, and guide decision-making. We are looking for someone who thrives in an independent research environment, takes initiative, and can lead projects from concept to conclusion with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively across disciplines. About you We’re looking for someone with an extensive background in the field of flow batteries. Requirements: PhD in chemistry, electrochemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a closely related field. Strict requirement: Research and/or industrial experience in aqueous organic flow batteries. Candidates with substantial experience in other flow battery technologies (e.g. vanadium, iron, zinc-based, or hybrid systems) may also be considered. Strong background in electrochemistry, organic chemistry, and physical chemistry. Demonstrated experience designing, planning, and leading independent research projects. Experience developing and optimising flow battery electrolytes and/or flow battery systems. Experience with analytical and electrochemical techniques (e.g. UV-vis, LC-MS, NMR, EIS, CV). Strong skills in data analysis and using scientific programming tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, etc). Ability to present results clearly, challenge ideas, and lead technical decision-making. Ability to lead and deliver complex technical projects with partners and suppliers. Strong analytical skills and a collaborative, self-driven attitude. Your role will involve: Scientific leadership in the development of Rivus' aqueous organic flow battery technology. Leading projects focused on the optimisation of Rivus' organic flow battery electrolytes. Designing, leading, and analysing experimental campaigns to improve electrolyte lifetime, energy density, efficiency, and overall battery performance, and translating the findings into new development directions and practical improvements. Analysing, processing, and communicating experimental data, including automation through programming scripts and AI tools. Guiding the development of new laboratory methodologies and experimental infrastructure. Mentoring junior colleagues and providing guidance across multidisciplinary projects. Planning and coordination of external R&D collaborations, including interactions with academic partners, consultants, suppliers, and contract research organisations. Organisation and active engagement in the work of Rivus' lab. What we offer: Competitive salary with performance-based stock options with vesting 6 weeks paid vacation + 5 bridge days annually A high-impact role in a climate and energy resilience critical technology Daily collaboration with experienced chemists, engineers and entrepreneurs A warm and inclusive team culture grounded in purpose and pragmatism Hands-on experience in a fast-growing deep tech and chemistry startup Location: …

items.desc: Job Description The Enterprise Machine Learning team builds intelligent systems that help the business make better decisions at scale. We combine machine learning, data engineering, and modern AI techniques to transform complex customer and revenue data into products and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. As part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics organization, we work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to build production-ready ML solutions that continuously improve as new data becomes available. Role Overview As a Machine Learning Engineer , you'll build, deploy, and continuously improve machine learning systems that power this intelligence layer. You'll own the complete lifecycle—from understanding the business problem and developing models to deploying them into production, monitoring performance, and iterating based on real-world results. You'll work alongside AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analytics professionals, building scalable ML solutions that become part of our core platform. What You'll Do Design, build, and deploy machine learning models that predict key business outcomes such as churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement. Develop and maintain scalable ML pipelines that continuously ingest data, retrain models, validate performance, and serve predictions in production. Work with large-scale structured and unstructured data, applying modern ML and LLM techniques where they deliver measurable business value. Monitor production models, improve performance over time, and ensure reliability through testing, validation, and continuous iteration. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver ML solutions that solve real customer and business problems. Own machine learning solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and experimentation to production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization. This Role Is For You If You enjoy building machine learning systems that solve real business problems—not just achieving better benchmark metrics. You've worked with imperfect, real-world datasets and understand challenges like noisy labels, feature leakage, class imbalance, and concept drift. You write clean, production-quality Python with testing, modular design, and maintainable code. You think beyond model performance and care about the impact your work has on users and business outcomes. You're comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial idea through production deployment and ongoing maintenance. You use data to guide decisions and proactively identify opportunities for new ML applications. What We're Looking For 3–5 years of professional experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline. Master's or PhD is a plus, but not required. Technical Skills Strong understanding of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques, including regression, classification, survival analysis, causal inference, uplift modeling, or related methods. Experience developing models on large-scale, real-world datasets, including feature engineering, model validation, and handling imperfect data. Experience working with unstructured data using embeddings, fine-tuning, vector representations, or other modern NLP techniques. Strong Python programming skills with experience building production-ready software. Solid SQL skills and experience working with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). Experience deploying, serving, and monitoring machine learning models in production environments. Familiarity with experiment design, A/B testing, or causal inference is a plus. Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar platforms is a plus. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar. The Poland annualized base salary range for this position is €98,000.00-€146,000.00. Please note that while the salary range represents the minimum and maximum base salary rate for this position, the actual compensation offered will be based on job related capabilities, applicable experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, or related incentives that will be communicated during the offer stage. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with another modern language such as C++ or Java . Solid understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation and ML lifecycle management . Practical experience with MLOps , including model monitoring, versioning, deployment and reproducibility. Hands-on experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, Lambda and S3 . Experience developing software for quantitative investment, trading, financial modelling or other data-intensive workflows is highly desirable. Experience working with equities, fixed income, multi-asset strategies or other quantitative investment domains is a strong advantage. Strong software engineering mindset, with an emphasis on code quality, testing, scalability and maintainability . This is an opportunity to work on high-impact AI and machine learning problems where research meets production engineering. items.desc: Senior Data Scientist – Product Analytics & Experimentation Location: Remote – UK Rate: Up to £500 per day PAYE Experience: 8–10+ years Contract : 12 Months We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist with a strong background in e-commerce, digital advertising and product experimentation to drive data-led decision-making and improve customer experiences. You will analyse large, complex datasets to understand buyer behaviour, identify commercial opportunities and evaluate product experiments. Working alongside product and engineering professionals, you will use Python, statistical analysis and experimentation methodologies to generate actionable insights and recommendations. Key Responsibilities Analyse large datasets to identify trends, customer behaviours and opportunities for product improvement. Design, execute and evaluate product experiments, including A/B testing and hypothesis-driven analysis. Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to support product analytics and feature recommendations. Assess market opportunities, purchasing trends and buyer interactions across digital platforms. Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product development. Provide business intelligence, data visualisation and dashboard support. Independently investigate analytical questions and deliver insights between experimentation cycles. Leverage AI tools and automated analytical frameworks to improve efficiency and accelerate insights. Essential Requirements – Non-Negotiable E-commerce experience: Previous experience in e-commerce, specifically working with digital advertising platforms or major retail businesses. Relevant experience: 8–10+ years in data science, product analytics or a closely related field. Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience analysing large and complex datasets. Excellent statistical analysis, hypothesis testing and problem-solving capabilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings to non-technical stakeholders. Desirable Skills Experience integrating analytics with machine learning infrastructure to automate product feature recommendations and validation. Familiarity with AI-powered analytical tools, multi-agent frameworks and automated workflows. Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau. A Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related discipline. Please note: This is a hands-on product data science role focused on analytics, experimentation and commercial insights. It does not involve backend software engineering or production model deployment. If you have strong e-commerce and advertising expertise and enjoy using experimentation and data to influence product decisions, we would like to hear from you.

Product sense: you care whether people actually use what you build, and you'd rather ship something rough this week than something perfect next quarter. Clear communication. items.desc: Drive the transformation of FAMAR’s business and industrial processes by combining Lean methodologies, data engineering, artificial intelligence and automation. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will work directly with operational teams to identify inefficiencies, redesign workflows and develop practical AI-powered solutions through to production deployment. You’ll connect fragmented systems and build reliable, secure and reusable data integrations that make enterprise data accessible. Using generative AI, intelligent agents, document intelligence and workflow automation, you’ll simplify complex processes, eliminate repetitive tasks and help teams work more effectively. What you’ll do: Work alongside business and manufacturing teams to identify bottlenecks and simplify processes using Lean principles. Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, RAG solutions and automated workflows that solve practical operational challenges. Connect enterprise systems through reliable data pipelines, APIs and reusable integrations, improving data quality and accessibility. Develop document automation solutions supporting activities such as customer quotations, quality reviews and reporting. Take solutions from prototype to production using Microsoft Azure and sound engineering practices, including testing, monitoring and appropriate human oversight. Partner with IT and Quality to ensure security, data integrity and regulatory compliance where applicable. Train users, drive adoption and work with IT to establish ongoing support and maintenance. Measure results through time saved, shorter lead times, improved quality and validated savings, scaling successful solutions across FAMAR. What makes you a great fit Min. 3 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI development or intelligent process automation. Proven ability to map, analyse, challenge and simplify end-to-end processes together with business teams. Strong collaboration skills, with a track record of delivering results jointly with operational, IT and Quality teams. Strong hands-on engineering capabilities, including application development, data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows and production deployment. Experience integrating diverse enterprise systems, data sources and AI solutions into business processes. Practical experience with LLM applications, intelligent agents, RAG architectures or workflow automation. Experience with cloud technologies and data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure. Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders. Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story - what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect!

Ability to translate business requirements and operational challenges into practical technical solutions. Experience with ERP, QMS, CRM or other enterprise systems would be advantageous; MES or LIMS experience would be a plus for future initiatives. Experience with document intelligence or enterprise workflow platforms would be advantageous. Knowledge of GxP, Computerized System Validation and data integrity principles would be an asset. Exposure to Lean methodologies or business process improvement would be advantageous. Why join FAMAR? Bring your engineering skills to a European pharmaceutical manufacturing and development group with more than 75 years of expertise and products supplied to 80 international markets. See your work in action. Build solutions alongside the people who use them, with visible results in manufacturing, quality and everyday business operations. Make an impact across borders. Develop solutions that can be adopted across FAMAR’s European sites and corporate functions. Expand your expertise. Receive dedicated Lean training and deepen your experience at the intersection of AI, data engineering and pharmaceutical operations. Own the journey. Take projects from understanding the problem to deploying the solution and measuring the improvement. We’d love to hear your story — what you’ve built, what you’ve learned and what you’d like to do next. Apply and let’s connect.

items.desc: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia ! Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail . Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès ! Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y ! Rigoureux(se) , vous ne laissez rien au hasard, Efficace , vous ne remettez pas à demain ce qui peut être fait dès aujourd’hui, Autonome , vous savez mener vos missions à bien sans aide. Dans le cadre de l'accompagnement de nos clients sur leurs enjeux Data & IA, vous serez amené(e) à être la personne clé faisant le lien entre la conception des modèles et leur intégration système. Vous interviendrez sur des projets ambitieux impliquant de : Industrialiser les modèles : Assurer la mise en production à grande échelle des modèles de Machine Learning développés par les équipes de Data Scientists. Automatiser les pipelines : Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines MLOps robustes (CI/CD) pour fluidifier et automatiser l'entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles. Superviser et optimiser : Assurer le suivi des performances des modèles une fois en production, détecter les dérives (data drift) et optimiser la consommation des ressources. Prendre le lead technique : Accompagner les équipes en place et prendre progressivement le lead sur le périmètre MLOps pour transformer les idées en solutions concrètes et robustes. Collaborer en transverse : Travailler en étroite synergie avec les Data Scientists et Data Engineers pour garantir la "production-readiness" des modèles face aux besoins métiers. Profil recherché Une expérience significative (minimum 5 ans) en tant qu'Ingénieur MLOps, ou un profil Data Engineer / Data Scientist possédant une très forte appétence croisée pour ces deux domaines. Une maîtrise éprouvée des environnements Cloud (idéalement GCP) et d'une plateforme de traitement de données majeure, principalement Databricks et l'écosystème Spark. Un solide bagage en programmation (Python en priorité, SQL, Scala) associé à une très bonne connaissance des librairies de Machine Learning. Une expertise sur l'orchestration de workflows (Airflow), la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles (MLFlow), la conteneurisation (Docker) et les pratiques de delivery (Git, GitHub, Jinja). Processus de recrutement Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous ! 3 jours de présentiel minimum requis. Les petits plus 🏠 Télétravail possible (hybride) 👛 100% des frais de transports en communs pris en charge, des tickets restaurant et une mutuelle haut de gamme ❤️‍🩹Une politique inclusive et une référente handicap à disposition pour vous accompagner #greatplacetobe 🎁 Un CSE avantageux et des challenges tout au long de l'année ! #greatplacetolive 📈 Des primes à hauteur des performances de l'année et de l'implication 🎉 250 événements par an pour rencontrer tes collègues et des locaux feel good 📢 Des formations, conférences et une plateforme d'e-learning avec LinkedIn pour monter en compétences #greatplacetolearn 👩‍ Des Communautés Métiers et du Mentorat pour partager son expertise et en apprendre sur de nombreux sujets #greatplacetoshare 🕹️ Une communauté de e-sport : Extia Gaming ! #greatplacetoplay 🌏 Envie d’évoluer ? Grâce à notre politique de mobilité interne, explorez de nouvelles opportunités en France ou dans l’un de nos 7 autres pays !

items.desc: AI Engineer (Manager) Senior AI engineering leadership role at one of the UK’s leading AI and Data businesses Production ML and GenAI delivery for major healthcare and public sector clients UK wide, client site up to 3 days per week Salary £90,000 to £120,000 SC clearance required About the Company Our client is a leading digital technology consultancy recognised as one of the UK’s foremost AI and data businesses, with a decade-long track record of delivering production-grade AI solutions across government, healthcare, defence and commercial sectors. Their 150-strong AI and Data Practice is trusted by Microsoft, AWS and others to deliver advanced solutions at citizen scale, and they are pioneers in responsible AI, having authored the UK government’s AI Cyber Security Code of Practice implementation guide. The Role This is an engineering role, not a data science role. You will deploy and serve ML models in production at significant scale, act as the most senior technical person on complex client projects and lead multi-disciplinary engineering teams across the full solution. Alongside delivery, you will bring genuine consulting capability, managing senior client relationships, contributing to bids and tenders and spotting commercial opportunities. Healthcare is a major growth area and early work may involve pipeline building before moving into full delivery. This role suits a technically exceptional, client-facing AI engineer who is as comfortable leading a project as they are reviewing an architecture. Key Responsibilities Lead the deployment and serving of AI and ML models in production at significant scale Act as technical lead across the full solution, leading software and platform engineers as well as the AI component Drive adoption of modern AI engineering approaches including RAG, agentic AI, model evaluation and drift detection Engage with senior and C-level client stakeholders on architecture, delivery management and commercial opportunities Contribute to bids, tenders and pre-sales activity as a credible technical voice Ensure responsible AI principles and engineering best practices are embedded throughout delivery Manage, coach and develop a team of engineers, setting standards and fostering a culture of excellence What You’ll Need Essential: Proven track record deploying and serving AI and ML models in production at significant scale Traditional ML experience across classic ML, computer vision, reinforcement learning and MLOps, as well as GenAI including LLMs, RAG and agentic AI, with experience predating the GenAI era Technical leadership across a full solution, leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams Strong client-facing consulting ability including senior stakeholder management, delivery management and commercial awareness Strong Python and engineering practice including CI/CD, testing and code reviews Experience with Azure and/or AWS, Docker and Kubernetes Experience managing, coaching and developing engineers SC clearable: UK national with five years UK residency Desirable: Healthcare or public sector delivery background Consultancy experience Existing SC clearance Experience with LLM fine-tuning or distillation, vector databases and semantic search Familiarity with ISO 42001 or AI compliance frameworks Experience shaping AI offerings and supporting pre-sales Why Apply? Salary of £90,000 to £120,000 Work at the cutting edge of AI delivery on some of the UK’s most significant public sector programmes Join a 150-strong AI and Data Practice with a dedicated talent development lead and strong upskilling investment Healthcare is one of the biggest growth areas in the practice, with further roles across other sectors in the pipeline Two stage interview process with no technical test Client site travel expenses covered in full Interested? items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤖 Ops AI Platform team 🔀 We're building something that doesn't exist yet. Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work. That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale. The project just launched . You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation. If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it. ⭐ Our north star We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path. Skills You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on: 💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data. 👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations 🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents , connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc. 💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling. If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations. You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures, and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring). You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering. Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful Self-directed and pragmatic Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English (no need to speak French!) But …

items.desc: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An Overview Of This Role As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer. Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy. What You'll Do Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant. Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry. Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations. Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI. Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback. Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering. Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency. Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic. What You'll Bring Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models. Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses. Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility. Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus. Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications. Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team. Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields. About The Team The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability. Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features. How …

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Job Description NEXTON recrute un Coach Technique IA - Spec-Driven Development H/F , en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Tu interviens pour l’un de nos clients, grand compte du secteur bancaire, dans le cadre d’un programme stratégique de transformation IA de son cycle de développement (SDLC). Avec plus de 300 équipes projet et un parc applicatif conséquent, l’enjeu est de passer à l’échelle une nouvelle façon de fabriquer les produits, en s’appuyant sur le Spec-Driven Development et les agents IA. Tu rejoins un dispositif de coachs techniques, en binôme avec des coachs organisation, pour accompagner les équipes dans cette bascule, principalement sur des applications existantes. Tes missions : Accompagner plusieurs équipes de développement en parallèle dans l’adoption du Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Diagnostiquer la maturité de chaque équipe et construire avec elle sa trajectoire d’adoption Animer les rituels de travail associés : ateliers , three amigos , instanciation des bases de specs Aider les équipes à mettre en place leurs repositories de specs , point de vérité unique de chaque projet Faire évoluer l’usage des agents IA sur l’ensemble de la chaîne, au-delà de GitHub Copilot en assistant Conseiller les équipes sur le framework adapté à leur contexte ( BMAD , Spec Kit , OpenSpec , etc.) Lever les résistances au changement côté développeurs, en lien avec les coachs organisation Formaliser des retours d’expérience pour préparer le déploiement à grande échelle Qualifications De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu as au moins 8 ans d’expérience en développement, dont une expérience significative en coaching technique (Technical Coach, Craft Coach, Coach DevOps ou équivalent). Tu as déjà accompagné des équipes de développement dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques d’ingénierie Tu as fait adopter le SDD ou une démarche de développement assistée par IA au sein d’au moins une équipe Tu maîtrises les agents IA de développement et les frameworks de spécification ( BMAD , Spec Kit , OpenSpec , ou équivalent) Tu as une expérience concrète sur des applications existantes (brownfield) et du legacy Tu sais embarquer des développeurs : posture de coach, pédagogie, crédibilité technique Tu es à l’aise pour intervenir sur plusieurs équipes simultanément Une connaissance du Domain-Driven Design (bounded context mapping) est un vrai plus Additional Information Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : ▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. ▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. ▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. ▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. ▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. ▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON

items.desc: Overview NCG is seeking a Senior AI Test Engineer to join our ITES sector team in England. This role is pivotal in ensuring the quality and reliability of our AI-driven solutions, aligning with our commitment to innovation and excellence. The Senior AI Test Engineer will be responsible for developing and executing test plans that validate and verify AI algorithms and systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards. This position involves collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure integrated AI solutions are robust and effective, contributing to the overall success of our projects. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in AI testing to drive improvements in our testing processes and methodologies, enhancing the quality and performance of our products. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers and contribute to the strategic direction of AI testing initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI models and algorithms. Collaborate with AI developers and data scientists to understand requirements and ensure test coverage. Automate testing processes using industry-standard tools and frameworks to improve efficiency and accuracy. Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams to resolve issues promptly. Conduct performance testing of AI systems to ensure scalability and reliability under different conditions. Maintain detailed documentation of test procedures, results, and improvements for future reference. Stay updated on the latest AI testing tools and methodologies and integrate them into the testing processes. Mentor junior test engineers, providing guidance and support in AI testing best practices. Requirements 3-6 years of experience in AI testing or related fields, with a strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts. Proficient in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++ for test automation and scripting. Experience with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras. Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues effectively. Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and version control systems like Git. Excellent communication skills to articulate testing strategies and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks efficiently. Education Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is required.

items.desc: About Gramian Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs. About The Role We are seeking experienced Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) from psychology, social work, counseling, qualitative research, human-computer interaction (HCI), communication, conflict resolution, coaching, and related advisory fields to support AI conversation evaluation research. You will review conversations between people and AI models, assess whether the AI gathered sufficient context before making recommendations, identify missed opportunities for clarification, and provide structured feedback to improve conversational quality. The ideal candidate has at least 3-5 years of relevant professional experience, strong analytical and interviewing skills, and the ability to distinguish essential, decision-changing information from details that are less relevant to a recommendation. Key Responsibilities Review AI conversations involving interpersonal relationships, workplace situations, education, family matters, everyday planning, wellbeing, and other real-world decisions Evaluate whether the AI gathered sufficient context before providing advice, recommendations, or proposed solutions Identify missing information and suggest relevant follow-up questions that could improve the quality of the AI's response Assess whether additional context would materially change the recommendation or decision Distinguish between load-bearing information that could change the outcome and non-essential or merely descriptive details Conduct qualitative reviews using structured evaluation guidelines and document findings consistently Identify missed opportunities for clarification, contextual understanding, and information gathering Consider relevant personal, psychological, social, financial, practical, and organizational factors when evaluating conversations Collaborate with research teams to maintain consistent evaluation standards and high-quality assessments Complete assigned tasks accurately within the required project timelines Requirements Candidates must have at least 3-5 years of direct professional experience in one or more of the following domains. 2. items.desc: What to Expect Working within the Data & AI capability team, this role designs, builds, and operates full-stack, AI-enabled software, with a strong frontend focus. You build the user-facing products and interfaces that make McLaren's data and AI usable: chat experiences, engineering assistants, dashboards, and internal digital products, backed by the AI platforms. You will work in a product-oriented delivery model, embedded in or allocated to a business-aligned product team (Product Development, Manufacturing, or Commercial), drawing on shared capabilities from the unified platform team. You sit at a valuable intersection where you build both the polished front-end users interact with and the AI integration layer behind it (streaming LLM responses, RAG, agents), deploying on the cloud infrastructure that runs them. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications and AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, streaming responses, dashboards, and interactive tools. Build AI-enabled UX that is transparent and trustworthy: token-by-token streaming, source citations, confidence indicators, human-in-the-loop review and correction, safety warnings, and graceful error/fallback states. Integrate frontends with the McLaren AI platforms, handle streaming, token limits, rate limits, and retries. Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support AI-powered features and connect to data products and source systems. Deliver data and AI products through the lifecycle, from POC and proof of integration (POI) to MVP and production, connecting cleanly to source systems and downstream consumers at every integration boundary. Own the infrastructure your services run on: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerisation, and observability and deployment. Contribute to AI evaluation and quality: build and run automated evals and regression tests and use observability tooling to track latency, token usage, and failure modes. items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 Job Title: Data Expert, Integration & Delivery, Data Capability, DDC, 
 Computational Sciences Center of Excellence 
 Location(s) : Welwyn office based
 Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.
 Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.
 The Opportunity 
 The Data Expert, Integration & Delivery is responsible for the support of the data operations for discovery and research data management and automation solutions. This role serves as a team member to support data management, solution architecture and cloud implementation needs of the department. 
 Work closely with the Automation teams, bioinformatics, and machine learning scientists to facilitate data ingestion, acquisition, and storage. 
 Contributes to technical/functional initiatives related to modernization of data management and curation solutions.
 Contributes to the design of solutions that modernize and improve the efficiency of FAIR data management and curation processes, providing business impact.
 Is proficient in at least one scientific or data domain, and is able to provide support to initiatives based on that knowledge.
 Provide data management support for integrated systems.
 Contribute to and deliver Data architecture vision and standards in conjunction with data users, engineering capabilities and key stakeholders. 
 Fosters a OneRoche data-centric mindset within the team, advocating for data standards, governance, and FAIR principles.
 Contributes to data strategies that ensure data is ready for AI/ML (AI data readiness).
 Contributes to tactical efforts that enable data quality tracking and policy compliance.
 Program Highlights: 
 13 months at full time (37.5 hours per week) paid placement. 
 Program start date is 1st July 2027. 
 Contribution to challenging and impactful business projects.
 Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry.
 Who You Are: 
 Required Education - You meet one of the following criteria :
 Currently enrolled a Bachelor’s degree and have completed 2 years of course at start of the placement
 Degree courses of interest include: Computer science, or related engineering field , or scientific domains.
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Experience in coding, such as R or Python development. 
 Experience in AI/ML usage.
 Experience with scientific data curation or computational methods and good data literacy.
 Excellent written communication skills, verbal communication/presentation skills, interpersonal skills and empathy for users.
 Previous coordination experience in a non-classroom setting (such as via extracurricular activities or a job).
 Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.
 Application Process: 
 Submit your application including your Curriculum Vitae and cover letter with responses to the following: 
 Can you describe a time you performed data curation and the reason why? 
Please detail: the method, tools and/or programming languages you used, if you had to scale-up the process - what you would do differently, whether AI tools played a role in your process, and the key takeaways from the experience. 
 Explain how you see this placement aligning with your personal, educational and career goals.
 Your cover letter should not exceed one page with double-spaced lines, and must reference the role you are applying for.
