At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 As a Custom Software Developer within Roche’s RDT Engineering Excellence & Experience organization, you will play a core role in engineering, scaling, and maintaining robust digital solutions that empower global healthcare innovation. 
 Operating at the Project level within cross-functional agile squads, you will combine hands-on full-stack development with strong engineering discipline. You will contribute across the entire software delivery lifecycle—from initial technical analysis and feature conception to automated deployment and operational excellence. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Full-Stack Application Development: Design, build, and maintain resilient microservices and responsive web applications using Java and modern web frameworks (Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS). 
 Software Quality & Testing: Apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles alongside manual and automated testing practices to ensure code reliability, security, and enterprise standards. 
 Database & Integration Engineering: Design and optimize database schemas and queries across relational systems (PostgreSQL) and manage data handling via template frameworks. 
 CI/CD & Operational Excellence: Execute end-to-end delivery using continuous integration and deployment pipelines (GitHub), Linux shell scripting, and modern DevOps tooling. 
 Domain & Business Analysis: Support technical feasibility studies, refine requirements, and assist with procedures aligned with Computerized System Validation (CSV) guidelines. 
 Collaboration & AI Integration: Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate delivery, engage in peer code reviews, and drive continuous improvement within internal Communities of Practice (CoPs). 
 Candidate Qualifications & Technical Profile 
 Primary / Essential Requirements (Must-Have) 
 Backend Mastery: Proven hands-on development experience in Java and python. 
 Frontend Core: solid experience with Angular , TypeScript , JavaScript (JS) , HTML5, and CSS . 
 Database & APIs: Strong SQL scripting skills and relational database experience (PostgreSQL); proven experience with RESTful microservices architecture. 
 Quality & Testing: Practical experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) , automated unit/integration testing, and clean code principles. 
 Version Control & Automation: Proficiency with Git workflows and Linux/Bash command-line automation. 
 Desirable / Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) 
 Complementary Languages & Frameworks: Exposure to Kotlin , Groovy , or Python for specialized development, utility scripting, or automation. 
 Servers & Templating: Familiarity with Apache Tomcat application server configuration and Apache Velocity template rendering. 
 CI/CD & DevOps Automation: Direct experience setting up and managing CI/CD deployments using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD . 
 AI-Assisted Development: Proficiency in utilizing modern AI Developer Tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot , Claude , or equivalent AI coding assistants) to increase quality and productivity. 
 Enterprise Tooling: Hands-on experience with Codebeamer Configuration (customizing fields, workflows, and state transitions). 
 Domain & Compliance Knowledge: Basic business analysis exposure, specifically around Computerized System Validation (CSV) procedures and regulatory compliance in healthcare/pharma. 
 Testing Versatility: Experience combining automated test suites with structured Manual Testing methodologies for edge-case validation. 
 Key Competencies 
 Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Ability to analyze complex business logic, evaluate technical feasibility, and propose well-structured solutions independently.

About the job
 Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.
 Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.
 Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.
 You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.
 The team and culture
 The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.
 Use evidence to guide test decisions, challenge gaps in coverage and take responsibility for moving improvements forward. Move quickly from diagnosis to action, bringing the right people together to resolve hardware problems.
 What we're looking for
 Strong electronics fundamentals, particularly digital electronics.
 Commercial experience in board or PCBA hardware testing.
 Understanding of manufacturing test for advanced electronic systems.
 Knowledge of surface-mount technology (SMT), PCB manufacturing processes and their failure mechanisms.
 Understanding of automated optical inspection (AOI) and automated X-ray inspection (AXI) capabilities.
 Ability to diagnose electronic defects to component level.
 While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.
 Benefits
 · Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship
 Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 
 Join the Team at Graphcore
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 
 Ready to put your board test expertise behind reliable Graphcore hardware? Apply now to join our Bristol team.

Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 AI-driven, autonomous systems cannot replace human decision making. To keep the human in the loop communication to remote unmanned vehicles is crucial. As Radio Engineer you will work in one of the most contested domains of the modern battlefield: The electromagnetic spectrum! You are the key to ensure the right decision can be made at the right time. You will own radio communication end-to-end as part of new product design and iterations on existing systems. You make pragmatic decisions when to integrate available solutions and when to develop new capabilities that shape the contested environment of the frontline RF space.

 Stay on top of the market and the ever-changing battlefield situations to identify existing, promising or missing RF solutions 
 Test, validate and integrate radio systems into newly developed and existing products and work against customer and internal requirements to build reliable radio solutions 
 Collaborate with internal teams and external companies to develop new antenna and radio solutions custom-shaped to what is needed for mission success 
 Shape discussions and opportunities inside the company as a go-to expert for radio communications 
 Collaborate with governmental bodies to get permissions for licensed bands and power outputs to test and show the true power of modern radio systems in the regulated RF domain 
 Work with external partners to get access to special equipment and build up an internal lab for commonly executed tests 
 You should apply if you 
 Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field 
 Possess a strong understanding how radio technology works and where its limitations lie 
 Have strong communication skills and enjoy working with internal stakeholders and external companies to get things done 
 Are pragmatic and you have to validate your calculated expectations in the real world to be satisfied. 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Collaborate with governmental bodies to get permissions for licensed bands and power outputs to test and show the true power of modern radio systems in the regulated RF domain Work with external partners to get access to special equipment and build up an internal lab for commonly executed tests 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

- aux activités de vérification liées à la certification du produit

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.



THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE

You will build our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU.

On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you build it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own.

That tension is the product: scale-to-zero economics with cold starts in milliseconds, autoscaling that absorbs a launch spike without a config change, GPUs scheduled onto containers the way other platforms schedule CPU. The customers betting on this layer are the developers building the next generation of AI software on European infrastructure.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the container platform end to end: image delivery, placement, request routing, scale-up, scale-to-zero — across CPU and GPU.

- Make cold starts a solved problem: snapshotting, prewarming, image-layer caching, whatever it takes for scale-from-zero to feel instant.

- Treat AI workloads as the normal case: GPU-backed containers, streaming responses, long-lived connections, MCP servers that cost almost nothing while idle.

- Write Go and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

- Partner with Product Managers to turn platform decisions into a product developers want to deploy on.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

- You have built container or workload platforms — orchestration, scheduling, isolation, request routing — not just deployed onto someone else's serverless platform.

- Deep Linux: namespaces, cgroups, image layers, page cache — comfortable well below the application layer.

- Multi-tenancy instincts: density, isolation, and fairness when hundreds of customers share one fleet.

- Significant experience building complex backend or infrastructure systems.

- You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

- A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

 - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

 - Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

 - Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

 - Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

 - Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

 - Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.




BONUS

 - Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

 - Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

 - Experience with OSquery and Santa

 - Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

 - Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).




LOCATION

This role is remote but if you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York or San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

Job Description: 
 Take off with Airbus Helicopters! 
 Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Drive System Design Responsible to join our Engineering departement based in Marignane, France. 
 You will join Transmission Design & Dynamic Systems Architecture department, which is in charge of the whole Airbus Helicopters fleet. Your missions will be operational.
 Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.
 The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.
 You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.
 To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane 
 Your future missions: 
 As System Design Responsible (SDR), you will be in charge of :
 - defining technical objectives of transmission systems (specification writing) ;
 - following detailed design & compliance to requirements of performance, manufacturing, assembly & reliability for any design change and/or new certification ;
 - managing activities in compliance with Airbus Helicopters AH applicable processes
 - writing (flight and bench) tests requests & conclusions, preparing, following-up these tests ;
 - certifying transmission systems (documents writing, discussions with EASA)
 You will belong to a Squad organization & will be interfaced with a lot of different AH entities (stress analysis, work preparation, quality, production, lab tests, flight tests, project, configuration, airworthiness, other design offices, program, customer support...) and transmission equipments suppliers.
 In order to succeed in this challenging transmission systems environment , you will use your experience within Airbus Helicopters engineering. You will also be closely supported by the whole Métiers organization (overall, design, gears & splines, bearings & freewheels, wear & phydical laws, spalling & chip detectability, sealing & TBO extension, Dynamic Systems architecture, stress analysis, lubrication & thermics), experts, CVE and TVE.
 You will also have deep interactions with physical parts, whatever it is linked to production (workshops, manufacturing, assembly, MRO), bench tests or helicopters.
 Your profile 
 - At least 3 years of Experience in aeronautical domain
 - Synthesis spirit, rigorous
 - Good communication skills
 - Language Skills: Advanced level in English and negotiation level in French ; German would be a plus
 3 Reasons to join us: 
 Our Values : Six essential values form the core of our company. Defined for employees by employees, our Airbus values shape the DNA of our business, reflecting the unique mix of qualities found in each member of our global family.
 Inclusion and diversity : We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

Job Description: 
 For Airbus Defence & Space in Taufkirchen we are looking for a 
 Ground Segment Systems Engineer (d/f/m) 
to join the System Delivery Germany team. The department is developing satellite communication systems for civil and military customers. 
As a Ground Segment Systems Engineer (d/f/m), you will work on the concept, design, development and technical procurement of the Ground Segment extensions and modifications of SATCOMBw and EDRS Ground Segments for new customers as well as for the support of further satellites. You are also In the frame of the procurement activities, you will follow the development and acceptance phase from the Request for Proposal (RFP) up to the final acceptance of the ground segment entities. After acceptance, you will accompany the implementation of the ground segment items into the Ground Segment until they go live in operations. During the operational phase, you are the technical point-of-contact for any anomalies that might occur and support the technical resolution of the issues. 
This job combines knowledge of several disciplines with the ability to think outside the box. 
 Your location 
Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. 
 Your benefits 
 Attractive salary and special payments

 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects

 Requirements engineering with DOORS in the area of the ground segment and lower levels
 Conduct and follow-up conceptual design activities in the area of ground systems engineering, including but not limited to requirement, interface, user data and management data flow within the ground segment as well as TM/TC interfaces
 Establishment of requirement for ground segment items, e.g. ground stations, mission operation center, spacecraft control center, payload control center, networks incl. IT infrastructure as well as data centers

Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters ! 
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un(e) Responsable Conception de la fonction "Gestion des Défaillances" (f/h) pour rejoindre le département Maintenance & Ground Operation basé à Marignane, France.
 Rejoignez nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères.
 Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement.
 Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères.
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions :
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers l'optimisation de la charge de travail de maintenance afin de maximiser la disponibilité de la flotte et de répondre aux attentes de nos clients. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département Maintenance & Ground Operation , une équipe transnationale de 70 personnes (France et Allemagne) en charge de la conception des opérations de maintenance et au sol pour tous les programmes d'hélicoptères.
 Votre objectif sera de concevoir des solutions permettant de minimiser l'impact des opérations de dépannage sur la disponibilité des appareils et les coûts de maintenance.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : 
 Conception de la fonction : Définir et challenger les solutions existantes ou proposées par les fournisseurs ; produire les documents de conception (spécifications fonctionnelles, validation et certification).
 Supervision technique : Superviser la conception de la testabilité (BIT) des équipements avioniques, spécifier les logiques de surveillance des pannes et définir les règles de diagnostic au niveau système.
 Gestion de projet : Piloter le planning, les livrables, les coûts et la qualité, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les risques du projet.
 Gestion de la sous-traitance : Définir les lots d'activités, contractualiser les prestations, assurer le suivi opérationnel et valider les livrables avant paiement.
 Amélioration continue : Contribuer au référentiel technique du métier "Failure Management" en définissant des processus et des règles de validation pour gagner en efficacité.
 Votre profil :
 Formation : Titulaire d’un Master (ou équivalent) en ingénierie système ou dans une discipline connexe.
 Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet pour le développement de programmes aéronautiques. Des connaissances en développement de systèmes avioniques, testabilité de systèmes embarqués, analyses de sécurité (FMEA/AMDEC) ou maintenance hélicoptère sont de réels atouts.
 Expertise technique : Maîtrise de la gestion de projet et de budget, suivi de sous-traitance, et idéalement une expertise en développement de fonctions hélicoptères (diagnostic système/troubleshooting).
 Langues : Anglais (niveau intermédiaire supérieur minimum requis). La maîtrise du Français ou de l'Allemand est un plus.
 Soft skills : Autonomie, excellente organisation, aisance relationnelle et fort esprit d'équipe.
 3 Raisons pour nous rejoindre :
 Nos Valeurs : Six valeurs essentielles constituent le noyau de notre entreprise. Définies pour les employés par les employés, nos valeurs Airbus façonnent l'ADN de notre activité, en reflétant le mélange unique des qualités que l'on trouve dans chacun des membres de notre famille mondiale.
 Inclusion et diversité : Nous favorisons un cadre de travail inclusif et valorisant, où la diversité de chacun est appréciée et respectée. Une main-d'œuvre inclusive et diversifiée est le moteur de l'innovation chez Airbus. Elle nous rend unique, contribue à une meilleure résolution des problèmes.
 Rémunération et avantages : Chez Airbus, nous construisons l'avenir ensemble et votre succès est notre priorité. Attendez-vous à un package de rémunération global, compétitif et transparent (incluant salaires, primes, intéressement, participation et plan d'actionnariat privilégié), conçu pour récompenser l'impact et la performance que vous apportez, à la fois individuelle et collective. Nous investissons dans votre épanouissement complet : développement professionnel (formation, mentorat, mobilité internationale), couverture santé, retraite, et un engagement pour un équilibre vie pro/vie perso soutenu (soutien à la parentalité, flexibilité).

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams in der Fertigung sucht Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH eine/n
 Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) der Arbeitsvorbereitung in der mechanischen Fertigung 
 Ihr Arbeitsort in Calden 
 Die Airbus Helicopters Technik GmbH mit Sitz in Kassel-Calden ist ein weltweit agierendes High-Tech-Unternehmen für die Entwicklung, Herstellung und Wartung luftfahrttechnischer Systeme, Komponenten und Präzisionsteile. Wir begeistern uns für hochwertige Technik und arbeiten mit Leidenschaft für Sicherheit und faszinierende Innovationen in der Luftfahrt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Arbeit und teilen unsere Fachkenntnisse gepaart mit langjähriger Erfahrung für die gemeinsame Erfüllung zukunftsorientierter Spitzenleistungen. Wir sind der Ansprechpartner für internationale zivile sowie militärische Programme und Entwickler neuer Schlüsseltechnologien.
 Ihre Vorteile bei Airbus: 
 Spannende und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben rund um die Getriebe- und Antriebskomponenten, dem Herzstück des Helicopters 
 Eine sehr gute Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die von unseren Produkten begeistert sind 
 Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen nach Tarif der Metall- und Elektroindustrie, Hessen 
 30 Tage Urlaub, 35 Stunden/Woche sowie Gleitzeit (außer im Schichtbetrieb) geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Job und Privatleben ideal miteinander zu vereinbaren 
 Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und interne Entwicklungsperspektiven für unseren gemeinsamen Blick in die Zukunft 
 Weitere Benefits wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Fahrradleasing, Gesundheitsangebote sowie eine werkseigene Kantine runden unser Angebot ab 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Sie sind die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen der Konstruktion und der Fertigung und stellen sicher, dass unsere Produktionsprozesse reibungslos, effizient und in höchster Qualität ablaufen.
 Prozessplanung und -steuerung: Sie planen und definieren die technologischen Bearbeitungsschritte für komplexe Bauteile an unseren CNC-Maschinen (Drehen, Fräsen, Schleifen).
 Erstellung von Arbeitsunterlagen: Sie erstellen und pflegen Arbeitspläne, Stücklisten und Fertigungsanweisungen im ERP-System (z. B. SAP).
 Werkzeug- und Vorrichtungsauswahl: Sie wählen die passenden Zerspanungswerkzeuge, Spannmittel und Vorrichtungen aus und beschaffen diese in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Einkauf.
 Kalkulation: Sie ermitteln Vorgabezeiten und führen Vorkalkulationen für die Fertigungskosten von Neu- und Bestandteilen durch.
 Prozessoptimierung (KVP): Sie analysieren bestehende Fertigungsabläufe, identifizieren Verbesserungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit um.
 Technische Unterstützung: Sie agieren als technischer Ansprechpartner für die Maschinenbediener (m/w/d) und unterstützen bei der Erstbemusterung und bei fertigungstechnischen Herausforderungen.
 Stammdatenpflege: Sie sind für die Anlage und Pflege aller fertigungsrelevanten Stammdaten im ERP- und CAM-System verantwortlich.
 Ihre Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. als Zerspanungsmechaniker, Industriemechaniker) mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/Techniker (m/w/d) oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Fertigungsplanung, idealerweise in einem metallverarbeitenden Unternehmen der mechanischen Fertigung.
 IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit einem gängigen ERP-System (Infor LN, BaaN, SAP) sowie den MS-Office-Anwendungen.
 Persönlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus. Sie sind ein kommunikationsstarker Teamplayer, der lösungsorientiert denkt und handelt.
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich.
 Kein 100%-iges Match? Kein Problem! Airbus unterstützt Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit individualisierten Entwicklungslösungen. Nehmen Sie die nächste Stufe Ihrer Karriereleiter und bewerben Sie sich jetzt online!

Job Description: 
 Are you interested in joining into a team that offers you the possibility of having a multidisciplinary view of the A/C development process, having a close relationship will all the Centres of Competence (Design offices), Chief Engineering Offices, Services organization, System Suppliers, Airworthiness Authorities and in some cases with operational customers?
 To support the Aircraft Development Safety team in Getafe, we are looking for a System Safety Engineer who will ensure that Airbus products are designed, developed and supported according to the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations).
 Tasks 
 As a member of the Aircraft Development Safety team, you will develop the following challenging tasks and activities:
 Performing System Safety Assessment activities for military aircraft systems, supporting the development phases until certification.
 Performing a systematic and comprehensive examination of System functions to identify and classify failure conditions of those functions according to their severity.
 Establishing the System Safety requirements and performing preliminary evaluations to determine that the proposed architecture can reasonably be expected to meet the safety objectives.
 Generating evidences to demonstrate in front of the Airworthiness Authorities that the final system architecture meets required System Safety requirements.
 Performing analyses of Common-Cause (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis).
 Performing Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to demonstrate the Continuous Airworthiness of the platform.
 Manage and establish safety requirements at the interface to interacting systems.
 Manage input from and output to interfacing technical domains and technology (processes, maintenance, human factos, aircraft performance, structures, quality, etc.).
 Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability.
 All these activities comprise all levels of development, from Aircraft level down to detailed requirements regarding hardware and Software.
 Required skills 
 As a successful candidate, you will be able to demontrate the following skills and experience:
 Master degree of Aeronautical or Industrial Engineer (or similar discipline).
 Good Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems.
 System Safety Assessment experience would be an advantage, at least System Engineering experience with interface to Safety Assessment/Airworthiness/Certification.
 Advanced skills with MS Office are presumed.

 Team working skills and problem-solving mind.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a System Safety Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the Aircraft Development Safety Team. The team is multicultural, multidisciplinary, and offers a 360-degree view of the aircraft development process. You will work closely with Design Offices, Chief Engineering, System Suppliers, and Airworthiness Authorities. The jobholder will reinforce our team to ensure that Airbus military products are designed, developed, and certified according to the highest safety and airworthiness standards.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 Perform System Safety Assessment (SSA) activities for military aircraft systems from development phases until final certification.
 Identify and classify failure conditions by conducting systematic examinations of system functions based on their severity.
 Establish System Safety requirements and perform preliminary evaluations to ensure the proposed architecture meets safety objectives.
 Generate technical evidence to demonstrate compliance with required safety standards in front of Airworthiness Authorities.
 Conduct safety analyses including Common-Cause (Particular Risk, Zonal, and Common Mode) and Continuous Airworthiness Risk Analyses.
 Manage supplier data and safety requirements at the interface of interacting systems, hardware, software, and technical domains.
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:
 Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree, or a related discipline.
 Experience: Professional experience in Systems Engineering with interfaces to Safety, Airworthiness, or Certification.
 Technical knowledge: Good understanding of Aircraft systems and advanced MS Office skills.
 Languages: Advanced level in English.
 Soft skills: Teamwork mindset, problem-solving skills, and high adaptability to work in a networking mode.
 Valuable / Nice to have: Experience with Safety Tools (e.g., Isograph FaultTree+) and System Safety Assessment (SSA) experience will be valued.
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: 
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. 
 Attractive salary. 
 Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance. 
 Collective transport service in some sites. 
 Benefits such as health insurance, em ployee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. 
 On-sit e facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. 
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. 
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. 
 Special rates in products & benefits.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Primary Flight Control System Designer (m/f) to join the Flight Control & Guidance Systems department, based in Toulouse, France. 
 You will be part of a team of about 20 people in charge of developing and designing the Primary Flight Control computers from earlier specification till validation. 
 You will be working on the IFCS (Integrated Flight Control System) project, aiming at designing the next generation of Flight Control Computer for the Airbus Aircraft family. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Participating in the primary flight computers specifications (using formal specification tools, like SCADE) and in the integration of flight controls laws in the PFCS computers, 
 Realising or following the definition of interfaces between Primary Flight Control computers and other avionics systems, 
 Participating in the definition of tools and methods for the specification of Primary Flight Control computers and establishing the applicable specification rules, 
 Writing the Test requirements (Simulation, Laboratory or Flight) and following the associated progress, 
 Participating in the safety analysis linked to Primary Flight Control System, 
 Producing the required technical evidences needed for certification, 
 Writing the documents associated with Primary Flight Control computers specification. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 A first experience in Flight Control System and/or System Design is required 
 System engineering methods 
 Aircraft flight control systems and equipment (Avionics systems) 
 Overall computing and communication 
 Communication skills to convince, justify and influence 
 Some knowledge of project management would be a significant advantage 
 Languages skills: French (intermediate minimum) + English (negotiation) 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply now!

Job Description: 
 Candidate profile:
 1. Educație și Formare 
 Studii superioare tehnice: Absolvent al unei facultăți cu profil tehnic (Inginerie Mecanică, Transporturi, Autovehicule Rutiere, Aerospațială, etc.). 
 2. Experiență Profesională 
 Experiența anterioară într-un rol tehnic, de suport ingineresc, planificare a producției sau mentenanță (în orice industrie, nu doar aviație) constituie un avantaj , dar nu este o condiție eliminatorie . 
 Experiența în lucrul cu manuale de reparații, cataloage de piese sau sisteme de gestiune a datelor reprezintă un plus.
 3. Abilități și Competențe 
 Înțelegere tehnică: Capacitatea de a citi, interpreta și extrage informații din documentații tehnice (manuale, fișe tehnologice, scheme sau desene industriale). 
 Limbi străine: Cunoașterea limbii engleze la un nivel mediu (în special tehnic - citit/scris), necesar pentru parcurgerea instrucțiunilor de lucru ale producătorului. 
 Competențe digitale: Abilități bune de operare PC (pachetul MS Office, Google Drive, etc) și ușurință în învățarea unor programe noi de planificare și gestiune. 
 4. Profil Personal 
 Atenție la detalii: Capacitatea de a lucra organizat și de a documenta corect și precis activitățile. 
 Atitudine orientată spre învățare: Disponibilitatea de a asimila proceduri noi și de a participa la trainingurile interne oferite de companie pentru înțelegerea legislației aeronautice și a standardelor de calitate. 
 Simț de răspundere și orientare către siguranță (Safety-first mindset): Responsabilitate asumată, înțelegând că munca desfășurată în back-office are un impact direct asupra siguranței zborului. 
 Abilități de comunicare și lucru în echipă: Capacitatea de a colabora eficient și deschis cu echipa pentru a asigura un flux de lucru continuu și fără blocaje. 
 Gândire analitică și orientare spre soluții: O abordare proactivă în fața provocărilor zilnice, capacitatea de a rezolva probleme de planificare și de a adapta rapid fișele de lucru atunci când apar situații tehnice neprevăzute. 
 Job mission and main responsibilities:
 Întocmirea documentației de lucru (MRO): Elaborați, structurați și actualizați pachetele de lucru (Work Packages), solutile de reparații, fișele tehnologice și instrucțiunile specifice de mentenanță, în conformitate cu manualele oficiale ale aeronavelor (AMM, MSM, SRM). 
 Analiza cerințelor clienților: Evaluați solicitările operatorilor de elicoptere, buletinele de service (Service Bulletins) și directivele de navigabilitate (Airworthiness Directives) pentru a le transpune corect în planul de inspectie al aeronavei. 
 Managementul neconformităților și defectelor constatate: Completați toate detaliile defectelor constatate în timpul inspecțiilor inițiale sau pe parcursul lucrărilor (coroziune, uzuri, fisuri, avarii) în sistemele de gestionare a mentenanței. 
 Adresați prompt neconformitățile constatate pe flux pentru a evita întârzierile în livrarea aeronavei. 
 Definiți soluții tehnice eficiente pentru remedierea defectelor, colaborând cu fabricantul sau cu reprezentanții tehnici ai grupului Airbus atunci când reparația depășește manualul standard. 
 Implicare activă în proiecte: Participați la proiecte complexe de modernizare (retrofitting), customizare sau implementare de noi capabilități de reparație în cadrul AHRo. 
 Optimizarea activităților de mentenanță: Propuneți activitățile necesare (achiziția de scule speciale, optimizarea fluxului în productie, reducerea timpului de imobilizare la sol a elicopterului - TAT) pentru creșterea eficienței operaționale. 
 Dezvoltare continuă (Training): Participați la cursurile de instruire și perfecționare (tehnice, de tip de aeronavă sau de legislație aeronautică EASA Part 145) pentru a vă menține certificările și cunoștințele la standardele stricte Airbus.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Architecte Système Junior (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Architecture Système et Spécifications basé à Elancourt , France.
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des solutions de communication et collaboration à usage des forces de sécurité pour les missions critiques en utilisant notre technologie Agnet. Au sein des équipes projets, vous serez impliqué(e) avec les architectes déjà présents dans l’étude, la définition et les spécifications de différents composants de la solution visant à améliorer notre offre Agnet dans un cadre de développement international incluant des équipes Airbus et ses partenaires.
 Pour en savoir plus sur nos activités, regardez notre site : https://www.securelandcommunications.com/agnet 
 Vos challenges : 
 Travailler avec les responsables produits pour capturer les besoins utilisateurs et les exigences associées
 Contribuer à la rédactions des spécifications de la solution technique des différents produits inclus dans la solution Agnet
 Participer à la définition et modélisation des architectures fonctionnelles et physiques des composants 
 Participer à des études de faisabilité technique sur les nouvelles fonctions
 Valider en collaboration avec les autres architectes les options techniques et les technologies sélectionnées
 Participer au choix des partenaires potentiels et choisir les meilleurs
 Discuter avec ces partenaires leur plan de développement produits (architecture, interfaces, conformité aux standards 3GPP)
 Supporter nos équipes d’Intégration et Validation durant les phases de test produit
 Supporter l’exécution du projet en respectant son planning
 Supporter nos équipes devant les clients pour les discussions techniques et les démonstrations
 Votre profil : 
 BAC + 5 dans le domaine de l’ingénierie de réseaux, les télécommunications 
 Bonne connaissance des systèmes de radiocommunications larges bandes (3GPP, 4G/5G), idéalement les solutions de Push-To-Talk et la norme 3GPP MCX
 Capacité à travail dans un environnement international complexe
 Connaissance de l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle dans un contexte professionnel et si possible pour l’écriture de spécifications d’architecture
 Les connaissances suivantes sont un réel avantage pour cette position : 
 Sécurité des réseaux
 Compétences en réseaux IP et voix sur IP (SIP en particulier)
 Infrastructure cloud incluant les micro-services, l’orchestration et les bases de données
 Supervision et Observabilité
 Haute disponibilité, redondance et méthodes de mise à jour
 Connaissance des solutions pour les différents verticaux dans un environnement 4G/5G (industrie, défense, sécurité publique, transports…)
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’Instruction Générale Interministérielle 1300 du 9 août 2021 (§1.2.2.1) 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 A deux pas du Château de Versailles et située à proximité de Paris, Elancourt est une ville dynamique, faisant partie de l'agglomération de Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines. La ville propose diverses activités culturelles et de plein air grâce à un riche réseau d'associations. Plusieurs options sont disponibles pour se rendre sur le site d'Airbus par les transports en commun.
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus et plan d’actionnariat salarié avec attribution d'actions gratuites sur la base du volontariat.
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services.
 Bien-être / santé : couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




 


ABOUT THE TEAM 

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. 

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

 
 


ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll be instrumental in visualising insights generated by our data scientists for our clients. Working closely with cross-functional delivery teams, especially within the Government & Public Services Business Unit, you will help solve unique challenges using AI and Machine Learning. 

 

We're looking for an entrepreneurial technologist to drive industry best practices and standards within our evolving frontend guild and bring Faculty's machine learning work to life.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 

 - Collaborating closely with data scientists, data engineers, and design specialists to build client-facing products 

 - Prioritisation, planning, coordination, and communication of frontend features to internal and external stakeholders

 - Setting up and maintaining the development and deployment infrastructure for your dedicated frontend team

 - Maintaining and enforcing the technical best practices and standards across Faculty's entire frontend capacity

 - Creating and maintaining reusable component libraries for use in projects company-wide

 - Providing training, mentoring, and onboarding support for new frontend engineers

 - Acting as the go-to authority for frontend software engineering within your team

 
 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 

 - You have demonstrated experience in building scalable, maintainable, and well-tested web applications using React

 - You are highly proficient in foundational web technologies, including ES6 JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3

 - You have hands-on experience writing TypeScript or other typed languages, contributing to robust codebases

 - You are experienced in data visualisation techniques and implementations, such as d3, to bring data to life

 - You have exposure to deployment into the Cloud with platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

 - You possess a strong focus on technical excellence, eager to set standards and mentor others to build a collaborative, high-performing culture

 


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 

 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

 3. System Design (90 minutes)

 4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

items.desc:
We are looking for a full-stack software developer with DevOps experience. In this role, you will be a member of the Web, DevOps and Authoring section in the IT -PW group.
 We have been consolidating all Web hosting services on our Platform as a Service (PaaS) infrastructure based on OpenShift/OKD4, including the supported CERN Web Content Management Systems (Drupal, WordPress). By joining us, you will support and contribute to the continuous improvement of .CERN top-level domain management and hosting.
 CERN is managing its own top level internet domain . This generic top-level domain (gTLD) is used for hosting highly visible public websites such as CERN , Careers , openlab , etc.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Supporting and further integration of the handling of the top-level domain .CERN, including the process of certificate procurement and automation of certificate renewal.
 Implementation of features for the CERN Web infrastructure services, including the Web Services Portal and dedicated functionality such as information retrieval from .CERN sites and extensions to the hosting mechanisms used for .CERN sites.
 Your profile: 
 Experience with full-stack software development.
 Experience with version control systems and CI/CD workflows.
 Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes / OpenShift is a plus.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proactive mindset to identify challenges and drive innovative solutions.
 Good communication and collaboration skills, with ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
 Strong commitment to user satisfaction, actively seeking feedback and collaborating with users to continuously improve services.
 Skills: 
 Programming in Python, JavaScript, React.
 Knowledge of Web protocols and technologies (including certificates).
 Git, CI/CD tools, test and deployment automation.
 Knowledge of Web Content Management Systems would be an asset.
 Linux and Bash scripting.
 Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift/OKD container technology is a plus.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Software or computer engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Hybrid
 Target start date: 01-June-2026
 Job reference: IT-PW-WDA-2026-108-GRAE
 Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
 Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer
 Global Benefits 
 A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
 Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
 Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
 A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
 Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
 On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! 
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART! 
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something bigger—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 Our Industrial Placement Programme 
 Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
 Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.
 During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.
 What you will do as an Industrial Placement Detector IC Design Engineer 
 You will support the design and development of our world leading infrared imaging products for use in remote sensing and thermal imaging applications including earth observation, border surveillance, search and track systems and laboratory equipment. 
 You will be introduced to utilising state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, acceptance and product support.
 You will interface with customers (internal and external) on many factors within the design and liaise closely with Engineers from all other disciplines including Mechanical, Software, Systems, Supportability and Design Integrity. 
 This role will be based within our mixed-signal IC design team, where you will gain experience working at transistor, cell or block level schematic and layout as well as testing of devices within the lab. 
 Key Areas of Responsibility 
 Support design, simulation and verification of circuit blocks
 Support transistor level layout of circuit blocks
 Support characterisation of circuits in the lab to retrieve circuit measurement data
 Assist in the progression of IC design development activities
 Support test set-up and automation of data acquisition
 Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required 
 Qualifications 
 All of our Industrial Placement roles require you to be currently studying an electronics biased degree including modules covering topics such as digital design, analogue design and signal processing with experience of using PCB design and simulation tools is highly desirable.
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
 Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
 Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
 Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing …

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 A propos de vos missions 
 Conception de Circuits de Test pour Capteurs d’Images 
 L’Equipe 
 L’équipe Pixel & TestChip Design regroupe des compétences variées qui lui permettent de supporter les besoins de la roadmap R&D Imager de la Division Imaging au sein de STMicroelectronics . Elle est organisée sur deux sites : un à Crolles et l’autre à Edinburgh. L’équipe est responsable du développement des pixels avancés, des SPAD et de leurs circuits de tests associés.
 Le Poste 
 L’équipe Pixel & TestChip Design de Crolles est à la recherche d’une(e) Designer Analog. 
 La personne retenue développera et mettra à jour les circuits de tests utilisés pour la caractérisation des Pixels et des SPAD. Il travaillera en collaboration étroite avec les Architectes, les équipes de caractérisation et de process pour définir les spécifications précises des circuits. Le design « full custom » du CAB (Custom Analog Block) nécessite à la fois des compétences de layout, de simulations, ainsi qu’une connaissance des procédés de fabrication des technologies CMOS avancées (40nm, 28FDSOI, 3D stacking)
 L’innovation est un autre aspect non négligeable du poste qui offre l’opportunité d’utiliser les connaissances de Développement Process, de Physique et de Design Avancé, pour augmenter la compétitivité de nos circuits de tests, tout en prenant en compte les exigences de nos capteurs.
 Le profil retenu 
 Le profil retenu doit avoir un esprit d’équipe et être hautement motive. Ce poste requiert la compréhension des systèmes imageurs (capture d’image) dans son ensemble. C’est pourquoi un des facteurs clés de réussite nécessite de très fortes interactions entre collègues, localement, mais également au sein de la Division Imaging.
 Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les sites de Crolles, Grenoble, Edinburgh et Singapore, ce qui nécessitera de développer et d’adopter des méthodes de travail et de « reporting ».
 A propos de vous 
 Compétences et Expériences Clés 
 • Diplomé(e) d'un Bac +5 en physique, microélectronique, ingénierie électronique ou équivalent.
 • Environnement Cadence (schéma et layout)
 • Design analogue et simulations “mixed signal”
 • Dispositifs photoniques (pixel, SPAD), capteurs d’images
 Autres Compétences et Expériences 
 • Procédés de fabrication des technologies CMOS avancées
 • Fonctionnement des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, expériences de caractérisation des composants semi-conducteurs ou de circuits
 • Communication, expérience de travail dans un environnement multidisciplinaire
 • Banc de caractérisation optique
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
 Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

Job Description Summary 
At Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace Business unit, we’ve been reimagining the power of flight for more than 100 years. We are specialized in the design, production and maintenance of components and systems for both the civil and military aviation. 
As IT Product Owner for Supply Chain, you will lead the evolution and management of digital platforms and drive projects that enable the Avio Aero Supply Chain organization to meet the specific requirements and regulations of military programs, with a particular focus on manufacturing and quality processes.
In this role you will ensure alignment with civil program platforms, leveraging shared blueprints, infrastructures, and vendors to maximize efficiency. 
 Job Description 
 Essential Responsibilities 
 In this role, you will:
 Own the whole Digital application lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment, adoption, and maintenance.
 Manage project schedule, risks, costs, and any non-standard events ensuring successful delivery and measurable customer impact through KPIs.
 Act as a bridge between Business functions, IT, external stakeholders maintaining clear communication with end-users and management.
 Contribute to the Digital operations to ensure business continuity, efficiency, and ongoing improvement.
 Proactively explore alternate technologies and make informed choices based on experience and impact analysis.
 Lead cross-functional teams to deliver digital solutions that meet military program requirements while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
 Ensure compliance to GE standards and practices, driving IT operational excellence.
 Partner with Business Leaders and Users to identify needs, improve business processes and deliver effective digital solutions.
 Ensure alignment with the broader GE Aerospace within DT Function.
 Strongly interact and collaborate within Digital Technology teams in all Sites.
 Develop key Business process knowledge to support Supply Chain operations.
 Serve as the site focal point for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), ensuring alignment between business requirements, operational needs, and digital technology solutions.
 Own the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) product roadmap for the assigned site(s), balancing business priorities, operational needs, and technology strategy.
 Act as the primary point of contact between Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Digital Technology teams for MES-related initiatives and continuous improvement activities.
 Drive the adoption, enhancement, and operational support of MES solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise standards.
 Identify opportunities to improve shopfloor processes through MES capabilities, digital manufacturing technologies, and integration with enterprise systems.
 Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in MES and shopfloor digital processes, acting as a trusted advisor for Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality organizations.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline.
 Good knowledge of Supply Chain processes.
 Experience working with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), preferably DELMIA Apriso, or equivalent shopfloor digital solutions.
 Understanding of manufacturing processes and shopfloor operations within a complex industrial environment.
 Ability to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into digital solutions and process improvements.
 Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset. 
 Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.
 Team-oriented attitude and inclusiveness. 
 Ability to work in ambiguity and deliver solutions with clear assumptions.
 Ability to exploit new technologies to improve Supply Chain processes.
 Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive adoption across diverse teams.
 Fluent in Czech and English (spoken and written).
 EU work permit. 
 Desired characteristics 
 Previous experience in similar role.
 Good customer-oriented approach with a focus on quality and cost. 
 Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), preferably DELMIA Apriso.
 Knowledge of manufacturing digitalization, shopfloor connectivity, Industrial IoT, or Industry 4.0 solutions.
 Experience supporting manufacturing process transformation and digital adoption initiatives.
 Familiarity with aerospace, manufacturing, or highly regulated industrial environments.
 Competencies in Agile and Scrum methodologies. 
 Ability to use Lean and 6 sigma tools and drive change.
 Good analytical and problem resolution skills.
 Motivated to grow, proactive and able to set own action plans.
 What we offer 
 Smart working and work life-balance 
 Avio Aero, when possible, promotes remote work and encourages a good, healthy and satisfying work-life balance. We value our employees’ wellbeing; hence we offer a variety of improvement …
