items.desc:
¡Hola! 
 Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. 
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. 
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. 
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! 
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Mariana ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Buscamos un/a Responsable de Negocio (RN) de Captación Agentes Málaga para la Dirección Territorial Sur / Canarias, con un rol clave en el desarrollo, dinamización y crecimiento de una red de agentes. La posición tiene como objetivo garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales en los negocios de Particulares, Empresas y Vida, asegurando un crecimiento sostenible y rentable. 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades? 
 Liderar, gestionar y desarrollar un panel de agentes asignado, impulsando su crecimiento y profesionalización, y asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales bajo criterios de rentabilidad y calidad. 
   Tu rol combina gesti ó n comercial, desarrollo de personas y visi ó n estrat é gica del negocio: 
 Captación y gestión de agentes: 
 Identificar, atraer y seleccionar nuevos agentes para la red. 
 Evaluar candidatos y formalizar su incorporación. 
 Garantizar una adecuada puesta en marcha operativa de los nuevos agentes. 
 Dinamización y desarrollo del negocio: 
 Mantener una relación continua con los agentes, tanto presencial como en remoto. 
 Realizar seguimiento de objetivos y resultados comerciales. 
 Detectar oportunidades de crecimiento en el mercado, anticipando tendencias y movimientos de la competencia. 
 Seguimiento y desarrollo de agentes: 
 Acompañar a los agentes en su desarrollo profesional mediante planes de carrera. 
 Realizar sesiones de mentoring y seguimiento. 
 Identificar desviaciones en resultados y activar planes de mejora y mitigación. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos: 
 Fuerte orientación a resultados y visión de negocio. 
 Habilidad para liderar e influir sin dependencia jerárquica directa. 
 Capacidad analítica y toma de decisiones basada en datos. 
 Proactividad, autonomía y capacidad de organización. 
 Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relación interpersonal. 
 Experiencia en gestión comercial y desarrollo de negocio. 
 Valorable experiencia en gestión de redes de agentes o canales indirectos. 
 Experiencia en gestión de clientes o cuentas relevantes. 
 Conocimiento y manejo de herramientas digitales y colaborativas (Teams, Power BI, CRM, entre otras). 
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. 
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. 
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar. 
 Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y …

 Education 
Degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.
 Experience 
 Relevant experience in demand planning, material planning, inventory management, procurement or supply chain management .
 Experience working with material availability and inventory planning is valued.
 Experience within an international or global organization is an advantage.
 Know-how 
 Good knowledge of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) processes and supply chain planning principles.
 Experience with SAP R/3, SAP S/4 or comparable ERP systems .
 Good analytical skills and confidence working with supply chain data and KPIs.
 Understanding of inventory management, master data and planning parameters .
 Ability to identify supply challenges, understand root causes and translate data into appropriate actions.
 Languages 
 Very good command of English , written and spoken.
 Additional languages are an advantage.

 You are curious, adaptable and motivated to continuously develop your knowledge.

 Cumplir con la cuota establecida en el presupuesto anual, a través del desarrollo de proyectos que brinden soluciones a las necesidades de los clientes asignados.

items.desc:
Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? 
 En Telefónica, hacemos que sea posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de última generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT o ciberseguridad. 
 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras, diseñamos el futuro . Buscamos personas que tengan inquietudes, entusiasmo y pasión por lo que hacen, que no se conformen y que quieran crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu lugar. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 La Dirección de Derivados financieros ejecuta las decisiones de gestión de costes y riesgos financieros, mediante (i) la negociación de derivados financieros, con una cartera viva de 78.000 millones € y mas de 2700 operaciones al año, (ii) Realiza monitorización continua del riesgo agregado del Grupo en FX/IR que pueden afectar el FCF, la cuenta de resultados y los ratios de endeudamiento, con el objetivo de proteger la solvencia del Grupo, (iii) Contribuye al diseño de actuaciones en mercados financieros, basadas en la visión sobre la evolución futura de tipos de interés y de cambio, y (iv) Gestiona la liquidez para cubrir las necesidades financieras diarias. 
 En cuanto a los objetivos que se persiguen desde el área, están los siguientes: 
 Dominar las características de los diferentes instrumentos financieros de cobertura (swaps de tipo de interés swaps de tipo de cambio, forwards, opciones,…) para definir la estructura más adecuada que optimice la relación rentabilidad/riesgo. Ser capaz de construir una visión de mercado para evaluar riesgos y proporcionar recomendaciones. 
 Negociar las operaciones, valorando previamente las mismas, para conseguir las mejores condiciones, poniendo en competencia a los bancos. 
 Recopilar los Inputs y Datos de Mercado que se utilizan para la correcta valoración de la cartera de Derivados del Holding. 
 Realizar en coordinación con el área de Posición el seguimiento exhaustivo de las posiciones asignadas. 
 Elaborar de las curvas IFRS16 para la correcta valoración de los contratos de arrendamiento del Grupo (~EUR 8.000M). 
 Seguir los límites, ratings y métricas internas de riesgo por contrapartida (CDS). 
 Calcular el CVA/DVA (riesgo de contrapartida). 
 Participar activamente en la realización del presupuesto anual de Gastos Financieros. 
 En un futuro, podría Gestionar (análisis, seguimiento y contratación) de las posiciones delegadas de acuerdo a las directrices establecidas por el Director de Derivados 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Habilidades de negociación con entidades financieras. 
 Proactividad en la proposición de eficiencias financieras que pudieran detectarse. 
 Coordinación y comunicación con otras áreas financieras del Grupo. 
 Saber asignar las prioridades cuando se solapan varias solicitudes urgentes. 
 Adaptación a las nuevas necesidades que se puedan requerir en un entorno cambiante. 
 Capacidad para desenvolverse eficazmente en entornos de alta exigencia y ritmo dinámico. 
 Excel avanzado, así como otras herramientas de Office. 
 Nivel de inglés avanzado 
 ¿Como contribuirás con tus capacidades al propósito del rol? 💼 
 Comunicación y colaboración con distintos equipos del área: Back Office, Middle Office, Tesorería, Sistemas, filiales de Grupo, etc. 
 Registro de operaciones en sistemas de captura de transacciones y fichero de posición. 
 Elaboración de Ficheros de Control para el seguimiento de las posiciones asignadas. 
 Actualización y validación de datos de mercado diarios, que se incorporan diariamente en los sistemas corporativos de valoración, riesgos y contabilización. 
 Apoyo en la correcta valoración de los derivados contratados. 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Formacion en :Matematicas Financieras, Economía, Ingenieria o equivalentes 
 Se valorará el conocimiento de aplicaciones financieras, Bloomberg, Reuters… 
 Ofimática: familiaridad con paquete MS Office, Programación y facilidad de aprendizaje de sistemas informáticos. 
 IDIOMAS: Ingles Fluido hablado y escrito 
 EXPERIENCIA de, al menos, 4 años en departamento Financiero de Corporate, Fondo, Banca. 
 ¿Qué ventajas tendrás por formar parte de nuestro equipo? 💙 
 Proyectos transformadores. En Telefónica formarás parte de proyectos de alto impacto, que marcan tendencia y responden a los retos de conectividad y transformación digital de nuestra sociedad. 
 Desarrollo profesional . Tendrás un largo recorrido y aprendizaje a escala global, gracias a nuestra presencia en diferentes …

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 TBS es Tech, Brands y Stories y, si somos lo que hacemos, en TBS somos muchas cosas. 
 Somos una productora, somos una agencia, somos una creadora de contenidos. Nos encanta el entretenimiento, y nos mueve montar, crear, contar buenas historias. Es lo que hacemos en las tres verticales que dan sentido a nuestro nombre.

 Experiencia mínima de 3 años en la conducción y manejo de vehículos de características similares.

 Serás responsable de garantizar la coherencia global de la transformación, desde la identificación de la necesidad hasta su adopción operativa, asegurando la alineación entre negocio, arquitectura, procesos, operación y proveedores. Además, velarás por maximizar el valor aportado por cada iniciativa y minimizar los riesgos asociados a su implantación, impulsando una ejecución eficiente y sostenible de la transformación.

 Analizar impactos sobre procesos y sistemas end-to-end. 
 Proponer alternativas funcionales y tecnológicas considerando valor de negocio, esfuerzo e impacto operativo.

 Diseñar capacidades funcionales alineadas con los procesos comerciales y operacionales. 
 Identificar oportunidades de automatización y optimización de procesos end-to-end. 
 Garantizar la coherencia entre modelo operativo, catálogo, procesos y arquitectura tecnológica. 
 Incorporar capacidades basadas en IA cuando aporten mejoras en eficiencia, calidad o experiencia de cliente. 
 Promover modelos reutilizables y escalables para la definición de nuevas capacidades de negocio. 
 Reto 4: Implantación y Coordinación de Iniciativas 
 Responsabilizarse de las iniciativas asignadas desde la fase de definición hasta la puesta en producción. 
 Coordinar las actividades técnicas necesarias entre negocio, equipos de desarrollo, operaciones y proveedores. 
 Realizar el seguimiento de hitos, riesgos, dependencias e impactos para garantizar el avance de las iniciativas. 
 Resolver desviaciones funcionales o técnicas durante la ejecución. 
 Participar en revisiones técnicas, pruebas integradas y validaciones funcionales. 
 Liderar la coordinación de las pruebas UAT y asegurar la correcta preparación para producción. 
 Facilitar la comunicación entre los distintos participantes de la iniciativa. 
 Reto 5: Evolución Tecnológica y Coordinación de Proveedores 
 Analizar propuestas técnicas de proveedores y validar su alineación con la arquitectura target. 
 Coordinar dependencias técnicas entre múltiples equipos y vendors. 
 Realizar el seguimiento de entregables y compromisos técnicos asociados a las iniciativas. 
 Identificar oportunidades de simplificación, reducción de deuda técnica y optimización del ecosistema BSS/OSS. 
 Promover la reutilización de capacidades y componentes comunes. 
 Contribuir a la evolución tecnológica del dominio mediante la evaluación de nuevas soluciones y tendencias.

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 La unidad de PROJECTS & INTEGRATION de Telefónica Cybersecurity & Cloud Tech juega un papel protagonista como Hub de conocimiento técnico interno de las capacidades de Telefónica Tech (Global Cloud Technology & Operations), así mismo concentramos la relación con diversas Áreas internas de TTECH (Preventa, Comercial, Producto, Finanzas y resto de los equipos de Operaciones). 
 El Área de Projects & Integration Center TTECH es clave en la consultoría técnica e implantación de las soluciones que necesitan nuestros clientes de Telefónica. Aportamos valor técnico, expertise especializado y capacidades de Delivery. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 El Arquitecto de Sistemas Microsoft desempeñará un papel estratégico en el diseño, validaciones técnicas y despliegue de soluciones y proyectos TI/Cloud que resuelven las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Conocimiento y sólida comprensión de todos los sistemas tecnológicos y de computación en onpremise y cloud privada, así como en cloud pública, incluidas las plataformas front-end, servidores, almacenamiento y redes de administración. 
 El candidato ideal tendrá experiencia en el diseño, despliegue y control de infraestructuras, estableciendo y liderando las dinámicas de mejora continua para su mantenimiento. Actitud positiva y excelentes habilidades de comunicación para compartir eficazmente sus conocimientos técnicos. 
 Colaborar en el diseño y en la supervisión de un plan de trabajo global de transición de servicio a nuevos equipos de Operaciones. 
 Diseño, desarrollo y validaciones técnicas de soluciones complejas basadas principalmente en cloud privada frente a la pública. 
 Hacer recomendaciones sobre estrategias de integración, arquitecturas de TI, plataformas y arquitecturas de aplicación necesarias para implementar una solución holística para nuestros clientes. 
 Liderazgo tecnológico interno dentro de Telefónica TECH de proyectos de transformación TI y sistemas del cliente. 
 Trabajar estrechamente y en colaboración con los equipos de Ingeniería y nuestros clientes de Telefónica para idear soluciones eficaces que respondan a las necesidades y expectativas actuales y futuras. 
 Validaciones técnicas de soluciones para clientes. 
 Documentación de diseños HLD y LLD y los procesos de transición asociados. 
 Tu día a día: 
 Diseñar arquitecturas estructuradas de empresa. 
 Definición de procesos de transición técnica que cuiden la disponibilidad del servicio, los riesgos y la coordinación de equipos multidisciplinares. 
 Diseño y colaboración en la implantación/transformación, junto a los equipos técnicos de Tech, de infraestructuras TI: almacenamiento, backup, virtualización, sistemas operativos, BBDD, VDI, red, seguridad y/o servicios de aplicación. 
 Liderazgo y coordinación técnica dentro del ámbito de los proyectos. 
 En resumen, este perfil técnico tendría un papel muy importante en la evaluación, diseño e implementación de soluciones de infraestructura para distintos clientes, asegurándose de que se cumplan las necesidades y requisitos de estos. 
 Su día a día sería muy diverso, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con equipos técnicos de TECH y clientes para garantizar el éxito de los proyectos.

 Experiencia demostrable en el diseño, implantación, evolución y transformación de plataformas Microsoft Active Directory en entornos empresariales complejos. 
 Experiencia en proyectos de consolidación, modernización y transformación de infraestructuras de identidad, incluyendo entornos híbridos basados en Active Directory y Microsoft Entra ID. 
 Experiencia en proyectos de migración de dominios, bosques (Forests), consolidación de directorios y adopción de servicios cloud de identidad.

 Experiencia liderando técnicamente proyectos de transformación tecnológica y gestionando la relación con áreas técnicas, de seguridad y de negocio. 
 Capacidad para elaborar y defender diseños de arquitectura tanto a nivel …

items.desc:
Telefónica Soluciones de Criptografía 
 En Telefónica Soluciones de Criptografía (TELCRYP) buscamos incorporar un/a Red Team & Penetration Testing Specialist con ganas de crecer, aportar su conocimiento y experiencia y participar activamente en la evolución de nuestro equipo de Red Team.
 Queremos atraer talento con experiencia en Test de Intrusión / Pentesting , conocimientos de desarrollo y una sólida comprensión de la Inteligencia Artificial aplicada a la ciberseguridad. Buscamos una persona con inquietud por aprender, capaz de afrontar retos técnicos complejos y de colaborar con diferentes equipos para identificar y contribuir a resolver vulnerabilidades.
 Si te apasiona la ciberseguridad ofensiva , disfrutas investigando nuevas formas de poner a prueba la seguridad de sistemas y aplicaciones y quieres seguir desarrollándote en este ámbito, esta posición puede ser para ti.
 ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? 
 Realizar Tests de Intrusión / Pentesting , participando en todas sus etapas: planificación, definición del alcance ( scoping ), ejecución y elaboración de informes.
 Analizar la seguridad de aplicaciones web , identificando vulnerabilidades y posibles vías de mejora.
 Desarrollar o modificar las herramientas necesarias para la ejecución de los pentests y otras actividades del equipo.
 Comunicar y gestionar los resultados con los equipos responsables de los sistemas afectados , colaborando con ellos en la resolución de las vulnerabilidades identificadas.
 Aplicar conocimientos de desarrollo de software para apoyar y evolucionar las capacidades técnicas del Red Team.
 Explorar y aplicar Inteligencia Artificial en casos de uso de ciberseguridad , contribuyendo a la evolución de las capacidades del equipo.
 Lo que buscamos en ti 
 Al menos 3 años de experiencia en Test de Intrusión / Pentesting. 
 Amplios conocimientos de seguridad en aplicaciones web .
 Capacidad para abordar de manera autónoma las diferentes fases de un pentest: planificación, scoping , ejecución y reporte.
 Capacidad para desarrollar o modificar herramientas en función de las necesidades de los proyectos.
 Conocimientos de desarrollo en Python y Go (Golang) .
 Experiencia o conocimientos de desarrollo web , tanto Backend con Python como Frontend con Vue.js.
 Conocimientos de Docker para el despliegue de soluciones.
 Sólida comprensión de los fundamentos de Inteligencia Artificial y de su aplicación práctica a casos de uso de ciberseguridad.
 Capacidad de comunicación y coordinación con diferentes equipos técnicos, así como orientación a la colaboración para la resolución de vulnerabilidades.
 Además, valoraremos especialmente 
 Experiencia en desarrollo de malware o herramientas de simulación APT .
 Conocimientos de OS Internals en Windows y Linux .
 Conocimientos de intrusión en entornos Windows Active Directory .
 Experiencia o conocimientos de ingeniería inversa .
 La actitud que marcará la diferencia 
 Formarás parte de un proyecto de Red Team en un entorno en el que podrás seguir aprendiendo y aportar tu conocimiento y experiencia para contribuir a la evolución del proyecto.
 Buscamos especialmente: 
 Pasión por la ciberseguridad ofensiva y curiosidad por entender cómo funcionan los sistemas y cómo mejorar su seguridad.
 Pensamiento analítico y orientación a la resolución de retos técnicos complejos .
 Iniciativa para investigar, desarrollar y adaptar herramientas a las necesidades de cada situación.
 Capacidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa con otros equipos técnicos.
 Curiosidad y aprendizaje continuo ante la evolución de las amenazas, las tecnologías y la Inteligencia Artificial.
 Si quieres seguir creciendo en el ámbito del Red Team y la seguridad ofensiva y te apetece aportar tu talento y experiencia a proyectos relevantes dentro de Telefónica Soluciones de Criptografía , queremos conocerte

WHO WE ARE 
 We are EssilorLuxottica, a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames and sunglasses. The Company brings together the complementary expertise of two industry pioneers, one in advanced lens technologies and the other in the craftsmanship of iconic eyewear, to create a vertically integrated business that is uniquely positioned to address the world’s evolving vision needs and the global demand of a growing eyewear industry.

 You do not see problems, you just see solutions

 In EssilorLuxottica you have the feeling of being part of a “success story”, no matter where you work in the EL world, you can really make an impact.
 Are you ready for this challenge?
 If yes, we are waiting for you.

 Your role 
 We are seeking a motivated and skilled R&D Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the developement of innovative solutions within our R&D department. 
 The ideal candidate has strong technical foundations and market aptitude for problem solving with experience in mechanical design and prototype development. 
 Main responsibilities: 
 Development of technical drawing packages for assemblies, in compliance with 
 manufacturing flows and production specifications. 
 Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams (mechanical engineers, industrial designers, and 
 other stakeholders) for product design, prototyping, and testing. 
 Analysis and identification of underlying principles to optimize design processes and reduce 
 development time. 
 Assessment of client needs through active listening and critical thinking, translating them 
 into concrete technical solutions. 
 Main requirements: 
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent qualification. 
 Proven experience in developing drawing packages for assemblies in line with 
 manufacturing processes. 
 Proficiency in CAD systems, with priority given to Autodesk Inventor. 
 Competence in Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools. 
 Good knowledge of English, both writen and spoken. 
 Excellent active listening, critical thinking, and teamwork skills. 
 Specific knowledge of vacuum equipment and PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) processes, 
 including related standards and regulations. 
 Experience in automation and robotics. 
 Familiarity with other CAD software such as Creo and SolidWorks. 
 Knowledge of the SAP system and Windchill PLM. 
 Advanced proficiency in the Microsot Office Suite.

 Access to our cutting-edge learning platform, Leonardo, and personalized development programs to help you grow professionally and personally.

 Access special offers for employees on a vast range of eyewear, eyecare products, and fashion apparel, so you can enjoy our world-class brands firsthand.

 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment​ 
 We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

 The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates cutting-edge, High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems as an essential service facility for science. The centre enables world-class research through its scientific user lab, which is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices in Lugano (headquarter) and Zurich.
 Project background
 With the convergence of HPC and cloud technology, supercomputing service providers like CSCS strive to improve our service portfolios that focus on large, complex, and diverse scientific and engineering applications. Effectively providing performant and capable storage systems supporting the needs of HPC platforms running on a multi-tenant infrastructure is complex and challenging engineering work.
 To support these efforts, CSCS is seeking a Storage Engineer (Systems Engineering) to join our team in Lugano. The position is initially offered on a two-year contract, with the possibility of extension. This position is funded by a project that will enable scientists to benefit from large scale climate and earth observation data, and will involve collaboration with partners such as the ETHZ Geolab and C2SM, as well as international partners such as ECMWF, NASA and NOAA.

 The main goal of this position is to implement and operate HPC storage services in a multi-tenant infrastructure. As a Storage Engineer you will directly contribute to the designing, implementation, maintenance, and documentation of storage services for HPC.

 Linux administration skills
 Generic filesystem aspects and functions (data, metadata, block-size etc.)
 Storage redundancy technologies (RAID, D-RAID, EC etc.)
 Backup solutions (DMF, TSM, Veeam) and backup concepts
 Object Storage concepts and S3 service usage/implementation
 Automation tools and framework, including CI/CD processes and ecosystem (e.g., Gitlab CI, HashiCorp Vault)
 Experience with the following is preferred, though there will be ample opportunities to learn and gain more experience with all of these skills on the job:
 Experience with parallel file systems (GPFS, Lustre) 
 Experience with Ceph Storage Clusters
 Experience with versioning systems and CI/CD workflows such as ArgoCD
 Experience with physical servers automated installation systems such as OpenCHAMI, MAAS, or Foreman
 Experience with developing Ansible configurations
 Experience developing services on top of Kubernetes
 You should have a bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running.  Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Note: This is a dual site based role as you will carry out work in both our Middenmeer and Schipol Datacenters. You will be based at one site but regular travel is required to the other so a driving licence/car is essential.
 Responsibilities 
 Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
 Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
 Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.
 Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
 Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. 
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities.
 Embodies our culture and values .
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications
 Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
 Due to dual site nature of the role a driving licence/car is essential. 
 Background Check Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications : 
 Some experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
 Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

items.desc:
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer 
 Pirelli UK Tyres Ltd – Carlisle 
 One of Europe’s leading tyre manufacturers, Pirelli UK Tyres Ltd, is seeking a Mechanical Maintenance Engineer to join us at our Carlisle factory.
 The successful applicant will work 40 hours per week, from 08:00-16:00 Monday to Friday. 
 Working within the Maintenance Department, and with the support and direction of the Maintenance Leadership Team, the Mechanical Maintenance Engineer will ensure all equipment is operating to the required standards to ensure safe operation and to maintain production requirements and quality standards.
 The objective is to improve the Safety, Quality and Overall Efficiency of the department, concentrating primarily on the maintenance aspects that can contribute to this improvement.
 Main duties include (but are not limited to): 
 Ensuring the correct completion of departmental maintenance tasks e.g. machine repairs, set ups, preventative maintenance checks and new installations
 Inspecting, assessing and taking action on planned work, modifications and breakdowns
 Installation and commissioning of new machinery in liaison with plant and process engineering staff
 Ensuring adherence to Company policy and statutory regulations especially in areas of Health, Safety and Engineering practice
 Completing all tasks as assigned by the supervisor
 Following all standard operating procedures of working
 Attending relevant training and development activities as required
 Although predominantly working days, candidates must also have the flexibility to cover a 3 shift rotating pattern and weekends when necessary.
 The successful candidate should be able to demonstrate the following abilities:
Education and professional background: 
 Time served mechanical engineer with appropriate Technical qualification
 HNC qualified or 3 years industrial experience
 Experience of maintaining and fault finding on industrial machinery
 Experience of maintaining hydraulic systems
 Experience of maintaining pneumatic systems
 Experience of maintaining industrial drive systems (gearboxes/sprockets/chains/belts etc.)
 Machining (lathe/milling machine) experience desirable
 Fabrication experience desirable
 Professional and personal aptitudes: 
 A sound problem solving ability
 Good communication and people management skills
 Sound technical knowledge of the processes and machinery
 Self-motivated, focussed and able to work on own initiative
 High level of resilience and able to work effectively under pressure
 Good organisation and IT skills
 The successful applicant can look forward to an excellent pay package and the opportunity to make an impact on our continuing success.
 If you would like to apply for this role, please submit your CV and covering letter via the Careers section of our Website: www.pirelli.com 
 The closing date for receipt of all applications is Friday 20th November 2026.

Privredna banka Zagreb d.d. je društvo čija je vizija biti uzor i centar izvrsnosti u području financijskog poslovanja u Hrvatskoj. Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija, odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću. Svi preduvjeti su tu, na Vama je samo da iskoristite. 
 Viši/Glavni menadžer za odnose s klijentima (m/ž) u SME centru Dalmacija 
 (mjesto rada Split) 
 Radno mjesto uključuje cjelokupan proces prodaje, odnosno: 
 kontaktiranje i akviziciju novih klijenata u SME/SMALL segmentu na području Splitsko-dalmatinske županije 
 direktnu prodaju rizičnih i nerizičnih proizvoda 
 prikupljanje dokumentacije i obradu zahtjeva za rizične proizvode 
 pisanje kreditnih prijedloga te administraciju (ugovorne i ostale) dokumentacije 
 brigu o postojećem portfelju klijenata 
 praćenje cjelokupnog poslovnog odnosa s klijentom, uzimajući u obzir strateške odrednice Banke i Grupe 
 Formalni uvjeti koje svi kandidati moraju zadovoljavati su: 
 VSS ekonomskog usmjerenja 
 poželjno najmanje dvije godine radnog iskustva u bankarstvu, u području upravljanja poslovnim odnosima s klijentima SME segmenta i/ili analize financijskih izvještaja tvrtki iz SME segmenta 
 aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu 
 Idealni kandidati za ovo radno mjesto iskazuju: 
 razvijene prodajne i komunikacijske vještine 
 samostalnost i organiziranost u obavljanju svakodnevnih zadataka 
 sklonost timskom radu i suradnji s ostalim organizacijskim dijelovima Banke 
 posvećenost ostvarenju dogovorenih i planiranih ciljeva 
 Što nudimo? 
 Mogućnost napretka u karijeri i profesionalno usavršavanje 
 dinamično i motivirajuće okruženje 
 izazovni projekti 
 stručni tečajevi, seminari, interni razvojni moduli 
 Ravnotežu poslovnog i privatnog života te brigu za zaposlenike 
 r ad izvan poslovnog prostora 
 sistematski pregled svake dvije godine 
 korporativni vrtić uz subvenciju 
 slobodan dan za rođendan 
 sportska udruga PBZ standard i MultiSport kartica 
 PBZ book club 
 Prigodne nagrade, dar djetetu, novčane nagrade 
 o karijeri u PBZ grupi više možete pročitati i na našim korporativnim stranicama 
 Zainteresirane kandidate pozivamo da se prijave za otvorenu poziciju najkasnije do nedjelje, 25. listopada 2026. 
 U Privrednoj banci Zagreb prepoznajemo vaš talent, pružamo vam vrhunske uvjete za profesionalni razvoj i želimo zajedno s vama stvarati nove vrijednosti. Ako ste ambiciozni i motivirani te želite napraviti izazovan iskorak u karijeri – javite nam se.

items.desc:
Dobre finančne odločitve se začnejo z dobrim pogovorom in zaupanjem. 
 Za vsakim bančnim računom, kreditom ali varčevanjem stoji zgodba. Nekdo načrtuje nakup prvega doma. Nekdo gradi finančno varnost za svojo družino. Nekdo potrebuje posvet za pomembno življenjsko odločitev. 
 V Intesi Sanpaolo Bank verjamemo, da so najboljše bančne storitve tiste, ki temeljijo na razumevanju, zaupanju in pristnem odnosu s stranko. Zato iščemo bančnega svetovalca, ki zna prisluhniti, razumeti potrebe ljudi in jim pomagati najti rešitve, ki bodo podpirale njihove cilje. 
 Če vas veseli delo z ljudmi, radi gradite dolgoročne odnose in želite svojo kariero razvijati v stabilnem ter spodbudnem okolju, vas vabimo, da se pridružite naši ekipi. 
 Kaj vam ponujamo? 
 zaposlitev za nedoločen čas s 3-mesečnim poskusnim obdobjem, 
 fleksibilen delovni čas, 
 strukturirano uvajanje in mentorstvo ob začetku dela, 
 strokovna izobraževanja ter možnosti osebnega in kariernega razvoja, 
 dodatne ugodnosti s področja zdravstvenega varstva, nezgodnega in pokojninskega zavarovanja, 
 sodelovanje v povezani in strokovni ekipi, 
 številne športne, družabne in timske dogodke na ravni banke in bančne skupine, 
 stabilno delovno okolje z jasno usmeritvijo v razvoj zaposlenih. 
 Kaj bo obsegalo vaše delo? 
 Grajenje in razvijanje odnosov z obstoječimi in novimi strankami, 
 svetovanje strankam pri izbiri bančnih produktov in storitev glede na njihove potrebe in življenjske cilje, 
 izvajanje poslov osnovnega bančništva, plačilnega prometa ter blagajniških in trezorskih poslov, 
 nudenje strokovnega finančnega svetovanja v okviru osnovne obravnave strank, 
 zagotavljanje podpore strankam prek osebnih, telefonskih in digitalnih kanalov, 
 prepoznavanje poslovnih priložnosti ter prispevanje k odlični uporabniški izkušnji in uspešnosti poslovalnice. 
 Koga iščemo? 
 Iščemo osebo, ki uživa v delu s strankami, zna graditi zaupanje in verjame, da je prijazen, strokoven in odgovoren pristop ključ do dolgoročnih odnosov. 
 Pri vas cenimo: 
 odlične komunikacijske in medosebne veščine, 
 pozitiven, proaktiven in odgovoren pristop k delu, 
 usmerjenost k strankam in iskanju kakovostnih rešitev, 
 željo po učenju in osebnem razvoju, 
 sposobnost sodelovanja ter timsko naravnanost, 
 natančnost, zanesljivost in profesionalnost. 
 Kaj pričakujemo? 
 Najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo ekonomske ali druge ustrezne smeri, 
 razvite komunikacijske in svetovalne veščine, 
 odgovoren odnos do dela s strankami in ravnanja s podatki, 
 pripravljenost za stalno pridobivanje novih znanj in strokovni razvoj. 
 Prednost predstavljajo izkušnje v bančništvu ali finančnih storitvah ter licenca za posredovanje zavarovalniških produktov in licenca za trženje investicijskih storitev. 
 Vas zanima? 
 Če vas navdihuje delo z ljudmi in želite biti del okolja, kjer sta strokovnost in zaupanje v ospredju, vas vabimo, da nam pošljete svojo prijavo z življenjepisom. 
 Dobrodošli so tudi kandidati, ki še nimajo vseh zahtevanih izkušenj, vendar izkazujejo motivacijo za učenje, strokovni razvoj in delo s strankami. 
 Prijave sprejemamo do 10. novembra 2026. Veselimo se, da vas spoznamo.

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella Divisione Banca dei Territori, all'interno di Digital Channels Bdt, in una struttura che si occupa di definire la user experience e la user interfacce di piattaforme digitali multicanale a 360 gradi. Nello specifico sarai coinvolto sia nelle attività di design che in quelle inerenti la stesura dei requisiti di accessibilità (legge stanca e EAA) occupandoti inoltre delle smart interaction derivanti dall'interazione con intelligenza artificiale (App mobile, Desktop, Responsive, ATM) attraverso linee guida specifiche che garantiscano la facilità d'uso del prodotto e la soddisfazione dell'utente. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Proposta di approcci e soluzioni che rispondano ai brief progettuali
 Traduzione dei requisiti in wireframe e interfacce visive
 Partecipazione ad attività di co-design e user research
 Scrivere requisiti legati alle caratteristiche di accessibilità delle interazioni e alle applicazioni AI delle interazioni
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
 esperienza 3-5 nel ruolo
 conoscenza dei principi di accessibilità digitale del WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines), con capacità di applicarli concretamente nella progettazione di interfacce inclusive
 capacità di produrre output di design strutturati e di qualità, tra cui wireframe, mockup, prototipi interattivi e specifiche di consegna per il front-end, con attenzione alla coerenza visiva e alla chiarezza comunicativa verso il team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder
 conoscenze sia in ambito di Human Centered Design, con particolare attenzione alle metodologie di user research (interviste, test di usabilità, analisi euristica) che dell'intelligenza artificiale applicata alla progettazione User Experience/User Interface, con familiarità con i pattern di interazione legati a sistemi AI e con gli strumenti che abilitano il lavoro del designer in sinergia con l'AI (es. generazione di contenuti, prototipazione assistita, analisi dei dati utente).
 Rappresentano un titolo preferenziale, le seguenti conoscenze:
 laurea in Design o Comunicazione Visiva, oppure corsi privati di specializzazione nello stesso ambito
 laurea in ambito economico, ingegneristico, statistico, matematico o informatico accompagnate da esperienze in ambito di design
 esperienze pregresse, anche in ambito universitario, legate al lavoro di gruppo e alla progettazione di interfacce digitali e legati ad accessibilità e AI
 buona conoscenza software: Figma, Adobe XD, After Effects. È richiesta in generale una buona conoscenza dell'Adobe Creative Suite
 competenze in ambito di animazione (After Effects)
 ottima conoscenza dell'inglese
 Saranno inoltre considerate in via preferenziale le candidature di coloro che abbiano maturato significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali.

 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 38.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli

Role description The Data Analytics Engineer I operates as a developing contributor on data pipelines and data models of low to moderate
items.desc: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands. As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the world’s leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable and Rentalcars.com. Role description The Data Analytics Engineer I operates as a developing contributor on data pipelines and data models of low to moderate complexity, supporting the cross-brand data, reporting and analytics needs of Booking Holdings. This role contributes to clearly scoped deliverables — from ingestion, through transformation, to enablement of reporting — under the guidance and framework set by senior peers and the Solutions Architect. Success in this role means consistent, reliable delivery on assigned tasks and components for the business areas served by the team (such as Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Procurement, Market Intelligence and others), while building a strong foundation in the team's tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, Python, AWS, Terraform) and growing technical judgement under close guidance from Senior Engineers and the Solutions Architect. This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties Pipeline Development: Assists in building and maintaining data ingestion, transformation and orchestration pipelines on Snowflake, dbt and Dagster (or Airflow / equivalent), following established team standards and working under the guidance of senior engineers to deliver assigned components on time and to agreed quality. Data Modeling on Snowflake: Implements well-defined, low to moderate complexity dimensional data models on Snowflake based on requirements provided by Business Analysts and Product, closely following team conventions for naming, layering and documentation; exposure to other modeling approaches (e.g. Data Vault) is a plus. Python for Data Analytics Engineering: Writes clean, testable Python — including basic object-oriented code — for Dagster assets and general Data Analytics Engineering tasks, with support and code review from senior peers. - is considered a plus Source Integration: Helps integrate data from a variety of sources (ERPs, transactional systems, SaaS tools, flat files, spreadsheets, etc.), developing familiarity with the relevant business semantics. Quality, Testing & Monitoring: Writes basic tests (dbt tests, custom checks) and helps monitor data quality for the pipelines they contribute to, escalating anomalies to senior peers for investigation. Operational Excellence (Awareness Level): Learns to work within the team's CI/CD, Git, Docker and Terraform setup, contributing to DataOps practices under the direction of senior peers. Collaboration: Works closely with other Data Analytics Engineers, the Reporting team, Business Analysts and the Product Manager, asking questions and escalating ambiguity early to translate requirements into technical tasks. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Documents the tasks, models and pipelines they contribute to, and actively participates in code reviews and knowledge sessions to accelerate their learning. Role Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s Degree & 1-3 years of relevant experience Foundational understanding of relational and dimensional data modeling. Basic understanding of cloud data warehousing, ideally on Snowflake. Awareness of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball); Data Vault is a nice to have (*). Awareness of business domains involving data and reporting (such as Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Procurement, Market Intelligence or comparable areas); transferable experience from other domains or academic / internship projects is also valued. Basic awareness of data privacy and security concepts (GDPR/PII). Nice to have (*): Awareness of Risk & Control / SOX concepts and how they apply to data and reporting. Good working SQL skills on Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse — including joins, aggregations and window functions; awareness of performance basics. Some hands-on or academic exposure to Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse), with willingness to deepen this on the job. Familiarity with dbt (models, tests, documentation), or a strong willingness to learn it quickly. Working knowledge of Python, including basic object-oriented Python — used for Dagster assets and Data Analytics Engineering tasks. Awareness of Dagster, Airflow or another modern orchestrator (hands-on exposure is a plus (*)). Basic knowledge of Git; awareness of CI/CD pipelines. Awareness of AWS services for data workloads (e.g. S3); …

items.desc:
As a Junior SW Development Engineer you will design, implement, and maintain the Linux kernel, device drivers, and the full software stack for embedded controllers with a strong focus on advanced security features. Your work will directly contribute to the security and resilience of global communications infrastructure.
 We offer:
 Opportunity to shape the secure Linux foundation of cutting-edge telecom infrastructure.
 Access to advanced development tools, AI-assisted analysis platforms, and research resources.
 Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
 Continuous learning programs, mentorship, and support for professional certifications.
 An inclusive, innovative culture that values curiosity, diversity, and work-life balance.
Linux kernel & driver development – create and maintain kernel code and custom device drivers.
 Security-first platform design – embed security mechanisms throughout the stack, including:
 Secure Boot and trusted hardware root of trust.
 Disk and file-system encryption (e.g., dm-crypt, LUKS) for data-at-rest protection.
 FIPS-validated cryptographic modules to satisfy regulatory and industry compliance.
 Certificate-based authentication for secure boot, OTA updates, and inter-component communication.
 Build and integrate the bootloader, root-filesystem, and runtime environment for embedded controllers.
 Contribute to threat modeling, code reviews, static/dynamic analysis, and security testing (fuzzing, vulnerability scanning).
 Collaborate with hardware engineers and application SW teams in a multi-national development project.
You Have: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 Strong interest in Linux kernel development and embedded systems (ARM).
 Curiosity about device drivers (networking, storage, GPIO, I²C, SPI) and a desire to write/debug them.
 Proven programming skills in C/C++ and scripting (Python, Bash).
 Familiarity with version-control (Git) and CI/CD tools.
 Interest in modern security fundamentals, especially: Secure Boot, Disk and file-system encryption techniques, FIPS-compliant cryptography.
 Certificate-based authentication mechanisms.
 Good problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset 
 It would be nice if you also had: 
 Experience with embedded operating systems for telecom/networking equipment.
 Experience with security feature implementations.

items.desc:
You will be an integral part of the software organization that develops the embedded software for large-scale optical telecommunication systems. To support the needs of our customers we operate complex ASICs and FPGAs, run software in an embedded computer network of multicore CPUs, provide board support packages and carrier-grade application code, and maintain a CI/CD pipeline.
 We empower our engineers to be proactive problem-solvers: If you identify a bottleneck or a potential system improvement, you are encouraged to bring it forward and learn how to contribute to its resolution. In this role, you will utilize AI-driven Development Life Cycle (DLC) tools in your daily workflow. By leveraging advanced AI coding assistants and LLM-based utilities, we automate boilerplate tasks, accelerate unit test generation, and enhance code analysis. We want our engineers focused on high-level architecture and complex logic while utilizing the latest tooling to streamline execution.
Develop & Implement: Develop and maintain high-performance embedded applications for Intel and ARM architectures using Modern C++.
 Learn & Apply: Understand and apply STL, Boost, and asynchronous programming concepts to solve concurrency challenges under guidance.
 Quality Contribution: Assist in writing and executing unit, E2E, and stress tests to ensure robustness.
 Collaborate & Learn: Participate in code reviews and contribute to team design discussions in a global environment.
Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, and 0–2 years of relevant professional experience.
 C++ Expertise: Strong C/C++ and object-oriented programming skills, with knowledge of inter-process communication, multi-threading, and data structures.
 Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for Modern C++ standards and keeping up with emerging industry developments.
 Development Tools: Working knowledge of Git, Python, and GTest.
 Domain Knowledge: Experience in embedded software development, testing and debugging across hardware-software interfaces. Interest in learning WDM, OTN, and optical networking technologies.
 Teamwork & Communication: Effective English communication skills and the ability to collaborate successfully within a team environment.
 It would be nice if you also had:
 An academic project or internship experience in telecommunications (L0-L3 transport technologies).
 Fluency in German or willingness to learn.

 Description and Requirements
 Descripción y requisitos 
 ¡Si quieres transformar el futuro de la energía, buscamos Profesional Medioambiente y Laboratorio para incluir en nuestro equipo de de Power Plant Las Salinas en Spain-Puerto Del Rosario-Lg Central Salinas 
 Con quién trabajarás 
 La Central Térmica de Las Salinas es la principal instalación de generación eléctrica de la isla de Fuerteventura. Se trata de una instalación estratégica dentro del sistema eléctrico insular canario, caracterizado por ser aislado y no interconectado con el sistema peninsular. La CT de Las Salinas dispone de una potencia instalada aproximada de 185,3 MW, compuesta por 11grupos de generación, integrando 9 motores diésel (fuel oil y gasóleo), 2 turbinas de gas (gasóleo) y equipos auxiliares. 
 La contribución de la Central Térmica de Las Salinas a la compañía puede detallarse desde varias perspectivas: 
 1. Estratégica : 
 Activo crítico dentro del sistema eléctrico extrapeninsular de Fuerteventura. 
 Garantía de suministro en un sistema no interconectado. 
 2. Económica: 
 Contribución relevante al negocio de generación en el ámbito extrapeninsular. (En el ejercicio 2025, El importe Neto de la Cifra de Negocios generada por la CT de las Salinas representa un 9% del Total de Unelco Generación) 
 Optimización de los costes de operación y mantenimiento, compatible con el cumplimiento de los estándares de fiabilidad exigidos. (En cifras de 2025 el BAI generado por la Central representa un 23% del total del BAI generado por UE) 
 Cumplimiento de los criterios técnicos y regulatorios exigidos por la regulación estatal (pruebas de rendimiento, disponibilidad y requisitos técnicos de operación). 
 3.Técnica 
 Experiencia consolidada en la operación de sistemas eléctricos aislados. 
 Gestión de activos térmicos envejecidos, con elevados requisitos de mantenimiento. 
 Capacidad técnica para la realización de simulacros de situaciones de emergencia, incluidas salidas desde CERO, imprescindibles en sistemas insulares. 
 Lo que harás

 Territorio di riferimento: Piemonte, Liguria e Valle D'Aosta 
 Informazioni sulla posizione 
 Sanofi è un'azienda della salute, innovativa e globale, guidata da una ragion d'essere: sfidare i confini della scienza per migliorare la vita delle persone.
 La Franchise Rare Diseases rappresenta uno degli ambiti più strategici e distintivi di Sanofi, in cui l'impegno verso i pazienti con bisogni terapeutici non soddisfatti si traduce in ricerca scientifica avanzata, innovazione terapeutica e presenza capillare sul territorio. All'interno di questa realtà, l'area Rare Hematology è focalizzata sulla Mastocitosi, una patologia rara e complessa, caratterizzata da un'elevata eterogeneità clinica e da un percorso diagnostico e terapeutico ancora oggi sfidante per la comunità medica.
 In questo contesto, la linea Rare Hematology è alla ricerca di un/una Clinical Science Associate da inserire nel proprio organico, all'interno di un team ambizioso, agile e orientato all'impatto concreto per i pazienti. Un'opportunità unica per contribuire attivamente alla formazione scientifica, alla costruzione di relazioni scientifiche solide con i centri specialistici di riferimento e al miglioramento della gestione clinica di una patologia ancora poco conosciuta.
 Responsabilità principali 
 Garantire un'informazione e una comunicazione scientifica di alto livello sui prodotti e sulla patologia di competenza, rivolta agli specialisti di riferimento (ematologi, allergologi, immunologi, onco-ematologi e altri professionisti sanitari coinvolti nella gestione della Mastocitosi), nel pieno rispetto delle normative vigenti e del codice deontologico.
 Costruire e mantenere relazioni solide e durature con i principali esperti e centri specialistici del territorio, promuovendo una partnership scientifica autentica e orientata al miglioramento della gestione del paziente.
 Contribuire attivamente alla disease awareness, supportando la comunità medica nella conoscenza e nel riconoscimento della patologia, con l'obiettivo di ridurre i ritardi diagnostici e migliorare l'appropriatezza terapeutica.
 Monitorare le dinamiche del mercato locale, l'andamento della patologia nel territorio di competenza e la disponibilità dei farmaci, identificando opportunità e aree di intervento prioritarie.
 Proporre e contribuire allo sviluppo di iniziative e progetti scientifici locali, in collaborazione con i principali interlocutori clinici e con le funzioni aziendali di riferimento (Marketing, Medica, Market Access).
 Partecipare ai principali congressi, convegni e seminari dell'area terapeutica di riferimento, rappresentando Sanofi con competenza e professionalità.
 Lavorare in modo trasversale e collaborativo con i colleghi delle diverse funzioni aziendali, contribuendo a una visione integrata del territorio e affermandosi come punto di riferimento credibile per gli interlocutori interni ed esterni.
 Profilo del candidato/della candidata 
 Esperienza : Esperienza nella promozione scientifica di prodotti farmaceutici specialistici in ambiente ospedaliero; la conoscenza dell'area ematologica, onco-ematologica o delle malattie rare costituisce un requisito preferenziale.
 Competenze tecniche e “soft skill” : Spiccate capacità relazionali e comunicative, con attitudine a costruire relazioni di fiducia autentiche con gli interlocutori scientifici; orientamento al risultato, proattività e spirito imprenditoriale; agilità nell'apprendimento scientifico e capacità di aggiornarsi rapidamente in contesti terapeutici complessi e in continua evoluzione; forte attitudine alla collaborazione in team e al lavoro trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali; conoscenza delle dinamiche di mercato e dei meccanismi di accesso ospedaliero in ambito specialistico; familiarità con la lettura e l'interpretazione di dati clinici e con il contesto della ricerca clinica; approccio orientato ai dati per la pianificazione e la gestione del territorio; buona padronanza degli strumenti digitali e informatici 
 Istruzione : Richiesta la laurea in discipline scientifiche, quali Biologia, Farmacia, Chimica e Tecnologie Farmaceutiche (CTF) o Medicina e Chirurgia.
 Lingue : Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta).
 Altro : e' richiesta la residenza nelle regioni di competenza
 Perche' scegliere noi? 
 Dai vita ai miracoli della scienza insieme a un team solidale e orientato al futuro.
 Scopri infinite …

 Experience in computerized maintenance management system, preventative maintenance, maintenance, scheduling, stakeholder management, KPI management, business continuity, project planning, resource management, program management.
 Ability to communicate in Dutch and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.
 Preferred qualifications:
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 EU Driving license Category B.
 Experience working with Maximo.
 Demonstrated experience working in critical facilities or operations as a Maintenance Planner.

 NXP Semiconductors enables secure connections and infrastructure for a smarter world, advancing solutions that make lives easier, better and safer.  Your Team

 We are looking for a talented technical university student or graduate (Electrical Engineering, Informatics, Computer Science or similar) with experience or interest in embedded C/C++ software development.

items.desc:
Your mission at Voi 
 For the Fleet Specialist position, you’ll have the opportunity to work across two main operational areas, with tasks allocated by the line manager based on business needs.
 In our mechanical team , you’ll focus on the maintenance and repair of our vehicles, keeping our scooters in excellent condition and providing crucial support to colleagues in the field.
 In our in‑field team , you’ll use our vans to carry out different tasks around the London area, ensuring our operations run safely, smoothly and reliably for our riders.
 Depending on daily priorities and workload, your line manager will assign you to one area or the other, giving you variety in your day‑to‑day while making sure we cover the most important operational needs.
 Here are some of the tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist: 
 Ensuring the logistics of collecting and deploying Voi scooters ⚙️
 Searching for and collecting damaged scooters 🛴
 Replacing batteries so vehicles are always ready to ride 🔋
 Performing quick on‑site repairs of scooters 🔧
 Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles 🔧
 Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired ♻️
 Assisting with the acceptance, packaging and preparation of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse 🔍
 Supporting our on‑site team as needed – for example, identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces or setting up fallen vehicles 🤝 You’ll work closely with a supportive team that shares knowledge and helps each other out.
 What you’ll need to embark 
 Mandatory requirement – You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months, with no more than 6 points and no major offences, to meet our e‑van insurance requirements. Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will drive one of our company e‑vans. 
 Good knowledge of your city and feeling comfortable driving there.
 A responsible team player who can manage tasks independently and also enjoys working together with others.
 Willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to a positive, respectful team culture.
 A practical, solution‑oriented mindset – you like getting things done and helping the team reach its goals.
 Comfortable navigating the city in a van in different weather and traffic conditions.
 Ability to stay calm and courteous in stressful situations (e.g. poor parking, traffic).
 A physical condition that allows you to safely handle and move scooters and batteries, using the equipment and support provided. 
 PLEASE NOTE: You may be required to go through a DBS Check for this role. 
 Job conditions 
 Working shifts : Sunday - Thursday 
 Working hours: 22:00 - 06:00
 Contract type: 6‑month fixed‑term contract
 Why Voi? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; it’s a personal Voiage where you can grow professionally and be part of a diverse team and culture committed to making a positive impact on society.
 At Voi, you’ll:
 Join Europe’s leading micromobility company and one of the fastest‑growing scale‑ups
 Make a direct impact on our success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in London
 Collaborate with inspiring, motivated and diverse colleagues who share a common goal
 Be part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are cleaner, quieter and less polluted.
 We’re committed to fair, transparent and ethical recruitment practices. All recruitment costs are covered by Voi – no recruitment fees or related costs are ever charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to protect workers’ rights and promote a safe and respectful experience for all candidates. We’re also committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We particularly welcome applications from women and other under‑represented groups in logistics, operations and technical roles.
 Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Our ambition is to empower 1 million people by 2030 to improve their health and well-being by preventing and managing chronic conditions through digitally-powered, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.
 Headquartered in Copenhagen and London, our collaborations with healthcare systems - including the NHS, life science companies and health insurers - allow us to impact lives at scale. We recently acquired Momenta, a leading developer and provider of evidence-based, outcome driven, healthy lifestyle solutions that help people negotiate the many day-to-day challenges they face in living healthier lives, with a focus on weight management.
 About the role 
 Once people start a Liva programme, we want them to feel supported every step of the way. You'll be one of the people making that happen: answering their questions, solving their problems, and reaching out when someone has drifted away. You'll also help us work smarter, by improving our help centre and building the automations that get patients answers faster.
 What you'll be doing 
 Supporting patients, coaches and partners across phone, chat and email, so everyone gets a quick, helpful answer
 Helping patients use our app and programmes, and fixing problems when things go wrong
 Handling first-line concerns and complaints with care, and escalating when needed
 Writing and improving help centre articles, so patients can find answers themselves
 Building automations and workflows in our helpdesk to make support faster and simpler
 Spotting common issues and helping us fix them at the root
 What you'll have 
 Experience in customer or patient support across several channels
 Excellent written communication, and the ability to stay calm in difficult conversations
 Experience with a CRM or helpdesk, including building automations or workflows
 An interest in health, wellbeing or helping people change their habits
 Help centre or knowledge base writing
 Understanding of data protection and safeguarding
 What you'll get 
 Meaningful work helping people improve their health
 The chance to shape how our support service works, not just run it
 A collaborative, supportive team
 Exposure to digital health and behaviour change at scale
 At Liva, we are a purpose-driven company; we go to work every day to help people live better lives. Our purpose is in our DNA, and we are always on the lookout for talented people eager to evolve and build a life-changing career within global health tech. 
 We believe in doing business the right way. Liva is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our workforce. We're committed to developing a representative workforce at all levels, and maintaining a working environment that promotes the health and wellbeing of our employees. 
 As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant we welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, and military spouses. 
 Guaranteed Interview scheme - As part of our commitment to the Government Disability Confident Initiative, and the Armed Forces Covenant, we are offering a guaranteed interview scheme to anyone with as disability as defined by the Equality Act 2010, or military veterans, service leavers, and military spouses. 
 Liva will operate a fair, inclusive and transparent recruitment and selection process. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout our interview process please let us know and will be happy to accommodate.

Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the #1 e-scooter service in Europe, operating in 100 cities and towns with over 250 MILLION rides to date. It has been an amazing journey and we have no intention of stopping now! We are now looking for a Shift Supervisor in Swansea!
 YOUR MISSION AT VOI 
 As Shift Supervisor, you’re the face of Voi on the warehouse floor in Swansea, working side by side with our 3PL partner’s team to keep the fleet moving. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on in the warehouse (70%), with the rest (30%) keeping the partnership running smoothly.
 Your responsibilities will be:
 Working alongside our 3PL : Be the go-to person for the partner’s team on shift, sharing the plan for the day, answering questions and keeping everyone on the same page.
 Getting vehicles out the door : Help receive, pack and deploy new vehicles, and pitch in wherever the shift needs you.
 Keeping quality high : Spot damaged or misplaced vehicles, get them fixed or moved, restore fallen vehicles and keep parking spots tidy, leading by example on how we like things done.
 Sharing know-how : Show the partner’s team Voi’s processes, tools and safety standards, and offer friendly tips and feedback along the way.
 Staying on top of the numbers : Keep an eye on how the shift is tracking against agreed targets, and check that hours and volumes match what’s reported.
 Raising your hand when something’s off : Flag issues early to Voi’s managers and the partner’s leads, and suggest ideas to make the way we work together better.
 Planning together : Work with Voi managers and the partner to make sure each shift is well staffed and ready to go.
 WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK 
 We are looking for a pragmatic and responsible team-player who can fulfill tasks, solve problems independently, and work as a part of a team to find new solutions and reach set goals. In addition to being fluent in English, the right person needs:
 2+ years of previous work experience
 Experience managing a team of people
 Mandatory requirement – Driving licence: You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months , with no more than 6 points and no major offences , to meet our e-van insurance requirements . Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will be required to drive one of our company e-vans 
 General understanding of digital work tools (MS-office, G-Suite)
 JOB CONDITIONS 
 Working days: Monday-Friday
 Working hours: AM- Shift 0800 - 1600 
 Contract type: 6 months fixed-term contract 
 Work Area: Warehouse 
 WHY VOI? 
 Join Europes #1 micromobility company and one of the fastest growing scaleups
 Have a direct impact on our continued success and the development of the micromobility industry in the UK 
 Work with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
 Join the micromobility-revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution
 At Voi, we are committed to responsible and ethical recruitment practices, ensuring that all recruitment processes are fair, transparent, and free from exploitation. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to ensure compliance, protect workers’ rights, and promote a safe and respectful hiring experience for all our candidates.

 Today Mobility facilita la propiedad de vehículos proporcionando soluciones de movilidad para toda la industria automotriz. En esencia, transportamos los vehículos de nuestros clientes hacia y desde la inspección técnica, el cambio de neumáticos, el mantenimiento, la reparación, etc.

Como resultado, los propietarios de automóviles disfrutan de una gran comodidad, las empresas mantienen su flota en excelente estado mientras ahorran tiempo y dinero, y los fabricantes de automóviles logran una distribución equilibrada en sus talleres, ofreciendo un servicio aún mejor a sus clientes.
 El ADN de Today Mobility: 
 Exigimos altos estándares de personalidad, espíritu de servicio y un fuerte sentido de responsabilidad en la gestión de proyectos.
 Today Mobility es una empresa amigable. Nos movemos con rapidez y hacemos lo necesario para ayudar a nuestros clientes, colegas y socios a tener un mejor día a día. Formamos equipos que actúan con un enfoque de "nosotros" en lugar de "yo", priorizando personas sin ego que valoran los resultados colectivos por encima de los individuales.
 Nuestro ADN impregna todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra identidad se demuestra con acciones más que con palabras. Por eso, nuestros socios nos eligen.
 ------------ 
 Conductor: 
 Como conductor, además de la conducción profesional y responsable exigida para el puesto, es importante que te sientas cómodo interactuando con clientes. En Today Mobility, nuestros clientes son grandes empresas y, en ocasiones, sus clientes finales, por lo que el trato con el cliente es necesario en el día a día.

items.desc: The Role This is a UK-based role that makes the AI systems which power our products measurably better. How well those systems perform is at the heart of what Aykua offers. You will design the evaluations that tell us how accurate they are, find out why they fail, and run the experiments that fix it. You will statistically assess prompt and model performance and maintain our internal evaluation frameworks. The role suits a scientist with rigorous experimental habits, from a PhD, postdoc or equivalent industry experience, who wants their work to ship in a product which real clinics are using today. What You’ll Do Improve how we measure AI quality: extend the evaluation frameworks for our existing products and stand up new ones as products are built, assessing prompt and model performance statistically and designing experiments that compare changes rigorously. Build and continuously improve our LLM-as-judge evaluations: calibrate judges against expert human review, find where they fail, and feed what you learn back into our prompts, models and products. Curate and maintain our internal evaluation datasets, working with expert reviewers to establish and keep ground truth. Work closely with our product and engineering teams to turn your findings into improvements that reach production. Mentor the team in evaluation and experimental practice, establish best practices, and raise the technical bar for how we measure AI quality across the company. What We’re Looking For A PhD and postdoctoral research experience, or equivalent industry experience (5+ years), in data science, machine learning or a related quantitative field. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python (with libraries like Pydantic, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn). A strong foundation in statistical analysis, experimental design and hypothesis testing, and experience applying it to large or messy datasets. Experience turning analysis into working tools: evaluation harnesses, data pipelines or reusable experiment code that others on the team can run. You will be a great fit if you... Enjoy working with frontier models. Would rather measure whether something works than assume it does. Automate away repetitive analysis and build tooling that makes evaluation faster and more reliable. It would be nice if you had... Hands-on experience with LLMs, such as prompting, LLM-as-judge or fine-tuning. Familiarity with evaluation metrics such as precision and recall, and with using them to check automated judgements against human review. Experience with healthcare or clinical data, or in another regulated industry, including de-identification, privacy-preserving data work or data governance for protected data (PII/PHI). Publications in peer-reviewed venues. Experience using coding agents in research work, with independent verification of the results. Please note: Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, and we aim to respond to every applicant within one week. You must have the right to work in the UK, as this is an in-person role near Cambridge. Pay: £42,000.00-£60,000.00 per year Benefits: Employee stock ownership plan Education: Bachelor's (required) Work authorisation: United Kingdom (required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge CB4
