items.desc: Vollzeit Ab wann kann es losgehen: Ab sofort Unternehmensbeschreibung Deloitte Österreich ist der führende Anbieter von Professional Services. Das gelingt uns mit unseren rund 1.900 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an 17 Standorten, die Unternehmen und Institutionen in verschiedenen Bereichen betreuen. Wir schätzen die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden und sehen sie als essenziellen Schlüssel für Innovation und Erfolg. Deshalb setzen wir uns dafür ein, dass bei uns jede:r die gleichen Chancen erhält. Stellenbeschreibung Wir unterstützen Unternehmen in der Konzeption und Umsetzung wichtiger Vorhaben im IT-Umfeld. Du möchtest mit uns spannende IT-Projekte begleiten und deinen nächsten Karriereschritt setzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Was dich erwartet: Du begleitest und führst abwechslungsreiche (IT-)Projekte durch. Du analysierst, konzipierst und optimierst Geschäftsabläufe sowie Daten- und System-Architekturen mit Fokus auf digitale Prozesse. Du analysierst Kund:innenanforderungen und konzipierst darauf basierend kundenspezifische IT-Lösungen. Du berätst und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von IT-Prozessautomatisierungs-Lösungen mithilfe geeigneter Werkzeuge. Du planst, führst durch und bereitest Kund:innenworkshops vor und nach und dokumentierst und verwaltest Anforderungen. Du arbeitest mit einem interdisziplinären Team zusammen und arbeitest eigenständig in agilen und traditionellen Projekten. Qualifikationen Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik (HTL, Universität oder FH). Du begeisterst dich für ein breites Spektrum von IT-Technologien und Business Anwendungen (z.B. ERP, CRM, ECM, Datenbanken). Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Lastenheften, User Stories und Prozessmodellen sowie Erfahrung mit Tools/Methoden wie Scrum, JIRA, Confluence. Du hast idealerweise eine Zertifizierung im Requirements Engineering-Umfeld (z.B. IREB Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering – Foundation Level oder IREB Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering – Agile Primer). Du denkst lösungsorientiert, arbeitest eigenständig und hast eine Affinität zu agilen Methoden. Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit guten Kommunikations- und Präsentationsskills. Erfüllst du nicht alle genannten Kriterien? Kein Problem! Uns ist bewusst, dass nicht jede:r alle Anforderungen erfüllen kann, deshalb sind wir bereit, in deine Entwicklung zu investieren. Zusätzliche Informationen Jahresbruttogehalt ab € 53.200,- (All In). Deine Vergütung orientiert sich selbstverständlich an deiner individuellen Qualifikation und positionsrelevanten Berufserfahrung. Darüber hinaus erwarten dich attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Benefits. Make an impact that matters . Wir ermutigen dich, neue Verantwortungen zu übernehmen, dich aktiv in spannende Projekte einzubringen und wertvolle Erfahrungen zu sammeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir dir exzellente Trainingsprogramme (Deloitte Academy, Deloitte University), strukturierte Karrierepfade, fachspezifische Ausbildungen und Trainings sowie persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, damit du deine Karriereziele erreichst und dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von starkem Zusammenhalt und unseren gemeinsamen Werten . Dabei ist uns das Wellbeing unserer Mitarbeitenden besonders wichtig. Außerdem bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit im Home Office oder im Büro im Stadtzentrum zu arbeiten. Auf deine Bewerbung freut sich : Chiara Schittenhelm , Tel.: +43 1 537002561 Für Fragen oder konkrete Unterstützung zur Barrierefreiheit wende dich bitte an barrierefreiheit@deloitte.at. items.desc: Category: Digital & IT Location: Høje-Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, DK Your impact begins here As Product Owner, you will take full ownership of two global facility monitoring systems (FMS) that track environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, diff Pressure etc.) across Novo. The FMS supports product release and compliance, so they need clear direction and reliable delivery. You will bring that responsibility in-house, setting the strategy, priorities and budget that keep quality and supply moving. What you’ll bring You are preferably already working as a Product Owner and are ready to take clear ownership of a product’s strategy, priorities, backlog and finances. You will also bring: An academic degree preferably in IT or business. Relevant experience counts as much as the path you took to get here. Around 3+ years of Product Owner experience, combined with broader relevant experience. Strong IT strategic understanding and experience shaping and owning the longer-term direction of a product. An understanding of technical and solution architecture at design level. You don’t need to be a deep technical specialist. Experience with cost management and budgeting. Strong written and spoken English. The team and stakeholder environment is fully international and works in English. Useful, but not essential: Understanding of compliance in the pharmaceutical industry. Experience from production or manufacturing. Knowledge of facility monitoring systems, including the FMS solutions used at Novo. Experience with agile ways of working. On a personal level, you bring the maturity to take ownership, make decisions and prioritise competing demands while staying effective under pressure. You are also able to lead informally and build strong stakeholder relationships across functions and cultures. What you’ll do The two FMS solutions offer different functionality, so the right one can be chosen for each site and situation. Your job is to give both a clear direction and to make sure the product team delivers what matters most. Own the overall direction of both global FMS systems, setting the product strategy and longer-term roadmap. Own and prioritise the backlog, deciding what gets delivered and when, based on business needs and input from the product team. Lead the product team informally, aligning roles, responsibilities and deliverables so the team works effectively together. Manage costs, budgeting and the financial model, making sure costs are covered and following up on actual spend against budget. Manage stakeholders proactively. Spot potential issues early and bring the right people in before problems escalate. Act as the first escalation point when significant issues arise with the product or its implementations, and set a clear example on quality. Who you’ll work with You will join Monitoring and Control Solutions, the area that sets the strategic direction for global monitoring and control systems at Novo. The team is based at the Novo IT hub in Høje Taastrup, Denmark, and works closely online with stakeholders and the application vendor around the world. You can expect to spend much of your week in the office with your team. Your closest colleagues will be your product team: a Product Manager, Business Analysts, Implementation Leads, a Compliance Partner, a Solution Architect and System Managers. Beyond the team, you will coordinate with Line of Business, implementation teams, lifecycle management, architecture and the application vendors. The systems serve factories and laboratories globally, so your priorities will affect sites across many countries and cultures. Your role is to bring these perspectives together, create clarity when things stall and keep work moving at pace. What you can expect here This is a role with real ownership. You will be trusted to make decisions about two global systems, and your voice will shape where they go next. You will build broad experience across IT strategy, finance, architecture and manufacturing-related compliance, all in one product area. You will work in a team that values a quality mindset, honest dialogue and an informal working climate, where colleagues support each other and never compromise on quality. Clear priorities and ambitious goals mean your results will be visible and recognised. What we offer At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage. Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 DKK to 1,091,600 DKK corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience. Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, …

As a Hardware & Automation Field Application Scientist (FAS) within BioProduction, you will be a trusted technical partner to biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers across the UK and Nordic region. You will work primarily with process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams, helping them evaluate, implement and adopt technologies that improve bioprocess performance. You will support bioprocess workflows spanning upstream and downstream activities, with a focus on hardware, single-use technologies and automation. This includes single-use bioreactors and mixers, DynaSpin harvest systems, fluid-management solutions and related process-control technologies. You will connect process requirements with equipment capabilities, workflow integration and manufacturing needs, and help customers develop, scale, transfer, optimize and troubleshoot their processes. We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding why a process or system behaves the way it does and turning that understanding into practical customer solutions. You do not need experience with every platform or at every scale; strong process understanding, technical problem-solving and the ability to transfer your knowledge to new systems are more important. What You Will Do Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor for BioProduction hardware, single-use systems and automation, serving as an application-focused contact for customer process development, MSAT, operations and manufacturing teams. Support workflow development and technology integration across upstream and downstream processing, with particular emphasis on upstream bioprocessing equipment and single-use systems. Support customers with process engineering, scale-up and scale-down, technology transfer, process optimization and troubleshooting from development through manufacturing. Lead or contribute to pre- and post-sales technical activities, including workflow assessments, hardware evaluations, proof-of-principle studies, demonstrations, pilot runs and technology qualification in regulated environments. Troubleshoot process, hardware, single-use flow-path and automation issues; coordinate with Field Service, Engineering, Quality, Technical Support and other teams to support timely, compliant resolution. Advise customers on effective use and integration of bioreactors, mixers, DynaSpin systems, single-use assemblies, fluid-management solutions and related technologies. Conduct workflow consulting and structured process walks at customer sites to understand operational needs, identify improvement opportunities and align technical recommendations with customer goals. Support Bioprocessing Development Center activities and other customer demonstrations, helping deliver clear, consistent technical messaging. Develop and follow hardware and automation adoption plans with customers; agree measurable milestones such as time to first run and, where applicable, time to first GMP lot, and review utilization after implementation. Deliver technical training and design or deployment workshops for scientists, engineers and operators, and support technology adoption from development through manufacturing. Document technical engagements in Salesforce CRM and contribute technical input to account plans and risk-mitigation plans. Work closely with commercial teams and cross-functional partners, including Field Service, Product Management, R&D, Quality/Regulatory and Technical Support, to understand customer needs and resolve technical challenges. Gather and communicate Voice of Customer feedback to inform product roadmaps and support technical content such as application notes, white papers and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant conferences, workshops, seminars and webinars through workflow-based technical presentations and demonstrations. What Will Help You Succeed You bring a strong foundation in upstream bioprocessing and a process-engineering mindset: the ability to connect biological process requirements with equipment capabilities, scale, controls and manufacturing constraints. You can apply this foundation across integrated bioprocess workflows and learn new platforms as customer needs require. items.desc: Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome. As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce. This is where you make a difference You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation. One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business. From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership. You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg. Key responsibilities include: Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions What you bring You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills: Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences Professional proficiency in English It is an advantage if you also have experience with: Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA Why Blue Water You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality. What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT. As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future. Interested? This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you. For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier. Student Project Assistant – Business, Data & Digitalization Padborg, Denmark | Part-time, approx. 10 hours/week | 6-month fixed-term position Role purpose Are you studying engineering, economics, business or a related field and interested in using data, technology and AI to solve real business problems? We are looking for a hands-on Student Project Assistant to support improvement and digitalization projects within our service operation in Padborg. This is not a role where you will only analyse data and make presentations. You will work with a problem from analysis to implementation : understanding the data and processes, identifying opportunities, proposing practical solutions and helping implement the changes together with the team. Projects will combine business analysis, data, digital tools and practical implementation . Depending on the project, implementation could mean digital implementation, establish new working processes or physically help reorganize how our physical inventory is managed. You will have the opportunity to work with real operational challenges, take ownership of defined projects and see the direct results of your work. Key responsibilities You will support and, progressively, take ownership of improvement projects such as: Work directly with colleagues in service, workshop and administration to understand how we work . Analyse data from different systems using Excel, AI and other digital tools to structure large amounts of information and turn data into conclusions. Translate analytical conclusions into practical actions and implement agreed improvements , rather than stopping at recommendations. Complete the implementations , both digitally and physically. Document improvements and new working processes supporting the use and maintenance of the improvement, creating long lasting impact. Examples of projects The exact projects may evolve according to business priorities, but initial areas could include: Warehouse and inventory improvement Analyse consumption and inventory data, help define a better inventory structure and then work with the Padborg team to physically and digitally implement the new setup. Telematics and contract reconciliation Analyse equipment registered in our telematics systems against active customer contracts, identify discrepancies and support correction/creation of missing contracts. Salesforce contract pricing Analyse and propose contract pricing and implement it, so that standardized contract-pricing models can be used improving quoting efficiency. Customer/partner discounts and alignment Compare customer/partners discount structures in different business systems, identify inconsistencies and propose and support implementation the of a harmonized structur Requirements Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, economics, business, data science, supply chain or another relevant field. Comfortable working with numbers, data and spreadsheets , particularly Microsoft Excel. Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and attention to the details. Able to work independently on clearly defined projects while collaborating with different colleagues. Comfortable communicating in Danish or English . Able to work sometimes from our Padborg location and therefore having a practical way of travelling to Padborg. items.desc: We are looking for a talented Mechanical Design Engineer to join us. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a highly specialized field, designing and developing products used by leading research organizations and technology companies around the world. We are looking for a curious and driven professional who enjoys technical problem-solving, collaborative teamwork, and continuous learning. Interested? Keep reading! Your tasks will include designing new customer-specific solutions and modifying existing product designs to meet project requirements. You will design components and sub-systems for our cryogen-free dilution refrigerators, ensuring that designs meet quality, functionality, and manufacturability requirements. In this role, you will participate in engineering change and continuous improvement projects, create detailed manufacturing drawings for production, and maintain accurate design data in our PDM and ERP systems. You will also contribute to team-specific initiatives related to CAD data management, documentation, and process development while working closely with colleagues across engineering, manufacturing, and product teams. We are looking for a mechanical engineering professional with a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering and relevant experience in mechanical design using 3D CAD software. You are capable of producing high-quality technical drawings with great attention to detail and have a solid understanding of production methods and manufacturing requirements. You are eager to learn, continuously develop your expertise, and take a systematic and careful approach to your work while maintaining a strong commitment to quality. In addition, you are a self-driven professional with a hands-on attitude who can work independently while also contributing positively to team success. Strong communication skills and good English language skills, both written and spoken, are essential for collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders in our international environment. To stand out in this role, you bring experience with Creo and are comfortable working with modern 3D CAD tools in a product development or engineering-to-order environment. Familiarity with PDM systems and engineering data management practices is also considered an advantage. Above all, we appreciate professionals who are motivated by solving technical challenges, enjoy working collaboratively across different teams, and are committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions. We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position as well as the support of a highly skilled growth organization. This is an excellent opportunity for your own professional growth in a dynamic, enthusiastic, and professional team where we work together, and we support each other. We have a multicultural work environment with room to grow, where you can use your potential and develop your skills. items.desc: The Impact You'll Make Join us in accelerating the energy transition through advanced power conversion technologies. Based in Vaasa, Finland, with a hybrid work model, you will help develop electronic solutions that improve energy efficiency, grid stability, and electrification across a wide range of industries. As an Electronics Engineer, you will contribute to next-generation power conversion products used in energy storage, data centers, EV charging infrastructure, marine electrification, renewable energy, and microgrids. Your work will help transform innovative ideas into reliable products that support a more sustainable future. Working alongside experts in power electronics, software, controls, testing, and manufacturing, you will have the opportunity to grow your technical expertise while making a meaningful impact on global electrification solutions. What You’ll Be Doing Design and develop electronic hardware for power conversion products, helping bring innovative technologies from concept to market. Create schematics, perform circuit calculations, and maintain engineering documentation to support high-quality product development. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop integrated solutions that deliver strong performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Test and validate prototypes, analyze results, and solve technical challenges to improve product quality and robustness. Contribute to the development of future power conversion technologies, including new semiconductor solutions and converter topologies. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. Experience in electronic hardware development, power electronics, or industrial product development gained through work, internships, research projects, or academic studies. Understanding of power electronic circuits, including converters, inverters, power supplies, gate drives, and protection functions. Hands-on experience with circuit design, simulation, laboratory testing, and engineering verification activities. Experience with engineering tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, OrCAD, LTspice, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, PSPICE, Teamcenter, SAP, or equivalent solutions, combined with good analytical and problem-solving skills. What You'll Get from Us At Danfoss, you will work on technologies that are helping shape the future of electrification and sustainable energy systems. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and industry experts developing solutions for energy storage, renewable energy, data center infrastructure, and advanced power conversion applications. We offer a collaborative environment where learning, innovation, and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will have opportunities to expand your expertise across power electronics, electronics design, system architecture, controls, and emerging electrification technologies while contributing to meaningful projects with global impact. This position is based in Vaasa, Finland, and includes a hybrid work model that supports both flexibility and collaboration. Ready to Make a Difference? Avec ses 2000 collaborateur·rice·s, le Crédit Coopératif et ses filiales, BTP Banque et Ecofi, prônent depuis plus de 130 ans un modèle d’économie sociale et solidaire durable pour ses clients comme pour ses talents. Et vivre votre métier autrement ! #UnAutreJobEstPossible ; #AvecVousCestPossible Poste et missions Notre Direction des Risques et de la Conformité recrute un·e Délégué·e à la protection des données pour accompagner les équipes du Groupe Crédit Coopératif dans la maîtrise des enjeux liés aux données personnelles. En qualité de Délégué·e à la protection des données (DPO), vous informez et conseillez la Direction et les équipes sur leurs obligations au regard du RGPD et des réglementations applicables. Vous accompagnez les métiers dans leurs projets et veillez à la conformité des traitements mis en œuvre. Vos principales missions seront de : Conseiller les équipes sur la réglementation applicable et les accompagner dans les études d’impact sur la vie privée et la réduction des risques. Piloter le registre des traitements, en intégrant, le cas échéant, les applications privatives, et contribuer au reporting interne et externe. Mettre en œuvre les règles et les contrôles du Groupe en matière de protection des données, dans le cadre du contrôle permanent et d’une approche par les risques. Veiller au traitement des droits des personnes et à la mise en œuvre du plan de formation et de sensibilisation. Animer la communauté des référents et assurer les relations avec les interlocuteurs internes, notamment l’opérateur informatique, ainsi qu’avec les autorités de contrôle telles que la CNIL, l’ACPR et l’AMF. Profil et compétences requises ✨ Et vous ? Vous êtes diplômé·e de l’enseignement supérieur en droit, conformité, gestion des risques ou protection des données, et justifiez d’une expérience dans un domaine lié à la protection des données personnelles. Vous maîtrisez le RGPD et les règles applicables ; une connaissance de la réglementation bancaire et des métiers du secteur serait un plus. Une certification en protection des données personnelles serait particulièrement appréciée. Organisé·e, autonome et rigoureux·se, vous savez coordonner des interlocuteurs variés, analyser des situations complexes et en dégager les principaux enjeux. Votre aisance relationnelle, votre pédagogie et votre diplomatie vous permettent d’accompagner les équipes et de faire avancer les sujets avec ténacité. Vous maîtrisez l'IA, mais également la rédaction de documents structurés et savez prendre des décisions. Vous voulez en savoir plus sur le poste ? items.desc: À propos de nous La société Coutot-Roehrig fondée en 1894 est le leader européen sur le marché de la généalogie successorale, au service des études notariales et autres professions juridiques. Notre ambition : fournir aux généalogistes la meilleure plateforme de recherche mondiale du secteur. Mission Nous recherchons pour notre équipe data, un Chef de projet Data (H/F) Le poste, basé à Paris, est à pourvoir en CDI, pour une prise de fonction immédiate. Rattaché(e) au directeur de projets et en lien étroit avec l’équipe data, vous serez responsable de projets data de bout en bout, de la collecte à la mise en production. Vos responsabilités principales : Collecte des données Concevoir et développer des solutions techniques de collecte Mettre en place et maintenir des batchs de collecte automatisés Nettoyage et redressement des données Automatiser et suivre le contrôle qualité et pertinence des données Mettre en conformité les données avec les spécifications internes Valorisation les données Organiser le traitement manuel, algorithmique ou par IA des données (reconnaissance de texte, contextualisation, enrichissement) Mise en production et contrôle des données Documentation des processus pour assurer leur traçabilité et les mises à jour Suivant profil : Maintenir et développer les outils de recherche Votre rôle au quotidien: Travailler en autonomie et responsabilité, avec un support du reste de l’équipe. Avancer avec méthode et rigueur pour garantir la livraison d’une donnée de qualité. Identifier les tâches récurrentes et automatiser ce qui peut l’être. Méthodes et outils: Gestion de projets : Slack, Trello, Confluence, GitHub + outils internes. Traitement des données : Environnement Azure, Debian Bases de données : postgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Développement : en Python, bash Une approche inspirée des valeurs agiles : Priorité aux individus et aux interactions, Importance des résultats plutôt que de la documentation exhaustive, Collaboration plutôt que négociation contractuelle, Adaptation au changement plutôt qu’exécution stricte d’un plan Profil Formation supérieure Bac +4/5 en informatique. Première expérience réussie en en data engineering ou développement de solutions data. Excellente maîtrise de l’algorithmie et aisance dans l’analyse de bases de données Vous vous reconnaissez dans l’un des profils suivants : Profil Data Engineer : conception et maintenance de pipelines de données, automatisation des traitements, contrôle qualité et intégration. Profil Développement IA : expérience (ou forte appétence) pour le traitement d’images, l’apprentissage automatique ou les modèles d’IA appliqués à la donnée. Profil Développement applicatif : expérience en développement fullstack (idéalement PHP) ou expérience en développement d’agent de recherche IA Compétences clés : Rigueur et sens du travail bien fait, Autonomie et esprit d’initiative, Esprit d’équipe et volonté de partage.

items.desc: Entreprise Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein du secteur bancaire, nous recherchons un Business Analyst Banque / Finance , spécialisé dans les processus de paiement et de décaissement. Vous intégrerez l’une des deux équipes agiles du périmètre Crédit court terme , couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie du crédit, de la contractualisation à la gestion du contrat jusqu’à son terme. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée d’un Product Owner, d’un Tech Lead, de développeurs et de Business Analysts. L’environnement technique s’appuie notamment sur Java, Angular et une architecture orientée événements reposant fortement sur Kafka. Poste En tant que Business Analyst, vous serez responsable de vos fonctionnalités de bout en bout, depuis le recueil du besoin métier jusqu’aux tests et à la recette fonctionnelle. À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront : Recueil et analyse des besoins : échanger avec les interlocuteurs métier, comprendre les processus existants et formaliser les besoins fonctionnels. Conception fonctionnelle : découper les fonctionnalités, analyser les impacts et définir les solutions fonctionnelles adaptées. Rédaction des spécifications : produire les spécifications fonctionnelles et rédiger les user stories avec des critères d’acceptation clairs. Tests et recette : préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, vérifier la conformité des développements aux besoins exprimés et assurer la recette de vos fonctionnalités. Collaboration avec les équipes techniques : travailler quotidiennement avec le Product Owner, le Tech Lead et les développeurs afin de garantir la bonne compréhension des besoins et la qualité des livraisons. Analyse des flux : lire et analyser les topics et les messages Kafka pour faciliter la compréhension des échanges entre les composants applicatifs et contribuer à l’analyse des anomalies fonctionnelles. Profil Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Business Analyst, idéalement acquise dans un environnement bancaire ou financier. Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge une fonctionnalité en toute autonomie, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’à la validation fonctionnelle, tout en assurant une bonne coordination entre les équipes métier et techniques. Vous recherchez un rôle opérationnel de Business Analyst, centré sur l’analyse, la conception fonctionnelle et la recette, et non un rôle de Product Owner. Compétences indispensables Expérience significative en Business Analysis. Bonne connaissance fonctionnelle du secteur bancaire. Capacité à recueillir, analyser et formaliser des besoins métier. Maîtrise de la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de user stories. Expérience dans la préparation et l’exécution de tests fonctionnels et de recettes. Aisance dans un environnement technique impliquant Kafka : compréhension, lecture et analyse des topics et des messages. Capacité à dialoguer efficacement avec des équipes de développement Java, sans nécessité de développer. Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’analyse. Compétences appréciées Expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des décaissements ou des flux financiers. Connaissance des processus de crédit, idéalement du crédit court terme. Pratique des méthodes agiles et expérience du travail en équipe Scrum. Familiarité avec les environnements techniques Java, Angular et AWS. Pourquoi rejoindre cette mission ? Intervenir sur un périmètre bancaire fonctionnel couvrant le cycle de vie du crédit court terme. Prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout avec un réel niveau d’autonomie. Elle accompagne près d’une vingtaine de clients, allant des grands comptes aux ETI et PME. Elle s’appuie sur un Centre de Services spécialisé dans le stockage et la sauvegarde ainsi que sur un Centre d'Expertise en sécurité. L'agence accorde une importance particulière à un recrutement fondé sur l'humain et la transparence. C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par l’architecture logicielle, l’industrialisation des outils internes et l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant que Responsable Technique DevOps , vous contribuez à la structuration, à l’évolution et à la pérennité du portefeuille d’outils internes, en garantissant leur cohérence technique, leur qualité et leur exploitabilité. Côté build : Définir et faire évoluer l’architecture de référence des outils internes : intégration, APIs, authentification, gestion des données, journalisation et supervision. Analyser les redondances entre applications, scripts, automatisations et composants techniques, puis proposer des scénarios de consolidation ou de mutualisation. Définir les standards techniques, les règles de réutilisation et les composants communs afin d’améliorer la cohérence du portefeuille d’outils. Contribuer à la conception, au prototypage, au développement et à l’intégration des solutions en fonction des besoins identifiés. Réaliser ou préparer les revues d’architecture, de conception et de code des outils prioritaires. Mettre en place des standards et accélérateurs réutilisables : templates de projets, conventions de développement, composants communs et checklists de mise en production. Intégrer les pratiques d’intelligence artificielle dans le cycle de développement logiciel, notamment pour la conception, le développement, les tests, la documentation et l’analyse de code. Mettre en œuvre des démarches de développement guidé par les spécifications ( Specification Driven Development – SDD ), en structurant les spécifications et les critères d’acceptation. Contrôler, tester et valider les productions assistées par l’IA avant leur intégration, dans le respect des règles de sécurité applicables. Participer à la réduction de la dette technique et à l’amélioration de la maintenabilité des solutions pérennes. Côté run : Piloter les sujets techniques complexes et coordonner les échanges avec les équipes d’architecture, d’infrastructure, de sécurité, d’IAM, de réseau, d’hébergement et d’exploitation. Préparer les validations techniques et les mises en service en tenant compte des flux, des dépendances, des habilitations, des secrets, de l’exposition réseau et des exigences de supervision. Assurer le suivi des décisions, des actions, des dépendances et des échéances, en identifiant les blocages et en proposant des scénarios de résolution. Définir et faire évoluer les critères de maturité des outils internes : versionnement du code, documentation, tests, revue de code, chaîne de livraison et procédures de retrait. Garantir l’exploitabilité des solutions en structurant la journalisation, les métriques, les alertes, les tableaux de bord et les procédures de diagnostic. Adapter les exigences de qualité, de sécurité et de maintenance à la criticité des outils et à la sensibilité des données traitées. Formaliser les choix d’architecture, les dépendances, les limites connues, les risques et les modalités de reprise des solutions. Produire et maintenir la documentation technique et technico-fonctionnelle, les procédures de déploiement, de retour arrière et d’exploitation. Organiser le transfert de connaissances auprès des contributeurs internes afin de faciliter la maintenance, l’évolution et la continuité des activités. C’est votre parcours Vous disposez d’une expérience significative dans le développement logiciel, l’architecture technique ou l’industrialisation de solutions applicatives en environnement complexe. Vous savez prendre en charge des sujets techniques transverses, coordonner plusieurs équipes expertes et transformer des contraintes techniques en solutions concrètes. Vous aimez structurer, concevoir et améliorer les outils existants, tout en gardant une approche pragmatique orientée qualité, sécurité et pérennité. C’est votre expertise : Architecture logicielle, intégration applicative, APIs, authentification, gestion des données et composants partagés. items.desc: About Exotrail Space is becoming more strategic and competitive than ever. Tomorrow’s space leaders will not simply launch satellites into orbit, they will be able to move them, reposition them, extend their lifetime, and maximize their performance in space. Since 2017, Exotrail has been developing and operating cutting-edge in-space mobility solutions for commercial, institutional, and defense customers. From our high-performance propulsion system spaceware to our orbital transfer vehicle spacevan , we enable satellites to go farther, stay operational longer, and achieve more. Today, more than 200 Exotrailers across Massy and Toulouse are working together to make space operations more efficient and sustainable. Backed by over €75 million in funding , we are pursuing a clear mission: Making space a sustainable frontier for future generations. Job Description At Exotrail, we're building the technologies that make space mobility more flexible, efficient and sustainable. As part of our In-Orbit Services (IOS) division, you will contribute to the development of SpaceTower , our flight dynamics and mission operations software platform supporting spacecraft missions from mission design to in-orbit operations. As a Flight Dynamics Software Engineer , you will combine astrodynamics expertise and software engineering skills to design, develop and maintain the flight dynamics capabilities used by our teams and customers worldwide. If you enjoy solving complex orbital mechanics challenges, building reliable software products and seeing your work directly support operational space missions, we'd love to hear from you. Your Mission You will contribute to the design, development and validation of Exotrail's Flight Dynamics System (FDS), supporting mission analysis, orbit determination, maneuver planning, trajectory optimization and operational flight dynamics activities. Working closely with Flight Dynamics, Software, System and Operations teams, you will deliver high-performance software solutions that support spacecraft throughout their entire lifecycle, from mission preparation to routine operations in orbit. Your Responsibilities Mission Analysis & Astrodynamics Design and implement orbit propagation, orbit determination and maneuver planning algorithms. Develop trajectory optimization solutions for spacecraft missions. Contribute to mission analysis and operational flight dynamics capabilities. Validate algorithms through simulation, testing and operational data analysis. Translate mission requirements into robust software solutions in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams. Software Development Design, develop and maintain Flight Dynamics software products, including SpaceTower. Participate in software architecture decisions and technical roadmap definition. Improve software performance, scalability, robustness and maintainability. Develop automated testing frameworks and validation tools. Contribute to continuous integration and software quality processes. Participate in code reviews and software development best practices. Produce high-quality technical documentation. Mission & Operations Support Support System Engineering and Operations teams during CONOPS definition and mission preparation. Train and assist internal and external users of SpaceTower. Participate in software and operational validation campaigns. Support critical mission phases such as launch, commissioning and end-of-life operations. Investigate operational anomalies and contribute to continuous process improvements. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Master's degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong foundation in applied mathematics and solid understanding of space mechanics Good understanding of spacecraft dynamics, orbit propagation and numerical methods. Proven experience in software development using Java (must have), Linux Git/GitLab, CI/CD/CT Fluency in English and French Preferred Qualifications Experience with flight dynamics libraries and tools (Orekit, GMAT, STK/ODTK, Tudat, Orecz). Python and Typescript Containerization and Orchestration (e.g.,Docker, Kbernetes) Knowledge of Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) systems. Knowledge of Agile development methodologies. Soft skills Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment, collaborating with engineers, scientists, and operations teams. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive attitude and ownership mindset, capable of driving topics from concept to completion. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Ability to provide constructive feedback and contribute positively to team growth and continuous improvement. Capacity to work on on-call …

items.desc: Dans le cadre d'un projet international de transformation et de valorisation des données, nous recherchons un Business Data Analyst expérimenté (H/F) pour accompagner l'intégration, la structuration et l'exploitation des données issues de l'écosystème Amazon au sein d'une plateforme Data interne. L'objectif de cette mission est d'assurer le lien entre les données Amazon, les besoins des équipes métiers et les modèles de données existants. La priorité métier porte sur les données Sales Performance (performance commerciale), suivies des données Media Performance (performance marketing et publicitaire). Le consultant interviendra sur l'analyse des sources de données, leur mapping, la définition des indicateurs métiers et la fiabilisation des données dans un environnement international. Principales responsabilités : Réaliser l'inventaire des données et API Amazon disponibles. Analyser les sources de données Amazon liées aux performances commerciales et publicitaires. Effectuer le mapping entre les données Amazon et les modèles de données internes. Définir, formaliser et documenter les KPI métiers ainsi que leurs règles de calcul. Identifier les écarts, incohérences et données manquantes. Réconcilier et valider les données Amazon avec les sources existantes. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité et de la cohérence des données. Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles et la documentation associée. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes métiers, Data et IT. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un Business Data Analyst disposant d'une solide expérience dans l'analyse, la structuration et la modélisation des données, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers liés à la performance commerciale et marketing. Une expérience préalable dans l'écosystème Amazon, notamment sur les données Sales Performance et Media Performance, sera particulièrement appréciée. Compétences recherchées : Expérience confirmée en Business Analysis / Data Analysis. Bonne connaissance de l'écosystème Amazon et idéalement de ses API. Solide compréhension des données Sales Performance : ventes, chiffre d'affaires, volumes, KPI commerciaux. Connaissance des données Media Performance : campagnes publicitaires, indicateurs de performance marketing. Expérience en Data Mapping, Data Modeling et Data Reconciliation. Capacité à définir et documenter des KPI et des règles de gestion. Bonne maîtrise de SQL pour l'analyse et la validation des données. Expérience dans la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de documentation Data. Capacité à interagir avec des équipes métiers et techniques dans un contexte international. Excellent esprit d'analyse, rigueur et autonomie. Français et anglais courants indispensables.

items.desc: The European Organisation for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere (ESO) is the foremost intergovernmental astronomy organisation in Europe and the world's most productive ground-based astronomical observatory. ESO carries out an ambitious programme focused on the design, construction and operation of powerful ground-based observing facilities enabling astronomers to make important scientific discoveries. ESO operates three unique world-class observing sites in northern Chile: La Silla, Paranal and Chajnantor (home to ALMA), and the ESO Headquarters are located in Garching, near Munich, Germany. At Paranal, ESO operates the Very Large Telescope, the world's most advanced visible-light astronomical observatory, and will host and operate the southern array of the Cherenkov Telescope Array, the world's largest and most sensitive high energy gamma-ray observatory. ESO is a major partner in ALMA. On Cerro Armazones, ESO is building the 39-metre Extremely Large Telescope (ELT), which will become "the world's biggest eye on the sky" and whose operations will be fully integrated into the Paranal Observatory. Due to the need for additional resources within the Directorate of Programmes, ESO is advertising the position of Document Control Assistant Garching Deadline 21/11/2026 In your role as Document Control Assistant, you will be supporting the work of the Document Control team responsible for the management of a high number of business-critical documents for the Instrumentation Programme, Technology Development Programme and ELT Construction Programme. The Document Control Assistant ensures that the Programmes' documents are formatted, identified, signed, released and archived according to the relevant document lifecycle's rules. The Document Control Assistant ensures the distribution of documents to appropriate internal stakeholders and facilitates the sharing of documents with external parties. This is a crucial role as accurate, timely and efficient management of documents is vital for the success of the different Programmes. You will be expected to work effectively in a team but at the same time to work independently exercising problem-solving skills with responsibility for your own area of work. While playing a supporting role in the active management of documentation related to the Programmes, you will work under the guidance of the Programme Engineers and in close collaboration with the Document Control team in managing the document archive and the product configuration repositories. You will have to ensure that they are updated and accessible by the users whilst meeting required standards of accuracy, quality and integrity and enforce the documentation and configuration management processes as defined within the Programmes. Main Duties and Responsibilities: Support the administration of the archive of the different Programmes through the ESO Information Repository system (PDM) by generating and maintaining folder structures, updating metadata and populating the folders according to the Programmes' evolution. Perform quality control of documents, in particular checking the correctness of reference documents/versions, the proper use of standard templates and lifecycles, and that the configuration control rules relevant for documentation management are observed. Ensure that the documents go through a traceable and approved release process before being archived. Support tasks related to product configuration management, by keeping the repositories updated with the relevant information and allocated documentation. Work in strict co-operation with project managers, engineers, the Programme Engineers and the Document Control team to ensure that the ESO documentation for procurements as well as the documentation submitted by contractors and consortia complies with the relevant documentation management requirements and is correctly stored in the ESO PDM system. Provide support in the preparation, update and implementation of Contract Data Lists (CDL) for procurements. Provide user support to staff ensuring that the relevant document archive is effectively used and that document management procedures are duly followed. Provide support in delivering training to contractors and consortia to ensure accurate and efficient document delivery. Grant access to authorized users to the archived documents in accordance to established access permission policies. Coordinate with the ESO Information Repository Manager and System Administrator user licenses, access groups and access profiles. Participate to the PDM Programme Assistants monthly meeting chaired by the ESO Information Repository Manager. Key Competences and Experience: Essential Competences and Experience Excellent knowledge and experience of MS Office Suite, in particular Excel, of Adobe Acrobat pdf and of electronic signature requirements is essential. You should be able to demonstrate advanced proficiency in the applications leveraging advanced …

items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Your role and responsibilities We are looking for a Global Application Engineer with good know-how of controls for AC and DC microgrids, relevant experience in the key parts of a microgrid: solar PV, battery energy storage, AC/DC and DC/DC converters, electrical protection and grid connection, are considered valuable assets. The role combines hands-on technical work, from reference architectures to testing, validation and project execution, with close customer contact on real projects, including DC microgrid pilots. You’ll be the link between customers, R&D, product management and research centers, bringing market needs into new developments and helping turn technical solutions into business. Depending on your background, your focus will be either on grid-connected AC microgrids for industrial and commercial customers, or on DC microgrid installations and pilots. Work model: Hybrid (#LI hybrid) You will be mainly accountable for: Supporting customers and sales teams in industrial and commercial segments, from early technical discussions to solution proposals, for MG electrical & control systems serving solar PV, battery energy storage and variable loads. Developing and promoting reference architectures and application notes for AC and DC microgrids using ABB’s low voltage portfolio, converters and digital solutions. Planning and managing microgrid installations and pilot projects, from system design and panel solutions to commissioning support. Supporting development, testing and validation of applications, including supplier selection and purchasing. Working with R&D, product management, digital teams and research centers to bring market needs into new developments. Analyzing the competitive landscape and market trends and recommend adjustments to mid- and long-term strategy. Qualifications for the role Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, with 4+ years of experience in microgrids systems. Practical experience with microgrid components such as controllers, converters/PCS, battery energy storage and solar PV, including their protection. Ability to read and work with multiline diagrams and technical specifications in tools such as AutoCAD or EPLAN. Technical sales or application engineering towards industrial and commercial customers. Electrical system design, panel building or project management of microgrid or similar installations. Knowledge of DC applications and grid codes is a plus. Electrical simulations using MATLAB Simulink is a plus Comfortable working with customers, with good negotiation and communication skills in English. Agile mindset and willingness to keep learning. Willingness to travel for short periods. Driving’s license. More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive. The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.desc: Enabling smaller, more powerful and energy-efficient microchips – Working where tomorrow takes shape. Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are manufactured using ZEISS technologies. As the heart of every electronically controlled system, they have become an indispensable part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, more powerful and more energy-efficient microchips – and, through its innovations, plays a key role in shaping the age of micro- and nanoelectronics. Your Role Our team “Quality Assurance and Devops” within the department of Quality concerns itself with establishing quality assurance processes and DevOps standards for software applications and modules that are used in our production lines. The team develops and maintains platforms that support the implementation of core aspects of quality ranging from an effective software release and deployment platform to using data engineering approaches to build a reliability prediction platform for our production value streams. Your role: Reliability, Data Engineering and Full-Stack DevOps Engineer Develop a data-driven software reliability prediction platform for complex, production-relevant applications and machines Combine simulation, test, production, field issues, and DevOps data into scalable data pipelines and reliable analytical foundations. Apply statistical, data science, and machine learning methods to identify reliability risks, failure patterns and quality trends Design and implement full-stack web solutions, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise systems that facilitate effective presentations of key learnings and trends towards stakeholders Integrate reliability models and algorithms into maintainable software components that support engineering and quality assurance decisions. Collaborate closely with operations and R&D to continue to build out and integrate effective Reliability prediction models that span across software and manufacturing machines Your Profile Degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, industrial engineering, or a comparable technical field Strong software engineering skills with practical experience in Python, C#, TypeScript/JavaScript or any high-level programming languages as well as clean code, modular design, and maintainable architectures Hands on experience and understanding of data science, statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics and reliability modeling Experience with data engineering concepts such as data pipelines, data quality, ETL/ELT, databases, APIs, and heterogeneous technical data sources Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, including modern frontend frameworks, backend services, REST APIs, authentication concepts, dashboards, and visualizations Good knowledge of DevOps and cloud native development and deployment approaches, GitOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and agile software development practices Analytical mindset, structured working style, and the ability to translate complex technical requirements into pragmatic software solutions Comfortable with English. items.desc: embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world. We are looking for a Master Data Specialist to own and optimize the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across our international business. You will be responsible for integrating data from Salesforce, SAP, IQVIA, and other key systems into a centralized, trusted, and scalable data environment. This role will lead the management of customer master data, account hierarchies, territory mappings, and reporting structures across more than 100 countries. You will drive improvements in data quality, governance, and automation while enhancing Power BI and Excel reporting capabilities to deliver accurate, actionable business insights. Working closely with Commercial Excellence, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional teams, you will help standardize data processes, support Salesforce data management, and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot. This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful business value. Key Responsibilities Data Integration & Extract, Transform & Load Pipelines Design, build, and maintain ETL processes connecting Salesforce, IQVIA, SAP, and additional data sources. Develop automated, schedule‑based data pipelines with robust error‑handling and alerting mechanisms. Centralize all locally purchased data assets (e.g., IQVIA) into a single environment Support the Monthly Business Review (MBR) data pipeline and reporting infrastructure. Data Cleaning & Quality Assurance Implement standardized data‑cleaning protocols and validation frameworks. Identify and resolve data‑quality issues at source or within transformation layers. Build and maintain data‑quality dashboards and metrics to monitor ongoing data health across all regions. Salesforce & Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data Management Maintain accurate account hierarchies and customer master data in Salesforce. Troubleshoot issues related to Salesforce‑to‑analytics data synchronization. Ensure data consistency across all Salesforce environments and connected systems. Account Mapping & Customer Master Data Maintain and update global account hierarchies and territory mappings. Develop and enforce standardized account‑naming conventions across regions. Create and manage account‑to‑cluster mapping tables. Manage account mergers, divestitures, and organizational structure changes. Power BI Infrastructure & Optimization Set up and optimize Power BI data models, using both DirectQuery and Import modes. Create reusable templates and design standards to support scalable Power BI development. Monitor and improve query performance across Power BI datasets and semantic models. AI & Automation Opportunities Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual data‑processing workload. Evaluate AI‑enabled features (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) in collaboration with IT to enhance data workflows. Develop scripts or tools to automate repetitive validation and transformation tasks. Education and Experience Third-level qualification (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Analytics Tools & Platforms Proficiency in Power BI including advanced DAX measures, calculated tables, and complex data‑modelling formulas. Strong command of Microsoft Excel for data manipulation, analysis, and model building. Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem, including custom fields, workflows, data models, and data‑quality structures. Familiarity with IQVIA, SAP, and other data systems commonly used in pharmaceutical and medical device environments. Strong problem‑solving mindset with a high level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business‑friendly language. Collaborative approach to partnering with regional teams, business analysts, and cross‑functional stakeholders. Strong documentation discipline and a process‑oriented working style. Desirable Skills Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and automation. embecta is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. items.desc: iNFINITUM is a client-oriented organization that continuously evolves. Our team consistently extends its capabilities to meet exact needs based on specific business requirements, with customers coming from a wide range of industry sectors. At iNFINITUM , our success depends on our people, productivity, and procedures. We believe that the continuous success of our projects depends upon the outstanding performance of our highly skilled and trained staff. Providing access to modern professional training designed in line with real-world challenges is paramount to that success. We are looking for an experienced and passionate OpenShift & Ansible Automation Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Cloud Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the architectural design, administration, scaling, and security of our Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters, ensuring high availability and seamless application migration. Additionally, you will drive infrastructure automation across the organization using the Ansible Automation Platform , transforming repetitive manual operations into reusable, reliable playbooks while maintaining stability and security across our IT environment. Key Responsibilities OpenShift Engineering & Administration Cluster Design & Architecture: Analyze requirements to size nodes (worker & infra), evaluate storage options, define authentication methods, and integrate appropriate load balancers. Cluster Scaling & Capacity Management: Manage cluster capacity and scaling, optimize workload placement, and evaluate performance impact. Upgrades & Patching: Research and analyze new Red Hat OCP releases, conduct impact assessments, and execute seamless cluster upgrades and routine patching. Logging & Monitoring Solutions: Configure ClusterLogForwarder to securely forward audit, infrastructure, and application logs to external logging platforms (e.g., Splunk) as per Red Hat best practices. Registry & Namespace Administration: Manage container registries for cluster and application images. Maintain namespaces/projects, configure ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges, and project templates. Security & Governance: Define ACLs, Network Policies, and enforce least-privilege RBAC for users and Service Accounts. Harden clusters using the Compliance Operator and integrate image security scanning (e.g., Aqua, JFrog Xray). Developer Experience & Migration: Collaborate closely with development teams to migrate applications to OpenShift, provide Helm charts, and assist with Kubernetes resource definitions (Pods, Services, PVCs, Network Policies). Ansible Automation & Orchestration Automation Development: Design, build, and refine Ansible Playbooks, Roles, Templates, and Variables for software installation, configuration management, patching, and user provisioning. Platform & Inventory Management: Maintain Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) / AWX environments, managing job templates, workflows, credentials, execution environments, and dynamic/static inventories. Quality Assurance & Testing: Perform syntax checks, playbook linting, and utilize Ansible’s check mode to validate changes on non-production hosts prior to rollout. Version Control & Operational Improvement: Manage automation code via Git, lead code reviews, and partner with Systems, Network, Security, and Application teams to standardize processes and eliminate configuration drift. Requirements Must-Have Experience & Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of hands-on experience in administering and designing Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) & Kubernetes environments. Strong experience with Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform (AWX) for configuration management and infrastructure automation (YAML, Playbooks, Roles). Deep understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift networking concepts (Ingress, CNI, Services, Network Policies, Load Balancers). Experience integrating external logging platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK) and managing container registries. Proficiency with version control systems ( Git ) and CI/CD / GitOps tooling ( Helm , ArgoCD). Solid grasp of container security practices (RBAC, Image Scanning, Compliance Operators). Strong background in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Nice-to-Have / Certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (EX280) or Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation (EX294) . Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). Soft Skills & Working Style Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical conversations between Developers, SysAdmins, and Security teams. Proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, standardization, and automating manual workloads. Benefits Friendly and Dynamic Working Environment. Interacting with product owners/clients, other business analysts, software developers and testers in the group. What you will bring Ideally you will have 1 -2 years experience in the banking and financial services industry, fund administration, accounting, tax or operations experience in financial services. Bachelor’s degree within Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics and Information Technology (BAIT). Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Finance, Economics Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Strong project management, organization and communication skills. What will set you apart? Experience with SQL and related tools (e.g., Microsoft Query, Rapid SQL, DBeaver, etc.) preferred. Knowledge of the Software Development Life-Cycle preferred and Agile methodology a plus. Experience with Cognos or other reporting platforms is a plus. Experience with business analysis, requirements, software testing or proficiency tools (e.g., automated testing tools, compare tools, robotics, data visualization, Python) a plus PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. The role works closely with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure programmes align with business priorities and drive measurable performance outcomes. Develop and facilitate impactful learning solutions tailored to organisational needs, with a focus on employee development and leadership development. Deliver training using a range of methodologies, including classroom sessions, workshops, e-learning, and blended learning approaches. Provide coaching and mentoring to employees and managers to support development and improve performance. 2. Evaluate programme effectiveness using feedback, performance metrics, and business impact measures. Continuously refine and improve learning solutions based on evaluation outcomes. 5. T&D Team Contribution & Innovation Collaborate with the Talent & Development Manager to design and implement strategies aligned to business objectives. Work with T&D colleagues to promote learning offerings across the organisation. Stay up to date with emerging learning trends, technologies, and methodologies. Drive continuous improvement and innovation within the T&D function. Support and lead change initiatives, building engagement and adoption across the organisation. Skills & Experience 2 – 3 years’ experience in a learning and development capacity Strong facilitation, coaching, and programme design capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to use data to evaluate and improve learning impact. Strong business acumen and understanding of organisational priorities. Ability to travel within Europe Mercury is an equal opportunity employer

Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health. By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare. Business Information Systems (BIS) Placement January–June 2027 | Galway, Ireland Role: Technical Operations Intern Reporting to: Global Tech Operations and Ireland Site Lead Location: Hybrid - Bonham Quay, Galway city About Datavant Datavant is a data platform company and a leader in health data exchange. Clear written and verbal communication skills. An organised approach and attention to detail. A willingness to ask questions, solve problems, and learn new tools. The ability to take ownership of tasks and work collaboratively. Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, process-mapping tools, or basic query languages is helpful but not essential. We value potential over experience. You'll receive support and guidance as you learn. How You'll Apply Your BIS Learning This placement connects your coursework to practical experience in: Systems analysis and design: Gather requirements, map workflows, and document system interactions. Project management: Support planning, task tracking, and delivery. Business process modelling: Analyse workflows and recommend improvements. Data and information management: Contribute to reporting and learn about data governance. IT governance and compliance: See how teams manage risk, maintain standards, and document controls. Enterprise systems: Understand how tools, platforms, and teams support business operations. You'll build a foundation for a career in technology operations, systems analysis, IT management, or technology delivery. What We Offer Meaningful project work and real responsibility. items.desc: Cosa aspettarti Siamo uno dei principali gruppi tecnologici in Italia e operiamo come Business & Technology Accelerator di Aziende, Istituzioni Finanziarie e Servizi Pubblici, supportando l’evoluzione delle loro strategie IT e digitali. Con un ecosistema di imprese che condividono valori e visione, aiutiamo i clienti a cogliere i benefici della tecnologia, amplificandone l’impatto positivo su economia e società. Entrerai nella Direzione Sustainability, Risk & Compliance di Dedagroup e affiancherai le società del Gruppo nella gestione dei rischi e nell'evoluzione del sistema di compliance. Ti occuperai di normative in ambito privacy, intelligenza artificiale, resilienza operativa digitale, responsabilità amministrativa degli enti (D.Lgs. 231/2001) e anticorruzione. Collaborerai con le diverse funzioni aziendali per tradurre i requisiti normativi in processi e strumenti concreti stabiliti dalla Capogruppo. Cosa farai Supporterai le società del Gruppo negli adempimenti previsti dal GDPR e dalla normativa sulla protezione dei dati personali, inclusi i trattamenti effettuati con sistemi di intelligenza artificiale. Contribuirai all'adeguamento ai requisiti dell'AI Act e alla definizione di procedure per un utilizzo responsabile e conforme dell'intelligenza artificiale, valutando l'impatto delle tecnologie emergenti su processi, prodotti e servizi. Supporterai l'analisi dei requisiti DORA applicabili e l'adeguamento di processi e documentazione aziendale. Contribuirai all'implementazione, al mantenimento e all'aggiornamento dei Modelli 231, dei presidi anticorruzione e del sistema di whistleblowing. Parteciperai ad audit e assessment, monitorando i controlli interni e le azioni di miglioramento. Aggiornerai policy, procedure e linee guida aziendali in linea con l'evoluzione normativa. Supporterai le funzioni aziendali nella gestione dei requisiti di compliance previsti dai contratti con i clienti, contribuendo all'analisi delle clausole e alla predisposizione della documentazione e delle evidenze richieste. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te Laurea ed almeno 3 anni di esperienza in compliance o nei sistemi di controllo interno. Conoscenza dei principali requisiti di GDPR, AI Act, DORA, D.Lgs. 231/2001, whistleblowing e anticorruzione (es. ISO 37001). Esperienza in audit, assessment e nella redazione di policy e procedure. Buona conoscenza di Microsoft 365. Precisione, capacità di analisi, problem solving, autonomia e attitudine alla collaborazione. Nice to have: Esperienza in gruppi complessi o società di consulenza; Ottime capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale; Proattività e forte senso di responsabilità. Cosa ti offriamo Work life balance grazie a un modello di lavoro agile personalizzato e flessibile Coinvolgimento in progetti strategici e innovativi per la trasformazione digitale della sanità pubblica Valori da condividere; possibilità di crescita, formazione e certificazione supportati dall’azienda – scopri la vita in Deda Se ritieni di possedere le competenze richieste, anche con un livello di seniority non pienamente allineato a quello indicato, ti invitiamo comunque a candidarti: durante la selezione valuteremo attentamente il tuo grado di esperienza professionale. Il range retributivo indicato nell'annuncio si riferisce al livello di seniority esplicitato; un’eventuale diversa valutazione durante l'iter selettivo potrà determinare un adeguamento al range salariale corrispondente.
