items.desc: embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world. We are looking for a Master Data Specialist to own and optimize the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across our international business. You will be responsible for integrating data from Salesforce, SAP, IQVIA, and other key systems into a centralized, trusted, and scalable data environment. This role will lead the management of customer master data, account hierarchies, territory mappings, and reporting structures across more than 100 countries. You will drive improvements in data quality, governance, and automation while enhancing Power BI and Excel reporting capabilities to deliver accurate, actionable business insights. Working closely with Commercial Excellence, IT, Finance, Supply Chain, and regional teams, you will help standardize data processes, support Salesforce data management, and identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot. This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful business value. Key Responsibilities Data Integration & Extract, Transform & Load Pipelines Design, build, and maintain ETL processes connecting Salesforce, IQVIA, SAP, and additional data sources. Develop automated, schedule‑based data pipelines with robust error‑handling and alerting mechanisms. Centralize all locally purchased data assets (e.g., IQVIA) into a single environment Support the Monthly Business Review (MBR) data pipeline and reporting infrastructure. Data Cleaning & Quality Assurance Implement standardized data‑cleaning protocols and validation frameworks. Identify and resolve data‑quality issues at source or within transformation layers. Build and maintain data‑quality dashboards and metrics to monitor ongoing data health across all regions. Salesforce & Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data Management Maintain accurate account hierarchies and customer master data in Salesforce. Troubleshoot issues related to Salesforce‑to‑analytics data synchronization. Ensure data consistency across all Salesforce environments and connected systems. Account Mapping & Customer Master Data Maintain and update global account hierarchies and territory mappings. Develop and enforce standardized account‑naming conventions across regions. Create and manage account‑to‑cluster mapping tables. Manage account mergers, divestitures, and organizational structure changes. Power BI Infrastructure & Optimization Set up and optimize Power BI data models, using both DirectQuery and Import modes. Create reusable templates and design standards to support scalable Power BI development. Monitor and improve query performance across Power BI datasets and semantic models. AI & Automation Opportunities Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual data‑processing workload. Evaluate AI‑enabled features (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) in collaboration with IT to enhance data workflows. Develop scripts or tools to automate repetitive validation and transformation tasks. Education and Experience Third-level qualification (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Analytics Tools & Platforms Proficiency in Power BI including advanced DAX measures, calculated tables, and complex data‑modelling formulas. Strong command of Microsoft Excel for data manipulation, analysis, and model building. Working knowledge of the Salesforce ecosystem, including custom fields, workflows, data models, and data‑quality structures. Familiarity with IQVIA, SAP, and other data systems commonly used in pharmaceutical and medical device environments. Strong problem‑solving mindset with a high level of attention to detail. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business‑friendly language. Collaborative approach to partnering with regional teams, business analysts, and cross‑functional stakeholders. Strong documentation discipline and a process‑oriented working style. Desirable Skills Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and automation. embecta is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Frequent use of computer systems and multi-function devices (MFD). Working Environment: Work is generally conducted in a shop environment. However, duties may involve the conduct of work in the outdoors area with a potential exposure to extreme climatic condition. Work will mostly be performed in a field maintenance environment inside a fabric maintenance facility. The facility is environmentally controlled, hours are generally 8/day x 5 days a week; however, overtime may be required given the gravity of the mission and schedule. Candidates must be flexible and committed to working the required hours to support this effort. Work requires stooping, climbing, prolonged standing, prolong sitting and occasional working in cramped and awkward position. Frequent exposure to conditions of inclement weather, extreme heat and cold, high/low humidity, blowing sand and dust, and working in confined spaces and at heights. Physical Activities: Must be able to climb up and down ladders and stairs, as well as bend, twist, and squad for prolonged periods. Must be able to pull, push and lift up to 50 pounds. Function in conditions of inclement weather, extreme heat and cold, high/low humidity, blowing sand and dust, and working in confined spaces and at heights. Qualifications: Required Skills: Minimum of three (3) years of experience in radar systems or equivalent equipment. Must be proficient in servicing, troubleshooting and repairing military electronic equipment. Must be familiar with the use of US Military & electronic technical manuals. Must be a U.S. citizen. Must possess a valid State Driver’s License. Must be able to secure and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC),within three months of employment. Desired Skills: Graduate of US Army MOS 13R or 94 series, or other service equivalent. Education / Certifications: High School Diploma or equivalent. items.card: Job Description: The opportunity The Junior User Experience (UX/UI) Designer is a developing member of the User Experience practice, working with experienced designers and partnering with product, engineering and delivery teams. The role supports the design of advanced software products for the energy sector and contributes to an evidence-based product vision for complex power-automation engineering environments.
items.desc: Location: Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland Job ID: R0148290 Date Posted: 2026-10-21 Company Name: HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O. Profession (Job Category): Creative & Design Job Schedule: Full time Remote: No Job Description: The opportunity The Junior User Experience (UX/UI) Designer is a developing member of the User Experience practice, working with experienced designers and partnering with product, engineering and delivery teams. The role supports the design of advanced software products for the energy sector and contributes to an evidence-based product vision for complex power-automation engineering environments. You will learn to apply an end-to-end design process – from understanding business objectives and user needs to mapping workflows, prototyping, testing and refining solutions. Working under guidance, you will gradually take ownership of clearly scoped UX tasks while building your research, interaction design, visual design and communication skills. How You Will Make an Impact Support UX research and design activities within an end-to-end design thinking process. Work with designers, product managers, product owners, engineers and domain experts to understand business objectives, user needs, scope and constraints. Review product documentation, backlog items, existing designs, issue reports, training materials and technical artefacts. Help prepare stakeholder and user interviews, usability tests, interview scripts and research materials. Participate in interviews, workshops and usability-testing sessions, with guidance from more experienced team members. Organize and synthesize findings, distinguishing evidence from assumptions, opinions and technical constraints. Contribute to user archetypes, jobs-to-be-done, journey maps, use cases and problem statements. Map user flows and clearly scoped workflows, including key steps, decisions, dependencies, handovers and error conditions. Brainstorm concepts and translate requirements into wireframes, prototypes and user-interface designs. Iterate designs based on research findings, usability feedback, design reviews and technical input. Apply established design-system components, UX methods, accessibility principles and interface-design best practices. Document design decisions and present work clearly to UX, product and engineering stakeholders. Manage assigned tasks reliably, communicate progress and risks, and ask for support when needed. Continuously develop knowledge of UX methods, tools, the energy domain and complex engineering software. Your Background Up to up to 2 years of professional UX/UI, product design or relevant project experience; strong graduate, internship, freelance or academic work is welcome. A portfolio demonstrating your design process, problem-solving approach and contribution to at least one digital product or service. Foundational understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, information architecture, usability and visual hierarchy. Basic experience with user research, workflow or journey mapping, wireframing, prototyping and usability testing. Ability to analyze information, identify patterns and translate findings into clear design decisions. Curiosity about complex domains and motivation to understand technical workflows, user roles and constraints. Openness to feedback, willingness to learn and ability to iterate your work. Good organization, attention to detail and reliability in delivering assigned tasks. Ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional and international environment. Professional English sufficient for meetings, workshops and documentation. Working knowledge of common UX design and prototyping tools. A bachelor’s degree in design, HCI, computer science, information sciences or a related field is a plus. Experience with enterprise software, industrial automation, energy, utilities, engineering tools or products combining software and physical devices is a plus. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. The role may support employees, managers and HR stakeholders across multiple markets within one or more end-to-end process areas (i.e. Hires & Job changes, Leavers, Time and Absence, and Global Employee Data and Support). Maintain process documentation, knowledge articles and working instructions so that information remains accurate, accessible and current. Monitor service performance, identify recurring issues and contribute to standardisation, simplification, automation and continuous improvement initiatives. Share knowledge, support onboarding and capability building, and provide day-to-day guidance to less experienced colleagues when needed. Adapt to changes in process scope, market coverage, systems and service priorities while maintaining high-quality delivery. Work arrangement: This role is hybrid. Typical schedule will include 2 to 3 days on-site per week, with flexible working hours. items.desc: Descrição da empresa We are an Engineering and Product Development Center that designs, develops and produces new technologies, products and services for a more sustainable society. We work to bridge the gap between cities, industry and universities around major development and industrialization programs for products and services, from Portugal, in high-tech sectors such as mobility, aeronautics and space. This opportunity for an Engineer | DevSecOps (m/f/d) will be integrated into the Digital Solutions team. Descrição do emprego We are seeking a curious DevSecOps Engineer to join our growing team. As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will be responsible for integrating security practices into our development and operational workflows. Your role is critical to enforce the alignment between development, security, and operations, ensuring our applications and infrastructure are scalable, resilient and above all, secured from day one. Key responsabilities are: Secure CI/CD Pipelines: Integrate security tools and practices into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., static code analysis, vulnerability scanning, secrets detection); Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and maintain secure IaC using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or similars; Cloud Security: Implement cloud-native (AWS, Azure, GCP) security solutions and controls; Incident Response: Participate in the incident response and post-mortem analysis, ensuring the rapid restoration of the solutions; Tooling & Monitoring: Deploy and manage security tools (e.g., using tools like Snyk, Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Falco, HashiCorp Vault or similars) for runtime protection and monitoring; Collaboration: Partner with development, operations, and security teams to foster a DevSecOps culture and champion security best practices across the organization. AI : Securing LLM-based applications or using AI-assisted tools responsibly to enhance DevSecOps workflows, plus, governing AI coding agents in defining project rules, context files, tool permissions, and guardrails. Qualificações University degree or technical-professional training in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering and similar areas; At least 2 years of experience in DevOps, Security Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering; Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., using tools like GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similars); Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., using tools like Python, Bash, Go or similars); Experience with containers and orchestration (e.g., using tools like Docker, Kubernetes or similars); Knowledge of secure coding principles, vulnerability management, and application security; Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with all teams; Clear and concise communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; Proactive and self-driven mindset with the ability to identify and resolve issues before they escalate; Pasion for problem-solving and a structured approach to quickly restore solutions; Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, constantly evolving technical environment; Commitment to continuous learning and staying up-to-date emerging technologies; Empathy and business awareness, balancing security needs with organizational goals. Informação adicional Dynamic, multidisciplinary team and a positive, relaxed work environment; We facilitate and promote a balanced and healthy lifestyle, integrating work with personal life; We offer Health Insurance for employees; Partnerships with gyms, a nutritionist, and other benefits; Up to three additional vacation days; Day off on your birthday.

Current work covers probability of default, redemption and prepayment, expected credit loss, and interactive analytics. The next challenge is to turn this work into a reliable, maintainable platform that can support different portfolios and client needs. You will work directly with the client’s business and technology teams, alongside a credit-domain and modelling lead and other engineers. You will own the engineering architecture, contribute production code, and help the team decide what to build and how to deliver it. We need someone who can question assumptions, propose simpler alternatives and explain technical trade-offs clearly. What you will do Translate business problems into an architecture, practical delivery plan and clear acceptance criteria. Identify gaps in requirements, data and dependencies before they become delivery problems. Design the path from working models and dashboards to a production-ready ML platform. Make deliberate choices about shared components, portfolio-specific configuration, model calibration and future client onboarding. Build and improve reproducible workflows for data preparation, feature engineering, training, validation, scoring and deployment. Establish clear versioning for code, data, models and calibration logic. Work with the modelling lead on how probability of default, prepayment, lifetime risk and loss estimates are calculated, tested and exposed to applications. Keep business definitions consistent across models, tables and dashboards. Strengthen the data foundation: trace results to source, investigate data-quality issues, document assumptions and build automated checks around important transformations. Improve the reliability of the Snowflake-backed analytics application, including deployment, testing, permissions and integration with model outputs. Put appropriate MLOps practices in place, including repeatable releases, monitoring, failure handling, rollback and operational documentation. Design for privacy, access control, auditability and model governance. Work with domain experts to make validation, stability and fairness checks practical and reviewable. Lead technical discussions, review code, unblock engineers and keep the client informed about progress, risks and architectural decisions. Assess where natural-language or LLM-assisted analytics would add value, without losing focus on trustworthy data, robust models and useful products. What we are looking for A track record of designing and delivering production data or ML systems, with ownership extending beyond prototypes and architecture diagrams. Strong hands-on Python and SQL. You should be comfortable investigating a dataset, reviewing modelling code and implementing critical parts of the solution yourself. Practical MLOps experience: reproducible pipelines, model and data versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and the operational consequences of model updates. Experience with cloud data platforms and modern warehouses. Snowflake experience is particularly relevant; you should be able to reason about data access, performance, cost and deployment constraints. An understanding of model evaluation, calibration, data leakage, changing populations and the difference between model quality and system reliability. The ability to work through incomplete documentation and inconsistent business definitions, and turn findings into maintainable code and clear documentation. Strong client-facing communication in English. You can explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, constructively challenge a requirement and take responsibility for the resulting decision. Experience leading a small technical team while remaining actively involved in implementation. Useful additional experience Credit-risk, lending or servicing analytics, including PD, LGD, ECL, prepayment or portfolio stress testing. Regulated financial-services delivery and model governance. Streamlit, Azure ML, semantic data layers or analytics applications built on Snowflake. Configurable ML products serving multiple portfolios or clients. Evaluated natural-language analytics, text-to-SQL or LLM-assisted workflows. Current technical environment Snowflake, SQL, Python, Streamlit and an Azure ML environment. The team also uses AI-assisted development tools. You will help evolve the architecture based on the product’s needs rather than introduce a predetermined stack. What we would like to discuss A production ML or analytics system you personally helped build, including the architecture decisions and code you owned. items.desc: What are you going to do? Your mission will be to help ambitious organisations secure European funding for innovative projects that strengthen Europe's technological capabilities, industrial competitiveness, and resilience. You will transform complex technical ideas into compelling funding proposals, connect the right partners, and support clients throughout the funding acquisition process. Beyond writing successful proposals, you will contribute your technical expertise, industry knowledge, and professional network to identify new opportunities and strengthen PNO Innovation's position within the Portuguese and European innovation ecosystems. Lead the preparation, writing, and coordination of competitive European funding proposals, from initial concept development to final submission. Identify and assess funding opportunities under Horizon Europe, EDF, Digital Europe, and other relevant European programmes. Work closely with industrial clients, research organisations, and technology developers to understand their innovation objectives and translate technical concepts into strong project proposals. Build and coordinate international consortia, identifying suitable partners and establishing effective collaborations. Develop proposal strategies, work packages, technical narratives, impact pathways, and implementation plans aligned with programme requirements and evaluation criteria. Monitor European policy developments, funding priorities, and emerging opportunities in strategic technologies, industrial resilience, and competitiveness. Maintain and develop relationships with relevant companies, research institutions, industry associations, and innovation stakeholders in Portugal and across Europe. Contribute to business development by identifying potential clients, supporting project acquisition, and leveraging your professional network to create new opportunities. Do you have any questions about this position? I’d love to tell you more about it! Please contact me. What do we offer you? Meaningful impact: Work on ambitious European projects addressing technological sovereignty, security, industrial resilience, and emerging technologies. International collaboration: Join a European consultancy group and work alongside experienced colleagues and partners across multiple countries. Professional autonomy: Take ownership of complex funding proposals and contribute directly to strategic innovation projects. Diverse projects: Collaborate with leading industrial companies, research institutions, and technology innovators across different sectors. Career development: Expand your expertise in European funding, innovation consulting, and strategic industrial technologies. Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in Portugal, with approximately 1–2 in-person meetings per month at our Porto office. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary between €32,000 and €38,000 , depending on experience and qualifications. Growing team: Join an expanding Portuguese operation where your expertise, ideas, and professional relationships can make a tangible difference. About you At least 3 years of professional experience in European funding, innovation consulting, or closely related activities, with demonstrated involvement in competitive funding applications. Proven ability to independently develop, write, and coordinate EU funding proposals, ideally including Horizon Europe Clusters 3 and 4, EDF, or Digital Europe. A technical or engineering academic background , combined with relevant professional experience in industry or consulting, enabling you to understand complex technologies and engage confidently with technical stakeholders. Strong technical understanding of one or more relevant sectors, such as industrial innovation, manufacturing, defence, security, resilience, space, advanced materials, or emerging technologies. Good knowledge of European funding mechanisms, innovation policies, and strategic priorities, including technological sovereignty, industrial competitiveness, and supply-chain resilience. Experience in consortium building, stakeholder coordination, and leading technical discussions with industrial or research partners. An established professional network within the Portuguese innovation ecosystem, particularly among industrial companies, research institutions, or technology organisations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English , and residency in Portugal, with the ability to work independently in a remote-first environment. About us PNO Innovation is the leading innovation and funding consultancy in Europe. With our broad sector expertise, generative AI tools and more than 40 years of experience in national and European grants, we help give space to good ideas and make innovation happen. PNO Innovation employs more than 600 professionals across offices throughout Europe: Belgium, France, Greece, Italy, The Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain and the UK. What started …

items.desc: Role Description: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands. Role description The Data Analytics Engineer I operates as a developing contributor on data pipelines and data models of low to moderate complexity, supporting the cross-brand data, reporting and analytics needs of Booking Holdings. This role contributes to clearly scoped deliverables — from ingestion, through transformation, to enablement of reporting — under the guidance and framework set by senior peers and the Solutions Architect. Success in this role means consistent, reliable delivery on assigned tasks and components for the business areas served by the team (such as Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Procurement, Market Intelligence and others), while building a strong foundation in the team's tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, Python, AWS, Terraform) and growing technical judgement under close guidance from Senior Engineers and the Solutions Architect. Data Modeling on Snowflake: Implements well-defined, low to moderate complexity dimensional data models on Snowflake based on requirements provided by Business Analysts and Product, closely following team conventions for naming, layering and documentation; exposure to other modeling approaches (e.g. Data Vault) is a plus. Python for Data Analytics Engineering: Writes clean, testable Python — including basic object-oriented code — for Dagster assets and general Data Analytics Engineering tasks, with support and code review from senior peers. - is considered a plus Source Integration: Helps integrate data from a variety of sources (ERPs, transactional systems, SaaS tools, flat files, spreadsheets, etc.), developing familiarity with the relevant business semantics. Quality, Testing & Monitoring: Writes basic tests (dbt tests, custom checks) and helps monitor data quality for the pipelines they contribute to, escalating anomalies to senior peers for investigation. Operational Excellence (Awareness Level): Learns to work within the team's CI/CD, Git, Docker and Terraform setup, contributing to DataOps practices under the direction of senior peers. Collaboration: Works closely with other Data Analytics Engineers, the Reporting team, Business Analysts and the Product Manager, asking questions and escalating ambiguity early to translate requirements into technical tasks . Basic understanding of cloud data warehousing, ideally on Snowflake. Awareness of data warehousing methodologies (Kimball); Data Vault is a nice to have (*). Awareness of business domains involving data and reporting (such as Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Procurement, Market Intelligence or comparable areas); transferable experience from other domains or academic / internship projects is also valued. Basic awareness of data privacy and security concepts (GDPR/PII). Nice to have (*): Awareness of Risk & Control / SOX concepts and how they apply to data and reporting. items.desc: About the role We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Architect to help develop a credit analytics platform for a regulated financial-services business operating in the UK and Ireland. The platform brings together lending and servicing data to support portfolio analysis, credit-risk modelling and better business decisions. Current work covers probability of default, redemption and prepayment, expected credit loss, and interactive analytics. The next challenge is to turn this work into a reliable, maintainable platform that can support different portfolios and client needs. You will work directly with the client’s business and technology teams, alongside a credit-domain and modelling lead and other engineers. You will own the engineering architecture, contribute production code, and help the team decide what to build and how to deliver it. We need someone who can question assumptions, propose simpler alternatives and explain technical trade-offs clearly. What you will do Translate business problems into an architecture, practical delivery plan and clear acceptance criteria. Identify gaps in requirements, data and dependencies before they become delivery problems. Design the path from working models and dashboards to a production-ready ML platform. Make deliberate choices about shared components, portfolio-specific configuration, model calibration and future client onboarding. Build and improve reproducible workflows for data preparation, feature engineering, training, validation, scoring and deployment. Establish clear versioning for code, data, models and calibration logic. Work with the modelling lead on how probability of default, prepayment, lifetime risk and loss estimates are calculated, tested and exposed to applications. Keep business definitions consistent across models, tables and dashboards. Strengthen the data foundation: trace results to source, investigate data-quality issues, document assumptions and build automated checks around important transformations. Improve the reliability of the Snowflake-backed analytics application, including deployment, testing, permissions and integration with model outputs. Put appropriate MLOps practices in place, including repeatable releases, monitoring, failure handling, rollback and operational documentation. Design for privacy, access control, auditability and model governance. Work with domain experts to make validation, stability and fairness checks practical and reviewable. Lead technical discussions, review code, unblock engineers and keep the client informed about progress, risks and architectural decisions. Assess where natural-language or LLM-assisted analytics would add value, without losing focus on trustworthy data, robust models and useful products. What we are looking for A track record of designing and delivering production data or ML systems, with ownership extending beyond prototypes and architecture diagrams. Strong hands-on Python and SQL. You should be comfortable investigating a dataset, reviewing modelling code and implementing critical parts of the solution yourself. Practical MLOps experience: reproducible pipelines, model and data versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and the operational consequences of model updates. Experience with cloud data platforms and modern warehouses. Snowflake experience is particularly relevant; you should be able to reason about data access, performance, cost and deployment constraints. An understanding of model evaluation, calibration, data leakage, changing populations and the difference between model quality and system reliability. The ability to work through incomplete documentation and inconsistent business definitions, and turn findings into maintainable code and clear documentation. Strong client-facing communication in English. You can explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, constructively challenge a requirement and take responsibility for the resulting decision. Experience leading a small technical team while remaining actively involved in implementation. Useful additional experience Credit-risk, lending or servicing analytics, including PD, LGD, ECL, prepayment or portfolio stress testing. Regulated financial-services delivery and model governance. Streamlit, Azure ML, semantic data layers or analytics applications built on Snowflake. Configurable ML products serving multiple portfolios or clients. Evaluated natural-language analytics, text-to-SQL or LLM-assisted workflows. Current technical environment Snowflake, SQL, Python, Streamlit and an Azure ML environment. The team also uses AI-assisted development tools. You will help evolve the architecture based on the product’s needs rather than introduce a predetermined stack. What we would like to discuss A production ML or analytics system you personally helped build, including the architecture decisions and code you owned. How you would adapt a model and its calibration for a new portfolio while …

items.desc: Would you like to join an international team working to improve the future of healthcare? Do you want to enhance the lives of millions of people? Grifols is a global healthcare company that since 1909 has been working to improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are leaders in plasma-derived medicines and transfusion medicine and develop, produce and market innovative medicines, solutions and services in more than 110 countries and regions. We believe that diversity adds value to our business, our teams, and our culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, fostering an inclusive environment where diversity makes us outstanding. Progenika Biopharma S.A. is seeking an Innovation Scientist to join its R&D Department. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing analytical methods based on Molecular Biology, Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), and Microbiology, working with biological samples and a variety of microorganisms. In addition, you will provide scientific guidance and be responsible for the design and execution of experiments, as well as sample preparation for proof-of-concept studies and validations, in compliance with applicable quality and regulatory procedures. What your responsibilities will be Design, propose, execute and analyze experiments, ensuring the generation of high-quality results. Work collaboratively as part of a team to perform and manage routine laboratory activities. Develop and apply molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR and NGS. Analyze experimental data and communicate findings effectively to the rest of the team. Ensure compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements for design, analysis, reporting and product development in accordance with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820. Conduct research into new methodologies, train laboratory personnel and deliver presentations in English to cross-functional teams. Work with Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) materials, including viruses, bacteria, fungi, and/or human clinical samples (e.g., serum, plasma, stool, respiratory specimens, etc.). Collaborate with other R&D teams, particularly the team based in San Diego. Partner closely with the Regulatory Affairs, Quality Control, and Manufacturing departments. Who you are To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, education, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions). Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Biochemistry, or another Life Sciences/Health Sciences discipline. PhD is required, preferably with a specialization in Molecular Biology and/or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and/or combined with 2 years of laboratory experience (highly valued). You have strong technical and hands-on expertise in handling biological samples and microorganisms, as well as experience with laboratory analysis systems used in clinical diagnostics, ideally within a hospital and/or pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge and practical experience in molecular techniques, particularly those used for the detection and characterization of microorganisms (e.g., nucleic acid extraction, PCR, NGS). Proficiency in data analysis using tools such as R, JMP, and bioinformatics software. Strong analytical, organizational, and creative problem-solving skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. English proficiency at a minimum level equivalent to the Cambridge First Certificate (B2). What we offer It is a brilliant opportunity for you, Grifols is fully aware that its employees are one of its major assets. We are committed to maintaining an atmosphere that encourages all our employees to develop their professional careers in an excellent working environment. Information about Grifols is available at www.grifols.com. If you are interested in joining our company and you have what it takes for such an exciting position, then don’t hesitate to apply! We look forward to receiving your application! We believe in diverse talent and want to remove any barriers that may hinder your participation. If you require any adjustments in our selection process, please do not hesitate to inform us when applying. We are here to help. Grifols is an equal opportunity employer. items.desc: Excited to grow your career? BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers. Learn more about the area: Buscamos un/a profesional con ambición, criterio y mentalidad independiente para formar parte del equipo que dará forma a un nuevo Multi Family Office. El Multi-Family Office es una unidad especializada de nueva creación orientada a prestar servicios de asesoramiento estratégico integral a clientes, enfocada en la ordenación, preservación y crecimiento del patrimonio a largo plazo, con autonomía de criterio y gestión. La unidad opera como una sociedad filial independiente 100% participada por BBVA. El puesto ofrece la oportunidad de participar en la creación y desarrollo de un proyecto desde sus inicios, lo que supone tanto el atractivo de construir el área desde cero como el reto de adaptarse a un entorno y procesos en definición, contando con el respaldo de la entidad. Propósito del rol Garantizar la ejecución de la operativa transversal y dar soporte al desarrollo de negocio del MFO. El profesional actuará como enlace ágil e integrador entre la filial y las áreas corporativas del grupo matriz, demostrando un sólido conocimiento transversal de las diferentes funciones de la organización para asegurar la eficiencia de los procesos y el riguroso control presupuestario. Asimismo, será una pieza clave prestando apoyo cuantitativo y organizativo en el desarrollo de la oferta de valor del MFO, aportando su conocimiento del ecosistema de gestión patrimonial para elaborar presentaciones técnicas y comerciales, y asegurando la puesta en marcha operativa de nuevas iniciativas para lograr una consolidación progresiva y un desarrollo sostenible del negocio a largo plazo. R esponsabilidades principales Enlace con la Matriz, Integración Corporativa y Control: Canalizar la relación de la sociedad con las áreas del grupo, aportando un profundo conocimiento transversal para garantizar una interlocución fluida, cohesionada e integradora con los equipos de Talento y Cultura (TyC), Legal, Compliance, Riesgos, Auditoría, Finanzas e IT. Apoyar activamente al cumplimiento y correcta implementación del marco de control interno, asegurando de forma continua que las operativas, proyectos y procesos de la filial se alinean con las directrices, políticas y exigencias de Compliance y los Servicios Jurídicos (SSJJ). Seguimiento Presupuestario y Financiero: Controlar rigurosamente el presupuesto y la contabilidad, asegurando que la facturación, los gastos y los reportes cumplan los plazos y formas exigidas. Elaborar entregables ejecutivos y cuadros de mando ( dashboards ) aportando métricas e insights cuantitativos precisos para el control del negocio. Garantizar la eficiencia y el estándar global operativo: Asegurar el funcionamiento integral de la filial en su día a día, asumiendo, facilitando y resolviendo de forma práctica todas las tareas operativas y organizativas necesarias para que una estructura pequeña funcione con máxima eficiencia y agilidad. Apoyo al Desarrollo de Negocio y Puesta en marcha: Realizar presentaciones técnicas y comerciales de alto nivel para respaldar el desarrollo y la comunicación de la oferta de valor del MFO, participando activamente en la elaboración de propuestas para oportunidades en el ámbito patrimonial. Prestar soporte técnico y analítico en el diseño de nuevos servicios y en la definición de enfoques comerciales, traduciendo requerimientos de negocio en soluciones operativas. Competencias técnicas Entendimiento de Family Office y Wealth Management: Comprensión práctica del ecosistema de gestión patrimonial (UHNW), con familiaridad en la dinámica de la banca privada, las operativas de inversión y los vehículos patrimoniales. Presentaciones y Comunicación Visual (Obligatorio): Dominio experto de PowerPoint para la estructuración visual de ideas, traduciendo análisis técnicos y requerimientos complejos en entregables comerciales y presentaciones ejecutivas impecables. Conocimiento Transversal de Negocio: Amplia comprensión técnica y operativa del funcionamiento interconectado de áreas corporativas críticas (Riesgos, Finanzas, TyC, IT, Compliance y SSJJ). Solvencia Numérica y Modelización: Excelente capacidad para el desarrollo de modelos financieros que soporten decisiones corporativas. items.desc: Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description As a Quantity Surveyor you will support the cost management team in delivering accurate and reliable cost estimation, budgeting, and procurement services for a wide variety of projects, including Government, industrial, commercial, residential, and infrastructure developments, both nationally and internationally. Working closely under the guidance of other team members, you will contribute to the preparation of budgets, cost reports, specifications, and tender documentation, while gaining experience across all aspects of cost management and procurement. The role is designed to develop your technical and professional skills as part of a structured career path within our organization The responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to: Assist in the preparation of cost estimates, budgets and financial reports. Support the preparation and follow up of cost control, tender documentation and procurement processes. Work with BIM 5D, Presto, and other digital tools to collect, analyze, and present cost data. Collaborate with project teams to ensure cost data is up-to-date and aligned with project objectives. Learn and apply company-wide procedures for cost control and reporting. Provide support during value engineering and risk analysis exercises. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Technical Architecture, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Cost Engineering, or a related discipline. Up to 3 years of professional experience in cost management, quantity surveying or a related role. Good command in the use of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.) and project planning tools such as Microsoft Project. Knowledge of software such as Presto, Cost-It and BIM 5D tools. Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills. Fluency in English and Spanish, both verbal and written will be essential for this role. Previous exposure to international projects will be a plus Additional Information At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. About AECOM AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to work You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. …

items.desc: Role Summary: The Material Handler is responsible for the loading and unloading of trucks, packaging and unpackaging of materials, assist in stocking and pulling parts from storage, and all other functions associated with shipping and receiving, all while providing exemplary service to internal and external customers. This role may also be required to operate a forklift to transport goods and materials of all kinds in and around the facility. Responsibilities & Requirements: Unload incoming shipments. Perform verification of bill of lading and packing list, unpack incoming shipments. Engage with purchasing and other departments to resolve packing list discrepancies. Conduct inspections and provide damaged goods with a damage identification, as needed Accurately record materials received on the appropriate purchase orders and distribute copies to the appropriate personnel. Ensure system (ERP) receipt of materials within 24 hours. Verify the accuracy of outbound shipments. Properly package out-bound shipments to ensure that the contents arrive at their destination in undamaged condition. Properly handle all document filing and archiving requirements. Follows all warehouse processes when performing work, while maintaining good housekeeping in all assigned work areas. Abides by all Flowserve safety requirements. Basis computer skills, including effectively navigating Microsoft Office. Able to work occasional overtime including weekends and evenings. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand for long periods of time, walk many steps throughout the day, kneel, twist, and bend. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally buddy lift and/or move more than 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to multitask and work in a production environment that has multiple product changeovers. Must be willing to learn and cross train as needed throughout different function(s) Speak and understand "the language of logistics". Good communication and interpersonal skills. Other duties as assigned. Preferred Experience / Skills: Previous related material handling and forklift experience. Forklift certified. Familiarity / working knowledge of ERP systems. Have strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. Have a keen attention to detail. HS Diploma / GED and / or 0-2 years relevant experience

items.desc: GENERAL PURPOSE : To support Axalta Refinish Color Marketing with color support in multiple Refinish mixing machine qualities. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES: Functions of this position include but are not limited to: Adjusting the color position of a formula. This will be accomplished by using both spectrophotometer or visual shading skills. Knowledgeable on customer facing color retrieval systems to demonstrate best practices and to access and load new or existing formulas. Work with Isocyanate paint chemistry. Be capable of spraying panels following specific spray procedures using mainstream refinish paint shop spray equipment. Knowledgeable in the level of color accuracy that is accepted by our customers to verify Axalta variant color positions. Be knowledgeable and utilize relevant functions within the Mobius and Global Color Analytics database. Be able to work with and communicate with all levels of customers. Maintain high levels of safety awareness. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: Be able to determine if a color is in an acceptable tolerance for optimized and targeted colors. Must be able to demonstrate the proper usage of Axalta spectrophotometers and all their functional applications. Must become proficient in the color knowledge of Spies Hecker, Standox, and Cromax solvent and waterborne systems. A working knowledge of all Axalta Refinish color related products and systems is essential. Possess basic math skills to correctly balance a formula using tint tables. Be a team-oriented person with strong interpersonal skills. Be able to plan, schedule and prioritize work activities. Must be able to present data in written and computer-based presentation style and formats. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Successfully pass the Farnsworth/Munsell 100 Hue or comparable color vision test. Need to have a working knowledge of MS Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Must have a working knowledge of paint preparation and finished product acceptability characteristics as defined by our customers/industry (i.e. – appearance orange peel, spray ability, mottle, color match etc.) SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS : Must be able to work in certain physically challenging conditions. Working in a customer’s place of business can be a very challenging endeavor. The non-Axalta environment will keep the coordinator on his “safety toes” while obtaining and or supplying important color data. Workload might vary depending on current tasks. Our Company: Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles. Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals. Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review. Recruitment Fraud Alert : We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA-Support-Center@axalta.com. This is an active opening for which we are recruiting to fill immediately.

As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. Mobile Architecture & Development: Build and evolve screens and user flows in React Native using TypeScript, ensuring clean architecture, and solid performance across devices. API & Service Design: Design and build, and maintain RESTful APIs and decoupled services in .NET (C#), establishing reliable integration contracts and robust throughput. Shift-Left Culture & Quality: Own code quality across both layers. Write and maintain unit, integration, and E2E tests, ensuring software reaches production with maximum stability and confidence. Direct Collaboration with Discovery: Partner directly with our Product Designer and Product Data Analyst without relying on managers as bridges. Continuous Delivery & Vertical Slicing: Break down complex epics into small, functional slices supported by feature flags, maintaining a steady, predictable delivery pace across parallel products. Your Profile Solid Experience with React Native & TypeScript: At least 3 - 4 years designing, developing, and maintaining production-grade mobile applications for iOS and Android. Backend & API Development Expertise: Proven hands-on experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs and backend services, preferably in C# / .NET. Automated Testing Across the Stack: Practical experience with unit and integration testing frameworks (Jest, xUnit/NUnit). Technical Pragmatism (KISS / YAGNI): Balanced judgment between clean, extensible architecture and delivering fast, iterative business value without over-engineering. Assertive Technical Communication: Ability to articulate technical decisions with data, defend estimations constructively, and participate comfortably in technical debates Nice-to-Have: Experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ). Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud deployment environments. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies. Hands-on experience working with shared design systems and component libraries. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Fastlane). Understanding of observability, tracing, and metric visualization (Prometheus, Grafana). Practical familiarity with Xcode and Android Studio, a clear understanding of the native bridge / NitroModules, and native integration.

items.desc: About the role We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Architect to help develop a credit analytics platform for a regulated financial-services business operating in the UK and Ireland. The platform brings together lending and servicing data to support portfolio analysis, credit-risk modelling and better business decisions. Current work covers probability of default, redemption and prepayment, expected credit loss, and interactive analytics. The next challenge is to turn this work into a reliable, maintainable platform that can support different portfolios and client needs. You will work directly with the client’s business and technology teams, alongside a credit-domain and modelling lead and other engineers. You will own the engineering architecture, contribute production code, and help the team decide what to build and how to deliver it. We need someone who can question assumptions, propose simpler alternatives and explain technical trade-offs clearly. What you will do Translate business problems into an architecture, practical delivery plan and clear acceptance criteria. Identify gaps in requirements, data and dependencies before they become delivery problems. Design the path from working models and dashboards to a production-ready ML platform. Make deliberate choices about shared components, portfolio-specific configuration, model calibration and future client onboarding. Build and improve reproducible workflows for data preparation, feature engineering, training, validation, scoring and deployment. Establish clear versioning for code, data, models and calibration logic. Work with the modelling lead on how probability of default, prepayment, lifetime risk and loss estimates are calculated, tested and exposed to applications. Keep business definitions consistent across models, tables and dashboards. Strengthen the data foundation: trace results to source, investigate data-quality issues, document assumptions and build automated checks around important transformations. Improve the reliability of the Snowflake-backed analytics application, including deployment, testing, permissions and integration with model outputs. Put appropriate MLOps practices in place, including repeatable releases, monitoring, failure handling, rollback and operational documentation. Design for privacy, access control, auditability and model governance. Work with domain experts to make validation, stability and fairness checks practical and reviewable. Lead technical discussions, review code, unblock engineers and keep the client informed about progress, risks and architectural decisions. Assess where natural-language or LLM-assisted analytics would add value, without losing focus on trustworthy data, robust models and useful products. What we are looking for A track record of designing and delivering production data or ML systems, with ownership extending beyond prototypes and architecture diagrams. Strong hands-on Python and SQL. You should be comfortable investigating a dataset, reviewing modelling code and implementing critical parts of the solution yourself. Practical MLOps experience: reproducible pipelines, model and data versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and the operational consequences of model updates. Experience with cloud data platforms and modern warehouses. Snowflake experience is particularly relevant; you should be able to reason about data access, performance, cost and deployment constraints. An understanding of model evaluation, calibration, data leakage, changing populations and the difference between model quality and system reliability. The ability to work through incomplete documentation and inconsistent business definitions, and turn findings into maintainable code and clear documentation. Strong client-facing communication in English. You can explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, constructively challenge a requirement and take responsibility for the resulting decision. Experience leading a small technical team while remaining actively involved in implementation. Useful additional experience Credit-risk, lending or servicing analytics, including PD, LGD, ECL, prepayment or portfolio stress testing. Regulated financial-services delivery and model governance. Streamlit, Azure ML, semantic data layers or analytics applications built on Snowflake. Configurable ML products serving multiple portfolios or clients. Evaluated natural-language analytics, text-to-SQL or LLM-assisted workflows. Current technical environment Snowflake, SQL, Python, Streamlit and an Azure ML environment. The team also uses AI-assisted development tools. You will help evolve the architecture based on the product’s needs rather than introduce a predetermined stack. What we would like to discuss A production ML or analytics system you personally helped build, including the architecture decisions and code you owned. How you would adapt a model and its calibration for a new portfolio while …

items.desc: Luleå Referensnummer 5512–2026 Vill du utveckla din forskning och undervisning i en miljö där samverkan med industri och samhälle är en självklarhet? Hos oss får du arbeta med engagerade kollegor, tillgång till modern forskningsinfrastruktur och goda möjligheter att attrahera extern finansiering. Du ges utrymme att göra verklig skillnad för dina studenter, din forskning och samhället i stort. Robotics & AI Group vid Luleå tekniska universitet söker en amanuens med fokus på hårdvaru- och mjukvaruutveckling för autonoma robotar. Robotics & AI-gruppen är involverad i många fältorienterade projekt, vilket kräver en mångsidig och proaktiv person som trivs i en miljö med högt tempo. Vill du kombinera dina studier med ett givande arbete inom akademin? Robotics & AI Group söker en eller flera studenter som vill arbeta som undervisningsamanuens (teacher assistant) som stöd till vår undervisande personal. Vi erbjuder Luleå tekniska universitet är en statlig myndighet och erbjuder goda anställningsvillkor. Med en anställning som amanuens får du som student möjlighet att förena studier med arbete för att komplettera dina teoretiska kunskaper med praktisk arbetslivserfarenhet. Arbetsuppgifter Arbetsuppgifterna varierar och ger inblick i den akademiska världen. Du kommer att ha löpande kontakt med kursansvariga lärare. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Samarbeta med forskare från RAI-teamet som bedriver grundläggande och principiell forskning inom alla aspekter av robotik Undervisningsstöd inom grundutbildning (handledning av laborationer och övningar) Rättning av rapporter, inlämningar och laborationer Kompetens och erfarenhet För att vara behörig för tjänsten måste du vara inskriven som student vid ett universitetsprogram inom tillämpad artificiell intelligent eller närliggande område och ha bakgrund inom robotik. Du behöver vara intresserad av att utveckla navigeringsalgoritmer för autonoma fordon inom ostrukturerade komplexa områden med störningar i form av miljöfaktorer. Du måste också ha erfarenhet av programmering med Python, C++ och MATLAB med fokus på datorseende. Eftersom en del av arbetsuppgifterna är att kommunicera resultaten på engelska med kollegor och forskningspartners måste du kunna uttrycka dig både muntligt och skriftligt på engelska. Du behöver också kunna ta egna initiativ och arbeta självständigt. Villkor Anställningen regleras enligt Högskoleförordningen (HF 5 kap §10). Du måste vara aktiv student under hela anställningstiden. Anställningen får motsvara högst 50 % av heltid. En anställning kan ske på högst ett år i taget, dock sammanlagt högst tre år. Timlön/ersättning För alla uppdrag får du timlön samt värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet för ditt CV. Timlön beroende på arbetsuppgiftens svårighetsgrad: Nivå 1: 156 kr/timme (motsvarar ca 25 700 kr/månad vid heltidsarbete). Nivå 2: 171 kr/timme (motsvarar ca 28 200 kr/månad vid heltidsarbete). Information Tjänsten omfattar 25 % av heltid, dvs. i genomsnitt 1,25 dagar i veckan under 6 månader, från den 01/11/2026 till den 31/05/2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Tjänstgöringsort är Luleå Arbetsbelastningen kan komma att variera över tid och enligt överenskommelse men målsättningen är att den fördelas på ett sätt som gör det förenligt med studier vid universitetet. För ytterligare information är du välkommen att kontakta: Dr. Anton Koval, 0920-49 2381, anton.koval@ltu.se Fackliga kontaktpersoner Ansökan Vi ser helst att du söker befattningen via ansökningsknappen nedan där du bifogar personligt brev samt CV/meritförteckning och kopior av verifierade examensbevis. Var vänlig och märk din ansökan med referensnumret nedan. Både ansökan och examensbevis ska vara skrivna på svenska eller engelska. Om jobbet Som Platform Engineer till vårt team på Länsförsäkringar AB i Stockholm får du en central roll i vår växande platform engineering-funktion. Du arbetar med drift, utveckling och automation av vår containerplattform byggd på OpenShift och säkerställer en stabil och effektiv plattform för utvecklingsteam och applikationsdrift. Du blir en del av ett kompetent och positivt team som driver innovation och utveckling inom containerplattformar, där du får arbeta med moderna verktyg och har goda möjligheter att utvecklas. Du kommer ingå i ett team med med produktägare, arkitekter och andra platform engineers där du rapporterar till chefen för Public Cloud Platforms. Ni har fokus på OpenShift/Azure RedHat OpenShift, Azure och AWS. Enheten Digital & IT inom Länsförsäkringar AB levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar och digitala tjänster till de lokala Länsförsäkringsbolagen, vilket innebär breda kontaktytor inom hela LF-federationen. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat: Underhålla och vidareutveckla vår Kubernetes/OpenShift-baserade containerplattform. Arbeta med CI/CD-pipelines och GitOps för att förenkla och automatisera deployment och drift. Samarbeta med utvecklare och arkitekter för att optimera plattformens prestanda och säkerhet. Stötta med expertis i incident- och felsökningsarbete. Arbeta med onboarding och utbildning av våra DevOps-team för att säkerställa att de effektivt kan använda plattformen. Vi har riktigt bra förmåner Personalvillkor på bolån och blancolån Rabatt på sak-, person- och djurförsäkring Friskvårdsbidrag och friskvårdstimma Gym & gruppträning på kontoret Lunchförmån Fyra extra lediga dagar/år utöver semesterdagarna Kvalifikationer Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst: Erfaren hands-on Kubernetes-expert med minst 3 års erfarenhet av Kubernetes och containerorkestrering, gärna inom finanssektorn. Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta i gränslandet mellan infrastruktur, utveckling, säkerhet och cloud native-teknik. Kunskap om CI/CD-pipelines, GitOps och automation. Erfarenhet av att arbeta i Microsoft Azure. Grundläggande förståelse för nätverk, lagring och säkerhet i Kubernetes-miljöer. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både tal och skrift. Meriterande är även om du har: Du har kompetens på AWS plattformar. Som person är du positiv, initiativtagande och självgående, samtidigt som du är en god team-player. Du är lösningsorienterad, ansvarstagande och nyfiken, med en stark vilja att automatisera och förbättra arbetsflöden. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team, och har god kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad förmåga. Kontaktuppgifter: Rekryterande chef: Klaus Seidel, klaus.seidel@lansforsakringar.se Facklig representant Forena: Jessica Lööw, jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Lisa-Maria Carensjö, lisa-maria.carensjo@lansforsakringar.se Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag. Om företaget Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund. Digital & IT är hjärtat i Länsförsäkringsgruppens digitala utveckling. Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen. Hos oss möts teknik, affär och innovation. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt ute i verksamheten i agila team där utveckling, drift och strategi går hand i hand. Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap. Klaus Seidel | Kontaktperson

items.desc: Lead the development and growth of our Vulnerable Children and Families activity, working with charity leaders to strengthen their organisations and maximise their impact. Venture Partners are at the core of Purposeful Ventures' work. They bring the knowledge, skills and experience needed to help shape our portfolios, identify opportunities for investment and support the organisations we work with to thrive. In this role, you will help shape the future of our Vulnerable Children and Families work, leading the review and development of our strategy and identifying where Purposeful Ventures can make the greatest difference. You will develop new opportunities and partnerships, work closely with our Philanthropy team to attract and direct funding to charity partners, and support and monitor the progress and impact of the organisations we work with. Alongside this, you will contribute to the broader work of our Venture Partners, working closely with charity leaders to strengthen their organisations, develop effective strategies and build the capabilities needed to bring about change. We are looking for a Venture Partner with a deep understanding of the challenges facing vulnerable children and families, and experience of working to address them. We welcome candidates who have developed their expertise in a range of settings, including working in a charity, delivering services, shaping government policy, working within children's social care or making funding and investment decisions related to the sector. What matters most is your ability to draw on this knowledge and experience, exercise sound judgement and work with others to bring about meaningful change for children and families. We are particularly interested in candidates who can combine their sector expertise with strong strategic and analytical skills, experience of leading projects or organisations, and the ability to build trusted relationships and work collaboratively to deliver impact. More information on our broader Children and Families portfolio Our ambition is for every child to grow up in a safe, stable and supportive environment, with the relationships and opportunities they need to thrive. Du ansvarar för att analysera, strukturera och dokumentera verksamhetsbehov samt funktionella och icke-funktionella IT-krav inom bland annat trafiknära system, fordonssystem, integrationer och IT-säkerhet. Ta fram kravspecifikationer, kravbilagor och utvärderingskriterier för IT-upphandlingar enligt LOU/LUF. Planera och leda workshops och intervjuer för kravinsamling och förankring. Arbeta med kravställning inom trafiknära system, fordonssystem, integrationer och IT-säkerhet. Samverka med verksamhet, IT och leverantörer samt säkerställa spårbarhet från krav till test och införande. items.desc: Solna Referensnummer 2026/064759 På Arbetsmiljöverket jobbar vi tillsammans för att ingen ska bli sjuk, skadas eller dö av jobbet. Därför hjälper vi arbetsgivare att uppfylla de krav som finns och informerar om hur arbetsmiljöarbetet blir en naturlig del av vardagen. Med arbetsmiljölagen som grund tar vi fram regler, inspekterar arbetsplatser och sprider kunskap om arbetsmiljöfrågor. Uppdraget är allvarligt men vår vardag präglas av arbetsglädje och vi är omtänksamma och hjälpsamma kollegor. Om sektionen IT-enheten på arbetsmiljöverket består av fyra sektioner, Digitalisering, IT-utveckling, Infrastruktur och Helpdesk. Tillsammans arbetar dessa fyra sektioner för att tillhandahålla stabila och innovativa tekniska lösningar som stödjer både daglig drift och vår långsiktiga utveckling. Vårt mål är att bygga en organisation som klarar av att växa med fler utvecklarteam och stärka vår kompetens inom utveckling och modernisering. Sektionen för IT-utveckling består idag av 12 medarbetare fördelade på tre agila team som ansvarar för utveckling och leveranser av främst våra egenutvecklade applikationer och tjänster. Ditt nya jobb Som vikarierande systemutvecklare kommer du erbjudas ett stimulerande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv organisation. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar med systemutveckling och förvaltning av Arbetsmiljöverkets egenutvecklade system, främst .Net baserade webbapplikationer och API:er. Som systemutvecklare arbetar du från krav till release och med hela teknikstacken. Du kommer medverka till att förvaltning och utveckling av våra system drivs framåt. Rollen bidrar till myndighetens digitaliseringsresa där vi nu satsar mycket på IT för att stärka våra digitala tjänster, öka tillgänglighet av data och använda oss av AI för att förbättra och effektivisera verksamhetens flöden. Gemensamt driver vi utvecklingen där hög ambition och tydliga mål präglar vårt arbete. Din bakgrund Rollen kräver att du har: Eftergymnasial utbildning inom system-, information- eller datavetenskap, alternativt motsvarande kunskaper förvärvade genom arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdiga. Minst 2 års aktuell erfarenhet av systemutveckling inom C# och .Net. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet av frontend-utveckling i React, CSS och HTML. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet av databaser och SQL. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet av REST-API:er. God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team. Erfarenhet av CI/CD och Azure DevOps. Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet av kvalitetssäkring och testning. Som person ser vi att du kommer att trivas i rollen om du fokuserar på att nå uppsatta mål och trivs med att utvecklas. Du tar egna initiativ inom ditt arbetsområde och är snabb på att respondera på kundbehov. Vidare ser vi att du kan självständigt lösa problem och har förmågan att hantera oväntade händelser på ett flexibelt sätt. Du samarbetar bra och bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Vid urvalet kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. En anställning hos oss kan innebära att befattningen placeras i säkerhetsklass. Säkerhetsprövning med eller utan registerkontroll kan därför komma att göras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning genomförs enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Vad vi erbjuder dig Arbetsmiljöverket är en trygg arbetsgivare och en myndighet som hela tiden förändras med samhället vi verkar i. Vi är stolta över att få använda vår kunskap och vårt förtroende i vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande kultur, som rymmer hjärta, mod och hjärna. Hos oss blir hela du en viktig del i något större. Anställningen är ett vikariat, på heltid i cirka 11 månader och är för närvarande placerad på vårt kontor i Solna. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Vi strävar efter att alla medarbetare ska ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö och en balans mellan jobb och fritid. Därför har vi flexibla arbetstider eller tillämpar förtroendearbetstid och ger möjlighet till distansarbete där verksamheten så tillåter. Så rekryterar vi Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering, både för att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringen och för att motverka diskriminering. Vi ber dig därför att endast bifoga ett CV, och svara på några frågor istället för ett personligt brev när du registrerar din an. Eftersom vi arbetar kompetensbaserat använder vi oss också av arbetspsykologiska tester i den här rekryteringen. Intervjuer sker från vecka 48. För oss är det viktigt att rekryteringsprocessen är ömsesidig. Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Adam Jansson för Saco, Marianne Martin för ST samt Jenny Bengtsson för Seko. Samtliga nås via Arbetsmiljöverkets växel: 010-730 90 00. Vill du jobba tillsammans med oss för att ingen ska bli sjuk, skadas eller dö av jobbet? Välkommen med din an senast den 4 november 2026 ! …

Teamet arbetar i hela kedjan från krav, design till utveckling, förvaltning och drift. Tillsammans med teamet kommer du upprätthålla en hög leveransförmåga och kontinuerligt leverera nytta till användare och tågresenärer. Våra team består av flera roller och kompetenser som samarbetar i ett agilt arbetssätt. I teamen jobbar vi ständigt med att utveckla och förbättra vårt arbetssätt. Du blir en del av kittet mellan IT och Verksamheten och får en unik förståelse för båda delarna. Med ett nyfiket sinne och en förmåga att våga tänka utanför ramarna medverkar du dagligen till att förbättra det svenska transportsystemet." Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?
