items.desc:
Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 Cette startup française spécialisée en cybersécurité compte aujourd’hui une quinzaine de personnes et est en pleine phase de croissance, portée notamment par la signature de très grands comptes et d'une levée de plusieurs millions d'euros.
 Dans ce contexte, l’équipe poursuit la construction d’une plateforme complexe avec de forts enjeux techniques. L’environnement est entrepreneurial, avec beaucoup de choses à construire, une réelle autonomie et la possibilité d’avoir un impact direct sur le produit et les choix techniques.
 Mission
 Vous avez envie de construire un produit tech ambitieux, de résoudre des problématiques complexes et d’avoir un impact direct sur les choix techniques ? Ce poste devrait vous intéresser.
 Le poste s'adresse a un Software Engineer capable de prendre en main des sujets de bout en bout, du développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités à la conception des systèmes qui font tourner la plateforme. Vous travaillerez au plus près des problématiques techniques, en collaboration quotidienne avec les ingénieurs IA, dans un environnement entrepreneurial où l’autonomie, la polyvalence et la prise d’initiative sont essentielles.
 Vous participerez également à la construction du produit et de ses fondations techniques, avec de vraies responsabilités.
 Développer les fonctionnalités front-end et back-end de la plateforme. 
 Concevoir et développer des API REST, des services et des systèmes évolutifs. 
 Travailler au quotidien avec les ingénieurs IA. 
 Participer à l’orchestration d’agents IA. 
 Assurer la responsabilité de bout en bout des nouvelles fonctionnalités, de leur conception jusqu’à leur mise en production. 
 Participer aux choix techniques et produit. 
 Profile
 Expérience d'au moins 5 ans en développement logiciel. 
 Développement fullstack, bonne maîtrise de Python et/ou TypeScript / JavaScript, avec une expérience de Node.js et React.js. 
 Expérience dans le développement d’API et la conception de systèmes évolutifs. 
 Coding avec l’IA, utilisation concrète de Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou d’outils équivalents. 
 Autonomie et ownership, capacité à concevoir, développer et mettre en production de nouvelles fonctionnalités. 
 Curiosité technique, capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et envie de contribuer aux choix techniques et produit. 
 Formation d’ingénieur et bon niveau d’anglais 
 Rémunération : entre 70 et 85 k€ brut annuel. 
 Mutuelle, Frais de transport, Carte Swile, RTT... 
 BSPCE

 A projektről: Az elmúlt 25+ évben fejlesztett Sitras Sidytrac szoftver mögött egy német-magyar fejlesztői csapat áll. Ezt a vasúti hálózatok áramellátását modellező szoftvert több száz új, illetve fejlesztés előtt álló vasúti szakasz tervezésénél, valamint valós idejű rendszerekben is sikeresen alkalmazták már. Dinamikusan fejlődő csapatunkba olyan C++ fejlesztőt keresünk, aki otthonosan mozog a kernel-szintű fejlesztésekben, képes elektrotechnikai és energetikai összefüggéseket szoftveresen leképezni, és elhivatott a kritikus magrendszerek teljesítményének optimalizálásában.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 Kernelszintű fejlesztés: A szimulációs kernel adaptálása és bővítése összetett tervezési és menetrendi adatok feldolgozására.
 Fizikai modellalkotás: Elektrotechnikai és energetikai összefüggések szoftveres leképezése és implementálása modern C++ szabványok alkalmazásával.
 Rendszerstabilitás biztosítása: Kritikus magmodulok karbantartása, hibajavítása és teljesítmény-optimalizálása (performance tuning).
 Szakmai együttműködés: Szoros kooperáció a vezető fejlesztőkkel a komplex vasúti infrastruktúra-szimulációs logikák megvalósításában.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel mérnöki/informatikai/természettudományi (matematika vagy fizika) területen.
 Van legalább 3 év C++ alapú szoftverfejlesztésben szerzett tapasztalatod (modern szabványok, memóriakezelés és optimalizáció).
 Magabiztos angol és német (minimum B1) nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban.
 Szeretsz a fizikai/matematikai modellek és a low-level kódok mélyére ásni.
 Képes vagy stabil, nagy teljesítményű és hibatűrő kernmodulokat létrehozni.
 Nem ijedsz meg az összetett performance-problémáktól és az architekturális kihívásoktól.
 Konstruktívan és hatékonyan együttműködsz a mérnöki csapattal.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: 
 Van tapasztalatod elektrotechnikai folyamatok és hálózati összefüggések átlátásában és elemzésében.
 Munkád során használtál már Git verziókezelőt.
 Dolgoztál már agilis (Scrum) környezetben.

 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.

 We are Siemens 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 
 We are looking for a Software QA Engineer – Performance Testing to design, automate, and execute performance testing strategies for cloud-based enterprise applications, APIs, platforms, and distributed services. 
 In this role, you will evaluate system performance, identify bottlenecks, analyze scalability and reliability, and establish performance baselines to support release readiness. Working closely with Software Development, Architecture, DevOps, and QA teams, you will help embed performance engineering into the software development lifecycle and explore AI-assisted performance analysis and anomaly detection. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design performance test strategies: Plan and execute load, stress, scalability, endurance, spike, capacity, and benchmark tests using realistic workload models. 
 Develop performance automation: Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts, frameworks, and workload-generation solutions using tools such as JMeter, k6, Locust, or equivalent technologies. 
 Analyze and troubleshoot performance: Investigate latency, throughput, resource utilization, and system behavior to identify bottlenecks and perform root-cause analysis. 
 Establish performance baselines: Compare results across builds and releases, identify regressions, and provide data-driven recommendations for performance and release readiness. 
 Test cloud-native and distributed systems: Evaluate APIs, microservices, databases, and enterprise applications across containerized and cloud-based environments. 
 Leverage monitoring and observability: Use metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards to correlate performance results with system behavior and communicate actionable findings. 
 Integrate performance engineering into delivery: Embed automated performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and collaborate across engineering teams to improve performance standards, test efficiency, and continuous quality. 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 4+ years of relevant experience in performance testing or performance engineering, including workload design, execution, analysis, and reporting. 
 Hands-on experience with performance testing tools such as Apache JMeter, k6, Locust, RPT, or equivalent. 
 Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Groovy, with the ability to develop and maintain test automation. 
 Experience testing web applications, APIs, and distributed services, with knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP, databases/SQL, and relevant communication protocols. 
 Strong understanding of performance metrics, workload modelling, statistical analysis, performance baselining, regression detection, and root-cause analysis. 
 Experience with cloud-native or enterprise application architectures, CI/CD integration, and monitoring/observability tools, along with strong analytical and communication skills. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience performance-testing microservices, Kubernetes-based applications, containers, and large-scale distributed systems. 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI. 
 Experience with observability and application performance monitoring tools such as Grafana, InfluxDB, Telegraf, Loki, Tempo, Kibana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics. 
 Experience with distributed load generation, performance dashboards, and automated performance regression testing. 
 Knowledge of Git/GitLab, Jira, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 Exposure to desktop application performance testing, WebSockets, GraphQL, CLI-based testing, or other relevant protocols. 
 Experience with AI/ML-assisted performance analytics, anomaly detection, or automated root-cause analysis. 
 Why Us 
 At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're …

Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
 Was trägst Du bei? 
 Als Software-Engineer (w/m/d) ziehst Du bei der digitalen Transformation mit und treibst Projekte mit voran, sowohl klassische als auch agile Projekte. Dabei unterstützt Du die Mobility Geschäftsfelder beim Architektur-Design von Systemen sowie beim Einsatz moderner Software-Technologien.
 Du verfolgst Trends, machst diese für andere verfügbar und treibst gemeinsam mit Kollegen die Entwicklung voran.
 Du entwickelst kundenspezifische Lösungen basierend auf standardisierten Produkten und Tools, entwirfst Spezifikationen, technische Konzepte und Schnittstellenintegrationen.

 Du konzeptionierst Testumgebungen und Automatisierungslösungen für Hard- und Software für den Bereich Schienenfahrzeug und -infrastruktur.

items.desc: Job Description At CluePoints, we’re redefining how clinical trials are run. As the premier provider of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) and Data Quality Oversight software, we harness advanced statistics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of clinical trial data, helping life sciences organisations bring safer, more effective treatments to patients faster. We’re an ambitious, fast-growing technology scale-up with a dynamic and diverse international team. Collaboration, flexibility, and continuous learning are part of our DNA, and we are guided by our values of Care, Passion, and Smart Disruption. The Role The AI Engineer will build the AI capabilities that sit on top of CluePoints’ new data layer: the platform that harmonizes data across clinical studies and applications and makes it available to CluePoints’ consumer applications. You will design, evaluate and ship AI solutions, such as metadata-driven variable harmonization and retrieval and knowledge-graph services, that are auditable, traceable and fit for a regulated clinical-trial environment. CluePoints has committed to building this data layer, so the role is an opportunity to shape the AI approach from the start. Success looks like AI components that measurably accelerate harmonization and whose outputs can be explained and defended in front of an auditor. Job Requirements Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI solutions into production, not only prototypes. Hands-on experience with RAG, including retrieval design, grounding and evaluation of results. Working knowledge of knowledge graphs, including when they are and are not the right tool. Strong Python skills and solid software-engineering fundamentals (testing, code review, API design). Experience evaluating AI outputs systematically, using test sets, accuracy measures and regression checks. Understanding of regulatory compliance, auditability and traceability in platform and system design. Comfort evolving quickly and experimenting with different technology capabilities, choosing solutions on evidence. Ability to work with data from multiple sources whose structures and variables differ. Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice To Haves Experience in clinical trials, life sciences or another regulated environment. Strong candidates from other sectors, such as fintech, will be considered. Familiarity with Databricks and/or Snowflake and with Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with spec-driven development frameworks such as BMAD, Superpowers or Spec Kit. Exposure to clinical data standards (for example CDISC) or to metadata from electronic data-capture systems. Experience building structured AI workflows, such as prompt pipelines, agent orchestration or automated review. Job Responsibilities AI Solution Design & Delivery Design, build and ship AI solutions that support the data layer, including approaches that use metadata from data-capture solutions to help harmonize differing study variables. Evaluate and experiment with AI and retrieval options (LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs) and recommend the approach best suited to each problem rather than defaulting to the newest tool. Prototype quickly against realistic study data, then take successful prototypes through to production-quality services. Retrieval & Knowledge Graphs Design and implement RAG pipelines over study metadata, data dictionaries and variable definitions. Apply knowledge-graph approaches to model relationships between studies, variables and concepts where they add value over conventional structures. Expose AI and retrieval capabilities through well-defined interfaces that CluePoints’ consumer applications can use. Evaluation, Auditability & Compliance Define evaluation methods and quality thresholds for AI outputs, such as proposed variable mappings, and measure them against reviewed examples. Make AI-supported outputs traceable and auditable, with versioned prompts, models and configurations and a clear record of what was generated and what a person approved. Build proportionate human-review controls into AI-assisted harmonization workflows. Work with the architect to ensure AI components meet regulatory compliance expectations within the platform design. Collaboration & Engineering Practice Work with the architect and data engineer on how AI components fit the data-layer architecture, harmonized snapshots and connectors. Clarify the underlying problem and expected value with product stakeholders before building. Write production-grade, tested and documented code, using AI-assisted and spec-driven development practices where they improve quality and speed. Document design decisions and share knowledge so the capability does not depend on one person. Job Benefits The chance to shape a new capability from the beginning: CluePoints has committed to building the data layer, and the AI approach is still to be …

items.desc: 📍 Amsterdam (hybrid) | 💼 Fulltime | 🌐 Fintech | 🚀 Cloud-native Core Banking Do you want to teach a bank’s document engine to read? Every mortgage application comes with a stack of documents: payslips, employer statements, valuation reports, bank statements and IDs. Our extraction engine automatically turns these documents into structured data that can be used throughout the lending process. Making that engine smarter is one of Ohpen’s key objectives for 2026 , as we move from classical extraction rules towards AI/LLM-based extraction . As a Data Extraction Specialist – AI , you’ll help drive that transition end-to-end. You’ll configure and optimise the engine, build the LLM-based extraction that replaces existing rules, benchmark the results to prove extraction rate. BRIEFING Ohpen launched the world’s first cloud-native core banking platform . Within our Lending Suite , several components work together to process every document that comes in with a mortgage application: DocStreet is our document processing platform. It receives, classifies and routes incoming documents. DTA2 is the data extraction engine within DocStreet. It reads each document and turns it into structured fields, such as income, employer and property value, which our clients’ lending processes rely on. Orbis is the engine that executes automated validations on the extracted documents. You’ll join our Transformation & Innovation team , working within a small and focused data extraction squad. A small team means high ownership and plenty of opportunity to make an impact. WHAT YOU WILL DO Improve extraction rates. Configure and tune DTA2 across different document types and fields, prioritising those that matter most to our clients. Roll out AI/LLM-based extraction. Design, build, evaluate and deploy LLM-based extraction within the engine. This includes everything from prompt design and model selection to guardrails, evaluation sets and production rollout. Prove that it works. Build and maintain the benchmarking loop that shows where extraction has improved, where it has regressed and why. No improvement ships without evidence. Improve the engine itself. Identify and implement engineering improvements across DocStreet, DTA2 and Orbis. Work closely with the people who use it. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Lending Operations, as well as directly with our clients. ABOUT YOU You are analytically strong . You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable being the person who figures out how things actually work. You have a technical engineering background , with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a comparable field, and 1–5 years of hands-on experience . You are AI-native . LLMs are a normal part of how you work. You know how to design and iterate on prompts and how to build benchmarks that show whether a change actually helped. You are a proactive self-starter . In a small team, there is no one to wait for. You spot what needs doing, propose it and take ownership of getting it done. You are a strong communicator . You can explain technical trade-offs to clients, respectfully challenge colleagues when needed and keep stakeholders informed without being asked. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Java and AWS , as our engine runs on them. Dutch language skills , as most of the documents we extract are in Dutch. WHY US? Ownership of a strategic 2026 objective from day one, in a team small enough that your work is visible to both clients and leadership. The opportunity to move a production system used by regulated lenders from rule-based to AI-based extraction . A role at the intersection of engineering, AI and the Dutch mortgage domain . Hybrid working from our office in the heart of Amsterdam. Competitive compensation and benefits .

items.desc: AI is strategisch belangrijk. Nu gaan we verder bouwen. Functieomschrijving Bij House of Covebo in Nijkerk stap je in op een moment waarop AI niet langer alleen een experiment is, maar een strategische prioriteit. De eerste toepassingen en use cases zijn in gang gezet en laten zien waar de kansen liggen. Tegelijkertijd staan we nog aan het begin van wat er mogelijk is. Veel moet nog worden ontworpen, gebouwd, getest en naar productie gebracht. Precies daarin ligt jouw ruimte: niet instappen in een volledig uitgekristalliseerd AI-landschap, maar meebouwen aan oplossingen die echt waarde toevoegen voor onze labels, systemen en gebruikers. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om mee te denken over richting, architectuur en technologie, maar vooral ook om zelf te bouwen. Van idee naar werkende toepassing, van prototype naar schaalbare oplossing: jij helpt bepalen hoe AI binnen House of Covebo verder vorm krijgt. Wat ga je doen? Je ontwikkelt nieuwe AI-oplossingen en bouwt bestaande toepassingen door tot robuuste productie-oplossingen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met onze AI-pionier, Product Owner en Teamlead. Kaan, Ruben en Floris kennen de business, use cases en richting; jij brengt de engineeringexpertise om daar technisch sterke oplossingen van te maken. Denk hierbij aan: AI-agents en slimme toepassingen ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren op basis van concrete businessvragen; waar relevant werken met technologieën zoals LLM’s, RAG, embeddings, vector databases en agent-tooling; AI-oplossingen koppelen aan systemen en processen binnen onze organisatie, bijvoorbeeld rondom recruitment, kennisdeling en operations; meedenken over en bouwen aan integraties, workflows en tooling die AI praktisch inzetbaar maken voor collega’s; keuzes maken rondom architectuur, modellen, data, veiligheid en schaalbaarheid; oplossingen stap voor stap naar productie brengen, monitoren en verbeteren op basis van gebruik en resultaat. Wat je hier niet krijgt, is een volledig uitgetekende technische blauwdruk. Je bouwt hieraan mee. Daarbij kiezen we technologie omdat die het probleem goed oplost, niet omdat het toevallig de nieuwste hype is. Wat we bieden Bij House of Covebo krijg je de vrijheid om het beste uit jezelf en je werk te halen. We bieden je een rol waarin AI geen innovatieproject aan de zijlijn is, maar een strategische prioriteit. Heb je een training of cursus nodig om dit waar te maken? Dat kan! Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel, zowel op professioneel als persoonlijk vlak. Al jaren boeken we succes na succes en deze vieren we graag. Denk aan een gaaf teamuitje of legendarisch personeelsfeest. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden in het kort: Goed salaris, afhankelijk van wat je meebrengt en bonusregeling Een laptop, telefoon én een auto van de zaak (of mobiliteitsvergoeding) Flexibele werktijden, inclusief thuiswerkmogelijkheden Wij bouwen samen aan jouw pensioen. Dit bestaat uit een basis en een (vrijwillig) flexibel deel. Voor het basisdeel betaal je 33,33% van de premie en voor het flexibele deel 100%. 26 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis en de mogelijkheid om bij te kopen en aandacht voor vitaliteit, bijvoorbeeld gezellig sporten met collega’s Maar dit is nog niet alles. Benieuwd naar wat we jou nog meer te bieden hebben? Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden. Wat we vragen Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in software-, ML- of AI-engineering en hebt ervaring met het bouwen of doorontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen richting productie. Of er nu AI Engineer, ML Engineer, MLOps Engineer, Backend Engineer of Data Engineer op je cv staat, vinden we minder belangrijk. We kijken vooral naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke technische verantwoordelijkheid je daarin hebt genomen en hoe je denkt over schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid. Verder breng je mee: een stevige basis in software-engineering en -architectuur; ervaring met AI-oplossingen in productie, dus verder dan alleen POC’s of demo’s; het vermogen om zelfstandig technische en architectuurkeuzes te maken en te onderbouwen; een pragmatische blik op modellen, frameworks en tooling: wat past bij het probleem staat voorop; het vermogen om technische expertise te combineren met de domeinkennis van anderen. Je hoeft niet alles uit onze stack al te kennen. Belangrijker is dat je begrijpt wat er ‘onder de motorkap’ gebeurt en weet wat nodig is om AI veilig en schaalbaar naar productie te brengen. Over ons bedrijf House of Covebo is onderdeel van House of HR, één van de snelst groeiende organisaties in arbeidsbemiddeling. Samen met onze merken Covebo, Effect, Eurojob, EU Facility Services, Fygi, Logi-technic, MAATT, PRAN, Pro Industry, Verder in Techniek, VNOM en Wolfram Chain hebben we dagelijks ruim 11.000 mensen aan het werk. Naast onze sterke Nederlandse recruitmentorganisatie zijn we ook actief in internationale arbeidsbemiddeling. In totaal hebben we ongeveer 1250 interne collega’s, verdeeld over zo’n 100 vestigingen in Nederland en 11 locaties in Polen, Spanje, Roemenië en …

Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities. General Information We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, build, and operate production-ready, enterprise-grade AI solutions with measurable business impact. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with a strong focus on LLM-based applications, agentic AI workflows, and scalable AI platforms . You will combine AI engineering expertise with strong software engineering and cloud-native practices to deliver secure, reliable, observable, and compliant AI products. As a player-coach, you will provide technical direction and guide a small cross-functional AI team while actively contributing to architecture, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Your Key Responsibilities Architect, design, and implement end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, backend services, frontend interfaces, and AI orchestration components. Build and maintain AI platform and harness components, including tool integrations, context management, guardrails, and evaluation of pipelines. Lead and guide a small cross-functional AI development team, providing technical clarity, direction, and hands-on support. Establish feedback loops and measurable evaluation frameworks to improve AI quality, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure AI solutions are production-ready, scalable, observable, secure, and aligned with enterprise and regulatory requirements. Apply post-training and fine-tuning techniques to improve model performance for relevant use cases. Deliver AI functionality iteratively, with clear business outcomes and stakeholder value. Collaborate with R&D, product management, quality, cybersecurity, sales, support, services, Global IT, and external technology partners. Contribute technical expertise and forward-looking know-how to support the division’s AI strategy. The opportunity to build enterprise-grade AI products that address real industrial and business challenges. Responsibility for technical direction and the development of a small, cross-functional AI team. Your Qualifications University degree in Computer Science, Applied Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a comparable field. Proven experience designing, building, and operating AI- or LLM-based applications in production environments. Strong knowledge and track record of AI engineering skills (e.g. Python, Pytorch, Transformers, post-training, fine-tuning of LLMs, RAG frameworks, agent architectures) Experience designing reliable, secure, and scalable enterprise applications. Experience leading small teams or technical initiatives in a hands-on, player-coach capacity. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills. Experience collaborating effectively in international and cross-functional teams. items.desc: AI-tillämpningar blir allt viktigare inom Swecos tjänsteutbud. Är du civilingenjör eller i slutet av dina studier och vill arbeta med AI-nära tillämpningarna i våra järnvägsuppdrag? Vi söker nu en person till den nya rollen som hybridingenjör, med syftet att accelerera AI-implementeringen i samarbete med våra kunder! Detta är en ny satsning hos oss och passar dig som vill kombinera kunskaper inom AI med ämneskunskap inom järnväg i en verksamhet som gör verklig skillnad. Hos oss får du både utveckla AI-lösningar och vara med och designa framtidens järnväg. I rollen som hybridingenjör inom vår verksamhet för järnväg blir du den viktiga länken mellan våra ämnesexperter inom lågspänning och den senaste AI-tekniken. Varför jobba hos oss? På Sweco får du möjlighet att arbeta med de senaste teknikerna inom AI och samtidigt göra konkret skillnad i en teknisk verksamhet med stor samhällsnytta. Vi erbjuder en flexibel arbetsplats med stor frihet under ansvar, kunniga kollegor och möjlighet att utvecklas både tekniskt och personligt. Hos oss får du vara med och påverka hur AI används för att stärka både vårt erbjudande och vår affär framåt. Vidare får du arbeta i en dynamisk och tvärvetenskaplig miljö där du kombinerar AI med praktiska ingenjörstillämpningar. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla nya arbetssätt, effektivisera processer och stötta verksamheten i gränssnittet mellan befintlig expertkunskap och ny teknik. Din framtida roll Som hybridingenjör blir du en del av vår regionala organisation inom järnväg. I rollen blir du en viktig länk mellan verksamhetens specialistkompetens och den senaste utvecklingen inom AI. Ditt uppdrag blir att identifiera, utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar som stärker våra konsulters arbetssätt och ökar värdet för våra kunder. Hos oss får du möjlighet att omsätta den senaste AI-tekniken i praktiken och bidra till hur framtidens ingenjörsarbete utvecklas. Samtidigt får du använda din järnvägstekniska kompetens för att vara med och utforma och designa framtidens järnväg. Du kommer att arbeta nära våra experter och våra kunder och i dialog med dem undersöka hur arbetsflöden i uppdragen kan effektiviseras och hur värdet av våra tjänster kan ökas med hjälp av AI. Arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att ansvara för att utveckla AI-verktyg och tillämpningar inom områden som CAD och projektering, beräkningar, dataanalys samt anbuds- och rapportskrivning. Du kommer även att arbeta med granskning och kvalitetssäkring samt ta fram expertchattar och AI-assistenter för att effektivisera arbetsflöden och skapa nya arbetssätt i verksamheten. Det ingår även i rollen att utbilda och stötta kollegor i användningen av AI, samt bidra till att stärka organisationens kompetens inom området. Du kommer ha en nära dialog med generella utvecklingsteam inom AI och automation för att säkerställa samarbete, innovation och teknisk utveckling. Möjliga placeringsorter är Stockholm, Västerås eller Norrköping. Den vi söker - är det du? Vi söker dig som har Ett genuint intresse för AI och teknik Civilingenjörsexamen, eller pågående civilingenjörsstudier, inom Industriell ekonomi, Teknisk fysik, Datateknik, Järnvägsteknik, Maskinteknik, Energiteknik, Samhällsbyggnad eller motsvarande Kännedom om järnvägsbranschen Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper eller utbildning inom Python-programmering Machine learning RAG CAD Cloud-miljöer (Azure, GCP, AWS) Automationer Projektledning Produktägarskap Vi tror att du är en initiativtagande och driven person med ett genuint intresse för AI, teknik och järnvägsfrågor. Du är nyfiken på utvecklingen inom området och motiveras av att utforska nya lösningar, arbetssätt och möjligheter. Du är skicklig på att omsätta idéer i praktiken och att implementera nya arbetssätt på ett strukturerat och engagerande sätt. Du har också ett starkt intresse för att utvecklas i din yrkesroll och bidra till utvecklingen av såväl kollegor som kunder. Du trivs med att samarbeta och har en naturlig förmåga att skapa och utveckla goda relationer, både internt och externt. Att arbeta tillsammans med andra mot gemensamma mål motiverar dig, och du uppskattar sammanhang där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte står i fokus. Du har lätt för att få med dig andra i förändring och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt introducera och förankra nya arbetssätt i verksamheten. Vidare har du god kommunikativ förmåga och uttrycker dig väl i både tal och skrift. Som person är du strukturerad, metodisk och kvalitetsmedveten, med ett stort engagemang i det du gör. På Sweco värdesätter vi ett gott affärsmässigt förhållningssätt, då våra samarbeten och kontaktytor bygger på långsiktiga relationer, förtroende och ett professionellt bemötande. Intresserad? A Billingónál egy dinamikusan fejlődő SaaS- és fintech ökoszisztémát építünk, ahol az AI valódi üzleti problémákra ad új lehetőségeket. Olyan AI Developert keresünk, aki naprakész a legújabb technológiákban, erős fejlesztői alapokkal rendelkezik, és szívesen vesz részt a vállalkozások mindennapjait megkönnyítő, innovatív megoldások fejlesztésében. 🛠️ MIVEL FOGLALKOZOL MAJD? AI-alapú funkciókat és megoldásokat fejlesztesz , az ötlettől az éles működésig. Olyan projekteken dolgozol, amelyek egyszerűbbé és hatékonyabbá teszik a vállalkozások mindennapjait. Kihasználod az aktuális AI-modellek és eszközök lehetőségeit, és eldöntöd, mikor melyik technológia a megfelelő választás. Részt veszel a technikai megoldások kialakításában , az integrációkban és a meglévő rendszerek továbbfejlesztésében. Önállóan keresel megoldásokat , tesztelsz, iterálsz, és figyelsz arra, hogy az elkészült kód ne csak működjön, hanem hosszú távon is vállalható legyen. 🔎 EZEKET KERESSÜK BENNED Fejlesztői tapasztalat: legalább 3 év fejlesztői tapasztalattal rendelkezel, emellett az AI-alapú fejlesztésben, AI-agentek építésében, natív AI-megoldások kialakításában is aktív gyakorlati tapasztalatod van, és szívesen mélyülsz el ezekben a gyorsan fejlődő technológiákban. Naprakész technológiai tudás: ismered a jelenlegi AI-eszközöket, modelleket és fejlesztési megközelítéseket, és követed a terület gyors változásait. Stabil fejlesztői alapok: érted a kódot, az architektúrát, az integrációkat és a fejlesztési kompromisszumokat is. DevOps és cloud infrastruktúra: van gyakorlati tapasztalatod AWS cloud infrastruktúrával, és átlátod az alkalmazások telepítésének, futtatásának és üzemeltetésének alapjait. Rendszerszintű gondolkodás: nem csak összeraksz egy működő AI-megoldást, hanem átlátod a működését, tudod tesztelni, hibakeresni és továbbfejleszteni. Önállóság és problémamegoldás: kritikusan gondolkodsz, és nem technológiát keresel egy problémához, hanem a megfelelő megoldást. Gyakorlati szemlélet: szívesen mutatsz korábbi munkákat, saját projekteket vagy portfóliót, amelyekből megismerhetjük a gondolkodásodat és a szakmai tudásodat. ✨ ELŐNYT JELENT LLM-ek és AI-agentek aktív használata: gyakorlati tapasztalat LLM-ekkel, AI-agentekkel, RAG-megoldásokkal vagy AI-alapú automatizációval. Production tapasztalat: AI-funkciók éles termékbe integrálása és üzemeltetése. Komplex rendszerek: tapasztalat valódi felhasználókat kiszolgáló, összetettebb rendszerek fejlesztésében. 💡 MIT KÍNÁL A BILLINGO? Valódi AI-fejlesztési feladatokat , nem kizárólag proof of concept projekteket. Lehetőséget arra, hogy közvetlenül részt vegyél egy dinamikusan fejlődő SaaS-termék fejlesztésében. Gyors fejlesztési ciklusokat, változatos problémákat és teret az önálló technikai döntéseknek. Olyan megoldások építését, amelyek kézzelfoghatóan segítik a vállalkozásokat. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in Italy. We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written and spoken …

items.desc: Job Description About CRU: CRU International is a leading provider of business intelligence and consulting services in the metals, mining, and fertilizer industries. With over 50 years of experience, we offer valuable insights and analysis that help our clients make informed decisions in an ever-changing global market. About the role : Help create valuable customer products by connecting CRU’s structured and unstructured data. You’ll build practical, reliable data-driven capabilities that make CRU intelligence easier to discover, interpret and use—combining data engineering and product development with applied AI technologies where they best serve customer needs. Job Requirements Qualifications: At least two years of experience in applied AI, data engineering or software engineering. Understanding of data modelling, data quality, metadata, lineage and governance principles. Experience with cloud-based data and application services; Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and/or Snowflake experience is ideal. Fluent written and spoken English. Skills & Experience: A customer- and product-oriented approach, with curiosity and the ability to test ideas and turn successful prototypes into reliable products. Organised, adaptable and delivery-focused, with a commitment to quality, reliability and continuous improvement. Ability to quickly understand business concepts, data relationships and customer use cases. Desirable: experience with search, vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic layers or retrieval systems. Desirable: experience with large language model application frameworks or managed model services, document processing, content management systems, or information-rich businesses. items.desc: AI-tillämpningar blir allt viktigare inom Swecos tjänsteutbud. Är du civilingenjör eller i slutet av dina studier och vill arbeta med AI-nära tillämpningarna i våra järnvägsuppdrag? Vi söker nu en person till den nya rollen som hybridingenjör, med syftet att accelerera AI-implementeringen i samarbete med våra kunder! Detta är en ny satsning hos oss och passar dig som vill kombinera kunskaper inom AI med ämneskunskap inom järnväg i en verksamhet som gör verklig skillnad. Hos oss får du både utveckla AI-lösningar och vara med och designa framtidens järnväg. I rollen som hybridingenjör inom vår verksamhet för järnväg blir du den viktiga länken mellan våra ämnesexperter inom lågspänning och den senaste AI-tekniken. Varför jobba hos oss? På Sweco får du möjlighet att arbeta med de senaste teknikerna inom AI och samtidigt göra konkret skillnad i en teknisk verksamhet med stor samhällsnytta. Vi erbjuder en flexibel arbetsplats med stor frihet under ansvar, kunniga kollegor och möjlighet att utvecklas både tekniskt och personligt. Hos oss får du vara med och påverka hur AI används för att stärka både vårt erbjudande och vår affär framåt. Vidare får du arbeta i en dynamisk och tvärvetenskaplig miljö där du kombinerar AI med praktiska ingenjörstillämpningar. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla nya arbetssätt, effektivisera processer och stötta verksamheten i gränssnittet mellan befintlig expertkunskap och ny teknik. Din framtida roll Som hybridingenjör blir du en del av vår regionala organisation inom järnväg. I rollen blir du en viktig länk mellan verksamhetens specialistkompetens och den senaste utvecklingen inom AI. Ditt uppdrag blir att identifiera, utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar som stärker våra konsulters arbetssätt och ökar värdet för våra kunder. Hos oss får du möjlighet att omsätta den senaste AI-tekniken i praktiken och bidra till hur framtidens ingenjörsarbete utvecklas. Samtidigt får du använda din järnvägstekniska kompetens för att vara med och utforma och designa framtidens järnväg. Du kommer att arbeta nära våra experter och våra kunder och i dialog med dem undersöka hur arbetsflöden i uppdragen kan effektiviseras och hur värdet av våra tjänster kan ökas med hjälp av AI. Arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att ansvara för att utveckla AI-verktyg och tillämpningar inom områden som CAD och projektering, beräkningar, dataanalys samt anbuds- och rapportskrivning. Du kommer även att arbeta med granskning och kvalitetssäkring samt ta fram expertchattar och AI-assistenter för att effektivisera arbetsflöden och skapa nya arbetssätt i verksamheten. Det ingår även i rollen att utbilda och stötta kollegor i användningen av AI, samt bidra till att stärka organisationens kompetens inom området. Du kommer ha en nära dialog med generella utvecklingsteam inom AI och automation för att säkerställa samarbete, innovation och teknisk utveckling. Möjliga placeringsorter är Stockholm, Västerås eller Norrköping. Den vi söker - är det du? Vi söker dig som har Ett genuint intresse för AI och teknik Civilingenjörsexamen, eller pågående civilingenjörsstudier, inom Industriell ekonomi, Teknisk fysik, Datateknik, Järnvägsteknik, Maskinteknik, Energiteknik, Samhällsbyggnad eller motsvarande Kännedom om järnvägsbranschen Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper eller utbildning inom Python-programmering Machine learning RAG CAD Cloud-miljöer (Azure, GCP, AWS) Automationer Projektledning Produktägarskap Vi tror att du är en initiativtagande och driven person med ett genuint intresse för AI, teknik och järnvägsfrågor. Du är nyfiken på utvecklingen inom området och motiveras av att utforska nya lösningar, arbetssätt och möjligheter. Du är skicklig på att omsätta idéer i praktiken och att implementera nya arbetssätt på ett strukturerat och engagerande sätt. Du har också ett starkt intresse för att utvecklas i din yrkesroll och bidra till utvecklingen av såväl kollegor som kunder. Du trivs med att samarbeta och har en naturlig förmåga att skapa och utveckla goda relationer, både internt och externt. Att arbeta tillsammans med andra mot gemensamma mål motiverar dig, och du uppskattar sammanhang där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte står i fokus. Du har lätt för att få med dig andra i förändring och kan på ett pedagogiskt sätt introducera och förankra nya arbetssätt i verksamheten. Vidare har du god kommunikativ förmåga och uttrycker dig väl i både tal och skrift. Som person är du strukturerad, metodisk och kvalitetsmedveten, med ett stort engagemang i det du gör. La figura dell’AI Engineer progetta soluzioni software di Machine Learning (ML) scalabili per i casi d'uso dei clienti e le industrializza per l’esecuzione in produzione garantendo i livelli richiesti di performance, sicurezza e governabilità. L’AI Engineer lavora a stretto contatto con altre figure di Datwave, come Cloud Data Architects, Data Scientists e Data Engineer, per realizzare soluzioni ML di alta qualità sotto ogni aspetto: disegnando e implementando per il team strumenti di lavoro come le piattaforme di MLOps, fornendo linee guida e best practise sulle architetture dati e di AI, supportando l’implementazione del software e funzionalità di osservabilità dell’AI, e altro ancora. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in Germany. We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written and …

items.desc: Je hebt ervaring met generatieve AI, volgt alle nieuwe modellen op de voet en hebt tientallen ideeën die je gewoon móet bouwen. Bij Zonneplan maak je hier je werk van. Als GenAI Engineer bouw je aan systemen zoals Kiki, onze AI-assistent die maandelijks 120.000 gesprekken voert. Je test de nieuwste modellen (LLM's, STT's, etc.) op echte klantgesprekken, bouwt je eigen agentprototypes en brengt geslaagde experimenten samen met het team naar productie. Ons Applied GenAI Team is een gedreven afdeling met een Silicon Valley-mentaliteit: als je een goed idee hebt, gaan we het gewoon doen. Van idee naar productie in dagen, niet maanden. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en werkt met de nieuwste generatieve AI-technologie. Jouw impact bij Zonneplan Technisch eigenaar van onze GenAI-oplossingen. Je neemt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor agentic systemen. Dat betekent: uitwerken, bouwen, monitoren, optimaliseren én doorontwikkelen. Hierin word je ondersteund door een developmentafdeling van 45+ data scientists, ML-engineers en developers. Ontwerp en bouw nieuwe AI-agents. Van agentic flow tot prompt engineering: jij denkt het proces uit en bepaalt hoe onze agents met klanten, collega's en systemen communiceren. Je bouwt eigen MCP’s en koppelt die binnen ons eigen agentplatform: AgentOS. Je ontwerpt evals en verbetert op basis van echte cases en feedback, onder meer met LLM-as-judge-systemen. Bouw aan de kennis en context die onze agents nodig hebben. Je zorgt dat agents de juiste informatie kunnen vinden en gebruiken. Daarvoor werken we o.a. met knowledge graphs (Neo4j) en vector databases. Automatiseer taken en denk processen opnieuw uit. Met tools als n8n bouw je workflows die het werk van collega's makkelijker maken. Je analyseert processen, ziet kansen en vertaalt die naar werkende oplossingen. Je krijgt de ruimte om zaken uit te zoeken en een betere aanpak te bouwen. Dit krijg je van ons Een salaris tussen €3.250 en €5.000 per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om er meer bij te kopen, en reiskostenvergoeding. Een persoonlijk keuzebudget voor sport, boodschappen of iets anders dat bij je past. Een toegewijd team met veel ervaring in generatieve AI, dat elkaar elke dag uitdaagt om bestaande werkwijzen anders aan te pakken. Veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid om met de nieuwste frontiermodellen te bouwen, inclusief een Codex- óf Claude Max-abonnement. Je kiest je eigen LLM-driven developmentstack, bijvoorbeeld OpenCode, T3 Code of Pi. Claude Code en Codex zijn de basis van hoe we dagelijks bouwen. We delen experimenten, zoeken samen uit waarom een agent iets verkeerd doet en bouwen ook agents en tools voor ons eigen werk. Dit neem jij mee Je hebt een 'getting things done'-mentaliteit en bent een echte GenAI-enthousiasteling. Je hebt minimaal 1 tot 2 jaar developmentervaring, bijvoorbeeld met Python of TypeScript. Ervaring met Claude Code is een pré. Je hebt affiniteit met prompt engineering en bent bekend met concepten zoals Chain of Thought prompting en Few Shot Examples. Je neemt graag technisch eigenaarschap over systemen, analyseert processen en vertaalt kansen naar werkende oplossingen. Je werkt comfortabel samen met verschillende stakeholders en weet techniek en business goed te verbinden. Zo ziet het proces eruit 1. Solliciteer via de button op deze pagina. 2. Telefonisch kennismakingsgesprek met Samer (recruiter). 3. Eerste gesprek met Glenn (Lead GenAI) en een recruiter. 4. Tweede gesprek met een praktijkcasus, en een persoonlijkheids- en capaciteitentest. 5. Is er een match? Dan doen we je snel een aanbod. Klaar om jouw GenAI-kennis in te zetten voor plan Zero? Bij Zonneplan werken we aan één duidelijk doel: een Nederland zonder fossiele energie. Wij noemen dat plan Zero. Geen uitstoot, geen verspilling, geen afhankelijkheid. Met jouw agents help je klanten en collega's bij de stappen die daarvoor nodig zijn: van een vraag over energie tot de voorbereiding van een installatie. Zo draag jij bij aan een van de grootste uitdagingen in Nederland: de energietransitie. Heb je vragen? Bel of mail met Samer: 088 020 3012, samer.elmokdad@zonneplan.nl Please note: Proficiency in the Dutch language is required

items.card: Responsibilities: Develop software in Python, C++ and Java. Work with Linux-based development environments and Git. Develop and integrate computer-vision solutions using cameras, image processing, object detection, person detection and depth sensing. Apply robotics fundamentals, including coordinate systems, kinematics, sensors, motion control and system integration. Develop and execute software and system tests.
items.desc: Scope: 100% Start : ASAP Duration: 1-year Location : Södertälje Assignment Overview: We are looking for an experienced professional to join our robotics project. The successful candidate will contribute to the development, integration and testing of advanced robotic systems, including embedded software, image processing, computer vision, autonomous functions and safety-critical applications. Responsibilities: Develop software in Python, C++ and Java. Work with Linux-based development environments and Git. Develop and integrate computer-vision solutions using cameras, image processing, object detection, person detection and depth sensing. Apply robotics fundamentals, including coordinate systems, kinematics, sensors, motion control and system integration. Develop and execute software and system tests. Troubleshoot complex software, hardware and communication problems. Coordinate development activities, manage technical priorities and deliver project milestones. Work with embedded systems and support integration between hardware and software. Contribute to safety engineering, risk assessment, verification and validation. Work independently while collaborating effectively with engineers and project stakeholders. Lead and coordinate a technical team when required. Education: Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field. Experience: At least 10 years of relevant professional experience. Strong programming skills in Python and C++; Java experience is also required. Professional experience with embedded systems. Previous experience with computer-vision and image processing projects, including cameras, image processing, object/person detection and depth sensing. items.desc: Le Groupe Revue Fiduciaire est un éditeur juridique de référence. Nous accompagnons au quotidien les professionnels des métiers du chiffre et du droit en leur proposant des solutions fiables, pratiques et innovantes pour s’informer, se former et anticiper les évolutions de leur métier. Rejoignez une structure à taille humaine, dynamique et en constante évolution où l’ esprit d’équipe, la qualité de service et l’innovation sont au cœur de nos valeurs. Le groupe Revue Fiduciaire recrute un(e) I ngénieur qualité & Évaluation IA (F/H) en CDI. Directement rattaché(e) à la Direction des Systèmes d’information (DSI) du Groupe Revue Fiduciaire, vous intégrerez l'équipe IA qui conçoit et opère les solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle du groupe : recherche documentaire augmentée et assistants conversationnels au service des professionnels du droit et du chiffre. Dans un domaine où l'exactitude des réponses est essentielle, vous serez le garant de la qualité mesurée de nos systèmes d'IA. Vos missions principales : Évaluation des systèmes d'IA : Construction et maintenance des jeux de tests de référence, en lien avec les experts métier (juristes, documentalistes) ; Développement de pipelines d'évaluation automatisée en Python (métriques RAG, LLM-as judge) ; Campagnes de non-régression avant chaque mise en production (changement de modèle, de prompt ou d'index) ; Enrichissement des jeux de tests à partir des cas problématiques remontés par la boucle de retour terrain, pilotée par l'Ingénieur IA. Qualité en production : Exploitation de l'observabilité (traces, scores d'évaluation) et construction des tableaux de bord qualité ; Recette fonctionnelle des livraisons IA et qualification des anomalies ; Tests de robustesse : injections de prompt, hallucinations, cas limites. Contribution à la chaîne de valeur IA : Collaboration étroite avec l'IA Engineer (qui porte la boucle de retour terrain) et les Développeurs Python pour améliorer en continu la fiabilité des solutions déployées ; Veille technologique sur les frameworks et pratiques d'évaluation des LLM Le profil recherché : Formation Bac+5 (informatique, data, NLP) ; débutant accepté, une première expérience en ML, data ou QA (stage, alternance) est un plus. Bonne pratique de Python : scripts, tests, manipulation de données. Compréhension des LLM et des architectures RAG ; curiosité forte pour l'IA générative. Rigueur, esprit critique et goût de la mesure : savoir douter d'une réponse plausible mais fausse. Capacité à communiquer avec des profils variés, techniques et métier. Avantages : Rémunération sur 13 mois, statut cadre Accord de participation PEE, PERCOL Tickets restaurant (Carte Swile) Compte épargne-temps (CET) 14,5 JRTT Comité Social et Economique Télétravail (possibilité de 2 jours/semaine) Forfait mobilités durables LOCALISATION : Nos locaux sont situés dans le 10e arrondissement de Paris, au pied du métro 7 (Poissonnière) et à proximité de la Gare du Nord et de la Gare de l’Est. Pourquoi rejoindre le Groupe Revue Fiduciaire ? Rejoindre notre DSI, c'est travailler sur des projets à fort impact, en interaction avec des experts métiers et techniques. Vous contribuerez activement à la transformation digitale du groupe, dans une ambiance collaborative et bienveillante.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Tooling Engineer based in United Kingdom. We are looking for an AI Tooling Engineer to develop and scale an internal agentic platform that brings together company knowledge, data, and tools in one secure, accessible environment. Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written …

Working closely with a Principal Engineer, you will build production-ready AI agents and integrations that help employees and their AI assistants access the information they need. You will take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and designing solutions to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Using technologies such as Python, LangGraph, LLM APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP), you will transform prototypes into reliable tools used across the organization. You will also establish evaluation frameworks, optimize AI performance and costs, and ensure robust security and access controls. This remote opportunity offers the chance to shape company-wide AI capabilities within a globally distributed, technology-driven team. Accountabilities You will help develop and maintain an internal AI platform, combining agent development, systems integration, production engineering, and continuous optimization to deliver practical tools that improve how teams work. Collaborate with the Principal Engineer to design, develop, and deploy new platform capabilities, taking ownership from initial design through production release. Integrate internal systems and SaaS applications by connecting APIs and data sources, defining shared data models, and implementing appropriate access permissions. Build AI agents and supporting tools, including MCP servers that enable agents across the organization to interact with internal systems and retrieve relevant context. Design and improve retrieval workflows, tool calling, embeddings, prompts, and context management to deliver accurate and useful AI-generated responses. Establish and maintain AI quality standards through evaluation datasets, benchmarks, regression testing, tracing, and observability. Monitor performance indicators, including cost per answer and token usage, and optimize models, prompts, and workflows for efficiency and reliability. Troubleshoot production issues, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve the platform based on real-world usage. Turn proofs of concept into secure, scalable cloud applications with appropriate infrastructure, deployment processes, and identity and access controls. Use AI coding agents as a core part of the development workflow while maintaining code quality through clear specifications, automated tests, reviews, and sound engineering practices. Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives, including evaluating and standardizing internal AI tools, tracking usage and costs, and defining standards for AI-generated applications. Support other teams in adopting and building on the platform, helping them develop effective AI-powered workflows and internal applications. Engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization to understand their needs, prioritize improvements, and communicate solutions clearly. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on software engineer with practical experience delivering AI agents to production, a strong understanding of modern AI development frameworks, and the ability to build secure, reliable internal tools. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, primarily using Python and relational databases. Proven experience building and deploying at least one production AI agent with LangGraph that is used by real users. Practical expertise in agent development, including tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt engineering, and context design. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from major providers, including token management and cost optimization. Experience working with MCP or comparable tool protocols, both as a server and as a client. Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including test datasets, LLM-as-judge approaches, regression testing, and performance monitoring. Familiarity with tracing and observability tools such as Langfuse or equivalent solutions. Experience integrating APIs and data sources, including SaaS applications, SQL databases, and data warehouses. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or both, including containers, managed databases, identity and access management, and CI/CD pipelines. Daily use of AI coding agents, with the ability to validate their output and maintain high standards of software quality. Strong understanding of security principles, identity management, permissions, and least-privilege access controls. Experience with version control and collaborative development tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket. Excellent written and …

Nous sommes présents à Paris, Montréal, Shanghai, New York et Genève, avec plus de 800 consultants. 🌍 Leader mondial de l'expérience client et corporate Nous collaborons avec les marques les plus emblématiques pour assurer leur succès : ✔️ De la stratégie et l'innovation ✔️ À l'exécution à grande échelle, grâce à notre expertise en business, tech, data et IA 🤖✨ 🏆 Reconnaissances & Leadership Leader en innovation et croissance 2025 (Les Echos Business Magazine) Acteur multi-tech et partenaire Premium Salesforce 🌿 Champion d'une "Tech Responsable et Durable" Créé avec la parité hommes-femmes, défendant l’égalité grâce à une équipe de direction engagée 🌟 45 % de femmes au sein de nos équipes Campagne primée TopCom en 2024 📜 Certifications et Prix Salesforce Impact Partner 2024 Cybervadis 2025 Entreprise à impact de l'année 2024 par Choose My Company 🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈 _________________________________________________________________ Pour l'un de nos clients majeurs dans le secteur du luxe, VO2 Group recherche un(e) Développeur(se) IA / AI Engineer pour rejoindre nos équipes à Paris en CDI. Vous interviendrez au cœur de projets d'intelligence artificielle générative, avec un objectif : concevoir, développer et intégrer des solutions IA performantes, sécurisées et industrialisables, en vous appuyant sur les technologies Google Cloud et les frameworks d'IA agentique. 🎯 Votre rôle Vous accompagnerez notre client dans la construction et le déploiement de solutions d'IA générative, notamment autour du développement d'agents intelligents et de leur intégration au système d'information. Au quotidien, vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des agents IA à l'aide de LangChain, LangGraph et Google ADK Développer et intégrer des APIs et connecteurs pour interagir avec les applications et systèmes existants Construire des solutions d'IA générative sur Google Cloud et Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) Développer et maintenir des composants backend en Python Mettre en œuvre les mécanismes de sécurité, de gestion des identités et des accès Assurer le déploiement, l'industrialisation et l'observabilité des solutions IA Optimiser la fiabilité, les performances et la maintenabilité des agents développés Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, Cloud et métiers pour garantir la bonne intégration des solutions 🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en développement logiciel, idéalement sur des projets d'IA générative ou d'IA agentique, et êtes capable d'intervenir de manière autonome sur des sujets techniques, de la conception jusqu'au déploiement. Vous maîtrisez particulièrement : → Python : développement backend, APIs et intégrations → LangChain / LangGraph : orchestration de workflows et d'agents IA → Google Cloud Platform (GCP) : développement et déploiement de solutions Cloud → Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) et Google ADK → APIs et connecteurs : intégration de services et de systèmes → Sécurité, IAM et observabilité : sécurisation, supervision et suivi des solutions en production Prérequis indispensables : Expérience pratique de Claude Code et/ou OpenAI Codex Certification Claude Certified Developer – Foundations obligatoire Formation ou certification Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (GEAP) réalisée avant le démarrage sur ce périmètre 🌍 Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international : un anglais professionnel courant est indispensable pour le poste. items.desc: Du willst KI nicht nur ausprobieren, sondern produktiv bauen? Bei uns entwickelst Du KI-Anwendungen, Agenten und Automatisierungen, die intern und bei unseren Kunden im Mittelstand wirklich im Einsatz sind. Vom ersten Prototyp bis zur stabilen Lösung im Betrieb. Was Dich erwartet: KI-Anwendungen mit echtem Einsatz: Du entwickelst KI-Lösungen für unsere internen Prozesse und für Kundenprojekte, von der Idee über den Proof of Concept bis zur produktiven Anwendung. RAG, Agenten und MCP-Server: Du baust Retrieval-Augmented-Generation-Systeme, die Unternehmenswissen nutzbar machen, entwickelst KI-Agenten für konkrete Geschäftsprozesse und stellst über eigene MCP-Server die sichere Anbindung von Datenbanken, APIs und Unternehmensanwendungen bereit. Plattformübergreifende Skills und Assistenten: Du setzt Agenten und Erweiterungen für Microsoft Copilot und Copilot Studio um, entwickelst Custom GPTs und Actions im OpenAI-Ökosystem und baust Skills und Tools mit Claude. KI im SAP-Umfeld: Du entwickelst SAP spezifische „Joule Skills“ und „Joule Agents“ und setzt KI-gestützte Lösungen auf der SAP Business Technology Platform um. Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du überführst manuelle Abläufe in KI-gestützte Workflows, vor allem mit n8n, inklusive Anbindung von LLMs, APIs und Unternehmenssystemen. Enablement und Beratung: Du unterstützt unsere Entwicklungsteams beim Einsatz von Claude Code, GitHub Copilot und weiteren KI-Werkzeugen und berätst Kunden und interne Fachbereiche zu sinnvollen KI-Anwendungsfällen. Das bringst Du mit: Verständnis für KI-Technologie: Du weißt, wie Large Language Models funktionieren und kannst einschätzen, welches Modell für welchen Anwendungsfall passt. Mit Blick auf Qualität, Geschwindigkeit, Kosten und Datenschutz. Entwicklungs-Know-how: Du programmierst sicher in Python, hast idealerweise auch schon mit TypeScript oder Node.js gearbeitet und kennst die Grundlagen der API- und Backend-Entwicklung. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung: Du arbeitest gerne mit Claude Code, GitHub Copilot oder vergleichbaren Coding Agents und prüfst KI-generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm blind zu vertrauen. Erste Praxis mit KI-Anwendungen: Ob im Studium, der Ausbildung, in Projekten oder aus Eigeninitiative: Du hast schon eigene Anwendungen gebaut, zum Beispiel mit RAG, Agenten, Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n oder Cloud-Services auf SAP BTP, Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud. Neugier und Eigenantrieb: Das KI-Umfeld verändert sich schnell. Du hast Lust, Dich einzuarbeiten, Neues auszuprobieren und Dich in Themen reinzudenken, die es bis letzte Woche noch nicht gab. Sprachskills: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (Niveau B2) in Wort und Schrift. Warum wir die perfekte Wahl für Dich sind: Ein eingespieltes Team: flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe: Wir suchen gezielt ein Teammitglied mit Engagement, Leidenschaft für KI-Technologien und die Arbeit mit mittelständischen Kunden. Langfristige Perspektive: Wir fördern Deine Karriere ab dem ersten Tag. Flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten: flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit auf 2 Tage mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche. Location zwischen High Performance und Wohlfühlen: sehr modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Arbeitsequipment und höhenverstellbaren Tischen. Entspannen kannst Du mit Kaffee, fritz kola Drinks oder Obst in unserem Lounge-Bereich. Benefits: 30 Urlaubstage und noch mehr, denn der 24.12. und 31.12. sind zusätzlich frei. Ein faires Gehalt, bezahlte Überstunden, Gleitzeit und Gewinnbeteiligung gelten für uns als Selbstverständlichkeit. Umfangreiche Zusatzleistungen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gewinnbeteiligung, iPhone zur privaten Nutzung, Jobrad, Kantine und Essenszuschuss in Stuttgart, attraktive Mitarbeiter-Events
