items.desc: Responsable Transformation Industrielle & Intelligence Artificielle (H/F) 📍 Paris | CDI | Package attractif + intéressement au capital Votre futur environnement Nous accompagnons un acteur innovant de l'écosystème technologique, spécialisé dans le développement et le déploiement de solutions digitales et d'intelligence artificielle pour l'industrie. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement international, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Transformation Industrielle & IA pour accompagner de grands groupes industriels dans l'amélioration de leur performance opérationnelle grâce aux nouvelles technologies. Vos missions: Au croisement de la stratégie, de l'industrie et de l'innovation technologique, vous piloterez des projets de transformation à fort impact. À ce titre, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes : Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité digitale et opérationnelle auprès de grands comptes industriels. Identifier les opportunités d'optimisation des processus de production grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et à la data. Définir les feuilles de route de transformation industrielle en collaboration avec les directions opérationnelles. Piloter le déploiement de solutions IA et digitales, depuis le cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en production. Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes : équipes industrielles, directions générales, équipes IT et partenaires technologiques. Accompagner la conduite du changement et l'adoption des solutions sur les sites de production. Mesurer les résultats des projets à travers des indicateurs de performance : productivité, qualité, coûts et efficacité opérationnelle. Contribuer à la structuration et au déploiement de solutions reproductibles à l'échelle internationale. Votre profil: Diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation équivalente. Vous justifiez idéalement de 4 à 7 ans d'expérience en conseil en stratégie ou transformation industrielle , notamment au sein d'un cabinet de conseil reconnu. Vous avez participé à plusieurs missions de transformation de sites industriels, avec une réelle exposition aux opérations terrain. Vous comprenez les enjeux de l'industrie 4.0, de la digitalisation des processus de production et des technologies IA/Data. Vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien avec les équipes opérationnelles qu'avec des interlocuteurs de direction générale. Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de communication et de pilotage de projets complexes. Vous appréciez les environnements entrepreneuriaux, exigeants et orientés résultats. Une expérience sur des projets d'IA industrielle, de maintenance prédictive, de vision artificielle ou d'optimisation de la performance constitue un véritable atout. Pourquoi rejoindre cette opportunité ? Participer à des projets d'innovation industrielle auprès de grands groupes internationaux. Piloter des transformations concrètes, de la stratégie jusqu'aux résultats opérationnels. Évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial dynamique. Bénéficier d'une forte autonomie et d'une exposition directe aux décideurs. Accéder à de réelles perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions de direction, de Partner ou d'entrepreneuriat. Vous souhaitez aller au-delà du conseil et participer directement à la transformation des industries de demain ? Échangeons sur cette opportunité !

items.desc: Descripción del puesto: En pocas palabras 📌 Posición: AI Engineer – Supply Chain Localización: Madrid / Híbrido Experiencia: 2-4 años ¿Quieres saber más? 👇 En Insud Pharma buscamos incorporar un/a AI Engineer – Supply Chain para diseñar e implementar soluciones de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a la cadena de suministro, integradas con datos, procesos y aplicaciones internas, con foco en la automatización, la creación de agentes y la mejora de la toma de decisiones. Buscamos un perfil muy aplicado, con una orientación clara a producto e ingeniería, más enfocado en llevar casos de uso desde la idea hasta producción que en la investigación pura. Si te motiva construir soluciones reales de alto impacto en negocio, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. ¿Qué buscamos? 🔎 Una persona que quiera asumir un rol clave en el diseño, desarrollo e integración de soluciones de IA aplicadas al negocio, especialmente en el ámbito de Supply Chain, colaborando con equipos técnicos y de negocio para identificar oportunidades de automatización y optimización. ¡El reto! 🚀 Diseñar agentes y asistentes internos sobre datos de negocio. Integrar LLMs con APIs, bases de datos y herramientas internas. Construir soluciones de RAG y búsqueda sobre documentación y datos. Automatizar análisis, reporting y procesos operativos. Trabajar con fuentes como SAP, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Excel y APIs internas. Diseñar sistemas de evaluación de calidad, precisión, coste y latencia. Implementar observabilidad y trazabilidad de prompts, respuestas y tool calls. Integrar capacidades de IA dentro de aplicaciones web existentes. Colaborar con los equipos de Data Analytics y Supply Chain para identificar casos de uso de alto impacto. Garantizar la seguridad, el control de acceso y el buen uso de los datos. ¿Qué necesitas? 🤓 Experiencia de 2 a 4 años en desarrollo de soluciones de IA, software engineering o automatización aplicada a negocio. Conocimientos sólidos de Python. Experiencia con FastAPI. Conocimientos en integración y consumo de APIs REST. Experiencia con LLMs y tool calling. Experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones RAG. Conocimientos de SQL. Experiencia con tecnologías como ClickHouse y Snowflake. Manejo de herramientas como Git y Docker. Experiencia en integración con aplicaciones web. Capacidad para llevar un caso de uso desde la idea hasta producción, con enfoque práctico y visión de producto. Muy valorable Experiencia con agentes empresariales. Conocimientos de embeddings y vector databases. Experiencia en evaluación automática de LLMs. Conocimientos de Machine Learning aplicado. Experiencia en entornos corporativos o trabajando con datos sensibles. Conocimiento de herramientas como LiteLLM y Langfuse. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 🌟 ⏰ Horario de entrada flexible de lunes a viernes (jornada completa). 📜 Contrato indefinido. 💸 Paquete salarial atractivo. 🥼 Seguro de vida y accidentes. 🍽️ Ticket restaurante. 🩺 Servicio médico en las instalaciones. 💸 Club de beneficios y ahorro. 💻 Plataforma de formación y aprendizaje de idiomas. 💆🏻‍♀️ Plataforma de bienestar con sesiones gratuitas e ilimitadas de psicología. 📈 Planes de desarrollo y política de movilidad interna. ⭐ ¡Y mucho más! 🔷¿Crees que esta oferta no es para ti? 🔷 Si esta oportunidad no encaja contigo, te invitamos a seguirnos para conocer futuras vacantes y novedades. Síguenos en LinkedIn e Instagram para más oportunidades laborales. #InsudPharma #Challenger #Insuder #InsudTalent Compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades En Insud Pharma estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y con la creación de un entorno de trabajo diverso e inclusivo. Todas las candidaturas serán valoradas sin distinción de género, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, edad, origen étnico, nacionalidad, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal o social protegida por la legislación vigente.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product) based in Romania. We are looking for an entrepreneurial technology leader ready to turn AI and data expertise into a business of their own. This founding opportunity is designed for experienced engineers who want to move beyond implementing someone else's vision and build an AI-powered B2B venture from the ground up. Over a focused 12-week, fully remote program, you will validate a real market problem, define a product-led minimum viable product (MVP), and develop a working solution with measurable business value. You will shape the technical architecture, data strategy, and deployment approach while establishing a compelling competitive advantage. Supported by experienced mentors, fellow founders, and a global startup network, you will refine your product and prepare an investor-ready technology vision. This is an opportunity to combine technical leadership, product thinking, and founder ambition to launch or join a founding team. Accountabilities As a founding technology leader, you will drive the technical and product development of an AI-powered B2B venture, balancing feasibility, customer needs, and commercial potential throughout the 12-week program. Identify and validate a B2B problem where AI can deliver measurable value through time savings, cost reduction, or risk mitigation. Define a product-focused MVP that addresses a clear customer need rather than prioritizing model complexity for its own sake. Design the data strategy, including data collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Architect and deliver a reliable prototype or MVP, incorporating APIs, data pipelines, appropriate safeguards, and feedback loops. Establish foundational production practices for model deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing performance evaluation. Iterate on the product based on validation results, user feedback, and evolving business requirements. Develop a compelling technical and product narrative for potential investors, explaining the venture's competitive advantage, data strategy, and product roadmap. Collaborate with co-founders, mentors, and other startup participants to refine the business concept and accelerate execution. Dedicate approximately 10–12 hours per week to building, validating, and improving the venture over the 12-week sprint. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong AI/ML or data product expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ambition to take ownership of a new business venture. At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, with substantial exposure to AI/ML or data-driven products. Demonstrated experience deploying software, machine learning models, or data products into production environments. Understanding of MLOps fundamentals, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and performance evaluation. Ability to design practical AI and data solutions that address real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Strong product judgment, with the ability to define MVP scope, prioritize essential functionality, and determine when a solution is ready for validation. Experience or familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready system design. An entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine desire to build a company, take ownership of technical decisions, and participate in the potential upside of a venture. Ability to work independently, make decisions under uncertainty, and move quickly from problem discovery to product execution. Willingness to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week for 12 weeks. Interest in collaborating with co-founders, engaging with mentors, and developing an investor-ready vision for an AI-powered B2B business. Benefits A structured, 12-week startup sprint to progress from problem discovery to MVP development, validation, and iteration. Fully remote participation with an international community of founders and technology professionals. Weekly accountability sessions and a consistent execution cadence to maintain momentum and focus. Access to a network of more than 500 mentors specializing in B2B businesses, product development, go-to-market strategy, and fundraising. Connections to a global alumni network of more than 440 startups across over 40 countries, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and introductions. A practical CTO toolkit for AI ventures, covering product scoping, model evaluation, deployment, and the development of a defensible competitive advantage. The opportunity to become a co-founder or join a founding team and build an AI-powered business with long-term growth potential. items.desc: Er du i gang med din kandidat? Vil du gerne arbejde tæt på ledelsen, få ansvar fra dag ét, og bygge AI i produktionskvalitet til store virksomheder ved siden af studiet? 📍 København · ⏱️ Studiejob (15–20 timer/uge) · 🗓️ Start efter aftale (gerne hurtigst muligt) Vil du se din kode blive brugt af rigtige kunder, mens du stadig studerer? Er du nysgerrig på, hvordan AI-agenter bliver bygget og sat i drift i store virksomheder? Vil du lære mere ved siden af studiet, end du gør i forelæsningssalen? Vil du være med, hvor det sker, i stedet for at læse om det bagefter? Så læs videre. Om Kompose Vi bygger fokuserede AI-løsninger i produktionskvalitet til rådgivningsvirksomheder og større virksomheder. Vi løser de svære problemer, som virksomheder har brug for at få løst: Behandling af komplekse dokumenter Navigation i compliance-krav Løsninger, som organisationer bygger deres drift på Vi er et team med baggrund i tech og consulting og holder til på Christianshavn i København (lige ved kanalerne). Vi er i en tidlig fase, vokser organisk med stærk traction og bygger noget, der virker. Vi rykker hele tiden grænserne for, hvordan vi bruger AI, både internt og for vores kunder. Vi leverer ikke kun AI-løsninger. Vi udvikler også løbende vores egen AI-leverancemodel, så vi leverer hurtigere og bedre for hvert projekt. Rollen: AI Engineer (studiejob) Vi søger en teknisk stærk studerende, der er i gang med en kandidat inden for fx datalogi, software engineering, AI/machine learning, data science, matematik eller ingeniørvidenskab. Du kan kode, du kan lide at shippe, og du vil gerne tage ansvar. Du har allerede bygget ting selv, fx på studiet, i et sideprojekt eller i et tidligere studiejob. Du kommer med på rigtige kundeprojekter fra start: du er med til workshops, hjælper med leverancen og arbejder tæt sammen med resten af teamet og vores kunder, både på dansk og engelsk. Vi kalder det "deep tech, not deep basement". Du bygger, men du kan også forklare, hvad du bygger, og hvorfor det betyder noget. Det kommer du til at lave Bygge AI-systemer, der ræsonnerer over komplekse dokumenter, orkestrerer workflows i flere trin og gør virksomheders drift hurtigere og klogere, med frontier-LLM'er, agentiske frameworks, RAG-arkitekturer og vektordatabaser Deploye og vedligeholde systemer på kundens infrastruktur med fokus på sikkerhed, skalerbarhed, CI/CD i Azure DevOps og observability med LangFuse Arbejde med de nyeste agent-harnesses og reasoning-modeller samt Conductor til parallel agent-orkestrering Bidrage til vores interne AI-leverancemodel, dvs. de systemer og den praksis, der gør hvert projekt bedre end det forrige Bygge frontend i React og skrive produktionskode i Python og TypeScript Arbejde med infrastructure as code i Terraform på Azure Deltage i kundeworkshops, sprints og projektmøder. Du er en del af det team, kunden møder Det er ikke en forskerstilling. Det er applied engineering, der rent faktisk bliver brugt i den virkelige verden. Det forventer vi af dig Du er i gang med en relevant kandidatuddannelse Du kan arbejde 15–20 timer om ugen (fleksibelt i eksamensperioder) Solide Python-kompetencer Kendskab til eller interesse for prompt & context engineering, RAG og vektordatabaser Gerne erfaring med React (eller lignende) til frontend Lyst til at lære Azure, Azure DevOps og infrastructure as code (Terraform) Du behersker dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau, både skriftligt og mundtligt Klar kommunikation, både med tekniske og ikke-tekniske folk Det tilbyder vi Ansvar fra dag ét. Du er ikke bare et nummer. Du arbejder tæt på ledelsen, får rigtigt ansvar og ser direkte effekten af dit arbejde Erfaring, der rækker ud over studiet. Du designer, bygger og deployer AI-systemer i produktion til store virksomheder Læring fra et erfarent team. Du arbejder tæt sammen med stifterne, der har solid baggrund i tech og consulting Indflydelse på, hvordan AI-projekter leveres. Du er med til at udvikle vores interne leverancemodel De bedste værktøjer. Vi investerer i de bedste AI-værktøjer og engineering-praksisser Mulighed for speciale eller fuldtidsstilling. Gode studentermedhjælpere vil vi gerne beholde Fleksibilitet om studiet. Vi planlægger arbejdstiden efter dit skema og dine eksamener Godt sted at arbejde. Kontor midt på Christianshavn, tæt på metroen og kanalerne til en ugentlig svømmetur. Derudover tager vi på strategiture sammen Start: Efter aftale (gerne hurtigst muligt) Omfang: 15–20 timer om ugen, primært på kontoret Sådan søger du Søg direkte her på LinkedIn med "Easy Apply". For at gøre processen relevant (for dig og for os) vil vi helst se ansøgninger med rigtigt arbejde. Sørg derfor for, at din ansøgning indeholder: Dit CV og karakterudskrift (gerne samlet i én PDF) Link til din GitHub (eller lignende), gerne med noget, vi kan kigge på En kort tekst om, hvad du har bygget, hvad du havde ansvar for, og hvad du lærte Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt os på hi@kompose.dk eller på telefon +45 23 98 78 42.

items.desc: Au sein de votre équipe #OneTeam Vous évoluez au sein de l'équipe AI Ressources & Solutions qui a pour mission d'accompagner OVHcloud pour accélérer l'usage de l'IA par les équipes. Vous interviendrez sur du développement fullstack afin de produire des solutions IA internes permettant d’optimiser l’adoption de l’IA au sein de l’entreprise. Vos principales responsabilités Développer des applications d'agents ou agents autonomes prototypes ou fonctionnalités à l’aide de Python ou Typescript, en vous appuyant sur les framework Langchain, Langchain Deep Agent, LangGraph. Développer en frontend (React) et en backend à l'aide de coding assistants pour intégrer des fonctions IA. Développer des skills ou MCP de génération de document ou des plugins onlyOffice ou MsOffice afin d’intégrer l’IA d’OVH dans ces outils Rédiger des system prompts ou user prompts en anglais ou en français avec les IA d’OVHcloud répondants à des cas d’usages variés. Documenter vos travaux dans une documentation interne rédigée avec le framework mkdocs. Déployer les solutions développées à l’aide de docker, kubernetes et helm chart Votre futur impact Dans 4 à 6 mois Vous serez autonome sur les sujets qui vous sont confiés. items.desc: NAOKO to polska marka modowa, która rośnie szybko i świadomie. Budujemy wewnętrzny ekosystem technologiczny, który bezpośrednio napędza sprzedaż, logistykę, marketing i obsługę klienta. Nie outsourcujemy kluczowych systemów – budujemy je sami, blisko biznesu i produktu. Szukamy osoby, która będzie budować moduły naszego produktu AI (ManyMinds) od początku do końca: backend, API i interfejs. Bierzesz prototypy i pomysły od zespołu AI i zamieniasz je w działające, stabilne moduły – takie, które da się wdrożyć u klienta zewnętrznego, a nie tylko u nas. Technologie, których używamy: TypeScript Node.js Frontend (React, Vue albo Svelte) PostgreSQL API modeli językowych. Dodatkowo: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, React. Twój Zakres Obowiązków budowanie modułów naszego produktu AI (ManyMinds) od początku do końca: backend, API, interfejs praca z zespołem AI: bierzesz ich prototypy i pomysły i zamieniasz je w działające, stabilne moduły rozwój warstwy obsługi wielu dostawców modeli językowych: przełączanie, limity, kontrola kosztów, logowanie wywołań budowanie interfejsów na podstawie gotowych projektów i flow od naszego Product Designera – panele do przeglądania i akceptacji treści, widoki raportowe, ekrany dla klientów zewnętrznych dbanie o to, żeby to, co powstaje, dało się wdrożyć u klienta zewnętrznego, a nie tylko u nas udział w decyzjach o tym, jak moduł ma działać – nie dostajesz gotowej specyfikacji do przeklikania TypeScript / Node – backend, API, integracje frontend w dowolnym komponentowym frameworku (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular) plus dobre podstawy JS/TS – panele robi ta sama osoba, która pisze do nich backend. Nie wymagamy konkretnego frameworka: stos frontendowy produktu nie jest jeszcze zamknięty, liczy się umiejętność budowania interfejsu relacyjne bazy danych (Postgres) – projektowanie schematu na poziomie podstawowym doświadczenie z integracją API modeli językowych (OpenAI, Anthropic lub inne) – wystarczy z własnych projektów, nie musi być komercyjne umiejętność pracy na podstawie gotowego flow i makiety – nie oczekujemy projektowania, ale czytania projektu ze zrozumieniem codzienna praca z asystentami AI przy kodowaniu i umiejętność weryfikacji tego, co wygenerują Git, praca na branchach, podstawy CI gotowość wchodzenia w obszary poza własną specjalizacją angielski techniczny (dokumentacja, API) Mile Widziane React – dziś najbardziej prawdopodobny kierunek dla naszego produktu, ale nie warunek Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, konteneryzacja kolejki zadań, praca asynchroniczna, obsługa długo trwających operacji doświadczenie z agentami, RAG, ewaluacją outputu modeli testy automatyczne e-commerce jako domena Czego Nie Wymagamy samodzielnego projektowania architektury promptowania i doboru modeli AI znajomości Comarch Optima ani OMS W NAOKO piszesz kod, który ma bezpośredni wpływ na to, jak firma działa i sprzedaje – nie siedzisz w silosie i nie czekasz na tickety od product managera. Działasz blisko biznesu, rozumiesz kontekst i masz realny wpływ na to, co budujesz. Pracujesz w środowisku, które traktuje AI poważnie – mamy wdrożone procesy, narzędzia i ambicje, żeby być jedną z najbardziej AI-native firm w polskim e-commerce fashion. Oferujemy atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie (UoP lub B2B) oraz pakiet benefitów: karta Multisport, ubezpieczenie grupowe i zniżki na produkty marki NAOKO.

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product) based in Switzerland. We are looking for an entrepreneurial technology leader ready to turn AI and data expertise into a business of their own. This founding opportunity is designed for experienced engineers who want to move beyond implementing someone else's vision and build an AI-powered B2B venture from the ground up. Over a focused 12-week, fully remote program, you will validate a real market problem, define a product-led minimum viable product (MVP), and develop a working solution with measurable business value. You will shape the technical architecture, data strategy, and deployment approach while establishing a compelling competitive advantage. Supported by experienced mentors, fellow founders, and a global startup network, you will refine your product and prepare an investor-ready technology vision. This is an opportunity to combine technical leadership, product thinking, and founder ambition to launch or join a founding team. Accountabilities As a founding technology leader, you will drive the technical and product development of an AI-powered B2B venture, balancing feasibility, customer needs, and commercial potential throughout the 12-week program. Identify and validate a B2B problem where AI can deliver measurable value through time savings, cost reduction, or risk mitigation. Define a product-focused MVP that addresses a clear customer need rather than prioritizing model complexity for its own sake. Design the data strategy, including data collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Architect and deliver a reliable prototype or MVP, incorporating APIs, data pipelines, appropriate safeguards, and feedback loops. Establish foundational production practices for model deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing performance evaluation. Iterate on the product based on validation results, user feedback, and evolving business requirements. Develop a compelling technical and product narrative for potential investors, explaining the venture's competitive advantage, data strategy, and product roadmap. Collaborate with co-founders, mentors, and other startup participants to refine the business concept and accelerate execution. Dedicate approximately 10–12 hours per week to building, validating, and improving the venture over the 12-week sprint. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong AI/ML or data product expertise, a product-oriented mindset, and the ambition to take ownership of a new business venture. At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, with substantial exposure to AI/ML or data-driven products. Demonstrated experience deploying software, machine learning models, or data products into production environments. Understanding of MLOps fundamentals, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and performance evaluation. Ability to design practical AI and data solutions that address real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. Strong product judgment, with the ability to define MVP scope, prioritize essential functionality, and determine when a solution is ready for validation. Experience or familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and production-ready system design. An entrepreneurial mindset, with a genuine desire to build a company, take ownership of technical decisions, and participate in the potential upside of a venture. Ability to work independently, make decisions under uncertainty, and move quickly from problem discovery to product execution. Willingness to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week for 12 weeks. Interest in collaborating with co-founders, engaging with mentors, and developing an investor-ready vision for an AI-powered B2B business. Benefits A structured, 12-week startup sprint to progress from problem discovery to MVP development, validation, and iteration. Fully remote participation with an international community of founders and technology professionals. Weekly accountability sessions and a consistent execution cadence to maintain momentum and focus. Access to a network of more than 500 mentors specializing in B2B businesses, product development, go-to-market strategy, and fundraising. Connections to a global alumni network of more than 440 startups across over 40 countries, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and introductions. A practical CTO toolkit for AI ventures, covering product scoping, model evaluation, deployment, and the development of a defensible competitive advantage. The opportunity to become a co-founder or join a founding team and build an AI-powered business with long-term growth potential. items.desc: Manufacturing Vision Engineer ITM Power Location: Sheffield Direct Applications Only - No Agency Applicants at this time About ITM Power ITM is at the forefront of the green hydrogen industry, designing and manufacturing cutting-edge PEM electrolysers that are instrumental in global decarbonisation efforts. With over two decades of scientific expertise, we’ve established ourselves as industry leaders in clean energy technology. Our Journey and Growth As pioneers in green hydrogen technology, ITM is offering the most advanced PEM electrolyser technology in the world. Founded in 2000, ITM Power PLC was one of the first companies of its kind to be listed on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange. Headquartered in the UK, our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is the world’s first largest PEM Gigafactory in commercial operation, and home to our R&D and manufacturing. ITM Power Germany is our hub in the heart of the EU. This facility not only houses regional functions including business development and engineering, but also our Aftersales services with the ability to quickly deploy stacks. Innovation and Impact Our PEM electrolysers are deployed in some of the world's largest green hydrogen projects. We continue to push the boundaries of technology, enhancing cost-effectiveness and sustainability. Join Our Mission ITM is in the midst of a transformative phase, focusing on streamlined delivery and operational excellence. We're seeking talented individuals who share our passion for clean energy and our drive to make a tangible impact on the world's transition to net-zero. You will be working with an inspiring bunch of people, encouraging each other to be the best we can. We’ve come a long way, join us in the next step of our incredible journey! What are we looking for The Manufacturing Vision Engineer is a key member of the Manufacturing Automation team responsible for the design, integration, commissioning, and optimisation of machine vision and automated inspection systems across production equipment. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable vision-based inspection solutions, including Automated Optical Inspection (AOI), camera systems, and DMC-based identification, ensuring consistent quality control and traceability across manufacturing processes. Working closely with Automation Engineers, Process Engineers, Quality Engineering, and equipment suppliers, the role ensures that vision systems are correctly integrated into manufacturing equipment and production lines. This includes defining inspection requirements, supporting system integration, and ensuring stable operation during commissioning and ramp-up phases. A key aspect of the role is supporting the introduction of new manufacturing equipment and ensuring that all vision and inspection systems are fully integrated into production processes. The role also contributes to the standardisation of vision inspection approaches across multiple machines and production areas to ensure consistency, scalability, and reliability. The Manufacturing Vision Engineer plays an important role in ensuring that inspection systems are stable, correctly configured, and capable of supporting production quality and traceability requirements in a high-volume manufacturing environment. Responsibilities Lead the integration and commissioning of machine vision systems, including AOI cameras and DMC-based identification systems, into manufacturing equipment and production lines. Define and support implementation of vision inspection requirements in collaboration with Process Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Automation teams. Work closely with Automation Engineers to ensure correct integration of vision systems into PLC-controlled equipment and production machines. Support installation, configuration, and commissioning of vision systems during equipment introduction and ramp-up phases. Develop and optimise inspection parameters to ensure stable, reliable, and repeatable defect detection performance. Ensure consistent implementation of vision inspection and DMC standards across multiple machines and production areas. Support troubleshooting and resolution of vision system issues, including cameras, lighting, image processing, and system communication. Collaborate with equipment suppliers and machine builders to define, validate, and improve vision system performance. Support industrialisation activities by ensuring vision systems are correctly integrated into new manufacturing processes and equipment. Contribute to continuous improvement of inspection systems to improve quality detection capability, reliability, and production robustness. Ensure vision system data is correctly captured and available for downstream systems such as MES and traceability platforms. About You Knowledge and Experience Degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline …

Strong Python and SQL skills. Hands-on experience with AI, LLMs and automation. An entrepreneurial mindset, intellectual curiosity and a passion for building solutions. Investment management experience is NOT essential. We are looking for technical ability, creativity and ambition. If you're working in a technology business, startup or data-focused role and want greater ownership, variety and exposure to the investment world, this could be an exceptional career move.

This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations and developing plans that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises. What you’ll do As an Enterprise Services Manager, you will sell
items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 Stripe’s Professional Services team works with our most strategic users. You will work on the highest visibility projects to provide technical expertise to our customers to help accelerate their knowledge, solution design and integrations with Stripe. This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations and developing plans that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises.
 What you’ll do 
 As an Enterprise Services Manager, you will sell Professional Services engagements to strategic clients and drive Stripe’s future growth engine by building relationships with prospective users and turning them into happy Stripe users.
 Responsibilities 
 Plan and execute integration engineering end-to-end, from high-level architecture down to code implementation. This includes conducting discovery sessions with users to understand their goals, parsing out specific use cases, and guiding users to implement high complexity integrations. 
 Think on your feet and communicate technical concepts, explaining how Stripe works from both a product feature and API architecture perspective. Manage user expectations on timelines and product changes.
 Be the primary, ongoing technical point of contact for our largest users' and partners' technical teams. You will be responsible for resolving user integration issues and owning escalations for operational issues and priority requests.
 Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture and Implementation teams to drive client engagement, customer wins, and revenue on behalf of the Professional Services team
 Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to proactively identify potential enhancements and new features based on feedback you’ll gather from the field.
 Provide deep technical support and debugging, inspecting and understanding the Stripe codebase and thoroughly testing functionality to best advise users, while also building and demonstrating proof-of-concept integrations, creating user-specific test plans, and answering ad-hoc technical questions.
 In some cases, lead "Hands On Keyboard" implementations for user engagements, providing material feedback on coding practices, CI/CD, and software architecture.
 Review and optimize existing user integrations and provide recommendations to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency.
 Build tools and analytics; create dashboards, run queries, and generate custom data reports to support user business reviews and operational needs.
 Develop and share knowledge, building reusable processes to enable the larger Professional Services team.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 4 years + experience in a Software Engineering / Integration Engineering role.
 Ability to write code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.) and quickly debug user code snippets.
 Comfortable with various code-level debugging (Stripe code and user code) and using code as a tool for problem-solving.
 Strong generalist technical experience, including proficiency in SQL and an understanding of data structures and algorithms.
 Understanding of the payments domain and API security topics.
 Be comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
 A user first approach & empathy with our users, capable of mapping business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
 Confident and comfortable with customers, with the ability to lead strategic technical conversations.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Enjoy the puzzle of solving open-ended problems, both individually and as a member of our team.
Willingness to learn and teach others, including mentoring newer team members.
 Collaborative, communicative, consultative; able to apply specific methodologies to ensure repeatability of engagements.
 Intellectually curious, with great problem solving skills.
 Technical writing skills to document complex integration guidance and processes.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring.  The Position
 Field Service Engineer – Somerset Area 
 The Opportunity 
 Are you ready to take on a role where the work you do truly makes a difference to patients’ lives? As a Field Service Engineer with Roche Diagnostics, you’ll be at the forefront of maintaining and supporting our world-class medical equipment across the South region of the UK.
 You’ll play a vital role in ensuring healthcare providers can deliver the best care possible by keeping our diagnostic systems running smoothly. From installations and preventative maintenance to troubleshooting and customer training, your expertise will help healthcare teams deliver results that patients rely on every day.
 With exciting product launches and ongoing investment in R&D, this is your chance to be part of a progressive, high-tech business that values innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.
 Who You Are 
 You’re an experienced and motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working hands-on with high-value capital equipment. You thrive on building strong customer relationships and take pride in representing a trusted global brand in the field.
 What You’ll Do 
 Diagnose, repair, and maintain electro-mechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems across the South and South West England region.
 Carry out preventative, corrective, modification, installation for a range of Roche products.
 Deliver both on-site and office-based customer training to ensure effective equipment use.
 Support new product launches and help grow key business accounts across your territory.
 Collaborate with the Regional Technical Manager and wider Technical Services team to deliver exceptional service.
 Represent Roche with professionalism and integrity at customer sites across the region (with occasional UK travel).
 What You Bring 
 An engineering or electrical qualification, ideally with experience in biomedical, industrial, automation, aerospace or related fields.
 Previous field service experience with high-value capital equipment.
 Strong diagnostic skills — from component-level troubleshooting through to system-level expertise.
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted, long-term customer relationships.
 Flexibility and willingness to travel within the South and South West England region (and occasionally across the UK).
 Join us and be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your expertise helps healthcare professionals do now what patients need next.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Software Specialist – Methods and Tools to join our "Avionics Software" department based in Toulouse, France. 
 This department is an internal supplier of avionics equipment and simulators. Engineers in this field are responsible for the design, development, production, and support of critical embedded products (e.g., flight controls, flight warning, communication, maintenance equipment) for all Airbus aircraft. 
 This department is also a center of excellence in software and electronics, thanks to accomplished and experienced teams. The scope of activities also extends to other Airbus divisions and partners in certain cases. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 You will be in charge of the development and maintenance of the avionics software production system for airborne and ground avionics products and components, in an environment with industrial and certification constraints (DO178, DAL A to D software, DO330). 
 This production environment consists of development processes based on a set of qualified common methods and tools used to specify, architect, design, code, unit test, integrate, and verify our software. 
 In this context, your main responsibilities will be: 
 Study, develop, qualify, deploy, and maintain the tools and associated methodology for the software factory. 
 Provide the associated support activities, including user training. 
 Value customer requirements and challenge them to offer common, reusable solutions. 
 Automate and optimize certain software development phases. 
 Manage subcontracting activities. 
 You will report to a manager responsible for a portfolio of avionics software products within an agile organization with dynamic role assignments.

Job Description: 
 Et si VOTRE aventure commençait avec NOUS !
 Nous vous proposons de travailler dans une entreprise leader mondial dans son domaine, tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation.
 Un poste d’ingénieur de conception en électronique analogique/puissance spatiale vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Defence & Space à Elancourt. Vous rejoindrez le département spatial.
 Vous participerez à la conception et au développement des nouvelles générations d’équipements électroniques spatiaux avec le support de l’équipe d’électronique de analogique/puissance constituées d’experts et d’ingénieurs expérimentés.
 Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des alimentations à découpage DC/DC, des commandes de moteurs, des fonctions analogiques pour diverses applications : propulsion électrique, digital, RF, …
 Ce poste vous permettra d’approfondir et de développer vos compétences en électronique de puissance et analogique ainsi que vos connaissances du monde spatial avec la prise en compte de ses contraintes spécifiques (radiation, haute fiabilité…).
 En intégrant cette équipe vous évoluerez dans un environnement international et multiculturel.
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 En tant qu’ingénieur de conception en électronique de puissance / électronique analogique, vous serez en charge des activités suivantes :
 Analyse et retranscription de la spécification client.
 Définition de l’architecture d’équipements électroniques spatiaux : choix de la topologie, prise en compte des modes de panne (protection, redondance, reconfiguration).
 Conception détaillée des fonctions électroniques : spécifications de fonctions, sélection et dimensionnement des composants, saisie de schéma, simulation, prise en compte de l’environnement radiatif, rédactions de plans de tests.
 Analyse et justification de la robustesse du design : analyse pire-cas, analyse part stress, analyse des modes de défaillances.
 Prototypage et réalisation de maquette pour les fonctions critiques.
 Réalisation des cartes des équipements de vol : placement, routage.
 Mise au point et caractérisation des cartes et des équipements électroniques.
 Support lors de la phase de qualification et de production des équipements : définition des critères de test, analyse et investigation des anomalies détectées en test.
 Amélioration des méthodes de travail et mise en place d’outils au sein du département d’analogique/puissance.
 Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe projet multi-métiers : électronique numérique, test, mécanique, thermique, radiation, production.
 Vous serez responsable de la maîtrise des coûts et des plannings pour vos activités.
 Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir une à deux fois par an en Europe et, de ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.
 Compétences requises 
 Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
 Vous êtes ingénieur en électronique de puissance ou de formation universitaire dans des disciplines apparentées.
 Vous avez un vif intérêt pour la technique et plus particulièrement l’électronique analogique/puissance
 Vous avez des connaissances en alimentation à découpage, circuit à transistors bipolaires, circuit à amplificateur opérationnel, automatique, magnétisme
 Vous avez des connaissances sur des logiciels de simulation électrique type SPICE (LTspice, Pspice, Simetrix/Simplis) et sur les appareils de mesure en laboratoire tel que les oscilloscopes, analyseur de réseau, analyseur de spectre
 Vous avez des notions de codage : VBA, Python
 Vous êtes doté(e) d’un bon relationnel et aimez travailler en équipe
 Vous avez un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse
 Vous avez le sens des responsabilités, êtes organisé(e), rigoureux et autonome.
 Vous faites preuve d’une bonne capacité d’adaptation
 Vous êtes dynamique, investi(e) et force de proposition
 Vous aimez interagir avec différents domaines de l’ingénierie (électronique numérique, test, mécanique, thermique, radiation, production …).
 Une expérience dans le spatial est un plus mais n’est pas indispensable.

Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters !
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un(e) Ingénieur(e) des Coûts / Cost Engineer (f/h) pour rejoindre le département "Business & Programs" basé à Marignane, France.
 Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement. Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères.
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions : 
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers le développement des offres et des contrats . Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département "Business & Programs" en assurant la compétitivité et la rentabilité de nos activités de contrats à l'heure de vol .
 En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) des Coûts au sein du bureau technique PBH (Part by the Hour), vous serez un acteur clé du processus de gestion des coûts. Vous serez en charge de l'analyse, de la projection et du suivi financier de nos contrats de services.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :
 Réaliser des analyses technico-financières complètes pour les contrats PbH (collecte de données, évaluation de la fiabilité des composants MTBUR/MTBF, analyse des écarts et des inducteurs de coûts techniques).

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Um die Abteilung “Data Center Technologies” zu unterstützen, sucht die Airbus Secure Land Communications GmbH einen
 Solution Architect IT Network / IP Backbone (m/w/d) 
 am Standort Ulm, Berlin oder Sulzbach (Ts.) .
 Die Airbus Secure Land Communications GmbH gehört zur Geschäftseinheit Airbus Public Safety and Security und ist einer der führenden Anbieter einsatzkritischer Kommunikationslösungen für Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben sowie militärische Organisationen. Insbesondere im Bereich missionskritischer Kommunikation – etwa über TETRA-Netze, LTE/5G-Hybridlösungen sowie moderne, verschlüsselte Kommunikationsplattformen – spielen Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit eine zentrale Rolle.
Die Verteidigungsbranche, in der Schutz und Sicherheit eine essenzielle Rolle spielen, befindet sich in einer Phase des technologischen und geopolitischen Wandels: Steigende Anforderungen an Interoperabilität, Cyber-Resilienz, Mobilität und Datenhoheit eröffnen neue Marktchancen, erfordern gleichzeitig ein tiefes Verständnis für sicherheitskritische Rahmenbedingungen und beschaffungsrechtliche Prozesse.
In diesem dynamischen Umfeld bieten wir spannende Karrierechancen in verschiedenen Bereichen. Ob in der Entwicklung, im Projektmanagement, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung –
 Als Solution Architect – IT Network / IP Backbone (m/w/d) haben Sie die Möglichkeit, innovative Lösungen mitzugestalten, die den Anforderungen moderner Streitkräfte und Behörden und Organisationen mit Sicherheitsaufgaben gerecht werden und damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Sicherheit unserer Bürgerinnen und Bürger zu leisten.
 Für diese Stelle ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. muss eine solche von den anerkannten Behörden erteilt werden.
 Standorte: 
 Die Universitätsstadt Ulm ist wunderschön an der Donau zwischen München und Stuttgart gelegen und bietet ein breit gefächertes Freizeit- und Kulturangebot. Hier genießen Sie die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt und werden Teil einer Stadt, die gleichzeitig ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt und die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet.
 Unsere Hauptstadt Berlin gilt als Weltstadt der Politik, Medien und Wissenschaften und bietet daher wunderschöne Sehenswürdigkeiten, eine reiche Kultur, urbanes Flair und kulinarische Genüsse. Neben dem „Big City Life“ kommen auch Naturliebhaber auf ihre Kosten: Berlin besitzt neben ausgedehnten Waldgebieten im Westen und Südosten des Stadtgebietes viele große Parkanlagen.
 Sulzbach (Taunus) liegt etwa eine halbe Autostunde westlich von Frankfurt am Main und ist eine aufstrebende Gemeinde mit einem breiten Freizeit- und Kulturangebot. Hier genießen Sie die Lebensqualität auf dem Land, während die nahe gelegenen Großstädte dennoch in guter Reichweite sind.

 Attraktive Vergütung einschließlich Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und Gewinnbeteiligung
 30 Tage Urlaub, zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
 Mobiles Arbeiten möglich
 Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
 Sonderleistungen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Autoleasing, Zuschuss zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Rabatte bei örtlichen Unternehmen, Kinderbetreuung (über unseren Kooperationspartner)
 Vor-Ort-Leistungen: Vorsorgeuntersuchungen und andere gesundheitsbezogene Leistungen, Kantine oder Essenszuschuss
 Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: 
 Entwicklung, Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von IT Network- und IP-Backbone-Architekturen
 Analyse, Bewertung und Umsetzung technischer Anforderungen in Kundenprojekten
 Übertragung von Architektur- und Designvorgaben in technische Lösungen sowie Validierung von Netzwerkdesigns
 Validierung und Verifizierung implementierter technischer Lösungen hinsichtlich Funktionalität, Qualität und Anforderungen
 Analyse komplexer Netzwerkprobleme sowie eigenständige Untersuchung, Diagnose und nachhaltige Behebung von Störungen (Troubleshooting)

 Eigenverantwortliches Vorantreiben technischer Themen sowie strukturierte Bearbeitung und Lösung anspruchsvoller Fragestellungen
 Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Optimierung bestehender Netzwerkarchitekturen, Lösungen und Prozesse
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams innerhalb eines Agile Release Trains (ART)
 Mitarbeit in agilen Entwicklungsprojekten nach Scrum und SAFe
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen: 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Nachrichtentechnik, Kommunikationstechnik oder eines vergleichbaren technischen Studiengangs
 Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im System Engineering sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich IT Network / IP Backbone
 Umfangreiches und tiefgehendes Fachwissen im Bereich IP-Netzwerke, insbesondere: Netzwerkgrundlagen
 Routing- und Routingprotokolle
 Quality of Service (QoS)

Job Description: 
 En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ? 
 Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage. 
 Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium. 
 Dans le cadre de votre formation BUT Management de la Logistique et des Transports, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire d'une durée de 4 semaines, afin de vous immerger dans un service logistique en Industrie. 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « SNR 2027 - Découverte Logistique Industrielle (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Saint Nazaire . 
 Cette mission débutera le 8 février 2027 pour une durée de 4 semaines. 
 Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo 
 Présentation du site de Saint-Nazaire 
 Afin de postuler à cette offre de stage, merci de joindre à votre candidature votre CV, votre lettre de motivation ainsi que vos trois derniers bulletins scolaires. 
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 5 personnes au sein du département "Logistique Physique" en charge de la gestion des flux physiques du site de Saint Nazaire.
 Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :
 Suivi des flux physiques et d'approvisionnement : Observez et participez aux opérations de réception, d'enregistrement des données dans les outils de gestion (ERP/WMS), de préparation de kits (kitting) et de suivi des manquants pour les lignes d'assemblage.
 Gestion et disponibilité des moyens logistiques : En lien avec l'équipe, contribuez au suivi du parc d'équipements de manutention, à la planification des opérations de maintenance de premier niveau et au maintien des standards 5S de la zone.
 Analyse et support opérationnel : Participez à l'identification des dysfonctionnements simples de flux et contribuez à la mise à jour des indicateurs de suivi du service.
 Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :
 Appréhender la chaîne logistique physique d'un site industriel : Comprendre l'articulation entre réception, stockage, kitting et mise à disposition des pièces sur ligne de production.
 Utiliser les outils de gestion de flux : Découvrir et pratiquer au quotidien l'utilisation d'un ERP/WMS en environnement industriel réel.
 Contribuer à la démarche d'amélioration continue et de sécurité : Appliquer la méthodologie 5S, veiller aux règles HSEQ et participer au suivi de la disponibilité d'un parc de moyens logistiques.
 S'intégrer dans un environnement professionnel : Communiquer efficacement au sein d'une équipe opérationnelle et restituer les informations clés liées aux indicateurs d'activité.
 Parlons de VOUS ! 
 Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau BUT en Management de la Logistique et des Transports.
 Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :
 Connaissances basiques de la logistique : Flux industriels, gestion des stocks, notions de Lean et maîtrise d'Excel.
 Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation, Rigueur.
 Anglais : courant
 Français : négociation
 Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur localement. 
 Parlons de NOUS ! 
 Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est : 
 Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux, 
 Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale, 
 Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain. 
 Notre processus de sélection 
 Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur. 
 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Laboratory Operations Analytical Scientist plays a key role in supporting the Analytical Chemistry department by ensuring efficient and compliant laboratory operations. Working closely with other analytical team members, the role is responsible for the oversight of HPLC-UV/CAD systems and the execution of routine analytical testing across the CMC product pipeline. The position requires a proactive mindset, strong organizational skills, a commitment to quality, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. As the role operates within a hybrid technical/GMP laboratory environment, a flexible, solution-oriented approach combined with an appreciation for structured and routine work is essential. 
 Job Description 
 Essential Responsibilities:
 GxP Instrumentation & Documentation 
 Serve as system owner for analytical HPLC-UV/CAD platforms
 Maintain instrument qualification, lifecycle management, and compliance documentation (URS, IQ/OQ/PQ, MOC, SOPs, logbooks).
 Support deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and instrument-related investigations.
 Coordinate instrument maintenance, calibration, and vendor service activities.
 Support procurement, qualification, and implementation of new analytical instrumentation.
 Routine Analytical Testing & Reporting 
 Perform routine HPLC-UV/CAD analyses using approved analytical methods.
 Prepare samples, standards, reagents, and mobile phases according to approved procedures.
 Review, document, and report analytical results in accordance with GMP/GxP and data integrity requirements.
 Support analytical testing activities across the CMC development portfolio to deliver timely and reliable data.
 Laboratory Operations & Compliance 
 Coordinate housekeeping and cleaning routines across the department
 Coordinate analytical procurement of analytical consumables and lab services such as instrument maintenance. 
 Act as back up to manage general ordering, and disposal of chemicals (waste management)
 Promote compliance with EHS, GMP/GxP, and laboratory best practices.
 Required qualifications: 
 Minimum Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, chemical engineering or a related field.
 Experience in routine HPLC-UV analyses
 Experience working in a GMP/GxP or other regulated laboratory environment.
 Experience maintaining laboratory documentation and records.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
 Fluent in English and Norwegian.
 Desired Characteristics/Skills: 
 Working knowledge of GMP/GxP requirements.
 Experience with laboratory instrumentation, qualification, and lifecycle management.
 Strong organizational and planning skills.
 Ability to coordinate activities across functions.
 Knowledge of LEAN and continuous improvement principles.
 Commitment to quality, compliance, and EHS standards.
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

 About the role 
 We are seeking an experienced Compensation Partner to join our Total Rewards team and lead compensation for our international locations as Anthropic builds out its global presence. This role will support our international org on the strategy, design and execution of Anthropic's compensation programs, adapting a global framework to markets that work differently. It is a great fit for someone who has seen compensation excellence at scale and has operated in rapidly scaling, high-ambiguity environments with evolving scope.
 You'll serve as connective tissue between a fast-moving regional business and a global Total Rewards team. 
 Responsibilities 
 Own compensation for our international locations (such as Germany, France, UK, Ireland, Japan, Australia, India, and beyond as the international team grows), building scalable processes and infrastructure across key markets
 Support Anthropic's overall compensation framework, including salary, variable compensation and equity-based programs, and adapt it for local market practice, legal requirements, and competitive dynamics while keeping a consistent global philosophy
 Operate as a strategic compensation business partner to international leadership, People Partners, and recruiting, building relationships and context to navigate ambiguous problems and recommend solutions tailored to Anthropic's unique needs
 Own comp cycle execution end-to-end for international employees, including local market benchmarking, budget modeling, currency considerations, manager enablement, edge-case resolution, and exec-ready rollups, in partnership with the broader Total Rewards team
 Navigate complex international regulatory environments, ensuring compliance with local pay and employment requirements across markets, including works councils, statutory pay and benefits requirements, pay transparency obligations, and country-specific equity and tax considerations, in close partnership with Legal and Equity
 Build and maintain international benchmarking methodology
 Provide subject matter expertise and counsel to People Partners, managers and leadership on pay decisions, policy and guideline interpretations, and job evaluations across regions
 Create compelling data narratives and presentations for leadership, translating complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations
 Partner cross-functionally to develop scalable processes that enable consistent, high-quality compensation decision-making across the organization
 Develop and deliver enablement on our compensation philosophy and programs across Anthropic for your business stakeholders
 You may be a good fit if you: 
 Have deep expertise in compensation, preferably in a high-growth environment, with direct experience across multiple countries or regions
 Have a strong working knowledge of international compensation practices and the regulatory landscape across key markets, including works councils and pay transparency requirements
 Have experience localizing global compensation programs
 Excel at collaborating across time zones with exceptional cross-cultural communication skills
 Have strong collaboration and program management skills, with a track record of taking on ambiguously-scoped projects and taking ownership to deliver great results
 Thrive in strategic thinking while remaining comfortable with hands-on execution and detailed analysis
 Are an exceptional communicator, particularly in writing
 Are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments

 Speak languages relevant to our international markets (fluency in German, French, Japanese, or other languages is a plus)
 Have supported a US-headquartered company through rapid international expansion

items.desc:
Valeo is a tech global company, designing breakthrough solutions to reinvent the mobility. We are an automotive supplier partner to automakers and new mobility actors worldwide. Our vision? Invent a greener and more secured mobility, thanks to solutions focusing on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. We are leader on our businesses, and recognized as one of the largest global innovative companies. 
 Masz pasję do motoryzacji i chcesz być częścią rewolucji w transporcie? W Valeo kreujemy przyszłość mobilności, a nasze innowacje znajdziesz w co trzecim nowym aucie na świecie. Dołącz do nas i zobacz, jak Twoja praca wpłynie na pojazdy jutra!
 Dołącz do Zespołu, który Elektryzuje Przyszłość!
 Jesteśmy międzynarodowym zespołem technicznym, który wdraża i doskonali procesy produkcyjne dla najnowocześniejszych silników elektrycznych (eMotor) i osi napędowych (eAxle). Szukamy ambitnej osoby na start w branży automotive. To nie jest staż, na którym będziesz parzyć kawę – to realna praca, wpływ i rozwój, w tym szansa na realizację własnego projektu z wykorzystaniem AI.
 Twoja Misja: Innowacje i Realne Projekty 
 Projekt z AI: Weźmiesz udział we wdrożeniu narzędzi sztucznej inteligencji do automatyzacji i optymalizacji pracy nad kluczową dokumentacją techniczną.
 Wsparcie Inżynierów Procesu w tworzeniu dokumentacji procesowo-projektowej.
 Udział w przeglądach projektów i podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
 Pomoc w fazie budowy prototypów i usprawnianiu procesów ich produkcji.
 Współpraca z zespołami R&D, Inżynierii Procesu i Produkcji.
 Zdobywanie wiedzy oraz doświadczenia w ramach standardów i metodologii Valeo przy pracy nad rozwojem produktu/procesu.
 Pomoc we wszystkich innych zadaniach zleconych przez przełożonego.
 Kogo Szukamy? Parę zdań o Tobie. 
 Studenta/ki (III-V rok) kierunków technicznych (np. Budowa Maszyn, Elektrotechnika, Mechatronika, Automatyka i Robotyka), lub absolwent/ka nie dłużej jak rok po absolutorium. 
 Dyspozycyjność min. 4 dni (poniedziałek-piątek)
 Pasja do nowych technologii: Zainteresowanie, a zwłaszcza chęć rozwoju w obszarze AI, będzie Twoim ogromnym atutem!
 Dobra znajomości angielskiego (min. B2).
 Znajomość rysunku technicznego, narzędzia CAD (np. AutoCAD, Inventor, CatiaV5 itp.) oraz środowiska Google Workspace.
 Komunikatywność i umiejętności pracy w zespole.
 Proaktywność, motywacja, zdolność analitycznego myślenia.
 Co Oferujemy? 
 Płatny staż (umowa o pracę ).
 Realne doświadczenie przy kluczowych projektach.
 Elastyczny grafik dopasowany do studiów.
 Wsparcie dedykowanego Mentora.
 Dostęp do nowoczesnych technologii i unikalnego know-how.
 Świetną atmosferę w zgranym zespole.
 Z bardziej tradycyjnych benefitów - prywatna opieka medyczna (Medicover), ubezpieczenie na zdrowie i życie (Uniqa), platforma benefitów Medicover Benefits (w tym karta sportowa), parking wyłącznie dla naszych pracowników, dofinansowana stołówka na terenie zakładu. 
 Brzmi jak plan na start Twojej kariery? Nie czekaj! Aplikuj już dziś i stań się częścią technologicznej przyszłości z Valeo!

Location: Bristol, UK 
 Start date: September 2027
 Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 
 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. 
 The Graduate Programme at Graphcore
 Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.
 What you’ll work on
 Put your technical foundations to work on the cloud platforms that help demanding AI workloads run at scale.
 As a Graduate Cloud Platform Engineer, you’ll help develop, deploy and operate services across Graphcore’s high-performance AI infrastructure. Your work will support the systems used by internal teams and Graphcore cloud customers. We believe technology should expand human potential and make progress more accessible.
 You’ll write automation, investigate issues, analyse logs and metrics, and help validate AI hardware and the infrastructure around it. It’s a chance to see how Linux, networking, storage and cloud services fit together and contribute to the platforms that make large-scale AI possible.
 How you’ll learn and grow
 During the two-year programme, you’ll build practical experience in Linux, cloud technologies, networking, storage, observability, OpenStack , Kubernetes, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and Infrastructure-as-Code.
 Hands-on automation and troubleshooting will help you understand how these systems fit together and develop a methodical approach to investigating issues. You’ll learn to use logs and metrics to test your thinking and explain what you find.
 Working with engineers, researchers and Datacentre Operations will help you understand how platform decisions affect the people using these services and develop your technical judgement and communication skills.
 What we’re looking for
 A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Electronic Engineering or a related subject, completed by summer 2027 or within the two years before the programme starts
 Practical experience using the Linux command line, with scripting or programming skills such as Python or Bash
 Familiarity with Git or another version-control system, with a clear approach to documentation and code review
 A methodical approach to troubleshooting and the ability to communicate your findings and work with others
 You’ll be curious about cloud infrastructure, platform engineering or computer systems, with an interest in areas such as networking, storage, containers or observability.
 You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, open-source work, placements or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned.
 Benefits
 Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
 Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
 Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
 Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
 Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
 Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
 Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
 Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship
 Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities.
 Introduction to Graphcore
 At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together.

 The Graduate Programme at Graphcore
 Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are.
 What you’ll work on 
 Put your understanding of computer architecture to work on the choices that shape Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware. 
 As a Graduate SoC Architecture Engineer, you’ll help specify, model and evaluate complex system-on-chip (SoC) subsystems, with guidance from experienced architects. You’ll explore how product requirements translate into technical options, design trade-offs and validation plans. 
 Your work will likely include some of: taking responsibility for the architecture of a chip subsystem or function, modelling architectural features, assessing third-party intellectual property (IP) and supporting silicon bring-up. Working across design, verification, hardware and software teams, you’ll help gather the performance evidence that supports architecture decisions. 
 Your team and support 
 The Silicon Architecture team sits within the Silicon group. We stand for practical ambition: clear thinking, careful engineering and curiosity that improves real systems. 
 You’ll work with mentors and experienced architects through design reviews, modelling, simulation, documentation and discussions with neighbouring teams. You’ll take ownership of defined tasks that grow in scope as you develop your skills. 
 Simulations, performance data and design constraints help guide our decisions. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when something needs testing, explaining or support. 
 How you’ll learn and grow 
 During the two-year programme, you’ll develop your architecture skills through hands-on architectural design + integration, modelling and evaluation of AI acceleration hardware, supported by mentors. 
 Exploring technical options and running simulations will help you understand how architecture choices affect system behaviour. You’ll learn how to compare trade-offs, document findings and use performance evidence to support a decision. 
 Design reviews and work across engineering teams will help you connect specifications to implementation and validation. Supporting silicon bring-up will give you experience of how architectural ideas are checked on real hardware, while tasks that grow in scope will build your technical judgement and confidence.

 A degree, or expected degree, in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related field 
 An understanding of computer architecture or digital systems, with an interest in SoC design, AI hardware or high-performance computing 
 Programming experience in Python, Rust, C++ or a similar language 
 Analytical problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication, including documenting findings and explaining technical ideas 
 You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, research, or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned.

Founded in 2024 by ETH Zurich researchers, mimic pioneered Video-Action Models for robotics while also developing in-house dexterous hand hardware. Our growing team brings together world-class researchers working across our offices in Zurich and San Francisco. 
 You will play a pivotal role in scaling our business by driving customer acquisition, professionalizing internal processes, and exploring strategic opportunities. You will collaborate directly with the business development lead, product and engineering team in shaping the company’s trajectory from the ground up. 
 Responsibilities 
 Drive customer acquisition: Explore potential markets, industry verticals to identify growth opportunities. Manage inbound and outbound sales channels to generate and convert new business opportunities. 
 Help scaling Business Development: Deploy and improve scalable business development and marketing processes and manage corporate sales efforts 
 Manage customer relationships: Own the customer journey and manage stakeholders on their automation journey. Develop effective outreach and communication strategies to build relationships, strengthen the sales pipeline, and convert prospects into customers. 
 Shape the Product: Gather industry-specific insights and customer feedback, translating operational needs into actionable input for the product and engineering teams to improve product-market fit 
 What you bring 
 Technical background in robotics, mechanical/electrical engineering, computer science or a related field 
 2+ years experience in business development, sales, project management, or strategy, ideally in early-stage startups or similarly fast-paced environments. 
 Proven track record in identifying and engaging with potential customers, particularly in B2B or industrial verticals such as manufacturing and logistics. 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience negotiating contracts and managing stakeholder relationships. 
 A proactive, hands-on approach with a passion for bringing technology to customers processes and growing with an early-stage company. 
 A solid understanding of manufacturing processes and operational challenges, with the ability to translate customer needs into technical solutions, is a strong plus. 
 Comfortable working with CRM tools, financial software, and productivity tools. 
 Fluent in English and German; additional languages are an advantage 
 Willingness to travel to factories and logistics centers internationally 
 Nice to have 
 Experience with the manufacturing, logistic, generative AI, or robotics market. 
 Strong organizational and project management skills. 
 Experience organizing industry events and managing event-related activities. 
 What We Offer 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 We offer a total compensation package including a competitive yearly base salary and a strong stock option package to make you part of our shared success. 
 You will work with the founders from day one, shaping the company and participating in its success from its early stages. 
 Surprise team trips, free gym and sports subscription, joint breakfasts and dinners and other exciting team activities. 
 You will have the opportunity to shape a robotics & AI company from the ground up. In flat hierarchies you will work directly with the founders and some of the best talent in the robotics space. At mimic, you are accepted for who you are. As part of our ongoing journey towards creating a diverse and inclusive environment we encourage everyone to apply and we are looking forward to you bringing along your knowledge, personal experiences, and fresh perspectives.
