items.desc:
Job Description: 
 How this role fits in 
 Luton is the home to around 1,000 people who are involved in the design and development of Leonardo’s Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, which is used to protect airborne platforms from a range of RF-based threats. This includes:
 The protection systems for current and future RAF and Army aircraft, including Typhoon and Apache.
 The technology development platforms being developed by the UK’s Team Tempest to support the development of a new 6th generation aircraft within the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP).
 Concept demonstrators for future Electronic Warfare technologies and systems.
 Air Platform Protection systems for export customer aircraft.
 Technology to draw insights from the vast amounts of data collected by our electronic surveillance systems using artificial intelligence and machine learning.
 Role description 
 As an Industrial Placement Systems Engineer you will work alongside some of the most talented engineers in the UK. You will support the development of world-leading technologies and capabilities across multiple Avionic Systems and Platforms.
 Industrial Placement Systems Engineers have the opportunity to be involved in different phases of the systems engineering lifecycle to create and deliver new and emerging capabilities required by our customers; from understanding the customer’s requirements, developing system architectures and concept designs for the next generation of EW capability, through to integration and testing of equipment and systems. 
 Key Responsibility Areas 
 Working as part of an established systems engineering community and supported by a team of experienced engineers, you will be responsible for:
 Developing practical skills in engineering design and development for complex systems, understanding key processes and technologies.
 Gaining an understanding of the EW domain to support the development of relevant products and technologies.
 Working closely with engineers across multiple disciplines to solve problems.
 Completing tasks to a high standard in accordance with appropriate processes and procedures.
 Developing and applying your academic skills to solve problems, generate ideas and be proactive within the team.
 What we need from you: 
 Qualifications 
 All of our Industrial Placement roles require you to be currently studying for a degree in a relevant discipline.
 For the Industrial Placement Systems Engineer role, the acceptable degrees are: aerospace/aeronautical engineering, computer science/systems, electrical/electronic engineering, general engineering, mathematics, mechanical engineering, physics, and systems engineering.
 You must have an understanding of mathematics to at least A-Level standard, and a basic understanding of electronics.
 You should also ideally have experience of working with engineering development tools (e.g. MATLAB, Simulink, Rhapsody, Cameo, DOORS).

Fixed term

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 What you will focus on 
 As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to be involved in various aspects of designing, developing, and implementing innovative security solutions. Depending on project needs, this could include areas like Zero Trust, AI/ML applications in threat detection and response, Cloud Security, Quantum Cryptography, and building out Security Operations Centers (SOC). You may engage in activities such as threat modeling, conducting security risk analyses, and setting security requirements for complex systems.
 You could also contribute to developing and optimizing SOC processes, and work on operational concepts for security infrastructures. Security analysis, incident management, threat monitoring, and system response might also be part of your journey with us, as well as supporting certification and accreditation processes, or implementing DevSecOps and GitOps frameworks.
 There’s plenty of room for collaboration with system engineers to foster a comprehensive security approach throughout system lifecycles. You might also assist with policy development and implementation, and work alongside interdisciplinary teams to uphold security standards and regulations. This role offers a flexible pathway to engage with a wide array of security-related projects, adapting to where your skills and interests align most.
 Who you are 
 We welcome applicants with experience in any combination of these areas, even if not all skills are covered 
 Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field a focus on cybersecurity is a plus.
 Some experience in security engineering, covering both theoretical and hands-on work
 Practical experience in developing security solutions and architectures, with an emphasis on IT security infrastructures and systems.
 Familiarity with industry-standard security frameworks and regulations (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST).
 Knowledge and experience in Risk Management methodologies and tools.
 Background in designing, implementing, and/or operating Security Operations Centers (SOC), with hands-on experience using SOC tools (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, Asset Management, Ticket Management) and supporting security processes.
 Proficiency in conducting system security analyses and translating security requirements into system designs.
 Team-oriented, responsible, with strong problem-solving skills.
 Capable to perform trade-off analyses of available tools(COTS) to decide fit for the purpose
 Additional Desirable Skills: 
 Understanding of the Space Domain, including applications, protocols, CCSDS standards, and ECSS standards.
 Experience in performing RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety) analysis.
 Programming experience in Python and Java
 Cybersecurity certifications (SSCP, CISSP, etc.) or equivalent training would be a plus
 Seniority: 
Junior 
 Primary Location: 
DE - Darmstadt - Europahaus 
 Contract Type: 
 Hybrid Working: 
Hybrid

 Leonardo Logistics (LLS), con oltre 70 siti, è presente a livello italiano ed europeo. Come parte del Gruppo Leonardo, siamo specializzati in logistica industriale inbound e outbound, progettazione e consulenza, trasporti, spedizioni e operazioni doganali, imballaggi customizzati e conservazione sostitutiva.
 L’obiettivo principale di LLS si concretizza nel supportare Leonardo attraverso la gestione di flussi logistici integrati e di supply chain con criteri di efficienza, innovazione e miglioramento continuo, adottando soluzioni tecnologiche personalizzate attraverso la professionalità del nostro team dedicato di ingegneri, analisti, esperti in tecnologie e project manager, tendendo all’innovazione tecnologica e promuovendo il benessere delle persone, in linea con gli obiettivi comuni di sostenibilità.
 All’interno del nostro Team di Ingegneria stiamo ricercando una risorsa che possa ricoprire il ruolo di Ingegnere logistico per il Plant di Lonate Pozzolo (VA). 
 La risorsa si occuperà delle seguenti attività:
 · Collaborare con il Team di ingegneria centrale e la Governance del Plant per definire e implementare le azioni volte ai miglioramenti dei processi del sito.
 · Analizzare i processi, individuare gli sprechi, avviare azioni di miglioramento ed eseguirne il follow up.
 · Implementare metodologie di WCM, nei pillar Safety, Logistics e di Cost deployment, nelle attività del Plant.
 · Supportare la governance del Plant per l’analisi e la definizione dei dimensionamenti in ottica di risorse e spazi.
 · Rivedere i lay-out e applicare gli standard di ergonomia e sicurezza definiti centralmente.
 · Lavorare all’ottimizzazione degli spazi, delle logiche di immagazzinamento e delle specifiche di imballaggio e conservazione in linea con le specifiche aereonautiche.
 · Condividere con il/la Responsabile dell’Area di Business la situazione del Sito riportandone fabbisogni, risultati e criticità, collaborando nella stesura del capitolato tecnico e lavorando sul miglioramento continuo.
 Titolo di studio: 
 Laurea in ingegneria gestionale e/o logistica.
 Seniority: 
 Junior 1-3 anni di esperienza maturata in ambito produzione e/o logistica.
 Conoscenze e competenze tecniche: 
 · Competenze di analisi e controllo (valutazione del beneficio rispetto ai costi dei progetti).
 · Monitoraggio degli stati di avanzamento delle attività.
 · Capacità di gestione delle informazioni (produzione di report; raccolta dati, elaborazione presentazioni e rappresentazioni formative).
 · Conoscenza metodologie di analisi rilevamento tempi attività.
 · Conoscenza dei principi Lean (WCM – sistemi KANBAN…).
 Competenze comportamentali: 
 · Ottime capacità relazionali.
 · Cooperazione, collaborazione e lavoro in team.
 · Orientamento al cliente.
 Competenze linguistiche: 
 · Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata.

 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Aerospazio, Difesa & Sicurezza. Innovazione, ricerca continua, digitalizzazione e sostenibilità sono i pilastri del suo business nel mondo.
 Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme), insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
 Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
 Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.
 Nell’ambito dell’unità organizzativa di ingegneria ed in particolare nella disciplina Electromagnetic Environmental Effects , per la nostra sede di Torino stiamo ricercando un/una E3 Computational Electromagnetics Engineer.
 La missione è quella di gestire e implementare le attività di sviluppo e certificazione per gli aspetti di compatibilità elettromagnetica dei velivoli. L’attività da svolgere è nell’ambito del programma GCAP e altre collaborazioni internazionali o programmi proprietari con mansioni prevalentemente di simulazione elettromagnetica per il progetto, l’installazione e la verifica dei sistemi di bordo per quanto riguarda gli aspetti di compatibilità elettromagnetica sia con l’ambiente esterno che fra i sistemi imbarcati, in particolare quelli ricetrasmittenti, dando supporto al posizionamento, all’installazione e alla protezione della piattaforma.
 La risorsa si occuperà principalmente di:
 Modellizzazione elettromagnetica delle antenne e dei sistemi ricetrasmittenti in base alle caratteristiche tecniche, diagrammi di radiazione e geometrie
 Realizzazione dei modelli elettromagnetici dei velivoli partendo dai modelli CAD delle superfici e dei cablaggi del velivolo e dai materiali
 Calcolo del diagramma di irradiazione delle antenne installate sul velivolo, del fattore di accoppiamento e del margine di interferenza fra trasmettitori e ricevitori
 Calcolo delle funzioni di trasferimento campo esterno campo radiato dai trasmettitori del velivolo verso campo interno nelle zone di installazione degli apparati elettronici o del personale e di quella campo-corrente ai cablaggi degli stessi apparati per gli aspetti di: compatibilità elettromagnetica - ElectroMagnetic Compatibility EMC; protezione dai campi elettromagnetici radiati - High Intensity Radiated Fields HIRF; protezione del personale dalle radiazioni elettromagnetiche - Radiation Hazards;
 Calcolo delle funzioni di trasferimento corrente incidente sul velivolo verso corrente ai cablaggi degli apparati elettronici per gli aspetti di: protezione dal fulmine - Lightning; protezione dall'impulso elettromagnetico nucleare - Electromagnetic Pulse (N-EMP); Scarica Elettrostatica (ESD)
 Identificazione di raccomandazioni per la mitigazione delle problematiche riscontrate

 Dottorato in Ingegneria Elettronica (campi elettromagnetici, compatibilità elettromagnetica) costituisce un plus per la selezione del candidato.
 Livello di esperienza richiesto (junior, expert, senior, master)
 Expert

 Conoscenza approfondita della teoria dei campi elettromagnetici, antenne e propagazione e delle linee di trasmissione
 Familiarità con i metodi di calcolo applicati alla computazione elettromagnetica, quali il metodo dei momenti, metodo degli elementi finiti, delle differenze finite, tecniche asintotiche, ecc.

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nell’Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Elicotteri, Velivoli, Aerostrutture, Elettronica, Cyber Security e Spazio. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una solida presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici a livello globale, è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese.
 Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme) , insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
 Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
 Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.
 All'interno dell'Area Engineering Transformation CE siamo alla ricerca di un/una LO RCS Engineer per il nostro sito di Torino.
 ​Attività Principali: 
 La risorsa dovrà essere in grado di svolgere attività di competenza dell’Unità Operativa “Special Projects & Virtual Engineering” per la disciplina Low Observability (RCS) in ambito di Programma GCAP e PN6G, in particolare dovrà:
 Effettuare analisi simulative CEM di piattaforme velivolo e di sue parti/componenti di dettaglio a partire da modelli CAD-3D;
 Effettuare semplificazioni e ottimizzazioni di CAD ai fini di generare griglie (mesh) di calcolo appropriate alle analisi CEM, operando direttamente sui modelli CAD prodotti da altre discipline;
 Supportare la definizione ed il mantenimento del budget RCS da allocare ai sistemi/sotto-sistemi e parti del velivolo;
 Supportare, interfacciandosi con gli altri enti di Ingegneria, la definizione dei requisiti per i trattamenti superficiali/materiali RAM/RAS per garantire il raggiungimento dei requisiti RCS a livello piattaforma.
 Titolo di studio:
 Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Elettronica o Aeronautica o Aerospaziale o Elettronica o affini.
 Livello di esperienza richiesto (junior, expert, senior, master):
 Expert
 Competenze tecniche:
 Forte esperienza nella generazione di griglie (mesh) di calcolo per solutori CEM,
 Conoscenza approfondita dei software di calcolo elettromagnetico,
 Gradita esperienza nell’utilizzo di solutori CEM come HFSS e CST,
 Conoscenza approfondita di campi elettromagnetici, compatibilità elettromagnetica e propagazione di onde elettromagnetiche.
 Conoscenza aeronautica di base (principi di sistemi di bordo e aerodinamica del velivolo),
 Gradita esperienza di modellazione CAD,
 Competenze comportamentali:
 Capacità di problem solving 
 Buone capacità comunicative e di interfaccia con diversi stakeholder 
 Attitudine al lavoro di squadra 
 Capacità di lavorare in contesti dinamici 
 Flessibilità e capacità di adattamento 
 Proattività 
 Conoscenze linguistiche:
 Ottima conoscenza dell’inglese
 Conoscenze Informatiche:
 Gradita esperienza con software di modellazione CAD (esempio Catia V5, NX)
 Esperienza con software di generazione mesh (esempio ANSA, Apex, Power Delta)
 Conoscenza dei software di calcolo elettromagnetico (esempio CST, Feko, HFSS)
 Gradita conoscenza dei linguaggi di programmazione C/C++ e Python
 Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto MS Office
 Altro ( es. Disponibilità a trasferte/Certificazioni specifiche richieste….): 
 Disponibilità a trasferte sia brevi che di media durata sia su territorio nazionale che all’estero
 Abilitazione di sicurezza (NOS) già in essere (preferibilmente)

Junior

items.desc:

 Job Area:

 General Summary: 
 About the role 
 Qualcomm’s SerDes PHY team is seeking Analog / Mixed-Signal design engineers to join our growing team in Cork, Ireland. The successful candidate will work on analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for high speed PHY receivers and drivers, VCOs, PLLs, and a range of other custom IP for Qualcomm Mobile, Auto, IoT & Compute SoC products. The primary focus of the work is on low-power and low-voltage mixed-signal design with emphasis on advanced nanometer FinFET and GAA technology nodes.
 The successful candidate will both design key circuit blocks and work closely with layout engineers to ensure the layout is fully optimized and complies with best analog layout practices. You will be directly involved in delivering next-generation SerDes and PLL designs for Qualcomm SoCs and will be part of a large analog mixed-signal design team involved in architecture analysis and IP delivery in leading-edge FinFET and GAA process technology nodes at 3nm and below.
 The role requires industry experience in transistor-level circuit implementations or highly relevant academic experience in a Masters’ or PhD program focused on full custom analog circuit design using nanometer CMOS technologies. In addition to Analog and Mixed-Signal circuit design expertise, good understanding of device physics, analog circuit custom layout, power distribution networks (PDN), mixed-signal design flow, SoC top-level integration and IC Design Tools are desired.

 Architecture, design, and development of analog / mixed signal hard macros for the SerDes IP Design team

 Set-up, run and analyse circuit simulations.
 Perform quality assurance procedures on developed hard macros.

 Perform silicon characterization analysis and prepare silicon verification reports.

 Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Science, Engineering, or related field.
 A minimum of 3-years of transistor level analog mixed-signal design experience, preferably in high-speed wireline SerDes, PLL, DDR or other high speed applications
 Experience in SPICE simulators and schematic capture tools
 Experience in designing op-amps, bandgaps, differential amplifiers, VCO, PLL, DLL
 Experience in high-speed SerDes block level designs such as transmitters, receivers, high speed VGA, CTLE, CDR, etc.
 Understanding of signal integrity in high-speed wireline design is preferred
 Scripting to automate circuit design and verification work
 Full-custom analog layout techniques and the ability to take a design and do all the layout extract verification and sign-off

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
At GE Aerospace we believe that the world works better when it's moving. Together we are creating a future of aviation where human safety is of the greatest importance. 
In our company we have been offering a flexible working model for many years now as to give our employees the possibility to adjust working hours to suit their individual needs. Our employees easily combine their professional and private responsibilities and have time to pursue their passions. No matter what stage of your career you are at, you can count on the support and mentorship of the best experts in the industry. 
On GE Aerospace Warsaw campus, we design aircraft engines and develop advanced technologies such as cooling methods for engine components as well as create statistical models and software applications for aviation. We develop all solutions in diverse teams, in which the best experts eagerly share their knowledge. At GE Aerospace we work together to achieve success. What is more, a career at GE Aerospace is not only an opportunity to work in an international environment, but also a chance to gain experience while visiting laboratories, factories and repair shops around the world. 
At GE Aerospace we give our employees space for comprehensive development by supporting a variety of employee initiatives and interest groups, including GE Women's Network, PRIDE Alliance, HealthAhead, Early Careers Network, Disability Advocacy Network, Neurodiverse and GE Aerospace Volunteers. Our flexible working model is based on the concept of work-life balance, because at GE Aerospace we believe that people come first in our organization. 
As a Thermal Design Engineer specializing in Component Cooling at GE Aerospace, you will support the thermal design and analysis of high-pressure turbine components for jet engines in service around the world. This position offers the opportunity to apply advanced thermal analysis to engines that power a global fleet, with a direct impact on their durability, reliability and safety. In this role, you will build deep technical expertise by identifying problems and developing solutions, strengthen your analytical skills and grow toward thermal design responsibilities. 
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 Perform thermal analysis and evaluation of high pressure turbine components, applying sound engineering principles and following business standards and product/program requirements
 Support the design team with thermal results and recommendations that inform component cooling design decisions
 Collaborate with design engineers and technical experts, share information openly and ask questions to solve problems and meet project goals
 Prepare and present technical results at internal and external reviews
 Document analyses and technical data in line with engineering policies and procedures
 Required Qualifications: 
 BSc/MSc in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
 Solid understanding of heat transfer and fluid mechanics
 Analytical mindset and attention to detail
 Effective communication and teamwork skills
 Good command of written and spoken English
 Benefits : 
 Join us to see your career take flight today. 
 We offer: 
 Flexible work schedule and hybrid work model adjusted to your needs 
 Fascinating job in dynamically growing aerospace industry 
 Competitive salary, annual bonus, copyright costs tax reduction 
 Diverse career opportunities globally 
 Environment of continuous learning and improvement 
 Onboarding support to make your start easier, mentoring support through your career 
 Benefits fit to all lifestyles 
 Wide variety of employee initiatives 
 #LI-Hybrid

Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Ericsson On-Demand: Shaping the next telecommunications paradigm 
 We are transforming the telecommunications industry by delivering cloud-native Core Network services through innovative as-a-Service business models built on public cloud platforms. Through our strategic partnership with Google Cloud, we are breaking new ground—enabling Ericsson Core Network Services, starting with 5G DMC, to be deployed at hyperscaler scale. 
 Launched earlier in 2025, Ericsson On-Demand is rapidly evolving from incubation to commercial readiness and is now preparing for trials to meet growing market demand. 
 As part of this journey, we are evolving Ericsson Signaling Controller, including DEA (Diameter Edge Agent) and SEPP (Security Edge Protection Proxy) capabilities, into cloud-native SaaS offerings running on Google Cloud. Ericsson Signaling Controller plays a critical role in enabling secure roaming, signaling control, and interconnectivity across 4G and 5G networks, supporting communication between operators worldwide. 
 You will have the opportunity to shape how signaling services are designed, developed, and operated in a public cloud environment. By combining telecom expertise with cloud-native technologies, automation, and DevSecOps practices, you will help build the next generation of scalable, resilient, and secure signaling solutions for Ericsson customers. 
 We are looking for multiple individuals who are passionate about software engineering, cloud technologies, and telecommunications, and who want to drive the industry's transition towards SaaS-based network services. 
 Come and join us and lead the industry change!
 What you will do: 
 Drive the end-to-end development lifecycle of Ericsson Signaling Controller services, including DEA and SEPP
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate cloud-native applications running on Google Cloud
 Contribute to the evolution of secure signaling and roaming solutions for 4G and 5G networks
 Develop and enhance automation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment frameworks to support SaaS operations
 Implement monitoring, observability, and reliability capabilities to ensure high service availability and performance
 Collaborate with architects, product teams, and operations teams in a Lean, Agile, and DevSecOps environment
 Continuously improve scalability, security, operational efficiency, and customer experience
 Explore and apply new technologies and cloud-native best practices to accelerate innovation

 Strong understanding of 4G and 5G Core Network architecture, signaling, and roaming concepts
 Experience with signaling products or technologies such as Signaling Controller, DEA, DRA, SEPP, SCP, or Diameter routing
 Solid programming skills in Go and/or C/C++
 Experience with cloud-native development using Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architectures
 Experience working with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
 Knowledge of CI/CD practices, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure automation
 Understanding of network security concepts and secure inter-operator communications
 Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for continuous learning
 Ability to work effectively in collaborative, cross-functional, and global teams

items.desc:
Overview 
 GitHub is looking for a Software Engineer II (L62) to join the Copilot API Platform Frameworks team. This role focuses on building and maintaining backend services and APIs that power GitHub Copilot and its integrations, with an emphasis on sound technical design, service performance, reliability at scale, and intelligent LLM request routing. 
 The ideal candidate has experience building and operating distributed systems in production and enjoys working close to the details of system behaviour, latency, and failure modes. You will contribute to technical designs for the features you own, clarifying requirements, proposing approaches, and making pragmatic trade-offs, while partnering with senior engineers to align with broader platform architecture. You care about building services that are observable, efficient, and resilient, and about designing routing and orchestration layers that optimise quality, speed, and cost. 
 As a Software Engineer III on the Copilot API team, you will collaborate with a distributed, diverse group of engineers, product managers, and AI-focused partners across GitHub to deliver improvements that other engineers can depend on. You will help design, implement, and iterate on APIs and service components that underpin Copilot’s scalability, reliability, and intelligence, taking responsibility for a defined area while coordinating dependencies and rollout plans with your team. 
 You will contribute through hands-on implementation, clear design communication, and strong collaboration. You’ll write and review design docs for your work, define success metrics (e.g., latency, error rate, throughput, routing quality, and cost efficiency), and improve performance and reliability through testing, safe deployments, and monitoring. You will participate in on-call and first responder rotations, resolving issues within SLOs and escalating when needed, and help continuously improve the resilience and maintainability of the services you touch. At GitHub, we value developer empathy, transparency, and inclusive collaboration, and we work iteratively with a bias toward action and impact. 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and ship high-quality technical solutions that scale across multiple GitHub services. 
 Build and evolve LLM routing/orchestration capabilities (e.g., model/endpoint selection, fallback, retries, guardrails, and request shaping) to optimise user experience, quality, latency, and cost. 
 Design and implement APIs and service components that support Copilot integrations and intelligent inference pathways. 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and applied AI partners to define and deliver innovative solutions. 
 Own and advocate for system health and quality, including participation in on-call and first responder rotations. 
 Write architecture briefs and proposals, run experiments/prototypes, and use production signals to drive iterative improvements. 
 Define and track success metrics, including platform reliability metrics (SLOs) and routing effectiveness metrics. 
 Use CI/CD and safe deployment practices to deliver changes confidently and quickly. 
 Mentor peers through technical leadership, pairing, and thoughtful code/design reviews. 
 Become intimately familiar with the systems you build and take pride in writing maintainable code. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Degree in Computer Science or related technical field, OR equivalent experience.
 Demonstrated technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python OR equivalent experience.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in one or more scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python, or a similar language).
 Experience using general purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Ruby, or a similar language). 
 Experience with cloud environments and/or Cloud Native Compute Foundation (CNCF) concepts.

items.desc:
Számunkra globális innováció. Számodra személyes fejlődés. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen SAP kulcsfelhasználó munkatársa, felelős vagy az SAP S/4 kiterjesztett raktármenedzsment (SAP S/4 EWM) rendszer folyamat- és informatikai környezetének tervezéséért és fejlesztésért, beleértve a koncepcióalkotást, integrációt és bevezetést, valamint a globális logisztikai és termelési rendszer folyamatainak és rendszereinek fejlesztését szolgáló innovációkat.
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen területén elhelyezkedő Kommunikációs Központban, korszerű, digitalizált, „open office” jellegű munkakörnyezetben fogsz dolgozni a többi irodai munkavállalóval és közvetlen csapattársaiddal együtt. A Kommunikációs Központ teakonyhákkal, kávézókkal, ergonomikus munkaállomásokkal felszerelt modern iroda, ahol egy vállalati étkezde is helyet kap.
 Csapat – egy több mint 10 fős, motivált és tapasztalt kollégákból álló csapat tagjaként egy korszerű, agilis, többfunkciós csapatban fogsz dolgozni, az agilis módszertan alkalmazásával.
 Főbb fókuszok – csapatoddal együtt részt veszel a rendszer bevezetési és tesztelési feladataiban egyaránt és hatékony megoldásokat kínálsz az üzleti folyamatok mély ismeretében.
 Reprezentáció – képviseled, meghatározod és felelősséget vállalsz az üzleti követelményekért.
 Priorizálás - gondoskodsz a feladatok elvégzéséhez és az üzleti célok eléréséhez szükséges erőforrásokról, és azok biztosítását legfőbb prioritásként kezeled
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – rendelkezel informatikai, közgazdasági vagy egyéb kapcsolódó területen szerezett diplomával.
 Munkatapasztalat – rendelkezel legalább 3 év tapasztalattal SAP S/4 EWM területen és 1 év operatív logisztikában szerzett tapasztalattal is.
 Munkarend – a munkavégzés a szokásos irodai munkarendben, on-site történik, távmunkára a közvetlen vezetővel történő egyeztetés alapján van lehetőség.
 Munkamódszer – Célorientáltság, strukturált munkamódszer jellemez.
 Nyelvtudás - üzleti szintű angol és magyar nyelvtudásod van; német nyelvtudás előnyt jelent.
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok.
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással.
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés.
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban.
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást.
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás.
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.
 Munkavállalói autóbérlési program 
 Tudj meg többet juttatásainkról ezen a linken : https://www.bmwgroup.jobs/hu/hu/about-us/our-benefits.html

 Teljes munkaidős, határozatlan idejű foglalkoztatás.
 Kérünk, hogy pályázatod angol nyelven nyújtsd be. További kérdés esetén keresd toborzó partnerünket a +36 52 333 603 telefonszámon hétköznap 8:00 és 16:30 között.
 A BMW Group Gyár Debrecennél nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk az egyenlő bánásmódra és az esélyegyenlőségre. Toborzási és kiválasztási döntéseink a jelentkezők személyiségén, tapasztalatán és képességein alapulnak.

¡Te estamos buscando! Nuestra apuesta es por el talento joven y por eso, queremos que formes parte de Talentum: un programa de impulso al talento joven de Telefónica que ofrece oportunidades a través de su extensa oferta de becas, formación y ret os en equipo. 
 Descripción del área : 
 El área de Riesgos y Seguros del Grupo Telefónica es la unidad responsable de la financiación de riesgos asegurables del Grupo y del apoyo a las Operadoras en la comercialización de productos de seguro para sus clientes y empleados. El área gestiona una compañía de seguros No Vida (TELEFONICA SEGUROS), una cautiva de reaseguro (NOVA CASIOPEA RE) y un Grupo Corredurías (TELEFONICA CORREDURIA DE SEGUROS), a través de las cuales implementa su estrategia y política.
 Misión : 
 Proyecto formativo basado en los conocimientos adquiridos durante el grado/máster y su aplicación práctica en el Departamento de Inversiones del Área de Seguros. Desarrollar habilidades en la gestión de una cartera de inversiones, valoración y control de los activos. Fomentar la generación de ideas y la visión de la persona candidata, así como la comunicación con el resto de departamentos de la compañía y las relaciones con proveedores y otras entidades financieras.
 ¿Como sera tu dia a dia? 
 Participar en el cálculo del VaR y, en general, en la gestión del riesgo de las inversiones.
 Ayudar en el control y organización de la documentación soporte de las operaciones.
 Participar en el análisis de las operaciones realizadas y comprobación de los datos financieros.
 Dar apoyo en el control de cumplimiento de las políticas internas de la compañía.
 Colaborar en el análisis y valoración de nuevas inversiones.
 Participar en la elaboración de reportes internos de seguimiento y estado de las inversiones. 
 Cooperar en las tareas de control general sobre la cartera (periodificaciones, gastos, dividendos...).
 Apoyar en las tareas de reporting mensual y trimestral tanto internas (Telefónica) como externas (reguladores, auditores...).
 Participar en los cierres mensuales.
 ¿Que buscamos en las personas del equipo? 
 Grado en ADE/Ciencias Economicas o Actuariales y Financieras o similar.
 Capacidad analítica, metodismo y proactividad. 
 Actitud colaborativa para trabajar en equipo.
 Conocimientos financieros, estadísticos y contables.
 Conocimientos de los principales activos financieros (bonos, pagarés, acciones…)
 Idiomas: Inglés: B2, hablado y escrito.
 Si te unes al equipo, te ofrecemos: 
 Jornada de 25 horas semanales.
 Ayuda al estudio.
 Beca con duración minima de 6 meses y máxima de 12 meses.
 Modelo híbrido.
 Trabajar en un equipo dinámico con proyectos retadores. 
 Ubicación de la beca: Madrid
 ¡Y plan formativo durante la beca! 
 En Telefónica tenemos el compromiso de construir un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y sostenible, donde cada persona se sienta valorada, respetada y libre. Nuestra cultura se basa en la igualdad de oportunidaes y en la inclusión porque tenemos la responsabilidad de transformar la sociedad y hacer un mundo mejor.
 Si quieres formar parte de un equipo innovador y contribuir a un futuro mejor, ¡te estamos esperando!

 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de EDR de Telefónica trabajamos en la administración y monitorización de eventos de plataformas EDR. El departamento se desenvuelve en constante mejora de las capacidades de detección y mitigación de los entornos de cliente. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Tu misión será gestionar la plataforma EDR así como las amenazas que en ella se generan.

 Administración de EDR 
 Investigación de alertas 
 Ejecución de pilotos y pruebas de laboratorio. 
 Implementación de la solución siguiendo las mejores prácticas de mercado en cuanto al marco tecnológico en cuestión. 
 Ajuste y optimización del rendimiento de la solución. 
 Coordinación y ejecución de las pruebas de integración y pruebas de rendimiento de la solución. 
 Elaboración de las Peticiones de Cambio con los detalles técnicos para cada servicio involucrado. 
 Ejecución de las tareas técnicas de implantación de todos los componentes de la solución. 
 Coordinación transversal de actividades entre los Servicios Técnicos Especializados. 
 Y PARA ELLO, CREEMOS QUE SERÍA IDEAL QUE CONTARAS CON… 
 Experiencia 
 3 año en administración de entornos EDR 
 Despliegues masivos de plataformas 
 Administración de plataforma del puesto de trabajo (Crowdstrike, Trellix, Symantec, y TrendMicro) 
 Gestión de incidentes de seguridad 
 Análisis de alertas 
 Automatización de procesos

 Grado Universitario / Licenciatura / Ingeniería / Ingeniería Técnica Informática \ Telecomunicaciones o similares.

 Certificaciones sobre seguridad (OSCP, CEH o relacionadas)

 Conocimientos técnicos

 Apasionado/a de la seguridad y la tecnología. 
 Voluntad de hacer siempre lo mejor, crecer y asumir nuevas responsabilidades. 
 Capacidad para aprender y crecer en un entorno en evolución. 
 Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita. 
 Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno que requiere un alto nivel de detalle y confidencialidad. 
 Proactivo/a, automotivado con la capacidad de trabajar de forma independiente y como miembro de un equipo en un entorno desafiante.

items.card: you will help create it. Our teams develop one-of-a-kind experimental facilities and undertake world-leading research programmes designed to answer questions that cannot be resolved through standards, guidance or modelling alone. We generate the evidence that helps clients make decisions with confidence. Our work spans some of the most important challenges facing the energy, industrial and critical infrastructure
items.desc:
What if your next technician role involved doing things that have never been done before? At Spadeadam, you’ll work hands-on with large-scale experimental facilities, tackling some of the biggest safety challenges facing energy and industry. 
 When the consequences are significant and confidence matters, industry often needs evidence. For 50 years, organisations from around the world have come to DNV’s Spadeadam R&D Centre to find those answers.
Spadeadam is one of the world’s leading major hazards R&D facilities. 
 Our engineers, scientists and technical specialists design, build and operate unique experimental facilities that help industry understand some of its most challenging safety and resilience questions. From hydrogen and alternative fuels to high-pressure gas releases, fire and explosion hazards, pipeline safety and critical infrastructure resilience, the work undertaken here helps shape engineering practice, inform major investment decisions and improve safety around the world.
 As our business continues to grow, we are looking for curious Gas or Mechanical Technicians to join our Major Hazards Research and Development team.
 Our Opportunity: 
 This is not a conventional role. Many Technician roles focus on applying existing knowledge. At Spadeadam, you will help create it. Our teams develop one-of-a-kind experimental facilities and undertake world-leading research programmes designed to answer questions that cannot be resolved through standards, guidance or modelling alone. We generate the evidence that helps clients make decisions with confidence.
 Our work spans some of the most important challenges facing the energy, industrial and critical infrastructure sectors. Projects may include hydrogen and alternative fuel safety, high-pressure gas release studies, full-scale fire and explosion research, pipeline safety and integrity, critical infrastructure resilience, hazardous area investigations, battery energy storage systems, industrial process safety and emerging energy technologies. Our expertise is also increasingly applied to energy security, infrastructure protection and defence-related programmes.
 As a Gas Technician you’ll play a key role in the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of essential site infrastructure and be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development and design through to construction, commissioning, testing and operation. One week you may be helping to develop a new hydrogen research facility; the next, you could be designing modifications to a high-pressure gas system, supporting the construction of a large-scale test rig or preparing for a full-scale explosion experiment.
 No two projects are the same, and many involve challenges that have never previously been addressed at full scale.
 What you’ll do: 
 Design and construct large scale experimental test rigs, as well as gas storage and piping systems.
 Designing and implementing gas distribution systems.
 Performing regular maintenance and inspections.
 Ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
 Emergency response planning and procedures.
 Attend safety meetings such as HAZIDs and stay up to date with current test procedures.
 Communicate effectively with technical colleagues 
 Our Technician roles offer an exceptional opportunity to develop rapidly within a highly capable multidisciplinary team. Working alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, you will gain a broad range of practical experience across mechanical and gas assets including pipeline and pressure systems. You will be encouraged to broaden your technical knowledge and build the skills needed to progress your career.
While the work is globally significant, the location offers something increasingly rare. Situated on the Cumbrian side of the border with Northumberland, Spadeadam provides access to some of the most spectacular landscapes in the United Kingdom. The Lake District, Northumberland National Park, Hadrian's Wall and the Solway Coast are all within easy reach.
 Many colleagues choose to live in rural villages, market towns, Carlisle, Newcastle or southern Scotland, combining an exceptional quality of life with technically challenging and rewarding careers.
 As our research, testing and engineering activities are highly practical and collaborative, this role is predominantly site-based at Spadeadam. Whilst occasional flexibility may be possible where project requirements allow, applicants should expect to spend the vast majority of their working time on site and this role is therefore likely to be best suited to someone within reasonable daily commuting distance of the facility.
 Reward and Benefits: 
 We value all our people and the contributions they make to our business, so it’s important that our rewards make us all feel valued here. That’s why we offer a flexible reward and benefits package, allowing you to choose the things that matter most to you, including;

This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Data Engineer 
 At Adyen, we treat data and data artifacts as first-class citizens. They form our backbone and drive the business and product insights we generate. To this end, Adyen is looking for a Data Engineer II to join our team in Amsterdam. This role requires a solid understanding of both the business context and its data needs, with a focus on building high-quality data pipelines on our Big Data Platform. As a Data Engineer at Adyen, you will be instrumental in maintaining our data infrastructure and ensuring smooth data flows across systems.
 What you’ll do 
 Collaborative Solution Development : Engage with a diverse range of stakeholders, including data scientists, analysts, software engineers, product managers, and customers, to understand their requirements and craft effective solutions.
 Quality Pipelines and Architecture : Design, develop, deploy and operate high-quality production ELT pipelines and data architectures. Integrate data from various sources and formats, ensuring compatibility, consistency, and reliability.
 Data Best Practices : Help establish and share best practices in performance, code quality, data validation, data governance, and discoverability in your team and in other teams. Participate in mentoring and knowledge sharing initiatives.
 High Quality Data and Code: Ensure data is accurate, complete, reliable, relevant, and timely. Implement testing, monitoring and validation protocols for your code and data, leveraging tools such as Pytest.
 Performance Optimization : Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in data pipelines and systems. Improve query performance and resource utilization to meet SLAs and performance requirements, using technologies Spark optimizations.
 Who you are 
 Experienced in Big Data: 3+ years of experience working as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
 Data & Engineering practices: You have a solid understanding of both Software and Data Engineering practices.
 Technical Super Star: Proficient in tools and languages such as: Python, PySpark, Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, SQL, Git. 
 Clear Communicator: Able to effectively communicate complex data-related concepts and outcomes to a diverse range of stakeholders. 
 Self-starter: Capable of identifying opportunities, devising solutions, and handling projects independently. 
 Innovator: You have an experimental mindset with a ‘launch fast and iterate’ mentality.
 Data Culture Champion: Skilled in promoting a data-centric culture within technical teams and advocating for setting standards and continuous improvement.
 Data positions at Adyen 
 We know companies handle different definitions for their data-related positions, this is for instance dependent on the size of a company. Since the birth of the Data Solution and the growth of all data streams, we categorized and defined all our positions. Have a look at this blogpost to find out!
 We currently have roles available in the following teams:
 Uplift Protect
 Balance Transactions
 Optimise Interfaces
 Payments Pricing
 Finance & Commercial Analytics 
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 Test Engineer
 Location: Valencia
 Reports to: Laboratory Lead and Test Architect
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Onsite
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 As our Lab Test Engineer, you’ll plan, run, automate and document the lab’s tests across simulation, signal capture, playback and hardware in the loop, so results are repeatable and trusted. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability. We simulate the constellation and its emitters end to end, capture real signals from real hardware, and generate and play back signals through a channel simulator for end-to-end runs and algorithm validation.
 A lab that only its builders can operate becomes shelfware. Specialists will build the simulation, the capture system and the playback chain, and you’ll turn those into tests that run reliably, on schedule, with traceable results. The role covers the full breadth of the lab: setting up hardware, running campaigns, automating procedures, keeping equipment calibrated and inventoried, and producing evidence that engineers and customers can rely on.
 You’ll have an early seat in a new lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Plan and run tests across all three lab missions: end-to-end simulation runs, emitter capture sessions, playback and channel simulator campaigns, flatsat and receiver tests, and algorithm validation.
 Write procedures and automate them: turn manual setups into scripted, repeatable test sequences, and add them to regression so each software or firmware build is checked.
 Set up and maintain the lab: instruments, SDRs, cabling, fixtures, the screened enclosure and emitter bays, network and compute. Track calibration, configuration and inventory so every result records what produced it.
 Manage test data: keep recordings, run outputs and metadata organised, searchable and backed up, with the provenance to reproduce a result.
 Analyse and report: compare results to expectations and to previous runs, flag regressions and anomalies, write concise test reports, and log issues with the evidence needed to fix them.
 Support campaigns in the field and in the air, customer and partner demonstrations, and the reproduction of on-orbit anomalies on the ground.
 Run the lab safely: RF safety, ESD, equipment handling, access control and the handling rules for controlled material.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Hands-on test experience in an electronics, RF, space or comparable hardware lab: test setups, procedures, execution and reporting
 Comfort with lab instruments (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power supplies) and basic RF practice (connectors, attenuators, cable loss)
 Scripting for test automation and data analysis, typically Python
 An organised and rigorous way of working: you write things down, version them, and can reproduce last month’s result
 Clear written English
 Nice to haves: 
 Satellite AIT, flatsat or hardware-in-the-loop testing
 SDR experience, RF capture or signal analysis
 Test automation frameworks, CI pipelines, instrument control (SCPI/VISA)
 Test data management, databases, dashboards
 Verification under a formal process (ECSS or similar)
 Experience setting up a lab from scratch: equipment selection, layout, safety, calibration programme
 Spanish, for working with local suppliers and facilities
 Eligibility for national security clearance (an advantage)
 What success looks like 
 6 months: lab equipment is inventoried, calibrated and configuration-tracked, and capture and playback sessions run from written procedures, with data stored and findable.
 12 months: core tests are automated and running in regression, test reports are produced routinely, and you’ve supported the first field campaign.
 24 months: the lab runs as a service. Other teams book and run tests with …

 As an individual contributor in the Functional Safety Competence Center, you will help make AI-based systems safe, certifiable, and deployable. items.card: The role We’re looking for a full stack developer who already works agentically. You write clear specs, run multiple agents in parallel against them, choose the right model for each job, and take full ownership of what ships. You’ll work on client products end to end, from shaping requirements with stakeholders through to production. You’ll also help define how Eidra UK builds software with agents: the practices,
items.desc: About Eidra UK Eidra is a collective of around 1,600 people across design, technology, data and business transformation companies, including Umain, Kurppa Hosk, Above and Curamando. Eidra UK brings that capability together for UK clients from our London base. Umain is the engineering practice inside Eidra UK. We design, build and run digital products at scale: apps with 400M+ downloads, platforms serving 50M+ monthly active users, and backends handling tens of thousands of requests per second. We are building Eidra UK around an AI-first way of delivering software. This role sits at the centre of that. The role We’re looking for a full stack developer who already works agentically. You write clear specs, run multiple agents in parallel against them, choose the right model for each job, and take full ownership of what ships. You’ll work on client products end to end, from shaping requirements with stakeholders through to production. You’ll also help define how Eidra UK builds software with agents: the practices, tooling and standards the rest of the team uses. How we build We start from a clear spec, break the work into tasks agents can complete, run those agents in parallel, verify the output with tests, evals and review, then ship. The spec is the source of truth. Agents do much of the implementation. You own the spec, the orchestration and the quality of the result. What you’ll do Spec driven delivery Define requirements in a structured way: identify the actors, describe their use cases, then derive the features that serve them. Turn client needs into specs that both people and agents can build against: clear scope, acceptance criteria, interfaces and constraints. Keep specs, tests and code in step as the product changes. Break work into units that agents can complete and verify independently. Agent orchestration Run and coordinate agent swarms: parallel agents, subagents and specialised roles (planning, implementation, review, testing). Build and maintain the supporting tooling: MCP servers, agent skills, prompts, context files and isolated workspaces. Design the checks that keep agent output trustworthy: test coverage, evals, guardrails and human review points. Model selection and mixing Combine frontier and open-weight models to deliver results. Route work by capability, cost, latency and data sensitivity, including self-hosted or private deployments where client data requires it. Measure model performance on real tasks and change the mix when the evidence says so. Full stack engineering Build secure, scalable web applications with TypeScript, React and Next.js. Build backend services and APIs with Node.js and NestJS. Create reusable UI components using design system principles. Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS or Azure), infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. Build observable systems with metrics, logging and tracing, including for LLM and agent behaviour in production. Clients and team Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams across design, product and data. Explain agentic delivery, its trade-offs and its limits to technical and non-technical audiences. Share what works: pair with colleagues, document patterns and help raise the agentic practice across Eidra UK. What we’re looking for 3+ years of professional full stack experience, with strong TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js and core web fundamentals. Hands-on experience delivering production software with coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar), beyond autocomplete. Strong requirement definition experience, working from actors to use cases to feature definitions with clear acceptance criteria. A working spec driven development practice. You can show specs you’ve written and what agents built from them. Experience running multiple agents in parallel and coordinating their output. Practical experience using both frontier and open-weight models, with a view on when each is the right choice. Strong engineering judgement. You read and review agent output critically and you own the result as your own code. Comfort with ambiguity, and the consulting instinct to work it through with clients. Curiosity. The tools change monthly and you enjoy keeping up. Nice to have Building agentic features into client products: tool calling, RAG, MCP servers, multi-agent workflows. Running open-weight models in production (for example vLLM, Ollama or managed inference). LLM evaluation and observability tooling. Contributions to open source agent tooling or published writing on agentic engineering. Tailwind CSS, Storybook and design system work. Experience in a consultancy or agency setting. Working setup London is the default office. You’ll work remotely when it suits the team or the client. Don’t match every point? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you’ve built than about ticking every box.

items.desc: Ben jij geboeid door elektromotoren, tandwielkasten en pompen? Krijg je energie van technische vraagstukken en werk je graag samen met klanten, mechaniekers en engineers? Je analyseert technische problemen, denkt mee over de beste herstelstrategie en zorgt ervoor dat revisies efficiënt en kwalitatief uitgevoerd worden. Geen dag is dezelfde. De ene dag bespreek je een complexe motorrevisie met onze mechaniekers in de werkplaats, de andere dag werk je een technische offerte uit of adviseer je een klant over de meest geschikte oplossing. Wat ga je doen? Je analyseert defecten, klantvragen en technische dossiers van elektromotoren, tandwielkasten en pompen. Je bepaalt samen met de werkplaats de meest geschikte herstel- of revisieaanpak. Je bereidt revisies en werkzaamheden technisch voor zodat de uitvoering vlot kan verlopen. Je werkt technische en commerciële offertes uit voor revisies en herstellingen. Je ondersteunt klanten met technisch advies en denkt actief mee over duurzame oplossingen. Je vormt de verbindende schakel tussen klant, werkplaats en verkoopingenieurs. Waarom wij deze functie interessant vinden Je combineert techniek, klantcontact en commerciële inzichten. Je staat met één voet in de werkplaats en één voet bij de klant. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende industriële toepassingen en technische uitdagingen. Je krijgt de kans om je verder te verdiepen in rotating equipment en industriële aandrijftechnieken. Je hebt een directe impact op het succes van onze projecten en klanttevredenheid. Wie zoeken we? items.desc: Locatie: België - Antwerpen | Thuiswerk mogelijk | Fulltime Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Als Privacy & AI Compliance Consultant adviseer en begeleid je organisaties bij vraagstukken rond gegevensbescherming en het verantwoord inzetten van AI. Je combineert privacykennis met een groeiende expertise in AI-compliance. Je helpt klanten niet alleen om de GDPR correct toe te passen, maar ook om nieuwe verplichtingen onder de AI Act te begrijpen en praktisch te vertalen naar hun organisatie. Bij Infosentry combineren we advies met concrete ondersteuning. We beperken ons niet tot het formuleren van aanbevelingen, maar helpen klanten ook bij de uitwerking, implementatie en opvolging ervan. Je werkt voor organisaties uit verschillende sectoren en krijgt daardoor te maken met uiteenlopende privacy- en AI-vraagstukken. Afhankelijk van je ervaring neem je zelfstandig dossiers op of werk je samen met meer ervaren collega’s. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen zowel privacy als AI-compliance. Takenpakket Je ondersteunt en adviseert klanten onder meer bij: privacy assessments en het bepalen van concrete verbeteracties; het opstellen en actualiseren van registers van verwerkingsactiviteiten; DPIA’s en andere privacy-risicoanalyses; privacyverklaringen, beleidsdocumenten en procedures; het beoordelen van verwerkersovereenkomsten en andere privacyafspraken; vragen rond rechtsgronden, bewaartermijnen, gegevensdeling en internationale doorgiften; verzoeken van betrokkenen, incidenten en datalekken; awareness en opleidingen rond privacy. Daarnaast werk je mee aan opdrachten rond AI-compliance. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: het in kaart brengen van AI-systemen en AI-toepassingen binnen een organisatie; het beoordelen welke verplichtingen uit de AI Act van toepassing zijn; het ondersteunen bij risico- en impactanalyses; het opstellen en verbeteren van AI-beleid, procedures en governance; het adviseren over het gebruik van generatieve AI en andere AI-tools binnen organisaties; het ondersteunen bij AI literacy en interne bewustmaking; het helpen vertalen van nieuwe AI-regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en verantwoordelijkheden; het verder uitbouwen van onze dienstverlening rond AI-compliance. Jouw profiel We zoeken iemand met minstens 1 jaar ervaring binnen gegevensbescherming (GDPR) en AI governance. Je hebt dus minstens een eerste ervaring met het opstellen van een ROPA, privacyverklaring en/of andere privacy documentatie. Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma of hebt via opleiding en relevante ervaring een gelijkwaardig kennisniveau opgebouwd. Je kent de belangrijkste principes van de GDPR en kunt deze toepassen op concrete situaties. Daarnaast heb je interesse en een eerste ervaring in AI-regelgeving en AI governance. Daarnaast: communiceer je helder en professioneel; werk je graag samen met klanten en collega’s; kun je zelfstandig taken opnemen en weet je wanneer afstemming nodig is; werk je gestructureerd en nauwkeurig; denk je pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht; volg je ontwikkelingen binnen privacy en AI met interesse; beheers je het Nederlands en Engels goed. Frans is een plus. Werken bij Infosentry Infosentry ondersteunt organisaties op het gebied van privacy, security en GRC. Binnen privacy en AI-compliance werken we pragmatisch en hands-on: we geven advies, maar helpen klanten ook om dit advies daadwerkelijk in de praktijk om te zetten. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar kennis wordt gedeeld en waar je kunt terugvallen op collega’s met verschillende expertises. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je eigen kennis verder uit te bouwen en mee te werken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening rond privacy en AI. Wij bieden onder meer: een aantrekkelijk salarispakket, met mogelijkheid tot optimalisatie via ons Flexible Income Plan; bedrijfswagen en laadkaart; laptop en gsm-abonnement; verzekeringen en andere extralegale voordelen; interne en externe opleidingen; begeleiding bij je verdere professionele ontwikkeling; een gezonde combinatie van thuiswerk, kantoorwerk en werk bij klanten; een collegiale en no-nonsense werkomgeving. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan sterke privacy-oplossingen voor toonaangevende organisaties? Solliciteer nu vrijblijvend en maak kennis met ons team! items.desc: The European Spallation Source ERIC (ESS) is hiring motivated and talented individuals to help design, build, and operate the world's most powerful neutron source. We are seeking ambitious professionals from a wide range of disciplines who are excited by the opportunity to contribute to the future of science in Europe. The ESS accelerator, target, and experimental facilities are located in the vibrant university city of Lund, Sweden, while our Data Management and Software Centre (DMSC) is based in Kongens Lyngby (North of Copenhagen), Denmark. ESS is seeking a Scientific HPC System Officer to join the Data Systems and Technology Group in Copenhagen. About the team The Data Systems and Technology Group is responsible for designing, deploying, operating, and continuously developing the infrastructure that supports the storage, processing, and management of the scientific data generated at ESS. The team plays a critical role in ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable computing services for one of the world's leading research facilities. About the role As our future Scientific HPC System Officer , you will apply advanced technical expertise to support and further develop ESS's scientific computing infrastructure. You will work independently on complex technical challenges, contribute to strategic infrastructure initiatives, and act as a trusted resource within your area of expertise. Your responsibilities will include: Driving the deployment of new IT hardware and services supporting scientific computing and data-intensive research; Developing, maintaining, and improving automation and deployment scripts for infrastructure and services; Contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of scientific computing infrastructure for a large-scale international research facility; Managing technical projects and infrastructure initiatives with a high degree of independence; Investigating, analysing, and resolving complex technical issues where standard solutions may not always exist; Acting as a technical point of contact within your area of expertise and providing guidance to colleagues and stakeholders; Monitoring, investigating, and reporting hardware, service, and infrastructure-related incidents; Identifying, assessing, and reporting information security risks and incidents; Contributing to process improvements, operational best practices, and the development of technical procedures and standards; Supporting knowledge sharing and providing guidance to junior scientists and engineers. About you The successful candidate combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and enjoys solving complex technical challenges in an international scientific environment. To be successful in this role, you should have: A Master's degree or PhD in computer science, physics, engineering, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline; Typically 4-7 years of relevant professional experience with a Master's degree, or a PhD combined with at least 2 years of post-doctoral or equivalent professional experience; Advanced knowledge of HPC environments, scientific computing infrastructure, large-scale data systems, or related technical domains; Demonstrated experience managing technical projects, processes, or infrastructure activities with limited supervision; Experience solving complex technical problems requiring analytical thinking, creativity, and sound engineering judgement; Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and cultures; Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Experience in the following areas is considered a strong advantage: Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) platforms; OpenStack, OpenNebula, Proxmox, or comparable virtualisation environments; High-availability and site-to-site failover solutions; Design and implementation of large-scale, high-performance storage solutions or virtualisation platforms; Kubernetes or other container orchestration technologies. What ESS offers At ESS, you will contribute to cutting-edge science while working with talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment. We offer: Challenging tasks involving open-source technologies integrated with state-of-the-art scientific computing infrastructure; Opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across ESS and leading research facilities around the world; The chance to contribute to future scientific discoveries enabled by neutron science; An attractive benefits package, including 25 days of annual leave plus 5 additional days, public holidays, flexible working arrangements, and a strong focus on work-life balance; Relocation support and allowances, where applicable. items.desc: Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company. Join a team of fintech heroes! Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era. Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs. You can read more about our product at performativ.com. As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients. Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work. Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves. You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs. You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests. You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input. You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy. You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend. You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required. We value your passion At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems. We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed. AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour. This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate. What we can offer you The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients. Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows. A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service. An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions. Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.
