items.desc: Tu cherches à trouver du sens à ton travail et à avoir un impact positif sur le quotidien de millions de clients bancaires en France ? Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement agile, collectif et technologique en évolution permanente ? Alors notre entreprise, Crédit Agricole Technologies et Services , pourrait te correspondre ! Que faisons-nous ? Nous fabriquons les outils informatiques des conseillers bancaires et de nos clients du réseau bancaire des Caisses Régionales du groupe Crédit Agricole. Que ferons-nous ensemble ? Nous continuerons, avec toi et nos 1900 collaborateurs et collaboratrices , à « faire de CA-TS, l'acteur IT de référence en termes de performance, de technologie et de responsabilité sociétale » avec comme objectif commun : la satisfaction client. Ta contribution en tant que Data Engineer au sein de la Tribu Data Factory ? En tant que Data Engineer au sein de notre équipe, tu rejoindras les 70 collaborateurs.rices de la Tribu Data Factory du pôle produit Data et plus particulièrement la squad Usages Data & IA en charge de l’exploration et de l’industrialisation d’accélérateurs en data, data science & IA à l’échelle des 39 Caisses régionales du Crédit Agricole. Intégrant une communauté dynamique et experte, tu auras un impact direct et mesurable sur les services autour de la Data & l’IA réalisés en collaboration avec le reste de la tribu, les autres Pôles Produits CATS, les architectes et les OPS CAGIP et nos clients en Caisses Régionales. Notre organisation est agile, en la rejoignant, tu donneras le sens, la vision et les apports de valeur de produits orientés clients. L’apprentissage continu, la collaboration et l’écoute active seront tes atouts indispensables au quotidien. Rattaché.e à la squad UDIA au sein de la Tribu Data Factory au sein de la gouvernance opérationnelle au quotidien portée par le Product Owner, le Scrum Master et le Tech Lead. Ta mission, avec le reste de l’équipe sera : De développer à des projets excitants en phase de BUILD en couvrant des cas d’usages variés sur la partie Data Avancé / IA : Développer une culture orientée objectifs et livrables sur des domaines et des enjeux métiers variés que ce soit sur la data préparation, modélisation ou l’industrialisation Collaborer en transverse avec nos référents CAGIP, référents CATS type architecture et MLOPS, d’autres Squads de la tribu Data Factory et au-delà du PP Data, le cas échéant Mettre en place et assurer les bonnes pratiques CI/CD Participer aux cérémonies AGILE, suivre les pratiques agiles et méthodologies de livraison en place, partager l’avancement avec l’équipe, remonter les points d’attention au Tech Lead, Scrum Master et Product Owner, contribuer à l’évolution des pratiques de la Tribu dans une logique d’amélioration continue et alerter D’assurer le run et de développer les évolutions de ces produits : En développant et réalisant les nouvelles fonctionnalités et usages définis et priorisés par le Tech Lead et le Scrum Master (user stories) En participant aux choix d’architectures afin de définir la solution Data la plus adaptée à mettre en place selon le besoin formulé et fonction des outils Data à disposition En s’assurant de la bonne mise en œuvre des méthodes MLOPS et des tests unitaires En implémentant ou améliorant les solutions de monitoring des modèles (métriques data science) et des applications (bon fonctionnement de la chaîne) En étant garant du bon fonctionnement et de la maintenance des produits en production notamment en participant au suivi des produits pour garantir une qualité de service optimale aux utilisateurs D’utiliser au quotidien une stack technique répondant aux tendances actuelles du marché : Utilisation des outils de suivi d’activité : Jira Software. Outils de DevOps : Gitlab CI, Jenkins, Sonar Python (Numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, fastAPI), Pyspark, Docker, SQL (Teradata) Stack Elastic (ElasticSearch, Logstash, Kibana…) AWS : Sagemaker (Studio, intégration, ... ), Terraform Ta vie au sein de notre Tribu : Un environnement de travail axé sur la qualité et l'excellence. L’opportunité de créer et d'améliorer des fonctionnalités pour nos 24 millions de clients à travers la France. Un partage continu des connaissances à travers des conférences, des réunions hebdomadaires et des Tech Talks mensuelles pour rester à la pointe des dernières tendances et meilleures pratiques. Découvre le site de Paris Ce que nous faisons pour faciliter ta vie professionnelle et personnelle : Nous te proposons : De participer à l’évolution de CA-TS en matière de performance, de technologie et de responsabilité sociétale : participation aux projets d’entreprise, développement de la fabrication responsable, contribution à la diminution de notre empreinte carbone. items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Aménageur du fleuve Rhône, référent de la ressource en eau et producteur d’électricité issue de l’eau, du vent et du soleil, CNR s’engage pour la transition écologique des territoires avec une expertise industrielle renouvelée depuis plus de 90 ans. Entreprise à statut unique, à la croisée du public et du privé, nous conjuguons performance industrielle et missions d’intérêt général : favoriser la navigation, irriguer les terres, aménager le fleuve et protéger les écosystèmes naturels. Travailler chez CNR, c’est choisir d’agir pour plus grand que soi, tout en restant fidèle à qui on est. C’est contribuer à faire bouger les lignes de la transition énergétique tout en développant ses compétences et en trouvant sa place dans un collectif qui avance ensemble. Pour en savoir plus ➜ CNR - Site internet Nous recherchons pour la Direction en Eau notre futur.e : Ingénieur Eau, Données et Outils Numériques (F/H) – Intérim 18 mois – Lyon 4ème ✅ Vos missions principales seront : Au sein de la Direction Ressources en Eau, vous contribuez au développement de la connaissance et au suivi de la ressource en eau du Rhône, afin de favoriser une gestion durable et résiliente de cette ressource stratégique. À l’interface entre les experts métiers, les utilisateurs et les équipes de développement informatique, vous participez à la conception, à l’évolution et à la valorisation des outils numériques et des données nécessaires au pilotage de la ressource en eau. À ce titre, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Concevoir et faire évoluer les outils numériques dédiés à la connaissance et à la gestion quantitative de la ressource en eau ; Recueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins fonctionnels des utilisateurs, et contribuer à la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles ainsi qu’au suivi des développements ; Identifier, recenser et caractériser les données et les modèles disponibles, en évaluant leur pertinence au regard des besoins des projets ; Assurer l’administration fonctionnelle et l’exploitation des bases de données dédiées à la gestion de la ressource en eau ; Produire et valoriser des analyses et des indicateurs à travers des tableaux de bord et des outils d’aide à la décision ; Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’utilisation des outils de modélisation de la ressource en eau ; Traiter, analyser et exploiter des données spatialisées pour répondre aux besoins des projets ; Développer des représentations cartographiques et des outils de visualisation facilitant l’analyse et le partage des connaissances ; Administrer, structurer et valoriser les données géographiques nécessaires aux activités et aux projets de la Direction ; Assurer une veille technique et méthodologique sur les innovations en matière de gestion, de traitement et de valorisation des données environnementales. Rattaché au Directeur de la Ressources en Eau, vous allez intégrer une équipe de 3 personnes. ‍ ️ Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac +5 en géomatique, data science appliquée à l’eau ou à l’environnement, ou équivalent, et justifiez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience. Vous disposez de connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : Gestion quantitative de la ressource en eau, hydrologie et fonctionnement des hydrosystèmes ; SIG (ArcGIS, QGIS) et gestion des données géographiques ; Analyse et traitement de données environnementales, programmation Python et automatisation ; Modélisation hydraulique. Une connaissance de l’intelligence artificielle, des jumeaux numériques ou des systèmes d’aide à la décision serait appréciée. Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’analyse et goût du travail en équipe sont attendus. Permis B requis (déplacements dans la vallée du Rhône). Les avantages : La rémunération débute à partir de 42K et est évolutive en fonction de votre profil et de votre expérience. En complément vous percevrez un 13e mois et des titres restaurants... Le processus de recrutement : Vous serez dans un premier temps contacté.e par l’équipe recrutement, puis rencontré.e pour un entretien RH et enfin un entretien métier avec le manager. Nos engagements : CNR favorise la diversité, l'inclusion et la mixité au sein de ses équipes, pour cela nous avons obtenu le label diversité depuis 2014 qui témoigne de notre engagement. Nous sommes aussi engagés dans la démarche du Recrutement Circulaire, une approche innovante et responsable du recrutement. Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et à tous Nom de l'entreprise: Compagnie Nationale du Rhône Salaire de base minimum: 42 000,00 EUR Salaire de base maximum: Base salariale: Annuelle Nos valeurs L’inclusion et la diversité sont au cœur de notre politique de ressources humaines. Nous assurons l'égalité des chances entre tous les candidats et sommes engagés à créer l’environnement de travail le plus accessible possible.

Analyser les redondances entre applications, scripts, automatisations et composants techniques, puis proposer des scénarios de consolidation ou de mutualisation. Préparer les validations techniques et les mises en service en tenant compte des flux, des dépendances, des habilitations, des secrets, de l’exposition réseau et des exigences de supervision. Assurer le suivi des décisions, des actions, des dépendances et des échéances, en identifiant les blocages et en proposant des scénarios de résolution. Vous aimez structurer, concevoir et améliorer les outils existants, tout en gardant une approche pragmatique orientée qualité, sécurité et pérennité. Développement logiciel, prototypage, intégration, versionnement du code, revues de code, tests et chaînes de livraison. Industrialisation des outils internes, standards …

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Institut NEEL Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 38042 GRENOBLE Durée du contrat 5 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration Entre 3041,58 € et 4 216,70 € mensuels bruts selon expérience Date limite de candidature : mardi 10 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Le candidat utilisera et développera des algorithmes de ptychographie pour les données de microscopie électronique en transmission. L'objectif de ce travail est de faire progresser et d'automatiser l'utilisation de la ptychographie sur différents types d'échantillons. En particulier : 1) accélérer le processus de reconstruction en utilisant un algorithme multislice 2) permettre une reconstruction 3D et 3) automatiser le processus de reconstruction et l’automatiser pour une reconstruction presque en direct et une expérience utilisateur simplifiée et améliorée, afin d'ouvrir cette technique extrêmement puissante à des utilisateurs non experts et à des applications à haut débit. L'Activité Optimiser les paramètres d'acquisition de la ptychographie électronique et améliorer ou développer l'algorithme de reconstruction. Les activités comprendront : Effectuer des simulations d'ensembles de données de ptychographie électronique reconstruire des données en utilisant des algorithmes à tranches multiples adapter les algorithmes de reconstruction de ptychographie automatiser l'analyse des données de ptychographie accélérer la reconstruction faciliter le processus de reconstruction. Votre Profil Compétences Expérience dans la reconstruction de données ptychographiques connaissances en programmation traitement de données simulations de diffraction électronique compétences mathématiques connaissances en matière d'apprentissage automatique et d'intelligence artificielle sont un atout Votre Environnement de Travail L'Institut NÉEL est une Unité propre de recherche du CNRS (UPR2940) conventionnée avec l'Université Grenoble Alpes. Le laboratoire est rattaché au CNRS Physique. Il est situé à Grenoble, au coeur d'un environnement scientifique, industriel et culturel unique. C'est l'un des plus grands instituts de recherche français pour la recherche fondamentale en matière condensée, enrichi par des activités interdisciplinaires à l'interface de la chimie, ingénierie et biologie. Il emploie 450 personnes dont 175 chercheurs. Le CNRS est un établissement public à caractère scientifique et technologique. Il a pour mission d’identifier, d’effectuer ou de faire effectuer, seul ou avec ses partenaires, toutes recherches présentant un intérêt pour l’avancement de la science ainsi que pour le progrès économique, social et culturel. Internationalement reconnu pour l’excellence de ses travaux scientifiques, le CNRS est une référence aussi bien dans l’univers de la recherche et développement que pour le grand public. La ptychographie électronique (PE) est devenue la technique de microcopie électronique à ultra-haute résolution et à faible dose [Science 372, 826–831 (2021)]. L'objectif de ce poste post-doctoral est de poursuivre le développement de la Ptychographie Electronique à Grenoble (France). Il/elle aura accès à des clusters informatiques performants et un microscope électroniques en transmission (TEM) de dernière génération situés à l'institut NEEL (Neoarm + caméra medipix). Le candidat sera accueilli à l’Institut Néel, au sein de l’équipe : MRS - Matériaux, Rayonnements, Structure, du département PLUM. items.desc: JOB DETAILS Type of contract : Consultant Contract Level : Level 1 - Junior Hiring Unit : Bureau for Digital Business Solutions (DBS) Duty Station : Paris Work location : On site Duration of contract : 6 months Hiring open to : External candidates Application deadline (Midnight UTC+2 Time) : 27/10/2026 UNESCO Core Values: Commitment to the Organization, Integrity, Respect for Diversity, Professionalism OVERVIEW Core Planner, Core Manager, Core Data Portal, Core HR + are recently deployed, organization-wide platforms supporting UNESCO's programme planning, implementation, HR management, monitoring, reporting processes. They continue to evolve through UNESCO’s successive C/5 planning, implementation and reporting cycles. User guidance must therefore be maintained and updated after each major release and each new functionality. An extensive, functionally indexed user support library is available on the UNESCO Intranet and is routinely consulted by users before they contact the Service Desk, thereby preventing avoidable Level 1 tickets. The same methodology was applied in 2026 to support the launch of Core HR+. With a growing pipeline of UNESCO80 initiatives, automation, AI and new digital solutions, DBS wishes to turn this capability into a DBS-wide function for user adoption and digital knowledge management. A key part of this evolution is preparing the DBS knowledge base for AI-enabled user support, a prerequisite for the AI agent pilot planned for 2027. ASSIGNMENTS To maintain and extend user documentation, launch communications and adoption support for DBS enterprise platforms, and to evolve this work into a standardized DBS-wide practice, while preparing an AI-ready knowledge base. The intended progression is: manual documentation → structured enterprise knowledge → AI-ready knowledge base → AI self-service → progressively reduced manual support demand. A. User documentation and adoption (core) Maintain and update the user support library for Core Planner, Core Manager, Core Data Portal and Core HR+ following each release. Develop new guidance for new functionality, including new reporting capabilities and advanced reports, in time for the C/5 cycles falling within the contract period. Prepare launch communications and in-application guidance associated with new releases, acting as the link between technical delivery and business adoption. Provide back-up Level 1 support during absence, peak demand and critical business cycles. B. DBS-wide user adoption and knowledge management (evolution) Apply the established methodology to other DBS projects, as prioritized by DBS Develop standardized, reusable documentation templates, launch communication guidelines and adoption practices for new IT projects. Document the approach so that it can be sustained and reused after the assignment. C. AI-readiness of the knowledge base (key evolution) Continue converting legacy documentation into AI-readable formats and develop new material according to AI-readiness criteria. Curate and structure the DBS knowledge base, using recurring Level 1 questions identified by the Level 1 support consultant to set priorities. Prepare and quality-check the content required for the AI agent pilot and, where it is under way within the contract period, support validation of AI-generated responses and work closely with technical teams. CONTRACT DURATION The assignment is expected to cover a period of 6 months, commencing on or around beguining of november 2026. The services will be delivered on UNESCO premises, subject to operational requirements. DELIVERABLES Deliverables are phased to reflect the progressive evolution of the role over the six-month period. Dates and scope are to be aligned with the contract start date and the applications release calendar. Period (indicative) Expected deliverables Months 1–6 Documentation and communications updated for releases and cycles within the period. Status inventory of the knowledge base: content already converted to AI-readable format and content remaining. Months 3–4 Standardized adoption and documentation kit for DBS projects (templates, launch communication guidelines). First application to a designated additional DBS project. Continued conversion of priority content. Months 4–6 AI-ready knowledge base content for the agreed pilot scope. End-of-assignment report with recommendations, and handover documentation so that knowledge maintenance can continue sustainably. Performance indicators Targets to be agreed with the Service Desk team at the start of the assignment. Timeliness of documentation updates relative to each release. Coverage of new functionality by user documentation and launch communications. Share of the agreed knowledge-base scope converted to AI-ready format. Uptake of the standardized kit by other DBS projects. Trend in "how-to" ticket volumes, analysed jointly with the Level 1 support consultant. Vos missions Assurer l'exploitation, la supervision et la disponibilité des applications. Participer à l'homologation et aux mises en production, notamment en préproduction (VABFO). items.desc: About Voyage Privé Founded in France in 2006, Voyage Privé has grown from an ambitious startup into Europe’s leading travel tech platform. Operating across 9 markets with tens of millions of users, we are not just another e-commerce success story – we are a tech powerhouse redefining online luxury travel. Our culture is mission-driven, blending performance with impact. Our innovative campus brings together tech talent, professional athletes, students, and artists, fostering an ecosystem where digital innovation fuels business growth and meaningful change. We are now entering a new phase, upgrading our technical foundation with cloud architecture, AI, and real-time systems to become a top-of-mind platform for luxury travelers and a trusted high-performance partner for providers. Your Mission We are hiring a Business Developer to join our team at Voyage Privé. As a Business Developer , you will play a key role in growing and managing our portfolio of hotel partners across one or more assigned destinations, depending on your experience, market knowledge and the company’s business needs. Based at our headquarters in Aix-en-Provence , you will identify new business opportunities, source and negotiate exclusive campaigns with hotel partners, and develop strong long-term relationships with key players in the hospitality industry. Your work will contribute to creating distinctive travel experiences for our members while driving strong commercial results. You will be the key point of contact for hoteliers in your assigned destination , representing Voyage Privé and developing trusted partnerships on the ground. Key Responsibilities Develop and grow your hotel portfolio , including boutique properties, resorts and luxury brands, according to the needs of your assigned destination. Identify and prospect new hotel partners and business opportunities across your market. Source, negotiate and secure exclusive campaigns with hotel partners to meet revenue and margin targets. Represent Voyage Privé to hoteliers, present our value proposition, onboard new partners and build long-lasting relationships. Manage the full business development cycle , from initial contact and negotiation to campaign launch and performance follow-up. Work closely with internal teams , including Marketing, Content, Revenue and Operations, to maximise campaign performance. Monitor market trends, competitor activity and destination developments to identify new opportunities and support the growth of the business. Travel regularly to your assigned destination , depending on business needs, to meet partners, develop your network and strengthen relationships on the ground. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our commercial approach , processes and partner proposition. Who You Are Native or fluent English speaker , with excellent communication skills. 3 to 5+ years of experience in business development, hotel contracting, tour operating, hospitality procurement, DMC, OTA or a related field. Proven ability to identify and develop new business opportunities . Strong negotiation and relationship management skills , with confidence when dealing with suppliers and senior stakeholders. Good knowledge of the hospitality and travel industry, ideally with an existing network of contacts in one or more destinations. Commercially minded, with a strong understanding of revenue, profitability and business performance. Data-driven, structured and results-oriented , with a focus on continuous improvement. Comfortable working in a dynamic, international and fast-growing environment. Independent, proactive and able to manage priorities effectively. items.desc: About us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role We’re looking for a sharp, user-focused UX Researcher to help shape and improve the overall player experience. You’ll act as the voice of the user by conducting research, uncovering behavioral insights, and turning those findings into clear, actionable product decisions. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, and Data teams , ensuring that product decisions are driven by real user needs and behaviors rather than assumptions. This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys working with ambiguity, finding meaningful insights, and turning research into measurable product outcomes. Key Responsibilities User Research Operations — Plan and execute qualitative and quantitative research studies including user interviews, surveys, usability tests, and diary studies across the full player journey. Behavioral Analysis — Analyze user behavior across our platform using analytics tools, session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify friction points and opportunities. Competitor & Market Research — Conduct structured competitive analysis of sweepstakes casino products to benchmark our UX against industry standards and identify gaps. Wireframing & Prototyping — Use Figma or Visily to translate research insights into wireframes, user flows, and low-to-mid fidelity prototypes that guide product and design decisions. User Personas & Journey Mapping — Develop and maintain player personas, customer journey maps, and mental models that inform product strategy and prioritization. Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work directly with Product Managers, Designers, and Developers to embed user insights into the product lifecycle from ideation through launch. Stakeholder Reporting — Document and present research findings clearly to stakeholders, making complex insights accessible and actionable. UX Standards — Champion user-centered design principles, accessibility standards, and usability best practices across all product initiatives. Continuous Discovery — Proactively identify new research questions, monitor industry UX trends, and propose process improvements to keep our research function sharp. Qualifications 2+ years of hands-on experience in UX research, with a portfolio or case studies demonstrating research-to-product impact. Proficiency in Figma and/or Visily for wireframing, prototyping, and user flow design. Proven experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, and surveys — both moderated and unmoderated. Familiarity with analytics and behavioral tools such as Mixpanel, Hotjar, FullStory, or Google Analytics. Strong analytical mindset — ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into clear, prioritized insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present research clearly to non-research audiences. Advanced AI user — comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, generate interview guides, and surface patterns at scale. English fluency required. Nice to have Experience in sweepstakes casino, online gaming, fintech, or consumer subscription products. Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments. Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. items.desc: Your Mission EV charging is moving from a specialist topic into the everyday infrastructure of businesses, buildings, and communities. The products behind that shift need to be powerful enough for complex energy systems and simple enough for people who are not mobility or energy experts. At reev, you will shape the experience of software used by businesses, electricians, and charging operators across Europe. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build real product experiences, not only define them from a distance. You will own product design end to end: from understanding a problem and exploring ideas to building interfaces, validating them with users, and preparing them for implementation. As reev's go-to Product Designer, you will work closely with Product Managers, the founder, UX Research, Engineering, customers and installers to boost our products’ usability and adoption. Your design work drives business metrics and caters to the success of reev. Own the full design process. Turn product problems into clear user experiences, flows, and interfaces that people can understand and use. Build, do not just advise. Spend meaningful time building prototypes and high-fidelity UI, while keeping the experience grounded in real user needs. Validate with the people who use the product. Test ideas and designs with customers and electricians, and use insights from Customer Support, Customer Success, and Sales to improve the experience. Work directly with Engineering. Explore feasibility with engineers early, explain design intent clearly, and hand over work in a way that supports high-quality implementation. Create consistency across the product suite. Help establish a coherent product design language across the entire product portfolio. Make design decisions that can stand up to discussion. Use design principles, benchmarks, user evidence, and sound reasoning to explain your choices while staying open to feedback and practical compromise. What you bring along You are a Product Designer with a strong foundation in product design and experience working as part of a cross-functional team. You enjoy building products, exploring solutions, and refining the details that make an experience work. You are comfortable working with C-Level Management and moving from early ideas to high-quality execution. You bring strong product design craft. You can move from user experience flows to detailed UI, and you care about the quality of the final interaction and interface. You bring structure and ownership. You can turn open questions into clear next steps, make thoughtful trade-offs, and involve the right people at the right time. You communicate and collaborate with clarity. You can explain and defend design decisions with evidence, incorporate feedback, and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the user need. You enjoy cross-functional collaboration. You work well with different perspectives and turn complex product challenges into useful products. You use a modern design toolkit. You have practical experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools such as Claude Design and Lovable, alongside Figma. You have developed a strong foundation through experience in a startup, scale-up, or established software company. You can apply your design foundation in a fast-moving product environment and work effectively across different stakeholders. Should have Experience designing B2B SaaS products or other complex software products where clarity matters. German language skills that help you take part in user interviews or user testing with customers and electricians. We don't expect every box ticked. But we do expect you to care deeply, move fast, and hold yourself to a high standard. Sound like you? Let's talk. What you can expect from us How we work Clear goals. Real ownership. No politics. We move fast, decide together, and hold each other accountable - because progress beats perfection. Monthly team events and regular cross-office collaboration between Munich and Zagreb keep us connected as one team. Where you'll work Our office at Stiglmaierplatz is where collaboration happens - face to face, shoulder to shoulder. For this role, we expect you on-site four days per week. Not because we track attendance, but because we believe the best outcomes happen when great people are in the same room. What you get 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest. Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive. AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down. Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life. €1,000 learning budget …

items.desc: Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies. At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Custom Projects Scientist is responsible for leading customer-focused diagnostic service projects and acting as the scientific interface between customers and Cytiva’s Diagnostics business. The role combines project leadership, laboratory execution, scientific consulting, and technical reporting to deliver high-quality service offerings that support customer success. This position reports to the Team Leader - Membranes and Diagnostic Applications with a dotted line to Diagnostics Services Leader and is part of the Diagnostics Services Team located in Dassel, Germany and will be an on-site role. What you will do: Lead customer-driven service projects from initial inquiry through project completion focusing especially on the execution part. Serve as the primary scientific point of contact for customers requesting new diagnostic and assay development projects. Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements in collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders. Execute laboratory experiments and analytical studies required to support customer projects. Analyze experimental data and generate comprehensive customer-facing technical reports and recommendations. Who you are: Master's degree (M.Sc.) in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline. Experience leading customer-facing scientific or technical projects within diagnostics, life sciences, biotechnology, CRO, or related industries. Demonstrated experience preparing project proposals, defining project scope, establishing timelines, and managing customer expectations. Experience performing hands-on laboratory work involving biomolecular analysis, assay development, protein characterization, or related techniques. Experience analyzing scientific data and preparing professional technical reports for external customers. Fluent in German and English. It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) technologies and data interpretation. Diagnostic assay development, immunoassays, molecular diagnostics, or biomarker characterization. Working directly with external customers in a service, applications, consulting, or contract research environment. items.desc: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the Platform Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be In the Platform Engineering team, you will build the next generation of the internal developer platform behind Spread Group's core services - a cloud-native platform on AWS, designed from the ground up. We see our platform as a product and our developers as our customers. This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission. What You´ll Do Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one Design and build platform services, APIs and self-service capabilities that let teams build, deploy and operate their core services end-to-end Provide "golden paths": standardized templates, pipelines and building blocks that get teams to production quickly and safely Build and evolve the AWS cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, including Kubernetes and managed services Keep the platform secure, reliable and cost-efficient Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience Maintain the existing on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes landscape - keeping all services reliably running while the migration to AWS is underway Guide the migration of roughly 175 existing services onto the new platform What You´ll Bring Several years of professional experience (mid-level to senior) in software engineering, ideally in platform engineering, SRE or DevOps - a computer science degree is welcome but not required Solid experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, Linux and containers Strong software engineering skills - you write production-grade code in a language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, building platform services and APIs, not just infrastructure scripts Experience designing REST APIs Solid Git skills and knowledge of platform services such as CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI) and observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) A product mindset - you see developers as the customers of your work Good communication skills in English Nice to Have Experience with GitOps (e.g., Argo CD) and secrets management (e.g., Vault) Experience with internal developer portals (e.g., Backstage) Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka) Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. Equal Opportunity Employer We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national …

items.desc: About Spira Labs Spira Labs is an early-stage TechBio and HealthTech venture builder based in Munich, Germany. Backed by Picus Capital and Arvantis Group, and supported by leading industry experts, we partner with exceptional founders from the earliest stages to turn ambitious ideas into scalable healthcare and life science companies. We focus on data- and AI-driven business models across diagnostics, life sciences and healthcare delivery, combining deep domain expertise with hands-on support across the early-stage phases, from product development to go-to-market. We are looking for an exceptional entrepreneur to take the lead in one of our incubated ventures, building a next-generation diagnostics company at the intersection of metagenomics, data science and precision medicine. The ambition is to combine increasingly accessible sequencing technology with advanced bioinformatics to develop clinically meaningful products while building a proprietary data foundation for future diagnostic applications. technical feasibility and commercial potential Strong commercial acumen, ideally with experience in go-to-market, sales, partnerships or early customer traction in healthcare or life sciences business opportunities and investor narratives High agency, ownership mindset and evidence-driven decision-making What we offer Opportunity to build and lead a company at the intersection of metagenomics, AI and precision medicine, with meaningful founder equity Direct access to experienced entrepreneurs, investors, clinicians and scientists across the Spira Labs, Picus Capital and Arvantis Group networks Ongoing partnership discussions with three leading diagnostic laboratories in Germany, providing a strong foundation for scientific validation, product development and commercialization Hands-on venture-building support, initial funding and access to operational resources and expertise High degree of entrepreneurial autonomy, with a lean team, fast decision-making and the freedom to shape the company from day one Flexible working arrangements and an attractive office in central Munich

items.desc: Enterprise Architecture Analyst The Enterprise Architecture Analyst supports the day-to-day operation of the Enterprise Architecture function. The role helps coordinate architecture activities, maintain clear records of decisions and actions, and support the development and use of architecture standards and guidance. This is a development-oriented, entry-level role for someone with strong organisation, communication and analytical skills who wants to build a career in enterprise architecture. The successful candidate will work with experienced architects and technology teams, gaining practical exposure to enterprise, solution, platform, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure and security architecture. The role does not require the successful candidate to be an experienced architect. Training, coaching and practical support will be provided to help the individual develop the required technical and professional knowledge. Roles and Responsibilities Coordinate and support architecture review activities, ensuring meetings, documentation, decisions and follow-up actions are effectively managed. Maintain architecture governance documentation, standards, principles and reference materials to support consistency across technology initiatives. Track architecture decisions, risks, technical debt, exceptions and action items, escalating issues where appropriate. Facilitate collaboration across architects, engineers, product owners, security teams, data teams and business stakeholders. Organize architecture forums, workshops, onboarding sessions and knowledge-sharing events for the architecture community. Support the development and maintenance of architecture artefacts including capability maps, roadmaps, transition plans and technology landscape documentation. Conduct research and analysis of technology trends, platforms, dependencies and opportunities for modernization, consolidation and reuse. Prepare reports, presentations, architecture summaries and governance metrics for technical and non-technical audiences. Required Experience and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Strong interest in Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy, Architecture Governance and enterprise technology operating models. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to manage priorities, analyze information and identify key insights. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing documentation, reports, meeting notes and presentations for diverse audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders in global, cross-functional and matrixed environments. Basic understanding of enterprise technology domains including cloud, data, integration, infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital workplace, APIs and software delivery concepts. Familiarity with architecture frameworks, methods and tools such as TOGAF, capability mapping, process modelling, LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign or Enterprise Architect is advantageous. Experience gained through internships, academic projects or early-career roles in technology, business analysis, project coordination or product delivery, together with exposure to platforms such as Azure, AWS, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow or Microsoft 365; relevant foundation-level certifications are a plus. items.desc: Description We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Associate Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for a consultant to develop their expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central while working alongside experienced consultants on a variety of client projects. In this client-facing role, you will support the delivery of Dynamics 365 Business Central implementations, assisting throughout the project lifecycle from requirements gathering and solution configuration through to testing, user training, go-live support, and post-implementation activities. You will collaborate closely with customers, project managers, senior consultants, and technical teams to help deliver solutions that align with client business objectives while developing your functional consulting and business process knowledge. Key Responsibilities Support the delivery of Dynamics 365 Business Central implementation projects under the guidance of Senior and Lead Consultants. Assist with requirements gathering, business process analysis, and process mapping activities. Support solution configuration, testing, data migration, and go-live activities. Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of functional specifications and project documentation. Assist in executing System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Participate in customer workshops, discovery sessions, and project meetings. Build positive and professional relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Support the delivery of user training sessions and preparation of training materials. Assist with demonstrations and proof-of-concept activities where required. Communicate project updates and progress effectively to team members and customers. Develop an understanding of customer business processes and how they align with Dynamics 365 Business Central functionality. Support solution design activities by documenting business requirements and recommending standard system functionality. Assist in identifying opportunities for process improvements and system enhancements. Contribute to solution documentation, configuration records, and knowledge-sharing activities. Work collaboratively with consultants, developers, project managers, and customer stakeholders. Contribute positively to a supportive and knowledge-sharing team environment. Take ownership of assigned tasks and ensure timely delivery to a high standard. Seek feedback and actively participate in mentoring and development opportunities. Ensure all work is completed in accordance with Codec methodologies, quality standards, and customer requirements. Maintain accurate documentation of project activities, decisions, testing outcomes, and customer communications. Assist in identifying project risks, issues, and dependencies. Adhere to internal policies, procedures, and industry best practices. Continuously develop knowledge of Dynamics 365 Business Central and related Microsoft technologies. items.desc: This role is basd in Letterkenny and will be 2 days on site a week. This role will be 11am - 7pm. Are you passionate about being a part of an Investment Accounting Business Analysis group that is focused on developing technical and professional skills while collaborating alongside internal business clients and technologists in the asset management and financial management community? Our group supports PGIM Investment Accounting Systems through all aspects of the software development life cycle. We work closely with our internal contacts to meet their needs with an increased focus on transformation, automation and improved data/workflow. We look for innovative solutions and continue to add new technology to the mix. Team members work on a variety of projects and support many different systems, applications, programs and processes. What you can expect Resolving customer service requests relate to system functionality and answering user questions. Identifying solutions to complex business problems by gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and systems requirements to enhance operational performance. Reviewing user and/or Operations requests and conducts data-gathering interviews. Writing business specifications/requirements/rules, redesigning applications\processes, creating mockups, and analyzing user data. Partnering closely with clients and developers to work through the phases of systems development lifecycle (SDLC). Creating test plans to validate that system functionality satisfies associated business requirements. Designing and implementing test for systems changes. Developing test cases matrices, creating actual test cases, executing the test, reviewing of actual vs. expected results, communicating and resolving issues and documenting results. Interacting with product owners/clients, other business analysts, software developers and testers in the group. Utilizing various technologies which may include (but are not limited to) Jira, Excel, SQL, Visio, Python, Sellenium, Oracle, SQL Server, PowerBI/Tableau, Cognos, Xceptor. What you will bring Ideally you will have 1 -2 years experience in the banking and financial services industry, fund administration, accounting, tax or operations experience in financial services. Bachelor’s degree within Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics and Information Technology (BAIT). Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Finance, Economics Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Strong project management, organization and communication skills. What will set you apart? Experience with SQL and related tools (e.g., Microsoft Query, Rapid SQL, DBeaver, etc.) preferred. Knowledge of the Software Development Life-Cycle preferred and Agile methodology a plus. Experience with Cognos or other reporting platforms is a plus. Experience with business analysis, requirements, software testing or proficiency tools (e.g., automated testing tools, compare tools, robotics, data visualization, Python) a plus PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. What we offer you Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses. Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay. Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme. …

Excellent technical and communication skills are essential in order to generate accurate data and access information from various data sources, both structured and non-structured. The successful candidate will have experience in a role involving detailed analysis and manipulation of data to produce meaningful reports to support performance visibility and business priorities. Work with the Business Support Team Lead/Manager to deliver high level administrative duties by assisting with key reporting duties. Provide all data input for the Master Data team from a pricing and billing perspective. Co-ordinate all ‘New Account’ and ‘New Product’ set up through the Key Account Management team to ensure accuracy and consistency for all clients. Recommend and implement where feasible alternate solutions and be a catalyst for change to improve the customer experience. Analyse and understand the client and their business, including future direction, business direction. IT interface management. Follow internal system processes but be flexible to adapt to different responsibilities in a fast-paced dynamic environment. Skill Sets Required: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; and computer skills Excellent attention to detail and ability to think outside the box Communication skills providing ability to create strong relationships internally and externally within the business Ability to multitask and problem solve effectively Highly driven and motivated Experience required: At least 3 years’ experience working in a business role. Ability to analyse high volume of financial and nonfinancial data and clearly communicating the results to commercial team. Well-developed PC skills and proficiency in MS Excel & PowerPoint – Required. Dynamic and proactive person, 'can-do' attitude. Demonstrated negotiation and conflict resolution skills. Strong knowledge of SAP Business Warehouse/Business Intelligence (tools & process) is essential.

Position Summary The Inventory Analyst is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing consignment inventory levels at Customer locations to ensure product availability, minimizing excess inventory and reducing financial risk. This role involves supporting the processing of stock count data and reconciliation of consignment inventory, focusing on optimized inventory levels provided by Sales. This role will see you work closely with the Sales team, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Finance teams to maintain efficient inventory processes. #LI-hybrid #LI-sc1 Principal Responsibilities Inventory: Monitor and maintain accurate records of consignment inventory across customer locations. Support the tracking of stock movements, customer consumption and replenishment to help maintain appropriate inventory and par levels. Review and process inventory reconciliations submitted by Sales Teams through ConsignPro and SAP, escalating more complex discrepancies as appropriate. Investigate routine inventory discrepancies and work with Sales Teams, Customer Service and customer contacts to support their timely resolution. Process expired inventory write-offs in accordance with established approval processes and month-end timelines. Perform inventory transactions and corrections in SAP, including stock write-ons, stock write-offs, stock transfers and other inventory adjustments, in line with approved procedures. Liaise with customers and Field Sales teams regarding routine consignment inventory queries, replenishment requirements and stock movements. Coordinate the return of expired, damaged or unwanted consignment stock, including following up on outstanding returns and relevant documentation. Support the management of country-specific Inventory mailboxes and respond to routine inventory-related queries. Monitor consignment inventory count activities against the established count plan and follow up on overdue or outstanding counts. Support Customer Service teams with the review of the EMEA open ZKE order report and follow up on missing documentation, inventory discrepancies and other stock-related issues. Help ensure inventory records accurately reflect customer consumption and stock movements, supporting accurate invoicing and revenue recognition. Data Analysis and Reporting: Prepare and distribute regular inventory-related reports, including daily, weekly, monthly and ad-hoc reporting as required. Support the maintenance of reports relating to inventory discrepancies, inventory counts, outstanding returns, expired inventory and other inventory activities. Review inventory data for accuracy and completeness and follow up with relevant stakeholders where information is missing or requires clarification. Support the analysis of basic inventory trends, usage patterns and recurring discrepancies, escalating significant findings or opportunities to the appropriate manager. Maintain accurate inventory data within relevant ERP and inventory systems. Assist with the preparation of information and data required for inventory KPIs and performance reporting. Compliance & Process Improvement Ensure inventory activities are completed in accordance with company policies, procedures, contractual requirements and applicable quality and regulatory standards. Maintain appropriate documentation and records to support inventory transactions, reconciliations and audit requirements. Identify and escalate process gaps, recurring issues or opportunities to improve inventory accuracy and efficiency. Support inventory-related process improvements, system enhancements and automation initiatives. Work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Warehouse and other relevant teams to support effective inventory management. Foster clear and timely communication with internal stakeholders and customers in relation to inventory queries and activities. Ensure compliance with Company QMS policies and applicable quality standards, including ISO requirements. Education / Experience Requirements Fluency in English …

items.desc: Vuoi imparare un nuovo mestiere e costruire il tuo futuro nel mondo dell’estetica? GENTILUOMO ESTETICA INVESTE SU DI TE! Cerchi un lavoro che ti permetta di imparare, crescere professionalmente e costruire qualcosa di stabile nel tempo? Gentiluomo Estetica ti offre l’opportunità di imparare sul campo, con una formazione pratica e un percorso pensato per accompagnarti nella crescita professionale. CHI SIAMO Gentiluomo Estetica è un centro specializzato nell’estetica maschile, che mette al centro la qualità dei trattamenti, la cura del cliente e l’attenzione ai risultati. Crediamo che le persone siano una parte fondamentale del progetto aziendale. Per questo vogliamo investire nella formazione di chi entra nel nostro team, trasmettendo un metodo di lavoro strutturato e offrendo l’opportunità di crescere insieme all’attività. Non cerchiamo semplicemente qualcuno che copra dei turni: vogliamo conoscere una persona che abbia voglia di mettersi in gioco e costruire un percorso professionale concreto. RICERCHIAMO UNA PERSONA DA FORMARE NEL SETTORE DELL’ESTETICA Sede di lavoro: Valle d’Aosta – Pollein COSA FARAI CON NOI Entrerai in un ambiente professionale in cui potrai imparare gradualmente il mestiere di estetista specializzata, affiancata dalla responsabile tecnica e dal team. Durante il tuo percorso ti occuperai progressivamente di: Apprendere il metodo di lavoro e gli standard qualitativi di Gentiluomo Estetica. Conoscere i trattamenti e i servizi dedicati all’estetica maschile. Imparare a utilizzare le tecnologie e le attrezzature del centro, secondo la formazione ricevuta e le mansioni consentite. Collaborare alla preparazione e alla gestione degli appuntamenti. Accogliere i clienti e contribuire a creare un’esperienza professionale e curata. Imparare a mantenere elevati standard di ordine, igiene e organizzazione degli spazi. Le attività saranno assegnate progressivamente, in base alla formazione, alle competenze acquisite e ai requisiti professionali necessari. PERCHÉ SCEGLIERE GENTILUOMO ESTETICA? 1. Impari facendo Ti offriamo un percorso di formazione pratica della durata prevista di sei mesi, durante il quale potrai conoscere il settore direttamente sul campo, con il supporto del nostro team. 2. Puoi avvicinarti a un nuovo settore professionale Se desideri cambiare lavoro o intraprendere un percorso diverso, questa può essere un’occasione per acquisire competenze senza dover necessariamente iniziare da subito un tradizionale percorso scolastico. 3. Hai tempo per imparare davvero Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia già fare tutto. Il percorso è pensato per accompagnarti gradualmente nell’apprendimento del nostro metodo di lavoro. 4. Un lavoro che lascia spazio alla tua vita personale La proposta è part-time, con un’organizzazione dei turni pensata per favorire un buon equilibrio tra lavoro e tempo libero. Il centro prevede due giorni consecutivi di riposo settimanale. 5. Un’opportunità che guarda al futuro I sei mesi non sono pensati come un’esperienza fine a sé stessa. Vogliamo investire nella formazione di una persona che possa entrare stabilmente nel team. Al termine del percorso, in caso di reciproca soddisfazione, è prevista la prospettiva di un inserimento lavorativo con un eventuale ampliamento dell’orario. COSA CERCHIAMO Più che un curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo una persona con le caratteristiche giuste per affrontare un percorso di crescita. Ci piacerebbe conoscerti se: Sei una persona seria, affidabile e responsabile. Hai voglia di imparare e sei disponibile a metterti in gioco. Sei precisa, ordinata e attenta alla cura degli ambienti. Ti piace lavorare a contatto con le persone e offrire un servizio di qualità. Cerchi un’opportunità professionale e desideri costruire un percorso nel tempo. Sei disponibile a seguire la formazione e a imparare il nostro metodo di lavoro. L’esperienza pregressa nel settore è un plus, ma non rappresenta necessariamente un requisito indispensabile: valuteremo anche persone motivate a intraprendere un nuovo percorso professionale, compatibilmente con i requisiti richiesti per le diverse mansioni. CONDIZIONI DELLA PROPOSTA Tipologia: percorso iniziale di formazione pratica, con prospettiva di inserimento. Durata del percorso iniziale: fino a sei mesi, secondo la formula contrattuale. Orario: part-time, indicativamente 20–24 ore settimanali. Retribuzione/compenso: 10.000-12.000€ annui. Prospettive: possibilità di proseguire il rapporto e un ampliamento dell’orario. La formula contrattuale, il trattamento economico e le condizioni definitive saranno illustrati durante il colloquio. TI RICONOSCI IN QUESTA OPPORTUNITÀ? Se hai voglia di cambiare, imparare qualcosa di nuovo e costruire un percorso professionale concreto nel mondo dell'estetica, ci piacerebbe conoscerti. Non devi necessariamente avere già tutte le risposte: quello che conta è la voglia di imparare, la serietà con cui affronti il lavoro e il desiderio di crescere. Over the years we have also gained great experience in the world of blockchain (digital assets, DLT) and artificial intelligence. We believe our main competitive advantage is having a team made of young talents who have a strong passion for technology. We treat every project for our customers with the same care we have for our own projects and we constantly try to improve our processes to achieve the best possible results. We are based in Rome, between Trastevere and San Pietro neighbourhoods. The main market segments we work in are: mobility and transportation, banking and finance, public administration and defence. Job description This job position is aimed at Product Designers with 2-4 years of experience. At our company, a Product Designer is expected to own the design process end-to-end: from discovery and user research, through interaction design and prototyping, up to high-fidelity UI and the handoff to engineering. We are glad to hire designers who are stronger on one side of this spectrum, as long as they are comfortable with the whole process and willing to grow on the parts they are less familiar with. We are looking for a person who is strongly goal-oriented and able to reason analytically. Before opening Figma, this profile dedicates the right amount of time to understanding the problem: who the users are, what the business needs, and which technical and regulatory constraints apply. We work on projects in mobility, banking and public administration, where a flow that is unclear or not accessible has a real cost for real people. We expect you to make your design decisions explicit and traceable, so that developers, delivery managers and clients can understand and challenge them. A very important skill for us is the ability to evaluate your own work, test it with users and iterate when the evidence says so. You will work autonomously on features and projects of medium complexity, and alongside our senior designers on the most complex ones. We expect you to grow towards full ownership of projects, and to share what you learn with the rest of the team. Discovery You will plan and run discovery activities proportionate to each project: stakeholder interviews, user interviews, usability tests, analysis of existing data and benchmarks. You will turn findings into clear artifacts that the whole team can use to make decisions. Interaction & UI Design You will design user flows, information architecture, wireframes and interactive prototypes, then bring them to polished, high-fidelity UI for both web and mobile. Our engineers often model frontend logic with state machines, so we value designers who think in states, edge cases, empty and error states, not only in happy paths. Design Systems & Delivery You will build, maintain or adopt design systems, depending on the project. You will work side by side with frontend engineers during implementation, reviewing what gets built and making sure the final product matches the intended experience. Designing with and for AI We use AI tools to speed up our workflow (research synthesis, rapid prototyping, exploration of alternatives, UI design, building and maintaining design systems) and we design AI-powered products for our clients and for our Innovation business unit. We expect you to use these tools with judgement, and to be curious about the specific challenges of designing for AI: uncertain outputs, trust, transparency and graceful failure states. Process Step 1 - Portfolio & CV review We will review the portfolio you submit with your application. We are not looking for pretty screens only: we want to understand the problems you worked on, your role in the team, the decisions you made and their impact. If your best work is under NDA, feel free to anonymize it or describe it in words. In case your portfolio is in line with what we are looking for, you will be moved to the next recruitment step. Step 2 - Let's get to know each other In this second step, you will have a short call with one of our recruiters, who will present our company. They will also ask you to briefly discuss your background, your previous experience and your expectations. At this stage, feel free to ask any question about our company and the job position! items.desc: We’re looking for a Mask Design Engineer who combines strong technical skills with a passion for automation, ownership, and customer impact. Meet the Team Our Design Enablement team bridges process development, device design, and PIC circuit design. We provide the tools and workflows that help customers turn their ideas into manufacturable photonic integrated circuits. You’ll join a team of 10 motivated engineers and report to the Cluster Lead and Principal Scientist. Your Mission Own and improve the end-to-end tape-out flow for SMART Photonics’ PIC platforms. You’ll execute tape-outs, understand the full post-processing chain, and take ownership of your deliverables. But this role goes beyond running scripts: you’ll make them smarter. Working alongside your colleagues, you’ll automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and build robust, reusable tools—while staying hands-on with tape-out execution. Key Responsibilities Tape-Out Execution Execute end-to-end tape-outs, from super-cell and PCM generation to GDS validation and mask ordering. Prepare and validate GDS files for mask production. Run Design Rule Checks (DRC) and ensure manufacturing compliance. Script Development Develop and maintain Python- and Ruby-based post-processing scripts. Build modular, reusable, platform-independent tools. Develop utilities that support tape-out workflows and mask-set users. Automation & Continuous Improvement Identify and automate repetitive, error-prone manual tasks. Implement CI validation and regression testing against platform reference files. Create reproducible development environments and automated checks. Improve repository structure, naming conventions, and Git workflows. Document solutions so the whole team can understand, maintain, and build on them. Collaboration Review colleagues’ code for quality, correctness, and maintainability. Work with Process Integration, R&D, Metrology, and Procurement. Coordinate with EDA, PDK, and IT engineers on tooling and infrastructure. And, of course, there’s Burrito Friday. You’ll help streamline tape-outs and we’ll help streamline your route to the burrito queue. Job requirements MSc in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Photonics, or a related field. At least 2 years of industrial design experience outside academia, ideally in a foundry, PIC design house, EDA provider, or customer-facing design enablement role. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to build trust and support leadership. Proactive mindset, eager to learn new tools, methods, and industry best practices. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Proficient in Python scripting. Working knowledge of Git and version control. Familiarity with GDS-II and layout tools such as KLayout or Nazca. Automation mindset: always looking for opportunities to replace repetitive manual tasks with scripts. We offer: Competitive salary, discussed during the first interview. Freedom, ownership, and real impact in a fast-growing high-tech environment. Cutting-edge photonic technologies and modelling tools. A highly customer-facing role with an international team of experts. Room to grow through training, coaching, and hands-on experience. How we create a safe work environment together. Security is a shared responsibility. At SMART Photonics, we are committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace, where everyone is treated fairly. Together, we protect our people, information, technology, and operations. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Tønsberg Søknadsfrist 19.11.2026 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Sektor Privat Er du Anleggsleder som trives med ansvar, korte beslutningsveier og et sterkt fagmiljø? WK Entreprenør søker en erfaren anleggsleder til avdelingen i Tønsberg. Vi ser etter deg som liker å være tett på produksjonen, ligger i forkant og skaper fremdrift gjennom god planlegging, tydelig ledelse og godt samarbeid. Som anleggsleder får du en sentral rolle i den daglige gjennomføringen av prosjektene. Du samarbeider tett med prosjektleder, prosjektingeniører og formenn, og sørger for at mennesker, materialer og arbeidsunderlag er på plass når de trengs. Du skal ha oversikt over det som skjer på byggeplassen, fange opp utfordringer tidlig og sørge for at produksjonen gjennomføres trygt, effektivt og med riktig kvalitet. Dine viktigste oppgaver blir å: Lede og koordinere egne medarbeidere og underentreprenører. Utarbeide og følge opp fremdriftsplaner, bemanning og ressursbehov. Følge opp HMS, kvalitet og avvik i prosjektet. Sikre nødvendige tegninger, arbeidsunderlag og avklaringer før arbeidene starter. Følge opp innkjøp og bidra til økonomistyring og kostnadskontroll sammen med prosjektleder. Identifisere og følge opp endringer og behov for varsling. Delta i og lede relevante drifts- og byggemøter. Bidra med praktisk gjennomføringskompetanse i kalkulasjon og tidligfasearbeid. Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring fra entreprenørvirksomhet og som kjenner den daglige driften på en byggeplass godt. Du har erfaring med å lede og følge opp produksjon, koordinere flere fag og sørge for at planene faktisk blir omsatt til god gjennomføring ute på byggeplassen. Du trives med ansvar og liker å være tett på både menneskene og produksjonen. Det er naturlig for deg å ligge noen steg foran, se hva som kommer og ta tak i utfordringer før der påvirker fremdriften. Vi ønsker at du har: Relevant høyere utdanning innen bygg eller tilsvarende. Bachelor- eller mastergrad er ønskelig, mens teknisk fagskole kan være aktuelt i kombinasjon med lengre relevant erfaring. Flere års erfaring fra ledelse og oppfølging av produksjon på byggeplass. Erfaring fra eksempelvis boligprosjekter, næringsbygg, offentlige bygg eller rehabilitering. God forståelse for byggeprosesser, kontrakter og oppfølging av kvalitet og HMS. Gjerne erfaring med betong- og trekonstruksjoner. Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig. Som person er du tydelig, selvstendig og trygg på å stille krav. Du planlegger fremover, tar tak i utfordringer og følger opp det som er avtalt. items.title: Middle Creative Designer
items.card: Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів
items.desc: Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Middle Creative Designer, щоб разом піднімати планку результату. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: Ideation — генерація візуальної складової креативів на основі технічних задач команди маркетингу; Production — розробка статичних та відео-креативів для просування продукту у рекламних мережах (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube); Cooperation — тісна співпраця з маркетинговим відділом, обговорення ідей та покращення існуючих креативів; Experiments — тестування нових інструментів, ефектів, плагінів, створення шаблонів для більш ефективної роботи; Creative research — аналіз рекламних матеріалів конкурентів та соціальних мереж для відстеження світових тенденцій у дизайні; Analytics — аналіз креативів та побудова гіпотез на основі їхніх результатів. Що для нас важливо: Практичні знання After Effects, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator; Практичний досвід з монтажу відео; Вміння створювати шаблони у Figma, працювати з компонентами та бібліотеками; Знання AI-інструментів: Midjourney, Higgsfield, Elevenlabs, Runway, HeyGen, Kling AI, ComfyUI та подібних; Досвід роботи з плагінами: Animation Composer, GifGun 2, AEUX та подібними; Глибоке розуміння принципів дизайну, композиції, типографіки та колористики; Високий рівень креативності та здатність генерувати ідеї, що відповідають потребам користувачів і бізнесу; Вміння аргументовано відстоювати своє бачення і приймати самостійні рішення; Грамотний тайм-менеджмент: вміння планувати завантаження і працювати з дедлайнами. Буде перевагою: Комерційний досвід від 1 року; Знання Blender, Cinema 4D та Premiere Pro. Тобі точно до нас, якщо ти: Не боїшся швидкого темпу роботи й великої кількості експериментів; Чуєш фідбек і прагнеш до швидкого професійного зростання; Готовий брати на себе відповідальність за результат. Що ти отримаєш разом з нами: — Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: маркетинг, розробка, фінанси, рекрутинг; — Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій; — Просторі та сучасні офіси у Києві та Варшаві; — Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: SKELAR Platform . Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів. Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!
