items.desc: Location: Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland Job ID: R0147163 Date Posted: 2026-10-20 Company Name: HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O. Profession (Job Category): General Management Job Schedule: Full time Remote: No Job Description: As an Emerging Technology Solution Architect within Hitachi Energy’s Innovation-as-a-Service function, you will perform architectural analysis and assess high-level solution designs for emerging technologies and innovative market solutions. You will evaluate how innovative technologies fit into the company’s architecture, how they can be integrated and scaled, and what their adoption would mean in a complex enterprise environment. You will work with internal stakeholders to ensure an appropriate fit and reuse of current assets, and with external vendors to understand their solutions in the context of architectural assessment. Your work will be proactive and reactive, depending on the innovation services provided. This role requires an understanding of emerging technologies and technology trends and the ability to stay up to date, particularly in artificial intelligence and other emerging technology areas. You will combine this knowledge with an understanding of business challenges and the outcomes that new technologies might bring. You will translate innovation ideas into concrete architectural assessments, solution design sketches, and integration options. Your work will provide technically grounded inputs for clear, actionable recommendations, ensuring that proposed solution paths are realistic and aligned with Hitachi Energy’s target architecture. This role connects emerging technologies and innovative solutions with other architecture and technology departments within Hitachi Energy. Alongside this work, you will collaborate with architecture, technology validation, and prototyping specialists and document architectural insights from completed assessments, contributing to reusable patterns and shared knowledge repositories. The focus is on internal enterprise innovation, not customer-facing products. How you’ll make an impact Assess the architectural fit, integration feasibility, and enterprise design implications of emerging technologies and market solutions for innovation topics accepted for assessment. Translate your findings into concise architecture compatibility assessments that support clear technology recommendations. Develop high-level solution design sketches and integration approach options, ensuring proposed solution paths are realistic and enterprise-grade. Provide these as architectural inputs to innovation recommendation packages. Coordinate with Hitachi Energy architects to ensure assessments and proposed solution approaches align with Hitachi Energy’s target architecture standards and approved reference patterns. Investigate the platform and application landscape to avoid duplication and ensure an appropriate fit with existing and onboarded solutions including build-vs-buy-vs-reuse considerations and high-level cost implications. Outline architecture options where a proof of concept or further investigation is recommended. Define the architectural guardrails and constraints for proposed proofs of concept. Identify potential security, data, or compliance considerations early and involve the relevant expert teams where needed. Engage with external vendors and startups to understand their solutions and evaluate them against architectural, integration, and scalability criteria. Participate in preparing recommendation packages, contributing architecture-specific findings, risks, and constraints relevant to next-step decisions. Document architectural insights and solution design lessons from completed innovation assessments. Contribute to architecture knowledge repositories and reusable pattern libraries where applicable. Your background At least five years of professional experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, AI/ML platform design, or cloud architecture in a complex enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience assessing emerging technologies from an architectural perspective, with the ability to develop high-level solution design sketches and integration approach options. Experience working with ambiguous, early-stage innovation topics and translating them into concrete architectural inputs and recommendations. Experience collaborating across innovation, architecture, and delivery stakeholder communities, supported by strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Familiarity with AI/ML architecture patterns, large language model integration, cloud-native design, and enterprise integration standards. Understanding of target architecture concepts and architectural guardrails. Strong strategic conceptual thinking skills and Strong ability to prepare architectural outputs that are clear and understandable to other teams. items.desc: Created in 2009, ESSP is a young and dynamic company, a pan European service provider, certified by EASA (the European Union Aviation Safety Agency) to deliver safety-critical services. ESSP Corporate Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_FKtcaN8YE ESSP Website career: https://www.essp-sas.eu/human-resources/careers/ We are looking for a Service Adoption Engineer who will contribute to the definition and implementation of EGNOS adoption and promotion activities within the aviation sector. Promotion activities for adoption of EGNOS navigation services by European aviation stakeholders; Technical support to aircraft operators for their upgrade to SBAS capabilities; Promotion activities towards the adoption of the EGNOS navigation services in other market segments, eg. Maritime, Rail, Drones, etc. Support to engagement activities including ad-hoc meetings with users/stakeholders and participation to workshops and events/webinars; Contributing to promotion activities and material (e.g. EGNOS Bulletin, success stories, news, leaflets, scripts for promotional videos, guidelines, presentations…); Supporting the identification and procurement of suitable tools or commercial licenses capable of supporting the established marketing/adoption requirements; Contributing to the maintenance of the aviation EGNOS implementation database, for aerodromes, operators and avionics, following the methodology in place. Supporting the definition and exploitation of technical and market tools to foster CNS adoption, in particular in the aviation market segment, for example: o EGNOS-based simulators and other CNS demonstrators, o Cost-Benefit Analysis and Market Studies. Profile: Knowledge of the GNSS sector, ideally gained through consulting, innovation projects, European projects, or activities related to EGNOS/Galileo and positioning applications - Familiarized with the aeronautical domain (SES – Single European Sky - regulation and ANSP operations, PBN - Performance Based Navigation -, avionics installations) Analytical skills to conduct market research and cost-benefit analyses Understanding of satellite-based CNS technologies, mainly SBAS/Navigation and also Communication and Surveillance Knowledge of EGNOS Services and GNSS applications Strong communication, presentation, and customer and stakeholder relationship skills Good capacity for analysis and synthesis Strong autonomy and proactiveness Ability to assume responsibilities Team player spirit - Very good level of English (B2- C1) – CEFR Job requirements: Engineering degree or equivalent in (aerospace, telecommunications), science, business, or related disciplines Available for regular travel mainly in Europe Human Resources information: 1st interview is held by the direct manager of the position you applied for (technical interview) 2nd interview is held by HR department Element of package of remuneration: Variable : bonuses based on objectives Teleworking : up to 3 days/week Health insurance, Life Insurance Saving plan Tickets Restaurant Sustainable Mobility Package : Home/Office travels reimbursement if car sharing or bicycling 29 holidays (for full-time year) Please send your application file only by email to the following address: recrut@essp-sas.eu Job Location : Madrid (Spain) Type of Contract : Full time - Permanent Contract

items.desc: Verisure is seeking a talented, innovative, passionate Data Scientist. The role will part of a growing and talented Technology Team and will report directly into our North QA Manager and will work closely together with the Field Quality Portfolio Manager. Technology plays an important role in our value creation. It is at the core of the service and operations we provide to our customers. It is what enables our people to do our job, protecting what matters most. But it is also at the heart of our future value creation. It is at the core of the new services we will offer, building on our legacy of value accretive innovation through deploying world-class products and services. Our Technology objectives for the coming years are ambitious. We must continue to support our countries and customers with secured and world-class quality, service and product performance. We must lead in product and service innovation and increase our innovation pace. We need to support our ambitious growth in customers and geographies. For this, we must provide key capabilities, Key talent and tools supporting business efficiency and commercial priorities. We offer As a Portfolio Data Scientist in the QA team you will use your programming and problem-solving skills to define, design and implement analysis and insight tools, converting data to communicated insights. You will support members of the QA team to analyze data and work actively to identify, model, solve, visualize, and deploy insight requests for key areas of Verisure portfolio. Your role will be both strategic and hands-on development and implementation. You will be using your scientific knowledge and engineering skills to prepare data from multiple sources into aggregated data sets, and to analyze large volumes of complex data. You will work and experiment with the data using machine learning and data mining technologies as well as classical statistics. You will work in collaboration with other scientists and engineers across Verisure to model, design, and build creative analytics solutions (on prem and in cloud) to serve the needs of the North QA team. You will present, communicate and share your insights and learning. You will consult other teams and functions to formulate the right questions with regard to what value machine learning and AI can add in a given situation. You will be based in Alicante at our new Technology Hub. The position reports to the Manager of the North QA team. Key deliverable You will complement our skilled, curious and humble quality assurance team on analytical topics incl., hypothesis testing, anomaly detection, large data analysis, creation of reports/ dashboards, data-driven portfolio improvement programs, etc. You will be a key support for the QA team to actively monitor performance of the product in the field, creating and leveraging data dashboards for key incoming issues from operations teams in the countries Additionally, you will suggest corrective actions in the case they are needed and maintain a set of pro-active suggestions to be implemented to improve portfolio performance What you bring You have a degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, or related area in which statistics and complex analysis are core skills. Experience working as a data scientist or in a data analyst role will be a plus (esp., experience working within the analytics chain: from raw data, data analysis and feature engineering, to stable, deployed models using which end users make better decisions). You are comfortable working with classical statistics (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, recognizing classical distributions, etc.). You have experience of data analysis tools on a daily basis, such as R, SQL, or similar. PowerBI knowledge will be highly valuable as you will be also working on the presentation/ reporting layer. We believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place. Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people, we offer a great opportunity to personal development with an environment characterized by humbleness and knowledge sharing and to enhance the on the job training we have a training budget to ensure personal growth. We are looking forward to your application!

As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. Understanding of observability, tracing, and metric visualization (Prometheus, Grafana). Practical familiarity with Xcode and Android Studio, a clear understanding of the native bridge / NitroModules, and native integration.

items.desc: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The role Legora is growing fast, and we’re building a Financial Systems team that owns the systems behind our billing, revenue and accounting, and we’re looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to build the integrations that connect them. Your job is to make our financial data flow reliably between CRM, CPQ, ERP and whatever comes next. That means replacing manual and fragile processes with systems that Finance can trust. This is a hands-on engineering role with a lot of autonomy, close to the business. You’ll work directly with Finance, Accounting and RevOps, and you’ll understand not just how the systems connect but why: how we book transactions, how revenue is recognised over time, and what the accounting team needs to close the books with confidence. What You Will Be Doing Build and own the integration platform that keeps our financial systems in sync: CRM, CPQ, ERP and more to come. Correctness is non-negotiable, and every bug has a number attached to it. Design and ship event-driven services end to end: APIs, reconciliation pipelines, queues and more. Write idempotent, resumable sync logic against third-party SaaS APIs you don’t control, handling partial failures, retries, out-of-order events and concurrency. Work in Python and Azure, with infrastructure as code in TypeScript (Pulumi). Own the deployment path: GitHub Actions CI/CD across dev, test and prod with gated environments, plus the observability that goes with it. Write the tests that make the system safe to change, including unit and contract tests against recorded fixtures. Work directly with Finance and RevOps to turn billing and revenue requirements into systems they trust, and debug with them when reality disagrees with the data. Contribute to architecture decisions as the integration surface grows (new systems, entities and flows) without turning the codebase into a pile of special cases. Who You Are You have 3+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, not just shipping features into one. You’re strong in Python, and comfortable enough in TypeScript to own infrastructure code (or keen to learn). You have hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs from SaaS applications, and you’ve moved and transformed data between them. You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

items.desc: Gillar du att se helheten, hitta smarta tekniska lösningar och påverka hur framtidens uppkopplade tjänster utvecklas? Den känslan lever vi för. Nu letar vi efter en Senior Solution Architect med erfarenhet inom Connectivity som vill ta en central roll i att forma skalbara, säkra och långsiktiga lösningar inom fordonsindustrin. Vill du ta ditt konsultande till nästa nivå hos en av Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare? Ja, vi vet vad du tänker. Du har hört det förut. Men tro oss, det har du inte. Sök jobbet och kolla själv! Vi söker dig som vill påverka mer än bara tekniska lösningar och som tycker att konsultlivet blir som bäst när frihet, kompetens och schyssta kollegor går hand i hand. Vem är du? Du är en erfaren lösningsarkitekt med bred teknisk förståelse och ett intresse för hur teknik och verksamhet möts. Du trivs med att se helheten, identifiera möjligheter och omsätta komplexa behov till genomtänkta tekniska lösningar. Du är trygg i att driva arkitekturfrågor, diskutera tekniska vägval och samarbeta med både utvecklingsteam och verksamhet. Du gillar att dela med dig av din kunskap, skapa samsyn och bidra till att utveckla både lösningar och arbetssätt. Rollen ️ Som senior lösningsarkitekt får du en central roll hos en av våra kunder i Göteborg, där du arbetar med utvecklingen av avancerade digitala tjänster och uppkopplade lösningar. Du blir en del av en tekniskt avancerad miljö där du samarbetar nära produktägare, utvecklare, kravanalytiker och andra arkitekter. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, driva arkitekturfrågor och bidra till den långsiktiga tekniska utvecklingen. Du kommer att: Ta fram arkitekturlösningar och tekniska underlag, från övergripande systemdesign till detaljerade integrationsflöden och databasmodeller. Designa skalbara lösningar med microservices och moderna molntekniker. Säkerställa att säkerhet, prestanda och långsiktig hållbarhet finns med i arkitekturen. Omsätta verksamhetens behov till tydliga tekniska lösningar och stötta utvecklingsteamen i implementationen. Bidra till arkitekturstrategier, tekniska roadmaps och utvecklingen av gemensamma arbetssätt. Utforska och driva användningen av AI och nya teknologier samt vid behov leda tvärfunktionella arkitekturinitiativ. Erfarenhet Vi söker dig som har: Minst 10 års erfarenhet inom IT, varav minst 5 år som Solution Architect eller motsvarande. Erfarenhet av att leda arkitekturarbete och driva tekniska beslut. Erfarenhet av Telematics eller Connectivity. God förståelse för microservicesarkitektur och distribuerade system. Erfarenhet av att designa applikationer för hög belastning och arbeta med prestandaoptimering. Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, SAFe och DevSecOps. Kunskap inom Java, Spring Boot, JMS och Linux. Kunskap om nätverksteknik, relationsdatabaser och NoSQL. Kunskap inom molnteknik, gärna AWS eller Azure, samt serverless. Du är trygg i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift, då flera uppdrag kräver det i det dagliga samarbetet med kund. I den här rollen är det viktigt att du är trygg i att leda arkitekturarbete, förankra tekniska vägval och skapa samsyn mellan verksamhet och utvecklingsteam. Samtidigt vet vi att ingen checkar varje box. Känner du igen dig i det mesta? Då tycker vi definitivt att du ska söka. Varför Castra? What’s in it for you? Vi tror att de bästa konsulterna förtjänar den bästa arbetsplatsen. Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT och management där medarbetarna har möjlighet till delägarskap. Det betyder att vi inte bara bygger lösningar åt våra kunder, vi är också med och bygger det företag vi själva vill jobba på. Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Du påverkar vilka uppdrag du tar, hur du vill utvecklas och du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Hos oss får alla vara med forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en. Vi tror att när människor får förtroende, inflytande och rätt förutsättningar gör de sitt absolut bästa. Vår vision är att bli Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Och vi är stolta över vår kultur, men det är faktiskt inte bara vi som säger det. Castra har varit certifierat av Great Place to Work sedan 2017 och har flera gånger utsetts till en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser. Lägg därtill engagerade kollegor, skickliga säljare, närvarande ledare och ett nätverk av några av branschens vassaste konsulter, då har du en arbetsplats där möjligheterna är nästan obegränsade. Castra har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro, Jönköping och Sundsvall. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss på castra.se/konsulterbjudande/ Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! items.desc: About Us Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it. Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on. Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development. We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us. IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries. About the Role As a Software Test Engineer, your primary focus will be on test execution and test automation. You will design, implement, and evolve testing strategies that ensure product quality from early development to release. You will work closely with development teams to improve testability, identify risks early, and build confidence in every release through effective automation and integration testing. You will act as a quality advocate across teams, supporting engineers with best practices, tools, and frameworks while helping shift testing efforts toward scalable, automated solutions. What You'll Do Perform and contribute to release testing, verifying end‑to‑end functionality and validating that releases meet agreed‑upon quality criteria. Design, develop, and execute high‑quality test plans and test cases for both manual and automated testing, with strong emphasis on testing across components and services. Build, maintain, and continuously improve test automation frameworks and contribute to automated testing within CI/CD pipelines. Supporting development teams in adopting effective testing strategies, including unit and integration testing. Identifying risks, defects, and quality gaps early, and communicating them clearly to stakeholders. Collaborating in planning, design, and requirement discussions to ensure quality is built into solutions from the start. Improving test frameworks, documentation, and processes to enhance long-term efficiency and reliability. Supporting troubleshooting, debugging, and incident analysis across development and release cycles. What You Bring to the Table You are a collaborative and quality-driven engineer who works closely with developers and stakeholders to improve outcomes, not just processes. You proactively communicate, share knowledge, and help teams adopt practical and effective testing approaches. You take a holistic view of quality, focusing on integration, system behavior, and real-world usage rather than isolated test cases. You are pragmatic, continuously improving systems step by step instead of waiting for perfect solutions. Experience in software testing with a strong focus on integration testing and automation. Hands-on experience with Python and/or Ruby for test automation. Familiarity with test frameworks such as Pytest, Squish, or similar tools. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) and development tools like GitLab, Jira, or Artifactory. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify risks and dependencies early. Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and influence quality practices. Conversational Swedish and fluency in English, both spoken and written. Bonus Points For.... Experience testing C++ software and understanding of C++ code. Familiarity with embedded systems, compilers, or tool chains. Experience with build systems such as CMake. Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are. Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too. Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs. Du har förståelse för samspelet mellan hårdvara och mjukvara och erfarenhet av att utveckla robusta och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar. Vi söker dig som har arbetat med den här typen av system i en produktorienterad teknisk verksamhet, snarare än enbart med generella IT-lösningar eller fristående applikationsutveckling. Som konsult på Sylog får du möjlighet att arbeta med tekniskt utmanande uppdrag hos ledande företag. Du blir en del av ett kompetent nätverk av specialister inom embedded och får möjlighet att påverka både dina uppdrag och din fortsatta kompetensutveckling. Vi erbjuder full transparens kring uppdragsmöjligheter, timtaxor och karriärvägar. Vi tror på en hållbar balans mellan arbete och privatliv och vill skapa förutsättningar för att du ska kunna utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som är en erfaren embeddedutvecklare med ett genuint tekniskt intresse och som vill bidra med din kompetens i utvecklingen av avancerade tekniska system. Erfarenhet från ett företag som utvecklar egna fysiska, tekniska produkter och system där mjukvara och hårdvara samverkar. Goda kunskaper inom C, C++ eller andra relevanta programmeringsspråk för embeddedutveckling. Erfarenhet av Linux, realtidssystem eller säkerhetskritiska system. Relevant högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, elektroteknik eller elektronik, alternativt motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift. Meriterande Erfarenhet från exempelvis fordonsindustrin, försvar, radar- och sensorsystem, marina system, järnväg eller industriell automation. Hos oss får du stor möjlighet att påverka din situation – från val av uppdrag och arbetssätt till arbetstid och kompetensutveckling. Vi värdesätter både din specialistkompetens och din personlighet och vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna gemenskap med dina kollegor. Utöver spännande teknik och utmanande uppdrag skapar vi gemenskap genom bland annat after works, aktivitetsveckor, föreläsningar, konferenser och utbildningar. Nordnet is customer-focused and product-led. We are now seeking an experienced Product Owner to lead our teams working closely with Customer Risk within the Product Platform area. You translate regulation into products that are compliant by design, efficient for our operations teams and as smooth as possible for our customers. On a daily basis, you work with a skilled, AI-first engineering team, our FCP experts, Compliance, and the teams that work on customer sign-up and customer data. Roadmap ownership: Lead the team roadmap by defining feature scope and prioritizing deliverables in collaboration with business owners and stakeholders. Stakeholder communication: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders regarding roadmap progress, changes, and potential blockers. Risk & compliance: Proactively identify and mitigate product risks while ensuring all features meet stringent regulatory and legal standards. Engineering leadership: Guide development teams through complex technical problem-solving to deliver impactful products and a high-performance user experience. This is you You have built products in, or worked closely with, FCP, and you care about why the rules exist, not just what they say. You have an interest within savings and investments and you have previous working knowledge and experience from digital product development within the financial service sector. You are comfortable saying "not now" and explaining why. You take a "low-ego, high-impact" approach. You take ownership of outcomes, stay calm and structured under pressure, and make the people around you better by sharing what you know. You have: A minimum of 3-5 years of experience as product owner or similar role within onboarding, risk assessment, customer due diligence or FCP in a bank, broker, fintech, payments company, consultancy or RegTech provider. Passion for creating smooth customer journeys, even where regulation adds friction. Ability to navigate the complex, competitive, and regulated finance landscape High personal initiative with a natural ability to lead by example, inspire others, and drive results We offer Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. You will become part of a journey that has only just begun towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. We’re over 1000 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Germany. Since November 2020, Nordnet (SAVE) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm main market with a market capitalization of SEK91bn. This role is based in Stockholm with the working language English Visit us on: www.nordnetab.com, www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk, www.nordnet.fi, www.nordnet.de Application If you have questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linnea Liljedahl, Linnea.liljedahl@nordnet.se Apply today – we will start interviewing immediately. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered. Security Analyst We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Security Analyst to join our team in a fast-paced software house environment. In this role, your primary focus will be clearing the backlog of Application, Governance and Assurance Pack (AGAPs) required under our Security by Design (SbD) framework for all products owned by TLSE and Live Services. You will act as the key facilitator and bridge across multiple technical functions; gathering, synthesising, and validating architectural, infrastructure, and operational security data. Your work will ensure that the products across our portfolio are fully documented, assessed, and aligned with security standards and governance policies. Key Responsibilities Systematically review, prioritise, and clear the backlog of AGAP assessments required across the portfolio of TLSE-owned software products. Proactively collaborate with TLSE, Live Services, Hosting Services, the Tech Office, and Software Developers to extract, verify, and consolidate technical security data needed to populate each AGAP. Identify, assess and document product architectures, data flows and hosting models, validating alignment with established SbD guidance and escalating issues where required. Identify missing security controls, unmitigated risks, assurance gaps or architectural concerns and provide recommendations, escalating findings to relevant stakeholders where required. Maintain complete, audit-ready AGAP documentation within central security repositories and track remediation actions to completion. Gather insights from the review process to provide constructive feedback to the Tech Office on streamlining SbD workflows and AGAP templates. Conduct application assurance reviews. Analyse existing assurance documentation and evidence. Identify gaps against Secure by Design requirements. Work with Service Owners, Product Teams and SMEs to discover, capture and document application, infrastructure, security and operational information where existing documentation is incomplete, outdated or unavailable. Gather, analyse and organise evidence required to support AGAP completion, assurance reviews and Secure by Design activities. Maintain assurance evidence repositories, track remediation actions and support governance and audit activities. Document findings, risks and remediation activities. Support tracking and reporting of assurance status across the portfolio. Requirements Must haves: 3+ years in information security, application security analysis, cybersecurity compliance, or IT risk management within a software development or SaaS environment. Practical understanding of Security by Design (SbD) concepts, threat modelling principles, and application security baselines (e.g., OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST). Familiarity with modern software development lifecycles (SDLC), cloud hosting platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and production service operations. Excellent stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to translate technical conversations with developers and engineers into structured security documentation. Methodical mindset with sharp attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex software ecosystems and systematically identifying governance gaps. Experience of MOD Secure by Design. Cyber assurance and risk management. Analysis of technical and security documentation. Stakeholder engagement and evidence gathering. Production of assurance artefacts and supporting documentation. Nice to haves: Relevant industry certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CISA, CRISC, or cloud security badges (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty). Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or automated GRC tools used for managing security backlogs and risk registers. Prior experience working in an Agile/Scrum software house setup. items.desc: This is a four-year (1+3 MRes/PhD) studentship funded through the Cambridge EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Future Infrastructure and Built Environment: Unlocking Net Zero (FIBE3 CDT). Further details can be found at https://www.net-zero-fibe-cdt.eng.cam.ac.uk/ The project is funded in collaboration with National Highways. National Highways is the UK government company which plans, designs, builds, operates and maintains England's motorways and major A-roads, known as the strategic road network. Due to geological abundance of its constituents, and its strength and resilience, concrete is used widely across National Highway's strategic road network in both ancillary and primary structures. However, conventional ordinary Portland cement concrete is carbon intensive so any new construction must have embodied carbon reduction at the fore and, wherever possible, the lifetime of existing infrastructure must be extended. In parallel, external weather demands on concrete during placement, and in service, are escalating due to climate change. This project therefore has elements of both concrete climate change mitigation, and adaptation. One particular area of uncertainty is whether lower carbon concretes may exhibit greater sensitivity to harsher early age curing conditions leading to detrimental longer-term chemical or microstructural effects, and thus an undesirable reduction in quality. Acceleration of concrete exposure conditions in practice will also be investigated to consider the effects on concrete of more extreme temperatures and repeated wetting and extended drying not previously seen in modern history. The project objectives include: to exploit advanced digital measurement techniques in tandem with concrete characterisation experiments under controlled and/or accelerated exposure conditions e.g. temperature, humidity, carbonation; to investigate macro-scale and micro-scale models for prediction (AI tools will be used as appropriate) to infer correlation and for physics-informed modelling; to conduct evidence-based analyses of trade-offs between quality and embodied carbon. The new knowledge derived through the project will frame guidance on acceptable weather conditions during placement and enable pre-emptive prediction of any detrimental effects due to more severe in-service exposure conditions to thereby future-proof both new and existing infrastructure. For project-specific enquiries please e-mail Professor Janet Lees: jml1010@cam.ac.uk. For general enquiries, please email cdtcivil-courseadmin@eng.cam.ac.uk. Applicants should have (or expect to obtain by the start date) at least a high 2.1 degree and preferably a 1st class degree. The degree should be in engineering, sciences or a relevant discipline, and will preferably be at a Master's level. Previous expertise in concrete materials is desirable. Fully-funded studentships (fees and maintenance) are only available for eligible home students in the first instance. A limited number of international students can be considered for funding at a later stage in the recruitment process. Further details about eligibility and funding can be found at: https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/career-and-skills-development/funding-for-postgraduate-training/eligibility-for-studentship-funding/ https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/finance/fees https://www.cambridgetrust.org/scholarships/ Applications should be made online via the University of Cambridge Applicant Portal: https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/directory/egegpdfib stating project title and supervisor's name. Please note there is a £20 application fee. Early applications are strongly encouraged as an offer may be made before the stated deadline. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society.

items.desc: Job Introduction The West Midlands Combined Authority is delivering ambitious plans to create a better-connected, more prosperous region, where people can access jobs, housing, transport and opportunity. Our Growth Plan and the Mayor's priorities set out what we want to achieve, but delivering these ambitions depends on having the right technology, systems and digital capabilities in place. Broad understanding of solution architecture across several relevant technology domains, such as applications, integration and APIs, cloud and infrastructure, data, security and identity, enterprise platforms and networking. Practical understanding of modern architecture approaches, including cloud-based solutions, APIs, integration patterns, and service-oriented architectures. Experience of considering security, resilience, performance, scalability, interoperability, supportability and value for money as part of solution design. Demonstrable experience of producing clear, high-quality architecture documentation and models, including solution designs, architecture diagrams and technical decisions. Ability to identify and clearly communicate technical dependencies, constraints, risks and trade-offs and provide pragmatic recommendations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to balance technical considerations with business and delivery requirements. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, technical specialists, delivery teams, and external technology suppliers. items.desc: Join us in shaping a new model of urgent and community care across Mersey Care NHS Foundation Trust. We are looking for passionate and innovative General Practitioners to join our new Community Access Service (CAS) Hub. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a multi-disciplinary clinical team providing senior clinical decision making, expert advice and leadership across urgent community care services. Working within the CAS Hub, you will support assessment, triage and management of patient with urgent and complex healthcare needs, helping people receive the right care, in the right place, at the right time. You will work alongside advanced clinical practitioners, nurses, therapists and community teams to support admission avoidance and deliver high quality, person centred care. This role offers the opportunity to influence service development, support workforce development, contribute to quality improvement and help shape the future of integrated urgent and community care. We welcome applications from GPs who enjoy collaborative working, complex clinical decision making and making a real difference to patient outcomes across community services. Mersey Care is one of the largest trusts providing physical health and mental health services in the North West, serving more than 1.4 million people across our region and are also commissioned for services that cover the North West, North Wales and the Midlands. We offer specialist inpatient and community services that support physical and mental health and specialist inpatient mental health, learning disability, addiction and brain injury services. Mersey Care is one of only three trusts in the UK that offer high secure mental health facilities. At the heart of all we do is our commitment to ‘perfect care’ – care that is safe, effective, positively experienced, timely, equitable and efficient. We support our staff to do the best job they can and work alongside service users, their families, and carers to design and develop future services together. We’re currently delivering a programme of organisational and service transformation to significantly improve the quality of the services we provide and safely reduce cost as we do so. Flexible working requests will be considered for all roles. Please refer to the attached job description and person specification for full details and requirements of the role. Why join us? Be part of a major transformation of urgent community care services. Work within a supportive multi-disciplinary team. Flexible hybrid working across CAS Hub, UCR and urgent care services. Opportunities for teaching, leadership, service improvement and innovation. Help deliver safe alternatives to hospital admission and improve patient flow across the system. Help build the future of urgent community care.

items.desc: Inspire Learning. Develop Future Talent. Deliver Outstanding Care. Are you a passionate Paediatric Critical Care nurse with a flair for education, leadership and developing others? Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is looking for an experienced and motivated Band 6 Clinical Practice Educator to join our thriving Paediatric Critical Care team . This exciting dual-role opportunity combines hands-on clinical practice with education and workforce development, allowing you to shape the future of paediatric critical care nursing while continuing to deliver exceptional patient care. As a Clinical Practice Educator, you'll be an expert practitioner and role model, supporting staff across all stages of their professional development. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our workforce is equipped with the knowledge, skills and confidence to deliver safe, evidence-based care to critically ill children and their families. If you're passionate about supporting colleagues to learn, grow and reach their potential, whilst maintaining your own clinical expertise in a specialist critical care environment, we'd love to hear from you. There is opportunity to complete Post Graduate Certificate in Education Post holders will be expected to work a minimum of 23hrs per week across days, nights and weekend shifts. Your Education Responsibilities Working alongside the PCCU Education Team, you'll: Facilitate learning and development within the clinical environment. Support learners and newly developing staff through all stages of their professional journey. Identify training and development needs across the service. Develop, review and update educational resources and learning materials. Deliver and support specialist education programmes within Paediatric Critical Care and the wider Directorate. Promote evidence-based practice and contribute to a positive learning culture. Support workforce development initiatives that enhance patient safety and patient experience. Your Clinical Responsibilities Alongside your education role, you'll remain embedded within the Band 6 clinical workforce, where you'll: Provide clinical leadership and expert care for critically ill children. Deliver high-quality, individualised, family-centred care. Lead and support nursing teams during shifts. Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Uphold and promote the PCCU Nursing Philosophy of Care. Support the day-to-day management of the unit in the absence of a Senior Sister/Charge Nurse. Act as a professional role model and mentor to colleagues. Our Paediatric Critical Care service includes 17 co-located Level 2 and Level 3 critical care beds , providing specialist care for children from Oxfordshire and across the Thames Valley and Wessex Paediatric Critical Care Operational Delivery Network. Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is one of the largest NHS teaching trusts in the country. It provides a wide range of general and specialist clinical services and is a base for medical education, training and research. The Trust comprises four hospitals - the John Radcliffe Hospital, Churchill Hospital and Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre in Headington and the Horton General Hospital in Banbury. Our values, standards and behaviours define the quality of clinical care we offer and the professional relationships we make with our patients, colleagues and the wider community. We call this Delivering Compassionate Excellence, and its focus is on our values of compassion, respect, learning, delivery, improvement and excellence. These values put patients at the heart of what we do and underpin the quality healthcare we would like for ourselves or a member of our family. Watch how we set out to deliver compassionate excellence via the OUH YouTube channel . In 2023 NHS England launched its first sexual safety charter, and our Trust proudly signed it. items.desc: We are seeking an enthusiastic, customer-focused Application Support Officer to support the operation and development of NEP Cloud, our shared finance and procurement solution. NEP is a not-for-profit NHS consortium providing services designed for the NHS, by the NHS. This Band 5 role combines your finance, procurement or customer service experience with an interest in systems, problem-solving and service improvement. Within our Applications Support Team, you will investigate and resolve support requests, helping consortium organisations use NEP Cloud confidently. You will advise on functionality and best practice across Purchase to Pay, Order to Cash and Accounting to Reporting, developing specialist application knowledge. You will also contribute to system developments, testing and quarterly upgrades, support training, prepare guidance and mentor systems support and customer service colleagues. You will bring strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a professional, approachable manner, alongside the ability to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities and take ownership of queries. Join a collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and excellent customer service, while developing your skills and supporting essential NHS business services. Please note you will be require to work onsite 3 days a week. Investigate, analyse and resolve application support requests through the NEP Service Desk, working within agreed service levels. Support the design, configuration, testing and implementation of system enhancements and quarterly upgrades. Analyse data, investigate discrepancies and produce reports to support consortium organisations. Prepare and deliver training, user guidance and supporting documentation. Mentor and support systems support and customer service colleagues, sharing knowledge and helping coordinate activities. Deliver allocated project tasks and work packages within agreed timescales and quality standards. Contribute to service reviews, audits and improvements while maintaining security, confidentiality and accurate records. NEP is hosted by Northumbria Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust and is the largest NHS Consortium in England. NEP provides a cutting-edge, fully integrated finance and procurement solution tailored specifically for NHS organisations, configured on Oracle Cloud ERP. Through collaboration and shared learning, we empower our members to optimise resources, meet evolving directives, driving improve outcomes for patients. At NEP, we foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration and continuous improvement. Staff are supported to grow professionally through mentorship, development programmes and opportunities to work on innovative projects. Our hybrid-working model supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining strong team connectivity and service delivery. You will join a motivated and knowledgeable team, where your input is genuinely valued. We are proud of our collaborative ethos and our shared commitment to supporting front-line NHS services through reliable digital infrastructure. Based in Stokesley, North Yorkshire, you will work under the direction of the Application Configuration Manager, with day-to-day mentorship from the Application Support Lead. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across NEP and build effective relationships with consortium organisations and external partners. You should hold a degree-level qualification in a finance or procurement-related subject, or an equivalent qualification and/or demonstrable relevant experience. Experience in a supervisory role within finance, purchasing or customer service support is essential, alongside operational knowledge of computer systems and an understanding of business and financial reporting processes. You will need strong communication, organisational and analytical skills, confidence using Microsoft Office and the ability to work independently while contributing to a supportive team. Knowledge of coaching, mentoring and quality improvement will help you support colleagues and improve services. NHS experience and a project management qualification would be beneficial.

The PMO Analyst is a core member of the Project Management Office, responsible for providing the planning, reporting, tracking, risk management, financial administration, and governance support that enables the PMO Lead and programme leadership to manage the IT Transition programme and subsequent IT Change programmes with confidence and control. This is not a passive administrative role. The PMO Analyst is expected to interrogate data, identify inconsistencies, flag emerging risks, and provide insight — not just information. They are the first line of defence against inaccurate reporting, missed milestones, untracked risks, and governance gaps. They must be comfortable challenging workstream leads on status accuracy, chasing overdue actions, and escalating concerns to the PMO Lead when something doesn't add up. Operating across the IT Transition and into steady-state Change programmes, the PMO Analyst must adapt to the different rhythms of each phase — the high-intensity, milestone-driven cadence of transition delivery and the rolling, pipeline-driven cadence of continuous change. Key Responsibilities Maintain the integrated programme plan, milestones, dependencies and key programme trackers. Collect, validate and analyse workstream progress, identifying schedule risks, slippage and emerging issues. Produce accurate and timely programme reports, dashboards and governance packs for senior stakeholders. Maintain RAID, risk, issue, action and decision logs, ensuring actions and treatments are actively tracked. Support programme financial tracking, including budgets, actuals, forecasts and variance analysis. Coordinate governance meetings, including agendas, papers, minutes, actions and decision tracking. Maintain programme deliverable, resource and document trackers, ensuring information is accurate and up to date. Support transition activities including readiness tracking, go/no-go evidence, cutover and hypercare reporting. During the Change Programme phase, maintain the change pipeline, benefits and capacity trackers and support ongoing programme reporting. Identify opportunities to improve PMO processes, reporting and tools, including automation where appropriate. Work collaboratively with the PMO Lead, workstream leads, programme teams and stakeholders to ensure high-quality programme information and governance. What you'll bring Experience in a PMO Analyst, Project Support Officer or Project Coordinator role, ideally within IT programmes or projects. Strong experience producing programme reports, dashboards and governance packs. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with strong data analysis and presentation skills. Experience using programme planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, Jira, Smartsheet or equivalent. Experience maintaining RAID logs, risk and issue registers, action trackers and programme plans. Experience with financial tracking, including budget vs actuals, forecasting and variance analysis. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, risks and emerging trends. Strong communication and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience working in an IT service delivery or ITSM environment. Desirable: PRINCE2, APM, PMP, CAPM or P3O qualification. ITIL 4 Foundation. Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, PPM tools or SharePoint. Experience supporting IT Transition, outsourcing or managed service programmes. Experience with Power Automate, VBA, PowerShell or other automation tools. Experience working in regulated, government or defence environments. What Success Looks Like You will ensure that programme information is accurate, timely and trusted, with effective reporting, governance and programme controls in place. You will help the PMO identify risks early, keep actions and dependencies moving, and provide stakeholders with clear information to support effective decision-making. items.desc: Junior QA Tester — Shoptimised We’re looking for a curious, methodical Junior QA Tester to join Shoptimised. You’ll help us deliver reliable, easy-to-use software through manual testing, while learning how AI can accelerate testing and support everyday work. You’ll receive practical training in testing principles, AI tools and AI-driven workflows. This role would suit someone starting a career in testing who enjoys solving problems and wants to explore new ways of working. What you’ll be doing Manually testing new features and changes against requirements and expected behaviour. Following test cases and checklists, then learning to write and maintain your own. Exploring the software from a user’s perspective to find unexpected behaviour and usability issues. Reporting bugs clearly, including steps to reproduce them, expected and actual results, and supporting screenshots or recordings. Retesting fixes and checking that changes haven’t broken existing functionality. Keeping accurate records of testing and communicating progress, findings and blockers. Working with developers and other colleagues to understand features and clarify requirements. Using AI with guidance to generate tests, explore edge cases, improve documentation and support investigations. Helping develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work and improve testing coverage. What we’re looking for Strong attention to detail and a patient, methodical approach. Curiosity about how software works and what might cause it to go wrong. Clear written and verbal communication. The ability to follow instructions, organise your work and keep useful notes. Confidence to ask questions and challenge assumptions. A willingness to learn, take feedback and work collaboratively. An interest in AI and how it can be applied to practical problems. Basic confidence using computers, web browsers and online applications. You don’t need previous professional testing experience or specialist AI knowledge. We’re interested in how you approach problems, communicate what you find and develop your skills. Helpful, but not essential An interest in software testing, technology or software development. Experience spotting and explaining problems in a website or application. Familiarity with bug-tracking tools or basic testing terminology. Experience experimenting with AI tools for work, study or personal projects. Relevant learning through a course, qualification, personal project or self-study. What you’ll learn Testing fundamentals How quality assurance fits into software development. How to turn requirements into useful tests. How to test typical usage, boundaries, invalid inputs and unexpected situations. How to write clear bug reports, assess impact and prioritise testing. How to combine planned tests with exploratory testing. AI-accelerated testing and workflows Hands-on use of AI tools, with training and mentoring from your manager. How to give AI clear instructions and useful context. How to use AI to support test planning, test case creation and documentation. How to evaluate AI suggestions, verify their accuracy and identify gaps. How to build repeatable AI-driven workflows and assess whether they improve the quality or speed of your work. When to use AI and when direct investigation and human judgement are needed. Test automation Practical automation skills, with training and mentoring from your manager. How to identify tests that are useful to automate. How to run automated tests and investigate failures. How to build and maintain reliable automated tests as your skills develop What success looks like As you develop in the role, you’ll become confident completing agreed testing, recording reliable results and raising clear, reproducible bug reports. Over time, you’ll take ownership of testing smaller changes, contribute your own test ideas and use AI thoughtfully to make your work more effective. Work Location: In person

items.desc: Solution Architect Location: Hamilton International Technology Park Reports to: Lead Architect About DataVita DataVita is a next-generation cloud and infrastructure company operating from Tier III-certified data centres in Scotland. We work at the bleeding edge of AI adoption, automation, and how these technologies can be integrated into complex legacy environments to deliver genuine transformation. DataVita is the fastest growing technology company in Scotland, with plans to deploy and invest over £2 billion in the coming years. You would be joining at a relatively early stage of that trajectory. For the right person, this is a chance to build something from the ground up inside a business that is scaling fast. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to join our architecture function and lead the design of complex managed infrastructure and cloud solutions. This is a customer-facing role that sits between presales, onboarding, and delivery. You will own solution design from early customer engagement through to delivery handover, making sure every solution is technically robust, commercially viable, and aligned with DataVita's platforms. block, and object) Networking and connectivity services Backup, archive, and disaster recovery Security controls and managed security services What We’re Looking For Experience Significant experience designing infrastructure and cloud solutions in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or Cloud Services Provider (CSP) environment Broad technical experience across compute, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery Experience owning end-to-end solution design rather than isolated components Strong awareness of operational and Day-2 considerations, and a pragmatic approach to balancing technical quality, commercial reality, and operational constraints A self-starter, comfortable progressing work independently without detailed instruction Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to support design and documentation, and willing to help drive their adoption within the team Confident, professional communicator, comfortable leading technical workshops and customer discussions Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences Works closely with Sales, Architecture, Delivery, and Operations, and takes ownership of design outcomes Desirable Experience These roles support the staff team in providing the highest level of residential care. The future is bright at our children's resource centres. Join us as we empower and support children and young people with complex disabilities and health care needs and inspire them to reach their full potential. Find out more - Children's resource centre opportunities | North Yorkshire Council About the Service No Wrong Door provides support to North Yorkshire’s most vulnerable young people. Our young people have complex needs and have experienced early childhood trauma. The Paddock is a residential care home for up children who live semi-independently with staff support You will support our established team in delivering support and interventions to young people aged between 13 and 25. We have the highest aspirations for all the young people we care for and our aim is to provide the scaffold for them to achieve the best possible outcomes in life. About the role You will be responsible for the day-to-day care of young people within our residential homes. The approach we adopt is to create a family environment where our young people feel valued and respected. An example of this would be to support and develop our young people’s positive experiences through education, activities and life skills. We want our children to feel included in the decisions made with them, and to be involved in every aspect of their care. You may also contribute to our Edge of Care Service, providing outreach support to young people in our local community. You will work with a solution focussed approach, in a fast-paced environment whilst always keeping the child at the centre of all decision making. Working with our young people can be challenging at times, and will require you to be compassionate, resilient, empathetic and non-judgemental. This role is extremely rewarding as you will find yourself influencing young people to make positive life choices and supporting them through the difficulties of adolescence. You will need to be flexible in your approach, as this role is shift work as part of a 24/7 rota. You must have the ability to meet the travel needs of this post: Please be aware that this may involve significant travel implications and will involve transporting children and families across the county. items.desc: We are thrilled to offer an exciting opportunity for a talented Band 6 Specialist Biomedical Scientist to join our diverse, highly motivated & friendly team. Our team is dedicated to delivering the highest quality service to patients across the region & we are looking for someone who shares this commitment to excellence. The ideal candidate must be HCPC registered & have either completed or be working towards the IBMS specialist portfolio, or possess equivalent experience. This is a fantastic opportunity for a skilled Biomedical Scientist ready to take the next step in their career. Our department is a busy and dynamic environment, processing approximately 33,000 histology & 1,800 diagnostic cytology samples each year. The Conquest Hospital is our main site, where we conduct a wide range of procedures including specimen dissection, centralized tissue processing, microtomy, staining, immunohistochemistry & diagnostic cytology preparation. Additionally, we have a satellite site at Eastbourne DGH where specimen dissection is also performed. Our facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art technology through a Managed Service Contract, featuring cutting-edge equipment such as Epredia Revos Tissue Processors, Menarini E-Gross Pro X grossing stations, ThermoScientific HM525NX Cryostats, Sakura Prisma staining machine with a film coverslipper, Ventana Benchmark Ultra, Ventana Benchmark Ultra Plus, Ventana Benchmark Special Stains and Hammamatsu Nanozoomer digital scanners. As a Specialist Biomedical Scientist, you’ll be experienced and operating as a Biomedical Scientist within Histopathology, in line with ISO 15189 standards and you’ll have rotated across the department, providing scientific services to patients and customers to aid pathological diagnosis. Y ou’ll deputise for senior team members, assist in workflow management, support with the management of documentation, and general overall performance. You'll also play a vital role in the training and development of junior scientific staff. We support and encourage our Specialist Biomedical Scientists to undertake Continuing Professional Development (CPD) activities, which could be internal talks and seminars, as well as attending approved courses. We have a dedicated Training officer within our department. The department has full HCPC training status for pre and post registration IBMS portfolios, and full ISO 15189 accreditation. In addition to the brief list above you must familiarise yourself with the full job description and person specification attached to this advert prior to applying. If you are a motivated, dynamic individual who embraces change and seeks to contribute to a forward-thinking department, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Join us in making a meaningful impact on patient care in our region. A wide range of staff benefits are available to our staff including staff development, enrolment in the NHS pension scheme, auto-enrolment to our Temporary Workforce Service, access to onsite nurseries. staff restaurants and accommodation. In addition to an internal Occupational Health department, all staff also have access to free psychological support through our confidential Employee Assistance Programme. Onsite parking is available from only £50 a year. There has never been a better time to join East Sussex Healthcare NHS Trust, submit your application today. Statement on the Use of AI We value the individuality that each candidate brings to the application process. We went live with Digital Pathology in November 2023 and are currently completing the clinical validation of digital imaging, positioning us at the forefront of innovation in pathology services.

items.desc: Lanes Group is a leading nationwide utility services provider with c.5000 dedicated employees. Our diverse subsidiaries drive our success across various sectors, contributing to a remarkable turnover of over £700 million. We are committed to excellence and innovation, ensuring we provide industry leading services to our clients and stakeholders. Join us to be part of a dynamic and growing team that values diversity and fosters professional growth. Department: Thames Water is the UK's largest water and wastewater company, serving around 16 million customers across London and the Thames Valley. As a trusted delivery partner, Lanes Group plays a vital role in maintaining one of the UK's most critical infrastructure networks, delivering essential wastewater and drainage services that protect communities and the environment. Our teams carry out everything from sewer maintenance and network cleansing to CCTV inspections and pollution response, ensuring customers receive a safe, reliable, and resilient service every day. Purpose of the role: The Drainage Patch Lining & Cutting Engineer will be responsible for carrying out specialist drainage rehabilitation and cutting works across a range of drainage and sewer networks. The role will primarily involve the removal of obstructions, roots, concrete, intruding connections and other defects from drains and sewers using specialist mechanical cutting equipment , including Picote milling machines and robotic cutters. The Engineer will also undertake patch lining repairs to damaged or defective drainage and sewer pipes, providing effective no-dig repairs and helping to restore the structural integrity and flow of the pipeline. Location: Iver, Colnbrook Job type: Full time Hours: Monday to Friday, 50 hours per week Salary: £42,000 - £44,500 (Depending on experience) Key Responsibilities: Travelling to residential sites via a specially equipped van in a two-person team, around the region. Repair and maintain drainage systems, installing patch liners to carry out first-time-fix sewer and drain repair. Utilise the Picote system to remove scale, roots, concrete, and other hard obstructions that high pressure water jetting systems can’t remove. Survey the network of drainage systems and assess pip conditions to produce high-quality reports with the help of state-of-the-art drain surveying equipment. Record each job report correctly on the specialist equipment provided. Delivering good customer service. Maintaining good H&S practise while carrying out works. Ensure vehicle stock is full and replenished. To comply with health and safety responsibilities i.e. PPE / safe site set ups protecting Lanes Group employees, the public and other road users. To be able to utilise VISTEC and Salesforce platforms. Liaising with the client regarding progress and any updates. Ability to work unsupervised in all weather conditions utilising correct PPE, lone worker system, etc. Dynamically risk assess site access & working conditions depending on specific circumstances on arrival. Provide support to your colleagues. To conduct thorough inspections of tools, equipment and plant before/after use. Report any defects or malfunctions in regards to training. Carry out risk assessments and have a mature approach to risk perception. Be aware of all Lanes Group policies and your responsibility towards them. Any other reasonable ad-hoc duties requested by management . Key Requirements Skills & Experience: Have experience within the drainage, sewer rehabilitation or utilities industry. Have practical experience using drainage equipment and mechanical tools. Have a good understanding of drainage and sewer systems. Be mechanically minded and comfortable operating specialist equipment. Be able to interpret CCTV footage and identify common drainage defects. Have excellent attention to detail, particularly when carrying out cutting and lining operations. Be physically capable of undertaking manual and practical work. Be able to work independently and as part of a team. Have a strong Health & Safety awareness. Be reliable, punctual and professional. Be willing to undertake further specialist training where required. Hold a valid UK driving licence where required for the role. Desirable: Previous Picote milling/cutting experience . Previous experience operating robotic drainage cutters . Patch lining / localised repair experience. Confined Space training. High Pressure Water Jetting qualification. Street Works / NRSWA qualification. items.desc: Job Description Turn customer understanding into better decisions At AJ Bell, understanding our customers is at the heart of how we grow and improve our business. Working in the D2C business at AJ Bell, the Insights team is a small but dynamic and experienced group of SMEs who work across data, insights and research to ensure customer understanding, market intelligence and data-led analysis are embedded at the heart of how the business sets direction, prioritises investment and measures success. The Market and Customer Researcher supports the delivery of our customer and market research portfolio, encompassing market research, customer surveys, both tactical and always-on initiatives, and direct customer feedback through interviews and focus groups. The role involves designing and delivering research that builds a strong understanding of our customers, the market and wider consumer trends. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the business, the researcher will help ensure that compelling market, customer and consumer insights inform and support our products, propositions, campaigns and business plans. What you'll be doing You'll work across a varied portfolio of market and customer research, combining qualitative and quantitative approaches to answer important business questions. You'll: Undertake end-to-end mixed-method customer and market research projects, incorporating market and desk research, qualitative and quantitative customer and consumer research, and internal data analysis as appropriate. Work closely with colleagues in product, marketing and digital, as well as other internal stakeholders, to understand their requirements and develop clear research briefs in response. Support the design and delivery of quantitative research and surveys, including questionnaire design, survey coding and build, and results analysis. Support the design and delivery of qualitative customer research, including participant recruitment, discussion guide and stimulus development, and conducting group and individual interviews. Own competitor tracking and reporting, ensuring that market and competitor alerts and insight packs are delivered to the business in a timely manner with clear implications. Undertake desk research using public and third-party data sources to develop an understanding of market trends, consumer behaviour and the competitive landscape. Analyse data and distil findings into relevant insights, delivered through clear, compelling and actionable reports that are grounded in consumer truth and commercially relevant. Represent the voice of the customer by sharing research findings and insights with internal stakeholders, helping ensure customer and market intelligence informs decision-making. Work with agency partners where required to support the delivery of high-quality research that meets stakeholder expectations and represents value for money. Support the development of the Voice of Customer capability, including the planning and delivery of always-on customer research and surveys, alongside the evaluation and testing of new data sources and platforms. Collaborate with specialist researchers across the business to help translate strategic and customer insights into high-quality delivery across UX, product and customer experience. Monitor the quality of research data, agency services and platforms, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency. Engage regularly with internal stakeholders to gather feedback on the quality and impact of research and contribute to a continuous improvement approach that delivers customer and commercial benefit. What we're looking for We're looking for someone who is naturally curious and enjoys getting underneath a business question to understand what is really happening. You'll be able to combine research expertise with commercial thinking, turning evidence into insights that people can understand and act on. You'll bring: Research experience Experience supporting or delivering multi-stage research projects using qualitative and quantitative approaches Practical experience of quantitative research, including questionnaire development, survey build and data analysis Experience developing and delivering qualitative research, including participant recruitment, discussion guides, stimulus and interviews Experience of customer or consumer research, including always-on or trigger-based research Strong market and competitor research experience, including ongoing monitoring, reporting and presenting insights to senior audiences Strong desk research skills, using public, third-party and internal customer data Experience working with research agencies or external partners Good brief-writing skills and the ability to translate stakeholder requirements into appropriate research approaches Insight and analytical skills Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to bring together different sources of data to identify trends, patterns and …
