 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN:
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Leyre, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):
 Trabajarás en el equipo de Group Cyber & Security, que tiene el objetivo de garantizar la protección de los activos de información de Zurich y minimizar los riesgos asociados a la seguridad de los datos . 
 Analizarás y gestionarás requisitos de seguridad de la información a aplicar sobre nuestras plataformas y sistemas , de forma que estas cuenten con una adecuada protección. 
 Colaborarás con el equipo de seguridad global de Zurich , con el que interactuamos de forma habitual para la definición de controles y la monitorización de las herramientas de ciberseguridad corporativas. 
 Colaborarás en la gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM) , contribuyendo a la implantación y supervisión de controles de autenticación, autorización y gestión de privilegios para proteger los sistemas y la información de Zurich. 
 Participarás en la elaboración y presentación de materiales de formación en seguridad de la información para toda la organización. 
 Monitorizarás la adecuada implantación de las herramientas y capacidades de ciberseguridad sobre los sistemas de la entidad. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos.
 Estudios en Ciberseguridad, Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o carreras técnicas similares. 
 Experiencia en posiciones relacionadas con la seguridad de la información. 
 Valorable experiencia en posiciones de liderazgo o gestión de equipos. 
 Conocimiento de normativas y estándares (ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, etc). 
 Habilidades comunicativas y capacidad para trabajar en equipo. 
 Nivel alto de inglés (deseable un C1). 
 Se valorarán certificaciones en el ámbito de seguridad de la información (CISSP, CISM, CCSP o similares).
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar.
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. 
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar cómo y dónde quieras dentro de España. Además, te daremos el material necesario para poder trabajar desde casa cómodamente. 
 Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa de mentoring personalizado. 
 Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más! 
 Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil …

items.desc:
Bist du bereit, mit dem Besten zu rechnen? 
 Bei Zurich leben wir Versicherung neu. Um die Wünsche unserer Kunden noch besser zu erfüllen, gehen wir neue Wege, denken kreativ, arbeiten agil. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schenkt dir in jeder Hinsicht mehr Flexibilität – und viel Freiraum, dich optimal zu entfalten. Think big – und gerne auch international! Denn deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten kennen bei uns keine Grenzen. Bereit, die Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen? 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Du unterstützt unser Team am Standort Köln, Hamburg oder Frankfurt am Main bei der Beratung unserer Kund:innen zu Risiken chemischer und Life-Science-Produkte sowie zu möglichen Umweltauswirkungen der Produkte und ihrer Herstellung 
 Mit deinem Know-how unterstützt du unsere Versicherungsfachabteilungen technisch und fachlich bei der Bewertung von Haftpflichtrisiken im Middle-Market-Segment sowie bei ausgewählten international agierenden Kund:innen 
 Dein Fokus liegt auf Umwelthaftpflicht, Produkthaftpflicht und angrenzenden Haftpflichtthemen 
 Du führst Risikodialoge und Besichtigungen mit Kund:innen, Makler:innen und internen Schnittstellen durch und erstellst strukturierte Risikoberichte für Underwriting, Vertrieb und Kund:innen 
 In deiner Rolle bewertest du die Risikoqualität ganzheitlich, analysierst Haftpflichtschäden und leitest Verbesserungspotenziale sowie geeignete Präventionsmaßnahmen ab 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Freude an der Einarbeitung in neue und komplexe Umwelt- und Haftpflichtthemen 
 Interesse an Produkthaftpflicht, Rückruf- und US-Risiken sowie an der Lebensmittel- und Pharmaindustrie 
 Kenntnisse der 4. und 12. BImSchV, des WHG, KrWG und BBodSchG sowie im Chemikalienrecht, einschließlich REACH, GHS-System und GefStoffV 
 Kenntnisse der ErsatzbaustoffV und des Bergrechts sowie Grundkenntnisse in HSE-Managementsystemen, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, EMAS, ISO 45001, Schadstoffwegen, Schadstoffausbreitung und Altlastenproblematiken 
 Abgeschlossenes Master- oder Diplomstudium vorzugsweise mit chemischem Schwerpunkt, Umweltingenieurwesen, Life Sciences oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung 
 Die Zurich Gruppe Deutschland unterstützt in Abhängigkeit zur individuellen Stellenanforderung und der persönlichen Eignung grundsätzlich sowohl flexible als auch Teilzeit-Arbeitsformen. Wenn du Interesse an dieser Stelle hast und deine persönliche Situation nicht ganz mit dem angegebenen Pensum (Voll-/Teilzeit) zusammenpasst, wende dich gerne an uns, um die potenziellen Möglichkeiten zu besprechen.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 Join our Power Design Team 
 About this opportunity 
 Are you an experienced power electronics engineer who enjoys combining circuit design, analysis and hands-on laboratory work?
 Ericsson’s Power Design team in Lindholmen, Gothenburg, develops and maintains power solutions for Ericsson’s baseband products. As part of our global design organization, you will contribute throughout the product lifecycle—from early concept studies and requirements definition to detailed design, verification and product maintenance.
 You will work with experienced colleagues in an international, multidisciplinary environment and help develop reliable, high-performance power solutions for future mobile networks.
 What you will do 
• Design and develop power solutions for Ericsson baseband products.
• Design and develop DC/DC converters, schematics and component selections.
• Define requirements and contribute to concept studies and design reviews.
• Perform design verification, troubleshooting and hands-on measurements in the laboratory.
• Analyse results and propose improvements to product performance, quality and robustness.
• Collaborate with digital, firmware, mechanical and thermal design teams.
• Work with colleagues, suppliers and design partners across Ericsson’s global organization.
• Explore and apply AI-assisted methods in power electronics design, verification, troubleshooting, data analysis and technical documentation.
• Contribute to product maintenance and continuous improvement.
 The skills you bring 
 Required qualifications 
• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field.
• Several years of relevant experience in power electronics.
• Experience with DC/DC converters and power distribution.
• Practical experience with laboratory verification and electronic measurement equipment.
• Good understanding of hardware design and how power solutions are integrated into complex products.
• Experience using AI-assisted tools or methods in engineering, analysis, automation or technical documentation.
• Strong interest in circuit design and hands-on problem solving.
• Fluent English, both spoken and written.
 Additional experience that is beneficial 
• Knowledge of simulation tools such as SIMPLIS, LTspice or PSpice.
• Experience with scripting or calculation tools such as Python, MATLAB or Mathcad.
 You are structured, analytical and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others. You communicate clearly, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of delivering results.
 Why join Ericsson? 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
 What happens once you apply? 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Responsibilities 
 Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
 Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
 Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
 Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
 Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
 Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
 Embodies our culture and values . 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications : 
 High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND demostrated experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
 This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised. 
 Background Check Requirements: 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: 
 Extensive experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
 Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? 
 En Telefónica, hacemos que sea posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de última generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT o ciberseguridad. 
 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras, diseñamos el futuro . Buscamos personas que tengan inquietudes, entusiasmo y pasión por lo que hacen, que no se conformen y que quieran crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu lugar.

 Formarás parte del Departamento de Estrategia Corporativa, participando en proyectos clave para la definición y ejecución de la estrategia del Grupo. Asimismo, contribuirás a la elaboración de planes estratégicos, identificación de oportunidades de crecimiento y generación de valor para la compañía. 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 A lta capacidad analítica y atención al detalle. 
 Habilidades de comunicación y síntesis, orientadas a distintos niveles, incluida la alta dirección. 
 Proactividad, responsabilidad y adaptación a entornos exigentes. 
 Capacidad de trabajo en equipo en entornos multiculturales. 
 Curiosidad intelectual y aprendizaje continuo. 
 Autonomía en la gestión de información y orientación a resultados. ) 
 ¿Cómo contribuirás con tus capacidades al propósito del rol? 💼 
 Participar en proyectos estratégicos de alta relevancia para el Grupo: 
 Realizar diferentes análisis (benchmark, diagnóstico, valoración de diferentes alternativas …) sobre cuestiones clave (e.g. transformación, desarrollo de negocios digitales, proyectos de infraestructura…) 
 Trabajar con los equipos de estrategia locales y con las áreas globales para consensuar las conclusiones y diseñar los planes de ejecución 
 Estructurar y sintetizar las conclusiones en documentos ejecutivos para la alta dirección 
 Apoyar en proyectos inorgánicos (Pre-deal, Post-deal): 
 Apoyar en la identificación y análisis de opciones inorgánicas que mejoren nuestra posición competitiva e incrementen el valor de nuestro portfolio 
 Elaborar el Business Case y cuantificar las sinergias de los potenciales activos 
 Apoyar en los procesos de Due Diligence, realizando análisis sobre las principales cuestiones de negocio y puntos críticos con impacto en valoración 
 Participar en proyectos de integración, formando parte del equipo de PMI, dando apoyo en el diseño del plan de integración, liderando la consecución de sinergias, etc. 
 Participar en el proceso de planificación estratégica de la compañía: 
 Colaborar en el diseño del “equity story” y en la definición de las prioridades estratégicas 
 Trabajar con las áreas globales y los países para alinear y consolidar los resultados 
 Elaborar los documentos consolidados para reportar a la alta dirección 
 Análisis de tendencias de mercado: 
 Identificar y analizar nuevas tendencias en el sector ICT (Edge, 5G, NaaS, APis, Web 3.0, Crypto, Blockchain, Metaverse, etc.) 
 Elaborar documentos que sinteticen las implicaciones para Telefónica/el mercado 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Grado en perfiles STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering o Mathematics – e.g. Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Industrial) o Grado en Administración de Empresas/Economía 
 Se valorarán positivamente estudios de máster, postgrado o MBA 
 Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint 
 Se valorará positivamente el manejo de herramientas de procesamiento y visualización de datos (Tableau, PowerBI…) 
 Inglés: Bilingüe-Alto 
 Otros idiomas (Portugués, Alemán): Se valorarán positivamente 
 2-4 años. Experiencia en Consultoría Estratégica o de negocio en Big Four o área de estrategia de un corporate 
 Se valorarán positivamente conocimiento sectorial (industria TMT) y/o financiero, así como en nuevas tecnologías (Edge, 5G, NaaS, APis, Web 3.0, Crypto, Blockchain, Metaverse, etc. 
 ¿Qué ventajas tendrás por formar parte de nuestro equipo? 💙 
 Proyectos transformadores. En Telefónica formarás parte de proyectos de alto impacto, que marcan tendencia y responden a los retos de conectividad y transformación digital de nuestra sociedad.

items.desc:
TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. ofrece soluciones integrales de aprendizaje para la Educación y Formación, con más de 20 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional. Desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. 
 En un mundo cada vez más incierto, uno de los mayores regalos que se le puede hacer a una persona es su formación. La formación es uno de los activos más valiosos que se pueden ofrecer para el futuro: amplía opciones, genera confianza y permite afrontar los cambios con mayor seguridad. En este sentido, el propósito de Telefónica Educación Digital es claro y profundamente relevante: ofrecer este regalo a cada uno de nuestros usuarios. Pocos propósitos tienen un valor mayor o un impacto más duradero que ayudar a las personas a construir su futuro. 
 Puesto: Responsable de Seguridad de la Información - Talent Pool 
 Vacante no activa. Cuando estemos en búsqueda activa, valoraremos las candidaturas. 
 Nuestro reto actual es adaptarnos a los requerimientos normativos de seguridad y reforzar la protección de nuestras plataformas educativas y servicios en la nube. Buscamos un/a Responsable de Seguridad de Sistemas de Información con ganas de asumir un rol clave, crecer con nosotros y ayudarnos a consolidar una cultura de seguridad sólida y eficaz.
 Funciones 
 Liderar la implantación y mantenimiento del ENS y la ISO 27001 en la compañía.
 Diseñar y supervisar los controles de seguridad: accesos, cifrado y continuidad de negocio.
 Gestionar alertas e incidentes de seguridad, proponiendo soluciones ágiles y efectivas, incluyendo la participación en guardias pasivas para atender incidencias críticas en caso de caídas de servidores u otros eventos relevantes.
 Revisar y coordinar medidas de seguridad en servidores Linux, Windows y en plataformas cloud: AWS, Azure o similares.
 Colaborar en la configuración y supervisión del WAF —Web Application Firewall— y controles perimetrales.
 Elaborar políticas, procedimientos y documentación de seguridad.
 Gestionar las herramientas de monitorización y desarrollar automatismos y reglas para garantizar la seguridad de nuestros entornos.
 Impulsar la concienciación en ciberseguridad entre empleados y trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de seguridad de Telefónica de España.
 Asistir a los subcomités de ciberseguridad con el resto de las empresas del grupo Telefónica y hacer seguimiento de las tareas.
 Conocimientos técnicos e informáticos 
 2–4 años de experiencia en seguridad informática y/o compliance tecnológico.
 Conocimientos en:
 ENS e ISO 27001.
 Administración de infraestructuras, especialmente servidores Linux.
 Redes, firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS.
 Principios de seguridad en cloud. AWS se valorará muy positivamente.
 WAF y medidas de seguridad en aplicaciones web.
 Conceptos y herramientas DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues.
 Será un plus si tienes certificaciones relacionadas con la ciberseguridad, como ISO 27001, CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCNA Security o LPIC.
 Competencias 
 Actitud proactiva.
 Capacidad de análisis.
 Pasión por la ciberseguridad.
 Ventajas de formar parte de nuestro equipo 
 Modelo híbrido de trabajo: Cuidamos la flexibilidad, posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo, horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación. 
 22 días de vacaciones + 4 días TED. 
 Disponibilidad de activar el plan de pensiones con las correspondientes aportaciones del participe y de la empresa. 
 Seguro de vida y seguro médico privado (100% a cargo de la empresa). 
 Cheque TED de 11€/día 
 Contarás con descuentos exclusivos por ser empleado de Telefónica en diferentes productos y servicios. 
 Acceso gratuito a formación de idiomas (Inglés, Alemán y Portugués) así como a diversos cursos de la plataforma E-learning. 
 Gimnasio gratuito en nuestras instalaciones (Distrito Telefónica). 
 A la hora de rellenar el formulario, no es necesario completarlo todo, solo los campos obligatorios. Sí necesitamos tu CV y contestación a las preguntas planteadas. ¡Gracias!
 ¿POR QUÉ TELEFÓNICA? 
 El futuro de Telefónica está en tus manos. 
 Trabajar en Telefónica es ser parte de una empresa centenaria que aspira a ser una operadora europea de referencia mundial. Una compañía con un propósito claro: ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales que están transformando el mundo. 
 Un reto que requiere de los mejores profesionales, de las mejores personas. 
 Nuestra forma de trabajar se basa en tres actitudes que nos definen: 
 Damos lo mejor de nosotros mismos . Creemos en el poder de la simplicidad y en centrarnos en lo que realmente genera impacto. Generamos confianza cuando entendemos al cliente y entregamos lo que marca la diferencia. La excelencia es nuestro estándar para lograr impacto hoy y a largo plazo. 
 Cuestionamos nuestros propios límites . Innovamos y somos transformadores cuando asumimos riesgos inteligentes. Promovemos el debate …

Nekünk a mobilitás jövője. Neked a szakmád csúcsa. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre. Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen logisztikai konténer menedzsment specialistája , kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy forradalmasítsuk azt, ahogyan az autózásról gondolkodunk. 
 Mi vár rád?
 Munkakörnyezet – A BMW Group Gyár Debrecen területén elhelyezkedő Kommunikációs Központban, korszerű, digitalizált, „open office” jellegű munkakörnyezetben fogsz dolgozni a többi irodai munkavállalóval és közvetlen csapattársaiddal együtt. A Kommunikációs Központ teakonyhákkal, kávézókkal, ergonomikus munkaállomásokkal felszerelt modern iroda, ahol egy vállalati étkezde is helyet kap. 
 Csapat – konténer menedzsment csapatunk tagjaként nemzetközi környezetben dolgozol. Helyben egy kb. 3 fős csapathoz csatlakozol, miközben szoros kapcsolatban vagy a debreceni gyár logisztikai részlegével. 
 Nemzetközi együttműködés – egy nemzetközi csapat tagja leszel, ahol más BMW Group szervezeti egységekkel is szorosan együtt dolgozol. 
 Beszállítói ügyek kezelése – a beszállítói újrahasználható csomagoló anyagokkal kapcsolatos kérdéseket és problémákat kezeled, hogy az anyagellátás zavartalanul működjön. 
 Konténeres számlák menedzselése – egy meghatározott beszállítói kör csomagoló anyagokkal kapcsolatos számláit intézed, illetve rendszeres havi egyeztetéseket tartasz. 
 Eltérések elemzése – azonosítod a nyilvántartási vagy könyvelési eltérések okait, majd a partnerekkel együttműködve hosszútávú megoldásokat dolgozol ki. 
 Éves konténerleltár koordinálása – megszervezed és koordinálod az éves leltárt az illetékes partnerekkel közösen. 
 Folyamatok fejlesztése – részt veszel a csomagoló anyagok kezelésének fejlesztésében és optimalizálásában, például a leltár vagy a pool management területén. 
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – gazdasági, üzleti informatikai vagy hasonló területen szerzett diplomával rendelkezel, vagy több éves logisztikai tapasztalatod van. 
 Szakmai tapasztalat – átlátod az ellátási lánc folyamatait és értelmezni tudod azok egymásra gyakorolt hatását. 
 Informatikai ismeretek – magabiztosan használod az MS Office programokat, különösen az Excelt. 
 Analitikus gondolkodásmód – magabiztosan elemzed az adatokat és folyamatokat, valamint a problémák okainak feltárását. 
 Kommunikáció és csapatmunka – jól tudsz együttműködni különböző területekkel és partnerekkel. 
 Munkastílus – strukturáltan, önállóan és felelősségteljesen végzed a feladataidat. 
 Nyelvtudás és jogosítvány – magabiztos angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel, a magyar és német nyelv előnyt jelent, valamint rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal. 
 Mit kínálunk?
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok. 
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria-keretösszeg havi folyósítással. 
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz- és vasútjáratok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés. 
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészségközpontban. 
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást. 
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás. 
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.

items.desc:
For us, the car of the future. For you, a key role in ensuring quality. 
 Join us on the road to the future of mobility, where excellent teamwork meets advanced technology. At our Debrecen plant, we do more than manufacture cars; we bring the vision of modern mobility to life by launching the production of the fully electric Neue Klasse models first. We are looking for colleagues who want to play an active role in the renewal of the BMW brand. 
 As a Body Quality Inspection Specialist (Quality Tester) at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will play a key role in ensuring that vehicle bodies meet the highest quality standards throughout the production process. 
 What awaits you? 
 Working environment – You will work in the audit and quality inspection area of the Debrecen plant in a structured environment supported by modern equipment. 
 Teamwork – You will work closely with specialists from quality, production, and engineering. 
 Body inspection – You will inspect both painted and unpainted vehicle bodies according to defined quality requirements. 
 Defect identification – You will identify surface defects, spot weld deficiencies, and soldering imperfections. 
 Evaluation and documentation – You will assess identified defects according to the applicable standards, classify them based on BI criteria, and document them accurately in the relevant systems. 
 Preparation-related tasks – As part of the inspection process, you will support preparation activities required for effective body inspection. 
 Training and development – You will participate in an extensive training program that prepares you to perform the role at a high professional level. 
 Process improvement – You will support the development of quality assurance processes and contribute ideas for defect prevention. 
 What we expect from you 
 Educational background – You have a secondary technical qualification. 
 Professional background – A relevant technical specialization or practical experience is considered an advantage. 
 Quality awareness – You are able to recognize defects accurately on inspected surfaces. 
 Attention to detail – You work precisely, reliably, and with high quality standards. 
 Technical mindset – You are comfortable navigating technical and quality inspection processes. 
 Documentation skills – You are able to document defects and deviations accurately. 
 Communication and teamwork – You collaborate effectively across functions and are open to learning new skills and processes. 
 Working schedule – Currently, the position is performed in a day-shift schedule. 
 Language skills – Hungarian language skills are required; English is an advantage. 
 Training period – You are willing to undertake a longer onboarding and training period of approximately six months. 
 What do we offer? 
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance. In addition to the base salary, our benefits package includes: 
 Salary development – Annually, based on performance evaluation. 
 Bonus – Based on company and individual results. 
 Cafeteria – Annual cafeteria allowance paid monthly. 
 Commuting support – Free direct bus and rail services aligned with shift schedules from major cities in the region. In the case of car use, reimbursement is provided in accordance with legal regulations. 
 Healthcare services – High-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise opportunities at the health center located in the Debrecen plant. 
 Private health insurance – Available to all employees after the probation period. 
 Accident and life insurance – Group accident and life insurance coverage both during and outside working hours. 
 Subsidized meals – One subsidized hot meal per day in the company canteen. 
 At BMW Group Plant Debrecen, we place great emphasis on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruitment and selection decisions are based on the personality, experience, and capabilities of the applicants. 
 Type of employment: permanent employment contract 
 Working hours: full-time 
 This position requires shift work. 
 CONTACT US: 
 Do you have questions about recruitment? Call our telephone customer service. 
 Phone number: +36 52 33 1717

items.desc:
WE’RE DRIVEN TO FINANCE DREAMS. 
 SHARE YOUR PASSION. 
 At BMW, our dynamic finance teams continuously drive our business forward. And we count on everyone to play their part in helping us to reach ambitious new milestones. So whether you’re passionate about supporting our diverse teams with expert financial planning and management, or creating innovative new financial products that enable more people to enjoy the thrill of driving our vehicles, you’re sure to find an exciting challenge with us. Fostering a culture where everyone feels empowered, rewarded and supported is the driving force behind our success. So join us in changing the way the world moves for good.
 Data tells a story, but only when someone knows how to bring it to life. As a Data Analytics Specialist, you will help transform complex data into meaningful insights that inspire action, drive decisions, and shape the future of the business. You will work with stakeholders across the organization to uncover opportunities, create compelling visual narratives, and foster a truly data-driven culture.
 What awaits you?
 Turn data into powerful stories that help business leaders make confident, informed decisions.
 Develop insightful reports, dashboards, and visualizations that clearly communicate trends, opportunities, and business impact.
 Ensure data quality, reliability, and accessibility, providing a trusted foundation for decision-making across the organization.
 Partner with local and international stakeholders to identify business challenges and translate them into data-driven solutions.
 Act as a trusted advisor in reporting and analytics, combining business understanding with technical expertise.
 Drive innovation within the analytics landscape by exploring and implementing new technologies, including AI and machine learning.
 Contribute to cross-functional projects and help shape a culture where decisions are guided by data, not assumptions.
 What should you bring along?
 At least 3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar role.
 A passion for storytelling with data and the ability to transform complex findings into clear, actionable insights.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a curious and business-oriented mindset.
 The confidence to engage with stakeholders at all levels and communicate technical concepts in an accessible way.
 Experience with Business Intelligence tools, data analytics methodologies, and data warehouse concepts.
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
 Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, paired with a continuous eagerness to learn, grow, and innovate.
 What do we offer? 
 At BMW Group Belux you will not only work for a strong brand, but also in an environment that breathes premium - from our products to our people.
 An international working environment with a clear vision of innovation and sustainability;
 A warm corporate culture where initiative and personal growth are encouraged;
 Extensive training and development opportunities;
 An attractive salary package with mobility solutions and a flexible cafeteria plan.
 Apply today and discover how you can make a difference at BMW Group Belux!
 Looking for purpose at work? One of BMW Group Belux’s entities (Alphabet Belgium) is recognized with EcoVadis Platinum for its sustainability!

 Infolge der Pensionierung eines langjährigen Mitarbeiters suchen wir eine:n technische:n Betriebspezialisten:in für die Unterstützung der Institutsleitung und des Forschungsbetriebes.

 Arbeitsort

 Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt. naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.

 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.

 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 150 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 750 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 2000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Za prácu v obchodnom centre Ťa navyše odmeníme mesačným príspevkom vo výške 150 EUR. 
 Účel a náplň práce 
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO HYPOTEKÁRNY ŠPECIALISTA/ŠPECIALISTKA BUDE:
 - samostatne predávať hypotekárne úvery a poskytovať kompletné služby pre klientov spoločnosti, ktorí majú záujem o hypotekárne úvery
- čeliť vysokým nárokom na plnenie obchodného plánu v oblasti hypotekárnych úverov, ako aj na Cross-sell ďalších produktov banky
- vyvíjať vlastné aktivity na podporu plnenia plánu
- profitovať z motivačného odmeňovacieho systému, postavenému na výraznej províznej zložke (na mesačnej báze)
- oceňovať transparentný a spravodlivý systém ďalšieho kariérneho rastu na riadiace pozície na základe dosiahnutých výsledkov
- zvládať neustále vzdelávanie sa a odborný rast (početné interné školenia, workshopy, samoštúdium)
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!

 stredoškolské s maturitou

 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 máš minimálne 2 roky praxe,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.

items.desc:
Berlin / Copenhagen / Gdansk / Madrid / Amsterdam or Porto Hybrid 
 About Shine
 Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners. 
 Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin. 
 Part of something bigger 
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, Spain,Portugal. 
 Your hiring experience matters 
 Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive. If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 One application. Multiple teams. The right fit.
 We're not hiring for one role, we're hiring for many, and we want to find the best place for you within Shine's engineering organisation.
 This is our Engineering Pool : a single application that puts you in front of multiple product and platform teams. Instead of applying to a specific opening and hoping it matches, you apply once. Our Talent Acquisition team will get to know you, understand what you're looking for, and help guide you to the team where you'll genuinely thrive.
 You'll meet engineers from across the organisation to get a real feel for how we build and operate, and with the right match, you'll join a team where the culture, challenge, and craft align with your own growth.
 Teams you could join
 When you enter the pool, you'll be considered across teams working in domains such as:
 Accounting
 Platform
 Banking
 Invoicing
 CPA Solutions
 What we're looking for
 We don't hire to a rigid checklist. But across all teams and levels, we look for engineers who:
 Care about the product , not just the technology
 Take ownership: follow through, raise problems early, and care about outcomes
 Deliver with craft: build systems they're proud of and hold themselves to a high standard
 Collaborate well in a multicultural environment, communicating clearly in team rituals, code reviews, and cross-functional conversations
 Are honest, direct, and kind in how they work with others
 Are comfortable in a fast-moving environment, as we're building something ambitious and teams naturally evolve as we grow
 Have made AI a real part of how they build, in their editor, debugging, and design process, and have opinions on what works, because they've tried things
 Levels
 Our process is designed to assess the right level for you:
 Mid-level: Autonomous delivery, good technical judgement, ability to build and operate a feature end-to-end
 Senior: Technical depth, cross-team influence, mentorship, ability to shape technical direction
 Staff: System-level thinking, long-horizon ownership, meaningful impact spanning the engineering organisation
 Our tech stack
 Teams at Shine work with a modern stack. Depending on the team, you'll find:
 Languages: TypeScript · Node.js · PHP · Kotlin
 Frontend: React · React Native · Next.js
 Frameworks: ExpressJS · NestJS · Laravel
 Architecture: Microservices · Event-Driven · CQRS · Event Sourcing · DDD · REST APIs · Pub/Sub
 Cloud: Azure · GCP · AWS · Kubernetes
 Databases: PostgreSQL · MySQL · Spanner · BigQuery
 We don't expect you to know everything, we expect you to be genuinely good at your craft and ready to learn.
 How this works
 Apply once: tell us about yourself, what you're looking for, and where you want to grow
 Intro call with Talent Acquisition: we'll learn about your background, your goals, and explore which teams could be the right match
 Technical evaluations: General Tech & Coding, System Design, and Engineering Manager interviews
 Stakeholder & Collaboration stage: you'll meet a Product Manager from Shine and get a sense of how we work together
 Soft skills interview: so we understand how best to support your growth at Shine
 Offer: if it's a match, we move fast
 We want you to leave every stage feeling like you learned something about Shine, not just the other way around.
 Where we work
 We're a hybrid team with engineering hubs in:
 🇩🇪 Berlin · 🇫🇷 Paris · 🇩🇰 Copenhagen · 🇵🇱 Gdansk · 🇪🇸 Madrid 🇳🇱 Amsterdam

items.desc: We are building the AI coworker for legal and professional services — automating emails, document analysis, and complex workflows in high-stakes industries. We are not looking for someone to “use GPT APIs.” We are looking for someone to own and scale a production AI system that users rely on daily. What you will own You will be responsible for one primary outcome: making our AI outputs reliable, fast, and indispensable in real workflows. Concretely: Design and evolve our LLM / agent architecture. Own output quality across key use cases (emails, document analysis, etc.). Build evaluation systems (datasets, metrics, regression detection). Drive fast iteration loops from production data. Improve retrieval, reasoning, and tool usage. Ensure production reliability (latency, failure modes, fallbacks). Work directly with product and founders on what to build and why. What this role is really about Most teams fail because they don’t know what “good output” means, lack proper evals, iterate randomly, or overuse agents. Your job is to fix that. You will turn vague user problems into structured AI systems with measurable performance that improve every week. What You Need to Be Excellent At Shipping Real LLM Systems Evaluation-Driven Development Debugging Complex Failures Speed of Iteration Strong Technical Judgment What we don’t care about Number of years of experience. Whether you’ve used a specific framework. Fancy research credentials. If you can build, debug, and improve real systems, you’re a fit. What success looks like (First 90 Days) A clear evaluation framework established for core use cases. Measurable, quantitative improvement in output quality. Faster iteration cycles across the team. Significantly reduced hallucinations and failure modes. Robust, scalable system architecture decisions. Tech Stack (Context, Not Strict Requirements) Language/Backend: Python (FastAPI) Database: Postgres Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Orchestration: LangGraph / LangChain (evolving) Observability: PostHog (analytics), Langfuse (LLM tracing) LLM Infrastructure: Azure OpenAI / Multi-provider APIs

items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Systèmes d'information Contrat CDI Intitulé de l'offre Ingénieur de Recherche en IA génératives (images et son) H/F Statut du poste Cadre Description de l'offre La Direction des Applications Militaires du CEA, acteur clé de la souveraineté et de la compétitivité numérique pour la France, se mobilise pleinement autour des enjeux liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Intégré(e) à nos équipes en tant qu’ingénieur de recherche en IA appliquée au traitement automatique du langage, vous contribuerez sur des projets internes et pluridisciplinaires à optimiser l’extraction d’informations à partir de documents structurés et non structurés (PDF, images, scans, etc.) via des modèles d’OCR et à concevoir et déployer des systèmes de RAG pour améliorer l’accès aux connaissances internes et automatiser des tâches de recherche ou d’analyse. Ce poste s’inscrit dans une démarche d’innovation technologique et de souveraineté des données, avec un fort accent sur l’évaluation, l’intégration et le déploiement en environnement on-premise. A ce titre, vos principales missions seront : Sélectionner et optimiser des Modèles d’OCR, en évaluant les modèles open-source et propriétaires en fonction des besoins métiers, en adaptant les modèles aux spécificités des documents du CEA, et en les comparant en termes de précision, latence, et robustesse. Concevoir et déployer des systèmes RAG, en indexant (postgreSQL, ElasticSearch) et retrouvant des informations, en choisissant les composants clés comme les modèles d’embeddings, les bases de données vectorielles, les modèles de langage (LLM), les mécanismes de re-ranking. Modéliser la multimodalité, en fusionnant via des modèles cross-modaux pour lier images, texte, et audio ; en déployant des générations Texte Image pour la visualisation de concepts techniques et Audio Texte/Image (ex. : transcription + analyse sémantique) ; en proposant des stratégies de modération (guardrails). Industrialiser les processus de développement et de déploiement, en garantissant la sécurité et l'intégrité des données. Rejoindre le CEA c’est évoluer dans un environnement scientifique d’excellence au service de projets à forts enjeux tout en bénéficiant d’un cadre de travail équilibré. Avec un Family Score de 98%, le CEA est à la tête du Label Parents on board qui récompense notre engagement en matière de parentalité. Ce poste bénéficie de télétravail, conformément aux accords et modalités en vigueur au sein du CEA. Il est également possible d’occuper le poste à distance sur un autre centre CEA DAM, notamment au CESTA en Nouvelle Aquitaine. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. #LI-RP1 Profil du candidat Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou en université spécialisé en informatique, vous justifiez d'une premiere expérience dans l'IA. Vous êtes à l'écoute et organisé, avec une capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos qualités de communication et la tenue des objectifs. items.desc: Ansök Vill du vara med och utveckla hur en hel kommun använder digitalisering, data och AI för att skapa verklig nytta? Hos oss får du möjlighet att omsätta ny teknik till smartare arbetssätt och bättre service för dem vi är till för. Rollen som verksamhetsutvecklare hos oss I Kungsbacka kommun satsar vi på verksamhetsutveckling med stöd av digitalisering för att möta framtidens utmaningar och möjligheter. Vårt mål är att skapa ännu större nytta för människor som bor, verkar och vistas i Kungsbacka. Tjänsten är placerad på Digitaliseringsenheten inom Kommunledningskontoret. Du arbetar kommunövergripande och får en viktig roll i att hjälpa våra verksamheter att omsätta möjligheterna med digitalisering, data och AI till konkret verksamhetsnytta. I nära samarbete med chefer, medarbetare och specialister vägleder du verksamheterna i hur ny teknik kan bidra till bättre arbetssätt och service. En central del av uppdraget är att inspirera, utbilda och stärka organisationens förmåga att använda data och AI på ett tryggt och ansvarsfullt sätt. Du bidrar också till att utveckla kommunens gemensamma arbetssätt inom AI genom att bland annat ta fram vägledningar, utbildningsmaterial och gemensamma principer. I rollen ingår även att fånga upp verksamheternas behov, bevaka utvecklingen inom området och identifiera och föreslå AI-lösningar som kan skapa nytta för flera verksamheter. Du kommer också att självständigt driva utvecklingsuppdrag, från identifierat behov till genomförande och uppföljning. Din profil Vi söker dig som har god förståelse för verksamhetsutveckling med stöd av digitalisering i en större organisation. Du ser sambandet mellan verksamhetens behov, teknikens möjligheter och den nytta vi vill skapa. Du har förståelse för data och AI ur ett verksamhetsperspektiv och kan resonera kring både möjligheter, begränsningar och risker. För att lyckas i rollen är du självgående, strukturerad och initiativtagande. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer, lyssna in behov och bygga förtroende. Samtidigt vågar du utmana invanda arbetssätt och ställa frågor som driver utvecklingen framåt. Du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ med förmåga att göra komplexa frågor begripliga för olika målgrupper. Du kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer, prioritera det viktigaste och omsätta idéer till konkret handling. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och hur du kompletterar teamet. Ready to help build a better future for generations to come? In an ever-changing, fast paced world, we owe it to ourselves and our future generations to live responsibly. At ROCKWOOL, we work relentlessly to enrich modern living through our innovative stone wool solutions. Join us and make a difference! Your future team You will become part of the ROCKWOOL New Businesses team, our innovation and growth engine. Guided by our mission of "Releasing the natural power of stone to enrich modern living," we leverage ROCKWOOL's global brand and footprint to identify, build, and scale entirely new businesses that extend stone wool's impact beyond our core business. You will be joining a small, close-knit, highly autonomous team of entrepreneurial colleagues who back each other up while each driving their own ventures forward independently. What you will be doing You will take ownership of identifying, building, and scaling new business ventures from early-stage exploration through commercial launch. items.desc: Description Energy Aspects is shaping its marketing team to support the next chapter of the company's growth. AI sits at the heart of that evolution: automated workflows do the heavy lifting, and people focus on strategy, judgement, and quality. We're hiring a Marketing Engineer to build and run the technical layer that makes this possible: the integrations, data flows, and AI-driven workflows that turn marketing strategy into execution, reliably and at scale. An engineer first, applied to marketing. We're looking for someone who builds things: automations, integrations, and AI agents that hold up in production. You don't need a marketing background or prior experience with our specific platforms. A good engineer can pick up any system, and we'll help you learn ours. You are the engine room of the marketing function. The team is organised around two demand engines. Account-based marketing (ABM), targeting existing and strategic accounts, is led by the Campaign Manager. New Customer Development (NCD), winning new logos, is led by the Digital Marketing Manager together with the SDR team. Both are fed by an AI-driven content engine and both run on the same technical foundation, which is the layer you own. You'll report to the Head of Marketing, work day-to-day with the marketing managers and the SDR team, and collaborate closely with the Technical team, following their standards and using the AI models and tooling they approve. Deploy, run, and maintain the pipelines that turn content ideas into campaign assets, sequences, and social copy, and connect those outputs to the systems that publish and distribute them. Data & reporting. Keep contact and account data clean, and build the segmentation, routing, and dashboards the marketing managers rely on. Reporting builds on Energy Aspects' existing data warehouse and BI layer, so there's a single source of truth. Support across the team. Give the SDR team and the marketing managers the list builds and targeting workflows they need for both demand engines, QA HTML email templates where automation needs a human hand, and support our Duda website and, later, the move to a code-first site alongside the Technical team. A track record of building software, integrations, or automation, whether your background is in software, data, automation, RevOps, or GTM engineering. Python or a similar language, APIs, and Git are part of your everyday toolkit. Data fluency. Comfortable with SQL and with moving, cleaning, and joining data across systems. AI experience or strong appetite. Experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI workflow tools is a real plus. If you haven't yet, we want to see genuine curiosity and a willingness to learn fast, because this is how the team works. A builder's mindset. items.desc: Position description Category Intrumentation, metrology and control Contract Internship Job title Reproducible elemental quantification of technological materials by photoemission H/F Subject The development of advanced electronic components requires a thorough understanding of the elemental composition of the constituent thin-film materials at the micro- and nanometer scale. This internship focuses on the physical aspects of X-ray photoemission to gain better understanding about reproducible quantification with uncertainties of 5% and below. Contract duration (months) 6 Job description Among the analytical techniques available in cleanrooms and laboratories, hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (HAXPES) is gaining ground due to its ability to perform non-destructive measurements below the surface and deeper at the sub-surface to adress buried layers. This internship addresses the major challenge, within the international community in the field, of high-precision quantification in HAXPES, based on recent methodologies using both intensity calibration with a spectrometer transmission function and core-line intensity determination using Tougaard background substraction. The internship will focus on refining the intensity determination by incorporating physical data describing the energy losses of photoelectrons in the materials under investigation. Methods / Means Hard X-ray photoemission spectrometer/dedicated quantification softwares Applicant Profile Master 2 Materials Science, Condensed Matter Physics or equivalent. An interest in carrying out physical measurements on ultra-high-vacuum systems (either commercial or home-made ones), analysing spectroscopic data using dedicated software, and working as part of a team within a multi-partner collaboration involving an academic laboratory (the Paris Institute of Nanosciences) and a British standards institute (the National Physical Laboratory). Position location Site Grenoble Job location France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Location Grenoble Candidate criteria Prepared diploma Bac+5 - Master 2 Recommended training Materials Science and Engineering, Condensed Matter Physics PhD opportunity Oui Requester Position start date 01/02/2027 General information Organisation The French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA) is a key player in research, development and innovation in four main areas : defence and security, nuclear energy (fission and fusion), technological research for industry, fundamental research in the physical sciences and life sciences. Drawing on its widely acknowledged expertise, and thanks to its 16000 technicians, engineers, researchers and staff, the CEA actively participates in collaborative projects with a large number of academic and industrial partners. The CEA is established in ten centers spread throughout France Reference 2026-42068 Description de l'unité The internship will take place at the one of the key platform of the Leti institute, the Nanocharacterisation Platform of CEA-Grenoble (PFNC), one of Europe’s leading centres for the advanced characterization of nanomaterials.

Votre rôle En tant qu'Ingénieur Cybersécurité Splunk, vous êtes garant de l'amélioration continue des capacités de détection déployées sur la plateforme Splunk du SOC et du CSIRT. Votre rôle consiste principalement à concevoir et optimiser des scénarios de détection dans Splunk, à automatiser les processus d'investigation et d'enrichissement, et à contribuer à l'intégration de nouvelles sources de données et de nouvelles technologies, notamment l'intelligence artificielle, dans les pratiques de surveillance. Vos missions Concevoir et développer de nouveaux scénarios de détection dans Splunk, et optimiser les règles existantes pour réduire les faux positifs et améliorer la pertinence des alertes ; Développer et maintenir des règles de détection en SPL (Search Processing Language), ainsi qu'en Sigma et YARA pour les contenus multiplateformes ; Concevoir des modèles de corrélation et de scoring dans Splunk Enterprise Security, et définir les indicateurs permettant de prioriser efficacement les alertes de sécurité ; Exploiter les retours d'expérience issus des incidents, du Threat Hunting et de la CTI pour enrichir en continu le référentiel de détection Splunk ; Réaliser les tests, recettes et validations nécessaires avant mise en production, et assurer le transfert des contenus développés vers les équipes SOC ; Développer et maintenir les connecteurs entre Splunk et les autres plateformes de sécurité (SOAR, CTI, EDR, NDR, outils d'investigation) ; Développer des scripts et outils d'automatisation pour industrialiser les processus d'enrichissement et d'investigation du CSIRT et du SOC ; Participer à l'intégration de nouvelles sources de logs et de nouveaux équipements dans Splunk, et contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité des données indexées ; Assurer une veille sur les solutions d'intelligence artificielle appliquées à la cybersécurité, et identifier les cas d'usage permettant d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle des analystes SOC et CSIRT ; Contribuer à l'expérimentation de solutions basées sur l'IA générative pour l'assistance à l'investigation et la génération de contenus de détection ; Documenter l'ensemble des développements réalisés et contribuer au suivi de la performance des détections via des tableaux de bord dédiés (Splunk dashboards). Votre profil De formation Bac+5 en informatique ou en cybersécurité, vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée en SOC, en détection ou en Threat Hunting, avec une pratique avérée de Splunk. Vous maîtrisez le langage SPL et avez une bonne connaissance du framework MITRE ATT&CK. Une pratique du scripting est attendue pour l'automatisation des processus de sécurité. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre esprit d'analyse, votre curiosité technologique et votre aisance à collaborer avec des équipes SOC et CSIRT. Les petits plus Certification Splunk (Power User, Admin ou Splunk Enterprise Security) ; Expérience en environnement SOC/CSIRT ; Pratique du Detection-as-Code (Git/GitLab) ; Connaissance de la CTI et du Threat Hunting ; Appétence pour l'IA appliquée à la cybersécurité. Informations pratiques Localisation : Aix-en-Provence Contrat : CDI uniquement Rémunération : 45 – 58 K€ brut annuel selon profil et expérience Démarrage : Dès que possible

items.desc: At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. items.desc: Org. Setting and Reporting This position is located in the CEB Secretariat, reporting to the Senior Inter-Agency Human Resources Advisor. The focus of the position is twofold: The first focus is to identify, structure and underpin data-and analytics-driven solutions in all areas of Inter-Agency Human Resources matters ranging from demographics and cost-related topics to behavioral aspects. A strong conceptual and scientific foundation is expected to underpin such solutions, in order to ensure objectivity and credibility of the proposed solutions. The second focus is to generate and communicate Human Resources-related data-driven analyses and insights in support of decision-making processes, by looking at historical trends, current data and predictions. Responsibilities Within delegated authority, the Data and Behavioral Scientist will be responsible for the following duties: • Works with stakeholders across the CEB organizations to identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive business solutions. • Develops and implements databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies to optimize statistical efficiency and quality including automation scripts and internal software. • Applies causal inference and experimental methods such as randomized controlled trials, quasi-experimental designs, and causal modeling of observational data to estimate the impact of system-wide policies and inform evidence-based decisions. • Collects, mines, scrapes and analyzes data including those shared by organizations shared by organizations to drive optimization and improvement of inter-agency coordination in behavioral sciences, human resources, organizational management and compensation. • Assesses and tests the effectiveness and accuracy of new datasets and data processing procedures. • Develops custom predictive algorithms to apply to data sets. • Coordinates with different functional teams in CEB organizations to implement models and monitor outcomes • Performs other duties as assigned. Competencies Professionalism: Knowledge of the data analysis life cycle from ingest and wrangling to analysis and visualization to present findings. Excellent knowledge of statistical and computational methods, such as clustering, classification, correlation, dimension reduction, forecasting, machine learning, detecting outliers, and regression. Takes pride in the work for the organization and understands the impact that can be brought into the organization by allowing data-driven and evidence-based decisions. Ability to apply judgment in the context of assignments given, plan own work and manage conflicting priorities. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work. Planning& Organizing: Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies; identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required; allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work; foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning; monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary; uses time efficiently. Accountability: Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honours commitments. Delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards. Operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules. Supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments. Takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable. Education Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in data science, computer science, information management, statistics, public administration, public information, economics, management or a related field. A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree. Job - Specific Qualification Not available. Experience with data science and statistics-related programming languages such as R and Python, with SQL and relational database design and management is required. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role We’re looking for a sharp, user-focused UX Researcher to help shape and improve the overall player experience. You’ll act as the voice of the user by conducting research, uncovering behavioral insights, and turning those findings into clear, actionable product decisions. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, and Data teams , ensuring that product decisions are driven by real user needs and behaviors rather than assumptions. This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys working with ambiguity, finding meaningful insights, and turning research into measurable product outcomes. Behavioral Analysis — Analyze user behavior across our platform using analytics tools, session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify friction points and opportunities. Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work directly with Product Managers, Designers, and Developers to embed user insights into the product lifecycle from ideation through launch. UX Standards — Champion user-centered design principles, accessibility standards, and usability best practices across all product initiatives. Continuous Discovery — Proactively identify new research questions, monitor industry UX trends, and propose process improvements to keep our research function sharp. Qualifications 2+ years of hands-on experience in UX research, with a portfolio or case studies demonstrating research-to-product impact. Proficiency in Figma and/or Visily for wireframing, prototyping, and user flow design. Proven experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, and surveys — both moderated and unmoderated. Familiarity with analytics and behavioral tools such as Mixpanel, Hotjar, FullStory, or Google Analytics. items.desc: Join our College team! We are the largest innovation hub in Europe, but we are also a College. We are looking to expand our outstanding teaching team and invite you to experience how rewarding it is to work in an environment that values: Your knowledge of management, leadership and organisational behaviour An entrepreneurial and hands-on approach to learning A collaborative and dynamic culture – our faculty is international, forward-thinking, and passionate about inspiring students Our campus is located in scenic surroundings near Venice and Treviso. Role Overview As part of our BSc programmes, we are seeking a Teaching Assistant for Management Principles to support the module leader in introducing first-year students to the principles and practice of management. The module is a foundation for many of the modules that follow and is shared across several programmes, including Business Creation and Entrepreneurship, Marketing and Global Commerce, Management and Data Science, Digital Economics and Finance, International Business Studies, and AI & Sports Management. It covers management processes and relationships, leadership and decision making, teamwork and negotiation, organisational behaviour and culture, human resource management, and business structures and typologies. The successful candidate will provide day-to-day support and assistance to students and faculty, helping first-year students connect core management theories with real-world examples and building their confidence in a supportive, developmental and well-scaffolded learning environment. Key Responsibilities Assist the module leader in the delivery of lectures, seminars, group discussions and case study activities (36 teaching hours in presence at the H-Farm Campus) Support students during in-class activities, group work and case study analysis, helping them understand key concepts such as management processes, leadership, motivation, team dynamics and conflict resolution Assist students in developing academic skills, including research, use of literature, critical reading, academic writing and Harvard referencing, with particular attention to the literature review assessment Support the organisation and invigilation of the two in-class mid-term tests and assist with marking and feedback under the guidance of the module leader Help prepare and update teaching materials, slides, readings, case studies and content on the virtual learning environment (VLE) Qualifications & Experience C1 level of English (teaching language) A Master’s degree in Management, Business Administration, Organisational Behaviour, Human Resource Management, or a related field (Ph.D. candidates are welcome to apply) Good knowledge of management theory, leadership models, organisational behaviour and HRM Previous experience as a teaching assistant, tutor or in student support roles is a plus Professional experience in management, HR or entrepreneurship is a plus Excellent communication, organisational and interpersonal skills, with a patient, student-centred and inclusive approach Ability to work collaboratively within a teaching team and in a multicultural environment Passion for supporting students as they build strong foundations for their future studies and careers What We Offer Contract type: freelance collaboration, or coordinated and continuous collaboration contract (co.co.co.) items.desc: Your job As a Research Funding Officer, you help turn new research ideas into concrete projects. You identify and assess opportunities for research funding and support the development of proposals, grant applications, and collaboration initiatives. In doing so, you work closely with researchers, project leaders, clients, and support departments within WMR and Wageningen University & Research (WUR). You will be part of the Acquisition Support & Project Management Team, a team of approximately nine colleagues who support researchers in acquiring and delivering research projects. You will work in an international, applied scientific environment where marine and freshwater ecological challenges are at the core. Projects range from field and experimental research to data management, modelling, and policy-oriented research. As a result, you will gain broad insight into the research activities of Wageningen Research and be involved in a wide variety of societal and scientific challenges. What does a typical day look like? You start the day by reviewing new requests, project proposals, and incoming questions. You then coordinate with project leaders regarding grant applications, proposals, and the progress of ongoing submissions. You align budgets, co-funding arrangements, and investments with finance colleagues and discuss contractual conditions with the legal department. Throughout the day, you critically review proposals and provide advice on their fit with grant requirements, tenders, or a client’s request. Researchers also approach you with questions about proposals, projects, and internal processes. In this way, you collaborate daily with a variety of colleagues to successfully move new research projects forward, from initial idea to contract award or grant application. Your tasks and responsibilities as a Research Funding Officer include: identifying and monitoring relevant contracts, tenders, and funding opportunities; assessing grant and tender requirements and advising on opportunities, risks, co-funding, and collaboration structures; coordinating proposal and grant application processes from initiation through submission; advising researchers and project leaders on acquisition, proposal, and grant procedures; coordinating with financial, legal, and scientific stakeholders to ensure successful applications and projects; monitoring the progress of acquisition, proposal, and research projects and identifying bottlenecks in a timely manner; supporting project leaders in the areas of planning, budgeting, quality assurance, and communication; maintaining relationships with clients, collaboration partners, and internal stakeholders; managing project administration, documentation, and reporting; improving and professionalising acquisition, proposal, and project management processes. Where you will work Wageningen Marine Research (WMR) is one of the nine research institutes that form part of Wageningen Research. WMR is a leading independent research institute with locations in IJmuiden, Den Helder, and Yerseke, specialising in strategic and applied marine ecological research. Our products and services are delivered on a project basis and are highly diverse, including field research, large-scale experiments, laboratory-based exploratory studies, data management, and modelling. We offer a varied position at the intersection of business development and project management; a professional and stimulating working environment; collaboration with dedicated researchers and project management professionals; the opportunity to contribute to societally relevant marine research; plenty of opportunities for personal development and growth. Your qualities You are proactive, results-oriented, and possess excellent organisational skills. You are able to maintain oversight of complex processes, work accurately, and feel comfortable in an environment where different interests and disciplines come together. Qualifications a completed academic degree (BSc, MSc level or equivalent) in a field relevant to the position; several years of experience in a role where process coordination is a key component; excellent command of both Dutch and English (C1 level), in speaking and writing; knowledge of and experience with research projects, grant processes, or business development activities is an advantage; affinity with marine ecological or other scientific research topics; strong communication and organisational skills. We offer Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment. A few highlights from our collective labour agreement include: working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance; sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave; a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%; excellent pension scheme. In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross …
