This is technical leadership, not architecture-only advice or task execution. You will work directly with operational experts, the client’s technology partners and our engineers, challenge assumptions constructively, and carry the technical solution from discovery through implementation and evaluation. How you will work You own the technical approach, engineering plan, implementation quality and evidence of readiness. You partner with the engagement Principal, who owns the integrated delivery plan, commercial scope and client commitments. You provide feasibility assessments before commitments are made and escalate unresolved dependencies or scope changes with options and their impact. What you will own 1. Establish an evidence-based technical baseline Inspect the code, infrastructure, APIs and operator workflows before estimating the build. Translate discovery into concise specifications with inputs, outputs, exclusions, acceptance tests and source references. Distinguish confirmed requirements from analyst recommendations and assumptions. Resolve contradictions with the appropriate owner. Do not implement them silently. 2. Make integration work early Build and review critical components, guide engineers and prove a thin end-to-end path in the client’s test environment: receive a request, retrieve operational data, produce a recommendation, obtain approval and perform the agreed system handoff. Verify API access, write capabilities, event contracts and error paths. Do not treat documentation or isolated components as proof of readiness. 3. Make rules and knowledge maintainable Design a clear separation between operational facts, business policies and software logic. Work with named business owners to define rule precedence, exceptions, validation and approval. Keep draft or inferred rules separate from approved rules. Support versioned updates without a software release, with historical replay, traceable approval and rollback. Use grounded reasoning and human escalation where rules do not resolve a case. 4. Own engineering quality and evaluation Review and test code, including AI-generated code, against the agreed architecture. Establish automated CI checks, integration tests and representative operational cases. Track the exact application, rule and data versions evaluated. Implement decision logs, monitoring, access controls and failure recovery. Define test-readiness evidence and agree workflow-quality, latency and operating-cost measures with the team and client. 5. Keep technical decisions and progress clear Maintain a concise architecture and decision record that shows what works, what remains and why. Raise blockers early with evidence, an owner, a decision needed and delivery impact. Propose simpler alternatives and update estimates when assumptions change. Demonstrate working increments, and clearly distinguish prototypes from integrated functionality. Leave the team with maintainable code, documentation and a practical handover. What good looks like Before build commitments: a reviewed technical baseline, verified critical dependencies and explicit assumptions behind the estimate. During delivery: a working end-to-end increment, automated tests running in CI, and demonstrated progress against agreed acceptance cases. For rule changes: a named business approver, a versioned baseline and recorded replay results before promotion. At evaluation: reproducible results, decision traces and documented limitations that support the agreed Go/No-Go decision, not just a successful demo. Specific targets will be agreed after the baseline is established. You will stay involved from the initial working sessions through delivery and evaluation. What you bring Evidence of taking an applied AI or LLM-enabled workflow beyond a prototype into operational use. Strong hands-on software engineering, architecture, API integration and code-review skills. Experience turning incomplete or conflicting discovery material into implementable, testable specifications. Sound judgment about structured rules, retrieval, AI reasoning and human review, including their failure modes. Practical experience with evaluation datasets, regression testing, CI and production observability. Confidence to challenge assumptions, explain alternatives and escalate decisions constructively across business and engineering teams. Du analyserar behov och möjligheter, utformar insatser tillsammans med sakkunniga och följer utvecklingen inom ditt teknikområde. Du ansvarar också för att handlägga och följa upp finansierade projekt. I arbetet har du löpande dialog med företag, forskningsaktörer, myndigheter och andra organisationer i Sverige och internationellt. Många av Vinnovas uppdrag rör banbrytande tekniker. Följande teknikområden pekas ut som strategiskt viktiga för Sverige: artificiell intelligens/autonoma system, avancerad digital teknik (inklusive halvledare), rymdteknik, kvantteknik, energiteknik, material- och produktionsteknik och bioteknik. items.desc: TIKK TAKK söker fyra seniora systemutvecklare inom .NET för konsultuppdrag hos en statlig myndighet inom transportsektorn i Örebro. Myndigheten inför en ny och förbättrad uppbördshantering och sidoordnad bokföring för skatter och avgifter inom vägtrafikområdet, vilket innebär förändrade verksamhetsprocesser och nya IT-system. Du blir en del av ett agilt leveransteam som bygger, vidareutvecklar och förvaltar verksamhetskritiska system i en komplex och distribuerad miljö. Rollen passar dig som är trygg i .NET och C# och vill bidra i hela utvecklingskedjan. Uppdraget kan även komma att omfatta andra produktområden eller projekt hos myndigheten. Om rollen Du deltar i alla steg i utvecklingsarbetet och levererar IT-system tillsammans med leveransteamet på ett agilt sätt. Arbetet omfattar både nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning. Arbetet sker inom myndighetens flextid mellan 06.30 och 18.30. I samband med produktionssättningar kan planerad övertid förekomma. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar att: - Förstå och tolka kravspecifikationer. - Planera och genomföra kodning, testning och felsökning av mjukvarukomponenter. - Leverera IT-system tillsammans med leveransteamet enligt agila arbetssätt. Arbeta med nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning av befintliga system. - Dokumentera systemdesign och implementation. Arbetsuppgifterna kan utvecklas utifrån verksamhetens behov och din kompetens. Vi söker dig som har - Erfarenhet av agilt arbete under senare tid. Minst sju års erfarenhet av .NET Core och C#. - Minst sju års erfarenhet av komplexa distribuerade system med många integrationer. - Minst sju års erfarenhet av tjänste- och händelseorienterade lösningar. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av Blazor. Minst fyra års erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL-databaser och datalager. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av SQL Server och databasoptimering. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD) och automatiserade tester. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av ServiceBus och NServiceBus. Minst fyra års erfarenhet av SpecFlow. - Minst två års erfarenhet av att dokumentera systemdesign och implementation. - Ett referensuppdrag som styrker din erfarenhet i rollen behöver kunna lämnas. Du behöver kunna arbeta från Örebro. Meriterande erfarenhet Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande: - Kundreskontra, betalningsavvikelsehantering eller ärendehanteringssystem, minst tre år. - Telerik UI for Blazor, minst två år under senare tid. - SSIS-paket för SQL Server, minst två år under senare tid. - Arbete hos en myndighet eller i en stor organisation med komplexa system och höga säkerhetskrav, under senare tid. Som person Du är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten och tar ansvar för att din kod håller över tid. Du samarbetar gärna i team, delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar aktivt till att teamet förbättrar sitt arbetssätt. Om uppdraget Plats: Örebro Omfattning: Heltid, 100 procent Antal tjänster: Fyra Planerad start: En tjänst med start 1 februari 2027 och tre tjänster med start 1 april 2027 Uppdragsperiod: Enligt avtal, med möjlighet till förlängning Ansökan Skicka ett uppdaterat CV och en kort motivering till varför du passar för uppdraget. Beskriv hur du uppfyller varje krav med antal år, bifoga ett referensuppdrag som styrker din erfarenhet i rollen och ange vilken startdag som passar dig. Urval sker löpande. Ansök snarast, senast den 24 oktober 2026.

items.desc: At GSK, we want to supercharge our data capability to better understand our patients and accelerate our ability to discover vaccines and medicines. The Onyx Research Data Platform organization represents a major investment by GSK R&D and Digital & Tech, designed to deliver a step-change in our ability to leverage data, knowledge, and prediction to find new medicines. items.desc: ServiceNow Technical & Enablement Architect Why Us! At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We’re proud to be leading a healthcare revolution, and we’re looking for people who can help us deliver on our ambition Job Purpose The ServiceNow Technical & Enablement Architect is accountable for setting the technical standards, patterns, and engineering practices that govern how solutions are built across the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools domain, ensuring consistent, scalable, and secure delivery aligned to enterprise architecture direction. The role translates platform strategy into reusable standards and development guardrails, and builds the engineering capability to apply them — through enablement, coaching, and hands-on guidance across ServiceNow development, configuration, and integration practices. This role supports Core platform capabilities for NLU, Chat and Service Portal in partnership with the Platform Manager and Product Managers, specifically the ServiceNow Data Intelligence & Experience Product Manager, who is accountable for ensuring UX experience aligned across the platform. Operating at a senior technical leadership level, the role provides design assurance, owns the technical skills path for engineers, and raises the consistency and craft of the engineering organization. It partners with the Automation Engineering Architect, Platform Architecture, and engineering leads to close capability gaps and reduce technical debt from inconsistent practices. The role sets standards and builds capability; it does not own delivery. Solution build sits with engineering teams, automation design with the Automation Engineering Architect, backlog priority with the Product Owner, and target architecture with Enterprise Architecture Key Responsibilities Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. Why You! We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). Experience in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations Other Job-Related Skills/Background Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. Clear design documentation, since patterns …

We want our town to be the best it can be. Our ambitious vision in the new Swindon Plan is supported by realistic transformation programmes, with the people of Swindon at their heart. Because that’s who we’re doing it for – the communities and businesses that make our town great. As part of the Council, you’ll support a friendly local authority making decisions with real impact. Your next role We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and experienced in Adult Social Care, who enjoys working alongside adults, building on their strengths, and supporting them to achieve the outcomes that matter most to them. You will bring excellent communication and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to work confidently within a fast-paced but supportive environment. If you are passionate about supporting adults, committed to delivering high-quality, strengths-based practice, and want to make a real difference to the lives of local people, we would love to hear from you. items.card: La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d’Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région et recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Ops Engineer H/F en CDI à Villeurbanne. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le contexte de transformation digitale des opérations, où vous serez le lien entre les équipes métiers et technologiques d’Akkodis pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des solutions d’automatisation basées sur l’IA.
items.desc:
La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d’Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région et recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Ops Engineer H/F en CDI à Villeurbanne. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le contexte de transformation digitale des opérations, où vous serez le lien entre les équipes métiers et technologiques d’Akkodis pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des solutions d’automatisation basées sur l’IA. Vous contribuerez à la création de workflows agentiques innovants, apportant une valeur mesurable aux processus opérationnels.
 Responsabilités principales : 
 Collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour diagnostiquer les besoins opérationnels et concevoir des solutions IA sur mesure.
 Déployer et intégrer des modèles IA dans l’infrastructure IT existante, en garantissant leur fonctionnement optimal.
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des workflows d’automatisation agentiques à grande échelle.
 Assurer la surveillance de la performance des systèmes IA et proposer des améliorations fondées sur l’analyse de données.
 Résoudre les incidents techniques et assurer la fiabilité et la sécurité des solutions en production.
 Former et accompagner les utilisateurs sur les outils et plateformes IA, en créant de la documentation et des retours d’expérience.
 Développer des bonnes pratiques et des modèles réutilisables pour les projets clients.
 Faire le relais entre le terrain et les équipes AI Ops pour capitaliser sur les succès et identifier les axes d’amélioration.
 Environnement de travail : 
Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique avancé, au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire et en interaction directe avec les directions opérationnelles, delivery, ventes, finance et RH. Les projets sont sponsorisés au plus haut niveau, avec une collaboration étroite entre les équipes IT et métiers. Le poste est basé à Lyon avec des déplacements limités, et implique une forte dimension collaborative, ainsi qu’une veille constante sur l’écosystème IA et agentique.

Issu(e) d'une formation d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un master en informatique, vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle, dont une pratique significative des solutions IA en production (LLM, workflows agentiques). Vous maîtrisez Python, FastAPI, FastMCP, les environnements cloud (Azure apprécié), la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), et les outils de monitoring. Vous avez une solide compréhension des architectures IA, du déploiement en production, et des principes DevOps (CI/CD). Votre capacité à diagnostiquer les besoins métiers, à analyser des données complexes et à traduire les enjeux business en solutions techniques vous distingue. Une expérience en management transverse et en accompagnement du changement est un atout. La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (niveau business) est indispensable. Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

 Hardware Security Engineer for Silicon Lifecycle Management Tools 
 Tessent is looking for a highly motivated, creative, and energetic engineer with a background in digital circuit design and verification, with an emphasis on hardware/software security, to strengthen our Research & Development team.
 Security is a critical aspect of solutions deployed for Silicon Lifecycle Management. We are seeking a hardware security expert who can help protect our Test IPs and Test Access Mechanisms (TAMs) against cyber-attacks.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for: 
 Designing secure architectures.
 Implementing cryptographic and authentication mechanisms.
 Performing adversarial assessments to identify vulnerabilities.
 Working closely with peer teams to ensure security requirements are integrated throughout the product lifecycle.
 The candidate will work as part of an international team of software and hardware development engineers, alongside Quality Assurance, Customer Support, Documentation, and Product Marketing teams.
 Together, we continuously strive to develop innovative products using the latest tools and technologies across multiple domains, including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
 This role offers the opportunity to lead the overall security strategy for our products and solutions, while continuing to develop both personal and professional skills and expertise.
 Required Experience 
 Strong understanding of semiconductor design.
 Experience designing and developing secure hardware and firmware solutions to defend against physical and side-channel attacks.
 Experience implementing: Hardware roots of trust Secure boot Secure key storage Hardware-accelerated encryption mechanisms
 Knowledge of: Cryptographic primitives Side-channel attacks Fault injection methods
 Expertise in hardware design, Verilog, and SystemVerilog.
 Demonstrated analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Preferred Experience 
 The following experience would be considered a strong advantage:
 Hands-on experience in semiconductor design.
 Knowledge of design flows and EDA tools in one or more of the following areas: HDL simulation Logic synthesis Integrated Circuit (IC) place and route Static Timing Analysis (STA) Logic Equivalence Checking Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) Reset Domain Crossing (RDC)
 Experience with industry standards and compliance frameworks, such as: FIPS Common Criteria ISO 26262 ISO/SAE 21434 (Automotive Cybersecurity)

 Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen verbinden wir die reale und die digitale Welt. 
 Als eines der führenden Technologieunternehmen beschäftigt Siemens in der Schweiz rund 6000 Mitarbeitende. Mit unseren wegweisenden Lösungen in den Bereichen Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie gestalten wir die Zukunft.
 Willst auch du aktiv am Puls der Zeit mitwirken und das Leben von Millionen von Menschen in der Schweiz besser machen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! 
 Für unseren Standort in Zug suchen wir einen engagierten Test Engineer zur Betreuung unserer Test- und Prüfsysteme in der Elektronikproduktion und Gerätemontage.
 Gemeinsam mit einem eingespielten Team von sieben Kollegen stellst du den reibungslosen Betrieb sicher, treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungen (KVP) voran und begleitest spannende Innovationsprojekte an der Schnittstelle zwischen R&D und Produktion.

 Aktive Einleitung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen zur Erhöhung der Testabdeckung und Anlageneffizienz
 Wartung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender In-Circuit- (ICT) und Funktionstest-Programme sowie Adapter infolge von Produktänderungen

 Praxis: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Mess- und Prüftechnik sowie im sicheren Umgang mit gängigen Messgeräten
 Methodik: Strukturiertes, analytisches Vorgehen bei der Fehlersuche an komplexen elektronischen Schaltungen und Prüfsystemen

 Mobilitätspauschale

 Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
 Alle Vorteile findest du hier

Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das von Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und persönlicher Entfaltung geprägt ist. Wir zeichnen uns durch Eigenverantwortung, Chancengerechtigkeit und Vielfalt aus, in der sich jede:r Mitarbeitende authentisch einbringen kann. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten sind bei uns gelebte Realität und ermöglichen unseren Mitarbeitenden eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Erfahre mehr und entdecke mit unserem Kulturquiz , ob du zu Siemens passt!

 Are you ready to shape the future of transportation with cutting-edge electronic design? Join us and make a real impact on sustainable mobility.
 Siemens Mobility: Shaping the Future of Transportation
 For over 160 years, Siemens Mobility has been a global leader, innovating transportation solutions that move the world. As a separately managed Siemens company, we are dedicated to making mobility more efficient, sustainable, and enjoyable for everyone.
 We lead the way in Rolling Stock, Rail Automation & Electrification, Turnkey Systems, Intelligent Traffic Systems, and comprehensive Related Services. Through digitalization, we empower operators worldwide to create intelligent infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and ensure unparalleled availability.
 Join us in transforming Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects, Electrification, Mainline & Urban Transport, and Customer Services. If you're ready to make a real impact on a more connected and sustainable future, your journey starts here.
 Your mission in our team
 As a Hardware Development Engineer, you will be a key player in our international and multidisciplinary development team, designing the electronic foundation for our next-generation railway solutions. Your work will directly contribute to the safety, reliability, and efficiency of our products.
 Challenges that await you:
 Designing robust analogue electronic circuits, including power electronics, signal amplification, filtering, and isolation.
 Collaborating on the design and implementation of communication and control boards for railway field elements.
 Conducting rigorous laboratory testing to verify designs functionally and non-functionally (EMC, climatic, etc.).
 Participating actively throughout the entire hardware development lifecycle, from requirements specification to testing.
 Driving innovation by researching and applying new technologies to our products.
 What will make your application stand out:
 A Degree in Industrial Engineering, Telecommunications, or an equivalent field, with a strong focus on Electronics.
 Fluent spoken and written English to thrive in our international environment.
 Proven experience in analogue electronics design, ideally within the railway, avionics, defense, or automotive industries.
 Strong analytical skills, self-motivation, and a creative approach to complex problem-solving.
 Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
 You’ll thrive even more if you also bring:
 Experience in digital electronics design, particularly with microprocessors and FPGAs.
 Hands-on experience with laboratory tasks, common electronic equipment, and debugging tools.
 Familiarity with manufacturing documentation processes.
 Knowledge of electronic board design and simulation tools like PSPICE, MatLab, or Simulink.
 Even if you don't meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to get to know you and explore the possibilities.
 What awaits you when you join:
 At Siemens Mobility, we are committed to sustainability, developing technologies that minimize environmental impact and promote green practices. We focus on our customers, delivering innovative solutions through digital transformation to enhance the passenger experience and optimize infrastructure. We believe in creating social value, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, learn continuously, and enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work model.
 If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit great minds from all walks of life. We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.
 Siemens aboga por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, así como en la Diversidad como fuente de creatividad e innovación. Your day-to-day impact: ✔ Turn raw, messy or unstructured data - article text, usage data, and new data arriving from external sources - into clean, ready-to-use formats for downstream products. ✔ Apply light ML/NLP techniques (e.g. entity extraction, classification, tagging) to structure unstructured text. ✔ Adapt existing pipelines to ingest and normalise new data types as they come online. ✔ Bring in
items.desc: Our client is the leading source of actionable intelligence for the global insurance, reinsurance and ILS markets. They are building a new AI-powered data product and need someone to help them turning their growing pool of data into the structured, ready-to-use formats that power search, personalisation and new features. They need a Data Scientist with a software or data engineering background who has moved into data science over the past few years and wants to keep developing in that direction. Or a generalist who's happy moving between engineering and data science work rather than a deep specialist in either. They'll soon be bringing in a lot of new data and new data types from external sources, which will make this data structuring and manipulation work even more central to the role. Your day-to-day impact: ✔ Turn raw, messy or unstructured data - article text, usage data, and new data arriving from external sources - into clean, ready-to-use formats for downstream products. ✔ Apply light ML/NLP techniques (e.g. entity extraction, classification, tagging) to structure unstructured text. ✔ Adapt existing pipelines to ingest and normalise new data types as they come online. ✔ Bring in new datasets - scraped or paid-for/third-party - and merge them with our existing data to create new, value-add content sets. ✔ Build personalisation logic that blends usage data with content suggestions, helping surface the right content to the right customer. ✔ Work with product and editorial to define the signals and rules behind personalised recommendations and content creation. Data Science tasks: ✔ Use statistical and ML methods (e.g. classification, clustering, embeddings) to analyse usage and content data, surfacing patterns and insights that inform personalisation and product decisions. ✔ Use LLMs to extract structure - keywords, entities, topics - from unstructured article text, and check the accuracy and quality of that output. ✔ Prototype and test simple models or scoring logic (e.g. for recommendations or content matching), working with product to validate they add value before scaling. ✔ Try different approaches to a data or personalisation problem, evaluate what works, and explain the trade-offs in plain terms to non-technical stakeholders. Data Engineering tasks: ✔ Maintain and extend our Databricks/Python pipelines - ingestion, transformation, scheduling and monitoring. ✔ Identify new data sources relevant to the product and help scope their integration. AI-Assisted Development: ✔ Use AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to build and iterate on data pipelines and structuring work quickly. ✔ Work across product, editorial and commercial teams to understand data needs and communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences. ✔ Monitor data quality in production, flagging issues and improving tooling and documentation. Your profile looks like that: ✔ 3–5 years' hands-on experience in data engineering, with strong Python and SQL. ✔ Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ideally with Databricks, Spark or a comparable cloud data platform. ✔ Some exposure to - or a strong interest in developing - data science/ML techniques, e.g. classification, clustering, NER, embeddings. ✔ Experience turning raw or messy data into structured, ready-to-use formats for downstream use. ✔ Comfortable working independently and using AI coding tools to move quickly. You are a great fit if you have: ✔ Experience with personalisation, recommendation systems, or blending usage/behavioural data with content. ✔ Exposure to using LLMs to extract structure (keywords, entities, topics) from unstructured text. ✔ A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field - or equivalent experience. ✔ Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster or Databricks Workflows. They offer, not just a nice team and environment, but: ✔︎ Flexibility with true hybrid working - expected to be in the office 1-2 days a week. ✔︎ 25 holiday days per year, plus your birthday off. ✔︎ Opportunities for professional growth and development. ✔︎ Competitive compensation and benefits package. items.desc: Information sur l'entreprise La délégation à la transformation et à la performance ministérielles (DTPM) assure, pour le compte du secrétaire général pour l'administration (SGA), la mission générale de modernisation de l'administration du ministère. Elle concentre à cet effet ses actions sur trois axes complémentaires, le conseil, le numérique et l'innovation et intervient, selon le cas, sur différents périmètres, ministériel, fonctionnel ou organique, aussi bien pour mettre en œuvre des actions relevant d'une administration centrale classique que d'une administration de mission. La DTPM est forte de près de cent trente agents, répartis en trois départements : une agence ministérielle de conseil (AMC), un nouveau service de transformation numérique (STN) et un département du management et de la transformation interne (DMTI). Le centre d’expertise données et intelligence artificielle (CEDIA) du SGA est rattaché au sein du STN. Le centre est chargé de contribuer au domaine de l’intelligence artificielle organique de défense plus précisément le périmètre administration et soutien. Il est un des acteurs clé du domaine IA au sein du ministère. Description Le Data Scientist Confirmé intègre l’équipe en tant que référent technique/ scientifique, il est chargé d’accompagner les juniors dans leur montée en compétences tout en participant à la réalisation des projets data 360 et IA. Il est également en charge de l’utilisation des technologies Big Data et IA, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision et faire de la veille technologique sur les architectures Big Data et IA Vous aurez la responsabilité de : • Analyser des données pour traduire une problématique métier en problème mathématique statistique, et réciproquement • Anticiper avantages/inconvénients de différents modèles ou méthodes calcul dans environnement métier après comparaison et évaluation de ces modèles • Apporter expertise pour exploration/analyse complexe de données au moyen techniques variées : statistiques, analyse texte, comportementale, images • Caractériser des données (qualité, richesse, contenu) en vue de leur intégration dans le système d'information cible du métier et créer des algorithmes de recherche de données permettant d'explorer les données utiles • Produire des rapports et des représentations graphiques à partir des données pertinentes afin de synthétiser et traduire des informations pour faciliter la prise de décision Profil Ingénieur diplômé d’une école spécialisée (ENSAE, ENSAI, Polytechnique…) ou d’un master en data science, vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire. Vous êtes doté de solides compétences techniques autour de Python et packages adaptés, Docker, Git. Vous avez également de très bonnes capacités interpersonnelles et de communication dans le travail quotidien.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data, DevOps, Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Juridique et métiers pour construire des solutions IA fiables, sécurisées et maîtrisées en coût. Vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer à des projets passionnants et de participer à la croissance de nos projets. Un poste résolument hands-on : vous passez une bonne partie de votre temps à concevoir et à coder, le reste à cadrer l’architecture et à faire monter en compétence les équipes. Responsabilités principales : Définir les architectures cibles et les standards de développement IA sur AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI et Azure Foundry Concevoir l’ossature de vos agents : orchestration, outils, serveurs MCP, gestion du contexte, sécurité Bâtir un socle de composants réutilisables et porter les cas d’usage à forte valeur du POC à la production Mettre en place un cadre d’évaluation commun pour comparer modèles et fournisseurs sur des cas d’usage réels, avec les métiers Industrialiser les solutions : CI/CD, observabilité, guardrails, avec les équipes DevOps Fixer les critères de mise en production en lien avec les exigences de cybersécurité et de réglementation Piloter le FinOps IA : suivi, optimisation et projection des coûts de tokens et de compute Partager les bonnes pratiques de développement agentique et jouer le rôle de référent technique IA auprès des équipes DSI et métiers Maintenir une veille active sur les modèles, frameworks et méthodes d’évaluation. Exigences du poste : Diplôme Bac+5 en informatique, data ou IA, ou expérience équivalente Expérience confirmée de Tech Lead ou de référent technique Au moins une solution LLM ou agentique déjà mise en production Connaissance approfondie des LLM, du RAG, du protocole MCP et du développement d’agents Pratique de la conception de harness et de l’évaluation de modèles et d’agents Bonne maîtrise des environnements cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) et de la CI/CD, ainsi que des outils de développement agentique (Claude Code ou équivalent) Culture de la mesure et du FinOps : vous décidez sur des données, pas sur des impressions Leadership technique, capacité à fédérer et à vulgariser des sujets complexes, excellentes compétences en communication et esprit d’équipe Nos avantages : Carte Swile pour nourrir vos corps Formation(s) régulières pour nourrir vos esprits Rémunération compétitive Plan de carrière personnalisé Et pleins d’autres avantages via notre comité d’entreprise ! Pour nous, si vous êtes passionné.es, vous êtes passionnant.es : nous sommes impatients d’échanger avec vous !

items.desc: AI Software Engineer Responsa è la practice di Generative AI del Gruppo Euris . Nati nel 2013, ci siamo evoluti da piattaforma FAQ a pionieri dei chatbot, fino a sviluppare oggi una piattaforma modulare di AI generativa proprietaria (agenti testuali multicanale, agenti vocali VoIP, elaborazione documenti e Knowledge Hub). Gestiamo il prodotto interamente in-house come servizio SaaS cloud multi-tenant, servendo oltre 40 grandi clienti (utilities, finanza, retail, industria) per più di 1 milione di conversazioni all'anno. Stiamo cercando AI Software Engineer Di cosa ti occuperai: Sviluppo e migrazione dei servizi verso un’architettura event-driven e multi-tenant; Scrittura di specifiche dettagliate per gli agenti AI e revisione critica del codice generato (sicurezza, performance, manutenibilità); Collaborazione diretta con il CTO e il team per la definizione e la documentazione dell’architettura; Gestione dell’intero flusso di rilascio, dai test e pipeline di deploy fino al monitoraggio in produzione; Sviluppo di connettori e integrazioni tra modelli linguistici e sistemi dei clienti tramite protocollo MCP; Supporto diretto sui progetti per analizzare requisiti e vincoli di business con i clienti. Hard skill Must Have Esperienza concreta di sviluppo backend su sistemi in produzione, indicativamente almeno 3-4 anni; Ottima conoscenza di Node.js e TypeScript. Valutiamo con piacere anche background in altri linguaggi backend, purché ci sia una forte solidità sui fondamentali della programmazione; Basi solide di architettura del software: progettazione di API, modellazione dei dati, sistemi distribuiti e asincroni, gestione degli errori, sicurezza; Familiarità con database (lavoriamo soprattutto con MongoDB), container (Docker) e servizi cloud (AWS); Critica tecnica e comunicazione: Capacità di analizzare il codice (umano/AI) e argomentare con chiarezza interventi migliorativi; Lingue: Italiano fluente e inglese tecnico scritto. Nice to have Non è una checklist rigida e non serve averli tutti, ma il primo punto è quello per noi fondamentale. Usi già ogni giorno Claude Code, Codex, Cursor o strumenti simili, e sai raccontarci cosa affideresti a un agente e cosa invece terresti per te; Hai esperienza full-stack, o almeno ti muovi senza difficoltà anche sul frontend; Hai portato LLM in applicazioni reali: RAG, valutazione della qualità delle risposte, gestione di costi e latenze delle chiamate ai modelli; Conosci NestJS, le architetture event-driven o protocolli di messaggistica come MQTT; Hai già lavorato su prodotti SaaS multi-tenant. Cosa offriamo? Contratto a tempo indeterminato, retribuzione commisurata alla tua esperienza ( range € 40.000 - € 50.000 ); Ticket Restaurant, welfare aziendale, assicurazione sanitaria; Licenze dei principali strumenti di AI per lo sviluppo; Un prodotto in piena evoluzione, tecnologie recenti e un team che studia di continuo i temi che oggi muovono il mercato: agenti, modelli linguistici, automazione dei processi. Modalità di lavoro : smart working o full remote dall’Italia. Sono previste trasferte saltuarie per gli incontri di team o per esigenze dei clienti. La ricerca è naturalmente rivolta a candidature di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77)

items.desc: Seleccionamos Ingeniero/a de Automatización e IA para incorporar a nuestras oficinas de Barcelona. Vilar Riba somos una organización de asesoramiento global en los ámbitos fiscal, legal, laboral, consultoría, auditoría y M&A. Contamos con un equipo de más de 200 profesionales especializados en varias áreas de asesoramiento y con más de 30 años de experiencia. También formamos parte de la red Geneva Group Internacional (GGI) la sexta firma mundial de servicios profesionales a empresas. Que buscamos? Buscamos un perfil técnico que construya las soluciones de automatización e inteligencia artificial que están transformando el trabajo de la firma, trabajando codo con codo con los profesionales de las diferentes áreas de negocio y manteniéndonos por delante de un entorno tecnológico que continuará cambiando rápidamente. Esta persona tendrá que convertir las oportunidades de mejora en soluciones reales, robustas y efectivamente adaptadas a los equipos profesionales de la firma. Entre las tareas y funciones a realizar, destacamos: Construir soluciones de automatización e IA: automatizaciones de procesos, integraciones con nuestro software, soluciones basadas en LLM (procesamiento de documentos no estructurados, extracción de datos a formato estructurado, agentes), trabajando principalmente sobre Power Platform y el entorno Microsoft 365. Garantizar la calidad técnica del que es despliega: soluciones robustas, mantenibles y bien documentadas, no prototipos frágiles. Hacer vigilancia tecnológica: probar herramientas y enfoques nuevos y proponer mejoras técnicas a la dirección. Qué valoramos: Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o similar. Conocimientos de programación en Python, Javascript/Typescript, y SQL. Experiencia mínima de 3 años en automatización de procesos. Perfil analítico, proactivo y metódico, con capacidad para interpretar indicadores de negocio y proponer mejoras. Experiencia con modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) y tecnologías de inteligencia artificial generativa ( embeddings, fine-tuning , RAG, etc.). Conocimiento de entornos cloud com AWS, GCP o Azure. Qué ofrecemos: Un proyecto profesional con recorrido, basado en el aprendizaje continuo y la participación en proyectos para organizaciones de primer nivel. Un excelente ambiente de trabajo. La posibilidad de formar parte de un equipo joven, motivado y altamente especializado. Autonomía y responsabilidad en los proyectos. Formación técnica, idiomas e itinerarios adaptados a tus necesidades profesionales. Plan de conciliación. Modelo de teletrabajo híbrido. Vilar Riba tratará los datos personales recibidos para la revisión y valoración de la información proporcionada con el objetivo de participar en el proceso de selección. En caso de que sea de su interés, se podrá contactar con el candidato con la intención de valorar su candidatura. Para más información sobre el tratamiento de los datos personales y sobre como ejercer los derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, limitación, oposición o portabilidad, los candidatos pueden consultar la política de privacidad de Vilar Riba (https://vilarriba.com/politica-de-privacitat/).

items.desc: Are you a synthetic chemist who enjoys taking innovative products from concept through to pilot scale and full-scale manufacturing? We are looking for a talented Research Chemist to join our client's Research & Innovation team. This is an opportunity to work on the development of new products and processes using high-hazard chemistries, playing a key role in innovation, scale-up and technical problem solving within a specialist chemical manufacturing environment. Reporting to the Technical Manager, you'll work closely with Production, Engineering, Quality and Regulatory teams to bring new products to life safely and effectively, while also supporting existing manufacturing processes. What You'll Be Doing Designing and delivering laboratory programmes to develop new products and improve existing products and manufacturing processes. Planning and supporting laboratory, pilot plant and full-scale manufacturing trials. Working alongside Production and Engineering teams to ensure safe, successful scale-up from laboratory to plant. Conducting hazard assessments and ensuring all work complies with site procedures, risk assessments and safe systems of work. Recording and reporting experimental results through clear technical documentation and reports. Providing technical expertise and problem-solving support to manufacturing operations. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovation projects and business objectives. Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and technical innovation. What We're Looking For Essential PhD in Synthetic Chemistry, or degree-level qualification with industrial experience. Experience working within a synthetic chemistry laboratory environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent planning, organisation and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams across R&D, production and engineering. Desirable Experience within organophosphorus chemistry. Knowledge of phosphorus-based or derivative chemistries. Experience handling air-sensitive materials. Experience using and interpreting high-field NMR data. Previous involvement in chemical process scale-up or pilot plant activities.

items.desc: Please note that for this role we are searching for someone who is proficient in the use of the Dutch language (C1 level) and is already living in the Netherlands. De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als R&D Specialist Future Insights & Experiences De interactie met digitale systemen wordt in de toekomst steeds ruimtelijker, context bewuster en mensgerichter. Waar deze systemen nu vaak nog via schermen, dashboards en losse applicaties worden gebruikt, onderzoeken wij hoe informatie straks op het juiste moment, op de juiste plek en in de juiste vorm beschikbaar komt. Bijvoorbeeld via 3D-visualisaties, augmented reality, digital twins, objectherkenning of interactieve werkinstructies. Met toegepast onderzoek en experimenten ontwikkelen en testen we oplossingen in het veld of op kantoor. Zo versnellen we bijvoorbeeld onze registratieprocessen en ondersteunen we buitendienstmedewerkers. Onze resultaten maken we tastbaar in inspiratiesessies, onderzoeks- en adviesrapporten en prototypes. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. Zo ben jij bezig met: Technologische principes, marktontwikkelingen en toepassingsrichtingen verkennen waarin mens, informatie en technologie samenkomen, zoals XR/AR/VR, Digital Twins, 3D-objectherkenning, human-machine interaction en spatial intelligence; Praktijkvragen vertalen naar heldere onderzoeksvragen, hypothesen, experimenten en onderzoeksvoorstellen; Proof-of-concepts, demonstrators en andere tastbare prototypes bouwen om ideeën snel zichtbaar, bespreekbaar en testbaar te maken; Product-, markt- en technologieonderzoek uitvoeren en werksessies, interviews en demosessies begeleiden met gebruikers, stakeholders en inhoudelijke experts; Prototypes en concepten met gebruikers testen en beoordelen of ze technisch, praktisch en organisatorisch kansrijk zijn; Inzichten vertalen naar kansen, risico’s en concrete vervolgstappen voor Alliander en de netbeheerder; Resultaten vastleggen in onderzoeksrapporten, adviesnotities, presentaties en beslisstukken, en deze waar relevant publiceren of presenteren op (internationale) conferenties; Techniek, code, werkwijze en professionele vaardigheden continu verder ontwikkelen. Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers van Nederland. Dit doen we samen en met aandacht voor onze klant. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij de energietransitie mogelijk. De nieuwste trends en ontwikkelingen volgen kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Het Research Center bestaat uit een gedreven en betrokken groep specialisten. We houden technologische ontwikkelingen scherp in de gaten en zetten vanuit die inzichten gerichte onderzoeksprogramma’s op rondom thema's die bijdragen aan het netwerkbedrijf van de toekomst, zoals AI, Robotica, Quantum en Future Insights & Experiences (FIX). We werken nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen (zoals Innovatie, Corporate Venturing en Digitalisering) binnen Alliander voor de beste innovaties die het verschil maken. Jij maakt het net energieker Als allround R&D-specialist voor FIX ben je van nature nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast over technologie en innovatie. Je stelt scherpe vragen, maakt je nieuwe technologie snel eigen en houdt daarbij de uitdagingen en belangen van Alliander goed in beeld. items.desc:
Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network - figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network - from evaluating new lanes to putting them live. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in the Midwest, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real-time, and keeping systems running 24/7.
We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.

- Working with AWS technologies such as Lambda, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EMR

About the team
We're a global team with members in Hyderabad and Luxembourg. The team includes software engineers, product managers, technical program managers and applied scientists working on transportation problems.

- Work spans multiple technologies: big data processing, backend services, frontend development, and integration with optimization and ML models. You'll also use GenAI to both augment your skills and build agents that automate workflows

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
 Therapeutic Modality (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.
 As an experienced Scientist in Oligonucleotide Chemistry, you will serve as a key architect behind our therapeutic pipeline, translating advanced chemical concepts into optimized lead candidates. In this strategic role, you will champion the rational design and chemical modification framework for next-generation small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) and antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs). Collaborating seamlessly with our computational platforms and discovery teams, you will guide the creation of proprietary libraries and establish structure-activity relationships to accelerate candidate selection. By synthesizing cutting-edge literature, emerging technologies, and external innovations, you will continuously elevate our core chemical design strategies and position our platform at the forefront of genetic medicine.
 The Opportunity
 Design and champion the rational chemical modification framework for next-generation oligonucleotides—including siRNAs and ASOs—to advance critical drug discovery projects.
 Collaborate seamlessly with computational experts and synthesis teams to create high-value, novel oligonucleotide libraries, bridging theoretical chemistry with data-driven design.
 Analyze experimental data using advanced computational methods, applying continuous learning cycles to systematically refine and elevate chemical designs.
 Translate innovative chemical concepts into synthetically accessible structures with precision and attention to detail.
 Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and external breakthroughs to identify novel ways to improve safety profiles, durability, and therapeutic performance.
 Partner across multidisciplinary teams—including biology, pharmacology, and toxicology—to evaluate biological impacts and guide strategic decisions in a highly collaborative environment.
 Who You Are
 You hold a Ph.D. in Oligonucleotide Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, or a related discipline, complemented by 3 to 5 years of industry experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical sectors. Experience across different oligonucleotide modalities is highly desirable.
 You bring deep expertise in translating chemical modifications of oligonucleotides into innovative drug candidate designs.
 You possess a comprehensive understanding of modern oligonucleotide modification patterns (such as 2'-O-methyl, 2'-fluoro, LNA, cEt) and how they influence therapeutic properties.
 You are familiar with delivery technologies (like GalNAc, lipid, or peptide conjugates), and any insights you have into linker design are highly valued.
 You combine scientific creativity and attention to detail with independent problem-solving skills, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where you can inspire and guide cross-functional teams.
 At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. 
 Strategy, Portfolio & Operations (SPO) is a unified function that serves as the strategic and operational backbone enabling pRED's strategy from lab to clinic. Operating under a dynamic Chapter Model, SPO centralizes specialized skills across critical areas including Sites & Lab Services, Program & Project Management, Strategy, Clinical Operations, External Operations, Capability Development, Core Lab Technology Platforms (360Labs) and Asset Team Leadership. SPO’s mission is to drive enterprise value creation by delivering operational excellence, and accelerating portfolio productivity. As a trusted partner, SPO fosters a culture of collaboration and accountability to ensure pRED transitions assets smoothly from early research to late-stage development. 
 360 Labs Chapter at a Glance 
 The primary mission of the 360 Labs Chapter within SPO is to provide greater access and support for the use of cutting-edge biomedical research technologies by scientists across our discovery portfolio. 360 Labs delivers core scientific technologies, expertise and enabling activities, as well as facilitating knowledge sharing in close collaboration with our therapeutic areas and functions. Our ambition is to bring to life a thriving workplace environment, where your collaborative mindset is as valued as your professional expertise. Our goal is to act as a highly integrated ecosystem, supporting research and development, working collaboratively, and focused on fostering excellence and sustainability. Together, these efforts will serve to increase the speed, enhance the robustness and improve the sustainability of our exploratory research and early discovery activities. 
 The Opportunity 
 The Microscopy Technology Platform in the 360 Labs Chapter is seeking an experienced, highly motivated, collaborative, and customer-centric lab-based senior scientist. The successful candidate will have a strong theoretical and practical background in the use of state-of-the-art optical microscopy techniques. Candidates with a solid understanding of how to best design and execute optical microscopy-based assays as applied to a variety of 2D and 3D sample types (including complex cell and organoid cultures and fixed cell/tissue preparations) are strongly desired. You will work with a sense of urgency as part of a matrix team, collaborating with specialists from each of our therapeutic disease areas and functions to advance early drug discovery programs, and you will also contribute to the ongoing development and operations of the Microscopy Technology Platform within the pRED organisation.

 You will embrace a continuous learning mindset by actively engaging with the scientific literature to stay abreast of emergent technologies/approaches in the advanced optical microscopy field.

Role and responsibilities As integrated optics researcher in the Optics and Photonics group you will be responsible for developing cutting edge
items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 ASML is relentlessly driving the semiconductor industry’s ongoing quest for producing faster, smarter and more energy efficient chips. We are a young, dynamic, international and highly skilled workforce creating, with strong support of our suppliers, the lithographic tools the industry needs to achieve its goals. 
Are you looking for a challenge to ensure the ultimate photonic solutions in our scanners and metrology instruments? Then you will enjoy this position in the Optics and Photonics group at ASML research. You will be part of the group responsible for demonstrating how new or existing technological solutions can be adapted to meet and exceed the needs of our metrology and lithographic tools.
 Role and responsibilities 
 As integrated optics researcher in the Optics and Photonics group you will be responsible for developing cutting edge photonic solutions and demonstrating their applicability to our industrial context. You will work in a fast paced and multi-disciplinary environment. Your responsibility is to take ownership of the experimental and theoretical work with the rest of the team and drive feasibility studies towards clear conclusions. This includes contributions to the definition of the photonic system’s architecture, design, specification, development, and documentation, as well as communication of the results towards various stakeholders. Using your technical knowledge, analytical thinking and people skills, you will work closely together with the team and other researchers at ASML.
 You will join a project team whose mission is to focus on the development of photonic solutions for both our lithographic as well as our metrology tools. The job consists of:
 Understand optical sensing concepts and their photonic equivalent in an industrial context
 Understand requirements, architecture and technology development needs for the photonic solutions
 Design and specification of photonic integrated circuits
 Definition of experiments for evaluation of these PICs
 Design and specification of the experimental set-up for PIC characterization
 Work together with other researchers towards better understanding of the technologies
 Generate new ideas and solutions for current and future photonic solutions
 Education and experience 
 PhD in Electrical engineering, Physics or Applied Physics in the field of integrated photonics.
 Experience in developing photonic integrated circuits: design and specification.
 Experience in designing photonic components using numerical methods such as FDTD, EME, and FEM and optics modeling software (e.g. Lumerical).
 Experience with experimental evaluation of PICs
 Experience with designing the experimental set-up for characterization of PICs
 Experience with manufacturing of PICs and interacting with foundries.
 Skills 
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
 To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:
 Deep understanding of optical sensing concepts and their integrated optics equivalent
 Proficiency modeling and designing photonic integrated circuits according to specifications
 Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and hands-on work
 Proactive team player focused on contributing toward common goals within a highly skilled team. Ability to propose practical and pragmatic solutions
 Good communicational skills
 Flexible, committed, result driven with the ability to plan and prioritize
 Self-propelling, showing initiative and drive, pragmatic attitude
 Strong analytical skills and drive for quality
 This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software. 
The Insight team runs one of Apple's most critical Big Data ecosystems — a multi-petabyte, highly-available infrastructure that underpins manufacturing operations for every Apple product, globally. Every iPhone, iPad, and Mac has touched our systems. We are establishing a new EMEA operational team in Cork, not only as an extension of our US/India/China operations, but also a team with its own identity, perspective, and contribution to how Insight runs at global scale. This is a new regional team being built from the ground up, and the people who join early will help shape what it becomes. 
We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who has operated in the European high-tech landscape, who brings the rigor and perspective that comes from that environment, and who wants to shape the practices of a new team. As one of the first few SREs in Cork, you will have real influence over how this team works, what it builds, and how it contributes to Apple's manufacturing infrastructure worldwide.

Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of services and infrastructure within the Insight ecosystem — with a build-to-manage mindset applied to design, deployment, and ongoing operations Build and advance AIOps capabilities across the ecosystem — developing ML-driven alerting, anomaly detection, LLM-assisted operational tooling, and automated incident triage that measurably improve observability and response Instrument services for deep observability: dashboards, meaningful alerts, runbooks, and clearly defined SLOs and SLIs that give the team and stakeholders an accurate view of ecosystem health Drive automation that reduces operational toil and improves ecosystem stability — key measures of success include ecosystem uptime, release quality, toil reduction, and sustained advancement of SRE practice Partner with incident management to drive effective incident response and conduct thorough post-incident reviews; translate findings into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and platform architecture decisions that shape the long-term direction of the Insight ecosystem Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams across Apple's global manufacturing services, communicating effectively across time zones and cultures Help define the culture, working practices, and technical standards of the new EMEA operational team — build strong in-region relationships with business partners and represent the team's perspective within the wider Insight organization Mentor and support team members as the Cork operational team grows

 An opportunity for a Materiel Solutions and IP Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the Materiel Solutions & Services Team. In this role, you will support customer process improvements and define robust material solutions across major defense programs, including Eurodrone.

 Participate in Eurodrone supplier selection, analyzing material services contributions and part requirements.
 Develop customized spare parts lists (IPL and RSPL) using aircraft configuration systems knowledge to meet Customer and ADS requirements.
 Represent Airbus Defence and Space directly in front of the Customer during Initial Provisioning milestones.
 Generate comprehensive technical and operational documentation to support overall Material Solution definitions.
 Align all Materiel Services functional and performance aspects across internal Airbus teams, Partner Companies, Suppliers, and Nations.

 Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline.

 Languages: Advanced level in English (written and spoken).
 Technical knowledge: Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance, technical manuals, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
 Valuable / Nice to have: Experience with spares dimensioning tools and prior knowledge of Airbus Defence & Space products.

Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters !
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un(e) Responsable Conception Système et Fonctionnelle Systèmes Optroniques (f/h) pour rejoindre le département Conscience Situationnelle et Gestion de Mission basé à Marignane, France.
 Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement. Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères.
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions :
 En rejoignant notre équipe de plus de 70 ingénieurs systèmes, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers la conception, le développement et la qualification de fonctions optroniques avancées. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département Conscience Situationnelle et Gestion de Mission, en charge des systèmes d'alerte terrain/météo/trafic, d'amélioration de la vision, de ciblage, de liaisons de données ainsi que des systèmes de gestion de mission pour l'ensemble des produits (e-)VTOL d'Airbus.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :
 Définir la chaîne fonctionnelle de bout en bout, gérer l'ingénierie des exigences et déployer les concepts opérationnels ainsi que les cas d'usage pour les systèmes optroniques (réalité augmentée, vision enrichie, optronique, ciblage).
 Assurer la responsabilité technique de l'intégration des systèmes optroniques au sein d'architectures avioniques d'hélicoptères complexes et soutenir les essais sur banc, au sol et en vol.
 Piloter, évaluer et suivre de manière proactive les fournisseurs durant la phase de développement et d'appels d'offres afin de garantir le respect des exigences techniques, des coûts et des plannings.
 Assurer la qualification et la certification des équipements et des fonctions associées en appliquant les méthodologies de développement agiles (Scrum, SAFe).
 Contribuer activement à la définition de la stratégie produit et aux activités de Recherche & Technologie (R&T) en réalisant des benchmarks des solutions optroniques de pointe (réalité augmentée, technologie laser, traitement d'image).
 Votre profil :
 Vous justifiez d'une expérience obligatoire en développement et intégration de systèmes optroniques sur une plateforme aéroportée.
 Expertise confirmée en ingénierie système, ingénierie des exigences, intégration avionique et gestion des fournisseurs. Une expérience préalable avec les méthodologies agiles (Scrum, SAFe) est appréciée.
 Anglais : niveau négociation / business fluent impératif. La maîtrise du français, de l'allemand ou de l'espagnol est un plus.
 Soft skills : Esprit d'équipe, excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication, gestion fluide des parties prenantes, proactivité.
 3 Raisons pour nous rejoindre :
 Nos Valeurs : Six valeurs essentielles constituent le noyau de notre entreprise. Définies pour les employés par les employés, nos valeurs Airbus façonnent l'ADN de notre activité, en reflétant le mélange unique des qualités que l'on trouve dans chacun des membres de notre famille mondiale.
 Inclusion et diversité : Nous favorisons un cadre de travail inclusif et valorisant, où la diversité de chacun est appréciée et respectée. Une main-d'œuvre inclusive et diversifiée est le moteur de l'innovation chez Airbus. Elle nous rend unique, contribue à une meilleure résolution des problèmes.
 Rémunération et avantages :
 Chez Airbus, nous construisons l'avenir ensemble et votre succès est notre priorité. Attendez-vous à un package de rémunération global, compétitif et transparent (incluant salaires, primes, intéressement, participation et plan d'actionnariat privilégié), conçu pour récompenser l'impact et la performance que vous apportez, à la fois individuelle et collective. items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Wir suchen mehrere 
 (Senior) DevOps Engineer (d/m/w) – AI-based Autonomy Hub 
 Um die Zukunft autonomer Systeme zu gestalten, bündelt Airbus seine Stärken in den Bereichen Künstliche Intelligenz und Autonomie. Zu diesem Zweck etablieren wir ein neues, agiles Kompetenz- und Entwicklungszentrum am traditionsreichen Technologiestandort von Tesat in Backnang. In diesem Umfeld, das jahrzehntelange Expertise in der Raumfahrttechnologie mit der Dynamik eines Startups verbindet, entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von KI-gestützten Verteidigungs- und Dual-Use-Anwendungen. 
 Als (Senior) DevOps Engineer sind Sie der entscheidende Wegbereiter für unser gesamtes Entwicklungsteam. Sie bauen die Infrastruktur und CI/CD-Pipelines hochautomatisiert auf – in der Cloud ebenso wie in on-premises eingestuften Umgebungen – und sorgen mit automatisierten Tests, Code-Reviews und klaren Qualitäts-Checks dafür, dass jede Änderung sicher in Produktion geht. Ihre Arbeit ermöglicht es uns, schnell und agil zu entwickeln, ohne jemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer missionskritischen Systeme einzugehen. 
 Ihr Standort 
 Backnang ist eine aufstrebende Stadt, nur 30 Kilometer nordöstlich von Stuttgart gelegen, die eine ideale Mischung aus urbanem Komfort und natürlicher Schönheit bietet. Mit hervorragenden Verkehrsanbindungen, einer starken lokalen Wirtschaft und einer hohen Lebensqualität ist es ein attraktiver Ort zum Arbeiten und Leben. Die Stadt verfügt über ein reiches industrielles Erbe und eine wachsende Technologie- und Innovationsszene, was sie perfekt für hochqualifizierte Fachkräfte macht. 
 Ihre Vorteile 
 Die einmalige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft autonomer Systeme bei einem weltweit führenden Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen zu gestalten 
 Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, das die Innovationskraft eines Startups mit der Expertise eines etablierten Technologiestandorts verbindet 
 Ein Team von brillanten Köpfen, die gemeinsam an einer großen Vision für Europas technologische Souveränität arbeiten 
 Ein attraktives Gehalt, flexible Arbeitszeiten und exzellente Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb des Airbus-Konzerns 
 Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (bis zu 40% mobiles Arbeiten) 
 Als (Senior) DevOps Engineer verantworten Sie (die Architektur und) die Bereitstellung der Infrastruktur, die unsere KI-Anwendungen absichert. Konkret heißt das: 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (& Architektur): Entwurf, Aufbau und Verwaltung unserer souveränen Cloud- und On-Premises-Infrastruktur mithilfe von Tools wie Terraform und Ansible (Senior Level: Setzen von Standards für Automatisierung und Sicherheit) 
 CI/CD & Automatisierungsstrategie: Konzeption, Aufbau und Optimierung unserer CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. mit GitHub Actions) sowie unseres GitOps-Workflows für eine vollautomatisierte, reibungslose Build-, Test- und Deployment-Kette 
 Holistische Teststrategie & Automatisierung: Implementierung einer ganzheitlichen Teststrategie und Aufbau automatisierter Test-Frameworks (Unit-, Integrations-, E2E-Tests) zur Verankerung einer Quality-First-Kultur 
 Monitoring, Zuverlässigkeit & SRE: Aufbau und Betrieb unseres Observability-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) zur proaktiven Überwachung von System-Health, Logs und Traces sowie Definition von SLOs/SLIs für unsere kritischen Systeme 
 Security & Compliance by Design: Integration von Sicherheitsscans und Compliance-Checks (z. B. Trivy, Kyverno, Cosign) als maßgebliche Instanz für Systemsicherheit 
 Mentoring & Technical Leadership (Senior Level): Sie fördern andere Ingenieure in Bezug auf Best Practices in der DevOps-/SRE-Kultur, etablieren technische Standards und leiten das Team fachlich an 
 Als Senior Engineer verantworten Sie das architektonische Fundament, verlieren dabei aber nie den Bezug zur Praxis: Sie schlagen die Brücke zwischen strategischem Design und leidenschaftlicher Hands-on-Automatisierung im Team 
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen 
 Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik oder eines verwandten Fachgebiets (für die Senior-Position idealerweise mit einem Master oder einer Promotion). 
 Fundierte (Senior Level: nachweisbare, mehrjährige) Erfahrung als DevOps, Cloud- oder QA-Automatisierungs-Ingenieur 
 Vertiefte (Senior Level: fundierte, maßgebliche) Kenntnisse von Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Google Cloud oder Azure), Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und IaC-Tools (Terraform, Ansible) 
 Solide Kenntnisse (Senior Level: Expertenwissen) gängiger Test-Frameworks (z. B. Pytest, Playwright) und tiefe Vertrautheit im Scripting (z. B. Python, Bash) 
 Eine ausgeprägte "Automate everything"-Mentalität, gepaart mit einem unerschütterlichen Engagement für Qualität, Systemverlässlichkeit und Sicherheit 
 Senior Level: Erfahrung im Mentoring von Kolleg:innen und beim Etablieren von Best Practices in einer DevOps-/SRE-Kultur 
 Verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch

 Work / Life Balance: 35 hour week, flexible working around core hours and Friday afternoons off, hybrid working, flexible working, option to buy/sell holiday 
 Personal Development: Personalised development plan, Airbus Leadership University and unlimited access to 10,000+ E-learning courses, internal mobility including international opportunities
 Health & Wellbeing: Bupa health insurance (including assisted fertility treatments and gender dysphoria & reassignment support), wellbeing benefits (including 24/7 online GP and mental health support), discounted family health / dental insurance / eye tests, cycle-to-work scheme, on-site canteen and coffee shop, lunchtime yoga / meditation
