 The team of around 70 safety engineers is based in five separate locations around Europe and is accountable for the safety activities (functional and physical) for all Airbus aircraft systems. 
 The Safety & Reliability team is key in ensuring that systems architectures and their integration on the aircraft comply with the latest airworthiness regulations and safety processes. 
 As a system safety & reliability specialist, you will play an integral part in ensuring that all Airbus products are developed, designed, produced and supported according to the state-of-art and the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations).
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 The safety specialist role will be primarily focused on ATA 28 and 32 systems, as well as associated particular risks such as Wheel and Tire Failure and Fuel Tank Safety. As part of the role, you will doing the following activities:
 Review systems design and in-service solutions through understanding how failures will affect systems operation
 Contribute to the safety 'validation and verification' activities at systems level
 Generate and review Safety Assessment and Analyses for Aircraft Systems (FHA, pSSA, SSA, Fault Trees, Quantitative and Qualitative Assessments)
 Generate and review Common Cause Analyses such as Particular Risk Analyses, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analyses
 Support the System Design Teams and suppliers to ensure compliance against the safety objectives.
 Liaise with key stakeholders e.g. Chief Engineer, Design Team Leaders regarding risks that will affect the safety of the aircraft and work closely with these stakeholders to manage these risks
 Analyse in-service occurrences to ensure safety compliance of the In-Service fleet.
 ABOUT YOU 
 You will be a naturally curious individual with a passion for learning new skills.
 University degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering.
 Proven experience in Aeronautical engineering, ideally in the field of Safety and Reliability Engineering.
 Good knowledge of Aircraft Systems
 Experience of Safety processes, regulations and guidelines (CS/AC 25.1309, ARP 4761, ARP 4754A).
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solution s.
 HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOU 
 Many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you need and we’ll always do our best to accommodate your request. 
 Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments for the selection process – you can share this with your Talent Acquisition Partner if you are invited to interview. Examples may include (but not exclusive to) accessible facilities; auxiliary aids; room layout, etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

To ‘opt in’, just select the option during your application submission and our Talent Acquisition team will contact you.

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry or a closely related technical field. Alternatively Higher National Certificate in Chemistry or equivalent with industrial experience

 Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of chemical testing theory & principles. 
 In-depth understanding of special processes, chemical surface treatments, and coating systems (paints) 
 Ability to interpret technical specifications and industry standards (e.g., ASTM, ISO, AMS). 
 Proficient in technical report writing and data analysis.

 Au sein du site de Montoir de Bretagne, vous rejoindrez le département « Ergonomie » de l’usine, chargé de définir et de déployer la stratégie en Ergonomie en partant de la conception de nouvelles lignes jusqu’au reclassement des personnes avec des restrictions médicales.  Créer de standards en ergonomie
 Donner son expertise en ergonomie
 Délivrer des formations
 Gérer l'activité prestation en ergonomie

About the Team 
 We are looking for a Software engineer with strong record in software development and interested in developing services for one of the most internationally used data resources in biological science, UniProt. Our team is very dynamic and interdisciplinary comprising talented and enthusiastic software engineers and bioinformaticians working closely together with biologists and scientists. 
 The UniProt resource is one of the most internationally used protein databases serving a large and diverse research community in genomics, proteins and proteomics.
 Duties & Responsibilities 
 As part of your daily work, you will be designing and developing software and APIs for the UniProt data services and website, providing protein information to the scientific community and computational biologists. You will also be working in the design, maintenance and monitoring of the website cloud infrastructure. Scalability will be an important feature of your clear, concise, well tested and documented code. You will also be interested in applying analytic engines and technical approaches to distributed processing of big data. The ability to work towards tight deadlines is essential.

 A degree in Computer Science or related discipline

 Experience in Agile processes

 Experience in developing web infrastructure (Solr, kubernetes)

 Experience in git and basic Unix Commands

 Experience with large data processing technologies (Apache Spark)

 Salary : Grade 5 Monthly salary starting at £3,452 after tax but excl. pension & insurances) + other paid benefits based on personal circumstances

 Do something meaningful 
At EMBL-EBI you can apply your talent and passion to accelerate science and tackle some of humankind's greatest challenges. EMBL-EBI, part of the European Molecular Biology Laboratory, is a worldwide leader in the storage, analysis and dissemination of large biological datasets. We provide the global research community with access to publicly available databases and tools which are crucial for the advancement of healthcare, food security, and biodiversity.
 Join a culture of innovation 
We are located on the Wellcome Genome Campus, alongside other prominent research and biotech organisations, and surrounded by beautiful Cambridgeshire countryside. This is a highly collaborative and inclusive community where our employees enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. We are committed to ensuring our employees feel valued, supported and empowered to reach their professional potential. Watch this video to see how EMBL-EBI makes an impact.

items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
As a R&D Engineer I at Medtronic Articulating Technologies, you will get the opportunity to develop advanced medical devices in order to enable next generation surgical procedures. You will gain knowledge and experience covering the full engineering domain of product and process development from conceptual design up to market introduction and scale-up. 
In a team of engineers, you will work on design, development and testing of surgical instruments and the development of their related manufacturing processes. You will improve product performance and manufacturability by calculating, modelling, prototyping and testing. Additionally, by developing processes to a world-class performance level by means of lean six sigma, you will help optimizing cost and consistency. Furthermore, you will get the chance to master high-tech manufacturing processes such as laser cutting, cleaning, laser welding and assembly. During the traineeship, you will be part of our talented team of specialists, and you will learn from our experts who will help you to develop yourself towards your role as Manufacturing or Research and Development Engineer. 
 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: 
 Perform engineering analyses, calculations, and modelling to evaluate product performance, reliability, and manufacturability
 Support development and optimization of manufacturing processes, including technologies such as laser cutting, laser welding, cleaning, and assembly
 Build and test prototypes, execute experiments, and analyse results to support design improvements and technical decision-making
 Assist in designing surgical instruments and related components, supporting new product development from concept through verification and market introduction
 Collaborate with cross functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain) to ensure successful product and process development
 Show entrepreneurial mindset be eager to learn and dare to fail fast.
 Required Knowledge and Experience :
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering/applied physics/Industrial Engineering or similar
 Mastering the Dutch and English language.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 You have a hands-on mentality, eager to learn, flexible and a strong team player
 Looking at questions from different perspectives, daring to bring less obvious solutions and strong analytical skills is natural for you.
 Physical Job Requirements

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE ROLE

As International Mobility Lead, you will own and develop our international mobility approach, supporting employees and the business on cross-border moves and assignments.

You will act as the key point of contact for mobility topics, balancing employee experience, business needs and compliance requirements.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to partner effectively with HR teams, managers and employees.

 - A pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to navigate complex situations.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple mobility cases and priorities.

 - A low-ego, team-first mindset

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

 - Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

 - Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

 - Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

 - Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

items.desc:
About Us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.




About the role:

As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you.



Your responsibilities will include:

 - Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

 - Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows

 - Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes

 - Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

 - Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

 - Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar



You're a great fit if you:

 - Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations

 - Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

 - Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost

 - Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

 - Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

 - Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code.

 - Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

 - Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains



What you can look forward to:

 - Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact

 - Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a …

 Accompagner et fédérer les équipes d'ingénierie autour des enjeux réseaux et cybersécurité, en contribuant au développement des compétences et à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques.
 Apporter une vision stratégique sur les évolutions technologiques du domaine, orienter les choix d'architecture et garantir la cohérence, la robustesse, la sécurité et la performance des solutions développées.
 Intervenir comme référent technique sur les sujets complexes, en accompagnant les équipes dès les phases amont de conception et lors de la définition des solutions pour les projets majeurs.
 Développer et promouvoir une culture d'excellence en architecture réseau et cybersécurité, notamment par le mentorat, le partage d'expertise et la représentation de l'organisation auprès des communautés techniques internes.
 Structurer et harmoniser les méthodes de conception et de modélisation des architectures réseau afin de garantir une vision claire, cohérente et pérenne des systèmes, dans des environnements technologiques innovants intégrant notamment les nouvelles solutions de connectivité.
 Piloter la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes en mobilisant les équipes concernées, en identifiant les causes profondes et en accompagnant la mise en œuvre de solutions durables.
 Cette fonction offre l'opportunité d'avoir un impact direct sur les orientations technologiques, d'accompagner les équipes dans leur montée en compétence et de contribuer au développement de solutions de communication sécurisées de haute technologie.
 Votre profil
 Disposez-vous d'une solide expérience en architecture réseaux sécurisés et dans des environnements à forts enjeux de sécurité ?
 Maîtrisez-vous la conception d'architectures réseau complexes et les technologies de connectivité avancées (IP, WAN, SD-WAN, 4G/5G, communications satellitaires, etc.) ?
 On vous reconnait pour votre capacité à fédérer, conseiller et accompagner des équipes sur des sujets techniques stratégiques ?
 Savez-vous partager votre expertise et rendre accessibles des problématiques techniques complexes ?
 Les atouts qui feront la différence : leadership, esprit de synthèse, communication, capacité d'innovation, rigueur, autonomie et goût du travail collaboratif.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

items.desc:
Location: Firenze, Italy 
In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible. 
Sesto Fiorentino is the Headquarter of Thales Italia. It hosts two Domains: Ground Transportation Systems (GTS) and Security (SIX). The activity of GTS domain: Security systems, telecommunications, supervision, control & management information and signalling solutions for trains, trams and metros Regarding railway solutions, Thales is the homologated supplier of Rete Ferroviaria Italiana for Axel Counters, Tunnel Security, Energy Saving, SCADA systems and Asset Management. Italy is Thales Group’s competence centre for tramway signalling solutions. The activity of SIX domain: mission critical solutions and applications for assets and citizens security (supervision, control and information management systems) as well as cybersecurity. Thales offers solutions to protect the information systems and critical data of its civilian and military customers and helps its customers to detect and prevent cyberattacks by devising secure architectures from the design stage, overseeing these architectures and ensures that they are kept in secure working order. Italy is Thales Group’s competence centre for Airport security and operations management solutions. 
 Il Capo Officina è responsabile della supervisione delle attività di installazione, verifica, implementazione e assemblaggio di sistemi veicolari militari su mezzi ad alta complessità, garantendo il rispetto degli standard di qualità, sicurezza e tempistiche. 
 Il ruolo include la gestione del team di installazione, la pianificazione delle attività ed il coordinamento con altre funzioni aziendali (ingegneria, logistica e qualità). 
 RESPONSABILITA' PRINCIPALI 
 1- Gestione Operativa dell' Officina 
 Supervisionare le attività di assemblaggio, installazione ed integrazione di sistemi veicolari militari (es. veicoli corazzati, blindati, sistemi di comunicazione, armamenti e sensoristica).
 Assicurare il rispetto delle specifiche tecniche, dei piani di lavoro e delle procedure di sicurezza.
 Pianificare e ottimizzare l'utilizzo delle risorse (attrezzature, personale, materiali) per massimizzare l'efficenza produttiva. 
 Monitorare i tempi di consegna e segnalare eventuali ritardi o criticità alla direzione. 
 2 - Controllo Qualità e Conformità 
 Verificare la corretta installazione dei sistemi secondo i requisiti del cliente (es.specifiche militari, normative NATO e standard Thales) 
 Eseguire o supervisionare test funzionali, collaudi e validazioni.
 Garantire la tracciabilità dei componenti e dei processi (documentazione tecnica, registri di collaudo, report di non conformità).
 Collaborare con il team di Qualità per l'implementazione di azioni correttive. 
 3 - Leadership e Sviluppo del Team 
 Guidare un gruppo di tecnici specializzati e assicurare la loro formazione su tecnologie o procedure. 
 Valutare la performance del gruppo.
 4- Coordinamento Interfunzionale 
 Collaborazione con Ingegneria, Acquisiti e Logistica
 Relazione con il Cliente (come Forze Armate o Enti Governativi) per aggiornamenti periodici sull'avanzamento dei lavori e chiarimenti. 
 Gestione audit interni ed esterni. 
At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

items.desc:
As a Quality Assurance Specialist at Empatica, you will be a key member of the Quality and Regulatory Department, supporting the maintenance of the Quality Management System as well as:
 Champion Quality culture and compliance within the different development teams, supporting them in the compliance effort
 Continually seeks to drive improvements in product and process quality.
 Provides the quality/independent review at defined design reviews, design plans, risk management, design verification/validation protocols and reports, for new development projects as well as design/process changes to existing products.
 Support team in performing required Risk Management activities 
 Support Engineering manager with the activities related to change management and new product development. Support developers in creating design control documentation, making sure product requirements and regulatory requirements are aligned.
 Support Design transfer activities to ensure quality compliance of the manufacturing process.
 Interfaces with Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Science, Marketing, and product manager to translate their needs in actionable and regulatory compliant requirements. 
 Implement, maintain and update procedures that ensure that the design control process constantly meets Empatica’s and regulatory requirements.
 Support Regulatory affairs in drafting EU Technical Documentation and US 510(k)s and De Novo submissions
 Ensure production activities are compliant with internal procedures and internationally applicable standards.
 Keeps up to date on all ISO/EN/FDA/MDR and other Product Development related regulatory requirements and relay this information to the Product Development group.
 Requirements 
 The ideal candidate for this role:
 Has a genuine interest, passion and motivation for Empatica's mission.
 Has a strong academic background, BS or MS in Biomedical Engineering
 Has at least 3 years of experience as a Quality Assurance Specialist, Design Quality Engineer, Quality Engineer or similar roles in a company that designs/manufactures medical devices.
 Has knowledge and experience working with ISO standards (13485, 14971, ...).
 Has knowledge and experience working with IEC standards (60601, 62304, ...).
 Has knowledge of MDR 2017/745.
 Has excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Is an autonomous person, with good organization and management skills.
 Is a native English speaker or have worked in English for the past at least 3 years.
 Some important details:
 Empatica operates in an international environment with presence in Europe, the US, and Korea. All work is conducted in English.
 We are operating a hybrid model where our employees choose whether to work from home or come to the office, however, please note that this position is not fully remote and in-person presence at the office is necessary.
 Life at Empatica
 You will join a fast-growing, international, and diverse team of 120+ talented people who care passionately about what we do and the difference we are making in the world. You’ll get the opportunity to work directly with colleagues across all levels of the organization, no matter their seniority, and learn from the people who built the business and our products.
If you jump on board, we can guarantee it won't be an easy ride, but it will be one of the most rewarding experiences in your career, one that will allow you to learn a lot, have true ownership of your work, and test your whole skillset on multiple projects which are helping thousands of people worldwide.
 Read our blog post and find out some reasons why we love working at Empatica .
 Inclusion & Diversity
 At Empatica we embrace diversity and inclusion. We have colleagues from 30 different countries, while over 50% of our team is women (double the tech average!). We believe this makes Empatica a more exciting and stimulating place to work, and brings different points of view to the table while fostering a spirit of communication, collaboration, and care, where everyone’s opinion and thoughts matter.
 Benefits 
 🧠 Multiple opportunities to be challenged and step up your career in a fast-growth company in one of the hottest areas of tech
 💰 Salary range: €37,000–45,000 gross per year, commensurate with the candidate’s experience and background
 📈 Employee stock options - we want everyone who joins us to own part of the company and our success
 📍 We have offices in Milan City Center and Downtown Boston
 🏥 Health Insurance
 🏋️‍♀️ Wellhub membership with access to gyms, online classes, personal training sessions, and nutrition plans
 🤍 Membership for mental health and wellness platforms
 🥗 Free healthy lunch every day
 🤓 Free Kindle and books
 🕰️ Flexible working hours
 🧑‍🎓 Personal learning and development budget
 👀 Much more…

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something bigger—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 Our Summer Placement Programme 
 Our 13 weeks Summer Placement Programme gives you the chance to work on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. Throughout your placement, you’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team, with the potential to return for future placements or progress onto our Graduate Development Programme. 
 The programme will run from 1st June to 27th August 2027.
 We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 What you’ll do as a Summer Placement Supportability Engineer 
 Supportability Engineers are integral to a product’s lifecycle: from concept and initial design, through production, and into in-service support.
 They analyse and report on the Reliability, Maintainability and Testability (RMT) of a product and advise on design and development in order to satisfy customer specifications. Supportability Engineering are the experts in Root Cause Analysis and are integral during production when manufacturing defects are observed.
 As a Summer Placement Supportability Engineer, you will contribute to a real ongoing project within the department alongside experienced engineers who will provide training, mentoring and guidance. You will be exposed to real-world engineering and learn about the use of Supportability processes and tools.
 In Edinburgh, Supportability Engineering are directly involved with: 
 IRCM (Infra-Red Counter Measures) Systems
 Laser Target Designator and Laser Ranging Systems
 Eurofighter Typhoon Radar
 SAAB Gripen Radar
 Surveillance AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) Radars
 The Global Combat Air Programme
 Examples of summer placement projects include: 
 Physics of Failure & Finite Element Analysis – an evaluation of Ansys Sherlock in addition to experience of other tools within Ansys suite
 Electronics Reliability Analysis - Evaluating Radar PCAs for Reliability, Maintainability, and Testability
 Lead Free & Materials Science – design, development and production support and interaction with engineers in a variety of functions and roles
 Data Analytics – producing reports using analysis from Production and Field Defect Data
 What you’ll bring 
 Entry Requirements 
 Currently studying Aerospace, Electronics or Mechanical Engineering or related disciplines
 Competencies we look for: 
 Strong communication skills, written and verbal 
 Ability to solve technical problems 
 Computer literacy (MS Office) 
 Appreciation of the lifecycle of a product and electronic product design
 A passion for reliability and root cause analysis
 Personal attributes: 
 Self-motivated, enthusiastic, and able to use initiative 
 Analytical with an eye for data 
 Outgoing with a willingness to ask questions
 Collaborative and flexible in approach 
 Security Clearance 
 At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your wellbeing, learning and …

 Your Impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 The Engineering Summer Placement Programme 
 We have an exciting opportunity for a Summer Placement Engineers to join our team within the Electronic Warfare (EW) and Future Combat Air (FCA) lines of business. This opportunity is based at Capability Green, Luton. The engineers based at this site work with the latest technology to develop a wide range of products for both manned and unmanned aircraft platforms, including airborne sensors, protection, countermeasure, and integrated mission systems.
 We have created a programme across our UK sites that not only increases your technical skills but gives you the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers across our business on meaningful real-life projects. Throughout your summer placement, you will receive coaching and support from a dedicated team of subject-matter-experts to work in multidisciplinary teams to gain experience across the product lifecycle. Our ultimate aim is to see you through your undergraduate years, and successful placements may result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 Our Engineering Summer Placement Programme commences on the 28th June 2027 and lasts for 9 weeks. During the programme, there may be options to extend your placement with us.
 What you will do as a Summer Placement Student 
 Summer placement students will be involved in a variety of tasks in one of the following engineering disciplines – Software, Systems, Hardware, Firmware, Microwave or Antenna Engineering.
 Providing support to real projects, placement students will be required to apply knowledge gained while studying in a practical way. Placement students will undertake activities including designing, testing, qualifying, and supporting technology across our range of products. The challenging tasks will involve communicating with other team members to gain information before completing objectives and examining outcomes.
 Working as part of an established engineering community, and supported by a team of experienced engineers, you will be responsible for:
 · Delivering small packages of work to time, cost, and quality.
 · Working within a team to achieve project targets, collaborate across multiple disciplines and solve problems.
 · Communicating with team members to share knowledge.
 · Gaining an understanding of the EW domain to support the development of relevant products and technologies.
 · Completing tasks to a high standard in accordance with appropriate processes and procedures.
 · Using the opportunity to develop engineering skills. A supervisor will be available to provide mentoring whilst working as a fully integrated member of the team.
 What we need from you 
 All our Summer Placement roles require a minimum of a predicted 2:2 grade in a relevant degree discipline. For technical roles please note that our preferred degree disciplines include Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or other STEM subject degrees.

 Excellent communication skills are essential, both written and verbal.
 Ability to solve technical problems.
 Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths (STEM) related degree.
 Computer literacy and the ability to use the MS Office suite of tools.
 MATLAB/Simulink experience beneficial.
 A strong passion/interest in engineering and/or science.

 Able to use own initiative to achieve overall objectives.
 Able to work under pressure and achieve challenging deadlines within an environment of changing priorities.

 Willst du mit deiner Expertise in der beruflichen Vorsorge direkten Mehrwert für unsere Versicherten schaffen und unsere Pensionskasse fachlich wie organisatorisch mitprägen? Begeistert es dich, dein Fachwissen in der beruflichen Vorsorge bei komplexen Kundenanliegen einzusetzen, Prozesse zu verbessern und neue Lösungen mitzugestalten?
 In dieser Rolle arbeitest du im Team Pensionskasse, welches organisatorisch dem Geschäftsbereich HR zugeordnet ist, und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung der Pensionskasse von Zurich Schweiz aktiv mit. Du übernimmst eine zentrale Funktion im Fachbereich Vorsorge unserer Versicherten, kombinierst deine fundierten Kenntnisse mit hoher Serviceorientierung und trägst dazu bei, unsere Prozesse weiter zu digitalisieren und zu optimieren. In einem kleinen, engagierten Team prägst du den Auftritt unserer Pensionskasse aktiv mit und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Versicherten transparent, verständlich und lösungsorientiert begleitet werden. 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Du begleitest unsere Versicherten durch alle Lebensphasen (Eintritte, Austritte, Wohneigentumsförderung, Scheidungen etc.) und informierst sie verständlich und serviceorientiert 
 Du prüfst, bearbeitest und begleitest Invaliditätsfälle strukturiert und empathisch 
 Du stellst eine hohe fachliche Qualität sicher, wirkst bei Kontrollen mit und entwickelst Arbeitsabläufe, Checklisten und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter 
 Du optimierst als Super-User unsere Verwaltungssoftware, testest neue Funktionen und bildest die Schnittstelle zum IT-Dienstleister 
 Du wirkst aktiv an der Erstellung von Versicherteninformationen und Versandaktionen mit, pflegst den Intranetauftritt der Pensionskasse und unterstützt die Einführung neuer digitaler Prozesse 
 Das zeichnet dich aus 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung oder Matura sowie eine Weiterbildung zur/zum Sozialversicherungsfachfrau/-mann oder Fachfrau/-mann für Personalvorsorge 
 Mehrjährige, fundierte Praxiserfahrung in der beruflichen Vorsorge 
 Hohes technisches Verständnis und Begeisterung für moderne Softwarelösungen, digitalisierte Prozesse und deren Weiterentwicklung 
 Diskrete, integre und belastbare Persönlichkeit mit selbständiger, exakter und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsweise, starkem Teamgeist und ausgeprägter Empathie für unsere Versicherten 
 Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie fliessende Kenntnisse (C1/C2) in Französisch und/oder Englisch für die professionelle Betreuung unseres mehrsprachigen Versichertenkreises 
 Gut zu wissen 
 Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 6 0 - 100% 
 Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich 
 Stellenantritt: ab 01.02.2027 oder nach Vereinbarung 
 Reisetätigkeit: keine 
 Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40% 
 Alles rund um deine Bewerbung 
 Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . 
 Wir legen Wert auf einen effizienten und wertschätzenden Bewerbungsprozess. Das Talent Acquisition Team prüft deine Bewerbung persönlich, ohne Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. items.desc:
Our Manufacturing Engineering (MFE) department is looking for a Manufacturing Specialist to join our technical team.
In this role, you will be a key connection between Engineering, Operations, and Production , helping to make sure that new ideas and technical solutions can be effectively implemented in production. You will assess whether proposed solutions are feasible, help define the best manufacturing approach, and coordinate specific tooling needs
 What will you take care of? 
 You will be responsible for:
 Feasibility & Engineering Support: Review technical proposals from Engineering and assess whether they can be efficiently implemented in production.
 Technical Drawing & 3D Model Interpretation: Read and understand technical drawings and 3D models to identify the best way to manufacture a component.
 Tooling Management: Coordinate requests for special tooling, working with suppliers to define requirements, following up on orders, and monitoring delivery dates.
 Production & Shop Floor Support: Work closely with the production team and carry out practical checks on the machines to make sure processes and setups work as expected.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with different departments, including Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Purchasing, Tooling, and Production, ensuring clear and effective communication
What distinguishes you? 
 Education: Bachelor’s/master’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent professional experience.
 Languages: fluent in English and Italian
 CAD/CAM Proficiency: Ability to read and understand technical drawings and 3D models. Experience with CAD software such as PTC Creo and SolidWorks is a plus.
 Machining & Process Expertise (Machining Center / Chip Removal): Good understanding of machining processes and production methods. Previous experience working directly with machines or in a production environment is highly appreciated.
 Materials & Cutting Technology: Good knowledge of industrial materials and machining tools, with the ability to understand which tools and solutions are best suited to different materials and applications.
 Good knowledge of industrial materials and machining tools, with the ability to understand which tools and solutions are best suited to different materials and applications.
 Other: strong interpersonal and communication skills to interface effectively across departments and with international/local suppliers. Ability to plan, organize, and monitor delivery schedules for specialized tooling and equipment.

items.desc:
Binnen onze aftersales-keten, van Helpdesk en Planning tot Fieldservice en Backoffice, ligt een schat aan data en werken we met geavanceerde planningssoftware. Ook staat de introductie van AI-toepassingen hoog op de agenda. Als duaal student bevind jij je midden in deze ontwikkeling en werk je projectmatig aan het optimaliseren van onze processen.
 Met een frisse, analytische blik breng je administratieve en operationele processen in kaart, signaleer je knelpunten en initieer en begeleid je verbeterprojecten. Daarbij onderzoek je hoe we data, slimme tools en AI effectief kunnen inzetten. Het doel: een Helpdesk die sneller antwoord kan geven, een efficiëntere planning, een Fieldservice die vaker in één keer slaagt en een Backoffice die kennis sneller en beter binnen de organisatie kan delen.
 Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
 Ketenbrede procesoptimalisatie: Je analyseert de processen tussen Helpdesk, Planning, Fieldservice en Backoffice en werkt aan verbeteringen die de doorstroom en samenwerking versterken.
 AI, data en tooling: Je ontwikkelt en onderzoekt (AI-gedreven) concepten en tools die de zelfredzaamheid van de eerste lijn en buitendienst vergroten en de kennisoverdracht vanuit de Backoffice versnellen.
 Planningsoptimalisatie: Je werkt aan de integratie van commerciële en reguliere planning en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze scheduling-tools om de efficiëntie te verhogen.
 Standaardisatie: Je helpt processen te standaardiseren en zo de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening te borgen, passend bij ons snelgroeiende productportfolio.
Wij zoeken een nieuwsgierige en analytische bedrijfskundige of technische student die energie krijgt van het verbeteren van processen en het oplossen van vraagstukken. Je hebt sterke affiniteit met serviceprocessen, planning, data-analyse en opkomende technologieën zoals AI en vindt het interessant om te ontdekken hoe we deze slimmer kunnen inzetten. Daarbij wacht je niet af, maar neem je zelf initiatief en vind je het leuk om een project zelfstandig van begin tot eind op te pakken.
 Omdat je binnen de hele aftersales-keten actief bent, schakel je gemakkelijk met verschillende collega’s, van Helpdesk en Planning tot Fieldservice en Backoffice. Je kunt jouw ideeën helder overbrengen, werkt gestructureerd en weet anderen mee te nemen in verbeteringen. Uiteraard ben je ook handig met computers en kun je goed uit de voeten met bijvoorbeeld Excel en andere data-tools.

 Pas jij in het plaatje van onze ideale kandidaat? Dan hebben we je natuurlijk ook wat te bieden! Bovendien hebben we veel ervaring in het werken met deeltijdstudenten. Wij waarderen eigen initiatief en geven je de vrijheid om, naast je reguliere taken, zelf ideeën aan te dragen.

 Belonen wij je met een salaris tussen 3190 en 3304 euro bruto per maand (o.b.v. fulltime) afhankelijk van o.a. relevante ervaring;

items.desc:
About the Position 
 The PTMH – Technological Platform for Hydraulic Machines provides independent scientific services to research laboratories and industry in the field of hydraulic machinery and hydropower. These services mainly consist of experimental testing of scale models of large hydraulic machines and systems.
 Testing activities are carried out using a unique experimental facility composed of three test rigs which allow for experiments in all types of hydraulic machines, hydroelectric units, and battery-hybrid systems.
 The maintenance and upgrading of the facilities must be continuous to guarantee the quality of the measurement results, which are subject to contractual clauses.
 We are seeking a mechanical engineer to join and strenghten our engineering team. 
 Key responsabilities 
 The main responsibilities include:
 Manage projects with clients, suppliers, and internal PTMH team. Main responsibilities include preparing and conducting model tests, performing calibration of required instruments, ensuring the quality of data acquisition, writing measurement reports, and contributing to performance analyses.
 Manage the maintenance of the experimental infrastructure and ensure the proper operation and reliability of the testing platforms.
 Participate in the continuous improvement of the installations, including software, and metrological adaptations.
 Ensure the quality of services by defining and implementing processes and conducting root cause analyses when issues arise.
 Support the training of new test engineers and assist with practical laboratory sessions for EPFL students.
 Occasionally conduct test monitoring and validation activities at partner laboratories or directly at hydropower plant sites.
 Profile 
 Mechanical engineering degree EPF, HES or equivalent, with competencies in hydraulic/electric systems.
 Experience with experimental techniques and National Instruments systems.
 Curiosity and ability to design and develop innovative set-up and instrumentation to meet specific testing and measurement needs.
 Experience with LabVIEW and control system programming is considered an asset
 Fluency in French and English is required.
 We offer 
 A unique environment within an independent hydraulic research and testing center, equipped with high-quality experimental facilities.
 Access to a network of renowned experts in the fields of hydraulics and electrical engineering.
 An excellent working environment with strong teamwork.
 Opportunities for continuous professional development and training.
 Information 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. Interested applicants should upload by March 23, 2026 the following documents in one PDF:
 CV
 Cover letter
 Work certificate if available
 For any further information, please contact: Dr. Elena Vagnoni (elena.vagnoni@epfl.ch)

 Contract Type: CDD
 Duration: 1 year, renewable

Join our Team
 About the Opportunity 
 Ericsson develops software-driven network solutions using Agile ways of working, Lean principles, Continuous Integration and modern automation. Customer and stakeholder feedback helps shape how our software, services and network capabilities evolve. 
Join a cross-functional team supporting Ericsson’s global test labs. The team is developing a new network blueprint spanning purpose-built and cloud solutions, helping testers access secure remote test capabilities. 
AI-assisted development and large language models are part of our approach to productivity, software quality, innovation and continuous learning. You’ll work with experienced engineers and architects, who can help you build network-domain knowledge as you contribute.

• Configure end-to-end test capabilities so testers can access the appropriate payloads, configurations and security.

• Foundational development skills in Python, Go, C++ or a similar language, along with an understanding of software-development principles, secure development and revision control.

• Curiosity, adaptability and a collaborative approach to solving technical challenges. 
• Interest in networking, automation and applying new technologies. Deep telecom-network expertise is not required.

 Microsoft Quantum has a talented and diverse international team working to create scalable quantum computing systems.  Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively while also working independently.

 Role Overview 
 This role is responsible for performing highly visible on‑site and remote software installations and upgrades across the Varian software portfolio. The position requires a combination of technical expertise, customer focus, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as required , while also supporting customers through remote delivery and virtual environments .
 Location 
 Ideally based in United Kingdom, but this role is part of our global team and as such there could be additional travel within EMEA, imperative the Jobholder lives near a International Transport hub.

 Perform on‑site and remote installations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and diagnostics of Varian software products.
 Work across physical and virtual environments, including operating systems, databases, networking technologies, and virtualization platforms.
 Review scopes of work to ensure all required hardware and software components are available prior to installation.
 Assess customer IT infrastructure and project plans to confirm alignment with documented installation requirements.
 Complete all required technical and quality documentation in accordance with Varian Quality processes and procedures.
 Maintain accurate customer system inventories using Site Equipment Configuration documentation or equivalent tools.
 Remain current on Varian products and technologies through internal and external training, certifications, and continuous learning.
 Create and maintain required accounts with Vendor Credentialing Systems (VCS) to support customer site access.
 Collaborate closely with project management, local service teams, and hardware installation teams to deliver world‑class customer service.
 Perform upgrades, new installations, and team lead responsibilities on small to medium‑scale software projects with limited supervision.
 Record detailed installation and upgrade activities in company systems to ensure accurate and up‑to‑date customer information.
 Maintain a high standard of professionalism, safety, and compliance with VMS guidelines and customer regulations when working on‑site or remotely.
 Submit field service reports (FSRs), timesheets, and expense reports accurately and on time.
 Follow prescribed escalation and problem‑resolution procedures, requesting technical support when required.
 Participate in planning calls, providing technical input and guidance as needed.
 Advise customers on Customer Technical Bulletins, Release Notes, and other product documentation, highlighting their importance.
 Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced Installation Representatives.
 Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge 
 Proficient computer usage, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
 Professional experience with Microsoft‑based server operating systems.
 Strong customer‑focused mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
 Fluency in the local language and English, both written and spoken.
 Comprehensive knowledge of networking concepts and technologies.
 Functional knowledge of Citrix and VMware environments.
 Familiarity with business tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, SharePoint, and time‑reporting systems.
 Associate Degree or equivalent practical experience.
 1–3 years of relevant, transferable experience in a technical or customer‑facing role.
 Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required , alongside supporting remote and hybrid working models .

items.desc:
Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst. 
 Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Softwarearchitekturen, Standards und wiederverwendbaren Softwarebausteinen für unsere Maschinenplattformen MagnetArc Welding (MAW), Rotationsreibschweißen (RFW) und Rührreibschweißen (FSW)
 Vorantreiben der Standardisierung, Modularisierung und Wiederverwendbarkeit unserer Softwarelösungen
 Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Virtualisierungs-, Simulations- und Virtual-Commissioning-Konzepten
 Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Automatisierungslösungen mit Siemens TIA Portal und Beckhoff TwinCAT
 Verantwortung für Motion-Control-, Antriebs- und hydraulische Regelungsanwendungen
 Fachliche Unterstützung und Coaching von SPS-Programmierern sowie Durchführung von Architektur- und Code-Reviews
 Technische Begleitung von Projekten von der Konzeptphase bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme in internationalen Kundenprojekten
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Schnittstellen zur Umsetzung innovativer Automatisierungslösungen)
 Aktive Mitwirkung als Experte im operativen Tagesgeschäft mit hohem Eigenverantwortungsanteil
 Das bringst du mit 
 Studium der Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von SPS-Projekten im Serien- oder Sondermaschinenbau.
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Siemens TIA Portal und Beckhoff TwinCAT
 Erfahrung in den Bereichen Softwarearchitektur, Motion Control und Antriebstechnik
 Idealerweise Kenntnisse im Bereich Regelungstechnik sowie hydraulischer Systeme
 Erfahrung mit Virtual Commissioning, Simulation oder Digitalen Zwillingen von Vorteil
 Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen voranzutreiben und als fachliche Ansprechperson für komplexe Fragestellungen zu agieren
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und internationalen Schnittstellen
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (min. C1)
 Besetzung der Position ist für Januar 2027 geplant. 
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Unsere Kultur ist tief in unserer Leidenschaft, Robotik und Automatisierungslösungen für jeden zugänglich und einfach nutzbar zu machen, verwurzelt. Das Ergebnis? Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen - nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.
 Vorteile und Leistungen 
 Als Teil unseres Engagements für das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten wir eine Reihe umfassender Vorteile und Leistungen. Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt, motiviert und inspiriert fühlen, ihr Bestes zu geben. Sei dabei und profitiere davon, Teil eines Teams zu sein, dem das Wohl und Wachstum seiner Mitarbeitenden am Herzen liegt.
 DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) 
 Der Kern unserer Überzeugung liegt darin, einander mit Freundlichkeit, Aufgeschlossenheit und gegenseitigem Respekt zu begegnen, mit dem Ziel, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle befähigt fühlen, ihr authentisches Selbst bei der Arbeit einzubringen. KUKA ist ein Unternehmen, das sich für Chancengleichheit einsetzt. Jede Bewerbung wird bei uns mit Sorgfalt und Bedacht behandelt - ohne Rücksicht auf deine Herkunft, deinen Bildungshintergrund, dein Alter, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung oder deine religiösen oder politischen Überzeugungen. Wenn du bei KUKA einsteigst, bieten wir dir viele Möglichkeiten, deine Motivation und Individualität …

With its brands BMW, MINI and Rolls-Royce the BMW Group is one of the world’s most successful premium manufacturers of automobiles and motorcycles as well as a provider of premium services for individual mobility. The engine for the intensity and attraction of our products and services is the passion of our employees.
 At BMW Group Financial Services Hellas we complete the BMW Group's range of mobility services in Greece, offering tailored financial solutions like credit financing and leasing.
 What awaits you? 
 • Perform calls of Collections & Recovery customers (more than 2nd dunning level-increased tonality) based on team leader’s assignments.
 • Implements collections strategy based on Team leader’s guidance.
 • Negotiates, proposes and monitors extended terms for delinquent customers to Collections Team Leader.
 • Collaborates and provides new ideas in process improvements initiatives.
 • Perform in all payments processing in Rental and Bank.
 • Prepares letters -sms-emails management to delinquent customers, based on Team Leader’s directions.
 • Align Compliance to comply with regulations and laws. Executes all legal actions as imposed by the laws and the Team Leader. 
 • Executes all relevant payments’ processes (Dias, DD, adhoc Payment, credit card, manual) and ensures validity against bank statements on a daily basis.
 • Propose to the team leader in monthly basis the collections tasks and activities alignment with the strategy scorecard.
 • Is responsible to document (business specifications) for all IT related changes (Change Management). Is the key test user in the developments of the Department.
 • Is the collections project member for all Collections and Recovery projects.
 • Act as a key/contact person in Regulatory and Compliance reporting of Collections & Recovery Dept.
 • Is responsible to implement the Recovery Strategy and propose changes, efficiencies and improvements to Collections Team Leader.
 • Achievement of Collections and Recovery Targets including customer satisfaction.
 What should you bring along? 
 University degree in Finance, Economics or Business Administration.
 More than 3 years experience in a similar position.
 Understanding of financial services, collections, and customer account management.
 Customer orientation behavior Process orientation.
 Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
 Fluent English language.
 Excel knowledge.
 Strong negotiation skills.
 What do we offer you? 
 In addition to the motivating working environment in our dynamic teams, we offer:
 Continuous Training & Development opportunities.
 A flexible working environment.
 Well-being initiatives with various events.
 If the answer is yes, then do not miss the opportunity to apply and #shareyourpassion
 After the screening of all the CVs received, we will only contact the candidates who meet the requirements of the job to arrange an interview. All applications are considered strictly confidential.

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 Área de la Vacante 
 Desde el área de Ingeniería y Soporte Externo de Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales se prestan servicios de mantenimiento según los requisitos sobre SLA´s de los proyectos en ejecución. 
 Principalmente integramos sistemas de producción digital y vídeo IP en entornos Broadcast de Televisión y Radio, donde se incluyen todos los procesos inherentes al mantenimiento, tanto preventivo como correctivo. 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Entre tus principales funciones destacan: 
 Prestar el servicio de soporte para sistemas de producción digital. 
 Participar en la resolución de incidencias como segundo nivel de soporte. 
 Recopilación de datos y logs en el caso que tenga que intervenir el siguiente nivel. 
 Instalación de parches, actualizaciones y las tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de los sistemas de producción. 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Formación: 
 Se valorará titulación o formación de Grado superior en Administración de sistemas informáticos en red (ASIR) o Grado de Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o informáticos, o experiencia equivalente de mínimo 3 años en la realización de actividades de soporte técnico. 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel medio/alto inglés hablado y escrito. 
 Experiencia: 
 Se valorará: 
 Experiencia en interpretación de esquemas de infraestructuras de red y esquemas funcionales de soluciones audiovisuales e informáticas, manuales de usuario, y guías de configuración y utilización de equipamiento audiovisual. 
 Orientación al cliente en cuanto a la atención y recogida de las incidencias, investigación y seguimiento de las mismas, así como presentación de los avances y resultados. 
 Habilidad para aportar soluciones. 
 Familiarizado con metodologías de gestión de soporte, con herramientas de seguimiento de incidencias u otras plataformas para ticketing y gestión. 
 Experiencia en trato con proveedores para apertura de incidencias y seguimiento. 
 Capacidad de análisis para la anticipación de problemas y autonomía y decisión para la valoración de alternativas y soluciones. 
 Capacidad de organización de grupos de trabajo multidisciplinares y gestión de múltiples tareas simultáneas. 
 Orientación a la realización de tareas y consecución de hitos, con gran capacidad de autogestión y control de tiempos. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorables conocimientos: 
 Configuración y administración de sistemas de producción digital, en entornos Broadcast. 
 Conocimiento de las tecnologías específicas de los sistemas de almacenamiento, NAS, SAN… 
 Conocimiento y experiencia en Sistemas Operativos Windows y Linux a nivel de administración y del entorno de todo tipo de aplicaciones cliente/servidor TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, FTP, SNMP, DHCP, TELNET, SSH, NTP. 
 Conocimiento o experiencia en software de entornos virtualizados, Vmware, Hyper-V, entre otros. 
 Se valorará experiencia o conocimiento de la administración y supervisión de Sistemas de Producción de Audio y Video, basados en plataformas IT, valorándose especialmente el conocimiento en las plataformas Dalet Galaxy y Avid. 
 Experiencia en redes y gestión de switches a nivel de soporte y gestión de incidencias, CISCO, DELL, ENTERASYS etc. Se valora haber configurado redes o certificaciones específicas. 
 Se valorará el conocimiento de equipamiento de audio y vídeo en entornos profesionales, mesas digitales, procesadores, sincronismo, distribución. 
 Ubicación: 
 Santiago de Compostela, A Coruña, Galicia. 
 Presencial en las instalaciones del cliente.

 Aprenderás a revisar y analizar alertas generadas por sistemas de seguridad, como intrusiones de red, comportamientos sospechosos y malware, con apoyo del equipo.
 Colaborarás en la respuesta a incidentes de baja complejidad siguiendo procedimientos establecidos, escalando los que requieran intervención adicional.
 Participarás en investigaciones iniciales sobre eventos de seguridad, identificando causas y recopilando evidencias bajo supervisión.
 Registrarás la actividad en la herramienta de ticketing y ayudarás a mantener documentación actualizada.
 Apoyarás en comunicaciones básicas como solicitudes de bloqueo de IPs, escaneo antivirus y gestión de listas en correo electrónico.

items.desc:
Student Research Assistant in Bridge Monitoring, Computer Vision & Data Science 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Student Research Assistant in Bridge Monitoring, Computer Vision & Data Science
 30%, Zurich, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Chair of Structural Mechanics & Monitoring , led by Prof. Eleni Chatzi, conducts research at the intersection of structural engineering, sensing, data science, and artificial intelligence for infrastructure monitoring.
 We are looking for a Student Research Assistant with a background in structural engineering, signal processing, data science, computer vision, or related fields to support our ongoing SwissBWIM project. The project combines bridge structural monitoring and traffic monitoring data to identify vehicle loads and assess the structural condition and performance of highway bridges.
 Project background
 Our project, “SWISS-BWIM: Multi-functional bridge loads and condition assessment,” develops robust and cost-efficient methods for bridge load identification and condition assessment based on the Bridge Weigh-in-Motion (B-WIM) concept.
 B-WIM uses sensors installed directly on bridges to estimate the loads of passing vehicles from the bridge response they induce. The same monitoring data can also provide information on structural behaviour and condition. By combining identified traffic loads with structural response, the project aims to derive performance indicators such as dynamic amplification factors, response envelopes, and load-response relationships, and ultimately support the identification of abnormal behaviour and potential damage.
 We have completed monitoring-system installations on several highway bridges in Switzerland and are continuously collecting large-scale, multi-modal datasets, including bridge acceleration, strain and displacement measurements, environmental data, and traffic videos.
 The Student Research Assistant will work with an analysis framework which has been developed by our Chair to process and integrate these datasets. Depending on background and interest, there will also be opportunities to develop and test new methods for traffic-load identification, computer-vision-based traffic monitoring, and structural health monitoring under the supervision of experienced researchers
 Job description
 The main tasks include:
 Multi-modal data preprocessing: synchronising measurements from different sensing systems, identifying and cleaning faulty data, and improving data organisation and storage.
 Traffic video analysis: applying deep-learning-based computer vision methods for vehicle detection and tracking; manually labelling data and fine-tuning models where needed; and using camera calibration and geometric transformation to determine vehicle locations and trajectories on the bridge.
 Bridge Weigh-in-Motion analysis: fusing vehicle trajectories with bridge acceleration, strain and displacement measurements to estimate traffic loads.
 Structural monitoring: analysing structural and environmental measurements to extract key performance indicators and investigate changes in bridge behaviour and structural condition.
 Integrated condition assessment: combining identified traffic loads with structural response indicators to support more comprehensive assessment of bridge performance and condition.
 Please note that the methods required to complete most of the tasks above have already been developed by our Chair. Depending on the candidate’s background and interests, there will also be opportunities to develop and test new methods.
 Profile
 We are looking for a motivated student who can contribute to several of the areas above. Ideally, you:
 Are currently enrolled at a university in Zurich or the nearby area.
 Have a background in civil/structural engineering, mechanical engineering, data science, computer science, or a related field.
 Have experience or strong interest in two or more of the following:
 bridge engineering, structural dynamics, or system identification;
 sensing systems and signal processing;
 data analysis and machine learning;
 computer vision, particularly object detection, tracking, or localisation.
 Are familiar with Python programming. Experience with MATLAB and Linux is an advantage.
 Can dedicate 15 hours per week to the project.
 Enjoy working on real-world engineering problems and developing practical, data-driven solutions.
 Are proficient in English. The working language of our group is English.
 Please note that you are not expected to have prior experience in all of the areas listed above . We particularly welcome applicants who have a strong foundation in two or more of them and are motivated to learn the others.
 Workplace
 Workplace
 We offer
 Salary in accordance with ETH Zurich’s standard rates for student assistants.
 Access to sufficient computational resources, including CPU and GPU computing on Euler, ETH Zurich's high-performance computing cluster.

 Overview 
 Stiamo selezionando persone motivate ad intraprendere un percorso di formazione e crescita professionale nella consulenza finanziaria del nostro Gruppo. 
 Il percorso inizia con uno stage di 6 mesi full time, in presenza, all’interno delle nostre filiali, dove apprenderai l’arte della gestione del cliente, della creazione di portafogli economico-finanziari mirati e seguirai un percorso formativo volto ad accompagnarti nella preparazione dell’esame OCF (Organismo Consulenti Finanziari) che ti abiliterà alla consulenza finanziaria. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Durante lo stage in filiale sarai supportato da un team con esperienza in ambito consulenza finanziaria e imparerai a:
 organizzare la tua giornata preparando gli incontri con la clientela, tramite studio e aggiornamento costante, sotto la guida dei tutor che ti seguiranno per tutto il percorso di stage
 far emergere i bisogni impliciti della clientela tramite la corretta esplorazione e argomentazione e la mirata proposizione commerciale che ne deriverà
 costruire una relazione di valore tramite conoscenze e competenze che ti permetteranno di gestire il portafoglio a te assegnato, in qualsiasi contesto di mercato, diventando un vero punto di riferimento per la clientela e il tuo team
 creare relazioni di spessore sia in filiale che fuori, con la naturale autorevolezza che la tua professionalità saprà attribuirti
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Persone che vogliano fare della loro passione una professione e siano in possesso di: 
 laurea triennale o magistrale in ambito economico, finanziario, giuridico o politico 
 diploma quinquennale con brevi esperienze in ambito assicurativo o commerciale 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Assunzione con contratto misto, a conclusione dello stage con esito positivo e ottenimento dei requisiti abilitativi OCF. Avrai la possibilità di sperimentare la flessibilità della libera professione unita alla sicurezza di un grande Gruppo: 
 sarai dipendente, con il ruolo di gestore nelle nostre filali del territorio nazionale, con un contratto part time verticale a tempo indeterminato (due giorni alla settimana) e con uno stipendio regolato dal CCNL Credito 
 il restante tempo sarai Global Advisor – Consulente Finanziario abilitato all’offerta fuori sede con contratto di Agenzia (partita IVA), in esclusiva per Intesa Sanpaolo, con la possibilità di crearti un portafoglio di clienti selezionati e di ottenere una remunerazione collegata alla redditività dello stesso, percependo un minimo garantito i primi sei mesi di attività e specifiche premialità in caso di ampliamento del portafoglio 
 pieno accesso ai benefit del Gruppo Intesa Sanpaolo (Fondo Pensione, Assistenza Sanitaria, Condizioni Agevolate, ecc.) 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 La Divisione Banca dei Territori è focalizzata sul mercato e sulla centralità del territorio per il rafforzamento delle relazioni con le persone, le piccole e medie imprese e gli enti non profit. Dedicata ai segmenti di clientela retail, exclusive e imprese offre un’ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi, distribuiti sia attraverso la rete fisica sia attraverso i canali digitali. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.
