items.desc: Description de l'entreprise QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? - Une Banque engagée : utile à tous nos clients, nous contribuons durablement au développement économique, environnemental et sociétal de nos territoires. - Une Banque coopérative : nous appartenons à 100% à nos clients-sociétaires et nous nous engageons pour et avec nos clients. - Une Banque régionale : 100% de l’argent collecté est réinvesti en Ile-De-France et sur le territoire de nos 3 filiales Banque BCP, Banque de Tahiti et Banque de Nouvelle Calédonie. - Une Banque bicentenaire et pionnière : en action depuis plus de 200 ans, nous avons créé le premier réseau bancaire français de proximité et avons participé activement à l'émancipation financière des femmes. - Une Banque humaine : notre politique de responsabilité sociale porte sur des sujets clés comme la mixité, la diversité, le handicap et la qualité de vie au travail. Poste et missions Au sein du Département Pilotage de la Rentabilité Commerciale rattaché au pôle Finance, vous assurez un ensemble de missions visant à faire fonctionner, évoluer et optimiser les différents outils existants, et à en créer de nouveaux. En particulier, cela consiste à assurer la production régulière des restitutions du département et participer à leur évolution (rapports quotidiens à destination du Directoire, tableaux de bord mensuels auprès du réseau commercial, alimentation des bases à destination des autres départements du Contrôle de gestion, travaux récurrents à destination des autres directions). Le poste comprend aussi un rôle d’animation auprès des équipes commerciales (par exemple, des interventions en comités Directions Régionales/Direction Secteur Commercial pour présenter les règles de gestion) et parallèlement aux résultats transmis, de diffuser des analyses expliquant le positionnement de l’entité ou les décalages par rapport à l’attendu. Et bien entendu, répondre aux sollicitations des commerciaux sur les chiffres fournis. Pour ce faire, vous exploitez les bases de données décisionnelles, tant communautaires (Système d’Information décisionnel sous Oracle) qu’internes (environnement SQL-Server) et assurez tous les développements nécessaires. Vous rédigez également toute la documentation fonctionnelle et les modes opératoires nécessaires. Profil et compétences requises Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+4/5 en informatique décisionnelle, tel qu’un Master MIAGE ou d’une formation spécialisée en analyse de données. Vous savez concevoir et exploiter des bases de données, êtes à l’aise avec le langage SQL et vous connaissez si possible la suite BI de Microsoft (dont Power BI) et/ou l’outil d’analyse Alteryx Designer. Informations complémentaires sur le poste Votre rémunération : Entre 45 000€ et 55 000€ selon profil Type de contrat : CDI Être collaborateur CEIDF, c’est : - Partager nos valeurs incarnées à travers notre histoire, notre culture et nos clients : Proximité, Confiance et Responsabilité. Profiter dès votre arrivée d'un parcours d'intégration complet, adapté à votre métier et favorisant la prise de poste. Accéder à notre politique sociale attractive : - Rémunération fixe en fonction du profil, assortie d’un variable sur objectifs et d’un intéressement. - Titre restaurant dématérialisé, de 12€ par jour travaillé pris en charge à hauteur de 50%. - Une protection sociale renforcée (mutuelle, retraite, prévoyance). - Une politique parentale avantageuse. - 32 jours de congés payés + RTT, Compte Epargne Temps. - Un accès à notre Comité Social et Economique dès votre arrivée. - Des tarifs bancaires et assurantiels préférentiels. Toutes les candidatures feront l’objet d’un contrôle de références : vérification des diplômes, du parcours professionnel et des documents administratifs.

items.desc: Medical Science Liaison (m/f/d) Oncology/Hematology Territory: Münster, Osnabrück, Oldenburg, Bochum & Bremen Help Us Get Ahead of Disease Together At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are committed to improving the lives of patients through innovative medicines and vaccines, while creating an environment where everyone can thrive, contribute and grow. We are looking for a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) who is passionate about scientific exchange, collaboration and advancing patient care. Whether your experience comes from Medical Affairs, clinical research, academia or industry, we welcome individuals who bring scientific expertise, curiosity and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. As a field-based scientific expert within Oncology and Hematology, you will build trusted partnerships with healthcare professionals, generate insights that shape medical strategy and support evidence-generation activities that advance patient outcomes. What You'll Do In this role, you will: Build and maintain collaborative scientific relationships with healthcare professionals, investigators, oncology centres and key external experts across the region. Facilitate balanced, evidence-based scientific exchange regarding GSK medicines, clinical data and pipeline developments. Gather, analyse and communicate medical insights that help inform strategy and identify opportunities to improve patient care. Support evidence-generation activities, including investigator-sponsored studies and scientific collaborations. Identify and engage potential investigators, research sites and external experts. Plan and contribute to scientific meetings, advisory boards and educational programmes. Represent GSK Medical Affairs at regional and national scientific congresses and meetings. Collaborate across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Market Access, Commercial and other cross-functional teams. Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable ethical, regulatory and compliance standards. What We're Looking For We recognise that talent and experience can be gained in different ways. If you are excited by this opportunity but do not meet every qualification listed below, we still encourage you to apply. Required Qualifications Advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline (MD, PharmD, PhD, MSc or equivalent). Experience in a Medical Affairs, Medical Science Liaison, Medical Advisor, Clinical Scientist or similar scientific role. Scientific knowledge within Oncology, Hematology or a related therapeutic area. Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, investigators, researchers or scientific experts. Strong communication skills in German and English. Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory. Understanding of ethical, regulatory and compliance requirements within healthcare or life sciences environments. Skills & Behaviours for Success We are looking for someone who can: Build trust and credibility with a wide range of stakeholders. items.desc: Weitere Informationen The successful candidate will be employed under a regular employment contract. The position is to be filled by 4/1/2027 and offered for a fixed term of 1 year initially. An extension to a total of at least 3 years is planned. The fixed-term employment is possible as it constitutes one of the fixed-term options of the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (German Act on Fixed-term Scientific Contracts). This is a full-time position with the possibility of a part-time contract upon request. The successful candidate has the opportunity to pursue a doctoral degree in this position. The salary is based on the German public service salary scale (TV-L). The position corresponds to a pay grade of EG 13 TV-L. Unser Profil The Chair for Digital Additive Production (DAP) at RWTH Aachen University collaborates with industrial and scientific partners to investigate the fundamental interrelationships of digital and additive manufacturing, transferring these findings to industrial applications. Our research encompasses a wide range of topics, from component design and process development to production and the application properties of additively manufactured components. Additionally, we focus on accompanying processes such as design, quality management, and the digital representation of the entire process chain. Our service portfolio is further enhanced by individual consulting and training services. Through industry projects, we work closely with partners from various sectors—including automotive, aerospace, turbomachinery, life sciences, machinery, tool making, and mold making—to develop and shape the future of digital and additive manufacturing. Furthermore, DAP offers extensive professional and personal development opportunities within a highly motivated team. Ihr Profil You hold a university degree (Master's or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, materials science, physics, computational engineering science, or a related field. You are well-versed in solid mechanics and the finite element method (FEM) . You have a strong interest in process and materials modeling. You are highly motivated to work scientifically with the goal of earning a PhD. You work independently and carefully, and you enjoy working in an interdisciplinary team. Very good English skills are required. Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage: thermo-mechanical simulation (e.g. COMSOL, Abaqus, ANSYS), simulation of laser-based or additive manufacturing processes, programming and data analysis (e.g. Python or MATLAB, machine learning methods), and materials characterization. You will receive training in any of these methods that are new to you. Ihre Aufgaben You will work in an ERC-funded project that combines laser-based Directed Energy Deposition (DED) with laser heat treatment and deep rolling in one hybrid process. The goal is to develop novel methods that enable tailoring mechanical properties of metal components directly during manufacturing and repair. For this position, computational and experimental research go hand in hand: you will develop multiphysics models of the hybrid additive manufacturing process and predict how temperatures, cooling rates, and residual stresses evolve over the processing history. Together with fellow doctoral researchers, you will integrate these simulations with experimental data from process monitoring and microstructure characterization to create a digital twin. Building on this, you will develop data-driven methods to cluster the complex processing history into representative states, for which you abstract governing physical conditions and characteristic microstructures. In close collaboration with experimental researchers and international partners, you will establish how thermal and mechanical loads in hybrid processing govern microstructure formation. items.desc: Mission Brief As LCA & Environmental Data Specialist, you will establish our Life Cycle Assessment and environmental data capabilities from the ground up. Your mission is to create a reliable environmental data foundation, conduct Life Cycle Assessments in accordance with recognized standards and translate complex environmental data into meaningful insights. You will work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Testing, Infrastructure and other teams to understand the environmental impact of our product throughout its lifecycle. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Life Cycle Assessment: Conduct and further develop Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for our product, components, materials, and processes in accordance with ISO 14040 and ISO 14044. LCA Methodology & Modelling: Define goal and scope, develop Life Cycle Inventories, perform impact assessments, interpret results and document assumptions, limitations, and methodological choices. Environmental Data Collection: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Infrastructure and Testing to actively collect and understand the environmental, operational, material and supplier data required for LCA. Environmental Data Management: Establish structured and scalable processes for environmental data, ensuring data quality, consistency, completeness and traceability. LCA Tools & Databases: Develop and maintain LCA models, datasets and Life Cycle Inventories in openLCA and relevant LCA databases. Environmental Impact Analysis: Analyse LCA results, identify environmental hotspots and improvement opportunities and translate complex results into clear and actionable insights. Environmental Requirements & Performance: Support environmental and LCA-related customer, project, and contractual requirements and contribute to the development of environmental KPIs and methodologies to measure and track environmental performance. Ecodesign Collaboration: Communicate relevant LCA results and environmental hotspots to the Ecodesign Engineer and work closely together to identify and evaluate potential environmental improvements. Qualification Checklist Degree in a relevant technical, scientific, environmental, or data-related field, such as Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable discipline. Practical experience in conducting Life Cycle Assessments in accordance with ISO 14040 and ISO 14044. Strong understanding of LCA methodology, including goal and scope definition, Life Cycle Inventory, Life Cycle Impact Assessment and interpretation of results. Experience in developing and maintaining LCA models and environmental datasets. Experience with openLCA or comparable LCA software. Familiarity with LCA databases and the use of primary, secondary, and supplier-specific data. Strong analytical skills and confidence working with complex and potentially incomplete datasets, including the ability to assess data quality, consistency, and traceability. items.desc: We're looking for someone for evenings and weekends: one weekday evening and two shifts at the weekend. Revival is a float centre and sauna in Raheen. Ideally you already work in wellness, in a spa, salon, gym, yoga studio or therapy room. We want someone trustworthy, interested in self-development and growth, with a passion for the wellness/holistic industry and helping people. If you're detail-oriented and a bit of a perfectionist, you'll flourish here. We have many rooms and there's always something to be done. The job combines customer service with a lot of cleaning, tidying and looking after our clients. We have a friendly, positive, growth-focused work environment, with opportunities for advancement within the company. The pay is €14.50 an hour, with free use of our facilities. Your duties will include (full training provided): Front desk customer service: answering phones, emails and web chat, booking appointments, taking payments Coaching first-timers on how to float Cleaning and maintaining the float rooms and float tanks, inside and out Deep cleaning, changing filters, floor drains, topping up water and salt, and checking pH, H2O2, buoyancy and water levels so every float is sparkling clean Closing the centre and having it fully ready for the morning floats Helping with our online shop: packing orders, adding new products to our Shopify store and keeping stock counts right Creating and scheduling social media posts with Canva and Buffer Essential Person Characteristics Free one weekday evening and for two shifts every weekend Fluent spoken and written English: you'll be explaining floating to first-timers, answering phones and web chat, and often running the centre on your own Responsible enough to work alone, with little to no supervision Attention to detail Kind, caring, warm and friendly with clients Great communication skills Sees what needs doing and gets it done without being asked The shifts: one weekday evening (until we close, around 10pm) and two shifts at the weekend, about 15 hours a week in all. Extra hours covering holidays and summer if you want them. For the right person there is a chance to grow into a supervisor or manager role. Once you're competent and willing to take on more, promotion and pay increases will follow. Good, But Not Required Experience (full training provided) Work in a spa, salon, gym, yoga studio or therapy room Online retail or Shopify experience Time floating, or a meditation or yoga practice Time maintaining float tanks, pools or spas Evening shift, cleaning or hospitality experience To show you've read the whole ad, please put the phrase "Floating towards wellness" at the top of your application. Work collaboratively with product, proposition, technology and operations teams to improve client and adviser experiences. items.desc: Trasforma le tue aspirazioni professionali in una storia di successo, entra in PwC come: Regulatory Risk Associate Your Perspectives Il team Risk Capital & Reporting affianca i clienti finanziari nella gestione integrata dei rischi e del capitale, combinando competenze quantitative, regolamentari e di reporting, con focus su capital management, framework di Risk Governance, analisi degli impatti normativi sul business e sviluppo di soluzioni per il monitoraggio e la misurazione dei rischi. In particolare, all’interno del nostro team prenderai parte a progetti in ambito Regulatory Risk e Capital Management, supportando primari gruppi bancari nell’evoluzione dei propri framework di gestione integrata dei rischi e del capitale. Entrando nel nostro team avrai l’opportunità di: Supportare l’evoluzione dei framework di Risk Governance, contribuendo all’analisi dei rischi e alla definizione di metriche, soglie e processi di monitoraggio. Partecipare a progetti di Recovery & Resolution Planning, affiancando i clienti nell’adeguamento alle aspettative regolamentari, nella preparazione alle ispezioni e nel confronto con le Autorità di Vigilanza. Contribuire a progettualità di Capital Management, tra cui Capital Planning, Capital Allocation supportando l’analisi dell’adeguatezza patrimoniale e degli impatti delle scelte di business sul capitale. Supportare l’integrazione tra pianificazione, budgeting e gestione dei rischi, sviluppando analisi sulle principali dinamiche economiche, finanziarie e patrimoniali degli intermediari. Contribuire allo sviluppo di metodologie e strumenti di analisi, monitoraggio e reporting, anche attraverso soluzioni data-driven, automazione e intelligenza artificiale. Your unique strengths Hai conseguito una laurea in Economia, Finanza, Banca e Intermediari Finanziari o discipline affini. Hai maturato da 1 a 3 anni di esperienza in primarie società di consulenza, istituzioni finanziarie o realtà bancarie, preferibilmente su tematiche di Risk Management, con focus sui processi di Risk Governance, Recovery & Resolution, Budgeting e Capital Management Possiedi una buona conoscenza delle principali logiche di gestione dei rischi bancari. Hai familiarità con le principali componenti del bilancio bancario e con le logiche sottostanti alla composizione e gestione del capitale. Hai un’ottima conoscenza del Pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint, e costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di SAS. Parli e scrivi in inglese fluentemente. Sei unə team worker, hai buone capacità analitiche e possiedi ottime doti relazionali e comunicative. items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €38.400,00 - €52.800,00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. items.desc: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Mollie has an important role and responsibility in the financial ecosystem, handling customer funds with a high degree of diligence and scrutiny. The financial services domain sits at the core of Mollie, it orchestrates all money movements to power all of Mollie's financial products. Analytics engineering plays an important role in this ecosystem, as these core financial processes handle massive, complex volumes of data originating from different internal systems. By establishing robust data pipelines, maintaining automated data quality checks, and fostering deep collaboration with cross functional partners in Engineering and Treasury & Merchant Finance, the Analytics Engineering team ensures full data integrity and enables the daily reconciliation of Mollie's books. You will be working on creating and maintaining critical data assets that enable Mollie to reconcile their books. This involves creating and maintaining solid dbt data models from raw source data to consumable mart tables. You will play a part in creating and maintaining tooling to visualize and report the required data, mostly in our BI tooling that makes it easy for the end user to extract the required data. To do this, you will be working closely with engineers to understand the inner workings of Mollie's money movements and, most importantly, get the correct data. You will also be collaborating with Merchant Finance & Treasury to make sure they can do daily reconciliation in our BI tooling. What you'll ship Build and maintain dbt data models, from raw source data to consumable mart tables, powering dashboards that monitor critical payment metrics and track payment method performance across the Payments domain Build and maintain BI tooling that makes it easy for end users to visualize and extract the data they need Work closely with engineers to understand how Mollie's money movements work and make sure the data is correct. Partner with stakeholders across Merchant Finance, Treasury, and the Payments domain to define and track key financial data, and enable daily reconciliation Create compelling data visualisations and narratives that communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, through presentations, reports, and memos Implement data quality validation checks, testing frameworks, and proactive monitoring to ensure high trust in the data used for analysis and decision making Contribute to a culture of technical rigour and data literacy by mentoring team members on analytics best practices and keeping documentation well organised and accessible What you'll bring Strong technical foundation in SQL and Python; experience with data modelling and automation Strong experience with cbt; additional experience in BigQuery/GCP and Airflow is a plus Ability to zoom out and to zoom in to support implementation, often on the same day Skilled at stakeholder management, especially across technical and non-technical teams Experience in financial data and financial processes is a big plus Business-aware, impact-driven, and curious Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge technology? Would you like to help shape the future of our global energy? Join our Team! Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team is responsible for the assembly of high-quality and innovative products. Partner with the best As Production Controller , you will be responsible for: Deploying the master production plan into detailed execution schedules, ensuring alignment with customer demand and operational priorities. Preparing, managing, and continuously updating production schedules to optimize resource utilization and meet fulfillment targets. Monitoring production progress, identifying deviations, and driving corrective actions to maintain schedule adherence. Coordinating with Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, and Engineering to ensure material availability and smooth production flow. Managing production priorities, balancing workload, and resolving capacity constraints to maximize throughput. Leading daily production reviews and driving recovery plans for critical shortages, bottlenecks, and overdue orders. Overseeing Work-In-Process (WIP) levels and inventory performance, supporting actions to improve inventory turns and reduce lead times. Ensuring operational alignment with production plans, business priorities, and key plant performance indicators. Driving continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning processes, operational efficiency, productivity, and delivery performance. Maintaining accurate system data and production records to support planning accuracy and manufacturing traceability. Supporting Farm-In and Farm-Out activities when required, coordinating external suppliers and internal stakeholders to achieve fulfillment commitments. Complying with company policies and processes, including Quality, EHS, Compliance, HR, Lean Manufacturing, and Operational Excellence. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will: Have a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college, or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or Manufacturing. Demonstrate experience in Production Planning, Production Control, Manufacturing Operations, or Supply Chain Management. Be able to work independently, prioritize multiple activities, and drive process improvements. Show strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Demonstrate the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a matrix organization. Be proficient in ERP/MRP systems and advanced Microsoft Office applications. Have strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Be fluent in Italian, both written and spoken. Desired Characteristics Strong oral and written communication skills in English. Strong interpersonal, leadership, and influencing skills. Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate analysis into operational actions. Ability to manage changing priorities while maintaining focus on customer commitments. Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and other productivity tools. Experience with production scheduling, capacity planning, inventory management, and fulfillment processes. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns: Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive Working with us Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities Comprehensive private medical care options Safety net of life insurance and disability programs Tailored financial programs Additional elected or voluntary benefits The initial pay range for this position will be EUR 43,600 To 70,000. items.desc: Keeping the customer at the heart of everything we do. Our passionate and driven Customer Relations team is committed to creating innovative and delightful experiences, on top of our award-winning customer-centric foundation. Share your talents Job Description In this role, you’re the calm, confident voice behind the screen and on the phone. As our Customer Relations & Sales Ambassador, you’ll turn questions into solutions, challenges into positive experiences, and “just browsing” into “add to basket”, without sounding like a bot. You’ll support customers via email, phone and social media, while spotting opportunities to recommend the right Rituals product for their moment (because yes, that hand soap might actually change someone’s day). What you’ll do: Be the go-to contact for our German- and English-speaking customers: questions, concerns, compliments and order issues. Deliver personal and engaging service (no copy-paste replies, no corporate scripts). Spot sales opportunities naturally and recommend products that truly match the customer’s needs. Keep an eye on quality and productivity, working with targets and KPIs while staying authentically you. Think in solutions, not problems and make sure customers feel genuinely heard along the way. Bring the Rituals brand to life through your service and help customers turn everyday routines into more meaningful moments. Bring all of you "High on energy, low on ego and with a little bit of humor." You like finding smart, practical solutions and you don’t settle for standard answers. You’re customer-focused, listen first, ask the right questions and make sure people feel understood. And when things get busy? That's when you're at your best. Plus, you have: Availability for at least 24 hours/week (32, 36 or 40 hours are also possible). Full flexibility: available 7 days/week, comfortable working different shifts and weekends (around 1.5 weekends per month). German (native level) and English (C1–C2 level) skills - written and spoken at a professional level. MBO or HBO level (secondary/higher vocational education) or a completed college degree. A strong customer-first mindset: you naturally go the extra mile, keep it personal and focus on resolution and results. Strong communication skills: clear, friendly, professional and empathetic, even when it gets busy. A solution-oriented approach: you don’t just explain policies, you help find the best way forward. Great extras: Experience in customer service, hospitality, retail or sales. Interest in premium retail, wellness, beauty or lifestyle brands. You don’t have to be a Rituals expert yet, we’ll help you get there! Shifts Monday – Friday: 08:00 – 16:30 08:45 – 17:15 10:00 – 18:30 12:30 – 21:00 We work with different shifts. Saturday – Sunday: 10:00 – 18:30 You’ll receive extra pay for working on these days: Sundays +50% and bank holidays +100% Onboarding You’ll start with a full-time, inspiring 1-week training program at the office. We offer a hybrid working model: you’ll work at least 50% of your time from the office, with the remaining time from home. Because of this setup, fully remote working isn’t possible for this position. items.desc: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Mollie has an important role and responsibility in the financial ecosystem, handling customer funds with a high degree of diligence and scrutiny. The financial services domain sits at the core of Mollie, it orchestrates all money movements to power all of Mollie's financial products. Analytics engineering plays an important role in this ecosystem, as these core financial processes handle massive, complex volumes of data originating from different internal systems. By establishing robust data pipelines, maintaining automated data quality checks, and fostering deep collaboration with cross functional partners in Engineering and Treasury & Merchant Finance, the Analytics Engineering team ensures full data integrity and enables the daily reconciliation of Mollie's books. You will be working on creating and maintaining critical data assets that enable Mollie to reconcile their books. This involves creating and maintaining solid dbt data models from raw source data to consumable mart tables. You will play a part in creating and maintaining tooling to visualize and report the required data, mostly in our BI tooling that makes it easy for the end user to extract the required data. To do this, you will be working closely with engineers to understand the inner workings of Mollie's money movements and, most importantly, get the correct data. You will also be collaborating with Merchant Finance & Treasury to make sure they can do daily reconciliation in our BI tooling. What you'll ship Build and maintain dbt data models, from raw source data to consumable mart tables, powering dashboards that monitor critical payment metrics and track payment method performance across the Payments domain Build and maintain BI tooling that makes it easy for end users to visualize and extract the data they need Work closely with engineers to understand how Mollie's money movements work and make sure the data is correct. Partner with stakeholders across Merchant Finance, Treasury, and the Payments domain to define and track key financial data, and enable daily reconciliation Create compelling data visualisations and narratives that communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, through presentations, reports, and memos Implement data quality validation checks, testing frameworks, and proactive monitoring to ensure high trust in the data used for analysis and decision making Contribute to a culture of technical rigour and data literacy by mentoring team members on analytics best practices and keeping documentation well organised and accessible What you'll bring Strong technical foundation in SQL and Python; experience with data modelling and automation Strong experience with cbt; additional experience in BigQuery/GCP and Airflow is a plus Ability to zoom out and to zoom in to support implementation, often on the same day Skilled at stakeholder management, especially across technical and non-technical teams Experience in financial data and financial processes is a big plus Business-aware, impact-driven, and curious Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. AI at Mollie We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future …

We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. This role offers the opportunity to apply your process or operational experience to complex simulation projects, work directly with customers and take technical responsibility for simulator deliveries. Experience working with customers or other technical stakeholders. The confidence to take ownership of technical deliverables. A collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 15.11.2026 Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Sektor Privat Antall stillinger 2 stillinger Norsk Regnesentral søker forskere innen maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens til spennende prosjekter Vi styrker laget Det er stor etterspørsel etter Norsk Regnesentrals kompetanse, blant annet fordi vi er en av hovedaktørene i det nasjonale kunstig intelligens-senteret TRUST - Norsk senter for pålitelig KI. Vi søker derfor etter nye forskere. Hos oss kombinerer du det beste fra akademia og næringslivet. Du vil ikke bare bruke algoritmene i spennende oppdrag, du får også muligheten til å utvikle dem og forstå dem til bunns. Vi jobber med alt fra mer tradisjonell statistisk modellering og maskinlæring til noe av det nyeste innen dyp læring/kunstig intelligens. Om stillingene og kvalifikasjoner Vi søker to forskere med master- eller doktorgrad i maskinlæring eller lignende. Du må ha dyp faglig forståelse, evne til metodisk nyutvikling og helst noen års erfaring etter utdannelsen. Det siste gjelder spesielt dem som ikke har doktorgrad. Stillingene ligger i forskningsavdelingen «Statistisk modellering og maskinlæring» med cirka 30 forskere. Vi jobber med mange typer data, fra tabelldata og tidsrekker til nettverksdata, sensormålinger og språkdata. Du må være genuint interessert i både metodeutvikling og anvendt forskning, der vi løser konkrete utfordringer for kunder og partnere. Ved siden av å være faglig sterk, må du være god til å programmere og interessert i nye utviklingsverktøy, også KI-baserte. Norsk er det primære arbeidsspråket i avdelingen og i møte med mange av våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Det er derfor ønskelig at du enten behersker norsk eller er villig til å lære det relativt raskt. Hva vi jobber med Våre forskere får muligheten til å arbeide med mange ulike metoder, prosjekter, kunder og samarbeidspartnere, og vi jobber med anvendelser innen et bredt spekter av områder, inkludert finans, forsikring, teknologi, industri, helse, marin, klima og miljø. Vi utvikler for eksempel risikomodeller for banker og forsikringsselskaper, metoder for tallfesting av konsekvenser av klimaendringer og ekstremvær, prognoser for kraftpriser, metoder for deteksjon av anomalier i tidsrekker, modeller for spredning av lakselus mellom oppdrettsanlegg, kunstig intelligens mot algoritmisk prissamarbeid og metoder for ansvarlig og forklarbar kunstig intelligens. Vår hverdag er variert, utfordrende og spennende. Vi samarbeider nært med fagfolk hos de ulike kundene og samarbeidspartnerne våre. Prosjektene er stort sett finansiert av private bedrifter, offentlige virksomheter, Norges forskningsråd eller EU-kommisjonen. Arbeidsoppgaver Avhengig av din erfaring, interesse og kompetanse, kan stillingene inneholde elementer av alle oppgaver på et forskningsinstitutt: prosjektarbeid, prosjektledelse, markedsføring, nettverksbygging, søknadsskriving og akademisk publisering. Har du spesiell interesse for eller erfaring med å bygge opp et oppdragsmarked, for eksempel fra et annet forskningsinstitutt eller konsulentbransjen, ønsker vi at du fremhever det i søknaden. Hvorfor skal du velge oss? Meningsfylt og samfunnsnyttig arbeid innen oppdragsforskning 100 % fast stilling Gode lønnsbetingelser og pensjons- og forsikringsordninger Fleksibel arbeidstid, fem uker ferie, i tillegg til betalt fri i romjul og påske Mulighet for hjemmekontor én dag i uken Egen personalkantine Gode opplærings- og utviklingsmuligheter sammen med høykompetente kolleger innen statistisk modellering, maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens i et inspirerende arbeidsmiljø. Norsk Regnesentral holder til i Kristen Nygaards hus ved Forskningsparken på Blindern i Oslo. Tiltredelse etter avtale. Søknaden skal inneholde søknadsbrev, CV, vitnemål og karakterutskrifter fra din høyere utdanning og attester. Ta gjerne kontakt med en av våre forskningssjefer for mer informasjon. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg. Ferdigheter AI-generert Analyse av tidsserier Dataprogrammering Deep Learning Kunstig intelligens Maskinlæring Norsk Statistisk modellering Om arbeidsgiveren Norsk Regnesentral STI (Norwegian Computing Center, NR) er et forskningsinstitutt som utvikler kunnskap og teknologi som tas i bruk. NR er en uavhengig, ideell og allmennyttig stiftelse, og vi er rundt 100 ansatte. To av tre forskere har doktorgrad. Vi forsker blant annet på kunstig intelligens, maskinlæring, statistisk modellering, språkteknologi, bildeanalyse, jordobservasjon og geomodellering. Vi arbeider også med digitalisering, digital inkludering og beredskap. I mer enn 70 år har NR brukt forskning til å løse konkrete utfordringer og skape nye muligheter. Forskningen vår bidrar til innovasjon og nye løsninger innen blant annet teknologi og industri, finans og forsikring, klima og miljø, naturressurser, hav, helse og samfunn. Samarbeid er en viktig del av måten vi jobber på. Vi utvikler kunnskap og løsninger sammen med virksomheter, offentlige aktører og …

items.desc: About the Role We are looking for a Technical Training Specialist to join NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions in Stavanger. In this role, you will combine your oil and gas field experience and well engineering knowledge with strong communication skills to develop, deliver and continuously improve technical training for employees and external stakeholders. Working closely with subject matter experts and teams across the business, you will help ensure that the right technical knowledge reaches the right people at the right time, strengthening competencies, knowledge sharing and the safe and effective use and support of NOV Downhole Broadband Solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex technical knowledge into clear, practical learning, working with different stakeholders, and helping others build the skills and confidence they need to succeed . What We Offer Opportunity to build deep expertise in NOV products and technical training. Broad exposure to different business functions and internal and external stakeholders. Development in instructional design, presentation and stakeholder management. A collaborative environment built on trust, open communication and knowledge sharing. About NOV NOV delivers technology-driven solutions that support the safe, efficient and reliable operation of the global energy industry. With a history of innovation spanning more than 160 years, we provide technology, equipment and operational expertise across drilling, production and the evolving energy landscape. NOV Diversity & Inclusion We are committed to promoting diversity and equal opportunities. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply – regardless of gender, age, cultural background, disability, or belief. Develop and maintain technical training materials, including course curricula, lesson plans, and supporting documentation. Deliver technical training programs for internal employees and external customers. Coordinate knowledge sharing and facilitate the transfer of technical expertise across business functions. Identify training gaps and recommend improvements to training programs. Collect and communicate product feedback from training sessions to support continuous improvement. Coordinate competency assessment processes and maintain related documentation. Support the implementation of new training initiatives and competency development activities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure training aligns with business and operational needs. Provide support to other departments and perform additional duties as assigned by the line manager. What You Bring B.Sc. or M.Sc. in engineering, natural sciences or a relevant related discipline. Substantial relevant experience may compensate for formal education requirements. At least 4 years of field experience within the oil and gas industry. At least 2 years of experience delivering classroom or field-based technical training. Strong understanding of scientific and engineering principles relevant to well engineering and drilling data, including hydraulics, mechanics and drilling. Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and confidently to varied audiences, including larger groups. Strong computer skills, including Microsoft office, with familiarity with Learning Management Systems. To Be Successful in This Role You will: Combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills . Explain complex technical concepts in a clear, simple and practical way . Be organized, well prepared and proactive in managing your work. Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across teams and functions . Be curious, eager to learn and open to feedback . Continuously look for ways to improve training and processes . Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed .

items.desc: Location: Wroclaw, Poland Seniority: Middle Technologies: Data Our partner is one of the largest retail e-commerce companies in North America, serving millions of customers each year and ensuring a secure and seamless shopping experience across digital and in‑store channels. We are looking for skilled and motivated engineer Data engineer to join the innovative team. The Orchestration team manages platforms within Insights Delivery Technology organization and offers self-service solutions designed to empower engineers, data scientists, and analysts to seamlessly perform ETL/ELT operations on data from diverse sources such as Kafka, S3, GCS, BigQuery, and Postgres, and write processed data back to these sources via batch or real-time processes. Increasingly, the team also owns the metadata, governance, and data-lineage layer that makes this data discoverable and trustworthy across the company. As an Orchestration Team Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing and maintaining this robust platform, ensuring that users can efficiently extract actionable insights without being burdened by the complexities of big data technologies. Your work will enable the client to scale its operations while keeping technical demands on non-engineering staff to a minimum. Platform Development: Evolve, design, and maintain our orchestration platforms which aim to abstract the complexities of big data technologies and simplify ETL/ELT operations for users Platform Support: Perform ongoing production support and on-call support duties. Work with both onsite and offshore resources daily to resolve incidents and issues. Infrastructure as Code: Provision and manage cloud data infrastructure declaratively with Terraform, delivering self-service platform capabilities through automated, version-controlled pipelines. Integration: Develop seamless connectivity to diverse data sources and destinations, ensuring high performance and reliability. Data Governance & Metadata: Build and operate metadata, cataloging, and data-lineage capabilities that make data across Nordstrom discoverable, trustworthy, and well-governed — including integrations across transformation, streaming, BI, and ML platforms. Scalability: Design solutions that are scalable and resilient, capable of handling large data volumes, high velocity, and diverse data formats. Innovation: Stay up-to-date with emerging big data, ETL, and AI-assisted tooling, incorporating them into the framework as needed to enhance functionality and user experience. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, ensuring users can easily understand and utilize the framework Experience building, developing, and maintaining data platforms, particularly self-service platforms that enable engineering teams, data scientists, and analysts to configure and manage data processing workflows with minimal manual intervention. Proficiency in SQL (e.g., BigQuery). Solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data pipeline architecture, and modern transformation frameworks such as dbt. Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build and maintain CLIs, services, and automation. Experience with cloud data platforms, primarily GCP (BigQuery, Dataproc Serverless, GCS); AWS experience a plus. Experience with Infrastructure as Code — particularly Terraform — for provisioning and managing cloud data infrastructure. Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines with Airflow and Kubernetes. Experience with streaming / event data using Kafka (e.g., Confluent Cloud). Working understanding of data governance concepts — metadata management, data cataloging, and data lineage. Familiarity with CI/CD and Git-based workflows (GitHub Actions) for platform and pipeline delivery. items.desc: Do you want to help shape how risk decisions are made at some of the highest levels of a major European bank? As a Governance Officer in our Governance & Reporting PL team, you will keep decision-makers informed and well-prepared, contributing to a risk management framework that builds trust with customers and society alike. What you will be doing: You will join a small, collaborative team that acts as the secretariat for more than ten All-Risk and Product Governance Committees and Product Decision-Desks . Working as part of Business Controls & Product Management, the first line of defense, you will build relationships across Large Corporates & Institutions, Business Customers, Personal Customers, the Finland, Norway and Sweden Branches, and seven product domains. Your work connects daily governance tasks to Danske Bank's Forward '28 Strategy and its broader contribution to society. More specifically, you will: Plan and facilitate committee meetings, build risk-driven agendas, and document decisions accurately. Support adherence to the Group Internal Governance Policy within the first line of defense. Contribute to an aligned risk management agenda across business segments, country branches, and product domains. Improve the integration of digital tools into how governance forums are run. Develop process enhancements that move the risk agenda forward at senior management level. About you: At least two years of experience in risk, compliance, governance, or a related field. Degree in law, political science, economics, finance, business, or a related subject . Experience navigating decisions through delegated authorities and committee structures in a large organization. Familiarity with operational risk or Enterprise Risk Management frameworks. Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to facilitate and understand nuanced committee discussions. Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams. Experience in the financial sector or another regulated industry is a distinct advantage, as is experience in a corporate secretariat role. Fluency in a Scandinavian language and experience using AI tools to improve productivity are also welcome. What We Offer: At Danske Bank, we promote a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages personal and professional growth. Our office premises in Warsaw are attractive and inspiring, and you have the flexibility to work from home 1-2 days a week. Are you ready for the next step? If you are interested in this position, we encourage you to apply by 9 November . For more information, please contact Michael Anker Kristensen | LinkedIn . We review applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future of risk management at Danske Bank.

items.desc: The Practical Detail Location: Warsaw, Poland Working model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will activate global nutrition science materials locally, ensuring they resonate with healthcare professionals and consumers in Poland. This role is essential for translating complex nutrition science into clear, relevant guidance that supports product development and communication. You will be the trusted nutrition expert on the ground, connecting global strategies with local market needs. Your work will help Flora Food Group deliver better food that meets real nutritional needs and builds trust in our brand. What you'll do Activate and adapt global nutrition strategies and communication materials for the Polish market, ensuring local relevance and compliance. Monitor local nutrition science developments, media, and competitor activities to provide timely insights to the global nutrition team. Build strong partnerships with marketing, sales, and communications teams to become the go-to nutrition expert locally. Deliver internal nutrition education and training to enhance team knowledge and capability. Support Healthcare Professional programmes by preparing scientific content and evidence summaries. Performance You will own the local execution of global nutrition science initiatives, ensuring consistent application of nutrition standards and evidence-based communication. Your data-driven insights and proactive approach will improve decision-making and strengthen our market position. Success will be measured by the effective local activation of nutrition materials, stakeholder engagement, and the quality of nutrition guidance provided. Care This role reports to the global nutrition team and works closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, communications, regulatory affairs, and product development. You will foster collaboration and accountability, ensuring nutrition science is applied responsibly and sustainably. Your long-term focus will help build a trusted nutrition foundation that supports both consumer health and business growth. Passion As a food lover and nutrition enthusiast, you will bring curiosity and energy to translating nutrition science into practical, consumer-friendly messages. You will stay ahead of emerging nutrition trends and innovations, helping Flora Food Group raise the bar in taste, nutrition, and functionality. Your passion for better food will inspire both internal teams and external partners. About you You hold a Master's degree in Nutrition or a related qualification and are a Registered Dietitian or equivalent. You are fluent in Polish and preferably bring experience working with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in Poland, with a solid understanding of the local HCP landscape and how these networks operate. You bring practical experience in applied nutrition science, ideally within the food industry or fast-moving consumer goods. You are confident in analysing nutrition data, applying nutrition standards, and navigating claims frameworks. You communicate complex science clearly to diverse audiences and work independently with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You build strong relationships and manage stakeholders firmly yet collaboratively. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role offers a clear path to becoming a Senior Nutritionist or moving into cross functional roles locally. There is also potential for mobility within the global nutrition team, allowing you to broaden your impact and expertise over time. What's next If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you. Apply before: 02-Nov-2026 For questions about the role, please contact: Elif Kocoglu elif.kocoglu@florafg.com We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles. Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias. No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

The position acts as a key link between Group Information Security, central platform teams and OpCos, ensuring that security standards, risk management practices, and compliance requirements are effectively implemented and embedded across the organisation. Provide risk-based guidance across both centrally delivered services and decentralised OpCo environments (e.g. IAM, network, endpoint, vulnerability management). Perform and support cyber risk assessments across UnITy platforms and OpCos, maintaining risk registers and tracking remediation to reduce enterprise risk exposure. Coordinate and support compliance and assurance activities, acting as a central interface between UnITy service teams, OpCos, and auditors. Support the delivery of the CRH International cyber programme, ensuring alignment between central technology initiatives and OpCo execution. Interpret and translate regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements into scalable and consistent controls applicable across both central and local operating models. Support third-party and supply chain risk management across both centrally managed services and OpCo suppliers, ensuring consistent security expectations and remediation tracking. Key Functional Competencies You possess the following: Strong understanding of cyber security frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS) Experience in risk management, control design, and audit support Ability to translate technical risks into business impact Strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences Structured, pragmatic, and delivery-focused mindset Experience operating in a federated or multi-entity organization Exposure to third-party risk and regulatory environments Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar GRC tooling Security certifications (e.g. CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001) Key Characteristics For this role you should be/have: Pragmatic approach to GRC and willing to learn and adopt Problem solver and resolves conflicts. items.desc: Är du kreativ, nyfiken på ny teknik och har erfarenhet av att använda AI för att skapa innehåll? Nu söker vi på The Place en Content Producer till vår kund i centrala Stockholm. Om rollen I rollen som Content Producer får du en central del i arbetet med att skapa och utveckla högkvalitativt innehåll för olika marknadsföringskampanjer och digitala kanaler. Du arbetar med hela produktionsprocessen, från idé och brief till färdig leverans, och bidrar till att effektivisera och skala upp innehållsproduktionen med hjälp av AI. En viktig del av rollen är också att utforska nya verktyg, utveckla kreativa arbetsflöden och hitta innovativa sätt att använda AI i det dagliga arbetet. Du samarbetar nära kollegor inom marknadsföring, produktion och media för att säkerställa att innehållet möter både kampanjernas behov och verksamhetens kvalitetskrav. Utveckla och optimera AI-baserade arbetsflöden, prompts och produktionsprocesser. Samarbeta med team inom marknadsföring, kreativ produktion och media för att ta fram kampanjmaterial. Goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud och moderna verktyg för innehållsproduktion. Erfarenhet av projektledning och av att samordna olika intressenter. God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika team. Ett starkt intresse för innovation och den senaste utvecklingen inom AI. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift. Vem söker vi? I detta projekt kommer du att arbeta med storskaliga
items.desc: Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet? Vi söker en mycket motiverad forskningsassistent till vår forskargrupp inom cancerbioinformatik vid Karolinska Institutet. Vår forskning kombinerar artificiell intelligens, digital patologi och cancergenomik för att öka förståelsen av tumörbiologi och identifiera biomarkörer som kan förbättra patientvården. I detta projekt kommer du att arbeta med storskaliga histopatologiska bild- och genomikdata och använda avancerade beräkningsmetoder för att studera cancerrelaterade biologiska processer och cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader. Projektet genomförs i nära anslutning till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health (Testing and Experimentation Facility for Health), ett EU-finansierat initiativ inom Digital Europe-programmet som bygger en europeisk infrastruktur för testning och validering av AI och digitala teknologier inom hälso- och sjukvård. Karolinska Institutet och SciLifeLab utgör en central del av det svenska TEF-Health-konsortiet. Du blir en del av en tvärvetenskaplig och internationell forskningsmiljö vid BioClinicum och kommer att arbeta i samverkan med SciLifeLab och TEF-Health, med forskare inom bland annat cancerbiologi, bioinformatik, digital patologi och datavetenskap. Din roll Du kommer att arbeta i ett forskningsprojekt som använder artificiell intelligens och metoder inom beräkningspatologi för att studera cancerbiologi med hjälp av storskaliga histopatologiska och genomiska datamängder. Projektet använder offentligt tillgängliga resurser såsom The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) och Genotype-Tissue GTEx) för att undersöka cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader. Arbetet omfattar analys av digitala patologibilder, tillämpning och utvärdering av djupinlärningsmodeller, integrering av bild- och genomikdata samt statistisk analys av kliniska utfall. Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av beräkningsflöden i Python och R samt genomföra analyser med hjälp av högpresterande beräkningsresurser. Arbetet kommer även att bidra till aktiviteter inom TEF-Health och SciLifeLab med fokus på testning, utvärdering och validering av AI-baserade metoder för hälsodata. SciLifeLab är en nationell infrastruktur för life science i Sverige som erbjuder avancerade teknologier och datadrivet forskningsstöd. Genom projektets koppling till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där AI, biomedicinsk forskning och utveckling av metoder för framtidens hälso- och sjukvård möts. Vem är du? Du har en examen inom bioinformatik, datavetenskap, biostatistik, datalogi, biomedicinsk teknik, beräkningsbiologi eller ett närliggande område. Vi söker en motiverad, nyfiken och analytisk kollega med ett starkt intresse för artificiell intelligens, beräkningspatologi och cancerforskning. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Krav och intressen: Starkt intresse för att tillämpa beräkningsmetoder på biomedicinska forskningsfrågor. Erfarenhet av programmering i Python och av att utveckla och anpassa beräkningsflöden för analys av biomedicinska data. Praktisk erfarenhet av att tillämpa och utvärdera djupinlärningsmodeller för prediktion av genuttryck från digitala histopatologiska helglasbilder (whole-slide images, WSI). Erfarenhet av förbehandling av WSI, inklusive vävnadsmaskering, uppdelning i bildrutor (patches) och extraktion av bildrepresentationer (features) Erfarenhet av att sammanföra och analysera matchade histopatologiska bilder, RNA-seq-data och kliniska metadata från offentliga cancerdatabaser, såsom TCGA. Erfarenhet av kvantitativ jämförelse av modellprediktioner med uppmätta genuttrycksdata, exempelvis med korrelationsmått och prediktionsfel. Erfarenhet av statistisk analys i R, inklusive överlevnadsanalys med Kaplan-Meier-metoden och log-rank-test. Erfarenhet av att köra beräkningsflöden i Linuxmiljö på högpresterande beräkningssystem (HPC). God samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i tal och skrift. Meriterande: Praktisk erfarenhet av SEQUOIA, HE2RNA, Path2Space eller motsvarande modeller för prediktion av bulk- eller spatialt genuttryck från histopatologiska bilder. Erfarenhet av att beräkna och utvärdera genuttrycksbaserade signaturer, exempelvis CIN70, och analysera deras samband med kliniska utfall och tumöregenskaper. Erfarenhet av analys av bröstcancerdata, inklusive molekylära subtyper Erfarenhet av analys av normalvävnadsdata från GTEx eller av spatial prediktion av genuttryck. Erfarenhet av att anpassa befintliga modellimplementationer och hantera förtränade modellvikter och programvaruberoenden. Erfarenhet av GPU-baserad inferens och batchkörning av storskaliga bildanalyser på HPC. Erfarenhet av tvärvetenskapliga forskningsprojekt inom AI, hälsodata eller precisionsmedicin. Vad erbjuder vi? En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. …

More about the role Are you passionate about working closely with customers and sales teams to deliver excellent solutions and support? In this role, you will be a key link between customers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders. To succeed in the role, you will combine a customer-focused and commercial approach with a good understanding of lighting products, applications, and solutions. While deep technical expertise is not the primary focus, technical knowledge will support your ability to provide guidance, make appropriate recommendations, and deliver high-quality quotations and customer support. items.title: Data Engineer with a Focus on Data Modelling – Finance & Risk Data Platform | SEB, Solna
items.card: About the role You will play a key role in transforming SEB’s Finance & Risk Data Platform into a modern, scalable, and audit-ready enterprise data warehouse. This is a hands-on data engineering role with a particular focus on enterprise data modelling. As part of the FR360 Data Platform team, you will help establish a data architecture that enables reliable integration at enterprise scale while meeting the high
items.desc: Are you an experienced Data Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise data warehouse design and data modelling, preferably with experience in Data Vault 2.0? Join us in transforming our existing GCP data platform into an advanced enterprise data warehouse that reliably integrates diverse data sources and helps shape the future of finance. SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. Cloud, AI, automation and modern engineering are natural parts of how we build, operate and continuously improve our technology platforms. From core banking platforms to hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, platform engineering, AI-enabled operations and automation, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future-proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? About the role You will play a key role in transforming SEB’s Finance & Risk Data Platform into a modern, scalable, and audit-ready enterprise data warehouse. This is a hands-on data engineering role with a particular focus on enterprise data modelling. As part of the FR360 Data Platform team, you will help establish a data architecture that enables reliable integration at enterprise scale while meeting the high standards of a regulated banking environment. Your primary focus will be designing and implementing robust data models that support business reporting, regulatory requirements, historical data management, and data governance. You will work closely with data engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and Finance & Risk specialists to ensure that data is accurate, traceable, and fit for purposes. Key responsibilities include: Take end-to-end responsibility for data modelling, from source analysis to the design and implementation of target data models. Use SQL and other analytical techniques to understand source data structures, content, relationships, keys, grain, and data quality. Design target data models using scalable and maintainable patterns based on Data Vault 2.0 principles and methodologies. Define and promote standards for historical data management, auditability, lineage, metadata management, and data quality. Build and optimise ELT processes using Google Cloud Platform technologies, including BigQuery, Cloud Composer, dbt, and Dataform. Drive best practices in data modelling, warehouse design, and engineering excellence across the team. You will share responsibility for the team’s day-to-day data engineering work while taking a leading role in data modelling, data governance, and data engineering standards. To thrive in this role, we believe you have: Deep expertise in data modelling and enterprise data warehouse design. Proven hands-on experience delivering data models end to end, from requirements gathering and source analysis through conceptual and logical modelling to physical design and production implementation. A track record of building scalable data platforms that integrate large numbers of heterogeneous source systems. Hands-on experience building and maintaining ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. A strong ability to balance business requirements, regulatory expectations, and long-term maintainability. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into practical data solutions covering data structures, semantics, keys, and data quality. Strong SQL and Python skills. Experience using AI-powered tools to improve engineering, operations or automation workflows, either professionally or through personal projects. It is beneficial if you also have: Experience in banking, finance, or another regulated industry. Hands-on experience with Data Vault 2.0 modelling principles and implementation. Familiarity with GCP services and tools such as BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataform, and dbt, or with comparable cloud data platforms. Knowledge of data governance, regulatory reporting, or frameworks such as BCBS 239. What we offer Agile and modern ways of working. A flat hierarchy and an open environment where ideas, opinions, and different points of view are welcomed. Extensive training and learning opportunities. The opportunity to work for an innovative company at the forefront of technology. A hybrid working model, with the possibility of working remotely up to two days per week. Do you want to be part of SEB? We believe that inclusion and diversity are crucial to our future success. We strive to foster an inclusive, value-driven culture in which employees feel valued, respected, and involved, regardless of who they are, what they believe, or where they come from. We review applications continuously, so please submit your application through the link in this advertisement as soon as possible, and no later than 15 November 2026 . items.desc: Beskrivning Vill du bidra till trygghet och säkerhet i det svenska samhället? Och dessutom göra det på en arbetsplats där vi bryr oss om varandra och arbetar tillsammans, då har du kommit rätt! Vi söker nu ytterligare en systemutvecklare med fokus på lösningsarkitektur till IT-enheten för systemutveckling i Karlstad. Vår systemutveckling sker i självdrivande, ansvarstagande och initiativrika agila team med stöd av våra lösningsmönster och arkitekturella riktlinjer. En del system har monolitisk arkitektur baserat på Java Enterprise och andra följer en mikrotjänstarkitektur baserat på Quarkus i Kubernetes. Arbetsuppgifter I rollen som systemutvecklare med inriktning lösningsarkitektur ingår följande: systemutveckla i nya och befintliga lösningar. Vi ser det som en viktig del i lösningsarkitekturen med förståelse för de olika systemen ansvara för att designa och vidareutveckla lösningsarkitektur för både egenutvecklade system och tillhörande inköpta produkter utvärdera och välja teknologier, ramverk och integrationsmönster ta fram prototyper (PoC) för lösningar både avseende egenutvecklade system och inköpta produkter införa och implementera moderna lösningar för nya och befintliga system ta fram och säkerställa efterlevnad av lösningsmönster, arkitekturprinciper och arkitekturella riktlinjer för Systemutvecklingsenheten dokumentera lösningar och arkitekturella beslut på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt bidra till att förbättra och standardisera utvecklingsprocesser och arkitekturpraxis I rollen sker samverkan med övriga arkitekturroller på myndigheten, produktägare, verksamheten, externa leverantörer och utvecklingsteamen. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig med universitets- eller högskoleutbildning med inriktning mot systemvetenskap eller dataingenjör, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt. Du ska även ha flera års erfarenhet av arbete som systemutvecklare erfarenhet av arbete som lösningsarkitekt eller motsvarande erfarenhet av arbete med Java Enterpriselösningar erfarenhet av arbete med integrationer av ”löst kopplade” system Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att migrera system till ny arkitektur har erfarenhet av arbete i mikrotjänstarkitektur baserat på Kubernetes är certifierad lösningsarkitekt Det är också viktigt att du kan uttrycka dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Dina personliga egenskaper Du är analytisk och strukturerad och har förmågan att bryta ner komplexa problem och se helheten i tekniska lösningar. Du ser långsiktiga konsekvenser och skapar hållbara lösningar. Du kan förklara tekniska koncept på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt för både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter. Du är samarbetsorienterad och trivs i nära samarbete med arkitekter, systemutvecklare, verksamhet och externa parter. Du driver arbetet framåt och tar ansvar för beslut inom sitt område och håller dig uppdaterad kring nya tekniker, verktyg och arbetssätt. Villkor Vi erbjuder dig en anställning tillsvidare på heltid som inleds med provanställning. På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan du inte arbeta hemifrån, men vi hoppas att detta istället kan bidra till en tydligare uppdelning mellan arbete och fritid. Hos oss får du upp till 35 semesterdagar beroende av ålder. Du får möjlighet att träna på arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag. Beredskap kan förekomma i tjänsten. Anställningen är säkerhetsklassad och vi gör därför en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt bestämmelserna i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi välkomnar en mångfald av sökande med olika bakgrund och vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Om oss Vi på Plikt- och prövningsverket arbetar för att göra Sveriges säkrare. Vår huvuduppgift är att mönstra, skriva in till grundutbildningen och registerföra personal i krigsorganisationen. Vi gör också tester och bedömningar åt andra myndigheter, till exempel Polisen och Försvarshögskolan. Kort sagt: vi ser till att rätt personer hamnar på rätt plats i totalförsvaret. Möt några av våra medarbetare – på vår webbplats hittar du filmer och intervjuer med några av oss!
