items.desc: Quantitative Researcher - Systematic Equities. High-calibre systematic investment firm - Central London/Hybrid Compensation: £200,000 - £250,000 + Up to 100% performance related bonus Location: London (1 day a week on-site) My client are looking to hire experienced Quantitative Researchers for an opportunity within a high-calibre systematic investment environment in London. This isn’t a role where your research disappears into a presentation. You’ll work close to the investment process, with the opportunity to originate ideas, develop models, test signals and see successful research progress towards real investment decisions. We’re particularly interested in researchers who combine strong scientific thinking with commercial judgement, understanding the difference between an interesting backtest and a signal that is robust, scalable and realistically implementable. You’ll be joining an environment where high-quality research, technology and data are central to the investment process, with significant scope to influence how new systematic strategies are developed. This is a front-office research role focused on systematic equities, alpha research and signal generation, working with large and complex datasets to identify, test and ultimately implement new investment ideas. You’ll work closely with senior investment professionals across the full research lifecycle, from initial hypothesis and data exploration through to modelling, backtesting, portfolio analysis and implementation. You’ll be responsible for: Researching and developing new alpha signals and systematic equity strategies Working with large, complex and alternative datasets to identify predictive relationships Building and testing quantitative and statistical models Applying machine learning and statistical-learning techniques to investment research Developing robust backtesting and research frameworks Assessing signals across transaction costs, turnover, capacity and changing market regimes Supporting portfolio construction and the progression of successful research towards implementation Developing and improving Python-based research tools Working closely with experienced Quant Researchers, Portfolio Managers and Engineers Ideally, you’ll have: 3-7 years’ professional experience within Quantitative Research, systematic investing or quantitative trading Previous exposure to systematic equities and/or equity alpha research Strong Python programming capability Excellent foundations in statistics, mathematics and quantitative modelling Experience across alpha research, signal generation and/or predictive modelling Knowledge of machine-learning techniques applied to financial data Experience working with large, complex and/or alternative datasets A strong understanding of backtesting and robust research methodology Exposure to statistical arbitrage or systematic trading strategies would be highly advantageous A Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Machine Learning or another highly quantitative discipline would be highly relevant. Sound interesting? If you have 3-7 years’ experience across Quant Research, Systematic Equities, Alpha Research or quantitative trading and would be open to a confidential conversation, please apply. All conversations will be treated confidentially.

items.desc: Job Description Laser Development Engineer – Ultrafast DPSS Lasers Help shape the next generation of ultrafast lasers for industrial micromachining. As part of Coherent’s Advanced R&D Group, you’ll develop laser concepts and turn them into high-performance, reliable products. You’ll work with an international team in a supportive environment that values collaboration, professional development and a good sense of humour. What You’ll Be Doing Developing new lasers and improving existing products, modules, components and related products for industrial applications. Designing high-end laser sources and optics for ultrafast pulses, including nonlinear optics for frequency conversion from the mid-infrared to ultraviolet. Planning and managing development projects, including contributing to requirements specifications and preparing progress, interim and final reports. Designing, building and testing development prototypes. Defining specifications for laser characterisation equipment and documenting measurement protocols. Designing and verifying optical and electronic test fixtures. Conducting and documenting short- and long-term tests, and preparing and presenting development results. Working with international colleagues and partners in the US and Asia. Supporting international customers and suppliers with technical problem-solving. What You’ll Bring A Diploma or Master’s degree in Physics; a PhD is preferred. Strong knowledge of laser technology and hands-on laboratory experience with complex, high-power picosecond or femtosecond laser systems, amplifiers, and infrared, visible or ultraviolet lasers. Engineering experience with diode-pumped solid-state lasers. A strong understanding of laser measurement and characterisation techniques. Excellent English and strong communication skills. Experience in an industrial environment or education in electronics would be an advantage. Familiarity with simulation tools and mathematical software would also be an advantage. What We Offer You will have access to breakfast, pizza lunches, fresh fruit, and complimentary coffee, water and tea. Other local benefits include a job bike offer, a discounted-products and services platform, free employee parking, and convenient access by car and public transport. Our mission is to continue to be a financially stable and predictable business partner, supporting our clients with solutions tailored to their needs, delivering superior returns to our owner, providing rewarding opportunities for our people and making a positive contribution to society. To achieve this, we live by our values of Integrity, Performance, Collaboration, Straightforward Communication and Respect and Care. Core to The PartnerRe Experience is our global nature. No matter where you sit in the company, you are part of something bigger. Our teams represent our truly international mindset, forging connections across office locations and all levels of the organization and building a network of mutual success. The result is a day-to-day experience that will allow you to: Shape your own career Grow in a supportive environment Connect with a community of experts Make an impact View Home - PartnerRe Experience e-book to find out more about what it’s like to work at PartnerRe. Compensation And Benefits The expected base salary range for this position, when hired into our Toronto location, is CAD $100-150K per year. For positions based in other jurisdictions, compensation will be determined in alignment with local regulations, market benchmarks, and internal compensation frameworks. The above range reflects the typical base salary range for candidates hired into this position. The actual salary will vary depending on a number of factors, including job location, experience, qualifications, education/training, skills, market conditions, and alignment with the role’s requirements. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in our annual incentive program, payment under which is at the discretion of PartnerRe and subject to individual and company performance. Eligible employees also have the opportunity to participate in an array of benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, a health spending account, a defined contribution pension plan, life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, etc. Working Arrangement PartnerRe operates with a hybrid work approach that balances in‑office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our employees are required to be in the office 3 days a week. Our goal is to create an environment where employees can connect, innovate, and perform at their best. This position is for an existing vacancy within our organization. PartnerRe is committed to an inclusive, accessible recruitment experience. Reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities are available upon request throughout the hiring process. About The Position We are a small data science research team with a mandate to build future-ready capabilities and strategic differentiation for PartnerRe’s Life & Health business globally, working on a horizon beyond 2 years. This role's initial and primary focus is medical underwriting in life insurance: turning data and medical research into insight that shapes how we assess biometric risk over the years ahead, not necessarily how we operate today. As a research team, priorities are set collectively with our stakeholders and evolve with business needs. The role may extend into other areas over time, potentially including AI applications or actuarial questions, as the team's agenda develops. This is not a subject matter expert role in medical underwriting. We are data scientists who support and inform underwriters and medical officers, not a team building independent underwriting authority. Our day-to-day work is currently primarily in R, reflecting where our core infrastructure is strongest today, though this may shift over time. Python is supported for specific needs, and our broader computing infrastructure is largely language agnostic. Key Responsibilities Track emerging trends in medical research, data availability, and relevant technologies, translating them into a perspective on what the business will need to understand in the coming years, not just today. Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, answerable research questions. Prioritize research questions with the greatest potential business impact. Analyze data and build models to generate forward-looking insights. Evaluate and adapt emerging technical methods to meet PartnerRe’s specific needs. items.desc: Am Institut für den Schutz maritimer Infrastrukturen in Bremerhaven erforschen und entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen, um die Resilienz maritimer Infrastrukturen zu stärken und diese anpassungsfähig, sicher und nachhaltig zu gestalten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus Forschung, Wirtschaft und weiteren Akteuren der maritimen Sicherheit verbinden wir technologische Innovation mit praxisnaher Expertise und bieten dir die Chance, an zukunftsweisenden Projekten mitzuarbeiten. Das erwartet dich Wir entwickeln innovative Sensor- und Bildgebungstechnologien, um Herausforderungen beim Schutz und bei der Sicherheit kritischer Infrastrukturen zu begegnen. Einer unserer Forschungsschwerpunkte ist die Myonentomographie, ein zerstörungsfreies Bildgebungsverfahren, bei dem Elementarteilchen zur Untersuchung dichter, abgeschirmter und schwer zugänglicher Objekte eingesetzt werden. Aktuell erforschen wir den Einsatz künstlicher Myonenquellen auf Basis von Laser-Plasma-Beschleunigern. Diese bieten das Potenzial, Messzeiten erheblich zu verkürzen, die Bildgebungsqualität zu verbessern und neue Anwendungsmöglichkeiten über die konventionelle kosmische Myonentomographie hinaus zu erschließen. Dieses aufstrebende Forschungsgebiet verbindet Teilchenphysik, Beschleunigertechnologie, computergestützte Modellierung und moderne Bildrekonstruktionsverfahren. Wir suchen eine motivierte wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin oder einen motivierten wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter zur Verstärkung unseres interdisziplinären Teams, um gemeinsam die nächste Generation der Myonenbildgebung zu entwickeln. Die Stelle bietet die Möglichkeit, an anspruchsvollen wissenschaftlichen Fragestellungen zu arbeiten, neue Simulations- und Rekonstruktionsverfahren zu entwickeln und zu validieren sowie mit internationalen Forschungspartnern an experimentellen Messkampagnen und innovativen europäischen Forschungsprojekten zusammenzuarbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung innovativer Methoden für die Myonentomographie auf Basis von Laser-Plasma-Beschleunigern unter Verwendung künstlicher Myonenquellen Durchführung von Modellierungen, Monte-Carlo-Simulationen und wissenschaftlicher Datenanalyse zur Bewertung neuartiger Bildgebungskonzepte Entwicklung und Optimierung von Methoden zur Rekonstruktion, Materialcharakterisierung und KI-basierten Datenanalyse Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung experimenteller Validierungskampagnen in Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Forschungsteam und internationalen Projektpartnern Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung zukünftiger Myonenbildgebungstechnologien durch wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Konferenzbeiträge Unterstützung bei der Erstellung nationaler und europäischer Forschungsanträge Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Universitätsdiplom oder Master) in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (z.B. Physik) oder einem ingenieurwissenschaft lichen Bereich (z.B. Informatik) oder andere, für die Tätigkeit relevante Studiengänge Erfahrung in der Experimentalphysik durch Tätigkeit in einer Forschungskollaboration oder in einem multinationalen Forschungsprojekt Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse, mit Monte-Carlo-Modellierungen (beispielsweise in Geant4) und im Umgang mit experimentellen Daten der Teilchenphysik Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und/oder C/C++ Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit Erfahrung im Verfassen wissenschaftlicher Veröffentlichungen und in der Präsentation von Ergebnissen Fließende Beherrschung der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos Doctores/as en Matemáticas o Estadística que quieran desarrollarse en el entorno de la Investigación Operativa y más concretamente en la resolución de problemas de optimización de procesos. ¿Qué harás? Modelado matemático de problemas de optimización. Resolución con soluciones comerciales como GUROBI, CPLEX, HEXALY o similares. Diseño, implementación y validación de algoritmos de optimización (evolutivos, poblaciones y/o trayectoriales). Optimización multi-objetivo. Retos, ventajas, desventajas, enfoques, etc. Revisión y análisis de los datos proporcionados por el cliente. Validación de pruebas end-to-end de aplicaciones en la nube. Desarrollarás e implementarás modelos matemáticos y estadísticos para la optimización de procesos. Aplicarás técnicas de Investigación Operativa para resolver problemas complejos de decisión y planificación. Analizarás y validarás datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos. Diseñarás algoritmos y soluciones computacionales eficientes para la optimización. Colaborarás con equipos interdisciplinarios para la implementación de soluciones óptimas. Documentarás y comunicarás los resultados de los análisis y propuestas a los stakeholders. Explorarás nuevas metodologías y herramientas en el ámbito de la Investigación Operativa y optimización. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Doctorado en Matemáticas - Doctorado en Estadística. Se valorarán otros doctorados afines con implicación en la optimización de procesos. Tener experiencia en la participación en proyectos de optimización de procesos complejos utilizando programación matemática o heurísticas (como algoritmos evolutivos, metaheurísticos como algoritmos genéticos, búsqueda tabú, búsqueda dispersa o evolución diferencial), tener conocimientos en problemas reales como optimización logística, cadena de suministro, planificación, secuenciación de tareas y/o planificación de horarios, y colaborar con equipos de Investigación Operativa y desarrollo de software para crear productos que maximicen el valor para nuestros clientes. Imprescindible nivel alto de programación Python. Valorable el conocimiento de otras plataformas y lenguajes. ¿Qué valoramos? Conocimiento en programación matemática, programación por metas, optimización multi-objetivo… Manejo de herramientas como CPLEX, LocalSolver (Hexaly), Gurobi, XPress o similares. Nivel de Inglés C1. Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especialización tecnológica. Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente. Trabajo en equipo y espíritu colaborativo. Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla. Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras. items.title: Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer

items.desc: Are you driven to build the hardware that will power the next generation of quantum technologies? Do you enjoy hands-on experimental work, turning measurement data into insights, and collaborating closely with device design and fabrication? Join SemiQon as a Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer and help advance cryogenic electro-thermal and quantum devices from concept to working components. Role overview As a Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer at SemiQon, you will contribute to the development, measurement, and optimization of cryogenic electro-thermal and quantum devices. In this role, you will plan and perform low-temperature electrical measurements, analyze device data, and use modeling and design work to guide experimental development. You will work closely with researchers, engineers, and the fabrication team to connect device concepts, fabrication processes, measurement feedback, and performance improvements. ‍Key responsibilities Perform cryogenic electrical measurements of electro-thermal and quantum devices Model and design devices to guide experiments and support performance optimization Plan and execute experiments in collaboration with the R&D and fabrication teams Analyze measurement data and communicate findings to guide device and process improvements Work closely with the fabrication team to connect device design, process development, and measurement feedback Qualifications Must have Ph.D. degree, or equivalent experience, in physics, electrical engineering, nanotechnology, semiconductor devices, quantum technology or a related field Hands-on experience with electronic transport measurements Hands-on experience with cryogenic experimental setups, especially in the sub-1 K temperature range Strong understanding of solid-state physics, electrical transport, and device physics ‍ Additional assets Understanding of component fabrication, with hands-on fabrication experience considered a strong advantage Experience in modeling, simulation, or theoretical analysis of semiconductor, thermal, electro-thermal, or quantum devices Experience in characterizing electro-thermal devices, such as Peltier devices or NIS-junction-based components Experience with custom thermometry, such as on-chip thermometry ‍ Note: Security clearance vetting may be required for this position. ‍ Join us in shaping the quantum future At SemiQon, you will join a fast-growing deep-tech company building the hardware to scale up quantum computing. If you are motivated by hardware R&D and want to contribute to device development at the intersection of physics, engineering, and manufacturing, we encourage you to apply for the Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer role. ‍ ‍About us SemiQon’s mission is to realize the promise of quantum computing by delivering scalability through powerful, resilient, and cost-effective silicon-based quantum hardware. Its technology builds upon decades of development and know-how from the semiconductor industry, making its cryo-optimized CMOS electronics commercially competitive and well-suited for mass-manufacturing. SemiQon’s first-in-the-world cryo-optimized CMOS electronics deliver scalability and power efficiency to wide-ranging applications in quantum, space, and beyond. ‍ Send us your application Please send your application to careers@semiqon.tech following these guidelines: Subject line: “Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer: your full name” CV as a PDF attachment A brief motivation letter in the message body and your earliest possible start date

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join the Scalable Core team as an AI Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering the platform that supports Siemens Energy’s agentic software development lifecycle. You will engage in hands-on platform engineering while collaborating closely with development teams as a Forward Deployed Engineer, translating their needs into reusable services and automation. You will help implement the agentic way of working on real projects, gaining insights that will enhance the platform and its blueprint. With the support of experienced colleagues, you will grow towards owning capabilities and leading engagements independently, making a significant impact on our mission. How You’ll Make an Impact Help shape and deliver the platform that underpins Siemens Energy’s agentic software development lifecycle by translating delivery teams’ needs into reusable services, APIs, and self-service capabilities. Implement essential capabilities such as token budgets, consumption tracking, automated onboarding, LLM routing, and management of agent personas and skills. Support forward-deployed engagements by embedding with software engineering teams, configuring tooling, coding agents and guardrails, and building proofs of concept under the guidance of senior engineers. Advance harness engineering through context, tool integrations, execution environments, evaluations, and feedback loops that enable agents to operate reliably within defined boundaries. Write, review, test, and ship production code using AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code, ensuring the correct application of guardrails and supporting reliable platform operation. Capture lessons from real projects to enhance the platform, blueprint, and developer experience while developing your ability to scope and run engagements independently. What You Bring A master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering and a minimum of 2 years in AI-assisted/agentic software engineering. Strong programming fundamentals with flexibility across languages; experience with a statically typed language such as C#, Java, or TypeScript, as well as CI/CD and cloud-native development, is a plus. Practical integration experience connecting systems through APIs or data pipelines, with an understanding of challenges beyond your own code, including authentication, dependencies, and error handling. A systems understanding and curiosity about design trade-offs, such as message queues versus synchronous APIs or relational versus NoSQL databases, along with an interest in reusable platform capabilities and developer tooling. Curiosity about and hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot, and an interest in agent workflows, context, skills, and evaluations. A willingness to embed with teams, learn quickly, and deliver in short cycles, complemented by a collaborative, hands-on attitude, good communication skills, and growing ownership; fluent English is required, with Spanish being a plus. Must be based in Portugal or Spain (mandatory). About the Team The Scalable Core team is dedicated to driving foundational technologies and developer platforms that empower scalable and intelligent energy management solutions across Siemens Energy. We focus on building reusable backend services, AI/ML platforms, and lifecycle tools to support cloud, on-prem, and edge deployments. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver intelligent solutions faster and with higher quality through automation, enhanced developer experience, and scalable software foundations. Whether through a streamlined Software Factory Console, advanced model lifecycle capabilities, or self-service deployment engines, we ensure that engineering teams can concentrate on solving energy challenges rather than reinventing the wheel. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. For more than 14 years, we have worked with companies across Europe, combining software engineering expertise with a strong understanding of business and technology. We bring together experienced technology specialists with a drive to experiment, explore new possibilities, and find better ways forward. We believe technology is more than something businesses use. The team is building an AI-based business intelligence and analytics platform, together with the data foundation underneath it. The data foundation brings business data from ERP systems into a modern cloud data platform – a data lake on AWS, a semantic layer that describes business objects, processes and a business glossary, and a fast analytical database. AI agents on top of it answer business questions in plain language: show me this customer's open orders becomes the right data, fields and filters. items.desc: Zimmer Biomet is one of the world’s leading Orthopaedics medical device companies. Our innovations help treat patients suffering from disorders of, or injuries to, bones, joints or supporting soft tissues. It is our mission to alleviate pain and improve the quality of life for people around the world: a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As part of that mission, we are committed to the highest standards in patient safety, quality and integrity. Within our Connected Health product group, we have set a new standard for digital health with our mymobility and ZBEdgeAnalytics platforms, which underpin a suite of digital healthcare products that transform Orthopaedic care for patients and clinicians alike. What You Can Expect We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our Connected Health team at Zimmer Biomet. This is a fully remote, UK-based job. You'll design, build, deploy and improve generative AI and data-driven products that raise the quality of care and quality of life for orthopaedic patients worldwide. You'll join our AI & Data Science team, which works across three areas: Product development: We develop prediction and decision-support algorithms, using classical ML and generative AI, for our patient- and clinician-facing applications. Product analysis: We help our product teams understand how people use our products, so they can make better decisions. Platform development: We build tooling and reusable infrastructure that supports AI and data-driven product development across Zimmer Biomet. We design it to follow best practice for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). We aim to keep improving, to communicate openly, and to enjoy ourselves along the way. How You'll Create Impact In this role you will work closely with machine learning scientists and application software engineers to bring advanced data insights to life. You'll build automation pipelines, deploy and serve both predictive models and generative AI systems, integrate third-party platforms and tooling, and design for observability and monitoring in production, whilst ensuring that we meet our regulatory commitments. Our work covers classical ML on structured, sensor and imaging data, and generative AI: retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. Because we build medical devices in a regulated context, quality, traceability and responsible AI matter at every step. You'll help us productionise these systems against standards including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled medical devices. You'll help shape our technical roadmap and influence how the Connected Health team moves forward with AI products. Today, our tooling revolves around: Azure ML and Azure DevOps for model orchestration, CI/CD and development; Python for data pipelines, machine learning pipelines and model serving; MLflow (or similar) for experiment tracking and model registry, with monitoring for drift and performance in production; LLM/GenAI tooling including foundation-model APIs, vector stores/retrieval, orchestration frameworks and evaluation harnesses; Pulumi for infrastructure as code; Occasionally C# to support integration between our internal systems. We also use modern developer tooling. Responsible use of AI coding assistants like Claude Code is part of how we work day-to-day. What Makes You Stand Out A passion for building generative AI and data-driven products to improve healthcare; The idea of shaping AI products excites you, and you’re comfortable working where requirements are still evolving; Your background covers the majority of the end-to-end lifecycle of a AI/ML product, from containerisation, CI/CD, infrastructure deployment to debugging and monitoring models in production; Hands-on experience with either classical ML or generative AI in production, and have a genuine interest in the other; The ability to build cloud-native applications and are comfortable with infrastructure as code; You can communicate analyses and technical ideas, and their value, to a range of audiences; A drive to learn about new technologies and methodologies; If you don't meet every requirement but are excited by this role, we'd still like to hear from you! Your Background A demonstrable background within healthcare data and/or delivering AI/ML in regulated spaces (SaMD, EU AI Act, FDA); Prior knowledge of evaluating and guard-railing generative AI systems Experience with model monitoring, drift detection and responsible-AI practices (fairness, robustness, explainability). Industry experience as a Machine Learning, AI or Data Engineer; Comfortable programming with Python and packages associated with the AI/ML workflow; Travel & Logistic Expectations This is a fully remote, UK-based role, and we actively support flexible working. We actively encourage team members to meet up and collaborate in person. Some of our colleagues are based in the U.S., so there will occasionally be a need to be available for evening …

items.desc: Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we're here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe's safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, "roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen" kind of people. It's these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you're someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let's go! Rather than handling operational onboarding, your focus will be on building intelligence into our AFC compliance architecture. You will design and maintain AFC compliance dashboards, test and validate the effectiveness of existing controls, and help construct scalable new risk controls. By combining strong data analytics capabilities with modern technology, you will drive process efficiency, automate routine compliance tasks, and strengthen our defense against financial crime across Europe. What you'll do: Design, build, and maintain interactive AFC compliance dashboards and monitoring tools (e.g., tracking risk metrics, alert volumes, SLA performance, and regulatory reporting indicators) for stakeholders across Compliance and Senior Leadership. Conduct regular quantitative testing and assessment of existing AFC controls (AML, CTF, sanctions, transaction monitoring) to identify coverage gaps, false-positive trends, and operational bottlenecks. Support the conceptualization and deployment of new, data-driven compliance controls. Identify manual workflows within the AFC team and engineer automated solutions. Drive projects to integrate AI agents, LLM workflows, and low-code automations to streamline compliance investigations, data extraction, and routine decisioning. Query complex financial datasets to extract actionable risk insights, uncover hidden transactional patterns, and conduct root-cause analyses on control failures or suspicious activity trends. Work closely with Product, Tech, Data, and Operations teams to translate regulatory requirements into functional technical specs, ensuring seamless deployment of automated control updates. Who you are: Educational Background: Degree (or currently enrolled in an advanced program) in Data Analytics, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field—combining analytical mindset with an interest in regulatory risk. Data Analytics & SQL Competence: Hands-on experience extracting, manipulating, and visualizing structured data. Strong command of SQL (e.g., Snowflake SQL) and experience with dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase, or similar) is essential. Control & AFC Understanding: Familiarity with Anti-Financial Crime (AML, CTF, Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring) concepts, control testing frameworks, or risk-scoring mechanics, preferably within banking, fintech, crypto, or payment services under EU/Austrian regulations. Language Skills: Excellent written and spoken English. German proficiency is considered a strong plus. These are individuals who, with their curiosity and their continuous pursuit of excellence, engage in international cutting-edge research and teaching. With us, you will also find space to unfold your potential. We are looking for a/an ... Scientific project assistant predoctoral 50 Faculty of Life Sciences Job vacancy starting: 02/01/2027 | Working hours: 30.00 | Classification CBA: §48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited contract until: 07/01/2030 Job ID: 6362 The working group of Marine Microbial Biogeochemistry at the Department of Functional and Evolutionary Ecology of the University of Vienna investigates how microorganisms shape carbon cycling and biogeochemical processes in the ocean, from coastal waters to the deep sea. We are looking for an enthusiastic, curious and communicative colleague who enjoys working in the laboratory, in the field and at sea as part of an international team. Does that sound like something for you? Apply to join our team! Your personal sphere of influence: As a scientific project assistant (predoctoral), you will join the research team around Dr. Thomas Reinthaler in the FWF-funded project “Variability of Ecologically Relevant Bacterioneuston (VERA)”. The project is carried out in collaboration with the University of Oldenburg and is embedded in a larger research group with prominent German universities and research institutes. You will investigate which bacteria are active in the sea-surface microlayer, the boundary layer between ocean and atmosphere, and how they vary over a seasonal cycle and along an Atlantic transect. By combining single-cell activity measurements with metagenomics and metatranscriptomics, you will identify the traits that allow key taxa such as SAR11 and Roseobacteraceae to thrive at the air-sea interface. The start of the contract is 1 February 2027. The employment period is 3.5 years from the beginning of the contract. As a team, an open, collaborative and respectful working environment is important to us. Your future tasks: You actively participate in research and teaching, which means: You sample the SML and the underlying water in northern Germany together with our project partners at GEOMAR in Kiel, during the first project year only (about 3 days per month, first sampling in February 2027) . You take part in the research cruise of RV METEOR across the tropical and subtropical Atlantic (February/March 2028), including sampling and shipboard experiments . You measure the activity of specific bacterial groups at the single-cell level using CARD-FISH, BONCAT and Redox Sensor Green (RSG), combined with flow cytometry and microscopy . You extract nucleic acids, prepare metagenomic and metatranscriptomic samples and analyse the data bioinformatically (about 85% laboratory and field work, 15% bioinformatics) . You co-supervise MSc students in the laboratory; teaching can be added at a later stage if you wish . items.desc: About Board of Innovation We help companies grow in the autonomous age. Intelligent technologies are reshaping how businesses innovate, market and sell, creating entirely new ways to generate value. To capture this shift, organizations need to rethink how they work, make decisions and build for the future. At BOI, we partner with the world’s most ambitious companies to rewire their growth engines with AI. Our work ranges from building AI-native product and service models for Walmart to shaping the future of AI-powered marketing for The Coca-Cola Company. Each project is first-of-its-kind, pushing the boundaries of how AI can unlock new growth for the companies shaping their industries. About the Traineeship This traineeship is designed for early-career talent eager to step into the world of AI x Innovation. Over six months, you’ll work directly on client projects while developing the skills needed to move into a full-time Junior AI Strategist role. You’ll support and eventually take the lead on individual workstreams. Some days you’ll help shape an AI growth strategy for a global brand; other days you’ll design no-code prototypes, run AI-powered research, or support on client deliverables. You’ll be part of a small, fast-moving team where ownership comes early. You’ll report to Robin Vermeulen and you'll get a chance to work on live client engagements learning how AI strategy gets built from the inside: from first insights to final delivery. What You Will Do Be the voice of your work: you will not only build analysis but you will help present it. Take full ownership of key project deliverables and support broader client workstreams. Conduct AI-powered research to uncover insights, market patterns and growth opportunities Help design AI-driven tools, prototypes or workflows (often no-code) Translate complex problems into clear logic, structures and outputs Create slides, frameworks and deliverables that help clients make decisions Contribute to internal learning, experimentation and models that advance BOI’s AI offering Ideal Candidate Profile We’re looking for someone who brings the right mindset, sharp thinking and the drive to learn fast. Curious about growth and AI: You’re motivated by how AI can reshape innovation, marketing and sales. You’ve already explored AI tools in your studies, internships or personal projects and you have experience with no-code AI tools beyond simple prompting, and coding experience is considered a strong advantage Early experience that shows potential: Some experience through studies, internships, a first role or personal projects in innovation, strategy, technology or AI is useful, but what matters most is your ability to learn quickly, structure problems and take ownership. Strong analytical and structured thinker: You approach problems with logic, clarity and attention to detail. You can prioritize well and make decisions based on data and sound reasoning. Hands-on and entrepreneurial: You like figuring things out, testing ideas and improving them. You feel comfortable in a dynamic environment and enjoy tackling new challenges. Collaborative and positive: You work well with others, communicate clearly and contribute to a constructive team culture. Educational background: A master’s degree in commercial engineering, economics, civil engineering, entrepreneurship or similar fields is a strong foundation. items.desc: TL;DR We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce) Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs) €45–60k + equity What this role is (and isn't) Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it. Why now Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients. What you'll do Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment. Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later. Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow. Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents. Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it. Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget. Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear. Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment. What you bring You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor. Must have Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered. AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop. Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match. At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it. A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once. Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States. Nice to have You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved You've already taken a complex B2B software live Comfortable with AI You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway. How we'll measure success ERP go-lives on the date we …

items.desc: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You'll do Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities. Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on. Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome. Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve. Must Have Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting. Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast. Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows. Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on. Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between …

items.desc: Analytics Engineer - Global Finance At a glance ABN AMRO Clearing N.V. (AACB) is looking for an Analytics Engineer within our core Data Science team who combines excellent quantitative and communication skills with a strong drive to understand and learn about the complexity of the financial markets. Do you want to work in a data science team that focuses on the financial markets and the clearing industry? ABN AMRO Clearing operates at the heart of global financial markets, serving many of the world's leading trading firms and connecting to the major exchanges and trading venues worldwide. Processing billions of transactions annually, AACB is recognized as one of the leading clearing firms globally. Your Job As an Analytics Engineer within the Data Science team, you will play a central role in the development and implementation of data-driven solutions, automation, analytical insights and support for our organization’s decision-making processes. Your key responsibilities are to provide data (quality) pipelines, automated workflows, and create reports & insights to support professionals across our organization. If you are passionate about financial markets, analytics and coding, this is the perfect opportunity for you. In your work you will: Develop and maintain robust data pipelines to efficiently extract, transform, and load data from various sources into our analytics platform Join a multidisciplinary team where data scientists, analysts, machine learning engineers, and finance professionals work together on complex, high-impact challenges in global financial markets Design and optimize automated processes to streamline data collection, data quality checks and report generation Analyze data and create visualizations to identify trends and explain findings to key stakeholders. Draft requirements together with finance professionals and translate them into data/statistical solutions Experiment with emerging technologies, including agentic AI, and identify and work on promising use cases that can create value for the organization. Working environment ABN AMRO Clearing is recognized as a global leading provider of integrated solutions in clearing, execution, custody, financing and risk management. With 11 offices globally, we service clients on 160+ exchanges, MTFs and FX liquidity centers, processing over 20 million trades daily. ABN AMRO Clearing consistently ranks amongst the top 3 clearing firms on most relevant derivatives exchanges globally and enjoys market share of 20% or higher for many of the major exchanges on which it operates. Our service is tailored to the needs of Principal Trading groups, Brokers, Financial Institutions, Corporates active in the physical commodity value chain and of Hedge Funds that apply strategies in multiple asset classes based on CTA/Managed Futures, Relative Value Volatility Arbitrage, and Long/Short positions including Synthetics. Positioning in the organization You will be working in the Global Finance Data Science team in Amsterdam, reporting to the Global CFO, and closely co-operating with regional finance teams and other departments. The team consists of a group of high-performing people. You will contribute your ideas and perspective to projects addressing concrete challenges in global financial markets. Your profile We are looking for candidates who: Is excited by the pace, complexity, and international nature of financial markets and the trading industry. Prior knowledge is not required, but a genuine interest in financial markets and a strong motivation to learn more about them are essential Combine strong quantitative capabilities with the ability to communicate their ideas effectively Both BSc and MSc in a STEM discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field Experience with programming in Python for doing (statistical) analysis Communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analyses into clear stories for both technical and non-technical audiences Demonstrated initiative beyond your academic studies, for example through extra-curricular activities or internships 0-3 years of working experience NL based We are offering You will gain extensive knowledge of the financial markets and clearing industry while working on challenging and impactful data science projects. items.desc: Upside is an applied AI engineering and consultancy firm. We build software for scaling companies, international brands and large institutions. Our team design, build and run systems, with particular depth in healthcare and life sciences. Alongside client delivery, we develop our own IP: frameworks and components distilled from systems we've taken to production. Clients come to us when the problem is unclear and the stakes are high. Our job is to work out what should actually be built, build it properly, and leave behind a system the client can own. The role At Upside, a modern software engineer brings three disciplines together: Engineer - owning the technical decisions that make a system hold up in production: architecture, data, security, performance and failure modes. Consultant - learning the client's domain in depth: their processes, data, and regulatory and operational constraints. Then turning that understanding into technical decisions. Product thinker - thinking about how a system behaves at scale, how it fails and how it's operated after launch, and you scope deliberately so that only what creates value gets built. Responsibilities: Work directly alongside client engineering and product teams on business requirements, architect solutions, and own delivery all the way through to production. Drive complex system development with coding agents as your core delivery engine, manage context, decompose architectural specs into agent-executable tasks, and run work in parallel under strict quality control. Review generated implementations critically, design the tests, evals, and runtime checks that catch edge cases and silent failures, and hold a high bar on security, performance, and maintainability. Make the foundational design calls on data models, integration boundaries, security parameters, and trade-offs, and document them for both human and synthetic contributors. Share proven workflows, evaluation methods, and agent orchestration patterns so the whole engineering team levels up, and contribute to Upside’s open-source frameworks Proven background as a Software Engineer - you’ve built, architected, and owned complex backend/cloud systems end-to-end. Production experience with LLM coding agents - you’ve applied them to production-grade software engineering, not only experiments. Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features - you’ve built, shipped, or integrated LLM-powered and agentic components into production software systems. Comfort with shifting ground and full ownership - you stay effective when requirements, tools, and domain contexts change, and you take responsibility for the technical outcome from initial problem discovery to post-launch stability. Strong client-facing communication - you work directly with client tech leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and explain complex architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong Python skills - or you bring deep experience in another major backend language like Ruby, Java, TypeScript, or Rust, and you’re ready to pivot to Python quickly. Fluent English (C1+) - you’ll collaborate directly with international clients. A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field - highly valued. Nice to Have Fullstack Experience: Frontend experience with React or Vue; cloud and infrastructure work (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). Open Source: History of contributions to open-source tools or libraries. How we work Built for the Long Run: We hire for the company, not a temporary project. We look for engineers who want to grow with Upside over time. Small, Accountable Teams: 3-9 people per project. We're small by design, meaning your technical decisions carry weight and your impact is visible. Mission-Critical Work: We tackle complex technical challenges that move the needle for international brands, scaling companies, and large institutions under real load. Real Autonomy: Complete freedom to drive solutions, experiment with novel agentic workflows, and lead implementations without unnecessary oversight. Uncapped Tooling: Your stack is fully covered (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and any tool that increases your velocity or sharpness). Location Kraków first, hybrid or remote from anywhere in Poland. If you'd like to understand more about how we work or read about the recruitment process in detail, feel free to explore our handbook. If something important to you isn't mentioned, share your thoughts with us at careers@upsidelab.io.

items.desc: The purpose of the position is to manage the day-to-day operations of the assigned laboratories to ensure regulatory and quality compliance, and to provide support to the different research groups and projects, as well as technical expertise and training to users. OTHER DETAILS Ref. num. 2026-JPF_PD-TECH-354 Laboratory coordinator – Chemical synthesis and polymer processing IMDEA Materials Institute is a public research organization founded in 2007 by Madrid’s regional government to carry out research of excellence in Material Science and Engineering by attracting talent from all over the world to work in an international and multidisciplinary environment. IMDEA Materials has grown rapidly since its foundation and currently includes more than 120 researchers from 22 nationalities and has become one of the leading research centers in materials in Europe which has received the María de Maeztu seal of excellence from the Spanish government. The research activities have been focused on the areas of materials for transport, energy, and health care and the Institute has state-of-the-art facilities for processing, characterization and simulation of advanced materials. Description The laboratory coordinator is expected to: Effectively support researchers by providing technical support, demonstrating procedures and collecting, preparing and/or testing samples. Preparation of technical reports. Ensure that the laboratories are well-stocked and resourced and that waste is disposed of according to the established procedure. Understand the requirements, issues and outcomes needed in their technical area. Understand the purpose, operate and maintain the equipment and installations in their laboratories. Take responsibility for ensuring that health and safety practices are followed in their laboratories. Collaborate with management to provide a safe and healthy workplace and carry out health and safety evaluation. Laboratory management tasks: Support laboratory users and train new users. Develop and maintain laboratory procedures, protocols, and instructions. Purchase chemicals and laboratory materials, liaise with suppliers, and monitor stocks. Ensure the proper storage of research materials, including those left by former users. Coordinate equipment maintenance and repairs. Support health and safety compliance in coordination with the H&S Technician, including user guidance, PPE use, and delivery records. Maintain chemical and equipment inventories and the physical SDS repository. Control access to restricted-use equipment, train users, and maintain authorisation records. Manage laboratory waste. Coordinate activities with external service providers. Plan laboratory activities. Identify risks and contribute to risk assessments and accident investigations. Technical tasks: Perform tests and measurements, analyse results, and prepare technical reports using specialised laboratory equipment. Apply polymer characterisation and processing techniques, including gel permeation chromatography, extrusion and micro-extrusion, injection moulding, melt flow index testing, filament production, electrospinning, DSC, DMA, TGA, and cone calorimetry. Ensure laboratory procedures comply with applicable quality standards. Troubleshoot technical and scientific issues. Supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s degree projects. items.desc: Are you an experienced data engineer or architect who knows a data foundation is more than a platform, and enjoys leading others to build one? At Curamando, you’ll design and deliver data foundations for AI-driven insights and activation. That means the platform, but also the data models, governance, ownership and teams around it. No two organisations need the same foundation, so you’ll fit each one to the client’s size, maturity and goals. We work across industries, with brands like McDonald’s and IKEA. Data foundations are changing. Clients now want custom reporting apps and AI agents that answer business questions on their own. That puts more weight on strong data models, a semantic layer that gives people and AI the same definitions, and clear rules for what AI can access. How we work is changing too. We’re quickly becoming AI-first, and you’ll help shape what that means for our team and our clients. As a Data Foundation Expert, you’ll own workstreams, lead data engineers and work as an equal with client leadership, often on site. What you’ll do Assess a client’s data foundation and set the roadmap with their leadership Design and build cost-efficient cloud data platforms, choosing the architecture and tools that fit each client Define data models and semantic layers that AI agents and downstream applications can rely on Shape governance, ownership, security and access for both people and AI Help clients build the data team they need and decide where AI fits in their work Lead and mentor data engineers, guide architectural choices and take on the hardest technical problems Set standards for orchestration, CI/CD, testing, monitoring and infrastructure as code Work AI-first with coding agents, and shape how our team and clients use them, holding AI output to the same standard as their own Contribute to proposals, scoping and pitches, and help grow our Data Foundation team and offering Who you are We believe you’re a good fit if you: Have many years’ experience building data platforms across different clouds and tools, including in a lead or architect role Have shaped governance, ownership and team setup in organisations of different sizes Have deep experience with data modelling and semantic layers Have led and coached data engineers, and enjoy helping people grow Still love to build and care about what you ship. Maybe coding agents got you hands-on again after years in engineering management Have strong Python and SQL skills Are a clear thinker who turns vague questions into a concrete plan and explains trade-offs to engineers and executives alike Have opinions on how AI is changing data foundations and engineering work, and the experience to back them up Communicate fluently in Swedish, both spoken and written Are based in Stockholm or open to relocating here Why Curamando? Curamando is part of Eidra, a group of 16 companies with more than 1,400 specialists across cities from Stockholm to New York. You’ll lead data foundation work for a range of clients and learn from experienced colleagues across Eidra. We value collaboration, curiosity and taking initiative, and believe in giving people responsibility and room to grow. We also believe in working together in person at our office in central Östermalm. The recruitment process We want the recruitment process to give both you and us a chance to get to know each other and see if we’re a good match. The process consists of: Introduction: A first conversation of around 45 minutes to discuss your experience, motivations and what you’re looking for. Technical interview and case: You’ll present a short take-home case on how you’d shape a client’s data foundation. We’ll focus on your technical depth, your judgement and how you communicate your approach. Team meet and greet: An optional opportunity to meet the team, ask questions and get a feel for everyday life at Curamando and Eidra. We review applications and invite candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

What you'll do We're looking for a Motion Designer to join our multidisciplinary team in London, bringing brand identities to life through best-in-class motion design. Working across all Landor clients, you'll use your expertise in 2D and 3D motion design and video editing to create dynamic brand assets, brand films, social content and campaigns that elevate brands and engage audiences. Motion plays an increasingly central role in our branding work, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how global brands behave across digital products, campaigns, experiences and social platforms. In this fast-paced studio environment, you'll collaborate with designers, strategists and creatives to push the boundaries of motion. Your core focus will be motion design and animation, supported by strong video editing skills that help craft compelling brand stories across multiple touchpoints. From high-energy digital activations to refined, cinematic brand expressions, you'll bring a deep understanding of movement, pacing, editing and storytelling to every project. Equally confident editing short videos, you understand how pacing, rhythm and sequencing can shape powerful narratives and create memorable brand experiences. You have a sharp eye for detail, timing and craft, ensuring every piece of work feels refined and impactful. Comfortable working across multiple clients, industries and visual styles, you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two projects are the same. You're highly proficient in Cinema4D, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro and Illustrator, with the ability to develop compelling motion narratives that extend brand identities beyond the static. Experience with generative AI workflows for motion, as well as emerging tools such as Cavalry, would be an advantage. You're a natural problem-solver, always experimenting with movement, transitions, composition and editing techniques to find the strongest creative solution. Above all, you bring energy, originality and a deep understanding of how motion and film can amplify brand storytelling. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. items.desc:
Description
 🚀 Le Bureau des Talents est spécialisé dans la chasse, l’accompagnement et le coaching des talents pour les startups, les scale-ups et les entreprises à impact.
 À propos de l'entreprise
 Notre client est une startup française à l'intersection de l'intelligence artificielle et de la cybersécurité.
 Elle vient de lever 4 millions d'euros en pré-seed pour accélérer le développement de sa technologie, qui s'appuie sur des agents IA autonomes pour automatiser des opérations de sécurité complexes.
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe technique à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs et d'experts en cybersécurité, à un moment clé de son développement.
 L'opportunité : participer à la construction d'un produit IA dès ses premières étapes, contribuer aux choix d'architecture et avoir un impact direct sur les orientations technologiques.
 Mission
 Le poste
 Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client recrute un AI Engineer pour concevoir et développer les systèmes d'intelligence artificielle au cœur de sa plateforme.
 Votre principal défi : construire des agents IA capables de prendre des décisions, d'utiliser des outils et d'exécuter des tâches complexes dans des environnements informatiques réels.
 Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement, de l'expérimentation à la mise en production, avec une forte implication dans les choix d'architecture.
 Un rôle mêlant engineering IA, systèmes agentiques et développement produit , avec une réelle autonomie technique.
 Vos missions
 Concevoir et développer des agents IA autonomes capables d'exécuter des tâches complexes de cybersécurité. 
 Construire des mécanismes de raisonnement et de planification permettant aux agents de prendre des décisions, d'utiliser des outils et d'enchaîner des actions. 
 Intégrer et optimiser des LLMs au sein de systèmes IA destinés à fonctionner en production. 
 Collaborer avec les experts en cybersécurité pour transformer des méthodes techniques en workflows automatisés. 
 Améliorer la fiabilité, les performances et la scalabilité des agents et des systèmes développés. 
 Expérimenter et évaluer différentes approches pour améliorer le comportement et l'efficacité des modèles. 
 Participer aux choix d'architecture et aux évolutions du produit , en tenant compte des retours terrain. 
 Profile
 👤 Profil recherché
 Les indispensables
 Vous disposez d'une solide maîtrise du développement logiciel , idéalement en Python. 
 Vous avez déjà développé des solutions reposant sur des LLMs, des agents IA ou des systèmes de machine learning appliqué . 
 Vous savez concevoir, développer et déployer des systèmes IA en production. 
 Vous comprenez les enjeux liés au prompting, à l'évaluation et au comportement des modèles . 
 Vous êtes capable de résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes et de faire avancer des sujets avec un niveau important d'autonomie. 
 Les plus
 Une expérience des architectures agentiques , notamment du tool calling et de l'orchestration d'agents. 
 Des connaissances en cybersécurité, pentesting ou sécurité offensive. 
 Une pratique des systèmes RAG, embeddings, bases vectorielles ou architectures de recherche. 
 Une expérience des environnements cloud (AWS, GCP…). 
 Une première expérience en startup early-stage ou dans un environnement de développement produit rapide. 
 Ce qui fera la différence : vous aimez construire des systèmes IA concrets, expérimenter, prendre des décisions techniques et travailler sur des problèmes qui ne disposent pas encore de solutions établies.
 💡 Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
 Des défis IA concrets : travailler sur des agents autonomes, le raisonnement, la planification et l'intégration de LLMs dans des systèmes réels. 
 Un impact direct sur le produit : contribuer aux décisions techniques et à la construction des fondations technologiques. 
 Une forte autonomie : prendre des responsabilités sur des sujets structurants, au-delà de la simple implémentation. 
 Une équipe technique resserrée : collaborer directement avec des ingénieurs et des spécialistes en cybersécurité. 
 Une participation au capital : bénéficier d'un dispositif d'equity en complément de la rémunération.

Your work will focus on building scalable training pipelines, designing reward functions and environments, and improving sim-to-real
items.desc: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About The Role We are looking for a Senior or Staff Reinforcement Learning Engineer to develop learning-based control policies for humanoid robots. You will design and train reinforcement learning policies that enable dynamic locomotion and loco-manipulation behaviors on real robots. Your work will focus on building scalable training pipelines, designing reward functions and environments, and improving sim-to-real transfer for reliable deployment on hardware. You will work closely with controls and robotics engineers to integrate learned policies into the robot control stack, ensuring stable and robust behavior in real-world conditions. Development will involve continuous iteration between large-scale simulation and hardware experiments. The problems you will work on include dynamic locomotion, balance recovery, contact-rich manipulation, and multi-behavior policy learning. What You’ll Do Design and train reinforcement learning policies for humanoid robot control. Build scalable simulation and training pipelines (e.g., Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). Design reward functions, observation spaces, and curricula for complex behaviors. Improve robustness and sim-to-real transfer of learned policies. Deploy and evaluate policies on real robotic systems. Integrate policies into the control stack. What We're Looking For MS or PhD in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field. Strong experience with reinforcement learning (e.g., PPO, SAC, offline RL). Experience applying RL to robotics or physical systems. Experience deploying learned policies on real robotic systems. Experience with physics-based simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++. Nice To Have Experience with RL for locomotion or legged robots. Experience with sim-to-real transfer. Familiarity with robot dynamics, control, or whole-body control. What We Offer Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale. 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown). Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care. Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office. Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.
