Our work
items.desc: Zimmer Biomet is one of the world’s leading Orthopaedics medical device companies. Our innovations help treat patients suffering from disorders of, or injuries to, bones, joints or supporting soft tissues. It is our mission to alleviate pain and improve the quality of life for people around the world: a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As part of that mission, we are committed to the highest standards in patient safety, quality and integrity. Within our Connected Health product group, we have set a new standard for digital health with our mymobility and ZBEdgeAnalytics platforms, which underpin a suite of digital healthcare products that transform Orthopaedic care for patients and clinicians alike. What You Can Expect We're looking for an AI Engineer to join our Connected Health team at Zimmer Biomet. This is a fully remote, UK-based job. You'll design, build, deploy and improve generative AI and data-driven products that raise the quality of care and quality of life for orthopaedic patients worldwide. You'll join our AI & Data Science team, which works across three areas: Product development: We develop prediction and decision-support algorithms, using classical ML and generative AI, for our patient- and clinician-facing applications. Product analysis: We help our product teams understand how people use our products, so they can make better decisions. Platform development: We build tooling and reusable infrastructure that supports AI and data-driven product development across Zimmer Biomet. We design it to follow best practice for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). We aim to keep improving, to communicate openly, and to enjoy ourselves along the way. How You'll Create Impact In this role you will work closely with machine learning scientists and application software engineers to bring advanced data insights to life. You'll build automation pipelines, deploy and serve both predictive models and generative AI systems, integrate third-party platforms and tooling, and design for observability and monitoring in production, whilst ensuring that we meet our regulatory commitments. Our work covers classical ML on structured, sensor and imaging data, and generative AI: retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. Because we build medical devices in a regulated context, quality, traceability and responsible AI matter at every step. You'll help us productionise these systems against standards including the EU AI Act and FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled medical devices. You'll help shape our technical roadmap and influence how the Connected Health team moves forward with AI products. Today, Our Tooling Revolves Around Azure ML and Azure DevOps for model orchestration, CI/CD and development; Python for data pipelines, machine learning pipelines and model serving; MLflow (or similar) for experiment tracking and model registry, with monitoring for drift and performance in production; LLM/GenAI tooling including foundation-model APIs, vector stores/retrieval, orchestration frameworks and evaluation harnesses; Pulumi for infrastructure as code; Occasionally C# to support integration between our internal systems. We also use modern developer tooling. Responsible use of AI coding assistants like Claude Code is part of how we work day-to-day. What Makes You Stand Out A passion for building generative AI and data-driven products to improve healthcare; The idea of shaping AI products excites you, and you’re comfortable working where requirements are still evolving; Your background covers the majority of the end-to-end lifecycle of a AI/ML product, from containerisation, CI/CD, infrastructure deployment to debugging and monitoring models in production; Hands-on experience with either classical ML or generative AI in production, and have a genuine interest in the other; The ability to build cloud-native applications and are comfortable with infrastructure as code; You can communicate analyses and technical ideas, and their value, to a range of audiences; A drive to learn about new technologies and methodologies; If you don't meet every requirement but are excited by this role, we'd still like to hear from you! Your Background A demonstrable background within healthcare data and/or delivering AI/ML in regulated spaces (SaMD, EU AI Act, FDA); Prior knowledge of evaluating and guard-railing generative AI systems Experience with model monitoring, drift detection and responsible-AI practices (fairness, robustness, explainability). Industry experience as a Machine Learning, AI or Data Engineer; Comfortable programming with Python and packages associated with the AI/ML workflow; Travel & Logistic Expectations This is a fully remote, UK-based role, and we actively support flexible working. We actively encourage team members to meet up and collaborate in person. Some of our colleagues are based in the U.S., so there will occasionally be a need to be available for evening …

items.desc: Ingénieur(e) Data & LLM (Python) – Trickstr Chez Trickstr , on construit des produits data & IA générative pour aider des décideurs (comex, directions data, communication, stratégie) à prendre de meilleures décisions en temps réel. On manipule de gros volumes de données, on joue avec les LLM, on teste des idées vite… et on ne se contente pas de faire des POC qui finissent dans un tiroir. Nous cherchons un(e) ingénieur(e) data/IA qui a envie : de coder tous les jours (Python), d' explorer les LLM au-delà des démos marketing, et de construire des vrais produits en équipe, utilisés par de vrais clients (très grandes organisations, CAC 40, etc.). Tes missions Au quotidien, tu vas : Concevoir et développer des briques techniques autour des LLM : pipelines d’ingestion et de préparation de données, systèmes de RAG (search + context), outils d’évaluation (hallucinations, biais, robustesse, qualité de réponse). Manipuler de la data (social media, presse, texte libre, métadonnées, etc.) : nettoyage, normalisation, enrichissement, feature engineering, scoring, agrégation. Prototyper puis industrialiser : passer d’un notebook à un service exploitable (APIs, scripts, jobs planifiés), documenter ton travail et le rendre utilisable par le reste de l’équipe. Travailler main dans la main avec : d’autres devs et data engineers, des deployment strategists des data analysts / consultants qui challengent les outputs, les fondateurs, directement, pour expérimenter de nouvelles idées produit. Veille & R&D appliquées : tester de nouveaux modèles, librairies, architectures, et mesurer ce qui marche vraiment pour nos cas d’usage. Ton profil On ne coche pas toutes les cases dans la vraie vie, mais si tu te reconnais dans une bonne partie de celles-ci, on veut te parler : Tu es jeune diplômé(e) d’école d’ingénieurs (ou 1–3 ans d’expérience) avec un vrai bagage en maths / computer science . Tu codes en Python tous les jours ou presque : tu maîtrises les bases (structures, fonctions, tests, environnement virtuel), tu es à l’aise avec des libs type pandas , numpy , éventuellement FastAPI , SQLAlchemy , etc. Tu as déjà joué sérieusement avec les LLM : appels d’API (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), prompt engineering, RAG, ou fine-tuning léger, tu comprends les enjeux de coût, latence, qualité, biais. Tu es rigoureux(se) sur la data : tu ne fais pas confiance aveuglément à un modèle, tu sais mesurer, comparer, remettre en question un résultat. Tu aimes travailler en équipe : code review, pair programming, expliquer ce que tu fais à des non-tech, recevoir et donner du feedback sans ego mal placé. Bonus (pas obligatoire mais très apprécié) : expérience avec Docker / déploiement, graphes de données, search, bases vectorielles, participation à un projet open-source, techno ou perso un peu ambitieux. Ce qu’on t’offre De vrais défis techniques : beaucoup d’itération produit et de problèmes pas déjà résolus sur StackOverflow. Un terrain de jeu LLM / data très concret : données réelles, enjeux business réels, interactions directes avec nos utilisateurs et clients. Une petite équipe solide , où tu as un impact visible sur : la roadmap produit, les choix techniques, les features livrées chaque mois. Des conditions de travail au top : magnifiques bureaux au cœur de Paris, matos adapté à ce que tu fais (machine costaude, environnement dev propre). coach de sport tous les lundis etc. Envoie-nous : ton CV , un projet dont tu es fier/fière (GitHub, repo privé, notebook, mémoire, etc.)

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als Medior AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je AI-oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering en ontwikkelt betrouwbare, schaalbare en uitlegbare toepassingen. Met jouw ervaring vertaal je klantvragen naar oplossingen die organisaties helpen beter te beslissen en te innoveren. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je samen met onder anderen Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers en Data Engineers. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en doorontwikkeling. Daarbij verdiep je je verder in Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps en Responsible AI. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Je kijkt kritisch naar wat AI daadwerkelijk oplevert en ontwikkelt samen met je team robuuste oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Daarbij houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Vertaal klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en robuuste oplossingen die in productie waarde leveren; Ontwikkel Generative AI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen, waaronder RAG-toepassingen; Bouw Agentic AI-oplossingen waarin agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders; Integreer AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en borg uitlegbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid; Test, monitor en verbeter antwoorden, agentgedrag, prestaties en kosten en onderzoek fouten en hallucinaties. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Je maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Jouw talenten en ervaring Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en 2 tot 4 jaar relevante ervaring als AI/ML Engineer of in een vergelijkbare data-rol. items.desc: WHO WE ARE? Being the daughter company of Swisscom - leading telecommunications company and one of the most sustainable and innovative companies in Switzerland - we share the same values, vision and goals. As a trustworthy and efficient Swisscom IT service partner, we create valuable customer experiences. We work in strong collaboration with our partners in Switzerland and attract and retain high performers. We're expanding our footprint in Lisbon and are looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to join our growing AI team. We invite driven professionals to join us, grow with us, and help shape the future. The team / project The Mobile Technology & Voice Value Stream is building an AI tooling suite that automates and supports the operation of Swisscom's mobile and voice network. We are a small, collaborative pod working closely with product owners and business stakeholders in Switzerland, network SMEs and external specialists, and together we're building an internal AI delivery capability for Swisscom Operations. As Agentic AI Engineer, you are a hands-on individual contributor who designs and builds agentic AI tools that automate operational processes. You help shape architecture decisions, engineering standards, code quality and technical delivery, and help embed AI engineering practices within Swisscom. What you'll do Build agentic workflows: Design and implement agent-based and multi-agent workflows that automate Mobile Technology & Voice operational processes. Orchestrate the agents: Develop and evolve orchestrator logic and tool-use patterns for operations automation. Ship production-grade LLM apps: Build LLM applications on AWS Bedrock with suitable agent frameworks, and define prompt, context, grounding, citation and response-assembly patterns. Make it trustworthy: Implement evaluation for quality, groundedness, latency, reliability and safety, plus guardrails against prompt injection, unsupported claims and unsafe tool usage. Keep humans in the loop: Design human-in-the-loop controls and evidence-based decision-support outputs. Shape the architecture: Contribute to the end-to-end architecture of the AI tooling suite, take part in design reviews, document decisions in Architecture Decision Records and make pragmatic build-versus-buy recommendations. Raise the bar: Uphold the pod's engineering, testing, documentation and code-review standards. Deliver as a pod: Plan and coordinate delivery with pod members, remove technical blockers, support onboarding, and pair with external specialists so knowledge stays within Swisscom. Turn operations into code: Work with Managers on Duty, network SMEs and operations engineers to convert workflows, SOPs and expert judgement into testable agent behaviour, and demo working software to non-technical stakeholders. Generative & Agentic AI Practical experience building production-grade generative AI or LLM applications. Experience with agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval, grounding and evaluation. Cloud Practical AWS experience, ideally including Bedrock, IAM, networking, logging and serverless services. Soft Skills Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, cross-location product team. Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong ownership mindset combined with a collaborative, pod-first attitude. Willingness to share knowledge and support the growth of colleagues. What you build goes straight into production and is used every day by real visitors in live venues. AI is not
items.desc: Eleva AI is the AI agent operating system for physical venues: shopping centers, outlets, retail parks, airports, stadiums and leisure destinations. 85% of consumer spending still happens offline, yet these places have no intelligent digital layer to talk to their visitors, sell to them and learn from them. We're building it. Our AI agents talk to visitors on web, QR, WhatsApp, apps and even phone calls, and our admin console turns every conversation into service, revenue and data for the operator. We're already live in some of Europe's leading shopping destinations and working with major retail real estate groups across Spain, Italy, Portugal and the Middle East. The category is brand new, and we intend to own it worldwide. 💼 THE ROLE We're hiring a Founding Full Stack AI Product Engineer: one of the first engineers of Eleva and part of the founding staff. This is not a job, it's a seat at the table. You'll build end-to-end: from the database and the agent orchestration to the APIs, integrations, admin console and deployment. What you build goes straight into production and is used every day by real visitors in live venues. AI is not only what we build, it's how we build. You'll work AI-native every single day: coding agents, LLMs and automation are part of your workflow, so one person ships what used to take a whole team. We don't care about the "Senior" title. We care about hunger, speed and ownership. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, become one of its most important people and, as we scale, lead the engineering team that takes Eleva global. That's why this role comes with a very significant phantom share package: a real stake in what we're building, not a token one. 🛠️ WHAT YOU'LL BUILD • The multi-agent platform: LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG over each venue's catalog, memory and guardrails. • Every channel: web widget, WhatsApp Business API, QR, apps and a voice agent that answers the venue's phone calls like a person. • The admin console: campaigns, segments, WhatsApp templates, and AI agents that take actions for the operator. • The Data Core: conversation analytics, intent, CSAT and the insights operators use to make decisions. • Integrations with the venue ecosystem: maps and wayfinding, loyalty and CRM, gift cards, parking, ticketing, bookings. • The next agents: asset management, review analysis, competitor analysis and operations. • The foundations: architecture, security, observability, CI/CD and reliability. 🧱 OUR STACK • Backend: Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, REST APIs, workers and webhooks • AI: LLM APIs, agents and tool calling, RAG, embeddings, Qdrant • Frontend: TypeScript and React • Cloud: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage), CI/CD • Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, OAuth, third-party APIs 📚 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Really strong backend: Python, SQL and APIs are your home. • You've shipped real products to production and you're probably already doing well in your current job. • You can move across the stack and are comfortable with TypeScript and React. • Hands-on with LLMs: you've built something with agents, tool calling, RAG or embeddings (side projects count). • AI-native in your day-to-day: you code with AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), automate everything you can and always test the latest models and tools. • You've owned something end-to-end and you're as much a product person as an engineer. • You take decisions, defend them and ship. Fast. 🔥 THIS IS FOR YOU IF… • You're very ambitious and want to build something that matters worldwide, not a feature in a big company. • You want real weight in a company: your decisions shape the product, the architecture and the culture. • You want to grow fast, from founding engineer to leading the engineering team. • You want to own the core of an AI company from day 0, and be rewarded like an owner. 🤝 WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive salary (40-65K€) + a VERY significant phantom share package • Founding impact: you'll design the backbone of the platform • A real career path to tech lead / head of engineering • Global from day one: Spain, Italy, Portugal and the Middle East • Young, fast team in central Barcelona, side by side with the founders • Barcelona office; flexible (ideally 2 days/week in office) for exceptional candidates based elsewhere in Spain If you've read this far, chances are you see the world a bit like we do. Let's talk.

items.card: What you will do Build gold sets with SMEs: annotate regulatory and clinical documents with the expected outputs (for example, extracted risks, relevant guidance and precedent, and whether the data supports each key message). Write the annotation guidelines, run adjudication, and measure inter-rater agreement. Evaluate extraction: score risk extraction for precision, recall, and completeness, and compare successive
items.desc: The project: We are building a GenAI regulatory science co-pilot for regulatory submission teams. It works like a virtual Health Authority reviewer. It extracts and assesses regulatory risks, maps submission content to relevant regulatory guidance and precedent, checks that key messages are supported by the underlying clinical data, and anticipates likely Health Authority questions. This system directly informs regulatory submission strategy, so its outputs must be accurate, grounded in cited sources, and traceable. We are hiring an experienced contractor to build and run the evaluations for the system’s core reasoning engines, working with regulatory affairs subject-matter experts (SMEs) and the product engineering team. What you will do Build gold sets with SMEs: annotate regulatory and clinical documents with the expected outputs (for example, extracted risks, relevant guidance and precedent, and whether the data supports each key message). Write the annotation guidelines, run adjudication, and measure inter-rater agreement. Evaluate extraction: score risk extraction for precision, recall, and completeness, and compare successive engine versions against a baseline. Evaluate retrieval and ranking: measure retrieval recall (Recall@K), ranking quality (MRR, nDCG), and question coverage when the engine retrieves regulatory guidance, precedent, and prior Health Authority interactions. Evaluate grounding and traceability: build code-based checks that every finding traces through evidence and document back to a valid source and citation. Detect fabricated guidance, fabricated precedent, and unsupported regulatory claims. Evaluate reasoning with LLM judges: design and validate LLM-as-judge rubrics for regulatory relevance, evidence sufficiency, risk assessment, and explanation quality, calibrated against SME judgment. Evaluate each pipeline stage: create evaluation datasets and baselines for each stage of a multi-stage engine (evidence structuring, question coverage, retrieval, ranking, mapping, grounding), plus an end-to-end review with SMEs. Report and harden: turn failure analysis into clear readouts for the product team, and package the evaluations as regression suites that run in CI/CD. Required experience 5+ years of hands-on work in AI/ML evaluation, NLP, or applied data science, including recent delivery on LLM, RAG, or agent systems. Has built evaluation frameworks and gold datasets for information extraction and retrieval/ranking systems. Please share examples. Strong grounding in evaluation metrics and statistics: precision/recall/F1, Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, inter-rater reliability (e.g., Cohen’s kappa or Krippendorff’s alpha), and confidence intervals for small evaluation sets. Experience designing and validating LLM-as-judge systems against human expert ratings. Experience running annotation projects with domain experts: guidelines, adjudication, and quality control. Strong Python; experience with evaluation harnesses (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, Inspect, or in-house equivalents), LLM APIs, and Git/CI/CD. Can deliver against fixed milestones with little onboarding and work independently. Fluent professional English, written and spoken. Nice to have Experience with regulatory affairs, regulatory intelligence, or submissions: FDA/EMA guidance, CTD structure (e.g., Modules 2.5 and 2.7), Health Authority questions, and labeling. Experience evaluating AI in regulated (GxP) environments. Familiarity with clinical trial outputs (CSRs, TLFs, statistical outputs) and drug development. Experience evaluating document-comparison, claim-verification, or fact-checking systems. Publications or open-source work in AI evaluation, information retrieval, or biomedical NLP.

items.desc:
At NVIDIA, we invite hard-working new college graduates and early-career engineers to apply for our System Software Engineer, Automotive Cybersecurity role and join the HPSE Interface team in the United Kingdom. This is a remarkable opportunity to aid the creation and upkeep of software that delivers security services for NVIDIA's automotive platforms. You will examine sophisticated, low-level software and gain hands-on knowledge of how PKCS#11 functions within the DRIVE OS security architecture alongside hardware and software components. As you expand your system-level expertise, you will collaborate with global engineering teams to translate requirements into durable solutions for our customers. Engage throughout the software lifecycle, from development and deployment to validation, integration, release support, and issue resolution.
 What you'll be doing 
 Build your expertise in our HPSE security architecture and its interactions with hardware security, operating-system components, and other security services.
 Build, implement, test, debug, and maintain C-based software and interfaces for PKCS#11 and related security services within DRIVE OS and other deployments of the Tegra chipsets.
 Collaborate with software, hardware, system architecture, safety, security, quality, and customer-facing teams to clarify requirements and refine specifications.
 Contribute to investigating and resolving complex system, integration, and customer-reported issues; communicate technical findings clearly and help drive issues to closure, taking on greater ownership as your experience grows.
 Build and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; improve test automation and software quality.
 Participate in code reviews, design and build discussions, and documentation to ensure maintainable, secure, and reliable software.
 Contribute to development and release activities that follow applicable product lifecycle, safety, security, and quality processes.
 What we need to see 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical area. The role welcomes new college graduates and early-career candidates with up to 4 years of experience following a Bachelor's degree or up to 2 years following a Master's degree. Responsibilities and ownership will reflect your experience, with opportunities to grow toward greater independence.
 Sound C programming and debugging skills; ability to write clear, reliable, and maintainable code, demonstrated through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional experience.
 Solid foundations in data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, and software engineering practices.
 A methodical and analytical approach, a willingness to learn complex systems, and the ability to work effectively with distributed cross-functional teams.
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate on customer requirements.
 A proactive, quality-focused approach and a desire to learn and deliver in a safety- and security-conscious engineering environment, while exploring and adopting Agentic AI in disciplined and creative ways.
 Curiosity about the broader effects of our work. A desire to develop technical expertise alongside commercial awareness and learn to make sound technical and practical decisions.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd 
 These are opportunities to showcase your interests and experience, not prerequisites; examples from coursework, personal projects, research, or internships are welcome alongside professional experience.
 Coursework, personal projects, internships, research or professional experience in Linux/QNX embedded systems, SoCs based on ARM technology, platform security, or device and driver connectivity.
 Python experience, particularly for test automation, tooling, analysis, or developer efficiency; interest in or experience with Rust for systems programming, secure software, or tooling.
 Knowledge of applied cryptography, PKCS#11, key management, hardware security modules, secure boot, roots of trust, trusted execution environments, or hardware/software security boundaries.
 Familiarity with automotive ISO 26262 functional-safety and ISO 21434 cybersecurity concepts.
 Exposure to or understanding of a disciplined product lifecycle (PLC) environment, including requirements, traceability, configuration management, verification, and release-quality practices; exposure to CI/CD, source control, code review, automated testing, and debugging of hardware/software integration issues.

Practical understanding of generative AI and agentic AI security risks, including prompt injection, tool and plugin abuse, sensitive data disclosure, model extraction, data poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, and denial-of-service scenarios. Strong analytical thinking, security ownership, pragmatic risk communication, documentation discipline, and the ability to collaborate with engineering, architecture, operations, compliance, and international country teams in English. items.desc: Are you looking for a new opportunity in hydrometallurgy in an organisation that strongly supports professional growth? Would you like to use your expertise to develop sustainable metals and materials recovery solutions while working in an inspiring community at the cutting edge of science and technology? Do you enjoy turning research ideas into practical solutions together with customers and multidisciplinary teams? VTT might be just the place for you. VTT is one of the leading applied research organisations in Europe. What unites us are curiosity, a passion for learning, and a purpose: to solve the biggest challenges of our time and turn them into sustainable growth and well-being. Our cross-disciplinary community of over 2000 brilliant minds from 55+ different nationalities focuses on creating impact through science-based innovation. Get to know us further by exploring VTT's tech & infra . We are now looking for a Research Scientist or Senior Scientist to join our Metals and Materials Recovery team. As a Research Scientist or Senior Scientist, you will plan and conduct hydrometallurgical research and help turn promising ideas into practical, industry-relevant solutions. Your work will combine experimental research, project preparation and customer collaboration with opportunities to contribute from early desktop studies to pilot-scale validation. Our Metals and Materials Recovery team develops hydrometallurgical and mechanical separation processes for low-grade and complex ores, concentrates, wastes and secondary raw materials, including spent batteries. Based at the Circular Raw Materials Hub laboratory and Hydrometallurgy pilot hall in Bioruukki, Espoo, the team works closely with industry to create applicable solutions that minimise waste and environmental impact while improving resource and energy efficiency. As a Senior Scientist, you will: Contribute to publicly funded research project proposal preparation and direct sales efforts. Develop process concepts from desktop studies towards laboratory testing and pilot-scale validation. Plan, conduct and interpret hydrometallurgical experiments. Apply techno-economic assessments into the research and publication workflow, supporting concept development and decision-making. Work closely with customers to understand their needs and translate them into relevant research questions and practical solutions. Coordinate multidisciplinary collaboration and communicate research ideas and results clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Contribute to safe, high-quality and forward-looking research practices in the team. Who we are looking for: A relevant master's or PhD degree and research or industry experience in hydrometallurgy. Strong knowledge of hydrometallurgical unit processes, from leaching to recovery, in particular solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange. Experience in planning and conducting experimental research and interpreting results. Ambition in combining scientific research and techno-economic assessments. Experience in preparing research projects or proposals for publicly funded or customer-funded work. Ability to understand customer needs, build networks and present complex ideas convincingly. items.desc: We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to build trusted knowledge platforms. Solita is helping to build knowledge platforms, sometimes called company brains, for our customers. These platforms connect company information to its business context, enabling employees and AI agents to find reliable answers, understand where they come from, and rely on having permission to see the information. The information usually already exists, spread across SharePoint sites, ticketing systems, ERP data, and the expertise of people who have spent years building the business. While building digital solutions is becoming easier and faster with AI-assisted development, creating trusted knowledge platforms still requires a deep understanding of business concepts, data, and how people make decisions. In this role, you’ll work closely with our customers’ domain experts to understand their business, which are the most valuable questions the platform should solve, and which sources and definitions those answers need. You then take each use case into production, where employees and agents rely on it in their daily work. AI coding agents are naturally used in your daily work. You’ll give them clear specifications, provide the right context, and ensure the quality and reliability of what is produced. While AI helps accelerate development, you remain responsible for delivering solutions that work in production and create real business value. Responsibilities Collaborate with customer domain experts to identify use cases and define success metrics, such as time to answer or answer accuracy. Translate the customer business concepts into maintainable conceptual models and ontologies, ensuring that both people and agents use the same definitions: what counts as an active customer, or which price list applies when. Integrate documents and enterprise systems such as SharePoint, Confluence, CRM and ERP platforms, and while modeling structured data from databases and data platforms to fit the ontology. Design and implement retrieval and agent workflows that respect source system permissions and stay up to date when the sources change. Set up the development workflows with automated testing, evaluations, and code review. Deploy and operate the platform and continuously track answer quality and operational performance after go-live. Investigate answers users don’t trust and fix the underlying cause. What helps you succeed in this role Experience delivering software to production and maintaining it afterwards. Conceptual modelling: turning how domain experts talk about their business into a model and judging where it needs precision and where it can stay loose. Good SQL and experience with relational data models. Ability to model business knowledge using ontologies or similar semantic modelling approaches and keep those models maintainable as the domain evolves. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Github Copilot, and the ability to review, debug and improve generated code. Experience building LLM applications or retrieval systems, including measuring whether they give good answers. Proficiency in Python or TypeScript Experience on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). Comfort with incomplete requirements and clarify them directly with customers. Modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks Fluent communication skills in English. Finnish language is considered an advantage. Additionally, we appreciate: Experience with semantic technologies such as RDF, OWL or SPARQL, graph databases. What do we offer? The opportunity to build AI-powered knowledge platforms that solve real business problems, helping organizations turn fragmented information into trusted answers that employees and AI agents can rely on every day. A role at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and business understanding, where you'll shape both what gets built and how it's built together with customers and domain experts. The chance to work on some of the most challenging AI adoption problems, designing retrieval systems, knowledge models, ontologies, and agent workflows that deliver measurable business impact in production. A high level of autonomy and influence, from selecting the most valuable use cases to defining solution approaches and driving them all the way to deployment and continuous improvement. The freedom to grow in the direction that interests you most, whether that's knowledge engineering, AI and agent systems, software architecture, customer advisory work, or building reusable capabilities that become part of Solita's broader offering. A multidisciplinary community of experts, collaborating with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Architects, Designers, and Software Developers who actively share knowledge and support one another. A culture built on trust, autonomy, and low hierarchy, where you're trusted to make decisions, take ownership, and shape your own way of …

Pas besoin d'être expert(e) en marketing : nous recherchons avant tout un esprit curieux, créatif et entrepreneurial ! Ton profil : un esprit curieux, autonome et entreprenant ! Pas besoin d'être déjà expert en growth hacking, en développement web ou en intelligence artificielle. Ce qu'on recherche avant tout, c'est un tempérament : de la curiosité, de l'initiative, l'envie de comprendre et surtout le plaisir d'expérimenter ! Le growth hacking, le web et les outils IA ? On te formera directement sur des projets concrets ! Ta mission : transformer la curiosité des chercheurs en opportunités commerciales Ton objectif sera de faire connaître nos instruments à travers le monde, attirer les bons chercheurs et transformer leur intérêt en prospects qualifiés. Pour y parvenir, tu toucheras à de nombreux domaines : Imaginer et lancer des campagnes d'acquisition : identifier les bons chercheurs, trouver les messages qui font mouche et choisir les canaux les plus pertinents pour engager la discussion. Booster nos campagnes de mailing : affiner le ciblage, personnaliser les messages, tester de nouvelles approches et analyser les résultats pour progresser à chaque campagne. Faire évoluer notre site web : utiliser les outils d'IA pour améliorer nos pages, optimiser les parcours utilisateurs, explorer le front-end comme le back-end et renforcer notre visibilité sur les moteurs de recherche et les IA génératives ( SEO & GEO ). Construire les outils IA de demain : concevoir des prompts efficaces, développer des assistants intelligents et automatiser les tâches qui méritent de l'être. Oser les idées « out of the box » : imaginer un outil utile aux chercheurs, créer un contenu inattendu ou inventer une nouvelle manière d'identifier leurs besoins. On partage les idées, on expérimente et on garde ce qui fonctionne ! Bien plus que du marketing : comprendre et influencer l'innovation ! Ton travail ne servira pas uniquement à générer des prospects. En analysant les besoins et les réactions des chercheurs, tu nous aideras aussi à mieux comprendre notre marché et à orienter les futurs développements de notre équipe R&D. L'IA au cœur de ton quotidien ! Ici, l'intelligence artificielle n'est pas juste un sujet à la mode : c'est un outil que nous exploitons pleinement. Notre ambition ? Te permettre de développer de véritables compétences de prompt engineer, en pratiquant chaque jour, avec nous. Ta formation Tu as une formation Bac +5 en sciences ou en ingénierie ? Parfait ! Tu as moins d'années d'études, mais tu t'es formé(e) par toi-même, tu as développé de solides compétences et tu as des réalisations concrètes à nous montrer ? Ta candidature nous intéresse tout autant ! Ce qu'on recherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un qui aime transformer ses idées en actions. Un esprit vif et inventif : tu réfléchis vite, tu es curieux(se) et tu trouves des solutions là où d'autres voient des obstacles. Le goût de l'action : quand tu identifies une opportunité, tu ne te contentes pas d'en parler. Tu imagines un premier test et tu passes à l'action ! Une approche expérimentale : tu testes, tu mesures, tu analyses et tu ajustes. Tu développes ce qui fonctionne et tu sais abandonner une mauvaise idée, même quand c'était la tienne ! Une vraie autonomie : tu prends des initiatives, tu anticipes et tu fais avancer tes projets sans attendre qu'on te relance. Une curiosité pour les nouvelles technologies : tu as envie d'explorer les possibilités de l'IA, d'expérimenter de nouveaux outils et de développer tes compétences. Chez nous, on aime : Les gens d'action, les inventifs, les autonomes, les curieux et ceux qui sont exigeants avec eux-mêmes tout en prenant soin des autres. Ceux qui osent essayer, qui apprennent de leurs erreurs et qui préfèrent faire plutôt que parler. Et ceux qui ramènent des chouquettes ont déjà compris une partie de notre culture ! Tu as lancé un projet, développé un outil, automatisé une tâche, testé une idée originale ou créé quelque chose de tes propres mains ? Un projet personnel, associatif ou autodidacte compte tout autant qu'une expérience professionnelle ! This is no AI hype. haddock's customers obtain visible value from their AI Agents, both in money and time saved. It’s a chance to leave your mark on an industry that’s ripe for transformation. Their best perk is honestly their work environment and the opportunities you'll get to learn and grow at haddock. ➡️ Their Tech Stack TypeScript, Python, langfuse, PostHog, Google Cloud Platform, mastra, Postgres, MongoDB, and several AI providers They heavily use AI workflows and agents for their development, but also to empower the entire organization to be 10x productive. What a time to be alive! ➡️ What do they offer? 💸 A competitive salary (€40–50k gross/year), that will increase as haddock and you grow. 🏢 A bright modern office in Barcelona, in Poblenou. items.desc: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer / Full Stack Engineer with strong software development skills, hands-on experience in prompt engineering, and a solid understanding of the evolving AI landscape. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in machine learning or full-stack software engineering with practical experience designing, testing, and optimizing prompts for AI-powered applications. This role involves hands-on development across both backend and frontend technologies, with a strong emphasis on backend engineering using Java and JavaScript, alongside frontend development using React and JavaScript. We welcome candidates with a strong Machine Learning Engineering background who also have full-stack development experience, as well as Full Stack Engineers with a strong interest in AI and practical prompt engineering expertise. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications across backend and frontend components. Develop backend services and APIs using Java and JavaScript. Build responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using React and JavaScript. Apply prompt engineering techniques to design, test, evaluate, and optimize prompts for accuracy, relevance, consistency, and efficiency. Explore and apply relevant AI capabilities to enhance application functionality and user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI-powered features into existing and new applications. Evaluate AI models, prompting approaches, and emerging tools to identify suitable solutions for business requirements. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance, reliability, and code quality. Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and AI-assisted software development. Required Skills and Experience 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical role. Strong backend development experience using Java and JavaScript, with an understanding of API development and application architecture. Hands-on frontend development experience using React and JavaScript. Practical experience in prompt engineering, including crafting, testing, evaluating, and optimizing prompts for AI applications. A solid understanding of the AI landscape, including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and their practical applications. Experience integrating AI capabilities into software applications or working with AI-enabled development solutions. Good understanding of software development best practices, debugging, testing, and maintainable code. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.

items.desc: Software engineering has moved up the stack. AI now writes a growing share of the code; the harder, more valuable work is specifying what to build, judging whether it's right, and getting it trusted into production. This programme is built for that shift. You will join our Agentic Engineering and Build Capability CoE as part of a client squad, working alongside senior engineers and Forward Deployed Consultants on real problems: agentic systems, AI-enabled products, and the evaluation and governance that make them safe to ship. We are not training you to write code AI can already write; we are training you to do what AI cannot: understand the problem, specify it precisely, evaluate the output, and defend your reasoning to engineers and the business alike. We are looking for graduates who can already show us this in practice. If you have built something with AI (a side project, a hackathon entry, an automation that actually runs), bring it: we will spend more time on what you built and why than on your degree. Key Responsibilities Work inside a client squad, contributing to agentic and software engineering builds under the direction of a Forward Deployed Consultant or senior engineer. Translate business problems into clear, testable specifications: the discipline that increasingly separates good engineers from AI that writes syntactically correct but wrong code. Build and integrate AI-powered features using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows. Evaluate AI-generated and AI-assisted output against defined success criteria, using evaluation harnesses and golden datasets rather than judgement alone. Apply security, governance and cost-awareness principles, including AI FinOps thinking, so what you build is reliable, scalable and safe to run. Work directly with product owners and business stakeholders to understand what "done" actually means, not just what was asked for. About You Skills & Knowledge A demonstrable AI engineering portfolio: personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions or coursework where you have actually built something with AI, not just studied it. Confidence to make and defend a technical judgement call, curiosity to keep exploring how the tools are changing, and enough security in your own reasoning to say when you think an AI-generated answer is wrong. Understanding of programming fundamentals and object-oriented concepts, strong enough to read and critique AI-generated code, not just write your own. An informed view on how the software engineer's role is shifting: less time producing code, more time specifying, evaluating and taking accountability for it. Strong communication skills: able to explain a technical decision to an engineer and a business outcome to a product owner, in the same week. Comfortable working in a squad, taking direction from a Forward Deployed Consultant or technical lead, and contributing across build, evaluation and delivery. Desirable Experience with Python or another modern language, including using AI coding assistants (such as Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor) as part of your workflow. Exposure to agentic frameworks, specification-driven development, or evaluation and testing tooling. Understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile delivery. Familiarity with version control (Git), cloud platforms or APIs. Awareness of AI governance, safety or risk concepts. Experience gained from academic projects, internships, bootcamps or personal builds, particularly anything you can show us running. What Success Looks Like We grade AI fluency separately from technical seniority, using FDM's AI fluency framework: AI Aware, AI Productive, AI Operational, AI Orchestrating. Within your first year, successful graduates will: Progress from AI Aware to AI Productive, and be working towards AI Operational. Deliver clean, tested, production-ready code as part of a live client squad. Specify, build and evaluate agentic and RAG-based solutions that others can trust without re-checking your work. Apply governed, auditable engineering practice by default, not as an afterthought. Present technical decisions clearly and confidently to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including product owners. Build the track record that opens the door to specialist tracks such as Agentic AI Engineer (AI Orchestration), FDM's most senior technical capability. You are: Confident enough to make a technical call and stand behind it, without needing to be told you're right. Curious about how AI is changing the craft of engineering, and genuinely interested in finding out rather than assuming you already know. Secure enough to say "I don't know" or "I think this AI output is wrong", and explain why. Collaborative, and comfortable taking direction inside a squad while still bringing your own point of view. Committed to building a portfolio of real, working things, not just credentials. Interested in the business problem behind …

items.desc: Buscamos incorporar un/a AI Skills Developer que diseñe, construya y mantenga una librería de skills complejas para agentes de IA que asisten y ejecutan tareas a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del ensayo clínico para una importante industria farmacéutica: desde feasibility y startup, pasando por monitorización, data management, bioestadística, medical writing y regulatory, hasta TMF y calidad. Qué harás: - Mapear y descomponer procesos de operaciones clínicas junto a los SMEs de cada área, convirtiéndolos en skills accionables por un agente. - Escribir y mantener archivos SKILL.md complejos: instrucciones claras, lógica de decisión, ejemplos y contraejemplos, manejo de casos límite, criterios de calidad y plantillas de referencia. - Construir los activos de soporte que cada skill necesita: prompts y plantillas, documentos de referencia, checklists, scripts auxiliares y esquemas de datos (p. ej. CDISC/CDASH, estructuras de CRF/SoA). - Probar, evaluar e iterar el comportamiento de los agentes: definir criterios de evaluación, medir precisión y calidad de salida, y refinar las skills hasta que sean fiables en producción. - Garantizar el cumplimiento: que las salidas se alineen con ICH-GCP, requisitos regulatorios, SOPs internas y privacidad de datos (anonimización). - Versionar y gobernar la librería de skills (control de versiones, documentación, trazabilidad, governance). - Formar a usuarios finales (CRAs, CTMs, DM, etc.) en el uso de los agentes y recoger feedback para mejora continua. Las skills abarcarán dominios como: - Monitorización y CRA: seguimiento de monitorización diaria, RBQM, preparación y reporte de visitas (SQV, SIV, IMV), monitoring report review, follow-up letters, PD classification e identificación de desviaciones. - Medical writing : protocolo, CSR, IB (creación, revisión v0 y actualización), ICF, briefing book. - Data management y bioestadística: CRF design y SoA programming, edit checks, data management/validation plans, SAP, programación de análisis estadístico, CDISC standardization, anonimización. - Regulatory y submissions: documentación esencial, respuestas y predicción de RFIs, EC programming, consulta de centros y países participantes. - Calidad y TMF: crosscheck eTMF vs CTMS, inspection readiness, quality check, QC de documentos, PD plan/review. - Feasibility y startup: feasibility questionnaires, site selection review, site activation, planificación del ensayo, performance review. - Vendors y gestión económica : alta y cualificación de proveedores, investigator grant plan, site payments, validación de facturas y seguimiento de presupuesto, study budgeting. - Formación: generación de materiales de CRA training, SIV e IM. Imprescindible: - Conocimiento sólido de operaciones de ensayos clínicos y del panorama documental y de procesos descrito arriba (no necesariamente experto en todas las áreas, pero capaz de entenderlas y entrevistar a quien sí lo es). - Experiencia escribiendo instrucciones estructuradas / prompts para agentes LLM: familiaridad con el formato de Agent Skills (SKILL.md) y con prompt engineering. - Fluidez técnica: Markdown, Git, scripting básico (Python preferente), trabajo con datos estructurados (JSON/YAML) y con formatos de documento (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx). - Capacidad analítica y de descomposición de proceso : convertir un proceso ambiguo y lleno de excepciones en pasos explícitos y verificables. - Mentalidad de calidad y cumplimiento:, con atención al detalle y conciencia de las implicaciones regulatorias de una salida incorrecta. - Español e inglés: (entorno de trabajo bilingüe; gran parte de la documentación clínica está en inglés). Valoraremos: - Certificación ICH-GCP y/o experiencia previa como CRA, CTA/CTM, data manager, medical writer o en regulatory/QA. - Conocimiento de CDISC (SDTM/ADaM/CDASH), sistemas EDC, CTMS/eTMF y herramientas de RBQM. - Experiencia con frameworks de evaluación de LLMs , RAG, integración vía API y construcción de agentes. - Experiencia documentando y versionando librerías de contenido o de código. Qué ofrecemos Salario competitivo Contrato indefinido Seguro de salud y de vida Entorno internacional y diverso con oportunidades a nivel mundial Plan de carrera a medida, orientado a crecimiento y aprendizaje continuo Formación tanto técnica como competencial cursos de Skills interpersonales...) Bonus por objetivos 31 días de vacaciones Un rol de alto impacto en el centro de una transformación real de las operaciones clínicas con IA. Trabajo transversal con todas las áreas de Clinical Operations de un grupo farmacéutico internacional.

Computer Engineering, Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Engineering, Matematica, Fisica ) o un percorso equivalente. items.desc: Why Ryan? Competitive Compensation and Benefits Business Connectivity Reimbursement (Phone/Internet) Gym Membership or Equipment Reimbursement LinkedIn Learning Subscription Flexible Work Environment Tuition Reimbursement After One Year of Service Accelerated Career Path Award-Winning Culture & Community Outreach The Full Stack AI Engineer is an early-career software engineering role focused on building and delivering full-stack applications with generative AI and agentic capabilities embedded into the solution architecture. The role is designed for high-potential graduates and engineers with up to three years of experience who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with a different way of thinking about how AI can reshape enterprise workflows and applications. This is not a traditional machine learning or data science role, and it is not about adding AI for AI's sake. The focus is on understanding business problems end to end and determining where large language models, agents, and AI-enabled workflows can materially improve how work gets done. Working as part of a fully functioning engineering team, the Full Stack AI Engineer contributes across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through development, deployment, and iteration. Success in this role means writing high-quality code, learning quickly, contributing effectively within a team, and developing the judgment to build AI-enabled software that creates measurable value for clients and the business. Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results This role operates in Ryan’s results-oriented and flexible culture, with a strong emphasis on engineering quality, ownership, and measurable outcomes. Engineers are trusted to choose appropriate tools, approaches, and AI-assisted workflows rather than follow heavy development processes. That autonomy is paired with clear accountability for the quality, reliability, and business impact of what they deliver. The role is intended for engineers early in their careers. Success is not measured by years of experience or by knowledge of a particular AI framework. It is measured by strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, quality of thinking, and the ability to contribute working code to AI-enabled solutions. Active mentorship and structured opportunities for growth support continued development in both software engineering and applied AI. People Works as part of a cross-functional engineering team to design, build, and improve AI-enabled full-stack software. Collaborates effectively with engineers, business professionals, and end users to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions. Participates in client-facing conversations where appropriate, communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Learns from more experienced team members and contributes knowledge, ideas, and emerging best practices back into the team. Uses feedback constructively and demonstrates strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving technical environment. Client Works with business professionals and customers to understand problems, workflows, and opportunities for improvement. Helps determine where generative AI or agentic approaches can create meaningful value, rather than applying AI where traditional software would be more appropriate. Contributes to the end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled applications, including discovery, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and iteration. Builds full-stack applications that may incorporate large language models, agent-based workflows, retrieval, APIs, and other AI capabilities as part of the overall architecture. Supports the deployment and adoption of solutions used by real users in business and client environments. Considers the complete enterprise workflow when designing solutions, including users, data, integrations, business rules, human oversight, and failure scenarios. Value Writes high-quality, maintainable code that contributes to dependable software used by real users. Applies AI where it materially improves a process, user experience, decision, or business outcome. Thinks critically about when an agentic solution is appropriate and when deterministic software is the better choice. Contributes to solutions that address real-world problems and generate measurable value for clients and the business. Iterates on deployed applications based on user feedback, performance, reliability, and adoption. Balances speed, scope, and engineering quality to support effective delivery. Makes effective use of AI-assisted coding tools while maintaining ownership and understanding of the code produced. Education And Experience Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. Suitable for recent graduates and candidates with approximately 0-3 years of professional software engineering …

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. AI ENGINEER Quale sarà la tua sfida? Il nostro team di Artificial Intelligence Engineering si impegna a supportare i clienti nel percorso di adozione dell’intelligenza artificiale attraverso la realizzazione di factory di soluzioni di AI, azionabili e integrate nell'architettura e nei processi aziendali. La figura dell’AI Engineer progetta soluzioni software di Machine Learning (ML) scalabili per i casi d'uso dei clienti e le industrializza per l’esecuzione in produzione garantendo i livelli richiesti di performance, sicurezza e governabilità. L’AI Engineer lavora a stretto contatto con altre figure di Bip xTech, come Cloud Data Architects, Data Scientists e Data Engineer, per realizzare soluzioni ML di alta qualità sotto ogni aspetto: disegnando e implementando per il team strumenti di lavoro come le piattaforme di MLOps, fornendo linee guida e best practice sulle architetture dati e di AI, supportando l’implementazione del software e funzionalità di osservabilità dell’AI, e altro ancora. L’AI Engineer inoltre contribuirà alla Bip xTech Data Community con attività di ricerca, scouting tecnologico, concept di nuove soluzioni e sviluppo del business sui clienti di BIP. Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, Java, e/o simili; Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi; Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository, come per esempio: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps e/o simili. Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning. Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL. Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di Italiano e Inglese professionali. Plus Esperienza nell’utilizzo delle principali piattaforme cloud (Google, AWS, Azure); Conoscenza dei concetti e tecnologie di Big Data e Data Warehousing (esempio: Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka); Esperienza con framework e metodologie di Deep Learning (esempio: Tensorflow, PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, LangChain). Conoscenza di framework di versionamento di dati e/o modelli (esempio: MLFlow, DVC, WanDB…). Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban). Perché Bip? Crescita e Formazione Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Salute & Benefits Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. Famiglia e Genitorialità Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). Cosa offriamo / What we offer La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui , in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda) . Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione. Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. Su di Noi Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione. items.desc:
About TomTom: TomTom is a global leader in navigation, mapping, and traffic information. Join our dynamic team and vibrant culture to contribute to shaping the future of location technology.

Role Overview: We are looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run AI-powered features and products that reach TomTom's customers. You'll turn advances in machine learning and large language models (LLMs) into reliable, scalable production systems. You'll work closely with applied scientists, software engineers and product managers to take ideas from prototype to production, and you'll help raise the standard for how AI is built and evaluated across TomTom.


Responsibilities::
Build AI systems: Design, develop and maintain production AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows and ML model services. 
 Productionize models: Take models and prototypes from applied scientists and turn them into robust, low-latency, cost-efficient services that scale to global traffic. 
 Evaluation and quality: Define and automate evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and guardrails that measure accuracy, safety, latency and cost, and monitor models once they're in production.

items.desc: At the University of Vienna almost 11,000 personalities work together towards answering the big questions of the future. Around 7,700 of them do research and teaching, around 3,000 work in administration and organisation. We are looking for a/an University assistant predoctoral/PhD Candidate 51 Faculty of Physics Job vacancy starting: 11/15/2026 | Working hours: 30.00 | Classification CBA: §48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited contract until: 11/14/2030 Job ID: 6310 “How does a quantum object gravitate?”, “How far can we push massive objects into the quantum regime?”, “How well can we measure gravity of microscopic systems?”. Such questions and their implications for the foundations of physics are the driving force behind our research. You will be part of our team and develop new ideas, technologies and experiments to provide new insights on macroscopic quantum physics, on gravity at small scales and, in the long run, on the phenomenology of the gravity-quantum interface in table-top experiments. Your personal sphere of influence: As a university assistant (praedoc) on this 4-year position, you will be part of the Experimental Quantum Physics and Gravity Group, led by Prof. Markus Aspelmeyer, and you will be exploring fundamentals and applications of macroscopic quantum coherence in levitated solidstate platforms. Our team is part of the Quantum Science group of the Faculty of Physics. We are a member of the Vienna Center for Quantum Science and Technology (VCQ), one of the largest quantum hubs in Europe, and of the Austrian Cluster of Excellence (quantA), advancing basic research in quantum sciences, aiming to expand the frontiers of knowledge and thus being the engine for future innovations. You will also benefit from being a fellow of the Vienna Doctoral School in Physics (VDSP), being part of a thriving community with more than 100 quantum scientists on site and about 300 quantum researchers in Vienna. The main research activities of the Aspelmeyer group include quantum optical control of levitated solid-state objects, the exploration of their quantum properties for fundamental questions and novel quantum technology platforms, as well as precision measurements of ultra-weak gravitational forces. On the quantum side, we explore the extreme regime of motional quantum states of solids and their interactions to understand how to maximize mass, delocalization, and coherence time in quantum experiments. On the gravity side, we explore the extreme regime of gravitational phenomena of miniature source masses to understand how to isolate gravity from all other interactions on a microscopic scale. Our main motivation is to explore the interface between quantum physics and gravity with new experimental platforms. Your future tasks: You will actively participate in research, teaching & administration. This means: You are involved in a specific and well-funded research project, here focused on exploring fundamentals and applications of quantum control in levitated solid-state platforms. You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12-18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis. You will work on your dissertation and towards its completion in time. We expect a large degree of independence paired with a high level of social awareness as the goal will only be achieved in a team. You will contribute to teaching (lab courses, exercise classes) within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement. You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration. You will continuously stay informed about the state of the art in your field. You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities. This is part of your personality: You have completed your Master's degree or Diploma in physics and written your Master's thesis in the field of experimental quantum optics, AMO physics, quantum optomechanics, advanced optics or quantum control. You have experience in academic writing (highly desirable). You have a solid background in experimental quantum optics, opto-mechanics and optical or diamagnetic levitation. You have experience with the usual tools for advanced experiments: homodyne and heterodyne detection, programming. You have an excellent command of written and spoken English. What we offer: Inspiring working atmosphere: You are a part of an international academic team in a healthy and fair working environment. Good public transport connections: Your workplace in the center of beautiful Vienna is easily accessible by public transport. Potential for development: Success in life depends on what you make of it, but if you are ambitious and successful, there are plenty of opportunities to connect you to all relevant top research groups in the world. items.desc: Solution Architect – AI-Native Business Solutions Design how people, agents and business systems work together. We are looking for an architect who can connect business goals, the implementation of agentic solutions, and the requirements of production use. An AI-native solution does not simply mean adding a chatbot on top of an existing process. It means redesigning the workflow: the right context is preserved, the agent prepares and acts within agreed boundaries, and people remain responsible for decisions. What will you get to work on? Together with the customer, you define the desired change, identify the first valuable workflow and determine how value, quality, and risks will be assessed. You design the end-to-end solution, from user interfaces and agent orchestration to runtime environments, reusable tools, context services and backend systems. You determine where the customer’s shared context, decisions and work state reside. You design how data provenance, freshness, access rights, and lifecycle are managed, while CRM and other core applications remain the systems of record. You make well-founded choices between ready-made agents, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, GitHub cloud agents and custom development. You make use of API and MCP interfaces without introducing unnecessary complexity. You design the governance model for agents, including ownership, identities, least-privilege access, human approvals, technically enforced guardrails and traceability. You participate in prototyping and implementation. Together with developers and the customer, you define production-readiness criteria, monitoring, recovery and cost management. What do we expect from you? Experience in the architecture of business-critical solutions, integrations, and cloud services, as well as the ability to take designs all the way to implementation. Hands-on experience with agentic or generative AI solutions and an understanding of their evaluation, limitations, and security. The ability to communicate with business stakeholders, developers and security professionals, and to justify architectural choices in terms of value, risk, maintainability and cost. A proactive and collaborative way of working, as well as fluency in Finnish and English. What kind of expertise will help you succeed? Microsoft environments are central to our work. We value experience with technologies such as Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365, as well as an understanding of the roles of Entra, Agent 365, Purview, and Defender. Deep expertise across all of these products is not required. What matters is the ability to identify the necessary controls and ensure they work effectively in the chosen implementation. What does AI-native work mean in this role? You challenge the existing workflow, not just its technical implementation. For example, in customer or project work, an agent may bring together context from approved sources, prepare decisions, and propose system updates. The agentic workflows you design may also support the transformation of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements and implementation to testing, release, and continuous improvement. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network. items.desc: About us At FMC, our employees are guided by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture, Solutions for the Planet. We provide farmers innovative solutions that increase the productivity and resilience of their land. From our industry-leading pipeline to novel biologicals and precision technologies, we are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. For more than a century, FMC has successfully delivered some of the of the industry's most advanced, innovative solutions that protect farmers’ crops from destructive pests and disease, while also protecting the environment. We are committed to fulfilling our mission of discovering new herbicide, insecticide and fungicide active ingredients, product formulations and pioneering technologies that are consistently better for the planet. ESG Reporting & Assurance Specialist The ESG Reporting and Assurance Specialist supports the organization’s ESG reporting, data management, disclosure, and assurance activities. The role is responsible for coordinating ESG data consolidation and reporting processes, ensuring alignment with applicable reporting frameworks, standards, and assurance requirements. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders and external assurance providers, the Specialist strengthens reporting governance, data quality, controls, and processes; supports emerging disclosure requirements and readiness initiatives; and drives continuous improvement in the organization’s ESG reporting capabilities. What you will do with us: Coordinate ESG data assurance process, including managing requests from external assurance providers, tracking deliverables and timelines, and coordinating with internal subject matter experts to facilitate efficient assurance engagements. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sustainability, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Operations, Procurement, Human Resources, and other functions to support ESG reporting objectives and disclosure requirements. Consolidate, validate, and maintain ESG and greenhouse gas emissions data, ensuring the completeness, consistency, accuracy, and traceability of reported information. Support the preparation, review, and publication of ESG disclosures, reporting deliverables, frameworks and indices, including GRI, SASB, ISSB, and TCFD-related disclosures. Maintain ESG reporting methodologies, standards, calculations, policies, procedures, governance documentation, and supporting evidence, ensuring updates are accurately reflected in reporting tools and processes. Develop and continuously improve ESG reporting controls, data management practices, procedures, and governance to enhance reporting quality, reliability, and efficiency, including evaluating ESG reporting software in collaboration with Accounting and the Controller organization. Support ESG disclosure readiness initiatives, including CSRD, by assisting with data gap remediation, process and control documentation, Double Materiality Assessments, and ESG rating and ranking submissions such as CDP and EcoVadis. Your qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; relevant professional certifications in ESG reporting, sustainability, assurance, auditing, or reporting frameworks are preferred. 3–5 years of relevant experience in ESG or sustainability reporting, corporate responsibility, assurance, auditing, or a related field, preferably within a multinational or publicly traded organization. Experience coordinating ESG data assurance engagements with external auditors or assurance providers; experience working with major audit firms is preferred. Demonstrated experience collecting, validating, analysing, consolidating, and reporting ESG and sustainability data, including greenhouse gas emissions data. Working knowledge of ESG reporting frameworks and standards, with an understanding of evolving disclosure requirements such as GRI, SASB, ISSB, TCFD, and CSRD. Strong data management, analytical, project management, and organizational skills, with experience documenting processes, controls, methodologies, governance procedures, and data quality practices. Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with strong written and verbal English; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data management/reporting platforms, and the use of Artificial Intelligence to improve data consolidation, reporting efficiency, and automation.
