items.desc:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. 
 Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.
 We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.
 Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.
 We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.
 The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !
 Context 
 Up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work — and the AI systems that can fix it only matter if they actually run in production, inside real hospitals, on sensitive health data. Building that is the heart of this role.
 This is an AI Engineer role : you won't just write models, you'll shape Parallel's core AI architecture, define our machine learning strategy, and embed intelligent systems directly into hospital workflows. You'll work hand in hand with the CTO and the founding team, with very high ownership over everything from agentic LLM workflows to the way AI outputs land in the tools doctors actually use.
 Your mission 
 Design and deploy production-ready AI systems — LLM-powered and agent-based — that automate medical coding and reduce administrative workload in hospitals, owning each feature from prototype to monitoring.
 Outcomes 
 Production LLM systems: design and deploy LLM-powered systems that automate medical coding in real clinical environments. 
 Agentic workflows: build and iterate on agent-based workflows tailored to complex clinical operations. 
 Secure data pipelines: work with hospital IT to build secure, scalable data ingestion pipelines that adhere to health-data security standards. 
 Product integration: integrate AI outputs into the apps used by doctors and hospital staff. 
 AI roadmap & full ownership: partner with the CTO to define the AI roadmap, and own the full lifecycle of each AI feature — research, prototyping, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 You you are : 
 This job is for you if: 
 You have 3+ years working on applied ML/AI problems in production environments — real systems that run, not just POCs. 
 You have strong experience with LLMs and NLP , including prompt engineering and/or fine-tuning. 
 You're proficient in Python or Node.js and have worked with ML libraries (Hugging Face, LangChain, PyTorch, etc.). 
 You have a deep sense of ownership and can move from prototype to product quickly. 
 You're action-oriented and autonomous , and you thrive in a fast-paced startup where you shape the core, not execute tickets. 
 You care about solving user problems over shipping features , and you're comfortable getting close to the product and its users. 
 Bonus: familiarity with backend services (Node.js/TypeScript) and data infrastructure . 
 Bonus: experience working with sensitive or regulated data (healthcare, finance, etc.). 
 Hiring process 
 Quick chat with Wallerand, our recruiter (30 min) 
 Chat with our CTO, Chris (30 min) 
 AI / technical case study, in person at our Paris office (60 min) 
 Meeting with our CEO, Paul (30 min) 
 Why should you join us? 
 A rare opportunity: you shape Parallel's core AI architecture and ML strategy from day one, with very high ownership alongside the founders. 
 Real-world impact: your systems directly reduce hospital burnout and free up medical staff to focus on patients, not paperwork. 
 Cutting-edge work that ships: state-of-the-art LLM and agentic systems deployed into real clinical environments — with the engineering rigor (type safety end to end, automated best practices, rapid iteration with tools like Cursor) to make them reliable. 
 Package & perks: competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus our standard benefits (Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% public-transport coverage). 
 On-site in Paris , 100% in person — building something this ambitious works best shoulder to shoulder. 
 We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. 
 If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

items.desc: Company Description VOSKER, leading provider of surveillance solutions for remote-area monitoring, is recruiting talent to support its Reconeyez solutions. Every day, we design intelligent, autonomous, solar-powered and cellular-connected surveillance systems for the world’s most demanding environments, providing consumers and businesses with peace of mind and greater knowledge of their world. In a few words, at Reconeyez by VOSKER: you’ll help protect critical assets, work with cutting-edge technology, and grow with a team that thinks big and delivers. Benefits Fast growing business Fantastic office in Tallinn Down-to-earth, innovative company culture Stebby wellness benefit Additional vacation and health days Job Description The Role We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own and evolve our models and ML infrastructure behind our actor-detection and visual-verification pipeline. This is the team that decides what our cameras "see" — from the object-detection models that flag intrusions, to the duplicate-suppression logic that stops a parked car from firing alarms all night, to the next generation of vision-language models we're bringing in for richer scene understanding (fly-tipping detection, license plates, image-quality scoring). This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research-only one. You'll train and optimize models and get them running reliably in production — building the data pipelines(and MLOps), serving infrastructure, and evaluation harnesses that turn a notebook experiment into something that survives contact with real field imagery (day/night, IR/RGB, weather, bad signal). You'll also help shape where we take agentic and LLM/VLM capabilities next. What You'll Do Train, fine-tune, and evaluate computer-vision models (object detection, image quality, static-object/duplicate suppression) on real-world camera imagery Own the model-serving pipeline — package models into our NVIDIA Triton ensembles (DALI GPU preprocessing → TensorRT inference → post-processing), build and deploy TensorRT engines, manage the model repository and no-downtime reloads Build and curate datasets — ingestion, labelling, and quality control using FiftyOne(Voxel51) and Label Studio; identify and fix the data problems that actually move model accuracy Design evaluation harnesses so model changes are measured, not guessed — regression suites, A/B comparisons, and metrics tied to real detection quality Develop LLM/VLM and agentic capabilities — extend our self-hosted VLM/LLM stack(vLLM and similar), build retrieval- and tool-using agents, and integrate them into engineering and product workflows Qualifications Must have: Strong Python and the modern ML stack — PyTorch, model training and fine-tuning, working in Jupyter / notebook-driven experimentation Practical computer vision experience — object detection, working with image data, understanding why models fail in the real world Experience taking models to production, not just training them — model serving, optimization, and the gap between offline metrics and live behavior Self-starter mindset — you can take an ambiguous accuracy problem, dig into the data, run the experiments, and ship a measurable improvement independently Rigorous about evaluation — you care about datasets, ground truth, edge cases, and not fooling yourself with a good-looking number Nice To Have NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, DALI, or comparable GPU model-serving / optimization experience Dataset tooling — FiftyOne (Voxel51), Label Studio, or similar curation/annotation platforms LLM / VLM experience — self-hosting (vLLM), fine-tuning (LoRA), RAG, or multimodal models Agent-building experience — tool-using agents, MCP, or LLM-orchestration frameworks MLOps — experiment tracking (CometML/Opik or similar), model registries, reproducible training pipelines Exposure to edge/IoT or resource-constrained inference, or to anomaly detection on device telemetry Familiarity with NATS / gRPC or other event-driven service communication Additional Information Level Mid-level (2–5+ years of relevant ML engineering experience). We value an engineer who can both improve a model and keep it running in production over a pure researcher or a pure MLOps specialist — depth in the CV/serving stack matters more than breadth across every framework.

items.desc: ¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales? En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti. Colabora con un equipo multidisciplinar en proyectos de impacto global Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa trabajar con empresas internacionales líderes en su sector en proyectos que abarcan toda su cadena de valor , combinando Analítica Avanzada , Machine Learning , Inteligencia Artificial y tecnología cloud con una clara orientación a negocio . Buscamos personas con curiosidad , pensamiento analítico y motivación por construir soluciones reales basadas en datos , dentro de un entorno colaborativo y multidisciplinar enfocado a resolver retos complejos y generar impacto tangible. Como Data Scientist , participarás en iniciativas de alto impacto, transformando datos en soluciones que aporten valor medible. Colaborarás estrechamente con equipos de Data Science, Data Engineering, Estrategia y Negocio a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones de IA : desde la identificación de las necesidades de negocio hasta su desarrollo, validación, puesta en producción y adopción por parte del cliente, asegurando que sean útiles, explicables y confiables. ¿Te unes al resto? Entre las funciones que desempeñarás, se encuentran: Cocrear casos de uso de datos e IA con negocio, identificando oportunidades donde la analítica avanzada, el machine learning o la IA generativa puedan generar impacto real. Explorar, preparar y enriquecer datos procedentes de distintas fuentes para construir datasets, variables y features robustas que sirvan como base para modelos y productos analíticos. Desarrollar modelos de machine learning y deep learning para resolver problemas de predicción, clasificación, segmentación, recomendación, optimización, forecasting, detección de anomalías o análisis de comportamiento. Diseñar soluciones con IA generativa, incluyendo casos de uso con LLMs, búsqueda semántica, RAG, embeddings, asistentes inteligentes, automatización documental o agentes orientados a tareas. Colaborar en la productivización de modelos, trabajando con prácticas de MLOps y LLMOps, versionado, trazabilidad, testing, monitorización, automatización y mejora continua. Crear visualizaciones, narrativas y experiencias analíticas que ayuden a perfiles técnicos y de negocio a entender resultados complejos de forma clara, sencilla y accionable. Trabajar directamente con clientes, entendiendo sus retos, explicando resultados, proponiendo soluciones y acompañando la adopción de la IA en sus procesos. Mantenerte al día de nuevas tecnologías y enfoques de IA, compartiendo aprendizajes con el equipo y contribuyendo a la evolución de nuestras capacidades. ¿Qué buscamos? Apostamos por personas con ganas de aprender y orientadas a aportar valor . No es necesario que domines todas las tecnologías desde el inicio: contarás con varios programas de acompañamiento y formaciones que te ayudarán a impulsar tu carrera y acelerar tu crecimiento . En nuestro equipo encaja un perfil adaptable , comunicativo y orientado al cliente , con iniciativa y dinamismo , capaz de trabajar de forma colaborativa en equipo y de analizar y sintetizar información compleja para aportar soluciones de valor en entornos cambiantes. Valoramos altamente las siguientes capacidades: Formación en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Física, Informática, Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial o disciplinas similares. Inglés C1 hablado y escrito. Fundamentos de estadística, machine learning y evaluación de modelos. Conocimientos sólidos de Python y librerías habituales de análisis, machine learning y visualización. Valoramos el manejo de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con datos estructurados y no estructurados. Interés o experiencia en IA generativa, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, búsqueda vectorial o agentes inteligentes. Familiaridad con herramientas de trabajo colaborativo y desarrollo como Git Capacidad para comunicar resultados complejos de forma sencilla, tanto a perfiles técnicos como de negocio. Se valora positivamente si tienes experiencia o interés en: Plataformas cloud como Azure, AWS o Google Cloud. Visualización de datos con Power BI, Tableau. Streamlit, Plotly o librerías interactivas. items.desc: As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer for Cyber Security , you will sit at the intersection of applied AI/LLM engineering and enterprise cybersecurity. You will be embedded directly with cybersecurity operational and engineering teams (Application Security, SecOps/SOC, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management) to build, deploy, and scale production-grade AI systems, LLM-powered pipelines, and autonomous agentic workflows that solve high-impact security challenges. You are not just integrating APIs or using chat assistants—you are designing and shipping resilient, evaluated, tool-using LLM architectures and automated security capabilities directly into production environments within a global financial institution. Key Responsibilities Build and Deploy LLM-Powered Security Systems: Architect, develop, and operationalize end-to-end AI applications, tool-augmented agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines tailored to cybersecurity workflows (e.g., automated vulnerability remediation, intelligent SOC triage, SAST/DAST triage automation, and detection engineering). Embedded Problem Solving (Forward Deployed): Work directly with security practitioners (AppSec engineers, SOC analysts, incident responders, penetration testers) to deeply understand operational bottlenecks and translate complex security requirements into working AI software solutions. Agentic Workflows & Tool Integration: Design autonomous, evaluated, tool-using agent frameworks that interact securely with enterprise APIs, security scanners, SIEM/SOAR platforms, code repositories, and containerized infrastructure. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre futur collectif Communauté Sud Est Collectif de 85 personnes Une communauté multi expertises Au sein de la maison du célèbre compositeur Darius Milhaud qui a rouvert ses portes à l’été 2023, en plein cœur d’Aix en Provence. Ancien logis du bras d’or bâtie en 1670, cette bâtisse provençale réhabilitée en haut-lieu de la création et de l’innovation compose avec son passé de lieu de rencontre et de foyer d’exploration musicale. Entre ses murs chargés d’histoire, elle invite les arts et la culture mais également nos équipes locales à travailler de concert autour d’espaces de travail, de sociabilité et de détente. Fort de nos multiples expertises et de notre ADN technologique, nous avons pour ambition de devenir l’acteur numérique incontournable de la région Sud-Est. Vos nouveaux challenges pour ce poste : Onepoint déploie IA4Dev , une initiative visant à intégrer l’Intelligence Artificielle dans le cycle de vie du développement logiciel. L’objectif : accélérer, fiabiliser et transformer les pratiques de delivery grâce à l’IA générative, au Machine Learning et à l’automatisation intelligente. Nous recrutons des passionnés par la tech et l’IA, capables de combiner expertise en développement logiciel et appétence pour les usages de l’IA, afin de construire les outils et méthodologies de demain. Les attentes de la fonction sont les suivantes : Expérimenter et industrialiser l’IA dans le développement logiciel : Génération assistée de code (Copilot, CodeWhisperer, ChatGPT, etc.) Automatisation des tests (unitaires, QA, intégration continue) Optimisation de la documentation technique et fonctionnelle Débogage assisté et revue de code augmentée par IA Contribuer à la conception d’outils et frameworks IA4Dev : Développement des plugins, intégrations et pipelines CI/CD augmentés Création des “AI agents” dédiés aux développeurs Accompagner nos clients et équipes internes : Formation et évangélisation sur les pratiques IA4Dev Identification des cas d’usage concrets par secteur et par contexte projet Définition des guidelines et bonnes pratiques de gouvernance IA Participer à la R&D IA4Dev : Veille technologique (LLMs, MLOps, DevOps augmenté, sécurité IA) Partage de retours d’expérience au sein de la communauté Onepoint Votre profil et les expertises que vous souhaitez développer : Vous disposez d’une expérience significative sur des postes de développeurs fullstack avec une expérience avérée en IA ; Vous avez une excellente maitrise du développement logiciel et des outils IA pour les développeurs (GitHub Copilot, OpenAI API…) Vous maitrisez les concepts devops, CI/CD, et conteneurisation (docker, kubernetes) et avez des notions de MLOps et d’IA Gen appliquée au code Vous aimez délivrer des missions chez nos clients ; Vous démontrez une bonne capacité à accompagner et former vos clients ; Votre sens du relationnel est reconnu, vous êtes résolument tourné vers vos clients ; Vous démontrez une appétence entrepreneuriale, notion ancrée dans l'ADN de Onepoint ; Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais. Notre processus de recrutement 1er échange avec Camille (Camille Lanéry | LinkedIn) ou Pauline (Pauline MORGANTI | LinkedIn) : échange sur vos souhaits et motivations, et présentation de l'entreprise (durée : 45 min, Teams ou présentiel) 2ème échange avec un expert ou une experte technique : questions techniques et descriptif de nos projets (durée : 1 heure, Teams ou présentiel) 3e échange avec un ou une partner : projection sur votre rôle au sein de Onepoint (durée : 1 heure, Teams ou présentiel) Onepoint en quelques mots Créée en 2002 par David Layani, Onepoint est devenu en un peu plus de 20 ans l’un des acteurs majeurs du conseil et de la tech, notre collectif compte aujourd’hui plus de 4000 talents en France (Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, Paris, Rennes, Strasbourg et Toulouse) et dans le monde (Australie, Belgique, Canada, Etats-Unis, Angleterre, Malaisie, Maroc et Singapour). Notre chiffre d’affaires a été multiplié par dix en 10 ans, atteignant plus de 500 millions d’euros, et ambitionne le milliard d’euros d’ici 4 ans. items.desc: Job Description We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our Mobile team in Front&Advisory in Tieto Banktech. Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong backend focus. You will help us design, build and operate the cloud services, APIs and integrations behind AI-enabled mobile banking experiences. Tieto Banktech is on a strategic journey to embed artificial intelligence at the core of our products and engineering practices. You will work closely with mobile developers, backend engineers, designers and product managers to turn relevant AI opportunities into secure, reliable and valuable capabilities for banks and their customers. When joining Tieto Banktech as an AI Engineer you will Work in a cross-functional autonomous Mobile team with ownership of a well-defined domain Identify where AI can create real value in mobile banking products and engineering practices Shape practical patterns, architectures and best practices for secure and reliable AI-enabled solutions Use AI-assisted workflows to understand, analyse and modernise existing technology Help teams evaluate new tools and adopt AI-supported workflows across development, testing and operations Take solutions from prototype to production, including architecture, integration, testing and operational readiness Continuously improve solutions with a focus on quality, security, performance, reliability, observability and cost Who We Are Looking For Software development: Minimum five years of experience developing and operating production software. Data analysis and applied AI: Experience analysing and interpreting data, identifying meaningful patterns and opportunities, and applying machine learning and AI technologies to create practical business value. Backend engineering: Experience with object-oriented development, APIs, integrations and scalable service architectures. CI/CD and operations: Experience with automated delivery, monitoring, observability and production troubleshooting. Security and privacy: Experience with secure data handling and the responsible use of AI in regulated environments. You are a collaborative and pragmatic engineer who takes ownership and enjoys solving complex problems. You are comfortable working across disciplines and can connect technical decisions with customer value, security, privacy and regulatory expectations in banking. It Is a Bonus If You Have Experience With Java and Spring or Spring Boot, Python OpenShift or Kubernetes, Git, GitHub Actions and Grafana Experience wih design, development and maintenance of backend services, APIs and integrations Large language model integration, context and prompt design, and evaluation of AI outputs Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases or related retrieval patterns Agentic workflows, function calling or AI orchestration frameworks We offer We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture and an outstanding work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to help shape how AI is used in mobile banking and software engineering while working with skilled colleagues across mobile, backend, product and design. We provide a flexible hybrid work model and believe in curiosity, knowledge sharing and continuous learning. Did we get you inspired? We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today. For more information or questions, please contact the Talent Acquisition team at recruitmentinbanking@tieto.com. Hope to hear from you soon! Location: Trondheim. We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies. Additional Information At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity. Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto Stay alert to recruitment scams: Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses. We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site. For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

items.desc: Wat je zal doen Ben jij de AI & Data Engineer die ons team wil versterken om innovatieve data pipelines en state-of-the-art AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen? Als AI & Data Engineer bij iO ben je in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer die AI- en data-oplossingen bouwt, integreert en operationeel maakt binnen bestaande IT-ecosystemen van klanten. Je gaat aan de slag met diverse AI-problemen : van het slim inzetten of fine-tunen van Large Language Models, agent en multi-agent setups, het toepassen van RAG-patronen, tot het bouwen van ETL-pipelines die een data platform voedt. Het terugkerende patroon is dat je bestaande cloud services en APIs integreert tot een efficiënt, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar geheel. De focus ligt daarbij op het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen die correct functioneren binnen complexe, vaak enterprise IT-landschappen. Prompt engineering is voor jou een 'art form', waarbij je creatief nadenkt over hoe je de beste resultaten kunt krijgen, met oog voor het voorkomen van hallucinaties of het toepassen van slimme guardrails. Je evalueert je oplossingen op een systematische manier om inzicht te krijgen in de kwaliteit van de output. Je komt in je werk in aanraking met allerlei soorten AI : van statistische modellen tot Large Language Models, van Generative AI op het vlak van afbeeldingen, video en audio tot Natural Language Processing. Het gaat vooral om het inzetten en toepassen van bestaande modellen en services , en het maken van de infrastructuur daaromheen. Je werkt aan allerlei verschillende klantvraagstukken : van het automatisch analyseren van documenten tot het herkennen van gebeurtenissen in audio of videodata, aan het bouwen van agents en orchestratie oplossingen, aan het genereren van grafische output op basis van data, of aan het creëren of valideren van content. Daar waar AI een plek kan vinden, zet jij als engineer de totaaloplossing neer. Je werkt samen met de verschillende AI-experten binnen iO en met diverse technische teams op klanten. Je oplossingen zijn gebaseerd op moderne (cloud)platformen, SaaS-services en talen als TypeScript en Python . Wat zijn jouw taken als AI & Data Engineer? AI en Data oplossingen bedenken: Klantenvraagstukken omtrent AI en data analyseren en uitwerken van oplossingen, aanpak en architectuur. Software engineering & integratie: Ontwikkelen van backend componenten, API’s en services om AI-oplossingen correct te laten samenwerken met bestaande applicaties en platformen. Data Pipeline Development: Ontwerpen en bouwen van robuuste ETL/ELT processen en real-time data streams Data Platform Architecture: Opzetten van moderne data warehouses, data lakes en analytics platforms AI Integration: Implementeren van machine learning pipelines en integratie van AI-services in data workflows Data Quality & Governance: Waarborgen van datakwaliteit, security en compliance binnen data ecosystemen Performance Optimization: Optimaliseren van data processing performance en schaalbaarheid Cloud Data Services: Werken met cloud-native data diensten zoals AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, of Google DataFlow Monitoring & Observability: Implementeren van monitoring en alerting voor data pipelines en AI-workloads Je Kwaliteiten En Skills Je hebt een Bachelor of Master diploma met focus op software engineering. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als software engineer en hebt gewerkt aan data- en/of AI-gedreven systemen in een professionele, bij voorkeur enterprise context. Je hebt ervaring met verschillende LLM-architecturen en je weet waar de sterke en zwakke punten liggen van diverse AI-oplossingen. Je kent de principes van moderne data architecturen, data modeling en big data processing. Je beheerst moderne data processing talen zoals Python, SQL en hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals Apache Spark, Pandas, of Dask. Je bent bekend met AWS of Azure cloud data platformen. Je hebt een sterke basis in software engineering, met kennis van o.a. CI/CD, Unit Testing, Git (flow) en secure development, error handling, asynchrone operaties en real-time data streams. Je kunt je ideeën goed omzetten in technische architectuurdiagrammen, dataflow schema's en documentatie, maar je slaagt er ook in je oplossingen toe te lichten aan een minder technisch publiek (klant en collega’s) Je vindt het leuk om over je ideeën en oplossingen te sparren met collega's en om samen met hen tot een beter resultaat te komen.

items.desc: The Role You will join the AI Team in Front Office Technology to design, build and maintain the firm’s knowledge layer. Its main users are investment teams and the AI tools that support them. It also covers the technology estate, so engineering and operations tools share the same picture. You will work closely with our AI Engineers, the wider engineering community and DevOps so the layer is maintained as part of everyday work, largely through agents. This is a hands-on engineering role. Data engineering moves and stores data; this role defines what things are, how they relate and where knowledge came from, so people and AI agents can use it. Role Purpose What the firm knows, and how that knowledge connects, is a large part of what sets it apart. Making it usable by AI multiplies its value, with people and tools then able to build on it. Significant information already exists across the firm: reference data, research, documents and system records. Documentation can sometimes be outdated or lacking, and the connections between the things we use, such as issuers, bonds, strategies, systems and services, are often not defined or maintained. Without them, AI tools can read each source on its own but cannot reliably move across them. AI will determine links for itself, at times slightly differently, with answers therefore becoming harder to trust or audit. A knowledge layer addresses these problems. It gives each thing a standard description and maps how things relate, so AI can follow those links to answer questions and carry out tasks across systems. It is not a one-off project: it needs continuous maintenance, much of it carried out by agents with people confirming changes. For example: A PM asks how a sovereign downgrade could affect their book. The answer spans the country’s bonds, rates curves and currency, state-owned companies whose debt trades with the sovereign, and the latest research on all of them. No single system holds those links, sources describe them differently, and some exist only in documents or people’s experience. The knowledge layer records them so an agent can follow them, within the user’s entitlements. An agent investigating a failing service can find what depends on it, who owns it and its runbook. Any answer can be traced back through those links to its sources. How We Work Thin and useful. We model what is needed, when it is needed. Agentic tool calling. Agents use well-defined tools with access control built in. Deterministic where it counts. Where accuracy matters, we use deterministic methods, not model recall. Maintained by agents, confirmed by people. Agents do the routine upkeep; people confirm what changes. Teams stay in control. Teams own their knowledge and decide what is shared beyond them. Key Responsibilites Design Design the knowledge model across front office and technology domains: instruments, issuers, research, themes, systems, services and owners, and how they relate. Manage the model as code, with version control, automated validation and clear change management, so others can contribute to and support it. Build Link knowledge reliably to existing reference data, research, documents and system records, starting with the most reliable sources. Design taxonomies and tagging for research, commentary, internal notes and runbooks. Build a small set of well-defined tools that AI agents use to find entities, retrieve knowledge and follow relationships, with access control enforced inside them. Support teams Help teams, including front office desks, define, capture, structure and share their knowledge, with simple tools standards, linked notes that people and agents can both read and update, and agent-assisted tools, demonstrating value early. Make capture part of everyday work, as notes, research and runbooks are written, not a separate task through the use of tooling built natively into emerging AI oriented workflows and with the support of our AI Engineers. Maintain Build agents that keep the layer current: detect changes in source systems and code, propose updates and new links, and flag stale or conflicting knowledge for review. Build updates into normal engineering work, for example when a service, pipeline or dataset changes. Record provenance and full history for audit, and manage change without breaking dependent tools. Measure coverage, accuracy and effect on AI answers, and test graph technologies on real use cases. Essential Key Experience and Qualifications 5+ years in data engineering, data modelling or knowledge engineering, with strong Python and SQL, and daily use of AI coding tools. Proven knowledge modelling or ontology design: entity and relationship models that other teams built on in production. Hands-on experience with knowledge graphs, using at least one graph technology (property graph or RDF). Experience structuring unstructured content: taxonomies, tagging and document metadata. Experience designing typed APIs or tool integrations that AI agents …

items.desc: Wat je zal doen Ben jij de AI & Data Engineer die ons team wil versterken om innovatieve data pipelines en state-of-the-art AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen? Als AI & Data Engineer bij iO ben je in de eerste plaats een ervaren software engineer die AI- en data-oplossingen bouwt, integreert en operationeel maakt binnen bestaande IT-ecosystemen van klanten. Je gaat aan de slag met diverse AI-problemen : van het slim inzetten of fine-tunen van Large Language Models, agent en multi-agent setups, het toepassen van RAG-patronen, tot het bouwen van ETL-pipelines die een data platform voedt. Het terugkerende patroon is dat je bestaande cloud services en APIs integreert tot een efficiënt, schaalbaar en betrouwbaar geheel. De focus ligt daarbij op het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen die correct functioneren binnen complexe, vaak enterprise IT-landschappen. Prompt engineering is voor jou een 'art form', waarbij je creatief nadenkt over hoe je de beste resultaten kunt krijgen, met oog voor het voorkomen van hallucinaties of het toepassen van slimme guardrails. Je evalueert je oplossingen op een systematische manier om inzicht te krijgen in de kwaliteit van de output. Je komt in je werk in aanraking met allerlei soorten AI : van statistische modellen tot Large Language Models, van Generative AI op het vlak van afbeeldingen, video en audio tot Natural Language Processing. Het gaat vooral om het inzetten en toepassen van bestaande modellen en services , en het maken van de infrastructuur daaromheen. Je werkt aan allerlei verschillende klantvraagstukken : van het automatisch analyseren van documenten tot het herkennen van gebeurtenissen in audio of videodata, aan het bouwen van agents en orchestratie oplossingen, aan het genereren van grafische output op basis van data, of aan het creëren of valideren van content. Daar waar AI een plek kan vinden, zet jij als engineer de totaaloplossing neer. Je werkt samen met de verschillende AI-experten binnen iO en met diverse technische teams op klanten. items.desc: About The Role Keepit is looking for a Mid-Level AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate AI-driven automations and agents that support our Go-To-Market (GTM) and Finance functions. You will work hands-on with the Claude Desktop application and API, local and hosted LLMs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to turn manual, repetitive workflows into reliable, monitored agentic systems. This is a builder role: you will own solutions end-to-end, from prototyping an agent to hardening it for production use by GTM Systems, Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams. You will: Design, build, and deploy AI automations and agents using Claude Desktop and the Claude API for real business workflows. Partner with GTM (Sales, Marketing, RevOps) and Finance stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and translate them into agent-based solutions. Develop and maintain MCP servers and/or an MCP gateway to connect agents securely to internal and third-party systems (CRM, ERP, data warehouses, ticketing, etc.). Stand up and manage local LLM environments and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for use cases requiring data privacy, low latency, or offline operation. Build and maintain an agent harness (orchestration, tool-calling, memory, guardrails, logging, evaluation) around local and hosted models. Write production-quality Python (and other languages as needed) to support agent tooling, data pipelines, and integrations. Establish testing, monitoring, and evaluation practices for agent reliability, cost, latency, and output quality. Document architecture, runbooks, and guardrails for all deployed automations and agents. Stay current on the AI/agent tooling landscape and recommend improvements to the team's automation stack. About You Must-haves: Build automations and agents hands-on with the Claude Desktop application and the Claude API. Build agents or automations for GTM (Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Customer Success) and/or Finance use cases. Program proficiently in Python, plus familiarity with other languages relevant to AI/automation work (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Bash). Build and manage MCP servers directly, or operate agents through an MCP gateway. Deploy and work with local/self-hosted LLMs and build RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval evaluation). Build an agent harness around local LLMs, covering orchestration, tool use, memory, guardrails, and evaluation loops. Nice-to-haves: Work with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector). Use GTM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM/marketing platforms. Use Finance systems (ERP, billing, or FP&A tooling). Work with CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP). Understand AI safety, data privacy, and security best practices for enterprise agent deployments. About Us At Keepit, we're on a mission to make cloud data protection simple, reliable, and built to last. Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk. We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents. We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way. As we collaborate across locations, English is our primary language. Please submit your CV in English to support the review process. We offer: Official employment (Umowa o pracę). 4 additional working days of vacation per full calendar year. 3 days of internal sick leave without a doctor's note. Health and life insurance. Employee Capital Plan (PPK). Multisport card compensation. Coverage of professional training, meetups, and conferences. English-speaking club with native speakers and Polish language classes. Internet and glasses reimbursement. Office in Krakow city centre (Dluga 72) with beverages, fruit, and snacks. Regular team-building events, winter and summer parties. We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. When applying for the vacancy, Keepit will process your personal data, and therefore we recommend that you also read our privacy policy , which describes our processing of personal data and your rights as a data subject. If you notice any misconduct or irregularities that fall within the scope of our whistleblowing procedure, please click here to report them.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.



No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

 - Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

 - Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

 - Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

 - Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.

 - Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.

 - Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

 - Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

 - Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.

 - Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.

 - Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.



Requirements

 - 3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. …

items.desc: At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. Thousands of applications to govern. Major transformations to manage. Growing regulatory complexity on one side, business units shipping AI prototypes in days on the other. And in the middle: enterprise IT teams still managing and collecting tech demands manually, managing the complexity of highly integrated processes and systems. Stackgini changes this fundamentally. Stackgini's system understands its customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up, from technical configuration to application documentation, from individual IT demands to dependencies across the entire tech portfolio, with the depth of knowledge of a senior IT expert and the speed of a machine. If you had unlimited budget, you would hire a dedicated IT expert for every IT demand. With Stackgini, this is now possible. Some of the largest organizations in this world trust Stackgini including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers or REWE. We're a small, talent-dense team of >10, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career. Tasks The role A Product Engineer at Stackgini owns features end to end. The person building the feature is expected to shape the feature. We have more good ideas than hands. For most reasonable feature ideas the question is not whether we build them, but when. Product Engineers are the people who turn that prioritization into shipped product quickly, without lowering the bar. The AI work AI is core to our product, but we don't run agents for everything. We use them where they create real value. For that we built our own LLM harness from hard-earned production experience: maximum freedom for the model, without compromising on enterprise control, governance or EU data residency. What this means for you: you work hands-on with these new technologies, you run evals instead of trusting demos, and you know how to put this stuff into production reliably. Agent output gets benchmarked against expert-curated baselines, and failure modes get named, measured and fixed. If you are obsessed with how AI systems behave, fail and improve, this is the place for you. How we ship Small teams of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. We deploy continuously to production. We use AI tools heavily, and you have freedom in which ones (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex). Around that we run a strong operating system: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, screenshots or videos for product changes, manual product testing before release, production verification after. The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix. Requirements What we need from you Nobody at 11 people knows everything. We hire people who dive in and own outcomes. 3 to 6 years of full-stack experience shipping production software people actually use. You can get productive in our stack fast: Kotlin/Spring Boot and Python on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend. You don't need to know all of it on day one, but you should get into it quickly. You have shipped agentic systems, side projects absolutely count. You think in tools, context and evals, not just prompts. Fluent English. German is a real plus because many customer calls run in German. We pair you with a German-speaking teammate when needed, but German gets you closer to users faster. You'll stand out if You build with AI natively, not as an afterthought. You can take a vague problem to a shipped feature. You scope, decide, implement, test and iterate. items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role Behind the API and the AI agents there is a real, physical lab in Lausanne: millions of francs of instruments, freezers full of reagents, deliveries arriving every day, and customer samples going out. When it runs smoothly, a customer gets their results in days. When it does not — a reagent runs out mid-run, a delivery sits unopened, an instrument goes down and nobody noticed the service contract lapsed — experiments stop, and customers feel it immediately. You are the person who makes sure that does not happen. What is on the shelves, what is on order, what is shipping, and what is about to break — that is yours, and you will run it. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager and with the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right. This is a good role to be early in your career in. We are going from roughly 25 people to roughly 50 in the next year and multiplying the throughput of the lab, and the person who does this job well will not be doing the same job in two years. We are looking for someone who fixes things rather than reporting them. What You'll Do Keep the lab stocked. Receive deliveries, unpack them, get them into the right freezer at the right temperature, and make sure our inventory system reflects what is actually on the shelf. Flag what is running low before anyone else notices. Run the day-to-day ordering. Place the orders, chase the ones that are late, and sort out the ones that arrive wrong. Handle shipping, in and out. Customer samples, reagents, equipment. Cold chain, dry ice, customs paperwork, and the courier relationships that make it all land on time. Support the science team hands-on. Reconstituting and aliquoting target proteins, buffer prep, plate handling, and tracking materials in our lab software. You will be at the bench for part of your week. Look after the instruments. Coordinate servicing, calibration, and repairs with vendors, keep the maintenance schedule honest, and get an engineer on site fast when something breaks. Keep the lab safe and organized. Chemical inventory, waste disposal, safety compliance, and the general war against entropy in a shared space. Keep the office and the team running. Supplies, workspace, new-starter setups, and the occasional team event. Help build the new lab. We are expanding into new space. You will be involved in setting it up. What We're Looking For Some hands-on lab experience. A degree, an apprenticeship, a technician role, or a couple of years in a research or biotech lab. We care much more about whether you are competent and reliable in a lab than about how many years you have logged. Genuinely organized. You are tracking dozens of small things at once — what is on order, what expires next month, which instrument is due for service — and none of them drop. You notice things before they break. The best people in this role are the ones who spot that we are three weeks from running out of a reagent, and quietly fix it, rather than the ones who report the stockout. You are comfortable getting your hands dirty. This is not an administrative job. You will be unpacking boxes, moving dry ice, and reorganizing a freezer that has become someone's junk drawer. You are tech-savvy, and you want to be more so. Our lab runs on our own software and we use AI tooling across the company, including for operational work. We would love someone who ends up automating the boring parts of their own job rather than doing them forever, and we will teach you how. Curiosity here counts for more than existing skill. You want to be in a startup. Priorities move, nothing is fully documented yet, and you will regularly be the first person to do something. If you need a defined process to work inside, this will be …

items.desc: AI Applications Architect — Agent-First Development Nationwide Utilities Location: Kensington, London W14, 100% office-based Salary: £35,000 per year Employment: Permanent, full-time Reports to: CEO Help build the software factory, not just its next application We are looking for a curious, technically capable builder who wants to develop quickly through real work at the frontier of applied AI. At Nationwide Utilities, our CEO is already directing specialist agent teams across a connected business-software portfolio. The work spans customer operations, email and documents, supplier portals, bill validation, markets, procurement and other business applications. We are also developing the coordination tools that help manage the development itself. These applications are at different stages of build, integration and release. Your opportunity is to help connect the pieces and turn ambitious development into dependable software people actually use. This is not a conventional coding role with an AI assistant added. Agents are central to implementation. Your contribution is the requirements, judgement, coordination and hands-on engineering that make the result work. You will help improve this method, not simply add more activity to it. Your contribution Translate business goals into clear requirements, guidelines, reusable agent instructions and testable acceptance criteria. Break work into manageable stages, map dependencies and keep several agent-led workstreams moving without losing the critical path. Use Claude, Codex and appropriate local tools for implementation, testing, review and documentation. Read code, debug problems and integrate changes. Know when to direct an agent, when to intervene and when to ask for experienced review. Distinguish built, tested, integrated and live. Challenge sample-data demos and confident agent summaries until the actual user journey is proven. Help make MVPs production-ready: data integrity, permissions, security, testing, useful interfaces, deployment, monitoring and rollback. Coordinate shared testing and deployment resources; resolve stale instructions, unclear ownership and failed hand-offs. Reduce avoidable supervision by giving the CEO clear progress, concise decisions and early warning of genuine blockers. Our development environment includes four Blackwell GPUs, lightweight local computers and multiple premium Claude/Codex accounts. The goal is more useful, verified software, not simply more sessions, tokens or GPU activity. What matters An insatiable, practical interest in AI: you experiment, learn and can explain what did and did not work. Software foundations: you can work with code, APIs, databases and version control, and diagnose a problem rather than blindly retry prompts. Pace and prioritisation: you can juggle workstreams, preserve context and focus on the next thing that will genuinely unblock delivery. Clear written thinking: an ambiguous idea becomes an executable instruction and an outcome a person can check. Finishing discipline: you care about usability, integration and reliability as much as producing the first working demonstration. Initiative, honest communication and a strong appetite for a demanding development opportunity. Experience with MCP, local models, GPU workloads, containers, CI/CD, Python or TypeScript is useful; you do not need to arrive as an expert in everything. Energy-sector experience is welcome but not essential. Relevant employment, independent projects and substantial learning projects can all demonstrate your ability. This is learning through hands-on contribution alongside the CEO, not a promise of a formal training programme. items.desc:
Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ? 
 Description de l'emploi
 L'univers de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) est à l'aube d'une révolution sans précédent, marquée par des avancées technologiques fulgurantes et une intégration toujours plus poussée dans tous les secteurs d'activité. L'ère de l'IA générative, avec son potentiel de transformer radicalement la stratégie de données des entreprises, s'annonce comme un tournant majeur pour les organisations.
 Rejoindre Deloitte France en tant qu' AI Engineer / Scientist confirmé vous offre une opportunité unique de jouer un rôle essentiel dans la conduite et la croissance de nos activités en Intelligence Artificielle au sein d'un cabinet de conseil de renommée mondiale. Vous travaillerez au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, en étroite collaboration avec des experts métiers et des cadres dirigeants, pour transformer les défis de nos clients dans divers secteurs tels que les services financiers, le secteur de l'énergie, la santé ou encore la technologie, les médias et les télécommunications. Vous contribuerez à établir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie IA (MLOps), de choix d'architecture technique et de delivery de produits IA en travaillant main dans la main, lorsque le contexte le permet, avec nos partenaires stratégiques (AWS, GCP, Microsoft , Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia) . Vous aurez également l'opportunité de travailler et apprendre auprès d'une équipe d’experts de l'IA . 
 Contribuer au delivery des projets et produits IA (Machine Learning, GenAI, NLP, Classification, Computer Vision, modélisation) pour des clients de divers secteurs 
 Encadrer de jeunes Data Scientists et Ingénieurs ML en les coachant et assurant leur montée en compétences. 
 Mettre en place et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques MLOps et LLMOps pour optimiser la livraison des modèles IA en production (scalabilité, fiabilité, coûts). 
 Être un prescripteur sur les outils communs Data & IA et assurer l'identification et le déploiement d'assets techniques réutilisables (internes, groupe, marché). 
 Contribuer activement à la veille technologique pour amplifier l'innovation et identifier les synergies entre technologies, méthodes et pratiques. 
 Assurer la qualité des solutions , le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement et de sécurité, et intégrer les principes d'architecture de Deloitte. 
 Capitaliser et diffuser auprès des équipes internes et externes sur les avancées et les résultats des projets IA. 
 Participer à des initiatives d'innovation et effectuer une veille technologique sur les pratiques LLMOps.

Et si c’était vous ?Au moins 3 années d'expérience significative dans le domaine du ML et de l’IA, et plus globalement de la data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de conseil ou en lien avec divers secteurs d'activité.Une formation scientifique et/ou informatique de niveau Bac+5 minimum, de préférence avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, machine learning ou domaines connexes. Une solide compréhension des technologies et outils d'IA, incluant notamment Python, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, services Clouds IA (Azure, GCP, AWS). La maîtrise de frameworks et outils liés aux LLM (ex?: LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS) est également un atout. Une maîtrise des concepts core du Machine Learning (Réseaux neuronaux, apprentissage non/semi/supervisé, Deep Learning, classification, modélisation). Une expérience significative dans les techniques de NLP/GenAI incluant LLM, RAG, VectorStores, Agents LLM. Une expertise avérée en gestion de projets techniques et une excellente capacité de collaboration interfonctionnelle. Une familiarité avec les processus et outils de développement modernes (DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes) et le déploiement de micro-services ou API (Flask, Django). Un esprit de synthèse et une capacité à travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires. D'excellentes capacités de communication et de présentation, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des profils techniques et non techniques. Une curiosité intellectuelle et d'excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes. La maîtrise des outils, méthodologies et concepts de suivi et gestion de projet est un plus.

Concevoir et développer des applications au travers du Software Development Lifecycle augmenté à l’IA, adaptés aux données et contraintes industrielles de Nexans. Contribuer au développement du framework IA Development Lifecycle améliorant la productivité, la qualité et la gestion des coûts IA. Industrialiser et déployer les applications en production via des pratiques de pipelines CI/CD, monitoring, versioning sur des environnements Cloud. Intégrer les solutions IA dans les produits digitaux existants (APIs, micro-services) en assurant performance, scalabilité et sécurité des données. Assurer la veille technologique sur les avancées en IA appliquée et proposer des expérimentations (PoC) pour enrichir la feuille de route IA du groupe. Orientation résultats : pragmatisme pour aller du prototype au produit opérationnel en limitant la dette technique. Autonomie & ownership : capacité à porter un sujet de A à Z sans supervision constante. Esprit de collaboration : aisance à travailler en mode transversal avec des profils métier, produit et technique. Communication claire : capacité à vulgariser des concepts IA complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques, réaliser et présenter des démos. Agilité et résilience : confort dans un environnement en transformation rapide, avec une forte tolérance à l’ambigüité.

Good understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals and strong knowledge in a specific domain (e.g., Computer Vision, Deep Learning, NLP). Expert coding skills in Python and at least one of these languages: Scala, C++, Java. Hands-on experience with database management languages (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL). Hands-on experience in cloud-based infrastructures (AWS/GCP/Azure). Hands-on experience with Unix-based command line and DevOps tools (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g. Spark, Hadoop, Databricks). You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer. Leader international de l’expertise après sinistre et de la gestion de sinistres, nous réunissons plus de 4 500 collaborateurs présents dans plus de 120 pays à travers le monde, dont 40 pays dans lesquels nous opérons directement, afin d’offrir une expertise reconnue, des relations humaines de qualité et des solutions innovantes. Ensemble, nous aidons les assureurs, les entreprises et les particuliers à avancer avec confiance, où qu’ils se trouvent dans le monde. Votre environnement La Direction des Solutions d’Expertise recherche Ingénieur IA / AI Software Engineer H/F pour accompagner son développement. Vous intervenez sur des sujets d’IA générative avec un objectif concret : transformer les innovations technologiques en solutions robustes, performantes et créatrices de valeur pour nos métiers. À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené à : Faire évoluer notre moteur interne d’orchestration IA afin de gérer des workflows complexes : routage de modèles, chaînes de traitement, function calling, tool use et protocoles émergents tels que MCP ; Concevoir des fonctionnalités IA facilement exploitables par les développeurs au travers d’APIs, de connecteurs et de SDKs internes simples, robustes et documentés ; Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des architectures RAG avancées, des systèmes d’agents et des solutions d’extraction d’informations permettant notamment d’exploiter des documents et pièces de sinistres complexes ; Évaluer et intégrer les technologies IA les plus pertinentes pour nos usages métiers : nouveaux modèles propriétaires et open source, frameworks d’agents, document intelligence, knowledge graphs ou encore fine-tuning de modèles locaux ; Mettre en place des protocoles d’évaluation et d’observabilité permettant de mesurer la qualité des réponses, réduire les hallucinations ainsi qu’optimiser la latence et les coûts d’inférence ; Partager vos bonnes pratiques avec les équipes de développement et contribuer à l’industrialisation et à l’adoption des solutions IA au sein de nos applications métiers Vous évoluerez dans un environnement orienté développement logiciel et IA générative, avec une attention particulière portée à l’industrialisation, à la performance et à la fiabilité des solutions. Stack technique Python / .NET / C# LLM et APIs de modèles Embeddings et bases de données vectorielles RAG et agents IA REST / gRPC / flux asynchrones MCP, function calling et tool use Azure Profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac+5 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou formation équivalente ; Vous disposez d’une solide expérience : en développement backend, notamment avec Python, .NET / C# ou un environnement équivalent ; dans la conception, l’intégration ou l’exposition d’APIs performantes, notamment REST, gRPC ou architectures asynchrones. dans un environnement Cloud, idéalement Azure, et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de déploiement et de maîtrise des coûts ; en pratique des outils d’évaluation et d’observabilité des applications LLM tels que Langfuse, Ragas ou DeepEval ; Une maîtrise des techniques avancées de prompt engineering, notamment la structuration des sorties et l’arbitrage entre qualité, latence et coûts ; en document intelligence et dans le traitement de données non structurées : OCR, extraction, indexation ou exploitation de documents complexes ; Vous maîtrisez les bonnes pratiques d’architecture logicielle, de tests et de robustesse applicative ; des concepts et technologies de l’IA générative : APIs de LLM, embeddings, bases vectorielles, architectures RAG, agents IA, function calling ou tool use ; Ce poste s’adresse avant tout à un profil d’ingénieur logiciel passionné par l’IA générative. Notre objectif n’est pas d’entraîner des modèles de Machine Learning from scratch, mais de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des architectures logicielles intelligentes au service de nos métiers. Pourquoi rejoindre ADENES Un groupe en pleine dynamique de croissance, reconnu pour son expertise métier, sa capacité d’innovation et son ancrage national et international solide. Un poste à fort impact stratégique, participer à la transformation digitale des métiers. Une culture managériale fondée sur la confiance, la responsabilisation et la collaboration, où vos idées et votre leadership font la différence. Un poste clé dans un groupe structuré, agile et tourné vers l’avenir. Un engagement fort en matière de RSE, de qualité de vie au travail et d’innovation durable. items.desc: Software, UI & Agentic Systems Engineer (m/w/d) Graz (hybrid) · Vollzeit Wir sind openmaind - wir bauen eine KI-gestützte, herstellerunabhängige Intelligenzschicht für AGV-/AMR-Flotten – den Fleet Orchestrator. Ein System, bestehend aus drei Modulen: Insight – sehen, was passiert: Bewegungen, Near-Misses, Blockagen Planning – Layouts und Materialfluss simulieren, bevor sie existieren Orchestration – manuelle und autonome Flotten in Echtzeit koordinieren Worauf es uns wirklich ankommt Urteilsvermögen vor Syntax. Du denkst in Systemen und erkennst, wenn der Output eines Agents – oder einer Kollegin, eines Kollegen – falsch, fragil oder over-engineered ist. Das ist uns wichtiger als Tiefenexpertise in einer einzelnen Sprache. Du schreibst selbst Code, leitest Coding-Agents an, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse und stehst für die Qualität dieses Outputs ein. Womit du dich beschäftigst Echte Produkt-Features in Go und Python ausliefern, mit React im Frontend Unsere agentischen Fähigkeiten mit LangGraph vorantreiben – mehrstufige Agent-Workflows entwerfen, testen und robust machen Ran an LLM-Training und -Evaluation: Fine-Tuning, Benchmarks, Regressionstests für Modellverhalten Unseren SDLC aufs nächste Level bringen – CI/CD, Test-Infrastruktur, Release-Prozess, Code-Qualität Dahin, wo die Roboter sind – Orchestrierungslogik gegen echte AGV-/AMR-Hardware im Feld integrieren und validieren Was du mitbringst Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch sicher und souverän, auch mit Kund:innen (mind. C1). Gutes Englisch gehört dazu. Ein solides technisches Fundament, idealerweise durch ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Software Engineering, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder Ähnlichem Starkes architektonisches Urteilsvermögen Echte Hands-on-Erfahrung im Bauen oder Betreiben von LLM-basierten Agents (LangGraph oder ähnlich) Du weißt, wie man LLM-Output bewertet und testet, nicht nur promptet Go, Python und React sind ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung – sich in das einzuarbeiten, was das Problem braucht, zählt mehr Neugier auf Robotik und Lust, dir mit Hardware im Feld die Hände schmutzig zu machen Ein Ship-it-Mindset – verlässlich statt nur clever Nice to have Erfahrung mit Flottenmanagement, Logistik oder industrieller Automatisierung Hintergrund in Simulation oder Planungsalgorithmen Was tatsächlich für dich drin ist Du pflegst nicht die Codebase von irgendwem anders – du baust die Architektur, auf der diese Firma die nächsten Jahre läuft. Deine Entscheidungen zum Design des agentischen Systems zeigen sich im Produkt, nicht in einer Vorschlagsbox Kleines Team heißt: Dein Name steht für das Ergebnis, gut oder schlecht – und genau das ist der Punkt Musst du um 14 Uhr zwischen zwei Meetings laufen gehen? Geh. Das bedeutet Gleitzeit hier – kein Buzzword Kernzeit 9–12 Uhr, den Rest des Tages flexibel, plus 1 Tag Home-Office pro Woche Working Holidays Klimaticket Steiermark, voll übernommen Büro mitten in der Stadt mit Terrasse Richtung Schlossberg, direkt an der Mur – perfekt für einen Kaffee zwischen zwei Debugging-Sessions oder um vor einem Deploy den Kopf freizubekommen Echter Zugang zur Startup-Szene: Events, Community, Leute, die an Ähnlichem bauen wie du Gehalt Faire Bezahlung ist uns wichtig! Das Bruttomonatsgehalt für diese Position beträgt mindestens € 4.061. Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation sind wir selbstverständlich bereit, ein höheres Gehalt anzubieten. Bewerbung Interessiert? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf an career@openmaind.ai. Statt eines klassischen Anschreibens interessiert uns etwas anderes: Erzähl uns in 3–5 Sätzen von einem LLM-Agent, den du gebaut oder betrieben hast. Was sollte er lösen, und was hat nicht so funktioniert wie gedacht? Wir lesen jede Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen bei dir.

items.desc: You'll work at the intersection of AI engineering, product development, and customer implementation. Rather than building in isolation or working from detailed specifications, you'll spend time understanding how businesses operate, identify opportunities for automation, and develop AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable results. You'll own implementations from the initial customer conversation through to production, ensuring agents are reliable, observable, and capable of handling real-world complexity. This is a builder's role. You'll be expected to write code, solve problems independently, and get AI systems working in production. What You'll Do Build and deploy AI agents: Design, develop, and ship AI-powered agents that execute multi-step business workflows, interact with external systems, and complete tasks autonomously. Own customer implementations: Work directly with customers to understand their operational processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate business requirements into working technical solutions. Develop integrations: Build and maintain integrations with ERP systems, APIs, email platforms, databases, and other business-critical tools. Handle messy data, edge cases, and inconsistent systems. Engineer reliable AI systems: Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, monitoring, and observability to ensure agents perform consistently in production. Work across the stack: Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and supporting interfaces where required to deliver complete solutions. Solve problems in ambiguous environments: Make technical decisions, iterate quickly, and take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions. Improve the core platform: Collaborate with the founding team to turn customer-specific solutions into reusable capabilities that can scale across deployments. What We're Looking For Essential Experience Strong hands-on Python experience , building backend systems, APIs, integrations, and production applications. Real AI agent development experience: You've built and shipped AI agents or LLM-powered systems that do more than generate text. You understand tool calling, multi-step workflows, structured outputs, failure handling, and the challenges of deploying AI reliably. Production ownership: You've taken software from initial development into live environments, dealt with real users and production issues, and improved systems based on actual performance. Early-stage startup experience: You've worked at an early-stage startup, ideally as a founder, founding engineer, or one of the first technical hires. You're comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and owning problems outside a narrowly defined job description. Customer-facing engineering experience: You're comfortable working directly with customers, understanding their workflows, explaining technical trade-offs, and translating business problems into practical engineering solutions. Integration and data experience: You can connect disparate systems through APIs, work with relational databases, and build solutions that handle real-world business data. Strong engineering judgement: You know when to use an LLM, when deterministic code is better, how to manage failure modes, and how to balance speed with reliability. Technical Environment The existing stack includes: Languages: Python, TypeScript and Go Frontend: Vue AI: LLMs, AI agents, LangChain and agent evaluation Data: PostgreSQL and Neo4j Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Integrations: REST APIs, email systems, ERP platforms and business applications You don't need to be an expert in every technology listed. Strong Python and production AI engineering experience are the priorities; the ability to learn unfamiliar tools quickly matters more than matching every item on the stack. You'll Stand Out If You Have Built AI agents that execute actions across multiple systems rather than simply powering chat interfaces. Developed AI-powered workflow automation for real customers or internal business operations. Worked with agent evaluations, observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and production reliability. Built integrations with ERP, CRM, supply chain, finance, logistics, or other enterprise systems. Worked in B2B SaaS, enterprise AI, or an AI-native startup. Experience in manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, logistics, or B2B commerce. Danish language skills. Who This Role Is For You're likely a strong fit if you're an AI engineer who enjoys building products from scratch, working close to customers, and taking responsibility for whether your software actually solves the problem.
