At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
 Our Data Platform team provides centralized data platforms and tools for various business functions at Netflix, enabling them to utilize data to make critical, data-driven decisions. We focus on making it easy for our business partners to work with data efficiently, securely, and responsibly. We aspire to set the industry standard in building a world-class data infrastructure, supporting Netflix’s goal to be the most popular and widely accessible destination for global internet entertainment.
 As the Data Platform charter grows, we are expanding our presence to Poland to further increase our impact. We are seeking Distributed Systems Engineers to help evolve and innovate our Product and Infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that brings new perspectives as we address the next set of challenges.
 Team Spotlights 
 Analytics Platform and Experience Team 
 This team owns the architecture and foundational systems of Netflix's Analytics Platform, a growing domain with an expanding charter as the platform scales to support critical initiatives like Live and Ads. The team currently owns automated Spark migration tooling and TableDiff, our in-house data validation tool used both as a critical enabler for migrations and as a widely adopted utility across the org. As the charter grows, the team will take on additional high-impact platform initiatives. This offers an excellent opportunity to shape foundational data infrastructure and deliver direct, high-leverage impact across Netflix
 Data Movement Team 
 The Data Movement Connector EcoSystem at Netflix is a growing domain with an expanding charter to own high-leverage business-critical connectors across Netflix. The team currently offers Frameworks, Libraries, and Control Planes and supports a large set of streaming/incremental and batch/snapshot-based connectors. This offering evolves the next step is full ownership of the Mantis ecosystem. We believe having the Poland team build and own a set of connectors to move and integrate data across different business domains would be the fastest way to unlock business values. This offers an excellent opportunity to learn the technology stack and deliver direct, relevant impact across the organization.
 Online Data Stores Team 
 This team takes end-to-end ownership of Netflix's internal Online Data Stores (ODS) platform, spanning two core areas:
 1. Core data platform products 
 Ownership of critical infrastructure such as ZooKeeper and the data abstraction layers that sit on top of our datastores - ensuring their reliability, scalability, and continued evolution as foundational components of the data platform.
 2. Self-service solutions for Online Data Stores 
 Building the self-service capabilities - including agentic interfaces - that let Netflix engineers provision, operate, and reason about their datastores independently, reducing operational friction and toil.
 Over time the team will expand its charter to additional datastores and broader infrastructure initiatives. The mission throughout is to boost Netflix engineers' productivity and innovation through a robust, efficient, and secure data platform, while fostering close collaboration across data platform teams to deliver greater organizational throughput and agility.
 Experimentation Platform Team 
 This team owns the data infrastructure that makes A/B testing work at Netflix. Specifically, they build and maintain the systems that store and govern the record of who was in which experiment, across hundreds of concurrent tests running across streaming, ads, growth, and device platforms. They also own the semantic layer that ties every experiment metric at Netflix back to that allocation data, and the pipelines that keep the whole thing fresh and reliable. As the team matures, the scope grows to include self-service tooling for the teams running experiments and support for AI-driven monitoring and analysis workflows.

items.card: You will join the team that owns the sync engine: the system that detects, tracks and applies changes flowing in both directions between a device and the cloud. The engine plans and executes a graph of dependent operations to apply each change to the other
items.desc:
Every day, hundreds of millions of people trust their documents to iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive and Box on Apple platforms. These services rely on a common foundation built at the core of our operating systems, the File Provider framework, APIs and daemons developed by a Core OS team in Paris. We are responsible for keeping users’ files consistent across their devices and services, and the deep system integration that provides the best local user experience with cloud-backed files.
We are looking for a systems engineer who wants to work where distributed state meets the operating system. You do not need to have sync experience. You do need to care deeply about getting things right, because at our scale, rare bugs have the potential to cause dataloss for many users.
You will join the team that owns the sync engine: the system that detects, tracks and applies changes flowing in both directions between a device and the cloud. The central problem is reconciling two trees that change independently: the local filesystem where users save their files, and remote services we don’t control. The engine plans and executes a graph of dependent operations to apply each change to the other tree, in an order that never breaks the folder structure, even through concurrent edits, crashes and conflicts. The workload is heavily bursty: we track millions of files, and a single event can change a large share of them at once. On iPhone and iPad, absorbing those bursts means competing with apps and daemons for memory, CPU, battery and storage.
You will contribute to a system that walks a constant tightrope: careful enough that it never loses data, fast enough that sync feels instant, and light enough that nobody notices it running. Day to day, you will design, implement, test and debug new features, quality safeguards and performance improvements. Initially, you will be paired with experts who will accompany you on scoped assignments, and you will build autonomy and ownership from there. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams worldwide, from kernel to cloud, across our operating systems and services stack, and external developers adopting our APIs throughout the industry.
Solid programming skills in a systems language such as C, C++, Objective-C or Swift
Working understanding of operating system fundamentals: processes, concurrency, memory, file I/O
Demonstrated ability to debug methodically
Clear written and verbal communication in English, and a collaborative approach to working across teams
Curiosity about how systems actually work underneath the abstractions
Experience reasoning about stateful systems that must stay correct across crashes, restarts, partial failures or concurrent mutation
Exposure to distributed systems concepts: eventual consistency, change tracking, reconciliation, conflict resolution
Familiarity with filesystems, APFS or otherwise, or with filesystem-adjacent system components
Experience with performance, memory or energy profiling
Experience maintaining an API or library that other developers depend on
Experience with agentic coding
Contributions to a large, long-lived codebase

items.desc:
About H:
H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.
H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

About the Team:
You’ll work alongside our CEO and make sure H follows through on every decision, relationship and commitment. This is a hands-on operator role. You’ll prepare our CEO for what’s coming, close the loop on what has happened, and run the projects that sit between teams. You’ll work closely with the CEO’s Executive Assistant.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Our CEO’s agenda: Prepare key meetings with context, bios, goals and talking points. Capture decisions and actions, and chase them until they’re done.

 - Relationships: Keep the CEO’s relationship tracker (investors, customers, partners, press) accurate. Every email, LinkedIn message and invitation gets a timely response, a named owner, or a polite decline.

 - Trips and events: Plan high-value schedules for trips and conferences, for example 6 to 8 qualified meetings in a city. Work with GTM leads to source the meetings and with the EA to get them into the CEO’s diary.

 - Memos and materials: Draft memos, briefs, all-hands slides and presentations that need little editing.

 - Visibility across teams: Gather updates from across the company, track how key priorities are progressing, and raise risks early with a proposed fix.

 - Ad hoc projects: Take on strategic projects as they come up and see them through to the end.

Requirements:

 - Technical Skills:
   
   - Around 2 to 5 years in strategy consulting, startup operations, VC, or a founder or associate role. We care more about what you’ve delivered than about the exact number of years.
   
   - Excellent written and spoken English and French.
   
   - Experience managing a high volume of competing priorities for a senior stakeholder.
   
   - Confident with modern tools (Notion, Google Workspace, CRMs, AI assistants).

 - Soft Skills:
   
   - You follow through on every yes and are selective about what you commit to.
   
   - You own the chase. “They didn’t get back to me” is never where it ends.
   
   - You come to meetings prepared, with data and updates in hand.
   
   - You bring a solution to every problem or blocker.
   
   - You get the right people involved at the right time, and your communication style is anchored in influencing without authority.
   
   - You know when to push back and when to knuckle down and deliver.
   
   - You’re calm, disciplined and organised, including when volume is high.
   
   - You handle confidential information with discretion.

 - Bonus Skills:
   
   - Experience building simple automations. You use AI and automation to remove manual work instead of adding to it.



What Success Looks Like After 90 Days:

 - No relationship falls through the cracks.

 - Every key meeting is prepped, followed up and tracked.

 - Our CEO spends no time on logistics or chasing people.



Location:

 - Paris or London.

 - This role is hybrid, and you are expected to be in the office 3 days a week on average.

 - Regular travel to the US and across Europe.



What We Offer:

 - Join the exciting journey of shaping the future of AI, and be part of the early days of one of the hottest AI startups.

 - Collaborate with a fun, dynamic, and multicultural team, working alongside world-class AI talent in a highly collaborative environment.

 - Enjoy a competitive salary.

 - Unlock opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and career development.

If you want to change the status quo in AI, join us.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Music is becoming a first-class part of ElevenLabs Creative. You’ll own the UI that lets creators make it, working closely with Research to turn new music models into products people use the next day.

The open question is what the best interface for AI music creation looks like. Creators come for video, dubbing or ads, and music is part of that flow. Making a song from scratch, scoring a video and localising a track into other languages each need a different flow. You’ll form a view on the right experience, build it end to end, and make it easy to adopt each new model as it lands.

You’ll take an ambiguous problem, decompose it, and carry it through legal, design, engineering and launch with Growth. You’ll work in a small, high-ownership team across product, research and go-to-market.

Requirements

 - Strong Frontend experience: you’ve shipped complex, production UIs (React/TypeScript or equivalent) and are comfortable on the backend when the work needs it

 - You’ve owned ambiguous, zero-to-one product work from problem definition to launch, without a PM or a prescriptive backlog

 - You’ve worked closely with designers (Figma) and have taste and opinions about UX

 - You’ve worked across functions such as legal, safety, growth and design to ship, and keep stakeholders updated without prompting

 - You weigh trade-offs and make pragmatic decisions with no single right answer, and build so that new models can be swapped in as they land

Bonus

 - Music, audio or creative-tools experience, or music as a hobby (singing, an instrument, production)

 - Experience building media-heavy interfaces such as audio, video or timeline editors

 - Experience working with ML models or research teams


LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Overview 
 As a Solution Engineer – Apps & AI , you will help organisations accelerate innovation by modernising applications, adopting AI-powered solutions, and building intelligent and agentic experiences that deliver measurable business value.
 You will independently lead complex and strategic customer engagements, working with technical decision-makers, architects, developers and business leaders to shape technical strategy, design and prove solutions, and lead complex technical wins. You will combine deep expertise across application modernisation, AI, agents and developer technologies with strong architectural judgement and business acumen to navigate ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs and build alignment around the right technical approach.
 Working across account teams, specialists, engineering, customer success and partners, you will orchestrate the right expertise to accelerate customer decisions, adoption and expansion. You will also scale your impact beyond individual engagements by mentoring others, developing reusable approaches, building competitive insight, and bringing customer and market learning back to product and engineering teams.
 Responsibilities 
 Build Strategy
 Develop strategic Apps & AI technical approaches that connect customer priorities with Microsoft’s application modernisation, AI, agentic and developer platform capabilities.
 Build deep competitive knowledge across the AI and application landscape, identifying patterns and sharing insights with field, product and engineering teams.
 Partner with account and specialist teams to shape strategic win, adoption and expansion plans for complex Apps & AI opportunities.
 Identify emerging customer and market patterns and provide actionable feedback to product and engineering teams.
 Education
 Act as an Apps & AI technical thought leader, sharing architectures, demonstrations, best practices and customer learnings across the community.
 Build readiness for peers across application modernisation, AI-powered applications, agents, developer productivity and emerging technologies.
 Identify capability gaps and create reusable content and learning that raises technical depth across the wider SE community.
 Lead and contribute to technical communities, events, hackathons and mentoring.
 Leverage Partner Ecosystem
 Build strong technical relationships with partners that extend Microsoft’s Apps & AI capabilities and capacity.
 Identify opportunities to use partners to accelerate application modernisation, AI implementation and customer adoption.
 Scale successful customer approaches through partners, helping replicate technical wins across customers and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.
 Scale Customer Engagements
 Build trusted relationships with key customer technical decision-makers and influencers, helping shape Apps & AI strategy and technical direction.
 Lead complex technical wins spanning applications, AI, developer platforms and related workloads, orchestrating the right Microsoft and partner resources.
 Proactively identify and resolve technical blockers, engaging engineering and product teams where required.
 Coach account teams and technical sellers and establish clear engagement and hand-off strategies that accelerate customer decisions, implementation and adoption.
 Solution Design and Proof
 Lead architecture design sessions, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots and hackathons that prove the value of modern applications, generative AI, agents and developer technologies.
 Design end-to-end solutions using Azure application platforms, Microsoft Foundry, GitHub, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, integration, data and AI capabilities.
 Adapt architecture patterns for complex customer requirements, balancing security, Responsible AI, scalability, resilience, performance and cost.
 Create reusable architectures, demonstrations and technical assets that allow successful approaches to scale across customers and the wider business.
 Qualifications 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field and technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; or technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; or equivalent experience.
 Experience with cloud and hybrid technologies, including solution architecture, application development or modernisation, migrations, and technology management.
 Experience with modern application development, cloud-native architectures, AI-powered applications, generative AI, copilots or agents, and associated developer technologies.
 Relevant Microsoft or industry certifications across Azure, AI, application development, architecture, security, or related technologies.

items.desc: Bit è un System Integrator ICT giovane ed innovativo, con sedi a Torino e Milano. Opera su 3 diversi modelli di business: Sviluppo di soluzioni turnkey e maintenance Sviluppo di prodotti in ambito Cloud e IOT Attività di consulting La Mission dell’azienda è supportare i propri Clienti, dislocati su tutto il territorio nazionale, nella realizzazione e nella gestione di programmi di Digital Transformation. Il nostro team è costituito da oltre 150 professionisti come Azure Devops Engineer, Cloud Architect, AWS Devops Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, Front-end Architect, Cyber Security Engineer. Da anni collaboriamo con i principali top players di mercato, intervenendo su progetti dei settori Finance, Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy&Utilities, Retail, Food&Beverage e Security. Generative AI Engineer: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Generative AI Engineer da inserire in un progetto in ambito Energy, focalizzato sullo sviluppo di una soluzione di Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa per l'analisi e l'elaborazione di documentazione tecnica e di business. La risorsa si occuperà dello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), finalizzate a estrarre, interpretare e mettere in relazione le informazioni contenute nei documenti, consentendo agli utenti di interrogare la base documentale e ottenere risposte e contenuti contestualizzati. Competenze richieste Conoscenza dei Large Language Models (LLM), delle tecniche di prompting e degli approcci di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Esperienza nello sviluppo di use case di Generative AI in ambito documentale. Familiarità con le tecniche di document parsing, chunking, embedding e vector search. Esperienza nell'integrazione di modelli LLM all'interno di applicazioni e pipeline. Buona conoscenza di Python. Conoscenza, anche parziale, dei servizi AWS per lo sviluppo di soluzioni AI/GenAI. Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (livello C1 o superiore). Competenze preferenziali Conoscenza di Amazon Bedrock. Familiarità con i servizi AWS per lo storage, la ricerca e l'indicizzazione dei dati. Conoscenza del dominio Energy & Utilities. Cosa offriamo: Inserimento in un contesto ad alto profilo tecnologico; Ambiente di lavoro giovane, dinamico e flessibile; Academy gratuita per profili junior; Formazione continua con possibilità di acquisire certificazioni professionali (Oracle, Java SE, Microsoft Azure, AWS, PMP, Project Management Professional, ecc.) e partecipare a workshop tecnici; Crescita professionale tramite un piano carriera ben strutturato; Possibilità di lavorare in Smart Working. Dettagli dell'opportunità: Sede di lavoro: Torino/Milano (modalità ibrida o full remote) Contratto: Tempo indeterminato RAL: da €24.000 a €29.000 per profili junior da €29.000 a €35.000 per profili middle da €35.000 a €43.000 per profili advanced A parità di requisiti, sarà data precedenza ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette (L. 68/99). Perché candidarsi? Ciò che ci contraddistingue è sicuramente la passione con cui svolgiamo il nostro lavoro, la sinergia che caratterizza le collaborazioni con i nostri clienti e la ricerca di nuove soluzioni per migliorare metodologie di progettazione e pianificazione. La nostra forza è basata sul Capitale Umano; crediamo fortemente nelle competenze e nelle abilità dei nostri dipendenti, che vengono seguiti passo dopo passo nel percorso di crescita personale e professionale all’interno dell’azienda. In Bit avrai modo di sentirti parte integrante dell’azienda grazie agli eventi di team building organizzati durante l’anno e alla collaborazione e disponibilità dei professionisti che ne fanno parte. Dunque, cosa aspetti? Invia il tuo CV. Ti aspettiamo! La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77).

items.desc: About the role: About Janus Digital Janus Digital ™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. We earn only on the additional value we create. Built on 15+ years of R&D, 76 granted patents and US$100M+ invested, the platform is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities with Fortune Global 500 owners, sovereign funds and hospitality groups. Strategic Context Every building we make intelligent starts with accurate information about how it is built. High-detail BIM models, and MEP models in particular, are the foundation for digital twins, predictive maintenance and autonomous building operations. Janus Digital is now building its own AI BIM platform to create, check and enrich these models far faster than traditional workflows allow. This role sits at the centre of that effort. You will deliver production-grade MEP and commercial BIM models using AI tooling to speed up every step, while giving the Chief Platform/Product Officer a practitioner's view of the AI-for-AEC market and the requirements our own platform must meet. Position Overview We seek an experienced BIM Modeller specialising in MEP and commercial buildings, reporting directly to the Chief Platform/Product Officer. This hands-on role combines high-detail model delivery with structured market research into AI tooling and platforms, directly guiding the build of the Janus AI BIM platform. Your time will split roughly 60% production BIM and 40% platform intelligence. You will model to LOD 350-400 under ISO 19650, measure the time AI and automation save against manual baselines, evaluate emerging AI tools on real project data, and translate real modelling workflows into product requirements, datasets and acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities Produce federated MEP models (HVAC, plumbing and drainage, fire protection, electrical, ELV and low-current systems) for offices, retail, hospitality, mixed-use and data-centre projects Model to LOD 350-400, including fabrication-ready ductwork, pipework, containment, hangers and supports where required Build and maintain parametric Revit families, shared parameters and project templates aligned to Janus Digital standards Run clash detection in Navisworks and BIM Collaborate Pro across architectural, structural and MEP models Apply AI and automation across the modelling workflow: auto-routing, family generation, drawing and sheet automation, model checking and scan-to-BIM Write and maintain Dynamo and pyRevit/Python scripts, using AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build them faster Map the AI-for-AEC landscape and run structured, hands-on evaluations of shortlisted tools on real Janus Digital project data Work closely with the Chief Platform/Product Officer to shape platform priorities from a practitioner's perspective Apply ISO 19650 information management: BEPs, MIDPs/TIDPs, naming conventions and CDE workflows Work with the Product team on developing an AI automation BIM tool. Highly skilled in testing and trailing new AI tool kits to build. Requirements Experience 6+ years of BIM modelling, with at least 4 years focused on MEP in commercial projects Portfolio of coordinated LOD 350+ MEP models on at least 3 delivered commercial projects Proven delivery on ISO 19650 projects, including multi-disciplinary clash coordination Demonstrable use of scripting or AI tools to speed up modelling, with before-and-after evidence Technical Expertise Expert in Autodesk Revit (MEP); proficient in AutoCAD Navisworks Manage, clash detection and BCF issue tracking Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 and BIM Collaborate Pro ISO 19650, BEP/MIDP/TIDP, Uniclass or OmniClass classification and IFC export Dynamo scripting and working knowledge of Python Daily use of LLM assistants for scripting, documentation and research Core Competencies Precision: models are right first time, with clashes and data errors caught before issue Builder mindset: automates any task done more than twice and shares the tool with the team Critical evaluation: tests AI vendor claims on real data and reports results without hype Product thinking: turns modelling pain points into clear problem statements the product team can build against Preferred Qualifications pyRevit, Revit API (C#), Grasshopper / Rhino.Inside or Autodesk Platform Services (APS) APIs Hands-on experience with AI-for-AEC tools in generative design, auto-routing, drawing automation, AI model checking or scan-to-BIM Point cloud import and modelling to scan Fabrication parts (Revit Fabrication / MEP Fabrication) and data-centre or healthcare services experience Solibri, Revizto or BIMcollab; COBie, IDS and bSDD; Dubai Municipality BIM e-submission experience Prior work at a software, PropTech or construction-tech company, or on an internal digital tools team Benefits This role can be based in our UAE office or fully remote, within a 4hr/+- window of Gulf Standard time

Intégré(e) au sein d’une unité regroupant les compétences
items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Systèmes d'information Contrat CDI Intitulé de l'offre Architecte logiciel IA H/F Statut du poste Cadre Description de l'offre La Direction des Applications Militaires du CEA, acteur clé de la souveraineté et de la compétitivité numérique pour la France, se mobilise pleinement autour des enjeux liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Intégré(e) au sein d’une unité regroupant les compétences nécessaires au développement et au déploiement sur nos réseaux sécurisés de défense de logiciels innovants avec des piles logicielles souveraines, vous contribuerez au développement et au passage à l’échelle de solutions d’IA générative, de RAG sur des bases documentaires scientifiques, de Data Lakehouse, de systèmes multi-agents ou d’adaptation de modèles de fondation. En tant qu’Architecte logiciel vous aurez la mission de définir et développer l’architecture technique des solutions logicielles client-serveur intégrant des services d’IA en garantissant la scalabilité, la performance, la sécurité et la maintenabilité des systèmes conçus. Les domaines d’intervention de votre équipe consisteront à : Proposer des architectures orientées événements robustes, modulaires et évolutives (Python, FastAPI), en maitrisant les patrons de conception et en vous appuyant sur une méthodologie SDD (Specification Driven Design) augmentée d’IA générative. Configurer, déployer et optimiser des moteurs d’inférence (vLLM) sur nos fermes GPU pour maximiser le débit (tokens/seconde) et minimiser la latence, en mesurant les performances et en appliquant des techniques d'optimisation (Quantification (INT8, INT4, FP16), pruning des modèles, PagedAttention, Batch inference, Offloading CPU). Concevoir les schémas de données (relationnels avec PostgreSQL, NoSQL avec MongoDB et stockage objet avec S3), en garantissant la sécurité et l'intégrité des données. Industrialiser les processus de développement (CI/CD, GitLab) et de déploiement (Docker, Kubernetes). Rejoindre le CEA c’est évoluer dans un environnement scientifique d’excellence au service de projets à forts enjeux tout en bénéficiant d’un cadre de travail équilibré. Parcours professionnels variés et accompagnés (formations, mobilité interne), équilibre vie pro/perso (jusqu’à 52 jours de congés/RTT) dispositifs d’épargne salariale et avantages facilitant le quotidien (restauration, transport, conciergerie, CSE, etc.). Avec un Family Score de 98%, le CEA est à la tête du Label Parents on board qui récompense notre engagement en matière de parentalité. Ce poste bénéficie de télétravail, conformément aux accords et modalités en vigueur au sein du CEA. Il est également possible d’occuper le poste à distance sur un autre centre CEA DAM, notamment au CESTA en Nouvelle Aquitaine. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. #LI-RP1 Profil du candidat Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou en université spécialisé en informatique, vous justifiez d'une premiere expérience dans l'IA. Vous êtes à l'écoute et organisé, avec une capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos qualités de communication et la tenue des objectifs. Participant à la protection nationale, une enquête administrative est réalisée pour tous les salariés du CEA afin d'assurer l'intégrité et la sécurité de la nation. Localisation du poste Site DAM Île-de-France Localisation du poste France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Ville 26 Rue de la Piquetterie, 91680 Bruyères-le-Châtel Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/09/2026 Informations générales Entité de rattachement La Direction des Applications Militaires (DAM) du CEA, au cœur des enjeux de la dissuasion nucléaire Française, cherche ses futurs talents. Organisme inclusif, le CEA est handi-accueillant : nos emplois sont ouverts à toutes et tous. Associer les forces et les compétences de chacun pour atteindre nos objectifs est l'une de nos valeurs partagée par nos 4 600 salariés, répartis sur 5 centres. Les 1 800 salariés du centre de Bruyères-le-Châtel, en Ile de France relèvent les défis scientifiques et technologiques au service de notre Sécurité Nationale. Le centre conçoit les charges nucléaires des armes de la dissuasion, garantit leur sécurité et leur fiabilité en s'appuyant sur le programme simulation. Il met son expertise technique au service des activités dans la lutte contre la prolifération nucléaire, le terrorisme et les alertes en cas de séisme ou de tsunami. Il assure l'ingénierie des infrastructures complexes de la DAM, de leur conception à leur démantèlement. Il co-développe avec Atos les supercalculateurs au meilleur niveau mondial, dont sont issus ceux du Très Grand Centre de Calcul du CEA, qu'il exploite pour ses missions Défense et gère au profit de la recherche. Enfin, il exploite les installations …

items.desc: Empower every employee. AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that. Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI. More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round , bringing our total funding to more than $85M . Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job description We welcome applicants with a range of experience levels, from those a few years into their career to seasoned engineers. If you are just starting your career but already have experience working alongside your studies, we are also happy to talk to you. We’re looking for a Product Engineer with a strong backend specialization, a solid technical foundation, and experience working on SaaS products in Agile environments. You’ll help us build reliable, scalable product experiences, with deep ownership of backend systems while staying close to the full user journey. This role is for someone who is willing to extend their impact across the full stack, from APIs, data models, and infrastructure to the product’s user experience, using AI to bridge the gap where needed. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to turn ideas into high-quality shipped features. What you can expect Cross-functional Collaboration: You will join a product squad and work closely with designers, product managers, and experienced engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and AI. Shift in Software Engineering: Driven by AI, the role is moving toward end-to-end ownership—focusing on understanding user problems, shaping product decisions, rapid prototyping, and validating ideas, rather than just coding from strict specs. A Shared Transition: The company is undergoing this transformation itself; you aren't expected to have everything figured out from day one. Key Traits Valued: What matters most is your curiosity, adaptability, strong engineering judgment, and a genuine willingness to learn new ways of working. Growth and Support: You will receive the tools, practices, and team environment needed to evolve into a product-minded, AI-enabled engineer while continuing to deepen your technical expertise. What you bring to the table If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter more to us than matching every bullet. Backend Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kotlin (or Java) and a web framework like Micronaut or Spring, ideally in a SaaS environment. Cross-stack Mindset: Backend is your home stack, and you're willing to step into web or mobile when a feature calls for it. Comfortable with AI Coding Tools: You use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) as part of your workflow, or are eager to adopt them, to navigate unfamiliar codebases, bridge the gap to frontend, mobile, or infrastructure, and ship small, well-structured changes outside your home stack. Ownership: You think in terms of user impact, not tickets. You ask "what would actually help the user — or what would bring me closer to understanding that?" and see it through: a prototype, instrumentation on existing features, a conversation with a PM or Customer Success - whatever the question calls for. You carry features through to rollout and observe their impact. Nice to Haves: Experience pairing with designers or working directly from mockups/prototypes. Instrumentation and experimentation experience (A/B testing, Grafana, Mixpanel, etc.). Deployment with Kubernetes and Helm Experience with PostgreSQL. Experience with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka). What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview. Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing. Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere. Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed. Happy to be a Flipster: …

Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time. What you bring to the table Must-haves Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure. Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype. German at C1 level or above and fluent English. Nice-to-haves Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet. Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only. Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection. What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. items.desc: About Boomi and What Makes Us Special Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity. Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you'll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more. How You'll Make an Impact You're the technical engine behind Boomi's biggest customer engagements. You take extreme technical complexity and turn it into a strategic solution, which positions Boomi as the leader in data activation. Then you convert each high-tier engagement into a reusable asset, so the rest of the organization moves with speed and precision. The ideal candidate knows the Boomi ecosystem cold and has a track record of clearing architectural hurdles to drive revenue attainment. You bridge field requirements and product innovation. You have the executive presence to engage C-suite personas, and the discipline to productize complex solutions into workshops and blueprints. You'll manage role ambiguity and stay focused on strategic architecture, while building a culture of curiosity and a resilient community. Key Qualifications Elite Technical Proficiency: Hands-on command of the Boomi portfolio (iPaaS, Data Management, API Management). You write code in Java, Groovy, JavaScript, or Python to extend the platform and build custom solutions. Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Advanced knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Docker and Kubernetes. You're comfortable navigating clusters with K9s, managing data streaming, and troubleshooting runtime frameworks. Data Management: Deep expertise in the modern data stack. You understand the nuances of data governance, lifecycle management, and synchronization. You're proficient in cloud data warehouses (Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) and ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica). Master Data Management and Governance: You've architected enterprise-grade MDM systems with tools like Reltio, Informatica, Ataccama, or Stibo, built around data integrity and a unified record strategy. You know metadata management and data lineage, and you design solutions that meet GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA. Agentic AI: You've built and deployed Agentic AI solutions. You know how to connect to model providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, and how to run local Agent Gardens for data sovereignty. Content and Enablement: You've created high-visibility expert content, such as blog posts, technical blueprints, and hands-on workshops, that eliminated manual effort and spread knowledge globally. What You'll Do Lead Strategic Engagements: Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering as the go-to resource on high-value opportunities. Work through complex architectural hurdles to drive revenue. Hands-on network programmability: Practical experience with protocols like NETCONF, RESTCONF, or gNMI, alongside tooling such as pyang or schema validators. Experience with DSLs or data translation engines: Prior work involving declarative domain-specific languages (DSLs), schema-to-schema mapping, or data-driven code generation. Automated testing & CI/CD workflows: Experience with network test frameworks (e.g., PyTest, PTF, Scapy) and automated validation pipelines in enterprise environments. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as a Network Automation Engineer, where you will transform repetitive network tasks into efficient, software-driven workflows. Imagine building Infrastructure-as-Code modules, integrating a source of truth with controllers, and creating automated validation processes that enhance network reliability. You will collaborate with network architects, service owners, SRE, operations, and suppliers to streamline network platforms, making them faster, safer, and easier to use. Your focus will be on developing an engineering system that emphasizes controlled version management, reusable APIs, testing, observability, and controlled deployment. How You’ll Make an Impact Build and maintain reusable automation for campus, WAN, Data Center, DDI, and Secure Access platforms using declarative data models, APIs, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Establish version-controlled engineering workflows that include peer review, automated testing, policy checks, change validation, rollback, and configuration-compliance controls. Integrate network source-of-truth, IPAM/DDI, ITSM, controllers, telemetry, and supplier workflows to enable end-to-end orchestration and ensure accurate operational context. Convert high-volume manual activities and runbooks into standardized self-service workflows, reducing lead time, configuration drift, and dependency on individual experts. Create the technical foundation for AI-assisted and agentic NetOps by exposing trusted data, safe actions, audit trails, and measurable automation outcomes. Collaborate effectively across traditional network operations, architecture, SRE, and supplier teams to drive innovation and efficiency. What You Bring A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A solid understanding of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, IP services, and at least one area of campus, WAN, Data Center, DDI, or Network Security. Hands-on software and automation skills with Python, APIs, data structures, and automation frameworks such as Ansible, Terraform, Nornir, or comparable tools. Experience with enterprise version-control and configuration-management practices, CI/CD, declarative infrastructure workflows, automated testing, secrets management, code review, and traceable infrastructure changes. Knowledge of network data models and interfaces such as YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and vendor APIs is highly desirable. An engineering mindset centered on reusable products, documentation, testing, security, maintainability, and measurable reduction of manual toil. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemensenergy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers: Competitive salary and fair monetary compensation when working abroad. Meal allowance and health insurance. Additional 5 pre-established “Pontes” vacation days if not working abroad. Birthday off if it falls on a weekday and you are not abroad. items.card: The role Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine: Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop
items.desc: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The role Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine: Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop Bring it to life with software on our in-house robotics operating system We work AI-first. AI tools help you scope the problem, drive your CAD, run the calculations and write the machine software. The software side needs basic software engineering skills, not a software background: you'll write it with AI agents, supported by a dedicated software engineering team who build the operating system. You must have built things before, ideally robots, whether as a hobbyist, student, employee or founder. We don't hire narrow specialists. We want engineers who can: Diagnose system-wide failures from first principles Prototype mechanical and software fixes on the fly Work autonomously and communicate clearly with a team spread across sites Take responsibility for how their machines perform in live production Things you'll do This is a design role with hands-on prototyping. For example: Conceive new mechanisms to handle electronics parts and other robotic handling tasks, using AI to scope and specify the problem Design gantries and end effectors in Fusion 360 Use AI agents to run the engineering calculations, and know when to distrust them Machine prototype parts in our in-house CNC shop Analyse end-effector behaviour from video and revise its geometry and control approach to improve throughput and reliability Program machine behaviour on our in-house robotics operating system, with AI agents doing the heavy lifting Specify sensors that catch errors while a machine is running, or monitor a chemical process Prototype and deploy a new test robot for in-line PCB validation Commission your machines and hand them over to our build team to scale up Work across our US and UK sites to share what you've learned and shape the roadmap Bonus skills Experience programming machines, whether PLCs, robot controllers, embedded systems or Python Programming and running CNC machinery Design of chemical handling machinery Optics Pay and level £45K–£125K depending on experience, plus equity. A candidate at the lower end of the range might have: Built some systems before, with some exposure to robotics or automation Seen parts and subsystems through to manufacture as part of a design team Knowledge of designing for machining A keen interest in moving their career towards practical robotics A candidate at the upper end might also have: Led the build and deployment of large-scale automated systems Written the software that controls their own machines Designed for a wide range of manufacturing methods, from machining to sheet metal to injection moulding Mentored more junior engineers The range isn't a hard limit: if you're an expert in all of the above, we still want to talk to you. Not quite so experienced but passionate and keen to learn? Talk to us too. Location Full-time on-site at one of our UK sites: Cambridge: our central Cambridge site, alongside the team designing, building and expanding the Grid. London: our London site. Compensation Range: £45K - £125K

 Mentoring, recrutement, animation technique, production interne :
 un système de points convertibles en euros valorise l’engagement transverse.

 Ce qui est valorisé est concret.

items.desc: Le Centre hospitalier régional universitaire de Nancy est l’établissement public de santé de référence pour la population lorraine. Classé 6ème meilleur hôpital de France (Le Point), le CHRU de Nancy compte plus de 9 600 professionnels et 1 300 étudiants en santé. Les équipes hospitalo-universitaires s’impliquent au quotidien dans le soin, la formation, la recherche et innovation, la santé publique et l’éducation à la santé. Elles ont collectivement identifié 4 valeurs pour définir leur façon de travailler, de collaborer, d’accueillir et de soigner : bienveillance, respect, engagement et faire équipe. Près de 150 métiers contribuent au fonctionnement de l’hôpital. Aux côtés des professions médicales, paramédicales et médico-techniques, on retrouve de nombreux secteurs : administration, finances, achats, qualité, ressources humaines, transformation numérique, biomédical, activités logistiques, techniques et sécurité. Employeur handi-accueillant, le CHRU de Nancy s’engage en faveur de l’intégration et du maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. items.desc: Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. With a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA. We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports. In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list , recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture. Who We’re Looking For We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered capabilities within the Creatio platform. This is an AI-first engineering role: you will spend most of your time designing agents, engineering prompts and context, building retrieval and evaluation pipelines, and directing AI coding agents - with solid .NET engineering as the foundation rather than the whole job. You will join the AI teams building the agent platform that enables AI agents to safely perform real work in the product: call tools and APIs, read and write data, maintain context and memory, follow permissions, and escalate to humans when needed. The team also owns the core infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring, logging, observability, and cost/performance control, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready. This role combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on AI engineering experience. You will work on enterprise-grade AI solutions, including assistants, copilots, knowledge systems, semantic search, RAG-based capabilities, and agentic workflows - and you will use AI coding agents as your primary daily development workflow. Responsibilities Design and implement AI-powered product features within the Creatio platform: assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, knowledge systems, RAG, and semantic search. Design agent architectures - tools, memory and context strategy, orchestration, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop escalation - and choose the right pattern for each problem (single LLM call vs. tool-using agent vs. multi-agent). Engineer prompts, system instructions, and agent context as first-class artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and covered by evaluations. Integrate LLM providers, MCP servers and tools, enterprise data sources, embedding pipelines, and vector/hybrid search into the platform. Build evaluation datasets, offline and online evals, quality gates, and observability (tracing, logging, drift detection) for AI capabilities. Monitor and improve the quality, latency, cost, reliability, and security of AI capabilities in production, including prompt and model updates. Identify and mitigate AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, hallucinations, over-permissioned agents, and sensitive-data leakage. Develop and maintain backend services using C# and .NET. Use AI coding assistants and engineering agents as the default development workflow; critically review and verify agent output; contribute reusable rules, skills, and prompts to the team. Follow the AI landscape closely and bring new models, tools, and patterns to the team. Requirements Must have: Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based features to production: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context-window and cost management. Practical understanding of agent architectures (tool loops, planner/executor, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop), MCP, and at least one agent framework or SDK. Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citations, and common failure modes. Experience with AI evaluation (datasets, offline evals, LLM-as-judge), LLM observability and tracing, and AI security (prompt injection, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, Responsible AI practices). Daily proficiency with AI coding agents: the ability to direct, review, and verify agent output rather than only write code by hand. Solid experience with C# and .NET, API design, distributed systems, and software architecture. Experience with SQL databases, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-native development; Docker and basic Kubernetes. Strong knowledge of engineering best practices and production-grade software development. Nice To Have Python for prototyping, data work, and evaluation scripting. Hands-on experience with a major AI platform (Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). Experience building agent-facing tools or MCP servers. LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, evaluation gates in CI/CD, canary rollouts of prompt changes. Fine-tuning, distillation, or adapter-based model customization. Experience with Creatio or other low-code CRM platforms. What To Expect …

items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Generative AI Engineer da inserire in un progetto in ambito Energy, focalizzato sullo sviluppo di una soluzione di Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa per l'analisi e l'elaborazione di documentazione tecnica e di business. La risorsa si occuperà dello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su Large Language Models (LLM), finalizzate a estrarre, interpretare e mettere in relazione le informazioni contenute nei documenti, consentendo agli utenti di interrogare la base documentale e ottenere risposte e contenuti contestualizzati. Competenze richieste Conoscenza dei Large Language Models (LLM), delle tecniche di prompting e degli approcci di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Esperienza nello sviluppo di use case di Generative AI in ambito documentale. Familiarità con le tecniche di document parsing, chunking, embedding e vector search. Esperienza nell'integrazione di modelli LLM all'interno di applicazioni e pipeline. Buona conoscenza di Python. Conoscenza, anche parziale, dei servizi AWS per lo sviluppo di soluzioni AI/GenAI. Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (livello C1 o superiore). Competenze preferenziali Conoscenza di Amazon Bedrock. Familiarità con i servizi AWS per lo storage, la ricerca e l'indicizzazione dei dati. Conoscenza del dominio Energy & Utilities. Cosa offriamo: Inserimento in un contesto ad alto profilo tecnologico; Ambiente di lavoro giovane, dinamico e flessibile; Academy gratuita per profili junior; Formazione continua con possibilità di acquisire certificazioni professionali (Oracle, Java SE, Microsoft Azure, AWS, PMP, Project Management Professional, ecc.) e partecipare a workshop tecnici; Crescita professionale tramite un piano carriera ben strutturato; Possibilità di lavorare in Smart Working. Dettagli dell'opportunità: Sede di lavoro: Torino/Milano (modalità ibrida o full remote) Contratto: Tempo indeterminato RAL: da €24.000 a €29.000 per profili junior da €29.000 a €35.000 per profili middle da €35.000 a €43.000 per profili advanced A parità di requisiti, sarà data precedenza ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette (L. 68/99). Perché candidarsi? Ciò che ci contraddistingue è sicuramente la passione con cui svolgiamo il nostro lavoro, la sinergia che caratterizza le collaborazioni con i nostri clienti e la ricerca di nuove soluzioni per migliorare metodologie di progettazione e pianificazione. La nostra forza è basata sul Capitale Umano; crediamo fortemente nelle competenze e nelle abilità dei nostri dipendenti, che vengono seguiti passo dopo passo nel percorso di crescita personale e professionale all’interno dell’azienda. In Bit avrai modo di sentirti parte integrante dell’azienda grazie agli eventi di team building organizzati durante l’anno e alla collaborazione e disponibilità dei professionisti che ne fanno parte. Dunque, cosa aspetti? Invia il tuo CV. Ti aspettiamo! La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77).

items.desc: act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique. Présent dans 12 pays et fort de plus de 5 600 collaborateurs, nous mettons nos expertises au service de leurs enjeux en développement logiciel, cybersécurité, data, cloud et IA. Notre ambition : devenir le partenaire technologique de confiance des entreprises les plus innovantes, en concevant et sécurisant des systèmes qui renforcent leur performance et leur résilience. Rejoindre act digital France, c'est intégrer une organisation agile et engagée, qui fait avancer les projets avec ses clients pour transformer les idées en résultats concrets, avec pragmatisme et exigence. POSTE / MISSIONS Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités autour de l'IA générative, de l'IA agentique et de l'Applied AI, Act Digital France recherche un Forward Deployed Engineer. Votre mission : intervenir directement au cœur des enjeux IA de nos clients, depuis le cadrage des besoins jusqu'à la mise en production de solutions concrètes, robustes et à fort impact métier. Votre rôle Véritable référent technique senior, vous combinez vision d'architecture, compréhension métier et capacité à construire avec les équipes. Vous intervenez notamment sur : le cadrage de cas d'usage IA à forte valeur ; la définition des architectures et choix technologiques ; la conception et le développement de solutions basées sur les LLM, RAG, agents IA et architectures agentiques ; l'industrialisation, l'évaluation et la mise en production des solutions ; la définition des standards techniques et bonnes pratiques ; l'accompagnement et la montée en compétence des équipes clientes ; les échanges avec les CTO, DSI, CDO ou directions métiers sur les enjeux d'architecture, de sécurité, de risques, de coûts et de ROI. Il s'agit d'un rôle résolument hands-on : vous êtes capable de prototyper, coder, challenger une architecture et intervenir directement sur les composants critiques. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Vous avez idéalement évolué dans des fonctions de : Tech Lead / Principal Engineer ; AI Architect ; Senior Machine Learning Engineer ; CTO / VP Engineering en environnement startup ; Forward Deployed Engineer. Vous disposez d'une solide expérience en Software Engineering, Data, Machine Learning ou Intelligence Artificielle et avez déjà conçu ou industrialisé des systèmes complexes. Vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien avec les équipes techniques qu'avec des interlocuteurs de direction. Une expérience concrète de mise en production de solutions Generative AI ou Agentic AI sera particulièrement appréciée. Environnement Technique : Selon les missions : Python, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral AI, LLM open source, RAG, agents IA, vector databases, API, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, observabilité et évaluation des systèmes IA. AVANTAGES Vous rejoignez un groupe international de plusieurs milliers de collaborateurs et contribuez directement au développement de notre activité Applied AI en France. Vous interviendrez sur des projets où l'IA doit produire un impact métier mesurable, tout en participant à la construction des méthodes, architectures et standards IA d'Act Digital. Nous recherchons avant tout des profils capables de réunir excellence technique, pragmatisme, orientation métier et leadership.

Combined with the power of SapiensAIP that knowledge gives us an extraordinary opportunity to transform how insurance works, and to help build the autonomous insurer of tomorrow. This is where Advance the Possible comes in. It isn’t a programme or a new strategy. It’s our DNA. It’s about how we think, work and challenge ourselves every day. It means moving with greater urgency, questioning old ways of working and creating better outcomes for our customers. Go to https://sapiens.com to find out more. Come and join us now! PURPOSE Turn ambiguous customer problems into production AI capability, fast, as the technical half of the Value FDE and AI-FDE pair. Job Requirements 5+ years of software engineering; Python, Java, C++ or TypeScript; APIs and cloud. Hands-on LLM or agentic workflows in production (retrieval, evaluation, tool use). Engineer-diplomat with customer judgement; willing to travel to client sites. Insurance systems: policy administration, claims, billing; or our platforms. Data engineering, MLOps or security in regulated industries. How success is judged: Time to first working capability and time to production value. Quality, safety, observability and reliability; customer adoption and independence. Reuse harvested from field work; strength of the pair partnership. Job Responsibilities Ship a working capability against the live backlog in the first week where feasible, then iterate. Own the build end to end: model real data and process, design agentic workflows, integrate, evaluate, release. Build close to the people who operate the process; no requirements hand-off. Meet the Minimum Viable Autonomy bar (evaluation, observability, escalation, controls) before production. Reuse and compose existing AIP and agent capabilities; feed proven patterns to the catalogue and R&D. Leave the customer able to run, monitor and adjust what has been built. Partners one-to-one with the Value FDE. BVDE and PDE are separate roles. Bengaluru engineers back 25 of the 80 pods. Job Benefits Total target cash at the top quarter of the market, with 15% variable. Real production work with insurers, not demos, on a platform built for industry. A team that learns fast together, with a path to pod and regional leadership.

items.desc: Machine Learning - Generative AI - Python - SQL La tua nuova azienda Il nostro cliente è una multinazionale italiana leader in ambito life sciences, con una forte presenza internazionale e una lunga tradizione industriale. Negli ultimi anni ha avviato un importante percorso di trasformazione digitale, investendo in dati e tecnologie avanzate. L’azienda opera in un contesto altamente regolamentato, con standard qualitativi elevati. La struttura è organizzata su scala globale, con team cross‑funzionali. L’innovazione e l’impatto sul benessere delle persone sono al centro della sua strategia. Il tuo nuovo ruolo Per potenziare il proprio Digital Transformation Office, siamo alla ricerca di un AI Engineer che si occuperà della progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di soluzioni AI end-to-end. La figura rappresenta un punto di incontro tra data science e software engineering, seguendo l’intero lifecycle delle applicazioni AI: dalla definizione architetturale fino al monitoraggio in produzione. Il ruolo offre la possibilità di lavorare su progetti greenfield, contribuendo attivamente alla costruzione di soluzioni innovative fin dalle fasi iniziali. Nel ruolo, la risorsa riporterà direttamente al Manager di riferimento, collaborando a stretto contatto con team tecnici e stakeholder di business, all’interno di un contesto dinamico che offre interessanti opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale. Di cosa hai bisogno per aver successo Per avere successo in questo ruolo è fondamentale possedere una solida base (3-5 anni di esperienza) in ambito Machine Learning e Artificial Intelligence, con esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di pipeline di modelli end-to-end e nella gestione del loro intero ciclo di vita in produzione. La figura si occupa di progettare e sviluppare applicazioni AI e Generative AI, dalla fase di proof of concept fino alla messa in esercizio di sistemi affidabili e scalabili, adottando principi di software engineering robusti e architetture cloud-native. È richiesta una buona padronanza degli approcci MLOps e DevOps, inclusa la progettazione e manutenzione di infrastrutture per il versionamento dei modelli, pipeline automatizzate di training e retraining, sistemi di monitoraggio e gestione delle performance, nonché l’implementazione di pratiche di caratterizzazione, orchestrazione e CI/CD. Un aspetto chiave del ruolo riguarda inoltre lo sviluppo di soluzioni di Generative AI basate su Large Language Models (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e framework agentici. A questa componente si affianca una solida preparazione in software engineering, in particolare in Python, necessaria per costruire applicazioni affidabili, modulari e scalabili, insieme alla conoscenza delle principali architetture cloud e dei principi di scalabilità e resilienza. La figura collabora a stretto contatto con data scientist e team tecnici per industrializzare i modelli, garantendone riproducibilità, scalabilità e affidabilità operativa, e monitora continuamente i sistemi in produzione per identificare eventuali fenomeni di data drift o degrado delle performance, attivando azioni correttive. Chiediamo un percorso accademico pregresso triennale e magistrale in Ingegneria Matematica/Informatica/Computer Science. Completano il profilo ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, fondamentali per interagire efficacemente sia con team tecnici sia con stakeholder di business, traducendo esigenze complesse in soluzioni concrete e contribuendo alla definizione di standard, strumenti e best practice di AI engineering a livello organizzativo. Cosa avrai in cambio Avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti ad alto impatto tecnologico, contribuendo attivamente alla trasformazione digitale dell’organizzazione. Entrerai in un ambiente stimolante, con concrete possibilità di crescita professionale e sviluppo continuo delle tue competenze in ambito AI. L’AI Engineer inoltre contribuirà alla Bip xTech Data Community con attività di ricerca, scouting tecnologico, concept di nuove soluzioni e sviluppo del business sui clienti di BIP. Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, Java, e/o simili; Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi; Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository, come per esempio: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps e/o simili. Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning. Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL.
