items.desc:
Lieu : Bordeaux, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Mérignac, à proximité de Bordeaux, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. 
 Votre Quotidien 
 Basé sur le site Thales Mérignac, dans un environnement dynamique et innovant, entre océan et vignes, nous concevons et développons des systèmes, des équipements et services pour garantir le succès des missions aéroportées de nos clients.
 Vous serez au cœur de notre transformation digitale et de l'évolution de nos infrastructures cloud.
 - Site moderne à taille humaine avec espaces de travail collaboratifs
 - Activités sportives à proximité
 - Télétravail partiel
 - Horaires flexibles
 - Temps partiel envisageable
 En tant qu'Architecte Cloud Landing Zone GCP, vous serez responsable de la conception, de l'implémentation et de l'optimisation de nos landing zones et des plateformes applicatives sur GCP. 
 Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition de notre stratégie cloud et accompagnerez nos équipes dans leur adoption des meilleures pratiques. 
 Votre Profil 
 Profil expérimenté avec une formation supérieure en informatique de niveau Bac+5, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d'au moins 5 ans en architecture de systèmes d'information, dont 2 années minimum dédiées à Google Cloud Platform.
 Vous êtes certifié/certifiée GCP Professional Cloud Architect ou GCP Professional Security Engineer et possédez les compétences suivantes :
 - Expertise approfondie de Google Cloud Platform et de ses mécanismes de sécurité
 - Expérience éprouvée de build de landing zone
 - Maîtrise des services GCP : Cloud Identity, Security Command Center, Cloud KMS, Cloud HSM
 - Expérience significative en sécurité des systèmes d'information
 - Expertise en architecture Zero Trust et en solutions de chiffrement
 - Maîtrise des conteneurs sécurisés et de Kubernetes (GKE)
 - Compétences en Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) et en automatisation sécurisée
 - Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de gestion des risques
 - Leadership et capacité à porter des ateliers avec nos clients
 - Force de proposition et d'innovation
 - Excellentes qualités relationnelles et capacité à travailler avec des équipes multiculturelles
 De plus, une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais est indispensable pour interagir efficacement avec nos équipes internationales et nos partenaires.
 Une connaissance des normes et réglementations (ISO 27001, HDS, SecNumCloud) serait un plus.
 Le mot du manager 
 Au sein de la direction APC (Automation Platforms & Cloud), nous vivons une période passionnante de transformation technologique.
 Notre équipe cloud est composée d'experts talentueux et passionnés qui partagent une vision commune : construire les infrastructures de demain tout en garantissant le plus haut niveau de sécurité.
 Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité qui saura apporter sa pierre à l'édifice, partager ses connaissances et grandir avec l'équipe.
 L'environnement technique est exigeant, mais nous accordons une grande importance à l'accompagnement et au développement de chacun.
 Vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis techniques et souhaitez travailler dans un monde en mouvement sans jamais vous ennuyer ?
 Alors, ce poste est pour vous! 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

Votre mission Intégré(e) à une équipe Data & IA, vous interviendrez sur des projets analytiques de bout en bout, depuis le recueil des besoins métier jusqu'à la mise en production et l'adoption des solutions. Votre rôle sera de transformer des données complexes en produits analytiques fiables, documentés et exploitables, facilitant la prise de décision et contribuant au développement de solutions de Business Intelligence et d'Intelligence Artificielle générative. À l'interface entre les équipes métier, les experts Data et les équipes techniques, vous contribuerez à la modélisation, à la qualité et à la gouvernance des données, tout en veillant à leur bonne exploitation dans des environnements cloud. Votre objectif : faire de la donnée un véritable produit métier, fiable, accessible et réutilisable, au service de la performance et de l'innovation. Vos principales responsabilités 1. Concevoir et développer des solutions Data & Analytics Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métier afin de proposer des solutions analytiques adaptées aux enjeux opérationnels. Concevoir et optimiser des requêtes SQL complexes pour extraire, transformer et structurer les données. Développer des modèles de données robustes et évolutifs, notamment à l'aide de BigQuery et dbt. Structurer les projets dbt en intégrant les bonnes pratiques de développement, de modularité, de réutilisation et de documentation. Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports Power BI intuitifs, pertinents et orientés utilisateurs. Challenger les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) afin de garantir leur pertinence et leur adéquation avec les besoins métier. 2. Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité des données Mettre en place des dispositifs de contrôle et de tests automatisés pour assurer la qualité des données. Définir et maintenir les règles de validation, les tests dbt et les mécanismes de surveillance de la fraîcheur des données. Documenter les transformations, les modèles de données et les dépendances entre les différents traitements. Contribuer aux démarches de gouvernance des données, de traçabilité et de fiabilisation des indicateurs. Identifier les anomalies, analyser leurs causes et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées. 3. Préparer et valoriser les données pour les usages IA Structurer et préparer les données destinées à alimenter des solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle générative. Contribuer à la préparation des corpus documentaires et textuels pour les usages basés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM). Participer à l'organisation des métadonnées, au nettoyage des données et à leur structuration pour des architectures de type RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Comprendre les exigences des solutions IA en matière de qualité, de disponibilité, de contextualisation et de réutilisation des données. Collaborer avec les équipes Data & IA afin de faciliter l'exploitation des données dans les solutions analytiques et les applications intelligentes. 4. Industrialiser les développements et collaborer avec les équipes techniques Développer et maintenir les traitements analytiques dans un environnement cloud, notamment sur Google Cloud Platform. Utiliser Git pour le versionnement du code et participer aux processus de revue de code via les Merge Requests. Contribuer aux chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continus (CI/CD) pour fiabiliser les mises en production. Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement, de documentation et de maintenance des projets Data. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data Engineering, Data Factory, métiers et infrastructure pour garantir la robustesse des solutions. 5. Accompagner les métiers et favoriser l'adoption Assurer l'interface entre les utilisateurs métier et les équipes techniques. Traduire les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications analytiques et en modèles de données exploitables. Vulgariser les sujets techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs non spécialistes. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la compréhension et l'appropriation des solutions développées. …

items.desc: DEINE AUFGABEN. Als Power Platform Entwickler:in gestaltest du die digitale Zukunft bei der WBS GRUPPE aktiv mit. items.desc: Finance | Remote (Republic of Ireland) Reports to: Senior Finance Manager (SFM) Direct reports: None Location: Remote, Republic of Ireland Job type: Full-time, permanent Salary: Competitive, plus bonus About Medihive Medihive is Ireland's longest-standing telehealth provider and a Deloitte Fast 50 company, built on deep clinical and technical expertise. Backed by leading private and institutional investors, we have recently raised capital to accelerate our growth in digital healthcare. We have a big vision, and we're just getting started. The role This is a varied role spanning management reporting, FP&A and commercial business partnering. As part of a small, remote finance team, you will own budgeting, forecasting and analysis, and work with department heads to turn financial insight into clear business decisions. Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite is essential. Key responsibilities Month end and reporting Support the month-end close, including general ledger and balance sheet reconciliations. Lead departmental variance analysis (actual vs forecast vs prior year), with clear commentary on trends, risks and opportunities. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, and support the Senior Finance Manager with senior leadership and board packs. Planning and analysis Prepare the annual budget and rolling forecasts with heads of department, and hold budget holders to account for performance against plan. Prepare the weekly cash flow forecast and monitor working capital. Develop commercial pricing and financial models to support decision-making and long-term strategic planning. Analyse key metrics and share insight with the relevant teams. Business partnering Support SFM in preparation of financial reports and presentations for senior leadership and key stakeholders. Provide regular financial updates to management, ensuring they are informed of financial performance, risks, and opportunities. Partner with Clinical Operations, Commercial, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and support decision-making. Support ad hoc projects across finance and the wider business. S ystems and process improvement Support the use of automation, AI and analytics tools, including Power BI dashboards, to improve reporting and insight. Continuous improvement of our forecasting and budgeting process. Build a deep understanding of our financial processes, including month end close. Support financial systems and AI projects, working with IT to implement and improve platforms. About you Essential Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 3–5 years' experience in FP&A, management accounting or financial analysis. Strong working knowledge of FRS 102. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with experience of budgeting, forecasting and scenario analysis. Hands-on experience with Power BI and finance systems. NetSuite experience, including involvement in ERP migration projects. A commercial, analytical mindset and strong attention to detail. A confident communicator who can explain complex financial information to senior and non-finance audiences. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment. Desirable Experience in a technology, healthtech or high-growth business. Knowledge of IFRS. Personal Attributes Strong problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail and accuracy. Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently. Ability to think strategically and translate financial data into actionable insights. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across the organisation. Adapts easily to a changing environment and responsibilities based on the organisational needs. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, and managing competing priorities Benefits Competitive salary and bonus. 22 days’ annual leave plus statutory public holidays. Pension scheme after probation (3% employer, 3% employee). Laya Healthcare group scheme (10% off health insurance, 50% off dental) and free access to Laya's digital gym. Free Webdoctor appointments for you and your immediate family. Fully remote, flexible working (core hours 10am–4pm) Apple Mac supplied, plus €250 towards your home office set-up if required. Bike to Work and TaxSaver travel schemes. 24-hour confidential Employee Assistance Programme. Access to First Tech Credit Union. Learning through Skillnet and TalentLMS. Virtual sports and social group, and active CSR campaigns.

Experience with RAG is useful, but this isn't a role for someone whose experience is primarily connecting APIs together with LangChain or similar frameworks. The role is 4 days a week hybrid in London and is paying up to the £110k + bonus mark on the top of the band. If interested, please apply or email me directly at tomasz@virtuetech.io

items.title: Security Engineer, Bridge
items.card: What you'll do We're hiring a Security Engineer to build and scale the Bridge security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design a security program from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry. Responsibilities Design and implement the Bridge security roadmap from first principles to production.
items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.
 We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.
 What you'll do
 We're hiring a Security Engineer to build and scale the Bridge security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design a security program from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry.
 Responsibilities
 Design and implement the Bridge security roadmap from first principles to production.
 Identify and tackle the most important Bridge security risks quickly and pragmatically.
 Integrate with Stripe infrastructure where it makes sense, and find custom solutions where it doesn't.
 Lead threat modeling and hardening efforts for the Bridge money movement systems in collaboration with crypto and infra teams.
 Build key security capabilities, including monitoring, secrets management, incident response, access controls, and CI/CD hardening.
 Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure.
 Ensure Bridge meets compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and the Stripe security organization to move fast without compromising safety.
 Who you are
 Minimum requirements
 8+ years of experience in Security engineering.
 Experience building or scaling security programs at a startup or in an embedded role.
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience in fast-paced startup environments, building security practices from the ground up.
 Startup mindset—scrappy, pragmatic, and quick to solve the most critical problems.
 Comfort writing and debugging backend application code, with Ruby experience preferred.
 Comfort with ambiguity and ability to ruthlessly prioritize.
 Ability to balance security rigor with speed, especially in fast-moving environments.
 Clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Interest in the potential of crypto and stablecoins to power global financial infrastructure.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Als Scientist Measurement Engineering Electronics (m/w/d) leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu unserer Vision: der nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Patient:innen weltweit. In Deiner Rolle bringst Du Deine Expertise in Messtechnik, Elektronik und elektrochemischen Messverfahren ein, um innovative kontinuierliche Monitoringsysteme (Continuous Glucose Monitoring / CGM) weiterzuentwickeln. Damit hilfst Du, neue diabetesrelevante Parameter und Begleiterkrankungen präzise zu erfassen und bahnbrechende medizintechnische Lösungen für die Praxis zu realisieren
 Dein neues Team: 
 Du wirst Teil unserer Abteilung Sterile Unit Design / Interface am Standort Mannheim. Wir sind ein dynamisches, interdisziplinäres Team, das mit Leidenschaft an den Sensor- und Messtechnologien der Zukunft arbeitet. Bei uns erwarten Dich eine offene Feedbackkultur, Vertrauen und der gemeinsame Wille, die Grenzen des technisch Machbaren im Sinne der Patient:innen zu erweitern.
 Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich 
 Deine Mission ist die messtechnische Weiterentwicklung sowie das Design robuster, regulatorisch konformer Mess- und Sensortechnologien. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben: 
 Du planst und steuerst Fach- und Teilprojekte (inklusive Ressourcen, Budget und Investitionen/Capex) eigenverantwortlich unter Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards. 
 Du gestaltest und erprobst neuartige Messtechnologien sowie Breadboards im Labor- und Technikumsmaßstab gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern und bewertest deren Funktionalität systematisch. 
 Du entwickelst messtechnische Systeme, Methoden und Prozesse stetig weiter und nutzt moderne Simulationswerkzeuge (z. B. SPICE), um die Entwicklungsleistung zu optimieren. 
 Du wertest Versuchsergebnisse mit mathematischen Methoden aus, dokumentierst diese normgerecht und präsentierst Deine Ergebnisse überzeugend in Gremien. 
 Du bringst Dein Know-how in Analog Frontends, Ultra-Low-Power-Architekturen sowie RF-Design ein und bewertest neue Detektionsansätze für zukünftige Messplattformen. 
 Du arbeitest eng mit internationalen Lieferanten sowie Entwicklungspartnern zusammen und bringst Dich aktiv in agilen Projektteams (z. B. nach SAFe) ein. 
 Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit 
 Wir suchen eine neugierige, zielstrebige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist und Freude an komplexen interdisziplinären Fragestellungen. Du verknüpfst technologische Exzellenz mit einer klaren Lösungsorientierung. Du bringst folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit: 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik (Master of Science oder vergleichbarer Abschluss). 
 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung, vorzugsweise im medizinischen oder sensorischen Umfeld. 
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Messtechnik, Elektronik und Analog Frontends für Multi-Analyt-Sensoren im In-Vivo-Einsatz. 
 Erfahrung mit Ultra-Low-Power-Embedded-Architekturen (Hardware/Software), elektrochemischen Verfahren (z. B. EIS, SWV, CV) sowie im Requirements Engineering. 
 Vertrauter Umgang mit CAD- und SPICE-Simulationstools sowie Kenntnisse in RF-Design und -Optimierung. 
 Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden (z. B. SAFe) sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams 
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift 
 Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. 
 Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 02.11.2026 
 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) 
 Deine Bewerbung 
 Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch. 
 Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches. 
 Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! 
 Your contact to us! With people. For people.
 Do you need further support?
 Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Méthodes et Performance Maintenance (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) basé à Toulouse, France. 
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe passionnée et engagée , en charge du pôle Maintenance et Moyens Industriels . Au sein de la plus grande salle blanche d'Europe dédiée à la fabrication de satellites, vous serez impliqué(e) dans le pilotage et l'optimisation des méthodes de maintenance visant à maximiser la fiabilité, la disponibilité et la compétitivité de notre parc d'équipements industriels de haute technologie. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Vos activités s'articulent autour de 4 grands axes : 
 1. Déploiement du projet de maintenance industrielle et digitale : 
 Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle solution de Gestion de la Maintenance Assistée par Ordinateur (GMAO) pour le pilotage et la planification des opérations préventives et correctives. 
 Intégrer les nouvelles technologies et assurer une veille technologique (ex. maintenance prédictive, Intelligence Artificielle / IA). 
 2. Démarche d'amélioration continue et démarche TPM : 
 Piloter le projet de Maintenance Productive Totale (TPM - Total Productive Maintenance ) afin d'ancrer une culture de maintenance autonome et d'en assurer la montée en maturité. 
 Accompagner et former les équipes opérationnelles pour garantir l'adhésion aux nouvelles méthodes de travail et mesurer les gains de compétitivité obtenus. 
 3. Analyse de la fiabilité et plans de maintenance : 
 Mettre à jour les plans de maintenance en lien avec l'ensemble des experts techniques et opérationnels. 
 Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et de fiabilité, tout en réalisant l'analyse des causes racines en cas de dysfonctionnement ou de panne. 
 4. Communication et suivi de la performance : 
 Présenter les résultats et avancements lors des commissions d'amélioration continue et des audits clients externes pour valoriser l'excellence industrielle du site. 
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Votre profil : 
 Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en amélioration continue, performance industrielle, ingénierie de maintenance ou gestion de systèmes de production. 
 Solides connaissances des méthodes de maintenance industrielle (TPM, maintenance préventive/corrective) et des outils digitaux de Gestion de la Maintenance Assistée par Ordinateur (GMAO). 
 Maîtrise du pilotage de projet, des démarches de résolution de problèmes et de la gestion des indicateurs de performance. 
 Excellentes qualités relationnelles, sens du service, écoute et capacité à communiquer avec pédagogie auprès d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. 
 Niveau d'anglais avancé et français couramment maîtrisé (niveau négociation) pour échanger dans un environnement international.

 Des déplacements professionnels ponctuels sont à prévoir et, de ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).

 CANDIDATES THAT WOULD IMPRESS US
You graduated with a Master of Engineering, Computer Science or any relevant field in University, and you have significant experience in project management
You appreciate to be a team-player and enjoy collaborative work (co-engineering)
You are recognised as a self-motivated leader, willing to engage and develop your team using collaborative work and challenging approaches
You are analytical, dynamic and autonomous
You are an effective communicator
COMPETENCIES:
You know how to use your skills to plan, organise teams, and guarantee the follow-up of engineering projects by respecting deadlines, costs and quality with a clear vision of risks and opportunities
You have good knowledge of subcontract and work package management
You have proven experience in coordination of various technical activities
You know how to produce synthetic and quality reports
You have outstanding problem-solving skills and a passion to solve hard problems
You can demonstrate knowledge in financial, workload plan and risks management
You are familiar with bidding process
LIFE AS A THALES ENGINEERING WORK PACKAGE MANAGEMENT ROLE
As an Engineering Work Package Management Role within Thales, you will be responsible for:
Work Package Organisation and Planning:
Author the Work Package Description with the WP team based on the project structure regarding the entity/Customer requirements
Identify deliverables, milestones and interdependencies with other WP’s
Establish the schedule and the estimates based on a viable solution, and identify the necessary resources and their availability
Initialise the risk and opportunity register and the work package baseline using the relevant key project tools
Where applicable obtain commitments from suppliers
Work Package Launch:
Establish a network diagram and a detailed schedule which is aligned with the project master schedule
Define the cost structure, resource profiles, supplier selection and the relevant metrics to monitor the WP
Write relevant plans within the WP scope
Work Package Execution:
Achieve the objectives of the Work Package and take the necessary management actions to correct any deviation from the baseline or objectives
Identifying and solving issues, managing the risks and opportunities and performing mitigation activities
Work Package Monitoring and Control:
Review document, specifications, schedule and estimate files using peers where necessary
Monitor & consolidate all deliverables
Update the schedule, risk & opportunities register, the ETC & EAC
Consolidate the work package dashboard and lead progress meetings
Report as per the PMP and escalate to the PM any variances or key issues
Quality of Deliverables:
The WPM is responsible for the quality of the delivered products, services and documentation within the project committed time and budget and in the scope of the work package
The WPM ensures that all configuration items within the WP scope are managed (could be done by a configuration manager)
Key Stakeholder Relations:
Lead the team and/or suppliers involved to perform the work package and ensures the respect of all commitments
Participate and input to all relevant project reviews as specified in the PMP
Act, where required, as PM delegate to the Client.
Act, where required, as the Thales representative for sub-contracted work
Capture of Lessons Learned:
The WPM must collect, analyse and synthesise the strengths and weaknesses during the performance of the work package, propose recommendations for improvement and record these as prescribed in the PMP
Work Package Closure:
The WPM must ensure that all the commitments taken in his work package description sheet have been honoured by collating all WP data, costs and estimates, recording them and then organise a closure review

Room and attention to personal development

items.desc:
Company: 
Qualcomm France S.A.R.L. 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering 
 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm’s Data Center AI Architecture team defines next-generation cloud AI system-on-chip (SoC) and systems for generative AI inference workloads that demand exceptional compute, memory bandwidth, capacity, and system scalability.
 We are seeking exceptional architects to help shape multiple generations of AI accelerators and complete data center systems, with a strong focus on SoC, memory, and system architecture and technologies.
 If you are passionate about solving complex architecture challenges in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while contributing to building a substantial new business for one of the leading system-on-chip and computer architecture companies in the industry, we want to hear from you.
 Role Description: 
 In this role, you will:
 Partner across architecture, design, systems, product, software, platform, and customer teams to deliver market-leading data center systems
 Translate product and workload requirements into SoC and system specifications, and drive feature-set requirements into technology, IP, platform, and software teams

Collaborate closely with hardware and software teams, as well as architecture and system engineering teams, to understand IP functionality and system-level use cases to define features, interfaces and integrate digital blocks.
items.desc:
Business Line Description: 
 Advanced Chip Engineering Digital IP team defines and develops components for a wide range of products, including automotive microprocessors, application processors, micro-controllers, and networking. The Munich Digital IP team develops interface components, DSP subsystems, next generation AI/ML core and RISCV IPs.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Develop and implement digital IP and logic designs for complex Mixed-Signal System-on-Chips (SoCs), adhering to architectural specifications and performance requirements.
 Collaborate closely with hardware and software teams, as well as architecture and system engineering teams, to understand IP functionality and system-level use cases to define features, interfaces and integrate digital blocks.
 Develop high-quality, area-optimal, low-power RTL design using industry-standard hardware description languages (Verilog/SystemVerilog)
 Complete design quality checks such as Lint, CDC/RDC, etc. using industry-standard tools.
 Conduct IP-level design verification activities, including basic testbench development, simulation and debugging to ensure functional correctness.
 Complete IP synthesis and basic timing analysis to meet timing, area and power targets.
 Ensure IP design implementation is done according to design for testability (DFT) requirements.
 Generate comprehensive design documentation and participate in design reviews.
 Troubleshoot and resolve design issues throughout the development lifecycle.
 Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and methodologies in digital design.
 Qualification: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
 Minimum 10 years of experience in IP or subsystem design.
 Solid understanding of microprocessor architecture, interconnects, and cache coherency mechanisms.
 Hands-on experience with CPU design (proprietary cores, RISC-V, or AI/ML accelerators).
 Experience in using AI-based tools to enhance development and design efficiency.
 Experience with AMBA protocols (AHB, AXI, ACE, CHI) and memory systems (ROM, RAM, Flash, DDR/LPDDR).
 Advanced knowledge of Verilog, SystemVerilog, and C/C++.
 Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, or Shell.
 Experience in debugging designs in both pre-silicon (simulation/emulation/FPGA) and post-silicon environments.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Basic conversational German is a plus.
 Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary 
 More information about NXP in Germany...

items.desc:
Role highlights 
 QMS Specialist 
 Location: Spain
 Department: GMO – Manufacturing Assurance
 Reports to: Global QMS Manager
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: On-site
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters 
 The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices.
 This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
 As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.
 ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Ensure ICEYE Quality Management System is fully implemented in our Valencia facility
 Drive ICEYE production framework maturity increase in Valencia - be the subject matter expert for QMS, QA, Support Health and safety and environmental topics.
 Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and industry requirements, serve as the main point of contact for auditors and certification bodies.
 Act as an internal auditor in our internal process audits covering quality and supporting EHS topics.
 Ensure controlled documentation rigor in Valencia operations
 Define and track quality KPIs; prepare and present regular performance reports to leadership.
 Provide training and coaching on QMS processes, standards, and quality tools; promote a culture of quality throughout the organization.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 5+ years in quality, engineering, operations, compliance, or process improvement roles.
 Strong experience with digital QMS systems and data-driven improvement methods.
 Strong knowledge of QMS standards (ISO 9001 required; AS9100, AQAP2110, PECAL or similar beneficial)
 Experience with quality tools and risk management (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments).
 Audit experience, either as an internal auditor or supporting external certification
 Adaptability and a real willingness to learn; comfortable in a fast-paced, agile production environment where processes are still taking shape
 Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills
 Ability to drive cross-functional alignment and work independently with minimal supervision
 Professional fluency in both English and Spanish
 Nice to haves: 
 Degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, or related field.
 Knowledge of AS9100, AQAP 2110, PECAL, or ISO 27001
 Multi-site or international corporate experience
 Background in defence tech, aerospace, advanced manufacturing, or automotive
 Experience with quality tools and risk management methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments). If you bring the right mindset, we can build these with you.
 Application Process 
 TA interview
 Hiring Manager video interview
 Home task + task review interview
 Final onsite interviews

 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. At Alan, we want people to find the right product to take care of themselves, as early and as easily as possible. Getting a new pair of glasses usually means an appointment, a lost prescription, 47 frames tried on in a store, and a two-week delay. Most people put it off for months. The Shop is how Alan members get glasses, lenses and well-being products in a few clicks, covered by their insurance when possible. Most e-commerce teams are incentivized to sell more. We're incentivized to get members the right product at the right time for their health. We're looking for a fullstack engineer to join the Shop crew. One brief: help our members choose what is right for them, when it is right for them, in a few clicks. Everything else, we figure out together. About the Shop crew The Shop crew is a fully autonomous product team that owns the whole lifecycle of the Shop: not just the code, but the whole business. Product managers, product marketers, ops specialists, designers, data scientists and engineers work side by side on one mission. What we've built so far: An end-to-end optics experience: frames and lenses, virtual try-on, prescription scanning, and checkout priced against each member's coverage. One commerce platform behind the whole Shop and its three verticals. A growing well-being catalog: about 14 brands and 170 products today, thousands soon. The Shop is growing fast: more products, smoother flows, and an experience that's more and more integrated into the rest of Alan for our members. The crew needs to grow too, and that means plenty of new opportunities for engineers. What you'll do The Shop is one of the most varied crews in Alan Engineering. In the same week, you might: Build integrations with our customized e-commerce back office, our in-house virtual try-on, suppliers and partner opticians. Ship member-facing flows: dynamic catalogs, purchase flows tailored to each member's coverage, prescription scanning, returns, and out-of-pocket purchases like lens upgrades and extra pairs. Scale the catalog beyond optics, with discovery and personalized navigation that still work at thousands of products. Navigate legal ground: e-commerce rules, invoicing, France's 100% Santé reform, and supplier compliance. Selling medical devices is not like selling socks. Help products reach members in the Alan app, in campaigns, and through Mo, our AI health assistant. A shop that can't promote its products is just a warehouse. Work with ops on orders, deliveries and customer service, so a two-day delay never surprises a member. You won't just write code. You'll question supplier contracts, debate marketing copy, and debug prescription-scanning logic. Some days it feels less like building software and more like running a small business. That's the point. And the impact is direct: when someone orders their glasses faster, they literally see better, sooner. What we're looking for 8+ years building scalable software, with full-stack experience across backend and frontend. A strong product mindset. You want to understand the why before the how, and you enjoy working with members, ops, legal and marketing. Ownership from start to finish: you frame the problem, ship the solution, and watch the numbers afterwards. Comfort with ambiguity and complex problems. You help shape the scope instead of waiting for a spec. Clear communication with non-engineers, in English (French is a plus, since our first market is France). Humility, curiosity, and a real interest in making healthcare more accessible. Bonus points Experience with e-commerce: catalogs, checkout, payments, order management, or a headless commerce platform like Saleor. Curiosity about where e-commerce meets healthcare. Experience with mobile (React Native) or with LLM-powered product features. How we work Our stack: React and React Native on the frontend, …

items.desc: Smart Energies est un producteur indépendant d’énergies renouvelables en très forte croissance issu d’un groupe familial qui développe, construit, finance et exploite des centrales de production d’énergies renouvelables (essentiellement solaires photovoltaïques en toiture) en France et en Europe. Le groupe a aujourd’hui en portefeuille plus de 500 centrales photovoltaïques en exploitation ou en construction représentant environ 140 MWc de puissance installée (toitures de bâtiments et ombrières de parking). Grâce à une première levée de fonds réalisée en 2022, le groupe s’est rapidement développé à l’international avec l’ouverture de nouveaux bureaux en Italie et en Grèce. De nouvelles activités telles que le stockage d’énergie ou les petites centrales solaires au sol sont venues compléter l’activité principale. Smart Energies compte aujourd’hui près de 100 salariés pour un pipeline de plus de 300 MW d’ici à 2028. items.desc: Architecte Technologies IA – Large Language Models (LLM) Vous êtes En tant qu’AI/LLM Architect opérationnel ( hands-on ), vous serez au cœur de la conception et du développement de systèmes d’IA avancés qui alimentent les entreprises modernes. Il s’agit d’un rôle hautement technique et pratique dans lequel vous consacrerez la majorité de votre temps à l’architecture et à l’ingénierie de solutions d’IA réelles couvrant le machine learning traditionnel, l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, dans le cadre de missions clients actives. Vous traduirez les besoins métier en décisions d’architecture concrètes, en sélectionnant les bons patterns de conception, en évaluant et benchmarkant les frameworks techniques, en assemblant des composants réutilisables et en réalisant des choix technologiques réfléchis qui équilibrent innovation et fiabilité de niveau entreprise ( enterprise-grade ). Vous concevrez et développerez des architectures d’agents IA, incluant l’orchestration multi-agents, l’utilisation d’outils ( tool use ), les skills et les systèmes de mémoire, tout en travaillant directement avec des foundation models via le fine-tuning , le Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) et l’intégration de modèles personnalisés. Une part importante de votre travail consistera également à concevoir et mettre en œuvre la couche de contexte IA ( AI Context Layer ) qui rend ces systèmes réellement intelligents en production. Vous connecterez des bases de connaissances d’entreprise, des sources de données structurées et non structurées ainsi que des contenus métiers spécifiques afin de garantir que les réponses générées soient fiables, pertinentes et alignées sur les enjeux du client. Vous concevrez et validerez les systèmes vis-à-vis des exigences non fonctionnelles de l’entreprise, notamment en matière de sécurité, d’observabilité, de gouvernance, de performance et de scalabilité. L’un des principaux livrables de ce rôle est la production d’artefacts d’architecture et d’ingénierie concrets. Cela signifie que vous développerez et prendrez en charge des composants logiciels en tant que praticien, en construisant, intégrant et testant des modules de systèmes d’IA, tout en produisant des documents d’architecture détaillés tels que les Architecture Decision Records (ADR), les diagrammes de composants, les diagrammes de flux de données ( data flow diagrams ) et les spécifications d’intégration qui serviront de référence aux équipes d’ingénierie. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires composées de Data Engineers, ML Engineers et développeurs applicatifs. Ce poste représente une excellente opportunité de développer une expertise approfondie sur l’ensemble de la stack d’architecture IA, d’affiner vos réflexes d’ingénierie sur des problématiques complexes et concrètes, et de construire une trajectoire de carrière vers un rôle de Lead Architect ou Principal Architect. Vos missions Concevoir, développer et livrer de manière autonome des composants logiciels couvrant l’ensemble de l’architecture IA, en prenant la responsabilité de bout en bout du design, du développement, de l’intégration et des tests. Concevoir et développer des architectures d’agents IA, incluant les agents individuels, leurs prompts, outils et skills, l’orchestration multi-agents ainsi que les systèmes de mémoire, tout en réalisant des choix réfléchis de patterns d’architecture et de technologies. Concevoir et implémenter des modèles d’orchestration d’agents capables de gérer les transferts de tâches, la communication, la gestion des états et la reprise après erreur, puis les valider à travers des prototypes opérationnels. Évaluer plusieurs options de conception et approches techniques afin de prendre des décisions d’architecture justifiées, équilibrant fonctionnalités, coût, performance et fiabilité de niveau entreprise. Concevoir, développer et exécuter des stratégies d’évaluation permettant de mesurer la qualité des agents et des systèmes sur des critères tels que l’exactitude ( accuracy ), la pertinence ( relevance ) et la fidélité ( faithfulness ), puis transformer ces résultats en améliorations de conception. Architecturer et implémenter l’intégration de foundation models, en sélectionnant les modèles, méthodes d’invocation et approches de personnalisation ( fine-tuning , RAG, intégrations personnalisées) les plus adaptés selon les compromis entre performance, coût et capacités. Concevoir et développer des pipelines d’adaptation et de fine-tuning des modèles en appliquant une bonne compréhension des architectures basées sur les Transformers afin d’optimiser le choix et les performances des modèles. Concevoir et développer la couche de contexte IA ( AI Context Layer ), incluant la conception de graphes de contexte et de pipelines d’ingestion capables d’analyser, segmenter ( chunk ), enrichir et indexer des contenus structurés ou non structurés issus de l’entreprise, ainsi que les composants de recherche permettant d’ancrer les réponses IA …

items.desc: Chef·fe de produit Confiance Numérique en CDI au sein d'AFNOR Certification Le Pôle Confiance Numérique d’AFNOR Certification se développe et recrute un·e chef·fe de produit opérationnel·le Confiance Numérique : Au sein d’une équipe experte et passionnée, vous aurez la responsabilité d’un portefeuille de prestations dans le domaine de la sécurité de l’information (cyber, cloud…). Vous évoluez dans un environnement international et réalisez des missions stratégiques pour nos clients Grands Comptes. Vos rôles et missions : En tant qu’Architecte Sécurité du Cloud, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la conception et la sécurisation des architectures hybrides et multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.) pour des environnements critiques. Vous intervenez à la croisée de la stratégie, de la gouvernance et de l’intégration technique afin de garantir la conformité, la résilience et la sécurité des systèmes d’information clients. Stratégie et gouvernance sécurité cloud : Vous élaborez et maintenez les politiques de sécurité cloud (Zero Trust et accès conditionnés, IAM/PAM et gestion des privilèges, politiques pour la protection des données, politique de segmentation, inspection des flux et filtrage). Vous contribuez à la définition et au déploiement de stratégies de conformité (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, RGPD, SecNumCloud, NIS2). Vous garantissez la cohérence entre les environnements on-premise, cloud public et services managés. Conformité et gestion des risques : Vous identifiez les risques des architectures Cloud, vous pilotez les audits et vous définissez les plans de remédiation adaptés vis-à-vis des risques et des menaces. Conseil et accompagnement : Vous accompagnez les clients dans leur transformation sécurisée vers le cloud et vous participez aux comités de validation, gouvernance et certification. Ce que nous vous proposons : Un accord télétravail pour télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine selon vos missions. Un package avantages intéressants : une mutuelle, un CSE, des titres restaurants, un accord d’intéressement, des primes vacances et cooptation. Des opportunités de carrières multiples : plus de 30 familles de métiers, autant de passerelles à imaginer ensemble. Des centaines de formations pour développer vos compétences et évoluer au sein du Groupe. Des plateformes de formations en autonomie pour préparer vos certifications et accompagner votre développement personnel. La possibilité de s'engager auprès de notre fondation ou de notre partenaire « Vendredi ». L'opportunité de rejoindre le collectif Tech'Me UP (formations, conférences, veille, et bien plus encore…). Qualifications Votre profil Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs ou équivalent, vous disposez d’une expérience d’au moins 5 ans en architecture cloud et cybersécurité. items.desc: Your Mission At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together. As a hands-on AI/LLM Architect, you will be at the heart of designing and building advanced AI systems that power the modern enterprise. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role — you will spend the majority of your time in the architecture and engineering of real-world AI solutions across classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems, delivering these within active client engagements. You will translate requirements into concrete architecture decisions: selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking technical frameworks, assembling reusable components, and making deliberate technology choices that balance innovation with enterprise-grade reliability. You will design and build AI agent architectures — including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, skills use, and memory systems — and work hands-on with foundation models through fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom model integration. A part of your work will also involve engineering the AI context layer that makes these systems intelligent in practice — connecting enterprise knowledge bases, structured and unstructured data sources, and domain-specific content so that AI outputs are grounded, accurate, and relevant to the client's business. You will design and validate systems against enterprise non-functional requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. A core output of this role is the production of tangible engineering and architecture deliverables. This means writing and owning software components — building, integrating, and testing AI system modules as a practitioner — alongside producing detailed architecture artifacts including architecture decision records (ADRs), component diagrams, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications that guide and enable broader engineering teams. You will work with cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, and this role is an opportunity to develop deep expertise across the full AI architecture stack, sharpen your engineering instincts on complex, real-world problems, and build a foundation for growing into a lead or principal architect over time. Your Daily Work Independently design, build, and deliver software components across the AI architecture — owning them end to end from design through implementation, integration, and testing as a hands-on practitioner Design and build AI agent architectures — including individual agents, their prompts, tools, and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and memory systems — making deliberate design pattern and technology choices Design and implement agent orchestration patterns that handle task handoffs, communication, state management, and error recovery, validating them through hands-on prototyping Evaluate multiple design options and technical approaches, making deliberate, justified design choices that balance capability, cost efficiency, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability Design, build, and run evaluation strategies and harnesses that measure agent and system quality on metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, translating findings into design improvements Architect and implement foundation model integrations — selecting the right models, invocation patterns, and customization approaches (fine-tuning, RAG, custom integration) based on capability, cost, and performance trade-offs Design and build model adaptation and fine-tuning pipelines, applying working knowledge of transformer-based architectures to inform model selection and optimization Design and build the AI context layer — including context graph design and ingestion pipelines that parse, chunk, enrich, and index structured and unstructured enterprise content, and the retrieval components that ground AI outputs in the client's knowledge Build embedding, vector storage, and retrieval (semantic, hybrid, reranking) into end-to-end RAG pipelines, applying integration patterns that connect to enterprise data sources Design and implement context assembly and memory components that manage prompts, context windows, and conversational state for grounded, accurate outputs Identify, design, and build reusable components and solution patterns that accelerate delivery and can be templated across engagements Design for cost efficiency and performance — optimizing items.desc: About the client and the challenge Our client is a global leader in passenger information systems — the displays, on-board computers, and real-time data platforms that tell millions of passengers when their bus, tram, or train arrives, in vehicles and terminals across Europe and North America. Having grown through multiple acquisitions across Europe, the client now operates a mixed landscape: transit fleets running hardware and backend systems from different acquired vendors — some brand new, some deeply legacy. Their strategic goal is to consolidate everything onto one unified cloud platform capable of managing both new and legacy systems, without disrupting vehicles in daily service. The first engagement is the migration of a legacy real-time transit system to the unified platform: re-implementing industry data protocols (real-time vehicle feeds, timetable imports, on-board device communication) as cloud services. More migration and modernization initiatives of similar shape will follow — this role is designed to lead them. About the role We are looking for a Tech Lead / Solutions Architect to become the long-term technical owner of this account at N-iX — not a per-project consultant. Requests from the client are often broad or abstract ("we need to migrate this system") and the concrete scope has to be discovered : investigate the legacy landscape, define what actually needs to be done, shape it into a roadmap and technical backlog, then guide delivery. This makes the role as much about bridging the business and technical worlds as about architecture itself: you'll translate business intent into technical direction and technical reality back into business language the client's leadership can act on. You will build and hold a holistic, cross-project view of the client's ecosystem — how their platforms, legacy systems, and initiatives interconnect — becoming the ultimate knowledge holder on the N-iX side and the client's trusted technical counterpart. As the current project completes, you will carry that context into the next initiatives and act as the technical driver of the whole account. Technology landscape: the legacy systems to be migrated are written mostly in C# and C++ (with Java present elsewhere in the client's ecosystem); the target platform is built in Python on Azure , with an MQTT-centric, event-driven architecture. You won't be supporting the legacy code — you'll be reading and dissecting it to migrate it. Responsibilities: Own solution architecture across the account: from ambiguous requests to investigated scope, target architecture, roadmap, and estimated technical backlog Lead technical discovery of legacy systems and define migration strategies to the target platform Act as the client's primary technical counterpart: workshops, architectural decisions, trade-off discussions with their engineering leadership and domain experts Guide the development team day to day: architecture and code reviews, technical standards, unblocking design decisions; hands-on coding when it matters most (PoCs, critical components) Own and maintain system documentation: architecture decisions, protocol specifications, and migration knowledge — kept current as delivery reveals gaps, so account knowledge lives in artifacts, not only in heads Safeguard the integrity of the overall platform architecture (event-driven, MQTT as the single source of truth, adapter-based integrations) across teams and initiatives Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities across projects; feed them into account planning together with delivery and engagement managers Drive AI adoption & strategic application: Proactively identify high-ROI opportunities across the engagement where AI tools can accelerate discovery, reverse-engineering, and delivery; advise client stakeholders and N-iX teams on where, when, and how to deploy AI safely and effectively Requirements: 8+ years in software engineering, 3+ years in a solution architect / tech lead role on complex backend or integration-heavy systems Proven experience leading legacy modernization / platform migration programs, including working with codebases you didn't write A software engineer's mindset rather than a single-language identity: we're not looking for "a C# engineer" or "a Python engineer," but someone ready to deep-dive into unfamiliar legacy codebases (C#, C++, Java) for migration purposes and design their replacements in the target stack (Python) Proven experience as a bridge between business and engineering: comfortable in front of C-level and product stakeholders as much as in a codebase, able to drive decisions on both sides Hands-on AI-augmented workflow & advocacy: Proven personal track record of integrating AI tools into your daily engineering practice, with the initiative and credibility to champion AI adoption across development teams, set standards and review guardrails, and mentor engineers on getting the most out of AI assistance. At Verisure, we are expanding our digital services offering and looking for a Proposition Management Associate to join our team in Madrid. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing, launching, and scaling new consumer-facing digital services across Europe and Latin America. You will be involved throughout the product journey, from identifying opportunities and shaping new propositions to driving go-to-market activities, measuring performance, and continuously improving the customer experience. We are looking for someone with a strong entrepreneurial mindset, hands-on experience launching B2C digital products or services, and the curiosity and drive to challenge existing ways of working. If you enjoy taking ownership, turning ideas into action, and working in an international environment where you can make a tangible impact, this could be the opportunity for you. About the Role As our Proposition Management Associate, you will work closely with the Proposition Domain Manager for Digital and the wider Proposition Management Team to identify, develop, and bring innovative digital services to market. Our ambition is to expand our digital services offering, exploring new ways to create value for customers and reach new audiences beyond our traditional product portfolio. We are entering an exciting phase where we are bringing new digital propositions to market, both as part of our existing customer offering and as standalone services available to a wider audience. You will play an important role in defining how these services reach customers, supporting customer acquisition and activation, and helping establish the right commercial strategies and performance indicators to drive future growth. The role combines elements of digital product management, proposition development, and go-to-market execution , offering the opportunity to influence both the development of new features and how our services are positioned and launched. Working across multiple markets and alongside international teams, you will help build and evolve digital propositions that can scale across different geographies, customer segments, and technology platforms. What You'll Be Doing Drive digital product launches: Support the development and launch of new B2C digital products and services, from initial concept through go-to-market execution and ongoing improvement. Shape compelling propositions: Identify customer needs and market opportunities, translating insights into attractive and commercially viable digital services. Develop go-to-market strategies: Work closely with commercial and market teams to define how new services are introduced, promoted, and adopted by customers, including both standalone and existing portfolio offerings. Drive customer acquisition and activation: Identify opportunities to attract new users, improve onboarding and activation, and create the foundation for long-term engagement and revenue growth. Contribute to product development: Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product owners, developers, and architecture teams to shape new features and continuously improve existing solutions. Measure and optimise performance: Define and monitor relevant KPIs related to acquisition, activation, customer engagement, commercial performance, and user experience, using data to guide decisions. Support international expansion: Contribute to the launch and evolution of digital services across European and Latin American markets, adapting propositions to different customer needs and market conditions. Collaborate across functions: Build strong relationships with colleagues across technology, design, marketing, operations, legal, and commercial teams to ensure successful product delivery. Ensure accurate and timely clinical documentation in line with your professional Code and Trust policy. Develop and maintain specialist clinical skills and expertise in the assessment and treatment of people with mental health needs. items.desc:
Jinto , déploie l’IA Claude d’Anthropic là où elle a le plus d’impact : dans les fonctions de gestion des entreprises. 
 Notre mission : aider les entreprises à tirer le meilleur parti de Claude :
 déployer Claude de manière sécurisée en entreprise;
 mettre en place des pratiques de développement agentique chez les équipes client (cycle de développement agentique outillé et partagé par toute l’équipe, du ticket jusqu’à la livraison, en intégrant la revue de code, les contrôles de sécurité et le déploiement);
 rénover, retro-documenter ou développer des applications;
 sécuriser et fiabiliser les processus de gestion d’entreprise (par exemple Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay et Record-to-Report), et de manière générale tout processus accélérable avec de l’IA (gestion documentaire par exemple);
 réduire les coûts de migration ou de montée de version ERP en automatisant les phases répétitives (migration de données, tests de non régression).
 En tant qu’ AI Engineer , vous construisez avec les équipes clients (sur site ou hybride) des agents IA fiables, de l’idée à la production, en quelques semaines.
 Vous ne serez pas seul.e : vous rejoignez une équipe multidisciplinaire, habituée au travail à distance avec un accès direct au management et vous vous appuyez sur notre partenaire Anthropic .
 Vos missions : 
 Cadrer & diagnostiquer : vous rencontrez les équipes métier et techniques client et vous analysez les contraintes réelles (données, systèmes existants, usages).
 Concevoir & développer : vous concevez et déployez des agents et workflows (orchestration multi-étapes, function calling, RAG, MCP) qui s’intègrent aux ERP, CRM et outils internes.
 Tester & fiabiliser : vous livrez par petites étapes, avec tests automatisés, revue de code et garde-fous adaptés au risque métier.
 Déployer & sécuriser : vous mettez Claude en production à l’échelle (accès, coûts, sécurité, réglementaire), en appui de la DSI et du DPO.
 Outiller les équipes du client : vous installez Claude Code chez les équipes IT (standards, harnessing, connecteurs, CI/CD) et Claude Cowork chez les équipes métier pour qu’elles puissent prendre la main sur la solution.
 Côté interne : 
 Contribuer au développement commercial et la notoriété : vous participez à l’élaboration et à la présentation de propositions, aux événements clients et partenaires, aux publications.
 Faire grandir l’équipe : vous participez aux actions de recrutement (cooptation, entretiens), de formation et d’animation interne.
 Capitaliser : vous documentez les patterns réutilisables (accélérateurs, prompts, architectures de référence).
 Faire remonter les expériences terrain : vous partagez les limites des modèles, les bonnes pratiques, les frictions d’outillage pour faire évoluer les méthodes.
 Diffuser la culture IA : vous faites de la veille et vous partagez avec le reste de l’équipe.
 Environnement technique : 
 IA : Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, MCP, RAG, function calling, prompt engineering, evals, guardrails, observabilité
 IDE IA : Claude Code en priorité, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex
 Cloud & DevOps : AWS, GCP ou Azure, containers, CI/CD
 Données : bases relationnelles et/ou NoSQL, bases vectorielles
 Intégration et sécurité : API, microservices, ERP, CRM, SSO/SCIM, OWASP
 Pratiques : Spec-Driven Development, CLAUDE.md , tests automatisés, revue de code assistée par IA

Ce qui compte pour nous :Ingénierie logicielle : au moins 5 ans d’expérience (frontend, backend ou fullstack), avec une vraie discipline qualité : tests automatisés, revue de code, standards.Cloud & Devops : vous savez conteneuriser, mettre en place une CI/CD et déployer sur au moins un grand cloud AWS, GCP ou Azure.IA en production : une expérience concrète d’agents IA est idéale. Des projets personnels sérieux sur le RAG, le function calling ou MCP comptent aussi.Sécurité : vous savez sécuriser une application (authentification, gestion des secrets) et vous connaissez les risques propres aux agents, comme l’injection de prompt ou l’isolation des outils exécutés.Posture conseil & terrain :Regard critique : vous relisez ce que produisent les agents de code, et vous refusez un code que vous ne sauriez pas expliquer ou maintenir, même s’il fonctionne.Pédagogie : vous savez cadrer un problème avec la DSI comme avec le métier non techniques et défendez vos choix.Français et anglais B2/C1.Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait ! items.desc: About MarvelX MarvelX is building highly specialized AI agents for the most complex, heavily regulated industries. Think insurance claims, compliance, support. Automated by AI that actually works in the real world. The opportunity is massive, and we’re moving fast. We’re looking for a AI Engineer to help us push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI in production. Someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and shipping real products. Someone who can turn ideas into working systems, fast. You’ll work directly with the founders and tech lead to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve mission-critical problems for our clients. This isn’t a typical engineering role. It’s an early seat on the rocket ship. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let’s talk. Mission As a founding AI Engineer, you’ll be at the core of MarvelX’s product and tech evolution. You’ll take ownership of designing and building agentic systems that can handle high-stakes, high-complexity workflows. You’ll explore the edge of LLMs, reasoning engines, and orchestration frameworks, and bring them to life in production environments where reliability, compliance, and explainability matter. What you'll be doing Build and deploy AI agents that handle real-world workflows in insurance, banking and other financial services domains . Experiment with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-use, and multi-agent orchestration to push performance . Design pipelines that ensure explainability, traceability, and auditability for every decision the AI makes . Collaborate directly with product, design, and GTM to rapidly iterate on customer feedback . Optimize models and systems for production: latency, accuracy, scalability, and security . Stay ahead of the curve: explore new architectures, open-source tools, and research to keep MarvelX at the frontier . What you'll need 4–6 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML systems (startups, scale-ups, or research labs). Strong background in Python , ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), and modern AI stacks (OpenAI APIs, vector DBs,etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic architectures - you’ve built with them, broken them, and made them better. Solid understanding of data engineering: pipelines, preprocessing, and deploying models in production. Proactive, scrappy, and able to ship fast without compromising on quality. Excited by solving hard problems where there’s no clear playbook, and you create the playbook. Bonus: exposure to compliance, fintech, or other regulated domains where explainability is critical.

items.desc: Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è portare AI nel core del prodotto Jet HR e nell'infrastruttura interna - costruendo agenti affidabili, pipeline robuste e sistemi di conoscenza che scalano. Nel concreto: Sviluppi agenti AI multi-step basati su LLM per casi d'uso complessi: orchestrazione, ragionamento, gestione degli errori. Implementi e integri MCP per la gestione di contesti, tool e fonti di conoscenza strutturate. Integri chatbot e agenti direttamente nei prodotti Jet HR e nei tool interni - non come demo o per esplorare, ma come funzionalità in produzione. Prepari e pulisci i dati per l'ingestion in sistemi RAG e knowledge base AI: qualità, struttura, aggiornamento continuo. Mantieni le knowledge base attive e aggiornate, con pipeline automatizzate di update e versioning. Contribuisci all'infrastruttura della data platform a supporto dei workload AI - sei parte integrante del team che la costruisce. Come Lavoriamo ‍ Il team Data di Jet HR non è un team di supporto. È una funzione strategica che costruisce la piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform prima di tutto. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Full stack mindset. Non aspetti che qualcun altro sblocchi qualcosa. Hai la piena ownership del tuo pezzo, dalla logica all'infrastruttura. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, AI engineers e analytics engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, payroll e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS · LangChain Chi stiamo cercando 3+ anni di esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni di data science o machine learning, di cui almeno 1 su AI (RAG, agent frameworks, LLM in produzione). Python solido. Non un "lo conosco", ma lo usi ogni giorno e conosci bene le librerie AI - LangChain e dintorni. ML/AI hands-on. Hai sviluppato, fatto tuning e deployato modelli reali. Sai cosa funziona fuori da un notebook. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €65.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Il ruolo del product manager è ripartito tra software engineer e designer. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment . Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Screening call — 30 minuti con Head of Data Task asincrono — ~3/4 ore Tech interview — 60 minuti con Head of Data Final interview — 60 minuti con il team, per il fitting

Mit einem modernen Tech‑Stack, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und einem agilen Umfeld bieten wir dir die ideale Basis, um deine Expertise einzubringen und gemeinsam KI‑Technologien weiter voranzutreiben. Laufveranstaltungen, …) Unsere Löhne und Gehälter liegen über dem Kollektivvertrag (KV) der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie.
