items.card: Act Digital is looking for an AI/ML Engineer for a leading European institution . TASKS : Develop agentic AI systems using Google ADK and / or LangGraph/Langchain. Develop, train, and maintain machine learning models and software applications in the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI for specific
items.desc: Act Digital is looking for an AI/ML Engineer for a leading European institution . TASKS : Develop agentic AI systems using Google ADK and / or LangGraph/Langchain. Develop, train, and maintain machine learning models and software applications in the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI for specific use cases. Work on AI ready data improvements, e.g., semantic layer, agent skills. Define data controls and implement strategies to ensure data quality (consistency, completeness, accuracy, reasonableness), integrity, and the detection and mitigation of bias in datasets and AI models. Perform processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis. Draft technical guidelines, documentation, and presentations to effectively communicate complex AI concepts, project status, and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Manage services deployments through CI/CD pipelines and OpenShift cluster. SENIORITY REQUIREMENTS : To qualify for this position, the consultant must have: University degree corresponding to Level 7 of the European Qualifications Framework (which typically corresponds to a master’s level or 5 years of higher education), and 5 years of IT professional experience . REQUIREMENTS : Required Certifications : Having successfully completed relevant training on how to deploy LLMs and Agents at Scale and build MCP servers. One of the following or an equivalent certification: Certified Usability Analyst (CUA). Certified User Experience Analyst (CXA). Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g) UXCertification. Certified Professional in User Experience (CPUX). Google UX Design Professional Certificate. Akendi UX Certification. Knowledge & Skills : Excellent knowledge of programming languages essential for AI/ML, primarily Python , and their key libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, SpaCy, NLTK). Excellent knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, data cleaning, and data lifecycle management for AI projects. Good knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Forests, Neural Network, deep learning, and/or artificial intelligence frameworks. Good knowledge of generative AI, small and large language models. Good knowledge of data scraping and data integration pipelines. Expertise in AI ready data improvements through a semantic layer. Good knowledge of cloud platforms for building LLM solutions (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio) and frameworks for orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and safety/guardrails. Good knowledge of AI Agent Orchestration frameworks, like Langchain or Semantic Kernel. Experience with data analytics over big datasets, non-structured databases as well as data lakes. Experience with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and governance (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow). Ability to understand, speak and write English. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously. Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering. Good, applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression, etc. Proficiency with programming skills in languages essential for AI development and key libraries. Data-driven mindset. (!) IMPORTANT : Open to EU candidates, as well as non-EU candidates already located in Belgium. Minimum level B2 in English, both spoken and written. Far-site/Remote. Long-term, Full-time. -- If you're interested, feel free to submit your application through this job posting, or alternatively send your resume to: oaraoua@actdigital.eu

items.desc: ESPRIMO Srl, società di consulenza informatica che opera dal 2002 su tutto il territorio nazionale ed internazionale, a supporto delle imprese, si colloca nel settore dell’Information Technology proponendosi come obiettivo quello di fornire una vasta gamma di prodotti, servizi e soluzioni nelle aree più strategiche per l’impresa, come: Infrastrutture IT, Content Management, ERP, Business Intelligence, CRM, Web Applications, è alla ricerca di un: AI Engineer con almeno 2 anni di esperienza Competenze Solide competenze nello sviluppo in Python, inclusa la creazione di API e servizi pronti per la produzione (production-grade) Solida conoscenza dei fondamenti del Machine Learning , dei flussi di lavoro per lo sviluppo di modelli, del feature engineering, della validazione e della valutazione Esperienza pratica con PyTorch e scikit-learn Approfondita comprensione dei Large Language Models (LLM) , delle architetture Transformer, della tokenizzazione, degli embedding e dei flussi di lavoro di inferenza Esperienza con LangChain e LangGraph per la creazione di applicazioni basate su LLM e sistemi basati su agenti (agentic applications) Progettazione e implementazione di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale multi-agente , inclusi orchestrazione, utilizzo di strumenti (tool usage), gestione dello stato e meccanismi di controllo (guardrails) Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , che includono chunking, strategie di embedding, recupero delle informazioni (retrieval), reranking e gestione del contesto Esperienza con database vettoriali (preferibilmente Qdrant) e tecnologie di caching/gestione dello stato come Redis Conoscenza delle tecniche di fine-tuning per LLM e modelli di deep learning, inclusi approcci efficienti in termini di parametri come LoRA/PEFT Conoscenza degli stack hardware per l'IA (sviluppo e inferenza), incluse GPU, vincoli di VRAM, fondamenti di CUDA e deployment di modelli ottimizzato per le prestazioni Capacità di progettare soluzioni di IA scalabili, efficienti, affidabili e ad alte prestazioni, con attenzione a latenza, throughput, costi, utilizzo della memoria e osservabilità Architetture a microservizi Algoritmi, strutture dati e capacità di selezionare la soluzione più adatta allo specifico contesto Docker (Dockerfiles, Docker Compose) e carichi di lavoro IA containerizzati Pratiche CI/CD per software e sistemi di ML/IA Progettazione di sistemi distribuiti e integrazione di servizi di IA in architetture di produzione Esperienza in ambienti Agile Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese Sede operativa: Remoto Retribuzione indicativa: RAL € 30.000 Si offre un inserimento in un contesto stimolante e innovativo, con grandi prospettive di crescita professionale e una retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza. Si richiede l’invio di Curricula rispondenti al profilo della posizione aperta, verranno presi in considerazione solo quelli effettivamente in possesso dei requisiti sopraindicati. La ricerca è rivolta ad entrambi i sessi (L.903/77). Inviare dettagliato curriculum vitae, con l’autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali secondo la Legge 196/2003.

Co nabízíme Práci na prvních personalizovaných AI asistentech pro finanční instituce na světě. Spolupráci přímo se seniorními lídry s praxí u CEO firem z Fortune 100. Projekty pro přední banky a pojišťovny, které se reálně nasazují do jejich každodenních procesů. Moderní technologie a prostor neustále se učit, s formálním školením i sdílením znalostí v týmu. Kancelář v historickém paláci v centru Prahy se střešní terasou. Týmové akce, kávu, čaj a pivo po práci.

The team is part of corporate R&D and delivers projects for business units worldwide. It combines specialists in agentic AI, time series and computer vision, and works directly with scientists, process engineers and business owners. The team runs its own agentic platform on Azure with a custom agent harness. It already supports several use cases in production, from finance processes to research assistants that query scientific and operational databases. The next phase is underway: more use cases in parallel, more data sources connected, and a larger library of shared skills and tools. You will build those agents and strengthen the platform underneath them. What You Will Do Agent development Design and build agents that carry complex, domain-specific logic, translating expert knowledge from scientists and engineers into reasoning steps, tools and guardrails Build multi-step and multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, combining retrieval, tool calls and business rules Connect agents to structured enterprise data in Databricks, often combining several sources in one solution Context and knowledge management Define what context an agent needs to reason correctly: instructions, retrieved documents, table and column descriptions, domain rules Improve metadata on the data platform so tables and fields are described well enough for agents to use them reliably Design retrieval and grounding strategies that keep answers traceable to their source Skills And Tooling Build reusable skills and tools that agents across use cases can share Decide which agent gets which tools and permissions, and keep the tool library maintainable Evaluation Willingness to build client-facing confidence over time, engaging with and presenting to accounting firm partners. A strong appetite for learning and quickly adapting to regulated domains and fast-paced, early-stage environments. Compensation and Benefits: Competitive graduate salary ranging from £45,000 to £60,000. Structured mentorship and hands-on training from experienced engineers. Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to an innovative AI-native platform from day one. Direct exposure to shaping the future of the accounting and audit industries. Rapid professional growth in a fast-paced, early-stage technology environment. Close collaboration with experienced professionals in software engineering and audit.

items.desc: As a K Trainee, your experience goes beyond your role as an AI Trainee. You will get to explore K Group’s business across different areas and broaden your perspective beyond your own field. You will take on a hands-on professional role while developing your skills and building a network for the start of your career. A personal mentor, development sessions, job shadowing across our different business divisions and opportunities to meet K Group leaders will bring perspectives beyond your day-to-day role. You will work as part of the AI Solutions team and contribute to the team’s ongoing development work. Your assignments will be determined through the team’s shared prioritization and will vary according to current business and technology needs. Your skills and experience will also be considered when determining suitable assignments for you. This gives you the opportunity to work on different AI-related challenges and gain broad, practical experience. Depending on your assignments, you may work on AI agents and generative AI applications, shared AI platforms and components, system integrations, data processing and RAG solutions. Your work may also involve testing and improving large language model based solutions or supporting their operationalisation, monitoring and continuous development through LLMOps practices. You will collaborate with business and technology specialists and learn to look at AI solutions from both a technical perspective and in terms of the business value they create. What We Expect From You You have completed a relevant degree within the past six months or you’ll be graduated in six-months-time. Your studies may focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer science, software engineering or a related field. You can program in Python and are familiar with common software development tools and practices. You understand the fundamentals of system integrations, APIs and data processing. You have basic knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, generative AI frameworks and RAG architectures. You are already familiar with LLMOps practices and understand the fundamentals of the operational lifecycle of AI solutions. You are fluent in both Finnish and English. While English is the working language of the AI Solutions team, the K Trainee programme and its joint activities are conducted in Finnish. You take an active approach to your assignments, take responsibility for agreed tasks and want to continue developing your skills throughout the traineeship. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Snowflake is considered an advantage. We also consider an interest in developing your communication skills and a willingness to share your K Trainee experience on social media an advantage. What You Will Gain As a K Trainee A real role with real responsibilityYou will join us for a paid traineeship. The final salary will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and skills. You will contribute to meaningful development work, and your responsibilities will grow as your skills develop. Personal support for your development You will learn above all by doing, but you’ll be surrounded by experienced specialists who can support you with everyday questions and help you develop your technical expertise. Your personal mentor and the K Trainee development programme will also support your professional growth. A broad view of the retail sector You will gain insight into K Group beyond your own role and learn about our three business divisions through the K Trainee programme. A network for the start of your career You will get to know other K Trainee participants and K Group specialists from different parts of the business. You will build a network that can support you well beyond the programme. You will also have access to a wide range of employee benefits, including the ePassi culture and sports benefit, employee discounts at K Group stores, occupational healthcare services and leisure-time accident insurance. You will work in the modern facilities of K Kampus in Helsinki, where employees have access to a gym, saunas, occupational healthcare services, a staff restaurant and a café. The work is carried out according to K Group’s hybrid working practices. The position is fixed-term from January 2027 to September 2027. Are you ready to join us? LET’S K! items.desc:
Meta's Privacy Engineering team is seeking a Security Engineer with experience in applying an adversarial mindset to identify, scope, contain, and eradicate real-world privacy threats to products and infrastructure. Your primary responsibilities will be to deal with privacy vulnerabilities by designing or guiding Software Engineers through remediations, learning from security/privacy incidents, identifying vulnerabilities in our codebase, and building agentic systems at scale to assist and perform these operations. Your skills will be the foundation of security initiatives that protect the security and privacy of billions of people. You will advance Meta’s mission of making the world more open and connected by identifying and neutralizing threats that aim to collect sensitive information or disrupt our systems.
Lead technical triage and investigation of complex privacy incidents - reviewing code, system architecture, logs, and other evidence to guide engineers through mitigation and remediation Design and build scalable agentic AI systems that can autonomously handle all aspects of incident response, discover and verify security/privacy vulnerabilities in product and infrastructure, and guide coding agents to write secure-by-default code Partner with engineering and product teams to improve designs, prioritize durable remediation, and shift privacy protections earlier in the development lifecycle Lead medium-to-large technical projects from ambiguous problem definition through implementation, adoption, measurement, and long-term ownership

Job Description: 
 Be a Founding Member of our New Connectivity Design Hub in Manching 
 Help us build the "Manching Footprint" of Connectivity & Comms. We are looking for a Senior Comms Engineer/Architect/Lead who thrives in "Brand New" environments. Based in our new Manching Design Office, you will take the lead on end-to-end development—from first concept to final qualification of all Connectivity Systems such as Tactical Datalinks (as but not only L-16), Comms Managers, IFDL, IVDL, CCAs C2 links for Air Power products such as Fighters, FCAS, CCAs, MuT, A400M…
 Why this is different: This is the birth of our "Manching Team." You have the rare chance to bridge two worlds: the deep, established expertise of our Connectivity domain and the fresh, high-stakes opportunities emerging from new programs in Manching. You aren't just joining a legacy; you are scaling it into a new big team full of professional opportunities.
 However, for all that, we need a skilful professional with proven knowledge in (some of) Systems Engineering or Connectivity, Tactical DataLinks, Satcom, Architectures definition, ready to be fully empowered and taking ownership of all Integration and Design Activities always paying attention to the future by means of innovation and R&T.
 The Reward: A clear development path in a high-visibility, innovative discipline reporting directly to the HO Domain.
 Ready for the challenge?
 Your location 
 Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras : Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones) : 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
 Growth Made Easy : Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
 Feel Good at Work : On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
 Diversity Connects : Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your Tasks and Responsibilities 
 Definition and Design of the Connectivity architecture 
 Support Customer (German mainly) meetings, Top Level requirements generation
 Alignment with Domain Connectivity Strategy considering National Programs specific requirements
 Suppliers Selection, RFP and RFI generation and analysis together with Procurement
 L1/L2/L3 Requirement definition and validation 
 Support interface definition of interfacing systems and equipment 
 Ensure requirement traceability and coverage 
 Support L2/L3 system test activity 
 Desired Skills and Qualifications 
 Master's degree in Communications/Aerospace-/Software Engineering or comparable studies 
 At least 3 years of professional experience
 Experience in Connectivity Systems such as Satcom 
 Experience in System Design and Development 
 Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills , showing a great team spirit 
 Fluent in English and German (C1 Level) 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Overview 
 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you’ll play an instrumental role in helping customers migrate, modernize and transform their architecture and applications, laying the groundwork for world-class, scalable, production-ready AI solutions. 
 You’ll be a trusted advisor, working directly with customer IT and business leaders to shape their transformation strategy, architect secure and scalable solutions, and deliver measurable business impact. From designing roadmaps to leading Proof of Concepts and MVPs, you’ll help customers build and run intelligent applications and AI agents at scale. Your expertise will guide customers through critical milestones, leveraging proven IP and delivery engines to accelerate adoption and unlock value. 
 This is an opportunity to deepen your knowledge across Azure AI, AI agents, applications, serverless, microservices, GitHub, databases, and hybrid environments. You’ll be part of a multinational team that values precision, creativity and impact - where your decisions influence outcomes and your growth is continuous. 
 Find out more about our culture and values , and the environment you will be working in. 
 Responsibilities 
 Build trusted relationships with key customer IT and business decision makers to drive long-term cloud adoption, understand their business objectives, priorities and success measures, and design secure, scalable, AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value.
 Lead architectural design sessions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient application and AI solutions aligned to customer business goals, using frameworks like the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF), Proof of Concepts (POCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
 Get hands-on: write code, build prototypes and MVPs, and co-develop with customer and partner engineering teams to fast-start and de-risk projects.
 Own the end-to-end technical delivery results, ensuring completeness and accuracy of consumption and customer success plans in collaboration with the account team.
 Take ownership of customer outcomes with a sense of urgency, driving issues to resolution across customer, partner and multinational Microsoft teams.
 Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across application and AI workloads.
 Deliver repeatable intellectual property (IP) to achieve targeted outcomes, accelerate Azure adoption and consumption, and contribute to centralized IP development initiatives.
 Provide delivery oversight and escalation support for key strategic engagements across application and AI workloads.
 Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go-live, and serve as the Voice of the Customer, sharing feedback and insights with Microsoft engineering teams to influence product improvements.
 Drive technical excellence by leading the health, resiliency, security, and optimization of mission-critical application and AI workloads, ensuring readiness for production-scale AI use cases.
 Achieve and maintain certifications in priority Cloud & AI Apps workloads.
 Maintain deep technical expertise and stay current with market trends, competitive insights, and Microsoft’s evolving application and AI capabilities.
 Demonstrate a growth mindset by continuously learning, contributing to technical communities, sharing best practices and mentoring others to accelerate customer outcomes.
 Qualifications 
 Proven hands-on software development experience: you have designed, written and shipped production code (e.g. C#/.NET, Python, Java, TypeScript), with solid engineering fundamentals.
 Experience with DevOps, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and infrastructure as code.
 Customer-facing experience, with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work across multinational teams.
 Business fluency in English.
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent experience.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Practical experience of software development and/or solution architecture experience in enterprise environments.
 Experience designing and delivering secure, scalable cloud-native and AI applications on Azure (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions, API Management).
 Experience building AI agents and RAG solutions, and with GitHub Copilot and agentic DevOps.
 Experience with Cosmos DB, Azure SQL or PostgreSQL.
 Azure or GitHub certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Developer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, DevOps Engineer Expert).

items.desc: Position Overview We are looking for a Configurable Materials Master Data Domain Lead whose core craft is Variant Configuration. SAP VC, including characteristics, classes, configuration profiles, dependencies, constraints, and super-BoMs, is the structural spine of how we define, price, manufacture, and service our products worldwide. You will own the strategic data roadmap for this domain, serve as Business Owner for SAP MDG-M and the SAP Variant Configuration landscape (LO-VC / AVC) , and orchestrate cross-functional initiatives that enable product innovation, operational excellence, analytics, and intelligent automation. This is a global role, reporting directly to the Global Head of Data Governance & MDM, with end-to-end accountability across R&D, Commercial, Procurement & Operations, and Finance, spanning Idea-to-Market (I2M), Market-to-Cash (M2C), Plan-to-Deliver (P2D), and Record-to-Report (R2R). Drive the strategic evolution from classic LO-VC toward Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC), defining the migration roadmap, capability gaps, and business-case priorities together with the Global Process Experts and Enterprise Architecture. Design and govern super-BoM and variant-BoM structures that translate configurable product definitions into executable manufacturing and procurement plans across global plants. Define and maintain the material classification, codification, and hierarchy frameworks that underpin VC model selection and variant determination at scale. BoM Mastership & Digital Thread Own the material-side BoM data strategy and mastership rules across the full digital thread: from engineering-BoM origins in PLM, through manufacturing-BoM refinement in ERP, to shop-floor execution in MES. Architect integration patterns across the materials ecosystem (PLM Windchill, SAP MDG, S/4HANA, PIM/DAM, MES) with a focus on data consistency, real-time synchronization, and API-first connectivity. Support the integration of VC-based product models into CPQ platforms and digital sales channels, enabling self-service configuration with validated, real-time data. Installed Base, Service & Aftermarket Extend the materials master-data domain toward serialized equipment, service BoMs, and spare-parts management. Define how VC-derived product structures translate into installed-base records and service-kit definitions, ensuring traceability from original configuration to aftermarket offerings. Sustainability, Compliance & Regulatory Data Embed material composition, weight, and substance data into the materials master record to support sustainability reporting and environmental compliance requirements. Ensure compliance-related data (REACH, RoHS, and future regulations) is structurally linked to the VC model and BoM, enabling automatic variant-level compliance determination. Drive the data standards that allow dormakaba to answer regulatory, customer, and investor questions about product composition and traceability. Governance, Quality & Architecture Own the strategic roadmap for Configurable Materials master data, aligning it with dormakaba's business, digitalization, and sustainability ambitions. Evolve the global materials governance framework, including data ownership, stewardship, policies, and standards. Champion data product thinking by treating master-data assets as products with defined consumers, SLAs, lineage, and lifecycle management. Apply modern data architecture principles to create a scalable and interoperable materials data ecosystem. Build and sustain an active external stakeholder network to benchmark practices and introduce emerging industry standards. items.desc: We're looking for a Product Engineer to join one of our clients, a UK-based proptech company building an AI-powered platform to transform residential property management. Its product brings together property operations, resident communication, and building management into a more connected, intelligent system. This is a highly hands-on, product-focused engineering role for someone who enjoys building from the ground up, taking ownership of features end to end, and turning ideas into products that solve real-world problems. You'll work closely with the team to shape product decisions, move quickly from concept to implementation, and use modern development tools, including AI, to build, ship, and iterate. The focus is on engineers who combine strong technical skills with product thinking, initiative, and a desire to make a tangible impact on the product's direction and growth. What you'll do Take problems from unclear to shipped. Discover, architect, build, test and deliver new features across the entire stack. Build with users, not just for them. Property managers and residents give us direct, sometimes blunt feedback. You will be close enough to hear it first-hand and turn it into product the same week. Use AI to do the previously impossible. Turning messy inspection reports into clear action plans, making sense of resident messages, drafting replies a manager can actually trust. The kind of thing that was not buildable a couple of years ago. Have a real say in what gets built. Your product instincts matter as much as your code. If you think we are building the wrong thing, we want to hear it. Share your expertise. Be on hand to help other team members, technical or otherwise, and help mentor other engineers. Help us operate more efficiently by building and maintaining our developer tooling and CI/CD pipelines, and staying at the forefront of the latest AI tools. Who does well hereWe care less about your exact CV than about how you work The people who thrive here tend to: Have a strong bias to action. You spot what is missing and go and do something about it, rather than waiting to be asked. Have good product instincts. You have taste for what to build and the discipline to leave the rest out. Be comfortable with ambiguity. You can make real progress without a clear spec, and you are happy changing course when the problem turns out to be different than you thought. Be kind and low-ego. You are collaborative and pragmatic, you would rather get it right than be right, and you are easy to build alongside. On the engineering side, you will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You have owned and shipped real features across frontend and backend, and you enjoy the whole stack rather than a slice of it. You are strong with TypeScript and React, and/or with Python and a modern web framework, and happy to become strong in the other. You can make the bigger architectural calls and have them still look right in six months. You already build with AI tools and have a genuine view on where they help and where they get in the way. Bonus, not essential: React Native, AWS, GraphQL, CI/CD, or having shipped LLM features to production. None of this is a checklist. If it sounds like you, even without every box ticked, get in touch. What We Offer Real product ownership - take features from idea to production and see the direct impact of your work. A meaningful technical challenge - help build an AI-powered product that is transforming residential property management. Influence over product decisions - contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape both the product and its technical direction. A high level of autonomy - work in a fast-moving environment where initiative and practical problem-solving are valued. Modern development practices - use AI-powered coding tools and modern technologies to build, ship, and iterate quickly. Competitive compensation and equity A collaborative team environment - work closely with the team from the London office, 4–5 days per week. Pay: £55,000.00-£90,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

items.desc: Description & Requirements Who we are looking for 🎯We’re building agentic systems that do real work in production: tool-using workflows, RAG, structured outputs, guardrails, and measurable quality. If you like shipping and iterating fast - but still care about doing it properly - this is the team. You’ll work with Solution Architects and LLMOps , but your focus is simple: build the thing, make it reliable, and keep improving it. 🔎 What you bring: 2+ years as a AI Engineer (or equivalent) with a strong focus on Gen AI implementation; ideally some NLP background for RAG and Talk2Document work . Python-first engineer who can build production APIs/services (FastAPI or similar). You’ve built agentic systems with LangGraph / LangChain / PydanticAI / CrewAI (or similar). You’re comfortable integrating tools /data safely (timeouts, retries, idempotency, rate limiting). You’ve worked with RAG/vector search (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Redis Vector, Milvus/Chroma). You’ve shipped Talk2Data and/or Talk2Document -style solutions (or very similar patterns). You care about quality: eval harnesses + regression suites, and you can use LangSmith/Langfuse/Datadog to debug what’s happening. Familiar with MCP and secure model-to-tool/data connectivity. Bonus: A2A patterns / agent-to-agent coordination. Bonus: agent builder frameworks (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock Agents, Vertex AI Agent Builder, or similar). Cloud experience : Azure preferred, AWS/GCP fine. EU work permit is required Your future role 🚀What you will build: Agent workflows with LangGraph / LangChain / PydanticAI / CrewAI (routing, retries, fallbacks, timeouts, human-in-the-loop). Tool calling that doesn’t break: APIs, databases, and internal services with clean contracts, predictable behavior, and safe error handling (retries/timeouts, idempotency, rate limiting). Hybrid systems: pre-built agents plus a thin custom orchestration layer (interfaces, policies, guardrails, reuse). MCP integrations: implement MCP servers/clients so models can safely access tools/data (DBs/APIs/files) using least-privilege patterns and audit-friendly logging. RAG + knowledge systems: chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval strategies, grounding patterns; vector stacks like Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Redis Vector, Milvus/Chroma; doc ingestion with Azure Document Intelligence. Real use cases : Talk2Data (safe querying + interpretation of enterprise data) Talk2Document (Q&A/summarize/extract/reason over docs with citations/grounding) Evaluation + observability : automated evals (task success, groundedness/relevance, safety, latency, cost), regression suites, and run tracing for debugging using LangSmith / Langfuse / Datadog. Cloud GenAI: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry + Azure AI Search / Document Intelligence / Content Safety. AWS/GCP equivalents welcome (Bedrock/Vertex AI + search/document pipelines). Hybrid way of work in a modern Prague office. International environment where personal development and growth are supported and highly encouraged. Unique opportunity for a long‑term career and promotions within Deloitte. Attractive and competitive salary , including a wide range of fringe benefits: Annual performance bonus rewarding excellence and dedication. Flexible benefits package via cafeteria system (meals, pension, sports, culture, and more). Extra time off , including additional vacation and sick days. Health, travel and life insurance to support your wellbeing and peace of mind. Support during important life events, such as illness or parental leave. Professional development through internal and external trainings, cloud partner certifications and mentoring. Access to sports, wellbeing and social activities, plus a friendly, inclusive team culture. Also: ✨ Professional Growth – Continuous learning with access to trainings (Azure, GCP, AWS, Databricks), free certifications vouchers and business udemy.com subscription, and mentorship 💰 Attractive Package – Competitive salary, performance bonuses, meal vouchers, extra vacation days, and flexible benefits. 🌍 International Projects – Work with leading companies across Europe and beyond. 📈Career Development – Clear paths for advancement into senior consultant and manager roles. 🏢 Modern Workplace in Prague – Hybrid working model with a centrally located office. 🎉 Culture & Community – Friendly, diverse teams, team-building events, and supportive leadership.

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Du stellst sicher, dass AI-Lösungen unter Produktionsbedingungen entwickelt werden und kennst die Proof-of-Concept-Wüste nur zu gut. Rapid Prototyping und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Nutzer:innen sind Teil deines Alltags. Du bist Teil eines agilen, innovationsgetriebenen Teams innerhalb der Exxeta und stehst in engem Austausch mit unseren Kunden. Gestalte die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Frontier Labs Partnern mit und bringe deine Erfahrungen aus Kundenprojekten in den fachlichen Austausch mit den Labs ein. Was erwarten wir von dir Persönlicher Background: Du bringst Expertise und Erfahrung in Software-Architektur, Software Engineering und Agentic Engineering mit und fokussierst dich auf alles rund um AI und/oder Machine Learning. Du weißt, wie man die gesamte Lösung verantwortet, nicht nur den Code. Tech Skills: Von Backend bis Frontend, Infrastruktur bis AI - du hast Spaß daran, überall dort anzupacken, wo Impact gebraucht wird. Dir ist Outcome wichtiger als Output. Techniken wie Agentic RAG und klassisches RAG beherrscht du, außerdem sind dir LLM-/Agent-Frameworks, Infrastruktur-Themen (wie Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) und Vektor-Datenbanken (wie Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) bestens bekannt. Kunden-Fokus: Du überzeugst durch deine Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und in agilen Delivery-Settings. Mit Ambiguitäten und Unsicherheit im Projektalltag gehst du souverän um. Mindset: Prototypen, MVPs und Produktion sind für dich kein Widerspruch, sondern der Spaß an deinem Job. Du bist kreativ und lösungsorientiert, kannst dich in Fachbereiche eindenken und hast dabei stets unsere Kunden im Fokus. On the road: Du bist reisebereit und flexibel, unsere Kunden bundesweit vor Ort zu beraten. Let's talk: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch - super, dann findest du dich bei Exxeta bestens zurecht. Wer legt die meisten Kilometer zurück? Warum Exxeta Bei Exxeta entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen, die wirklich etwas verändern – in Unternehmen, Märkten und Köpfen. Über 1200 Kolleg:innen bringen dafür Technologie, Ideen und unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammen. Was uns antreibt: Neugier, Teamspirit und der Anspruch, echten Impact zu schaffen. Hightech with a heartbeat eben. Wir sind ein Zuhause für Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Diversität und unterschiedliche Perspektiven bereichern unser Team. Haltung, Ideen und Lust aufs Machen - das zählt bei uns! Bewirb dich jetzt!

Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bij PwC werk je dicht bij de klant en de mensen die de oplossing gebruiken. Je onderzoekt hoe hun processen werkelijk werken, brengt een nog onduidelijk probleem terug tot iets dat je kunt bouwen en vertaalt feedback uit de praktijk direct naar werkende software. Je schrijft productiecode, bouwt integraties en brengt oplossingen naar productie. Je wacht niet tot alle requirements zijn uitgewerkt, maar stelt vragen, maakt aannames expliciet en bouwt snel een eerste versie om met gebruikers te toetsen wat daadwerkelijk werkt. Waar je terechtkomt Binnen het Data & AI Consulting-team van PwC Nederland werk je aan complexe vraagstukken bij ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, financiële instellingen en grote commerciële opdrachtgevers. Je helpt klanten om generatieve AI niet alleen te verkennen, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun processen, applicaties en dagelijkse werk. Forward deployed betekent bij ons dat je regelmatig dicht op de praktijk van de klant werkt. Je spreekt met gebruikers en domeinexperts, werkt met echte data en bestaande systemen en ontwikkelt de oplossing samen met het klantteam. Maar, je begint niet vanaf nul: we nemen onze AI-versnellers en frameworks mee naar de klant en versterken daarmee onze eigen producten. Afhankelijk van de fase van het traject werk je bij de klant, op ons kantoor in Amsterdam of vanuit huis. Belangrijk om te weten wat deze rol níet is. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en adviseert, geen sales engineer die vooral demo’s bouwt en geen software engineer die uitsluitend vanuit een uitgewerkt backlog werkt. Je bent en blijft een engineer. Je schrijft productiecode en bent aanspreekbaar op wat je bouwt, dus we meten je niet af op je PowerPoint slides en beschermen je focustijd. Tegelijk ga je zelf naar de bron. Samen met onze consultants spreek je met gebruikers, onderzoek je data en processen en stel je aannames ter discussie. Ons werk is pas geslaagd als de oplossing technisch werkt én in de dagelijkse praktijk waarde oplevert. Dit ga je doen Je werkt van een nog niet volledig uitgewerkt klantvraagstuk naar een AI-oplossing die in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt gebruikt. Je combineert discovery, software-engineering en klantgerichte delivery. Concreet: Je onderzoekt samen met gebruikers het echte probleem. Je brengt processen, knelpunten, data en bestaande systemen in kaart en vertaalt een nog onduidelijke klantvraag naar heldere requirements, succescriteria en een eerste leverbare stap. Je bouwt en toetst snel een eerste werkende oplossing. Met echte gebruikers en realistische data test je aannames en ontwikkel je GenAI-oplossingen met bijvoorbeeld LLM’s, RAG, agents en reguliere softwarecomponenten. Je integreert de oplossing in de klantomgeving. Je bouwt API’s, datastromen, authenticatie en koppelingen met bestaande applicaties en systemen. Daarbij maak je bewust de afweging wanneer AI waarde toevoegt en wanneer reguliere softwarelogica beter past. We werken voor klanten waar security, privacy en compliancy van levensbelang zijn (zoals banken en ministeries). Snel naar productie gaan is daar een uitdaging. Jouw rol is om met onze teamleden de discussie aan te gaan met security-officers en architecten. Je helpt hen in te zien hoe we op een veilige en verantwoorde manier die eerste versies live kunnen krijgen. Je brengt de oplossing betrouwbaar naar productie. Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerde tests, evaluaties, security, CI/CD, monitoring en logging. Je blijft betrokken bij livegang en stabilisatie en draagt bij aan het oplossen van technische blokkades in de klantomgeving. Je verbetert op basis van gebruik en maakt lessen herbruikbaar. Je verzamelt feedback, meet kwaliteit en gebruik, begeleidt de technische ingebruikname en vertaalt terugkerende patronen naar herbruikbare componenten, evaluatieframeworks en implementatieaanpakken. Je staat er niet alleen voor. Hoewel je als FDE de technische leiding neemt over de AI-oplossing, werk je nauw samen met onze gespecialiseerde data-engineers, architecten en consultants. Jij focust op de AI-logica, integratie en de developer experience van de oplossing, terwijl je collega’s zich op de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur en de organisatorische adoptie richten. Je maakt daarbij steeds een bewuste afweging tussen AI en reguliere softwarelogica. Niet ieder probleem heeft een LLM of agent nodig. Waar je mee werkt Onze stack varieert per klant en per vraagstuk. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je regelmatig in een technische omgeving die je niet zelf hebt gekozen. We zoeken daarom een sterke technische basis, brede nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om nieuwe tools snel eigen te maken. AI-applicaties bouwen: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic en SQL. Voor RAG en agentic AI gebruiken we bijvoorbeeld LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP, embeddings en vector stores zoals Azure AI Search of pgvector. Integreren en naar productie brengen: Microsoft Azure is ons meest …

items.card: you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so.
items.desc: Role Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic systems end-to-end: multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, tool invocation, memory management, and lifecycle observability Build and own RAG pipelines: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector search, context window engineering and tuning against real quality targets Integrate and abstract across multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models — with fallback routing, token, cost, and latency management Implement LLMOps in production: eval harnesses with real quality metrics, prompt versioning, observability tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), cost and safety monitoring Embed directly with client engineering teams to design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions — workshops, proofs of concept, code-with sessions, and architecture walkthroughs Build reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual client engagement and enable the next one to start faster Define and use metrics to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness; present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in business terms Basic Qualifications Strong software engineering experience in production environments Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm) Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.



THE TEAM

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on.

THE ROLE

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will build ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

- Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

- Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

- Write Go and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

- Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

- You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

- You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

- Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

- 5+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

- You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

- A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

You design the architecture that lets AI systems work on our data and knowledge, and you define the standards the whole company follows when it produces, models and consumes data. Strong curiosity and drive: you go beyond what is asked, and you stay on top of the latest technologies, especially in AI applied to data platforms. How You’ll Make an Impact You will take technical responsibility for tuning, optimizing, and validating wind turbine control systems,
items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team at Siemens Energy as a Senior Control Engineer, where your expertise will play a crucial role in shaping the future of wind power technology! Imagine tuning, optimizing, and validating control systems for cutting-edge wind turbines, ensuring they operate at peak performance throughout their lifecycle. You will collaborate closely with a talented international team of engineers, gaining insights from various disciplines such as loads and aerodynamics. Your contributions will directly enhance the competitiveness of our products, making a significant impact on the wind energy sector. How You’ll Make an Impact You will take technical responsibility for tuning, optimizing, and validating wind turbine control systems, balancing energy production, mechanical loads, and operational availability Collaborate with functionality development teams to identify and evaluate improvements to control strategies, enhancing turbine performance and reliability. Tune and optimize control parameters for various turbine types and operating conditions, ensuring stability and robustness across the defined operating envelope. Plan and execute software-in-the-loop simulations to validate control functionalities and parameter settings against performance and safety requirements. Support the commissioning and field validation of prototypes and fleet turbines, analyzing operational data to verify compliance with design specifications. What You Bring You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Control and Automation, Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering, or possess equivalent relevant experience. You have proven experience in control system tuning, optimization, and validation, ideally within the wind turbine sector or similar dynamic systems. Your strong understanding of control theory and system dynamics allows you to assess trade-offs between energy production and mechanical loads effectively. Proficiency in MATLAB and Simulink is essential, along with hands-on experience in simulation-based verification and diagnosing control-related issues. items.desc: The briefing Every good service has an origin story. Ours starts with a broken promise. The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked something: to build a company that reimagines credit, rooted in transparency, flexibility and respect. That company became Fairlo. Current operations Since launching in 2018, Fairlo has grown to around 50,000 active customers, with a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from over 4,700 reviews. Proof that putting transparency, flexibility and people first isn't just the right thing to do. It's a winning model. We’re a tight team of 45 people based in Stockholm, Crete and the UK. Backed by some of Sweden’s most experienced investors and driven by a culture that prizes kindness, courage, collaboration and common sense, we’re very proud of what we’ve built so far. The mission Every operation needs a quartermaster. Fairlo is becoming a bank, and we’re building it to be AI-driven from the ground up. We’re bringing AI into everything we do, not just engineering: how we assess credit, how we run finance, how we serve customers, and how we work day to day. With today’s AI tools, the distance between an idea and a working solution is shrinking fast, and the people closest to our customers and our business can increasingly shape and build solutions themselves. We want to be early, not catch up later. That’s why we’re hiring AI Engineer #1. This is a new role, so there’s no roadmap to inherit. You’ll help write it. Based in our Stockholm office, you’ll report directly to our CTO and work with every part of the company: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, building the tools that make it real, and creating the platform and guardrails that keep it safe in a regulated bank. Your assignments You’ll build things people use every day, and you’ll see the impact across the whole company. As our first AI engineer, you’ll also shape how we work: how fast we try new things, and how we make sure they hold up. Others will follow your lead, so how you work matters as much as what you build. Your work will involve: Build the gadgets. Design and ship AI-powered tools and agents that change how colleagues work, from automating manual processes in operations to giving credit and finance teams answers in seconds instead of days. You’ll own them from the first conversation with users through backend, integrations, deployment and iteration. Find the next mission. Sit down with teams across Fairlo, understand their work, and spot where AI can remove friction or open up something new. Then prototype fast, test with real users, and turn what works into something reliable. Keep the lab ahead. Try new models, tools and ways of working as they appear, decide quickly what’s worth adopting, and bring what works into Fairlo safely. Run the lab on AWS. Own the foundation for how Fairlo uses AI, including Amazon Bedrock, approved AI tools, model access, logging, cost control and monitoring, so every new tool builds on solid ground. Wire the gadgets into headquarters, safely. Build integrations that give AI tools controlled, least-privilege access to our codebase, analytics and data, including MCP servers and internal APIs. Write the instruction manual. Create templates, self-serve environments and clear documentation so colleagues outside engineering can build and experiment on their own. The goal is a paved road where the safe path is also the easy one. Unlike certain famous agents, ours will actually read it. Build in the safety catch. Turn security, compliance and data-protection rules into automated checks in our CI/CD pipelines, so speed and safety go together. Train the field agents. Run workshops, coach colleagues, and share what works, so the whole company gets better at using AI. Field requirements We’re looking for someone who is hungry, fast and knows what they’re doing. You ship quickly, and what you ship is secure and built to last. We believe you: Have several years of backend engineering experience and love building complete products yourself, ideally in TypeScript / Node.js. Have owned systems in production end to end, including architecture, operations and incidents, and are comfortable making technical decisions independently. Keep pace with a field that changes every few months, and can show us something you built recently with tools that didn’t exist a year ago. Move fast without cutting the corners that matter. You know when a quick prototype is the right call and when something needs to be built properly from day one. Have hands-on experience building with LLMs, for example through Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic or OpenAI APIs, agents, tool calling or RAG. Have solid production experience with AWS, including IAM, networking and …

Drive the data standards that allow dormakaba to answer regulatory, customer, and investor questions about product composition and traceability. Champion data product thinking by treating master-data assets as products with defined consumers, SLAs, lineage, and lifecycle management. You will lead nursing assessment and treatment for people with highly complex needs, supporting safe, effective and evidence-based care. Your clinical responsibilities will include referral triage, assessment, discharge planning and physical health management, helping to ensure that people with eating disorders can access appropriate, timely and coordinated care. Alongside your clinical work, you will provide professional leadership for the nursing workforce, working closely with clinical, professional and operational leads to strengthen nursing practice, support the development of junior colleagues and contribute to an effective multidisciplinary team. You will work collaboratively with service managers and other senior clinicians to promote high standards of care and continuous improvement across the service. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the strategic development of Connect’s service model, helping to design and improve clinical pathways across both inpatient and community settings. items.desc: Goldfern is recruiting 3 x Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE III) for a UK Government AI unit. It's a small, fast-moving team that sees itself as a disruptor inside government, building AI products used directly by frontline operational teams who handle highly sensitive data. This is the unit's senior hands-on engineering role and its top priority. You'll work directly with frontline teams, find the real problems and build AI products that make a measurable difference to them. The key word is ownership. You build the whole thing yourself: front end, backend, database, AI, monitoring and deployment. Architecting it, or directing others who built it, doesn't count. You'll usually run several projects at once and work alongside more junior engineers, so explaining technical decisions clearly and supporting others carries real weight. What you'll be building • LLM and agent workflows, retrieval (RAG), speech-to-text, translation and document intelligence • Data pipelines and production AI services, built with the people who use them and improved from their feedback • Products handling sensitive data, with access control, human review and audit trails built in from the start What we're looking for • You have personally shipped an AI product end to end into live use, with a clear before and after: users, time saved, cost reduced. A list of technologies isn't evidence • Equal strength across front end and backend. Strong backend and AI work where someone else built the UI is read as a gap, and the same applies the other way round. You can talk in depth about component structure, state management, data fetching and performance, and you've built more than one basic screen: separate views for different users, admin or operations tooling, or several workflows in one product • Production Python APIs, ideally FastAPI: routers, dependency injection, Pydantic models, async and background tasks, database access and migrations, and serving AI features such as streamed model responses • Authentication and security done properly: identity provider integration (ideally Microsoft Entra ID, covering app registrations, token validation, roles and scopes), least-privilege access, secrets management, service isolation, logging and monitoring • A solid understanding of how AI systems behave and fail: context engineering, retrieval, tool-using agents, unpredictable model output, prompt injection and over-privileged tools • Working directly with users where there's no fixed spec, and a methodical approach to debugging that owns problems through to a real fix The stack (or demonstrably similar) • Next.js and React, Python and FastAPI, Postgres • Microsoft Azure (App Service, Blob Storage, Postgres, Terraform-managed containers) and Microsoft Entra ID If you've built on a different stack, you'll need to show how you'd build the same thing on this one. Desirable • Designing AI safeguards: prompt injection defences, least-privilege tools, human approval points and audit trails • Delivery in a regulated, safety-critical or high-consequence setting • Taking a product from prototype to adoption at scale • Sensible build-versus-buy decisions and integrating third-party models and data services • A start-up background, and mentoring other engineers • Current SC clearance The practicalities • 12-month contract, day rate, inside IR35 via an umbrella company • Hybrid, with regular time on site in London, Manchester, Glasgow or Cardiff • BPSS required before starting. SC isn't needed to start and will be progressed alongside; it normally requires around five years' UK residence • Start: as soon as clearance allows • You must be based in the UK with the existing right to work here. Applications from candidates based overseas will not be considered The process is quick: a single informal, conversational interview with the hiring team. Expect to talk through real examples of what you've built, including what went wrong and to that end, please ensure that your CV and supporting information covers all of the above. You must be UK based and eligible for security clearance. lester@goldfern.co.uk

items.desc: TL;DR → You design and build production-grade RAG and agentic AI systems end-to-end. From use-case definition through to a working interface in users' hands. → Consulting across the Nordics, with clients spanning industries from financial services to manufacturing. → You work in cross-functional delivery teams alongside Data Engineers and Platform Engineers, each owning a distinct layer of the stack. → Certifications without a debate. Colleagues who are obsessed with the craft. Freedom to grow your way. What you'll do As a GenAI Developer, you own the AI application layer end-to-end: the systems that ingest, retrieve, reason, and respond, plus the lightweight interfaces that put them in front of users. You're the person closest to the end customer. You turn a business problem into a working use-case, from gathering requirements and aligning stakeholders to shipping a production system people actually use. You come in before the solution is defined. Together with the client, you shape what gets built, then you build it. You work alongside Data Engineers and Platform Engineers, each owning a distinct layer of the stack. Your layer is where the model meets the business problem, and where the user meets the product. A few examples of what this looks like in practice: A production RAG system for a financial services client, letting internal teams navigate regulatory documentation using generative AI. From ingestion through to answer generation, quality evaluation, and a lightweight front-end for day-to-day use. An agentic AI solution in the FinOps space, applying LLM reasoning over infrastructure data to drive cloud cost optimization beyond what rule-based tooling can handle. AI capability building at enterprise clients: use-case workshops, requirements definition, and architecture advisory on agents and coding tools for senior technical audiences. The bar for what "done" means here is high: production-grade, observable, secure and used. What you get Assignments that accelerate you. Every 6–18 months you're in a new engagement. New industry, new architecture decisions, new stakeholders to earn trust from. You'll face more distinct technical challenges in two years here than most engineers see in five. Work that's hard to come by elsewhere. Agentic AI in enterprise environments is one of the most technically demanding spaces in the industry right now. The problems here aren't solved yet, and you'll be among the people solving them. Your direction, your call. Want to go deep technically and become the go-to person for enterprise AI architecture? Go for it. Want to lead client engagements, own stakeholder relationships and drive use-cases from discovery to production? Also go for it. Both paths are real and equally valued. People who make you better. The people here are genuinely passionate about technology, not as a job, but as something they care about. Engineers who go deep because they want to, follow the space obsessively, and get restless when things stop moving. That's what keeps Redeploy consistently ahead, and it's what you'll feel from day one. The perks. 30 days vacation · hybrid work and flexible hours · private medical insurance · pension (ITP1) · wellness allowance 5,000 SEK · free choice of tools and tech · free breakfast, soda and snacks · yearly gatherings and AW's · a team with genuine interests outside work — gaming, food, running, padel, golf, football, cycling. Who you are You care whether your AI systems actually work, not just whether they run, and you have an instinct for finding failure modes before they reach production. You care about how users interact with it, and you don't consider a use-case done until it's working end-to-end, interface included. You might come from a fullstack engineering or traditional ML/Data background. What matters is that you're already building AI solutions, whether that's a side project, a POC, or a deep dive into a new framework. Curiosity is a given. The question is whether you act on it. You like being close to the people who'll use what you build. You can run a requirements workshop, figure out what a stakeholder actually needs versus what they asked for, and explain why a retrieval pipeline is underperforming, all with the same clarity. What you bring Strong requirements engineering and stakeholder management skills, you can drive a use-case from problem definition to delivery, keeping technical and non-technical audiences aligned throughout Strong Python skills and solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, testing, version control, system design Production experience with RAG architectures: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and retrieval evaluation Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI, including tool use, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration Experience with Azure AI Services or Azure OpenAI, including integration across Azure …
