items.desc: À propos Ipsos bva est le leader en France des études de marché et des enquêtes d’opinion. Groupe français indépendant, fondé en 1975, Ipsos bva opère aujourd’hui dans 90 pays et donne aux entreprises et aux institutions pour lesquelles il travaille, les clés de compréhension de la société, des marchés, des citoyens et des consommateurs. Une mission qui s’appuie sur la disruption numérique, l’extension des domaines d’observations et l’innovation continue pour améliorer la finesse des analyses. Intégrer Ipsos bva aujourd’hui c’est : Choisir un métier passionnant au cœur des enjeux d’actualités et des transformations de la société. Bénéficier d’une multiplicité d'opportunités d’apprentissage dans des secteurs différents : le marketing, la publicité, les médias, la politique, le CRM, qui intègrent les dernières innovations digitales et technologiques. Se voir confier des responsabilités immédiatement sur des études avec de véritables perspectives d’évolutions professionnelles. Evoluer au sein d’un groupe international dans lequel les opportunités de mobilité sont une réalité. Descriptif du poste Ipsos has committed to becoming the AI-augmented leader in market research. Clients expect faster turnaround and more proactive insights, and Ipsos has set an ambitious goal to produce and deliver the majority of our activities in 48h or less. Meeting that expectation means changing how our teams work, not just giving people better tools. Gemini Enterprise is the enterprise AI platform Ipsos has selected to build, deploy and govern AI tasks, skills, workflows and agents, which will be made available to our research teams under the “Ipsos.Facto 2.0” name. It is one of the foundations of the Horizons Speed program alongside the generalization of IDP as our primary survey platform. The AI and speed for researchers Program will focus on identifying, building, testing and rolling-out AI enabled tasks, skills, workflows and agents to all our research teams worldwide across three transversal research areas : Business development Proposal writing Charting and reporting These objectives will be realized through the implementation of a so called AI Agent Use Case Factory . This is a function/tool within an organization that provides the infrastructure, processes, expertise, and governance to manage the entire lifecycle of an AI agent—from the initial idea to its eventual retirement The ‘Use Case Factory' is a partnership between the different constituents of our matrix: Countries, service line and client organization. It operates in a Federated (Hub-and-Spoke) Model: This hybrid model combines a central "hub" (the UCF) with "spokes" embedded within countries, service lines, client first,… . Ensure all use cases and AI-enabled solutions are grounded in Ipsos intellectual property, proprietary assets, methodologies and research expertise. Ensure that solutions deliver trusted outputs consistent with Ipsos research excellence and standards by partnering with Service Lines, Legal, Chief Science Office and other stakeholders. Promote appropriate human oversight, accountability and responsible use of AI across all deployed solutions. Contribute to the evolution of the Use Case Factory operating model and roadmap. 3. Support agent development and validation Define and maintain specifications, templates and supporting assets used within the Use Case Factory. Support the development of no-code agents, skills and agent templates for business users. Contribute to the definition of testing, validation and quality assurance protocols. Support the testing and validation of priority use cases before release. Identify risks, gaps and improvement opportunities and drive corrective actions where required. 4. Build community engagement and adoption Partner with AI champions, ambassadors and business stakeholders to drive awareness, adoption and behavioural change. Build and nurture an active researcher community around AI-enabled ways of working. Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration across functions and markets. Act as a key point of connection between business users and the AI & Speed programme. 5. Monitor performance and …

items.desc: Job Title Cybersecurity Solution Architect Job Type: Full-Time Permanent Location: Sandyford, Dublin – Office Based / Customer Facing About Us Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity specialist, helping organisations across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean and North America manage and reduce cyber risk. With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity services spanning advisory and consulting, cyber risk and assurance, security testing, professional services, managed security, incident response and cyber recovery. We support more than 3,000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, manufacturing and critical infrastructure. At Integrity360, our people are central to our success. We invest heavily in learning, technical development and career progression, creating an environment where people are encouraged to challenge thinking, share knowledge and develop innovative solutions to real customer security challenges. The Role We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Solution Architect to join our Solution Architecture team in Dublin. This is a senior customer-facing role, working closely with our Account Management, Professional Services, Managed Security Services, Product and specialist technical teams. You will engage with customers ranging from security and technology teams through to CISOs, CIOs and other senior stakeholders, helping them understand their security challenges and translating those challenges into practical, commercially viable cybersecurity solutions. The role goes beyond selecting technology. You will be expected to understand a customer's business objectives, security maturity, threat exposure, technology environment, and operating model, bringing these together to design solutions spanning technology, professional services and managed security services. You will take technical ownership of opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial discovery and qualification through solution architecture, proposal development, and customer presentation, supporting a smooth transition into successful delivery. Most importantly, you will become a trusted security advisor to our customers, helping them understand where to focus investment, improve security maturity and strengthen their overall cyber resilience. Working Location This is an office-based and customer-facing role. When not visiting customers at their locations, you will be expected to work primarily from our Sandyford office, collaborating closely with the wider Solution Architecture, Sales and technical teams. We recognise the benefits of flexibility, and hybrid working arrangements may be considered over time. However, candidates should join with the expectation that regular office presence is an important part of the role, particularly during their initial period with Integrity360. Due to the nature of the position, the role will involve travel to customer locations across Ireland and occasional international travel where required. Key Responsibilities Customer Discovery & Advisory Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customers' business objectives, security challenges, existing architecture, security maturity and risk priorities. Engage confidently with stakeholders ranging from security engineers and architects through to CISO, CIO and executive leadership. Translate technical and business challenges into clear security requirements and pragmatic improvement plans. Help customers prioritise security investment based on risk, business outcomes and existing capabilities. Build trusted advisory relationships, constructively challenging customer thinking where appropriate rather than simply responding to stated technical requirements. Solution Architecture Architect cybersecurity solutions combining technology, professional services and managed security services. Develop high-level architectures, solution designs, bills of materials, licensing models and professional services scopes. Design solutions across new and existing customer environments, identifying opportunities to consolidate, optimise and improve security capabilities. Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, operationally supportable and aligned with Integrity360's portfolio and delivery capabilities. Work across multiple security technologies and vendors, selecting appropriate capabilities based on customer requirements rather than relying on a single technology stack. Managed Security & Cyber Resilience Design solutions incorporating a broad range of cybersecurity capabilities, including: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) SIEM, XDR and Security Operations Endpoint Detection and Response Incident Response and Cyber Resilience Vulnerability and Exposure Management Cloud Security Identity Security …

items.card: Description Role Purpose As a Managing Consultant within the Red Teaming practice, you’ll take a leading role in delivering high-end adversary simulation engagements for clients with mature security postures and critical risk profiles. items.desc: Description Role Purpose As a Managing Consultant within the Red Teaming practice, you’ll take a leading role in delivering high-end adversary simulation engagements for clients with mature security postures and critical risk profiles. You'll operate across the entire attack lifecycle—from initial access and evasion of EDR, through lateral movement and objective completion—while ensuring the safety, confidentiality, and operational integrity of every engagement. You’ll also contribute to our capability development, tooling, and methodologies, while mentoring the next generation of Red Teamers and representing NCC Group in client-facing engagements, including with C-level stakeholders. This role is central to advancing NCC Group’s offensive security capability while helping our clients understand, detect, and respond to sophisticated threats in real-world scenarios. Key Accountabilities You’ll lead the design, planning, and execution of Red Team and adversary simulation engagements across critical sectors such as financial services, government, and defence. These operations will align with frameworks such as CBEST, TIBER, CORIE, and more. You’ll also build strong stakeholder relationships, lead debriefs with both technical and executive audiences, and translate complex attack paths into clear, actionable insight. Over the next 12–24 months, you'll establish yourself as a senior authority in the Red Teaming space, contribute to tooling and methodology development, mentor rising talent, and play an active role in growing our capability in both regulated and bespoke assessments. Skills You are an experienced operator who combines deep technical expertise with strong client-facing and leadership skills. You’re comfortable running complex operations end-to-end and enjoy mentoring others while staying hands-on. We’d love to see experience in: Designing and delivering complex adversary simulations Evading controls such as EDR/EPP and navigating defensive environments Microsoft AD, Office 365, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), MacOS Stakeholder engagement, including executive-level briefings Report writing that balances narrative flow and technical accuracy Desirable: Familiarity with CBEST, TIBER, CORIE, AASE, iCAST, FEER Experience building tools or automation for Red Team use Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory standards Certifications required: CREST CCT-INF is desired. What do we Offer in Return? We have a high-performance culture which is balanced evenly with world-class well-being initiatives and benefits: Flexible working Financial & Investment Pension Life Assurance Share Save Scheme Maternity & Paternity leave ‍‍ Employee Referral Program Lifestyle & Wellness Learning & Development About NCC Group We assess, develop and manage cyber threats across our increasingly connected society. We advise global technology, manufacturers, financial institutions, critical national infrastructure providers, retailers and governments on the best way to keep businesses, software and personal data safe. With our knowledge, experience and global footprint, we are best placed to help businesses identify, assess, mitigate & respond to the risks they face. We are passionate about making the Internet safer and revolutionising the way in which organisations think about cyber security. Headquartered in Manchester, UK, with over 35 offices across the world, NCC Group employs more than 2,000 people and is a trusted advisor to 15,000 clients worldwide. We review every application received and will get in touch if your skills and experience match what we’re looking for. If you don’t hear back from us within 10 days, please don’t be too disappointed – we may keep your CV on our database for any future vacancies and we would encourage you to keep an eye on our career opportunities as there may be other suitable roles. To ensure a fair and consistent assessment process, candidates must not use AI tools to generate, suggest, coach or provide responses during live or recorded interviews unless this has been approved in advance, by the hiring team. For more information please read our AI in Hiring - Candidate Policy. If you do not want us to retain your details, you can utilise the Manage Your Data tool provided by Pinpoint or contact us directly at: global.ta@nccgroup.com. All personal data is held in accordance with the NCC Group Privacy Notice. We are committed to diversity and flexibility in the workplace. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the application process, please tell us at any stage. Please note that this role involves mandatory pre-employment background checks due to the nature of the work NCC Group does. To apply, you must be willing and able to undergo the vetting process.

items.desc: Project description Luxoft a DXC Technology Company is an established company focusing on consulting and implementation of complex projects in the financial and Insurance industry. Together with the customer, we deliver top performance! For one of our clients in the Insurance Segment, we are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with specialized expertise in cloud operational processes AWS and AMS Responsibilities The Business Analyst is accountable for: Process Optimization & Model Design: Analyse, define, and document cloud operational processes, change management models, and operating frameworks, specifically tailored for AWS and AMS environments. Data-Driven Analysis: Apply strong analytical skills to synthesize complex datasets, identify operational bottlenecks, and present evidence-based recommendations to key stakeholders. Project Delivery & Leadership: Lead and support project delivery initiatives from discovery through deployment, ensuring align met with business goals and timelines. Stakeholder Management & Communication: Confidently communicate complex technical and operational concepts to both technical teams and executive-level non-technical audiences. Requirements Gathering: Conduct workshops, user interviews, and process mapping sessions to elicit clear, actionable functional and non-functional requirements. Change Management: Support team transitions to cloud-native operating models, ensuring smooth adoption of change controls and governance practices. Skills Must have Key Competencies: Cloud Operations Literacy: Understanding of AWS/AMS operational guardrails, incident/change management, and cloud migration impact. Evidence-Based Mindset: Ability to root problem-solving in facts, metrics, and quantitative evidence rather than assumptions. Stakeholder Influence: Confident and articulate in leading meetings, facilitating agreement, and managing client expectations. Qualifications & Requirements: Experience: Proven track record as a Business Analyst with direct exposure to cloud operational processes and IT service management (ITSM/ITIL). Cloud Expertise: Deep familiarity with cloud operating and change models (experience with AWS and AWS Managed Services / AMS is strongly preferred). Analytical Capability: High-level analytical mindset with demonstrated success in data and evidence-based decision-making. Language Proficiency: Fluent / Advanced level of English (written and spoken) with clear, confident presentation skills. Leadership & Delivery: Strong track record of taking initiative, leading project delivery workstreams, and collaborating cross-functionally. Tools & Methodologies: Experience with Agile/Scrum frameworks, process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Visio), and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence). Nice to have Prior experience working with or within Aviva environments/projects is a strong plus, but not obligatory Other Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Senior Remote United Kingdom, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland Req. items.desc: Project overview: This project focuses on assessing a complex existing technology landscape and defining pragmatic modernisation plans for business critical platform components. You will help shape target state architecture, delivery roadmaps, and implementation strategies across multiple architectural domains. Position overview: DataArt is seeking an experienced, hands-on Principal Solution Architect to support a strategic technology modernization program for a major UK digital platform - encompassing platform modernization, cloud infrastructure and the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering practices. The initial focus will be on Web Platform Modernization, but the engagement is expected to extend across multiple architectural domains, including AWS infrastructure, APIs, search, commerce, identity and other core platform services. We are looking for a technically credible, commercially aware architect who can operate across these domains, assess complex existing environments and translate modernization opportunities into pragmatic, executable delivery plans. The successful candidate will act as DataArt’s senior technical representative, working closely with the client’s architecture, engineering and transformation leadership while providing technical direction to DataArt’s distributed engineering teams. This is not a traditional enterprise architecture or governance role. We need someone who combines broad architectural expertise with hands-on technical experience and a strong track record of delivering complex modernization programs. Technology stack: AWS, APIs, Microservices, Distributed systems, Containers, Serverless technologies, Infrastructure as code, CI/CD, DevOps practices, Headless CMS, Event driven systems, Real time data processing, Observability Responsibilities: Lead architecture discovery across the technology landscape with an initial focus on the web platform. Assess existing applications, platform services, cloud infrastructure, and integration patterns. Evaluate technical debt, scalability constraints, resilience, performance, and operational challenges. Review AWS architecture and identify opportunities for cloud native modernisation, optimisation, and simplification. Define pragmatic target state architectures aligned with the broader technology strategy. Develop modernisation approaches covering application replatforming, refactoring, cloud migration, and incremental replacement. Design scalable, resilient, and secure solutions using AWS and modern cloud native technologies. Assess integration patterns, API architecture, distributed systems, and service boundaries. Identify architectural dependencies and risks related to modernising business-critical components. Translate architecture assessments into prioritised delivery work packages. Develop technical roadmaps, implementation strategies, and migration plans. Support engineering estimation, resource planning, and commercial scoping. Provide technical direction to distributed engineering teams. Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, and solution design discussions. Communicate architectural options, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 12+ years’ experience in software engineering and solution architecture, with significant experience in senior architecture leadership roles. Proven track record delivering complex application and platform modernisation programmes. Strong hands-on AWS architecture experience, including cloud-native application design and infrastructure considerations. Broad technical experience across web platforms, APIs, microservices and distributed systems. Experience architecting high-volume, business-critical, customer-facing platforms. Strong understanding of modern application architectures, integration patterns and service-oriented design. Experience assessing complex legacy environments and defining incremental modernisation strategies; building a holistic understanding of the technical landscape with its interdependencies, caveats and historical variety of approaches Ability to translate architectural recommendations into executable engineering work packages. Experience leading technical discovery and solution design in environments where requirements are initially ambiguous. Experience providing architectural leadership to distributed engineering teams. Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with CTOs and senior engineering leaders. Commercial awareness, including experience supporting technical estimation and delivery planning. Nice to have: Experience in travel, transportation, e-commerce or other high-volume transactional environments. Experience with search-intensive platforms, including distributed search architectures. Familiarity with AWS services supporting compute, containers, networking, databases, messaging, and observability. Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and modern DevOps practices. items.desc: Iedereen kan een prompt schrijven. Een AI-oplossing bouwen waar een organisatie echt op durft te vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) maak jij het verschil tussen een interessante demo en een oplossing die elke dag werkt in een echt proces. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker. De uitdaging Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op. Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy. Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework. Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen. Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen. Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering. Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar ben je wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €3.314 - €7.919 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling (50% premie door ons betaald of extra salaris). Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen over deze rol? Neem contact op met Raoel via raoel.fatehmahomed@linkit.nl of via +31638859892. Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. items.desc: The Digital Evolution Company Of Today And Tomorrow Lutech è il Gruppo leader in Italia e player europeo nel digitale e nell’intelligenza artificiale , con oltre 6.000 professionisti impegnati nello sviluppo di soluzioni innovative per aziende e istituzioni. In Lutech tecnologia, dati e AI diventano strumenti concreti per trasformare processi, servizi ed esperienze. Attraverso competenze tecnologiche avanzate, ecosistemi digitali integrati e piattaforme AI proprietarie come Lutech BrAIn, il Gruppo accompagna l’evoluzione dell’intelligenza artificiale dall’analisi all’impatto operativo reale, in scenari complessi e internazionali. Entrare in Lutech significa far parte di una community tecnologica globale , collaborando con team multidisciplinari su sfide reali legate ad AI, cybersecurity, cloud e digital transformation , in un am biente inclusivo e orientato alla crescita , dove competenze, collaborazione e diversità delle esperienze contribuiscono a costruire l’evoluzione tecnologica del futuro. Posizione Come AI Engineer contribuirai alla progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni basate su AI, Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa e Agentic AI , con focus su progetti cliente di Digital Transformation e su iniziative finanziate in ambito R&D, ad alto contenuto tecnologico. Lavorerai all'interno di team multidisciplinari e dinamici occupandoti dello sviluppo, integrazione e messa in esercizio di componenti AI scalabili, affidabili e riutilizzabili, collaborando con clienti e stakeholder di progetto. Attività Principali Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni AI/GenAI scalabili e robuste, dalla raccolta dei requisiti al deployment; Sviluppare applicazioni, servizi, backend e API in Python basati su LLM, RAG e Agentic AI, collaborando con il team di Front End; Integrare soluzioni AI con database, API, sistemi enterprise, repository documentali e knowledge base; Realizzare e ottimizzare pipeline RAG e progettare workflow agentici e architetture multi-agente per attività di retrieval, reasoning e generazione di contenuti; Integrare e orchestrare LLM (cloud e on-prem), gestendone selezione, performance e affidabilità, con attenzione al contenimento dei costi d'esercizio; Monitorare, testare e ottimizzare qualità, performance e costi delle soluzioni sviluppate. Requisiti Cerchiamo te se hai : Esperienza nel ruolo di almeno 2 anni nello sviluppo software con focus su AI/GenAI; Ottima conoscenza di Python, SQL, gestione dati e principi di sviluppo software; Esperienza con LLM, architetture RAG (vector DB, embedding, Vector Search) e sistemi di recupero della conoscenza; Conoscenza di framework come LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework o equivalenti; Familiarità con ambienti Cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), Docker/containerizzazione, Kubernetes e CI/CD; Comprensione dei principi di sicurezza, governance e valutazione delle soluzioni AI. Nice To Have Esperienza con FastAPI; Certificazioni Cloud o AI; Esperienza in contesti consulenziali e multi-cliente; Conoscenza di Graph RAG, sistemi multi-agent e AI governance; Esperienza nel monitoraggio e nella gestione operativa di soluzioni AI; Contributi a progetti open source o iniziative personali in ambito AI. Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con CCNL Commercio, inquadramento dal livello 2° e una retribuzione annua lorda a partire da €35.000, comprensiva di eventuale componente variabile. Il pacchetto retributivo include inoltre Ticket Restaurant. Nel rispetto della normativa sulla trasparenza retributiva, la retribuzione indicata rappresenta un riferimento iniziale, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. L'offerta finale sarà determinata tenendo conto delle competenze, dell'esperienza, delle responsabilità associate al ruolo e delle evidenze emerse durante il processo di selezione. items.desc: Van slimme chatbots tot geavanceerde LLM-oplossingen: bij ilionx bouw je aan AI-toepassingen die ertoe doen. Jij brengt de visie, wij bieden de ruimte, technologie en collega’s om het waar te maken. Jouw nieuwe functie als AI Engineer Binnen ilionx en dan op een vestiging bij jou in de buurt werk je als AI Engineer aan het praktisch én schaalbaar toepassen van AI bij onze klanten. Jij bouwt niet alleen slimme oplossingen, je helpt organisaties ook echt vooruit. Dat betekent: meedenken met de klant, de juiste vragen stellen, kansen signaleren en AI vertalen naar concrete bedrijfswaarde. Je werkt aan innovatieve AI oplossingen met bewezen impact. Denk aan het ondersteunen van besluitvorming met machine learning (human-in-the-loop), het automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen, en het ontwikkelen van generatieve AI oplossingen met LLM’s en agents. Je integreert taal-, beeld- en multimodale modellen naadloos in bestaande bedrijfsprocessen en IT landschappen. Daarnaast bouw je aan slimme chatbots, co pilots en agent based systemen die gebruikers ondersteunen en processen versnellen. Je weet hoe je met prompt engineering het maximale uit LLM’s haalt en hoe je generatieve AI koppelt aan interne en externe kennisbronnen met technieken als RAG, vector search en tool calling. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en toepassing. Samen met data engineers, data scientists en cloudspecialisten werk je aan oplossingen die niet in de la verdwijnen, maar daadwerkelijk in productie draaien. Je ontwerpt mee aan robuuste AI-architecturen en denkt mee over system- en solution design: van probleemdefinitie tot eerste schets en uiteindelijke implementatie. Je werkt met de AI-offeringen van grote public cloud providers (zoals Azure, AWS of GCP) en maakt gebruik van moderne frameworks en tooling zoals LangChain, dSPy, PydanticAI, n8n en MCP. Platforms als Databricks zijn daarbij een pré, geen must. Wat ons onderscheidt: we zoeken tech savvy developers. Engineers die zelf dagelijks LLM’s en agents inzetten om slimmer en sneller te werken, en die hun kennis actief delen met collega’s én klanten. Wat Bieden Wij Jou Salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.500,- o.b.v. 40 uur, plus bonussysteem Volledig hybride werken: bij de klant, op kantoor of vanuit huis Veel ruimte voor initiatief, innovatie en experimenteren Een persoonlijk loopbaantraject, waarin jij bepaalt hoe je je verder ontwikkelt (technisch, inhoudelijk of richting consultancy/architectuur) Samenwerking met gedreven collega’s uit verschillende specialismen binnen Data, AI en Cloud Wat Vragen Wij Van Jou Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, implementeren en productierijp maken van AI-oplossingen Ervaring met LLM’s, prompt engineering en agent-based toepassingen Ervaring met de AI-offeringen van grote public cloud providers Je hebt meegebouwd aan AI-oplossingen zoals chatbots, co-pilots, classifiers, recommender systems of vergelijkbare toepassingen (verras ons!) Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren. Onze collega’s zijn niet alleen (cloud) back-end data specialisten, maar ook experts in rapportages, dashboards, voorspellende analyses, data-gedreven werken, machine learning en data science. Leuk weetje: in totaal werken er zo’n 350 data specialisten binnen ilionx! Bij ilionx draait het niet alleen om technische expertise, maar ook om de mensen achter de technologie! We hechten waarde aan een cultuur van samenwerking, kennisdeling en inspiratie. Als onderdeel van ons team maak je deel uit van een gemeenschap die gedreven wordt door nieuwsgierigheid, innovatie en een passie voor het creëren van waarde uit data. Of je nu op een van onze kantoren, bij de klant of thuis werkt, bij ilionx krijg je de perfecte omgeving om je passie voor data tot leven te brengen. items.desc: Bull steht für ein Jahrhundert europäischer Innovationskraft. Als Teil eines zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsumfelds entwickeln unsere Expertinnen und Experten leistungsstarke, nachhaltige und souveräne digitale Lösungen – damit Staaten und Industrien die volle Kontrolle über ihre Daten und ihre Künstliche Intelligenz behalten. Was Bull ausmacht, sind die Menschen Tausende Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, Forschende sowie leidenschaftliche Tech-Expertinnen und -Experten arbeiten jeden Tag daran, die Zukunft des High Performance Computing, der KI und der Quantentechnologien aktiv zu gestalten. Unsere Teams gehen täglich an die Grenzen des technologisch Machbaren – von HPC-Architekturen der nächsten Generation bis hin zu Exascale-Supercomputern. Dabei profitieren sie von exzellenter Forschung und Entwicklung, über 1.600 Patenten sowie einzigartigen End-to-End-Kompetenzen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von Hardware-Design über Software Engineering und Data Science bis hin zur Quantenforschung. Bei Bull stehen die Mitarbeitenden und das Thema Innovation im Mittelpunkt. Zusammenarbeit kennt bei uns keine Grenzen – unsere Teams sind in Europa, Nord- und Südamerika sowie Indien vernetzt. Uns verbindet eine gemeinsame Vision verantwortungsvolle und nachhaltige Innovation, die echten, messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schafft. Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten . Die science + computing AG, ein Unternehmen von Bull, erbringt hochwertige, innovative und spezialisierte IT-Dienstleistungen für anspruchsvolle internationale Kunden im Bereich Automotive und Manufacturing. Mit 285 hochqualifizierten Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und Rumänien stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Kunden ihre Geschäftsziele im Bereich R&D und Engineering, sowie beim Betrieb ihrer geschäftskritischen Anwendungen bestmöglich realisieren können. Was sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie arbeiten in Projekten vorwiegend mit Python (z. B. pandas, numpy), SQL, Jupyter, PySpark, sowie Databricks. Zudem beschäftigen Sie sich mit Spark, Data Warehousing, Data Engineering, Big Data, MLOps und LLMOps. Sie arbeiten mit modernen KI-Technologien wie Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Embedding-Modellen und Vektordatenbanken. Sie entwickeln KI-gestützte Lösungen, insbesondere mit NLP-Architekturen und RAG-Systemen. Sie arbeiten mit den modernsten Cloud-Technologien (AWS, Azure oder GCP). Sie entwerfen und entwickeln intelligente Anwendungen unter Verwendung moderner ML- sowie LLM-basierter Architekturen. Sie arbeiten während der Implementierung von Lösungen mit modernen Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LlamaIndex sowie cloudnativen AI-Services und bringen die entwickelten Lösungen mit Hilfe von MLOps- und LLMOps in die Produktion. Sie entwickeln automatisierte Prozesse zur Extraktion, Transformation und zum Laden von Daten (insbesondere auf Databricks). Sie stellen die Datenqualität, Sicherheit und den effizienten Datenfluss (ETL/ELT-Prozesse) im Projekt sicher. Sie entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Daten- und KI-Architekten innovative Fachthemen für unsere Kunden. Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche (Teil-)Projektleitung und Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Aufwänden gemäß (Projekt-)vorgaben. Im Rahmen von Pre-Sales Aktivitäten unterstützen Sie bei der Qualifizierung sowie Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen aus technischer Sicht. Sie identifizieren proaktiv Optimierungs- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des laufenden Projektes und wirken bei den nachfolgenden Vertriebsaktivitäten mit. Sie analysieren Kundenanforderungen, untersuchen die technische Machbarkeit und setzen diese in ein Angebot um. Außerdem erstellen Sie Aufwandsabschätzungen / Kalkulationsgrundlagen für Angebote. Sie arbeiten in agilen Teams (2-5 Personen, z.B. Data Scientist, Analyst sowie Projektmanager) sowohl an langfristigen Projekten als auch an kürzeren Proof-of-Concepts. Sie vertreten unser Unternehmen überzeugend nach außen und arbeiten mit den unterschiedlichsten Branchen zusammen. Sie führen Kunden-Workshops durch. Sie arbeiten an Konzeption, Design, Implementierung, Test und Beratung mit und setzen Lösungskomponenten oder Funktionsbausteine um. Sie erstellen die jeweils erforderliche Dokumentation nach den geltenden Standards unter Anwendung gängiger Methoden und Verfahren bzw. Regelwerken in einem Aufgabengebiet. Was bringen Sie mit? Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mindenstens C1) und Englisch Bachelor oder vergleichbar Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 3 Jahre in dem Umfeld) Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL Erfahrung mit Databricks, Spark, Data Warehousing und modernen Data-Plattformen Erfahrung in den Bereichen AI, ML, GenAI, BI oder verwandten Gebieten Erfahrung mit modernen KI-Tools, RAG-Architekturen, Vektordatenbanken und Embedding-Modellen Vertraut im Umgang mit LLM-Frameworks und -Bibliotheken (z.B. LangChain, LlamaIndex) Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung und Implementierung …

items.title: AI Native SW Engineer
items.card: Job Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what
items.desc: Job Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. Key Responsibilities Design and build production-grade agentic systems end-to-end: multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, tool invocation, memory management, and lifecycle observability Build and own RAG pipelines: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector search, context window engineering and tuning against real quality targets Integrate and abstract across multiple LLM providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models — with fallback routing, token, cost, and latency management Implement LLMOps in production: eval harnesses with real quality metrics, prompt versioning, observability tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), cost and safety monitoring Embed directly with client engineering teams to design, prototype, and deploy agentic solutions — workshops, proofs of concept, code-with sessions, and architecture walkthroughs Build reusable patterns, accelerators, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual client engagement and enable the next one to start faster Define and use metrics to measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness; present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in business terms Job Qualifications Software engineering experience in production environments Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm) Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure

Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto. Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza. ¿Qué es lo que valoramos? Experiencia de al menos 3 años en desarrollo de software, ingeniería de plataformas o sistemas distribuidos. Experiencia sólida en desarrollo de software con Python. Conocimiento práctico y experiencia demostrable con Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, Large Language Models (LLMs) y aplicaciones empresariales basadas en IA. Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de arquitecturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Experiencia desarrollando e integrando APIs y microservicios. Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL. Experiencia trabajando con Docker, Git y entornos CI/CD. Experiencia en resolución de incidencias y troubleshooting en entornos productivos. Conocimientos de observabilidad, monitorización, logging, trazabilidad y métricas. Capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles y multidisciplinares. Nivel de inglés B2 o superior, en un entorno técnico internacional. Capacidad analítica, orientación a la calidad y mentalidad de mejora continua. ¿Cuáles serían tus funciones? Diseñar, desarrollar y desplegar agentes de IA para casos de uso empresariales. Implementar soluciones basadas en LLMs, arquitecturas RAG y sistemas multiagente. Integrar agentes inteligentes con aplicaciones y sistemas corporativos mediante APIs y servicios. Garantizar la estabilidad, escalabilidad, resiliencia y rendimiento de las soluciones desplegadas. Monitorizar el comportamiento de los agentes y definir mecanismos de observabilidad que permitan su correcta operación en producción. Analizar incidencias en entornos productivos, realizar troubleshooting y ejecutar análisis de causa raíz (Root Cause Analysis). Optimizar prompts, flujos de ejecución, consumo de tokens y utilización de modelos fundacionales. Colaborar estrechamente con arquitectos, equipos de plataforma y áreas de negocio en la evolución de la plataforma de IA. Participar en la industrialización de soluciones de IA, llevando casos de uso desde pruebas de concepto hasta entornos productivos. Contribuir a la definición de estándares, buenas prácticas y modelos operativos para el desarrollo y despliegue de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa. Además, valoraremos muy positivamente si tienes experiencia y/o conocimientos en: Frameworks de agentes como LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI o AutoGen. Sistemas multiagente y agentic workflows. Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock o Vertex AI. Bases de datos vectoriales, embeddings y búsqueda semántica. Herramientas de observabilidad como OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Jaeger o Elastic Stack. Diseño y construcción de plataformas de IA escalables. Patrones de integración mediante tool calling y function calling. MLOps, AIOps y automatización de plataformas de IA. Certificaciones Cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP). Experiencia previa trabajando en proyectos internacionales. Y con nosotros podrás disfrutar de: Incorporación a un proyecto estratégico de evolución de una plataforma de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa para entornos empresariales. Participación en iniciativas innovadoras relacionadas con agentes inteligentes, sistemas multiagente y plataformas basadas en LLMs. Modelo híbrido de trabajo con 1 o 2 días de teletrabajo por semana. Horario flexible de entrada entre las 07:00 y las 10:00 horas. Jornada completa de 8 horas diarias y 1 hora para comer. Aproximadamente 30 días hábiles de vacaciones al año, compensando la ausencia de jornada intensiva. Ubicación: Madrid. items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Senior Software Engineer - Java Application Core Components (JACC) 
 Adyen provides a global, unified platform built by Java application teams across the company. The Java Application Core Components (JACC) team plays a key role in this: we build and maintain the shared frameworks and components that define how other Adyen teams design, structure, and deploy their Java applications.
 As part of JACC, you will build and maintain the core Java tools and components used across all of Adyen, shaping how other engineering teams build their services. You'll work on some of the largest ongoing efforts in the company, including 3 large-scale migrations that will shape the future of Adyen's application architecture. You'll join a lean team of 6 Java experts, working in a Kanban-like way with minimal process overhead, and gain real influence over the architecture of one of the leading players in the payments space.
 What you will do 
 Design, build, and evolve the internal and open source Java frameworks and components used by every Java application team at Adyen.
 Play an active role in one or more of the team's 3 large-scale migrations that are reshaping Adyen's application architecture.
 Provide hands-on technical guidance to other engineering teams, by guiding them on how the frameworks and libraries we provide can be used to solve Adyen's business problems.
 Design and evolve workflows used by other engineering teams across Adyen, working closely with them to identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
 Collaborate with partner platform teams (Kubernetes infrastructure, deployment, security) to make sure our components integrate well across Adyen's tech stack.
 Advocate for best practices across Adyen and define boundaries/guidance on how the frameworks/libraries we maintain can be used. This should be achieved by creating code validation rules, running workshops and giving presentations to other development teams.
 What you bring 
 5+ years of experience with Java backend development
 Strong skills in core Java and code/API design
 Track record of building high-quality software, with testing at all levels
 A communicative, proactive team player who takes ownership, is decisive under ambiguity, and can act as a technical influencer with a multiplier mindset
 Comfortable being a driver: able to build alignment with stakeholders and partners while pushing initiatives for our customers
 Nice to have 
 Experience with Kubernetes/cloud migrations, legacy application modernization, security-related work or platform development experience
 Experience developing and maintaining libraries/frameworks used by many other developers (either open source or internal)
 Experience with build tools, ideally for Java (Gradle/Maven)
 Broader architecture sense across distributed systems
 Familiarity with Spring, Jersey, Feign, OpenAPI
 Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 Exposure to AI agent workflows and a DevOps mindset
 Developer advocacy experience: public speaking or training/facilitation skills
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc: Position Overview Our sales & growth team is growing fast, and so is the amount of information it creates every day: accounts, calls, meetings, conversations. We want every rep to pull exactly what they need from our CRM in seconds, complete and ready to act on, and every number leadership needs to be one click away. At the same time, we sell to thousands of manufacturing and industrial companies, and the ones getting ready to rethink their procurement leave signals behind. Catching those signals early and putting them in front of the right rep at the right moment is one of the biggest growth levers we have. We're looking for a GTM Engineer to own both and far beyond. You build and run the systems behind our commercial engine: a CRM that makes information dramatically faster to find and more complete, signals that tell sales who to call today and why, and automations that give our team more time to sell. You'll work mostly with Sales, and with Marketing wherever their systems touch the pipeline. This is an engineering role with a commercial brain. You don't need to have closed deals yourself, but you need to understand why a BDR cares about a signal and what an AE wants to see before a call. Then you build the thing, ship it, and check if it moved the numbers. What You'll Own CRM Foundation and Data Model Everything else runs on this. If the data is wrong, every play built on top of it is wrong too. Commercial audit: sit down with every Account Executive and BDR to map how they actually use the CRM today, what they need from it, and where it could do much more for them A shared setup: turn those conversations into one common data model and pipeline structure, then build it into HubSpot Data quality and guardrails: raise the completeness and consistency of our data, streamline properties and objects, and add the validations and conditional logic that keep quality high as the team scales Data on demand: make sure pipeline, conversion and account data can be pulled in minutes, whether it's for a Monday pipeline review or a board deck Signals and Prioritization Most of our market isn't buying right now. Your job is to find the companies that are, before anyone else does. Signal layer: build the system that collects buying signals (website visits, LinkedIn engagement, hiring, company news, public procurement strategies - you name it) and plugs them to the right accounts and contacts in HubSpot Prioritization: turn those signals into a clear daily answer for the sales team: who to call, and why now Feedback loop: track which signals actually turn into meetings, and kill the ones that are just noise Lead Routing, Enrichment and Outreach Systems Building the proper infrastructure is critical for the actual work of growth & sales team. It’s the plumbing nobody notices until it breaks. Inbound routing: own and improve the flow that enriches inbound leads, filters them against our ICP and routes them to the right rep in minutes Enrichment: keep accounts and contacts enriched with firmographic and contact data, using Clay or whatever does the job best Outreach tooling: own the stack the sales team uses to reach prospects (dialer, sequencing, LinkedIn tools) and be the first call when something stops working Automation: spot the repetitive tasks eating into selling time and automate them with n8n, agents, or whatever gets it done Pipeline Systems for Demand Gen Not ads, not content. The systems that connect what Marketing does to what ends up in the pipeline. Account based plays: build audiences and hyper personalized campaigns based on our best accounts and the patterns in the CRM Marketing to Sales handoff: make sure every lead Marketing generates lands in Sales with the context needed to act on it Lifecycle sequences: support Marketing in building and running HubSpot lifecycle workflows that follow up with prospects through rules, delays and touchpoints across email, WhatsApp and other channels Attribution basics: help us understand which sources and campaigns actually create or influence pipeline Experimentation and AI Building Nothing here is sacred. If it doesn't move the numbers, it changes. Ship fast: prototype with Claude Code, Lovable, n8n and Clay, test with the team, and scale what works Agents in the workflow: build AI agents that take over GTM work once done by hand, from account research to qualification to follow up drafting Never stop exploring: you're compulsively checking Product Hunt, listening to GTM Engineering podcasts and getting your hands on new tools before they go mainstream, then bringing in what's worth trying and skipping what's hype How Your Impact Is Measured In your first months, we'll look at: Speed to lead: how fast an inbound lead reaches the right rep and gets a first touch Call to meeting ratio: how many more meetings the team books when calls are prioritized by signals CRM data health: completeness and accuracy of the fields that matter on accounts, contacts and deals Lead to SQL …

items.desc: Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration. As a Senior Cybersecurity Fraud Analyst, you will use your expertise in data analysis, financial transactions, and web traffic analysis to identify and investigate potential fraudulent activities within our hCaptcha SaaS security platform. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting advanced investigations into complex fraud patterns, developing actionable insights to enhance our fraud detection capabilities, and collaborating with machine learning teams to continuously improve our AI/ML detection and response systems. Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines. What will you do: Monitor, identify, and analyze events from diverse data sources, including financial transactions and web traffic, to detect and respond to fraudulent activities. Conduct advanced investigations of suspected fraud, analyzing behavior patterns and anomalies to assess risk and determine appropriate actions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product, Customer Support, to enhance fraud detection and prevention strategies. Help build and align fraud detection automation, dashboards, and reports. Continuously audit and refine fraud detection measures to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices. Stay informed of emerging fraud trends, technologies, and regulatory changes to keep our fraud prevention strategies up-to-date. What we are looking for: Minimum of 3 years of experience in fraud detection, financial data analysis, risk management, or trust & safety. Proficiency in SQL and ideally Python for data analysis and visualization. In-depth understanding of fraud detection methodologies and the fraud landscape. Ability to work with large datasets and derive actionable insights. Excellent problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented and analytical mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, able to work effectively across teams. Familiarity with the analysis of web-based and API abuse. Nice to Have: Hands-on experience with web security and secure configuration practices. Interest in staying current with industry trends and fraud prevention technologies. Familiarity with modern fraud machine learning practices. Holding a valid CFE, CFS, CFF, or CISA certification is a plus. What do we offer: Fully remote position with flexible working hours. An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world. Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often. High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting-edge R&D. Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams. We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online! Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an RF Engineer (GNSS) in the Hardware (Electronics) team, you will own the radionavigation architecture of our products. Our systems need high-precision navigation and robust connectivity in contested, complex environments, and you will be the expert responsible for the RF subsystems, from antenna design to integration and compliance. You will design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules, extend them towards CRPAs for GNSS-denied operations, and see each design through simulation, lab validation and flight tests. Based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Responsibilities Antenna Design: Design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules for our products, and extend the work towards CRPAs (Controlled Reception Pattern Antennas) for GNSS-denied environments. Antenna Integration: Integrate all antennas (GNSS, radio link) into the drones, validating through simulation (gain diagrams) and real-life lab and flight testing. GNSS Test Bench: Develop, maintain and configure the GNSS test bench to simulate satellite constellations and interference scenarios. RF Measurement: Run hands-on characterization with network and spectrum analyzers, and simulate new antenna iterations with EM software. Electromagnetic Compatibility: Lead EMC troubleshooting and pre-compliance testing, identifying and removing blockers early. PCB Collaboration: Work with PCB designers to review routing, shielding and RF layout. Architecture Ownership: Review and own the RF architecture across product lines, including link budgets and system-level RF performance. Mentoring: Act as the team's RF subject matter expert, coaching junior engineers on RF layout principles and EMC mitigation. Candidate Requirements Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field. Experience: Proven track record taking complex wireless devices from concept to mass production, including clearing strict EMC compliance hurdles. Background in aerospace, commercial drones or GNSS products is a strong advantage. GNSS: Solid grounding in GNSS, including hands-on use of a GNSS test bench to simulate edge-case environments, and an understanding of effects such as multipath. Antenna Design: Experience designing custom antennas under tight mechanical and space constraints, with EM simulation tools. RF & EMC: Strong command of RF fundamentals and measurement equipment (network and spectrum analyzers); comfortable working in an anechoic chamber. Mindset: Analytical, meticulous, structured and resilient; a hands-on problem-solver who works autonomously and collaborates well. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Chi siamo Fides S.p.A. , realtà operante nel settore della gestione del credito, è alla ricerca di un AI Engineer da coinvolgere in progetti di innovazione tecnologica e sviluppo di soluzioni basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. La risorsa contribuirà alla realizzazione di sistemi intelligenti capaci di supportare e automatizzare i processi aziendali, attraverso l'utilizzo di modelli linguistici (LLM), tecnologie RAG ( Retrieval-Augmented Generation ) e sistemi agentici. La ricerca è rivolta a profili Junior e Middle , con differenti livelli di esperienza, accomunati dalla passione per la tecnologia e dall'interesse per le applicazioni concrete dell'Intelligenza Artificiale. Di cosa ti occuperai In collaborazione con il team tecnico, avrai l'opportunità di: Sviluppare soluzioni basate su AI generativa e sistemi RAG, contribuendo all'elaborazione, indicizzazione e ricerca intelligente delle informazioni aziendali. Collaborare alla progettazione di agenti AI in grado di supportare e automatizzare workflow e processi operativi. Lavorare con modelli linguistici locali (LLM), partecipando alle attività di configurazione, sperimentazione e ottimizzazione. Contribuire alla valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli AI, attraverso test, metriche e analisi dei risultati. Supportare l'integrazione delle soluzioni AI con i sistemi e le applicazioni aziendali. Collaborare alle attività di sviluppo, testing e miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni tecnologiche. Il livello di autonomia e responsabilità sarà commisurato alle competenze e all'esperienza maturata. Il profilo che cerchiamo Laurea triennale o magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Matematica, Fisica o discipline affini, oppure percorso formativo equivalente. Conoscenza dei principi fondamentali del Machine Learning, delle reti neurali e dell'architettura Transformer. Familiarità con i modelli linguistici (LLM), anche attraverso progetti universitari, di tesi, personali o professionali. Conoscenza delle architetture RAG, degli embedding e della ricerca semantica. Conoscenza delle tecniche di prompt engineering. Competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in C#/.NET, TypeScript o linguaggi equivalenti. Conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL. Familiarità con Git e capacità di consultare documentazione tecnica in inglese. Costituiscono requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza di Python, PyTorch e Hugging Face. Esperienza con strumenti per l'esecuzione di modelli locali come Ollama, llama.cpp o vLLM. Familiarità con PostgreSQL, pgvector e database vettoriali. Conoscenza di framework come LangChain, LlamaIndex o Semantic Kernel. Nozioni di Docker, Linux e ambienti di sviluppo AI. Esperienza nella valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli e nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi AI. Interesse per la sicurezza dei sistemi di Intelligenza Artificiale e la protezione dei dati. Valutiamo anche candidature di neolaureati e professionisti nelle prime fasi della carriera , con buone competenze di base e una forte motivazione all'apprendimento. Per i profili Middle sarà valorizzata una maggiore esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e nell'integrazione di soluzioni basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un contesto aziendale orientato all'innovazione e all'evoluzione tecnologica. Opportunità di partecipare a progetti concreti di Intelligenza Artificiale applicata ai processi aziendali. Affiancamento tecnico e possibilità di sviluppare competenze specialistiche. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e opportunità di crescita professionale. Sede di lavoro: Catania Modalità di lavoro ibrida, con possibilità di alternare attività in presenza e da remoto. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze: Profilo Junior: € 25.000 – € 30.000 Profilo Middle: € 30.000 – € 35.000 Candidati! Se l'Intelligenza Artificiale è la tua passione e vuoi contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative, inviaci la tua candidatura! Se hai realizzato progetti personali, universitari o professionali legati all'AI, puoi condividere anche un link al tuo repository GitHub o a un progetto che racconti le tue competenze. items.desc: The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated: AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role. Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry. Key Responsibilities Embed directly with client engineering and business teams to deploy, scale, and operationalize AI platforms — Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir — inside enterprise environments Own production outcomes end-to-end: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability, with business metrics attached — not just delivery milestones Move from ambiguous business problem to working production system through rapid experimentation: days to prototype, weeks to production-ready Design and govern AI architectures across the full enterprise stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and workflow integration Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO; shape use case roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators that the client owns after you leave — enabling the client team to run it without you Lead design workshops, proofs of concept, architecture walkthroughs, and code-with sessions with client engineering and leadership teams Codify patterns and delivery learnings that scale across engagements and contribute to the growth of the FDE practice Job Qualifications 3-5 years engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless). Minimum of 1 years of deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments. Minimum of 3 years of experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines. Minimum of 10 years of experience deploying to production , CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging. Demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership in a client-embedded environment, internal projects, vendor labs, or team-only deployments do not qualify Proven ability to articulate business value: can quantify the impact of deployments in terms a CFO would recognize and act on Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders, CTO, CFO, or CISO level Non-linear profiles are expected and welcomed, assessment is based on demonstrated deployment experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching

items.desc: Experienced Data & AI Ethics Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Consultant/Senior Consultant – Esperto/a di Intelligenza Artificiale da inserire nel team Data & AI Ethics di Deloitte, all’interno della divisione Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, con sede a Milano o Roma, che lavorerà in modalità hybrid. Il ruolo è ideale per professionisti con una solida preparazione tecnica in ambito Data Science, Machine Learning o ingegneria dell’Intelligenza Artificiale, unita a una buona conoscenza degli aspetti etici, sociali e di governance legati all’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati. Il nostro team collabora con organizzazioni nazionali e internazionali per promuovere un’adozione responsabile dell’intelligenza artificiale e dei dati, supportare la progettazione e l’implementazione di modelli di governance per garantire pratiche etiche nell’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati, nonché condurre valutazioni d’impatto e affiancare i clienti nell’allineamento delle proprie strategie di IA alle normative internazionali, come l’EU AI Act, e agli standard etici di riferimento. Your Role Consulenza in materia di IA responsabile e governance dei dati: supportare i clienti nella traduzione dei requisiti normativi ed etici in processi, strategie e procedure operative di natura tecnica e organizzativa. Valutazione dei rischi e analisi d’impatto: individuare e mitigare i rischi etici e sociali associati all’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati, adottando prospettive tecniche, sociali e incentrate sulla persona Gestione di progetti di etica dell’IA e dei dati: realizzare progetti per importanti clienti nazionali e internazionali, operanti in diversi settori industriali e nella pubblica amministrazione. Progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche per la verifica dell’affidabilità dell’IA: sviluppare e migliorare strumenti per la valutazione dell’equità e l’individuazione dei bias, procedure di valutazione della sicurezza dei modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e framework per i test di sicurezza. Sviluppo di metodologie di red teaming: definire metodologie per testare modelli di IA generativa e predittiva, nonché sviluppare strumenti per valutarne la robustezza, l’affidabilità e le prestazioni. Sviluppo di strumenti di monitoraggio e governance: realizzare strumenti automatizzati di monitoraggio e dashboard per la governance dei modelli, a supporto del controllo e della supervisione continuativi dei sistemi di IA. What We Offer La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 33.000 e EUR 34.000 lordi annui per il grade Consultant, e tra EUR 37.500 e EUR 41.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione Winning Requirements Laurea in discipline STEM (es. Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o Data Science), in discipline umanistiche o in scienze sociali (es. Filosofia, Giurisprudenza o Sociologia), oppure formazione equivalente, accompagnata da conoscenze dimostrabili in materia di etica dell’AI e dei dati Da 2 a 5 anni di esperienza nella consulenza o presso organizzazioni tecnologiche, con attività legate all’intelligenza artificiale, ai dati, alle tecnologie digitali o alle relative implicazioni etiche e sociali. Saranno considerate un plus le esperienze in ruoli quantitativi o ingegneristici, oppure nell’ambito della gestione dei rischi, della governance o di iniziative legate all’IA responsabile Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti, dalla progettazione allo sviluppo e al testing di soluzioni di IA. In alternativa, esperienza nella valutazione di casi d’uso dell’IA, nella progettazione di processi di governance, nella ricerca o nella traduzione di requisiti etici e normativi in misure concrete e applicabili Conoscenza di Python e delle principali librerie per lo sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning e LLM (ad esempio PyTorch, Hugging Face e LangChain), oppure capacità di confrontarsi con sicurezza con concetti tecnici, documentazione specialistica e team esperti di IA, al fine di supportare le attività di valutazione e governance Familiarità con i moderni framework e protocolli per lo sviluppo di LLM e sistemi di IA agentica, nonché con le tecniche di prompt engineering, a un livello adeguato alla propria area di specializzazione Familiarità con metodologie di valutazione dell’equità, dell’esplicabilità, del monitoraggio e della robustezza dei sistemi di IA, con l’EU AI Act e con i principali standard di governance dell’IA e dei dati.
