items.desc: #StormYourCareer Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Augmente la puissance du SOC et orchestre la réponse aux menaces par l?IA agentiqueDans le cadre de la modernisation de ses opérations de sécurité, l?un de nos partenaires stratégiques recherche un(e) Ingénieur IA pour SOC & SecOps. Ton rôle sera hautement innovant et opérationnel : tu concevras et intégreras des solutions d?intelligence artificielle générative et des systèmes agentiques au c?ur du Security Operations Center (SOC) pour automatiser le traitement des alertes, enrichir la Threat Intelligence et accélérer la réponse aux incidents de cybersécurité. Ton futur environnementTu évolueras au sein d?une équipe pluridisciplinaire réunissant des ingénieurs en cybersécurité, des analystes SOC et des développeurs spécialisés en intelligence artificielle. En interface directe avec les équipes de détection (SIEM) et de réponse à incident (SOAR), tu interviendras sur des flux opérationnels en temps réel. C?est le cadre idéal pour déployer des cas d?usage novateurs à base de LLMs, concevoir des agents autonomes fiables et mesurer concrètement l?impact de tes outils sur la réduction des temps de remédiation face aux cyberattaques. Tes missions clésConception d?Agents IA & Automatisation SecOps (Mode BUILD) : Concevoir, développer et déployer des agents IA d?assistance aux analystes SOC : enrichissement automatique du contexte des alertes, corrélation multi-sources d?événements et pré-qualification intelligente des incidents. Automatiser la réponse à incident en interconnectant des modèles de langage avec les moteurs de SOAR pour orchestrer l?exécution des playbooks de sécurité et générer des synthèses d?incident détaillées. Développer des pipelines de traitement exploitant les LLMs pour la Threat Intelligence : synthèse automatique de bulletins de sécurité, extraction d?indicateurs de compromission (IoC) et mapping sur la matrice MITRE ATT&CK. Bâtir des architectures de type RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) connectées aux bases de connaissances internes, aux flux CTI (MISP, STIX/TAXII) et aux documentations de sécurité. Intégration, Fiabilisation & Supervision (Mode RUN & Co-design) : Intégrer les solutions IA aux outils du SOC (SIEM Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, plateformes SOAR) via des APIs REST et du function calling. Mettre en ?uvre des garde-fous stricts (guardrails) et des mécanismes de validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) pour garantir que les actions de remédiation critiques restent sous contrôle. Mesurer la performance opérationnelle des outils déployés : réduction du temps moyen de qualification (MTTD), du temps moyen de réponse (MTTR) et diminution de la charge manuelle. Collaborer au quotidien avec les analystes de sécurité pour tester, affiner et garantir l?adoption des interfaces développées. Ton profilFormation : Diplôme d?Ingénieur ou Bac+5 universitaire en informatique, génie logiciel, cybersécurité ou intelligence artificielle. Expérience : Tu justifies d?une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en développement logiciel, intégrant une pratique opérationnelle confirmée des technologies d?IA générative. Expertise IA & Développement Impérative : Excellente maîtrise du développement en Python et manipulation des APIs LLM (Claude, GPT, Mistral). Pratique confirmée des frameworks d?orchestration et de conception d?agents : LangChain, LangGraph, architectures RAG et function calling. Culture Cybersécurité & SecOps : Bonne compréhension du fonctionnement d?un SOC et de la cinématique de traitement des alertes. Connaissance des outils de supervision et d?orchestration : SIEM (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic), SOAR, plateformes de Threat Intelligence (MISP, STIX/TAXII). Familiarité avec le référentiel MITRE ATT&CK, les APIs REST et la conteneurisation (Docker). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atoutsSensibilité Forte à la Fiabilité : Conscience aiguë des impacts opérationnels en environnement critique, où l?exactitude des sorties de modèles conditionne l?efficacité défensive. items.desc: Job ID REF64764E Date posted 21/10/2026 Localisation Milan, Italy Job IT Design & Development Contract type Standard Descrizione dell'azienda Veolia è leader mondiale nei servizi ambientali e si impegna ogni giorno a rafforzare la sicurezza ecologica, a tutela della salute pubblica e della competitività delle imprese e dei territori. Presente in cinque continenti, il Gruppo contrasta l’inquinamento, riduce le emissioni di carbonio e rigenera le risorse con soluzioni concrete nei settori dell’acqua e delle tecnologie idriche, della gestione dei rifiuti — anche pericolosi — e dell’energia locale. In Italia da oltre 100 anni, Veolia affianca clienti pubblici e privati nel percorso di decarbonizzazione, attraverso interventi integrati di efficientamento energetico e produzione locale di energie rinnovabili. Gestiamo 14.500 edifici, tra scuole, ospedali e immobili pubblici e privati, e 180 siti industriali, contribuendo a rendere più sicuri, efficienti e sostenibili i luoghi in cui le persone vivono, studiano e si curano. Guidati dalla sostenibilità e dall'innovazione, contiamo su un team di oltre 3.200 persone che uniscono uno storico know-how alle potenzialità dei nuovi strumenti digitali e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale e gestiamo oltre 3.000 strutture sanitarie, coprendo circa il 25% dei posti letto del Paese, e finanziamo opere pubbliche attraverso iniziative di Partenariato Pubblico Privato. Siamo tra le prime aziende in Italia certificate UNI ISO 56001 per la gestione dell'innovazione. Il digitale è il cuore della nostra offerta: sviluppiamo partnership di eccellenza e utilizziamo soluzioni avanzate - come la suite Hubgrade, Green Path, Flexcity e algoritmi di AI per il building energy optimizer - per ottimizzare i consumi e guidare i nostri partner nella transizione ecologica. Nell’ultimo anno sono oltre 132.000 le tonnellate di CO2 risparmiate e 200 gli impianti di depurazione acque gestiti e 33.000 le tonnellate di rifiuti liquidi e solidi speciali intermediati. Cosa troverai in Veolia Italia? In Veolia crediamo che le persone siano il motore del cambiamento: valorizziamo il talento coniugando il radicamento territoriale e la solidità della tradizione con l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale. Entrerai a far parte di un team dinamico e inclusivo dove potrai mettere a frutto le tue competenze per costruire concretamente un futuro più sostenibile. Keep up to date with developments in applied AI and evaluate new techniques and tools where they can improve our products. Internships, research, and substantial academic or personal projects are relevant experience. Strong Python programming skills and sound software engineering fundamentals. Practical experience building at least one meaningful AI/ML application or project. Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Nice to Have: Experience with LLM or agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent. Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, or vector databases. Familiarity with SQL and data-processing workflows . Experience building APIs or backend services. Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform. items.desc:
We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of Artificial Intelligence solutions supporting our engineering and R&D activities. 
 The position combines software engineering and Generative AI. You will design and develop applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise data and modern AI platforms, while ensuring that these solutions can be effectively integrated into our existing software environment. 
 You will work closely with software engineers, architects, technical experts and project stakeholders to identify relevant AI use cases and transform them into practical, reliable and maintainable solutions. 
 As an experienced member of the team, you will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, contribute to technical and architectural decisions, and share your knowledge with other engineers working on AI initiatives.
Design and Develop AI Solutions 
 Design and develop applications and services leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI. 
 Build AI-powered solutions supporting engineering and R&D activities. 
 Develop solutions using Microsoft Azure AI services and Azure AI Foundry, as well as other approved AI technologies when appropriate. 
 Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions combining LLMs with internal documents, knowledge bases and enterprise data. 
 Integrate AI models through APIs and SDKs into new or existing applications. 
 Design AI workflows involving multiple processing steps, models, tools or data sources. 
 Explore multimodal use cases involving text, documents and images when relevant. 
 Develop Enterprise Software 
 Design and develop backend applications, services and REST APIs. 
 Contribute to applications primarily based on C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core within the existing enterprise software environment. 
 Use Python when appropriate for AI development, experimentation, data processing or integration with the broader AI ecosystem. 
 Integrate applications with databases, enterprise systems and external APIs. 
 Write maintainable, reliable and well-documented code. 
 Diagnose and resolve technical issues across AI and application components. 
 Contribute to the technical architecture of new AI solutions. 
 Evaluate and Improve AI Solutions 
 Evaluate different AI models and approaches according to the requirements of each use case. 
 Design and improve prompts, system instructions and context-management strategies. 
 Understand and manage concepts such as tokens, context windows, embeddings and vector search. 
 Evaluate AI outputs in terms of quality, reliability and consistency. 
 Consider performance, latency and cost when designing AI solutions. 
 Identify limitations and risks associated with LLM-based solutions and propose appropriate technical approaches. 
 Contribute to the continuous improvement of existing AI applications based on usage and feedback. 
 Explore and Recommend Technologies 
 Follow developments in Generative AI, LLMs and related technologies. 
 Experiment with new models, frameworks and approaches when they could bring value to the organization. 
 Compare technical alternatives and contribute to technology and architecture choices. 
 Help determine when Generative AI is appropriate for a use case and when a traditional software approach may be more suitable. 
 Collaborate and Share Knowledge 
 Work with engineers and domain experts to understand their needs and identify valuable AI use cases. 
 Translate functional needs into appropriate technical solutions. 
 Explain technical concepts and architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions. 
 Share knowledge and good practices with other developers. 
 Provide technical guidance to junior engineers or students contributing to AI projects.
Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 Significant professional experience in software development. 
 Strong backend development and software engineering skills. 
 Professional experience with C#/.NET and/or Python, with the ability and willingness to work with both technologies when required. 
 Hands-on experience developing applications or services using Generative AI and Large Language Models. 
 Good understanding of LLM concepts such as prompting, context management, tokens and model limitations. 
 Experience integrating services and systems through REST APIs. 
 Experience working with relational databases and data-driven applications. 
 Good understanding of software architecture and application integration. 
 Ability to investigate complex technical problems and propose pragmatic solutions. 
 Ability to work autonomously and take ownership of technical topics.

items.desc: Software Engineer - Energy | Job details Software Engineer - Energy We are looking for a Software Engineer - Energy to join our Energy department based in Louvain-la-Neuve . Who we are N-SIDE is a world leader in increasing the efficiency of life sciences and energy industries by providing software and services that optimize the use of natural resources, facilitating the transition to a more sustainable world. To achieve this, N-SIDE leverages its deep industry knowledge, technical expertise, and understanding of applied mathematics to help global pharmaceutical and energy companies anticipate, adapt, and optimize their decisions. N-SIDE is driven by a diverse team of over 200 passionate engineers, computer scientists, and business experts from 30+ different nationalities, with 25% holding PhDs. Together, they are committed to making a meaningful impact toward a more sustainable future. We are continuously looking at how we can support system operators (TSOs, DSOs, Transcos, and Integrated Utilities) with advanced grid optimization tools. System operators face a tremendous challenge. They are under heavy pressure to upgrade and expand their networks fast - but face shrinking time windows available to execute this work. Our standardized solutions enable operators to maximize work throughput while maintaining uncompromised grid safety, efficiency, and reliability. As a Software Engineer - Energy , you will help the company be the top reference in Advanced Analytics Solutions for energy power systems. You will contribute in particular to the inception, development, and validation of a new optimization platform, aimed to help system operators better execute expanding CAPEX and maintenance programs within tighter, less predictable execution windows. What you’ll do Together with the N-SIDE team, and more particularly the GEO task force, you will help incept, develop and deliver a new grid execution optimization platform: Collaborate with the product owners, analysts and tech lead to gather and analyze requirements, and design software solutions that meet business needs. Lead backend developments & rapid prototyping. Implement new features and do the maintenance of a Spring Boot backend codebase (Web MVC, JPA, Security, ,...), including, among others algorithm, servers, APIs (Rest API, …) and databases. Contribute to the integration of some of our existing solutions at customers to get acquainted with the tech stack. Participate in containerization (Docker), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm charts, Argo, …), continuous integration & continuous deployment aspects. As a Software Engineer, you will also participate in the technical growth of the product and team. You will therefore: Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software development. Depending on your seniority level, you may also mentor junior developers, providing technical guidance and fostering their growth within the team. Contribute to a positive and inclusive work environment, promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing. By providing qualitative code reviews and participating in technical choices around our product, you will ensure that the team develops an efficient, reusable, and reliable code, and that they adhere to coding standards, best practices, and company guidelines. About you You have a master in Computer Science or Software Development; or a bachelor with minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience. You have solid programming skills. Proficiency in Java and Spring Boot is a must. You demonstrate extensive knowledge of Spring Web MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security. You are interested in software design and wish to contribute and evolve in that career path. You demonstrate excellent problem-solving abilities. You are able to break down complex problems into manageable components and devise efficient solutions. You have a continuous learning mindset. The tech stack is constantly evolving, so a willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and best practices is essential for long-term success. You have a great team spirit, creativity, sense of initiative and responsibility. You are willing to share your knowledge and, depending on your seniority level, to mentor junior profiles. Leveraging agentic coding for rapid prototyping and proof-of-concepts has no secret for you. You are also able to take AI integration to a higher level: everything we build will leverage AI directly or be architected as AI-native (e.g., agent or LLM-powered apps, scalable model interfaces, etc…) You are fluent in English. Nice to have: Mathematical optimization Other Spring tools Build tools (Gradle/Maven) Database management (SQL / NoSQL) Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, …) Experience in or interest for building user interfaces Python Knowledge in the Energy sector Travel: 5% Start date: ASAP Our offer What’s important for us is that you grow and …

items.desc: About Paperbox Paperbox builds AI agents for claims and policy administration, serving insurers, banks, brokers and expertise firms across Europe. Their agents tackle the biggest bottleneck in insurance operations: the mailroom. 100+ customers and growing fast, they are working towards a future where nobody is put on hold. This is what Paperbox values They work hard to create a company culture where each individual can thrive in a healthy way and where they truly excel as a team. They keep the following values close to heart: Stronger together : They deeply care about our customers, users and employees, and believe you can best take care of others if you focus on taking care of yourself too. Distributed ownership : Taking up responsibilities is encouraged. They share and create opportunities for each other to grow. Build to scale : Everything they do needs to be scalable. This mindset helps us create the impact needed to drive us forward. Quality, then speed : We work intentionally towards a bigger picture that requires us to think before we act. Building a foundation for future success is setting yourself up to win. Role You'll join the Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) Team as the person who takes the AI agents from "signed contract" to "live in production at a real insurer's mailroom" - and keeps them running well after that. You'll own a portfolio of 6–10+ enterprise accounts at different stages, combining deep technical work with real customer contact. What you'll actually do: Lead onboardings from kickoff to go-live; configure and tune our agents for each customer's workflows, document types, and process flows. Build Python integrations with customer back-office systems - REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, custom legacy stacks Tune prompts, evaluate LLM output, and design agent flows for new use cases Lead architecture and security conversations with customer IT teams - SAML/SSO/mTLS, data flows, privacy controls Translate what you see in the field into concrete input for Engineering and Product - your portfolio is our product radar Who you will work with You'll be part of a tight FDE team that shares accounts, reviews each other's work, and learns in the open. Onboarding is structured: you'll ramp on real accounts with a clear owner alongside you, not get handed ten enterprise customers on day one. If you're earlier in your career, you'll have the support to grow into full ownership; if you're senior, you'll have the room to shape how we deliver. We all love you, but… You must understand and speak Dutch to help customers in Belgium and the Netherlands. To be easily available for them, you should also be based in Europe. Paperbox is open to medior and senior profiles. What matters most is that you can do the work and want to do it well. Also, d on't hesitate to apply if you don't fulfil 100% of the requirements. Superheroes don't exist. People with passion and talent do! People skills You communicate smoothly, taking your audience into account. You have the talent to explain technical stuff clearly. You genuinely enjoy customer work: kickoffs, working sessions, and conversations with customer IT teams. A self-directed operator - comfortable holding 6–10+ accounts in your head and planning your own delivery. Technical skills Fluent in Dutch: your customer portfolio is mainly Dutch-speaking. English is a given. Strong Python; you can ship production code independently. Comfortable with LLMs and modern agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent), prompt engineering, evaluation, tuning. Experience setting up integrations: APIs, webhooks, platforms like Make or Zapier. Bonus points Experience as an FDE is a clear plus. Software-As-A-Service experience Affinity with the domain is always relevant. What will you be offered? At Paperbox, they strongly believe in a diverse and healthy work environment. That’s why they provide perks and benefits that help you thrive as a person. A flexible office culture, combining our amazing office space at Wintercircus with the freedom to work where you perform best Competitive salary All the tools you need for success Flexible vacation policy Transparent and digital healthcare insurance by Alan for you and your family Learning & Training opportunities with a flexible training policy A fun and supportive team culture with regular team activities, events and moments to connect (Paperbox is open to both payroll and subcontractors. Benefits will slightly differ, however.) If this sounds like you, please don't hesitate and hit the 'Apply' button! The process If you pass the CV screening, you will have a first video interview with a non-technical recruiter from madewithlove. The selected candidates will receive a technical challenge. Candidates who survive these two rounds will be forwarded to Paperbox, where they will face two more interview rounds, including a role-play exercise. Good luck!

items.desc: You can restart pretty much any device. Also, a bank? Commerzbank is a leading international commercial bank with branches and offices in almost 50 countries. Unlike external consultancies, we are colleagues who stay. Based in Frankfurt, Sofia, and Łódź, we drive high-priority initiatives while building internal expertise that lasts. What's in it for you: Consulting variety meets corporate stability. You join different teams across the bank when your expertise is needed, then move on to the next challenge. As Applied AI Engineer (f/m/x) you won't be doing research or building demos that never ship. You'll design, build and run production-grade systems that bring LLMs, agentic workflows and generative AI into the core of our product and business operations, with an engineering mindset and entrepreneurial ownership: you build it, you own it, and you see the impact in production. At exmox, we're embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build, and in this role AI is what you build every day. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in. If you're excited by complex systems, high traffic, data-driven decisions, and the chance to grow by solving challenging problems, we want to hear from you. What You'll Own Backend development: Design and build performant, well-tested Python/FastAPI services that power AI-driven features and automations. Agentic workflow design: Architect multi-step AI agent pipelines using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom orchestration layers. Define tool schemas, manage state, implement retry/fallback logic, and ensure human-in-the-loop controls where required. LLM integration: Integrate LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models) via APIs and SDKs. Manage prompt engineering, context-window strategies, structured output parsing, streaming, caching, and cost optimization. Generative media API integration: Connect and orchestrate external AI creative tools such as Arcads, Seedance, Runway and more into automated content pipelines. Business process automation: Identify, propose, and implement AI-native automations across the organization, from content creation workflows to data enrichment, QA, customer support, and internal tooling. Cloud & DevOps: Collaborate closely with our Platform team to deploy and operate services on AWS. Manage observability and cost governance for AI workloads. Collaboration: Work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into concrete AI-powered solutions. What You Bring Backend engineering: 5+ years of production Python experience, with strong hands-on knowledge of FastAPI or similar frameworks. LLM integration: Proven experience building LLM-powered applications including prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and cost optimization across providers like OpenAI or Anthropic. Agentic systems: Hands-on experience designing multi-step agent pipelines using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom orchestration layers, including state management, tool schemas, and fallback logic. API integrations: Experience integrating third-party APIs at scale, ideally including generative media or creative AI tools. Engineering mindset: You write clean, tested, production-ready code and take full ownership of what you ship. Stakeholder collaboration: Able to translate ambiguous business problems into concrete technical solutions, working closely with non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Generative media: Exposure to video, image, or audio generation APIs such as Runway, Seedance, or similar. Human-in-the-loop: Experience with AI quality assurance or approval workflows. Scale-up experience: Background in fast-paced, product-led environments. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Beyond project delivery, you will help shape the engineering direction, reusable patterns, and technical standards for all AI-driven automation within the Smart Automation team. AI & Azure Engineering Design, build, and deploy intelligent automation solutions leveraging the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, model orchestration, vector search, secure prompt pipelines, and evaluation frameworks. Develop and maintain production-grade Python services integrated with AI models, Azure AI Foundry workflows, AI hubs, datasets, APIs, and enterprise systems. Create reusable AI components, frameworks, and engineering patterns that can be adopted across multiple teams and business functions. Define and champion best practices for prompt engineering, model governance, AI evaluation, security, and responsible AI deployment. Contribute to AI architecture discussions, technical design decisions, performance optimization, and engineering standards across the Smart Automation team. Build and maintain pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, embeddings generation, vector indexing, retrieval, monitoring, and evaluation. Collaboration & Business Partnership Partner closely with Payroll, Product, and Business SMEs to identify automation opportunities and drive measurable business outcomes. Translate business problems into scalable AI solution designs and technical requirements. Clearly communicate AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with engineers across the Smart Automation team to ensure consistent architecture, engineering quality, and reusable design patterns. Reliability, Governance & Continuous Improvement Ensure all solutions follow modern engineering practices including version control, testing, observability, monitoring, and secure software development. Participate in incident reviews and continuously improve AI architectures through lessons learned. Promote best practices for model evaluation, telemetry, traceability, prompt management, and responsible AI. Stay current with emerging Azure AI and Generative AI capabilities and proactively identify safe adoption opportunities. What you have to offer? Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline. Minimum 5 years of hands-on Python development experience in production environments, including backend development, APIs, automation, integrations, testing, and software engineering best practices. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. Minimum 3 years of experience delivering AI or Machine Learning solutions in production or enterprise environments. Unit tests should be developed alongside code and all solutions must include observability and monitoring from day one. Secrets and credentials must be stored in Azure Key Vault and never in source code repositories or pipeline variables. Azure service-to-service communication must use Managed Identity and Zero Trust principles wherever possible. All AI solutions must implement Content Safety controls, grounding mechanisms, evaluation frameworks, and Responsible AI guardrails before deployment to staging or production environments. Collaboration Standards Engage proactively with Payroll and Product SMEs to validate business requirements and AI solution designs before development begins. …

items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Présentation du contexte : Onepoint accompagne les entreprises et les acteurs publics dans leurs grandes transformations numériques, en combinant expertise métier, stratégie, technologie et accompagnement humain. Frontier Makers est la Business Team Microsoft du Hub Smart Business Transformations. Elle porte la practice AI Business Solutions , dédiée à la conception et au déploiement de solutions d’IA répondant aux enjeux métiers des clients, de la stratégie à l’industrialisation. Dans le cadre du développement de Frontier Makers, Onepoint recherche un ou une Technical Business Leader Microsoft. À l’intersection du conseil, de la technologie et du développement d’activité, ce rôle accompagne les décideurs, construit des offres à forte valeur et pilote des missions stratégiques autour de l’écosystème Microsoft. Écosystème de référence : Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform et Dynamics 365, complétés par Microsoft Azure et Microsoft Foundry selon les besoins des solutions. Vos nouveaux challenges : Identifier et cadrer les cas d’usage agentiques Recueillir et analyser les besoins auprès des équipes métiers et IT. Identifier les processus pouvant être augmentés ou transformés par des agents IA. Définir les objectifs, utilisateurs, données, systèmes et actions nécessaires au fonctionnement des agents. Évaluer la faisabilité, la valeur attendue, les risques et les contraintes d’intégration. Proposer une approche adaptée entre configuration, low-code et développement sur mesure. Concevoir et prototyper des solutions Concevoir des architectures agentiques adaptées aux cas d’usage. Développer des prototypes, POC et MVP sur l’écosystème Microsoft. Mettre en œuvre des solutions avec Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform et les services Azure. Connecter les agents aux données, applications et processus de l’entreprise. Mettre en place des mécanismes de recherche et de génération augmentée par les connaissances. Intégrer les agents aux environnements Microsoft 365 et aux applications métiers. Tester rapidement les hypothèses fonctionnelles et techniques avec les utilisateurs. Garantir la qualité et la maîtrise des solutions Définir les scénarios de tests fonctionnels, techniques et utilisateurs. Évaluer la pertinence, la fiabilité et la robustesse des réponses et actions produites. Prendre en compte les enjeux de sécurité, de confidentialité, de conformité et de gouvernance. Concevoir les mécanismes de contrôle humain, de traçabilité et de supervision adaptés au cas d’usage. Documenter les choix de conception, les limites et les conditions d’exploitation. Préparer l’industrialisation et le passage à l’échelle Transformer les prototypes validés en solutions robustes, maintenables et déployables. Définir les conditions du passage en production avec les architectes et les équipes Cloud. Contribuer à l’observabilité, à la gestion des accès, au monitoring et à l’amélioration continue. Construire des composants, connecteurs, patterns et accélérateurs réutilisables. Capitaliser les réalisations dans les assets de l’Agentic Studio et des AI Builders. Diffuser une culture de l’expérimentation Animer des ateliers de co-construction avec les métiers. Présenter et démontrer les solutions de manière claire et pédagogique. Contribuer aux hackathons, démonstrateurs et initiatives d’innovation. Partager les bonnes pratiques au sein des communautés Microsoft, Data & IA et développement. Votre profil et les expertises que vous souhaitez développer : Vous êtes diplômé d’une école d’ingénieurs, d’une formation informatique ou d’une université. Vous disposez d’une expérience en développement logiciel, Data, intelligence artificielle, automatisation ou intégration de solutions. Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge un sujet de bout en bout, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au prototype fonctionnel. Vous avez une expérience ou une forte appétence pour Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Power Platform ou les services Azure. Vous comprenez les principes des LLM, du prompt engineering, des embeddings, des bases vectorielles, du RAG et de l’orchestration d’agents. Vous savez intégrer des API, des sources de données et des applications métiers. Une expérience en développement Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET ou dans un environnement low-code constitue un atout. Vous êtes sensibilisé aux problématiques de sécurité, de gouvernance …

items.desc: About us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we can empower everyone to experience the world. FinTech business unit – with teams in Amsterdam, Bangalore, London and Shanghai – develops new products and drives innovation to help us continue removing financial friction from the travel process. That makes buying and selling travel-related products and services simpler for both travelers and partners. The newly established Data & AI organisation within FinTech: Financial Systems/Enterprise Applications brings together Enterprise Data Products, AI First Finance (Finance Intelligence & Autonomous Finance), and Intelligent Automation into a single, unified organization. To support this vision, the Architecture team requires a strong technical lead for the Data and Product AI organisation to partner across trusted Finance intelligence, governed agent workflows, and scalable data foundations, establishing clear architecture responsibility while collaborating closely with Product and Engineering on delivery and trade-offs. Role Description AI First Finance is transforming how Finance teams across Booking Holdings access information, make decisions and execute work. We are developing trusted Finance intelligence and governed AI workflows, connecting certified financial data with reusable enterprise capabilities. As our Data & AI Architect, you will lead technical design for these capabilities and work hands-on with engineering teams to bring them into production. You will connect data products, semantic models, enterprise systems and AI services into solutions that are reliable, traceable and practical to operate. Your designs will support shared capabilities across brands while respecting local business definitions, systems and data-access boundaries. You will partner closely with the AI First Finance Product leaders, engineering leaders, Finance experts, enterprise data teams and Central Technology. Together, you will translate prioritized business problems into achievable delivery increments, making trade-offs between speed, quality, cost and risk explicit. You will validate critical decisions through working implementations and production evidence, and develop reusable patterns that help subsequent teams deliver faster. Key Job Responsibilities Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Data Governance, Legal, Security, and Compliance to translate business priorities and governance policies into scalable architecture, balancing value, delivery speed, cost, and risk. Connect AI products to certified Finance data with clear definitions, data contracts, quality standards, lineage, and access controls. Design Finance intelligence with governed calculations, traceable answers, and evaluation against examples validated by Finance. Design and deploy AI workflows with secure integrations, robust SAP and third-party application connections, appropriate permissions, human approvals, and safe failure handling. Reuse, extend, and evaluate enterprise capabilities, making clear build, buy, and reuse decisions in collaboration with Central Technology. Validate architecture through prototypes, reference implementations, code reviews, process automation, and hands-on support for production delivery. Embed evaluation, monitoring, audit evidence, SOX compliance, and segregation of duties (SoD) risk controls throughout the AI lifecycle alongside Engineering, Security, and Risk & Controls. Architect robust compliance structures and reusable patterns across teams and brands that scale with company growth while respecting local business definitions and data boundaries. Measure quality, reliability, performance, cost, and reuse to guide continuous improvements with Product and Engineering. Qualifications 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with at least 3–5 years in a lead or architect role owning platform design for large organisations Delivered at least one enterprise data or AI platform into supported production (with SLAs, on-call and real internal users), using tools like Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka or Airflow. items.desc: G2A.COM is the world's largest marketplace for digital entertainment. On our platform, over 35 million people from 180 countries have already purchased more than 145 million digital items. Why? Sellers from all over the world present a rich offering of over 125,000 digital codes for games, software, gift cards, subscriptions, DLCs, in-game items, and various digital entertainment. We are a safe marketplace, where sellers guarantee instant delivery. What else sets us apart? G2A.COM is a place co-created by a team of around 400 exceptional experts representing 10 nationalities. Most of us work in a hybrid model, some remotely, or on-site in a chosen location. Our R&D center is in Rzeszow, we also have office in Warsaw. The company's main headquarters are in Hong Kong, with the central office in Amsterdam. We address each other by our first name, we are supportive, and we share knowledge. We operate based on DEI values – Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion and provide extensive development opportunities – in 2025, we delivered approximately 86 development and wellbeing events. We work in a dynamically changing environment, continuously implementing and utilizing the latest technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) or augmented reality (AR). Our mission is to seek new opportunities , pursue continuous growth , and deliver engaging entertainment . G2A’s vision is to build and strengthen its position as a leader in the digital industry by creating a comprehensive, integrated digital ecosystem based on innovative technologies and cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. As part of our “First in Digital, Digital First” strategy, we emphasize the balance between being external innovators and internal drivers of progress—leading digital transformation while simultaneously developing people to thrive in an ever-changing environment. This approach allows us to shape a future where technology and human potential go hand in hand, delivering exceptional results and driving sustainable growth. We regularly check job satisfaction. According to the latest survey, as many as 96% of people trust themselves and support one another, 97% appreciate teamwork, and 83% highly value managerial support. The average tenure at G2A.COM is an impressive 5 years. This is simply a place where people want to be. We place particular emphasis on maintaining a healthy work–life balance, as well as on the value of Deliver Value – providing value to the user, the company, oneself, and the people we work or collaborate with. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to collaborate and create projects with international brands such as Google, PayPal, Amazon, VISA, Mastercard, PayU, EY, Synerise, Modivo, Empik, and Microsoft. We think and act globally, and in our daily work, we are guided by analysis and data, although intuition and experience-based insights are also considered a significant asset. We invite you to join us on the journey of co-creating Gate2Adventure – the gateway to the world of digital entertainment. We’re waiting for you! At G2A, we’re looking for an AI Automation Engineer who wants to harness the potential of artificial intelligence to create solutions that transform the way we work at G2A.COM. If automation, system integrations, and AI models are areas you’re eager to explore, experiment with, and develop your skills in while turning ideas into tangible business results, this role is for you. As part of our team, you’ll design and develop intelligent workflows in n8n, build integrations, and create solutions powered by LLMs and AI agents to streamline processes and free teams from repetitive tasks. Join us and make a real impact on how we put AI into practice from the initial idea, through prototyping, to deploying solutions in production. You're a perfect match for the role, if: You have at least 3 years of experience in process automation, system integration, or backend development You have experience building and maintaining production workflows in n8n or similar tools, such as Make or Zapier, and are eager to further develop your skills in n8n You're proficient in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and working with JSON is second nature to you You have a good understanding of REST APIs and system integration mechanisms, including webhooks, OAuth 2.0, API tokens, pagination, and rate limits You have hands-on experience using language model APIs, such as Claude or OpenAI, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool calling You know how to build reliable solutions, with a focus on error handling, idempotency, logging, and testing workflows before deployment You're familiar with Git, Docker, and the basics of Linux You understand the importance of GDPR and the principles of securely processing sensitive data in AI-powered solutions You have a process-oriented mindset: you look for ways to simplify a process before automating it You understand business …

items.desc: Job Title: Junior Prompt Engineer Reports To: AI Team Lead Position Overview: We are excited to announce an opening for a Junior Prompt Engineer within our team! This is a crucial role in driving the transformational use of cutting-edge artificial intelligence across Workforce Management at Softworks, acting as the bridge between foundation model capabilities and user-facing value. We believe that the true power of AI lies in execution and turning research into functional, scalable, and highly reliable business tools. The successful candidate will support our AI lab’s rapid prototyping initiatives by testing prompts, evaluating model responses, and assisting in building early-stage POCs from concept through testing. Acting as an entry-level practitioner, this role combines hands-on prompt crafting, quality assurance, and dataset preparation to validate new product capabilities. This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic, highly curious individual passionate about generative AI to learn from experienced engineers and build a career within a growing organisation. Role Responsibilities: Rapid Prototyping & POC Development · Assist senior engineers and product managers in building and iterating on early-stage POCs to validate new AI-driven features, workflows, and integrations. · Help turn early AI ideas into functional prototypes that prove what is possible while supporting product and operational efficiency validation. Prompt Crafting & Engineering: · Write, test, and refine prompts across various foundational models, such as GPT-4, Claude 3, Llama 3, Gemini, etc., to achieve high quality, reliable outputs. · Experiment with prompt structures to optimise response accuracy, tone, and logic formatting. Quality Assurance & Evaluation: · Run systematic testing frameworks on model outputs to evaluate performance, latency, and effectiveness. · Categorise model responses, identify hallucinations, and log performance metrics to continuously improve overall reliability. Data Preparation & Management: · Assist in gathering, cleaning, and formatting datasets for prompt testing, few-shot examples, and basic RAG experiments. · Ensure data preparation adheres to security, quality, and organisational standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: · Foster collaboration within the Softworks Group and liaise effectively with other departments and stakeholders. · Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous learning within the AI team. · Stay up to date with the rapidly evolving AI landscape, model updates, and emerging tools. · Document prompt experiments, successes, failures, and best practices to share knowledge with the broader AI team. Requirements: Education & Qualifications: · Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or related field. Professional Skills: Foundational understanding of LLMs, including context windows, prompting techniques, strengths, and limitations. Hands-on experience, or a strong tinkering mindset, experimenting with AI tools, e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney. Basic programming proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or scripting, with an understanding of REST APIs and running code snippets. Analytical mindset with high attention to detail for analysing text outputs, identifying edge cases, and verifying logic formatting. Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing technology landscape. Excellent problem-solving, analytical and technical troubleshooting skills Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Desirable: · Personal projects, hackathon entries, or GitHub repositories demonstrating simple AI/LLM integrations. · Familiarity with Ai-assisted development tools, such as Cursor or Claude. · Basic understanding of LLM orchestration frameworks, e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or direct API documentation, e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic. Expectations: · Demonstrate agility in a fast-changing technological environment, being open and adaptable to unsuspecting change. · Encouraging excellence and goal achievement within Softworks, while striving for the same in your personal development. · Communicate regularly and efficiently with all stakeholders, both internal and external. · Maintain strong co-operative relationships within the team and other departments to ensure that the organisation continues to function successfully. · Ability to analyse complex data, identify issues, and recommend solutions. · High level of accuracy and a commitment to producing high quality work. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and concisely. · Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines. · Strong ethical standards and a professional approach to work. items.desc: AI Engineer Location: Co Westmeath, mostly on-site Type: Permanent Reports to: Engineering Lead About the Role My client, based in Co Westmeath, is a growing international business. They’re hiring a permanent AI Engineer to design, build and run AI-powered applications, intelligent agents and data-driven solutions that automate work and support better decision-making. This is a hands-on role blending software engineering, data engineering and applied AI. You’ll build scalable, secure, production-ready solutions using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks, and you’ll turn the company’s proprietary data into reliable, automated insight and action. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows that automate data processing, analysis, reporting and wider business processes. Build LLM-powered applications, integrating external models and services while optimising prompts, context management, performance and cost. Develop RAG solutions, vector databases and AI-driven data pipelines that combine structured and unstructured data. Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and APIs to securely connect AI systems to internal databases, applications and third-party services. Own AI features from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, observability, safe rollback and evaluation of accuracy, latency, reliability and cost. Apply MLOps/LLMOps best practice, including version control, CI/CD, containerisation and automated deployment. Put guardrails, access controls and audit trails around agents working with sensitive data, in line with security, privacy and responsible AI standards. Work with data engineers, data scientists and business stakeholders to turn business problems into practical AI solutions, and keep clear technical documentation. Skills & Experience Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline. 3+ years in software engineering, data engineering or AI/ML development, with a track record of delivering production solutions. Strong Python, with hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude or similar) and AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent. Working knowledge of MCP, RAG, vector databases, embeddings and system-level prompt engineering. Experience with Azure AI or other cloud AI platforms, plus MLOps/LLMOps practices, Docker and CI/CD. Solid grasp of AI security, governance, privacy and responsible AI. Experience in a regulated industry is desirable. Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions. The Person A self-directed technical expert who can work on their own initiative and deliver best-practice AI that supports the team’s goals. Curious and pragmatic, keeping pace with a fast-moving AI landscape and recommending new tools only where they add real business value. A strong relationship builder who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre futur collectif : La Communauté Atlantique regroupe 350 talents Expertises: Data/IA, Architecture, Développement, Product/ Projet Management, Test, Devops/Cloud, Cybersécurité. 3000m² d’espaces de travail exceptionnels et flambant neufs en plein centre-ville (Salle de sport, Fablab, Medialab, Livepoint…). Solidement ancrée auprès de comptes locaux, elle dispose d’un centre d’excellence reconnu également nationalement. Dotée d’une forte dynamique collective, elle offre un cadre stimulant le développement des expertises en connexion avec nos communautés nationales et met en œuvre des modèles à forte valeur ajoutée pour ses clients. Vous intervenez entre autres sur les missions suivantes : Implémenter des solutions RAG, agents IA et assistants métiers. Intégrer des LLM dans les systèmes existants et orchestrer leurs interactions. Optimiser les prompts, embeddings et chaînes d’orchestration pour améliorer la pertinence et la performance. Gérer les problématiques de coûts, latence et sécurité des solutions GenAI. Mettre en place les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance et de conformité pour l’IA générative. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers pour assurer la cohérence des solutions. Vos challenges au quotidien : Vous intervenez sur tout le cycle de vie du projet, du conseil au code : Cadrer et architecturer : analyser le besoin métier pour définir la meilleure stratégie (RAG, agents, fine-tuning) et la stack adaptée à l'environnement client. Industrialiser : développer du code robuste et modulaire (Python) pour intégrer les LLM aux SI existants (API, Data Lakes) et sortir de la logique de POC. Optimiser et sécuriser : garantir la viabilité des solutions en maîtrisant les coûts/latences (LLMOps) et en implémentant les barrières de sécurité (guardrails). Accompagner : vulgariser les concepts techniques et guider les équipes métiers et IT du client dans l'adoption de ces nouvelles technologies. Votre palette technique : Nous ne cherchons pas un expert d'un seul outil, mais un ingénieur capable de naviguer dans des écosystèmes variés. Voici les technologies sur lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir et conseiller : Le socle : maîtrise indispensable de Python et des bonnes pratiques de Software Engineering (Clean Code, Git, CI/CD) pour garantir la robustesse des livrables chez nos clients. LLM et orchestration : capacité à orchestrer des chaînes complexes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) et à choisir le bon modèle pour le bon usage (OpenAI, Azure AI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, ou solutions open source type Mistral/Llama). Data et bases vectorielles : savoir intégrer la solution dans l'écosystème data du client, que ce soit sur Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate ou directement via pgvector/Elasticsearch. Architecture et cloud : aisance à déployer aussi bien sur AWS, Azure que GCP, ou dans des environnements on-premise contraints. LLMOps : mettre en place les outils de monitoring et d'évaluation adaptés au client (LangSmith, MLflow, Ragas, etc.). Votre profil : ingénieur et pédagogue Expérience : vous avez un background solide en Data Science, Data Engineering ou Software Engineering (min. 2 ans) et avez pivoté vers l'IA générative avec des premières réalisations concrètes (projets pros ou personnels avancés). Polyvalence : vous ne bloquez pas si le client utilise Azure au lieu d'AWS. Vous apprenez vite et savez vous adapter aux contraintes (legacy, sécurité bancaire, etc.). Posture conseil : vous savez vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes. Vous êtes capable d'expliquer pourquoi un RAG est nécessaire (ou non) à un directeur métier. Mindset « Prod-Ready » : vous codez proprement. Vous savez que la valeur d'un consultant se mesure à la pérennité de ce qu'il laisse derrière lui. We are looking for a Geospatial Platform Engineer to help design, develop and operate scalable software systems that enable discovery, access, processing and integration of geospatial and EO data across cloud and hybrid environments.

You will work closely with senior architects, software engineers, scientists and external partners to translate business and technical requirements into reliable, interoperable and production-ready solutions.

 Develop reusable platform services, APIs and integration components while preserving each product’s domain-specific capabilities.
 Apply open geospatial standards, including STAC and OGC APIs, to build interoperable catalogue, search and data-access capabilities.
 Work with modern cloud-native geospatial formats and tooling, including COG, Zarr, GDAL/rasterio and Xarray.
 Build and integrate REST APIs, backend services and data processing components following established software engineering practices.
 Explore and prototype automation opportunities, including AI-assisted and agent-based solutions supporting data curation, operational workflows, testing and documentation.
 Contribute to user-facing capabilities with a focus on usability, including API-first services, notebook-based workflows and interactive geospatial applications.
 Participate in the design and implementation of data ingestion, transformation and integration workflows across multiple systems and providers.
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing processes and software delivery workflows.
 Troubleshoot performance, configuration and integration issues across platform components with support from senior team members.
 Collaborate with internal teams and technical suppliers on integration activities, technical reviews and delivery milestones.
 Produce and maintain technical documentation, software design specifications, requirements analyses and operational procedures.
 Stay informed about emerging technologies and best practices in cloud-native geospatial platforms, workflow orchestration and AI-enabled automation.

 Up to 5 years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, geospatial applications or related technical fields.
 Strong software development skills, preferably in Python.
 Understanding of modern web application and API architectures, including REST APIs, authentication mechanisms and basic microservice patterns.
 Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform such as AWS or Azure.

 Demonstrated willingness to learn rapidly and progressively take ownership of technical responsibilities.

D'abord qui D'abord qui ️ Compétences Requises ️ Architecture Cloud & SI Environnement Cloud : Expertise sur Google Cloud (GCP) / Vertex AI en priorité. La maîtrise d'Azure ou AWS est un plus apprécié. Intégration SI : Solide maîtrise des architectures distribuées, des API, de la gestion des identités et des flux de données. Socle Data : Connaissances avancées en Data Engineering et structuration des socles de données. Expertise IA & LLMOps IA Agentique & RAG : Maîtrise des architectures RAG avancées, des agents IA et du protocole MCP. Outillage IA : Pratique de Vertex AI, Dataiku ou environnements équivalents. LLMOps & Sécurité : Maîtrise des enjeux d'évaluation, de supervision de modèles en prod, et sécurité OWASP LLM. Profil Recherché Expérience : 6 ans minimum d'expérience, dont 2 à 3 ans sur des projets Data ou IA déployés en production. Parcours : Idéalement issu d'un parcours de Développeur ayant évolué vers le rôle d'Architecte Cloud ou Data (avec une première expérience en cabinet de conseil). Certifications (un vrai plus) : Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect ou Machine Learning Engineer. Posture : Capacité à dialoguer d'égal à égal avec une DSI, arbitrages argumentés à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et forte capacité de vulgarisation auprès des métiers. Langues : Français & Anglais courants (lu, parlé, écrit). Ensuite quoi Ensuite quoi Contexte & Ambition Passer du prototype à la production impose des choix structurants : choix des modèles, hébergement, sécurité et maîtrise des coûts. En tant qu’Architecte IA / IA Agentique, vous arbitrez ces choix complexes avec le client, garantissez la faisabilité technique dès la phase d'avant-vente et concevez des architectures pérennes intégrées au SI client. Missions Principales Architecture Cible : Concevoir les architectures des solutions d’IA Générative (RAG, agents autonomes, protocole MCP) et orchestrer leur intégration au SI existant. Arbitrages Techniques : Sélectionner les modèles, les modes d'hébergement et les approches (Build vs Buy, RAG vs Fine-tuning) en fonction des contraintes budgétaires et métiers. Avant-vente & Chiffrage : Rédiger la partie technique des propositions commerciales, chiffrer les solutions et défendre les architectures en soutenance aux côtés des équipes business. items.desc: AU QUOTIDIEN ÇA DONNE QUOI ? Pour accélérer la transformation de ses activités par l’IA, le Head Office du pôle Investment & Protection Services (IPS) renforce son équipe Data & AI. Nous recrutons un AI Engineer / Data Scientist spécialisé en IA générative, rattaché hiérarchiquement au pôle et positionné au plus près des métiers. Votre enjeu : transformer des opportunités à fort potentiel en solutions concrètes, robustes et créatrices de valeur. Vous développerez une vision transverse des activités de Cardif, Wealth Management, Asset Management et Real Estate grâce à plusieurs rotations. Leur calendrier, généralement compris entre 18 et 24 mois, s’adaptera aux opportunités et aux priorités du pôle. Votre première mission se déroulera au sein de l’équipe AI Solutions du Head Office de BNP Paribas Wealth Management. Vous contribuerez directement à la transformation de ses processus et de ses activités grâce à des solutions d’IA générative et agentique. VOS OBJECTIFS Vous accélérerez l’adoption de l’IA au sein des métiers du pôle en vous appuyant sur les standards et les assets du Groupe. Vous transformerez des opportunités GenAI en solutions concrètes, mesurables et intégrées aux processus métiers, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de protection des données sensibles. Vous tirerez parti des partenariats stratégiques du Groupe avec IBM, Mistral, Anthropic, Google et Microsoft pour sélectionner les technologies les plus adaptées à chaque cas d’usage. VOS RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS Vous cadrerez, avec les équipes métier, des cas d’usage à fort impact en intégrant dès l’amont les enjeux de valeur et de ROI. Vous concevrez et déploierez des agents via la plateforme interne et en Python avancé, et développerez des solutions sur mesure en arbitrant entre performance, coût et robustesse. Vous industrialiserez les solutions à l’échelle : mise en production, CI/CD, monitoring, auditabilité et optimisation des coûts. Vous accompagnerez les utilisateurs métiers dans la conception des interfaces, le développement des outils et leur prise en main. Vous contribuerez aux standards d’architecture, de sécurité et de qualité, documenterez les choix et les tests, et développerez des accélérateurs et des briques transverses réutilisables. Vous travaillerez à Paris, à deux pas de l’Opéra et du boulevard Haussmann, dans des locaux récemment rénovés et organisés en flex office au sein d'une équipe taille humaine. ET APRÈS ? Ce poste vous placera au cœur de projets GenAI à fort impact business, dans un environnement international couvrant l’Europe et l’Asie, au contact direct des métiers et des sponsors. La visibilité stratégique de vos projets vous permettra de bâtir rapidement un réseau solide au sein du pôle IPS, du groupe BNP Paribas et de l’écosystème de partenaires externes : Mistral, Anthropic, Google et Microsoft. À l’issue de cette première mission, vous pourrez rejoindre d’autres métiers du pôle IPS et faire évoluer votre parcours vers une expertise technique, des fonctions transverses ou des responsabilités davantage orientées business. LES AVANTAGES À NOUS REJOINDRE : En rejoignant BNP Paribas, vous bénéficierez d’un environnement de travail stimulant et d’avantages conçus pour accompagner votre quotidien : Un package rémunération et des avantages : Une rémunération fixe annuelle versée sur 12 mois, ajustée à votre profil et à votre expérience. Une rémunération variable individuelle, liée à l’atteinte d’objectifs individuels et collectifs ainsi qu’aux résultats de l’entreprise, versée annuellement au prorata du temps de travail et de présence. Des dispositifs d’épargne salariale et retraite, l’intéressement et la participation, une couverture santé et prévoyance, une offre de restauration ainsi que les activités sociales et culturelles du CSE. Un rythme de travail hybride pouvant aller jusqu’à 2,5 jours de télétravail par semaine, à définir avec votre manager. Rejoignez un Groupe engagé auprès de ses clients et de la société, et contribuez activement à notre transformation en faveur d’un monde plus durable. Impliquez-vous à nos côtés, sur votre temps professionnel, grâce à notre programme One Million Hours To Help. ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE PROCHAIN AI ENGINEER H/F? Diplômé d’un Bac+5 en Data Science, informatique ou programmation, vous justifiez d’au moins 4 à 5 ans d’expérience en ML Engineering ou Data Science. Vous maîtrisez l’industrialisation de solutions — déploiement et monitoring — avec des technologies telles que GitLab, Kubernetes, Docker ou Domino, idéalement dans un environnement régulé traitant des données sensibles. Vous maîtrisez Python, les environnements Jupyter, les SDK de plateformes internes et la création d’API. Vous disposez d’une expérience concrète en IA générative et agentique, notamment sur les technologies suivantes : RAG, y compris les approches hybrides, LLM-as-a-Judge et protocoles d’évaluation avancés ; Workflows d’IA générative (LangChain, LlamaIndex…), frameworks agentiques …

items.desc: Sammanfattning Vill du hjälpa till att forma framtiden för AI-drivet arbete? På Avanade får du möjlighet att designa, bygga och implementera banbrytande generativ AI och agentisk AI-lösningar med hjälp av den senaste Microsoft-teknologin. Vi söker en innovativ och praktisk AI-ingenjör till vår Data & AI-verksamhet. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kunder och multidisciplinära team för att utveckla intelligenta lösningar som löser verkliga affärsutmaningar med hjälp av Large Language Models (LLM), AI-agenter, automation och Microsoft AI-plattformar. Den idealiska kandidaten kombinerar starka grundkunskaper inom mjukvaruutveckling och/eller data engineering med en passion för framväxande AI-teknologier och en vilja att ständigt lära, experimentera och innovera. Du kommer att bli en del av en livlig gemenskap av AI- och data-specialister, arkitekter, ingenjörer och konsulter som hjälper organisationer att förändra hur de arbetar genom generativ AI. Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder för att förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera möjligheter för AI-adoption och översätta krav till säkra, skalbara och produktionsklara lösningar. Rollen kombinerar praktisk ingenjörskonst, lösningsdesign, snabb prototypframställning, kundnära konsultation och kontinuerlig innovation. Du kommer att bidra genom hela lösningens livscykel, från discovery och proof of concept till implementering, utvärdering och optimering. Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Designa, utveckla och distribuera AI-drivna applikationer och agentiska lösningar med hjälp av Microsoft AI-teknologier. Bygga och optimera Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-lösningar och kunskapsåtervinning-lösningar. Bidra till AI-lösningsarkitektur, teknisk design, utveckling, testning, implementering och dokumentation. Delta i kundworkshops, discovery-sessioner, demonstrationer och tekniska diskussioner med både affärs- och tekniska intressenter. Tillämpa principer för ansvarsfull AI, styrningskontroller och utvärderingsramverk genom hela AI-utvecklingslivscykeln. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets. Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming. Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging. Now we are looking for a AI Engineer (LLM focus) to build and scale the core intelligence behind Summy AI Copilot , our agentic assistant for compliance officers. This is an exciting opportunity to own a cutting-edge GenAI product, pushing LLMs beyond basic text generation to execute complex reasoning, and autonomous tasks. What You Will Be Doing: Drive Summy AI Copilot: Own the core intelligence behind our AI assistant for compliance officers, taking features from concept to production rollout and operation. Agentic Experience: Evolve our public MCP server and Agent Skills so that external AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc) can work with Sumsub reliably and securely. Pragmatic Iteration: Start with elementary, solid baselines and iteratively scale complexity based on real-world production metrics and A/B tests. About You: Experience: 5+ years in Software/Data/ML Engineering, with 1+ years explicitly focused on building and shipping production-grade GenAI/LLM systems. In-Depth LLM Knowledge: You understand how LLMs work under the hood. You know how to push models far beyond basic text generation (e.g., structured extraction, tool calling, cost-aware routing). LLM Stack Mastery: Hands-on experience with agentic orchestration (LangChain/LangGraph) and modern LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI). Engineering Excellence: You write production-ready code for microservices (Java/Dropwizard), with experience in cloud deployments (GCP/AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). Ownership: You own the system from early talks with customers to operating it in production. Nice to have Background in classical NLP, traditional MLOps, or large-scale data engineering. Familiarity with compliance, anti-fraud, KYC/AML, or fintech domains. Experience shipping production RAG systems. What We Offer: Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours. True flexibility. We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team. Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal. Work that matters. Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online. Compensation. We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market. Truly global. We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide. Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums. Celebrating your big moments. We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family. Team offsites. Our clients trust us to navigate complexity and make it real: turning ambition into action in environments where the margin for error is small and the consequences of getting it wrong are real, for customers, employees, supply chains, and the bottom line. Build and Scale the AI Solutions That Drive Real Business Impact Our Technology & Innovation team is growing, and we are looking for a GenAI Engineer who is curious and eager to grow with us. As a GenAI Engineer you will uncover scalable AI solutions that create real business value, while applying state-of-the-art GenAI, Python development, cloud platforms, and modern MLOps for CI/CD and monitoring. You'll be part of a true collective, working alongside consultants, data engineers, and AI specialists to deliver impact-driven solutions. items.desc: We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to own the overall technical architecture of the entire GoMining ecosystem, not just individual products. Your scope covers the architecture of all key domains (Payments, Cards, Custody, Wallet, Mining, and Core Platform) and the connections between them. You will ensure that our products, platforms, infrastructure, and financial services operate as a scalable, secure, reliable, and interconnected ecosystem. This is a highly influential role that requires both strategic architectural vision and deep hands-on engineering expertise. You will shape the target architecture, define technical standards, manage architectural dependencies, make critical technical decisions, and help teams choose the right path. You will work closely with the CTO, engineering leadership, and product teams. Proven experience in FinTech, banking, payments, or cryptocurrency platforms is mandatory. Key Responsibilities Own and continuously evolve the end-to-end architecture of the GoMining ecosystem. Define the target enterprise architecture, architectural principles, standards, and long-term technology roadmap. Ensure architectural consistency and seamless integration across financial products, payments, wallets, custody, cards, mining services, and core platform infrastructure. Design scalable and resilient distributed systems capable of supporting millions of users and high transaction volumes. Establish clear architectural boundaries, service ownership, integration patterns, and data flows across multiple engineering teams. Drive critical architecture decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. Identify and eliminate architectural bottlenecks, technical debt, scalability limitations, and system dependencies. Lead architecture reviews and provide technical guidance to engineering teams. Collaborate with the CTO, Engineering Leads, Product Leaders, and business stakeholders to align technical architecture with business strategy. Evaluate new technologies, architectural approaches, and infrastructure solutions. Ensure security, reliability, observability, performance, and operational resilience are embedded into architectural decisions. Remain deeply involved in technical discussions, solution design, and implementation reviews. Requirements 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in enterprise, platform, or solution architecture roles. Mandatory experience architecting systems within FinTech, banking, payments, digital banking, or cryptocurrency companies. Proven experience designing architecture across multiple interconnected products, services, or business domains. Strong software engineering background, ideally as a Senior / Lead / Principal Engineer. Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, and integration patterns. Experience designing high-load, fault-tolerant, and mission-critical systems. Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience driving architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience with card issuing, payment processing, banking integrations, or financial ledgers. Experience building or transforming complex multi-product financial ecosystems. Familiarity with PCI DSS, KYC, AML, and financial compliance requirements. Experience scaling platforms to millions of users.
