items.desc: SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. Nos chiffres clés : 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. ▪️ À propos de la mission En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients. Architecture & Ingénierie GenAI Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production : Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching , system prompts ) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP). Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct). Industrialisation & FinOps : Évaluation de la fiabilité (LLM-as-a-judge), maîtrise des coûts au token, guardrails de sécurité (AI Act, prompt injection, étanchéité des données) et déploiement multi-cloud (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI). Formation & Transmission "Développeur Augmenté" (SFEIR Institute) Tu es le visage de l'excellence pédagogique de SFEIR. Tu conçois et animes nos parcours phares (jusqu'à 60% de pratique / labs) pour transformer les méthodes de dev chez nos clients : Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté ( Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate ) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI. Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte (CLAUDE.md, règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés. Pédagogie & Regard Critique : Vulgarisation adaptative (du décideur à l'ingénieur) tout en insufflant une culture de la sécurité (code review, vulnérabilités) et du maintien des compétences en dev classique. Conseil & Stratégie GenAI Tu transformes des besoins métiers complexes ou flous en feuilles de route opérationnelles et à fort ROI : Cadrage & Roadmap : Animation d'ateliers d'idéation, priorisation des cas d'usage ( Quick Wins vs Chantiers structurants ) et construction du business case pour les sponsors. Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy , conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token. Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement. ▪️ Le profil idéal Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) ou bénéficiant d'une solide expérience terrain équivalente dans la conception logicielle et l'architecture système. Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle ou architecture cloud, avec une spécialisation marquée et récente en IA générative , ingénierie de prompt et orchestration agentique. Une première expérience réussie en formation/consulting ou une appétence forte pour la transmission est indispensable. ▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, …

Experience with Azure OpenAI and/or the OpenAI API. Practical experience with LangChain and LangGraph. Experience building production RAG systems using Azure AI Search or similar technologies. Strong knowledge of FastAPI, asynchronous programming and streaming. Experience with LLM evaluation and observability. Nice to have Experience with Azure AI Foundry or Azure AI Document Intelligence. Familiarity with Langfuse, MLflow or Databricks. Knowledge of spec-driven development (SDD). items.desc: About Proxify Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Stockholm, Proxify helps 2,500+ companies worldwide scale their technical teams. We're now expanding beyond providing individual engineers to helping clients identify, build, and deploy valuable AI-powered solutions. The challenge Companies know AI can transform how they operate, but often struggle to identify where it creates real value and how to turn an opportunity into a working solution. That's where you come in. You'll be the senior technical and consultative counterpart in our client conversations. Working closely with our commercial team, you'll understand clients' business challenges, identify where AI agents and automation can make a meaningful difference, and turn promising opportunities into clearly scoped projects. You'll own the journey from initial discovery through solution design, estimation, and proposal delivery, helping clients understand what's feasible and what it takes to succeed. Once a project is agreed upon, you'll hand over to a Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE), who owns implementation and may lead additional engineers from the Proxify network. You'll remain involved when important technical or commercial decisions require your input, but you won't be responsible for day-to-day development. What you'll do Lead technical pre-sales and discovery : Work directly with prospective clients to understand their business processes, existing systems, data, and challenges. Identify AI opportunities : Find high-value use cases for AI agents and automation, and recognize when conventional software or simpler solutions are more appropriate. Design solutions : Develop credible high-level architectures, identify integrations and technical dependencies, and assess feasibility, security, and operational requirements. Scope and estimate projects : Translate opportunities into actionable project briefs with clear deliverables, assumptions, technical requirements, success criteria, and realistic effort estimates. Support winning deals : Work closely with the commercial team on proposals, solution presentations, technical objections, and client conversations. Enable successful delivery : Validate feasibility with engineering before commitments are made, and hand over projects effectively to our FDEs, who own the technical implementation. Improve our offering : Help develop repeatable approaches, reusable solution patterns, and best practices as we scale our AI solutions business. Occasional client site visits. Must-have Strong technical background : 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or a similar role, with enough technical depth to design and scope real-world systems. Practical AI expertise : Hands-on experience building or designing LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and workflow automations. You understand what these technologies can and cannot reliably do. Outstanding client-facing skills : You can confidently lead conversations with senior stakeholders, uncover underlying business needs, build trust, challenge assumptions, and manage expectations. Technical pre-sales and solution design : Experience translating ambiguous business problems into technical solutions, project scopes, estimates, and proposals. Business and commercial judgment : You understand how to assess expected value, prioritize opportunities, balance solution complexity against business impact, and avoid overengineering. Systems thinking : Comfortable understanding unfamiliar architectures, data environments, integrations, and technical constraints. Strong communication : Fluent professional English and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ownership and autonomy : Comfortable running several opportunities in parallel, independently driving progress, and collaborating with commercial and engineering teams. Nice to have Experience in a solutions architect, solutions engineer, technical pre-sales, or client-facing consulting role. Experience delivering production AI solutions for external clients. Experience designing or building AI prototypes to demonstrate feasibility and support sales. Experience estimating and scoping software projects delivered by other engineers. Experience in a startup or scale-up, where priorities shift quickly and processes are still being established. Why you'll like it You'll be directly involved in and learn at the forefront of the most exciting technology shift of our time at the intersection of AI, technology, business, and client relationships, helping companies move from AI ambitions to concrete solutions. Enjoy flexible remote work alongside our homey office in central Stockholm. You will tackle varied industry challenges and help shape our AI solutions division, reporting directly to our first hire in this space, Akash Shrivastava.

items.desc: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et mettre vos compétences au service des Allocations Familiales, c’est ici ! Rejoignez-nous et participez au développement des solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle pour l'ensemble de la branche Famille ! Qui sommes-nous ? La CNAF (Caisse Nationale des Allocations Familiales), tête de réseau des 101 CAF, représente la branche Famille de la Sécurité sociale et a pour mission de piloter la politique familiale et l’aide aux populations en situation de précarité ainsi que la politique d’action sociale. Votre futur service : Au sein de notre Direction des Systèmes d'Information (800 collaborateurs), et plus précisément de notre Direction Collaboratif et SI des Fonctions Support (DCiSIFS), l’IA Gen Factory est responsable de l’offre IA souveraine pour l’ensemble de la branche Famille (35 000 collaborateurs, 101 organismes). Vous rejoindrez une organisation de 8 à 10 personnes en plein développement qui imagine et implémente nos solutions IA. Concrètement votre futur quotidien ? Vous serez un acteur clé du développement et du déploiement des solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle pour l'ensemble de la branche famille. Vous contribuez à utiliser et faire évoluer des solutions innovantes principalement Open Source (Mistral, LLaMA, Gemma, etc.) en veillant aux enjeux de performance, de sécurité et de souveraineté. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Concevoir et développer des modèles d'intelligence artificielle pour répondre à divers besoins opérationnels et stratégiques ; Implémenter et optimiser des algorithmes de Machine Learning et de Deep Learning ; Collecter, traiter et analyser de grandes quantités de données pour entraîner et tester des modèles d'IA ; Contribuer à la mise en place de pipelines de données robustes pour assurer l’efficacité et la performance des modèles ; Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit, design et ingénierie pour intégrer les modèles d'IA dans les solutions applicatives ; Travailler sur l’interprétabilité et l’explicabilité des modèles IA pour garantir la transparence et l’éthique des solutions déployées ; Assurer une veille technologique pour rester à jour sur les dernières avancées en intelligence artificielle et machine learning ; Tirer parti des outils d'IA générative (assistants de code, agents) pour accélérer le développement, tout en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, la maintenabilité et la maîtrise du code produit. Etes-vous notre prochain(e) collaborateur(trice) ? Diplômé.e d’un Bac+ 5 en informatique / systèmes d'information / ingénierie, complété idéalement par une formation en IA, vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement de modèles d'intelligence artificielle et de machine learning. Une expérience en tant que développeur.euse et Lead Tech IA dans un environnement complexe et à grande échelle est requise. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des architectures et du développement pour des IA comme les RAG, Agents Autonomes, LangGraph, LangChain, et Python Capacité à analyser et à comprendre des données complexes et à transformer ces analyses en solutions pragmatiques Vous avez déjà pratiqué le développement augmenté par l'IA générative et maîtrisez l'usage d'assistants de codage (Codestral, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex ou équivalents) dans un contexte professionnel : génération et revue de code assistée, prompt engineering, et capacité à évaluer de manière critique les suggestions produites par l'IA Pratique de méthodologies de projets variées : Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Cycle en V Une expérience avec les outils de traitement des données et de big data (Hadoop, Spark, SQL, etc.) est un plus Compétences comportementales et relationnelles : Bonnes compétences en communication pour travailler efficacement avec des équipes interdisciplinaires Orientation client interne et sens aigu du service rendu aux collaborateurs Esprit d'analyse, de priorisation et de prise de décision Capacité à conduire le changement et à accompagner les transformations techniques Pragmatisme, sens du résultat et culture de l'amélioration continue Quelle sera votre rémunération ? Une rémunération annuelle brute comprise entre 42,9K€ et 52K€ (versée sur 14 mois) en fonction de votre profil. Votre futur environnement de travail ? Intégrer la CNAF, c’est aussi pouvoir bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Possibilité de télétravail (jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine), Flexibilité des horaires de travail, Jusqu’à 20 RTT / an, Transport : remboursement à 75% de votre abonnement, bénéfice d’un forfait mobilité durable si vous utilisez des modes de transport alternatifs à la voiture individuelle, Tickets restaurant (pris en charge à hauteur de 60%), CSE avec des œuvres sociales avantageuses (sport, loisirs, voyages…), Une prime d ’intéressement . Dans le cadre de sa politique de diversité, la CNAF ouvre ses offres d’emploi à toutes les candidatures.

items.desc: Love AI? Brilliant. We want someone who's actually building with it. AI is moving fast. We're looking for someone who wants to move with it. At ECA, we're building AI-powered capabilities into our global mobility technology, and we're looking for a curious, hands-on AI Engineer to help us take things further. This isn't a role where you'll spend your days experimenting with AI concepts that never see the light of day. You'll be building real AI features, working with the latest models and tools, and helping us bring intelligent solutions into production. From RAG pipelines and agentic workflows to AWS Bedrock and Claude Code, you'll have the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting technologies in AI engineering. You'll join a collaborative, Agile engineering team where experimentation is encouraged, ideas are welcomed and you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills. If you're already building with AI, constantly exploring what's next and excited about turning emerging technology into something genuinely useful, we'd love to hear from you. What will you be doing? Quite a lot of interesting stuff, actually. Building real AI solutions: Design, develop and deliver AI-powered features using technologies such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and open-weight models. Making RAG work: Build and improve retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, working with embeddings, vector databases and retrieval techniques to deliver reliable results. Exploring agentic AI: Help develop intelligent agents and workflows using AWS Bedrock, with opportunities to work with AgentCore and agent orchestration frameworks. Working AI-first: Use Claude Code as part of your everyday engineering workflow, helping us develop smarter ways of designing, building and delivering software. Making AI better: Evaluate and monitor AI performance, identifying opportunities to improve quality, reliability, speed and cost. Building responsibly: Help ensure our AI solutions are secure, trustworthy and developed with appropriate governance, privacy and safeguards. Collaborating and innovating: Work closely with engineers, product teams and other specialists to turn ideas into working solutions. And because AI never stands still, neither will you. We want someone who enjoys experimenting, sharing ideas and challenging how things are done. RequirementsWe're open to junior and mid-level engineers, so we're particularly interested in your practical experience, technical foundations and enthusiasm for AI. Ideally, you'll bring: Around 2–5 years of software development experience, including hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications. Strong development skills in Python and/or TypeScript, alongside solid software engineering fundamentals. Practical experience working with LLM APIs, including Claude, OpenAI or Gemini. Experience building and deploying RAG solutions, including embeddings, vector databases and retrieval optimisation. Hands-on experience running open-source or open-weight models, such as Llama, Mistral or Qwen. Practical experience using Claude Code, including its workflows, plugins, skills and other development capabilities. Experience with AWS Bedrock, including model integration and associated services. An understanding of responsible AI, including governance, data privacy, security and appropriate safeguards. Experience working in an Agile software engineering environment. Most importantly, you'll be curious, proactive and comfortable learning in a field that changes almost daily. You'll enjoy collaborating with others, taking ownership of your work and explaining complex technical ideas without making everyone's head spin. A few bonus points if you have... Agentic AI development, multi-agent systems or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or Strands Agents. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. LLM evaluation and observability tools. Building MCP servers or integrating external tools with AI agents. Technologies such as Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Docker or Terraform. Developing AI features within a multi-tenant B2B SaaS environment. You don't need to tick every bonus box. We're interested in people who have the foundations and the ambition to keep developing. BenefitsAt ECA, we're helping organisations navigate the complexities of global mobility through technology, data and expertise. We're investing in the next generation of our technology, and AI has an important role to play in how we develop our products and deliver value to our customers. Joining us means you'll have the opportunity to: Work on meaningful AI projects that make it into production. Get hands-on with emerging AI technologies and development tools. Collaborate with experienced engineers and product specialists. Experiment, innovate and contribute ideas that influence how we build software. Develop your career as part of a team embracing AI-native engineering. We're looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute and grow with us.

items.desc: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. Role Summary The Cyber Tooling Solution Architect is a senior technical role responsible for designing, developing, and delivering secure cybersecurity tooling solutions across the enterprise. This position translates enterprise cybersecurity architecture strategies into practical, implementable tooling solutions that align with business objectives, effectively mitigate risks, support regulatory compliance, and enhance the organisation’s overall security capabilities. The role requires strong solution design and product selection skills with deep expertise in Microsoft cyber tooling, EDR/XDR, SIEM, CSPM, and related security platforms. Key Responsibilities Design and develop secure solution architectures for cybersecurity tooling initiatives, ensuring alignment with the enterprise cybersecurity architecture strategy, frameworks, and standards. Provide expert technical leadership in the solutioning of cybersecurity tooling requirements across detection, response, posture management, and related capabilities. Collaborate with business leaders, IT teams, security operations, and delivery teams to translate business needs and security requirements into robust, scalable, and effective tooling solution designs. Lead the evaluation, selection, and integration of appropriate cybersecurity tooling solutions, with particular focus on Microsoft cyber tooling, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) / Extended Detection and Response (XDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and related platforms. Conduct solution-level risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies to address security gaps in tooling architectures. Ensure solution designs comply with architecture governance processes, standards, and regulatory requirements. Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to support the implementation, integration, and validation of secure cybersecurity tooling solutions. Contribute to incident response planning and ensure tooling solution resilience against evolving cyber threats. Communicate complex tooling solution architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including project teams and senior leadership. items.desc: Ever wondered how it would be to revolutionise one of the least digitised industries in the market, alongside a growing and switched-on team? Read on! ___________________________________________________________________________________ We are Shape.Construction ! We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it). We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech and watch this video about what we are doing ) The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and mission ). This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 4 core values for a good life We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website. We are achieving this vision through the following two missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society Laminar Projects is proud to be recognized as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Construction, Engineering & Property™ for 2024! Join a team where learning, collaboration, and growth are at the core of everything we do, and where solving big challenges is part of the fun. ___________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines deep knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong software engineering skills and a pragmatic approach to product development. This person will help us design, build and deploy AI-powered features across Shape App and Channels, working closely with the Product and SRE Teams to define optimal solutions and ensure they run reliably in production. You should be excited by the challenge of turning AI potential into real, useful features, for construction teams, and you should know when a small, lean approach is better than a large, complex one. Team You will join a team of product-minded software engineers, designers, and strategists focused on improving the way construction projects are delivered. You will work closely with Product Managers to shape AI features, and with our SRE Team to ensure production-readiness. You will be the go-to expert on AI/LLMs and play a key role in shaping our AI capability. Your top 3 objectives Design Lean, Fit-for-Purpose AI Solutions: Choose and implement the most appropriate AI/LLM approach for each use case, balancing quality, performance and cost. Integrate AI-features into our Applications: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation. Prepare for Production: Work with SREs to ensure AI features are reliable, scalable, observable, and secure in production. Your Top 5 Responsibilities Understand the Product Context: Work with product teams to translate user needs into clear AI opportunities and technical requirements. Own the AI Feature Lifecycle: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and …

items.desc: Role & impact 🎯 At Evaneos, our mission is simple: to help travelers experience trips that are more local, more responsible, and more human, all around the world. Within the Innovation Department , the Pathfinder team is reinventing how travelers design their tailor-made trips, with AI as the central lever of the experience. We are hiring an AI Product Engineer to ship AI-native travel experiences used by real travelers in production . You’ll design, build, and operate AI products powered by agentic architectures, working end-to-end from problem framing to live monitoring, always in service of real user and business needs. Your impact: you'll build traveler-facing AI products that move metrics on conversion , experience , and cost . Two are already live and serving traffic: an AI trip designer that helps travelers explore and customize itineraries and a conversational experience that turns their intent into a structured travel project local agencies can act on. Real products, not internal tools. The innovation Department 👥 Within the Innovation Department , AI runs on two complementary fronts: Pathfinder : we design and build AI-native products to unlock new growth opportunities and keep Evaneos at the forefront of its market. AI Company : we solve real team problems to improve internal efficiency, accelerate execution, and build a practical AI-native culture. You’ll join Pathfinder . It’s a small, focused team: Clément Stouls (Product Manager), Lou Anfriani (Product Designer), Jocelyne Boun (AI Product Engineer) You (Full stack Engineer). The team reports to Romain Quilliot (Head of Innovation), who leads strategy, operations, and execution. By design, the team member owns it’s direction and proposes initiatives — with direct exposure to C-level leadership on product and business strategy. 🧰 Our stack, at a glance: Languages : Python, TypeScript AI/LLM : LiteLLM Gateway, Langfuse, Langsmith, multi-provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral), Langchain DeepAgents, Claude Agent SDK Frontend : CopilotKit, React Infra : Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions) Data : PostgreSQL, MongoDB, vector databases Dev workflow : Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, In house tooling Your role as Fullstack Engineer (AI) ⚙️ 🤖 Build AI-native products (AI agents) Design agent architectures: runtime, tool systems, orchestration patterns, middleware, state management, RAG. Choose the right pattern for the right problem! Own context engineering: shape what the models see and find ways to better steer the model and system, raising quality while controlling cost. Make quality measurable: build evaluation pipelines (offline benchmarks plus online metrics) and observability to catch hallucinations, drift, and regressions before users do. Own the economic viability: once something is live, find the right balance of quality, speed, and cost. Keep it running: debug production issues on non-deterministic systems, handle model migrations when providers change their APIs, and deal with structured output failures and tool call errors. Own the infra: You build it, you ship it. Keep the dev environment fast and the deployment pipeline reliable. Own problems end-to-end: from framing to resolution, in collaboration with product, design, and business stakeholders. 🌉 Be a bridge between tech and product Take an active part in product direction , grounded in real user and business stakes. Translate technical constraints into product options, and explain the paradigm shifts AI brings. Proactively communicate on progress, decisions, and blockers: position yourself as an enabler for the team . 🧠 Grow our internal AI community Co-lead the AI Champions Tech program , leveling up Product & Tech across Evaneos on AI practices and knowledge. Share your learnings with the Innovation team and wider tech community. Run workshops and talks that demystify what matters in the agentic era. Why join us? 🚀 🤩 You build the product, not the platform. Focus on shipping AI experiences directly to travelers: real users, real conversion, real business impact. 🙌 Full ownership in a team that fits in one room. No ticket queues, no handoffs between ML and product teams. You frame problems with the PM, design solutions with the designer, build and ship them yourself, then watch the traces to know if it works. The loop is tight and you own all of it. 💰 AI at the core of a 15-year-old profitable marketplace. This isn't a startup burning cash on an AI bet. It's an established travel company with real revenue, real users across 160+ destinations in over 5 markets, and a strategic conviction that AI will reshape its core experience. Startup autonomy with business-model gravity. What's in it for you? 🎁 La Voyagerie : our lively HQ in the 9th arrondissement of Paris Based in Paris? Up to 3 days of remote work per week. Fully remote? Up to 2 consecutive days on-site per month when the whole team comes together in Paris. Travel budget through the CSE to experience Evaneos trips. …

Build reliable, scalable software integrations using APIs, cloud services, and containerized systems. Act as the customer’s trusted technical advisor, enabling adoption of new product capabilities and AI features. Direct experience with Generative AI (LLMs, multimodal models) and applying them to real-world problems. Exposure to Computer Vision techniques (detection, segmentation, OCR, embeddings, multimodal pipelines). Strong knowledge of ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, etc.). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences. Comfort leading customer-facing engagements and guiding stakeholders through ambiguity. Willingness and ability to travel frequently. Preferred Prior experience in consulting , technical solutions , professional services , or customer-embedded technical roles. Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Experience building APIs, microservices, or distributed systems. Familiarity with MLOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, model registries, CI/CD for ML). Background in deploying or fine-tuning CV models (YOLO, SAM, CLIP, DETR, etc.). Experience in startup or high-growth environments. What We’re Looking For A customer-obsessed senior engineer who thrives in deeply technical, fast-moving environments. A creative problem solver who can translate vague requirements into robust, scalable solutions. Someone excited to combine software engineering with real-world AI deployments. A leader who can own outcomes end-to-end and influence both customer and internal teams. Why Join Nexxa.AI ? Innovative Environment: Play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking AI and automation technologies. Collaborative Culture: Be part of a team that values innovation, discipline, and continuous improvement. Professional Growth: Benefit from significant opportunities for career development and advancement. Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive salary and equity package reflective of your expertise and contributions. If you're passionate about development and eager to shape the infrastructure powering advanced AI solutions, we'd love to connect.

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. What You'll Architect As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you work at the heart of a client's most pressing AI challenges, turning intent into an operational, measurable result in weeks rather than months. This is an experienced individual-contributor role for someone who combines hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, and business understanding. You own the problem from ambiguity through to execution - understanding the real context, building and deploying the solution, and proving, not declaring, that it creates value. Once the terrain is understood, you become the reference the team relies on to make that result last. Your responsibilities Co-create solutions with business and technical stakeholders through workshops, rapid iterations, and hands-on delivery. Define success criteria from the outset, including adoption, performance, reliability, risk, cost, and measurable business value. Ensure solutions are documented, governed, and transferable so clients can operate them with confidence. Turn successful delivery into reusable patterns, accelerators, and building blocks that strengthen future engagements. Who You Are You are a hands-on engineer who thinks like an architect and acts like a builder. You are comfortable working closely with the client, the problem, and the delivery, and you make sound decisions in complex, evolving environments. You enjoy solving operational challenges, not only exploring technical concepts. You communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders. You navigate ambiguity with confidence, validate assumptions, and adapt quickly. You take ownership of outcomes and raise risks or changing priorities early. You understand that AI value depends on the full system: data, workflows, governance, adoption, and measurement. You naturally look for what can be reused, improved, and scaled. Evidence of turning complex use cases into adopted measurable solutions. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience. items.desc: Détail de l'offre Informations générales Référence DSI-RC 26-40-2131 Description du poste Intitulé du poste Architecte logiciel IA– IA générative, RAG et agentique H/F Contrat CDI Temps de travail Temps plein Présentation de la fédération La Fédération Agirc-Arrco, le régime de retraite complémentaire obligatoire des salariés du secteur privé, piloté par les partenaires sociaux, est un acteur essentiel du modèle de protection sociale français. Il repose sur les principes de répartition et de solidarité entre les générations. 28 millions de salariés cotisent à l’Agirc-Arrco pour constituer leurs droits futurs et 1,8 million d’entreprises adhèrent au régime. 14 millions de retraités perçoivent, chaque mois, une allocation de retraite complémentaire Agirc-Arrco. Le montant total annuel des allocations versées par le régime s’élève aujourd’hui à 101 Md€. Les orientations stratégiques du régime ont conduit les équipes Agirc-Arrco à engager un vaste chantier d’amélioration du service, au meilleur coût visant à offrir un parcours client simple et personnalisé. Description de la mission A la DSI Agirc-Arrco, nos 1000 talents œuvrent à la conception, la mise à disposition et l’évolution du SI Retraite Complémentaire. Ce SI rend service à 7000 gestionnaires, 57 millions de clients et 1,7 million d’entreprises. La DSI Agirc-Arrco, ce sont 5 sites en France : l’ensemble des métiers informatiques y sont représentés et un Data Center en propre sur le site de Bordeaux. Avec un plan de charge 2026 de près de 215 000 jours-hommes et des projets pluriannuels, l’Agirc-Arrco dispose d’une des DSI les plus importantes du secteur privé. Dans le cadre du développement et de l’industrialisation de sa plateforme de services d’intelligence artificielle, l’organisation recherche un architecte logiciel IA capable de concevoir, sécuriser et faire évoluer des solutions d’IA générative à forte valeur d’usage. Le poste s’inscrit dans un environnement exigeant mêlant architecture logicielle, R&D appliquée, industrialisation DevSecOps, gouvernance des usages IA et accompagnement des équipes métiers et techniques. Rattaché(e) à l’équipe en charge de la gouvernance et de la mise en œuvre de l’IA, vous jouerez un rôle de spécialiste technique et d’architecte sur la conception, l’industrialisation et l’évolution d’une plateforme IA d’entreprise. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Définir et faire évoluer l’architecture logicielle de la plateforme IA, en concevant des architectures IA génératives robustes intégrant notamment : agents, bases de connaissances, pipelines RAG, modèles LLM adaptés aux besoins, connecteurs MCP et expositions API. Réaliser ou encadrer des prototypes avancés, ou des démonstrateurs technologiques, autour du RAG, de l’agentique, de l’orchestration multi-outils, du routage de modèles et de l’évaluation de la qualité des réponses. Structurer les développements d’extensions, d’agents, de tools et de connecteurs MCP de la plateforme ; en veillant à leur maintenabilité, leur testabilité, leur sécurité et leur capacité à être réutilisés. Participer à l’industrialisation DevSecOps de la plateforme : gestion des versions, images Docker, pipelines CI/CD, promotion entre environnements, registre d’artefacts, tests, traçabilité et retour arrière maîtrisé. Participer à la définition des bonnes pratiques d’ingestion documentaire, de vectorisation, de recherche sémantique, de contextualisation, de citation des sources et d’évaluation des réponses produites par les assistants. Accompagner les équipes projets, métiers et techniques dans la conception des cas d’usage IA, la formulation des besoins, la préparation des jeux de test, la validation fonctionnelle et la mise en service progressive. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams. Why join Shadow? Product Ownership You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions. Shape the Engineering Culture You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring. Work with Challenger Consumer Brands Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue. The agency behind the product Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo. Technical Leadership & Collaboration · Provide technical direction and mentorship; lead design discussions for complex AI features. · Partner with product, data, and DevOps teams to ship scalable solutions. · Document architecture and decisions clearly for a distributed team. Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-based self-service portals, utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and prompt engineering techniques. Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks, specifically Python (FastAPI/FastMCP), Node.js/TypeScript, and React. Extensive experience integrating with enterprise platforms using Microsoft Graph API, Google Workspace APIs, and implementing secure authentication via OAuth 2.0/Entra ID. Preferred Qualifications Advanced experience in AI agent orchestration and building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Deep understanding of system architecture principles for highly available, distributed cloud applications. Proficiency in PowerShell and associated scripting for automation and system integration tasks. Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to optimize application performance and user experience. Experience acting as a senior individual contributor, guiding technical design discussions and driving best practices within cross-functional teams. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
